businessSummary: Service Stream Limited is a provider of essential network services to the telecommunications, utility and transport sectors. It designs, constructs, operates and maintains critical infrastructure networks. Its segments include Telecommunications, Utilities, and Transport. The Telecommunications segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, installation, design and construction services to the owners of fixed-line and wireless telecommunication networks in Australia. The Utilities segment offers a range of operations, maintenance, design and construction services to gas, water and electricity network owners, industrial asset owners and other customers in Australia. Service capabilities include asset maintenance, engineering, design and construction of network assets. The Transport segment offers long-term operational support and maintenance services to public and private road and tunnel asset owners. Service capabilities include road network maintenance and control room operations.

name: UNIVERSAL STORE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Universal Store Holdings Limited is a retailer specializing in trend-led and casual men's and women's fashion, shoes, accessories, lifestyle, and gifting. The Company owns a portfolio of premium youth fashion brands and omnichannel retail and wholesale businesses. The Company operates through two segments: Universal Store and CTC. The Universal Store segment trades under the Universal Store and Perfect Stranger retail banners. The CTC segment trades under the THRILLS and Worship brands. The Company operates approximately 109 physical stores across Australia in addition to online channels. It offers various types of clothing products, which include Tops, Shirts, Jeans, Sherpa, Dresses, Hoodies and Jumpers, Jackets and Coats, Pants, Skirts, Shorts, Micro shorts, Basics, Matching Sets and T-Shirts. Its shoe offerings include Sneakers, Sandals, Birkenstocks, Boots, Thongs, Crocs and others. It also offers various types of accessories, including Jewellery, Hats, Bags, Belts, and others.

businessSummary: Downer EDI Limited is an Australia-based company that provides integrated services in Australia and New Zealand. The Company’s segments include Transport, Energy and Utilities, and Facilities. Its Transport segment consists of road services businesses across Australia and New Zealand, rail businesses in Australia and projects businesses in New Zealand. Utilities segment consists of power, gas, water, telecommunications, industrial, resources, and energy businesses. This includes planning, designing, constructing, operating, maintaining, managing, and decommissioning power and gas network assets, and others. Its Facilities segment provides outsourced facility services to customers across a diverse range of industry sectors including education, health, government, and defense. Facilities provide asset management services to facilities and estates that cover maintenance, expansion and frontline services for strategic assets across a range of sectors.

businessSummary: Sandfire Resources Limited is a mining and exploration company with a focus on copper exploration. Black Butte Project consists of the evaluation activities for the Black Butte Copper Project located in central Montana in the United States of America. The Exploration and Other segment include its exploration and evaluation activities.

businessSummary: Dexus Industria REIT is a listed Australian real estate investment trust which is invested in high-quality industrial warehouses. The fund has a target gearing range of 3040 percent. Dexus Industria REIT was established in 2013 and was incorporated in Australia.

businessSummary: Growthpoint Properties Australia Limited is an Australia-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company invests in industrial and office properties across Australia. businessSummary: Kinatico Limited is an Australia-based provider of know-your-people solutions. This is delivered via its proprietary technology platform, which includes an employment screening and verification offering. Its geographical segments include Australia and New Zealand. businessSummary: Bravura Solutions Limited is an Australia-based provider of software solutions for the wealth management, life insurance and funds administration industries. The Good Guys brand is a retailer of home appliances and consumer electronics with a position with home-making families. The e&s brand is engaged in the kitchen, laundry and bathroom product segments. Its products include consumer electronics and technology products, telecommunications products and services, home appliances, and software (music, movies and games) and associated collectibles and merchandise. businessSummary: Redox Limited is a global chemical, ingredient and raw material distributor focused on specialty and commodity products. In the food and beverage market, it focuses on antioxidants, proteins and fibers, acidity regulators, vitamins, sweeteners, and other products. In the personal care market, it focuses on solvents, sunscreen, haircare products, among others. In the detergent market, it focuses on activated carbon, acetone, ammonium sulphate, butanol, calcium chloride, and other products. In the water treatment market, it focuses on swimming pool salt, water softening salt and others. It markets a range of over 1000 specialty and commodity products.

name: PACIFIC SMILES GROUP
businessSummary: Pacific Smiles Group Limited is an Australia-based dental company. The Company provides dentists with fully serviced and equipped facilities, including support staff, materials, marketing, and administrative services. The Company operates approximately 120+ dental centers nationally. The Company's Dental Center Networks are located in Belconnen, Manuka, Gungahlin and Tuggeranong in Australian Capital Territory (ACT); Ashfield, Belmont and Balgowlah in New South Wales; Caroline Springs and Chirnside Park in Victoria, and Birtinya, Bribie Island and Capalaba in Queensland.

businessSummary: Nick Scali Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates as a retailer and importer of furniture. Its sofas and armchairs collection includes recliner sofa collections, leather sofa collections, fabric sofa collections, occasional armchairs, and others. Its living room collections include TV units, coffee tables, side tables, consoles, occasional chairs, and others. Its dining room collections include dining tables, dining chairs, and buffet tables and sideboards. Its bedroom collections include mattresses, bedframes, bedside tables, and dressers, among others. Its rugs and accessories collections include rugs and mirrors. The Company imports leather and fabric lounges as well as dining rooms and occasional furniture.

businessSummary: Top Education Group Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides private higher education services and English language courses in Australia. The company also offers undergraduate courses in law, business, management, accounting, and finance  and postgraduate courses in information technology, accounting, international business, marketing, and business administration. It also provides education consulting services, education and training services, as well as invests in education services. Top Education Group Ltd was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Eveleigh, Australia.

businessSummary: Aussie Broadband Limited is an Australia-based operating as a national carrier of telecommunications and technology services in Australia, servicing residential, business, wholesale and enterprise and government customers. The Company provides a suite of data, voice, and managed solutions. The Company’s segments include Residential, Business, Wholesale, Enterprise and Government, and Symbio. The Residential segment provides telecommunications services to residential users. The Business segment provides telecommunications services to business users. The Wholesale segment provides telecommunication services to third-party resellers. The Enterprise and Government segment provides telecommunication services to large enterprises including those in the public sector. The Symbio segment provides telecommunication services to software companies, telecom providers and enterprise customers.

businessSummary: Metcash Limited is an Australia-based wholesale distribution and marketing company. The Company provides merchandising, operational and marketing support across its food, liquor and hardware pillars. Its segments include Food, Liquor, and Hardware. The Food segment distributes a range of products and services to independent supermarkets, convenience retail outlets and food service customers. The Hardware segment distributes hardware products to independent retail outlets and the operation of Company-owned and joint venture retail stores. The Liquor segment distributes liquor products to independent retail outlets and hotels. It provides various brands including Cellarbrations, The Bottle-O, Porters Liquor and IGA Liquor. Its hardware brands include Mitre 10, Home Hardware, Total Tools and Hardings Hardware. The Company provides service to Independent Retailers in various corners of Australia, including Cape York and Cooktown in the Northeast, Dampier and Broome in the Northwest.

businessSummary: oOh!media Limited is an Australia-based out-of-home (OOH) media company. The Company is engaged in offering advertisers the ability to create deep engagement between people and brands across diverse OOH location-based portfolios in Australia and New Zealand. It also invests in technology. Its portfolio includes large format digital and classic roadside screens; large and small format digital and classic signs located in retail precincts such as shopping centers; large and small format digital and classic signs in airport terminals, lounges and in-flight; digital and classic street furniture signs; digital and classic format advertising in public transport corridors, including rail, and digital and classic signs in high dwell time environments, such as universities and office buildings. It also provides advertising creative and printing services. It has a network of over 35,000 digital and static asset locations that include roadsides, airports, train stations, bus stops, and others.

name: MARITANA MINERALS
businessSummary: Maritana Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mid-tier gold producer with projects located in the West Australian goldfields. It has land positions in the Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia, centered around the regional towns of Kalgoorlie, Boulder and Coolgardie. The Boorara Gold Project is located 15 km east of Kalgoorlie-Boulder adjacent to the Super Pit, and one km southwest of the Nimbus Silver-Zinc Project site. Burbanks is located on a granted Mining Lease over nine km south of Coolgardie. The project area covers more than five km of strike in the highly prospective Burbanks Shear, which historically is the most significant gold-producing structure within the Coolgardie Goldfield. The 100% owned Black Swan processing hub is located over 50 km northeast of Kalgoorlie-Boulder in the Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia. The Nimbus Ag-Zn-Pb-Au deposit is located over 15 km east of Kalgoorlie-Boulder in Western Australia within the Kalgoorlie Terrane.

name: NORTHERN STAR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Northern Star Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold producer. The Company's principal activities include exploration, development, mining and processing of gold deposits and sale of refined gold derived from the Yandal and Kalgoorlie operations in Western Australia and from the Pogo operations in Alaska, and exploration in relation to gold deposits in Western Australia, the Northern Territory and Alaska. Its segments include KCGM, Kalgoorlie Operations, Carosue Dam, Pogo, Jundee, Thunderbox and Exploration. The Kalgoorlie Consolidated Gold Mines (KCGM) Operations is located adjacent to the City of Kalgoorlie-Boulder approximately 600 kilometers (km) east of Perth, Western Australia. The KCGM Operations include the Fimiston Open Pit (Super Pit), Mt Charlotte Underground Mine and the Fimiston and Gidji Processing Plants. The Thunderbox Operations (TBO) are located in the highly prospective Yandal Belt and the Agnew-Wiluna Belt in the Northeastern Goldfields of Western Australia.

businessSummary: Saferoads Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company specializing in innovative safety solutions. The Company provides state government departments, local councils, road construction companies and equipment hire businesses with a range of products and services designed to direct, protect, inform and illuminate public safety. Its product range includes solar lighting, electronic signs, temporary barriers, security bollards, traffic-calming, guideposts, and vehicle mitigation. Its solar lighting consists of permanent and portable solar lighting. Its permanent solar lighting includes Roadway Solar V-LED Light and Blade Solar Light - Galvanized Pole. Its portable solar lighting includes Blade Solar Light-Telescopic Pole and Blade Solar Light - Hinged Pole. Its electronic signs include Zone VMS Essential and Zone VMS Classic. It also offers modular trailer, tray and canopy range, building a customer base across mining, agriculture, construction and high-end recreational markets.

businessSummary: Buxton Resources Limited is an Australia-based company. Its projects include Graphite Bull Project (BUX 100%), West Kimberley Project (three separate Joint Ventures with IGO - BUX 16% - 20%), Fraser Range Project (BUX 10%/IGO 90%), Narryer Project (BUX 100%), Centurion Project (BUX 100%), Shogun & Royale Projects (BUX 100%), Lateron Project (BUX 100%), and Madman Project (BUX 100%). The Graphite Bull Project is located 280 km East of Carnarvon in the Murchison Region of Western Australia. The West Kimberley Project is targeting Nova-style magmatic Ni-Cu sulphide mineralization in Proterozoic belts of the West Kimberley Region of Western Australia. The Narryer Project is targeting magmatic Ni-Cu-PGE sulphide mineralization along the Yilgarn Craton margin within the Murchison Region of WA.

The Company’s essential oils include essential oil blends, pure essential oils, and essential oil body care. Its diffuser products include glass diffusers, resin diffusers, ceramic diffusers, and mini diffusers. Its reed diffusers come in fruity, gourmand, fresh, woody, floral, or unscented options. Its bath & body collection includes bath bombs, perfumes, body care, and soaps & scrubs. Its home & living offers home cleaning products, room spray, lighting, plates, and glass and mug.

businessSummary: Kingston Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper company, operating the Mineral Hill mine in Cobar, New South Wales (NSW). Mineral Hill boasts an extensive gold, copper, zinc, lead and silver resource, alongside existing gold production and exploration upside. The site consists of a number of exploration and development opportunities, including several historic small open pit and underground operations and a number of exploration targets. Mineral exploration licenses EL1999 and EL8334 represent an exploration footprint in the Cobar Basin, which hosts a number of gold, copper-gold and polymetallic occurrences and operating mines.

businessSummary: Michael Hill International Limited is an Australia-based jewelry retailer, with a portfolio of brands, operating a network of over 287 stores across Australia, New Zealand, and Canada, with international digital platforms. The Company offers various products and services in various categories, including engagement and weddings, jewelry, gifts, and collections. Its engagement and wedding categories include engagement rings, promise rings, bridal sets, women's wedding rings and men's wedding rings. Its jewelry includes rings, earrings, bracelets and bangles, anklets, necklaces and pendants, chains, men's jewelry, watches, sterling silver, yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, as well as diamond jewelry and gemstone jewelry. The Company also offers a range of watches for men and women in gold tone, rose tone, and silver tone.

The Specialist Recruitment segment is engaged in providing temporary, contract, and permanent recruitment services at all levels of seniority for businesses in both the public and private sectors. Its expertise spans various industries, including IT and digital, government, business support, engineering, information management, and professional services recruitment. Its On Demand IT Services segment comprises the delivery of specified information technology skills.

The Company’s segments include Casino Operations-Vietnam, Casino Operations-Cambodia, and Corporate Operations. The Casino Operations-Vietnam segment is comprised of the Aristo International Hotel operating in Vietnam. These operations include hotel accommodation, and gaming and leisure facilities. The Casino Operations-Cambodia segment comprises the Star Vegas Resort and Club, operating in Cambodia. Its operations include hotel accommodation and gaming and leisure facilities. The Corporate Operations segment consists of development and implementation of corporate strategy, commercial negotiations, corporate finance, treasury, management accounting, corporate governance, and investor relations functions. Its Star Vegas Resort and Club is a casino resort in Poipet. The Aristo International Hotel is located on the border between China and Vietnam.

businessSummary: Globe International Limited is an Australia-based company, which is a global producer and distributor specializing in purpose-built apparel, footwear and skateboard hardgoods (decks, wheels, trucks, etc.) for the board sports, street fashion, outdoor and workwear markets with products sold in more than 65 countries worldwide. The Company's segments include Australasia, North America, and Europe. Its proprietary brands include Globe, Salty Crew, FXD, Impala Skate, and X/DMG. Its third-party brands include XLarge, S/DOUBLE, Stance, szade, Ritual Vision, Pro-Tec, and hardcore. Impala Skate offers roller skates, inline skates, and skateboards. The Company holds working interests in a number of producing oil and gas assets located in Alberta in Canada. Its portfolio of oil and gas well assets include Drumheller, Caroline, and Wapiti. The Company's segments include Americas (AMR), Australia/New Zealand (ANZ) and Developing Markets (DEV). Its brands include Coolaroo and GALE Commercial. Coolaroo provides shade sails over backyards and playgrounds to pet beds and awnings. Coolaroo product categories include Umbrellas, Roller Shades, Shade Sails, Shade Fabric, Pergolas and Gazebos, Grow and Utility Bags, and Pet Beds. GALE Commercial delivers architectural and industrial-grade fabrics. GALE Commercial product categories include Architectural Shade Fabric, Horticultural Knitted Fabric, Commercial Netting, Agricultural Shade and Protection, All-Weather Advertising Banners, Coated Polyfabrics, and Food-Grade Coated Non-Wovens.

name: RAND MINING
businessSummary: Rand Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploration, development and production activities at the Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture tenements. The Company’s East Kundana Joint Venture (EKJV) is an operational underground gold mining project located in the Kundana area 25 kilometers (km) west northwest of Kalgoorlie and 47 km northeast of Coolgardie. The project comprises two producing underground mines Raleigh and Rubicon/Hornet /Pegasus (RHP). The Hornet orebody is located 600 meters (m) to the south of the Rubicon orebody. The Pegasus deposit is located approximately 480 m to the north of Rubicon and also accessed from the Rubicon decline.

name: MITCHELL SERVICES
businessSummary: Mitchell Services Limited is an Australia-based diverse drilling company. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are exploration and mine site drilling services to the exploration, mining, and energy industries, primarily in Australia. It offers drilling solutions at all stages of the mining lifecycle, across a diverse range of commodities and geographies. Its operations include surface and underground. It conducts multi-rig contracts utilizing both surface and underground drilling services on one project or on one site. Its surface services include diamond coring, directional, mud rotary, mine services, mineral performance drilling, reverse circulation, water bores, and geotechnical. It conducts conventional and wireline diamond coring throughout Australia. It performs underground in-seam (UIS) drilling in underground mining for the purposes of gas seam extraction, water drainage, coal seam delineation, cross-measure drilling and exploration.

name: CLINUVEL PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals Limited is a specialty pharmaceutical company. It is focused on developing and commercializing treatments for patients with genetic, metabolic, systemic, and life-threatening, acute disorders, as well as healthcare solutions for specialized populations. Its lead therapy, SCENESSE (afamelanotide 16mg), is approved for commercial distribution in Europe, the United States of America, Israel, and Australia as the first systemic photoprotective drug for the prevention of phototoxicity (anaphylactoid reactions and burns) in adult patients with erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP). It has operations in Europe, Singapore, and the United States of America. It develops and manufactures NEURACTHEL (adrenocorticotropic hormone) in different formulations, to target neurological, endocrinological, and degenerative disorders. Its pharmaceutical product, PRENUMBRA, has been developed, and its use is to be expanded in the clinic from stroke to Parkinson's.

name: CONNEXION MOBILITY
businessSummary: Connexion Mobility Ltd is an Australia-based mobility software company. The Company operates through two segments, which include Software and Automotive Repair. The Software segment is engaged in development and commercialization of fleet management software and related technology solutions for automotive industries in Australia, the United States of America, Canada, and Mexico. The Automotive Repair segment is engaged in the provision of automotive servicing, maintenance, and repair services in Australia. It specializes in developing global information technology solutions for the automotive industry. It helps to manage dealership vehicles through short-term / long-term rentals, test drives, shuttles, pickup / delivery, and concierge service. The Company offers mobility-toll management through automated toll use tracking, automated toll fee cost recovery, toll hardware in applicable regions, no software installation required, and itemized invoicing.

name: TRIBUNE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Tribune Resources Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in exploration, development and production activities at the Company's East Kundana Joint Venture tenements (EKJV). EKJV is an operational underground gold mining project located in the Kundana area approximately 25 kilometers (km) west-northwest of Kalgoorlie and approximately 47 km northeast of Coolgardie, in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The project comprises two producing underground mines, Raleigh and Rubicon/Hornet /Pegasus (RHP). The Company's exploration projects include Diwalwal Gold Project, Philippines and Japa Gold Project, Ghana. The Diwalwal Gold Project is located approximately 120 km northeast of Davao City on Mindanao Island in the Philippines. The Japa Gold Project is located in the Western Region of Ghana, approximately 110 km southwest of Kumasi and 50 km north of Tarkwa, centered in the village of Gyapa in the Wassa Amenfi East District.

name: CUE ENERGY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Cue Energy Resources Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas production and exploration company with production assets in Australia, Indonesia, and New Zealand. In Australia, it has interests in three production assets, Mereenie, Palm Valley, and Dingo Fields, situated in the Amadeus Basin within the onshore Northern Territory. The Mereenie field produces gas, which is transported through the Northern Gas pipeline to serve the Eastern Australia gas market. The Palm Valley field is over 100 kilometers west of Alice Springs and produces gas, which is transported through the Amadeus and Northern Gas pipeline and sold into the Northern Territory and Eastern Australia gas markets. The Dingo field produces gas, which is processed at the Brewer Estate processing facility located near Alice Springs. In New Zealand, it holds a 5% interest in Petroleum Mining Permit (PMP) 38160, which contains the Maari and Manaia producing oilfields. In Indonesia, it holds a 11.25% interest in the Mahato PSC.

name: BEACON MINERALS
businessSummary: Beacon Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold producer based in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The principal activity of the Company is mineral development and production in Western Australia. Its projects include Lady Ida Project, Jaurdi Gold Project, and Mount Dimer Project. The Lady Ida Project is situated approximately 29 kilometers (km) from Beacon’s Jaurdi Gold Processing Plant, which is itself located around 50 km west of Kalgoorlie. The Jaurdi Gold Project consists of The Black Cat, Wealth of Nations, Panther and Lost Dog deposits, in addition to the Jaurdi Gold Processing Plant. The Mount Dimer Project is positioned approximately 120 kilometers northeast of Southern Cross and 113 kilometers northwest of Beacon’s Jaurdi processing plant. The Mount Dimer Project area encompasses 12 tenements, including five mining tenements, with the lightning and golden slipper deposits.

name: AMPLITUDE ENERGY
businessSummary: Amplitude Energy Limited engages in exploration, development, and production of natural gas and low-cost oil in Australia. It operates through Southeast Australia, Cooper Basin, and Corporate and Other segments. The company is involved in the exploration, evaluation, operation, and care and maintenance of natural gas assets in the Gippsland and Otway basins. It also produces and sells crude oil, as well as explores and evaluates additional oil targets. The company was formerly known as Cooper Energy Limited and changed its name to Amplitude Energy Limited in November 2024. Amplitude Energy Limited was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Adelaide, Australia.

name: REGAL PARTNERS
businessSummary: Regal Partners Limited is an ASX-listed specialist alternative investment manager. It manages a range of investment strategies covering hedge funds, growth equity, real & natural assets and credit & royalties on behalf of institutions, family offices, charitable groups and private investors. Regal Partners Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Sydney, Australia.

name: AUSTRAL GOLD
businessSummary: Austral Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold and silver mining producer. The Company is focused on production, exploring, and equity investments for new gold deposits in the Americas. It owns a 100% interest in the Guanaco/Amancaya mines in Chile and the Casposo-Manantiales mine complex in Argentina, and a non-controlling interest in the Rawhide Mine in Nevada, United States of America. It has produced approximately 5,996 gold equivalent ounces at the Guanaco/Amancaya mine complex in Chile. The Guanaco/Amancaya mines in Chile operation is in northern Chile in the Antofagasta Region, approximately 220 kilometers (km) southeast of Antofagasta City. The Casposo-Manantiales mine is situated approximately 150 km northwest of San Juan City, in the Department of Calingasta, San Juan Province, Argentina. Its explorations include the Triassic Choiyoi Belt and Paleocene Belt. Under its equity investments, the Company holds shares and options in Unico Silver.

name: FENIX RESOURCES
businessSummary: Fenix Resources Limited is an Australia-based integrated mining, logistics and port services company with assets in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. The Company’s flagship Iron Ridge Iron Ore Mine is a high-grade direct shipping iron ore operation located approximately 360 km northeast of Geraldton. Its segments include Mining, Haulage and Port Services. Its iron ore products are transported by road to Geraldton using its Fenix-Newhaul haulage and logistics business. Its Newhaul Port Logistics business operates its own loading and storage facilities at the Geraldton Port. Its diversified mid-west iron ore, port and rail asset base includes Iron Ridge mine, the Beebyn W11 Deposit, the Shine Iron Ore Mine, the Newhaul Road Logistics haulage business, which owns and operates a road haulage fleet, two rail sidings at Ruvidini and Perenjori, as well as the Newhaul Port Services business that owns and operates three on-wharf bulk material storage sheds at Geraldton Port.

name: BEACH ENERGY
businessSummary: Beach Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration and production company. The Company has operations in South Australia, Victoria, Western Australia and New Zealand. In South Australia, it operates Cooper/Eromanga Basin, Moomba Carbon Capture & Storage (CCS), and Otway Basin South Australia. It operates Otway Basin Victoria Bass Basin, and Enterprise Project in Victoria. It operates Perth Basin in Western Australia. It operates Taranaki Basin in New Zealand. The Otway Basin Victoria is an onshore and offshore basin which extends approximately 500 kilometers from Cape Jaffa in South Australia to north-west Tasmania. The Company has around 33% ownership interest in the Moomba CCS Project, operated by its joint venture partner Santos. Its Perth Basin operations consist of the Waitsia project (operated by Mitsui E&P Australia) and Beharra Springs (operated by Beach Energy) projects. The Taranaki Basin is located along the west coast of the North Island in New Zealand.

name: WHITEHAVEN COAL
businessSummary: Whitehaven Coal Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the production of coal. It is focused on the development and operation of coal mines in New South Wales (NSW) and Queensland (QLD). Its segments include NSW Operations and QLD Operations. It operates six mines (five open-cut and one large underground mine) in the Gunnedah Coal Basin of NSW and Bowen Basin of QLD. Its assets include Maules Creek Mine, Narrabri Mine, Vickery Extension Project, Werris Creek Mine, Gunnedah CHPP, Winchester South Project, Narrabri Stage-3 Extension Project, Rocglen Mine, Sunnyside Mine, Canyon Mine, Daunia Mine, and Blackwater Mine. Its development projects include the Vickery project and Winchester South project. The Tarrawonga open cut mine produces high-quality thermal coal and semi-soft coking coal. Vickery Extension Project is a proposal to construct an open-cut coal mine and associated on-site infrastructure about 25 kilometers north of Gunnedah.

name: LASERBOND
businessSummary: Laserbond Limited is an Australia-based surface engineering company. The Company is focused on the development and application of materials, technologies, and methodologies to increase operating performance and wear life of capital-intensive machinery components. It operates through four segments: Services, Products, Technology, and Research & Development. The Services segment includes the reclamation or repair of worn components for end users, or the manufacture of products that do not incorporate LaserBond cladding applications. The Products segment is engaged in the manufacture of products incorporating LaserBond cladding applications. The Technology segment is engaged in the sale of LaserBond cladding technology and associated licensing fees and consumables supply. The Research & Development segment includes ongoing development of new or improved technology, applications, and products. It serves various industries, such as mining, agriculture, mineral processing, and others.

name: EXCELSIOR CAPITAL
businessSummary: Excelsior Capital Limited is an Australia-based listed investment company (LIC) and manages an investment portfolio. The Company's primary investment strategy focuses on achieving long-term growth and capital appreciation while effectively managing risk through a diversified portfolio approach. The fund portfolio construction is primarily a non-market correlated strategy for investments that seeks to generate positive absolute return at low volatility with negligible correlation to both the other investments within the portfolio and that of the broader risk assets such as listed equities and sovereign bonds. Capital may be allocated to direct and indirect investments in managed investment schemes and trusts, as well as in both listed and unlisted companies, through equity, derivative instruments, debt, or a combination. The Company may also invest in a broad range of businesses, providing both capital and strategic guidance to generate sustainable long-term returns and capital growth.

name: GULLEWA
businessSummary: Gullewa Limited is engaged in exploration and mining, investments in equities and property. The Company’s activities cover Gold in Western Australia, base metals, mineral royalties and land subdivision in New South Wales (NSW). The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary Central Iron Ore Limited (CIO) is an exploration and development company engaged in the search for gold in Australia. Its main focus of exploration is in the Darlot Region of Western Australia, within 10 kilometers from the Red 5 Darlot Mine. The two main projects are: Red 5 Joint Venture and British King Gold Mine. It has a 1% royalty in several ATW Venture (Australia) Pty Ltd Mining Tenement, which include the Deflector Gold-Copper Project, located in the Gullewa Project area. The Company’s Gullewa Project is located 450 kilometers (km) north of Perth, 160 km east of Geraldton. The Company, through its fully owned subsidiary Gullpro Pty Ltd holds a 69% interest in a land subdivision at Aberglassyn.

name: DATADOT TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: DataDot Technology Limited is an Australia-based company that provides asset identification, authentication and digital protection solutions. The Company’s OEMs and Distributors segment is engaged in the manufacture and wholesale supply of DataDotDNA polymer and metallic microdots to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) for application to their own products, and to authorized distributors and wholesale customers in overseas markets for on-sale under their own brands. Its DataTraceID segment offers a high speed, high security, machine-readable system for authenticating materials, products, and assets. Its Direct Business and Consumer sales segment includes all activities that have a direct to business and/or consumer focus and includes online, retail and dealer sales of the newly developed range of DatadotDNA product kits, Vault branded security products, and Vault-facilitated stolen property recovery and insurance sales commissions.

name: ROX RESOURCES
businessSummary: Rox Resources Limited engages in mineral exploration activities in Australia. It explores for gold and nickel deposits. It's flagship project is the 100% owned Youanmi Gold Project covering 643 square kilometers located to northeast of Perth. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in West Perth, Australia.

name: SHINE JUSTICE
businessSummary: Shine Justice Ltd is the holding company of a stable of firms which provide legal services. These firms include Shine Lawyers, Sciaccas Lawyers, Stephen Browne Personal Injury Lawyers, Bradley Bayly Lawyers and Carr & Co Divorce and Family Lawyers. It specializes in plaintiff litigation services focused on damage-based claims, on personal injury matters, and class actions. It also offers national practice areas, which include superannuation and disability, dust disease litigation and medical negligence. The PI segment specializes in damage-based plaintiff litigation legal services, and consists of motor vehicle accidents, abuse law, workers' compensation, public liability, head trauma, disability insurance and superannuation claims, asbestos and dust disease, medical law and catastrophic injuries. The Class Actions segment includes work types that are not considered core personal injury, such as class actions, international mass torts, commercial disputes (in wind-down) and family law.

name: WAM CAPITAL
businessSummary: WAM Capital Limited (WAM) is an Australia-based investment company. WAM’s investment objectives are to deliver investors a stream of fully franked dividends, provide capital growth and preserve capital. It provides investors with exposure to an actively managed diversified portfolio of undervalued growth companies listed on the Australian Securities Exchange, with a focus on small-to-medium sized businesses. It also provides exposure to relative value arbitrage and market mispricing opportunities. Wilson Asset Management is the Company's investment manager.

name: CADENCE CAPITAL
businessSummary: Cadence Capital Limited is an Australia-based investment company. The Company is engaged in investing primarily in securities listed both in Australia and internationally. The Company may take short positions and may also deal in derivatives. The Company has only one segment. It operates predominately in Australia and in one industry being the securities industry. It invests in various sectors, including basic materials, energy, communications, financial, insurance, industrial, utilities, technology, and consumer, non-cyclical. The Company is managed by Cadence Asset Management Pty Limited.

name: TYRO PAYMENTS
businessSummary: Tyro Payments Limited is an Australia-based technology-focused and values-driven company. The Company is focused on providing Australian businesses with payment solutions and complementary business banking products. Its segments include Payments and Banking. The Company provides credit, debit and electronic funds transfer at point of sale (EFTPOS) card acquiring, Medicare and private health fund claiming and rebating services to Australian businesses. It takes money on deposit and offers unsecured cash-flow based lending to Australian EFTPOS merchants. The Company is focused on in-store payments through e-Commerce solutions. It also provides solutions, such as its loans in the form of merchant cash advances and its fee-free, interest-bearing merchant transaction accounts and term-deposit accounts. It offers Tyro Connect, which is an integration hub for applications and point of sale (POS) systems, a plug and play platform software solution.

name: ALKANE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Alkane Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold and antimony producer with a portfolio of three operating mines across Australia and Sweden. The Company’s projects include Tomingley, Costerfield, and Bjorkdal. Tomingley is an open pit and underground gold mine southwest of Dubbo in Central West New South Wales that covers an area of approximately 440 square km, stretching 60km north south. Its operations include Tomingley Gold Operations, Tomingley Gold Extension Project, and Peak Hill Gold Mine. Costerfield is a gold and antimony underground mining operation northeast of Heathcote in Central Victoria. It covers an area of approximately 10km northeast of Heathcote in central Victoria and 50km east of Bendigo. The Bjorkdal is an underground gold mine northwest of Skelleftea in Sweden that covers an area of approximately 750km north of Stockholm. It also owns the Northern Molong Porphyry Project (NMPP), which includes Boda & Kaiser.

name: CAPRAL
businessSummary: Capral Limited, together with its subsidiary, Austex Dies Pty Ltd, manufactures and distributes fabricated and semi-fabricated aluminum-related products in Australia. The company offers aluminum systems for windows, doors, framing, curtain walls, window and door hardware, showers and robes, fencing, sunshades and fixed louvres, cladding, Qubelok light fabrication, seating, landscaping, scaffolding, and balustrading. It also provides extrusions, sheets, plates and coils, and treadplates. The company offers its products under the Urban Comfort, Urban, Urban Plus, Artisan, Futureline, AGS Commercial, Edge, Caprio, Caprice, Ventus, Envy, Elegance, AB Pivot, Magic Touch, Lumière, Amplimesh, Aquago, Qubelok, Quiklok, CA55 Aluminium Cladding, and Garden Edge brands. It serves residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The company was formerly known as Capral Aluminium Limited and changed its name to Capral Limited in April 2008. Capral Limited was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Bundamba, Australia.

name: ASHLEY SERVICES GROUP
businessSummary: Ashley Services Group Limited is an Australia-based labor hire company. The Company is engaged in the provision of labor hire (including recruitment) and training services. It operates through two segments: Labour Hire and Training. Labour Hire segment provides supply chain and warehousing labor hire, transport and logistics labor hire, e-commerce labor hire, defense labor hire, merchandising, layout services, rail labor hire, construction labor hire, manufacturing labor hire and horticulture labor hire. Training segment provides training services in civil construction; supply chain operations; telecommunications technology; data and voice technology; business; disability; individual support; and rail industry qualifications, including protection officers, safe working, track workers and track vehicle operators. The Company offers white-collar recruitment services, such as permanent, temporary and contract placements through multi-specialist provider, Concept Recruitment Specialists.

name: SCIDEV
businessSummary: SciDev Limited is an Australia-based water treatment technology company providing solutions to the mining, data center, and energy industries. The Company delivers specialized water treatment and process solutions that help clients improve performance, reduce freshwater consumption and minimize wastewater. Its segments include Water solutions, Energy services, and corporate. The Energy Services segment develops, manufactures and supplies specialty oilfield and production chemistries and performance solutions that improve operational efficiencies, reduce waste and minimize water consumption across the energy industry. The Water Solutions segment offers specialized water treatment and remediation technologies, together with process chemistries for the mining and construction industries, that remove harmful contaminants from groundwater, surface water and industrial liquid waste to improve operational efficiencies and allow water to be recycled or safely discharged to the environment.

name: BAPCOR
businessSummary: Bapcor Limited is a provider of vehicle parts, accessories, equipment, service and solutions. The Company’s segments include Trade, Specialist Wholesale, Retail and New Zealand. The Trade segment represents the trade-focused automotive aftermarket parts distribution to independent and chain mechanic workshops. It also includes the operations of Burson Auto Parts, Precision Automotive Equipment, Blacktown Auto and the Thailand-based operation. The Specialist Wholesale segment includes specialized wholesale distribution and network channel areas that focus on a specific automotive area, such as AAD, Baxters, Bearing Wholesalers, Roadsafe, Diesel Distributors, Federal Batteries, JAS, Premier Auto Trade, Truckline and WANO. The Retail segment includes operations of Autobarn, Autopro, Midas, ABS and Opposite Lock. The Retail segment is a full-offer retailer and service center. The New Zealand includes operations of Brake & Transmission (BNT), Autolign and HCB Technologies.

name: ALLIANCE AVIATION SERVICES
businessSummary: Alliance Aviation Services Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides contract, charter and allied aviation and maintenance services. It provides specialized aviation services to airlines and clients, including aircraft dry leasing, airport management, aircraft trading, part sales, engine leasing and engineering services. It offers an ad-hoc air charter service, regular public transport services and several allied aviation services, including engine and part sales, aircraft, engine and parts leasing, aerodrome management services and other engineering services. It has a growing aircraft, engine and spare parts trading business allied to the two aircraft types it operates. Its fleet is composed of three different Fokker aircraft (Fokker 70 LR jet and Fokker 100 jet) and Embraer 190. Fokker 100 is a modern and reliable jet aircraft with an aerodynamic design and operational performance. It serves mining, energy, government sectors and wet lease services for other airlines.

name: LE MINERALS
businessSummary: LE Minerals Limited, formerly Lithium Energy Limited, is a battery minerals company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and development of sustainable minerals projects. Its projects include Capricorn Gold-Copper Belt Project, White Plains Lithium Brine Project, Solaroz Lithium Brine Project, Burke and Corella Graphite Projects, and Mt Dromedary Natural Graphite Project. Its Capricorn Gold-Copper Belt Project (Queensland) tenements cover an area of approximately 1,795 square kilometers (km2). The Company has staked 6,870 hectares of mineral claims in Utah, United States (White Plains Lithium Brine Project). Its Solaroz Lithium Brine Project comprises eight mineral concessions totaling approximately 12,000 hectares. It holds 100% of the Mt Dromedary Natural Graphite Project. Its Burke Graphite Project comprises EPM 25443, covering approximately 6.47 km2. Its Corella Graphite Project comprises EPM 25696, covering approximately 19.41 km2. It also holds Leichhardt Crossing Tenement.

name: RECKON
businessSummary: Reckon Limited is an Australia-based software company. The Company provides software for startups, sole traders, small and medium enterprises (SMEs), accountants, bookkeepers, and lawyers. The Company operates two divisions: Business Group and Legal Group. The Business Group provides accounting and payroll software for small to medium sized businesses and personal wealth management software branded as Reckon One, Reckon Mobile and Reckon Accounts Hosted, Reckon Accounts Business, Reckon Accounts Personal and Cashflow Manager. The Business Group operates in Australia and New Zealand. The Legal Group operates under the nQ Zebraworks brand. nQ Zebraworks is a document and billing workflow company that leverages the power of its Zebraworks cloud-based integration platform to deliver digitalization, billing and collections automation, cost recovery and analytics solutions for law firms and government and corporate legal departments. nQ Zebraworks is based in the United States.

name: ORORA
businessSummary: Orora Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the design, manufacture and decoration of glass bottles and aluminum cans. The Company' segments include Glass and Cans. The Glass segment manufactures and provides glass packaging solutions with operations across Australasia, Europe, the Americas and the United Arab Emirates. The business produces a spectrum of glass packaging ranging from the manufacture, customization and decoration of glass bottles for the spirit and wine markets to standard bottles. The Cans segment provides customers across the Asia-Pacific region with aluminum can solutions within the beverage sector with manufacturing sites located across Australia and New Zealand. The business offers a varied range of aluminum can styles and sizes as well as custom printing and decoration. It produces cans of all shapes and sizes for customers across carbonated soft drinks, beer, cider, and alcohol ready-to-drink.

name: CITY CHIC COLLECTIVE
businessSummary: City Chic Collective Limited is a global omnichannel retailer specializing in dressing plus-size women’s apparel, footwear and accessories. Its omnichannel model comprises a network of approximately 76 stores across Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and Websites operating in ANZ, the United States of America, and third-party marketplaces and wholesale partners in Australia, New Zealand, United States of America, and Canada. Its brand, City Chic clothing and lingerie, is centered on beautiful design and its experience in the plus-size fashion industry. City Chic plus-size fashion includes plus-size dresses, plus-size denim, plus-size lingerie, plus-size tops, and plus-size clothing. City Chic brands shoe categories include boots, heels, flats, and wedges. Its geographical segments include ANZ and the Americas.

name: FORTESCUE
businessSummary: Fortescue Ltd is an Australia-based global green technology, energy and metals company. The Company's segments include Metals and Energy. Metals segment includes exploration, development, production, processing, sale and transportation of iron ore, and the exploration for other minerals. Its metals business comprises its iron ore operations in the Pilbara as well as a pipeline of exploration projects globally including in Gabon in Africa, Latin America and Australia. The Company's metals business includes Hedland operations, Chichester Hub, Western Hub, Iron Bridge, Green Metal Project, integrated operations, Belinga Project, Blacksmith Project and Pilbara Energy Connect (PEC) project. Energy segment undertakes activities in the global development of green electricity, green hydrogen, green ammonia projects, as well as green technology development and manufacturing. Its energy business includes Arizona Hydrogen project, Holmaneset project, Pecem project and Gladstone PEM50 Project.

name: BISALLOY STEEL GROUP
businessSummary: Bisalloy Steel Group Limited is an Australia-based manufacturer of structural, wear-resistant and armor steel plates using quenched and tempered steel. The Company’s products are used in the mining, construction, general fabrication and defense sectors. The Company operates through two geographic segments: Australia and Overseas. The Australian operations comprise of Bisalloy Steels Pty Limited and Bisalloy Steel Group Limited. Bisalloy Steels Pty Limited manufactures and sells wear-grade and high tensile plate through distributors and directly to original equipment manufacturers in both Australia and Overseas. The Overseas operations comprise of PT Bima Bisalloy and Bisalloy (Thailand) Co Limited located in Indonesia and Thailand respectively. These businesses distribute Bisalloy Q&T plate as well as other steel plate products. It has a distribution network across Australasia, Indonesia, Thailand, the People’s Republic of China and the United States of America.

name: ALARA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Alara Resources Limited is an Australia-based mining and exploration company with operations focused on the Middle East. Its projects include Al Wash-hi Majaza Copper-Gold Project, Daris Copper-Gold Project, Awtad Copper-Gold Project, Mullaq Copper-Gold Project and Al Ajal Copper-Gold Project. Its Al Hadeetha Wash-hi Majaza Copper-Gold Project is located over 160 kilometers (km) south-west of the capital city Muscat, in the Sultanate of Oman. Its Daris Project consists of two high-grade copper mineralization within the 587 square kilometers (km2) Block 7 Exploration License. Its Awtad Project comprises an area of approximately 497 km2 (Block 8) and is located immediately adjacent to the Block 7 (Daris Copper-Gold Project). Its Mullaq Exploration License area is adjacent to the Wash-hi Exploration License. Its Al Ajal Prospect is located near the village of Al Ajal in the Taww area, near the northern coast of the Sultanate of Oman and about 65 km west of Muscat.

name: CASH CONVERTERS INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Cash Converters International Limited is an Australia-based consumer lender and second-hand goods retailer operating globally. The principal activity of Company and its subsidiaries is that of a franchisor and financial services; a provider of secured and unsecured loans and the operator of corporate stores in Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom, all of which trade under the Cash Converters name. Its segments include Personal Finance, Vehicle Financing, Store Operations, New Zealand, and United Kingdom. Personal Finance segment comprises the Cash Converters Personal Finance personal loans business. Vehicle Finance segment comprises Green Light Auto Group Pty Ltd. Store Operations segment involves the retail sale of new and second-hand goods and personal lending including cash advance and pawnbroking operations at corporate-owned stores in Australia. It also has retail presence in repurposed luxury goods.

name: SIMS
businessSummary: Sims Limited is engaged in metal recycling and the provision of circular solutions for technology. Its activities include the buying, processing, and selling of ferrous and non-ferrous recycled metals, and the provision of environmentally responsible solutions for the recycling and repurposing of post-consumer electronic products and IT assets. The NAM segment comprises subsidiaries and joint ventures in the United States of America and Canada which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The ANZ segment comprises subsidiaries in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The SAR comprises its investment in the SA Recycling joint venture in the United States of America. The SLS segment comprises subsidiaries which provide IT asset and cloud infrastructure reuse, redeployment and recycling in various countries. The GTO segment comprises its ferrous and non-ferrous marketing subsidiaries.

name: INCANNEX HEALTHCARE
businessSummary: Incannex Healthcare Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The Company is engaged in developing combination medicines that target the underlying biological pathways associated with chronic conditions, including obstructive sleep apnoea, rheumatoid arthritis, and generalized anxiety disorder. Its lead clinical program, IHL-42X, is an oral fixed-dose combination of dronabinol and acetazolamide designed to target underlying mechanisms and act synergistically in the treatment of obstructive sleep apnoea. IHL-42X has completed a Phase II clinical trial. PSX-001 is a synthetic psilocybin treatment for the treatment of generalized anxiety disorder. PSX-001 has completed a Phase II clinical trial. IHL-675A is an oral fixed-dose combination of cannabidiol and hydroxychloroquine sulfate designed to act synergistically to alleviate inflammatory conditions, such as rheumatoid arthritis. IHL-675A is in a Phase II clinical development program.

name: WESTSTAR INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: WestStar Industrial Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of an industrial services company providing engineering, construction and mining services to the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. Its segments include SIMPEC Pty Ltd and Alltype Engineering Pty Ltd. SIMPEC Pty Ltd is a construction contractor with specialist experience in both Structural Mechanical and Piping and Electrical and Instrumentation works. Alltype Engineering Pty Ltd provides workshop, site installation, construction and maintenance services to the oil and gas, water, power generation, infrastructure, mining, resources, utility, petrochemical and defense industries. Its services include multidiscipline construction contracting, structural mechanical piping (SMP), electrical and instrumentation, fabrication of pipe, plate and structural steel, rotating equipment installation, fluid systems solutions, equipment and services, and asset management services.

name: 3P LEARNING
businessSummary: 3P Learning Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates within the education technology sector. It is engaged in the development, sales and marketing of educational software and ebooks to schools and to parents of school-aged students, delivered via a software-as-a-service subscription model. Its segments include Business-to-School (B2B) and Business-to-Consumer (B2C). Its solutions include Mathletics, Reading Eggs, Mathseeds, Writing Legends, LiteracyPlanet and Brightpath Progress. Mathletics is a mathematics program that provides instant access to thousands of digital and physical activities for practice, fluency and critical thinking in one place. Mathseeds develop early numeracy skills with captivating activities covering number sense, addition, subtraction and multiplication. Reading Eggs makes learning essential reading and phonics skills easy and fun. The program uses a sequence of online reading lessons, activities and books that keep students engaged and on tasks.

name: NTAW HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NTAW Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in distribution and marketing of motor vehicle tires, wheels, tubes and related products throughout Australia, New Zealand and South Africa. The Company is engaged in managing 11 business units, each operating separately. As part of its commercial retail businesses, its subsidiaries, Black Rubber Pty Ltd in Australia and Carters Tyre Service Limited, C.O. Tire & Retreading Co Limited and Tyre Distributors New Zealand Limited (collectively Carter’s) in New Zealand specializes in supplying truck and bus tires to commercial fleet owners and managing the performance of the tires through in-house technology, providing the required services (e.g. fitting) through company owned and affiliated tire stores. It owns Solid Plus, a business specializing in supplying industrial tires (mainly forklift tires) and fitting the tires at the premises of the customers. It operates approximately 23 distribution centers.

name: VIVA LEISURE
businessSummary: Viva Leisure Limited operates fitness and health clubs. It operates through two segments: Health Clubs and Viva Pay / Technology. The company operates health clubs under the Club Lime  and franchised health clubs under the Plus Fitness brand in Australia, New Zealand, and India. It also operates fitness club under the hiit republic, GROUNDUP, rebalance brands. In addition, the company offers Viva Pay, a proprietary payments platform  Supp Society, an in-house e-commerce, and in-club supplement brand  and Fling, a flexible gym access platform. Further, it offers Viva Labs, a dedicated in-house technology division that designs, builds, and manages the platforms underpinning every aspect of operations  and Viva Access, a control system, to power secure, seamless, and fully autonomous entry across our entire network. Additionally, the company provides debit services  rents fitness equipment  and supplement. Viva Leisure Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Dickson, Australia.

name: BRIGHTSTAR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Brightstar Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold development company. The Company hosts a portfolio of assets hosted in Western Australia, with approximately 3.9 million ounces (Moz) of mineral resources across the Goldfields and Murchison regions. The Company owns and operates the underground Second Fortune and Fish Gold Mines south of Laverton. It has consolidated three project hubs-Laverton, Sandstone, and Menzies. The Laverton hub is the Company’s primary production center with main deposits Jasper Hills (Lord Byron and Fish), Cork Tree Well, Second Fortune, and Beta. The Sandstone Hub is located in the Sandstone Greenstone Belt, approximately 600 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth, Western Australia. It includes the Sandstone Gold Project and Montague East Gold Project. The Menzies Gold Project is centered on the town of Menzies, over 130 km north of Kalgoorlie, within the Norseman-Wiluna Greenstone Belt with key deposits of Lady Shenton.

name: MAYNE PHARMA GROUP
businessSummary: Mayne Pharma Group Limited is an Australia-based specialty pharmaceutical company focused on commercializing novel pharmaceuticals. The Company’s segments include Women’s Health, Dermatology, and International. The Women’s Health segment distributes women’s health branded products in the United States. This segment includes NEXTSTELLIS, ANNOVERA, BIJUVA, IMVEXXY and branded pre-natal vitamins. The Dermatology segment distributes established dermatology products in the United States. The International segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of branded and generic pharmaceutical products globally and the provision of contract development and manufacturing services to third party customers. The Company's products include ACTIKERALL Solution, ASTRIX Capsules and Tablets, MAGNOPLASM Paste and SPLINTEX Splinter Removal Gel, and ANNOVERA Vaginal Ring, among others. Its subsidiaries include Mayne Pharma International Pty Ltd, Mayne Holdings US Inc, Mayne Pharma LLC, and others.

name: RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT GROUP
businessSummary: Resource Development Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of the contracting services to the mining sector within Australia, and the development of the Company’s Lucky Bay Garnet Project. The Company's segments include Construction, Mining and Other. It provides diversified mining services to the resources, infrastructure, and energy sectors within Australia, and owns two mining projects. It has manganese and garnet mining tenements in the Northwest of Western Australia. The Company, through its subsidiary, Central Systems Pty Ltd, provides multi-discipline construction and plant modification services to the resources, energy, and infrastructure sectors in Australia. Its subsidiaries include Comcen Pty Ltd, Australian Garnet Pty Ltd (AGPL) and others. Comcen Pty Ltd is the holder of the Ant Hill and Sunday Hill manganese project. AGPL is the holder of the Lucky Bay Garnet project and associated power infrastructure, including wind turbines.

name: AMBERTECH
businessSummary: Ambertech Limited is an Australia-based distributor of audio-visual solutions for all types of installation projects in Australia and New Zealand, including professional broadcast, media and communications; live sound and production; music instruments and sound recording; residential and commercial installation, and home entertainment markets. The Company operates through three segments: Retail, Integrated Solutions and Professional. The Retail segment is engaged in the distribution of home entertainment solutions to dealers. The Integrated Solutions segment is focused on distribution and supply of custom installation components for home theatre and commercial installations to dealers and consumers, and the distribution of projection and display products with business and domestic applications. The Professional segment is engaged in the distribution of high technology equipment to professional broadcast, film, recording and sound reinforcement industries.

name: KINGSROSE MINING
businessSummary: Kingsrose Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. It is focused on the acquisition and exploration of critical mineral deposits. Its projects include Penikat, Rana, Finnmark, Central Finland, and Jakon. The Penikat Project is a high-grade PGE-nickel-copper deposit located in North-West Finland. The Rana Project is a brownfield nickel-copper-cobalt project that is prospective for the discovery of massive sulfide mineralization and is located in Nordland County, Norway. It owns 291 new exploration licenses in Finnmark County, northern Norway, totaling 2,736 square kilometers (km2) of early-stage nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE prospective ground across two mineral belts. The Central Finland project is located in the Kotalahti Nickel Belt, a 400-km long greenstone belt, which hosts the past-producing Hitura, Kotalahti and Enonkoski nickel mines. The Jakon project comprises two exploration permits and six exploration reservations totaling 205 km2 in Central Finland.

name: VOLT GROUP
businessSummary: Volt Group Limited, formerly Volt Power Group Limited, is an industrial technology company, which develops and commercializes ESG focused, zero emission power generation and hydrogen production technologies and mining equipment. Its products include EcoQuip, ATEN, HYTEN and Wescone. EcoQuip offers mobile solar light and communications towers incorporating United States military spec build quality, superior illumination performance and advanced OEM power management, data and remote-control telemetry. ATEN Technology or System is a waste heat recovery, zero emission electricity generation technology. An installed ATEN system recovers open cycle gas turbine and reciprocating engine driven power station exhaust heat or industrial waste heat to generate zero emission, baseload electricity. The HYTEN technology is a waste heat to hydrogen production system. Wescone supplies sample crushers and sample crushing solutions to the mining, mineral processing and assay laboratory industries.

name: BABY BUNTING GROUP
businessSummary: Baby Bunting Group Limited is an Australia-based specialty maternity and baby goods retailer. The Company primarily caters to parents with children from newborn to three years of age and parents-to-be. It also provides services to new and expectant parents. The Company operates through two segments: Australia and New Zealand. Its principal product categories include prams, cots and nursery furniture, car safety, toys, babywear, feeding, nappies, manchester and associated accessories. It also provides services that are complementary to the products it sells, including car seat installation and hire services for certain nursery products. It offers various brands, including 4Baby, Bilbi, Britax, Bugaboo, Jengo, Camelbak, Charli Chair, Cherub Baby, Chicco, Dentons, Disney, and others. It operates retail stores in Australia and New Zealand and related online stores. Its subsidiaries include Baby Bunting Pty Ltd, Baby Bunting EST Pty Ltd, and Baby Bunting NZ Limited.

name: STEP ONE CLOTHING
businessSummary: Step One Clothing Limited is an Australia-based direct-to-consumer online retailer company that offers a range of organically grown and certified, sustainable, and manufactured innerwear. The Company offers a range of underwear that suits a range of body types. It owns the designs for its innerwear and contracts the manufacturing of its products in Asia for export to warehouses in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States. The Company's product range also includes women's underwear. The Company's sales channels include Amazon and other retailers. The Company also conceives and produces its own advertising content. Its subsidiaries include Step One Clothing Australia Pty Ltd, Step One Production Pty Ltd, Step One Clothing UK Limited, and Step One Clothing USA Inc.

name: MINERAL RESOURCES
businessSummary: Mineral Resources Ltd is a diversified resources company with operations in lithium, iron ore, energy and mining services across Western Australia. The principal activities of the Company include mining activities and the integrated supply of goods and services to the resource sectors. It operates in five segments: Mining Services, Iron Ore, Lithium, Energy and Other Commodities. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiary, CSI Mining Services (CSI), is a provider of pit-to-ship mining services to the resource industry. Its offerings include mining and processing, transport and logistics, and manufacturing, rehabilitation services, and equipment and parts. Its engineering and construction division consolidates project delivery and offers a range of complex projects across several commodities, including iron ore, lithium and gas, as well as road and port construction projects. It has a portfolio of iron ore operations spanning the Pilbara and Onslow regions.

name: CERYVYN THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Ceryvyn Therapeutics Limited, formerly Opthea Limited, is an Australia-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The Company is focusing on developing therapies by translating advances in human biology into transformative medicines for patients with serious diseases. It focuses on identifying biological mechanisms that drive disease and developing targeted therapies capable of addressing unmet medical needs. Its focus is lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM), a rare, chronic and progressive systemic disease that predominantly affects women and primarily involves the lungs, where it leads to progressive loss of lung function. The Company's lead development program, CYV-101, is a fusion protein designed to selectively bind and neutralize VEGF-C and VEGF-D, key signaling proteins involved in pathological lymphangiogenesis. It targets a fundamental biological pathway to drive disease progression, CYV-101 offers a differentiated therapeutic approach for patients with LAM.

name: LINDSAY AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Lindsay Australia Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated transport, logistics, and rural supply services to the food processing, food services, fresh produce, and horticulture sectors in Australia. The company operates through Transport, Rural, and Hunter segments. It offers various services, such as Lindsay rural, a rural merchandising service that provides seed, chemicals, nutrients, fertilizer, irrigation, farm consumables and packaging  Lindsay transport, a refrigerated warehousing and distribution service that comprises linehaul, dry and general freight, refrigerated chiller freight, and local pick up delivery  and Lindsay fresh logistics that provides unloading, cross-docking, storage, ripening, quarantine, inspection, fumigation, and import/export services. Further, the company provides fencing and livestock products  agricultural services, such as agronomy and feed testing services  trade essentials, including hardware, timber, and trade supplies  and pet products. Lindsay Australia Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Acacia Ridge, Australia.

name: SIMS
businessSummary: Sims Limited is engaged in metal recycling and the provision of circular solutions for technology. Its activities include the buying, processing, and selling of ferrous and non-ferrous recycled metals, and the provision of environmentally responsible solutions for the recycling and repurposing of post-consumer electronic products and IT assets. The NAM segment comprises subsidiaries and joint ventures in the United States of America and Canada which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The ANZ segment comprises subsidiaries in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea which perform ferrous and non-ferrous secondary recycling functions. The SAR comprises its investment in the SA Recycling joint venture in the United States of America. The SLS segment comprises subsidiaries which provide IT asset and cloud infrastructure reuse, redeployment and recycling in various countries. The GTO segment comprises its ferrous and non-ferrous marketing subsidiaries.

name: ENVIRONMENTAL GROUP
businessSummary: The Environmental Group Limited is engaged in the design, application and servicing of gas vapor and dust emission control systems, inlet and exhaust systems for gas turbines, engineering services, developing water treatment and service install provider for heat transfer plant and equipment primarily related to boilers, including 24/7 customer service for mechanical, electrical and automation support to a variety of industries. Its five business units include EGL Clean Air-Total Air Pollution Control and Airtight Solutions; Baltec IES; EGL Clean Energy-Tomlinson Energy Service and Ignite Services; EGL Water, and EGL Waste Services. Its Baltec IES produces inlet and exhaust systems for gas turbines, which are used to complement and augment solar and wind energy production. The EGL Water division continues to develop its patented technologies in conjunction with Victoria University. EGL Waste Services provides the sales and services platform for the Turmec Agency agreement in Australia.

name: IMMUTEP
businessSummary: Immutep Limited is an Australia-based late-stage biotechnology company. The Company is focused on developing novel immunotherapies for cancer and autoimmune disease. It is focused on advancement of therapeutics related to Lymphocyte Activation Gene-3 (LAG-3), and its diversified product portfolio harnesses LAG-3’s ability to stimulate or suppress the immune response. Its lead clinical candidate is eftilagimod alfa (efti or IMP321) for the treatment of different types of cancers. Efti is the Company’s first-in-class novel immunotherapy that directly activates the immune system to fight cancer, which is under evaluation in TACTI-004 (KEYNOTE-F91), a registrational Phase III trial for the first-line therapy of advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer. Its second in-house product candidate (IMP761) which is in clinical development for the treatment of autoimmune disease, a third product candidate, IMP731, a depleting antibody that could remove T cells involved in autoimmunity.

name: K&S
businessSummary: K&S Corporation Limited is an Australia-based provider of transport and logistics solutions within its target markets in Australia and New Zealand. The Company's principal activities include transport and logistics, warehousing and fuel distribution. The Company operates through three segments: Australian Transport, Fuels and New Zealand Transport. The Australian Transport segment includes provision of logistics services to customers within Australia. The Fuels segment is engaged in the distribution of fuel to fishing, farming and retail customers within the Southeast of South Australia. The New Zealand Transport segment is engaged in the provision of logistics services to customers within New Zealand. Its businesses include K&S freighters, K&S energy, chemtrans, K&S bulk, K&S New Zealand, DTM business logistics, K&S heavy haulage, and others.

name: GENETIC SIGNATURES
businessSummary: Genetic Signatures Limited is an Australia-based specialist molecular diagnostics (MDx) company. The Company's principal activities include research and commercialization of identifying individual genetic signatures to identify diseases and the sale of associated products into the diagnostic and research marketplaces. The Company is focused on the development and commercialization of its platform technology, 3base. Its MDx 3base platform technology provides high-volume hospitals and pathology laboratories with the ability to screen for an array of infectious pathogens, with a high degree of specificity, in a rapid throughput (time-to-result) environment. It designs and manufactures a suite of real-time Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) based products for the routine detection of infectious diseases under the EasyScreen brand. Its products include EasyScreen Pan-Enteric Detection Kit, EasyScreen STI Genital Pathogen Detection, EasyScreen Viral Meningitis Detection Kit, and others.

name: VULCAN ENERGY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Vulcan Energy Resources Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in geothermal energy and lithium exploration and production. The Company’s segments include Germany, Other European (France and Italy) and Australia. The Germany segment is engaged in the supply of geothermal energy, exploration relating to the Zero Carbon Lithium Project and engineering services. The Other European segment is engaged in exploration relating to battery materials and geothermal lithium. The Australia segment is engaged in administration and corporate support services. Its products include Geothermal energy, Sustainable Lithium, and In-house sorbent: VULSORB. The Company’s Lionheart Project is located in the Upper Rhine Valley Brine Field bordering Germany and France, is the lithium resource in Europe and a tier-one lithium project globally. Its subsidiaries include Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH, Vulcan Energy Europe Pty Limited, and Vulcan Energy Engineering GmbH, among others.

name: BLUESCOPE STEEL
businessSummary: BlueScope Steel Limited is a steel production company. The Company is focused on providing steel materials, products, systems and technologies across North America, Australia, New Zealand, Pacific Islands and throughout Asia. It is engaged in manufacturing of coil coating and coated steel products. Its segments include Australian Steel Products (ASP), North Star BlueScope Steel, Coated Products Asia, Buildings and Coated Products North America, and New Zealand & Pacific Islands. ASP segment produces and markets coated and painted flat steel products for Australian building and construction customers as well as offering commodity flat steel products. Coated Products Asia segment offers building products for China, consisting of metal coating, painting, Lysaght operations and engineered building solutions. It manufactures and markets a range of branded products that include pre-painted COLORBOND steel, zinc/aluminum alloy coated ZINCALUME steel and the LYSAGHT range of building products.

name: RAIDEN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Raiden Resources Limited is a lithium-based metal gold exploration company. The Company is focused on the Andover North-South, Mt Sholl, and Arrow lithium projects. Its Mt Sholl Lithium project is located approximately 22 kilometers (km) southeast of Karratha in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The property comprises two exploration licenses covering an area of 9.6 square kilometers (km2). It also has a portfolio of gold projects in Western Australia, including the Arrow project, which is located approximately 110 km southwest of Port Hedland in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. Its other projects include Boodaylerrie, Yandicoogina, Tolisnica-Stanca, Donje Nevlje, Pirot, Zupa, Majdanpek West, Vuzel, Zlatusha, Kalabak, BG1 and others. The Boodalyerrie is located 78 kilometers northeast of Nullagine and 113 kilometers southeast of Marble Bar in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Boodalyerrie exploration license (E45/3586), which covers an area of 50 km2.

name: DGR GLOBAL
businessSummary: DGR Global Limited is engaged in the generation of projects and the provision of services and support to sponsored listed companies, within the mineral resources industry. The Company’s business is the creation of resource exploration, development, and mining companies. It owns a portfolio of investments in companies, which include SolGold Plc, Atlantic Lithium Ltd, Clara Resources Australia Ltd, New Peak Metals Ltd, and Lakes Blue Energy NL. SolGold plc focuses on the copper and gold porphyry systems at Cascabel in Ecuador. Atlantic Lithium Ltd focuses on the Ewoyaa Lithium Project in Ghana. Clara Resources Australia Ltd is focusing on a diverse commodity base including cobalt, nickel, and metallurgical coal. New Peak Metals Ltd is focused on exploring for alternative gold deposits as well as other precious and base metals project opportunities. The Company’s pipeline projects include Coolgarra Minerals Pty Ltd, and Pinnacle Gold Pty Ltd.

name: CLOVER
businessSummary: Clover Corporation Limited focused on technology, new product development, and commercialization. The principal activities of the Company are the refining and sale of natural oils, the production of encapsulated powders and the research and product development of functional food and infant nutrition ingredients. Its microencapsulation technology enables nutritional oils, such as tuna, fish, algal and fungal oils, to be added to infant formulas, foods, and beverages. Its technologies protect those sensitive oils from oxidation, allowing them to be incorporated into a range of applications.
