The Company, through its subsidiary, Nu-Mega Ingredients Pty Limited (Nu-Mega), supplies refined Omega-3 oils and a range of other encapsulated ingredients for use in infant formula, nutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, and sports nutrition markets. Nu-Mega’s Driphorm range of microencapsulated powders enables the addition of Hi-DHA tuna and/or algal oils to a broad spectrum of products.

name: SOMNOMED
businessSummary: SomnoMed Limited is engaged in producing and selling devices for the oral treatment of sleep-related disorders. It provides treatment solutions for sleep-related breathing disorders, including obstructive sleep apnea, snoring, and bruxism. It is focused on the commercialization of the SomnoDent Mandibular Advancement Splint and other oral devices for sleep-related disorders in Australia and overseas. Its segments include North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, CORE, and RSS. Its SomnoDent product line includes SomnoDent Avant, SomnoDent Classic, SomnoDent Flex, SomnoDent Fusion, Herbst Advance Elite and Herbst Advance. Its SomMorning Repositioner is designed to help return their mandible back to its pre-treatment centric position. Its SomnoBrux Michigan splint is a custom fit, acrylic splint (dental guard) for upper teeth designed to protect the teeth from grinding and scraping during Bruxism. It also offers SomTabs, which are cleaning tablets that are developed to clean oral appliances.

name: CIVMEC
businessSummary: Civmec Limited is an Australia-based multidisciplinary construction and engineering services provider to the energy, resources, infrastructure, marine and defense sectors. The Company’s business activities include heavy engineering, shipbuilding, modularization, structural, mechanical, piping (SMP), electrical, instrumentation and control (EIC), precast concrete, site civil works, industrial insulation, maintenance, surface treatment, refractory and access solutions. In the energy sector, it provides solutions for upstream and downstream energy projects. Its vertically integrated operating model supports the delivery of projects in the resource sector, allowing the Company to develop solutions for small or large greenfield and brownfield projects. It delivers several infrastructure, marine and defense projects across Australia, which include Matagarup Bridge, Perth Stadium, Sydney Gateway Project, among others. Its facilities are in Henderson, Port Hedland, Gladstone, and Newcastle.

name: EZZ LIFE SCIENCE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: EZZ Life Science Holdings Limited is an Australian genomic life science company. The Company’s principal activity is the formulation, production, marketing and sale of the EZZ branded health supplements to retailers and consumers domestically and internationally. It is also engaged in wholesale distribution of the EAORON branded skin care products to retailers in Australia and New Zealand and direct to consumer distribution via a company operated EAORON e-commerce store. The Company's segments include Brought in Lines and Company Owned products. The United States focused brand EZZDAY’s products include EZZDAY Debloat & Gas Relief Pro (Capsule), EZZDAY Vaginal Probiotics & pH Balance (Capsule), EZZDAY Triple Anti Solution (NAD+, Multi-Collagen & Resveratrol) (Gummy), and EZZDAY Colon Detox (Capsule). The EZZ-branded products include EZZ Hair Growth Spray Duo, Maximum Growth Bundle, EZZ Children's Eye Health , EZZ JTN Immunity Plus, among others.

name: BULLETIN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Bulletin Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. Its projects include the Lake Rebecca Gold Project, Ravensthorpe Lithium Project, Chifley Gold Project, Mt Cue Gold Project, Farmer Project and Powder Sill Project. The Lake Rebecca Gold Project comprises approximately 1,100 square kilometers (km2) of gold prospective exploration tenements in the southern Laverton Tectonic Zone, 150 kilometers (km) east north-east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Its 100% owned Ravensthorpe Lithium Project contains outcropping spodumene and lepidolite lithium bearing pegmatites. The 130km2 tenement package is 12km southwest and along the strike of Rio Tinto’s Mt Cattlin lithium mine. The Chifley project is a 79km2 exploration tenement that is prospective for gold. It is approximately 50km to the south of Lake Rebecca and on a northwest trending splay of the Claypan Fault. Mt Cue Gold Project is 25km2 in area and is located approximately 33km west of Cue, Western Australia.

name: AMPOL
businessSummary: Ampol Limited is an Australia-based transport energy provider. The Company supplies petrol and a convenience network, as well as refining, importing and marketing fuels and lubricants. It also launched its electric vehicle charging and home electricity solutions. The Company supplies fuel to approximately 80,000 customers in diverse markets across the Australian economy, including defense, mining, transport, marine, agriculture, aviation and other commercial sectors. Across its retail network, the Company serves approximately three million customers every week with fuel and convenience products, as well as electric vehicle charging at selected locations. Its customer base is supported by its robust supply chain and strategic infrastructure positions across the country, which includes 16 terminals, six pipelines, 55 wet depots, over 1,800 branded sites and one refinery located in Lytton, Queensland. This network is supported by over 8,300 people across Australia and overseas.

name: TUAS
businessSummary: Tuas Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company's primary operations of the Group are via its investment in Simba, a company which is primarily involved in owning and operating a mobile network and providing telecommunications services in Singapore. It is operated by Simba Telecom Pte Ltd and supported by the wholly owned Malaysian IT support center, Tuas Solutions Sdn Bhd. It focuses on the deployment and operation of mobile network infrastructure and the provision of wireless communication services internationally. The Company operates through the Singapore telecommunications segment. The Company's subsidiaries include Simba Telecom Pte Ltd, Simba 5G Pte Ltd, Netco East Pte Ltd, Netco West Pte Ltd, Goose Esim Pte Ltd and Tuas Solutions Sdn Bhd among others.

name: WEBJET GROUP
businessSummary: Webjet Group Limited is an Australia-based digital consumer travel company. The principal activities of the Company are online sales and distribution of travel products including flights, hotels, holiday packages, car and motorhome rentals, and travel insurance. The Company operates through three segments: Webjet OTA, Cars & Motorhomes, and Trip Ninja. Its Webjet OTA segment is an online travel agency that operates in Australia and New Zealand. Webjet OTA enables customers to compare, combine and book the domestic and international travel flight deals, hotel accommodation, holiday package deals, travel insurance and car hire worldwide. Its Cars & Motorhomes segment operates a global e-commerce platform specializing in motorhome and car rentals, servicing customers across multiple international markets. Its Trip Ninja segment is a travel technology business that develops solutions to optimize complex travel itineraries.

name: CREDIT CORP GROUP
businessSummary: Credit Corp Group Limited is an Australia-based provider of responsible financial services to the credit-impaired consumer segment. The Company's segments include debt ledger purchasing (Australia and New Zealand), debt ledger purchasing (United States) and consumer lending (Australia, New Zealand and the United States). The debt ledger purchasing (Australia and New Zealand) segment purchases consumer debts at a discount to their face value from credit providers in Australia and New Zealand. This segment includes the contingent collection services business in Australia and New Zealand. The debt ledger purchasing (United States) segment purchases consumer debts at a discount to their face value from credit providers in the United States. The consumer lending (Australia, New Zealand and the United States) segment offers various consumer loan products focused on credit-impaired consumers. Its loan products are delivered under a portfolio of brands, including CarStart and Wallet Wizard.

name: MEDICAL DEVELOPMENTS INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Medical Developments International Limited is an Australia-based company that delivers emergency medical solutions dedicated to improving patient outcomes in both domestic and international markets. The Company operates in two segments: Pain Management and Respiratory. The Pain Management segment is engaged in the supply of analgesia for acute and procedural pain. The Company manufactures an inhaled analgesic, Penthrox (the Green Whistle), at manufacturing facilities at Scoresby and Springvale in Victoria, Australia. Penthrox is sold into domestic and international markets through distribution partnerships and direct in-market capability. The Respiratory segment is a supplier of respiratory products including asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) space chambers, peak flow meters, portable nebulizers and silicone face masks. The respiratory supplies into Australia, the United States of America, Europe, and Asia through partnerships with distributors.

name: PIONEER CREDIT
businessSummary: Pioneer Credit Limited is an Australia-based financial services provider. The Company is focused on acquiring and servicing Purchased Debt Portfolios (PDPs). The Company is also focused on providing customer service along with a range of products and solutions to help them achieve their financial goals. The Company specializes in acquiring and servicing retail debt portfolios. These portfolios consist of individuals with financial obligations to the Company and are the cornerstone of its customer relationships. It works with Australia’s banks, non-bank lenders, and financial institutions. Its key focus is on providing commercial solutions to its financial sector partners. The Company has approximately 219,000 customers throughout Australia and New Zealand. The Company's subsidiaries include Pioneer Credit Solutions Pty Limited, Sphere Legal Pty Limited, Pioneer Credit (Philippines) Pty Limited, Pioneer Credit Connect Pty Limited, Pioneer Credit Broking Services Pty Limited and others.

name: STANMORE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Stanmore Resources Limited is a resources company with operations and exploration projects in the Bowen and Surat basins. The Company controls and operates the South Walker Creek, Poitrel and Isaac Plains Complex metallurgical coal mines as well as the undeveloped Isaac Downs Extension, Eagle Downs, Lancewood and Isaac Plains underground projects, in Queensland’s prime Bowen Basin region. It holds several additional prospective coal tenements located in Queensland’s Bowen and Surat basins. South Walker Creek is an open-cut mine located approximately 35 kilometers (km) west of Nebo in Queensland's Bowen Basin. Poitrel is an open-cut mine located approximately 35 km east of Moranbah. Isaac Plains Complex is located approximately seven km east of Moranbah. Isaac Downs Extension is an undeveloped open-cut project situated immediately south of the Isaac Downs mine, across the Isaac River. Eagle Downs is a hard-coking coal development project located approximately 20 km from Moranbah.

name: ACROW
businessSummary: Acrow Limited is a provider of smart integrated construction systems across formwork, industrial access and commercial scaffolding in Australia. The Company's portfolio is falsework and shoring, screen solutions, Jacking System and internal engineering capabilities. The Company operates in 17 locations with over 65,000 tons of equipment. Its products include Slim-Lite and Slim-Max Soldiers, Acrowall-60, Acrowall-80, Single sided A-Frames, Acrow Deck, Acrow Flex Deck, Acrow Prop, Acrow GASS, Powershore 60, V-shore, Powershore 30, Powershore 150, Acrow Screens, Jumpform, Universal Soldier System, Acrow Bridge Brackets, Acrow Adjustable Loading Platform, Acrow Modular Hanging Stair, Quickstage, SuperCuplok, Uni-ring, QuikDeck, Timber and Ply, Props, Containment, and Accessories and other. Its Services include Engineering & Design, Industrial Access & Scaffold supply, and others.

name: NUFARM
businessSummary: Nufarm Limited is an Australia-based crop protection and seed technology company, which is engaged in the manufacture and sale of crop protection products and its proprietary seed technologies business. It operates two business lines: Crop Protection and Seed Technologies. The Crop Protection business deals in the manufacturing and selling of crop protection products used by farmers to protect crops from damage caused by weeds, pests and disease. It is managed by geographic segments: APAC (Australia, New Zealand and certain parts of Asia), Europe (United Kingdom, European Union, and certain other countries in Europe, Middle East and Africa) and North America (United States, Canada and Mexico). Seed Technologies business comprises the base seeds, bioenergy, omega-3 and seed treatment. platforms. Its omega-3 canola - the plant-based source of omega-3 for human nutrition and animal feed. Its carinata and energy cane are supplying sustainable biomass feed stocks for the biofuels industry.

name: ARTICORE GROUP
businessSummary: Articore Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates the global online marketplaces, Redbubble.com, TeePublic.com and Dashery.com. These marketplaces facilitate artists’ design and sale of a range of products printed with the creators’ artwork to their customers worldwide. The products are produced and shipped by third party service providers, such as product manufacturers, printers and shipping companies referred to as fulfillers. The Company sells uncommon designs, everyday products, such as apparel, stationery, housewares, bags, and wall arts. Its segments include Redbubble and TeePublic. Redbubble and TeePublic segments are online marketplaces for print on demand products. The Redbubble product range includes clothing, stickers, phone cases, wall art, home & living, kids and babies, accessories, stationery and office, and gifts. Republic is a marketplace for independent creators to sell the merchandise bearing their art.

name: HELIA GROUP
businessSummary: Helia Group Limited is a provider of Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI). It also provides tailored risk and capital management solutions. Its LMI proposition protects lenders if a homeowner defaults on a home loan and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of the secured property. Lender's purchase LMI for risk transfer and capital management purposes. LMI provides protection to a lender to help borrowers purchase a property with a smaller deposit. LMI protects the lender against the risk of potential losses in case they are unable to make home loan repayments, and the lender is unable to recover the outstanding loan amount from the sale of security property. This makes loans more accessible to people who are looking to buy a home for less than a 20% deposit. Home buyers have a range of flexible options for paying the LMI cost to their lender. It also offers flexible solutions to support homeownership and provide options for covering the LMI cost.

name: PANTORO GOLD
businessSummary: Pantoro Gold Limited, formerly Pantoro Limited, is an Australia-based gold producer. The Company is focused on its 100%-owned Norseman Gold Project in Australia. The Norseman Gold Project is located in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, at the southern end of the highly productive Norseman-Wiluna greenstone belt. The project lies approximately 725 kilometers (km) east of Perth, 200 km south of Kalgoorlie, and 200 km north of Esperance. The project tenure of approximately 1,000 square kilometers (km2) covers nearly all the historic Norseman Gold province. The project has measured, indicated and inferred mineral resources of 4.87 million ounces. The Norseman Gold Project lies immediately adjacent to the Norseman township and is infrastructure-rich with office and workshop complexes, camp accommodation, site laboratory, 10MW power station, bore fields and a road network servicing all existing mineral resource areas already in place.

name: MYER HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Myer Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company which is engaged in the department store business. Its segments include Myer Retail and Myer Apparel Brands. Myer Retail segment includes store and online sales made under the brands: Myer, sass & bide, Marcs and David Lawrence. Myer Apparel Brands include stores and online sales made under the brands: Just Jeans, Dotti, Jacqui E, Portmans and Jay Jays. Its merchandise offer includes core product categories: Womenswear; Menswear; Childrenswear; Beauty; Homewares; Electrical Goods; Toys and General Merchandise. The Company operates approximately 56 department stores across Australia, as well as its online business: myer.com.au. Its subsidiaries include NB Elizabeth Pty Ltd, NB Russell Pty Ltd, NB Lonsdale Pty Ltd, NB Collins Pty Ltd, Warehouse Solutions Pty Ltd, Myer Group Pty Ltd, Myer Pty Ltd, Myer Group Finance Limited, The Myer Emporium Pty Ltd and others.

name: MEEKA METALS
businessSummary: Meeka Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral exploration and resource project development in Western Australia. The Company is focused on the exploration and evaluation of its mineral assets at the Murchison Gold Project and Circle Valley Project. Its flagship Murchison Gold Project hosts a 1.2-million-ounce (Moz) mineral resource. The Murchison Gold Project covers the northern extent of the highly prospective Mount Magnet and Youanmi Shear Zones in the prolific Murchison Gold Fields of Western Australia. In addition, the Company owns the Circle Valley Project, which is located 85 kilometers (km) south of Norseman in Western Australia. The project tenure covers the southwestern Albany-Fraser Mobile Belt. The Company also owns Blue Vein, Bushpig and Razorback gold deposits near Mt Holland in Western Australia’s Forrestania greenstone belt. Mt Holland is located 375 km east of Perth in the Southern Cross Province of the Yilgarn Craton.

name: JCURVE SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: Jcurve Solutions Limited is an Australia-based business transformation technology company. The Company is engaged in the sale, implementation and support of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions, which consist of the exclusively licensed small business edition of Oracle NetSuite, JCurve ERP (in Australia and New Zealand), and the Oracle NetSuite mid-market and enterprise editions. Its segments include ANZ ERP, Asia ERP, TEMS and Quicta. ANZ ERP segment includes ERP cloud-based Business Management solutions and associated consulting services that are sold to Australian and New Zealand customers. Asia ERP segment includes ERP cloud-based Business Management solutions and associated consulting services, which are sold to Southeast Asian customers. TEMS segment develops and markets Telecommunications Expense Management Solutions (JTEL, Full Circle and Phoneware) that are sold to Australian customers. Quicta segment develops and sells service management and scheduling software.

name: INTEGRATED RESEARCH
businessSummary: Integrated Research Limited is an Australia-based provider of user experience and performance management solutions for payment transactions and collaborative systems. The Company offers three key solution suites: Collaborate, Transact and Infrastructure - powered by the Prognosis platform. Its Collaborate solution offers enterprise grade performance management, testing solutions and analytics across voice, Web, video and collaboration ecosystems. Its Transact solution includes analyzing transaction data, deploying new technology and ensuring a seamless payments experience to keep its client card, high value and real-time payments business flowing. The Company's infrastructure solution includes access to real-time insight into HPE Non-Stop environments to help manage information technology (IT) performance, spot patterns in data and proactively prevent problems. Its solutions are used by various organizations, such as stock exchanges, banks and telecommunication companies.

name: IMAGE RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Image Resources NL is an Australia-based mineral sands focused mining company. The Company is engaged in operating an open-cut mine and ore processing facility at its 100%-owned, high-grade, zircon-rich Boonanarring Project, located 80 kilometers (km) north of Perth in the infrastructure rich North Perth Basin. The Boonanarring Project comprises a zircon rich open pit mine and wet concentrate plant (WCP). The project produces zircon rich, heavy mineral concentrate (HMC) which is exported to international markets through the port of Bunbury. The Company’s Atlas Development Project is s located 90 km north of Boonanarring. Its mineralization extends from surface to 16 meters (m) depth and has an average thickness of 3.5 m and a maximum thickness of 12 m. The Company’s tenements are located in Western Australia, and all mineral sands related tenements are located in the North Perth Basin, across a combined area of 1,704 square kilometers.

name: IMEXHS
businessSummary: IMEXHS Limited is an Australia-based provider of medical imaging software and radiology services in 18 countries, including Colombia, the United States and Australia. The Company develops software-as-a-service imaging solutions that includes a Picture Archiving and Communications System (PACS), a Radiology Information System (RIS), a Cardiology Information System (CIS) and an Anatomical Pathology Laboratory Information System (APLIS). Its solutions are cloud-based, vendor neutral and zero footprint, with no need for installed software. Its radiology services provide radiological diagnostic services to hospitals and medical facilities in Colombia and Spain using IMEXHS medical imaging software. The Company's services business also provides it with medical images and radiologists interpretation and reports to develop artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Its solutions include AQUILA - Radiology, ALULA - Pathology, ANTEROS - cardiology, artificial intelligence and advanced visualization.

name: CENTRAL PETROLEUM
businessSummary: Central Petroleum Limited is an oil and gas exploration and production company. The Company is focused on supplying reliable energy to Australians. It has a diverse portfolio of producing and prospective gas tenements across the Northern Territory (NT) and Queensland. Its segments include Producing assets, Development assets, and Exploration assets. Producing assets are engaged in the production and sale of crude oil, natural gas and associated petroleum products from fields that are in the production phase. Development assets include fields under development in preparation for the sale of petroleum products. Exploration assets include exploration and evaluation of permit areas. Its key production area is the Amadeus Basin, where it produces oil and gas from its Mereenie, Palm Valley and Dingo fields. Its license area includes Amadeus Basin, Pedirka Basin, and Wiso Basin. Its Amadeus Basin includes Southern Amadeus and Ooraminna Retention Licenses.

name: COUNTY INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: County International Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company's Polymet Tenement Portfolio includes exploration licenses, such as Mayfield (EL8983) and Shoalhaven (EL9343). Its Copper/Gold Group Tenement Portfolio-Sector-1-Gold consists of exploration licenses, such as Yambulla (EL7547), Nerrigundah (ELA5727), Whipstick (EL8508), Imlay (EL8679) and Wangarabell (EL006612). Its Copper/Gold Group Tenement Portfolio-Sector 2-Copper consists of exploration licenses, such as Dunedoo (EL9173), Koorawatha (EL8740), Murringo (EL8757) and Narrallen (EL8758). EL8983 is about 50 kilometers (km) east north-east of Queanbeyan. EL9343 is located about 30 km north of Braidwood in the Lachlan Fold Belt to the east of the Mayfield tenement. EL7547 covers about 53 square kilometers is located contiguous with the Imlay tenement. EL9173 is located about 10 km northeast of Dunedoo. The Company holds two coal projects located in the Powder River Basin in Wyoming, United States.

name: SIV CAPITAL
businessSummary: SIV Capital Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in renting commercial equipment to businesses. The Company’s subsidiaries include SIV Finance Company Pty Ltd, and GoGetta Equipment Funding Pty Ltd.

name: VALIANT GOLD
businessSummary: Valiant Gold Limited engages in the exploration and development of gold projects in Australia. The company holds 100% interest in the Reedy Project located in Murchison Goldfield in Western Australia  and the Comet Project located southeast of Cue in Western Australia. Valiant Gold Limited was incorporated in 2025 and is based in West Perth, Australia.

name: CHARTER HALL LONG WALE REIT
businessSummary: Charter Hall Long WALE REIT is an Australian Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) listed on the ASX and investing in high quality Australasian real estate assets that are predominantly leased to corporate and government tenants on long term leases. Charter Hall Long WALE REIT is managed by Charter Hall Group. Charter Hall is one of Australia's leading fully integrated property investment and funds management groups. They use their expertise to access, deploy, manage and invest equity to create value and generate superior returns for their investor customers. They've curated a diverse portfolio of high-quality properties across our core sectors  Office, Industrial & Logistics, Retail and Social Infrastructure. With partnerships and financial discipline at the heart of their approach, they create and invest in places that support their customers, people and communities to grow. Charter Hall Long WALE REIT was incorporated in Australia.

name: OD6 METALS
businessSummary: OD6 Metals Limited, a mineral exploration company, engages in the exploration and development mineral sector in Australia and the United States. The company explores rare earth elements, copper, fluorspar, and zinc deposits. Its flagship is the Splinter Rock project located in the Goldfields-Esperance region of Western Australia  owned 100% interest in the Quinn Fluorspar Project consist of 226 mining claims covering approximately 1,890 hectares and located in Nevada the United States  and Gulf Creek Project located in New South Wales. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Subiaco, Australia.

name: HIGHCOM
businessSummary: HighCom Limited is an Australia-based international defense industry company. The Company operates through two divisions: HighCom Armor (the United States Operation) and HighCom Technology (Australian Operations). HighCom Armor division designs, manufactures, and supplies global military, law enforcement, and first responder customers with advanced personal protection ballistic products and solutions for body armor, ballistic helmets, and composite armor panels and platform structures. HighCom Technology division supplies Australian Defense and Security Agencies with small uncrewed arial systems and sensor payloads, and provides local program, project and engineering management, systems integration, maintenance, composite repairs, and logistics support services. Its HighCom Armor also designs, develops, tests, manufactures, and distributes dozens of National Institute of Justice compliant hard and soft armor products, as well as other composite armor panels and complex curved items.

name: VMOTO
businessSummary: Vmoto Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development and manufacture, marketing and distribution of electric two-wheel vehicles (electric motorcycles and electric mopeds). It operates in four geographical segments: Australia, China, Europe and Singapore. Its E-Mobility Solutions (EMS) is an integrated electric mobility solution focused on electric two-wheel mobility, which encompasses range of two-wheel vehicles, dual battery models for extended range, electric charging infrastructure in the form of fast charging and battery swapping technology, and pre-installed Internet of Things (IoT) devices with fleet management software. Its e-motorcycle vehicles include STASH, TC MAX, TS STREET HUNTER PRO, OFF-R, and others. Its Smart Connectivity and IoT include services such as smart platform, sharing solutions, and others. Its 4G APP prepares scooters for integration with third-party IT ecosystems. The Company has approximately 76 distributors in over 90 countries.

name: CREDIT CLEAR
businessSummary: Credit Clear Limited is a technology company. It has developed a digital billing and communication platform that helps organizations drive smarter, faster, and more efficient financial outcomes by changing the way customers manage their re-payments through a user experience that the market demands in a digital age. It manages customer accounts across a range of industries, including transport, financial services, government, and utilities. Its segments include Receivable Collections and Legal Services. Receivable Collections segment represents the provision of receivable collection services using a combination of technology solutions and traditional collection methods. Legal Services offers specialized credit legal services, which when combined with the Receivables Collections business, allows the Company to offer a full-service end to end offering for its clients. Its RepayTech technology allows customers to make re-payments through a variety of channels and with re-payment option.

name: HANSEN TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Hansen Technologies Limited is a global provider of software and services to the energy, utilities, communications and media industries. The Company is engaged in the development, integration and support and global support of billing and customer information systems. Its segments include Energy & Utilities and Communications & Media. The Energy & Utilities segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Energy & Utilities customers that primarily operate in electricity, gas and water. The Communications & Media segment encompasses the sale of software and the provision of consulting services for Communications & Media customers that primarily operate in telecommunications and pay-TV. Its services include Software Product Services, Cloud and Hosting, Managed Services, and Data Protection. Its Software Product Services include Architecture Consulting, Solution Delivery, and Systems Integration, CIS Managed Services, Hansen Learning, Product Support.

name: GWR GROUP
businessSummary: GWR Group Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is focused on the development of mineral exploration and development projects. It is primarily focused on the exploration and development of its Prospect Ridge Project. It holds a 70% interest in the advanced Prospect Ridge Magnesite project located in northwest Tasmania. The Prospect Ridge Magnesite project area is in northwest Tasmania, 40 kilometers (km) southwest of the Port of Burnie. It sits upon a granted exploration license (EL5/2016), and is 11 km long and covers approximately 51 square kilometers (km2) in area and contains two magnesite deposits, the Arthur River and Lyons River deposits containing the magnesite inventory in Australia. The Company has a portfolio of mineral commodity projects that includes projects held in its own right, in joint ventures and indirectly through investment in other listed entities.

name: IMMURON
businessSummary: Immuron Limited is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing orally delivered targeted polyclonal antibodies for the treatment of infectious diseases. It operates through two segments: Research and development (R&D), and Hyperimmune products. The R&D segment is focused on R&D projects performed in Australia and the United States. Hyperimmune products segment is engaged in Travelan and Protectyn activities which occur predominantly in Australia, the United States and Canada. Its flagship products consist of Travelan and Protectyn. Travelan is an orally administered passive immunotherapy that prophylactically reduces the likelihood of contracting traveler’s diarrhea and is sold in pharmacies throughout Australia. Protectyn is sold online and in health practitioner clinics and is marketed as an immune supplement to help maintain a healthy digestive function and liver. Its clinical programs include Travelan (IMM-124E), and IMM-529.

name: AJ LUCAS GROUP
businessSummary: AJ Lucas Group Limited is a provider of drilling services primarily to the coal industry in Australia, and an operator, through its United Kingdom subsidiary Cuadrilla Resources Holdings Limited, of exploration and appraisal of conventional and unconventional oil and gas prospects in the United Kingdom. The Company's segments include Australian Operations and UK Oil & Gas. The Australian Operations segment encompasses the Australian Drilling business and the Company's head office and corporate costs. The Australian Drilling business provides integrated professional drilling services, predominantly for exploration and degasification of coal mines, but may also include the recovery and commercialization of coal seam gas, and associated services. The UK Oil & Gas segment is engaged in the exploration and development of unconventional and conventional hydrocarbons in the United Kingdom. Its license holdings include Bowland, Elswick, Balcombe, Weald, and Weaverthorpe.

name: KORVEST
businessSummary: Korvest Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in hot dip galvanizing, sheet metal fabrication, and the manufacture of cable and pipe support systems and fittings. It operates through two segments: Industrial Products and Production. The Industrial Products segment includes the manufacture of electrical and cable support systems and steel fabrication. It includes the EzyStrut business. The Production segment represents the Korvest Galvanizing business, which provides hot dip galvanizing services. In the Industrial Products segment, the EzyStrut cable and pipe support business supplies products for infrastructure developments and also supplies products to electrical wholesalers and contractors for small industrial developments. The Company provides solutions across infrastructure, commercial, utilities, mining, food processing, oil and gas, power stations, health and industrial segments. Korvest Galvanizers operates a hot dip galvanizing business in South Australia.

name: G8 EDUCATION
businessSummary: G8 Education Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the operation of early childhood education and care centers. The Company has around 399 total centers with more than 36,000 children attending it. Its brands include Bambinos, Buggles, Casa Bambini, Community Kids, Creative Garden, Early Learning Services, First Grammar, Great Beginnings, Greenwood, Headstart Early Learning Centre, Jellybeans Childcare, Kinder Haven, Kindy Patch Kids, Kool Kids, NurtureOne, Pelicans, Pelican Childcare, Penguin Childcare, Sandcastles Childcare, The Learning Sanctuary and World of Learning. The Company’s childcare locations include Sydney, Newcastle, Melbourne, Brisbane, Gold Coast, Adelaide and Perth. Its subsidiaries include Grasshoppers Early Learning Centres Pty Ltd, Togalog Pty Ltd, Bourne Learning Pty Ltd, Ramsay Bourne Licences Pty Ltd, World of Learning Licences Pty Ltd, Shemlex Investment Unit Trust, and others.

name: CYCLOPHARM
businessSummary: Cyclopharm Limited is an Australia-based radiopharmaceutical company. The Company's principal activity is engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical equipment and radiopharmaceuticals, including associated research and development and distribution of third-party products to the diagnostic imaging sector. Its Technegas product is a broad-spectrum diagnostic lung imaging technology for visualization of pulmonary ventilation and lung function. It includes the sale of diagnostic equipment and consumables used by physicians in the detection of pulmonary embolism and other respiratory conditions. The Company uses Technegas technology, which is a structured ultra-fine dispersion of radioactive labelled carbon, produced by using driedTechnetium-99m in a carbon crucible. Company distributes its products in approximately 65 countries.

name: IMMURON
businessSummary: Immuron Limited is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing orally delivered targeted polyclonal antibodies for the treatment of infectious diseases. It operates through two segments: Research and development (R&D), and Hyperimmune products. The R&D segment is focused on R&D projects performed in Australia and the United States. Hyperimmune products segment is engaged in Travelan and Protectyn activities which occur predominantly in Australia, the United States and Canada. Its flagship products consist of Travelan and Protectyn. Travelan is an orally administered passive immunotherapy that prophylactically reduces the likelihood of contracting traveler’s diarrhea and is sold in pharmacies throughout Australia. Protectyn is sold online and in health practitioner clinics and is marketed as an immune supplement to help maintain a healthy digestive function and liver. Its clinical programs include Travelan (IMM-124E), and IMM-529.

name: PREMIER INVESTMENTS
businessSummary: Premier Investments Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates a number of specialty retail fashion chains within the specialty retail fashion markets in Australia, New Zealand, Asia and Europe. It also has investments in listed securities and money market deposits. It operates through two business segments: investments and retail. The retail segment represents the financial performance of a number of specialty retail fashion chains. The investment segment represents investments in securities for both long- and short-term gains, dividend income and interest. It owns Australian retail brands, such as Peter Alexander and Smiggle. Smiggle is a children’s stationery brand. Smiggle operates over 300 standalone stores across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. It also provides electrical consumer products. Its subsidiaries include Kimtara Investments Pty Ltd, Premfin Pty Ltd, Springdeep Investments Pty Ltd and others.

name: LAWFINANCE
businessSummary: LawFinance Limited is an Australia-based provider of finance solutions for the legal industry in the United States. The Company, through its subsidiary, National Health Finance HoldCo, LLC (NHF), operates a medical lien funding business in the United States. NHF purchases medical liens generally related to the provision of medical services to individuals involved in motor vehicle accidents where the services are required due to an injury sustained in the accident and where those individuals were the not-at-fault party (except in Michigan, which is a not-at-fault state). NHF's funding solution enables medical providers to maintain liquidity and reduce the administrative burden by managing medical claims through the litigation process. NHF's funding solution is also of benefit to the lawyers acting on behalf of the injured party as it ensures there is no gap in medical care and the claim can be maximized. Its subsidiaries include JustKapital STL Pty and JustKapital NHF USA Holdings.

name: BOTANIX PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: Botanix Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based dermatology company. The Company’s lead product is Sofdra (sofpironium) topical gel, 12.45%, a prescription anticholinergic medicine used on the skin (topical), to treat excessive underarm sweating (primary axillary hyperhidrosis) in adults and children nine years of age and older. Sofdra regulates sweating at the site of application, by binding to the primary sweat receptor and thereby blocking the sweat signal. Its product pipeline targets the various skin diseases, such as BTX 1503 for Acne, BTX 1702 for Rosacea, BTX 1204A for Atopic Dermatitis, and BTX 1801 for Hemodialysis Patients. Its BTX 1503 is a transdermal gel formulation for the treatment of serious acne in adults and teenagers. BTX 1702 is used for the treatment of papulopustular rosacea. BTX 1801 is an antimicrobial gel focused on targeting Staphylococcus Aureus and Methicillin Resistant Staphylococcus Aureus (MRSA).

name: GRAINCORP
businessSummary: GrainCorp Limited is engaged in the integrated grain and edible oils business with a presence in grain storage and handling business in East Coast Australia (ECA) and is an edible oil processor and oilseed crusher in Australia and New Zealand. It has created a global supply chain with infrastructure assets that store, process and facilitate the transportation of grains and edible oils. Its Agribusiness segment is a grain and oilseed storage and handling network located on the ECA with diversified international grain and oilseed origination and destination capabilities. The key commodities and products handled and traded by this segment include wheat, coarse grains (including barley, sorghum and corn), oilseeds, pulses and organics. The Nutrition & Energy segment includes integrated business comprising of edible oils crushing, processing, manufacturing, distribution and trading of animal fats, and used cooking oils and vegetable oils to supply products to food, feed and fuel customers.

name: L1 GROUP
businessSummary: L1 Group Ltd, formerly Platinum Asset Management Limited, is an Australia-based global independent investment manager. The Company is a provider of listed equities and alternative investment strategies. It seeks to deliver this through breed investment strategies and remaining fully aligned with its clients.

name: CULLEN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Cullen Resources Limited is an Australia-based minerals explorer with drill ready targets for gold and base metals in several prospective terranes in Western Australia. The Company holds a multi-commodity portfolio including projects managed through a number of joint ventures with key partners (Rox, Fortescue, Capella and Lachlan Star), and a number of projects in its own right. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiary Cullen Exploration Pty Ltd, holds exploration tenements and applications in prospective, mineralized regions in Western Australia, exploring for gold, base metals and rare-element pegmatites. Its key projects include Wongan Hills, North Tuckabianna, Barlee, Bromus South, Mt Eureka JV, Killaloe JV, and Finland. Wongan Hills Project is located 200 kilometers northeast of Perth in the Western Yilgarn province. The North Tuckabianna project lies along gold corridor stretching between Cue and Meekatharra.

name: AGL ENERGY
businessSummary: AGL Energy Limited is an Australia-based company, which operates an electricity generation portfolio, comprising coal and gas-fired generation, renewable energy sources such as wind, hydro and solar, and others. The Company also owns an electric vehicle (EV) software platform. The Company's segments include Customer Markets, Integrated Energy and Investments. The Customer Markets segment comprises the consumer and large business customer portfolios responsible for the retailing of electricity, gas, broadband/mobile/voice, solar and energy efficiency products and services to residential, small and large business customers. The Integrated Energy segment operates its power generation portfolio and other key assets, including coal, gas, wind and hydro generation facilities, grid-scale batteries, natural gas storage and production facilities, and development projects. The Investments segment comprises its interests in the ActewAGL Retail Partnership, Tilt Renewables, and other investments.

businessSummary: Generation Development Group Limited engages in the diversified financial service business in Australia. The company operates through Benefit Funds Management and Funds Administration (Generation Life), Research and Ratings (Lonsec), and Managed Account Businesses (Evidentia) segments. It offers investment-linked savings and retirement income solutions  and investment bond products, funeral bond products, and investment-linked lifetime annuities, as well as investment research, ratings, governance, and portfolio services, which connect financial advisers, fund managers, and super funds with tools, data, and insights. The company also provides outsourced investment management, portfolio construction, and tailored managed account solutions. The company was formerly known as Austock Group Limited and changed its name to Generation Development Group Limited in March 2018. Generation Development Group Limited was founded in 1991 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.

name: CLOSE THE LOOP
businessSummary: Close the Loop Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in creating products and packaging that include recyclable and made-from recycled content. The Company collects, sorts, reclaims and reuses resources that would otherwise go to landfills. The Company is primarily involved in collection and recycling of electronic equipment, imaging consumables, plastics, paper and cartons and any other activity incidental thereto as well as providing premium and innovative flexible and carton packaging, flexographic print packaging, seafood packaging, storage solutions and the supply of thermal paper and associated paper products. Its products include RFlex and TonerPlas. It offers end-to-end solutions across packaging and consumables to a variety of markets, with advanced innovation in product development, as well as end-of-life take-back and recovery systems for complex commodities to reduce waste to landfills. It also offers battery collection and recycling services.

name: MAYFIELD GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Mayfield Group Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides electrical and telecommunications infrastructure products and services in Australia. It offers electrical test instruments for power quality analysis, fault finding, and system diagnostics  uninterruptible power supplies for backup power during outages and maintaining continuous operations for critical facilities  and battery products and management systems, such as testing, maintenance, and replacement services. The company also provides critical power equipment, including generators, dc power systems, and computer room air conditioning for reliable backup power  calibration services for electrical laboratory and field test equipment  and installation, maintenance, and repair services for equipment-only suppliers. Mayfield Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1936 and is based in Edinburgh, Australia.

name: PLAYSIDE STUDIOS
businessSummary: PlaySide Studios Limited is a video game developer and publishing studio. The Company develops video games for multiple platforms including mobile, personal computer/console, virtual reality and mixed reality, with a portfolio of approximately 60 titles. The Company publishes its own games based on original intellectual property, as well as providing end-to-end game development services in collaboration with AAA game studios and technology and entertainment companies, such as Activision Blizzard, Meta, Netflix Games and Take Two Interactive. The Company also has a Publishing arm which provides funding, development support, marketing and publishing of third-party games from smaller independent studios. Its games include Age of Darkness (PlaySide), Mouse (Fumi Games), Warcraft 3 (Blizzard Entertainment), The Walking Dead (Skydance Interactive), Kill Knight (PlaySide), Dumb Ways to Die (PlaySide Mobile), Dynasty of the Sands (Rocket Flair Studios) and Archangel (Skydance Interactive).

name: WOODSIDE ENERGY GROUP
businessSummary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is a global energy company. Its segments include Australia, International, Marketing and Corporate. The Australia segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of liquefied natural gas, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids. International segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of LPG, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in international jurisdictions outside of Australia. Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing, shipping and trading of its oil and gas portfolio. Its projects include Pluto LNG, North West Shelf Project, Woodside Solar, Scarborough Energy Project, Beaumont New Ammonia Project, Sangomar, and others. It holds an interest in Woodside Louisiana LNG, which is an under-construction LNG production and export terminal in Lake Charles, Louisiana. The Sangomar oil and gas is located 100 kilometers south of Dakar.

name: WOODSIDE ENERGY GROUP
businessSummary: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is a global energy company. Its segments include Australia, International, Marketing and Corporate. The Australia segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of liquefied natural gas, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids. International segment is engaged in the exploration, evaluation, development, production and sale of LPG, pipeline gas, crude oil and condensate and natural gas liquids in international jurisdictions outside of Australia. Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing, shipping and trading of its oil and gas portfolio. Its projects include Pluto LNG, North West Shelf Project, Woodside Solar, Scarborough Energy Project, Beaumont New Ammonia Project, Sangomar, and others. It holds an interest in Woodside Louisiana LNG, which is an under-construction LNG production and export terminal in Lake Charles, Louisiana. The Sangomar oil and gas is located 100 kilometers south of Dakar.

name: CETTIRE
businessSummary: Cettire Limited is an Australia-based global online retailer. The Company is engaged in offering a selection of in demand personal luxury goods via its Website, cettire.com. It has access to an extensive catalogue of more than 2,500 luxury brands and 500,000 products of clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. It sells a range of products from over 500 designers, which include a range of women's and men's wear from brands, such as Prada, Gucci, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, and Valentino, among others. The Company's product categories include clothing, shoes, bags, and accessories. Its clothing category offers activewear, coats, jackets, jeans, knitwear, pants, and various others. Its shoes category offers boots, espadrilles, lace-up shoes, loafers, and various others. The Company’s bags category offers bag accessories, belt bags, clutch bags, crossbody bags and various others. The Company also offers accessories, such as belts, glasses, gloves, hats, and various others.

name: MANDRAKE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Mandrake Resources Limited is an Australia-based explorer focused on advancing its lithium project in the Paradox Basin in south-eastern Utah, United States. The Company’s segments include Utah Lithium Project, Jimperding Ni-Cu-PGE Project and Berinka Pine Creek Gold Project. The Utah Lithium Project is located in the Paradox Basin in south-eastern Utah and covers approximately 93,755 acres. The Utah Lithium Project also incorporates the Lisbon Valley uranium mining district. The Jimperding Project lies approximately 30 kilometers (km) east of Chalice Gold Mines Limited’s (Chalice) Julimar Ni-Cu-PGE discovery in the Jimperding Metamorphic Belt located 70 km northeast of Perth. Berinka Pine Creek Gold Project covers an approximately 289km2 exploration license in the under-explored western limb of the Pine Creek Orogen, Northern Territory, 180 km south of Darwin.

name: CORPORATE TRAVEL MANAGEMENT
businessSummary: Corporate Travel Management Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides business travel management services. The principal activities of the Company consist of managing the procurement and delivery of travel and accommodation agency services for its clients. The Company’s segments include Australia and New Zealand, North America, Asia, and Europe. Its services include global corporate travel, and global meetings and events management. The Company designs global travel programs that design services and solutions for global business travel. The Company's technology framework enables it to integrate a range of tools into one travel portal, providing its global customers with a single, customized and configurable platform that meets the needs of users for maximum adoption, compliance and user-experience. The Company's specialist meetings and events division, event travel management (ETM), consolidates its meetings and events expenditure.

name: VEEM
businessSummary: VEEM Limited (VEEM) is an Australia-based company, which is a designer and manufacturer of high-technology marine propulsion and stabilization systems for the global luxury motor yacht, fast ferry, commercial workboat, and defense industries. The Company is also engaged in manufacturing engineered products and services for the marine, defense, and mining industries. It operates various businesses, including VEEM Marine Propellers, VEEM Marine Gyrostabilizers, VEEM 24-7 Engineering, Defense, Timcast Hollowbar, Conquest Propellers, and SHARROW by VEEM. VEEM is a producer of high-performance propellers for inboard powered vessels. It is a manufacturer of specialized fin systems and components for defense, including the US Navy's LCS ride control foils and submarine valves and mufflers. VEEM is a manufacturing demonstrator propeller blades for the BAE type-26 Hunter Class frigate program. VEEM was also involved in the Large Hadron Collider and the Atlas Detector's Radiation Shield Doors.

name: PLS GROUP
businessSummary: PLS Group Limited is an Australia-based global producer of lithium materials, with a diversified portfolio of assets and strategic partnerships in the battery materials sector. The Company owns 100% of the independent hard-rock lithium operation, the Pilgangoora Operation in Australia, and the Colina Lithium Project in Brazil. The Company is also integrated into the lithium value chain through its joint venture with POSCO in South Korea, which manufactures battery-grade lithium hydroxide. The Company also owns Salinas group of lithium properties, which includes the Baixa Grande lithium resource, located in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The Pilgangoora Operation is its flagship hard rock lithium asset, located approximately 140 kilometers south-east of Port Hedland in Western Australia's Pilbara region, on Nyamal and Kariyarra Country. The Company's Colina Project is an early-stage hard rock lithium mining project located near Salinas in the state of Minas Gerais, Brazil.

name: LEGACY IRON ORE
businessSummary: Legacy Iron Ore Limited is an Australia-based exploration company, focused on the development of iron ore, gold, and base metal deposits. Its projects include Mt Bevan, South Laverton and East Kimberley. The Mt Bevan Project is the Company’s flagship project, comprising a single tenement located approximately 100 kilometers (km) west of Leonore in the Yilgarn region of Western Australia with close proximity to existing projects, road, rail and port facilities. Its South Laverton project includes Mt Celia Project, Yilgangi Project, Yerilla Project, Patricia North Project and Sunrise Bore project. The Sunrise Bore project lies some 12 km east of the world-class Sunrise Dam gold mine operated by AngloGold Ashanti. The East Kimberly Project is located in the Halls Creek area, approximately 350 km south of Kununurra and is readily accessible via the Great Northern Highway. The project comprises Koognie Park, Sophie Downs, Ruby Plains and Taylor Lookout tenements.

name: SOUTH32
businessSummary: South32 Limited is a mining and metals company engaged in the exploration, development, production and processing of minerals and metals. Its portfolio includes operations and projects producing alumina, aluminium, copper, silver, lead, zinc and manganese. The Company operates through segments including Sierra Gorda, Cannington, Hermosa, Australia Manganese, South Africa Manganese, Worsley Alumina, Brazil Alumina, Brazil Aluminium, Hillside Aluminium and Mozal Aluminium. Sierra Gorda comprises a copper mining operation in Chile; Cannington consists of silver, lead and zinc mining operations in Australia; Hermosa is a base metals development project in the United States; Australia Manganese and South Africa Manganese are manganese mining operations. The Company also operates alumina refineries, bauxite mining operations and aluminium smelters in Australia, Brazil, South Africa and Mozambique.

name: OVANTI
businessSummary: Ovanti Limited provides fintech and digital commerce software and services that enable institutional customers to authenticate end-user customers and process banking, purchase, and payment transactions in Malaysia. It offers mobile banking, messaging, digital payments and enterprise technology services to banks, telecommunications providers and corporate customers. The company was formerly known as IOUpay Limited and changed its name to Ovanti Limited in January 2024. Ovanti Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Double Bay, Australia.

name: VERBREC
businessSummary: Verbrec Limited is an Australia-based engineering, asset management, project delivery, operations and maintenance, training and mining technology service provider that supports customers across Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea and beyond. The Company serves the energy, infrastructure, and mining industries through their technical specialties; asset management, automation and control, pipelines, power, process plant and training, with capabilities that span across the entire life cycle of an asset. It operates through two segments: Engineering services and Training services. The Company's services include engineering, asset management, infrastructure and industry training. It provides engineering and project delivery solutions to clients. Its infrastructure services offer full lifecycle services for project delivery from inception through procurement and/or construction, commissioning, operations and maintenance. Its StacksOn product is a digital twin for stockyards.

name: ALFABS AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Alfabs Australia Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company provides fabrication, construction and maintenance services, mining equipment and services, protective coatings, transport and logistics, and consumables. Its segments include Mining, Engineering, and Other. The Mining segment manufactures, repairs, overhaul servicing, and hire of underground mining and ancillary equipment, together with sales of mining-related consumables and spare parts. The Engineering segment is engaged in heavy steel fabrication, site installation work and site-based maintenance. Its Other activities include ancillary businesses, including protective coatings and transport. Its products include Structure Pod, Mesh Pod, Auger, Belt Splicing Pod, Bucket 2.1 Eject, Bucket 3.1 Eject, Bucket MH40 - The Hungry Hippo, CABA Quick Fill Pod, CABA Storage Pod, Cable Boat, Clan Clamp, Chain Locker, Concrete Kibble, and others.

name: EML PAYMENTS
businessSummary: EML Payments Limited is an Australia-based company, which provides a global payment solutions platform. The Company offers program management and payments to create customizable solutions for businesses, brands and their customers. Its segments include North America, Europe, and Asia Pac. The North America segment provides provision of prepaid payment services, predominantly with single-load card solutions, to its customers in the United States and Canada. The Europe segment provides provision of reloadable and non-reloadable prepaid payment solutions to customers in Europe and the United Kingdom. The Asia Pac segment provides the provision of prepaid payment services to customers in Australia and New Zealand. It offers a range of products and payment options, including banking, credit, and disbursements services, earned wage access, gifts, incentives and rewards and FX solutions. Its products include Card Payments, Open Banking, Digital Account Payments and Seamless.

name: CENTURIA CAPITAL GROUP
businessSummary: Centuria Capital Group is an Australia-based specialist investment manager. The Company delivers a range of products and services to investors, advisers and security holders. The Company offers a range of investment opportunities, including listed and unlisted real estate funds as well as tax-effective investment bonds. Its principal activities are the marketing and management of investment products including property investment funds and friendly society investment bonds, as well as co-investments in property investment funds. Its segments include Property funds management, Co-investments, Developments, Property and development finance, Investment bonds management and Corporate. Property Funds Management segment is engaged in the management of listed and unlisted property funds. Developments segment manages development projects and completion of structured property developments, which span sectors ranging from commercial office, industrial, health through to residential mixed use.

name: ATTURRA
businessSummary: Atturra Limited is an Australia-based advisory and technology solutions provider. The Company is engaged in the technology business, providing a range of enterprise advisory, consulting, information technology (IT) services and solutions with a focus on local government, utilities, education, defense, federal government, financial services, and manufacturing industries. Its advisory and consulting capabilities across three areas include strategy and preparation, design and implementation, and realization and improvement. Its business applications capabilities include enterprise resource planning, process optimization for local government, professional services, safety solutions, and others. Its data and integration capabilities include intelligent integration and automation, enterprise data management, advanced analytics, middleware modernization, and others. Its managed services include cloud, modern workplace, among others.

name: SUPER RETAIL GROUP
businessSummary: Super Retail Group Limited is an Australia-based company primarily involved in the retail industry. The Company's principal activities include retailing of auto parts and accessories, tools and equipment, retailing of boating, camping, outdoor equipment, fishing equipment and apparel, and retailing of sporting equipment and apparel. Its segments include Supercheap Auto (SCA), rebel, BCF and Macpac. Its Supercheap Auto (SCA) segment is engaged in retailing auto parts and accessories, tools and equipment. Its rebel segment is engaged in the retailing of sporting equipment and apparel. Its BCF segment is engaged in the retailing of boating, camping, outdoor equipment, fishing equipment and apparel. Its Macpac segment is engaged in retailing apparel, camping and outdoor equipment. The Company operates in Australia, New Zealand, and China.

name: ARENA REIT
businessSummary: Arena REIT is an ASX200 listed property group that develops, owns and manages social infrastructure properties across Australia. Our current portfolio of social infrastructure properties is leased to a diversified tenant base in the growing childcare and healthcare sectors. Arena REIT was established on August 27, 2003 and incorporated in Australia.

name: COMET RIDGE
businessSummary: Comet Ridge Limited engages in the oil and gas exploration, appraisal, and development activities in Australia. The company's flagship property is the Mahalo Gas Hub, which comprises 2 reserves and 2 contingent resources totaling 676 petajoules located in southern Bowen Basin in Queensland. Comet Ridge Limited is based in Brisbane, Australia.

name: QANTAS AIRWAYS
businessSummary: Qantas Airways Limited is an International and Domestic Air Transportation Services. Its Segment includes Qantas Domestic, Qantas International, Jetstar Group, Qantas Loyalty, Corporate. The Qantas Domestic segment consists of Qantas Domestic and QantasLink. Qantas Domestic full-service airline serving Australian capitals, cities, regional hubs under the Qantas brand. QantasLink services metropolitan and regional transport destinations. The Qantas International segment consists of Qantas International and Qantas Freight. Qantas International is a full-service international airline providing transportation between Australia and New Zealand, Asia, North and South America, Africa and Europe. Qantas Freight provides air freight services. Jetstar Group is the Qantas Group's low-cost airline brand. Qantas Loyalty includes diverse brands focused on customer loyalty programs. Corporate includes centralized management, governance, support functions, and overheads.

isin: SER.AX|Strategic Energy Resources Limited|SER.AX|Strategic Energy Resources Limited
name: STRATEGIC ENERGY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Strategic Energy Resources Limited engages in the exploration of mineral properties in Australia. The company's principal activities include the identification, acquisition, and exploration of projects, such as Isa North, Canobie, Bulimba, and Diamantina in Queensland. The company also focuses on exploring copper, gold, nickel, and mineral sands. Strategic Energy Resources Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in South Melbourne, Australia.

name: REGIONAL EXPRESS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Regional Express Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of air services, including the transportation of passengers and freight, along with pilot training. The Company's segments include regular public transport, charter and other, and training. The Company has a regional and domestic airline, Rex, operating a fleet of approximately 57 Saab 340 and nine Boeing 737-800 NG aircraft to 56 destinations throughout all states in Australia. In addition to the airline Rex, the Company comprises wholly owned subsidiaries, including two pilot academies, Australian Airline Pilot Academy with campuses in Wagga Wagga and Ballarat, and a propeller maintenance organization, Australian Aerospace Propeller Maintenance.

name: WINCHESTER ENERGY
businessSummary: Winchester Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration and production company with operations in West Texas, USA. It controls over 2,600 acres in the Permian Basin, producing predominantly from the Strawn Formation but also from the Ellenburger and Cisco Formations. It operates 26 wells and has interests in another 10 non-operating wells. Its projects include Nolan County and Jocelyn - Varn. The East Permian Basin contains a number of stacked oil and gas reservoirs and its leased acreage in Nolan County has significant oil resource potential across a host of historically productive formations, such as the Fry/Strawn Sands as well as the thick Penn Carbonate, Wolfcamp 'D' organic shales, Crystal Falls (Canyon), and Cisco formations. The Company has a 70% working interest in the Jocelyn - Varn waterflood project in Taylor County, Texas. The project is located 18 miles to the east of its Nolan County acreage.

name: STREAMPLAY STUDIO
businessSummary: Streamplay Studio Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the development and operation of online eSport gaming platforms. The Company’s activities include development, publishing, and distribution of interactive digital entertainment across both Tier one gaming storefronts and telco value-added services. The Company is also a provider of competitive gaming and cloud streaming technologies. Its platforms support telco-integrated services such as mGames in the Pacific Islands, PlayStream in the UAE and MTN Arena and Arena Plus in South Africa. It owns North America based Noodlecake Studios, a game developer and publisher. Its broader operations include development and publishing, esports, streaming, and telco-aligned gaming services across North America, Australia, the Middle East, Africa, and the Pacific Islands.

name: JANISON EDUCATION GROUP
businessSummary: Janison Education Group Limited operates within the education technology sector globally. Its principal activities include the provision of a digital assessment platform and assessment services (invigilation, marking, test development and exam management) as well as the sale of assessment products, such as International Competitions and Assessments for Schools (ICAS), Academic Assessment Services (AAS)/Allwell and Quality Assessment Tasks (QATs). The Company operates two business units: Product and Platform. The Product segment provides exam products, exam items and associated exam services which are sold to schools, parents and teachers. The Platform segment operates exam enterprise-grade assessment platform technology and event management services for large organizations, national education authorities and accreditation bodies. The Company’s core customer segment is the Schools market (K-12) in Australia, Singapore and the United Kingdom.

name: SYMAL GROUP
businessSummary: Symal Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is in public and private infrastructure and offers a comprehensive range of services, including contracting, plant and equipment hire, material sales, recycling, and remediation services. Its services provide an end-to-end civil construction solution with touchpoints across the entire construction project lifecycle under four main brands - Symal, Sycle, Unyte and Wamarra (49% owned). Its segments are Contracting Services segment delivers construction projects in a variety of sectors, including public infrastructure, building and construction, roads and bridges, inland and marine ports, airports, energy and defense; Plant & Equipment segment provides internal and external construction crews, including supervision and project management support, as well as wet or dry plant hire, in a variety of sectors, and other segment provides recycling and remediation service includes materials transport and skip bin hire and collection.

name: MGX RESOURCES
businessSummary: MGX Resources Ltd is an Australia-based independent mid-tier miner and mining project developer. The Company’s flagship operation, Koolan Island, is located in the Buccaneer Archipelago 140 kilometers (km) north of Derby. It has 50% interest in the advanced Central Tanami Project Joint Venture (CTPJV) and adjacent wholly owned exploration tenements in the Northern Territory. The Company also holds precious and base metals exploration tenements in the Mid-West and Gascoyne regions of Western Australia.

isin: HDN.AX|HomeCo Daily Needs REIT|HDN.AX|HomeCo Daily Needs REIT
name: HOMECO DAILY NEEDS REIT
businessSummary: HomeCo Daily Needs REIT is an Australian Real Estate Investment Trust listed on the ASX with a mandate to invest in convenience-based assets across the target sub-sectors of Neighbourhood Retail, Large Format Retail and Health & Services. HomeCo Daily Needs REIT aims to provide unitholders with consistent and growing distributions. HomeCo Daily Needs REIT(ASX:HDN) operates independently of Home Consortium Limited as of December 31, 2020.

name: ACCENT GROUP
businessSummary: Accent Group Limited is an Australia-based digitally integrated consumer business in the retail and distribution sectors of branded performance and lifestyle footwear, apparel and accessories. The Company operates approximately 847 stores across 19 different retail banners, and distribution rights for 11 international brands across Australia and New Zealand. The Company operates through two segments: Retail and Wholesale. The Retail segment is engaged in selling of footwear and apparel directly to consumers. The Wholesale segment is engaged in selling of footwear and apparel in bulk internally and to other businesses. The Company's banners and brands include Skechers, The Athlete’s Foot (TAF), Platypus Shoes, Genuins, Hype DC, Merrell, Vans, Dr. Martens, Saucony, Timberland, HOKA, Norda, ODE, Subtype, Stylerunner, Nude Lucy, Glue Store and UGG.

name: BRAIIN
businessSummary: Braiin Limited operates as an agriculture and analytics services company that provides solutions to improve farming productivity using IoTs, Wireless Connectivity, Robotics, Software, and AI/ML in Australia and New Zealand. It has strategic partnership with Muval to support and expand residential lifecycle opportunities in the United Kingdom and United States. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Subiaco, Australia. As of March 20, 2023, Braiin Limited operates as a subsidiary of Northern Revival Acquisition Corporation.

name: OVANTI
businessSummary: Ovanti Limited provides financial technology and digital commerce software solutions and services. The Company enables its institutional customers to authenticate customers and process banking, purchase and payment transactions. The Company’s platform enables customer communities to connect to end user customers using any mobile device and integrates mobile technology throughout its existing business and customer product offerings. Its business divisions consist of Mobile Banking and Digital Payments, which serve banks in Malaysia, and telecommunications and corporates in Malaysia and Indonesia. It also works with telecommunications network providers to provide mobile over-the-top (OTT) services that leverage their subscriber base to build active communities. Its fintech solutions serve institutional clients, ensuring secure customer authentication and facilitating banking, purchases, and payments. It is also operating buy now, pay later services (BNPL) in the United States.

name: KANTRA COPPER
businessSummary: Kantra Copper Limited, formerly Hillgrove Resources Limited, is an Australia-based mining company and also focused on copper production from the Kanmantoo Underground Copper Mine in South Australia. The Company's flagship project, The Kanmantoo Underground project, is located approximately 55km from Adelaide. The Kanmantoo Copper Mine, located in the mining jurisdiction of South Australia, has quickly ramped up to an annual copper production rate of approximately 12,000 tons and is well-capitalized with a 3.6 million tons per annum processing plant. The Company holds 100 % of a series of Exploration Licenses covering over 4,187 square kilometers in south-east South Australia alongside 311 square kilometers surrounding the Kanmantoo Mine and the northern Mount Lofty Ranges in the Cambrian-Ordovician Kanmantoo Province.

name: SWOOP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Swoop Holdings Limited is an Australia-based Internet service provider with mobile and national broadband network (NBN) products. It also services the residential and small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) broadband markets through its fixed wireless and fiber infrastructure as a fixed wireless network provider. It designs, builds and services its own residential infrastructure, including towers, and with mobile and NBN as flagship products. Its principal activities include the provision of services over the NBN fixed line and fixed wireless networks; fiber network management and construction, and fixed wireless access as well as wholesale transit services to other Internet service providers (ISPs) and telecommunications companies. Through its subsidiary, Telco Pay Pty Ltd (Moose Mobile), the Company provides mobile services. It also operates a fixed wireless, fiber and wholesale network infrastructure carrier with the national network.

name: BWP TRUST
businessSummary: BWP Trust (the Trust) is an Australia-based real estate investment trust, which is engaged in investing in and managing commercial properties throughout Australia. The Trust’s objective is to provide unitholders with a secure and growing income stream and long-term capital growth. The Trust’s properties are large format retailing properties, in particular, Bunnings Warehouses, leased to Bunnings Group Limited (Bunnings). Bunnings is a retailer of home improvement and outdoor living products in Australia and New Zealand, and a supplier to project builders, commercial trades people, and the housing industry. The Trust is an owner of Bunnings Warehouse sites in Australia, with a portfolio of 61 stores. Seven of the properties have adjacent retail showrooms that the Trust owns and are leased to other tenants. The Trust also owns six large format retail showroom properties, three industrial properties and has three vacant properties.

name: SOLVAR
businessSummary: Solvar Limited is an Australia-based consumer and commercial finance company, which is engaged in the delivery of secured automotive loans as well as secured and unsecured personal loans. The Company operates through two segments: Australia and New Zealand. The Australia segment provides lending facilities in Australia generally based on the provision of an underlying asset as security, generally referred through a broker or distributed directly through digital channels. The New Zealand segment provides lending facilities in New Zealand generally based on the provision of an underlying asset as security, generally referred through a dealer. The Company operates through three business units in Australia - Money3, Automotive Financial Services (AFS) and Bennji; and one business unit in New Zealand - Go Car Finance. Money3, AFS and Bennji business units operate in Australia with broker networks and direct as primary distribution channels.

name: ORDINARY FULLY PAID EX OPTION DEFERRED G
JUMBO INTERACTIVE
businessSummary: Jumbo Interactive Limited is a digital lottery specialist. The Company provides its lottery software platforms and lottery management expertise to the charity and government lottery sectors in Australia and globally. Its segments include Lottery Retailing, which services business-to-consumer (B2C), Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), which services business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-government (B2G), Managed Services, which services B2B, and Dream Giveaways, which services B2C. Lottery Retailing is engaged in the sale of Australian national lottery and charity lottery tickets online and on mobile devices to customers in Australia and eligible overseas jurisdictions. SaaS is focused on development, supply and maintenance of SaaS for authorized businesses, charities and governments in the lottery market in Australia. The Managed Services is engaged in provision of lottery-related services for authorized businesses and charities in the lottery market.

name: INFRAGREEN GROUP
businessSummary: Infragreen Group Limited is an Australia-based diversified infrastructure company. The Company owns, operates and holds interests in sustainable infrastructure businesses across Australia and New Zealand. The Company backs infrastructure businesses across clean energy, energy transition, and recycling and waste management. The Company's platform of infrastructure businesses includes Pure Environmental, Minemet, Energybuild and Merredin Energy. Pure Environmental business includes recycling and waste recovery (regulated waste recycling).
