Minemet is a vertically integrated recycling company that collects, processes and exports ferrous and non-ferrous metals from Australia and New Zealand. Energybuild business includes clean energy and energy transition. Energybuild is an installer of new build solar, working with manufacturers and builders to provide homeowners with new energy solutions. Merredin Energy business includes clean energy and energy transition (peaking power).

name: GROUP 6 METALS
businessSummary: Group 6 Metals Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration and development company. The Company is focused on producing high-grade tungsten concentrate from its 100%-owned Dolphin Mine located on King Island, Tasmania. The Dolphin Tungsten Mine is located near the town of Grassy on the south-east coast of King Island, the most western large island in the Bass Strait between Victoria and Tasmania. The hosts the highest-grade tungsten deposit of size in the western world. Scheelite (tungsten) within the Dolphin mining area occurs within carbonate-rich Mine Series rocks in close proximity to the Grassy Granite and against controlling faults. The Company holds the exploration license EL19/2001 at Grassy, King Island (63 square kilometers) and mining lease CML 2080P/M at Grassy, King Island.

name: NEW HOPE
businessSummary: New Hope Corporation Limited is a coal producer with associated port, oil and gas, and agricultural operations. The Company operates the Bengalla Mine in New South Wales and the New Acland Mine in southeast Queensland, with coal primarily exported to customers in Asia. Its agricultural enterprises are located near its coal mines. Its Coal Mining in Queensland segment includes mining-related production, processing, transportation, port operations and marketing. Its Coal Mining in New South Wales segment includes mining-related production, processing, transportation, marketing, exploration. Its Other segments include coal exploration outside existing operational areas, oil and gas-related exploration, development and production, pastoral operations, treasury and administration. The Bengalla Mine is located four kilometers south-west of Muswellbrook in New South Wales. New Acland Mine is an open-cut thermal coal mine located 27 kilometers north-west of Oakey in southeast Queensland.

name: LENDLEASE GROUP
businessSummary: LendLease Group is an integrated real estate business, with an international investment management capability. The Company's Investments segment includes owning and/or managing investments in Australia, Singapore, United Kingdom, Italy, the United States, Malaysia, and Japan. The segment includes an investment management platform and its ownership interests in residential, office, retail, industrial, and infrastructure investment assets. Its Development segment represents development projects in Australia only. Its products and services include the development of inner city mixed use developments, apartments, retail, commercial assets and social and economic infrastructure. Its Construction segment represents the Construction business in Australia only. Its products and services include the provision of project management, design, and construction services. Its Capital Release Unit segment includes overseas construction operations, overseas development projects, and others.

name: SELECT HARVESTS
businessSummary: Select Harvests Limited is an Australia-based vertically integrated almond food company. The Company manufactures, processes and markets almond products for the Australian retail and industrial markets, in addition to exporting almonds globally. It is engaged in growing, processing, packaging and sale of almonds and its by-products from Company-owned and leased almond orchards. It supplies a full range of value-added almond products (blanched, roasted, sliced, diced, meal and paste) in multiple customer categories, including beverage, bakery, confectionery, cereal, snacking, health, dairy (ice cream), re-packers and wholesalers. It supplies both branded and private label products to key retailers, distributors and industrial users. Its brands are Renshaw and Allinga Farms. Its geographically diverse almond orchards are located in Victoria, South Australia and New South Wales. Its portfolio includes over 9,262 hectares of Company-owned, leased and joint venture almond orchards.

name: PEOPLEIN
businessSummary: PeopleIN Limited is an Australian workforce solutions company. The Company's principal activities are the provision of staffing, business services and operational services. The Company's services include workforce management, recruiting, onboarding, contracting, rostering, timesheet management, payroll, and workplace health and safety management. It serves various sectors including education, trades and labor, agriculture and food, finance, tech and IT, and defence. Its specialist early education staffing and recruitment includes Expect a Star, which is an Australian owned provider of early childhood staffing and recruitment for childhood educators and childcare services. AWX is its brand in Trades and Labour, including construction, mining, manufacturing, transport and logistics, hospitality and more across Australia and New Zealand. Regional Workforce Management is the brand in the agriculture and food processing industries, offering recruitment, staffing, and managed services.

name: AUDINATE GROUP
businessSummary: Audinate Group Limited is a developer of Dante audio over IP networking solutions. Its principal activity is the development and sale of digital Audio Visual (AV) networking solutions. Dante is its technology platform that distributes digital audio and video signals over computer networks. Dante comprises software and chips, cards and modules that are sold to and integrated inside the AV products of its original equipment manufacturer customers. It also provides a series of products and services to AV professionals, including AVIO adapters and management and control software. Its Dante IP networking solution is used in the professional live sound, commercial installation, broadcast, public address, and recording industries. Dante replaces traditional analogue audio cables by transmitting perfectly synchronized audio signals across large distances, to multiple locations at once, using nothing more than an Ethernet cable. It also offers AI-powered, cloud-based camera control technology.

name: WASHINGTON H SOUL PATTINSON AND
businessSummary: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Ltd., formerly First Services Company Ltd, is an Australia-based holding company. The Company’s subsidiaries include Brickworks Limited and WHSP Holdings Ltd. Brickworks Limited is a manufacturer and distributor of building products in Australia and North America, with operations spanning bricks, roofing, masonry, and property investments. Its operations are categorized into four segments: Building Products Australia, Building Products North America, Property, and Investments. WHSP Holdings Ltd is a diversified investment company with investments across a range of industries and asset classes. Its investment portfolios include Strategic Investments Portfolio, Large Caps Portfolio, Private Equity Portfolio, Credit Portfolio, Emerging Companies Portfolio, and Property Portfolio. It invests in multiple industries, including building materials, telecommunications, natural resources, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, property and financial services.

name: ARB
businessSummary: ARB Corporation Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs, manufactures, distributes and sells motor vehicle accessories and light metal engineering works. Its product range includes a host of different accessories, from vehicle specific applications to a range of accessories, which are suitable for vehicles. Its products include earth camper; bull bars; side rails and side steps; rear protection, towing and wheel carriers; canopies; UTE lids and tub accessories; roof racks, cross bars and carriers; Old Man Emu 4X4 Suspension; Linx; driving lights; air compressors and tire accessories; air lockers; winches; recovery equipment; recovery points; under vehicle protection; fuel tanks and fuel storage; drawers and cargo solutions; slide kitchen; portable fridge freezers; tents, swags and awnings; camping and touring accessories; UHF radios, GPS and reverse cameras; safari snorkels; dual battery and solar systems; general accessories; interior protection, and merchandise.

name: RIDLEY
businessSummary: Ridley Corporation Limited is an Australia-based animal feed manufacturer. The Company operates through three segments: Bulk Stockfeeds, Packaged Feeds and Ingredients and Fertilizer. The Bulk Stockfeeds segment includes animal nutrition stockfeed solutions delivered in bulk. The Packaged Feeds and Ingredients segment comprises animal nutrition feed and ingredient solutions delivered in packaged form, ranging from one ton down to three-kilogram bags. Its Fertilizer segment sells fertilizers in Eastern Australia and to the export market. Its specialist areas include Bulk Ruminant Stockfeeds, Bulk Monogastric Stockfeeds, Animal Proteins & Oils, Commodities, NovaqPro, Specialty Product Distribution and Primo Aquaculture. Its product range includes Beef, Sheep, Dairy, other Ruminants, supplements & concentrates and partial mixed ration (PMR) & total mixed ration (TMR) smart blends. It is also a provider of dairy feed, cattle feed, and sheep feed.

name: TREASURY WINE ESTATES
businessSummary: Treasury Wine Estates Limited is an Australia-based wine company. The Company is involved in the production, marketing and sale of wine. The Company’s segments include Treasury Premium Brands, Penfolds, and Treasury Americas. The Treasury Premium Brands segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of wine within Australia, Asia, Europe, Canada, the Middle East and Africa. The Penfolds segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of Penfolds wine globally. The Treasury Americas segment is responsible for the manufacture, sale and marketing of wine within North American and Latin America regions. In Australia, it owns and operates six wineries and one packaging facility with wines primarily produced in South Australia and Victoria. In New Zealand, it owns one winery located in Marlborough. Its brands include Penfolds, DAOU Vineyards, 19 Crimes, Drop of Sunshine, Frank Family Vineyards, Etude, Beaulieu Vineyard, and Seppelt.

name: HEALIUS
businessSummary: Healius Limited is a healthcare company. The Company's specialized pathology businesses deliver healthcare services across Australia. It provides pathology services, including specialty pathology and clinical trials. It offers medical laboratory and pathology services through a variety of specialty brands. It provides medical laboratory and pathology services across key diagnostic activities. These include anatomical pathology (histopathology and cytology), clinical pathology (biochemistry, hematology, immunology and microbiology), genomic diagnostics and veterinary pathology. Its brands include Abbot, Agilex Biolabs, Dorevitch, Gastrolab, Genomic Diagnostics, IQ Pathology, Kossard Dermatopathology, Laverty Pathology, QML Pathology, TML Pathology, Vetnostics Pathology and Western Diagnostic Pathology (WDP). These brands operate in Queensland, New South Wales (including the Australian Capital Territory), Victoria, Western Australia and Northern Territory, Tasmania, and South Australia.

name: FLIGHT CENTRE TRAVEL GROUP
businessSummary: Flight Centre Travel Group Limited is a travel retailer and corporate travel manager. The Company's principal activities consist of leisure travel retailing and corporate travel management, plus in-destination travel experience businesses, including tour operations, destination management companies (DMCs) and wholesaling. It also provides meetings and events agency services. The Leisure segment combines the retail storefront and online brands for retail customers, luxury travel brands Travel Associates and Scott Dunn, independent agents and complementary offerings. The Corporate segment includes the FCM brand, corporate traveler and other corporate customer brands. The Global HQ segment includes Brisbane-based and other support businesses, including Supply, that support the global network and also includes In Destination activities which incorporate touring and ground-handling. Its brands include Flight Centre, Aunt Betty, ignite, and Scott Dunn, among others.

name: BENDIGO AND ADELAIDE BANK
businessSummary: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank Limited is an Australia-based banking and financial services company. It is engaged in the provision of a range of banking and other financial services, including consumer, residential, business, rural and commercial lending, deposit taking, payments services, wealth management, margin lending, treasury and foreign exchange services. Its Consumer division focuses on engaging with and servicing its consumer customers and includes the branch network, Up digital bank, mobile relationship managers, third party banking channels, wealth services, cards and payments, home safe and customer support functions. Its Business and Agribusiness segments focus on servicing business customers and includes Business Banking, Portfolio Funding, and Agribusiness, which includes all banking services provided to its agribusiness and farming customers. Corporate includes the results of its support functions including treasury, technology, property services, finance, risk and others.

name: AUSTRALIAN CLINICAL LABS
businessSummary: Australian Clinical Labs Limited is a private provider of pathology services. Its laboratories perform a range of pathology tests each year for a range of clients, including doctors, specialists, patients, hospitals, and corporate clients. It performs a range of services for doctors, patients and corporate clients, including chemical pathology, hematology, histopathology & cytopathology, serology & microbiology, allergy & immunology, molecular cancer testing, genetic carrier screening & other antenatal testing, cardiac testing services, veterinary pathology, functional pathology, and pathology services for clinical trials, among others. Its specialist services include molecular cancer services, obstetrics and gynecology, pharmacogenetic testing, gastroenterology, and hospital services. It has operations in Victoria, New South Wales, Western Australia, South Australia, Queensland, and the Northern Territory. Its SunDoctors brand provides skin cancer care services.

name: TTA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TTA Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is trading via e-commerce and selling to retail customers through TEAC Store Website and various e-commerce platforms. The Company operates through a single segment, which is sale of electronic consumer goods via e-commerce in the Australian market.

name: VICINITY CENTRES
businessSummary: Vicinity Centres is an Australia-based retail property company with a fully integrated asset management platform, and $24 billion in retail assets under management. The Company’s principal activities include investment in a portfolio of retail investment properties. It owns and manages retail destinations across Australia and offers a range of retail, residential, and office spaces. It has a direct portfolio with interests in approximately 51 shopping centers (including the DFO Brisbane business) and manages 26 assets on behalf of Strategic Partners. Its properties include Bankstown Central, Bayside, Buranda Village, Chadstone, DFO Perth, Emporium Melbourne, Queen Victoria Building, QueensPlaza, and The Glen. Its development properties include One Middle Road, Chadstone, Bankstown Central, Victoria Gardens, Box Hill Central, and Chatswood Chase Sydney. Its retail solutions include advertising, brand activations, leasing, and pop-up retail.

name: 29METALS
businessSummary: 29Metals Limited is a copper-focused base and precious metals mining company with producing and exploration assets in Australia and Chile. The principal activities of the Company are mining and mineral production, mineral concentrate sales, mineral exploration and development, and ancillary services. The Gossan Valley project, located 7 km south of Gossan Hill at Golden Grove, comprises multiple deposits including Gossan Valley, Conteville and Grassi. It evaluates the potential to develop one or more of the deposits. The Redhill project, located in Chile, is a 29Metals exploration asset covering a historically under-explored copper region. It hosts mesothermal polymetallic quartz-sulphide veins with copper, silver and precious metals mineralisation. The Cervantes project at Golden Grove lies beneath the Scuddles underground mine, with about 210 meters/ mineralization below existing development. Prefeasibility study supports extending the Scuddles underground mine life.

name: PARAGON CARE
businessSummary: Paragon Care Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the healthcare sector. The Company is a provider of medical equipment, devices, consumables, pharmaceuticals, complementary medicines, nutritional supplies, and manufacturer of Blood Bank diagnostic reagents to the healthcare markets in Australia, New Zealand and Asia. The Company’s geographical segments comprise Australia & New Zealand and Asia. It also offers equipment repair, maintenance and total equipment management through ParagonCare Service & Technology. Its CH2 brand distributes pharmaceutical, medical consumables, nutritional and over the counter products medical equipment and medical supplies. Its product portfolio includes critical care, dental, diagnostic & scientific, medical products & consumables, neonatal, orthopedics, service, surgical, technology & connectivity, urology, veterinary and aesthetics. Its brands include ParagonCare Immulab, ParagonCare Veterinary, Medtek, and Western Biomedical.

name: DUKETON MINING
businessSummary: Duketon Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral resources exploration and development company. Its Barlee Project is in the northern portion of the Archaean Southern Cross Province, approximately 200 (kilometer) km north of Southern Cross in Western Australia. The belt contains several small gold deposits including Mt Dimer, Marda Gold Projects and Penny Mine. Its Killarney Project is located approximately 63 km east of Mount Magnet and 8km north of the former Paynesville townsite. The Penny Mine is located 70 km north-north-west of Barlee. Its Duketon project's tenement package lies along strike and adjacent to Regis Resources' landholding, including the Rosemont, Garden Well and Moolart Well Gold Mines. Its other projects include Doris and Stephens. Doris is located 120 km north-northwest of Meekatharra and covers an area of 168 km2. The tenements cover uranium mineralization within the Despair Granite. Stephens is located 335 km north-northeast of Perth in Western Australia.

name: SOUTHERN CROSS MEDIA GROUP
businessSummary: Southern Cross Media Group Limited is an Australia-based media company. The Company is engaged in the production and broadcast of commercial television and audio content, newspaper publishing, and the operation of associated digital platforms. Its segments include Television, Audio and Publishing. The Publishing segment includes publishers of newspapers and insert magazines in Western Australia; Colourpress; Digital publishing, West Australian Publishers and Perth Now. The Company owns various media businesses and platforms, including the Seven Network and its channels 7two, 7mate, 7flix and 7Bravo; 7plus; 7NEWS.com.au; LiSTNR; the Hit and Triple M radio networks; The Nightly; The West Australian; The Sunday Times; and PerthNow. The Company also owns approximately 104 radio Hit and Triple M stations across FM, AM and DAB+ and provides national sales representation for a further 56 regional radio stations.

name: STOCKLAND
businessSummary: Stockland Corporation Limited is an Australia-based creator and curator of connected communities. The Company is a diversified property group in Australia. It owns, funds, develops and manages portfolios of residential and land lease communities, retail town centers, and workplace and logistics assets. The Company's segments include Development, Investment Management, and Other. The Development segment develops a range of assets including residential properties, commercial properties and mixed-use assets. The Investment Management segment invests in and manages commercial properties and residential investment properties, manages capital investments, and earns management income for services performed. The Company sector includes masterplanned communities, land lease communities, town centre, logistics, and workplaces. It comprises investments and asset management across all asset classes, property management, leasing and funds management of its capital partnership platform.

name: DIMERIX
businessSummary: Dimerix Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, develops and commercializes pharmaceutical products for unmet medical needs in Australia. It develops DMX-200 for the treatment of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis disease  as well as DMX-652 for the treatment of acute kidney injury. The company is headquartered in Fitzroy, Australia.

name: WELLNEX LIFE
businessSummary: Wellnex Life Limited is an Australia-based health and wellness company, which is engaged in the consumer healthcare business. The Company is developing, licensing, and marketing registered products and brands to customers in the healthcare market segment. Its brands include Wakey Wakey, Nighty Night, Pharmacy Own, Mr Bright and Pain Away. The Company has intellectual property (IP)-licensing agreements with Haleon and Arrotex. The Company, through a joint venture with OneLife Botanical and Chemist Warehouse for SAS-B medicinal cannabis under the Wellness Life brand. It has launched a Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA)-approved soft gel liquid paracetamol product in a jointly owned brand with retailer Chemist Warehouse under the Wagner Liquigesic brand. Mr Bright is a natural tooth whitening brand, which is being sold in the United Kingdom through Boots and TJ Maxx retail stores and is available online domestically.

name: COVENTRY GROUP
businessSummary: Coventry Group Limited is a distributor of industrial products and services operating throughout Australia and New Zealand. The Company operates in two segments: Trade Distribution and Fluid Systems. The Trade Distribution segment includes the importation, distribution and marketing of industrial fasteners, industrial hardware supplies and associated products, temporary fencing, and cabinet-making hardware. Trade Distribution supplies a range of fastening systems, cabinet hardware systems, industrial and construction products to customers in the industrial, manufacturing, infrastructure, building and construction, roofing and cladding, mining and mining services, resources/oil and gas and agriculture and aquaculture sectors. The Fluid Systems segment includes the design, manufacture, distribution, installation and maintenance of lubrication and hydraulic fluid systems and hoses. It also offers rock hammer service and repair and installation of fire suppression systems.

name: HARRIS TECHNOLOGY GROUP
businessSummary: Harris Technology Group Limited is an Australia-based online retailing company. The Company is focused on providing information technology/consumer electronics (IT/CE) products for small and medium businesses in Australia. The Company’s main business is the eCommerce business of Harris Technology (HT). The Company’s business is conducted online both on www.ht.com.au and through the online platforms, such as Amazon, Kogan, Catch and eBay.

name: MAGELLAN FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Magellan Financial Group Ltd is an Australia-based company. The Company is a financial services company. It is engaged in providing investment management and specialist financial services. Its segments include investment management and partnerships & investments. Its investment management segment provides investment management services to wholesale and retail investors in Australia and New Zealand, and to institutional investors. Its investment management segment provides investment research and administrative services to clients. It provides investment management and sub-advisory services under client mandates. Its Partnerships & Investments segment comprises direct investment in Magellan Funds, which is a portfolio of listed Australian and international equities and investments in unlisted businesses. Its subsidiaries include Magellan Asset Management Limited (MAM), Magellan Capital Partners Pty Limited, and Magellan Capital Partners No. 2 Pty Limited.

name: HMC CAPITAL
businessSummary: HMC Capital Limited is an Australia-based diversified alternative asset manager focused on real estate, private equity, energy transition, healthscope, and digital infrastructure. Its segments include Real Estate, Private Credit, Private Equity, digital, and Corporate. Its Real Estate segment includes its HMC Capital managed HomeCo Daily Needs REIT, HealthCo Healthcare and Wellness REIT, HMC Wholesale Healthcare Fund and the Last Mile Logistics Fund. Its Private Equity segment comprises the HMC Capital Partners Fund I. Its Private Credit segment comprises commercial real estate and corporate credit fund management strategies. Its Digital Infrastructure segment comprises its digital infrastructure strategies, including HMC Capital managed fund, DigiCo Infrastructure REIT and StratCap. Corporate segment comprises capital solutions activities. It operates a private credit asset management platform over the medium-term spanning real estate, corporate, mezzanine, and infrastructure loans.

name: CALIX
businessSummary: Calix Limited is an Australia-based technology company focused on creating businesses that solve global challenges in industrial decarbonization and sustainability. The Company’s segments include Magnesia, Leilac, Sustainable Processing (SusPro) and Corporate. The Magnensia segment offers safe, sustainable and cost-effective solutions for water treatment, aquaculture and wastewater management. Its Magnesia line of business is supported by a magnesite mine in South Australia, a Magnesium Carbonate Calciner in Victoria to produce Magnesium Oxide, and Magnesium Oxide hydration facilities in Victoria, Queensland, and in six locations in the United States to produce Magnesium Hydroxide Liquid. The SusPro segment enables low carbon, low waste and value-added metal and mineral products. The Leilac segment applies the Company’s patented indirect heating technology to the cement and lime industries with the aim of providing solutions that reduce both emissions and costs.

name: CROMWELL PROPERTY GROUP
businessSummary: Cromwell Property Group is an Australia-based real estate investor and fund manager. The Company's segments include Funds and asset management, and Investment portfolio. Its Fund management segment represents activities in relation to the establishment and management of external funds for institutional and retail investors. Asset management includes property and facility management, leasing and project management, and development related activities. The Investment portfolio segment involves the ownership of investment properties located in Australia. These properties are held for long-term investment purposes. The Company’s properties include HQ North Tower, Brisbane, Queensland; 475 Victoria Avenue, Chatswood, New South Wales (NSW); Qantas HQ, Sydney; 207 Kent Street, Sydney; McKell Building, Sydney, NSW, and others.

name: IRON BEAR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Cyclone Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral investment, exploration, and evaluation company. The Company is focused on developing its flagship Iron Bear Project, an iron ore project located in the Labrador Trough, Canada. The Iron Bear Project is an iron ore project consisting of around ten licenses totaling 11,025 hectares (ha) and 441 graticular mineral claims which are 100% owned by the Company. The Company’s other projects are Grand Port, Wee Macgregor and Nickol River Gold. Grand Port project holds 100% of six projects over a diversified portfolio of gold, copper, nickel and platinum group elements (PGE) assets in New Zealand. The Company holds a 20% interest in the Wee Macgregor project which comprises three granted mining licenses, ML 2504, ML 2773 and ML 90098. These licenses are located approximately 60 kilometers (km) southeast of Mt Isa. Nickol River Project tenements are located 10km east of Karratha in the West Pilbara of Western Australia.

name: ARTRYA
businessSummary: Artrya Limited, a medical technology company, engages in the development and commercialization of artificial intelligence platform that detects, diagnoses, and address coronary artery disease in Australia. It offers Salix, a suite of cloud-based software that uses artificial intelligence to automate the detection of coronary artery disease from coronary computed tomography angiography scans to identify and manage patients at risk of a heart attack. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in West Perth, Australia.

isin: OMA.AX|Omega Oil & Gas Limited|OMA.AX|Omega Oil & Gas Limited
name: OMEGA OIL & GAS
businessSummary: Omega Oil & Gas Limited engages in the evaluation and exploration of oil and gas resources in Australia. Its flagship project is The Canyon Project, located in the Taroom Trough. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.

name: SOLARA MINERALS
businessSummary: Solara Minerals Ltd operates as a mineral exploration company in Australia. It primarily explores for gold, nickel, diamond, copper, cobalt, niobium, and lithium elements. The comapny was formerly known as Lycaon Resources Limited and changed its name to Solara Minerals Ltd in March 2025. Solara Minerals Ltd was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Perth, Australia.

isin: AT4.AX|AMERICANTU FPO [AT4]|AT4.AX|American Tungsten and Antimony Ltd
name: AMERICAN TUNGSTEN AND ANTIMONY
businessSummary: American Tungsten and Antimony Ltd engages in the exploration, evaluation, and development of mineral resources in Australia. The company explores for antimony, tungsten, and gold. It's flagship project owned 100% interest of the Antimony Canyon Project located in Utah, the United States. The company was formerly known as Trigg Minerals Limited and changed its name to American Tungsten and Antimony Ltd in December 2025. American Tungsten and Antimony Ltd was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.

name: BRAZILIAN RARE EARTHS
businessSummary: Brazilian Rare Earths Limited focuses on the exploration of rare earth elements and other critical minerals in Brazil. It holds interests in the Monte Alto, Pelé, and Sulista projects located in the Rocha da Rocha Province. The company offers rare earth elements, including neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr), dysprosium-terbium (DyTb), yttrium, and gadolinium, as well as critical minerals such as uranium, tantalum, niobium, scandium, and a substantial bauxite-gallium resource. Brazilian Rare Earths Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Sydney, Australia.

name: STRICKLAND METALS
businessSummary: Strickland Metals Limited engages in the exploration of mineral resources in Australia. The company primarily explores for gold, base metal, zinc, lead, silver, and copper deposits. The company owns 100% interest in its flagship Rogozna Project comprising four exploration licences covering an area of approximately 184 square kilometres located in the Raka, Southern Republic of Serbia. The company was formerly known as Alloy Resources Limited and changed its name to Strickland Metals Limited in August 2020. Strickland Metals Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Perth, Australia.

name: ECHO IQ
businessSummary: Echo IQ Limited, an artificial intelligence (AI) and medical technology company, engages in the development and application of AI for the cardiac diagnostics sector in Australia. It offers EchoSolv, a machine-learning and AI-based clinical decision support software for use as an adjunct to echocardiography in the assessment of severe aortic stenosis and other cardiovascular conditions. The company has a research collaboration with Mayo Clinic to assess cardiac risk in patients receiving cancer therapy. The company was formerly known as Houston We Have Limited and changed its name to EchoIQ Limited in December 2021. Echo IQ Limited is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.

name: ADYTON RESOURCES
businessSummary: Adyton Resources Corporation explores for copper and gold resources in Papua New Guinea, Canada, and Australia. Its flagship project is the Feni Gold Project located in New Ireland Province, Papua New Guinea. The company is headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.

name: HELLOWORLD TRAVEL
businessSummary: Helloworld Travel Limited is a travel distribution company comprising retail distribution travel networks, destination management services (for inbound travel into Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific), air ticket consolidation, wholesale leisure services (domestic and international), accommodation management operations and online operations, and coach operations. Its segments include Travel Operations Australia, Travel Operations New Zealand, and Travel Operations Rest of World. Its retail brands include Helloworld Travel, Helloworld Business Travel, Magellan Travel, Mobile Travel Agents, My Travel Group, and The Travel Brokers. Its wholesale brands include Viva Holidays, Sunlover Holidays, Territory Discoveries, GO Holidays, Creative Cruising, Cruiseco, and Ready Rooms. Inbound brands include AOT New Zealand, ATS Pacific, Experience Tours Australia (ETA), Australiareiser, and AOT Inbound. Air Consolidation brands include Air Tickets, SmartTickets, and Express Tickets.

isin: GG8|GORILLA GOLD MINES|GG8.XA|Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd
name: GORILLA GOLD MINES
businessSummary: Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Australia. It explores for gold, rare earth elements, and copper deposits. The company was formerly known as Labyrinth Resources Limited and changed its name to Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd in February 2025. Gorilla Gold Mines Ltd was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Subiaco, Australia.

name: OLIVERS REAL FOOD
businessSummary: Oliver’s Real Food Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the provision of fast-food services. The Company runs two contract packing manufacturing facilities for the retail, catering, and hospitality industries. In addition, the Company has investments in property, listed and unlisted companies. It operates through the Quick Service Restaurants segment in Australia. Its menu includes Mango Passion Morning Mix, Berry Morning Mix, Moroccan Vegetable Bowl, Mexican Chicken Bowl, Peri Peri Chicken Burger, OLI Burger, Mexican Chicken Pocket, Moroccan Vegetable Pocket, Organic Chicken Nuggets, Kids Chicken Nuggets Meal, Junior Cheeseburger Meal, Kids Chicken Burger Meal, Crumpets with Butter and Honey, Breakfast Egg Wrap, Bacon and Egg Roll, Avocado on Sourdough, among others. Its products sold online are Date and Walnut Cookie, Oliver's Blueberry Protein Bar, Oliver's Cranberry and Almond Cookie, Oliver's Goji and Superfruit Protein Bar, among others.

name: KALINA POWER
businessSummary: KALiNA Power Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in delivering cost-effective power projects that incorporate technologies that generate constant baseload electricity with a low carbon footprint. Its 100% owned Canadian subsidiary, KALiNA Distributed Power (KDP) is developing a portfolio of multiple, 170 megawatts of natural gas-fired combined cycle power plants incorporating Carbon Capture and Sequestration (Power-CCS) in Alberta, Canada. The Sites are strategically located near ample interconnection infrastructure, including proposed carbon-di-oxide geological sequestration hubs, electrical grid connections, natural gas (NG) pipelines, and transportation infrastructure. Its KALiNA Cycle technology offers significant enhancements for power cycle applications involving geothermal as well as industrial waste heat to power (WHP). The KALiNA Cycle generates zero-emissions power from heat produced by energy-intensive industrial processes and geothermal resources.

name: NICKEL INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Nickel Industries Limited is a nickel pig iron (NPI) producer, which is a key input in the production of stainless steel. It is engaged in the production of nickel matte. The Company owns a portfolio of mining and low-cost downstream nickel processing assets in Indonesia. It holds interest in high pressure acid leach (HPAL) projects, producing mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) for use in the electric vehicle (EV) supply chain. Its segments include Nickel ore mining in Indonesia, Ranger Nickel rotary kiln electric furnace (RKEF) project in Indonesia and Singapore and the HPAL projects in Indonesia. Its principal operations, located in Indonesia, are the Hengjaya Nickel, Oracle Nickel and RKEF projects located within the Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP), the Angel Nickel RKEF Project within the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park (IWIP) and the Hengjaya Mine, a large tonnage, high grade nickel laterite deposit in close proximity to the IMIP.

name: SOLSTICE MINERALS
businessSummary: Solstice Minerals Limited engages in the gold and base metal exploration in Australia. The company also explores copper and nickel deposits. Solstice Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Subiaco, Australia.

name: RIO TINTO
businessSummary: Rio Tinto Limited is a mining and materials company. The Company operates in over 34 countries and six continents, and its portfolio includes iron ore, copper, aluminum and a range of other minerals and materials. Its business is finding, mining, and processing mineral resources. Its Aluminium & Lithium segments include bauxite mining, alumina refining, aluminum smelting and recycling, and mining and processing of lithium. Its Copper segment includes mining and refining of copper, gold, silver, molybdenum, other by-products and exploration activities. Its Iron Ore segment consists of iron ore mining and salt and gypsum production in Western Australia; iron concentrate and pellets from the Iron Ore Company of Canada. It owns and operates an integrated portfolio of iron ore assets in the Pilbara region of Western Australia comprising a network of 18 iron ore mines, four port terminals, a nearly 2,000 km rail network and other infrastructure (Pilbara Property).

name: AUSTRALIS OIL & GAS
businessSummary: Australis Oil & Gas Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas company. The Company's principal activity is oil and gas exploration, development, and production. Its segment includes Oil & Gas Production and Other. The Company's Oil & Gas Production segment is engaged in the development and production of oil and gas assets in the United States (USA). The Company operates one area of interest onshore being leases, wells and facilities in the Tuscaloosa Marine Shale (TMS) in the states of Louisiana and Mississippi in the USA. It holds approximately 47,400 net acres within the production delineated core of the oil producing TMS. The Company is engaged in operating approximately 30 producing wells and 18 non-operated wells all within the TMS. Its subsidiaries include Australis Services Inc, Australis TMS Inc, Australis USA 1 Pty Limited, and Australis Europe Pty Limited.

name: AVA RISK GROUP
businessSummary: Ava Risk Group Ltd is an Australia-based company, which provides technologies and services to protect critical and high value assets and infrastructure. The Company is engaged in the provision of security technology products for perimeter intrusion detection solutions. The Company operates through three segments: Detect, Access, and Illuminate. The Detect segment manufactures and markets smart fiber optic sensing systems for security and condition monitoring for a range of applications including perimeters, pipelines, conveyors, power cables and data networks. The Access segment specializes in the development, manufacture and supply of high security biometric readers, security access control and electronic locking products. Illuminate segment specializes in the development and manufacture of illuminators, automatic number plate recognition (ANPR) cameras and perimeter detectors. Its subsidiaries include FFT MENA Pty Ltd, Future Fibre Technologies (US) Inc., and MaxSec Group Pty Ltd.

name: ECS BOTANICS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ECS Botanics Holdings Ltd is an Australia-based medicinal cannabis cultivator and manufacturer located in Northwest Victoria. The Company utilizes progressive and cultivation methodologies to produce medicine in a sustainable way, adopting regenerative and organic horticultural practices and renewable energy sources. The Company is a producer and supplier of affordable, premium-grade medicinal cannabis. The Company services both the Australian market and key international markets. It specializes in cultivating cannabis, which after drying and curing, is supplied as a trimmed flower for inhalation, or extracted into resin for further formulation or manufacturing.

name: ATOMO DIAGNOSTICS
businessSummary: Atomo Diagnostics Limited is an Australia-based medical device company. The Company supplies integrated rapid diagnostic test (RDT) devices to the global diagnostic market. The Company’s patented devices simplify testing procedures, enhance usability and improve reliability across rapid point-of-care (POC) and at-home testing applications. The Company has commercialized a number of products across international markets and has supply agreements in place for testing applications targeting infectious diseases, including COVID-19, HIV, viral vs bacterial differentiations as well as the early detection of pregnancy. Its products include Atomo HIV Self-Test, AtomoRapid Pascal and AtomoRapid Curie, among others. Its Atomo HIV Self-Test is an integrated, blood-based rapid diagnostic test (RDT) for HIV screening, which provides results in 15 minutes. The AtomoRapid Pascal platform offers improved performance and usability in point of care testing.

name: CHAMPION IRON
businessSummary: Champion Iron Limited is an Australia-based iron ore exploration and development company. The Company's segments include Bloom Lake Mining Operations, Rana Gruber Mining Operations and Exploration and Evaluation. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Quebec Iron Ore Inc., owns and operates the Bloom Lake Mining Complex, located on the south end of the Labrador Trough, approximately 13 kilometers (km) north of Fermont, Quebec. Bloom Lake is an open-pit operation with two concentration plants that primarily source energy from renewable hydroelectric power. It ships iron ore concentrate from Bloom Lake by rail and sells its iron ore concentrate to customers globally. In addition to Bloom Lake, it owns a portfolio of exploration and development projects in the Labrador Trough, including the Kamistiatusset Project, located over 21 km south-east of Bloom Lake, and the Cluster II portfolio of properties. Its other projects are Cluster I, Powderhorn and Gullbridge projects.

name: NEX METALS EXPLORATIONS
businessSummary: Nex Metals Explorations Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the gold, copper and nickel exploration. The Company holds a suite of prospective tenements in Kookynie and Yundamindra area. Its projects include Kookynie Gold project, Yundamindra Gold project, and Kookynie Tailings Research Project. The Kookynie Gold Project lies approximately 180 kilometers (kms) north of Kalgoorlie, 50 kms south of Leonora and approximately 25 kms from the bitumen Goldfields Highway linking Kalgoorlie to Leonora in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The Yundamindra Gold Project is located 65 kms southeast of Leonora and 65 kms east of Kookynie. The Yundamindra Project consists of nine granted mining leases, which the Company holds the rights to explore. The Company's Kookynie Tailings Research Project has drilled a total of 81 air core holes for approximately 497 meters over the tailing's stockpiles.

name: ORIGIN ENERGY
businessSummary: Origin Energy Limited is an Australia-based integrated energy company. The principal activity of the Company is the operation of energy businesses, including exploration and production of natural gas, electricity generation, wholesale and retail sale of electricity and gas, and sale of liquefied natural gas. The Company’s segments include Energy Markets, Share of Octopus Energy, Integrated Gas, and Corporate. The Energy Markets segment is engaged in energy retailing and wholesaling, power generation, and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) operations predominantly in Australia. The Share of Octopus Energy segment includes the Company's investment in Octopus Energy Group Limited. The Integrated Gas segment is focused on the investment in Australia Pacific Liquified Natural Gas (APLNG) and also includes commodity hedging and trading. The Corporate segment provides various business development and support activities.

name: CAMPLIFY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Camplify Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company that operates peer-to-peer digital marketplace platforms connecting recreational vehicle (RV) owners to hirers. The Company’s platform delivers a seamless and transparent experience for consumers (potential RV hirers) to connect with RV owners and SMEs with a fleet of RVs. Its segments include Hire, Membership and Other. It has a global family of RV rental marketplace brands. The brands include Camplify, PaulCamper, and MyWay. The Company provides a range of caravans, motorhomes, camper trailers and campervans for hire via the respective platforms. MyWay provides insurance solutions to RV marketplace customers, and PaulCamper is a peer-to-peer van-sharing platform connecting van owners with travelers. It operates in seven key markets, such as Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Spain, Germany, the Netherlands, and Austria. Its subsidiaries include Camplify Co (Australia) Pty Ltd, Camplify Co (NZ) Limited, and others.

name: JUDO CAPITAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Judo Capital Holdings Limited is an Australia-based holding company of Judo Bank Pty Ltd (Judo Bank). It offers term deposits directly and through intermediaries to retail and wholesale customers, including individuals, charities, universities, government bodies, self-managed super funds (SMSFs), and corporates. All deposits are term deposits, with limited overlap between the small and medium enterprises (SMEs) lending customers and the deposit customer base. It provides business lending solutions to SMEs. Its key services include business loans, asset finance, lines of credit, residential mortgages (business loan customers), and bank guarantees. Its other subsidiaries include Judo Securitisation Warehouse Trust 2020 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2020 - 2, Judo Securitisation Trust 1R, Judo Capital Holdings Limited Employee Share Trust, Judo Securitisation Trust 2022 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2023 - 1, Judo Securitisation Trust 2023 - 2, and Judo Capital Markets Trust 2023 - 1.

isin: CEH|COAST ENTERTAINMENT HOLDINGS|CEH.AX|Coast Entertainment Holdings Limited
name: COAST ENTERTAINMENT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Coast Entertainment Holdings Limited engages in the investment and operation of leisure and entertainment businesses in Australia. It operates theme park and attractions under the Dreamworld and WhiteWater World in Coomera, Queensland  and SkyPoint observation deck and climb in Surfers Paradise, Queensland. The company was formerly known as Ardent Leisure Group Limited and changed its name to Coast Entertainment Holdings Limited in December 2023. Coast Entertainment Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in North Sydney, Australia.

name: AMA GROUP
businessSummary: AMA Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is the operation and development of collision repair businesses in Australia and New Zealand. Its segments consist of AMA Collision, Capital SMART, Wales, and Specialist Businesses. The AMA Collision segment provides larger, more complex repairs to cars that have sustained high-severity collision damage and may be undriveable. The Capital SMART segment specializes in performing rapid repairs on cars that have sustained low-to-medium collision damage and are still drivable. The Wales segment provides specialized facilities for all commercial vehicle repairs, from light commercial to prime movers, B-doubles, buses, and earthmoving equipment. Its Specialist Businesses include AMA Prestige, which offers sites servicing prestige vehicle marques; TechRight, an Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) calibration service; and Track Right, a mechanical repair service.

name: AMOTIV
businessSummary: Amotiv Limited owns a portfolio of companies specializing in providing automotive products and solutions that meet the needs of its customers worldwide. The Company’s divisions include 4WD Accessories and Trailering; Lighting, Power and Electrical; and Powertrain and Undercar. Its 4WD Accessories and Trailering division encompasses various brands, including AutoPacific Group (APG), Hayman Reese, CruiseMaster, ECB, Rola, Parkside, Trojan, Trail Boss, Kaymar, TriMotive, BestBars, Fully Equipped, Crown Canopy, X-Bar, and Christine Products. Its Lighting, Power and Electrical division is engaged in delivering advanced lighting, power, and electrical solutions. The division includes various brands, including Brown & Watson International (BWI), Projecta, Big Red Gear, Twisted Throttle, and Caravan Electrical Solutions. Its Powertrain and Undercar division encompasses various brands, including Ryco Filters, AA Gaskets, Infinitev, and Australian Clutch Services (ACS).

name: RURAL FUNDS GROUP
businessSummary: Rural Funds Group is an agricultural Real Estate Investment Trust listed on the ASX under the code RFF. RFF owns a diversified portfolio of Australian agricultural assets. RFF's strategy is to generate capital growth and income from developing and leasing agricultural assets. RFF targets distribution growth of 4% per annum. Distributions are paid quarterly. RFF is a stapled security, incorporating Rural Funds Trust and RF Active. Rural Funds Group was incorporated in Australia.

name: LEGEND MINING
businessSummary: Legend Mining Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration of nickel and copper deposits in Australia. The Company’s exploration focus is on its nickel-copper Rockford Project in the Fraser Range, Western Australia. The Rockford Project is located within the highly prospective Fraser Range district of Western Australia, with tenure covering a total area of approximately 2,532 square kilometers (km2). The Company's exploration is primarily focused on magmatic nickel-copper-cobalt (Nova-Bollinger/Voisey’s Bay style), along with volcanogenic massive sulfide (VMS) style zinc-copper-silver and Tropicana style structurally controlled gold mineralization. The Rockford Project comprises over 11 granted exploration licenses. The Rockford Project’s tenements include E28/1716, E28/1717, E28/1727, E28/2188, E28/2189, E28/2190 and others. The Company's wholly owned subsidiary is Legend Cameroon Pty Ltd.

name: VECTION TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Vection Technologies Limited is an Australia-based enterprise-focused company that helps businesses bridge the physical and digital worlds. The Company helps organizations leverage their three-dimensional (3D) data through extended reality (XR) interfaces that foster collaboration and learning, grow sales and more. It is engaged in developing and commercializing integrated digital transformation technology solutions and services as part of its INTEGRATEDXR suite, including ICT infrastructure, kiosks, mixed reality (MR), augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR), computer-aided design (CAD), 3D modeling and renderings, and artificial intelligence (AI). Its INTEGRATEDXR products include Mindesk, EnWorks, 3DFrame, Configurator, and XRKiosk. Mindesk is a solution to support design review and real-time rendering workflows. EnWorks is a solution that supports training, manufacturing and maintenance processes.

name: MACH7 TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Mach7 Technologies Limited is an Australia-based global healthcare software company. The principal activity is the development and commercialization of medical imaging and data management software solutions for global healthcare organizations. The Mach7 eUnity Enterprise Diagnostic Viewer is a zero-footprint viewer that allows medical professionals to remotely access patients' medical images at any location, from any device, without loss of speed or image quality. The Mach7 Vendor Neutral Archive (VNA) is a vendor agnostic data management solution that includes administration tools that allow for the fast storage, access, retrieval and viewing of images across a healthcare network. Mach7's Workflow Applications is designed to promote better clinical decision-making by giving users tools and worklists that provide access to contextual patient data and images.

name: NICO RESOURCES
businessSummary: Nico Resources Limited is an Australia-based company focusing on Australian nickel projects. It owns a 100% legal and beneficial interest in nickel assets consisting of the Wingellina (WA) and Claude Hills (SA) nickel projects. The Wingellina Nickel-Cobalt Project (Wingellina) is an undeveloped nickel-cobalt project in Australia and part of NiCo Resources Central Musgrave Project (CMP), which straddles the triple-point of the Western Australia, Northern Territory and South Australia borders. The CMP has a Mineral Resource of approximately two million tons of nickel and 154,000 tons of cobalt. The Project covers approximately 1,756 square kilometers (km2) of the mid-Proterozoic Musgrave Block, an east-west trending belt of granulite-gneiss basement rocks approximately 500 kilometers long. The Company’s Claude Hills Project is located approximately 30 kilometers (km) to the east of Wingellina.

name: BOSS ENERGY
businessSummary: Boss Energy Limited is an Australia-based uranium company focused on the Honeymoon Uranium Project in South Australia. The Honeymoon Uranium Project is located in South Australia, 80 kilometer (km) northwest of the town of Broken Hill. Its Project consists of two main exploration areas (the Eastern and Western tenement regions) with one granted Mining Lease 6109 (ML6109), totaling a 2,595 square kilometer (km2) tenement package, which covers approximately 980 km2 of pastoral leases. The project also consists of five Exploration Leases (EL) covering prospects at Honeymoon and Gould's Dam, 70 km northwest of Honeymoon. It operates through two segments: Australian uranium operations and Alta Mesa operations. It also operates 30%-owned Alta Mesa Project in South Texas is a high-grade uranium In-Situ Recovery (ISR) project in South Texas, a prolific United States district for sandstone-hosted ISR production, having produced approximately 80 million pounds (Mlb) historically.

name: TEMPEST MINERALS
businessSummary: Tempest Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with a diversified portfolio of projects in Western Australia prospective for precious, base and energy metals. The Company’s projects include Yalgoo, Mount Magnet, Five Wheels and Elephant Project. Its flagship project is its holding in the Yalgoo region of Western Australia totaling over 1,000 square kilometers (km2). The Remorse Deposit sits on the eastern side of the Yalgoo Project, near a number of historical gold, iron and base metal occurrences. The Sanity Target sits in the eastern portion of the Yalgoo project area. Mount Magnet project is a prolific multi-million-ounce gold mining center with numerous large-scale, long-life open pit and underground mines. The Five Wheels project is over 266 km2 of granted tenure in the Earaheedy region of Western Australia proximal to the high-profile Rumble Resources Ltd discoveries. The Elephant project comprises over 194 km2 of highly prospective exploration leases.

name: AUSTRALIAN AGRICULTURAL
businessSummary: Australian Agricultural Company Limited is an Australia-based integrated cattle and beef producer. The Company’s principal activities include distribution of branded beef into global markets; production of beef including breeding, backgrounding and feedlotting, and ownership, operation, and development of pastoral properties. It owns and operates properties, feedlots and farms comprising approximately 6.5 million hectares of land in Queensland and the Northern Territory. It manages a cattle herd of over 456,000 head across properties, feedlots and farms throughout Queensland and the Northern Territory. Its Livingstone Beef processing facility is situated in Livingstone Valley, over 50 kilometers south of Darwin in the Northern Territory. Its brands include Westholme and Darling Downs. Its subsidiaries include A. A. Company Pty Ltd, Austcattle Holdings Pty Ltd, A. A. & P. Joint Holdings Pty Ltd, Shillong Pty Ltd, James McLeish Estates Pty Limited, and others.

name: LITTLE GREEN PHARMA
businessSummary: Little Green Pharma Ltd is a global, vertically integrated and geographically diverse medicinal cannabis business with operations from cultivation and production through to manufacturing and distribution. Its principal activities include the cultivation of medicinal cannabis, procurement of raw materials and production of medicinal cannabis medicines; the supply of medicinal cannabis products into Australia and Europe; the supply of medicinal cannabis products for observational and clinical studies and research and development of new medicinal cannabis products, and the development of a psychedelics business including sponsoring a clinical trial into the treatment of refractory depression with psilocybin assisted therapy, construction of a psilocybin mushroom cultivation facility, and establishment of a psychedelic treatment clinic. It has a diverse and growing portfolio of cannabis-based medicines, distributed across Australia and over 12 export markets.

name: ASTRON
businessSummary: Astron Limited is engaged in the exploration and development of mineral sands projects, the upgrading of mineral sand products into higher value products and the development and application of technologies for the production of advanced materials and chemicals from mineral sands products. Its principal activities include work to advance its interest in the Donald Rare Earths and Mineral Sands Project (Donald Project) in regional Victoria to operations; exploration activities through Jackson Mineral Sands Pty Ltd, to delineate and advance its Jackson Rare Earths and Mineral Sands Project, which is located in close proximity to the Donald Project, and the operation of titanium and zirconium minerals processing activities, using a mineral separation plant at Yingkou, China; the evaluation and advancement of downstream applications for zircon and titanium, and titanium and zirconium minerals procurement and trading activities through its subsidiary Astron Titanium (Yingkou) Co. Limited.

name: CHANGE FINANCIAL
businessSummary: Change Financial Limited is an Australia-based global fintech company. The Company leverages scalable technology to provide payment solutions, card issuing and testing to banks and fintechs. Its principal activity includes commercialization and ongoing development of its payments management platform and payment testing solution. Its core products include Vertexon Payments as a Service (PaaS) and PaySim. Vertexon (PaaS) integrates with the core systems of banks and fintechs, enabling the delivery of physical, digital, and virtual card solutions to their customers. It includes integrated features such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay and Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) services. PaySim is a payment testing solution, which enables banks and fintechs to complete end-to-end testing of their payment platforms and processes from a desktop. It also provides the default standard for payments testing for many Australian companies, including Australia’s domestic card payment service eftpos.

name: CENTURIA OFFICE REIT
businessSummary: Centuria Property Funds Limited is Australia's largest ASX listed pure-play office REIT. COF owns a portfolio of high quality office assets situated in core submarkets throughout Australia. COF is overseen by a hands-on, active manager and provides investors with income and the opportunity for capital growth from a pure-play portfolio of high-quality Australian office assets. Centuria Property Funds Limited is the Responsible Entity for the ASX listed Centuria Office REIT. CPFL is a wholly owned subsidiary of Centuria Capital Group. CNI is an ASX-listed specialist investment manager with more than 22 billion dollar in total assets under management (as at 30 June 2026) and offers a range of investment opportunities including listed and unlisted property funds as well as tax-effective investment bonds. Centuria Property Funds Limited was incorporated in Australia.

name: 5G NETWORKS
businessSummary: 5G Networks Limited is a digital services company. The Company's principal activities include the supply of cloud-based solutions, managed services, and network services, the operation of fiber and wireless infrastructure and management of cloud computing environment, and the operation of data center facilities. Its segments include Enterprise and Wholesale. The Enterprise segment include cloud hosting, domain names, data center, networks, and voice, information technology (IT) managed services, hardware and software and digital marketing products and services provided to enterprise and government customers. The Wholesale segment include cloud hosting, data center, networks and voice products and services provided to wholesale telecommunications and Segment information is provided below in relation to these segments.

name: ITECH MINERALS
businessSummary: iTech Minerals is a mineral exploration company exploring for and developing battery materials and critical minerals within its 100% owned Australian projects. The Company is exploring for graphite and developing the Lacroma and Campoona Graphite Deposits in South Australia and copper-gold-antimony and lithium in the Reynolds Range Project. It is focused on developing the advanced Eyre Peninsula Graphite Project in South Australia and exploring the early-stage Reynolds Range Copper-GoldProject in the Northern Territory. The Reynolds Range project consists of three exploration licenses and covers a total of over 375 square kilometers (km2) of the Aileron Province, part of the Paleoproterozoic North Australian Craton. It owns 100% of the Eyre Peninsula Graphite Project (formerly the Campoona Project). It is an emerging graphite district, and close to established energy infrastructure, transportation routes, facilities and shipping options.

name: BEAMTREE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Beamtree Holdings Limited is an artificial intelligence decision support and data company. The Company provides automation technology and data analytics that support health care providers. The Company's segments include Diagnostic Technology, Clinical Decision Support, Coding Assistance and Data Quality, and Analytics and Knowledge Networks. The Diagnostic Technology which is engaged in Enabling the effective delivery of diagnostic services as they underpin the future of health and personalized medicine, and its product includes RippleDown. The Clinical Decision Support which is engaged in combining human and artificial expertise together to enhance decisions that improve care, value and experience and its product includes Ainsoff Deterioration Index. The Coding Assistance and Data Quality segment products are PICQ, RISQ, and Integrated Coding Platform. The Analytics and Knowledge Networks segment is engaged in combining data analytics solutions with peer-to-peer alliances.

name: WASHINGTON H SOUL PATTINSON AND
businessSummary: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Limited, an investment company, engages in investing various industries and asset classes in Australia. It operates through six segments: Listed Companies, Fixed Income, Private Companies, Credit, Emerging Companies Portfolio, and Real Assets. The company invests in managed investments held for income and growth  short-duration and managed investments  unlisted companies with growth opportunities  corporate loans, bonds, and structured credit solutions  listed and unlisted high-growth companies  and real-estate, agriculture, and data centres. It also engages in the manufacturing, distribution, and sale of building products. Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Limited was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.

name: FLEETPARTNERS GROUP
businessSummary: FleetPartners Group Limited provides fleet management services in Australia and New Zealand. The company operates through three segments: Australia Commercial, Novated, and New Zealand Commercial. It offers vehicle fleet leasing and management, novated leasing, salary packaging, and vehicle accessories and sales solutions. The company also provides asset management, related financial products and services, vehicle acquisition, in-life fleet management and vehicle remarketing, and driver services under the FleetPartners brand. The company was formerly known as Eclipx Group Limited and changed its name to FleetPartners Group Limited in March 2023. FleetPartners Group Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in North Sydney, Australia.

name: AF LEGAL GROUP
businessSummary: AF Legal Group Limited is an Australia-based tech enabled law firm specializing in family and relationship law. The Company provides advice to clients in respect of divorce, separation, property, and children's matters together with related and ancillary services such as litigation. It is engaged in contested wills and estates practice, which includes all aspects of wills and estates disputes including contesting challenging and defending wills. Its subsidiaries include AF Legal Pty Ltd, Watts McCray (NSW) Pty Ltd, Withnall Cavanagh & Co Pty Ltd, AF Legal (Wollongong) Pty Ltd and AF Legal (Gold Coast) Pty Ltd. Watts McCray (NSW) Pty Ltd provides various legal services, including legal services, family law, dispute resolution, international law & expat services, Divorce.com.au and other legal services.

name: GWA GROUP
businessSummary: GWA Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in research, designing, importing and marketing building fixtures and fittings for residential and commercial premises, including sanitaryware, tapware and showers, baths, intelligent water management solutions, and related kitchen, bathroom and laundry products/accessories. It distributes, installs, maintains and repairs various products through a range of distribution and customer channels in Australia, New Zealand and selected international markets. It is also engaged in Water Solutions, which includes the sale of vitreous China toilet suites, basins, plastic cisterns, taps and showers, baths, kitchen sinks, laundry tubs, domestic water control valves, smart products and bathroom accessories. Its brands include Caroma, Methven, Clark and Dorf. Its subsidiaries include Caroma Holdings Limited, Caroma Industries Limited, Caroma International Pty Ltd, Caroma Singapore Pte Ltd, Deva Tap Company Ltd and others.

name: RIVCO AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Rivco Australia Limited, formerly Duxton Water Limited, is an Australia-based company. The Company owns and manages a portfolio of water entitlements, providing the irrigation community with a broad range of water supply solutions. The primary investment objective of the Company is to build a portfolio of permanent water entitlements and utilize this portfolio to provide flexible water supply solutions to its Australian farming partners. It provides investors with direct exposure to the Australian water market. The Company owns and actively manages a diverse portfolio of water assets, primarily located in the Southern Murray Darling Basin (SMDB) region of Australia. The Company is engaged in providing irrigators with a range of water supply solutions and resource risk management tools. The Company holds approximately 91.5 gigalitres (GL) of permanent water entitlements. Duxton Capital (Australia) Pty Ltd. is the investment manager of the Company.

name: NOVATTI GROUP
businessSummary: Novatti Group Limited is an Australia-based payments company. The Company provides a single destination for all payment needs in a digital world. The Company operates through four business segments: Payments AU/NZ, Payments International, Technology Solutions and Investments. The Payments AU/NZ segment includes acquiring, card issuing, cross-border payments and Novatti Billpay, which enables payment of Australian invoices directly from a range of Asian digital wallets. Payments International offers customers an alternative payment method in the form of a prepaid cash voucher and provision of an established payments network across Malaysia enabling prepaid top-ups and bill payments. Technology Solutions includes enterprise, automation and billing software. The Investment segment includes products, such as AUDD, which is an Australian Dollar-backed stablecoin for facilitating payments, transactions and remittances between businesses and their customers.

name: LOTUS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Lotus Resources Limited is an advanced uranium company. The principal activities of the Company include the exploration and development of its Kayelekera Uranium Project in Malawi and Letlhakane Uranium Project in Botswana. The Company operates through four business segments and two geographical locations, being the exploration, evaluation and development of Uranium assets in Africa (comprising the geographical locations Malawi and Botswana), nickel-cobalt exploration, evaluation and development in Australia, and corporate activities in Australia. The Kayelekera Uranium Project is located in northern Malawi, Southern Africa, 52 kilometers (km) west by road from the town of Karonga. It owns a 100% interest in Letlhakane Uranium Project in Botswana. The asset is located within 50 kilometers of Francistown, a population center in Botswana.

name: SCENTRE GROUP
businessSummary: Scentre Group is an Australia-based company, which owns and operates a platform of 42 Westfield destinations with 37 located in Australia and five in New Zealand. Its retail services offer to help retailers trade, promote their business and enhance customer experience, including Marketing Services, Gift Cards, Centre Services and Marketing Hub. Its BrandSpace gives businesses access to over 1,800 full motion SuperScreens and SmartScreens and various retail pop-up and promotional touchpoints, located to optimize customer connections. The Company operates through two segments: Property Investment, Property Management and Construction. The Property investments segment owns and operates shopping centers. The Company's Property management and construction segment includes external fee income from third parties, primarily property management and development fees, and associated business expenses.

name: OFX GROUP
businessSummary: OFX Group Limited is an Australia-based company which is engaged in the provision of international payments and foreign exchange services. The Company's segments include Business to Business (Corporate/B2B) and Business to Consumer (Consumer/B2C). The Company's business products include Global Business Account, Payments & Transfers, Corporate Cards, FX Solutions, Control Hub, Spend Management, AP (Accounts Payable) Automation, Integrations, and Pricing. Its Global Business Account combines with corporate cards to create a single expense control system. FX Solutions optimize costs with foreign exchange rates and reactions to currency changes, alongside total control and visibility over spending. Its Control Hub creates approval workflows, monitors payments and tracks budgets, all in one automated platform. Spend Management platform streamlines employee spending and automates expense management across all business entities in real time.

name: RECTIFIER TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Rectifier Technologies Limited is an Australia-based company, which designs and manufactures high-efficiency power rectifiers and produces electronic and specialized magnetic components. The Company's segments include Electronic Components, Industrial Power Supplies (Electricity generation/distribution and Defence) (E&D), Industrial Power Supplies (Transport and Telecommunication) (T&T) and Industrial Power Supplies (Electric vehicles) (EV). Electronic Components segment is engaged in manufacturing electronic components. Industrial Power Supplies (E&D) segment manufactures and distributes rectifiers, controllers, accessories and complete systems for the power generation, distribution industries and defense. Industrial Power Supplies (T&T) segment manufactures and distributes power supplies for the transport industries and telecommunications. Industrial Power Supplies (EV) segment manufactures and distributes electric vehicle charges, battery charges and power supplies.

name: DIGITALX
businessSummary: DigitalX Limited is an Australia-based digital investment manager and crypto fund manager. The Company’s segments include Product Development, Asset Management (AM) and Other. Its Sell My Shares (SMS) provides share brokerage services via its Sell My Shares platform. The Asset Management division offers high net worth and institutional investors access to a portfolio of digital assets. It operates two funds focused on digital assets: the DigitalX BTC Fund and the DigitalX spot Bitcoin ETF. Its other segments include governance, finance, legal, risk management, company secretarial and management of corporate entities. Its subsidiaries include DigitalX Bitcoin Fund, DigitalX Asset Management Pty Ltd and Sell My Shares Pty Ltd.

name: PRAEMIUM
businessSummary: Praemium Limited is an Australia-based company that helps financial advisers with investment, administration, and retirement solutions. The Company is focused on artificial intelligence (AI)-driven financial services. The Company's solutions provide access to global markets, alternative assets, and over 350 integrated SMAs. With technology and reporting, the Company enables advisers to manage, report, and administer complex wealth portfolios, with a digitized view of total wealth. From outsourced administration of non-custody assets to superannuation solutions, it delivers a complete wealth management platform. The Company's product categories include Administration, Investment and Retirement. Its Administration products include Scope and Scope+. The Company's Investment products include Spectrum and SMA. Its Retirement product is Super. Its platform includes reporting, digital experience, data integration, customizations, tax optimization, and alternative assets.

name: REGION RE
businessSummary: Region Re Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in investment and management of shopping centers. The Company is engaged in investing in and management of convenience-based retail properties in Australia. Its portfolio focuses on the non-discretionary retail sector. The Company owns and manages approximately 101 convenience-based retail properties. The Company's properties include Auburn Central, Belmont Central, Cabarita Beach shopping center (SC), Cardiff SC, Cooleman Court, Delroy Park SC, Goonellabah SC, Griffin Plaza, Katoomba Marketplace, Lane Cove Market Square, Lane Cove Market Square, Lavington Square, Leura SC, Lismore Central SC, Macksville SC, Marketown SC – East, Marketown SC – West, MarketPlace Raymond Terrace, Moama Marketplace, Morisset SC, Muswellbrook Fair, North Orange SC, Sturt Mall, The Waterfront Town Centre, Tura Beach SC, Ulladulla sc, Annandale Central, Brassall SC, and others.

name: BHAGWAN MARINE
businessSummary: Bhagwan Marine Limited is an Australia-based marine services company. The Company provides a diverse range of marine solutions within ports, nearshore, offshore and subsea locations to industries including oil and gas, subsea, port, civil construction, renewables and defense. Its offshore services include dive support, ROV support, crew change operations, metocean equipment deployment, geophysical surveys, geotechnical surveys, offshore accommodation services, decommissioning support, pilot transfers, FPSO offtake assist, oil field support services, coastal towage, coastal freight and others. Its port services include wharf & jetty construction support, crew change/transfers, harbor towage, line boats, inshore survey and ship supply runs. It has a fleet of approximately 95+ vessels comprising various vessel types, including dive support vessels, tugboats, multi-cats, utility vessels, barges and crew transfer boats, as well as other specialist vessels.

name: 8COMMON
businessSummary: 8common Limited is an Australia-based company, whose solutions deliver enterprise grade financial transaction processing for government entities and large enterprise businesses. Its flagship Expense8 platform is a pureplay provider of end-to-end travel expense management software, card applications and management. The software solutions improve organization, productivity, incorporate company organizational policies and expense auditing to reduce fraud. Its product CardHero (prepaid card fund distribution) delivers a closed loop solution to support regulated, large network and high-volume requirements. CardHero integrates fund payment with spend management and targets not for profits, grant providers, charities and government. CardHero delivers convenient fund distribution and spend data. Its growing client base of more than 150,000 platform users includes enterprise customers Woolworths, Broadcast Australia, Amcor, and over 150 state and federal government entities.

name: ADVANCE ZINCTEK
businessSummary: Advance ZincTek Limited is an Australia-based company, which manufactures aluminum oxide powder (Alusion), zinc oxide dispersions and zinc oxide powder (ZinClear) for the Personal Care Sector. The Company’s Personal Care segment produces and distributes dispersions of mineral-only ultraviolet (UV) filters in cosmetic emollients used for sunscreen, skincare and pharmaceutical formulations, as well as alumina plate-like powders used for cosmetic applications. It supplies cosmetic and pharmaceutical grade zinc oxide powder used in sunscreens and personal care products. Its products offer vegan natural zinc oxide powders, bulk sunscreens and dispersions. The Company’s Dispersions include ZinClear IM 50 CCT, ZinClear XP60 CCT, ZinClear XP65-70 CCT, ZinClear XP65-70 CCT + LCT, ZinClear XP35 CCT + SGa, ZinClear XP47 CCT + TES, ZinClear XP52 CCT + SGlu, ZinClear XP60 CCT + LCT, and others. Its subsidiaries include Antaria Pty Ltd, Sunscreen Safety Testing Laboratory Pty Ltd and others.

name: NUIX
