businessSummary: Nuix Limited is a provider of investigative analytics and intelligence software, which enables organizations to find insights from large amounts of unstructured data. The Company helps customers collect, process, and review large amounts of structured and unstructured data. It offers a software platform (Nuix platform) comprising a proprietary data processing engine (Nuix Engine) and several software applications. The Nuix platform operates at a forensic level, providing users with a detailed, contextualized and legally defensible way of viewing and interacting with data. Its solutions include Nuix Neo Data privacy, Nuix Neo Discover, Nuix Neo Investigations, and Nuix Neo Legal. Its products include Nuix NEO Platform and Nuix Components. Nuix Components include Nuix Discover, Nuix Workstation, Nuix Investigate, Nuix Enterprise Collection Center, Nuix Adaptive Security, and Nuix Rampiva. Nuix Adaptive Security offers visibility, adaptability, and control over data right at its source.

name: KELSIAN GROUP
businessSummary: Kelsian Group Limited is a global operator of bus, motorcoach, and marine services. The Company is engaged in providing domestic metropolitan public bus transport operations, international public bus and motorcoach transport operations, urban, regional and school bus charter and coach tours, and domestic ferry services. The Australian Bus segment operates metropolitan public bus services on behalf of governments in Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, Adelaide, and Stradbroke Island, as well as regional and remote bus services supporting the resources sector in Western Australia. It also operates charter bus services in the Northern Territory. The International Bus segment operates or participates in the operation of metropolitan public bus services on behalf of governments in the United Kingdom, Channel Islands and Singapore. It also operates charter motorcoaches for corporates, local and federal government and educational sectors in the United States.

name: ARAFURA RARE EARTHS
businessSummary: Arafura Rare Earths Limited is an Australia-based company that is engaged in the production of rare earth products. The Company produces rare earth products from the Nolans Project. The Nolans Project consists of a mine, process plant, including beneficiation, extraction and separation plants, and related infrastructure to be constructed and located at the Nolans site, approximately 135 kilometers north of Alice Springs in Australia's Northern Territory. Its rare earth products are Neodymium-Praseodymium (NdPr) oxide, and Mixed middle-heavy rare earths (SEG/HRE) oxide. NdPr oxide is the Company's flagship product, which is used by magnet and magnet alloy customers. The Company’s primary products from the Nolans project are rare earths, which are used in catalytic converters in automobiles, consumer electronics, energy efficiency lighting, optics, alloys, advanced ceramics and permanent magnets that enable e-mobility and renewable energy applications.

name: ELEVRA LITHIUM
businessSummary: Elevra Lithium Limited, formerly Sayona Mining Ltd, is a North American lithium producer, with projects in Quebec, Canada and Western Australia. Its projects include Abitibi-Temiscamingue Hub, Eeyou Istchee James Bay Hub and Western Australia. Its Abitibi-Temiscamingue Hub includes North American Lithium, Authier Lithium Project, Tansim Lithium Project and Vallee Lithium Project. Its Eeyou Istchee James Bay Hub includes Moblan Lithium Project, Lac Albert Lithium Project and Troilus Claims. In Western Australia, it has lithium and gold projects. Its projects also include Ewoyaa Lithium Project and Carolina Lithium Project. Authier Lithium Project in Quebec, Canada is a hard rock spodumene lithium deposit. Tansim Lithium Project is situated 82 kilometers south-west of the Authier Lithium Project. Moblan Lithium Project is located in the Eeyou-Istchee James Bay region of northern Quebec, a proven lithium mining province which hosts lithium resources including the Whabouchi mine.

name: PLATINA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Platina Resources Limited is an Australia-based company focused on advancing early-stage metals projects through exploration, feasibility, and permitting towards development. The Company controls a 100% interest in a portfolio of gold projects in the Yilgarn Craton in Western Australia. It operates a range of projects consisting of Mt McKenna, Beete, Brimstone, Binti Binti, Mt Narryer, and Jubilee. The Beete Gold Project covers 134 kilometers (km) and is located in a historical high-grade mining district near Norseman, and 10 km south of 1 Moz Scotia Mining center. The Brimstone Gold Project covers 65.62 km2 and is located 40 km north-east of Kalgoorlie within a proven gold district in close proximity to the Penny's Find gold deposit. The Challa project includes two exploration licenses covering 293 km2 located approximately 500km north-east of Perth in Western Australia. The Binti Binti Project comprises two exploration licenses located approximately 50km north-east of Kalgoorlie.

name: QUANTUM HELIUM
businessSummary: Quantum Helium Ltd, formerly Mosman Oil and Gas Limited, is a helium, hydrogen and hydrocarbon exploration, development, and production company with projects in the United States and Australia. It has several projects in the United States, in addition to exploration projects in the Amadeus Basin in Central Australia. Its exploration focus is Southwest and Southeast Colorado, which has significant concentrations of helium and historical helium production. Its projects include Sagebrush project, Cinnabar Lease and Coyote Wash Project. The Sagebrush project is in the Four Corners region in Colorado, the United States, which is an area of helium production from the Leadville formation carbonates from fields such as Doe Creek. The Sagebrush project covers over 10,000 acres with existing oil fields and helium encounters in the area. It holds a 100% working interest across the Coyote Wash Project area of 4320 acres. It has 75% working interest in over 350 acre Cinnabar Lease in East Texas.

name: GREAT BEAR EXPLORATION
businessSummary: Great Bear Exploration Ltd is an Australia-based company. The Company's Great Bear Project covers an area over 2,800 square kilometers (km2). The Project is located in the Echo Bay Stratovolcano Complex (EBSVC) situated near the northeastern margin of the Great Bear Magmatic Zone (GBMZ), along the eastern shore of Great Bear Lake in the northwestern Canadian Shield. The Company owns an oil technology business (HCD Multi-Flow) that allows for the swift, clean and cost-effective treatment of heavy, asphaltenic and paraffinic oils. The technology is applicable to oil production, transportation and storage.

name: LARK DISTILLING
businessSummary: Lark Distilling Co. Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the production, marketing, selling and distribution of Australian craft spirits. The Company has three segments: whisky, gin, and other. It offers various Whisky products, such as Dark Lark Single Malt Whisky, Classic Cask, Boilermaker House Whisky Bar Limited Release, and Para 1992 Cask Finish with 100ml Tawny Liqueur, among others. It offers a range of Gin products, which include Forty Spotted Citrus & Pepperberry + Pinot Noir Gin, Forty Spotted Classic Gin & Raspberry + Rose, Forty Spotted Classic, Forty Spotted Tassie Bush Honey, Forty Spotted Wild Rose, Forty Spotted Citrus & Pepperberry, Forty Spotted Raspberry & Rose, and Forty Spotted Pinot Noir. It operates in Tasmania and Australia. It markets its products via traditional off-premise retailers and on-premises bars, and via its direct-to-consumer business, which is hospitality and online e-commerce. Its primary focus is Whisky and the Lark brand.

name: ADORE BEAUTY GROUP
businessSummary: Adore Beauty Group Limited is an Australia-based beauty focused e-commerce Website. The Company provides an integrated content, marketing and e-commerce retail platform that partners with a portfolio of over 300 brands and 14,000 products. It sells beauty and personal care products to Australian and New Zealand consumers. It fulfils orders from its customer fulfilment center in Victoria. The Company's product categories include skin care, makeup, hair, body, fragrance, teen, men, Korean beauty, clean beauty, wellness, travel size, trending, gifts, subscribe and save, refills, specials, and bundles. It offers various brands, which include Aceology, Adore Beauty, AERIN Beauty, Aesop, Aesthetics Rx, Baebrow, Calvin Klein, Davines, Davroe, Denman Brushes, Embryolisse, Espoir, others. The Company's skin care products include cosmeceuticals, serums & treatments, moisturizers, cleansers & scrubs, and masks. Its hair products include hair bond repair, hair fall & thinning, and conditioners.

name: HARVEY NORMAN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Harvey Norman Holdings Limited is engaged in the integrated retail, franchise, property and digital system business. Its principal activities include franchisor; Omni-channel retailing of furniture, bedding, computers, communications and consumer electrical products in New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Slovenia, Ireland, Croatia and the United Kingdom; Property investment; Lessor of premises to Harvey Norman, Domayne and Joyce Mayne franchisees and other third parties; media placement, and Provision of other commercial loans and advances. Its segments include Franchising Operations, New Zealand (retail), Singapore & Malaysia (retail), Slovenia & Croatia (retail), Ireland (retail), United Kingdom (retail), Other Non-Franchised Retail, Retail Property, Retail Property Under Construction, Property Developments for Resale, Equity Investments, and Other. New Zealand (retail) segment includes retail trading operations in New Zealand under the Harvey Norman brand name.

name: PATRONUS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Patronus Resources Limited is a gold, base metals and uranium development and exploration company. The Company has combined gold Mineral Resource of more than 1.2Moz gold. The Company’s key focus in Western Australia is its 100% owned Cardinia Gold Project (CGP) located in the highly prospective North-Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia. The CGP has a 1.0 Moz gold Mineral Resource defined in both oxide and deeper primary mineralization at East Cardinia and Mertondale. The Northern Territory Project covers more than 1,500 square kilometers of prime tenure in the Pine Creek Orogen, which hosts significant gold and uranium deposits. It has gold MRE of 0.3Moz at its Fountain Head Project and 177kt zinc, 37kt lead,16Moz silver and 0.2Moz gold at its Iron Blow and Mt Bonnie base metals projects. It covers over 739 square kilometers of tenure in the highly prospective Leonora region of Western Australia. It also has an interest in the Tennant Creek area of the Northern Territory.

name: WESTPAC BANKING
businessSummary: Westpac Banking Corporation is an Australia-based company that provides banking and selected financial services, operating under multiple brands, and predominantly in Australia and New Zealand, with a small presence in Europe, North America, Asia and the Pacific. Its segments include Consumer, Business & Wealth, Westpac Institutional Bank (WIB), Westpac New Zealand and Group Businesses. The Consumer segment provides a full range of banking products and services to customers in Australia through three lines of business consisting of mortgages, consumer finance and cash and transactional banking. The Business & Wealth segment comprises business banking, wealth management, private wealth, and Westpac Pacific. The WIB segment delivers a range of financial products and services to corporate, institutional and government customers. The Westpac New Zealand segment provides banking, and wealth products and services for consumer, business and institutional customers in New Zealand.

name: FIREFLY METALS
businessSummary: FireFly Metals Ltd engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral deposits in Australia and Canada. It primarily explores for gold, titanium, vanadium, and copper deposits. Its flagship project is the Green Bay copper-gold project located in Newfoundland, Canada. The company was formerly known as Auteco Minerals Limited and changed its name to FireFly Metals Ltd in November 2023. FireFly Metals Ltd was incorporated in 2004 and is based in West Perth, Australia.

isin: BKB|BLACK BEAR MINERALS|BKB.AX|Black Bear Minerals Limited
name: BLACK BEAR MINERALS
businessSummary: Black Bear Minerals Limited explores and evaluates mineral properties in the United States and Canada. It explores for gold, silver, and lithium deposits. The company holds 100% interest in the Shafter Project located in Presidio County  Independence Project comprising 80 unpatented mining claims and 84 unpatented mill sites covering an area of 1,861 acres located in Lander County, Nevada  and lithium exploration portfolios located in the James Bay region of Quebec, Canada. The company was formerly known as James Bay Minerals Limited and changed its name to Black Bear Minerals Limited in November 2025. Black Bear Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2022 and is based in East Perth, Australia.

name: WAYPOINT REIT
businessSummary: Waypoint REIT is Australia's largest listed REIT owning solely fuel and convenience retail properties, with a high-quality portfolio of 394 assets across Australia as at 30 June 2026. Waypoint REIT's objective is to maximise the long-term returns from the portfolio for the benefit of all securityholders. Waypoint REIT is a stapled entity in which one share in Waypoint REIT Limited is stapled to one unit in the Waypoint REIT Trust. This ASX announcement is prepared for information purposes only and is correct at the time of release to the ASX. Factual circumstances may change following the release of this announcement. Waypoint REIT was established on 14 June 2016 and was incorporated in Australia.

name: FORRESTANIA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Forrestania Resources Limited operates as a gold exploration and development company in Western Australia. It also explores for copper and lithium. It's flagship project is Ada Ann project covering an area of 90 square kilometers located in Western Australia Eastern Goldfields  and The Lady Lila deposit located in Western Australia. Forrestania Resources Limited was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Perth, Australia.

name: ORBIT RESOURCES
businessSummary: Orbit Resources Limited, formerly Godolphin Resources Limited, is an Australia-based exploration and project development company. The Company is focused on unlocking value from its portfolio of gold, silver and base metals projects located within the highly prospective Lachlan Fold Belt of New South Wales. The Company is advancing the Lewis Ponds Gold, Silver and Base Metals Project, while exploring a substantial tenement portfolio prospective for precious and base metals. Its other projects include Narraburra Rare Earth Element (REE) Project, Yeoval Porphyry gold-copper-molybdenum-rhenium joint venture project, Copper Hill East porphyry copper project, and Mt Aubrey epithermal gold-silver project. Its other REE projects include EL9506 - Bingara (New South Wales). The 100% owned Lewis Ponds project covers approximately 148 square kilometers located 15 kilometers east of Orange (EL5583) in a historically active gold and base metals workings area.

name: NATIONAL AUSTRALIA BANK
businessSummary: National Australia Bank Limited is a financial services company. Its segments include Business and Private Banking, Personal Banking, Corporate and Institutional Banking, New Zealand Banking, and Corporate Functions and Other. Business and Private Banking focuses on small and medium enterprise customer segments. This includes diversified businesses, as well as specialized agriculture, health and professional services. Personal Banking provides banking products and services to customers, including securing a home loan and managing personal finances through deposits, credit card or personal loan facilities. Corporate and Institutional Banking partner with customers globally to meet their financial needs, through a range of products and services including client coverage, corporate finance, markets, enterprise payments and asset servicing. New Zealand Banking serves customers across New Zealand with personal and business banking services, through a nationwide network of customer centers.

name: IRESS
businessSummary: Iress Limited is a technology company providing software to the financial services industry. The Company provides software and services for the financial services industry. It operates across Asia-Pacific, the United Kingdom and Europe, Africa, and North America regions. Its Trading & Global Market Data segment provides comprehensive solutions to financial market participants, encompassing market data, trading, compliance, order management, portfolio, and related tools designed to enhance business efficiencies. Its APAC Wealth Management provides financial advice software and related tools to the advice industry in the Asia Pacific region. Its UK segment includes UK Wealth Management and Sourcing, which provides insurance and mortgage comparison tools to UK financial advisers. Its South Africa, Canada & Other segment includes Financial Markets businesses related tools to financial market participants in South Africa and Canada.

isin: AFG.AX|Australian Finance Group Limited|AFG.AX|Australian Finance Group Limited
name: AUSTRALIAN FINANCE GROUP
businessSummary: Australian Finance Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the mortgage origination and lending business in Australia. It operates through Distribution and Manufacturing segments. The company is involved in the distribution of home loans, consumer asset finance and commercial loans through AFG broker, as well as residential mortgage lending of own branded home loan products distributed through warehouse facilities and the Group's residential mortgage-backed securities program and white label products. Its products include Suite360 Platform, BrokerEngine Plus Software, and SMART marketing platform, and analytics and business data. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Perth, Australia.

name: FREELANCER
businessSummary: Freelancer Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the provision of an online outsourcing marketplace and escrow payment services. The Company is involved in the freelancing and crowdsourcing marketplace. The Company operates through two segments: Online Marketplace and Online Payment. The Company owns Escrow.com, a provider of secure online payments and online transaction management for consumers and businesses on the Internet. It safeguards both the buyer and seller with all funds kept in trust that are transacted in escrow. The Company also owns Loadshift, a heavy haulage freight marketplace with over 750 million kilometers of freight posted. The Company has more than 80 million registered users and have posted over 25 million projects and contests in over 3,000 areas, as diverse as Website development, logo design, marketing, copywriting, astrophysics, aerospace engineering and manufacturing.

name: ALTERITY THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Alterity Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is focused on developing disease modifying treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. The Company's lead asset, ATH434, is to treat various Parkinsonian disorders. ATH434 is an oral agent designed to inhibit the aggregation of pathological proteins implicated in neurodegeneration. It has the potential to treat Parkinson's disease, as well as various Parkinsonian disorders, such as Multiple System Atrophy (MSA). The Company also has a drug discovery platform generating patentable chemical compounds to intercede in disease processes. Its lead asset, ATH434, is in a randomized, double blind, placebo-controlled Phase II clinical trial in participants with MSA. The Company is also conducting various nonclinical studies with ATH434 for use in Parkinson’s disease based on imaging of brain iron, preservation of neurons, and improvements in motor performance.

name: DUBBER
businessSummary: Dubber Corporation Limited (Dubber) is an Australia-based company. The Company enables communications service providers to unlock the potential of the network. It is engaged in unified call recording and conversational intelligence solutions. The Company’s segments include provision of subscriptions services in Europe, the United States of America (Americas), and the Rest of the World (including Australia). The Company’s solutions include Dubber Insights, unified conversation capture, and call recording. The Company offers its products to various industries such as finance, healthcare, automotive, retail, government, and other industries. It provides conversational intelligence and unified conversational recording embedded at the heart of over 245 communications service provider networks and services. Its subsidiaries include Medulla Group Pty Ltd, Dubber Pty Ltd, Dubber USA Pty Ltd, Dubber Connect Australia Pty Ltd, and others.

name: ST BARBARA
businessSummary: St Barbara Limited is an Australia-based gold mining company with operations in Canada and Papua New Guinea. The Company's operations include the Atlantic Operations and the Simberi Operations. Its Atlantic Operations in Nova Scotia, Canada consists of its open pit Touquoy mine, along with three additional planned projects nearby at Fifteen Mile Stream, Cochrane Hill and Beaver Dam. Its Atlantic Operations are located approximately 80 kilometers (km) north-east of Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. The Company is also exploring the Moose River Corridor and elsewhere in Nova Scotia. Its Simberi Operations consists of an open cut mine on the northernmost island in the Tabar group of islands in the province of New Ireland in Papua New Guinea. Its Simberi Operations is located approximately 900 km away from the capital of Papua New Guinea, Port Moresby.

name: IDT AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: IDT Australia Limited is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company. The Company is engaged in the supply of products and provision of research and development and other technical services within the pharmaceutical and allied industries. Its business includes research and development, active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and finished dosage form manufacture (FDF), clinical and commercial, project management, chemical services, analytical chemistry, pharmacy services, pharmaceutical development in all dosage forms, clinical packaging and regulatory affairs services. Its Current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) manufacturing facilities produces both API and FDF across the medicinal cannabis manufacturing space. It also provides a full-scale service for new drug development and scale-up, commercial active drug manufacture as well as a variety of oral and injectable finished drug dose forms. Its analytical laboratories offer medicinal cannabis cGMP testing.

name: ENERGY RESOURCES OF AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Energy Resources of Australia Ltd is an Australia-based company. The principal activities of the Company consist of site rehabilitation of the Ranger Project Area. The Company’s Ranger Mine area is located about eight kilometers (kms) east of Jabiru and approximately 260 kms east of Darwin, in Australia's Northern Territory. It also holds title to the Jabiluka mineral lease. The Ranger Mine area and the Jabiluka mineral lease are located on Aboriginal land and are surrounded by, but separate from, the Kakadu National Park. The Ranger uranium mine lies approximately 79 square kilometers and is surrounded by, but separate from, the Kakadu National Park, which is located in the Northern Territory. The estimated mineral resource is approximately 137,100 tons of uranium oxide.

name: XREF
businessSummary: Xref Limited is an Australia-based human resource (HR) and recruitment technology company that automates the candidate reference process for employers. The Company operates through three segments: Xref Platform, Trust Marketplace, and Xref Engage. The Xref Platform segment includes enterprise platform, which provides pre-employment reference surveys, pulse and exit surveys; and recruiter platform, which provides pre-employment reference surveys. The Trust Marketplace segment includes ID verification, qualification checks and background checks. The Xref Engage segment includes engagement surveys. The Company's solutions by industry include not-for-profit, health and aged care, government, construction, retail, hospitality, and aged care QI surveys. Its platform's features include survey builder, people records, reporting and insights, integrations, security and compliance, and automated requests. Its types of integration include background checks and applicant tracking system.

name: CANN GROUP
businessSummary: Cann Group Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on developing, producing, and supplying innovative cannabis medicines. The principal activities of the Company include the cultivation of medicinal cannabis for both medicinal and research purposes pursuant to the licenses and permits issued to the Company, the development and manufacture (via third party arrangements) of finished product formulations, and the pursuit and execution of various supply agreements with third parties. It operates through cultivation of the medicinal cannabis segment. The Company supplies a range of dried flower and oil products, as well as active pharmaceutical ingredients and extracts, to customers in Australia and around the world. It also owns Satipharm and its patent-protected capsule technology. The Company's research and good manufacturing practices (GMP) manufacturing facilities are near Mildura, Victoria.

name: MASTERMYNE GROUP
businessSummary: Mastermyne Group Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company provides mine operations, contracting, training and related services in mining and supporting industries across Australia. Its mining provides a full range of services and equipment to the coal mining industry, including new mine development, mine operation, roadway development, conveyors, outbye services, ventilation, secondary support, longwall relocations, polymeric emergency strata consolidation, production and ancillary equipment, and mining consumables. In addition, its Registered Training Organization delivers training and compliance solutions that improve efficiency and reduce costs to mine operators. Its portfolio of work encompasses outcomes for clients including Anglo American, Centennial Coal, Fitzroy Mining Operations, Glencore, GM3, Peabody Energy, Whitehaven Coal and Yancoal.

name: MATSA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Matsa Resources Limited is an exploration and gold mining company operating south of Laverton in the northeastern goldfields of Western Australia. The Company’s exploration activities are focused on its flagship Lake Carey Gold Project and has landholding in Thailand for lithium and base metals. The Company holds a ground position of about 449 square kilometers at Lake Carey within the Laverton tectonic zone, located in Western Australia. The Lake Carey Gold Project includes three gold mines that are in care and maintenance, including the underground Red October gold mine and open pit Fortitude and Devon gold pits. Its key exploration focus at Lake Carey is centered on defining a new resource at the Fortitude North prospect, located about six kilometers (km) to the north and along the strike of the Fortitude Gold Mine. It also has a number of developing lithium and copper assets in Thailand with approximately 1,700 square kilometers.

name: MINERALS 260
businessSummary: Minerals 260 Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company's projects include the Moora Project, Aston Project, and Bullabulling Project. The 100%-owned Moora Project is located 140km north-east of Perth in the Wheatbelt Region of Western Australia. The Moora Project consists of three granted exploration licenses and one exploration license application registered in the name of the Company’s subsidiary, ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd, covering approximately 371 sq km. The Aston Project is located in the Gascoyne Region of Western Australia, approximately 850 km north of Perth and 100 km northeast of the township of Gascoyne Junction. The Aston Project consists of 15 granted exploration licenses and two exploration license applications. The Bullabulling Project is an undeveloped gold deposit, located 25km south-west of Coolgardie in the Western Australian Goldfields. Its subsidiaries include ERL (Aust) Pty Ltd and Minerals 260 Holdings Pty Ltd.

name: TALONX RESOURCES
businessSummary: Talonx Resources Limited, formerly Mount Burgess Mining N.L., is an Australia-based company engaged in the discovery and developing commercial deposits of mineral resources. Its projects include Viking Project, Blair North Project, and Kihabe Project. The Viking Gold Project is located 30 kilometers (km) east of Norseman. The project comprises 66 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenure situated within the Albany-Fraser Province. The Blair North Project is located 25 km east of Kalgoorlie, surrounded by established operations and gold deposits. The Blair North project offers drill-ready targets along strike and at depth at the Commodore prospects. The Blair North Project sits approximately 20km southeast of Kalgoorlie in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia, within a prolific gold and nickel district rich in existing infrastructure. The Kihabe Project (PL43/2016) is situated in West Ngamiland, within the Republic of Botswana. The Kihabe project covers an area of 1,000 km2.

isin: MAF.AX|MA Financial Group Limited|MAF.AX|MA Financial Group Limited
name: MA FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: MA Financial Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial services in Australia. It operates through Asset Management, Lending & Technology, and Corporate Advisory & Equities segments. The company operates as an asset manager specializing in private credit, real estate, and private equity and venture capital  and manages traditional asset classes, including equities, bonds, and cash for wholesale, retail, and institutional investors. It also offers lending platforms for the provision of loan funding, real estate mortgages, and financial technology comprising mortgage aggregation services. In addition, the company provides financial advice for mergers and acquisitions and strategic advisory, equity and debt capital markets, capital structure advisory, and equities research and trading  and corporate advice, underwriting, and institutional stockbroking services, as well as specialised services in real estate, credit and restructuring, resources technology, and small to mid-cap industrial companies. MA Financial Group Limited was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Sydney, Australia.

name: SENSEN NETWORKS
businessSummary: Sensen Networks Limited is an Australia-based sensor artificial intelligence (AI) solutions provider. The principal activities of the Company include developing and selling SenDISA platform-based products and services into smart city and retail markets across three market segments: Smart Cities, Casinos, and Retail. Smart Cities include civic compliance, traffic data and law enforcement solutions to city councils, national parks, road authorities and transit agencies across the globe. Casinos include delivering actionable insights about casino table game occupancy, hands per hour, bet type and value for every bet placed on the gaming floor. Retail provides anti-theft and debt recovery services to fuel retailers. The Company’s geographical segments include Australia and New Zealand, North America (comprising USA and Canada), and Asia. SenDISA’s Live Awareness automates processes and ensures other decisions can be made more quickly and accurately.

name: FREEHILL MINING
businessSummary: Freehill Mining Limited is a mining and exploration company. It is focused on the development of its 100%-owned, 478-hectare Yerbas Buenas magnetite and associated materials project in Chile. It also holds copper and gold exploration projects in Chile and is assessing other related investment opportunities. The Company, through its Chilean companies Yerbas Buenas SpA and San Patricio Mineria SpA, hold several concessions in an area just north of the city of Coquimbo-La Serena, Chile. These concessions are all located in one area in Region IV of Chile on the coast about 500 kilometers north of the capital Santiago. The concessions comprise a large JORC magnetite resource within the Yerbas Buenas and Arenas concession blocks and a magnetite-copper-gold exploration area on the northern boundary of Yerbas Buenas with eight blocks collectively known as the El Dorado project. The El Dorado project is located in the El Tofo fault and within the Atacama IOCG belt (Iron Oxide Copper Gold).

name: ADISYN
businessSummary: Adisyn Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development of graphene-based interconnects in Australia. It operates through Adisyn Services and 2D Generation segments. The company offers managed support services, cyber security services, cloud and data centre co-location, network services, and back-up services. It also provides graphene technology which focuses on low-temperature atomic layer deposition (ALD) process to enable direct graphene growth on semiconductor wafers. The company was formerly known as DC Two Limited and changed its name to Adisyn Ltd in October 2023. Adisyn Ltd was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Henderson, Australia.

name: AML3D
businessSummary: AML3D Limited is an Australia-based technology company. It is disrupting metal part supply chains using the Company’s patented wire additive manufacturing (WAM) process. WAM combines state-of-the-art welding science, robotics automation, materials engineering, and proprietary software to lead metal additive manufacturing globally. It is the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the ARCEMY industrial metal 3D printing systems. ARCEMY uses WAM to provide advanced, automated, point-of-need 3D manufacturing solutions that are efficient, cost-effective and have ESG outcomes compared to traditional casting, forging and billet machining processes. ARCEMY is the Internet of Things (IoT) and Industry 4.0 enabled to allow manufacturers across aerospace, defense, maritime, manufacturing, mining and oil & gas to become globally competitive. It also provides metal 3D printing design engineering services, software licensing, technical support, consumable sales and contract manufacturing services.

name: BKI INVESTMENT
businessSummary: BKI Investment Company Limited is an Australia-based investment company. The Company is primarily focused on long-term investment in Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) listed securities. The Company focuses on generating an increasing income stream for distribution to shareholders in the form of fully franked dividends to the extent of available imputation tax credits, through long-term investment in a portfolio of assets that are also able to deliver long term capital growth to shareholders. Its investment strategy is focused on research-driven, active equities management, investing for the long term, in profitable companies, with a history of paying attractive dividend yields. The Company's portfolio includes sectors, such as financials, materials, energy, consumer discretionary, utilities, industrials, consumer staples, telecommunication, healthcare and property. Its investment manager is Contact Asset Management Pty Limited.

name: READYTECH HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ReadyTech Holdings Limited is an Australia-based provider of software as a service (SaaS) for the education, employment services, workforce management, government and justice sectors. The Company's segments include Education and Work Pathways, Workforce Solutions, and Government and Justice. Education and Work Pathways segment provides products and services to tertiary education providers. Its products include cloud-based student management systems and learning management systems for education and training providers. Workforce Solutions provides products and services to mid-sized companies across various industries with payroll software, outsourced payroll services, human resource management and recruitment software solutions to employers to assist them with payroll and the management of their employees. Government and Justice segment provides government and justice case management software as a service solution to local governments, state governments and justice departments.

name: ANDEAN SILVER
businessSummary: Andean Silver Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing its 100% owned Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold project in the Aysen region of Southern Chile. The Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold project covers 285 square kilometers (km2) and comprises over 70 contiguous exploration concessions as well as surface properties that cover the areas of the Laguna Verde mining district and processing facilities. The Cerro Bayo Silver-Gold Project hosts indicated and inferred mineral resources of 9.8 million tons at a grade of 353 grams per ton for 111 million ounces of contained silver equivalent (AgEq). Its other projects include Hillside Project, Mt Alexander Project and Araluen Project. The Mt Alexander Project (E29/1167) is located on the western margin of the prospective Mt Alexander greenstone belt. The Los Domos represents southeastern extension of the Cerro Bayo system with a cumulative strike of over 10km and comprising over 8 major targets.

name: AUSTAL
businessSummary: Austal Limited is an Australia-based global shipbuilder and defense prime contractor designing, constructing and sustaining advanced commercial and defense vessels. The principal activities of the Company include the design, manufacture and support of high-performance vessels for commercial and defense customers. The Company operates through four segments: USA Shipbuilding, USA Support, Australasia Shipbuilding and Australasia Support. The USA Shipbuilding segment includes the USA manufactures high-performance defense vessels primarily for the US Navy and Coast Guard. The USA Support segment provides ongoing support and maintenance of Austal and non-Austal vessels to the US Navy, principally in the United States (USA) and other international jurisdictions. The Australasia Shipbuilding segment comprises Australia, Philippines and Vietnam shipbuilding operations. The Australasia Support segment comprises Australia and Trinidad and Tobago operations.

name: GULF STREAM ENERGY
businessSummary: Gulf Stream Energy Ltd, formerly Galilee Energy Limited, is an Australia-based company. The Company is focused on building a United States Gulf Coast oil and gas business through the acquisition and development of low-risk, near-term production opportunities. The Company’s strategy is focused on the Zydeco Project in Louisiana. The Company also retains a 2% net overriding royalty over production from the Glenaras Gas Project, Queensland.

name: AURIZON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Aurizon Holdings Limited is an Australia-based rail freight operator. The Company’s segments include Network, Coal and Bulk. The Network segment manages the provision of access to the CQCN rail infrastructure and operation and maintenance of the network. The Coal segment provides transport of metallurgical and thermal coal from mines in Queensland and New South Wales to domestic customers and coal export terminals. The Bulk segment provides integrated supply chain services, including rail and road transportation, port services and material handling for a range of mining, metal, industrial and agricultural customers throughout Australia. This segment also manages the Tarcoola-to-Darwin rail infrastructure, and the intrastate rail freight network in South Australia, and containerized freight services between Adelaide and Darwin. It transports more than 250 million tons of Australian commodities, connecting miners, primary producers and industry with international and domestic markets.

name: CENTURIA INDUSTRIAL REIT
businessSummary: Centuria Industrial REIT is Australia's largest domestic pure play industrial REIT. CIP's portfolio of high-quality industrial assets is situated in urban infill locations throughout Australia and is underpinned by a quality and diverse tenant base. CIP is overseen by a hands-on, active manager and provides investors with income and an opportunity for capital growth from a pure play portfolio of high quality Australian industrial assets. Centuria Industrial REIT was incorporated in Australia.

name: SYNTARA
businessSummary: Syntara Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage drug development company. The Company is targeting extracellular matrix dysfunction with its amine oxidase chemistry and other technologies to develop novel medicines for blood cancers and conditions linked to inflammation and fibrosis. The Company’s lead candidate SNT-5505 is for the bone marrow cancer myelofibrosis which causes a build-up of scar tissue that leads to loss of red and white blood cells and platelets. The Company is also advancing topical pan-LOX inhibitors in scar revision, keloid scarring and scar prevention post-surgery. Its product candidate, SNT-4728, is an inhibitor to treat sleep disorders and slow progression of neurodegenerative diseases like Parkinson’s by reducing neuroinflammation. The Company’s other drug candidates target fibrotic and inflammatory diseases such as kidney fibrosis, NASH, pulmonary fibrosis and cardiac fibrosis.

name: INFOTRUST
businessSummary: Infotrust Ltd, formerly Spirit Technology Solutions Limited, is an Australia-based technology and cyber security services provider. The Company helps organizations to stay secure, compliant and connected through integrated cyber security, secure managed technology, and cloud communication services. The Company delivers end-to-end cyber security, managed IT, and advisory services for public and private sectors. Its Australia-based security operations center operates 24/7, ensuring real-time threat detection and rapid response. Its services include offensive, defensive, compliance, managed security operations center (SOC), secure modern workplace, network security, managed IT support, and business automation & Internet-of-Things (IoT). Its solutions include secure email ecosystem, secure endpoint, secure cloud access and secure network. Its offensive services include Penetration Testing and SMB1001. Its defensive services include continuous threat exposure management and data security.

name: CORONADO GLOBAL RESOURCES
businessSummary: Coronado Global Resources Inc. is a global producer, marketer, and exporter of a full range of metallurgical coals. The Company has a portfolio of operating mines and development projects in Queensland, Australia, and in the states of Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia in the United States. It has operations in Australia and the United States. Its Australian Operations comprise the 100%-owned Curragh producing mine complex. Its Curragh complex is located in the Bowen Basin, approximately 14 kilometers (km) north of Blackwater in central Queensland. Curragh produces a variety of low-ash metallurgical coal products. The United States operations are located in the Central Appalachian region in Virginia and West Virginia and produce a suite of metallurgical coal products. It has two producing mining complexes in the United States, which include Buchanan Complex and Logan Complex. It also has two development properties in the United States, which include Mon Valley and Russell County.

name: ANZ GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ANZ Group Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a non-operating holding company. It provides banking and financial products and services. Its divisions include Australia Retail, Australia Commercial, Institutional, Suncorp Bank, New Zealand, and Pacific. The Australia Retail division provides banking products and services to consumers, including home loans, deposits, credit cards and personal loans. The Australia Commercial division provides banking products and services to small-to-medium enterprises, large commercial customers and high-net-worth individuals and family groups. The Institutional division provides services to institutional and corporate clients, including governments, via transaction banking, corporate finance and markets business units. The Suncorp Bank division provides banking and related services to retail, commercial, small and medium enterprises and agribusiness customers.

name: GSTECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: GSTechnologies Limited is an Australia-based fintech company. The Company's principal activity comprises of fintech services through the use of blockchain technology, and the provision of data infrastructure, storage and technology services by its subsidiaries. The Company's subsidiaries include Golden Saint Technologies (Australia) Pty Ltd, GS Fintech Ltd, GS Fintech Pte Ltd, GS Fintech UAB, Angra Limited, Angra Global Limited and Semnet Pte Ltd. Angra Global operates under the AngraFX and Angra Global brand names and is an FCA approved Authorized Payment Institution (API), as well as holding a Canadian Money Services Business (MSB) license. The GS20 Exchange is offering spot trading and over-the-counter trading desk services for crypto assets, although it is not a pure cryptocurrency exchange. Its GS Money platform is a blockchain-driven neo banking platform. The Company's Bake Cryptocurrency platform includes the Bake.io Web application and Bake mobile app.

name: MAYFIELD CHILDCARE
businessSummary: Mayfield Childcare Limited is an Australia-based childcare services provider. The Company is primarily engaged in operating long day childcare (LDC) centers located in Victoria, Queensland and South Australia. The Company owns and operates approximately 45 long day care centers located in Victoria, Queensland and South Australia, providing education and care to over 3,600 families. It has over 4,000 registered childcare places. The Company’s childcare centers include Mayfield Early Education Oakbank, Clever Kids Early Learning, Precious Cargo Westbourne Park, Precious Cargo Woodville Park, Mayfield Early Education Bayswater, Mayfield Early Education Camberwell, Mayfield Early Education Cheltenham, Mayfield Early Education Clyde North, Mayfield Early Education Dandenong, Mayfield Early Education Allenstown, Mayfield Early Education Brinsmead, Mayfield Early Education Brose Street, Mayfield Early Education Clifton Beach, Mayfield Early Education Norman Gardens, among others.

name: RMA GLOBAL
businessSummary: RMA Global Limited is an Australia-based online digital marketing company. The Company operates RateMyAgent, a review platform for client-centered Real Estate professionals. It is engaged in providing data on real estate agents, their active residential property listings and sale results, as well as reviews from vendors and buyers of residential real estate. It operates sales, leasing and mortgage broking across the United States of America, Australia, and New Zealand. Its business offers a way for agents to efficiently collect and promote client reviews, helping them stay top of mind with past clients and earn trust with prospective new clients. The primary streams for the business consist of subscription and promoter fees. Promoter is a product that enables agents and agencies to digitally promote their digital profiles through various third-party platforms. Its subsidiaries include RateMyAgent.com Pty Ltd, RateMyAgent Services Pty Ltd, RAdmin (Aus) Pty Ltd, and RateMyAgent Inc.

name: PENINSULA ENERGY
businessSummary: Peninsula Energy Limited is an Australia-based uranium mining company. The Company owns the Lance Project (Lance) and Dagger Project. The Lance Project is located in Wyoming, United States of America, operated through its 100% owned subsidiary, Strata Energy Inc (Strata). The Lance Projects comprise the Ross Production Project Area, Kendrick Development Project Area and Barber Exploration Area. The Lance Projects are located in Crook County, in northeastern Wyoming, approximately 31 miles east-northeast of the town of Gillette and extend over a strike length of 37 kilometers (kms) to the north, and over a strike width of eight km. It holds mineral rights and surface access rights over a non-contiguous north-south distance of about 50 km. In Wyoming, the Company has mineral rights of over 43,358 acres and surface access rights over land holdings of 11,982 acres. The Dagger Project in Crook County, Wyoming lies within the North Black Hills district in the northeast corner of the state.

name: HUMM GROUP
businessSummary: humm Group Limited is an Australia-based diversified financial services company that provides instalment plans which enable businesses and consumers to make large purchases. The Company operates in Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Its principal activities include the provision of Commercial Lending in Australia and New Zealand; Point of Sale Payment Plans (PosPP); Australia Cards (humm 90, and Lombard); and New Zealand Cards (including Farmers Finance Card, Farmers Mastercard, Q Card, Q Mastercard and Flight Centre Mastercard). The Company operates through four segments: Commercial and Leasing, New Zealand Cards, Australia Cards, and PosPP. Its Commercial segment consists of Australia and New Zealand Commercial Lending. Its Australia Cards segment includes humm90, and Legacy Lombard. Its PosPP segment includes a consolidation of humm Australia, humm Canada, humm Ireland and humm UK.

name: SANTANA MINERALS
businessSummary: Santana Minerals Limited engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in New Zealand and Cambodia. The company explores for gold deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the Bendigo-Ophir gold project that covers approximately an area of 324 square kilometers located in the Central Otago region of the South Island. Santana Minerals Limited was formerly known as Cerro Resources NL, Non-Cerro del Gallo Projects and Interests. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.

name: BUBS AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Bubs Australia Limited is an Australia-based producer of infant and adult chilled and powdered, goat dairy products. It offers families around the world a comprehensive range of Australian premium infant nutrition products under the Bubs brand, including goat milk infant formula, organic grass-fed cow milk infant formula, organic baby food, cereals, toddler snacks, as well as a range of adult nutritional powders and chilled goat milk under the Caprilac brand. Bubs A2 Beta-Casein Protein, Bubs Organic Grass-fed, and Easy-Digest Goat Milk Infant Formula, along with Bubs Organic baby food range, cater for all feeding occasions and stages of a child’s development during their first 1,000 days of life. Its organic food range includes organic plant burst pouches, organic snack range and organic baby cereal. Its products are sold in supermarkets and pharmacies throughout Australia, as well as exported to around 10 markets across China, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and United States.

name: COMPUMEDICS
businessSummary: Compumedics Limited is an Australia-based medical device company which is involved in the development, manufacture, and commercialization of diagnostics technology for sleep, brain and ultrasonic blood flow monitoring applications. Its geographic segments include the Americas, Australia and Asia Pacific, and Europe and the Middle East. It sells all of its product offerings in this region, including sleep diagnostic systems, clinical electroencephalograms (EEG systems), brain monitoring systems, ultrasonic blood-flow systems, supplies and technical service and support. It provides Sleep Diagnostics and Neurology Diagnostics Solutions. Its products include Compumedics Siesta, Compumedics Somfit, Compumedics Somte PSG and others. It provides a range of solutions for the neurology laboratory, from clinical epilepsy monitoring applications to Transcranial Doppler Sonography. Its other products include Grael 4K PSG, Falcon HST, Okti, Neuvo 64-512 Channel LTM EEG and others.

name: SONIC HEALTHCARE
businessSummary: Sonic Healthcare Limited is a global provider of medical diagnostic services. The Company's segments include Laboratory, Radiology, and Other. The Laboratory segment includes pathology/clinical laboratory services provided in Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, the United States of America, Germany, Switzerland and Belgium. The Radiology segment includes diagnostic imaging services provided in Australia. The Other segment includes corporate office functions, medical center operations (IPN), occupational health services (Sonic HealthPlus), and other minor operations. The Company's Healthcare’s Australian Clinical Services division (Sonic Clinical Services) is a medical center operator (under the Independent Practitioner Network brand) and occupational health provider (under the Sonic HealthPlus brand). Sonic Clinical Services operates in partnership with approximately 2,000 general practitioners working in more than approximately 235 centers across Australia.

name: INTELLIGENT MONITORING GROUP
businessSummary: Intelligent Monitoring Group Limited is an Australia-based security company. The Company is engaged in providing provision of security, monitoring and risk management services in Australia. The Company operates through three segments: Monitoring, Installations, Maintenance, and Service. Its Monitoring segment provides security and video systems for commercial and residential customers. Its Installations segment provides security and video systems designed to meet individual customer requirements, both commercial and residential. Its Maintenance segment provides alarm and video installation and maintenance ser security and video systems for existing customers. Its Services segment includes guarding, patrolling and security officer training. The Company’s business includes ADT Security, Intelligent Monitoring Solutions, Signature Security Group, and Threat Protect Training.

name: LIFESTYLE COMMUNITIES
businessSummary: Lifestyle Communities Limited is an Australia-based company, which develops, owns and manages affordable independent living residential land-lease communities. It monitors all settings, including local house prices, national economic indicators, demographics, design trends, environmental advances and customer expectations. The Company’s land lease model allows working, semi-retired, and retired people to downsize their family home to free up equity in retirement, whilst enjoying resort-style living including pools, gyms, clubhouse, cinema, lawn bowls, tennis, and others. It has over 29 residential land lease communities under contract, in planning, in development, or under management. Its communities include Bayside and Peninsula communities, Bellarine communities, South-East communities, North Victoria communities, and West Victoria communities. Its subsidiaries include Lifestyle Investments 1 Pty Ltd, Lifestyle Developments 1 Pty Ltd, Lifestyle Management 1 Pty Ltd, among others.

name: MIRVAC GROUP
businessSummary: Mirvac Group is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in property investment for the purpose of deriving rental income and investments in unlisted funds. It owns and manages assets across the residential, office and industrial, retail and build to rent sectors. The Company’s residential properties include apartments, town homes, houses, and land. It has residential apartment projects and communities across New South Wales, Queensland, Victoria & Western Australia. Its portfolio of office properties includes 101-103 Miller Street, North Sydney; 410 Ann Street, Brisbane; Locomotive Workshop, South Eveleigh; 380 St Kilda Road, Melbourne; 31 Market Street, Sydney; Olderfleet, 477 Collins Street, Melbourne; 55 Pitt Street, Sydney, and others. Its portfolio of industrial properties includes 36 Gow Street, Padstow and 39 Herbert Street, St Leonards. Its Birkenhead Point Brand Outlet is situated five kilometers from Sydney CBD on a prime 3.7-hectare waterfront site.

name: IGO
businessSummary: IGO Limited is a resources company that discovers, develops and produces products critical to the clean energy transition. Its segments include Nova Operation, Forrestania Operation, Cosmos Project, Lithium Business, and Growth. The Nova Operation includes the Nova underground nickel mine and processing operation producing nickel and copper concentrates. Forrestania Operation is located approximately 400 kilometers east of Perth in Western Australia. Cosmos Project comprises the development of the Odysseus underground mine focused on the production of nickel concentrate, containing nickel and cobalt metal. The Lithium Business represents its 49% share in the lithium joint venture, Tianqi Lithium Energy Australia Pty Ltd (TLEA), with Tianqi Lithium Corporation. The existing assets of TLEA are Greenbushes Lithium Mine and the Kwinana Lithium Hydroxide Refinery. It also owns Copper Wolf Project in Arizona. Growth segment comprises exploration, business development and project evaluation.

name: DYNO NOBEL
businessSummary: Dyno Nobel Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing and distribution of industrial explosives, industrial chemicals and the provision of related services. The Company's Dyno Nobel segment includes Dyno Nobel Asia Pacific (DNAP), Dyno Nobel Americas (DNA), and Dyno Nobel EMEA & LATAM (DNEL). DNAP manufactures and sells industrial explosives and related products and services to the mining industry mainly in the Asia Pacific region. DNA manufactures and sells industrial explosives and related products and services to the mining, quarrying and construction industries in North America and initiating systems to businesses in Australia, Turkey and South Africa. It also manufactures and sells industrial chemicals to other specialist industries. DNEL manufactures and sells industrial explosives and related products and services to the mining, quarrying and construction industries in the EMEA and LATAM regions (including Turkey, France, South Africa and Chile).

name: MICROBA LIFE SCIENCES
businessSummary: Microba Life Sciences Limited is an Australia-based precision microbiome company. The Company is engaged in the discovery and development of therapeutics for chronic diseases and delivering gut microbiome testing services globally to researchers, clinicians, and consumers. It offers various platforms, such as Analysis, Discovery, and Therapeutic. Its Analysis platform is an end-to-end solution for microbiome analysis. Using advanced metagenomic sequencing technology and proprietary bioinformatic tools, it provides precise and comprehensive measurement of the human gut microbiome. Its Discovery Platform is a global databank for microbiome discovery and develops new health solutions from the gut microbiome. Its Therapeutic platform is a repeatable platform for microbial therapeutic leads. Its Diagnostic testing products are MetaXplore and MetaPanel. MetaXplore offers a comprehensive gastrointestinal testing solution. MetaPanel is an advanced gastrointestinal pathogen detection panel.

name: AXP ENERGY
businessSummary: AXP Energy Limited is engaged in oil and gas exploration, development and production in the United States of America. The Company’s segments are geographic areas within its Oil & Gas basins in the United States: Denver-Julesburg (DJ) Basin, and Corporate and Other. The Denver-Julesburg Basin assets are located in the historic Florence oilfield and are geologically defined by the Canon City Embayment. This area is an extension of the prolific DJ Basin which spans across Colorado, Kansas, Montana and Wyoming. Formations of interest in this area include the Pierre Shale, Niobrara Shale, Codell Sandstone and Greenhorn Limestone. It has 24 operating oil and gas wells at its Pathfinder Field.

name: DEXUS
businessSummary: Dexus is an Australia-based real estate company. The Company’s segments include Office, Industrial, Co-investments, Property management, Funds Management, and Development and Trading. The Office segment consists of domestic office space with any associated retail space, as well as car parks and office developments. The Industrial segment includes domestic industrial properties, industrial estates and industrial developments. The Co-investments segment includes distribution income earned from investments in pooled property and real estate security funds. The Property management segment includes property management services for third-party clients and owned assets. The Funds Management segment consists of funds management of third-party client assets. The Development and trading segment includes revenue earned and costs incurred by the Company on development services and inventory.

name: YOWIE GROUP
businessSummary: Yowie Group Limited is a global brand licensing company. The Company specializes in the development of consumer products designed to promote learning, understanding and engagement with the natural world through the adventures of over six endearing Yowie characters. It owns and manages a portfolio of intellectual property underpinning the Yowie surprise-inside chocolate brand and associated digital and licensed products. The Company's core markets are North America and Australia/New Zealand. It operates through two geographical segments: the United States and Australia. Its collections include Baby Animals, Animals with Super Powers, Blast from the Past, Wild Water, WCS, Rescue, All Americas collection, Ranger series, Premier collection, and others. In addition to its core Yowie chocolate line, the Company is also engaged in brand licensing with iconic names such as the NBA (National Basketball Association), Bluey, NRL, and AFL. It also owns the Ernest Hillier brand and factory.

name: BLUGLASS
businessSummary: BluGlass Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing semiconductor manufacturing technology and devices. The Company is a provider to the global Gallium Nitride (GaN) photonics industries, delivering cutting-edge, custom laser diode and LED development across the industrial, defence, display, and scientific markets. The Company is developing a suite of laser diode products, from small batch custom lasers through to high-volume and off-the-shelf products. The Company uses metal organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) technology and its patented low-temperature remote plasma chemical vapor deposition (RPCVD) technology to manufacture higher performance, lower cost GaN laser diodes. Its laser diode product range spans a spectrum of wavelengths from ultraviolet 397 nanometers (nm) to blue 450nm devices. The Company’s facilities are located in Sydney, Australia, and Nashua, United States.

name: EDEN INNOVATIONS
businessSummary: Eden Innovations Ltd produces and sells a high-performance concrete admixture, EdenCrete and retrofit dual fuel technology, OptiBlend developed for diesel generator sets. Its segments include Eden Innovations LLC and Eden Innovations (India) Pvt Ltd. Eden Innovations LLC segment includes EdenCrete sales and development and Optiblend sales, service, and manufacturing in the United States. The Eden Innovations (India) Pvt Ltd segment includes Optiblend sales, service, and manufacturing in India. The Company’s innovations include EdenCrete, OptiBlend, EdenPlast, and Other Technologies. Its EdenCrete is a carbon nanotube enriched admixture for concrete that improves tensile and flexural strength. Its OptiBlend technology allows a conventional diesel engine to run natural gas as its primary fuel without modifying the engine or the current diesel fuel system. Its EdenPlast is a CNT enriched polypropylene tape. Its other technologies are Pyrolysis Project and Hythane.

name: ATLAS ARTERIA GROUP
businessSummary: Atlas Arteria Group is an Australia-based global owner, operator, and developer of toll roads. The Company has a portfolio of five toll roads in France, Germany, and the United States. The Company owns a 31.14% interest in the Autoroutes Paris-Rhin-Rhone (APRR) toll road group in France. In addition to the APRR business is the smaller Autoroute des deux lacs (ADELAC) business, which connects to APRR in southeast France. Together APRR and ADELAC comprise approximately 2,424 kilometers of motorway network located in the East and Southeast of France. In the United States, it owns a 66.67% interest in the Chicago Skyway, a 12.5 kilometers toll road in Chicago and has 100% of the economic interest in the Dulles Greenway, a 22 kilometers toll road in the Commonwealth of Virginia. In Germany, it owns 100% of the Warnow Tunnel in the northeast city of Rostock.

name: DIGICO INFRASTRUCTURE REIT
businessSummary: DigiCo Infrastructure REIT (DGT) is a diversified owner, operator and developer of data centres, with a global portfolio and broad investment mandate across Stabilized, Value-add and Development opportunities. DigiCo Infrastructure REIT was established on November 01, 2024.

name: WISR
businessSummary: Wisr Limited is an Australia-based neo-lender company. The Company provides a collection of financial products and services. The Company is engaged in writing personal loans and secured vehicle loans for three, five and seven-year maturities to Australian consumers, and funding these loans through the warehouse funding structures. It provides a Financial Wellness Platform underpinned by consumer finance products, the Wisr App. The Wisr App helps Australians pay down debt, multiple credit score comparison services and Australia’s first money-coaching app Wisr Today. Combined with content and other products that use technology to provide better outcomes for borrowers, investors, and everyday Australians. The Company’s products include loans, credit scores and round up. Its credit score is a summary of financial habits, and helps lenders get to know its customers. Its loan products include debt consolidation loans, car loans, medical loans and others.

name: LIONTOWN
businessSummary: Liontown Limited is an Australia-based battery minerals producer. The Company controls two major hard rock lithium deposits. The Company's projects include Kathleen Valley Project and Buldania Project. The Kathleen Valley Project is located in an established mining region about 60 kilometers north of Leinster and 680 kilometers north-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Kathleen Valley Lithium Project is a Tier-1 battery metals asset. The Buldania Project is in the Eastern Goldfields Province of Western Australia, approximately 600 kilometers east of Perth. The Project is close to major road and rail infrastructure with direct access to the Port of Esperance 200 kilometers to the south. The Company's downstream expansion project includes investigating the potential for an integrated refinery to upgrade its spodumene from the Kathleen Valley mine to higher value lithium products.

name: TPG TELECOM
businessSummary: TPG Telecom Limited is an Australia-based telecommunications company. The Company owns and operates the Vodafone mobile network nationwide. It operates a number of mobile and internet brands including Vodafone, TPG, iiNet, Internode, Lebara and felix, providing consumers with a portfolio of fixed and mobile products in the Australian telecommunications market. Its segments include Consumer and Enterprise, Government and Wholesale. The Consumer segment provides telecommunications services to residential and small office/home office customers. The Enterprise, Government and Wholesale segment provides mobile services to corporations, government and wholesale customers. It also provides fixed services to small-sized enterprise customers. Its subsidiaries include Vodafone Hutchison Spectrum Pty Limited, H3GA Properties (No. 3) Pty Limited, Vodafone Foundation Australia Pty Limited, Vodafone Australia Pty Limited, Mobile JV Pty Limited and AAPT Limited.

name: AUSTRALIAN ETHICAL INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Australian Ethical Investment Limited is an Australia-based company, which acts as the responsible entity for a range of public offers ethically managed investment schemes and acts as the Trustee of the Australian Ethical Retail Superannuation Fund. It is focused on future-building sectors, including renewable energy, information technology, healthcare, and education, and restrict+ investment in areas like fossil fuel companies, gambling and tobacco. It creates well-diversified portfolios of ethical investments that can deliver long-term, risk-adjusted returns. All its superannuation, managed fund, pensions and exchange traded fund products are ethically screened, and investment focused. Its managed funds use professional investment management alongside ethical considerations. It offers a diverse range of super investment options depending on investment objective, timeframe and risk profile.

name: ACRUX
businessSummary: Acrux Limited is an Australia-based specialty pharmaceutical company. The Company is engaged in developing and commercializing a pipeline of topically applied pharmaceutical products. Its products include Lidocaine and Prilocaine Cream, USP 2.5%/2.5%, Lenzetto, Evamist, Dapsone Gel, 5% and Testosterone Topical Solution, 30 mg / 1.5 ml. Lidocaine and Prilocaine Cream USP (a eutectic mixture of lidocaine 2.5% and prilocaine 2.5%) is indicated as a topical anesthetic for use on normal intact skin for local analgesia and genital mucous membranes for superficial minor surgery and as pretreatment for infiltration anesthesia. Lenzetto (estradiol 1.53 mg/spray, transdermal spray, solution) is an estradiol spray for women which is used to treat moderate to severe hot flushes commonly associated with menopause. Testosterone Topical Solution is indicated for replacement therapy in males for conditions associated with a deficiency or absence of endogenous testosterone.

name: CLEAN TEQ WATER
businessSummary: Clean TeQ Water Limited is an Australia-based water treatment company. It is a global technology company, specializing in providing economic and environmentally sustainable solutions to address critical issues related to freshwater scarcity, mine tailings, and metal recovery. Its technology solutions include desalination, nutrient removal, zero liquid discharge and hardness removal. Its core markets include water and wastewater recycling, lithium production, and the remining and rehabilitation of mine tailings. Its technologies include CIF (continuous ionic filtration), HIROX (ultra-high recovery RO), DESALX (membrane free desalination), BIOCLENS (lens encapsulated bacteria), BIONEX (complete nutrient removal), and EVAPX (low energy evaporation and crystallization), among others. Its solutions include ammonia removal, boron removal, hardness removal, sulphate removal, uranium removal, and others. It has a presence in locations, including Melbourne, Perth, Darwin, Beijing, and others.

name: PYX RESOURCES
businessSummary: PYX Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral sands company. The Company is focused on identifying, developing and acquiring undervalued, mineral assets strategically located in countries participating in China’s Belt and Road initiative that possess resources and zircon assemblage in the world. The Company's key deposits, Mandiri and Tisma, are large-scale, near-surface open pit deposits both located in the alluvium-rich region of Central Kalimantan, Indonesia. The Mandiri Deposit is a licensed concession covering an area of approximately 2,032 hectares Kuala Kurun City in the Gunung Mas Regency of Central Kalimantan, Indonesia. Mandiri Deposit is focused on the exploration of mineral sands products and the production and export of premium 65.5 grade zircon. The Tisma Project is a licensed mineral sands deposit in Central Kalimantan Province, Indonesia. The Tisma Project is a licensed mineral sands asset consisting of a concession area of 1,500 hectares.

name: POINTSBET HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Pointsbet Holdings Limited is an Australia-based corporate bookmaker with operations in Australia and Canada. The Company has developed a cloud-based wagering platform through which it offers its clients advanced sports and racing wagering products, and iGaming. The Company’s segments include Australian Trading, Canadian Trading, and Corporate. The Australian Trading segment provides online sports and online fixed odds racing betting services to Australian customers. The Canadian trading segment offers online sports betting and iGaming services provided to Canadian customers. The Company’s products include Fixed Odds Sports, Fixed Odds Racing, PointsBetting, and iGaming (online casino). Its subsidiaries include PointsBet Australia Pty Ltd, PointsBet Pty Ltd, PBH Softech Private Limited, PointsBet Canada Operations 1 Inc., and others.

name: MACQUARIE TECHNOLOGY GROUP
businessSummary: Macquarie Technology Group Limited is an Australia-based datacenter, cloud, cybersecurity and telecom company. The Company is engaged in the provision of telecommunication, cloud computing, cybersecurity and data center services to corporate and government customers within Australia. The Company operates through three segments: Cloud Services and Government, Data Centres and Telecom. The Cloud Services & Government segment is engaged in the provision of services utilizing the Company and its subsidiaries’ data center facilities to provide cybersecurity, colocation services, public and private cloud and storage to corporate and government customers. The Data Centres segment is engaged in the provision of services utilizing the Company and its subsidiaries’ data center facilities for wholesale customers. The Telecom segment is engaged in the provision of voice and mobile telecommunications services and the provision of services utilizing the Company and its subsidiaries’ data network.

name: RENASCOR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Renascor Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the development of economically viable mineral deposits, including its Siviour BAM project in South Australia. The Company holds interests in various tenements, such as Carnding, Marree, Dutton Bay, Malbrom, Lipson Cove, Verran, Malbrom West, Cleve, Hincks, Outalpa, Cutana, Old Wartaka, Witchelina, Flat Hill, Malbooma Railway, Carnding, Iron Baron and Gregory Creek. The Siviour BAM Project comprises the Siviour Graphite Deposit, located near Arno Bay on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. Siviour BAM Project has a battery anode material production facility, located in Bolivar, where Siviour graphite concentrate is converted into purified spherical graphite (PSG). The Carnding Project contains several near-surface, high-grade gold prospects in South Australia's Central Gawler Craton. The Marree Project is a copper-prospective ground position within South Australia's Adelaide Fold Belt.

name: KOGAN COM
businessSummary: Kogan.com Limited is a portfolio of retail and services businesses. The Company’s businesses include Kogan Retail, Kogan Marketplace, Kogan Mobile, Kogan Internet, Kogan Insurance, Kogan Money, Kogan Energy, Kogan Travel, Dick Smith, Matt Blatt, Mighty Ape, and Brosa. Its segments include Kogan.com and Mighty Ape. The Kogan.com segment is an online retailer selling in-house and third-party brand products, as well as providing services for telecommunications, Internet, insurance, home finances, utilities, vehicles and travel. The Mighty Ape segment is an online specialist retailer of gaming and entertainment products. Its offering comprises products released under Kogan.com’s brands, such as Kogan, Ovela, Fortis, Certa, and Komodo and products sourced from imported and domestic third party, such as Apple, Canon, Swann, and Samsung. It trades through various channels, including the Kogan.com Website and Apps and the Dick Smith Website.

name: ARGOSY MINERALS
businessSummary: Argosy Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development of the Rincon Lithium Project and exploration of the Tonopah Lithium Project. The Company has approximately 77.5% interest in the Rincon Lithium Project in Salta Province, Argentina and a 100% interest in the Tonopah Lithium Project in Nevada, United States. The Rincon Lithium Project comprises up to 8,606 hectares of Mining Titles and mining easement landholdings at the Salar del Rincon in Salta Province, Argentina. The Project is located in the elevated and arid Puna region of Argentina and forms part of a number of highly mineralized salars in production and development. The Company’s Tonopah Lithium Project is located within the Big Smokey Valley region in Nevada, United States, and comprises 425 claims covering an area of approximately 34.25 square kilometers (km2). The Tonopah Lithium Project is strategically located at the neighboring Silver Peak Lithium Mine deposit.

name: SANTOS
businessSummary: Santos Limited is an Australia-based global energy company with operations across Australia, Papua New Guinea (PNG), Timor-Leste and the United States of America (USA). The Company is a domestic gas supplier and liquefied natural gas (LNG) supplier in Asia. The Company has a portfolio of LNG plants adjacent to prolific gas resources and diverse integrated oil and gas production assets which include Cooper and Eromanga Basins, Gladstone GLNG (GLNG), PNG LNG and Western Australia. The Cooper Basin produces natural gas, gas liquids and crude oil. Gas is sold primarily to domestic retailers, industry and for the production of liquefied natural gas, while gas liquids and crude oil are sold in domestic and export markets. The GLNG project in Queensland produces LNG for export to global markets from the LNG plant at Gladstone. Its midstream and energy solutions activities are operating midstream assets, progressing technologies, such as carbon capture and storage (CCS) and others.

name: INGHAMS GROUP
businessSummary: Inghams Group Limited is an Australia-based integrated poultry producer. The Company is focused on the production and sale of chicken and turkey products across its vertically integrated free-range, value enhanced, primary processed, further processed and by-product categories. In addition, the Company's stockfeed is produced primarily for internal use but also for the poultry and pig industries. The Company's operating segments are Poultry and Feed. Its geographic segments include Australia and New Zealand. The Company's Ingham’s brand offers a range of products including Ingham's Chicken Breast Nuggets Cheesy, Ingham's Turkey Mince, Ingham's Classic Turkey Breast Oven Roasted, Ingham's Frozen Turkey Buffe, Ingham's Fresh Turkey Necks, Turkey Tenders Lettuce Wraps, Ingham's Turkey Thigh Roast, Ingham's Family Chicken Nuggets Original, and Ingham's Ready To Roast Turkey Breast With Spiced Apple And Cranberry Stuffing, among others.

name: STRUCTURAL MONITORING SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Structural Monitoring Systems Plc is an Australia-based company engaged in the design and manufacture of electronic products and the provision of manufacturing services to the aviation industry.
