The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Anodyne Electronics Manufacturing Corp. (AEM), operates three business segments: Avionics, Contract Manufacturing and CVM. The Avionics segment provides customer-driven solutions designed to meet the requirements of the special mission aviation industry. The Contract manufacturing segment provides contract electronics manufacturing to a select group of aerospace customers. The CVM segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sales, and support of the Comparative Vacuum Monitoring (CVM) sensor technology and equipment for meeting crack detection and inspection requirements for certain metal structures of commercial airframes. The Company has operations in North America, Europe/ United Kingdom and others.

name: PERPETUAL
businessSummary: Perpetual Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a diversified financial services company. Its segments include Asset Management and Corporate Trust. The Asset Management segment provides equities, credit and fixed income, multi-asset, cash, and sustainable investment solutions. It includes over $219.2 billion in Assets Under Management across six investment boutiques in Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States. It offers perpetual investment funds which are designed for individual and wholesale investors, and super fund trustees. The Corporate Trust segment provides fiduciary, custody and digital solutions to the banking and financial services industry in Australia and Singapore. It includes over $1.3 trillion in funds under administration across debt market services and managed funds services; $0.6 trillion in assets under administration in digital and markets. It offers debt market services which include securitization, document custody, agency and trustee.

name: ASX
businessSummary: ASX Limited (ASX) is a vertically integrated multi-asset exchange company. The Company is engaged in offering listings, trading, clearing, settlement, technical and information services, technology, data and other post-trade services. It acts as a market operator, clearing house and payments system facilitator. The ASX operates markets for a range of asset classes including equities, fixed income, commodities, and energy. Its activities span primary and secondary market services, including the raising, allocation and hedging of capital flows; trading and price discovery; central counterparty risk transfer, and securities settlement for both the equities and fixed income markets. ASX operates through four divisions: listings, markets, technology and data, and securities and payments. It also provides data and technology services to intermediaries, banks, information vendors and software developers to help them make decisions, offer services to their clients and connect with one another.

name: MCMILLAN SHAKESPEARE
businessSummary: McMillan Shakespeare Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a provider of salary packaging, novated leasing, disability plan management, support coordination, asset management and related financial products and services. Its segments include Group Remuneration Services, Asset Management Services, Plan and Support Services. The Group Remuneration Services provides administrative services in respect of salary packaging and facilitating motor vehicle novated leases for customers. It also provides ancillary services associated with motor vehicle novated lease products, including the provision of novated lease finance. The Asset Management Services provides financing and ancillary management services associated with motor vehicles, commercial vehicles and equipment with operations in Australia and New Zealand. The Plan and Support Services provides plan management and support coordination services to participants in the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS).

name: MAYFIELD GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Mayfield Group Holdings Limited is a holding company that is engaged in the provision of electrical and telecommunications products and services. Its principal activities include manufacturing of switchboards, transportable switch rooms and electrical protection panels, provision of telecommunications and power quality solutions and services, and maintenance services of electrical and telecommunication infrastructure. Its subsidiaries include Mayfield Industries Pty Ltd, ATI Australia Pty Ltd, Mayfield Services Pty Ltd, Walker Control Pty Ltd, Mayfield Engineering Pty Ltd, and others. ATI Australia Pty Ltd's capabilities include system design, supply, installation, network commissioning and maintenance support. Mayfield Industries Pty is engaged in project management, engineering, design, manufacture, installation, and commissioning. Mayfield Services Pty Ltd delivers high, medium, and low voltage infrastructure services for a range of clients across Australia.

name: STRIKE ENERGY
businessSummary: Strike Energy Limited is an Australia-based energy company. The Company is an independent gas producer, developer and explorer focused on its quality conventional gas resources in the Perth Basin. Its projects in the Perth Basin include the producing Walyering gas facility, South Erregulla peaking gas power project, West Erregulla and Ocean Hill. The Walyering gas field sits in production license L23. The field is situated approximately 150 km north of Perth near the town of Cataby in the Mid-West. The South Erregulla field sits within L 24 and EP 503. It is situated approximately 350 km north of Perth near the town of Dongara in the Mid-West. The West Erregulla field sits within EP 469 which is operated and owned 50% by the Company. The Ocean Hill sits within EP495, situated approximately 350km north of Perth near the town of Eneabba. The Company also owns 100% of the geothermal rights in the Perth Basin, covering approximately 3,500 square kilometers (km2), namely The Precinct.

name: ASTRAL RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Astral Resources NL is an Australia-based gold exploration and base metals company. Its projects include Mandilla Gold Project (Mandilla), Feysville Project, Carnilya Hill Project, Wattle Dam Gold Project, Lefroy Lithium Project, Larkinville Lithium Project, Hilditch Gold Deposit, Larkinville Gold Deposit, Eagles Nest, and others. Its flagship Mandilla is located over 70 kilometers (km) south of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia. Mandilla's deposits include Theia, Iris, Eos and Hestia. The Feysville Gold Project is located within the north-north-west trending Norseman - Wiluna Greenstone Belt, within the Kambalda Domain of the Archean Yilgarn Craton, approximately 14km south of the KCGM Super Pit in Kalgoorlie. The Company has 100% of the gold rights in Carnilya Hill Gold Project, which includes various tenements - M26/047-049, M26/453, representing an aggregate area of approximately 2.65 square kilometers. The project is located over 20 km south-south-east of the Feysville Project.

name: NUENERGY GAS
businessSummary: NuEnergy Gas Limited is an Australia-based independent clean energy company. The Company is primarily involved in the exploration, appraisal, and development of hydrocarbons with a primary focus on unconventional gas on coal seam gas, also known as coal bed methane (CBM). The Company operates onshore coal bed methane (CBM) Production Sharing Contracts (PSCs), such as Tanjung Enim PSC, Muara Enim PSC, Muara Enim II PSC and Muralim PSC. The Tanjung Enim PS is located approximately 50 kilometers and 130 kilometers from the industrial cities of Prabumulih and Palembang, respectively. The Muara Enim PSC is located about 45-60 kilometers and 100-120 kilometers from the industrial cities of Prabumulih and Palembang. The Muralim PSC is Located about 70 kilometer and 140 kilometers from the industrial cities of Prabumulih and Palembang respectively. Its subsidiaries include Dart Energy (Tanjung Enim) Pte Ltd, PT Trisula CBM Energi, and Dart Energy (Muralim) Pte Ltd.

name: CLARITY PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: Clarity Pharmaceuticals Ltd is an Australia-based clinical-stage radiopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on developing targeted copper theranostics based on its SAR Technology Platform. It is progressing clinical trials with its approximately three key products, SARTATE, SAR-bisPSMA, and SAR-Bombesin. Its lead product, SAR-bisPSMA, is progressing through over three clinical trials: one theranostic trial (SECuRE) and two Phase III diagnostic trials (CLARIFY and AMPLIFY). SARTATE is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating cancers that express somatostatin receptor 2 (SSTR2). SAR-bisPSMA is developed for diagnosing, staging, and treating prostate cancer that expresses prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA). SAR-Bombesin is developed for identifying and selecting patients for subsequent treatment of cancers that express a specific receptor called the gastrin releasing peptide receptor (GRPr), including breast cancer and prostate cancer.

name: FORTE ENERGY
businessSummary: Forte Energy Limited, formerly IPB Petroleum Limited, is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company. The Company has a 100% interest in the petroleum exploration permits located in the Browse Basin: WA-424-P. The Browse Basin is located north of Broome, offshore, Western Australia, and covers an area of approximately 140,000 square kilometers (km2). The WA-424-P permit contains three wells, including Gwydion-1, Caspar-1A, and Pryderi-1. The Company's subsidiaries include IPB WA 424P Pty Ltd and IPB Exploration Pty Ltd.

name: CHALICE MINING
businessSummary: Chalice Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of the Gonneville Palladium-Nickel-Copper Project and the exploration of projects located in the West Yilgarn region of Western Australia. The 100%-owned Gonneville Project is located on Chalice-owned farmland approximately 70 kilometers (km) north-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Company’s exploration projects include Kings Exploration Project, Barrabarra Exploration Project, Northam Exploration Joint Venture Project, Voyager Exploration Project, Warrego North Exploration Project, Bangemall Exploration Project, Julimar Exploration Project, and South West and Narryer Projects. The approximately 1,000 square kilometers (km2) Kings Project, located 80 km north-east of Perth, includes the 30 km2 Bolgart JV (E70/5151), where it earns a 75% interest. The 100% owned, approximately 3,400 km2 Barrabarra Project is located 85 km east of Geraldton in Western Australia.

name: CYPRIUM METALS
businessSummary: Cyprium Metals Limited is an Australia-based copper company. The Company’s flagship property is the Nifty Copper Complex in Western Australia, which produces copper from both oxide and sulfide resources. The Nifty Copper Mine is located on the western edge of the Great Sandy Desert in the north-eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia, approximately 350 kilometers (km) southeast of Port Hedland. Nifty has a mineral resource estimate of 1,038,000 tons of copper and a mineral inventory of 91,000 tons of copper in existing leach pads. The Company’s other assets include copper-focused properties in the Paterson Province, including multiple defined resources. The Paterson Exploration Project is located in the north-eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia. The 2,400-square kilometer (km2) land package is contiguous with much of the Nifty Copper Mine and Maroochydore Copper Project tenement boundaries. The Maroochydore deposit is located over 85 km southeast of Nifty.

name: CHALLENGER GOLD
businessSummary: Challenger Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper exploration company. The Company’s projects include the Hualilan project, El Guayabo project, and Karoo Basin Gas project. The Hualilan project consists of 15 mining leases and an exploration license application covering the surrounding area of approximately 26 square kilometers (km2). The Hualilan Project is located approximately 120 kilometers (km) north-northwest of San Juan, the capital of San Juan Province in north-western Argentina. The El Guayabo Gold/Copper project is located within the El Oro Province of southern Ecuador, approximately 35 Kilometers south southeast of Machala. The El Guayabo project comprises four contiguous tenement groups, the El Guaybo, El Guaybo 2, Cerro Pelado 1, 2, and 3 tenements, and Colorado V tenement. The Karoo Basin Gas project includes application for the Cranemere project, a shale gas prospect located in the Eastern Cape Province. The application covers approximately 3,500km2.

name: ALLIANCE NICKEL
businessSummary: Alliance Nickel Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company with nickel and cobalt interests in Western Australia. The Company is focused on becoming a supplier of battery-grade nickel and cobalt products. The Company's principal asset is its 100% owned NiWest Nickel Cobalt Project situated adjacent to Glencore's Murrin Murrin Operations. NiWest hosts undeveloped nickel laterite resources in Australia, estimated to contain approximately 93.4 million tons averaging 1.04% Nickel and 0.07% Cobalt. The region is recognized for a long history of nickel and cobalt production supported by an infrastructure including rail links to ports, gas pipeline, roads, fiberoptic networks, a commercial airstrip and established mining communities.

name: GOLD MOUNTAIN
businessSummary: Gold Mountain Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company focused on rare earth elements (REE) with projects in Brazil and Papua New Guinea (PNG). Its assets are primarily centered around REE and niobium. It is also exploring a diverse range of tenements for lithium, nickel, copper, and gold. It holds a total of 801 square kilometers (km2) of tenements in the Lithium Valley, which hosts the producing Grota do Cirilo Mine. It is also working on a number of other early-stage Lithium Projects across Brazil, which include Salinas target, Juremal target, Salitre, Solonoploe, and Logradouro. The Down Under Rare Earth Project is situated in the Jequie Region. The Araxa Rare Earth-Niobium Project is located in the Alto Paranaiba Igneous Province, close to Araxa. It is also advancing the Green River Project, covering 1,048 km2 across two exploration licenses. Its portfolio in Brazil, holding areas of highly prospective REE and REE-niobium licenses in Bahia and in Minas Gerais.

name: DREADNOUGHT RESOURCES
businessSummary: Dreadnought Resources Limited is an exploration and development company focusing on acquiring and exploring quality projects within the state of Western Australia (WA). The Company's projects include Kimberley Project, Mangaroon Project, and Bresnahan Project. It controls approximately 420 square kilometers (km) in the highly prospective West Kimberley region of WA. The Tarraji-Yampi Copper-Silver-Gold-Cobalt Project is located only 85 km from the port of Derby. Its Mangaroon Project covers approximately 5,000 km2, located 250 km south-east of Exmouth in the underexplored Gascoyne Region of WA. Mangaroon has three focus areas, the Mangaroon Critical Metals, Mangaroon Gold and Base Metals. Bresnahan is located over 125km southwest of Newman in the Ashburton Basin. The project comprises over 3,700 km2 covering over 200kms strike along the Bresnahan Basin / Wyloo Group unconformity. Bresnahan is prospective for unconformity related heavy rare earth (HREE) deposits.

name: DIATREME RESOURCES
businessSummary: Diatreme Resources Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is a producer of mineral and silica sands. It is focused on exploration and development of its silica mineral exploration tenements in Australia with silica exploration land packages covering an area of circa. 625 square kilometers (sq km) in Queensland’s Eastern Cape York region, around 200 km north of Cairns. Its projects comprise the Northern Silica Project and Galalar Silica Sand Project. The Northern Silica Project is a supplier of silica products for the solar photovoltaic and specialty glass industry. It is located approximately 35 kilometers north of Hope Vale and 14 kilometers west of the Port of Cape Flattery in Far North Queensland. It contains silica sands with a silicon dioxide purity of greater than 99% and a low iron content of less than 120 parts per million (ppm). The Galalar Silica Sand Project is situated near Cape Bedford approximately 20 kilometers from Hope Vale, the Galalar Silica Sand Project.

name: HAMMER METALS
businessSummary: Hammer Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is involved in mineral exploration in Western Australia and Queensland. The Company’s projects include Bronzewing South Au/Li/Ni Project and Mount Isa Projects. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Bronzewing South Gold Project located adjacent to the 2.3 million-ounce Bronzewing gold deposit in the highly prospective Yandal Belt of Western Australia. It also has a 51% interest in the Jubilee (Cu-Au) deposit. It also holds a strategic tenement position covering approximately 2,800 square kilometers (km2) within the Mount Isa mining district, with 100% interest in the Kalman (Cu-Au-Mo-Re) deposit, the Overlander North and Overlander South (Cu-Co) deposits, the Lakeview (Cu-Au) deposit and the Elaine (Cu-Au) deposit. It is an active mineral explorer, focused on discovering large copper-gold deposits of Ernest Henry style and has a range of prospective targets at various stages of testing.

name: BARYS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Barys Resources Limited, formerly ENRG Elements Limited, is an Australia-based company focused on the exploration and development of its uranium and lithium projects. The Company holds 100% of the underexplored Agadez Uranium Project located in the Tim Mersoi Basin of Niger. Its Agadez Uranium Project is located in the highly prospective Tim Mersoi Basin, Niger, a mining jurisdiction with a history of uranium production. It owns 100% of three exploration permits (726km2) and an exploration license application. The Project hosts similar geology to Orano SA’s Cominak and Somair uranium mines, Global Atomic Corporation’s Dasa Project and the significant Imouraren and Madouala deposits.

name: FINDER ENERGY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Finder Energy Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is an oil and gas explorer. It operates in the Northwest Shelf of Australia and the United Kingdom North Sea. Its projects include Australia - North West Shelf, Timor-Leste - North West Shelf, and the United Kingdom (UK) - North Sea. The Australia - North West Shelf is a hydrocarbon province which covers approximately 2,400 kilometers (km) along the northwest margin of the Australian continent. Its locations include AC/P 61 and WA-547-P. The WA-547-P is located in Bonaparte Basin, Vulcan Sub-basin, covering an area of approximately 337 square kilometers (km2). The WA-547-P is located in the Northern Carnarvon Basin, covering an area of over 7,260 km2. It holds a 66% interest in PSC 19-11, located within the prolific Laminaria High oil province of Timor-Leste. Its UK - North Sea locations include P2530, P2610, and P2655.

name: ATLANTIC LITHIUM
businessSummary: Atlantic Lithium Limited is an Australia-based lithium-focused exploration and development company with assets in Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company is advancing its Ewoyaa Lithium Project. In Ghana the Company holds approximately 509 square kilometers (km2) of granted and under application tenure. In Cote d'Ivoire, the Company holds approximately 771 km2 of granted and under application tenure. The Ewoyaa Lithium project is located within one kilometer (km) of the Takoradi Accra N1 highway, 110 km from the Takoradi deep-sea port and adjacent to grid power. In Cote d'Ivoire, the Company through its wholly owned subsidiary Khaleesi Resources SARL, holds exploration permits over the highly prospective Rubino and Agboville exploration licenses, which cover over 374.18 km2 and 396.89 km2, respectively.

name: HAWSONS IRON
businessSummary: Hawsons Iron Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is mineral exploration and development of the Hawsons Iron Project. Its flagship Hawsons Iron Project is located approximately 70km from Broken Hill, New South Wales. The Company's tenements include Redan, Burta, Little Peak, Wonga and Hawsons Iron, which cover approximately 180 square kilometers (km2), 290 km2, 41 km2, and 287 km2 respectively. The Company is advancing green steel production through high-grade magnetite concentrate. Its dry processing technology produces high-grade magnetite concentrate (68.4% Fe).

name: HAWTHORN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Hawthorn Resources Limited is an Australia-based diversified critical minerals and gold explorer with tenement holdings throughout Western Australia. The Company’s projects include Mount Bevan Magnetite Project, Mount Bevan Critical Minerals Project and Anglo Saxon Gold Mine. The Company has a joint venture with Hancock Magnetite Holdings Pty Ltd and Legacy Iron Ore Limited on the Mount Bevan Magnetite and Critical Minerals Project, which is located in South Yilgarn, southwest of Leonora. The Anglo-Saxon gold project is a joint venture between the Company (70%) and Gel Resources Pty Ltd (30%) located at Pinjin, approximately 140 kilometers northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Anglo-Saxon gold mine is located in the South Laverton Tectonic zone (SLTZ), 140 kilometers north-east of Kalgoorlie and 35 kilometers east of the Carosue Dam mill. The project is part of the Trouser Legs Joint Venture (TLJV) with Gel Resources Pty Ltd.

name: GRAPHENE MANUFACTURING GROUP
businessSummary: Graphene Manufacturing Group Limited is a clean-technology company. The Company seeks to offer energy-saving and energy storage solutions enabled by graphene, including those manufactured in-house via a proprietary production process. It has developed a proprietary production process to decompose natural gas (methane) into its elements, carbon (as graphene), hydrogen and some residual hydrocarbon gases. This process produces scalable, tunable and low/no-contaminant graphene suitable for use in clean-technology and other applications. The Company focuses on de-risk and developing commercial scale-up capabilities and secure market applications. In the energy-savings segment, it has focused on graphene-enhanced heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC-R) coating (or energy-saving paint), lubricants and fluids. In the energy storage segment, the Company and the University of Queensland are working to progress the research and development and commercialization of G+AI batteries.

name: CENTRAL IRON ORE
businessSummary: Central Iron Ore Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company, which is engaged in the search for gold in Australia. The Company is mainly focused on exploration in the Darlot Region of Western Australia, within 10 kilometers from the Red 5 Darlot Mine. The Company's projects include South Darlot Gold Project, British King Mine and Red 5 Joint Venture. The Red 5 Joint Venture project’s 20-hole drill program, which included approximately 17 reverse circulations for 706 meters and three diamond core holes for 141 meters include a suite of narrow vein, high gold grades of up to 124.4 grams per ton. The British King Gold Mine is approximately five kilometers south-west from the Darlot Mine. The Company’s South Darlot Gold Project area is located approximately 320 km northwest of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia and includes British King Mine. Its tenement holdings cover an area of approximately 324 square kilometers.

name: MARMOTA
businessSummary: Marmota Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company. The Company is focused on gold, titanium, and uranium. Gold exploration is centered on the Company's gold discovery at Aurora Tank that is yielding outstanding intersections in the highly prospective and significantly underexplored Gawler Craton in the Woomera Prohibited Defense Area. Its flagship uranium resource is at Junction Dam adjacent to the Honeymoon mine. Its Gawler Craton gold project comprises seven adjacent gold deposits, including Marmota’s flagship Aurora Tank gold discovery, Campfire Bore, Golf Bore, Greenewood and Mainwood. Aurora Tank is the Company's flagship gold project, located 100km SW of Coober Pedy. Its new Titanium discovery at Muckanippie features bonanza Heavy Mineral (HM) concentrations and intercept thicknesses, starting from the surface, hosted in mineral sands.

name: COPPERMOLY
businessSummary: Coppermoly Limited is an Australia-based exploration company targeting large scale of IOCG, BHT and porphyry style mineralization systems for copper, gold, silver and zinc. The Company’s projects are located in North Queensland (Australia). The Company is focused on copper and gold projects in the Mount Isa Inlier. The Company’s Mt Isa projects include two granted tenements and five applied tenements, four of them with IOCG potential are located within the Eastern Succession and one for Isa style copper system sits in the Western Foldbelt. It holds contiguous EPM 27835 (Foxes Creek) and EPM 27836 (Mount Tracey), located over 55 km south southwest (SSW) of Cloncurry, and are situated along the north-south striking Cloncurry Fault. Its Windy Hill Prospect is located approximately 80 kilometers (km) south-west of Cloncurry. Its Jessievale application is located about 50 km north of Cloncurry. The application consists of 11 subblocks and sits next to its Mt Malakoff Project (EPM 28853).

name: ELEMENT 25
businessSummary: Element 25 Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is the operator of the Butcherbird Manganese Project (Project), which hosts onshore manganese resources with Joint Ore Reserve Committee (JORC) resources of more than 274 million tons (Mt) of manganese ore. The Project is located approximately 1,050 kilometers (kms) north of Perth and over 130 kilometers south of Newman in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Company is also commercializing proprietary technology to produce battery-grade high purity manganese sulphate monohydrate (HPMSM) for use in electric vehicle (EV) battery manufacturing. The Company’s other project includes Lake Johnston Lithium Project, which is located approximately 500km east of Perth, Western Australia. Its subsidiaries are Element 25 (Malaysia) SDN. BHD., Element 25 Butcherbird Project Pty Ltd, Butcherbird Operations Pty Ltd, Element 25 (HPMSM) LLC, and others.

name: ENTERPRISE METALS
businessSummary: Enterprise Metals Limited is an Australia-based company and is focused on gold, lithium and base metals exploration in Australia. The Company's projects include the Fraser Range Project, Murchison Gold Project, Doolgunna Copper/Gold Project and Mandilla Gold Prospect. The Fraser Range Project is located within the Albany Fraser Orogen approximately 100 kilometers (km) east of Norseman and covers in excess of 500 square kilometers (km2) in a prospective portion of the Fraser Range. Its Murchison Project consists of E20/912, E20/913, E20/944, P20/2302 and P20/2303 and is centered approximately 30 km north of Cue and forms a landholding of approximately 197 km2 over a buried Archean greenstone belt. Its Doolgunna Project covers part of the southern boundary of the Bryah Basin and the northern part of the Yerrida Basin. Its Mandilla Gold Prospect (Exploration Licence 15/1437) is located approximately 20 km south of Kambalda on the eastern margin of the Mandilla Syenite.

name: RTG MINING
businessSummary: RTG Mining Inc. is a mining and exploration company. The Company is focused primarily on progressing the Mabilo Project to start-up, with a view to moving quickly and safely to a producing gold and copper company. It also has a number of new opportunities, including the Panguna Project in Bougainville. The Company holds a 40% interest in Mt. Labo Exploration and Development Corporation (Mt. Labo), which owns the high-grade Copper and Gold Mabilo Project in the Philippines. It holds a 90% interest in the Chanach Project. The Chanach Project is located in the prolific southern Tien Shan metallogenic belt. Its Bunawan Project includes four project areas situated in the mineral province of the Pacific Cordillera volcanic arc in the South Philippines. Its Nalesbitan Project is only 15 kilometers (km) west of the Mabilo development project in the historic Paracale Gold District in Eastern Luzon. Its Panguna Copper-Gold Project is located in the Central Region of the island of Bougainville.

name: EQUATORIAL RESOURCES
businessSummary: Equatorial Resources Limited is an Australia-based company primarily focusing on Africa. The Company is advancing its mineral assets, including the notable Nimba Alliance Iron Ore Project. Its projects also include Badondo Iron Project (Badondo) and Mayoko-Moussondji Iron Project. The Nimba Project covers a large landholding in Guinea's prolific Nimba Iron Ore Corridor and comprises majority ownership of two permits: 100% of the Nimba West permit covering approximately 198 square kilometers (km2), and 56% of the Nimba North permit covering around 107 km2. The Nimba Project is located within a cluster of major iron ore projects where the development of large-scale transport infrastructure to enable efficient economic production is ongoing. Badondo is a potentially large-scale iron project in the northwest of the Republic of Congo, situated within a cluster of world-class iron ore exploration projects. It has retained a 2% royalty on production from the Mayoko-Moussondji Iron Project.

name: CONSTELLATION RESOURCES
businessSummary: Constellation Resources Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in exploration for minerals and other commodities. Its projects include Edmund Collier, Yerrida and Ashburton Projects (natural hydrogen projects); Ularring Copper Gold Project; and Orpheus Project. Its natural hydrogen projects expand over a total area of 87,602 square kilometers (km2) in Western Australia across the Edmund-Collier, Yerrida and Ashburton Basins, intersecting and/or in proximity to the Goldfields gas transmission. The Ularring Copper Gold Project consists of tenements E70/4686, E70/4901, E70/6671 covering 222 km2, and is located 100 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth. The Orpheus joint operation area consists of a 70% interest in three mineral exploration licenses, E28/2403, E63/1281, E63/1282, and a 100% interest in E28/2738 and E28/2957, and one exploration license under application, E63/1695 all located in Fraser Range province and targets nickel-copper sulphide mineralization.

name: LAKES BLUE ENERGY NL
businessSummary: Lakes Blue Energy NL (LKO) is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration for oil and gas within Australia and Papua New Guinea. Its projects include Nangwarry Carbon Dioxide, Wombat Gas Field, Trifon/Gangell Gas Field, Baragwanath Gas Field, Roma Shelf Oil and Gas Project, Enterprise North, Otway-1, Portland Energy Project, and Buna. Through its subsidiary, Otway Energy Pty Ltd, the Company holds 50% of, and operates PRL 249. PRL 249 contains the Nangwarry Carbon Dioxide Project. Through Gippsland, it focuses on Petroleum Retention Lease 2 (PRL2), within which the Wombat (100% LKO) and Trifon/Gangell (57.2% LKO) gas fields are located. It holds 100% of ATP 1183, which is located in the Roma Shelf area of Queensland. ATP 1183 contains multiple oil and gas exploration targets, including Wellesley, Riverslea Updip, Major, Emu Apple, and Bendee, with significant conventional prospective resource potential.

name: AUSTRAL RESOURCES AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Austral Resources Australia Ltd is an Australia-based copper cathode producer, developer and explorer located in the Mt Isa District of northwest Queensland. The Company’s projects include Anthill Project, Lady Annie Project, Cameron River Project, and Miranda Project. The Anthill Project area lies within the Lady Annie Project, and it is located 45 kilometers (km) from the Mt Kelly processing facility. The Lady Annie Project tenements are in the Western Fold Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier. The Cameron River Project tenements lie within the Eastern Fold Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier with the northern most tenement close to the boundary with the Central Kalkadoon-Leichardt Belt. The tenements are prospective for copper, gold and rare earths. The Miranda Project tenements lie predominantly within the Central Kalkadoon-Leichardt Belt of the Mount Isa Inlier. The Company has entered into an agreement to acquire the Rocklands Copper Mine located in North-West Queensland.

name: INTEGRATED MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Integrated Media Technology Limited is a technology investment, product development, and distribution company. The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing and selling of nano-coated plates for filters, the manufacture and sale of electronic glass, Halal certification and distribution of Halal products, and new energy products and services. The Company's products include smart glass, halal products and services, and filters. Its laminated switchable and energy-saving glass can provide more natural light and outdoor views while minimizing heat and glare. Its subsidiary, World Integrated Supply Ecosystem Sdn. Bhd., is engaged in the global supply chain for halal products in a secure digital marketplace for growers, producers and traders. Its air filter products are a filtering system. Through OH Radical, air sterilization component, and five stages of air sterilization, purification and filtering, unpleasant odour and harmful viruses are turned into aromatic scents.

name: AMERICAN TUNGSTEN & ANTIMONY
businessSummary: American Tungsten & Antimony Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is advancing critical mineral development in Tier-1 United States jurisdictions. Its projects include Antimony Canyon, Tennessee Mountain, Central Idaho Antimony, Achilles Antimony and Nightingale Tungsten. The Company owns 20 patented mining claims covering around 375 acres of the core deposit area. These are surrounded by approximately 360 unpatented lode claims, offering potential for expansion. The Tennessee Mountain Project includes four patented lode claims covering the historic Garnet Mine in Elko County, Nevada: NV106359075 - Tennessee Mountain, NV106359076 - Tennessee Mountain 2, NV106359077 - Tennessee Mountain 3 and NV106359078 - Tennessee Mountain 4. The project, located in the Alder Mining District. The Nightingale Project is a district-scale tungsten exploration opportunity in the historic Nightingale Mining District, Pershing County, Nevada, USA.

name: ZINC OF IRELAND NL
businessSummary: Zinc of Ireland NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company focused on its zinc/lead projects in the Republic of Ireland as well as at its Earaheedy zinc/lead/silver and Cascade rare earth element (REE) exploration projects in Western Australia (WA). Its 100%-owned Kildare Project is located approximately 40 kilometers (km) southwest of Dublin and comprises approximately 240 square kilometers (km2) of contiguous prospecting licenses. The Earaheedy license is located approximately 200 km east of Wiluna and 220 km southeast of the RTR Chinook and Magazine Pb-Zn discoveries. The Earaheedy license contains approximately 23 km of strike of the target unconformity between the Frere and Yelma formations. The Company also covers approximately 1380 km2 lithium exploration project in the Superior Province, Manitoba, Canada. Through its subsidiary Avignon Resources Pty Ltd, it has six mineral exploration licenses and seven mining claims in Manitoba.

name: ZEOTECH
businessSummary: Zeotech Limited is an Australia-based mineral processing technology company. The Company develops and commercializes zeolite mineral processing technology. The Company's projects include Toondoon Kaolin project (Toondoon) and Abercorn Kaolin project. The Toondoon Kaolin Project comprises an approved mining lease (ML80126) and two exploration permits for minerals (EPM 27395 & 27866), located approximately 20 kilometers south of Mundubbera, Queensland and spans over 28,000 hectares. The Abercorn Kaolin Project comprises four contiguous exploration permits for mineral (EPM) for a total of 50 sub-blocks, comprising EPM 26837 (33 sub-blocks), EPM 26903 (4 sub-blocks), EPM 19081 (1 sub-block) and EPM 27427 (12 sub-blocks), located 20 kilometers (km) north of Eidsvold and 70 km south of Monto in the North Burnett District of south-central Queensland, spanning circa 20,000 hectares. Its portfolio of zeolite synthesis technologies can produce a range of targeted grades and products.

name: ZENITH MINERALS
businessSummary: Zenith Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company. The Company is focused on minerals containing lithium and related metals required for rechargeable lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and renewable energy storage. It also has a portfolio of gold and base metal deposits located in Western Australia and Queensland. Its projects are Split Rocks Lithium-Tantalum Project, Waratah Well Lithium-Tantalum Project, Hayes Hill Lithium - Nickel Project, Split Rocks Gold Project, Red Mountain Gold-Silver Project and Earaheedy Zinc Project. The Split Rocks Project is located approximately 40 km south of the regional town of Marvel Loch in the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. The Waratah Well project is located over 20 km northwest of the regional town of Yalgoo in the Murchison Region of Western Australia. The Hayes Hill project consists of four granted exploration licenses in a highly mineral prospective corridor north of Norseman in Western Australia.

name: YOJEE
businessSummary: Yojee Limited is an Australia-based logistics technology company focused on simplifying freight operations through digital innovation. The Company is a developer and provider of software solutions to the Asian Pacific contracted road transportation industry. Its platform enables logistics providers to consolidate complex supply chain networks into a single, intuitive system. Its cloud-based software-as-a-service (SaaS) logistics platform facilitates the flow of freight movements into a single ecosystem. Its Transport Carrier Management System (TCMS) platform enables real-time collaboration, execution, and visibility across transport operations. The Company is also developing its MOSAIC platform, the freight forwarding software that simplifies complex logistics with an intuitive user-focused interface. The Company serves third-party logistics providers (3PLs), global freight forwarders, major shipping lines, and large-scale manufacturers.

name: CENTAURUS METALS
businessSummary: Centaurus Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is primarily involved in exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources. Its projects include Jaguar Nickel Sulfide Project, Boi Novo Copper Gold Project, Jambreiro Iron Ore Project and Rio Novo Copper-Gold Project. Its Jaguar Nickel Sulfide Project is located in the Carajas Mineral Province of northern Brazil. The Project is approximately 250 kilometers (km) from the regional city of Parauapebas in the Brazilian State of Para and sits within a 30 square kilometers (km2) tenement package in the Sao Felix do Xingu municipality. The Company’s Boi Novo Copper-Gold Project, secured as part of Centaurus’ Horizon II Business Development and Growth Strategy in NE Brazil, covers 35 km2 of highly prospective ground in the Carajas Mineral Province. The Company’s 100%-owned Jambreiro Project is located in south-east Brazil. Its Rio Novo Project (40 km2) lies immediately north of its Boi Novo Project.

name: HELIOS ENERGY
businessSummary: Helios Energy Ltd is an Australia-based onshore oil and gas exploration company. The Company’s principal activity includes the exploration activities in Presidio Oil and Gas Project located in Presidio County, Texas, United States. The Company is organized into two segments, being oil and gas exploration in the USA and helium in China. The Presidio Oil & Gas Project is comprised of a large wet gas resource. The Company has a 70% working interest (WI) in a total of approximately 66,776 acres (46,743 net acres). It has drilled two vertical wildcat wells into the Presidio Oil Project: Quinn Creek 141 and Quinn Mesa 113 (two miles apart). The Company’s subsidiaries include Helios Energy USA, Ltd, Helios Operating, LLC, Helios Energy (China) Ltd and Helios Energy Holdings Ltd.

name: EVERFLOW RESOURCES
businessSummary: Dragon Mountain Gold Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company’s principal activities include exploration for minerals within the Cawse Project, and the Avalon Project, all located in Western Australia. It holds a 25% interest in the Cawse and Avalon Projects, each comprising 26 tenements and seven tenements respectively. The Cawse Project covers approximately 115.3 square kilometers in Ora Banda, Western Australia. The Avalon tenements are located approximately 30 kilometers to the east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia.

name: H3 ENERGY
businessSummary: H3 Energy Limited, formerly Whitebark Energy Limited, is an Australia-based exploration and production company focused on exploring and delivering hydrocarbons, natural hydrogen and helium for the energy transition. The Company has an exploration acreage in the Officer Basin located in South Australia; a substantial contingent gas resource in Western Australia; and geothermal exploration applications over proven conventional hot water production locations in southwest Queensland. Its Alinya Project in South Australia. The Alinya Project includes PEL 81 and PEL 253, position Whitebark as a hydrogen, helium and hydrocarbon explorer in Australia. Its Warro Gas Project is ideally a renewable energy project with potentially multiple streams of energy able to be extracted. Its geothermal to Hydrogen Project, including EPG2049, EPG2050 and EPG2054.

name: NEOMETALS
businessSummary: Neometals Ltd is an Australia-based battery materials producer. The Company has developed and is commercializing three environmentally friendly processing technologies. The Company operates through three segments: lithium, titanium/vanadium and other. It is commercializing Lithium-ion Battery (LiB) Recycling technology via Primobius GmbH JV. It is providing recycling service as principal in Germany and commenced plant supply and licensing activities as technology partner to Mercedes-Benz. The Company is involved in commercializing patented ELi electrolysis process to produce battery quality lithium hydroxide from brine and/or hard-rock feedstocks. It also enables sustainable production of high-purity vanadium pentoxide from processing of steelmaking by-product (Slag). Its Barrambie Titanium and Vanadium Project is a highest-grade hard-rock titanium-vanadium deposits. The other segment comprises other minor exploration projects and mineral process technology businesses.

name: WIA GOLD
businessSummary: Wia Gold Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the gold exploration business focused on the Kokoseb discovery in Namibia. The Company’s Kokoseb Gold Project is located in north-west Namibia approximately 320 kilometers by road from the capital city of Windhoek. The Kokoseb Gold Project lies within the Okombahe Exploration License, which is held under a joint venture by the Company (80%) and the Namibian state-owned mining company, Epangelo. The Okombahe EL is part of its broader Damaran Belt tenure in Namibia, which consists of approximately 12 tenements across a total area of over 2,700 square kilometers (km2).

name: ENERGY TRANSITION MINERALS
businessSummary: Energy Transition Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based exploration and development company focused on developing mineral projects globally. The Company manages exploration projects in Western Europe, North America and Greenland. Its Kvanefjeld project is located in an area of southern Greenland, which has approximately one billion tons of mineral resources (JORC-compliant). The project includes various large-scale multi-element resources, including Kvanefjeld, Sorensen and Zone 3. Its Kvanefjeld project remains subject to arbitration procedures in the Arbitration Tribunal in Copenhagen. Its Villasrubias project is located in the southwest corner of the province of Salamanca, close to the Portuguese border and 33 kilometers (km) away from Ciudad Rodrigo, the district capital. Its Good Setting and Solo lithium projects in James Bay, Quebec. It also owns the Penouta tin-tantalum-niobium mine and processing facility in Galicia, Spain (Penouta Mine).

name: DATELINE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Dateline Resources Limited is an Australian company focused on mining and exploration in North America. The Company owns 100% of the Colosseum Gold-REE Project in California. Its Colosseum Gold and Rare Earths Project are situated in San Bernardino County, California, United States. The Colosseum Gold Mine is located in the Walker Lane Trend in East San Bernardino County, California. The Colosseum is located less than 10 kilometers (km) north of the Mountain Pass Rare Earth mine. Its other projects are the Argos Strontium Project (100%, San Bernardino County) and the Music Valley Heavy Rare Earths Project (100%, Riverside County). The Argos Project comprises four patented claims situated on the southern margin of the Cady Mountains. The Music Valley HREE Project (Music Valley), located in Riverside County, California, United States. Music Valley consists of 57 claims totaling 1,140 acres.

name: NT MINERALS
businessSummary: NT Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and minerals development company with projects in the Northern Territory and Western Australia. The Company is focusing on copper, bulk commodities and strategic minerals. Its projects include Redbank Project, Millers Creek Project, Wollogorang Project, Finniss River Critical Minerals Project and Twin Peaks Project. The Redbank Project is located in the east McArthur Basin and spans an area from the Northern Territory/Queensland border west towards Glencore’s McArthur Mine. The Millers Creek Project is located approximately 700 kilometers (kms) northwest of Adelaide and consists of real estate situated between mining companies OZ Minerals to the north and FMG to the east. The Wollogorang Project is located in the southeast McArthur Basin. The Finniss River Critical Minerals Project is located 70 kms southwest of Darwin. The Twin Peaks Project is 520 kilometers north of Perth and approximately 200 kms northeast of Geraldton.

name: SINCLAIR GOLD
businessSummary: Sinclair Gold Ltd, formerly Alicanto Minerals Limited, is an Australia-based gold exploration and development company focused on Mt Henry Gold Project. The Mt Henry Gold Project is located approximately 20 kilometers (km) south of Norseman and 220km south of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields. The Project sits within a 16km mineralized corridor containing a JORC (2012) Mineral Resource. Selene Gold Deposit is a deposit within the Mt Henry Gold Project and hosts more than 70% of the Mineral Resource. Selene Gold Deposit is a continuous gold system hosted within the same mineralized BIF horizon that extends across the broader 16 km mineralized corridor. North Scotia Deposit is a high-grade gold deposit located within the broader Mt Henry Gold Project area. The Company also has an interest in tenements in Sweden’s highly regarded mining region of Bergslagen, including the Falun copper-gold and polymetallic skarn project and the historic Sala silver zinc-lead Project.

name: BRAINCHIP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: BrainChip Holdings Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in edge artificial intelligence (AI) on-chip processing and learning. The principal activity of the Company is the development of software and hardware accelerated solutions for advanced artificial AI and machine learning applications, with a primary focus on the development of its Akida Neuromorphic Processor to provide a complete ultra-low power and fast AI Edge Network for vision, audio, olfactory and smart transducer applications. Akida mimics the human brain to analyze only essential sensor inputs at the point of acquisition, processing data with unparalleled efficiency, precision, and economy of energy. Akida is a neural processor platform inspired by the brain’s cognitive capabilities and energy efficiency. The Company’s BrainChip offers a full suite of Akida development tools for building Edge AI solutions, centered around the MetaTF software environment and supported by hardware platforms.

name: NEUROTECH INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Neurotech International Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical development company. The Company focuses predominately on pediatric neurological disorders with a broad-spectrum oral cannabinoid drug therapy called NTI164. It has completed a Phase II/III randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial in autism spectrum disorder (ASD). In addition, it has completed and reported significant and clinically meaningful Phase I/II trials in ASD and pediatric autoimmune neuropsychiatric disorders associated with streptococcal infections (PANDAS) and pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome (PANS), collectively PANDAS/PANS along with Rett Syndrome. NTI164 is being developed as a therapeutic drug product for a range of neurological disorders in children where neuroinflammation is involved. The Company’s subsidiaries include AAT Research Ltd and AAT Medical Ltd.

name: BLUE STAR HELIUM
businessSummary: Blue Star Helium Limited is an Australia-based independent helium exploration and production company. The Company is engaged in finding and developing new supplies of high-grade helium in North America. The Company’s projects include Voyager Project and Galactica/Pegasus Projects. The Galactica project is being undertaken in joint venture with Helium One Global Ltd. It has an inventory of over 11 helium development well locations approved at Galactica/Pegasus Projects. Its portfolio comprises substantial shallow resources associated with the Lyons helium play. The Company’s subsidiary is BNL (Enterprise) Inc.

name: BELLAVISTA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Bellavista Resources Limited is an Australia‑based mineral exploration company. The Company 100% owns the Brumby Base metal Project which is a large scale and highly prospective mineral province in Western Australia capable of hosting giant to super-giant base metal deposits, and battery mineral deposit. Its Projects include Brumby Deposit, Vernon Base Metals, Vernon Nickel-PGE, and Gorge Creek, which are highly prospective for zinc, copper, silver, PGE and uranium deposits. The Company has a large and highly prospective tenement package that covers approximately 100 kilometers (km) of strike of the northern margin of the highly prospective Edmund Basin. The Edmund project's tenement holding includes approximately five exploration licenses and two license applications Project area totaling 1,068 square kilometers (km2). The Brumby Project covers an area of 81.4 km2 covering the Brumby Creek Base Metal system. Its other projects include Pickle Crow Project and Sioux Lookout Project.

name: LINDIAN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Lindian Resources Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals company. The Company is engaged in development of rare earths and bauxite assets in Malawi and Guinea. Its flagship asset, Kangankunde Rare Earths Project, is located in Malawi. The Kangankunde hosts a significant rare earth resource with low levels of uranium and thorium for downstream processing. The SARECO plant in Kazakhstan provides a hydrometallurgical processing facility for converting Kangankunde monazite concentrate into Mixed Rare Earth Carbonate. Its Guinea Bauxite projects include Lelouma, Gaoual, and Woula. The Gaoual Bauxite Project (Gaoual Project) is in northwestern Guinea within the Boke Bauxite Belt. Gaoual Project is situated south of the township of Gaoual in the northern portion of the Kogon-Tomine interfluve, approximately 65 kilometers northeast of Sangaredi. Its Tanzania bauxite tenements include Lushoto and Pare positioned in Tanzania's prospective bauxite belt.

name: NEW FRONTIER MINERALS
businessSummary: New Frontier Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration company focused on the development of multicommodity assets, including uranium, niobium, copper, and heavy rare earth minerals. Its projects include the Harts Range Project and the NWQ Copper Project. The Harts Range Project comprises two granted tenements and an application license for a total of 135 square kilometers (km2), approximately 140 kilometers (km) north-east of Alice Springs, with mining infrastructure and access to a skilled labor pool. The Harts Range Project is situated northwest of the Entia Dome and lies within the Harts Range Group. The NWQ Copper Project comprises five mineral leases, covering a total area of 977 km2. The NWQ Copper Project is located approximately 150 km north of Mt Isa in Queensland, and hosts several historic / operating copper mines, including Lady Annie, Mt Oxide and Capricorn Copper. Its additional project, Mkushi Project, is located within the Mwembeshi Shear Zone (MSZ).

name: BARTON GOLD HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Barton Gold Holdings Limited is an Australia-based gold developer. The Company is focused on the production of 150,000ozpa with 2.1Moz Au & 3.1Moz Ag JORC Mineral Resources (78.9Mt @ 0.85 g/t Au), brownfield mines, and 100% ownership of the single gold mill in the Gawler Craton of South Australia. Its projects include Challenger Gold Project, Tarcoola Gold Project, Tunkillia Gold Project and Wudinna Gold Project. The Challenger Project is located approximately 730 kilometers (km) northwest of Adelaide, South Australia and about 130 km northwest of the Tarcoola Project. It comprises the Challenger Mine, the Challenger Mill, a mine village and associated infrastructure. The Tunkillia Project is located about 70 km S/SE of the Tarcoola Project on a 1,360 square kilometer (km2) tenement package which hosts a 1.5Moz Au JORC Mineral Resource Estimate. The Tarcoola Project is located over 70km N/NW of the Tunkillia Project on about 1,640 km2 of tenements.

name: AUMEGA METALS
businessSummary: AuMEGA Metals Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on exploring its two properties, Cape Ray Shear Zone and Hermitage. It is focused on exploration to explore on its district scale land package that spans over 110 kilometers (Km) along the Cape Ray Shear Zone. This zone hosts EquinoxGold's Valentine Gold Project, a gold deposit with significant mineral resources. The Hermitage Project is highly prospective for gold exploration following a review of targets in Newfoundland that have exploration potential. The Blue Cove Copper Project is in southeastern Newfoundland, over 175 km to the east of its Hermitage Project and 260 km by road west of St. John’s. The Blue Cove option agreement covers over 78 non-contiguous claims covering 19.5 square kilometers (km2). In addition to the option agreement, it has staked 113 mineral claims covering an additional 28.25 km2 adjacent to the Blue Cove mineral claims.

name: QUANTUM GRAPHITE
businessSummary: Quantum Graphite Limited is an Australia-based company which engaged in the manufacturing of high-grade flake graphite products and the mining of and exploration for graphite deposits in South Australia. The Company is the owner of the Mikkira Graphite Deposit located on the Eyre Peninsula, South Australia. The Company's Uley 2 Project is located on the Eyre Peninsula, South Australia, approximately 20 kilometers west-south-west of Port Lincoln. The Uley Graphite Project consists of a fully permitted mining operation with five contiguous mining tenements. Its Uley 2 processing plant produces a minimum of approximately 100,000 tons of high purity coarse flake. The Uley mine produces high purity coarse flake graphite with a product mix serving a number of thermal applications, including refractories and oil and gas drilling fluids.

name: BALLARD MINING
businessSummary: Ballard Mining Limited is an Australia-based gold company. The Company is engaged in developing the Mt Ida Gold Project in Western Australia. The gold asset covers 1,518 square kilometers of rights to explore for gold at the Mt Ida Project, which is located approximately 100 kilometers (km) northwest of Menzies in the Goldfields region of Western Australia. The gold asset resides on six granted mining leases and is approved for open pit and underground mining at Baldock, which hosts the majority of the high-grade gold mineral resource at the Mt Ida Project. The gold asset is located in central Western Australia within the Goldfields-Esperance region, located approximately 540 km northeast of Perth, 200 km northwest of Kalgoorlie-Boulder and approximately 100 km northwest of Menzies. The gold asset comprises deposits, including Baldock deposit, Kestrel deposit, West Knell deposit, Bombay deposit, Golden Vale deposit, and Jupiter deposit.

name: MIDAS MINERALS
businessSummary: Midas Minerals Ltd is a junior mineral exploration company with a primary focus on copper and precious metals. Its projects include the Newington Project, Challa Gold, Nickel-Copper-PGE Project, Reid-Aylmer Project, Otavi Project, and Greenbush Lithium Project. The Reid-Aylmer Project has mineral claims totaling about 157 square kilometers (km2) located northeast of Yellowknife, in the Northwest Territories of Canada. The Greenbush lithium project covers over 102 km2 and is located 12 km east of Highway 599, about 95 km north of Savant Lake and 70 km south of Pickle Lake. The Newington Lithium-Gold Project has 212 km2 of tenements located at the north end of the Southern Cross greenstone belt. Its Challa Gold, Nickel-Copper-PGE encompasses over two exploration licenses and three license applications totaling 860 km2 and an option for a 47 km2 exploration license. It has the 1,776 km2 high-grade Otavi Copper Project and holds an option over the 194 km2 South Otavi Project in Namibia.

name: XENORA MINERALS
businessSummary: Xenora Minerals Limited, formerly Trinex Minerals Limited, is an Australia-based resources company exploring critical minerals. Its Dudley Lithium Project is located on Kangaroo Island in South Australia within exploration licence EL6892. It also holds a lithium exploration footprint in the Northwest Territories, Canada, with tenure spanning approximately 650 square kilometers (km2). The Company holds 100% interest in mineral claims across the Halo-Yuri Lake Lithium Projects, East Yellowknife Lake Lithium Projects, MAC Lake Lithium Projects, and Ross Lake Lithium Projects. Its Halo-Yuri Lake Lithium Project is located over 250 kilometers northeast of Yellowknife on the Gahcho Kue annual winter road and covers approximately 450 km2. The Ross Lake Lithium Project is a single claim situated approximately 70 km east-northeast of Yellowknife. The MAC Lithium Project comprises four contiguous claims that cover approximately 4,300 hectares and is located 80 km north of Yellowknife.

name: GREAT SOUTHERN MINING
businessSummary: Great Southern Mining Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company's projects are located within approximately 40 kilometers (km) of operating mills and major operations. It holds exploration licenses totaling 421 square kilometers (km2) in the Duketon Greenstone Belt located to the north of the town of Laverton in Western Australia. The Company is exploring primarily for gold with advanced exploration areas including Amy Clarke and Golden Boulder. The East Laverton Nickel Project comprises four granted exploration licenses covering an area of 405 km2, located approximately 35 km from the town of Laverton. The Mon Ami Project comprises five licenses centered on a permitted mining license, all located in Western Australia. The Edinburgh Park project is located approximately 100 km southeast of Townsville in Queensland and encompasses an area of approximately 1,750 km2 surrounding the high sulphuration epithermal Mt Carlton gold-silver-copper mine.

name: YANDAL RESOURCES
businessSummary: Yandal Resources Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is focused on exploring its portfolio of highly prospective 100% owned gold projects located in the Yandal and Norseman-Wiluna Greenstone Belts in Western Australia. Its projects include Ironstone Well-Barwidgee and Mt McClure. The Ironstone Well-Barwidgee Project covers approximately 370 square kilometers (km2) of prospective and under-explored tenure located between the Jundee and Bronzewing mines in the northern Yandal Greenstone Belt. The Mt McClure Project is located approximately 15 kilometers (km) south-west of the historic Bronzewing gold mine and 10 km from Orelia gold mine both owned by Northern Star Resources Ltd in the southern Yandal Belt. The project covers a total strike length of over 17 km of prospective stratigraphy and includes several shallow historical open-cut pits.

name: MOHO RESOURCES
businessSummary: Moho Resources Ltd is an Australia-based natural resources company advancing early-stage gold and other metals projects in Western Australia through exploration towards development. The Company operates the Silver Swan North Project, located approximately 40 kilometers (km) northeast of Kalgoorlie-Boulder in Western Australia, which lies on the eastern flank of the Kanowna-Scotia Dome within the Boorara Domain. The Weld Range North Project is located in the highly prospective Youanmi Terrane of the Yilgarn Craton in Western Australia. Its Bush Chook Gold Project expanded around 386 square kilometers (km2) in the Mosquito Creek Basin of the Pilbara Craton, Western Australia.

name: BRAZILIAN CRITICAL MINERALS
businessSummary: Brazilian Critical Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company’s primary exploration focus is Brazil, in the Apui region. It is exploring for rare earth elements (REEs) and (PGE) projects via the exploration, development of projects in Northern Brazil. The Company’s flagship projects include EMA ionic REE and APUI ENE REE, which covers approximately 700 square kilometers (km2). The Ema ionic adsorbed clay (IAC) project is contained within the 781 km2 of exploration tenements within the Colider Group. The Apui project encompasses seven tenements spanning a total of over 510 km2. Its Tres Estados Project contains a total inferred resource of 725,230 ounces at 1,152g/t of 5E precious metals (platinum, palladium, iridium, rhodium, and gold).

name: PRAIRIE LITHIUM
businessSummary: Prairie Lithium Limited, formerly Arizona Lithium Limited, is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the sustainable development of the Prairie Lithium Project. The project is located in the Willson Basin of Saskatchewan, Canada. The project is comprised of over 345,000 acres of subsurface permits. It utilizes direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology to separate lithium from the brine. The extracted lithium concentrate is then converted onsite to an upgraded high-purity material. The remaining lithium-depleted brine shall be disposed of back underground into a different aquifer. The DLE process uses less land and fresh water while also generating less waste in comparison to hard rock and evaporation mining.

name: WHITE CLIFF MINERALS
businessSummary: White Cliff Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company, pioneering high grade copper discoveries in a Tier 1 Jurisdiction. The Company’s projects include RAE Copper-Silver Project and Great Bear Copper-Gold-Silver-Uranium Project. The RAE Copper-Silver Project, located in Nunavut, is prospective for a range of copper-silver mineralization styles. The RAE Copper-Silver Project is located on mainland Canada, 75 kilometers (km) from nearest town of Kugluktuk, providing support and a deep-water port. The RAE Copper-Silver Project covers an area of approximately 1,228 square kilometers (km2). The Great Bear Lake Project is located 240 km southwest of the Company’s RAE Copper-Silver Project and the settlement of Kugluktuk covers an area of approximately 2,900 km2 of the iron oxide copper gold prospective Great Bear Magmatic Zone (GBMZ). The GBMZ is an extensively hydrothermally altered and mineralized Proterozoic continental andesitic stratovolcano-plutonic complex.

name: STAVELY MINERALS
businessSummary: Stavely Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. It is focused on the exploring for copper, gold and silver at the Stavely and Ararat Projects in western Victoria, and nickel, copper and cobalt at the Hawkstone Project in west Kimberley, in northern Western Australia. The Stavely Project, covering an area of approximately 1,000 square kilometers (km2) over the prospective Stavely Volcanic Belt in western Victoria, includes a 100% owned retention license RL2017, 100% owned exploration licenses EL6870, EL7347, EL7921, EL7922, EL7923 and EL7924 and the Black Range Joint Venture license EL5425. The Ararat Project comprises a retention license, RL2020, covering an area of approximately 26km2. The Ararat Project is located on part of the western margin of the Stawell-Bendigo Zone, which is part of the western Lachlan Fold Belt. Its Hawkstone Project covers an area of 1,100 km2 over prospective stratigraphy in the west Kimberley, in northern Western Australia.

name: NORTHSTONE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Northstone Resources Limited, formerly MinRex Resources Limited, is an Australia-based gold and copper exploration company with advanced exploration and development assets across Serbia and Australia. The Company's projects include the Tlamino Project, the Timok East Project, and the Sofala Gold Projects. The Tlamino Gold Project is a district-scale gold-silver exploration and resource hub located in southern Serbia along the Serbo-Macedonian Massif, a highly prospective metallogenic belt that extends through the Balkans and hosts a range of precious and base metal deposits. The Timok East Project is a district-scale copper-gold exploration asset located in eastern Serbia within the Timok Magmatic Complex. The Sofala Gold Projects form an exploration and resource base within the highly prospective East Lachlan Fold Belt of New South Wales, Australia for gold, copper-gold and silver deposits which is located approximately 180 kilometers northwest of Sydney.

name: UNICO SILVER
businessSummary: Unico Silver Limited is an Australian exploration and development company focused on uncovering world-class silver and gold deposits in Argentina’s prolific Santa Cruz province. It holds 100% of the Cerro Leon, Cerro Puntudo, and Joaquin Projects, all are located in silver gold districts, Santa Cruz, Argentina. Its flagship Cerro Leon project is located within the mining friendly Santa Cruz province of Argentina, about 130 kilometers (km) northwest of the port town San Julian. The Cerro Leon Project is in the central Deseado Massif geological province, approximately 45 kilometers northwest of AngloGold Ashanti's Cerro Vanguardia mine. The Joaquin and Cerro Puntudo are located towards the central eastern margin of the Deseado Massif geological province that stretches across southern Argentina into the Chilean southern Andes. The Joaquin and Cerro Puntudo mining properties include over 16 titles, totaling approximately 35,946 hectares.

name: SUREFIRE RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Surefire Resources NL is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds mineral exploration licenses over Vanadium, Magnetite and Gold projects located in Western Australia. It is focused on Victory Bore Vanadium critical and battery minerals project. The Victory Bore project is located in the Mid-West region of Western Australia. Its Perenjori Iron Ore Project is located within 15 kilometers (km) of both the Morawa-Peronjori trunk rail line and the Karara rail spur. Its Yidby Gold Project is situated within the southern portion of the Yalgoo-Singleton Greenstone Belt, 40 km from Paynes Find and 400 km northeast of Perth. The project is also surrounded by several significant gold projects. Its Kooline Lead-Silver Project tenements cover almost 50 km strike length of mineralized Ashburton Formation and are located 55 km south of the one Moz Paulsen’s gold mine and 190 km northwest of Paraburdoo in the Ashburton province of Western Australia.

name: TORQUE METALS
businessSummary: Torque Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company’s projects include Paris Gold Project, New Dawn Gold Project, Edleston Gold Project, and Penzance Gold Project. Its Paris Exploration Camp is the prime asset of the Company, which covers approximately 1,200 square kilometers (km2) of land, including 16 mining licenses, two prospecting licenses and 48 exploration licenses. The Paris Gold Project mineral resource estimate3 (MRE3) includes three deposits (Paris, HHH and Observation). The Edleston Gold Project is situated in the Abitibi Belt, approximately 60km via road to the south of Timmins, Ontario, Canada. Its over 310km2 land package is surrounded by numerous processing facilities including Alamos Gold, IAMGOLD and Newmont. New Dawn’s gold potential lies in the northernmost area of the project, also known as New Dawn North. The New Dawn Gold Project comprised of approximately four exploration licenses.

name: ASPIRE MINING
businessSummary: Aspire Mining Limited is an Australia-based coking coal development company. The Company 100% owns the Ovoot Coking Coal Project, and 90% owns the Nuurstei Coking Coal Project, both located in Khuvsgul aimag of north-western Mongolia. The Company is primarily focused on developing the Ovoot Coking Coal Project to mine coking coal via open pit methods, beneficiate it onsite, transport it by truck to a Company-owned coal unloading and loading facility near Erdenet, and delivering it onward via rail to customers in China, Russia and beyond utilizing the existing trans-Mongolian rail network. The Ovoot Project area is located in north-western Mongolia and comprises mining license MV017098. The Nuurstei project comprises mining license MV-020941 and is capable of producing washed hard coking coal. The project is located approximately 10 kilometers (km) from Khuvsgul provincial capital of Moron and is approximately 160 km northeast of the Ovoot project.

name: TOUBANI RESOURCES
businessSummary: Toubani Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The Company is focused on gold development projects with its oxide dominant Kobada Gold Project. The Kobada Gold Project is located in the Sikasso administrative region in southern Mali, near the border with Guinea, approximately 126 kilometers from Bamako. The Kobada main deposit hosts over 2.2 million ounces (Moz) of predominantly free-dig, oxide gold over a strike extent of 4.5 kilometers, which is also open at depth with mineralization open down dip. The Kobada Gold Project consists of two exploration permits and one exploitation permit. The Company’s subsidiaries include AGG (Barbados) Limited and Toubani Resources (Mali) SARL.

name: ENERGY METALS
businessSummary: Energy Metals Limited is an Australia-based uranium exploration company. The Company has eight exploration projects located in the Northern Territory (NT) and Western Australia covering around 2,400 square kilometers (km2). Its projects include Bigrlyi, Ngalia Regional, Macallan, Anketell, Mopoke Well, Lakeside, Manyingee, and Lake Mason. The Bigrlyi deposit is a sandstone hosted uranium-vanadium deposit located on the northern margin of the Ngalia Basin, approximately 350 km northwest of Alice Springs. The Ngalia Regional Project is located in the Ngalia Basin, between 180 and 350 km northwest of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory. The Macallan project comprises a single exploration licence application (ELA27333), located 460 km northwest of Alice Springs and 140 km from Bigrlyi. The Anketell project is located 100 km east of Mt. Magnet and comprises retention licence R58/2. The Manyingee project (E08/1480 and R08/3) is located 85 km south of the port of Onslow.

name: 3D ENERGI
businessSummary: 3D Energi Limited is an Australia-based energy company. The Company is engaged in exploration and development of upstream oil and gas assets. It has developed a portfolio of highly prospective offshore exploration permits in the offshore Otway and Gippsland basins of Southeast Australia. Its project includes Offshore Otway, VIC/TAS; Offshore Gippsland, VIC; Onshore Otway, SA, and Offshore Bedout, WA. The Offshore Otway Project includes two offshore exploration permits in the offshore Otway Basin, VIC/P79 and T/49P. The VIC/P74 petroleum exploration permit covers an area of 1,006 square kilometer (km2) and lies within shallow Commonwealth waters of the Gippsland Basin, where water depths range up to 70 m. Its Onshore Otway Project at GSEL 759 is exploring the feasibility of the abandoned Caroline carbon dioxide (CO2) field within the onshore Otway Basin as a gas storage site, with the depleted reservoir potentially suitable for the storage of hydrogen, natural gas, or carbon dioxide.

name: WA1 RESOURCES
businessSummary: WA1 Resources Ltd is an Australia-based mineral company. The Company is primarily involved in the mineral exploration, evaluation and project development of mineral resources in Western Australia. The Company owns 100% of two exploration projects in Western Australian. The West Arunta Project, which contains the Luni Niobium deposit, is in Western Australia, approximately 490 kilometers (km) south of Halls Creek in Western Australia. Luni Niobium Project was discovered in 2022 in West Arunta initial drilling at Luni highly anomalous niobium, REE, and phosphorous mineralisation in three holes up to 1.3 kilometers (km). Its future development includes water, environment, power, transport studies and niobium marketing are underway. The Madura Project tenements are located approximately 540 km east of Kalgoorlie-Boulder. The exploration project comprises seven granted Exploration Licenses and two Exploration License applications in the Madura Province of southeastern Western Australia.

name: CLEARVUE TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: ClearVue Technologies Limited is an Australia-based technology company. The Company integrates solar technology into building facade and rooftop surfaces to provide renewable energy generation and offset the operational carbon footprint of buildings. The Company manufactures to a range of Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) products, enabling entire buildings to generate electricity. Its patented solar glass technology allows energy generation from clear glass windows. This technology can be applied to windows, skylights, greenhouses, and facades, enhancing the sustainability and energy efficiency of buildings by generating energy from nearly all surfaces. Its products include Solar Vision Glass, Smart Solar Facade, Solar Cladding, Architectural BIPV, and Horticultural Solar Glass. Its Solar Facade products include Solar Spandrel, Solar Skylight, and Solar Railings.

name: MITHRIL SILVER AND GOLD
businessSummary: Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd is a precious metals exploration company. The Company is focused on developing its flagship Copalquin Project. The Copalquin mining district Project is located in Durango State, Mexico and covers an entire mining district of 70 square kilometers (km2) containing several dozen historic gold and silver mines. Its Copalquin Mining District, covered by approximately five contiguous mining concessions, is a large epithermal gold-silver system, located in Mexico’s Sierra Madre Gold-Silver Trend. It also holds free carried interest in the Limestone Well vanadium tenements located in Western Australia.

name: VANADIUM RESOURCES
businessSummary: Vanadium Resources Limited is an Australia-based vanadium producer. The Company is focused on developing its flagship project, the Steelpoortdrift Vanadium Project which is strategically located 15 kilometers (km) apart within the Bushveld Geological Complex in South Africa. The Steelpoortdrift Vanadium Project consists of the Steelpoortdrift Mine, Concentrator Plant, and Salt Roast Leach Processing Plant. Steelpoortdrift Vanadium Project boasts a substantial vanadium deposit for generations to come with a Mineral Resource of 680 million tons at an average in-situ grade of 0.70% V2O5 (equivalent to 4.74 million tons of contained metal) and a Proved and Probable Ore Reserve of 77 million tons at an average in-situ grade of 0.72% V2O5 (equivalent to 0.55 million tons of contained metal). The Company is engaged in transforming vanadium applications across various sectors, including energy storage, infrastructure development, and more.

name: TRUE NORTH COPPER
businessSummary: True North Copper Limited is an Australia-based copper-focused exploration company. The Company’s projects include Cloncurry Project, Mt Oxide Project, and Bundarra Project. The Cloncurry Project is centered around the Great Australia Mine Complex located at Cloncurry in north-west Queensland. The Cloncurry Project’s mineral resources contain 101.25 kt copper, 76.62 koz gold, and 1.86 kt Cobalt. The Mt Oxide Project has established infrastructure, including an exploration camp and proximity to a processing plant and power grid. The Mt Oxide Project offers development and exploration potential. The Mt Oxide Project holds substantial resources, including 220 kt Copper, 5.13 Moz silver, and 21.2 kt cobalt. Its Bundarra Project is strategically situated approximately 130 kilometers (km) southwest of Mackay and 50 km east of Moranbah in the central Queensland coal fields.

name: TIVAN
businessSummary: Tivan Limited is a critical minerals company primarily involved in the exploration, evaluation and development of mineral assets within Australia. The Company's Speewah Fluorite Project and Speewah Vanadium Project are located 100 km south of the port of Wyndham, and 110 km south-west of Kununurra, in the Kimberley region of north-east Western Australia. Its Sandover fluorite project is 8 km from its Sandover AI Project, which is located 100 km north of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory, covering an area of over 8,000 km2 across two contiguous blocks of exploration licenses within the Northern Arunta Pegmatite Province. Its Molyhil Tungsten-Molybdenum project is located over 220 km north-east of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory. Its Turiscai Project is a copper-gold exploration project, located over 40 km south of Dili, the capital of Timor-Leste. Covering an area of 344 km2, the project is situated within a geological setting that hosts significant copper-gold deposits.

name: TITANIUM SANDS
businessSummary: Titanium Sands Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company, through its local partners, Orion Minerals (Private) Limited, Sanur Minerals (pvt) Ltd and Kilsythe Investments (Private) Limited, are developing a high grade mineable heavy mineral sands project at Mannar Island, Sri Lanka. The Mannar Island Heavy Mineral Sands Project is located in Northwest Sri Lanka and is an ilmenite feedstock project with minor credits from other mineral components. It holds five heavy mineral sands exploration licenses located in North West Sri Lanka on Mannar Island and the adjacent mainland coast.
