The exploration licenses include EL 370, EL 351, EL 425, EL 423, and EL 424. It also has four renewal pending licenses including EL 180/R/3, EL 182/R/3, EL 371, and EL 372. It is focused around Mannar Island, an island approximately 26 kilometers (km) long and six km wide, and 140 square kilometers in area, joined to the mainland shore by road and rail connections over a short causeway.

name: ALCHEMY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Alchemy Resources Limited is an exploration company. The Company is focused on the discovery and development of gold, base metal and battery metals within Australia. Its projects include Cobar Basin/Lachlan Fold Belt Projects, West Lynn and Woodsreef Projects (NSW), and Bryah Basin Project (WA. The Lachlan Projects cover highly prospective terrain in the Central Lachlan Orogen and comprise three project areas prospective for Cobar-style epithermal gold and base metals and copper-gold porphyry mineralization. The Lachlan/Cobar Basin Projects consist of the Overflow Gold-Base Metal Project, the Yellow Mountain Copper-Gold Project, the West Lynn Nickel-Cobalt-Alumina Project and the Eurow Copper-Gold Project, each containing multiple drill-ready gold and/or base metal and/or nickel-cobalt targets. The West Lynn and Woodsreef projects contain two highly prospective nickel-cobalt tenements covering approximately 381 square kilometers.

name: STARPHARMA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Starpharma Holdings Limited is an Australia-based biotechnology company specializing in advancing dendrimer technology. The Company's principal activities are focused on the research, development and commercialization of dendrimer technology for pharmaceutical and healthcare applications. The Company's portfolio of dendrimer-based products includes three clinical-stage dendrimer enhanced product (DEP) assets, preclinical radiopharmaceutical assets, research collaborations, and three commercially marketed over the counter (OTC) products. Its clinical-stage assets, DEP SN38, DEP cabazitaxel, and DEP docetaxel, are dendrimer-based chemotherapeutic drugs. Additionally, the Company has a preclinical pipeline of DEP radiopharmaceuticals in development. It also manufactures and sells SPL7013 (astodrimer sodium) proprietary products: VivaGel BV, Viraleze nasal spray, and VivaGel condom. The Company has applied its DEP technology to the innovative area of antibody-drug conjugates.

name: ST GEORGE MINING
businessSummary: St George Mining Limited is focused on developing critical minerals projects in Brazil and Western Australia. The Company's projects include Araxa Project, Mt Alexander Project, Paterson Project, Broadview Project, Ajana Project, Lithium Star-WA Projects, and Destiny Project. Araxa is a niobium-rare earth element (REE) project in Minas Gerais, Brazil. The Mt Alexander Project is located about 120 kilometers (km) south-southwest of the Agnew-Wiluna belt, which hosts numerous nickel deposits. Its Paterson Project is an early-stage project with exploration upside. The Broadview Project is located in Western Australia’s Wheatbelt, approximately 150 km east of Perth. The 100% owned Ajana Project is located within the Meso-Proterozoic age Northampton mineral field, situated near the western margin of the Yilgarn Craton. The Lithium Star-WA Projects encompass 14 exploration licenses. The Destiny Project is located in the Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia.

name: FIRST AU
businessSummary: First AU Limited is an Australia-based advanced gold and base metal exploration company. The principal activity of the Company is exploration for gold and other metals in its interests in mining tenements located in Western Australia, Victoria, Australia and Liberia and West Africa. It is engaged in pursuing exploration programs at its Victorian Goldfields Project in East Gippsland and its 100% owned Gimlet Gold project near Kalgoorlie. The Victorian Gold Project is located in the Gippsland region, which is in the historic mining area of Swifts Creek and is focused on the Haunted Stream and Snowstorm Projects. The Company’s Gimlet Gold Project is located approximately 15 km northwest of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia and comprises two titles, exploration license (E) 26/174, area 4.37 square kilometers and Mining Lease (M) 26/849, area 520.73 hectares. Its Nimba Gold Project is located in the West African Craton and encompasses over 831.09 km of tenement package in northern Liberia.

name: BEETALOO ENERGY AUSTRALIA
businessSummary: Beetaloo Energy Australia Limited is an Australia-based pure Northern Territory hydrocarbon player. The Company is focused on the Beetaloo Sub-basin. The Company’s 100%-owned subsidiary, Imperial Oil & Gas Pty Limited, is the holder of the acreage position (>28m acres) in the highly prospective Betaloo Basin. Technically, the Beetaloo is a sub-basin of the McArthur Basin. The Beetaloo Basin is developing that its extensive shale targets are gas-rich, and potentially liquid-rich, and offer a possible boost to future East Coast Australia’s energy supplies.

name: AURORA LABS
businessSummary: Aurora Labs Limited is an Australia-based industrial technology and innovation company. The Company’s principal activities include the design and development of three-dimensional (3D) metal printers, digital parts, and their associated intellectual property. It has a single reportable segment, namely design, development of 3D metal printers, parts printing and associated products and services. It manufactures propulsion systems and metal components, with a focus on additive manufacturing (AM) for defense, aerospace, and advanced industrial sectors. It is engaged in propulsion systems, research and development, industrial print services, 3D metal printers, and printer design and manufacture. The Company offers propulsion systems across mission profiles, from loitering munitions to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) drones and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). It supports five markets: energy, mining, infrastructure, utilities, and defense.

name: SOVEREIGN METALS
businessSummary: Sovereign Metals Limited is an Australia-based company is focused on developing its Kasiya Rutile-Graphite Project (Kasiya) in Malawi. Kasiya is located in the Lilongwe District of the Southeastern African country of Malawi. Kasiya’s Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) is 1.8Bt at 1.0% rutile resulting in over18 Mt tons of contained natural rutile. The MRE has broad zones of very high-grade rutile, which occur contiguously across a very large area of over 200 square kilometers. Kasiya’s graphite by-product Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) is 1.8 Bt at 1.4% graphite, containing over 24.4 Mt tones of contained natural graphite. The Kasiya Rutile-Graphite deposit is in an area northwest of Malawi’s capital of Lilongwe called the Lilongwe Plain.

name: ARGENT MINERALS
businessSummary: Argent Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the mineral exploration of silver, lead, zinc, copper, and gold in Australia. The Company's projects include NSW Kempfield Project, NSW Polymetallic and WA Copperhead Polymetallic. The NSW Polymetallic projects include Mount Dudley Gold, Trunkey Creek Gold, and Pine Ridge Gold. The NSW Kempfield Polymetallic project is located approximately 41 kilometers (km) to the south of Newcrest’s Cadia is Kempfield. The Copperhead Project is located approximately 300 km east-northeast of Carnarvon and 950 km north of Perth in Western Australia. The Mt Dudley Exploration License (EL) 5748 is located approximately five km northwest of the township of Trunkey, near Blayney in New South Wales. The Trunkey Creek Project is located over the township of Trunkey approximately 38 km southwest of Bathurst in New South Wales (NSW). The Pine Ridge Exploration License 8213 is located in the region of the Central Tablelands in NSW.

name: ALTAMIN
businessSummary: Altamin Limited is an Australia-based mineral company focused on base and critical metals exploration and brownfield mine development in Italy. The Company’s Gorno Zinc Project, in the Lombardy region of northern Italy, is at an advanced stage, and presents the opportunity to deliver high-grade, clean zinc and lead concentrates to smelters and offtake customers in Europe. The Company is a 100% owner of the Lazio Geothermal Brine Project in the Lazio region of central Italy in the southern half of Italy’s premier geothermal field. The project area consists of six granted exploration licenses with a geothermal reservoir considered highly prospective for production of geothermal energy, sulfate of potash (SOP fertilizer) and lithium. The Punta Corna Cobalt project in Piedmont, Italy, historically mined for cobalt, nickel, copper and silver, is an active exploration project with outcropping mineralization and a permitted proposed drilling program.

name: ALTAIR MINERALS
businessSummary: Altair Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company with the primary focus of investing in the resource sector through direct tenement acquisition, joint ventures, farm in arrangements and new project generation. Its principal activity is exploration of natural resources, including metals, precious metals, lithium, cobalt and minerals. It has projects located in South Australia, Western Australia and Queensland with a focus on its Olympic Domain tenements located in South Australia. Its project includes Olympic Domain, Wee Macgregor, Pyramid Lake, and Greater Oko. It holds a tenement package Gawler Craton comprising eight exploration licenses covering 831 square kilometers (km2) in the Horse Well (Pernatty B), Pernatty C and Andamooka-Peninsula (Lake Torrens) areas. The Wee Macgregor group comprises three granted mining licenses, located over 60km southeast of Mt Isa, Queensland. Pyramid Lake is the Company’s Gypsum Project located 115km northwest of Esperance in Western Australia.

name: SIREN GOLD
businessSummary: Siren Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold and antimony exploration company with three key projects in the upper South Island of New Zealand: Sams Creek gold project in Upper Takaka, Langdons antimony-gold project near Reefton and the Queen Charlotte antimony-gold project. The Company has seen high-grade gold and stibnite mineralization throughout tenements due to its position on the Lachlan Fold Belt. The Reefton Project is a significant gold exploration and mining venture in the South Island of New Zealand. The Langdons project prospecting permit (PP 60893) is located in the Paparoa goldfield, approximately 50 kilometers (km) SW of Reefton. The Queen Charlotte gold-antimony mineralization that contains the historic Endeavour antimony mine is 120kms to the east of Sams Creek. The Sams Creek Gold Project is located 140kms NE of Reefton and 100kms NE of Lyell. The mineralization is contained within a hydrothermally altered peralkaline granite porphyry dyke.

name: ACTINOGEN MEDICAL
businessSummary: Actinogen Medical Limited is an Australia-based biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in the development of a therapy for neurological and neuropsychiatric diseases associated with dysregulated brain cortisol. The Company is engaged in the development of its lead compound, Xanamem, as a therapy for Alzheimer’s Disease, Major Depressive Disorder, Fragile X Syndrome, and other neurological diseases where reducing cortisol inside brain cells could have a positive impact. Xanamem’s mechanism is to control elevated levels of cortisol (stress hormone) in the brain through the inhibition of the cortisol synthesis enzyme, 11B-HSD1, without affecting production of cortisol by the adrenal glands, which is essential for the body’s normal functioning. Xanamem is a once-a-day pill designed to deliver high levels of cortisol control in key areas of the brain related to Alzheimer’s and other diseases such as the hippocampus and frontal cortex.

name: INFINITY METALS
businessSummary: Infinity Metals Limited, formerly Infinity Lithium Corporation Limited, is an Australia-based minerals company. The Company is principally engaged in the exploration and evaluation of lithium assets and progression of the integrated lithium chemicals conversion plant. The Company, through its subsidiary, Extremadura New Energies, maintains a 75% ownership interest in the San Jose Lithium Project. The Project is located approximately three hours from Madrid, and three and a half hours from Lisbon, accessible by dual-lane highway. The proposed fully integrated industrial project is focused on the production of battery-grade lithium chemicals from a mica feedstock. The Company, through Highland Resources Limited, owns 100% of four granted, advanced high-grade gold exploration assets in the Lachlan Fold Belt, Victoria. The Comstock Gold-Silver Prospect lies two kilometers along strike to the southeast from Forsyth Prospect. Its other projects include Mitta, Goodhope-Union and Bindi.

name: GOLDEN MILE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Golden Mile Resources Limited is an Australia-based project development company and mineral exploration company. The primary focus is on growing the Company with a multi asset and multi commodity strategy through advancement of core projects, acquisition of high-quality assets and tactical alliances with joint venture partners. Its projects include Pearl Copper Project, Quicksilver Nickel-Cobalt Project, Leonora Gold Joint Venture (JV) Project, Gidgee JV Project, Yuinmery Project, Yarrambee Project, Marble Bar Lithium-Gold Project, and Murchison Project. The Pearl Copper Project is situated in the San Manuel mining district, Pinal County, Arizona, over 40 kilometers (km) north-east of Tucson, near the town of Mammoth. The Quicksilver Project, located near the town of Lake Grace, is over 300 km south-east of Perth, Western Australia. The Quicksilver Project is centered over a narrow greenstone belt, the Project is prospective for nickel-cobalt, and gold.

name: LODESTAR MINERALS
businessSummary: Lodestar Minerals Limited is an Australia-based active critical metals, gold and base metal's explorer. The Company’s projects include the Virgin Mountain rare earths (REE) project in the United States, Three Saints Copper & Gold projects in Chile, and the 100% owned Earaheedy and Ned’s Creek Gold projects in Western Australia. The Three Saints Project in Chile lies adjacent to the Darwin Project, within the IOCG (iron oxide, copper, gold) Belts. The Virgin Mountain REE Project is situated on the border of Nevada and Arizona. The Neds Creek is a 100% owned gold project located in the northern Yilgarn region of Western Australia. The Earaheedy Project is defined by an approximately 450 square kilometer (km2) land package in the Earaheedy Basin. Los Loros project is located in the Coastal Cordillera of north-central Chile, around 20 kilometers NE from the city of La Serena at approximately 500m elevation.

name: IONEER
businessSummary: Ioneer Ltd is an Australia-based lithium-boron producer. The Company is principally engaged in the development of the Rhyolite Ridge lithium-boron deposit in the state of Nevada, United States of America. The Company’s Rhyolite Ridge Lithium-Boron Project is located in Esmeralda County, Nevada, situated in the Silver Peak Range, part of the larger geo-physiographic Basin and Range Province of western Nevada. Rhyolite Ridge is approximately 14 miles northeast of Dyer, Nevada. It is 65 miles southwest of Tonopah, Nevada, 215 miles from Reno, and 255 miles from Las Vegas. The Company operates through two segments: North America and Australia.

name: TUNGSTEN MINING NL
businessSummary: Tungsten Mining NL is an Australia-based resources company, which is primarily focused on the discovery and development of tungsten deposits in Australia. The Company's key projects are Mt Mulgine is in the Murchison Region of Western Australia, approximately 350 kilometres (km) north northeast of Perth. The scale of the project, coupled with the strategic importance of tungsten and molybdenum in industrial and defence applications, positions the Mt Mulgine project (Mount Mulgine) as a significant future supplier of critical metals essential for global supply chain security. Watershed Project is located 130km north of Cairns in a mining-friendly jurisdiction. Hatches Creek Project is located 375 km north-east of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory of Australia. The Project consists of two granted exploration licenses' covering 31.4 km2 which cover the entire historic Hatches Creek tungsten mining centre.

name: ION VIDEO
businessSummary: Ion Video Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in video, creating immersive, deeply personalized viewing experiences. The Company’s patented Video Virtualisation Engine (VVE) turns big, bulky video files into lightweight, searchable data that is enriched with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), making it easy and efficient for users to find and share what matters to them. Creators and owners of videos can drive greater viewing and monetization of their video assets.

name: JAVELIN MINERALS
businessSummary: Javelin Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold producer in Western Australia. The Company's projects include Coogee and Eureka. The Coogee Gold Project, located 55 kilometers (km) southeast of Kalgoorlie, provides both gold and copper exposure within Western Australia’s prolific Goldfields. The project is held on a granted Mining Lease, surrounded by five Exploration Leases (E’s) and four Exploration Lease Applications (ELAs), offering substantial growth potential. The Eureka Gold Project is located 50 km north of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia. The project sits on four granted Mining Licenses and has a history of successful gold production, with over 32,000 ounces mined historically. Its Central Yilgarn Project is located immediately southeast of Sandstone, in the center of Western Australia’s Yilgarn Craton, and consists of over 690 square km of tenure and covers over 120 km of strike of the Panhandle, Illaara and Mt Cook/Maynard Hills Greenstone belts.

name: JINDALEE LITHIUM
businessSummary: Jindalee Lithium Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on lithium exploration and development. The Company’s projects include McDermitt Lithium, Sherlock and Clayton North. The Company’s flagship project is the McDermitt Lithium Project in south-east Oregon, United States. The McDermitt Lithium Project is 100% owned and located approximately 35 kilometers (km) west of the town of McDermitt, straddling the Oregon and Nevada border. The McDermitt Lithium Project is a sediment-hosted lithium deposit. The Clayton North project is located approximately 23km north of the only producing lithium operation in the United States at Silver Peak. The project is ideally located in close proximity to the only lithium producing operation in the United States of America. The Sherlock Project comprises one Exploration License (E47/4345) centered approximately 75km east of Karratha in Western Australia.

name: WEEBIT NANO
businessSummary: Weebit Nano Ltd is an Australia-based developer and licensor of advanced semiconductor memory technology. The Company’s Resistive RAM (ReRAM) addresses the growing need for higher performance and lower power non-volatile memory (NVM) solutions in a range of new electronic products, such as Internet of Things (IoT) devices, smartphones, robotics, autonomous vehicles, fifth generation (5G) communications and artificial intelligence. Its ReRAM technology is based on fab-friendly materials and can be easily integrated with existing flows and processes. It is creating ReRAM IP that customers can embed in their system-on-chip (SoC) designs. It is also developing discrete (stand-alone) memory technology, targeting storage class memory, persistent memory and NOR flash replacement. Weebit ReRAM is ideal for applications requiring high temperature and endurance levels, offering a power efficient NVM that is easy to integrate and tolerant to radiation and electromagnetic fields.

name: RAREX
businessSummary: RareX Limited is a critical minerals company specializing in rare earths and niobium in hard rock carbonatites. It is engaged in curating a portfolio of carbonatite related prospects within which the Khaleesi Project represents the exploration flagship. The exploration focus of the business is on the Khaleesi Project in the East Yilgarn which is a district-scale, elevated-niobium, and alkaline intrusive complex. The Company's engineering and commercial focus is on offtake and approvals at the mid-study-level, Cummins Range Project, a carbonatite hosted rare earth and phosphate project, containing magnet grade rare earths and battery grade phosphates and undeveloped rare earths project. The new Khaleesi Project is located along strike from Ponton Dyke, the Cundeelee carbonatite, and the Tropicana Gold mine. The Khaleesi Project is located adjacent to the Mulga Rocks deposits on the transition of the Yilgarn Craton to the Albany-Fraser Belt, specifically in the Northern Foreland Unit.

name: ODYSSEY GOLD
businessSummary: Odyssey Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold explorer. The Company is focused on its high-grade gold projects in the Murchison Goldfields. The Company holds a land position of approximately 169 square kilometers (km2) in the prolific Murchison Goldfields. The Murchison Goldfields is host to a 35 million ounces (Moz) gold endowment. It holds an 80% interest in the Tuckanarra and Stakewell gold projects (Tuckanarra Project). The Tuckanarra Project is located between Meekatharra and Mount Magnet, proximal to multiple gold processing plants, along the Great Northern Highway. The Tuckanarra Project area has open pits, extensive minor gold workings, and prospecting pits principally associated with quartz veins and the mafic and banded iron formations (BIF) units. Its Stakewell Project area is located within the Meekatharra-Wydgee Greenstone belt within the north-eastern Murchison Domain. The Project area covers Archean basement rocks.

name: 4DS MEMORY
businessSummary: 4DS Memory Limited is an Australia-based semiconductor development company. The Company is engaged in the research and development of non-volatile memory technology, pioneering Interface Switching resistive random-access memory (ReRAM), that features tunable persistence and low energy per bit for computing intensive and artificial intelligence (AI) processor applications. This ReRAM switches the memory cell between a high resistive state (HRS) and low resistive state (LRS). This state is then read by the memory circuitry to determine if the cell is programmed to a 1 or 0, in the digital sense. It owns a patented Internet protocol (IP) portfolio, comprising 34 United States patents granted, which has been developed in-house to create high-density storage class memory. The granted patents are 100% owned by the Company.

name: TALGA GROUP
businessSummary: Talga Group Ltd is an Australia-based battery materials and technology company. The Company is engaged in the development of sustainable battery materials via technology and vertical integration of its 100% owned Swedish graphite resources. Its flagship product, Talnode-C, is a natural graphite anode material made using renewable energy for a low emissions footprint. Its battery materials under development include an advanced silicon anode product and conductive additives for cathodes. It is also advancing the commercialization of its silicon anode, Talnode-Si. Its product portfolio also includes recycled graphite anode product, Talnode-R. It owns 100% of multiple mineral assets of graphite, copper, cobalt and iron in northern Sweden. Its projects include the Vittangi Anode Project, Vittangi Graphite Project, Jalkunen Graphite Project, Kiskama Copper-Cobalt Project, Raitajarvi Graphite Project, Masugnsbyn Iron Project, and Other Battery Metals Project.

name: ISLAND PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: Island Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based drug repurposing company. The Company is focused on areas of unmet need for antiviral therapeutics to address infectious diseases. Its lead asset is ISLA-101, a drug with a safety profile being repurposed for the prevention and treatment of dengue fever and other mosquito (or vector) borne diseases. ISLA-101 has been shown to have activity against all four strains of dengue virus as well as other flaviviruses such as Zika virus, West Nile virus, and Yellow Fever virus, as well as Chikungunya virus. While ISLA-101 is an oral formulation, the Company is also considering alternative formulations, including a long-acting oral formulation and intravenous formulations for severe dengue infections. The Company operates a single segment, being research and development activities principally in the geographic regions of Australia and the United States. Its subsidiary is Isla Pharmaceuticals Inc.

name: WILDCAT RESOURCES
businessSummary: Wildcat Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company focused on discovery. Its projects include Tabba Tabba Lithium-Tantalum Project and Bolt Cutter Gold and Lithium Project in the Pilbara region of Western Australia and the Mt Adrah Gold Project in the Lachlan Fold Belt in New South Wales, plus, several early-stage tenements and applications in Western Australia. Tabba Tabba Project is an advanced lithium and tantalum development project located on granted Mining Leases just 80 kilometers (km) by road from Port Hedland, WA. It is near some of the hard-rock lithium mines, situated 47 km by road from Pilbara Minerals’ 414Mt Pilgangoora Project and 87 km by road from Mineral Resources’ 259Mt Wodgina Project. The Mt Adrah Project comprises 493 km2, straddling 52km of strike of the Gilmore Suture Zone. The Bolt Cutter Gold and Lithium Project comprises six granted exploration licenses, and 14 applications covering 913 km2 of the Mallina Basin in WA’s Pilbara region.

name: RAPID CRITICAL METALS
businessSummary: Rapid Critical Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company, focused on advancing high-grade silver and gallium projects in New South Wales, Australia and British Columbia, Canada. The Company's projects include Webbs and Conrads Silver Projects, and Prophet River Project. The Webbs and Conrads Silver Projects are high-grade silver-polymetallic deposits located in the New England Fold Belt of northern New South Wales, a proven mineral district with established infrastructure and a history of mining. The Prophet River Project is a high-grade zinc, gallium, and germanium asset covering approximately 2,110 hectares in British Columbia, Canada. Located near the historic Cay Mine, the project has demonstrated some of the highest recorded germanium values globally, alongside significant gallium grades. The Prophet River Project sits within a one kilometer plus mineralized system defined by soil anomalies and remains open in both directions.

name: FORRESTANIA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Forrestania Resources Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration and development company, which is focused on building Western Australian gold business. The Company's projects include Forrestania, Westonia, Southern Cross, Bonnie Vale, Eastern Goldfields, Edna May Gold Project, Karonie Gold Project, Lake Rebecca Project, British Hill Project, Mt Dimer, Hyden Gold Project, Coolgardie and Menzies, among others. The Westonia gold project is located at Westonia in the Southern Cross region, Western Australia. The Southern Cross tenements gold project is located in and around the Golden Horse tenements, immediately adjacent to Hopes Hill and consists of around five tenements. The Bonnie Vale region is located in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields, strategic to approximately 90 square kilometers holding five kilometers (km) from the operating EVN Mungari Gold Project. The Eastern Goldfields is located over 17 km east of Menzies, within the Eastern Goldfields Super Terrane.

name: FALCON METALS
businessSummary: Falcon Metals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company's projects include Blue Moon Gold Project, Pyramid Hill Gold Project, Farrelly Mineral Sands Project, Victorian Mineral Sands Project and Errabiddy Gold Project. The Blue Moon Gold Project is on the 100%-owned license EL007839 and is the exploration ground surrounding the Bendigo mining permit. The Blue Moon Gold Project is located approximately 25 kilometers (km) west of the Fosterville Gold Mine in the Swan Zone. The Errabiddy Gold Project is a craton margin gold target, located approximately 220km north-west of Meekatharra in Western Australia. The 100%-owned Pyramid Hill Gold Project covers an area of approximately 6,000 square kilometers, in the prolific Bendigo Zone of Victoria, north of the high-grade historic Bendigo Goldfield. The 100%-owned Farrelly Mineral Sands Project is located approximately 80km north-west of Bendigo, near the town of Boort in Victoria.

name: TESORO GOLD
businessSummary: Tesoro Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on the acquisition, exploration and development of commercially significant resource projects in Chile, with a focus on gold. It is focused on the exploration and development of the El Zorro Gold Project in the Coastal Cordillera region of Chile. The Ternera Gold Deposit is situated within the El Zorro Gold Project, located 900km north of Santigo in Chile’s Atacama Region. The Ternera Gold Deposit occurs within the El Zorro Gold Project, which covers a total concession holding area of approximately 570 square kilometers, located 130 kilometers (km) north of Copiapo City, in Region III (Atacama) in northern Chile. The Ternera Deposit is over 13 km inland from the Pacific Ocean, 57 km by road from the port town of Caldera. Its subsidiaries include Tesoro Mining Chile SPA, El Zorro S.C.M, Tesoro Australia Pty Ltd, among others.

name: INOVIQ
businessSummary: INOVIQ Ltd is an Australia-based biotechnology company developing diagnostics and therapeutics for cancer. The Company's commercialized products include EXO-NET exosome isolation technology for biomarker discovery and diagnostics development, and the hTERT test as an adjunct test for bladder cancer. The Company is also advancing clinical-stage diagnostics for the detection and monitoring of ovarian and breast cancers, and early-stage exosome therapeutics for solid tumors.

name: PILBARA GOLD
businessSummary: Pilbara Gold Limited, formerly Kairos Minerals Limited, is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on advancing its 100%-owned flagship 1.4 Moz Mt York Gold Project, which is an advanced gold deposit located over 100 kilometers (km) south of Port Hedland in Tier one gold country. The Company's Roe Hills Project situated 100km east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia covers over 353 square kilometers (km2) of prospective Archean granite-greenstone geology that has known mineralization of gold, nickel, rare earth elements (REEs) and lithium. It has also discovered significant high-grade REE mineralization at Black Cat within enriched lower saprolite clays overlying fertile REE-bearing syenite intrusions. Its additional exploration projects in the Pilbara include: Wodgina, Lalla Rookh, and Kangan. It holds approximately 1,200km2 of granted licenses across greenstone belt geology with limited historical exploration, offering significant discovery potential.

name: VIRIDIS MINING AND MINERALS
businessSummary: Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration and development company with assets in Brazil, Canada and Australia. The Company’s projects comprises, the Colossus Project, which the Company considers to be prospective for Rare Earth Elements; the South Kitikmeot Project and the Boddington West Project, which are prospective for gold; The Bindoon Project, which the Company considers to be prospective for nickel, copper and platinum group elements, and the Poochera and Smoky Projects, which the Company considers to be prospective for kaolin-halloysite. The Colossus IAC REE Project is located in the State of Minas Gerais, Brazil and comprises a total of over 228.62km2 licenses within and around the prolific Pocos De Caldas Alkaline Complex. The South Kitikmeot Gold Project consists of seven properties (Hiqiniq, Ujaraq, Gold Bug, Esker, Bling, Uist and Qannituq) covering over 11,448 hectares within the Back River of Western Nunavut, Canada.

name: KAZIA THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Kazia Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based pharmaceutical drug development company. The Company operates in the pharmaceutical research and development business. The Company’s lead program is paxalisib, an investigational brain-penetrant inhibitor of the PI3K / Akt / mTOR pathway, which is being developed to treat multiple forms of brain cancer. It is also developing EVT801, a small-molecule inhibitor of VEGFR3, which is critical to the development of new blood vessels and lymphatic vessels in a growing tumor, as well as to the metastasis of tumors to distant sites in the body. It designed paxalisib to inhibit PI3K, a critical control mechanism in growth and cell division, which is activated in many forms of cancer. The Company’s drug candidates are designed to treat diseases, such as brain cancer, renal cancer, and liver cancer.

name: ALTERITY THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Alterity Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is focused on developing disease modifying treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. The Company's lead asset, ATH434, is to treat various Parkinsonian disorders. ATH434 is an oral agent designed to inhibit the aggregation of pathological proteins implicated in neurodegeneration. It has the potential to treat Parkinson's disease, as well as various Parkinsonian disorders, such as Multiple System Atrophy (MSA). The Company also has a drug discovery platform generating patentable chemical compounds to intercede in disease processes. Its lead asset, ATH434, is in a randomized, double blind, placebo-controlled Phase II clinical trial in participants with MSA. The Company is also conducting various nonclinical studies with ATH434 for use in Parkinson’s disease based on imaging of brain iron, preservation of neurons, and improvements in motor performance.

name: PEPPER MONEY
businessSummary: Pepper Money Limited is an Australia-based non-banking lender. The Company's segments include Mortgages, Asset Finance, and Loan and Other Servicing. The Mortgages segment includes both residential mortgages and commercial real estate and includes the revenues and direct expenses associated with the origination of residential mortgages in Australia and New Zealand and with the origination of small balance commercial real estate and self managed super fund (SMSF) loans in Australia, and its lending comprises residential prime and non-conforming mortgages. The Asset Finance segment is engaged in the ownership of loans secured over a range of assets, including new and used cars, caravans, small commercial equipment and novated leasing in Australia. The Loan and Other Servicing segment includes the servicing of loan portfolios for third parties conducted by the Company in Australia.

name: LCL RESOURCES
businessSummary: LCL Resources Limited is an Australia-based is an exploration and mining company. The Company holds approximately 3890 square kilometers (km2) of exploration titles in five regions of Papua New Guinea prospective for copper, gold and nickel. Its Ono project is prospective for high grade gold skarn and copper/gold porphyry and sits on the same structure as Hidden Valley gold mine and the Wafi-Golpu copper/gold project. It also owns Liamu Project, which hosts the Dada copper‑gold porphyry prospect. Its Auya Project is located within the Bismark Intrusive Complex, six km along strike from Yandera Cu-Mo porphyry.

name: ASARA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Asara Resources Limited is an exploration company with a portfolio of advanced minerals projects in Guinea, West Africa and in Chile, South America. Its projects consist of Kada, Paguanta, and Loreto. The Company’s flagship project is the advanced Kada Gold Project in eastern Guinea. The Kada Gold Project comprises two exploration permits, Kada and Bamfele, and covers an area of about 200 square kilometers (km2) in eastern Guinea. The project is located in the central Siguiri Basin and lies 36 kilometers (km) along the strike from the 10 million ounces (Moz) Siguiri Gold Mine operated by AngloGold Ashanti. The Paguanta Copper and Silver-Lead-Zinc Project lies on the northern extension of Chile’s West Fissure - a concentration of major porphyry copper-molybdenum deposits. The Loreto Copper Project is located in Northern Chile, South America.

name: ALGORAE PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: Algorae Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based artificial-intelligence (AI) enabled pharmaceutical development company. The Company’s proprietary AI platform, Algorae Operating System (AlgoraeOS), is an AI platform that leverages extensive medical and scientific databases from various disciplines within an advanced system at the intersection of AI and pharmaceutical research. Its other drug candidates include AI-116, AI-168, NTCELL. AI-116 is a combination drug candidate made up of cannabidiol (CBD) and an off-patent pharmaceutical ingredient. It is conceptualized to be a potential treatment for dementia, including Alzheimer’s disease. AI-168 is a novel combination drug candidate made up of a cannabinoid and an off-patent pharmaceutical ingredient, which is conceptualized to be a potential treatment for cardiovascular disease, including hypertension. NTCELL is an alginate coated capsule containing clusters of neonatal porcine choroid plexus cells.

name: MAGNUM MINING AND EXPLORATION
businessSummary: Magnum Mining and Exploration Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on Buena Vista Magnetite and HIsmelt Green Pig Iron Project, located in Nevada in the United States. The Company is also developing the Appalachian Iron HIsmelt Green Pig Iron Project located in West Virginia, United States. It owns 100% interest in Monomatapa Mining Services Inc, which holds the Parker and Mormon Canyon Projects. The project assets include two packages of prospective copper-gold properties situated in Arizona and Idaho, United States. The Company owns 100% interest in EV Resources Inc, which holds the La Cienega Gold Project situated in Arizona, United States. It owns 100% interest in Palmares Estudos Geologicos LTDA, which owns a major portfolio of Rare Earth Element (REE) prospective mineral exploration licenses. Its Azimuth 125 and Palmares REE Projects are located across the states of Bahia, Minas Gerais and Goias states in south-central Brazil. Both projects cover 1,549 km2.

name: ALPHA HPA
businessSummary: Alpha HPA Limited is an Australia-based specialty materials and technology company, focused on the delivery and operation of the HPA First and Alpha Sapphire Projects in Queensland. The Company specializes in producing ultra-high purity alumina (HPA) and related premium aluminum materials through its solvent extraction (SX) and refining technology. Its projects represent the commercialization of its aluminum purification and refining technology and the production of critical high purity aluminum materials for a range of growing high technology sectors, including semiconductors; lithium-ion batteries; direct lithium extraction; synthetic sapphire glass for sapphire optics, power-semiconductors, micro-LED technology, and technical ceramics and specialty catalysts. Its products include Ultra AAP, Ultra GAP, Ultra GAP-X, Ultra TAB, Ultra NAP, Ultra HPB, Ultra ALN, ALN_ACS, Ultra ATH, and Ultra SAPPHIRE. HPA First Project Stage 1 produces its full range of high purity aluminum materials.

name: BLUE ENERGY
businessSummary: Blue Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration, evaluation and development of conventional and unconventional oil and gas resources. Its geographical segment is Australia, which includes Queensland and the Northern Territory. The Company’s projects include Bowen Basin (ATP 814P), Surat Basin (ATP 854P) and Greater McArthur Basin (EP199A, EP200, EP205A, EP206, EP207, EP208A, EP209A, EP210A, EP211A). ATP814P consists of six disconnected blocks in the North Bowen Basin in an area ranging from south of Moranbah up to Newlands in the Northern Bowen Basin. The Sapphire Pilot is situated within the PL 1034 production license application area, (part of ATP 814). ATP854P is located near the township of Injune in central Queensland and the Wallumbilla - Gladstone gas pipeline passes through the eastern portion of the permit. The gas resource is located near the heart of the CSG-LNG Surat Basin gas supply precinct.

name: CELSIUS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Celsius Resources Limited is an Australia-based multi-asset copper and gold resources company. The Company is engaged in mineral exploration and mineral project development in the Philippines. Its projects include Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog Copper-Gold Project, Botilao Copper-Gold Prospect, Opuwo Cobalt Project and Sagay Copper-Gold Project. Its Maalinao-Caigutan-Biyog copper-gold project is located in the Philippines, approximately 320 kilometers (km) north of Manila. The Sagay Project is owned by its Philippine subsidiary, Tambuli Mining Company, Inc., and is located in the center of the Philippines archipelago in the northern part of Negros Island. The Botilao Porphyry Copper-Gold Prospect is held by Makilala Mining Company, Inc., which is located in the Cordillera Administrative Region, approximately 320 km north of Manila. The Opuwo Cobalt Project lies approximately 730 km north-west of the Namibian capital city, Windhoek.

name: ANTEOTECH
businessSummary: AnteoTech Ltd is an Australia-based supplier of advanced material solutions to the battery materials and life sciences markets. Its products and technologies include Anteo X, Ultranode, AnteoBind and AnteoBind NXT. Anteo X is a water-based, binder-compatible cross linker designed to improve the mechanical stability and performance of high silicon anodes in lithium-ion batteries. Anteo X enhances cohesion between active materials, binders, and conductive agents, enabling higher silicon loadings, greater energy density, and improved cycle life. Ultranode is its proprietary high silicon anode formulation technology, developed to boost energy density in lithium-ion batteries. AnteoBind is a patented surface chemistry platform that simplifies and enhances the immobilization (bioconjugation) of biomolecules on a variety of substrates. AnteoBind NXT builds on the core AnteoBind technology, delivering improved binding efficiency, and reducing reagent usage.

name: MANY PEAKS MINERALS
businessSummary: Many Peaks Minerals Limited is an Australia-based gold and copper focused exploration company. The Company’s projects include Ferke Gold Project, Odienne Gold Project, Oume Gold Project, Baga Gold Project and Aska Lithium Project. The Ferke Gold Project is located in northern Cote d’Ivoire covering 300 square kilometers (km2) in a granted exploration permit license. The Odienne Project is located in northwest Cote D’Ivoire and comprises two granted exploration permits covering a combined area of 758 km2. The Baga Gold Project is a 644 km2 land holding comprised of two recently granted exploration permits located 150 kilometers (km) east of the city of Bouake, Cote d’Ivoire and situated 80 km west of the border with Ghana. The Oume Gold Project is located in south-central Cote D’Ivoire. The Aska Lithium Project is located proximal to Newfoundland’s southwest coast over 45 km east of Cape Ray.

name: MARONAN METALS
businessSummary: Maronan Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is engaged in exploration for and evaluation of its silver-lead and copper-gold mineral deposits. It holds a 100% interest in the Maronan project. The Maronan lead-silver and copper-gold deposit is a base metal deposit in the Carpentaria Province, which hosts multiple Tier 1 lead-zinc-silver mines including Mount Isa, George Fisher, Century, Cannington, Dugald River and copper deposits, including Mount Isa, Ernest Henry, Osborne, and Eloise. Maronan, located just 65 kilometres south of Cloncurry and 90 kilometres north of the giant Cannington mine.

name: MARQUEE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Marquee Resources Limited is an Australia-based critical metals explorer. The Company’s projects include Mount Clement antimony, gold, lead, copper and silver Project, Rare Earth Elements (REE) Project, West Spargoville Project, Lone Star Copper-Gold Project, Clayton Valley Lithium Project, Kibby Basin Lithium Project, Sa Pedra Bianca Gold and Silver Project, and Yindi Gold and Lithium Project. Its 100% owned Mount Clement antimony, gold, lead, copper and silver Project is located 30 kilometers (km) southwest of Black Cat Syndicate’s Paulsens gold mine, at the western end of the Ashburton Basin in the northern Capricorn Orogen. The Yindi Gold and Lithium Project is situated within over 106 square kilometers of highly prospective gold tenure and is strategically positioned over the greenstone belt and the structurally significant Yilgani Fault, a gold-bearing corridor. The 100% owned Redlings REE project is located over 40 km west of Leonora, and 77 km north of Menzies.

name: RESOLUTION MINERALS
businessSummary: Resolution Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of precious and battery metals, such as antimony, gold, copper, and uranium. Its Horse Heaven Antimony-Gold-Tungsten Project is well-situated in Valley County, Idaho United States. The Horse Heaven Project comprises 699 federal lode mining claims covering over 5,644 hectares. Its George Project covers a large area prospective for roll-front style uranium (2,839km2) in central South Australia. The Company’s Drake East Project hosts fourteen known antimony occurrences, including the well-documented Mosquito Creek Antimony-Gold Reef and Ball & Smiths Lode. These antimony occurrences cover a large area with a NW-SE strike length of over 15 kilometers (km). Its Neardie Project hosts three past producing antimony mines. Its Spur South Gold-Copper Project is located within the highly mineralized Macquarie Arc region in NSW.

name: MARVEL GOLD
businessSummary: Marvel Gold Ltd is a resource company. The Company is a gold explorer with advanced exploration projects and substantial landholdings in the country’s key gold-bearing regions. Its projects include Hanang Gold Project, Yanfolila Gold Project, and Kolondieba Gold Project. The Hanang Gold Project is a regional gold project, located within a highly prospective, underexplored greenstone belt on the Eastern Margin of the +70Moz gold endowed Lake Victoria Gold Field. The Yanfolila Project is in southern Mali, 45 kilometers north of Endeavour Mining’s Kalana gold project and 35 km east of the hummingbird resources Yanfolila gold mine. The 200 square kilometer Kolondieba Project is prospective for gold mineralization in a similar structural setting to the Morila mine and the Tabakorole deposit. Kolondieba Project is located 70 km north-west of Resolute Mining’s Syama gold mine and 50km south of Barrick Gold’s Morila gold mine.

name: PDI GOLD
businessSummary: PDI Gold Limited, formerly Predictive Discovery Limited, is an Australia-based gold production and development company. The Company's segments include Kiniero, Nampala, Bankan, Other Exploration, and Corporate. The Kiniero segment is engaged in gold mining operations at the Kiniero gold mine in the Republic of Guinea. The Nampala segment is engaged in gold mining operations at the Nampala Gold Mine in the Republic of Mali. The Bankan segment includes all support operations for mining property exploration and evaluation for the Bankan Gold Project in the Republic of Guinea. The Other Exploration segment includes all support operations for mining property exploration and evaluation in Mali. The Nampala operation mined approximately 1.11 million tonnes (Mt) of ore and 4.12 Mt of waste and milled 1.0 Mt of ore at an average head grade of 0.71 grams per ton (g/t) Au and recovery of over 86.4%.

name: KUNIKO
businessSummary: Kuniko Limited is an Australia-based company, focused on the development of copper, nickel, cobalt and lithium projects in Scandinavia. Its key assets are located in Norway, which include Ertelien Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Project,Ringerike Battery Metals Project, Skuterud Cobalt Project, Undal-Nyberget Copper Project, Vaga Copper Project and Gullvag Copper-Zinc Project. Its Sweden projects include Vane Ryr Pegmatite Project and Stora Flaten Greisen Project. The Ringerike Project covers over 405 square kilometers (km2) of exploration licenses in southern Norway, located 40 kilometers (kms) northwest of Oslo. Its Ertelien Project has over 10 km2 exclusive exploration license area. The Skuterud Cobalt Project has around 90 sq kms exclusive license area. The Undal-Nyberget Copper Project is located in the prolific Roros Copper region. The Vane Ryr Pegmatite Project is considered a potential site for LCT pegmatite-hosted mineralization.

name: 4DMEDICAL
businessSummary: 4DMedical Limited is a medical technology company that creates and deploys software-based cardiothoracic imaging technology integrating both algorithms and artificial intelligence. The Company's software platform delivers quantitative insights from routine clinical imaging to help clinicians assess lung function and cardiopulmonary disease. It provides thoracic imaging that enhances physician diagnoses and management of respiratory conditions. Its products include CT:VQ-Non-Contrast Ventilation-Perfusion, CAC-Coronary Artery Calcification, CT LVAS-Lung Ventilation Analysis, IQ-UIP-Early IPF Detection, LDAf-Functional Lung Density Analysis, LDAi-Lung Density Analysis – Inspiration, LTA-Lung Texture Analysis, PHA-Pulmonary Hypertension Assessment, XV LVAS-Lung Ventilation Analysis, and Companion Imaging. The CT:VQ is a non-contrast post-processing technology that transforms routine, chest computed tomographies (CTs) into quantitative, lobar ventilation (V) and perfusion (Q) maps.

name: MINBOS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Minbos Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company. The Company is engaged in the nutrient supply and distribution business. The Company is focused on the development of a primary phosphate and nitrogen-based fertilizer business that stimulates agricultural production and promotes food security in Angola and the broader Congo Basin. It is primarily focused on the development of the Cabinda Phosphate Project and the Capanda Green Ammonia Project. Its phosphate fertilizer brand is Prosper Primeiro. The Capanda Green Ammonia Project produces nitrogen for the Primeiro+ products. It also provides education to commercial and family farmers through extension services.

name: CODA MINERALS
businessSummary: Coda Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based exploration company focused on the exploration, discovery and development of minerals in the base metals, precious metals and battery minerals sector. The Company’s projects include the Elizabeth Creek Copper Cobalt Project, Cameron River Copper Gold Project, Kinloch (Boss Energy JV), and Booleroo. It owns a 100% interest in the Elizabeth Creek Copper Cobalt Project, which is centered over 30 kilometers (km) south-east of Woomera and 135 km north-west of Port Augusta in South Australia. It covers over 701 square kilometers (km2) in the Olympic Dam Copper Province. The Cameron River Copper Gold Project is located approximately 60 km east of Mt Isa in Queensland. The project consists of over two exploration permits (EPM 27042 and EPM 27053) and covers over 35 km2 in the highly prospective MT Isa Inlier. The Kinloch Project is located in eastern South Australia, is a collection of four tenements held in association with Boss Energy.

name: WIN METALS
businessSummary: Win Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company holding 350 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenure in the Southern Goldfields and Kimberley regions of Western Australia. The Company possesses gold, nickel, and lithium resources within its tenure. Its Mt Edwards Nickel and Faraday-Trainline Lithium Projects are situated near Widgiemooltha, approximately 80 kilometer (km) south of the regional center of Kalgoorlie-Boulder and 30 km south of Kambalda. The Mt Edwards Nickel Project is a collection of eleven nickel deposits. The Faraday-Trainline Lithium Project is shovel-ready with an approved small mining proposal. The Butchers Creek Gold Project is located 30 km southeast of Halls Creek in the Kimberley region of Western Australia. The Company also owns the Radio Gold Mine, which is located 8 km north of Bullfinch, approximately 40 km northwest of Southern Cross and about 400 km east of Perth in the Yilgarn region of Western Australia.

name: WIDE OPEN AGRICULTURE
businessSummary: Wide Open Agriculture Ltd is an Australia-based ingredient company focusing on the next generation of plant protein ingredients for food and drink manufacturers globally. The Company focused on commercializing its lupin protein isolate products, along with research and product development activities. The Company’s flagship product, Buntine Protein, is a novel plant-based protein derived from lupins. Manufactured under a globally protected patent, Buntine Protein is a versatile ingredient that creates products across multiple categories, including plant-based dairy, meats, baked goods, and health foods. Its subsidiaries include Wide Open Land Pty Ltd, Wide Open Plant Protein Pty Ltd, and Wide Open Agriculture Germany GmbH.

name: WEST WITS MINING
businessSummary: West Wits Mining Limited is an Australia-based company focused on the exploration, development, and production of precious and base metals. The Company’s projects include Witwatersrand Basin project (WBP) and Mt Cecelia project. The Witwatersrand Basin project is located in the gold region of Central Rand Goldfield of South Africa boasts, an approximately 5.025 million ounces (Moz) gold project. The Witwatersrand Basin is a largely underground geological formation which surfaces in the Witwatersrand. In Western Australia, the Company is exploring gold and copper at the Mt Cecilia Project in a district that supports several world-class projects such as Woodie Woodie manganese mine, Nifty copper and Telfer gold/copper/silver mines. The Mt Cecelia project is located on the border of the East Pilbara and Paterson Provinces of Western Australia and covers approximately 225 square kilometers (km2) of prospective ground, strategically located adjacent to tenements held by Rio Tinto Ltd.

name: VITAL METALS
businessSummary: Vital Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is primarily focused on developing and exploring the Nechalacho Rare Earth and Niobium Project in Northwest Territories, Canada. The Nechalacho Project is located in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories (NWT), Canada. The Company is advancing the Tardiff deposit at its Nechalacho project in NWT, Canada. Tardiff is a large-scale deposit, representing one of the single rare earth systems in the Western world. Its subsidiaries include Nechalacho Resources Corp, Cheetah Resources Pty Ltd, and NWT Rare Earths Ltd.

name: FRONTIER ENERGY
businessSummary: Frontier Energy Limited is an Australia-based renewable energy company. The Company is developing the Waroona Renewable Energy Project, which is located strategically in the heart of the South-West of Western Australia. The Project is approximately 120 kilometers (km) south of the Perth, eight kilometers southwest of the Waroona townsite and five kilometers east of Forrest Highway, the traffic route linking Perth and Bunbury. The nearby 330kV Landwehr Electricity Terminal will allow the Company to sell electricity via the Southwest Interconnected System. The Company holds 830 hectares (ha) of freehold land located within 0.5 km of the Landwehr Terminal, a major connection point to WA’s electricity network, located on high voltage (330kV) transmission lines in the least constrained portion of the network.

name: TURACO GOLD
businessSummary: Turaco Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration company, which is engaged in developing the Afema Gold Project in southern Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Afema Project is located in south-east Cote d'Ivoire near the Ghanian border and approximately 120 kilometers (km) east of Abidjan and is serviced by a new bituminized major highway connecting Abidjan to Ghana. Its mining permit covers an area of approximately 227 square kilometers (km2). The Afema Project covers a total granted area of approximately 1,040km2, comprising the central mining permit and three contiguous exploration permits. It also holds an exploration permit application covering approximately 228km2 and an option over an additional application area of 366km2, bringing the total Afema Project tenure to more than 1,600km2.

name: NAGAMBIE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Nagambie Resources Limited is an Australia-based natural resources exploration company. The Company is engaged in exploration for, and development of, gold, associated minerals including antimony, and construction materials in Australia, and the investigation and development of waste handling assets. It is focused targeting epizonal-style, high-grade antimony and gold mineralization of contiguous tenement holding in the Waranga Domain of the Melbourne Structural Zone in northern central Victoria, Australia. Its flagship project is the Nagambie Antimony-Gold Project, which sits in proximity to the gold-antimony mines at Fosterville (Agnico Eagle) and Costerfield (Mandalay Resources). It also holds interest in Whroo Goldfields Project, Nagambie Joint Venture, and Nagambie Resources tenements. Its Whroo Goldfields Project is located approximately 130 kilometers north of Melbourne and is comprised of seven tenements that are highly prospective for epizonal gold-antimony mineralization.

name: TERRA METALS
businessSummary: Terra Metals Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is advancing its 100%-owned Dante polymetallic project (Dante Project), located in Western Australia, targeting a unique, multi-commodity system rich in platinum, palladium, copper, gold, titanium and vanadium. The Dante Project is located in the West Musgrave region of Western Australia and contains magmatic copper (Cu), gold (Au), platinum group metals (PGMs), titanium (Ti) and vanadium (V) discoveries in the same geological complex and in close proximity to one of the mining development projects, BHP’s Nebo-Babel deposit. Its Giles Complex is hosted within the broader Musgrave block in central Australia which is located at the junction of three major crustal elements: the West Australian, North Australian, and South Australian cratons. The Onslow silver-copper-gold (Ag-Cu-Au) project (Onslow Project) covers over 303 square kilometers and comprises over two tenements considered prospective for silver, gold and copper.

name: TASMAN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Tasman Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company, focusing on exploration projects with potential to host mineral deposits in a wide range of precious and base metals including gold, silver, copper, zinc, lead, nickel, and uranium. The Company is a diversified, multi-commodity explorer with projects covering tenement holdings in South Australia. Its Lake Torrens Iron oxide-copper-gold (IOCG) Project tenement holding (Exploration license 6416, over 1,079 square kilometers) adjoining BHP Billiton’s world class Olympic Dam deposit in central South Australia. The Lake Torrens IOCG Project hosts the Vulcan and Titan IOCG prospects located approximately 30 kilometers (km) north of BHP’s Olympic Dam mine in South Australia. The Parkinson Dam Epithermal Gold-Silver (Lead-Zinc) Project is located over 60 km west of Port Augusta in South Australia. The Company also has investments in Conico Ltd and Eden Innovations Ltd.

name: BCI MINERALS
businessSummary: BCI Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral resources company which is operating an industrial minerals business, with salt and potash as its initial focus. The Company is developing its 100 percent owned Mardie Salt Operation and Potash Project, a Tier One operation located on the Pilbara coast in the center of Western Australia's key salt production region. The Mardie Salt and Potash Project (Mardie) is 100% owned by Mardie Minerals Pty Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. Mardie represents sustainable opportunity to develop a large-scale, multi-generational solar evaporation operation on the Pilbara coast of Western Australia. Mardie has been designed to produce 5.35 Mtpa of high-purity salt and 140 ktpa of Sulphate of Potash. Its other assets include substantial shareholdings in Agrimin Limited and Highfield Resources Ltd, potential royalties and/or deferred payments from iron ore projects at Koodaideri South, Bungaroo South, Kumina, Nullagine and Extension.

name: SUN SILVER
businessSummary: Sun Silver Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in exploration and evaluation of silver resources in the Elko County & White Pine County region of Nevada, United States of America. Its Maverick Springs Silver-Gold Project is located 85 kilometers (km) from the fully serviced mining town of Elko in Nevada, United States of America, and is surrounded by several gold and silver mining operations including Barrick’s Carlin Mine. The Project, which is proximal to the prolific Carlin Trend, hosts a joint ore reserves committee inferred mineral resources of 237 million tons (Mt) grading 45.5 grams per ton (g/t) silver (Ag) and 0.30 g/t gold (Au) for 347.2 million ounces (Moz) of contained silver and 2.25 Moz of contained gold. Its mineralization is hosted within carbonate rocks, such as limestone or dolomite, and associated with minerals like pyrite, arsenopyrite, and other sulfides.

name: SULTAN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Sultan Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company has a portfolio of mineral exploration projects in Australia that are prospective for gold, copper, nickel and cobalt. Its projects include Lachlan Fold Belt, East Tallering Gold, Dalwallinu Gold, Thadunu Gold/Copper/Minerals, and Lake Grace Nickel/Cobalt/Gold. The Lachlan Fold Belt projects comprise granted exploration licenses, EL8734, EL8704 and EL8735, which together cover a total area of approximately 330 square kilometers (km2). The East Tallering project is prospective for gold mineralization and comprises one granted tenement covering approximately 67 km2. The project is 450 kilometers (km) northeast of Perth and 180 km northeast of Geraldton, Western Australia (WA). The Dalwallinu Gold project has the potential for the discovery of high-grade gold deposits, which comprise tenements covering approximately 167 km2. The project is approximately 250 km northeast of Perth, WA.

name: SKY METALS
businessSummary: Sky Metals Limited is focused on the exploration and development of mineral resources in Australia. The Company’s project portfolio offers exposure to tin, gold, copper, and other critical metals projects in the mining jurisdiction of New South Wales. Its tin projects include Tallebung Tin Project, Doradilla Project and Narriah Project. Its gold projects include Cullarin Project, Caledonian Project, and Kangiara project. Its gold-copper projects include the Iron Duke Project and Galwadgere project. Its 100% owned flagship project is Tallebung project is located over 70 kilometers (km) north-west of Condobolin in central-western New South Wales. The Doradilla Project is located approximately 45 km south-east of Bourke in western New South Wales and is considered prospective for polymetallic tin, copper, silver, bismuth, indium and zinc mineralization. The Narriah Project (EL9524) is located approximately 10 km south-southeast of Rankin Springs in southwest New South Wales.

name: RESOURCE MINERALS INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Resource Minerals International Ltd, formerly Resource Mining Corporation Limited, is an Australia-based company. In Tanzania, it has two exploration projects targeting Copper-Gold and six projects focused on nickel occurrences in sulphides within known and prolific mafic and ultramafic intrusions. In Finland, it has two projects, focusing on the exploration of lithium. Tanzanian Projects include Mpanda and Mbozi, Kabanga North Nickel, Kapalagulu, Kabulwanyele and Southern Projects (Liparamba, Kitai, Mbinga). Its Finnish Projects include Kola Lithium Project (Koyhajoki and Pikkukallio exploration permits) and Hirvikallio Lithium Project (Laitiainen permit application). The Mpanda and Mbozi projects are located within the Ubendian Orogenic Belt, a source of Ni, Cu and Au resources within Tanzania. Kabulwanyele Project is in the Mpanda District of Tanzania, covering over 20.5 square kilometers. The Kabanga North Nickel Project is situated along strike from the Kabanga Nickel Project.

name: REEDY LAGOON
businessSummary: Reedy Lagoon Corporation Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company has exploration projects for gold and magnetite. The Company’s focus is on its Burracoppin Gold project and obtaining a joint venture partner for the Burracoppin Iron project. Burracoppin Gold project is located 60 kilometers north of the Tampia gold mine and 30 kilometers southwest of the Edna May gold mine. The Burracoppin Gold project comprises the Lady Janet, Windmills, Shear Luck and Zebra prospects. The Lady Janet Prospect is located over a section of the Yandina Shear Zone. The Windmills prospect is located about 1.5 kilometers east from the mapped location of the Yandina Shear Zone. The Shear Luck prospect is located in the Northeast trending Yandina Shear Zone. The Zebra prospect is located about four kilometers east from the mapped location of the Yandina Shear Zone.

name: RED METAL
businessSummary: Red Metal Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The principal activities of the Company are acquisition and exploration of mineral prospects in Australia. The Company's projects include Pulkarrimarra Project Copper-Cobalt & Gold-Copper, Gulf copper-gold project and Lawn Hill Project. Its funded projects include Gidyea copper-gold project, Corkwood Copper-Gold project, Three Ways Project, Pardoo Nickel-Copper and Gold project, Punt Hill and Pernatty Lagoon Copper-Gold project, Nullarbor Project, and Callabonna Copper-Gold project. The Company's other projects are located in the regions, including Queensland, Western Australia and Northern Territory. The Corkwood project is situated about 100 kilometers northwest of Glencore’s Ernest Henry copper-gold mine and about 60 kilometers north of the Little Eva copper-gold deposit.

name: RAGUSA MINERALS
businessSummary: Ragusa Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds interests in Burracoppin REE & Halloysite Project in Western Australia. The Burracoppin REE & Kaolin/Halloysite Project comprises granted exploration license E70/5708, located approximately 300 kilometers east of Perth in Western Australia, and is prospective for REE, halloysite and kaolinite. The Project is located near Merredin, with port access easily accessible via the Great Eastern Highway. The Company is also reviewing new projects across various commodities and jurisdictions.

name: PROSPECT RESOURCES
businessSummary: Prospect Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the exploration and development of electrification and battery metals mining projects in the broader sub-Saharan African region. The Company’s projects include Omaruru Lithium Project, Step Aside Lithium Project and Mumbezhi Copper Project. The Mumbezhi Copper Project is situated in the world-class Central African Copperbelt region of north-western Zambia. It is located on two fully permitted Large Scale Mining Licenses (39445-HQ-LML; 39465-HQ-LML), covering an area of approximately 356 square kilometers. The area is prospective for large tonnage, low to medium grade copper deposits. The Omaruru Lithium Project, comprising the EPL 5533 tenement, is centered on the village of Wilhelmstal, east of Karibib in Namibia and covers approximately 132 square kilometers. The Step Aside Lithium Project is located approximately 35km from Harare and approximately 8 kilometers north of the Arcadia Lithium Mine Project.

name: PLENTI GROUP
businessSummary: Plenti Group Limited is an Australia-based fintech lending and investment company, which provides loans through leveraging its technology. The Company provides automotive, renewable energy and personal loans, and is focused on borrowers with a strong credit profile. Additionally, it seeks to provide retail investors with returns by investing in loans via its lending marketplace. The Company's activities include the facilitation of investment opportunities for investors (through the Plenti Lending Platform and Plenti Wholesale Lending Platform) and the funding of loans via the Company’s warehouse and asset backed securities (ABS) programs. The Company's loan types include personal loans, car loans, debt consolidation loans, holiday loans, electric vehicle loans, medical loans, wedding loans, renovation loans, motorbike loans, moving costs loans, boat loans, legal fee loans, solar and battery loans, and caravan loans. The Company operates primarily in Australia.

name: PIVOTAL METALS
businessSummary: Pivotal Metals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is an explorer and developer of mineral deposits. The principal activity of the Company is exploration for and development of copper, nickel, and platinum group metals (PGM) deposits. The Company holds the flagship Horden Lake property, which contains a joint ore reserves committee (JORC) compliant Indicated and Inferred Mineral Resource Estimate of over 27.8Mt at 1.49% copper equivalent (CuEq), comprising copper, nickel, palladium, and gold. The property is located approximately 140km north of Matagami in northwest Quebec. Horden Lake is complemented by a battery metals exploration portfolio in Canada located within the Belleterre-Angliers Greenstone Belt (BAGB) comprised of the Midrim, Laforce, Alotta and Lorraine high-grade nickel copper PGM sulfide projects in Quebec. The BAGB Project covers approximately 157 square kilometers (km2) landholding in the prospective BAGB.

name: FIREBIRD METALS
businessSummary: Firebird Metals Limited is an Australia-based advanced manganese developer. The Company is focused on combining mining and downstream processing for the advancement of the electric vehicle (EV) battery sector. Its projects include Oakover Manganese Project, China Battery Grade Manganese Plant, Wandanya Project and Hill 616 Manganese Project. The Oakover Manganese Project is located approximately 85 kilometers (kms) east of Newman in the Eastern Pilbara region of Western Australia. The Hill 616 Manganese Project is located over 85 kms southeast of Newman within the Peak Hill Mineral Field. Wandanya Project consists of two exploration license applications, E46/1456 and E46/1457, which cover an area of 51 square kilometers (Km2) located in the Eastern Pilbara Region of Western Australia. Its other projects include Disraeli Manganese Project, and Midgengadge Manganese Project.

name: PANCONTINENTAL ENERGY NL
businessSummary: Pancontinental Energy NL is an Australia-based petroleum (oil and gas) exploration company. The Company is focused on conventional oil and gas projects. It has key assets in Africa (Namibia) and Australia (Queensland). The Company’s portfolio includes resource potential, offshore oil projects. The project in Namibia includes Orange Basin PEL 87. The project in Australia includes Onshore Cooper Eromanga Basin, which includes ATP 920 and ATP 924. The Orange Basin PEL 87 is located approximately 10,947 square kilometers in Orange Basin, Offshore Namibia. The ATP 924 is located approximately 2,220 square kilometers in Cooper Eromanga Basin.

name: PACIFIC LIME AND CEMENT
businessSummary: Pacific Lime and Cement Limited, formerly Mayur Resources Limited, is focused on the development of natural resources and renewable energy in Papua New Guinea (PNG). The Company's diversified asset portfolio spans iron and industrial sands, lime, cement, nature-based forestry carbon credits, and renewable power generation (geothermal and solar). It also holds an approximate 19.6% interest in copper-gold explorer/developer Adyton Resources Corporation. It Is developing Asia Pacific neutral quicklime, clinker and cement project that will supply meet demand in PNG, Australia and Southeast Asia. The company's key projects include the Central Lime Project (CLP), the Central Cement Project (CCP), and the Orokolo Bay Industrial Sands Project (OBP).

name: NORWEST MINERALS
businessSummary: Norwest Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on exploration of highly prospective assets, including rare earth elements (REE), copper, gold and base metals. Its projects include Bulgera, Marymia East, Bali, Arunta West and Marriott. The Bulgera Gold Project is located approximately 200 kilometers (km) north of Meekatharra in the seven million ounces (moz) gold Plutonic Well greenstone belt. The Bali Copper Project is located 75 km west of Paraburdoo in Western Australia. The Bali Project includes an eight km long shear being a faulted zone proven to host copper, lead, zinc and silver mineralization. The Arunta West Rare Earth project is located in Western Australia, over 600 km west of Alice Springs. The tenements cover a ground holding of 1600 square kilometers (km2) along the Arunta belt. The Marriott Project is located 70 km southeast of the nickel mining and processing center of Leinster, and 80 km from Leonora.

name: NORTHERN MINERALS
businessSummary: Northern Minerals Limited is a mineral exploration company. It owns 100% of the Browns Range Project (Project) in northern Western Australia, tenements rich in the heavy rare earth elements dysprosium (Dy) and terbium (Tb). The Browns Range Project is located over160 kilometers (km) south-east of Halls Creek on the northern edge of the Tanami Desert in Western Australia. Its other projects include John Galt, Boulder Ridge, Coomarie Dome, Gardiner Tanami, and Rabbit Flats. The John Galt Project comprises granted tenements held 100% by the Company, which covers a combined area of 78 square kilometers (km2). John Galt is situated in East Kimberley, approximately 150km north of Browns Range. The John Galt Project comprises granted tenements, such as E80/4298, E80/4967, E80/5230, and E80/6079. Boulder Ridge Project is located 150 km south of the Browns Range Dome along the western margin of the Coomarie Dome. Rabbit Flats tenement group lies immediately east of the Tanami village in the NT.

name: CASPIN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Caspin Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company, which is engaged in early-stage exploration and development. Its projects include the Bygoo Project, Yarawindah Brook Project and the Mount Squires Project. The Bygoo Project is an advanced, high-grade tin project located in a prolific tin-producing region. The Bygoo Project is positioned within the Wagga Tin Granites, a mineralized belt with many occurrences of tin and associated metals, the project surrounds the Ardlethan Tin Mine. Its Yarawindah Brook Project is located in the West Yilgarn region, a new mineral province hosting the Gonneville PGE-Ni-Cu Deposit owned by Chalice Mining Limited, only 40km to the south. Mount Squires is a large-scale, greenfield gold, rare earths and base metal project located in the West Musgrave region of Western Australia. The project is located adjacent to the western border of the West Musgrave mine development, which hosts the Nebo-Babel Ni-Cu sulfide deposits.

name: OMNI BRIDGEWAY
businessSummary: Omni Bridgeway Limited is an Australia-based company involved in legal finance and risk management, including dispute and litigation finance, from case inception to post-judgment enforcement and recovery. The Company provides solutions, including arbitration financing, judgment enforcement, dispute funding, distressed asset recovery, bankruptcy, commercial, intellectual property, investor recoveries, class/group actions, appeals, and whistleblower. Arbitration financing analyzes factors impacting claims and advises on navigating the various arbitral institutions. Judgment enforcement advises clients on how to safeguard collectability and enforcement of judgments. The bankruptcy financing solutions include pre-litigation and pre-confirmation investigations, working capital, fees and credit funding and monetizing appeals. It assesses investment and enforcement opportunities in Africa, Asia, Australia, Canada, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, the United Kingdom, and others.

name: ORE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Ore Resources Limited, formerly Future Battery Minerals Limited, is an Australia-based gold and lithium focused exploration company, with an asset portfolio located in the Eastern Goldfields of Western Australia. The Company's projects include Coolgardie Gold Projects, Randalls Gold Project and Coolgardie Lithium Projects. Its Coolgardie Gold Projects are located in a region of the Coolgardie Greenstone Belt overlying a suite of mafic and ultramafic units along with felsic intrusives. It is focused on the rapid exploration and development of emerging gold opportunities at its Miriam Gold Project. Its Randalls Gold Project consists of six tenements overlying 620 km2 of Archaean greenstone, sedimentary and Banded Iron Formations, along with key regional structures which are highly prospective for orogenic lode gold deposits with near-surface potential. It holds two high-quality lithium exploration assets at the 100%-owned Kangaroo Hills Lithium Project and Miriam Lithium Project.

name: HERAMED
businessSummary: HeraMED Limited is an Australia-based medical data and technology company. The Company is engaged in the digital transformation of maternity care by transforming the prenatal and postpartum experience with its hybrid maternity care platform. The Company offers a proprietary platform that utilizes hardware and software to reshape the doctor/patient relationship using its clinically validated in-home fetal and maternal heart rate monitor, HeraBEAT, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and big data. The HeraBEAT medical device is used by pregnant women in Europe, the United States, Israel and Australia. The Company’s proprietary offering, HeraCARE, is engineered to offer a fully integrated maternal health ecosystem designed to deliver care to ensure expectant mothers are engaged, informed and well-supported, allowing healthcare professionals to provide quality care and enable early detection and prevention of potential risks.

name: JUPITER MINES
businessSummary: Jupiter Mines Limited is an Australia-based pure-play manganese company.
