The Company's core asset is a 49.9% stake in Tshipi e Ntle Manganese Mining, an independently operated and managed, black-empowered company that operates the Tshipi manganese mine in South Africa’s Kalahari region. Tshipi operates as an open pit mine, producing on average 3.4 million tons of manganese ore annually, with the flexibility to scale production in line with market demand. The mine produces both lumpy and fines manganese ore, with average grades of approximately 36.5% and 35.5%, respectively. The mine employs a combination of rail and road transport to deliver processed manganese ore to eight commercial ports across South Africa. These ports include Port Elizabeth, Saldanha, Cape Town, East London, Durban, Richards Bay, Mossel Bay, and Ngqura, as well as Luderitz in Namibia. The Company is exploring the potential to supply high purity manganese sulphate monohydrate to the electric vehicle battery market.

name: MRG METALS
businessSummary: MRG Metals Limited is a heavy mineral sands (HMS) exploration company. Its projects include Corridor Projects, Marao, Marruca and Linhuane. Its Corridor Central and Corridor South portfolio at the Corridor Projects in Mozambique include two contiguous tenements containing 13 targets. Corridor Central (6620L) comprises 179 square kilometers (km2) and Corridor South comprises 208 km2. The Marao and Marruca projects are contiguous and consist of 385 km2, with over 75 kilometers (km) of strike of interpreted palaeocoastline. The Linhuane project (7423L) comprises 113 km2 located in Inhambane Province and is an application pending grant. It has three exploration licenses for Rare Earth Elements (REEs) and uranium that have been granted in Mozambique, which include Fotinho (11000L; 19,865.18 Ha), Adriano (11002L; 19,777.14 Ha), and Olinga (11005L; 16,534.47 Ha). Its Garies Rare Earth Project is a high-grade, monazite-hosted rare earth system located in South Africa’s Northern Cape Province.

name: VICTORY METALS
businessSummary: Victory Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company focused on the exploration and development of its North Stanmore Rare Earth Element (REE) Project in the Cue region. Its key assets include a portfolio of assets located in the Midwest region of Western Australia, approximately 665 kilometers (km) from Perth. Its North Stanmore Ionic Clay REE Discovery is situated within the Company’s 100% owned exploration license E20/871 and is situated in close proximity to the Cue township and is bordered by the Great Northern Highway on its eastern boundary. The bullseye magnetic anomaly is situated within the North Stanmore exploration license E20/871 which is 100% owned by the Company. Its projects also include Victory Buttercup, Coodardy Project, Emily Wells Project, Eagle Hawk Project, Klondyke Project, Young Australia Project, Nemesis (Tuckanarra) Project, Mafeking, Monte Carlo and Lady Godiva Project, among others.

name: PERCHERON THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Percheron Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based biotechnology company. The Company is focused on the development and commercialization of novel therapies for oncology and rare diseases. The Company’s lead program is HMBD-002, a monoclonal antibody targeting the immune checkpoint regulator, VISTA. HMBD-002 has completed a phase I clinical trial in patients with advanced cancer. HMBD-002 is a recombinant humanized monoclonal IgG4 antibody to human v-domain immunoglobulin suppressor of T-cell activation (VISTA). VISTA is one of a number of novel immuno-oncology targets under investigation by pharmaceutical companies, with potential applications to a range of solid tumors and hematological malignancies.

name: PALISADE METALS
businessSummary: Palisade Metals Ltd, formerly IRIS Metals Limited, is a minerals exploration and development company with projects in Montana and South Dakota, United States of America. The Company is advancing the Finley Basin Tungsten Project in western Montana, where it is preparing to undertake a drilling program targeting tungsten mineralization. Its tungsten is used in defense, aerospace, manufacturing, energy and electronics applications. The Company also holds lithium and rubidium assets in the Black Hills of South Dakota, where it has completed extensive drilling, metallurgical test work and resource definition activities.

name: MORELLA
businessSummary: Morella Corporation Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals company. The Company is engaged in exploration and resource development activities, advancing projects in lithium, rubidium, titanium and vanadium across Australia and United States. These critical minerals underpin the global transition to clean energy, electrification and advanced technologies. Its projects span the Mt Edon Rubidium-Lithium and Dixon Well Titanium-Vanadium prospects in Western Australia, the Mallina, Tabba Tabba and West Wodgina Lithium Projects in the Pilbara, and the Fish Lake Valley and North Big Smoky Lithium Projects in Nevada, United States. The Company's Mt Edon Project is located approximately five kilometers southwest of Paynes Find in Western Australia’s Mid-West region. Its Lake Valley Project is located in western Nevada, within the Esmeralda lithium brine province that also hosts the nearby Silver Peak operation - North America’s only producing lithium brine mine.

name: HIGHFIELD RESOURCES
businessSummary: Highfield Resources Limited (Highfield) is an Australia-based company engaged in mineral exploration. The Company has around four potash projects. The Company's Muga, Vipasca, Izaga, Pintanos and Sierra del Perdon potash projects are located in the Ebro potash producing basin in northern Spain covering a project area of over 550 square kilometers. The Muga project targets the shallow sylvinite beds to the south east of the project area. The Muga project is located approximately 50 kilometers to the southeast of Pamplona. The Sierra del Perdon project is located approximately 10 kilometers from Pamplona. The Vipasca project area includes the Vipasca permit, the Borneau permit and the Osquia permit. The Pintanos project covers an area of around 125 square kilometers abutting the Muga-Vipasca project. The Izaga project is located in a syncline structure abutting the northern extent of the expanded Vipasca project.

name: NEUROSCIENTIFIC BIOPHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing peptide-based pharmaceutical drugs that target a number of neurodegenerative conditions with high unmet medical demand. The Company's product portfolio includes EmtinB, a therapeutic peptide initially targeting glaucoma, as well as other Emtin peptides (EmtinAc, EmtinAn and EmtinBn). EmtinB is a peptide-based compound that binds to surface-based cell receptors from the LDLR family, activating intracellular signalling pathways that stimulate neuroprotection, neuroregeneration and modulate neuroinflammation. EmtinB is modelled on a specific active domain of the complex human protein called Metallothionein-IIA, which is produced as part of the human body's innate immune response to cell injury. Its StemSmart is a global patented technology engaged in manufacturing cell products. The use of its proprietary StemSmart technology in a special access program for fistulising Crohn’s disease.

name: SPORTSHERO
businessSummary: SportsHero Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the development of sports gamification platforms. The Company has developed a white label digital solution, such as SportsHero. SportsHero offers its digital solutions across multiple sports to sporting groups and other partners globally. SportsHero’s strategy is to build a large and engaged user base of active sports fans utilizing its technologies. SportsHero operates in Indonesia. It has developed and owns Olahbola, the Indonesian local market version of SportsHero’s platform. Olahbola provides fanatical football fans with the opportunity to predict outcomes, compete with other users and climb the leaderboard and win prizes, including money cannot buy experiences, merchandise and entertainment products.

name: RIMFIRE PACIFIC MINING
businessSummary: Rimfire Pacific Mining Ltd is a critical minerals exploration company. The Company's 100% owned projects include Green View Cobalt Project, Valley Project and East Cowal Copper Gold Project. The Green View Cobalt Project lies around 35 kilometers (km) west of Broken Hill, within the highly prospective Broken Hill geological district of NSW, and includes three high-grade cobalt targets: Bald Hill, Staurolite Ridge and Railway Extension. Valley Project is located five km west of Kincora Copper's Mordialloc porphyry copper gold discovery. East Cowal Copper Gold Project has around 500 square kilometers, which lies 60 km southwest of Parkes within the highly prospective Lachlan Orogen of NSW. Avondale and Fifield projects are being funded by its exploration partner, Golden Plains Resources. It has an option to acquire 100% of EL8666, which contains the Malamute Scandium Prospect and together with the adjoining EL9748, makes up the Rabbit Trap Scandium Project.

name: NEW MURCHISON GOLD
businessSummary: New Murchison Gold Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company holds a substantial package of tenements in the prolific Murchison goldfield near Meekatharra, Western Australia. Murchison Project comprises approximately 14 exploration licenses and three applications for exploration licenses, encompassing over 460 square kilometers (km2) in the Murchison region of Western Australia. The Company is focused on the Garden Gully Gold Project, which comprises an approximately 677 square kilometers (km2) tenure package covering the Abbots Greenstone Belt (AGB) and other key regional structures. The project has multiple gold prospects along the belt, with the most advanced being the Crown Prince Prospect. Crown Prince Prospect is located within a granted mining lease and is advancing towards development.

name: AURUM RESOURCES
businessSummary: Aurum Resources Limited is an Australian gold exploration company focused on the discovery and development of gold projects in Cote d'Ivoire, West Africa. The Company's projects include Napie Gold Project and Boundiali Gold Project. The Napie Gold Project covers approximately 224 square kilometers (km2) and consists of the Tchaga and Gogbala deposits located on the Napie shear. The Napie Gold Project is a shallow, open pittable, high-grade resource with a maximum resource depth between 160 meters and 195 meters across the two deposits and has access to hydroelectricity, bitumen road and water. It has 100% ownership of the Korhogo Project (manganese discovery) and the Brobo Project (lithium/rare earths). The Boundiali Gold Project is comprised of four neighboring exploration tenements: Boundiali Minex Tenement PR0893, Boundiali DS tenement PR808, Boundiali South tenement PR414 and Boundiali North tenement PR283. The Company owns and runs approximately eight diamond drill rigs.

name: LATROBE MAGNESIUM
businessSummary: Latrobe Magnesium Limited is an Australia-based company, which is developing a magnesium metal Demonstration Plant in Victoria's Latrobe Valley using its patented extraction process. The Company intends to extract and sell magnesium metal and cementitious material from industrial ash, which is a waste resource from brown coal power generation. The Company's byproducts include supplementary cementitious material (SCM), silica, char, iron oxide and calcium carbonate. It is also developing an International Mega Plant (magnesium metal) in the state of Sarawak, Malaysia via its wholly owned subsidiary company Latrobe Magnesium Sarawak Sdn Bhd.

name: JANUS ELECTRIC HOLDINGS
industry: Biomass & Waste to Energy Electric Utili
businessSummary: Janus Electric Holdings Ltd, formerly ReNu Energy Limited, is an Australia-based cutting-edge electric vehicle technology company. The Company’s viable next generation battery technology delivers a zero-carbon solution for the electrification of road transport fleets. Janus Electric technology features a battery that can be charged utilizing renewable energy sources such as solar, wind and hydro. Its Janus (patent pending) Change & Charge Station utilizes renewable energy to provide a three-way system - grid to battery, battery to battery, and battery to grid. This enables renewable energy to be fed back into the grid, assisting balance and minimizing surges and outages. The Janus fleet electrification solution provides up to a 60% reduction in maintenance and operating costs over the vehicle's lifetime.

name: NH3 CLEAN ENERGY
businessSummary: NH3 Clean Energy Limited, formerly Hexagon Energy Materials Limited, is an Australia-based company focused on reducing carbon emissions by providing clean energy solutions. The Company is engaged in delivering low-emission ammonia solutions to support the global transition to clean energy. The Company's flagship project, WAH2 Project in Maitland, Western Australia (WA), focuses on producing low-emission ammonia for export, supporting Asia’s transition to clean energy.

name: IONDRIVE
businessSummary: Iondrive Limited is an Australia-based battery recycling technology company. The Company primarily focuses on developing and commercializing solutions for lithium battery recycling. Its Hydrometallurgical Battery Recycling project employs a patented, environmentally safe solvent to gently separate critical components from used batteries, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional methods. The Company holds licenses from the University of Adelaide for next-generation battery technologies, including an enhanced performance non-flammable lithium-ion based battery and a low-cost, high-cycle life water-based battery. The Company holds prospective Lithium, rare-earth elements (REE) and precious metals projects. Its lithium projects include Samguen Li Project and Seobyeok Li Project, which has two highly prospective REE projects, including the Jangnam REE Project comprising 10 exploration license applications covering 24.7 square kilo meters (km2).

name: TYRANNA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Tyranna Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral explorer primarily focused on lithium exploration in Angola, Africa. The Company's Namibe Lithium and Caesium Project is located near the Port of Namibe (or Mocamedes), drilling is targeting spodumene and pollucite mineralization. The Project covers 207 square kilometers (km2) area targets the Giraul pegmatite field, in which approximately 600 or more pegmatites are exposed within an area spanning 25 kilometers (km) long and up to 10km wide. Its Chinguar Gold Project comprises a single, very large, granted Prospection Title3 with an area of 3,342 km2, located 50km northeast of Huambo Its Australian projects include Dragon and Knight Project, Weebo Gold Project, and Pacific Express Ni Project. The Dragon & Knight Project comprises over two tenements (E29/1034 and E37/1336) is approximately 590km to the northeast of Perth, Western Australia’s capital city. The Weebo Project comprises over two tenements (E37/1342 and E37/1353).

name: INVEX THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Invex Therapeutics Ltd is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on the repurposing of an already-approved drug, Exenatide, for the efficacious treatment of neurological conditions derived from or involving raised intracranial pressure (ICP). In addition, the Company has generated early-stage data on the use of Exenatide in the treatment of glaucoma, through the lowering of intraocular pressure in the eye. The principal activity of the Company is the development of Exenatide, including generating new pre-clinical data in Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) under a collaboration with Tessara Therapeutics. The Company has trademarked its repurposed Exenatide as Presendin. The Company is focused on managing the close out of the Phase III Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (IIH) EVOLVE clinical trial and explore new potential applications for Exenatide in TBI and other neurological disorders with raised ICP, consistent with its patents.

name: INVESTIGATOR SILVER
businessSummary: Investigator Silver Limited is an Australia-based metal exploration company focused on the Gawler Craton of South Australia. Its projects include the Paris Silver Project, Uno Morgans, Curnamona and Paris Silver Corridor. Its flagship asset, the Paris Silver Project, hosts a Joint Ore Reserves Committee (JORC) resource of over 57 million ounces (moz) silver and 99,000 tons (kt) of lead, and is located approximately 70 kilometers (km) north of the rural township of Kimba on South Australia’s Eyre Peninsula. Uno Morgans Project is located 85 km east of the Paris Silver Project. It holds over 700 square kilometers (km2) within the prospective Curnamona Province, which has gold and copper deposits. The Paris Silver Corridor consists of Peterlumbo tenement (EL6347-100% IVR) and the Black Hill tenement (EL6475).

name: METALLIUM
businessSummary: Metallium Limited is an Australia-based company, engaged in recovering critical and precious metals from mineral concentrates and high-grade waste streams. The company's patented Flash Joule Heating (FJH) technology enables the extraction of high-value materials, including gallium, germanium, antimony, rare earth elements, and gold from feedstocks such as refinery scrap, e-waste, and monazite. It also owns gold and rare-earth element projects in Canada and Australia, which include the Pomme Project, East Laverton Gold Project, Mt Monger Gold Project and West Arunta Project. The Pomme Project, located in Quebec, Canada, consists of over 43 mineral claims, covering approximately 2,400 hectares. The East Laverton Project comprises twelve exploration licences, covering an area of approximately 3,000 square kilometers. The Mt Monger Gold project comprises six granted exploration licenses, covering an area of about 100 square kilometers.

name: IMUGENE
businessSummary: Imugene Limited is a clinical-stage immune-oncology company. It is engaged in developing a range of new and novel immunotherapies that seek to activate the immune system of cancer patients to treat and eradicate tumors. Its platform technology seeks to harness and promote the body’s immune system against cancerous tumors. Its product pipeline includes an off-the-shelf (allogeneic) cell therapy CAR T drug Azer-Cel (azercabtagene zapreleucel) which targets CD19 to attack blood cancer. Its pipeline includes an Oncolytic Virus and B-Cell Immunotherapies aimed at treating a variety of cancers in combination with standard of care drugs and immunotherapies. Its lead candidate is a chimeric vaccinia (pox) virus known as CF33, which is a combination of genomic sequences from multiple vaccinia virus strains to generate a new, safer and more potent virus. Its Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-engineered T cells (CAR T) are T cells redirected against tumors through engineered expression of CARs.

name: IMPACT MINERALS
businessSummary: Impact Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company’s projects include Lake Hope - High Purity Alumina (HPA) Project, Arkun - Battery Metals Project, and Broken Hill - Nickel-Copper-PGM Project. The Lake Hope Project spans a large area of approximately 238 square kilometers, encompassing salt lakes stretching from Hyden to Norseman in southern Western Australia. The Arkun project covers about 850 square kilometers, centered between York and Corrigin 100 square kilometers east of Perth. The Broken Hill Ni-Cu-PGE project is located 20 kilometers (km) east of the Broken Hill silver-lead-zinc mine in New South Wales and consists of 100% owned seven exploration licenses covering 816 square kilometers in the southeast part of the mineralized Curnamona Province. Its Broken Hill East project is located to the high-grade zinc-silver-lead deposit in western New South Wales. The Broken Hill East Project consists of two tenements covering 684.3km2 (EL8434 and EL8435).

name: HAZER GROUP
businessSummary: Hazer Group Limited is an Australia-based technology company, driving global decarbonization efforts with the commercialization of its disruptive climate-tech. The principal activity of the Company is the research and development of hydrogen and graphitic carbon production technology. The Company’s advanced technology enables the production of clean and economically competitive hydrogen and graphite, using a natural gas (or biogas) feedstock and iron-ore as the process catalyst. The Company has intellectual property rights to a technology (the Hazer Process), which enables the production of hydrogen gas from the thermo-catalytic decomposition of methane (natural gas) with low carbon dioxide emissions and the co-production of a high-purity graphite product. The Company's markets include industrial hydrogen, hydrogen mobility and synthetic graphite. It has facilities, including a research and development lab and a fluid bed reactor pilot plant.

name: KRAKATOA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Krakatoa Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the mineral exploration and evaluation of acquisition opportunities. Its projects include Mt Clere Rare Earth Project, King Tamba Speciality Metals Project, Belgravia Porphyry Project, Turon Gold Project, Rand Gold Project and Mac Well Project. The Mt Clere Rare Earth Project is located approximately 200 kilometers (km) northwest of Meekatharra. Belgravia Porphyry Project is located in the central division of the Molong Volcanic Belt (MVB) and covers an area of over 80 square kilometers (km2) located in the tier 1 mining jurisdiction of the Lachlan Fold Belt, New South Wales, Australia. The Turon Project covers 120 km2 and is positioned approximately 50km east of the Company’s Belgravia Project and 60km northeast of Newcrest Mining’s Cadia Valley Mine in the central tableland region, NSW. The Rand Gold Project covers a substantial area of 580 km2 in the Central Lachlan Fold Belt, New South Wales.

name: BESRA GOLD
businessSummary: Besra Gold Inc. is an Australia-based gold mining company focused on exploration and development of the Bau Goldfield in East Malaysia. The Company controls, directly and indirectly, a 98.5% interest (93.8% on an equity-adjusted basis) in the Bau Gold Project located in Sarawak, East Malaysia. Its interests in mining tenements extend across four concessional areas, collectively covering around 1,340 square kilometers (km2) of Sarawak; the Bau Gold Project (consisting of Blocks A and B), Rawan and Serian (Block C) areas. Its development activities are focused on the Jugan Project located within the Bau Gold Project. Its Jugan Project is located approximately six kilometers (kms) northeast of the Bau township. Gold is associated with sulfide (refractory) mineralization within the shale dominated lithologies of the Pedawan Formation, locally outcropping as a topographic high at Jugan Hill. Its Bekajang Project lies along a prospective trend that includes two historical gold mines.

name: GALILEO MINING
businessSummary: Galileo Mining Ltd is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is focused on the exploration and development of palladium, nickel, copper, and cobalt resources in Western Australia. It has two prospective West Australian resource and exploration projects: the Norseman Project and the Fraser Range Project. The Norseman Project contains the Callisto Discovery and adjacent regional prospects Jimberlana and Mission Sill with potential for palladium, platinum, nickel, copper, cobalt, and rhodium mineralization. The Company’s tenure at Norseman project comprises exploration and prospecting licenses covering a total area of over 278 square kilometers (km2). The Fraser Range project covers exploration licenses totaling 602 square kilometers in the Albany-Fraser Orogen. The Fraser Range Project with exploration tenements prospective for nickel-copper-cobalt deposits. The Fraser Range tenure is located across two areas: the North Fraser Range and the South Fraser Range projects.

name: RED MOUNTAIN MINING
businessSummary: Red Mountain Mining Ltd is a critical minerals exploration and development company focused on accelerating development at it's the United States and Australia based Projects, located in Tier-1 Mining Districts. Its Armidale Antimony-Gold Project located in New South Wales (NSW), and its US Critical Minerals Portfolio comprising the Pioneer Tungsten Project in Montana, Utah Antimony Project, the Thompson Falls Antimony Project, the Yellow Pine Antimony Project, and Silver Dollar Antimony Project. Armidale Antimony-Gold Project encompasses over 391 square kilometers (km2) of prospective ground within the Southern New England Orogen in northeastern NSW. Utah Antimony Project is located over 11 km east of the town of Antimony, Utah and the project comprises approximately 87 claims. Thompson Falls Antimony Project lies at the eastern end of Idaho's Coeur d'Alene mineral district. Silver Dollar Project is located southeast of Yellow Pine in a highly prospective antimony-gold district.

name: HAWK RESOURCES
businessSummary: Hawk Resources Limited is a critical and precious metal exploration company. The Company has copper and gold projects in Utah, the United States of America (Cactus and Detroit) plus eight lithium projects in Minas Gerais and Bahia, Brazil Resources Corp. Its Cactus Copper-Gold Project has exploration potential for medium-tonnage high-grade copper-gold deposits. The Cactus district lies approximately 300 kilometers (km) south-southwest of Salt Lake City and 20 km west of Milford in Utah, the United States of America. The Detroit project has potential for intrusive-related gold deposits. It lies within the Detroit Mining District, over 290 km southwest of Salt Lake City, and contains numerous historical copper, gold and manganese mines. It controls over 21 square kilometers of tenements at Detroit through an option agreement with Tamra Mining LLC. Its Salitre lithium project is in north-central Bahia over 420 km northwest of the state capital of Salvador.

name: METEORIC RESOURCES
businessSummary: Meteoric Resources Limited, formerly Meteoric Resources NL, is an Australian company, developing the Caldeira Rare Earths Project in the state of Minas Gerais in Brazil. The Caldeira Rare Earths Project comprises approximately 77 mining and exploration licenses (with total landholdings over 193 square kilometers (km2)) located between the cities of Caldas, Pocos de Caldas, and Andrades in the southwest region of the state of Minas Gerais in Brazil. Caldeira is located 254 km from the city of Sao Paulo and approximately 350 km from the port of Santos.

name: CARNARVON ENERGY
businessSummary: Carnarvon Energy Limited is an Australia-based independent oil and gas explorer. The Company’s principal activities are oil and gas exploration, development and production. The Company secured its interests in the Bedout Sub-Basin permits, WA-435-P, WA-436-P, WA-437-P and WA-438-P. The offshore permits cover an area of 21,652 square kilometers (km2), which is located approximately 110 kilometers (km) from the coast, offshore of Port Hedland in Western Australia. The Pavo North oil discovery was made with the Pavo-1 well intersecting reservoirs and confirming net oil pay across a zone of 46 meters. Pavo lies in offshore permit WA-438-P, where Carnarvon holds a 20% interest. The Company’s core exploration portfolio offshore Western Australia contains more than 100 prospects, providing plenty of running room in the emerging Bedout sub-basin. It holds a 10% interest in WA-435-p and WA-437-P.

name: GOLDARC RESOURCES
businessSummary: GoldArc Resources Limited, formerly Asra Minerals Limited, is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. Its flagship projects are located in the prolific Leonora and Kookynie districts of the Eastern Goldfields. Leonora South Gold project consists of over 8 semi-contiguous granted mining licenses, including 313 square kilometers (km2) across its eastern tenements and an additional 236 km2 in the western area. The project consists of two JORC compliant resources at their Orion and Sapphire deposits totaling over 48,000 ounces. Leonora South Gold project is located 60km south of Leonora along the Goldfields Highway in the historic Kookynie Goldfields. The Leonora North Gold Project is located 40km northeast of Leonora. It is located within the Archaean Eastern Goldfield Superterrane, the eastern division of the Achean Yilgarn Craton, and it is located around 250km north of Kalgoorlie, covers an area 100km long and 80km wide and contains an abundance of orogenic gold deposits.

name: AGUIA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Aguia Resources Limited is an Australia-based multi-commodity company with pre-production phosphate projects located in Rio Grande do Sul, the southernmost state of Brazil. The Company controls over 1,834 square kilometers (km2) of land in the Brazilian states of Rio Grande do Sul, Paraiba and Minas Gerais containing phosphate and copper mineralization through exploration permits. The Company’s projects consist of the Phosphate Project and the Copper Project. It also holds additional assets in the Rio Grande copper belt. All projects and assets are located within Rio Grande do Sul, the southernmost state of Brazil. Its Metallic Copper Project is located about 255 kilometers (km) from Port Alegre, the State Capital. Its phosphate project is located in the rich agricultural heartland of Rio Grande do Sul in southern Brazil, about three hours from the capital Port Alegre. The Company also has a portfolio of gold, silver and copper projects in its asset base.

name: MANUKA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Manuka Resources Limited is a mining and exploration company. The Company's principal activities include mine development, mining and processing of silver, gold and exploration activities. Its segments include Exploration - Australia, Exploration - New Zealand, and Operations. Exploration - Australia segment is engaged in exploration of existing gold and silver leases and exploration leases at Wonawinta and Mt Boppy projects. Exploration - New Zealand is engaged in exploration of acquired mining and exploration leases at the Taranaki VTM Project (New Zealand). Its Operations segment includes appraisal, development and processing of gold and silver deposits. Its 100% owned Taranaki VTM (vanadium titanomagnetite) iron sands Project is located over 22 kilometers (km) to 36 km offshore in New Zealand’s Exclusive Economic Zone. Its Mt Boppy gold project is located over 43 km east of Cobar. Its Wonawinta Silver and Base Metals Project is in the Cobar Basin, New South Wales.

name: METAL BANK
businessSummary: Metal Bank Limited is a mineral exploration company, which holds a portfolio of copper, cobalt and gold exploration projects. It holds a 75% interest in the Livingstone Gold Project located 140 kilometers (km) northwest of Meekatharra in Western Australia and includes 395 square kilometers (km2) of granted exploration licenses covering the entire western arm of the Proterozoic Bryah-Padbury Basin. Its 8 Mile project is located near the Mt Rawdon gold deposit in south-east Queensland, Australia. It has the right to earn up to 80% of the Millennium Cobalt-Copper-Gold project, located approximately 35km west-northwest (WNW) of Cloncurry and 19 km from the Rocklands copper-cobalt processing facility in North Queensland. Wild Irishman project is located approximately 20km south-east of Gin Gin, Queensland. The Eidsvold project has identified a range of gold targets, including Mt Brady, Mt Jones, Great Eastern Target, Forty Horse, Tower Hill, all located in Southeast Queensland.

name: LI S ENERGY
businessSummary: Li-S Energy Limited is engaged in development and commercialization a new type of battery based on Lithium-Sulphur (Li-S) and using boron nitride nanotubes (BNNT) as both an integrated protective insulation layer and a component in composite anodes, which allows faster charging rates and increased battery cycle life. The Company produces batteries in pouch, cylinder and flexible battery formats to address the needs of partners and prospective customers who manufacture drones, electric cars, electric trucks, other electric vehicles, space and other applications. Its lithium sulfur batteries are lighter, cleaner and greener and deliver more than twice the energy density of lithium ion. BNNT is an advanced nanomaterial with physical properties. It takes advantage of its physical strength, thermal conductivity and electrical resistance as well as some electrochemical properties to enhance its lithium sulfur and lithium metal batteries.

name: PROVARIS ENERGY
businessSummary: Provaris Energy Ltd is an Australia-based company. The Company is advancing innovative Compressed Hydrogen (H2) and Carbon Dioxide (CO2) storage and transport solutions through proprietary tank designs for storage, maritime gas carriers and integrated supply chain development. The Company’s principle activities include supporting the development of hydrogen production and export projects in Europe, with a focus on local collaborations in Norway; the design, engineering and Maritime Class Approvals for its proprietary H2Neo Carrier and H2Leo Storage Barge for the marine storage and transportation of compressed hydrogen; and developing innovative liquid CO2 tank designs for marine transport and offshore storage and injection applications. Its proprietary H2Neo carrier is based on a conventional MR tanker with two integrated tanks to store (450-tonnes) hydrogen at 250 bar MAOP.

name: GOLDEN STATE MINING
businessSummary: Golden State Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company's projects include Yule, Paynes Find, Southern Cross East, and Other Western Australia Projects. The Yule Project is located over 45 kilometers (km) southwest of Port Hedland in the northern Pilbara region of Western Australia and consists of approximately six granted exploration licenses and two exploration license applications covering approximately 730 square kilometers (km2). The Southern Cross East project is located approximately 60kms north-east of Southern Cross and 36kms east of Koolyanobbing in the central Yilgarn region of Western Australia and consists of three granted exploration licenses for a total of 620km2. The Canning Hill gold project consists of a single, granted exploration license (E59/2824) located approximately 80 kilometers south of Mt Magnet and 13 kilometers south of the Kirkalocka Gold mine in the Murchison region of Western Australia.

name: GCM
businessSummary: GCM Corporation Limited is an Australia-based manufacturer and producer of high-performing thermal management and cooling products for the technology, electronics, and industrials sectors. The Company's advanced cooling product leverages proprietary VHD technology to deliver superior thermal management for high-performance, energy-intensive applications, including heat sinks, heat spreaders, and cold plates. VHD Technology represents advanced technology which produces commercial very high density (VHD) blocks. Its products serve critical sectors such as data centers, high performance computing, high performance electronics, advanced industrial manufacturing, renewable energy, aerospace and defense, and energy systems. Its projects include McIntosh Graphite Project, Torrington Topaz and Tungsten Project, Greenfields Projects, and Single-Crystal Mullite Fibers. It is initiating a work program to advance and commercialize single crystal mullite fiber technology (utilizing Topaz).

name: GBM RESOURCES
businessSummary: GBM Resources Limited is a mineral exploration and development company focused on the discovery of gold and copper deposits in Eastern Australia. The Company has a project portfolio, hosting district scale mineral systems, located in several metallogenic terrains. Its projects include Twin Hills Gold Project, Yandan Gold Project, Mount Coolon Gold Project and Cloncurry Copper Gold Project. The Mount Coolon Gold Project is located within the Drummond Basin, one of Queensland’s prolific gold provinces. Located 250 kilometers (km) to the West of Mackay in North Queensland, the tenement package covers a total area of over 2,613 square kilometers (km2). The Yandan Project is located approximately 40 km to the west of the township of Mount Coolon and 155 km southeast of Charters Towers, north Queensland. The Twin Hills Gold Project is a 1,102 km2 tenement package in the prospective Drummond Basin. The Cloncurry Copper Gold Project tenement package covers a total area of over 680 km2.

name: ADMIRALTY RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Admiralty Resources NL is an Australia-based diversified mineral exploration company with mineral interests in Chile and Australia. The Company is engaged in advancing the production at its flagship Mariposa Iron Ore Project in Chile (Mariposa Project). It has approximately 32 mineral exploration and exploitation concessions covering approximately 6,600 hectares (ha) and is located within the Chilean iron belt in the Atacama Desert at an altitude of 380 meters above sea level and 10 kilometers south from the city of Vallenar in the Third Region of Chile. Its exploration projects in the Company’s Harper South district (2,498 ha) include La Chulula and Soberana, with the potential for further growth in iron ore resources. Other exploration areas in Chile include the Pampa Tololo district (3,455 ha) and El Cojin (600 ha). In Australia, the Company holds a 50% stake in the Pyke Hill Project, a cobalt and nickel project in Western Australia.

name: GALAN LITHIUM
businessSummary: Galan Lithium Limited is an Australia-based lithium exploration and development company. The Company is focused on its lithium brine projects, Hombre Muerto West (HMW) and Candelas, located on the Hombre Muerto Salar in Argentina. Its projects include HMW Lithium Project, Candelas Project, and Greenbushes South Project. Its flagship HMW Lithium Project is situated within the Hombre Muerto basin. The Project lies 90 kilometers (km) north of the town of Antofagasta de la Sierra, in the Province of Catamarca, Argentina, and is located to the southwest of the Salar del Hombre Muerto. The Candelas Project comprises 14 exploration permits covering over 24,000 hectares hosted within an approximately 15km long by three-four km wide structurally controlled basin. It also owns 100% of the Greenbushes South Project, which covers a total area of approximately 315 square kilometers (km2) located about 250 km south of Perth, Western Australia.

name: GOLD HYDROGEN
businessSummary: Gold Hydrogen Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in discovery and development of natural hydrogen and helium gases in a potentially extensive province in South Australia. The Company holds one granted Petroleum Exploration License (PEL) in South Australia (PEL 687) that covers approximately 75,000- square kilometers (km2) of permitted tenement on the Yorke Peninsula and Kangaroo Island in South Australia. The Company through its subsidiary hold an additional seven applications for Natural Hydrogen and Helium exploration within South Australia. The Company is also the applicant for four gas storage exploration licenses applications (GSELA) covering an area of approximately 8,000 km2 within the Yorke Peninsula portion of PEL 687 in South Australia.

name: KEY PETROLEUM
businessSummary: Key Petroleum Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas company focused on pursuing conventional exploration programs in the Cooper Eromanga Basin, Australia. The Company is engaged in acquisition of petroleum permits, and the exploration of these permits with the objective of identifying economic oil and gas reserves. The Company’s asset holdings in the Cooper Eromanga Basin in Queensland are located between the Inland and Cook/Cuisinier Oil Fields, with the eastern assets located just north of the Eromanga Oil Refinery. Its projects include ATP920 and ATP924. ATP920 is located over 100 kilometers (km) southwest of Windorah in southwest Queensland and covers approximately 2337 square kilometers (km2). ATP924 is located approximately 140 km southwest of Windorah in southwest Queensland and covers over 2220km2 in four blocks.

name: SPARC AI
businessSummary: Sparc AI Inc. is a software and electronics engineering company. The Company has developed, patented and commercialized an innovative spatial, predictive, approximation and radial convolution technology called Spatial Predictive Approximation and Radial Convolution (SPARC) technology and associated product suite that turns any sensor, camera or smartphone device (fixed, mobile, portable or handheld) into a target co-ordinate acquisition system. The Company is a defense-focused technology company enabling drones to perform real-time target acquisition and autonomous navigation without the Global Positioning System (GPS), LiDAR, image recognition, or external connectivity. The system is built for covert operations and optimized for lightweight military drones. The Company combines advanced mathematics, on-board intelligence, and neural artificial intelligence (AI) to redefine spatial computing and mission autonomy.

name: JADE GAS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Jade Gas Holdings Limited is an Australia-based gas exploration company. The Company is focused on the coal bed methane (CBM) potential of Mongolia. The Company’s flagship project is the Coal Bed Methane gas project over the Production Sharing Agreement (PSA) area of Tavantolgoi XXXIII unconventional oil basin, (TT CBM Project). It operates and manages the TT CBM Project through its subsidiary Methane Gas Resource LLC (MGR), a joint venture (JV) company partnering with Erdenes Methane LLC (EM). It also holds two prospective CBM permits: Shivee Gobi and Eastern Gobi. Together the permits cover an area of over 18,000 square kilometers (km2) and are located within existing coal basins and near coal deposits and mines. Its Shivee Gobi permit covers an area of over 8,317 km2 and is located approximately 300 km south of Ulaanbaatar. It also holds a prospecting agreement permit over the Baruun Naran coal field (BNG Project), which is located immediately adjacent and west of its TTCBM Project.

name: SUNRISE ENERGY METALS
businessSummary: Sunrise Energy Metals Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in the development of its Sunrise Battery Materials Complex (Sunrise Project) in New South Wales (NSW). The Sunrise Project is a supplier of battery raw materials and aluminum-scandium alloys. It is utilizing its Clean-iX resin technology for extraction and purification of a range of metals and progressing exploration activities at its other mineral tenements. Its Clean-iX Continuous Resin-In-Column is a continuous counter-current process that extracts metals from clarified leach solutions. Its Clean-iX Continuous Resin-In-Pulp is a continuous countercurrent process that directly extracts metals from leached pulps. It is advancing activities across its range of exploration assets in NSW. Its limestone exploration includes Hunters (EL9627), EL8883 Meloola and EL8833 Boona Gap, Gleninga South (EL9598) and Gleninga (EL8882). It also focused on rare earth elements exploration, which includes Minore (EL9031 and EL8961).

name: FELIX GOLD
businessSummary: Felix Gold Limited is an Australia-based gold discovery company operating in the Tintina Gold Province. The Company’s flagship asset is a substantial landholding in a Fairbanks Gold District, where historical gold production exceeds 16 million ounces. The Company holds an interest in gold projects within the Fairbanks District of the Tintina Gold Province. The Company's projects include Treasure Creek Project, Grant-Ester Project and NE Fairbanks Project. The Treasure Creek Project area consists of over 236 Alaska State Mining Claims that cover 11,573 hectares (ha). The Grant-Ester Project is comprised of over 154 Alaska State mining claims that total 3,397 ha. The NE Fairbanks Project is comprised of over 326 Alaska State mining claims that total 14,637 ha located approximately 25 kilometers (km) to the Northeast of the city of Fairbanks. The MHT Project comprises Alaskan State Mining claims of over 6,203 acres located only 20 km north of mining and logistics hub, Fairbanks City.

name: SOUTHERN PALLADIUM
businessSummary: Southern Palladium Ltd is an Australia-based platinum group metal (PGM) company. The main business activity of the Company is the advancement of Bengwenyama PGM project, located in South Africa. The Bengwenyama Project is a large shallow advanced exploration and pre-development PGM opportunity situated on the Eastern Limb of the Bushveld Complex and south of the Anglo Platinum Modikwa property. The Project lies approximately five km west of the village of Steelpoort, 20 kilometers (km) west-southwest of the larger town of Burgersfort, and 250 km east-northeast of Pretoria. The Project has a total areal extent of 5280 hectares. Two economic reefs, the Merensky and UG2 reefs, occur on the Properties, which extend from surface to a depth of 1,100 meters over 10 km downdip. Both these reefs are primary economic deposits exploited by other platinum mining companies for PGMs and base metals in the region.

name: INVICTUS ENERGY
businessSummary: Invictus Energy Limited is an Australia-based independent upstream oil and gas company. The Company is focused on energy resources in sub-Saharan Africa. Its asset portfolio consists of 360,000 hectares within the Cabora Bassa Basin in Zimbabwe, SG 4571 and EPOs 1848/49 contain the Mukuyu and multiple Basin Margin prospects. The Cabora Bassa Basin project is located in northern Zimbabwe near the border of Mozambique. The Mukuyu Gas Field has multiple hydrocarbon-bearing reservoirs containing gas in the Upper and Lower Angwa Formations. The Mukuyu structure has an areal closure of more than 200 square kilometers (km2) and vertical relief of approximately 1,400 meters. Basin Margin Play has a total of eight targets: Kigelia, Baobab, Munondo, Acacia, Marula, Mukamba, Mimosa and Mukwa, identified stretching east-west through the southern reaches of the EPO 1848 licence area. Its subsidiaries include HIS Texas LLC, Invictus Energy Resources Pty Limited, Geo Associates (Pvt) Ltd, and others.

name: POLARX
businessSummary: PolarX Limited is an advanced mineral explorer and developer. The Company holds interests in copper, gold and silver exploration projects in Nevada and Alaska USA. Its projects include the Alaska Range Copper Gold Project (Alaska Range Project), which comprises the Stellar Gold Copper Property and the Caribou Dome Copper Property, and the Humboldt Range Project, which comprises the Black Canyon and Fourth of July mineral claim groups. The Stellar Project comprises 231 contiguous State Mining Claims and is located immediately adjacent to the Company’s Caribou Dome Copper Project. The Caribou Dome Project comprises 216 contiguous State Mining Claims and is located immediately adjacent to the Company’s Stellar Project. The Humboldt Range Gold-Silver project comprises 364 lode mining claims in Nevada in two claim groups: Black Canyon and Fourth of July and is situated between two large-scale active mines: the Florida Canyon gold mine and the Rochester silver-gold mine.

name: FAR
businessSummary: FAR Limited is an Australia-based independent, Africa focused, oil and gas exploration company. The principal activities of the Company are identifying and developing strategies to realize value from the consideration receivable for the sale of its interest in the RSSD Project in Senegal to Woodside Energy (Senegal) BV (Woodside Energy). The Company has rights to a contingent payment, as consideration for the sale of its interest in the RSSD Project. The contingent payment comprises 45% of entitlement barrels (being the share of oil relating to its previously held 13.67% of the RSSD Project comprising the Sangomar Field exploitation area of interest), multiplied by the excess of the crude oil price per barrel and US$58 per barrel (capped at US$70 per barrel).

name: HIGH PEAK ROYALTIES
businessSummary: High Peak Royalties Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in building a portfolio of diversified high-value resource royalties around the world. The Company has royalties over 20 oil and gas permits in Australia, and over 2,000 wells in the United States. The Company’s portfolio includes PL 171 and ATP 574P; ATP 299P; Petroleum Leases: PL29, PL38, PL39, PL52, 3.6/4.0 Santos PL57, PL95, PL169, PL170, PL293, PL294, PL295 and PL298; Peat Gas Field (PL101); Surprise Oil Field (PL6); Longtom Gas Field (VIC/L29); WA-90-R / WA-91-R (formerly WA-315-P) Poseidon Field; EP(A)111, EP115, EP(A)120 and EP(A) 124; EP112, EP115NM and EP125; EP(A)155; Planet Gas USA Inc. Royalties; United States (Harrison County East Texas, Preston Spraberry Permian Basin and Willacy County Texas Gulf Coast Basin); United States (Burleson and Lee Counties, East Texas; ML 04/244 and ML 04/249 Admiral Bay, Canning Basin; and Royalty over Hydrogen Sales, including Catalysts.

name: FAMIEN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Famien Resources Limited, formerly Enegex Limited, is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with a primary focus on Ni-Cu-PGE in the prospective West Yilgarn Province of Western Australia. Its West Yilgarn projects cover over 1,755 square kilometers (km2), all within 200 kilometers. Its West Yilgarn tenements is divided into five project areas: Perenjori, Three Springs, Miamoon, Walebing and Goomalling. The Perenjori Project is comprised of five exploration licenses (E70/6524, E70/6525, E70/6526, E70/6527 and E70/6591). The Three Springs project consists of exploration license E70/6597. The Miling project area comprises two exploration licences (E70/5444 and E70/5445) covering 408km2. The Green Hills Project area consists of six tenements (E70/5566, E70/5567, E70/5568, E70/5569, E70/5570 and E70/5571). The project area is prospective for a wide variety of mineral types, including magmatic nickel-copper-PGE deposits, porphyry gold-copper deposits and orogenic gold deposits.

name: EVION GROUP NL
businessSummary: Evion Group NL. is an Australia-based vertically integrated graphite developer with projects being developed in Madagascar, India and Europe. The Company’s principal activities are mineral exploration, evaluation and development. Its flagship project is the Maniry Graphite Project in Madagascar and the Panthera Expandable Graphite Joint Venture in India. Its business also includes Battery Anode Material Project. Panthera Graphite (PGT) is a joint venture downstream graphite processing group, Metachem Manufacturing, India and the Company. The Company’s subsidiaries include BlackEarth Australia Pty Ltd, Madagascar Graphite Ltd, and BlackEarth Minerals Madagascar SARL.

name: RICHMOND VANADIUM TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Richmond Vanadium Technology Limited is an Australia-based minerals exploration company. The principal activity of the Company includes mineral exploration and development with a focus on vanadium resources. The Company is focused on its 100% owned Richmond-Julia Creek Vanadium Project in North Queensland. The Richmond-Julia Creek Vanadium Project is a non-titanomagnetite vanadium deposit. The Richmond-Julia Creek Vanadium Project is situated between the towns of Julia Creek and Richmond in North Queensland. The Project is approximately 500 kilometers (km) west of Townsville and 400km east of Mount Isa on the main east-west Flinders Highway. The Project consists of five tenements (EPMs 25163, 25164, 25258, 26425, and 26426) totaling around 1,403 square kilometers and comprises three main prospects; Lilyvale, Manfred and Rothbury. Its project has developed a metallurgical process flow sheet using conventional technology relating to the method for concentration of vanadium ore.

name: WA GOLD
businessSummary: WA Gold Limited, formerly BMG Resources Limited, is a mineral resource exploration and development company. It is developing its portfolio of 100%-owned projects located in Tier one and emerging gold and lithium districts in Western Australia. Its projects include Abercromby Project, Invincible Project, Bullabulling Project, and South Boddington Project. The Abercromby Gold Project is located in the Agnew-Wiluna Greenstone Belt. The Invincible Project is located in the emerging Central Pilbara gold and lithium district. Bullabulling is located in the Coolgardie region, a lithium province of increasing significance with established gold heritage. The South Boddington Gold Project is located in the Saddleback Greenstone belt that hosts the giant 40Moz+ Boddington deposit. The South Boddington Gold Project comprises two granted exploration licenses (E70/6206 and E70/6207) and five exploration licenses under application (E70/4225, E70/4590, E70/6496, E70/6454 and E70/6455).

name: HOT CHILI
businessSummary: Hot Chili Limited is an Australia-based copper company. The principal activity of the Company is engaged in mineral exploration. The Company is focused on copper exploration and development in Chile’s Atacama Region. The Company’s Costa Fuego Project is a copper mining hub in Region III on the Chilean coastal range. Its Chilean coastal range Costa Fuego Copper-Gold Project comprises the Cortadera, Productora and San Antonio deposits. The Cortadera deposit is focused on copper-gold discoveries in Chile. Productora is an advanced-stage copper-gold project. Its El Fuego copper Project encompasses two historic underground mines, which include San Antonio and Valentina. The Company’s wholly owned subsidiaries include Sociedad Minera El Corazon Limitada, Sociedad Minera Los Mantos SpA, Sociedad Minera Frontera SpA, and Sociedad Minera Bandera SpA.

name: HAVILAH RESOURCES
businessSummary: Havilah Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration for and evaluation of mineral resources (predominantly copper, gold, cobalt and iron ore) in South Australia. The Company’s projects are the Kalkaroo copper-gold project (Kalkaroo), Mutooroo copper-cobalt-gold project (Mutooroo, Grants Project, Maldorky Project and Prospect Hill Project. The Kalkaroo Project is an open pit copper-gold-cobalt project in northeastern South Australia. Mutooroo is a high-grade open pit and underground copper-cobalt-gold project located 40 minutes from Broken Hill. Grants Project is a iron ore deposit within a few kilometers of the railway line in northeastern South Australia. Maldorky Project is the highest grade Braemar Iron Formation hosted iron ore project in northeastern South Australia. The Prospect Hill tin project, located on the northern margins of the Flinders Ranges.

name: AUSTRALIAN FOUNDATION INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Australian Foundation Investment Company Limited is an investment company, which is focused on investing in Australian and New Zealand equities. Its investment objective is to pay a stable and growing dividend over time and to provide attractive total returns over the medium to long term. It has two portfolios of securities: the investment portfolio and the trading portfolio. The investment portfolio holds securities which the Company intends to retain on a long-term basis and includes a small subcomponent over which options may be written and an additional small subcomponent of international (non-Australian/New Zealand listed) stocks. The trading portfolio consists of securities that are held for short-term trading only, including call option contracts written over securities that are held in the specific subcomponent of the investment portfolio and on occasion put options, and is relatively small. Australian Investment Company Services Limited (AICS) is a subsidiary of the Company.

name: PODIUM MINERALS
businessSummary: Podium Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and resource development company. The Company’s core project, Parks Reef, is located within granted mining leases over the Weld Range Complex igneous intrusion in the Mid-West Region of Western Australia. The Parks Reef 5E PGM Project is a platinum group metal (PGM) deposit that extends over a strike length of 15 kilometers (km), and contains platinum, palladium, rhodium and iridium as well as gold and base metal (copper, nickel and cobalt) mineralization. The Parks Reef is located approximately 80 km west of Meekatharra in the mid-west region of Western Australia. Parks Reef also contains a Copper-Gold Zone located directly above, and contiguous with the high-grade hanging wall of the PGM Zone.

name: AVENIRA
businessSummary: Avenira Limited is an Australia-based fertilizer focused project developer. The Company is developing the Wonarah Phosphate Project located in the Barkly region, Northern Territory, and exploring the Jundee South Project located in the north-eastern part of the Norseman Wiluna belt of the Archaean Craton in Western Australia. Wonarah Phosphate Project focuses on the development of Yellow Phosphate and aims to mine and process high-grade phosphate ore from its Tier 1, 100% owned Wonarah Phosphate Mine. The project is designed as a simple open-cut mining operation. The Jundee South Project covers operating gold projects including Jundee, Bronzewing and Darlot and contains more than a 60-kilometer strike of prospective greenstone stratigraphy. The Project area contains regional structures interpreted to control gold mineralization throughout the Yandal Greenstone Belt and contains a number of historically defined gold occurrences.

name: ALICE QUEEN
businessSummary: Alice Queen Limited is an Australia-based resources company engaged in developing gold and copper exploration and mining opportunities in Australia and Fiji. The Company’s projects include Sabeto, Viani, Mendooran and Boda East and Byrock and Gongolgon. The Sabeto project is located on the Sabeto range, which hosts the Vuda deposit to the west and Lion One Metals’ operating Tuvatu gold mine six km to the east. The Viani Project is located on Vanua Levu. Viani has the potential to host a high-grade vein style epithermal gold system. The Horn Island project is an intrusive related gold system (IRGS) located in the Torres Strait Queensland. Mendooran is located on the Lachlan Fold Belt in New South Wales and is prospective for a large-scale copper gold porphyry system. Boda East (Yarindury) is located adjacent to Alkane’s Boda and Kaiser porphyry copper gold deposits in the Lachlan Fold Belt and is also prospective for a large-scale copper gold porphyry system.

name: CADOUX
businessSummary: Cadoux Limited is an Australia-based resources company, which is focused on the exploration and development of critical and strategic mineral projects. The Company’s segments include high purity alumina exploration and evaluation in Australia and potash exploration and evaluation in Asia. Its project includes High Purity Alumina (HPA) and Rare earths. HPA is a processed non-metallurgical alumina product characterized by its purity level. HPA is used for its properties and characteristics, such as corrosion and scratch resistance, high brightness, and its ability to withstand extreme temperatures. HPA is also used as a base material in the manufacture of sapphire substrates for applications, such as light emitting diodes (LEDs), in the manufacture of artificial sapphire glass and in certain battery and power storage components, artificial gemstones and special space, aeronautical and medical applications. Its Rare-Earths are a set of 17 metallic elements.

name: AMERICAN RARE EARTHS
businessSummary: American Rare Earths Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals company. Through its wholly owned subsidiary, Wyoming Rare (USA) Inc., the Company is advancing the Halleck Creek Project in Wyoming, a rare earth deposit. The Halleck Creek Project is located in the Central Laramie Mountains, approximately 70 kilometers (km) northeast of Laramie, and 30 km southwest of Wheatland, Wyoming and covers over 3304 hectares (ha). Through its wholly owned subsidiary Wyoming Rare (USA) Inc., it controls approximately 367 unpatented lode mining claims and four Wyoming State Mineral Leases. Its 100% owned La Paz Rare Earth Project, which is located in La Paz County, Arizona, approximately 170 kilometers northwest of Phoenix. The La Paz Project covers over 2779 ha. Its projects also include Beaver Creek and Searchlight properties. The Searchlight Heavy Rare Earths Project is an exploration project located in a precious metal mining district in the eastern Mojave Desert Region.

name: CORE LITHIUM
businessSummary: Core Lithium Ltd is an Australia-based hard-rock lithium company. The Company owns the Finniss Lithium Operation on the Cox Peninsula, south-west and 88 kilometers (km) by sealed road from Darwin Port, Northern Territory. The Finniss Lithium Project includes mining, processing and export of high-grade lithium ore used in the manufacturing of batteries for electric vehicles and energy storage. The project includes Grants and BP33 deposits. The Grants Project comprises an open pit mine, waste rock dump, stockpiles, and established processing infrastructure. BP33 is an underground mine and is located in proximity to the Grants processing facility. Its other projects include Anningie and Barrow Creek Lithium, and Blueys-Inkheart. The Anningie and Barrow Creek encompass eight exploration licenses over approximately 2,000 square kilometers (km2) in and around the Anningie and Barrow Creek tin-tantalum pegmatite fields in the Northern Territory.

name: GLOBAL LITHIUM RESOURCES
businessSummary: Global Lithium Resources Limited is a diversified West Australian focused mining exploration company. The Company has multiple assets in key lithium branded jurisdictions with a primary focus on the 100%-owned Manna Lithium Project in the Goldfields and the Marble Bar Lithium Project (MBLP) in the Pilbara region, Western Australia. The Manna Lithium Project is an outcropping pegmatite exploration project located approximately 100 kilometers (km) east of Kalgoorlie in the Goldfields region of Western Australia. The tenements in Manna Lithium Project include E28/2551, E28/2522, M28/414, E28/3357, E28/3359,and others. The MBLP is located approximately 150 km south-east of Port Hedland and over 15 km north-east of Marble Bar in the Pilbara region of Western Australia. The tenements in MBLP include E45/4309, E45/4328, E45/4361, E45/4724, E45/4669, E45/5812, E45/5843, E45/5871, E56/5873, and E45/5869.

name: G11 RESOURCES
businessSummary: G11 Resources Limited is a gold and copper development and exploration company. Its projects include Koonenberry Project, Packsaddle, NW Cobar Project, and Sedgwick Bluff. Its Koonenberry Project is located approximately 80 kilometers (km) east of Broken Hill, New South Wales and covers an area of 3,300 square km, located within the Koonenberry Belt. The area is prospective for copper, gold, lead, silver, and other base metals. Koonenberry Project includes four distinct corridors: The Wilandra Corridor, The Cymbric Vale Corridor, The Wertago Corridor and The Bilpa Corridor. The Sedgwick Bluff Copper/Gold project is located along the strike of the Mount (Mt) Lyell copper-gold mine in the Mt Read Volcanic belt in Tasmania. The Packsaddle Gold/Copper (Au/Cu) project includes the untested Kings Hill anomaly in the Thomson Orogen of NW New South Wales targeting intrusive-related Cu/Au (IRCG) and Orogenic Au. The NW Cobar Copper project is targeting Cobar style base metal deposits.

name: ANDROMEDA METALS
businessSummary: Andromeda Metals Limited is an Australia-based industrial minerals company. The Company is engaged in the sustainable supply of industrial minerals and the advancement of nanotechnologies. The Company's Great White Project (GWP) contains several deposits containing a naturally occurring blend of halloysite tubes and kaolinite plates. The Great White Project is located within the District Council of Streaky Bay, near the community of Poochera on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. Its Mount Hope Kaolin Project is located 80 kilometers (km) northwest of Port Lincoln on the Eyre Peninsula in South Australia. The Company’s Eyre Kaolin Project is composed of four exploration tenements totaling 2,799 square kilometers on the Western Eyre Peninsula, South Australia. It is also advancing a High Purity Alumina (HPA) Project in South Australia, leveraging its proprietary low-carbon processing technology and using premium refined Great White kaolin product as a feedstock.

name: BERKELEY ENERGIA
businessSummary: Berkeley Energia Limited is a Spain-based mineral development company. The Company's main focus is bringing its wholly owned Salamanca project into production in a uranium mining area in western Spain. It's activity provides exploration and production with the objective of supplying nuclear energy sector.

name: ROKEBY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Rokeby Resources Limited, formerly Inca Minerals Limited, is a junior resource company. It is focused on gold-copper porphyry deposits, SEDEX style deposits and iron ore-copper-gold deposits and has secured projects that are prospective for lithium. Its 100% owned Hurricane Project is located over 125 kilometers (km) northwest of Cairns, the Hurricane Project comprises three granted exploration tenements spanning 49 square kilometers (km2). The project is prospective for high-grade gold and antimony mineralization hosted in undrilled vein structures. The MaCauley Creek Project is located 100 km west of Townsville in Queensland. It consists of two granted exploration permits (EPM 27124 and EPM 27163) covering over 359 km2 and it lies within the Townsville-Mornington Island porphyry belt. The Jean Elson Project is located over 325 km east of Alice Springs in the Northern Territory and 30 km north of its Lorna May Project. It also includes the Frewena projects and Stunalara portfolio.

name: GREEN TECHNOLOGY METALS
businessSummary: Green Technology Metals Limited is focused on the lithium exploration and development business. The Company’s main 100% owned Ontario lithium projects comprise high-grade, hard rock spodumene assets (Seymour, Root, Junior and Wisa) and lithium exploration claims (Allison, Falcon, Gathering, Pennock and Superb) located on prospective Archean Greenstone tenure in north-west Ontario, Canada. The Seymour Project is located near the township of Armstrong and approximately 230 kilometers (km) north of the city and the port of Thunder Bay. Its Junior Lithium Project covers over 10,856 hectares and is situated within the Eastern Hub, close to the proposed Seymour mine and concentrator. The Company’s 100% owned Root Lithium Project has revealed multiple stacked LCT pegmatites, and a maiden Inferred Mineral Resource estimate of over 14.6Mt @ 1.21% lithium oxide from the McCombe and Root Bay pegmatites. Its subsidiaries include Lithium Triangle Pty Ltd and Green TM Resources (Canada) Ltd.

name: ESTRELLA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Estrella Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is focused on the exploration and development of nickel projects. The Company’s projects include the Carr Boyd Nickel Project and the Spargoville Project. The Carr Boyd Nickel Project covers the Carr Boyd Layered Complex, 75 square kilometers (km2) mafic igneous complex which hosts several nickel and copper sulfide occurrences. The Carr Boyd Layered Complex is in a Tier 1 jurisdiction approximately 80 kilometers (km) north-north-east of Kalgoorlie, Western Australia. Carr Boyd Nickel Project, north of Kalgoorlie in Western Australia, is a focus for the Company-where it has recently made a nickel and copper discovery while drilling into the T5 electromagnetic target. Its two-reverse circulation (RC) drill holes, CBP042 and CBP043, were completed to test the T5 EM conductor plate. The Spargoville Project is located approximately 20 km southwest of Kambalda, Western Australia.

name: ENCOUNTER RESOURCES
businessSummary: Encounter Resources Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on discovering major copper and niobium/ rare earth element (REE) deposits in Australia. It controls a portfolio of 100% owned projects in Australia's exciting mineral provinces that are prospective for copper and critical minerals. It has numerous large scale copper projects being advanced in partnership and funded through farm-in agreements with miners: South32 and IGO. Its projects include Aileron Critical Minerals Project, Sandover Copper Project, Beetaloo Basin Copper Projects, Junction Lithium Project, Irwin REE Projects, Lamil Copper-Gold Project, Jessica and Carrara Copper-Zinc Projects, Yeneena Copper Project and Elliott Copper Project. The 100% owned Aileron project covers around 1,765 square kilometers and is located in the West Arunta region of Western Australia. The Jessica and Carrara projects are being explored in partnership with South32 under farm-in agreements.

name: STRATEGIC ELEMENTS
businessSummary: Strategic Elements Limited is an Australia-based pooled development fund (PDF). The Company’s segment includes Resources and Technology. The Company is managed primarily on the basis of its exploration projects (Resource segment) and research and development of the energy ink cell and robotics and AI solutions (technology segment). Its ventures include Australian Advanced Materials, Stealth Technologies and Other ventures. Energy Ink is a renewable energy technology that generates electrical energy from moisture in the air to power a device directly or provide energy for battery storage. Stealth Technologies is focused on developing autonomous security vehicles (ASV) for perimeter security. Stealth Technologies has also systematically advanced the application of key components of its ASV technology to develop a new product application.

name: ELEVATE URANIUM
businessSummary: Elevate Uranium Ltd is an Australia-based uranium exploration and development company. The Company is engaged in the exploration and evaluation of its mineral tenements in Namibia and Australia. Its flagship Namibian portfolio is located in the Erongo uranium province and includes the Koppies Uranium Project and the Marenica Uranium Project. The Koppies tenement (EPL 6987) is located in the Namib Desert region of Namibia. The Marenica Uranium Project (MDRL 3287) covers 321 square kilometers in the Erongo region of Namibia. Its Australian Uranium Projects include Napperby Uranium Project, Fitton Uranium project, and Entia uranium projects. Its Napperby uranium project, located approximately 150 kilometers (km) northwest of Alice Springs, along the sealed Tanami Road. The Fitton project is located in the Flinders Ranges of South Australia, 500 km north of Adelaide in a proven uranium province, within 25 km of the Beverley Uranium Mine and the Four Mile Uranium Mine.

name: NEXUS MINERALS
businessSummary: Nexus Minerals Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is engaged in mineral exploration in Australia. It has a portfolio of gold projects. Its projects include Wallbrook Gold Project, Pinnacles Joint Venture Gold Project, Jamieson Minerals New South Wales (NSW) Lithium-Caesium-Tantalum (LCT) Project, Pinnacles Regional Gold Project, and Bethanga Porphyry Copper-Gold Project. The Wallbrook Gold Project is located approximately 140 kilometers (km) northeast of Kalgoorlie in the Eastern Goldfields. The Pinnacles Joint Venture Gold Project covers over 125 square kilometers (km2) and is located approximately 100 km northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Pinnacles Regional Gold Project covers over 125 km2, located 100 km Northeast of Kalgoorlie. The Bethanga Porphyry Copper-Gold Project site is located over 300 km northeast of Melbourne and 30 km east of the regional center of Albury Wodonga.

name: TURNSTONE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Turnstone Resources Ltd, formerly South Harz Potash Limited, is an Australia-based company focused in building a diversified critical minerals asset base. The Glava-Klinten Project is located in the eastern extensions of the Proterozoic Grenville Orogenic Belt, an emerging copper-gold exploration district extending through Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, Greenland and Newfoundland. The Glava-Klinten Project comprises Glava 100, Glava 200, Glava 300, and Klinten 100. The Torsby West Project is located over 40 kilometers (km) north of the Glava Region, the Torsby West Project covers 63 square kilometers across a 25 km structurally controlled copper-gold-cobalt belt mineralization corridor. The Torsby West Project comprises three exploration licenses Mangens 100, Bockgruvan 100, and Kyrkskogen 100. It holds three perpetual potash mining licenses, Ohmgebirge, Ebeleben, and Muhlhausen-Nohra.

name: VRX SILICA
businessSummary: VRX Silica Limited is an Australia-based silica sand company. The Company is focused on developing its 100% owned silica sand projects at Arrowsmith (North, Brand and Central), Muchea and Boyatup in Western Australia. The Arrowsmith project includes Arrowsmith North, Brand Silica and Central Silica Sand projects, all located approximately 270 kilometers (km) north of Perth, Western Australia. Its 100%-owned Muchea Mining Lease is located approximately 50 km north of Perth, Western Australia. Muchea comprises one granted exploration license, two exploration license applications, one granted mining lease, three granted miscellaneous licenses and one miscellaneous license application for an area of 74.4 km2. The Company’s 100%-owned Boyatup Silica Sand Project is located about 125km east of Esperance in Western Australia and is connected by sealed road to the Esperance Port. Boyatup includes two tenements, E69/3560 and E69/3668, for a total project area of 124 km2.

name: ENERGY WORLD
businessSummary: Energy World Corporation Limited is an Australia-based independent energy company, primarily engaged in the production and sale of power, and development of liquefied natural gas (LNG) projects. The Company operates through four segments: Oil and Gas in Australia, Oil and Gas in Indonesia, Power in Indonesia, and Project Development. The Company’s operations are in three countries: Philippines, Indonesia, and Australia. Its Philippines operations is engaged in the development of the LNG Hub terminal in the Philippines and development of 650 megawatts (MW) combined cycle gas fired power plant. Its Indonesia operations include a 315 MW Senkang combined cycle gas fired power plant, development of a 2 million tons per annum (mtpa) LNG liquification plant and Sengkang gas field. Its Australia operations include ownership interests in various gas fields, development of a 56,000 tpa LNG Liquification plant, an 8 MW Alice Springs power plant, and Alice Springs LNG plant.

name: APOLLO MINERALS
businessSummary: Apollo Minerals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company. The Company is focused on the discovery and development of substantial near-surface gold mineralization at the Company’s Salanie Gold Project within its 100% owned Keri permit in Gabon. It also owns the near surface zinc-lead, Kroussou Project in Gabon. The Salanie Gold Project is located 16 kilometers (km) from the town of Lambarene and lies within the Company’s 100% owned Keri Permit (G4-456). The Kroussou project is located in south-west Gabon on the central west African coast. The project exploration permit is 100% owned by the Company, located approximately 220 km south of the capital Libreville within the Ngounie Province. The Project consists of two exploration permits (G4-569 and G4-456) which cover over 2,363 square kilometers (km2) and have 135 km of strike length along the prospective contact between the Cretaceous Cotier Basin to the west and Archean/Proterozoic basement to the east.

name: VITAL METALS
businessSummary: Vital Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is primarily focused on developing and exploring the Nechalacho Rare Earth and Niobium Project in Northwest Territories, Canada. The Nechalacho Project is located in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories (NWT), Canada. The Company is advancing the Tardiff deposit at its Nechalacho project in NWT, Canada. Tardiff is a large-scale deposit, representing one of the single rare earth systems in the Western world. Its subsidiaries include Nechalacho Resources Corp, Cheetah Resources Pty Ltd, and NWT Rare Earths Ltd.

name: LAKE RESOURCES NL
businessSummary: Lake Resources NL is an Australia-based lithium developer utilising ion exchange extraction technology for production of sustainable, high purity lithium from the Company's flagship Kachi Project in Catamarca Province within the Lithium Triangle in Argentina. The Company also has an additional early-stage project in this region, the Ancasti or Catamarca Pegmatite Lithium Project.

name: ARCHER MATERIALS
businessSummary: Archer Materials Limited is a quantum technology company building advanced semiconductor devices for quantum computing, quantum sensing, and medical diagnostics. The Company principal activities include technology research and development of the carbon nano onion quantum material (12CQ Project), tunnelling magnetoresistance (TMR) sensor project and graphene-based lab-on-a-chip biosensing chip (biochip) and utilizing semiconductor technology development infrastructure and facilities, research, and development to support technology research and development. The Company is focused on developing its biochip technology, including identifying and developing testing for blood potassium levels, for its first target of hypo- and hyperkalemia detection in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients. Its biochip marks an inflection point in diagnostics, enabling fast, accurate, and low-cost digital testing.

name: JUPITER ENERGY
businessSummary: Jupiter Energy Limited is an oil exploration and production company. The Company is focused on developing its onshore assets in Western Kazakhstan. The Company holds 100% of the Block 31 permit, located in the oil rich Mangistau Basin, close to the port city of Aktau. Block 31 is approximately 123 square kilometers in size and the entire permit covers an area of proven oil production. It has its operations based in the port city of Aktau, which is located around 80 kilometers from Block 31. Three oilfields have been discovered on the permit area - West Zhetybai, Akkar East and Akkar North (East Block). Both Akkar East and Akkar North (East Block) oilfields operated under the Full Commercial Licenses and the West Zhetybai oilfield operated under the Preparatory Period of its Commercial License. The Company sells its products through a variety of sales channels, including both the domestic and export oil markets. It has cumulative production at around 90 tons (675 barrels) per day.

name: SARAMA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Sarama Resources Ltd. is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company's principal business is to explore for and develop mineral deposits. The Company holds 32% interest in Riedel Resources Limited. The Company is also focusing on the arbitration claim against the Government of Burkina Faso.

name: ECLIPSE METALS
