businessSummary: Eclipse Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration company focused on exploring south-western Greenland, Northern Territory and Queensland for multicommodity mineralization. The Company has a portfolio of assets prospective for cryolite, fluorite, siderite, quartz, rare earth elements (REE), gold, platinum group metals, manganese, palladium, vanadium and uranium mineralization. Its Ivigtut Project within mineral exploration license MEL2007-45 in southwest Greenland hosts the Ivigtut cryolite mine and a range of undeveloped mineral deposits. The Company holds two granted exploration licenses and six exploration license applications in the Ngalia Basin, with a combined area of approximately 7,550 square kilometers (km2) situated within this uranium mineralized region. The Devil’s Elbow uranium-gold-palladium prospect in the Northern Territory is covered by EL27584. Its tenements also include the Amamoor Manganese Project, Cusack's Bore Uranium Project and Yuendi Copper Project.

name: CORAZON MINING
businessSummary: Corazon Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company’s focus is on nickel, gold, copper and cobalt. The Company's primary focus is the exploration and advancement of its West Australian gold portfolio, located in the highly prospective Gascoyne Region. This portfolio consists of two key projects: Feather Cap Gold Project and Two Pools Gold Project. Its other projects include Mt Gilmore Copper-Gold-Cobalt Project and Lynn Lake Nickel-Copper-Cobalt-Project (Lynn Lake). The Two Pools Gold Project is located within the proven Plutonic-Marymia Greenstone Belt. The Feather Cap gold Project is a potential asset located within the Bryah-Padbury Basin, part of the Capricorn Orogen in Western Australia. The Project is situated in a proven mineral province that hosts significant gold and base metal deposits. The Lynn Lake Project in Manitoba, Canada, is a significant Class-1 nickel resource.

name: NEURIZON THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Neurizon Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in advancing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases. It is developing its lead drug candidate, NUZ-001, for the treatment of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), which is the common form of motor neurone disease. ALS treatments for patients while exploring the potential of NUZ-001 for broader neurodegenerative applications. ALS is a devastating neurodegenerative condition that primarily affects nerve cells that control voluntary muscles. Through international collaborations and rigorous clinical programs, it is focused on creating new horizons for patients and families impacted by complex neural disorders.

name: DOTZ NANO
businessSummary: Dotz Nano Limited is an Australia-based developer of climate and industrial nanotechnologies. The principal activities of the Company include developing, manufacturing and commercializing customized nanomaterial-based solutions. Its primary focus is centered around carbon management technologies as enablers of carbon neutrality. The Company’s two main areas of focus are: in-product tagging technology, commercial solution for corrosion inhibitor monitoring for the oil and gas industry, and next generation sorbent materials for Direct Air Capture and Point Source Carbon Dioxide (CO2) Mitigation. Point-Source Capture technology is designed, using durable carbon-based and polymeric materials, to ensure consistent, high performance CO2 capture. Direct Air Capture (DAC) Sorbent Technology includes Modified DAC Sorbents which are engineered to deliver CO2 working capacity through advanced chemical absorption.

name: TRITON MINERALS
businessSummary: Triton Minerals Limited is an Australia-based mining exploration and development company. The Company is focused on graphite projects. It holds a 30% economic interest in Grafex Limitada (Grafex). Its flagship Ancuabe Project is located adjacent to the producing AMG Graphit Kropfmuhl (GK) graphite mine. The project is approximately 80 kilometers (km) by sealed road from an operating container port in Pemba. Grafex comprises over four exploration licenses, EL5305, EL5380, EL5365 and EL5304. The Company has also granted a mining concession for the Cobra Plains Graphite Project located in northern Mozambique, within Neoproterozoic rocks of the Xixano Complex. The Company holds a 100% beneficial interest in Cobra Plains miming concession (MC11548 C). Its project portfolio includes flake graphite deposits and flake size, purity, distribution and significant exploration upside. It also holds an interest in the Aucu Gold and Copper Project in Tete Province, Mozambique.

name: DESOTO RESOURCES
businessSummary: DeSoto Resources Limited is an Australia-based exploration company with gold, rare earth and base metal Projects in Guinea (Siguiri Basin) and the Northern Territory, Australia. The Company’s projects include Fenix Lithium Gold Project, Fenton Gold Project, and Spectrum rare earth elements (REE) Project. Fenix Lithium Gold Project has over 345 square kilometers of land position in a prolific mineral region. The Fenix Lithium Gold Project has three 100%-owned and granted tenements located within the Pine Creek Pegmatite Field. The Fenton Gold Project has three 100%-owned and granted tenements and three 100%-owned applications. The Spectrum REE Project includes Quantum REE-Au-Ag Prospect and Vesper Base-Metals Prospect. Vesper Base-Metals Prospect is located 1.5 kilometers (km) from Quantum REE Prospect. Its Siguiri projects include Dadjan, Koba, Kassa Est, Mini, Yarakoura, Doutila, Moussaya, Dabidiana, Falama, Moiko, Alamakono, among others.

name: TAMBORAN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Tamboran Resources Corporation is an Australia-based independent natural gas exploration and production company. The Company is focused on an integrated approach to the commercial development of the natural gas resources in the Beetaloo Basin located within the Northern Territory of Australia. Through its subsidiaries, the Company holds approximately 2.8 million net prospective acres and is an acreage holder in the Beetaloo Basin depocenter. The Company and its subsidiaries hold prospective acreage positions, including Northern Pilot Area, Southern Pilot Area, Orion Area, Beetaloo Central Development Area (BCDA), Retention Lease (RL) 10, North Beetaloo, Southeast Beetaloo, Northwest Beetaloo, Southern Development Area, South Beetaloo, Northeast Beetaloo, EP 161, and EP 136. Northern Pilot Area (44.38%) covers approximately 20,239 acres. Southern Pilot Area (44.38%) covers around 20,230 acres. Orion Area (78%) covers approximately 493,229 acres. EP 161 (25%) covers around 512,000 acres.

name: TARUGA MINERALS
businessSummary: Taruga Minerals Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on acquiring and developing gold, copper and precious metals exploration projects in Australia. Its projects include the Gascoyne Project, Mt Craig Copper Project, Flinders Iron-Oxide-Copper-Gold (IOCG) Project, Meekatharra Magmatic Ni-Cu Project and Torrens IOCG Project. The Company’s Gascoyne Project consists of four contiguous exploration licenses, E08/3245, E08/3733, E08/3734 and E08/3752, covering 416.5 square kilometers (km2) in the prospective Gascoyne province of Western Australia. The Mt Craig Copper Project includes exploration licenses EL 6541, EL 6695 and EL 6829, covering over 1,712km2 centered around a major structure, the Worumba Anticline. The Company holds an approximately 20% interest in the Meekatharra Project, which includes exploration license E51/1832, located 30km southeast of the regional center of Meekatharra in the Murchison region of Western Australia.

name: ELEMENTOS
businessSummary: Elementos Limited is an Australia-based tin company with development assets in mining jurisdictions in Andalucia, Spain and Tasmania, Australia. The Company is focused on developing both the Oropesa Tin Project in Andalucia, Spain and the Cleveland Tin Project in Tasmania, Australia. The Oropesa Tin Project is located in the Guadiato Valley, in the Province of Cordoba, within the Andalucia autonomous region, Spain. The Oropesa Tin Project consists of approximately 13 square kilometers, located approximately 75 kilometers (km) north-west of city of Cordoba and 180km north-east of the capital of Seville in southern Spain. The Cleveland Tin Project is located approximately 80km southwest of Burnie in the mineral-rich northwest region of Tasmania, Australia. Its subsidiaries are Rockwell Minerals Pty Ltd, Rockwell Minerals (Tasmania) Pty Ltd, Elementos Minerales S.A., Elementos Spain Pty Ltd, and others.

name: ECOGRAF
businessSummary: EcoGraf Limited is an Australia-based integrated battery anode materials developer. The Company is engaged in building a diversified battery anode material business to produce high-purity graphite products for the lithium-ion battery and advanced manufacturing markets. In Tanzania, it is developing the TanzGraphite natural flake graphite business, commencing with the Epanko Graphite Project, to provide a scalable supply of feedstock for EcoGraf battery anode material processing facilities, together with quality flake graphite products for specialized industrial applications. Using its EcoGraf HFfree purification technology, the Company seeks to upgrade the flake graphite to produce 99.95%C high performance battery anode material to supply electric vehicle, battery and anode manufacturers in Asia, Europe and North America. The Company’s EcoGraf purification process recycles battery anode materials to support customers to reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and lower battery costs.

name: BATTERY AGE MINERALS
businessSummary: Battery Age Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company which is focused on the exploration of battery minerals, such as germanium, gallium, gold, silver and lithium across Austria, Argentina and Canada. Its segments include Australia, Canada, Argentina, Austria, and Morocco. Its projects include Bleiberg Zinc Lead Germanium Project, Austria, El Aguila Gold & Silver Project, Argentina, and Falcon Lake Lithium Project, Canada. The Bleiberg Project is in Carinthia, Austria. The El Aguila Project covers three contiguous license blocks in the Santa Cruz Province, Argentina’s region for gold and silver mining. El Aguila Gold & Silver Project covers 9,124 hectares, adjacent to five active gold and silver mines in Argentina’s mining province. The Falcon Lake Project area is located over 325 km North-northeast of Thunder Bay, Ontario, which is the closest port of Lake Superior for seaboard access. The Project area is located over 75 km northeast of Armstrong, Ontario.

name: CORE ENERGY MINERALS
businessSummary: CORE Energy Minerals Limited is an exploration and development company. The Company is focused on building and developing a portfolio of battery and critical minerals assets. The Company’s projects include Brazilian Uranium & Rare Earth Projects, Namibia Uranium Projects, and other projects. The Brazilian Uranium & Rare Earth Project covers a combined area of approximately 800 square kilometers (km2) of prospective ground across Paraiba, Parana, Goias and Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The Brazilian Uranium & Rare Earth Project includes the Amorinopolis Uranium Project, and Grande Uranium Project. Namibian Uranium Projects comprise a 100% interest in two uranium projects within the highly prospective Erongo region: Gemsbok (EPL9725) and Oryx (EPL9652). Namibia Uranium Projects include Gemsbok Uranium Project, Oryx Uranium Project, and Erongo region. The other projects include the Oar Graphite Project and Douglas Canyon Project.

name: DEEP YELLOW
businessSummary: Deep Yellow Limited is an Australia-based uranium mining company. Its projects include the Namibian project portfolio comprises of Tumas Project, Omahola Projects, Nova joint venture (JV) Project, Yellow Dune JV Project, Mulga Rock Project, and Alligator River Project. The Tumas Project comprises a series of palaeochannel/calcrete-type uranium deposits. Omahola Project is located within the prospective Alaskite Alley corridor, within which uranium deposits, including Rossing, Husab, Etango and Valencia are located. The Nova joint venture (JV) Project includes two exclusive prospecting licenses (EPL) prospective for both basement and palaeochannel-type uranium mineralization. The Yellow Dune JV comprises one mineral deposit retention license (MDRL) covering a drilled-out uranium resource of the palaeochannel/calcrete-type at Aussinanis. The Mulga Rock consists of two separate mining areas over a total length of 30 kilometers.

name: 88 ENERGY
businessSummary: 88 Energy Limited is an Australia-based oil and gas exploration company with a North American focus. The Company's projects include South Prudhoe, Kad River East, Phoenix and Namibia. The South Prudhoe project’s lease position covers approximately 52,269 acres within one of the prolific hydrocarbon fairways on the North Slope, immediately south of the Prudhoe Bay Unit and Kuparuk River Unit. The South Prudhoe project offers multiple prospects within the conventional Ivishak reservoir. The Kad River East project comprises seven leases covering approximately 17,920 gross acres east of the Trans Alaska Pipeline System (TAPS). The Phoenix project is an advanced conventional project on the North Slope of Alaska. The Company has approximately 74.3% working interest in Phoenix project. The Company holds an approximately 20% non-operated interest in PEL 93 in the Owambo Basin, onshore Namibia, under a three-stage farm in arrangement to earn up to a total of 45% working interest.

name: SUPERIOR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Superior Resources Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploring for large copper, nickel-copper-cobalt-PGE, lead-zinc-silver and gold deposits in northern Queensland. It is focused on the exploration for copper-gold and magmatic nickel sulphide deposits in northern Queensland, Australia. Its projects include Greenvale Project, Nicholson Project, and Victor Project. The Greenvale Project is situated in North Queensland and fully owned by Superior, stands as the northernmost stretch of the Ordovician Macquarie Arc, dubbed the Lucky Creek Corridor. The Nicholson Project is located in the Carpentaria Zinc Province of north-west Queensland. The Victor Project encompasses four exploration permits that collectively span 438 square kilometers situated within the Carpentaria Zinc Province in northwest Queensland. The Victor Project is located 150 kilometers north-west of the prolific Mount Isa Mine. It also holds 100% interest in Hedleys Uranium Project.

name: CARNABY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Carnaby Resources Limited is an exploration and development company. The Company is focused on copper and gold projects in the Mount Isa Inlier of Queensland and the Pilbara’s Mallina Basin and Yilgarn Margin of Western Australia. Its flagship Greater Duchess Copper Gold Project is located approximately 70km southeast of Mount Isa in Queensland and centered around the historical Duchess copper mining district. The Greater Duchess Copper Gold project encompasses 1,921 square kilometers (km2) of Iron Oxide Copper-Gold (IOCG) prospective tenure, including its Mount Hope, Nil Desperandum and Lady Fanny deposits. The Company’s Pilbara Gold and Lithium Projects comprise the Strelley, Mt Grant and Goldsworthy Gold Projects and the Big Hill Lithium Project. Each of these projects are located in the prospective Mallina Basin of Western Australia, northeast of the Hemi gold deposit of De Grey Mining Ltd. Its Yilgarn Margin Projects comprise the Malmac and Throssel Projects.

name: AMARA MINERALS
businessSummary: Amara Minerals Limited, formerly Adelong Gold Limited, is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company is advancing towards gold production at its flagship Adelong Goldfield Project in New South Wales (NSW) and the Apollo Gold Project in Victoria. It also holds a prospective lithium portfolio in Brazil. The Adelong Goldfield Project spans 70 square kilometers and hosts a 188,000oz resource, with the potential for expansion at depth and along strike. The project includes multiple deposits, with the Perkins West deposit at Gibraltar. The Apollo Gold Project, covered by EL006430, encompasses approximately 102 square kilometers at the under-explored northern end of the Walhalla Gold Belt, situated about 120 kilometers northeast of Melbourne, Victoria. Its lithium projects are the Santa Rita do Aracuai Lithium Project and the Paraiba Province Lithium Project. It also has an agreement to acquire a 100% legal and beneficial interest in the Lauriston Gold Project in Victoria.

name: STRIKE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Strike Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company owns the high-grade Apurimac Iron Ore Project in Peru. Its principal activities include the development of a small-scale direct shipping Iron Ore (DSO) operation in relation to the Apurimac Iron Ore Project. The Apurimac Iron Ore project is located in the Southern Highlands of Peru, which has concessions totaling approximately 72,800 hectares. Apurimac Iron Ore project contains a JORC mineral resource of 269 metric tons of Iron ore at Opaban of 57.3% Iron. The Company's mineralization include Iron, Silica, Alumina, Phosphorus, and Sulphur.

name: AMERICAN URANIUM
businessSummary: American Uranium Limited, formerly GTI Energy Limited, is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in exploring mineral tenements in the United States of America, including Utah and Wyoming. The Company's projects include Wyoming in situ recovery (ISR) and the Henry Mountains. The Wyoming in situ recovery (ISR) project includes Lo Herma, Great Divide Basin (GDB) and Green Mountain. The Lo Herma ISR Uranium Project is located in Converse County, Powder River Basin (PRB), Wyoming (WY). The Project lies approximately 15 miles north of the town of Glenrock and within 60 miles of five permitted ISR uranium production facilities. The Thor, Teebo, Odin, Loki and Wicket prospects (GDB Prospects) are located within Wyoming’s Great Divide Basin (GDB) Uranium District in Sweetwater County, Wy. The Company has land holdings in the Henry Mountains region of Utah, which include uranium and vanadium mineralization, generally shallow at 20-30 meters average depth.

name: CARAVEL MINERALS
businessSummary: Caravel Minerals Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in the exploration of mineral tenements in Western Australia. The Company's Caravel Copper Project is located 150 kilometers north-east of Perth in Western Australia's Wheatbelt region. The Project has a Mineral Resource Estimate of 3.03 million tons of contained copper and an Ore Reserve of 1.4 million tons. The project is in the Southwest Native Title Settlement Area of Western Australia where all residual Native Title rights and interests have been settled by agreement between the State of Western Australia and Noongar Groups. The Company's other projects include Mt William, Dalwallinu, Brookton, Gillingarra, Caravel Copper, Mukinbudin, Burakin, and Cadoux.

name: SHEFFIELD RESOURCES
businessSummary: Sheffield Resources Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in mineral sands evaluation and development in Australia and mineral sands evaluation in Brazil. The Company’s operating segments include South Atlantic project, Thunderbird project, and Other. The South Atlantic project consists of mineral sands tenements located in Southeast Brazil. The Thunderbird project consists of mineral sands tenements located in the Canning Basin that form part of the Thunderbird mineral sand mining operation held by Thunderbird Operations Pty Ltd, a subsidiary of Kimberley Mineral Sands Pty Ltd (KMS). The South Atlantic Project is located within the Rio Grande do Sul Coastal Plain, a region located in the southernmost state of Brazil, Rio Grande do Sul, along the coast of the Atlantic Ocean. The Thunderbird Mineral Sand Project lies 70 kilometers (km) west of Derby and 30 km north of the sealed Great Northern Highway (GNH) joining Derby and Broome.

name: STRICKLAND METALS
businessSummary: Strickland Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company operates in four projects. Its Rogozna Gold and Base Metals Project is located in the Raska District of southern Serbia, covering approximately 184 square kilometers (km2) and comprises four exploration licenses. The Rogozna Gold and Base Metals Project, located in the Raska District of southern Serbia, lies within the globally significant Tethyan Metallogenic Belt, which hosts multiple, giant, porphyry-related deposits. The project comprises four exploration licenses covering approximately 184 square kilometers (km2). Its Iroquois Project is located directly along strike Earaheedy Project Chinook zinc-lead discovery. Its Bryah Basin project lies within the Gascoyne region of Western Australia, approximately 90 kilometers north of Meekatharra. The Bryah Basin Project lies at the center of the basin and is prospective for copper-gold mineralization akin to that at Sandfire's DeGrussa Project.

name: AMERICAN WEST METALS
businessSummary: American West Metals Limited is an Australia-based clean energy mining company. The Company is focused on the discovery and development of base metal mineral deposits in North America. Its projects include Storm Copper Project, Seal Project, West Desert, and Copper Warrior. The Storm Copper Project is located on Somerset Island, Nunavut, Canada and spans approximately 2,200 square kilometers in Polaris mineral district. The West Desert project is located in west-central Utah, over 160 kilometers (km) southwest of Salt Lake City. The Copper Warrior project is located over 45 km south of Moab, Utah, within the Paradox Basin, with sedimentary sequence of Vanadium, Uranium and Copper. The project lies along the Lisbon Valley Fault and within the same geological units as the Lisbon Valley copper mine. The Seal Project is located within the Storm Project claims, at the northern end of a regionally extensive zinc horizon.

name: GLOBAL GOLD MINING
businessSummary: Global Gold Mining Ltd, formerly MetalsTech Limited, is an Australia-based gold exploration company. The Company’s principal activity is the mineral exploration at the Sturec gold exploration project. The Company’s project includes Sturec Gold Mine, Slovakia. The Company’s 100% owned Kremnica Mining License covers approximately nine square kilometers. Its significant exploration upside exists along strike of the Sturec resources as well as down dip/plunge of the existing ore. It produced over 1.5 million ounces (Moz) of gold and 6.7 Moz of silver. The Sturec project remains the flagship project of the Company hosting a Joint Ore Reserves Committee (2012) Measured, indicated and inferred resource of over 2.7 million ounces of gold. The Company’s subsidiaries include Ortac Resources (UK) Ltd, Ortac s.r.o., and St Stephans Gold s.r.o.

name: ANTIPA MINERALS
businessSummary: Antipa Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company engaged in discovering gold-copper-silver deposits in the highly prospective Paterson Province of Western Australia. Its tenement holding covers over 4,100 square kilometers (km2) situated within an underexplored gold-copper-silver-cobalt province. It has three growth projects, such as the Wilki Project, Paterson Project and Citadel JV Project. The Wilki Project comprises approximately 1,430km2 in total landholding and is located on the southern portion of its tenement ground in the Paterson Province of Western Australia. The 1,520 km2 Paterson Project is situated within 22 kilometers (km) of Greatland's Telfer gold-copper-silver mine and 22Mtpa mineral processing facility, 8km from Rio Tinto-Sumitomo's Winu copper gold-silver development project. The Citadel JV Project is located within 5km, adjoining the Antipa's Paterson Project.

name: ADALTA
businessSummary: AdAlta Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company uses its i-body platform to discover and develop protein therapeutics addressing drug targets that are challenging for other technologies. The Company's first-in-class lead asset, AD-214, is being developed for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other fibrotic diseases, for which current therapies are sub-optimal. AD-214 is an Fc-Fusion protein that contains two AD-114 i-body molecules at the front end, that bind with high affinity to the human target, CXCR4. It is also engaged in developing i-body enabled Chimeric antigen receptor T cell (CAR-T) cells. It co-develops i-bodies as diagnostic imaging agents (i-PET imaging) against Granzyme B, a biomarker of response to immuno-oncology drugs.

name: GREENX METALS
businessSummary: GreenX Metals Limited is focused on the exploration of Tannenberg Copper Project and the Arctic Rift Copper (ARC) Project. The Tannenberg Copper Project is a copper brownfield exploration project which is highly prospective for sediment-hosted (Kupferschiefer type) copper deposits. It holds an over 90% interest in the Tannenberg exploration license, which covers over 1900 square kilometers in the state of Hesse in central Germany, encompassing the Richelsdorf copper-silver mines. The ARC project is the copper-silver bearing Discovery Zone, located at the northern end of Neergaard Dal. The Discovery Zone comprises three parallel breccia faults trending northwest-southeast. Mineralization is expressed in two main forms, within which there are two sub-forms: Breccia bound, and Stratiform. In Breccia bound, mineralization occurs in thin quartz. In Stratiform, mineralization occurs immediately adjacent to the faults. Its Eleonore North project in Greenland is located in Eastern Greenland.

name: AUREKA
businessSummary: Aureka Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company holds a portfolio of advanced stage gold exploration projects across Victoria. Its projects include Stawell Corridor, St Arnaud Gold, and Jubilee Gold. The Stawell Corridor Project (which incorporates the Irvine and Langi Logan gold projects and five other prospective targets) captures 60 kilometers (km) of a multi-million-ounce gold zone. Jubilee Gold is a highly prospective exploration project consisting of a single tenement of 122 square kilometers located 25 km south-west of Ballarat, Victoria. Its tenements encompass the historical St Arnaud Goldfield and its associated mines, including the Comstock Open Pit. It owns a 49% contributing interest in the Tandarra Gold Project, which contains three main prospects: Tomorrow, Macnaughtan and Lawry located only 50km northwest of Agnico Eagle’s world-class Fosterville Gold Mine, and 40km north of the 22-million-ounce Bendigo Goldfield.

name: AUSGOLD
businessSummary: Ausgold Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration and development company. The Company’s flagship project is the Katanning Gold Project, located approximately 275 kilometers (km) south-east of Perth and approximately 40km north-east of the wheatbelt town of Katanning. The tenements cover over 5,500 square kilometers (km2) of the Katanning Greenstone Belt in the south-west corner of the Yilgarn Craton, which hosts some of Australia’s gold deposits. Its portfolio also includes the Doolgunna Station Cu-Au project and the Yamarna Ni-Cu-Co project in Western Australia and the Cracow Au Project in Queensland. The Doolgunna Station Project is located over 150 km north-east of Meekatharra in Western Australia’s Bryah Basin and approximately 13km to the west of, and along trend from, Sandfire Resources’ Degrussa copper-gold operation. The Yamarna Project is located approximately 125 km north-east of Laverton in central Western Australia on Exploration Licenses E38/2129 and ELA 38/3311.

name: COBRE
businessSummary: Cobre Limited is a dual-hub copper company focused on high-margin production in Chile and tier-1 exploration in the Kalahari Copper Belt (KCB), Botswana. It owns 100% of a land package of highly prospective copper and silver exploration tenements in the Kalahari Copper Belt (KCB). Its projects include Sierra Atacama Project, Ngami Copper Project, Kitlanya West Copper Project, Kitlanya East Copper Silver Project, Okavango Copper Project, and Perrinvale Project. The Perrinvale Project is located over 260 kilometers (km) NW of Kalgoorlie in the Yilgarn Craton of Western Australia. Its Sierra Atacama Copper Project is an operating underground copper mine and heap leach, solvent extraction and electrowinning plant in the Antofagasta Region of northern Chile. The Kitlanya West Copper Projectt straddles the northern margin of the KCB including an estimated 500km of prospective D’Kar / Ngwako Pan Formation contact with additional potential for fold-hinge and doubly plunging fold trap-sites.

name: BLACKSTONE MINERALS
businessSummary: Blackstone Minerals Limited is a Canada-based mineral exploration company. The Company focuses on advancing the Mankayan Copper-Gold Project in the Philippines, including initiating a pre-feasibility study (PFS). It operates through two segments, which include Philippines exploration and Canada exploration. The Philippines exploration offers copper and gold at the Mankayan Copper-Gold Project. The Canada Exploration offers the Gold Bridge Project in British Columbia. The Mankayan Copper-Gold Porphyry Project is located in Northern Luzon, Philippines. The project boasts a JORC-compliant mineral resource of approximately 793 million tons at 0.65% copper equivalent, containing over 2.8 million tons of copper, 9.7 million ounces of gold, and 21 million ounces of silver. The Gold Bridge Project (Cobalt & Gold) is located 180 kilometers (km) north of Vancouver in British Columbia, Canada.

name: BLACK ROCK MINING
businessSummary: Black Rock Mining Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in producing graphite in Tanzania. Its segments include Graphite and Corporate. The Company has approximately 84% interest in the Mahenge Graphite Project (Mahenge) located in Tanzania. The Project has a joint ore reserves committee (JORC) compliant mineral resource estimate of approximately 213m tons. The Mahenge Project is spread across 324 square kilometers of exploration tenements in Tanzania’s Ulanga district, approximately 250 km north of the border with Mozambique. The Mahenge Project is also located approximately 250 kilometers west of the coastal port city of Mtwara on the Indian Ocean and 300 kilometers southwest of Tanzania’s city, Dar es Salaam. The Company's subsidiaries include Mahenge Resources Limited, Grafiti Resources Pty Ltd and Faru Grahite Corporation Limited.

name: BIOTRON
businessSummary: Biotron Limited is a clinical-stage biotechnology company. The Company is engaged in developing and commercializing a novel small molecule approach that has the potential to treat several serious viral diseases. Its proprietary primary bacterial cell-based screening platform enables rapid screening for target viroporin proteins, including hepatitis C, HIV-1, Dengue, Zika, Influenza, and Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). The Company has developed a library of over 350 compounds with potential activity against a range of viral diseases. Its lead compound, BIT225, is in Phase II development for the treatment of HIV-1. BIT225 appears to inhibit HIV-1 replication in macrophage reservoir cells offering the potential, when used in combination with other anti-retroviral compounds, to eradicate HIV-1. The Company also owns SedRx, which is a general anesthetic containing alfaxalone.

name: ALDORO RESOURCES
businessSummary: Aldoro Resources Limited is a mineral exploration and development company. The Company has a portfolio of critical mineral projects, including rare earth, niobium, lithium, rubidium and base metal projects. Its project is the Kameelburg REE/Niobium Carbonatite Project in Namibia. Its other projects are based in Western Australia, including the Wyemandoo lithium-rubidium project, the Niobe lithium-rubidium-tantalum Project and the Narndee Igneous Complex in Western Australia. The Wyemandoo critical metal pegmatite project comprises four exploration licenses (E57/1017, E58/571, E58/555 and E59/2431) that overlie part of the Windimurra Igneous Complex. The Niobe Rb-Li Project consists of 195-ha mining lease application over part of the Dalgaranga-Mount Farmer pegmatite swarm located approximately 70-kilometer northwest of Mount Magnet. The Narndee Project covers a large portion of the ultramafic zone of the Narndee Igneous Complex.

name: SILVER MINES
businessSummary: Silver Mines Limited is an Australia-based silver exploration company. The Company's projects include Bowdens Silver Project, Barabolar Project, Tuena Gold Project and Calico North Project. Its segments include mining and exploration operations and agricultural operations. The Bowdens Silver and Barabolar Projects are located in central New South Wales, over 26 kilometers (km) east of Mudgee. The consolidated project area comprises 2,115 square kilometers (km2) (521,000 acres) of titles covering approximately 80 kilometers. The Bowdens Silver Project lies within Exploration License 5920, which is wholly owned by the Company. The Tuena Gold Project is located 80 km south of the city of Orange in New South Wales. The Company also holds a significant land position in the Orange/Blayney district covering 747 km2. The Kramer Hills Project is made up of mining claims covering approximately 48 km2 as well as mining claims and real property at the historic Shaherald oxide gold mine.

name: CYNATA THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Cynata Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage stem cell and regenerative medicine company. The Company is focused on the development of therapies based on Cymerus, which is a therapeutic stem cell platform technology. Cymerus uses induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) to manufacture cell therapy products, including mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), at commercial scale. Its product candidates include CYP-001, CYP-004 and CYP-006TK. CYP-001 is under Phase II clinical trials with a focus on treatment for steroid-resistant acute graft versus host disease (GvHD) and a Phase 1/II trial in patients undergoing kidney transplantation. CYP-006TK is a Cymerus iPSC-derived MSC topical wound dressing product candidate. This product is used in the Company’s Phase I clinical trial in diabetic foot ulcers (DFU). CYP-004, is an iPSC-derived MSC product for intra-articular injection (injection into a joint), is ongoing with a Phase III trial in patients with osteoarthritis of the knee.

name: LARVOTTO RESOURCES
businessSummary: Larvotto Resources Limited is a resources company. The Company is advancing its portfolio of in-demand minerals projects, including the 1.7Moz AuEq high-grade Hillgrove Gold-Antimony Project in New South Wales (NSW), the Mt Isa copper, gold, and cobalt project adjacent to Mt Isa townsite in Queensland, the Eyre multi-metals and lithium project located 30 kilometers (km) east of Norseman in Western Australia and a gold exploration project at Ohakuri in New Zealand's North Island. The Hillgrove Gold-Antimony Project covers 254 square kilometers and comprises six key mining areas within 48 granted mining licenses. Mt Isa Project is located in northwest Queensland, Australia. The Eyre Project is located approximately 600 km east of Perth, Western Australia, and 200 km south of the major mining center of Kalgoorlie and covers an area of approximately 580 square kilometers. The Ohakuri Project is in the north island of New Zealand and consists of a partially explored epithermal gold system.

name: ZEUS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Zeus Resources Limited is a mineral exploration company. The Company holds 12 granted tenements and applications. These tenements include five granted tenements: one at Wiluna, two at Kalabity and two at Wydgee. There are seven applications for new tenements, including three adding to the Mortimer Hills Project, one adding to the Wiluna Project, one adding to the Blue Hill Project and two adding to the Kalabity Project. The Wiluna Project consists of one granted exploration license (EL), E53/1603, and one EL application, E53/2197, located near the township of Wiluna, approximately 540 km north of Kalgoorlie. The Mortimer Hills Project comprises three EL applications (E09/2791, E09/2798 and E09/2874), located over five kilometers (km) east southeast along the strike from DLI’s Yinnietharra Lithium Prospect. It also owns six exploration licenses with an area of approximately 79 square kilometers (km2) comprising the Casablanca Antimony Project located in central Morocco.

name: BLINKLAB
businessSummary: BlinkLab Limited is an Australia-based digital healthcare company focused on Artificial intelligence (AI) powered diagnostics. The Company has fully developed a smartphone based diagnostic platform for autism, Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), schizophrenia, and other neurodevelopmental conditions. Its product is an autism diagnostic test that leverages the power of smartphones, AI and machine learning to deliver screening tests specifically designed for children as young as over 18 months old. Its pipeline includes BlinkLab Dx 1 and BlinkLab Dx N. Its BlinkLab Dx 1 is an autism diagnostic adjunct. Its BlinkLab Dx N is an ADHD diagnostic adjunct.

name: AUSTRALIAN POTASH
businessSummary: APC Minerals Limited, formerly Australian Potash Limited, is an Australia-based explorer, which holds three project areas, primarily in Western Australia’s north-eastern Goldfields. The Company’s projects include Lake Wells Gold Project, Laverton Downs Base Metals Project, and Nexus Project. The Nexus Project is located in the West Arunta of Western Australia’s Kimberley region. The project comprises one granted exploration license (E80/5917). The Lake Wells Gold Project is located approximately 60 kilometers (km) from Gold Road Resource’s tier 1 Gruyere Project. The Laverton Downs Project is located in the richly endowed Laverton region of Western Australia. The Laverton Downs Project (LDP) has demonstrated potential to host both gold and nickel sulphide mineralization. The LDP commences just 20 km north of Laverton in the north-eastern Goldfields, where it occupies some high potential mineralized real estate.

name: CUFE
businessSummary: CuFe Ltd is a mineral producer and explorer with holdings, or rights or interests in, various tenements prospective for copper, lithium, gold, rare earths and iron ore located in Western Australia and the Northern Territory. Its main focus is its mature iron ore assets in Western Australia (JWD Iron Ore Project) and the Northern Territory (Yarram Iron Ore Project) and copper asset (Tennant Creek Copper Project). The JWD Iron Ore Project is located in Western Australia, 700 kilometers from Geraldton Port. It holds a 50% interest in Gold Valley Iron and Manganese Pty Ltd, the owner of the iron ore rights over the Yarram project. It owns 55% interest in the Tennant Creek project. It owns West Arunta (niobium) and Tambourah (lithium) exploration tenure. It owns North Dam Lithium and Rare Earths Project- E 15/1495, M15/1893 (certain mineral rights), and M15/1495. Its other projects include Bryah Basin Joint Venture Projects, Morck Well Project, Peak Hill Project and Mt Ida Iron Ore Project.

name: RUMBLE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Rumble Resources Limited is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of base and precious metal projects. Its Earaheedy project is located over 110 kilometers (km) north of Wiluna, Western Australia in the Earaheedy Basin. It owns 75% of E69/3464 and 100% of two contiguous exploration licenses, E69/3787, E69/3815, E69/3862 and applications for E69/4062, E69/4099, E69/4257, M69/150 and an application for miscellaneous license L69/58. Its projects are Western Queen, Fraser Range, Lamil, Munarra Gully, Braeside, Warroo, Wardawarra, and Thunderstorm project. The Western Queen Gold and Tungsten Project is located 90km northwest of Mt Magnet within Western Australia’s Yalgoo Mineral Field. Lamil Project is in Western Australia’s highly prospective Paterson Province, between two major mining operations-the Nifty Copper Mine and Telfer Gold-Copper Mine. The Thunderstorm Gold Project lies over a northeast terrane boundary between the Fraser Zone and the Nornalup Zone.

name: ATOMIC EAGLE
businessSummary: Atomic Eagle Ltd, formerly Tombador Iron Limited, is an Australian uranium exploration and development company. The Company is focused on the exploration and development of uranium properties in Africa. The Company’s 100%-owned Muntanga Project is located in the southeastern region of Zambia in the Siavonga and Chirundu Districts. The Project encompasses over three mining licenses-Muntanga (License no. 13880-HQ-LML), Dibbwi (License no. 13881-HQ-LML), and Chirundu (License no. 12634-HQ-LML), covering approximately 719 square kilometers (km2), that are located approximately 200 km south of Lusaka, north of Lake Kariba. Additionally, the Company holds over two exploration licenses for Nabbanda (License no. 22803-HQ-LEL) and Chirundu Extension (License no 22075-HQ-LEL). The Muntanga and Dibbwi mining licenses comprise the Muntanga, Dibbwi and Dibbwi East deposits. The Chirundu mining license contains the Njame and Gwabi deposits.

name: CRITICA
businessSummary: Critica Limited is an Australia-based company. The principal activity of the Company is mineral exploration and development of the Jupiter Rare Earths Project in Western Australia. Its Brothers Clay-Hosted Rare Earth Project (Brothers) is a large strategic landholding totaling approximately 1,356 square kilometers (km2) of granted tenure, with an additional 435 km2 of licenses under application, all situated on pastoral leases in Western Australia. The Jupiter Project is a high-grade, clay-hosted rare earths deposit located within the broader Brothers landholding. Jupiter is strategically located within the Mt Magnet and Yalgoo mining district. In addition to its primary project, Jupiter and the Brothers Project, it holds exploration licenses in several regions, and those projects include Kulin, Mount Lindsay, and the Livingstone DSO Hematite.

name: SILEX SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Silex Systems Limited is a technology commercialization company, the primary asset of which is the SILEX laser enrichment technology (SILEX technology). It is focused on the commercialization of its SILEX laser-based enrichment technology for application to key global markets: uranium production and enrichment (nuclear power), silicon enrichment (silicon quantum computing) and medical isotope enrichment (new cancer therapies). Its segments include Silex Systems, Translucent and Silex USA. Its technology includes SILEX Laser Isotope Separation Technology, SILEX Uranium Enrichment Technology, Global Laser Enrichment and SILEX Quantum Silicon Production for Quantum Computing. SILEX technology has been under development for uranium enrichment jointly with licensee, Global Laser Enrichment LLC. It is focused on the development of additional commercial applications of SILEX technology, including the production of Quantum Silicon for the emerging technology of silicon-based quantum computing.

name: BOAB METALS
businessSummary: Boab Metals Limited is an Australia-based exploration and development company with interests in Australia and South America. The Company’s projects include The Sorby Hills, The Manbarrum Project, and The Eight Mile Creek Project. The Company is focused on the development of its Sorby Hills Lead-Silver-Zinc Project (Sorby Hills), located within the Kimberley Region of Western Australia. The Project is located 50 kilometers (km) from Kununurra and 150km from Wyndham Port. Its Manbarrum Project is located within the Northern Territory, 25 km east of the Company’s flagship Sorby Hills Project. Its Eight Mile Creek exploration tenements cover around 206 square kilometers of relatively under-explored tenure immediately south of Sorby Hills. The Company's subsidiaries include Pacifico Holdings SAS, Pacifico Minerals Sucursal Colombia, Sorby Hills Pty Ltd, Sorby Management Pty Ltd, West Rock Resources Panama Corp., West Rock Resources Pty Ltd, and Manbarrum Pty Ltd.

name: NOVIQTECH
businessSummary: NoviqTech Limited is an Australia-based company. The Company is engaged in development and delivery of carbon reporting and guarantee of origin solutions. The Company leverages artificial intelligence and distributed ledger technology to offer trusted solutions for supply chain reporting, carbon emissions tracking, and guarantee of origin. Through its platforms, the Company supports organizations worldwide in making data-driven decisions and driving sustainable growth. It consists of two brands, Carbon Central and NoviqAI. Carbon Central empowers businesses to seamlessly integrate carbon reporting, tokenization, or guarantee of origin initiatives into their operations. Its platform provides a comprehensive, adaptable solution designed to empower businesses to manage their sustainability projects, track emissions and energy use in real-time. NoviqAI offers end-to-end transparency and confirmation of product authenticity and processes throughout the entire value chain.

name: ANTIMONY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Antimony Resources Limited is an Australia-based critical minerals company focused on building new antimony supply for global markets. The Company's projects include Tecomatlan Processing Plant, Los Lirios Antimony Project, Dollar and Milton Antimony Projects, and the Don Enrique Copper Project. It operates a 150 tpd processing plant near the small town of Tecomatlan in the state of Puebla, Mexico. The plant helps in processing ore of varying characteristics. Los Lirios is a high grade, structurally controlled antimony project. The project sits within the Lirios Fault Zone, a mineralized corridor extending approximately six kilometers (km). The Milton project targets multiple high-grade antimony-bearing veins and shear zones hosted within the Triassic Luning Formation limestone. The Dollar Project is a high-grade prospect located in a proven antimony district in Nye County, Nevada. Its landholdings consist of 2,684 hectares covering a continuous 5.5 km strike of prospective ground.

name: BRAZILIAN RARE EARTHS
businessSummary: Brazilian Rare Earths Limited is a mineral exploration company. The principal activity of the Company is exploring for rare earth elements and other critical minerals in the Rocha da Rocha province in the state of Bahia in Brazil. Its segments include Brazil exploration and Corporate. The Rocha da Rocha Project is located in the state of Bahia in Northeast Brazil and is located over 200 kilometers (km) from a port. The Rocha da Rocha Project is comprised over 267 granted exploration permits registered with Brazil’s National Mining Agency. The Rare earths and critical minerals province with multiple discoveries over one million acres of highly prospective exploration ground. The Amargosa Bauxite-Gallium Project is an advanced exploration stage asset, located in the Tier one mining jurisdiction of Bahia, Brazil. The Sulista Project area is located over 80 km southwest of the Monte Alto project.

name: REDSTONE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Redstone Resources Ltd is a base, precious metals and a lithium company. The principal activity of is mineral exploration in Australia and Canada. It focuses on exploring its 100% owned prospective West Musgrave Project, which includes the Tollu Copper deposit, in Western Australia. The West Musgrave Project is located between BHP’s Nebo Babel Deposit and Nico Resources’ Wingellina Ni-Co project. The Tollu Project is located in the south-east portion of the West Musgrave region of Western Australia. The Tollu Project consists of hydrothermal copper quartz veins in a mineralized system covering an area at least five square kilometers (km2). Its other projects include Atlas Project, Babylon Project, Herculaneum Project, Pergamon Project, and Pompeii Project. The Atlas Project lies to the immediate north of the Tollu Project and is proximal to the Tollu Fault Zone. The Babylon Project is located east of the Tollu fault zone. The Herculaneum Project is located west of the Tollu Project.

name: CANYON RESOURCES
businessSummary: Canyon Resources Limited is an Australia-based bauxite resource development and exploration company. The Company is focused on expediting the development of the high-grade Minim Martap Bauxite project in central Cameroon through its wholly owned subsidiary, Camalco Cameroon SA (Camalco). The Company’s 100% owned Minim Martap Bauxite project is a global direct shipping ore (DSO) project development opportunity. The project is located in central Cameroon and situated near the main rail line linking the region to the Atlantic port of Douala. The project seeks to produce up to 6.4 metric tons of bauxite per annum. The Minim Martap Bauxite Project comprises the Makan, the Ngaoundal and the Minim Martap exploration permits. The Minim Martap and Makan permits are adjacent and are located around 25km from Ngaoundal permit. These permits cover an area of approximately 981 square kilometers (km2).

name: BURU ENERGY
businessSummary: Buru Energy Limited is an Australia-based diversified energy company focused on exploration and production of hydrocarbon and non-hydrocarbon energy resources in Australia. The Company’s petroleum assets and tenements are located onshore in the Canning Basin in the southwest Kimberley region of Western Australia. In the Kimberley, it owns and operates 100% of the conventional Ungani Oilfield project and the conventional gas condensate discovery at Rafael 1. The Ungani Oilfield is located approximately 90 kilometers east of Broome and includes six production wells and associated production facilities. It also operates a Canning Basin wide portfolio of exploration permits and licenses for prospective conventional and unconventional resources with working interests ranging from 60% to 100%. It owns over 22,500 square kilometers (km2) of permits, including 100% of EP 129, EP 391, EP428, EP431 and EP 436, and 60% of the EP 457 and EP 458 permits it shares with Rey Resources Ltd.

name: ORION MINERALS
businessSummary: Orion Minerals Ltd is an Australia-based company. It is engaged in exploration, evaluation and development of base metal, gold and platinum-group element (PGE) projects in South Africa (Areachap Belt and Okiep Copper Complex, Northern Cape). Its projects include Prieska Copper-Zinc Mine Project, Okiep Copper Project, Fraser Range Project, Jacomynspan (JMP) Battery Metals Project, Walhalla Project, and Areachap Exploration. The Prieska Project is located in the Northern Cape Province of South Africa, over 270 kilometers south-west of the regional capital Kimberley. The Okiep Copper Project (OCP) is located in the Northern Cape Province of South Africa, over 570 km north of Cape Town and 450 km west of the Company's flagship Prieska Copper Zinc Project. The JMP Project is located 65 km north of Orion’s flagship Prieska Copper Zinc Mine in South Africa’s Northern Cape. Fraser Range Nickel-Copper and Gold Project in Western Australia and the Walhalla Project in Victoria, Australia.

name: TLOU ENERGY
businessSummary: Tlou Energy Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in developing energy solutions in Sub-Saharan Africa through gas-fired power and ancillary projects. The principal activity of the Company is to explore and evaluate power solutions in Sub-Saharan Africa through Coalbed Methane (CBM) gas-fired power. Its operations include Lesedi Project, Lesedi Gas-to-Power project, Mamba Project, and Boomslang Project. The Lesedi Project consists of four Prospecting Licenses (PL) and a Production License. The Lesedi Gas-to-Power Project (Lesedi) is 100% owned and is the Company's advanced project. At Lesedi, the Company is developing a proposed 10MW gas-to-power project. The Mamba area is situated adjacent to Lesedi. It consists of five Prospecting Licenses covering an area of approximately 4,500 square kilometers (Km2). Prospecting License, PL011/2019 designated Boomslang, is approximately 1,000 Km2 and is situated adjacent to the Company’s existing licenses.

name: CATALINA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Catalina Resources Limited is a diversified mineral exploration and mine development company. The Company is focused on the exploration of prospective gold, base metal, lithium and iron ore projects and the development of these projects into production. Its projects include Breakaway Dam, Auric North, Central Yilgarn, Aerosmith, Spinifex Silver and Beasley Creek. The Breakaway Dam Project, located 17 kilometers (km) east of Menzies, hosts a copper-rich volcanogenic massive sulfide (VMS) system with lithium potential. The Auric North Project is located approximately six km from the Deflector Gold Mine, Deflector Nort. The Central Yilgarn Project is located within an underexplored region of the Yilgarn Craton, approximately 190 km to the northwest of Kalgoorlie and 160 kms southwest of Leonora. The project area covers an area of over 650 square kilometers (km2), and over approximately 65 km of strike, along the Yerilgee and Evanston greenstone belts.

name: CANTERBURY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Canterbury Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource company. The Company is focused on exploring potential Tier-1 copper-gold projects in the Southwest Pacific. The Company has a portfolio of projects in Australia and Papua New Guinea that are prospective for porphyry copper-gold, epithermal gold-silver and intrusion-related Ni-Cu-PGM deposits. Its portfolio includes multiple projects that are at the advanced exploration phase. Each project provides potential for the discovery and/or delineation of large-scale copper, gold, and molybdenum resources. Its tenements in Australia include Briggs, Mannersley, Fig Tree Hill, Don River, Rocky Point, Ulam Range, and Peenam. Its tenements in Papua New Guinea include Bismarck, Ekuti Range, Wamum, Waits Creek, Waffa River, and Legusulum. It also has an agreement to acquire EPM 29106 (Jack Shay) in central Queensland, Australia. Briggs is located approximately 60 kilometers west of the deep-water port of Gladstone.

name: CAZALY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Cazaly Resources Limited is an Australia-based resource exploration company that operates internationally, holding a diverse portfolio of mineral projects in Australia, Canada and Namibia. The Company’s projects include the Halls Creek Copper, Zinc and Silver Project, Carb Nb/REE Project, Kaoko Lithium Project and Abenab North REE & Base Metals Project. Its joint venture projects include Sundown Lithium JV Project, McKenzie Springs JV Project and Mount Venn JV Project. It also has an agreement to earn approximately 80% interest in the Goongarrie Gold Project. The Halls Creek Copper, Zinc and Silver Project is situated 25 kilometers (kms) southwest of Halls Creek and covers part of the Halls Creek Mobile Zone, which is prospective for a range of commodities including copper, gold, and nickel. The Carb niobium (Nb) and rare earth elements (REE) Project is located in northwest Ontario, Canda in the Red Lake District, comprising over 93 mineral claims.

name: CARNAVALE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Carnavale Resources Limited is a mineral exploration company. It is engaged in acquiring and exploring advanced exploration and development projects. It is focused on exploring and developing high-grade, truckable resources at the Kookynie Gold Project, of a similar size to the historic Cosmopolitan Mine that can be processed at an existing third-party nearby processing plant. The Kookynie Gold Project is located only 60 kilometers (km) south of Leonora in Western Australia. Its Grey Dam Ni-Co Project is located near Kurnalpi approximately 90 km northeast of Kalgoorlie, West Australia. It has 80% ownership in the Ora Banda South Project, which covers an area of approximately 25 square kilometers, located 65km northwest of Kalgoorlie in Yilgarn Craton, Western Australia. It also owns the Barracuda Ni Cu PGE Project. It continues to evaluate new gold exploration opportunities and exploration projects associated with the electric battery sector and other new-age disruptive technologies.

name: BOA RESOURCES
businessSummary: BOA Resources Ltd is an Australian explorer. The Company is focused on the discovery of copper, lithium, nickel and critical minerals. The Company's copper projects include Neds Creek Project, Thaduna, Green Dragon, Boundary Fence and Springfield. Neds Creek project is its flagship project in Western Australia's highly prospective Murchison district. The Neds Creek is a basin-scale project with tenement holding of approximately 1,378 square kilometers (sq km) that covers an area of approximately 60 kilometers (km) by 40 km in the northeastern arm of the Paleoproterozoic Yerrida Basin. The Bald Hill East tenement (E15/1608) encompasses approximately 17.6 sq km and is located approximately 65 km south-east of Kambalda in the Eastern Goldfields region of Western Australia. The Fraser South E63/1859 nickel copper tenement covers an area of approximately 158 sq km. The Roy Hill project EL1/2022 covers an area of approximately 60 sq km and is prospective for lithium and tin.

name: PYC THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: PYC Therapeutics Limited is an Australia-based clinical-stage biotechnology company creating a new generation of ribonucleic acid (RNA) therapies to change the lives of patients with genetic diseases. The Company utilizes its proprietary drug delivery platform to enhance the potency of precision medicines within the rapidly growing and commercially proven RNA therapeutic class. Its drug development programs target monogenic diseases - the indications with the highest likelihood of success in clinical development. Its first-in-class drug programs include Retinitis Pigmentosa type 11, (VP-001), Polycystic Kidney Disease, (PYC-003), Autosomal Dominant Optic Atrophy (ADOA) (PYC-001) and Phelan-McDermid Syndrome (PMS) (PYC-002).

name: THETA GOLD MINES
businessSummary: Theta Gold Mines Limited is an Australia-based gold exploration and development company. The Company holds a range of prospective gold assets through its subsidiary, Transvaal Gold Mining Estate Ltd (TGME), in a South African gold mining region. TGME Project phase one consists of four existing mines, including Beta, Frankfort, CDM and the Rietfontein mine. The Project is located next to the historical gold mining town of Pilgrim’s Rest, in the Mpumalanga Province, some 370km northeast of Johannesburg or 95 km north of Nelspruit (the Provincial Capital City) and includes more than 43 historical mines identified across the prospective gold field of 620 square kilometers. Beta Mine is a producing mine in the Pilgrim’s Rest area. Rietfontein quartz reef is near vertical, sitting in a 16 km long structure which has been mined and partly drilled over 3.5 km. The Glynns Mine is located near the town of Sabie in northeast South Africa. Its subsidiary is Theta Gold SA (Pty) Ltd.

name: PRODIGY GOLD NL
businessSummary: Prodigy Gold NL is an Australia-based company, which focuses on exploration and evaluation of mineral resources. The Company has greenfield and brownfield exploration projects and prospects in Tanami Gold Province, hosting deposits such as Newmont Australia’s Tanami operation, and its Oberon Deposit. It is focused on the development of its Tanami North and Twin Bonanza projects. The Tanami North project area is located about 150 kilometers (km) to the south of Lajamanu and 470 km west of Tennant Creek. The Tanami North project covers an area of approximately 2,415 square kilometers (km2) and hosts two mineral resources at Tregony and Hyperion. The Hyperion Deposit is located on EL9250. The Tregony Deposit is located south-west of the community of Lajamanu. This area hosts gold deposits including the 1.3 million ounce Groundrush/Ripcord Deposit. Its Tanami West Project is located 650 km to the north-west of Alice Springs. The project covers an area of approximately 2,248 km2.

name: PRESCIENT THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Prescient Therapeutics Limited is a clinical-stage oncology company. It is engaged in developing personalized medicine approaches to cancer, including targeted and cellular therapies. Its product pipeline includes PTX-100, CellPryme-M, and OmniCAR. PTX-100 is a first-in-class targeted therapy which can disrupt the RAS family pathway by inhibiting the prenylation action of the enzyme GGT-1. PTX-100 is in a Phase 2a clinical study in refractory/relapsed Cutaneous T Cell Lymphoma with Fast Track Designation. CellPryme-M is a high-performance cell therapy enhancement platform that can improve CAR-T efficacy. The CellPryme platform consists of two distinct components which can be used separately but have significant synergies when used together. OmniCAR is a universal CAR platform that is controllable, with plug and play capabilities to enable a wider range of cancers to be targeted. OmniCAR enables controllable T-cell activity and multiantigen targeting with a single cell product.

name: ALLIGATOR ENERGY
businessSummary: Alligator Energy Limited is an Australian exploration company. The principal activities of the Company are uranium and energy minerals exploration and development. The Company's projects include Samphire and Big Lake. The Samphire Project is located approximately 20 kilometers (km) south of Whyalla in regional South Australia. The Samphire project comprises two historical uranium prospects (Blackbush and Plumbush). The Company owns 100% of the Big Lake Uranium Project in the Cooper Basin, South Australia, a project targeting discovery of Australia's next in situ recovery (ISR) uranium field. The Big Lake Uranium Project targets REDOX and roll front uranium mineralization within stratigraphic paleo channels of the Lake Eyre Basin. The Company also supports feasibility and technical advancement of its South Australian In Situ Recovery (ISR) copper projects, including Kapunda and Alford.

name: AUSTIN METALS
businessSummary: Austin Metals Limited is an Australia-based base and precious metals explorer focused on the prolific mining districts of Broken Hill, the Cobar Basin and the Lachlan Fold Belt of New South Wales, Australia. Its flagship Austin Gold Project is located in the highly prospective Murchison greenstone province of Western Australia, directly adjacent to the Cue Gold Project owned by Musgrave Minerals Limited, which includes the high-grade Break of Day Deposit and Starlight discovery. The Company has also secured a significant ground holding of the Tallering Greenstone belt in the prolific Murchison gold mining region of Western Australia located approximately 150 kilometers (km) south of the Golden Grove deposit. Its Ashburton Project comprises around eight granted exploration tenements and one granted prospecting license covering 510 square kilometers (km2) and is located on Ashburton Downs Station, approximately 75 km SW of Paraburdoo in the Pilbara Region of Western Australia.

name: PC GOLD
businessSummary: PC Gold Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company owns 100% of the Spring Hill Gold Project located in the Pine Creek region of the Northern Territory, Australia. The Spring Hill Project is in the Central Domain of the Palaeoproterozoic Pine Creek Orogen. The Project comprises one granted exploration license (EL 33234) and one granted mineral lease (ML23812) in the Northern Territory, which covers a total area of 11 sub-blocks or approximately 36.6 square kilometers (km2). The Project is located 200 km to the southeast of Darwin in the Northern Territory. The tenements are held by TM Gold Pty Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

name: NANOVEU
businessSummary: Nanoveu Limited is an Australia-based technology innovator across advanced semiconductor, visualization, and materials science applications. Its businesses include EMASS, EyeFly3D, and Nanoshield. EMASS is a technology company specializing in the design and development of advanced systems-on-chip (SoC) solutions. EyeFly3D is a comprehensive platform solution for delivering glasses-free 3D experiences across a range of devices and industries. Nanoshield is a self-disinfecting film that uses a patented polymer of embedded Cuprous nanoparticles to provide antiviral and antimicrobial protection for a range of applications, from mobile covers to industrial surfaces. It also owns two proprietary, commercially validated drone platforms, ALICE and METRON. ALICE is a tethered aerial high payload platform that can withstand high reaction forces. METRON is a sub-millimeter photogrammetry and visual AI system capable of real-time anomaly detection at millimeter-level precision.

name: STELLAR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Stellar Resources Limited is engaged in the mineral exploration and evaluation business. The Company is focused on developing its Heemskirk Tin Project located in the stable tier-1 mining jurisdiction of Zeehan, Western Tasmania. The Heemskirk Tin Project includes three tin deposits: Severn, Queen Hill and Montana. It holds secured mining leases over the Heemskirk Tin Project, including the tailings pipeline route, tailings storage site and also over the St Dizier satellite tin deposit. In addition to the Heemskirk Tin Project, it owns a portfolio of nearby exploration licenses, including the Montana Flats and Mount Razorback exploration licenses (EL), which contain various silver-lead-zinc mines with associated tin mineralization. Its wholly owned subsidiary, Tarcoola Iron Pty Ltd, holds over five EL in NE Tasmania covering a combined area of 648 square kilometers, which is prospective for gold, tin, lithium and base metals. Its East Renison Project consists of over two contiguous EL.

name: HASTINGS TECHNOLOGY METALS
businessSummary: Hastings Technology Metals Limited is an Australia-based rare earths and gold company. The Company is focused on the development of its flagship Yangibana Rare Earths and Niobium Project and Whiteheads Gold Project in the Goldfields Region of Western Australia. Yangibana is located in the Gascoyne region of Western Australia and contains one of the highly valued deposits of NdPr in the world with an NdPr to Total Rare Earth Oxide ratio of up to 52% in some areas of the orebody. The Yangibana Project occupies 650 square kilometers and is located approximately 250 kilometers (km) northeast of Carnarvon in Western Australia. The projected is located on Gifford Creek Station, which covers Thiin-Mah, Warriyangka, Tharrkari and Jiwarli country. The Whiteheads Gold Project is strategically located approximately 80 km northeast of Kalgoorlie, offering access to existing infrastructure, operating mines and gold processing facilities. Its projects also include Brockman and Ark Gold.

name: KALI METALS
businessSummary: Kali Metals Limited is an Australia-based lithium focused exploration company. The Company is engaged in minerals exploration with a focus on lithium, gold, tin and critical minerals. Its portfolio of assets includes Pilbara Projects: include DOM’s Hill Project, Marble Bar Project, and Pear Creek Project; Southern Lachlan Fold Belt Projects; include Jingellic Project and Tallangatta Project, and Higginsville Lithium District. Its DOM’s Hill Project comprises 125 square kilometers (km2) is located in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia and is 110 kilometers (km) southeast of Port Hedland and 52 km northwest of Marble Bar. The 100% owned Pear Creek Project consists of three exploration licences and is located between the DOM’s Hill Project and the Marble Bar Project in the East Pilbara region of Western Australia, approximately 140 km southeast of Port Hedland and 60 km northwest of Marble Bar. Its Jingellic Project is situated in southern New South Wales.

name: AGRIMIN
businessSummary: Agrimin Limited is an Australia-based fertilizer development company. The principal activity of Company includes advancing the Mackay Potash Project in Western Australia. It operates in the area of mineral exploration and development in Western Australia. The Company is focused on the development of its 100% owned potash projects in Western Australia. It is a global supplier of specialty potash fertilizers to both traditional and value-added markets. The Mackay Potash Project is situated on Lake Mackay in Western Australia. The Mackay Potash Project is located approximately 940 kilometers by road south of Wyndham Port in Western Australia. It comprises nine granted exploration licenses covering over 3,000 square kilometers in Western Australia and four exploration license applications covering over 1,200 square kilometers in the Northern Territory. The Lake Auld Potash project is located approximately 640 kilometers south-east of Port Hedland, Western Australia.

name: SUNSTONE METALS
businessSummary: Sunstone Metals Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company with gold and copper assets in Ecuador. The Company’s assets are the Bramaderos Gold-Copper Project and El Palmar Copper-Gold Project. The Bramaderos Gold-Copper Project is located in Loja province, 130 kilometers (km) from the provincial capital city Loja and west of Catacocha. The Bramaderos property covers approximately 4,959 hectares (ha). The sealed Pan American Highway, which crosses the western part of the concession. The concession is approximately 900 meters above sea level. The El Palmar Copper-Gold Project is located in northern Ecuador, 60 km north-west of Ecuador’s capital Quito. The El Palmar Copper-Gold Project is located in a highly prospective mineralised district related to the Toachi Faults Zone.

name: AUSTRALIAN VANADIUM
businessSummary: Australian Vanadium Limited is a resource company focused on vanadium. The Company is advancing the development of the Australian Vanadium Project at Gabanintha. Its segments include Upstream: Australian Vanadium Project - evaluation and feasibility of the Australian Vanadium Project; Midstream: Electrolyte Plant - manufacturing of vanadium electrolyte, and Downstream: Energy Storage - sale, development and deployment of utility-scale vanadium flow battery energy storage solutions by VSUN Energy. The Australian Vanadium Project is located in the Murchison Province over 43 kilometers (km) south of the mining town of Meekatharra in Western Australia. The Nowthanna Hill deposit is located over 50 km south of Meekatharra in Western Australia and is hosted in carnotite within silicified calcrete layers and carbonate-rich sandy clays. The Coates Project is situated over 60 km east of the Perth metropolitan area in the Shire of Wundowie.

name: AUSQUEST
businessSummary: AusQuest Limited is an Australia-based mineral exploration company. The Company controls approximately 4,100 square kilometers (km2) of exploration title within Australia; 3,700 km2 within Western Australia (WA); 250km2 within Queensland (QLD); and 165km2 in South Australia (SA). It explores for a range of commodities and mineralization styles, including magmatic nickel-copper-platinum group element sulfides, large porphyry copper and iron oxide-copper-gold, strata bound base metals, lithium and rare earth element deposits. Five of the six projects (Balladonia, Morrisey, Jubilee, Coober Pedy and Mt Davis) are subject to the strategic alliance agreement (SAA), while the Hamilton Project in NW Queensland is 100% owned by the Company. The Balladonia Project covers an area of 1,370 km2 and is located 50km south of the Nova-Bollinger nickel-copper deposit within the Fraser Range region of WA. The Hamilton Project, which covers an area of 250km2, is located in north-west Queensland.

name: TALISMAN MINING
businessSummary: Talisman Mining Limited is an Australia-based mineral development and exploration company. The Company is engaged in the exploration, discovery and development of opportunities in base and precious metals. It has secured tenements in the Cobar/Mineral Hill region in Central New South Wales (NSW) through the grant of its own exploration licenses and through a joint venture agreement. Its projects include Lachlan NSW Project, Macquarie NSW Project, and Mabel Creek IOCG Project. The Lachlan NSW Project has a highly prospective base metals and copper-gold tenure, with a 6,000 square kilometers (km2) exploration portfolio in the Lachlan Fold Belt, NSW. The Yarindury Prospect is an undrilled anomaly in a lightly explored project within the Macquarie Arc Porphyry Cu-Au corridor of New South Wales. Yarindury is located over 30km north-east of Dubbo in NSW. The Mabel Creek Prospect is a lightly explored project within the Gawler Craton Iron Oxide Copper-Gold (IOCG) corridor of South Australia.

name: AURA ENERGY
businessSummary: Aura Energy Limited is an Australia-based mineral company with uranium and polymetallic projects in Africa and Europe. The Company is engaged in exploration and evaluation of uranium, vanadium and gold and base metals in Mauritania and Sweden. The Company is focused on uranium production commencing at the Tiris Project, a greenfield uranium discovery in Mauritania. It holds 125 square kilometers of virgin Greenstone belt and is located approximately 36 kilometers south of the Kinross 20 Moz Tasiast Mine. Its Haggan deposit is located in Berg municipality in the province of Jamtland in central Sweden. The Haggan Project is a poly-metallic deposit containing economically significant levels of vanadium, sulphate of potash, nickel, zinc, and molybdenum. It holds a 100% direct interest in the deposit. Its subsidiaries include Vanadis Battery Metals AB, Aura Energy Mauritania Pty Ltd, Tiris Ressources SA, Tiris International Mining Company sarl and others.

name: ATLAS ARTERIA
businessSummary: Atlas Arteria Limited owns, develops, and operates toll roads in France, Germany, Australia, Bermuda, and the United States. It holds 30.82% interest in the APRR motorway network, 30.85% interest in the ADELAC commuter road, and 30.79% interest in the A79 transversal link located in France  100% interest in the Warnow Tunnel located in Rostock, Germany  66.67% interest in the Chicago Skyway situated in Chicago, United States  and 100% interest in the Dulles Greenway located in Virginia, United States. Atlas Arteria Limited was formerly known as Macquarie Atlas Roads Limited and changed its name to Atlas Arteria Limited in May 2018. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Melbourne, Australia.

name: WORLEY
businessSummary: Worley Limited is an Australia-based global professional services company. The Company provides engineering, project and asset management solutions in the energy, chemicals and resources sectors. The Company partners with customers to design, build and maintain critical assets across their full life cycle. In the energy sector, it produces energy from conventional, such as coal and oil, and low-carbon energy sources, such as gas, wind, solar and hydrogen, as well as undertaking projects related to power generation, transmission, and distribution. In the chemicals sector, it manufactures, processes, and refines chemicals and fuels, such as renewable fuels, petrochemicals, polymers, and specialty chemicals. In the resources sector, it processes mineral and metal resources, such as resources that are central to the energy transition and resource projects related to water use and re-use, the environment, transport, ports and site remediation and decommissioning.

name: TELIX PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: Telix Pharmaceuticals Limited is an Australia-based biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of therapeutic and diagnostic radiopharmaceuticals and associated medical technologies. It is developing a portfolio of clinical and commercial stage products that aims to address significant unmet medical needs in oncology and rare diseases. Its segments include Therapeutics, Precision Medicine and Telix Manufacturing Solutions. Therapeutics segment develops targeted radionuclide therapies for urologic, neurologic, musculoskeletal and hematological cancers. Precision Medicine segment focuses on bringing diagnostic imaging solutions to market. Precision Medicine segment also includes MedTech and International businesses. Telix Manufacturing Solutions segment is its global network of facilities designed to deliver patient doses worldwide. Its pipeline products include TLX591, TLX250, TLX101, TLX66, TLX592, TLX252, TLX400, Illuccix (68Ga-PSMA-11) and TLX007-CDx.

name: NRW HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NRW Holdings Limited is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing engineering, construction, manufacturing, technology, operations and maintenance services. The Company operates through four segments: Civil, Mining, Minerals Energy & Technologies (MET) and Electrical, Mechanical, Infrastructure & Technology (EMIT). Its Civil segment specializes in the delivery of private and public civil infrastructure projects, mine development, bulk earthworks and commercial and residential subdivisions. Its Mining segment specializes in mine management, contract mining, load and haul, drill and blast, coal handling preparation plants, maintenance services and the fabrication of water and service vehicles. Its Minerals, Energy & Technologies segment specializes in the design, construction, operation and maintenance of global resource projects across the mineral processing, energy and non-process infrastructure market segments.

name: IDP EDUCATION
businessSummary: IDP Education Limited is an Australia-based company engaged in international education services. The Company specializes in matching universities, colleges, and schools with the right students worldwide. Its segments include Asia, Australasia, and Rest of World. The principal activities of each segment are provision of student placement services, International English Language Testing (IELTS) and English language teaching services. It offers placement of international students into education institutions in Australia, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, New Zealand, and Ireland. The placement services include counselling, application processing and pre-departure guidance. It is engaged in the distribution and administration of IELTS tests. It is also a co-owner of IELTS with the British Council and Cambridge Assessment. It is also engaged in the operation of English language schools in Taiwan, Vietnam and Cambodia and the operation of digital marketing and event services.

isin: DBI.AX|Dalrymple Bay Infrastructure Limited|DBI.AX|Dalrymple Bay Infrastructure Limited
name: DALRYMPLE BAY INFRASTRUCTURE
businessSummary: Dalrymple Bay Infrastructure Limited owns the lease of and right to operate the Dalrymple Bay terminal, a metallurgical coal export facility in Bowen Basin in Queensland, Australia. It provides terminal infrastructure and services for producers and consumers of Australian coal exports. Dalrymple Bay Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Brisbane, Australia.

name: SMARTGROUP
businessSummary: Smartgroup Corporation Ltd is an Australia-based company, which is engaged in providing outsourced administration, fleet management, and software, distribution, and group services.
