The Company entered into option agreements to acquire a 100% interest in five exploration projects, namely Majorodam, Igab and Tosso Creek in Suriname and Tamakay and Abuya in Guyana. The Majorodam Project is located in Suriname, approximately 12 kilometers (km) from the Saramacca deposit. The Igab Project is located in northeast Suriname, within the Marowijne Greenstone Belt. The Abuya Project is located in northeastern Guyana, within the Guiana Shield. The Tamakay Project is located approximately 300 km west of Georgetown, Guyana. The Tosso Creek Project is a gold exploration site located in southern Suriname, approximately 180 km south of Paramaribo.

name: ENEREV5 METALS
businessSummary: Enerev5 Metals Inc. is a Canadian resource company. The Company is focused on the exploration and development potential related to energy metals such as nickel, copper, cobalt and other strategic battery minerals, as well as other net-zero carbon-related assets. The Company has two nickel exploration projects in Quebec. The Company’s projects include Barbara Bay and Goals Met. The Barbara Bay totals 33,200 hectares of contiguous claims. The Goals Met claims were acquired through the staking of 135 mining claims comprising approximately 7,290 hectares in the Province of Quebec.

name: CRUZ MINING
businessSummary: Cruz Battery Metals Corp. is a Canada-based company. The Company is focused on acquiring and developing battery metals projects. Its projects include Solar Lithium Project, Clayton Valley Lithium Brine Project, Central Clayton Valley Lithium Brine Project, Idaho Cobalt Belt Project, and Sterling South Gold/Copper Project. Its Sterling South Gold/Copper Project in Ontario consists of approximately 25 claims for 1,204 acres. The Solar Lithium Project is located in Nevada, United States of America, with over 4,938 acres. The Clayton Valley Lithium Brine Project is located in Nevada, United States of America, with over 240 acres. The Central Clayton Valley Lithium Brine Project consists of 29 claims for 580 acres. The 124-acre Idaho Cobalt Belt Project is located within the Idaho Cobalt Belt bordering Jervois Mining Ltd. It also acquired South Advocate Hydrogen Project consisting of 5,000 acres.

name: MEGAWATT LITHIUM AND BATTERY METALS
businessSummary: MegaWatt Lithium and Battery Metals Corp. is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of assets. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Benedict Mountains Uranium Property, consisting of two mineral licenses covering an area of approximately 350 hectares (ha) in the Central Mineral Belt on the east coast of Labrador, Canada, approximately 200 kilometers (km) northeast of Goose Bay. It holds a 100% undivided interest in all bases, rare earth elements and precious metals, in the Cobalt Hill Property, consisting of eight mineral claims covering an area of approximately 1,727.43 ha located in the Trail Creek Mining Division in the Province of British Columbia, Canada. Additionally, the Company holds a 100% interest in the Tyr Silver Project. It holds a 100% interest in and in the Route 381 Lithium Property, comprised of 40 mineral claims located in James Bay Territory, north of Matagami in the Province of Quebec, covering 2,126 ha.

name: ARGO
businessSummary: Argo Corporation is a Canada-based company. The Company is a technology venture delivering a vertically and publicly integrated city transit system designed to augment public transportation and create a network of intelligently routed vehicles that work together to serve and scale to the needs of entire cities, putting people in control of their mobility. The Company is the provider of municipal and school transit services and operates in Canada. It offers two vertically integrated, technology-enabled transit solutions: Argo Transit and Argo School. Argo Transit is the Company’s primary platform, offering municipalities a full service, electrified, and scalable transit solution. Argo School services include families benefiting from safe, reliable, technology-enabled transit solutions, supported by real-time vehicle tracking, optimized routing, and dedicated, certified drivers. Argo School is a modern school transit solution designed to address the drawbacks of traditional bus systems.

name: NORTH PEAK RESOURCES
businessSummary: North Peak Resources Ltd. is a Canadian gold exploration and development company. The Company's flagship property is the Prospect Mountain Mine complex which lies in the Battle Mountain Eureka trend, in an area known as the Southern Eureka Gold Belt, where three styles of mineralization have been identified, gold, silver Carlin style mineralization, Carbonate Replacement gold, silver, lead, zinc mineralization (CRD) and carbonate hosted Porphyry Related Skarn lead, zinc and gold mineralization associated with cretaceous intrusions. At the Property, the CRD mineralization is heavily oxidized to depths of at least 610 m (2,000 ft) below the top of the ridge line.

name: MKANGO MAGNETIC MATERIALS
businessSummary: Mkango Magnetic Materials Limited, formerly Mkango Resources Ltd, is a Canada-based company which is focused on the production of recycled rare earth magnets, alloys and oxides, through its interest in Maginito Limited (Maginito) to develop new sustainable sources of neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium and terbium to supply accelerating demand from electric vehicles, wind turbines and other clean energy technologies. The Company holds a 100% interest in HyProMag Limited and a 90% direct and indirect interest in HyProMag GmbH, focused on short loop rare earth magnet recycling and manufacturing in the United Kingdom and Germany, respectively, and a 100% interest in Mkango Rare Earths UK Ltd (Mkango UK), focused on long loop rare earth magnet recycling in the United Kingdom via a chemical processing route. The Company owns 100% of the Songwe Hill rare earths project in Malawi and the Pulawy rare earths separation plant in Poland.

name: MINEHUB TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: MineHub Technologies Inc. is a Canada-based digital supply chain platform for the commodity markets. The Company provides enterprise-grade digital solutions that connect buyers, sellers, laboratories and financiers within physical commodities supply chains in a digitally integrated workflow powered by data that is useable, shareable, verifiable and unforgeable. The Company is engaged in the development and operation of a suite of digital tools for the commodities supply chain. Its platform provides trade management, inventory management, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) and compliance, emissions, trade finance, and assay exchange. Its trade management platform provides buyers and sellers to share real-time trade data for commodity shipments. Its emissions platform simplifies the calculation and reporting of scope three emissions through automation. Its trade finance platform enables financiers with real-time monitoring of the transactions.

name: NOBEL RESOURCES
businessSummary: Nobel Resources Corp. is a Canadian resource company focused on identifying and developing prospective mineral projects. It evaluates copper prospects, primarily in Chile and Peru. It has option agreements to acquire a 100% interest in four separate copper projects, namely Cuprita, Janett, Pampa Austral and Anais. The 1,000-hectare (ha) Cuprita property is located approximately 126 kilometers (km) northeast of Copiapo, and 36 km southeast of Diego de Almagro. The project is accessible by road with a short traverse along a gravel track for the final few kilometers. The Janett project is located about 16 km north-north-east (NNE) of Antofagasta. The Janett project includes several past-producing small-scale mines, including the Janett and Michos mines. The Pampa Austral project is located about 35 km north from the city of Diego de Almagro. The 2,700-ha project is located within the Iron Oxide Copper Gold belt (IOCG). The Anais project is located about 10 km from Manto Verde mine.

name: CASA MINERALS
businessSummary: Casa Minerals Inc. is a Canada-based company. The Company is engaged in gold exploration in two regions: Arizona and British Columbia, Canada. It is involved in gold exploration on the Congress Gold Mine, a past-producing mine located in Arizona. It is also active in copper-gold exploration in British Columbia, Canada. Its projects include Congress, Arsenault and Pitman. It owns a 90% interest in the Congress Mine, located in Arizona. The Congress Mine consists of approximately 14 patented mineral claims totaling 260 acres and contiguous 25 mineral staked claims totaling 494.48 acres. The Arsenault property is situated in the Traditional Territory of the Teslin Tlingit First Nation and Taku River Tlingit First Nation. The Company owns a 100% interest in the Pitman and Paddy-Mac Properties, located in the Province of British Columbia. Pitman is a developed porphyry prospect located in close proximity to the south of Paddy-Mac.

name: CBLT
businessSummary: CBLT Inc. is a Canada-based mineral exploration company. The Company is engaged in the acquisition, directly and indirectly, sale, and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. Its properties include Copper Prince, Chilton Cobalt, Geneva Lake, Big Duck Lake, Burnt Pond, Mikayla, Shatford Lake, Cape Victoria, and Falcon Gold. The Chilton Cobalt property is located in the Laurentian Region of Quebec. The Burnt Pond property is a Zinc-Copper Property located in central Newfoundland. The property is located in the Tally Pond volcanic belt. The Shatford Lake property consists of two mining claims located in the Bird River Greenstone Belt in Manitoba. The Cape Victoria property is located approximately five kilometers (km) east of Terrace Bay in Northern Ontario. It has100% interest in the Falcon Gold property, consisting of six patented mining claims. The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary is AgAuCu Canada Inc.

name: FIRST HYDROGEN
businessSummary: First Hydrogen Corp. is a Canada-based company focused on zero-emission vehicles, green hydrogen production and distribution and supercritical carbon dioxide extractor systems. The Company has designed and built hydrogen-fuel-cell-powered light commercial vehicles (FCEVs). The FCEVs has a range of 630+ kilometers on a single refueling and are road-legal in the United Kingdom. The Company has launched its bespoke vehicle design phase, which develops its fleet of zero-emission vehicles. It is also focused on developing a 35-megawatt (MW) green hydrogen production facility and vehicle assembly factory in Shawinigan, Quebec. It is pursuing opportunities in green hydrogen production and distribution in the United Kingdom, the European Union and North America. It offers vehicles in two categories: First Generation and Second Generation. Its First Generation (Gen I) vans are market-ready hydrogen fuel cell electric vehicles designed to meet the diverse needs of modern businesses.

name: ICG SILVER AND GOLD
businessSummary: ICG Silver & Gold Ltd. is a Canada-based mineral exploration and development company advancing the Tuscarora District in northern Nevada. The Tuscarora District is a silver-gold epithermal system located on the Carlin Trend, approximately one hour northwest of Elko, Nevada. The Company controls 100% of the approximately 10,000-acre land package, which has extensive rock chip sampling, thousands of meters of reverse circulation and core drilling, and tens of kilometers of CSAMT geophysics completed on the property.

name: FIRST ATLANTIC NICKEL & COBALT
businessSummary: First Atlantic Nickel & Cobalt Corp., formerly First Atlantic Nickel Corp., is a Canada-based critical mineral exploration company in Newfoundland and Labrador developing the Pipestone XL Nickel-Cobalt Alloy Project. The project spans the entire 30-kilometer Pipestone Ophiolite Complex, where multiple zones, including RPM, Alloy Max, Super Gulp, Atlantic Lake, and Chrome Pond, contain awaruite, a naturally occurring magnetic nickel-iron-cobalt alloy of approximately 77% nickel with no-sulfur and no-sulfides, along with secondary chromium mineralization. The Pipestone Ophiolite Complex is a continuous belt of ultra mafic rocks enriched in nickel, cobalt and chromium. The Pipestone Ophiolite Complex's harzburgite and dunite (peridotite) composition creates the geological conditions required to form awaruite. Awaruite is a source of production for the stainless steel, electric vehicle, aerospace, and defense industries.

name: BLACK SWAN GRAPHENE
businessSummary: Black Swan Graphene Inc. is focused on the large-scale production and commercialization of patented graphene products aimed at several industrial sectors, including concrete, polymers and others. The Company’s products include GraphCore, GEM, and Graphene Concrete and Cement Add mixture. GraphCore consists of Aqueous Dispersion (GC100) and Powder (GC1004). GC1001 is a graphene nanoplatelet (GNP) dispersion. GEM masterbatch products are designed to integrate into supply chain and production processes. GEM consists of Polypropylene (PP) (GEM X23M & GEMS24M); High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) (GEM S27M); Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) (GEM N28M); Polyamide 6 (Nylon) (PA6) (GEM D26M); Polyamide 66 (Nylon) (PA66) (GEM A29M), and Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) (GEM B25L). The Company is also a manufacturer specializing in the custom molding of plastic and rubber components. It also offers injection molding services, including bi-injection and over molding.

name: CHAMPION BEAR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Champion Bear Resources Ltd. is a mineral exploration company focused on the historically prospective regions of the province of Ontario. Its targets are gold, platinum group metals, copper, poly-metallics, tantalum and rare earth elements (REE). The Company has assembled a large land position in the Dryden and Sudbury areas, totaling almost 17,000 hectares. Its projects include Eagle Rock, Parkin JV, Plomp Farm and Separation Rapids. The Eagle Rock Property is an advanced-stage copper-PEG exploration project located 65 kilometers (km) south of Dryden, Ontario and consists of 32,850 acres with 458 staked claims. The Parkin Project is an advanced exploration project located five km northeast of the Sudbury Basin comprised of 29 claims (2,850 acres) and covers a significant portion of the Parkin Offset Dike. The Plomp Farm Gold project consists of over 4,000 acres in two main claim blocks, owned 100% as patented and unpatented claims. The Separation Rapids lithium and tantalum property.

name: WALKER RIVER RESOURCES
businessSummary: Walker River Resources Corp. is a Canada-based exploration stage company. The Company is in the process of exploring its interest in the Lapon Gold Project, which consists of the Lapon Canyon Project, the Rattlesnake Project (the Rattlesnake), and the Pikes Peak Project (the Pikes Peak). The Lapon Gold Project consists of 149 claims (3103 acres) situated in the Wassuk Range, within the Walker Lane shear zone, a 100 kilometers wide structural corridor extending in a southeast direction from Reno, Nevada. The Lapon Gold Project includes Lapon Canyon, the Pikes Peak claims located four kilometers to the north and the Rattlesnake and Range Front claims three kilometers to the west and over 600 meters lower than the present drilling at Lapon Canyon. The Rattlesnake, Range Front, and Pikers Peak claims cover over 8 km of possible extensions of the range front zones to the west, north, and south of Lapon Canyon, adding several additional drill target areas to the project.

name: GOLD X2 MINING
businessSummary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., formerly Goldshore Resources Inc., is a Canada-based gold company. The Company is focused on the acquisition and advancement of primary gold assets in tier-one jurisdictions. The Company's focus is the advanced stage 100% owned Moss Gold Project which is located in Ontario, Canada. The Company also owns Huronian Gold Project. The Huronian Gold Project is situated in the emerging Shebandowan Greenstone Belt located in the AbitibiWawa Subprovince of the Archean Superior Province. The Company also adds an additional approximately 293 contiguous unpatented mining claims and four patented cell claims, totaling approximately 5,181 hectares. The Company also acquired a 100% interest in the non-core Bluffpoint Gold Project (the Bluffpoint Project). The Bluffpoint Project is comprised of over 449 mining claims covering approximately 9,134 hectares located in Bluffpoint Lake Township.

name: NORAM LITHIUM
businessSummary: Noram Lithium Corp. is Canadian junior exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing its Zeus Lithium Project (Zeus) to production in Nevada. The Zeus property is approximately halfway between Las Vegas and Reno, and within two kilometers of Albemarle Corporation’s lithium brine producing operations (Silver Peak Mine). The property consists of 1,133 hectares, which is the equivalent of 2,800 acres. Zeus consists of approximately 146 placer claims and 136 lode claims. The perimeter of the Zeus claims is located within 1-mile (1.6 kilometers) of Albemarle Corporation's (Albemarle's) lithium brine operations. Lithium is produced at Albemarle’s plant from deep wells that pump brines from the basin beneath the Clayton Valley playa.

name: IFABRIC
businessSummary: iFabric Corp. is a Canada-based company engaged in textile and performance-apparel technologies. Its segments include Intimate Apparel, Intelligent Fabrics and Other. Its two strategic divisions offer a variety of products and services through wholly owned subsidiaries, namely, Intelligent Fabric Technologies (North America) Inc. (IFTNA) and Coconut Grove Pads Inc. (Coconut Grove). IFTNA is focused on the development and sale of high-performance sports apparel, medical protective apparel, consumer protective apparel, and treatments that provide intelligent properties to fabrics, foams, plastics, and numerous other surfaces, thereby improving the safety and well-being of the user. Its intelligent properties include antiviral and antibacterial characteristics, water-repellence and UV protection, among others. Coconut Grove, operating as Coconut Grove Intimates, is a designer, manufacturer, distributor, licensor and licensee of ladies’ intimate apparel products and accessories.

name: BENZ MINING
businessSummary: Benz Mining Corp. is a Canada-based pure-play gold exploration company. The Company is engaged in the acquisition, exploration and exploitation of mineral properties located in Canada. Its projects include Glenburgh Gold Project, Mt Egerton Gold Project, and Eastmain Gold Project. The Eastmain gold project is located in the Upper Eastmain Greenstone belt, 320 kilometers (km) northwest of Chibougamau and 800 km North of Montreal. The property covers 8,000 hectares (ha), consists of 152 mineral claims and one industrial lease permit. The Glenburgh Gold Project and Mt Egerton Gold Project are located in the Gascoyne region of Western Australia. The Glenburgh Gold Project features a Mineral Resource Estimate of 16.3Mt at 1.0 g/t Au (510,100 ounces of contained gold). It also holds a 100% interest in an additional 124 claims on the Ruby Hill West property. It also holds a 100% interest in the Windy Mountain property, located in James Bay District, Quebec.

name: NATIONS ROYALTY
businessSummary: Nations Royalty Corp is a royalty company focused on Indigenous-owned royalties on precious metals and other natural resources assets. The Company acquires and manages Indigenous Benefit Agreement payments (royalties) from a variety of precious metals and natural resource assets. By pooling these assets together into a single public company, it looks to create a diversified portfolio of high-quality royalty payments to unlock premium valuations. The Company’s operations are anchored in five annual benefit entitlements linked to specific resource properties in Canada: Brucejack Gold Mine, operated by Pretium Resources Inc., a subsidiary of Newmont Corporation; KSM Copper-Gold-Silver-Molybdenum deposit, under development by Seabridge Gold Inc.; Premier Gold Project, managed by Ascot Resources Ltd.; Red Mountain Gold Deposit, owned by Ascot Resources Ltd; and Kitsault Molybdenum Deposit, a permitted brownfield site advanced by New Moly LLC, majority-owned by Resource Capital Fund VI L.P.

name: NV GOLD
businessSummary: NV Gold Corporation is a Canada-based exploration company. The Company is engaged in the identification, acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in the United States and Switzerland. It owns a 100% interest in 21 mineral exploration projects in Nevada, United States, comprising 639 mining claims totaling 53.4 square kilometers (20.6 square miles). Its Nevada projects include SW Pipe Project, Slumber Gold Project and Triple T Gold Property. Its Nevada projects also include Oasis, Root Spring, Darby Flats, Queens, Cooks Creek, Gold Cloud and others. Its Switzerland projects include Surselva Gold Project. The SW Pipe Gold Project is located in Lander County approximately six kilometers (km) southwest of the Pipeline gold mine in the central Cortez gold belt of north-central Nevada. The Slumber Gold Project is located over 80.5 kilometers (50 miles) northwest of Winnemucca and 35 kilometers west of the Sleeper gold deposit, Humboldt County, Nevada, United States.

name: ONGWE MINERALS
businessSummary: Ongwe Minerals Inc., formerly Great Quest Gold Ltd, is a Canadian mineral exploration company. The Company is a gold explorer in Namibia. Its projects include Khorixas Gold Project in Namibia, Omatjete Gold Project, Outjo Gold Project, and Eastern Desert Gold Project in Egypt. The Khorixas Gold Project, covering approximately 169,000 hectares, is located 350 kilometers (km) northeast of Walvis Bay in the Northern Zone of the Damara Orogenic Belt. The Omatjete Gold Project is located in the North Central Zone of the Damara Orogenic Belt over 93,000 hectares and situated approximately 80 km southeast of the Khorixas Project. The Outjo Gold Project, located approximately 80 km east of the Khorixas Project, covers 45,000 hectares within the Damara Orogenic Belt. Lotus Gold Corporation is subsidiary of the Company.

name: NOUVEAU MONDE GRAPHITE
businessSummary: Nouveau Monde Graphite Inc. is a Canada-based integrated company. The Company is engaged in developing responsible mining and advanced processing operations to supply the global economy with carbon-neutral active anode material to power electric vehicle (EV) and renewable energy storage systems. The Company is developing a fully integrated ore-to-battery-material source of graphite-based active anode material in Quebec, Canada. It is advancing the development of its Matawinie graphite property, in which the Company has 100% interest, to produce approximately 106,000 tons per annum (tpa) of graphite concentrate. The Becancour Battery Material Plant is approximately 150 kilometers (km) northeast of Montreal on the Saint Lawrence River. Its Uatnan Mining Project is in the Cote-Nord administrative region, Quebec, Canada, approximately 220 km as the crow flies, north northwest of the closest community, the city of Baie-Comeau.

name: FURY GOLD MINES
businessSummary: Fury Gold Mines Limited is a Canadian-focused exploration company. The Company consolidates a prospective gold and critical minerals exploration portfolio totaling over 157,000 hectares in Quebec. It has a portfolio of mineral properties, including the Eau Claire property located in the Eeyou Istchee James Bay Region of Northern Quebec (the Eau Claire Project), the Committee Bay gold project located in the Kitikmeot Region of Nunavut (the Committee Bay Project) and the Eleonore South property also located in the Eeyou Istchee James Bay Region of Northern Quebec (Eleonore South Project). Its other assets include the Sakami project, the Elmer East project, and the Kipawa project, among others. The Sakami gold project is located in Eeyou Istchee James Bay territory in Quebec, Canada. The Elmer East gold and lithium project is located in Eeyou Istchee James Bay territory in Quebec, Canada. The Kipawa project is located about 50 kilometers east of Temiscaming in southwestern Quebec.

name: CITY VIEW GREEN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: City View Green Holdings Inc. is a Canada-based consumer packaged goods company focused on the development of cannabis-infused edibles. The Company formulates, produces and sells cannabis edibles and related products.

name: DYNASTY GOLD
businessSummary: Dynasty Gold Corp. is a Canadian junior company focused on exploring for and developing economically viable mineral resources. The Company’s 100% owned Golden Repeat Gold Property is located in Elko County, Nevada, United States. The Golden Repeat Property is on the north slope of the Midas Trough, along the Carlin Trend, within the Northern Nevada Rift. The Golden Repeat Property consists of approximately 49 contiguous mining claims totaling over 392 hectares, adjacent to Waterton’s Clover gold property. The Company’s Thundercloud Property is located in the central Wabigoon greenstone belt in Western Ontario. The property consists of approximately 2,250 hectares, located 47 kilometers southeast of Dryden, northern Ontario.

name: ECO ATLANTIC OIL & GAS
businessSummary: Eco (Atlantic) Oil & Gas Ltd. is a Canada-based oil and gas exploration company with offshore licensed interests in Guyana, Namibia, and South Africa. The Company operates a 100% working interest in the 1,354 square kilometers (km2) Orinduik Block in Guyana. The Orinduik Block is situated in shallow to deep water (70m-1,400m), approximately 170 kilometers (km) offshore Guyana in the Suriname Guyana basin. The Company holds operatorship and an 85% working interest in four offshore petroleum licenses in the Republic of Namibia, being petroleum exploration licenses (PELs) 97 (the Cooper License); 98 (the Sharon License); 99 (the Guy License); and 100 (the Tamar License), representing a combined area of approximately 28,593 km2 in the Walvis Basin. In South Africa, the Company holds an approximately 5.25% working interest in Block 3B/4B and pending government approval of a 75% operating interest in Block 1, in the Orange Basin, totaling some 37,510km2.

name: UNIGOLD
businessSummary: Unigold Inc. is a mineral exploration company. The Company is focused primarily on exploring and developing its gold assets in the Dominican Republic. The Candelones oxide gold deposit is within the 100% owned Neita Fase II exploration concession located in Dajabon province, in the northwest part of the Dominican Republic. The Candelones project area is about 20 kilometers south of the town of Restauracion. The oxide deposit occurs at the surface as a result of the tropical weathering of underlying mineralization. It owns 100% of the exploration rights for gold, silver, zinc, copper, and all associated minerals on the Neita Norte and Neita Sur Properties in the northwestern Dominican Republic. The Candelones Project is composed of two distinct mineralization zones: the Candelones Main and Connector (CMC) and the Candelones Extension (CE). The Neita Norte Exploration Concession covers approximately 10,902 hectares. Neita Sur is an Exploitation Concession covering over 9,990 hectares.

name: FATHOM NICKEL
businessSummary: Fathom Nickel Inc. is a Canada-based exploration company. The Company is targeting magmatic nickel sulphide discoveries to secure the supply of North American Critical Minerals and to support the global green energy transition. The Company has a portfolio of three exploration projects located in the prolific Trans Hudson Corridor in Saskatchewan: Albert Lake Project, Gochager Lake Project, and Friesen Lake Project. The Albert Lake property consists of approximately 90,000+ hectares, located within the Rottenstone Domain, which defines the western margin of the Trans Hudson Corridor. The Gochager Lake Project consists of over 33,000+ hectares. The Gochager Lake Project also hosts the historic Gochager Lake deposit. Its 10,000+ hectare Friesen Lake Project is located over 40 kilometers (km) southwest of the historic Rottenstone Mine and 30km northwest of the Gochager Lake deposit. The Friesen Lake property hosts the Olsen Cu-Ni-Pt.

name: PLATAURO METALS
businessSummary: Platauro Metals Corp., formerly Mexican Gold Mining Corp., is a Canada-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focusing on discoveries and strategic acquisitions of prospective precious metals and copper projects in the Americas. The Company's portfolio includes the Las Minas Project, Mexico and the Princesa Silver-Polymetallic Project in the Puno-Cusco Mining District, Peru. The Las Minas project is located 16 kilometers (km) from a toll highway and rail corridor at Cruz Blanca junction, which by road is another 240 km east of Mexico City and 150 km west of the port city of Veracruz. The Las Minas project has two gold-copper deposits in advanced-stage exploration, and multiple exploration targets. The project comprises six mineral concessions located in the Las Minas district in the state of Veracruz, Mexico, consisting of the Pepe, Pepe Tres, San Jose, Pueblo Nuevo, La Luz I and San Valentin mineral concessions.

name: EPLAY DIGITAL
businessSummary: ePlay Digital Inc. is a Canada-based technology company specializing in augmented reality, mobile game development, and esports. The Company's portfolio includes sports, esports, and entertainment gaming platforms. It leverages its technology to deliver interactive experiences to its users. The Company is focused on the ongoing development of and upgrades to its Klocked app and Klocked World metaverse. Klocked is a sports metaverse with automated virtual sports production and stadium/mass participation activation. Klocked works for any sport, including the augmented reality running app, Klocked.run, sports gaming app Fan Freak, and flagship title Big Shot Basketball. Big Shot AR Basketball is an augmented reality (AR) game that allows users to build their fantasy team while taking AR selfies with their favorite athletes. Through its subsidiary Mobovivo Inc. (MV), the Company offers a social game engine and content marketing platform to engage audiences.

name: CASCADERO COPPER
businessSummary: Cascadero Copper Corporation is a Canada-based integrated mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on the exploration and development of its properties located in Salta, Argentina. It holds an interest in 27 mineral properties in the northern area of the Argentine Puna (primarily in the Province of Salta). The Company’s properties include Amarillo, Amarillo Norte, El Oculto Group, Incamayo Norte, Ochaqui Silver, Santa Rosa Group, Taca Taca Group, Taron Group and Viejo Campo. The El Oculto group comprises the El Oculto, Centauro, Cerro Lari I and Cerro Lari II properties. The Incamayo Norte property is located approximately 100 kilometers (km) west of the city of Salta, in the Sierra de Cachi portion of the Nevados de Palermo Mountain Range. The Ochaqui property is located at the eastern edge of the Argentine Puna, about 100 km west of Salta city. The Company has a joint venture with Golden Minerals on its Sarita Este license.

name: CONDOR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Condor Resources Inc. is a precious and base metals' exploration company focused on its portfolio of projects in Peru. The Company's flagship Pucamayo project is located 185 km southeast of Lima and covers an area of approximately 85 square kilometers (km2), containing a high sulfidation epithermal system with disseminated precious metals mineralization with a large lithocap alteration visible at the surface. Its other projects include Huinac Punta, Cobreorco, Lucero, Andrea, Rio Bravo, Chavin, and San Martin. The Huinac Punta project is about 65 km south-east of the Antamina mine. The project, a 7,200 Ha property in Huanuco, Peru, has the potential to host a large carbonate replacement style (CRD) silver-dominant polymetallic mineralized body with the potential for discovery of a bulk tonnage silver and base metals deposit. The Chavin property covers an area of over 14 km2 within the central Andes mineral belt in northern Peru and is host to a polymetallic vein system.

name: BLUEBERRIES MEDICAL
businessSummary: Blueberries Medical Corp. is a Canada-based producer of cannabis derivatives with its primary operations ideally located in the Bogota Savannah of central Colombia. The Company is fully licensed for the cultivation, production, domestic distribution, and international export of cannabidiol (CBD) and tetrahydrocannabinol (THC)-based medical cannabis in Colombia. The Company is focusing on cultivating, processing, and supplying medicinal-grade Cannabis oil extracts, medical flowers, and related products. Additionally, the Company distributes functional supplements, wellness products, and natural ingredients. The Company’s subsidiaries include Blueberries Research Corporation (BRC) and Blueberries SAS (BBSAS). BBSAS is a licensed producer and distributor of medicinal Cannabis and Cannabis-derived products in Colombia.

name: FORGE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Forge Resources Corp. is a Canadian junior exploration company. The Company is engaged in the business of the exploration and development of natural resource properties in Canada and Colombia. The Company holds an 80% interest in Aion Mining Corp., a company that is developing the fully permitted La Estrella coal project in Santander, Colombia. La Estrella contains approximately eight known seams of metallurgical and thermal coal. Aion Mining controls the FLG-111 concession that covers approximately 548 hectares (Ha) in a region of historic and current coal mining. The Company also holds an option on the Alotta project, a prospective porphyry copper-gold-molybdenum project located 50 kilometers (kms) south-east of the Casino porphyry deposit in the unglaciated portion of the Dawson Range porphyry/epithermal belt in the Yukon Territory of Canada. The Alotta property comprises 230 mineral claims covering a total of 4,723 hectares, situated in the Dawson Range gold belt in Yukon, Canada.

name: MAGMA SILVER
businessSummary: Magma Silver Corp., formerly African Energy Metals Inc., is a natural resource company with a focus on the acquisition, exploration, development, and operation of precious metal mining exploration projects. The Company’s primary focus is on exploring and developing the advanced Ninobamba silver gold project in the mining-supportive country of Peru. The Ninobamba silver gold project is located less than 500 kilometers south-southeast of Lima, within the Ayacucho region, and is just 45 minutes from the city of Ayacucho. The property spans about 4,100 hectares and is 100% optioned by the Company. Situated in the mineral-rich Ayacucho region of Peru, the Ninobamba Project lies within a highly prospective geological belt.

name: QUARTZ MOUNTAIN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Quartz Mountain Resources Ltd. is a Canada-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on acquiring, exploring, developing and transacting gold, silver and copper deposits in British Columbia. The Company holds 100% of the Maestro Gold-Silver-Molybdenum-Copper Property and 100% of the Jake Copper-Gold-Silver Property. The Maestro Project is located in central British Columbia and lies adjacent to Highway 16, 15 kilometers(km) north of Houston and 45 km -7 south of Smithers, providing year-round road access to the project and nearby infrastructure including rail, hydroelectricity, and natural gas. This property comprises 13 mineral claims and totals 2,309 hectares (ha). The Jake Property is located 160 km north of Smithers in north central British Columbia. This property comprises 14 mineral claims and totals 6,731 ha. The Company also acquires additional mineral claims surrounding Jake, hosting an entire new potential copper-gold porphyry district.

name: SILVER47 EXPLORATION
businessSummary: Silver47 Exploration Corp is a Canada-based mineral exploration company. The Company is focused on uncovering and developing silver-rich deposits in North America. The Company owns three exploration projects, such as Red Mountain Project, Adams Plateau Project, and Michelle Project. The flagship Red Mountain VMS silver-zinc-lead-copper-gold project is located in south central Alaska 100 kilometers (km) south of Fairbanks, United States of America. It owns over 942 mineral claims and one mining lease in the project. The Adams Plateau silver-zinc-lead-copper Project covers an area of over 150 square kilometers (km2) and is located approximately 40 km north of Chase, British Columbia, and 100km north east of Kamloops. The Michelle silver-lead-zinc-gallium-antimony Project is located in Northcentral Yukon Territory, Canada, covering approximately 158 km2 of land. The project is a silver-rich Mississippi Valley Type (MVT) SEDEX deposit.

name: CONTAGIOUS GAMING
businessSummary: Contagious Gaming Inc. is a Canada-based company. The Company is in the business of developing software solutions for regulated gaming and lottery markets. It is focused on capitalizing on its proprietary digital instant lottery content while pursuing other opportunities to grow the business through potential transactions.

name: CORDOBA MINERALS
businessSummary: Cordoba Minerals Corp. is a Canada-based mineral exploration company focused on the exploration, development and acquisition of copper and gold projects. The Company holds a 51% interest in the Perseverance Copper Project in Arizona, United States of America. The Perseverance Project is a large-scale copper project in Arizona’s Copper Triangle, a Tier 1 jurisdiction with multi-billion-dollar copper deposits. The Perseverance Project is located approximately 19 miles southeast of Kingman and 150 miles northwest of Phoenix, with a land package comprising more than 13,000 acres.

name: SCORPIO GOLD
businessSummary: Scorpio Gold Corporation is a Canada-based company, which holds a 100% interest in the Manhattan District project, a past producing project located in the Walker Lane Trend of Nevada, United States. The Company’s Manhattan District is approximately 4,780-hectares and comprises the advanced exploration-stage Goldwedge Mine, with a 400-ton-per-day maximum capacity gravity mill, and four past-producing pits. Situated on the southern periphery of the Manhattan Caldera, approximately 16 kilometers (km) south of the over 15-million-ounce Round Mountain Mine is a 100% owned Manhattan property. This 6,071-acre property encompasses the Goldwedge Mine. The Goldwedge Mine is a fully permitted underground mine with over 600 meters of excavation.

name: FRONTIER NUCLEAR AND MINERALS
businessSummary: Frontier Nuclear and Minerals Inc., formerly Snow Lake Resources Ltd., is developing a front-end nuclear fuel cycle company through a portfolio of United States uranium exploration and development projects in Wyoming, Colorado, and Utah, together with uranium enrichment and small modular reactors. The Company’s projects include Engo Valley, Shatford Lake, Pine Ridge, Snow Lake Lithium and Tallahassee. The Engo Valley is located on Skeleton Coast, Namibia and is an exploration stage uranium project covering around 63,000 acres with an exclusive prospecting. Pine Ridge is an exploration stage uranium project located in the Powder River Basin, Wyoming. Shatford Lake is an exploration stage LCT (lithium, caesium, tantalum) project located immediately to the south of the Tanco Mine. Snow Lake Lithium is located in Manitoba with primary minerals lithium. Tallahassee is located in Freemont County, Colorado with sandstone hosted uranium deposits.

name: METALLA ROYALTY & STREAMING
businessSummary: Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. is a Canada-based precious and base metals royalty and streaming company. The Company focuses on acquiring gold, silver, and copper metal purchase agreements, Net Smelter Return (NSR) royalties, Gross Value Return (GVR) royalties, Net Profit Interests (NPI), Gross Proceeds (GP) royalties, Gross Overriding Return (GOR) royalties, Price Participation (PP) royalties, Net Proceeds (NP) royalties, and non-operating interests in mining projects. The Company owns about 100 royalties, streams, and other interests. Six of the royalties and streams are in the production stage, 41 are in the development stage, and the remainder are in the exploration stage. The Company’s streams and royalties include Tocantinzinho, Wharf, Aranzazu, La Guitarra, La Encantada, New Luika, Akasaba West, Amalgamated Kirkland, Aureus East, Hoyle Pond Extension, Timmins West Extension, Castle Mountain, Twin Metals, Vizcachitas, Wasamac, West Wall, Saddle North, and Zaruma, among others.

name: COSA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Cosa Resources Corp. is a Canadian uranium exploration company operating in northern Saskatchewan. Its portfolio comprises over 237,000 hectares (ha) across multiple projects in the Athabasca Basin region, all of which are underexplored, and the majority reside within or adjacent to established uranium corridors. Its properties include Ursa, Astro, Helios, Orion, Orbit, Charcoal, Castor, Aurora, Solstice, and Cosmos. The Ursa Property is located 45 km west of the McArthur River uranium mine and covers over 60,000 ha. The Astro property is located over 28 km west of the McArthur River Mine, 17 km west of the Fox Lake Deposit, and 13 km north of the Millennium Deposit. The Cosmo property consists of over 12 claims totaling 9,308 hectares. The Solstice property comprises over three mineral claims totaling 628 hectares, which is located 14 km north of the Smart Lake uranium occurrence, 24 km northwest of F3 Uranium Corp.’s JR Zone, and 36 km southwest of the Shea Creek uranium deposits.

name: SELKIRK COPPER MINES
businessSummary: Selkirk Copper Mines Inc., formerly Venerable Ventures Ltd., is a Canada-based company, which is engaged in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties located in Canada. The Company owns 100% interest in the Minto copper-gold-silver mine (Project) located in the Yukon. The Minto copper-gold-silver mine is an idle open-pit and underground copper-gold mine located on Selkirk First Nation land in Yukon, Canada. The Company controls approximately 26,850 hectares of prospective mineral claims located in the Minto-Carmacks copper belt as well as significant open-pit and underground infrastructure, a 4,100 ton per day processing plant, water treatment facilities, numerous ancillary buildings, and mobile equipment centered on the former Minto copper-gold-silver mine.

name: XALI GOLD
businessSummary: Xali Gold Corp. is a gold and silver exploration company focused on advancing opportunities in the Americas. The Company is focused on completing the exploration and development of Pico Machay, an advanced exploration stage gold project in South America. In Mexico, it maintains exploration, as well as two royalty agreements with third parties who have rights to produce gold and silver from specific areas of the El Oro gold-silver Project. The Pico Machay is a high-sulphidation gold deposit that lies within the northern extent of the Southern Peru Epithermal Gold-Silver Belt. Las Brujas project is located in the Province of San Miguel, Department of Cajamarca in Northern Peru. It is located 34 kilometers (km) northwest of the Yanacocha mine, 18 km west of the Tantahuatay Prospect and 12 km northeast of the La Zanja Project. Its Mexico projects include El Oro Hard Rock, El Oro Tailings, and Western Mexico. The San Dieguito de Arriba (SDA) plant is located in Nayarit, Western Mexico.

name: SKYHARBOUR RESOURCES
businessSummary: Skyharbour Resources Ltd. holds a portfolio of uranium exploration projects in Canada's Athabasca Basin, with interests in around 37 projects covering over 616,000 hectares (over 1.5 million acres) of land. Its projects include Moore Lake Project, Russell Lake Project, South Falcon, South Falcon East, Preston, East Preston, Hook Lake and others. The Moore Uranium Project consists of 12 contiguous claims totaling 35,705 hectares located 42 kilometers (km) northeast of the Key Lake mill, approximately 15 kilometers east of Denison’s Wheeler River project. The Russell Lake Project is a large, advanced-stage uranium exploration property totaling 73,314 hectares strategically located between Cameco’s Key Lake and McArthur River Projects. The South Falcon East Project covers approximately 12,234 hectares and lies 18 km outside the Athabasca Basin, approximately 55 km east of the Key Lake Mine. The Hook Lake area is located near the northern end of the property. It also owns Foster property.

name: NEPTUNE DIGITAL ASSETS
businessSummary: Neptune Digital Assets Corp. is a Canada-based blockchain company. The Company engages in operations across the digital asset ecosystem, including Bitcoin mining, proof-of-stake mining, blockchain nodes, decentralized finance (DeFi), and other associated cutting-edge technology. The Company builds, owns, and operates infrastructure supporting the digital currency ecosystem. The Company’s ancillary activities include lending various digital currencies. Its computing power generates earnings for the work of securing and processing transactions across the Bitcoin network. It runs GPU mining machines in North America with access to renewable power. It is focused on using renewable energy like solar, hydro, and wind to power its Bitcoin mining operations. Its wholly owned subsidiary is Neptune Digital USA Corp. (Neptune USA). Neptune USA is engaged in Bitcoin mining operations in the United States. The principal place of business of Neptune USA is in the United States.

name: US COPPER
businessSummary: US Copper Corp. is a Canada-based junior exploration stage company. The Company has interests in exploration properties in Ontario, Canada and, through wholly owned subsidiaries, has interests in exploration properties in Nevada and California, United States. It controls approximately 13 square miles of patented and unpatented federal mining claims in the Lights Creek Copper District in Plumas County in northeast California. The District contains substantial copper sulfide and copper oxide resources in three deposits, such as Moonlight, Superior and Engels, as well as several partially tested and untested exploration targets. The Superior Project includes about 132 unpatented mining claims and a lease on 36 patented claims in Plumas County, California. It also owns mining interests in Timore, Warren Whiteside, and Black Warrior. The Company owns a 100% interest in patented claims covering one property near Timmins, Ontario and one property near Red Lake, Ontario.

name: SCOTTIE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Scottie Resources Corp. is a Canada-based exploration stage company engaged in the exploration and evaluation of gold and silver properties located in the Golden Triangle of British Columbia, Canada. The Company's projects include Scottie Gold Mine Project, Cambria Project and Georgia Project. It owns a 100% interest in the Scottie Gold Mine Property which includes the Blueberry Contact Zone and the high-grade, past-producing Scottie Gold Mine. The Scottie Gold Mine Project consists of approximately 20 mineral claims and 14 Crown granted claims for a total area of 8,534 hectares. It also owns 100% interest in the Georgia Project which contains the high-grade past-producing Georgia River Mine, as well as the Cambria Project properties and the Sulu and Tide North properties. The 17,625-hectare high-grade gold Georgia Project is centered on the past-producing Georgia River Mine. It altogether holds around 58,500 hectares of mineral claims in the Stewart Mining Camp in the Golden Triangle.

name: NICOLA MINING
businessSummary: Nicola Mining Inc. is a junior mining company that maintains a 100% owned mill and tailings facility, located near Merritt, British Columbia. Its fully permitted mill can process both gold and silver mill feed via gravity and flotation processes. The Company owns 100% of the New Craigmont Project, a property that hosts high-grade copper mineralization and covers an area of over 10,800 hectares (ha) along the southern end of the Guichon Batholith and is adjacent to Highland Valley Copper. The Craigmont Property consists of 10 mineral leases and 22 mineral claims. The Craigmont Property is located over 14 kilometers (km) northwest of Merritt and 190 km northeast of Vancouver. It also owns 100% of the Treasure Mountain Property, which includes 30 mineral claims and a mineral lease, spanning an area exceeding 2,200 ha. The Treasure Mountain Property is located within the Similkameen Mining Division in British Columbia. It maintains a 75% economic interest in Dominion Creek Property.

name: DIAGNOS
businessSummary: Diagnos Inc. is a Canadian company, which is engaged in the early detection of critical eye-related health problems using advanced technology based on Artificial Intelligence (AI). It markets Computer Assisted Retinal Analysis (CARA), a software platform which assists health specialists in the detection of certain retinopathy pathologies through the computerized analysis of retina images. CARA is an in-house-hosted Web-based application that integrates fundus cameras with an image processing engine over a secure Internet connection. The CARA suite of applications allows an eye care specialist to more clearly visualize both normal retinal landmarks (optic nerve, vascular system, macula, fovea), and pathological changes (exudates, haemorrhages, micro-aneurisms, neo-vascularization). CARA is indicated for use by healthcare professionals in an adult general population in the context of a general eye-health exam.

name: NEXTSOURCE MATERIALS
businessSummary: NextSource Materials Inc. is a Canada-based battery materials development company. The Company is focused on supplying battery materials through the mining and value-added processing of graphite and other minerals. Its segments include mine development and BAF development. The Company’s principal business is the development of the Molo Graphite Mine (the Molo Mine) located near the town of Fotadrevo in the Province of Toliara, Madagascar. The Molo Mine has a production capacity of about 150,000 tons per annum (tpa) of SuperFlake graphite concentrate. The Company is also developing a downstream graphite value-added business through the staged rollout of Battery Anode Facilities capable of large-scale production of coated, spheronized and purified graphite for direct delivery to battery and automotive customers. It also owns the Green Giant Vanadium Project, located in Madagascar, and the Sagar Project, located in Quebec, which are at the exploration and evaluation stage.

name: QUANTUM EMOTION
businessSummary: Quantum eMotion Corp. is a Canada-based developer of cryptographic solutions. The Company is a developer of quantum-based cryptographic solutions pursuant to the development of intellectual property and commercialization of cybersecurity solutions. Its software products include Sentry-Q, eFlux-Q, eCrypto-Q, eHot-Q, among others. Its hardware products include eCore-Q, and others. Its Sentry-Q is a quantum safe encryption platform to sensitive data across networks and applications. Its eFlux-Q is a Cloud based entropy distribution system delivering quantum generated entropy. Its eCrypto-Q is a developer ready software development kit (SDK) combining electron-based quantum random number generators (QRNG) and post quantum cryptography (PQC) to build quantum resilient applications and services. Its SecureKey is a cryptographic software platform engineered to deliver hardware-grade security protections across cloud, network, and embedded environments.

name: RIVERSIDE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Riverside Resources Inc. is a mineral exploration and evaluation company. The Company is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of assets across North America. Its projects include La Union Project, Suaqui Verde and Suaqui Grande, Los Cuarentas Gold-Silver Project, Cecilia Gold-Silver Project, Sandy Gold Project, Maria Luisa Copper Property and Ariel Copper-Gold Project. La Union Project is located in western Sonora, approximately 30 kilometers south of Caborca, part of the orogenic gold trend, Mexico. The Los Cuarentas Gold-Silver Project is located in northern Sonora, 170 kilometers northeast of Hermosillo and located 17 kilometers northwest of SilverCrest Metals’ Las Chispas Mine. It has developed copper targets on both the Suaqui Verde and Suaqui Grande properties and both are located in the copper belt of central Sonora, Mexico. It also has a 100% ownership interest in the Australia Gold Project, which is made up of two concessions: Sandy and Sandy 2.

name: ANFIELD ENERGY
businessSummary: Anfield Energy Inc. is a Canada-based uranium and vanadium development and near-term production company. The Company’s portfolio of projects includes Shootaring Canyon Mill, Velvet-Wood, Slick Rock and West Slope. Its additional projects include Marquez-Juan Tafoya Uranium, Frank M, Findlay Tank Breccia Pipes, Newsboy Gold and Artillery Peak. The Shootaring Canyon Mill is located approximately 77 kilometers south of Hanksville, Utah. The Slick Rock is an advanced-stage uranium and vanadium project located in San Miguel County, Colorado, covering approximately 4,976 acres with 268 contiguous mineral lode claims. The West Slope Project, located in Montrose and San Miguel Counties of southwestern Colorado, consists of nine Department of Energy (DOE) leases, associated with adjacent lode mining claims and leases, covering 6,913 acres. It has also entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a 100% interest in twelve DOE leases and associated data in various counties in Colorado.

name: NORSEMONT MINING
businessSummary: Norsemont Mining Inc. is a Canada-based company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and development of resource properties. The Company owns a 100% interest in the Choquelimpie gold-silver-copper project in northern Chile, a previously permitted gold and silver mine with significant exploration upside. Choquelimpie has over 1,710 drill holes, with significant existing infrastructure, including roads, power, water, camp and a 3,000-tonne-per-day mill. The Choquelimpie Gold and Silver Project is located in the Arica and Parinacota Region of Chile, covering over 5757 hectares (ha) with year-round access.

name: SKEENA RESOURCES
businessSummary: Skeena Resources Limited is a precious metals developer that is focused on advancing the Eskay Creek Gold-Silver Project, a past producing mine located in the Golden Triangle in British Columbia, Canada. Eskay Creek represents one of the highest-grade and lowest cost open-pit precious metals mines in the world, with substantial silver by-product production. It also owns the past-producing Snip gold mine (Snip). In addition to Eskay Creek and Snip, the Company also owns several exploration stage mineral properties in the Golden Triangle and Liard Mining Division of British Columbia. Its 100%-owned Eskay Creek Project is a high-grade volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) deposit. The Hoodoo property is situated approximately 65 kilometers northwest of Eskay Creek. Snip Deposit is located approximately 40 kilometers (km) west of Eskay Creek. The Snip Gold Project is a past-producing underground mine that produced 1.1 million ounces of gold.

name: MINNOVA
businessSummary: Minnova Corp. is a gold development company. The Company's core business is the exploration and development of mineral properties in Manitoba, Canada, specifically the past producing Puffy Gold Mine (PL Mine). The Company owns a 100% interest in the PL Mine and contiguous Nokomis property, located in Manitoba. It owns 46% minority interest in the Nokomis Property from Claude Resources Inc. The property is located less than eight kilometers (kms) northeast of the existing mine and mill infrastructure on the PLP, near Flin Flon, Manitoba.

name: DEEP SEA MINERALS
businessSummary: Deep Sea Minerals Corp., formerly Copperhead Resources Inc., is a Canada-based subsea mineral exploration and development company focused on evaluating opportunities to support the supply of critical minerals through the acquisition, exploration, and development of deep-sea mineral assets. The Company’s strategy is centered on identifying jurisdictions and geological settings with potential exposure to polymetallic nodule systems, which are recognized for containing combinations of metals that may be relevant to defense, industrial manufacturing, clean energy infrastructure, advanced electronics, and artificial intelligence-related supply chains. The Company has commenced early-stage engagement with selected governments and regulatory bodies in the Pacific Ocean region to assess potential pathways for future exploration initiatives, subject to applicable international, national, and environmental frameworks. Its projects include EEZ Projects and ISA Projects.

name: TRIDENT RESOURCES
businessSummary: Trident Resources Corp. is a mineral exploration company. It is focused on the development, exploration and acquisition of advanced-stage gold and copper exploration projects in Saskatchewan, Canada. It is advancing its 100% owned Contact Lake and Greywacke Lake projects, which host historical gold resources located within the prospective and underexplored La Ronge Gold Belt, as well as the 100% owned Knife Lake copper project which contains a historical copper resource. The Contact Lake Gold Project, Trident Resources Corp’s flagship asset, spans approximately 23,000 hectares situated at the junction of the La Ronge, Kisseynew and Glennie Domains of the prolific Reindeer Zone in Saskatchewan. The Greywacke Lake Gold Project is located 88 km northeast of La Ronge and 22 kilometers (km) northeast of the community of Missinipe. Its Reindeer Project consists of 10 contiguous mineral claims totaling 29,000 hectares in northern Saskatchewan. The Raney Gold Project is 2,800 hectares.

name: ALLIED CRITICAL METALS
businessSummary: Allied Critical Metals Inc., formerly DeepRock Minerals Inc., is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral resource properties in Canada, as well as the acquisition, exploration, and potential development of tungsten projects in Portugal. The Company owns, through its wholly owned Portuguese subsidiaries, ACM Tungsten Unipessoal Lda., and Pan Metals Unipessoal Lda., 100% of two Portuguese tungsten projects: the Borralha Tungsten Project and the Vila Verde Tungsten Project. The Borralha Tungsten Project is a 3.8-square-kilometer land package located within a mining jurisdiction in Portugal, 80-kilometers (km) northeast of Porto. The Vila Verde Tungsten Project is located approximately 45 km south of Borrahla, located within a mining jurisdiction in Portugal, 80 km northeast of Porto.

name: ROCKHAVEN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Rockhaven Resources Ltd. is a Canada-based mineral exploration company. The Company is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral property interests located in Canada. It is focused on the exploration and development of its 100%-owned Klaza Property, which hosts the Klaza Deposit and numerous explored exploration targets. The Company’s Klaza Property hosts a gold-silver deposit located in the Mount Nansen Gold Camp in southwestern Yukon. The Klaza project is comprised of 1,478 mineral claims and covers an area of approximately 287 square kilometers (km2). All of the mineral claims comprising the Klaza project are located in the Whitehorse Mining District, approximately 50 km west of the community of Carmacks, in southern Yukon Territory. The Klaza project includes the BBB, Sked, Desk, Dade, Queen and Nor claims located in the Whitehorse Mining District, Yukon Territory. It also includes the Val claims located in the Whitehorse Mining District, Yukon Territory.

name: NEW FOUND GOLD
businessSummary: New Found Gold Corp. is a Canadian gold producer with assets in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The Company holds a 100% interest in Queensway Gold Project, as well as the Hammerdown Operation, Pine Cove Operation and Nugget Pond Hydrometallurgical Gold Plant. Its Maritime Division controls over 43,900 hectares of exploration land, including the Green Bay, Whisker Valley, Gull Ridge and Point Rousse projects. The Queensway Gold Project encompasses approximately 230,225 hectares, which is located on the Trans-Canada Highway, 15 km west of Gander and the Project is divided by Gander Lake into Queensway North and Queensway South. The Hammerdown gold deposit is located approximately five km southwest of the Town of King’s Point and 15 km northwest of the Town of Springdale in Newfoundland & Labrador. The Pine Cove Operation includes the Point Rousse Project, located within the Baie Verte Mining District, in the northern portion of the Baie Verte Peninsula.

name: 1911 GOLD
businessSummary: 1911 Gold Corporation is a Canada-based junior exploration company. The Company holds a prospective, consolidated land package totaling approximately 61,647 hectares (ha) within and adjacent to the Archean Rice Lake Greenstone belt in Manitoba, and also owns the True North mine and mill complex at Bissett, Manitoba. It also owns the Apex property near Snow Lake, Manitoba, and the Denton-Keefer property near Timmins, Ontario. Its True North Complex is located adjacent to the town of Bissett on the north shore of Rice Lake, approximately 150 kilometers (km) northeast of the capital city of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Its Rice Lake exploration properties, totaling over 61,647 ha, cover the most prospective portions of the Rice Lake Greenstone belt, part of the same belt of greenstones that includes the high-grade Red Lake gold district. The Denton-Keefer property (2,106 ha in area) covers a 6.5 km long section of the Abitibi greenstone belt, including a portion of the Porcupine-Destor Fault.

name: AIS RESOURCES
businessSummary: A.I.S. Resources Limited is a Canada-based company, which is exploring copper-gold-silver-antimony opportunities in New Brunswick. The Company is focused on advancing two highly prospective mineral projects in New Brunswick - the St. John Project and the Pocologan Copper-Gold-Silver Project. The Saint John Project is considered prospective for IOCG-style mineralization based on regional geological setting and the Company's exploration model. The Pocologan Project is an early-stage copper-gold-silver exploration project, which covers around 21.5 square kilometers. Its Frenchmans Creek project is an early-stage, district-scale copper-gold-silver exploration project focused on IOCG/magmatic copper-gold, and structurally controlled copper-silver-gold targets. The Company's total land position covers approximately 25,683 hectares across Southwestern New Brunswick. Its other projects include Bright Gold Project, Toolleen-Fosterville Gold Project, Kingston Gold Project and Candela II Project.

name: SERNOVA BIOTHERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Sernova Biotherapeutics Inc. is a Canada-based clinical-stage company, which is focused on developing regenerative medicine therapeutics combining its Cell Pouch with human donor cells or stem cell-derived cell therapies to create bio-hybrid organs to treat chronic diseases. A bio-hybrid organ is comprised of non-biomaterials, such as the Cell Pouch, integrated with living tissues to restore or enhance the function of a compromised organ. This approach aims to deliver a potentially revolutionary treatment for patients with chronic diseases, initially focusing on type 1 diabetes (T1D) and thyroid disorders. Cell Pouch is a bio-hybrid organ which is surgically implanted beneath the skin of the abdomen.

name: BRAZIL POTASH
businessSummary: Brazil Potash Corp. is a mineral exploration and development company. The Company has a potash mining project (which is referred to as the Autazes Project) located in the state of Amazonas, Brazil. Its technical operations are based in Autazes, Amazonas, Brazil and Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The Mineral Resources on the property on which the Autazes Project is situated are in an area encompassing approximately 98 square miles located in the Amazon potash basin near the city of Autazes in the eastern portion of the state of Amazonas, Brazil, within the Central Amazon Basin, between the Amazon River and the Madeira River, approximately 75 miles southeast of the city of Manaus, northern Brazil. The Company holds all the mineral rights for the Autazes Project through its wholly-owned local subsidiary in Brazil, Potassio do Brasil Ltda. It has the rights to access over 24 rural properties, consisting of a total area of approximately 5.4 square miles.

name: ZODIAC GOLD
businessSummary: Zodiac Gold Inc. is a Canada-based gold exploration company. The Company is focused on its flagship Todi Project situated in Liberia-an underexplored, politically stable, mining-friendly jurisdiction hosting several large-scale gold deposits. The Company owns 100% of the Todi project in Liberia, which consists of three district scale Mineral Exploration Licenses covering an area of approximately 2,316 square kilometers. The Todi Project is located in the Montserrado and Bomi Townships, approximately 13 kilometers north of Zodiac Gold’s operational office in Monrovia, the capital city of Liberia. It also has interests in Bomi South and Bong West exploration licenses in Liberia. The Company’s subsidiary is Gem Rocks Mining Resources Inc.

name: VERSAMET ROYALTIES
businessSummary: Versamet Royalties Corporation is a mid-tier precious metals royalty and streaming company. The Company is focused on building a diverse portfolio of royalty and streaming assets ranging from those which are under exploration through to those which are in production and which are already cash-generating for the Company. Its portfolio includes producing and development-stage assets across a range of commodities. Its portfolio includes Zuun Mod, Wiluna, Vittangi, Toega, Primavera, Prairie Creek, Pilar, Pacaska, Nefasit, Mocoa, Midas, Mercedes, Mason, Kolpa, Kiaka, Hackett River, Greenstone, Golden Sidewalk, El Pilar, Del Norte, Converse, Bobosso, Blackwater, Ajax, and Adi Dairo. The Zuun Mod Project, 100% owned by Erdene Resource Development, is an undeveloped molybdenum-copper porphyry deposit. The Wiluna uranium project is located in Western Australia, 30 kilometers (km) south of the town of Wiluna. The Vittangi graphite project is located in Kiruna, Sweden.

name: EXCELLON RESOURCES
businessSummary: Excellon Resources Inc. is a Canada-based company, which is engaged in the acquisition and advancement of precious and base metal assets. The Company is focused on the potential restart of the Mallay Silver Mine in Peru. The Company also holds a portfolio of exploration-stage projects, including Kilgore, an advanced gold project in Idaho, and Silver City, a high-grade epithermal silver district in Saxony, Germany, providing additional growth upside. The Mallay is located in the Andes of central Peru, within the Lima Region, approximately 180 km north of Lima by road. The Mallay Mine hosts a high-grade silver-lead-zinc vein system with epithermal characteristics. The Kilgore project consists of approximately 5,489 hectares of mineral concessions located in Clark County, situated in eastern Idaho, United States. The Silver City project is comprised of four mineral licenses totaling 340 square kilometers. The Tres Cerros project is located in the Andes of north-central Peru.

name: ALDEBARAN RESOURCES
businessSummary: Aldebaran Resources Inc. is a Canada-based mineral exploration company, which is engaged in the acquisition and exploration of exploration and evaluation properties. The Company is focused onadvancing the Altar copper-gold project, an undeveloped copper asset. The Company holds an 80% interest in the Altar copper-gold project in San Juan Province, Argentina. The Altar project hosts multiple porphyry copper-gold deposits with potential for additional discoveries. The Altar project forms part of a cluster of world-class porphyry copper deposits which includes Los Pelambres in Chile (Antofagasta Minerals), El Pachon (Glencore), and Los Azules (McEwen Copper) in Argentina. Its porphyry copper-gold systems with mineralization are defined in six distinct zones (Altar North, Altar Central, Altar East, Altar United, QDM Gold, Radio) along with over seven kilometres(km) of strike.

name: REGULUS RESOURCES
businessSummary: Regulus Resources Inc. is a Canada-based international mineral exploration company. The principal project held by the Company is the AntaKori copper-gold-silver project in northern Peru. The AntaKori project is located approximately 600 kilometers (km) north of Lima and 50 km northwest of the city of Cajamarca, in the Miocene Au-Cu-Ag belt of northern Peru. The Company owns or controls approximately 53 mineral concessions, for a total of 3,303 hectares, which cover most of the AntaKori mineralized system. The AntaKori claim group is located immediately adjacent to the Tantahuatay high-sulphidation epithermal (HS) Au mine (Compania Minera Coimolache, Buenaventura-Southern Peru); 7 km NW of the Cerro Corona porphyry Cu-Au mine (Gold Fields), and 32 km NW of the Yanacocha HS gold mine (Newmont-Buenaventura), all within the mineralized Yanacocha-Hualgayoc mining district in the Department of Cajamarca. It has completed 53,805.88 m of drilling on the AntaKori project.

name: SILVER ELEPHANT MINING
businessSummary: Silver Elephant Mining Corp. is a Canada-based mineral exploration company with precious metal projects in Bolivia. The Company is focused on the development of its Pulacayo Paca silver-lead-zinc project located in southwestern Bolivia (the Pulacayo Paca Project). The Pulacayo Paca Project is 3,553 hectare of contiguous areas located on the historical Pulacayo mine 18 kilometers east of the town of Uyuni in the Department of Potosi, in southwestern Bolivia. The Pulacayo-Paca Project is located 460 kilometers south-southeast of the national capital of La Paz and 150 kilometers southwest of the City of Potosi, the Department capital. The Company also holds interests in the Ulaan Ovoo coal project, located in Mongolia, and the Chandgana coal project, located in Mongolia.

name: AMERICAN PACIFIC MINING
businessSummary: American Pacific Mining Corp. is a precious and base metals explorer and developer focused on opportunities in the Western United States. The Company's flagship asset is the 100%-owned past-producing Madison Copper-Gold Project in Montana. Its Madison Project is a high-grade Cadia-like skarn over porphyry system, encompassing over 2,514 acres consisting of six patented lode claims and 108 unpatented mineral claims. Its other projects include Ziggurat, Red Hill, and Gooseberry. Its Ziggurat project is located at the northern end of Round Mountain Trend. Red Hill is a sediment-hosted gold project located approximately 24 kilometers (km) southeast of the 12-million-ounce Cortez Hills gold deposit within the Cortez trend. The project covers an area of hydrothermally altered lower plate carbonate rocks. The Gooseberry property contains gold-silver bearing quartz-calcite vein structures that are characterized as low-sulfidation epithermal style mineralization.

name: CANADA ONE MINING
businessSummary: Canada One Mining Corp. is a Canada-based resource exploration company. The Company is focused on the exploration of its resource properties in British Columbia. The Company is exploring its 100% owned Copper Dome Project located 18 kilometers (km) south of Princeton, British Columbia. Its Abitibi East project is located at the western end of the Abitibi greenstone belt. The Company owns a 100% interest in the Zeus gold property located near Lillooet, British Columbia. Its Zeus Property is a copper and gold prospect. It covers a series of Auriferous quartz veins associated with altered ultramafic intrusions on the Schulaps Mountain Range in the Lillooet Mining Division of southern British Columbia. The Nellie Project is located northwest of the town of Iroquois Falls, Ontario. The project comprises 18 contiguous cells within the Aurora township, part of the Larder Lake Mining Division. The area is accessed from Big Nellie Lake Road off Highway 11 near Iroquois Falls.

name: AMEX GOLD MINING
businessSummary: Amex Gold Mining Inc., formerly Amex Exploration Inc., is engaged in gold discoveries, along with copper-rich volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) zones, at its 100%-owned Perron Gold Project, located approximately 110 kilometers north of Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec. The Perron Project in Quebec consists of 183 contiguous claims for a surface area of 65.75 km2. The project hosts several zones of high-grade gold mineralization, VMS mineralization and hybrid gold-rich VMS mineralization. When combined with the adjacent and contiguous Perron West Project and Abbotsford and Hepburn Projects (including additional claims acquired through staking) in Ontario, the consolidated land package spans a district-scale 570.94 km2.

name: APOLLO SILVER
businessSummary: Apollo Silver Corp. is a Canada-based mineral exploration and development company. The Company is focused on advancing its portfolio of two prospective silver exploration and resource development projects, the Calico Project, in San Bernardino County, California and the Cinco de Mayo Project, in Chihuahua, Mexico. The Calico Project, comprising the adjacent Waterloo and Langtry properties, is located in the historic Calico Silver Mining District in the Mojave Desert of San Bernardino County, California. The Cinco De Mayo Project is located in the north central part of Chihuahua State, Mexico, approximately 190 kilometers northwest of the state capital of Chihuahua City. The Cinco de Mayo is made up of 29 concessions totaling over 25,000 ha located in the Municipio de Buenaventura. The Project is host to the Upper Manto Pb-Zn-Ag (Au) deposit, which consists of two parallel and overlapping manto deposits referred to as the Jose Manto and the Bridge Zone.

name: ARBOR METALS
businessSummary: Arbor Metals Corp. is a mining exploration company focused on developing high-value, geographically significant mineral projects worldwide. The Company is engaged primarily in the business of identifying, acquiring and exploring and, if warranted, developing natural resource properties. The Company’s projects include the Jarnet, Corvette Lake and St. Pierre lithium projects, located in the James Bay region of Quebec, comprise 83 map-designated claims, covering an area of approximately 5,606 hectares. The projects are contiguous to the Corvette-FCI property, where diamond drilling has confirmed significant lithium mineralization representing lithium exploration projects in the sector. The Company’s Kemlee Lake Lithium project is strategically located three kilometers east of Rock Tech Lithium Inc.'s Aumacho claim blocks and twelve kilometers south of the Georgia Lake Project.

name: ARIANNE PHOSPHATE
businessSummary: Arianne Phosphate Inc. is a Canada-based development-stage phosphate mining company. The Company is engaged in developing the Lac a Paul phosphate deposits located approximately 200 kilometers (km) north of the Saguenay/Lac St. Jean area of Quebec, Canada. These deposits will produce a high-quality igneous apatite concentrate grading 39% P2O5 with little or no contaminants. The Company specializes in the extraction of independent phosphate rock. The Company’s phosphate is used in fertilizer production, preservatives, animal feed, fungicides, water treatment, the beauty industry, metallurgy, and advanced battery technology. The Company's subsidiary is 9252-5880 Quebec Inc.

name: FUTURE FUELS
businessSummary: Future Fuels Inc. is a Canada-based company. The Company's principal asset is the Hornby Uranium Project, covering the entire 3,407 square kilometers (km2) Hornby Basin in north-western Nunavut, a geologically promising area with over 40 underexplored uranium showings, including the historic Mountain Lake Deposit. The Company's district scale uranium exploration portfolio comprising five project areas, Hatchet Lake, Highway, CBX/Shoe, Usam and Genie, totaling approximately 97,674 hectares (ha) in northern Saskatchewan. It holds the Covette Project in Quebec's James Bay region, comprising 65 mineral claims over 3,370 hectares. Its Hatchet Lake Property consists of six mineral dispositions totaling 13,711 ha, located adjacent to the north-eastern margin of the Athabasca Basin in Saskatchewan, Canada.

name: CEYLON GRAPHITE
businessSummary: Ceylon Graphite Corp. is a Canada-based company, which is engaged in the business of mining for graphite, and developing and commercializing graphene and graphite applications and products. The Company holds a land package constituting approximately 121 square kilometers (km2) grids containing historic vein graphite deposits located in Sri Lanka. The Company's work sites include K1 Development, M1 Development, H1 Development and P1 Development. The K1 Development (Exploration License No. EL/222) is its first mining project and operates under the Sarcon Development legal umbrella. The M1 Development (Exploration License No. EL/361) is an active exploration site located in Malsiripura (near Kurunegella) and is operated under the Company's subsidiary JADS Enterprise (Private) Limited. The H1 Development (Exploration License No. EL/221) is located in Hakbewa. The site is over 50 acres and has a substantial surface graphite dump. The P1 Development is located in the Pasyala district.

name: ASARIAN ENERGY
businessSummary: Asarian Energy Limited, formerly Forsys Metals Corp., is a Canada-based uranium developer. The Company is focused on advancing its wholly owned Norasa Project, located in the uranium friendly jurisdiction of Namibia, Africa. The Company is engaged in the business of acquiring, exploring and developing mineral properties which are located in Namibia, Africa. Its principal focus is on uranium and bringing the Norasa Uranium Project (Norasa), which combines the fully licensed Valencia Uranium deposit (Valencia) and the exploration stage Namibplaas Uranium (Namibplaas) projects, into production. Its flagship project is the Norasa, which is held by the Company's indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Valencia Uranium (Proprietary) Limited (Valencia Uranium). Norasa comprises Mining License 149 (the Valencia Main and satellite deposits) and Exclusive Prospecting License 3638 (the Namibplaas deposit, located over five kilometers northeast of Valencia).

name: ASHANTI SANKOFA
businessSummary: Ashanti Sankofa Inc. is a Canada-based exploration and development stage company. The Company is focused on acquiring gold exploration projects either directly from the government or through purchases/options with other companies/individuals.

name: QUANTUM CRITICAL METALS
businessSummary: Quantum Critical Metals Corp. is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on advancing critical metals projects essential for artificial intelligence (AI), quantum computing, 5G, defense, clean energy, and advanced battery technologies. The Company's projects consist of the NMX East Gallium Rubidium Cesium Critical Metals Project; Babine Copper Gold Project; Victory Antimony Project; Prophecy Germanium Gallium Zinc Project; Discovery Polymetallic Project; Shefford Copper Project; Logan Copper Project; Bower Copper Project; Windfall East Gold Project, and Mayner's Fortune Limestone Project.
