name: NEXUS INFRASTRUCTURE
businessSummary: Nexus Infrastructure plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of sustainable infrastructure. The Company provides a range of civil engineering and infrastructure services to the United Kingdom housebuilding sectors, with operations focused on the South-East of England and London. The services provided by the Company include earthworks, highways, substructures and basements, and installing sustainable drainage systems. It operates through two segments: Tamdown and Nexus Park. Tamdown's operations are focused on the southeast of England and London. Tamdown customers are United Kingdom housebuilders and affordable housing developers, including housing associations. Tamdown works with various quoted housebuilders. Tamdown also works alongside a number of housing associations that deliver mixed tenure developments and are focused on the affordable homes segment of the housing market.

name: GEAR4MUSIC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Gear4music (Holdings) plc is a United Kingdom-based online retailer of musical instruments and music equipment. The Company sells own-brand musical instruments and music equipment alongside premium third-party brands, including Yamaha, Roland, and Fender, to customers ranging from beginners to musical enthusiasts and professionals, in the United Kingdom, Europe and the Rest of the World. The Company is also developing its own bespoke e-commerce platform, with multilingual and multicurrency websites. It offers products, such as guitars and bass, keyboards, pianos, drum kits, flutes, lightweight instruments, woodwind, brass, strings, audio-visual products, and others. It operates approximately 21 websites in 15 languages and nine currencies. The Company retails over 63,000 stock-keeping-units across all musical instruments and categories. The Company’s subsidiaries include Gear4music Sweden AB, Gear4music GmbH, Gear4music Europe Limited, and others.

name: OSB GROUP
businessSummary: OSB Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based specialist mortgage lender, primarily focused on selected sub-segments of the United Kingdom mortgage market. The Company operates through two segments: OneSavings Bank (OSB), and Charter Court Financial Services (CCFS). The OneSavings Bank segment includes Buy-to-Let/SME sub-segments and Residential sub-segment. Buy-to-Let/SME sub-segments include buy-to-let, residential development, commercial, and funding lines. Residential sub-segments include first charge and second charge. The segments consist of brands such as Kent Reliance and InterBay. The Charter Court Financial Services segment includes Buy-to-Let, Residential, Bridging, Second charge, and Other. This segment operates through Precise Mortgages brand. Its Precise Mortgages brand uses an automated underwriting platform to manage mortgage applications. The Company’s lending is funded by retail deposits sourced through its Kent Reliance (KR) and Charter Savings Bank (CSB) franchises.

name: NWF GROUP
businessSummary: NWF Group plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist distributor of fuel, food, and feed across the United Kingdom. The principal activities of the Company and its subsidiaries are the sale and distribution of fuel oils, the warehousing and distribution of ambient groceries and the manufacture and sale of animal feeds. The Company's segments include Fuels, Food, and Feeds. The Fuels segment is engaged in the sale and distribution of domestic heating, industrial and road fuels. The Food segment is engaged in the warehousing and distribution of clients' ambient grocery and other products to supermarkets and other retail distribution centers. The Feeds segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of animal feeds and other agricultural products. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, which include NWF Distribution Holdings Limited, NWF Agriculture Holdings Limited, NWF Fuels Holdings Limited, New Breed (UK) Limited, and others.

name: CENTRAL ASIA METALS
businessSummary: Central Asia Metals plc is a base metals producer with copper operations in Kazakhstan and a zinc and lead mine in North Macedonia. Its principal business activities are the production of copper cathodes at its 100% owned Kounrad SX-EW copper project in central Kazakhstan and the production of lead, zinc and silver at its 100% owned Sasa zinc-lead mine in North Macedonia. It owns an 80% interest in CAML Exploration, an early-stage exploration opportunity in Kazakhstan, and a 28.4% interest in Aberdeen Minerals Ltd, focused on the exploration and development of base metals opportunities in northeast Scotland. It operates the SX-EW copper recovery plant at Kounrad, near the city of Balkhash in central Kazakhstan. This facility recovers copper from waste dumps that originated from the Kounrad open-pit copper mine. The Sasa mine is located in north-eastern North Macedonia, over 150 kilometers (km) east of the capital city, Skopje, and 10 km north of the local town, Makedonska Kamenica.

name: SPEEDY HIRE
businessSummary: Speedy Hire Plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of tools and equipment hire services to a range of customers in the construction, infrastructure, industrial, and support services markets, as well as to local trade and retail. The Company's segments include Hire and Services. The Hire segment relates to hire of its core fleet of owned products, covering a range of product lines in categories such as small tools, access, power and battery storage, lifting, survey, powered access, welding and plant machinery. The Services segment predominantly relates to the re-hire of an extensive range of specialist equipment through partnerships with suppliers, referred to as Customer Solutions. This segment also includes fuel and energy sales and management, training, product sales, and test, inspection and certification services. The Company operates from 135 Service Centers and on-site locations across the United Kingdom and Ireland and through a joint venture in Kazakhstan.

name: JAMES LATHAM
businessSummary: James Latham plc is a trade distributor of timber, panels, and decorative surfaces. The Company supplies products to a range of customers from contractors and merchants through to designers and makers. It offers a range of wood-based sheet materials and joinery quality hardwoods and softwoods, as well as laminates, acrylic stone surfaces, special doors and flooring. It offers products ranging from architectural moldings and components, panels, melamine, veneered, laminates, washroom collection, solid surface, door blanks, plastics, hardwoods, softwoods, engineered timber-WoodEx, flooring, decking, timber cladding, modified timber and panels, fire retardant panels, advanced technical panels, solid wood worktops, among others. The Company also supplies commodities and specialist panel products to timber and builders’ merchants. It operates over 12 branches throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland, and it works with construction professionals, designers, architects, and others.

The Company also supplies commodities and specialist panel products to timber and builders’ merchants. It operates over 12 branches throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland, and it works with construction professionals, designers, architects, and others.

name: GOLDPLAT
businessSummary: Goldplat plc is a United Kingdom-based gold recovery services company with two operations in South Africa and Ghana. The Company is engaged in the production of gold and other precious metals, by processing by-products of the mining industry. Its segments include South African Recovery Operations, West African Recovery Operations, South American Recovery Operations, and Administration and Other. The South African Recovery operations include the recovery of precious metals from metallurgical challenging materials and the processing of ore, sourced from other mining operations in South Africa. The West African Recovery Operations includes the recovery of precious metals from metallurgical challenging materials and the processing of ore, sourced from other mining operations in West Africa as well as South America. Administration and Other includes activities conducted by holding companies. Its subsidiaries include Gold Mineral Resources Limited, Goldplat Recovery (Pty) Ltd, among others.

name: FIRSTGROUP
businessSummary: FirstGroup plc is a private sector provider of public transport services. The Company's divisions include First Bus and First Rail. First Bus is a bus operator in the United Kingdom with a fleet of approximately 3,000 buses and coaches. It provides tendered bus services for local authorities and is an operator in the majority of its local areas, including major urban centers such as Glasgow, Bristol and Leeds. Its adjacent services business provides a range of bus and coach services, including schools, private tour operators, airports and airlines, and distribution centers. First Rail is a rail operator which operates a fleet of approximately 1,800 locomotives and rail carriages through two DfT contracted train operating companies: West Coast Partnership (WCP), (incorporating Avanti West Coast and West Coast Partnership Development) and Great Western Railway (GWR), and two open access routes (Hull Trains and Lumo). The Company also has sightseeing bus operations.

name: SAMUEL HEATH AND SONS
businessSummary: Samuel Heath and Sons Plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing of a wide range of products in the builder’s hardware and bathroom field. The Company's collections include speed forme, classic forme, oriel forme, one hundred collection luxe, one hundred collection modern, landmark industrial, landmark pure, style moderne, fairfield, antique, and xenon. The Company's product categories include basin ancillaries, bath ancillaries, bath taps, bidet taps, generic roughs, kitchen taps, shower ancillaries, and toilet fittings. Its finishes product category includes amber brass, anthracite, antique brass gloss, antique brass matt, antique gold, brushed gold gloss, brushed gold matt, brushed gold unlacquered, chrome plate, city bronze, country bronze, matt black chrome, non lacquered brass, old brass matt, polished nickel, stainless steel finish, urban brass, and urban brass matt lacquered. Its product features include bidet sprays.

name: GEM DIAMONDS
businessSummary: Gem Diamonds Limited is a United Kingdom-based global producer of diamonds. The Company owns approximately 70% of the Letseng mine in Lesotho and 100% of the Ghaghoo mine in Botswana. The Letseng mine produces white diamonds. In addition, Letseng has produced pink and blue diamonds. The Company's segments include Lesotho; Belgium; BVI, RSA, UK and Cyprus, and Botswana. The Lesotho segment is engaged in diamond mining activities. The Belgium segment is engaged in the sales, marketing, and manufacturing of diamonds. The BVI, RSA, UK and Cyprus segment provides technical and administrative services. The Botswana segment is engaged in diamond mining activities (on care and maintenance). Its subsidiaries include Gem Diamond Technical Services (Proprietary) Limited, Letseng Diamonds (Proprietary) Limited, Gem Diamonds Botswana (Proprietary) Limited, and Gem Diamonds Investments Limited. Letseng Diamonds (Proprietary) Limited is engaged in diamond mining and holds mining rights.

name: CASTINGS
businessSummary: Castings P.L.C. is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing iron castings and machining operations. Its segments include Foundry operations and Machining operations. It operates three iron foundries, such as Castings P.L.C. (Brownhills, West Midlands) and William Lee Limited (Dronfield, Derbyshire) and Castings Ductile Limited (Scunthorpe, North Lincolnshire) together with the CNC Speedwell Limited machining operation, which is also based in Brownhills. It produces Ductile iron, SG iron, Austempered ductile iron (ADI), SiMo, and Ni-resist castings over 7000 kilograms in weight. Its three Disamatic molding machines and three horizontal green sand molding machines provide a foundry capacity of over 70,000 tons per annum. Its machining operation is invested to support the capacity requirements of the foundry customer base. Its customer sector profile includes commercial vehicles, automotive, and others.

name: PORTMEIRION GROUP
businessSummary: Portmeirion Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based company that is focused on the homeware sector. The principal activity of the Company is that of a marketer and distributor of ceramic tableware, home fragrance, cookware and giftware, glassware, candles, placemats, coasters, and other associated products, and is engaged in manufacturing ceramics and home fragrance products. Its brands include Spode, Portmeirion, Royal Worcester, Nambe, Pimpernel and Wax Lyrical. The Company designs, manufactures, and distributes its branded products around the world to its customers. Its two manufacturing sites include a ceramics factory in Stoke-on-Trent and a home fragrance site in the Lake District. Its segments include the UK and North America. It sells its products through wholesale (national and independent retailers), e-commerce, and retail. Its wholesale customers are omni-channel retailers with both physical stores and online sites.

name: BELLWAY
businessSummary: Bellway p.l.c. is a United Kingdom-based home construction company engaged in the building and selling of homes, ranging from one-bedroom apartments up to six-bedroom family homes, as well as providing social housing-to-housing associations. The Company operates in approximately 20 divisions, covering centers across England, Scotland and Wales. The Company's brands include Bellway, Ashberry brand and Bellway London. The Bellway brand is engaged in building quality homes in selected locations inspired by the needs of families. The Ashberry brand is offered on larger sites, and it also provides two differentiated outlets, offering choice to its customers. The Bellway London brand covers all developments in London boroughs and commuter towns. Its properties range from one-bedroom apartments to four-bedroom houses. The Company’s subsidiaries include Bellway Homes Limited, Bellway Housing Trust Limited, Bellway Properties Limited, Bellway (Services) Limited and Litrose Investments Limited.

name: BERKELEY GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: The Berkeley Group Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based company engaged in building homes and neighborhoods across London, Birmingham, and the South of England. The Company and its subsidiaries are engaged in residential-led, mixed-use property development. The Company specializes in brownfield regeneration, reviving underused land to create sustainable and nature-rich places. The Company's portfolio of developments includes Sunningdale Park, Sunninghill Square, Bankside Gardens, Berkeley Place, Abbey Barn Park, Hareshill Crookham Village, Hartland Village, Knights Quarter, Hertford Locks, The Arches, The Eight Gardens, Farmstead at Tannersbrook, Hildenborough, Holborough Lakes, Foal Hurst Green, Hollyfields, Grand Union, Prince Of Wales Drive, Camden Goods Yard, South Quay Plaza, Chelsea Creek, Beaufort Park, Filmworks Ealing, Woodberry Down, Fulham Reach and others. The Company’s brands include Berkeley, St Edward, St George, St James, St Joseph, and St William.

name: CROMA SECURITY SOLUTIONS GROUP
businessSummary: Croma Security Solutions Group plc is a United Kingdom-based security solution provider. The Company operates through two segments: Croma Fire and Security, and Croma Locksmiths. The Croma Fire and Security segment is engaged in designing, supplying, installing, monitoring, and maintaining Intruder Alarms systems, closed-circuit television (CCTV), fire and life safety systems, perimeter detection systems, barriers, gates, bollards, and automatic doors. The Croma Locksmiths segment provides mechanical solutions via its 16 retail outlets as well as its team of onsite engineers. This allows the Company to supply, install, and maintain locks, padlocks, safes, ironmongery, Unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) mechanisms, security shutters, grilles, and doors. The Company also offers emergency call-out services and provides electronic security. Its subsidiaries include CSS Total Security Limited, Croma Locksmiths & Security Solutions Limited, Safeguard (N/W) Limited, and others.

name: FACILITIES BY ADF
businessSummary: Facilities by ADF plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is engaged in providing serviced production facilities, location and equipment hire to the UK film and high-end television industry (HETV). Its segment includes Facilities by ADF, Location One, and Autotrak. The Company’s production fleet is made up of 700 premium mobile make-up, costume and artiste trailers, production offices, mobile bathrooms, diners, schoolrooms, and technical vehicles. It serves customers in an industry with additional demand driven by a material rise in the consumption of film and HETV content via streaming platforms such as Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+ and Amazon Prime.

name: BP MARSH & PARTNERS
businessSummary: B.P. Marsh & Partners Plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist investor in early-stage financial services businesses. The Company invests in various business, including insurance intermediaries, financial advisors, wealth and fund managers and specialist advisory and consultancy firms. The Company invests amounts of up to £5m in the first round and takes an approach to investment structures, reviewing companies ranging from start-ups to those that have developed to the next stage of growth. Its active investments are in the insurance intermediary sector. Its Insurance Intermediary investments are separated into two areas, including insurance brokers and underwriting agencies/managing general agents (MGAs). The Company's subsidiaries include B.P. Marsh & Company Limited, Marsh Insurance Holdings Limited, B.P. Marsh Europe Limited, and others. The Company has a significant presence in North America and Australia.

name: FISKE
businessSummary: Fiske plc is a United Kingdom-based independent investment management and stockbroking company. The Company's principal activity is the provision of financial intermediation, which consists of private client and institutional stockbroking, and private client investment management. It offers services to individuals, professional advisers, and companies and trusts. It also operates Ocean Equity Fund. The Ocean Equity Fund does not have an objective linked to the oceans or marine biodiversity, but the Fund Manager may choose to invest in companies that derive their revenue from shipping and energy transition sectors. It offers three levels of investment service: discretionary investment management, advisory managed and execution only. Its discretionary investment management service is for people who wish to delegate decision-making on investment matters to a professional investment manager. It provides self-invested personal pensions (SIPPs) and small self-administered schemes (SSASs).

name: CEPS
businessSummary: CEPS PLC is a United Kingdom-based holding company. The principal activities of the Company are that of a holding company for service and manufacturing companies, acquiring stakes in entrepreneurial companies. The Company's segments include Aford Awards, and Signature Fabrics. Its Aford Awards segment is an engraving and color print company specializing in the personalization of sports and corporate awards. Its Signature Fabrics segment comprises Friedman's, a convertor and distributor of specialist lycra, and Milano International (trading as Milano Pro-Sport), a designer and manufacturer of leotards. Aford Awards also manufactures handcrafted pewter gifts and tableware. It manufactures a range of products, including personalized and engraved gift sets, tankards, hip flasks and a range of decorative homeware.

name: SANDERSON DESIGN GROUP
businessSummary: Sanderson Design Group PLC is a luxury interior furnishings company, which is engaged in the design, manufacture, and marketing of wallpapers, fabrics, and paints. It operates through three segments, namely Brands, Licensing, and Manufacturing. Its Brands segment includes around six brands: Sanderson, Morris & Co., Zoffany, Harlequin, Clarke & Clarke, and Scion, which offer wallpaper, fabrics, and paints. The Licensing segment involves the use of the Company’s designs on a wide range of products such as bedding, rugs, blinds, tableware and apparel through licensing arrangements. The Manufacturing segment includes the wallcovering and printed fabric manufacturing businesses operated by Anstey and Standfast & Barracks, respectively. It operates manufacturing facilities at Anstey Wallpaper factory in Loughborough and Standfast & Barracks fabric printing factory in Lancaster. Its subsidiaries include Sanderson Design Group Brands Limited, Anstey Wallpaper Company Limited, among others.

name: TAYLOR WIMPEY
businessSummary: Taylor Wimpey plc is a United Kingdom-based residential developer. The Company operates through two segments: United Kingdom and Spain. The Company operates across five divisions and at a local level from 22 regional businesses in the United Kingdom, with a small operation in Spain. Its each division builds and delivers residential homes, uses consistent methods of construction, sells homes to both private customers and local housing associations. Its Spanish business primarily sells second homes to European and other international customers, with a small proportion of sales being primary homes for Spanish occupiers. In London, it builds developments within the London Boroughs of the City of London, Westminster, Kensington & Chelsea, Hammersmith & Fulham, Camden, Southwark and Greenwich. In Spain, it builds homes in the locations of Costa Blanca, Costa del Sol and the islands of Mallorca and Ibiza. Taylor Wimpey Logistics (TWL) is its supply chain logistics business.

name: NAKED WINES
businessSummary: Naked Wines plc is a United Kingdom-based online wine retailer. The Company's principal activity is the direct-to-consumer retailing of wine. The Company's segments include Naked Wines US, Naked Wines UK and Naked Wines Australia. Its product categories include best sellers, medal winners, sustainably conscious, top-rated riojas, seasonal favorites, fantastic fizzes, and vegan friendly wines. It offers various wines, including red wine, white wine, rose wine, sparkling wine, and dessert wine. Its products include Catoria Sauvignon Blanc 2023, Villebois Prestige Sauvignon Blanc 2023, Reserve de Pierre Rose 2023, Dom Maxwell Pinot Noir 2023, Sacchetto Col de L'Utia Prosecco Superiore, Jen Pfeiffer The Rebel Bubbles, Kimbao Sauvignon Blanc 2023, Rambla 41 Mediterranean Dry Gin and Lucien Lurton Sauternes 2018. Its Angel customers in the United Kingdom, United States and Australia have direct access to over 300 world-class independent winemakers and over 2,500 wines from 23 countries.

name: ZIGUP
businessSummary: ZIGUP plc is an integrated mobility solutions provider, offering a platform that delivers services across the vehicle lifecycle. The Company provides mobility solutions to businesses, fleet operators, insurers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and other customers in a wide range of areas, including vehicle rental, fleet management, accident management, vehicle repairs, and service and maintenance. The Company supports its customers through a network and a diversified fleet of over 130,000 owned and leased vehicles, operating from approximately 180 branches across the United Kingdom, Ireland, and Spain. The Company serves corporate clients ranging from blue-chip companies to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) across various industries, from support services to infrastructure. Its business-to-business (B2B) offerings include rental and incident claims handling, delivered through both retail and partner channels.

name: SHOE ZONE
businessSummary: Shoe Zone plc is a United Kingdom-based footwear retailer. The Company sells a range of footwear for the whole family from over 265 stores nationwide and its Website, shoezone.com, which offers free next day delivery and free returns to stores. Its new format stores stock approximately 600 styles per season. Its Digital shoehub platform offers the full store range plus approximately 1,400 online exclusive styles per season. The Company sells a range of brands, including Skechers, Rieker, Kickers, Lilley & Skinner, Lotus, Wrangler and Heavenly Feet. The Company's distribution center is located in Leicester, England. Its United Kingdom distribution network is managed in-house with stock being distributed to stores. Its subsidiaries include Castle Acres Development Limited, Shoe Zone Retail Limited, Shoe Zone Pension Trustees Limited, Shoe Fayre Pension Trustees Limited and others.

name: GENEL ENERGY
businessSummary: Genel Energy plc is a United Kingdom-based independent oil and gas exploration and production company with production assets in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq and exploration assets in Oman and Somaliland. The Company operates through two segments: Production and Pre-production. The Production segment comprises the producing fields on the Tawke PSC (Tawke and Peshkabir), which are located in the KRI and make sales predominantly to the KRG. The Pre-production segment is comprised of exploration activities, principally located in Somaliland and Oman. The Company holds a 25% working interest in Tawke PSC, located in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. The Company holds approximately 51% and 50% working interests in SL10B13 and Odewayne blocks, all located in Somaliland. It holds a 40% working interest in Block 54 (the Karawan Concession), located on the eastern side of the South Oman Salt Basin and immediately adjacent to existing production activities.

name: INVESTEC
businessSummary: Investec plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company provides its clients with products and services in the corporate mid-market, bespoke solutions to high-net-worth clients and access to a wealth management offering through its strategic partnership with Rathbones. Its principal business divisions include Wealth & Investment; Private Banking; Corporate, Investment Banking and Other, and Group Investments. Its private client offering provides transactional banking, lending, private capital, savings, and foreign exchange. Its corporate and investment banking activities include lending, advisory, hedging, savings, equity placement, and risk management services for private companies, private equity, institutions, intermediaries, and governments. This division also includes central treasury and liability management channels. Its subsidiaries are Investec Bank plc and Rathbones Group plc.

name: FIH GROUP
businessSummary: FIH Group plc is an international services company that owns essential services businesses in the Falkland Islands and the United Kingdom. The Company operates through segments: General Trading (Falklands) and Art Logistics and Storage (UK). Its segments offer different products and services and are determined by business type: goods and essential services in the Falkland Islands and art logistics and storage. In the Falkland Islands the Company owns, The Falkland Islands Company (FIC), which provides essential services to the people of the Falklands. FIC's activities include retailing, property, automotive, insurance, tourism shipping and fishing agency services. In London, it owns Momart, which is a specialist in fine art logistics, providing a comprehensive range of services, including transport, storage, and installation. Momart offers secure fine art storage in purpose-built warehouses.

name: SEVERFIELD
businessSummary: Severfield plc is a United Kingdom-based structural steel company that offers various products, such as severstor, modular frames, seversafe, fabsec, rotoflo, siloflo, pressure relief valve and bin activators. The Company's services include design, manufacturing, fabrication, delivery, construction and project management. Its segments include Core Construction Operations and Modular Solutions. Its Commercial & Industrial division designs, fabricates and constructs structural steelwork for various sectors, including commercial offices, stadia & leisure, industrial & distribution, data centers, retail and health and education. The Modular Solutions division consists of the modular product ranges of Severfield Modular Solutions, Construction Metal Forming, and its cold rolled steel joint venture business. Its projects include Stadia & Leisure, Industrial, Bridges, Transport Infrastructure, Nuclear, Commercial, Education, Power and Energy, and Distribution.

name: RENEWABLE ENERGY VCT 1
businessSummary: Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT 1 plc is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust (VCT). The Company invests in a portfolio of renewable energy projects in the United Kingdom, which it co-owns with Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT 2 plc. Its principal objective is to manage the VCT with the intention of realizing the sale or monetization otherwise of all remaining assets in the portfolio. It has invested in a portfolio of renewable energy generating assets that are mature, generating electricity and earning revenues both from the sale of electricity and from government incentives to support the development of renewable energy generation capacity, including feed-in tariffs and renewable obligation certificates. The investment adviser of the Company is Gresham House Asset Management Limited.

name: MJ GLEESON
businessSummary: MJ Gleeson plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company operates through two segments: Gleeson Homes and Gleeson Land. The Gleeson Homes segment builds affordable homes in the North of England and Midlands. The Gleeson Land segment operates across the South of England and the Midlands, is the Company’s land promotion division. The division identifies sustainable development opportunities which it then promotes through the residential planning system and sells on behalf of the landowner. The Company’s subsidiaries include Gleeson Developments Limited, Gleeson Regeneration Limited, Gleeson Developments (Northeast) Limited, Gleeson Land Limited, Gleeson Land (Fleet) Limited, Gleeson Construction Services Limited, and others.

name: KOOTH
businessSummary: Kooth plc is a United Kingdom-based digital mental health service provider. The Company’s platform is clinically robust and accredited to provide a range of therapeutic support and interventions. Its products include Kooth.com, Qwell.io, and Soluna platform. Kooth.com is commissioned both in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the United Kingdom, the national health service (NHS), local authorities, charities and businesses have access to anonymous and personalized mental health support for children and young people. Qwell.io is commissioned by the NHS, local authorities and charities to improve the mental health of entire populations of specific cohorts. Soluna offers youth people to access a range of services beyond mental health support, acting as a digital front door connecting users and a range of public services. Specifically designed for users aged 13-25, Soluna provides comprehensive mental health support via an app, Web-platform, and contact center.

name: ARBUTHNOT BANKING GROUP
businessSummary: Arbuthnot Banking Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based holding company. The Company is primarily involved in banking and financial services. Its segments include Banking, Wealth Management, Renaissance Asset Finance (RAF), Arbuthnot Commercial Asset Based Lending (ACABL), Asset Alliance Group (AAG), All Other Divisions, and Group Centre. The Banking segment includes private and commercial banking. The Wealth Management segment offers financial planning and investment management services. Mortgage portfolio is also included in Banking. The RAF segment operates as a specialist asset finance lender in high value cars but also business assets. The ACABL segment provides finance secured on either invoices, assets or stock of the borrower. The AAG segment provides vehicle finance and related services, predominantly in the truck and trailer, and bus and coach markets.

name: OBERON AIM VCT
businessSummary: Oberon AIM VCT plc is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust. The principal activity of the Company is making long-term equity and loan investments in alternative investment market (AIM) traded and unquoted companies in the United Kingdom. The Company’s principal objective is to invest in a broad range of AIM or Aquis Stock Exchange (AQSE) traded companies in order to provide shareholders with attractive tax-free dividends and long-term capital growth. Its investment portfolio includes qualifying investments and non-qualifying investments. The Company's investment manager is Oberon Investments Limited.

name: CHARACTER GROUP
businessSummary: The Character Group plc is a United Kingdom-based independent toy company. The Company designs, manufactures and distributes a range of toys, games and playthings. Its diverse product ranges focus on key areas within the toy sector, which include pre-school, boys, girls and activity and crafts. The Company’s product brands include Goo Jit Zu, Terror Fried, Smooshzees, Shimmer ‘n Sparkle and Sticki Rolls. Its business in the United Kingdom, Scandinavia and the Far East is the design, development and international distribution of toys, games and gifts. It also partners with other overseas-based toy producers, either to market and distribute their products in the United Kingdom or to collaborate to jointly develop and distribute toy products and ranges worldwide. Its Far East operations are carried out from leased offices in Hong Kong and Shenzen, China and its Scandinavian operations are managed from leased offices in Copenhagen and a third-party warehouse in Sweden.

name: TRANSENSE TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Transense Technologies plc is a provider of specialist sensing solutions and measurement systems. The Company operates through two business segments: SAWsense and Translogik. The SAWsense segment designs, supplies and licenses advanced sensor solutions based on patent protected Surface Acoustic Wave (SAW) technology to companies in aerospace, automotive, and industrial machinery (including robotics), enabling improved efficiency and performance of their products. The Translogik segment develops smart, connected commercial vehicle tire inspection equipment to many of the tire suppliers, fleet operators and service centers. Enabling accurate measurement and digital capture of safety-critical tire condition data, used to reduce operating costs, improve safety and provide audit records for regulatory compliance. In addition, the Company earns residual royalty income from Bridgestone iTrack - a tire monitoring system for off-highway vehicles that was developed by Translogik.

name: GENUS
businessSummary: Genus plc is a United Kingdom-based global animal genetics company. The Company is advancing animal breeding and genetic improvement by applying biotechnology and selling added value products to livestock farming and food producers. It focuses on the dairy, beef and pork food production sectors, through two businesses: ABS (bovine genetics) and PIC (porcine genetics). Its segments include Genus PIC, Genus ABS and Genus Research and Development. Its bovine genetics business sells dairy and beef bull semen and embryos from its superior cattle, which are sold to farmers to breed their cows through artificial insemination. Its porcine genetics business sells genetically superior breeding pigs and semen to farmers, so they can breed commercial pigs with desirable characteristics for pork production. Its porcine and bovine divisions operate under the brand names PIC and ABS. It operates in 30 countries, across six continents, and reaches a further 50 markets through distribution partners.

name: CAPRICORN ENERGY
businessSummary: Capricorn Energy PLC is an energy producer with a portfolio of onshore development and production assets in the Egyptian Western Desert. The Company’s producing assets are located across four concession areas: Obaiyed, which includes an onshore gas field; Badr El Din (BED) comprises five producing concessions, both oil and gas; North East Abu Gharadig (NEAG) comprises the concession covering the NEAG Tiba area and the NEAG Extension area; and Alam El Shawish West (AESW) concession area.

name: SHELL
businessSummary: Shell plc is an international energy company engaged in the principal aspects of the energy and petrochemical industries. The Company's segments include Integrated Gas, Upstream, Marketing, Chemicals and Products, Renewables and Energy Solutions, and Corporate. The Integrated Gas segment includes liquefied natural gas (LNG), conversion of natural gas into gas-to-liquids (GTL) fuels and other products. It includes natural gas and liquids exploration and extraction, and the operation of the upstream and midstream infrastructure. The Upstream segment includes exploration and extraction of crude oil, natural gas and natural gas liquids. It also markets and transports oil and gas and operates the infrastructure necessary to deliver them to the market. The Marketing segment comprises the Mobility, Lubricants, and Sectors & Decarbonization businesses. The Chemicals and Products segment includes chemical manufacturing plants with their own marketing network, and refineries.

name: RENEWABLE ENERGY VCT 2
businessSummary: Gresham House Renewable Energy VCT 2 plc is a venture capital trust (VCT) with a portfolio of renewable energy projects in the United Kingdom. Its principal objective is to manage the VCT with the intention of realizing the sale or monetization otherwise of all remaining assets in the portfolio in a prudent manner consistent with the principles of good investment management and with a view to returning value to Shareholders in an orderly manner, whilst protecting the tax position of shareholders. The Renewable Energy VCT funds have mainly been invested in a portfolio of renewable energy generating assets, since inception. These assets are mature, generating electricity and earning revenues. The revenues are both from the sale of electricity and from government incentives to support the development of renewable energy generation capacity, such as feed-in tariffs and renewable obligation certificates. The Company’s investment adviser is Gresham House Assets Management Limited.

name: ENQUEST
businessSummary: EnQuest PLC is an independent energy company with operations in the United Kingdom North Sea (UKNS) and Southeast Asia. Its operations are focused on maturing and underdeveloped assets in the United Kingdom and Malaysia. Its UK upstream production operations include its Magnus, Kraken, Golden Eagle, Greater Kittiwake Area, Scolty/Crathes and Alba assets. Its Malaysian operations include its PM8 Extension Production Sharing Contract, consisting of the PM8 and Seligi Fields. It operates a large number of in-field pipelines, risers and control umbilicals which support the efficient operation of its upstream and decommissioning asset base, offshore in the UKNS. It also holds an equity interest in (and operatorship of) the Chim Sao and Dua production fields (Block 12W) in Vietnam. Its decommissioning division manages the decommissioning programs for assets that have already ceased production and its mature producing assets, which are between one and five years from cessation of production.

name: OXFORD METRICS
businessSummary: Oxford Metrics plc is a United Kingdom-based smart sensing and measurement technology group. The Company segments include Motion Capture and Vision Metrology. The Motion Capture segment is the development, production and sale of computer software and equipment for the entertainment, engineering, and life science markets. The Vision Metrology segment, previously known as Smart Manufacturing, is engaged in the development, production, and sale of vision inspection systems. The Group trades through two divisions: Vicon Motion Systems, and Industrial Vision and Metrology Systems. Vicon Motion Systems provides motion measurement analysis to thousands of customers globally in healthcare, entertainment, and engineering markets. Industrial Vision and Metrology Systems is a machine vision software and measurement providing precision, automated quality control systems by blue-chip manufacturing companies in medical devices, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, automotive, and others.

name: BRAIME GROUP
businessSummary: Braime Group PLC manufactures deep-drawn metal presswork and distributes material handling components and monitoring equipment. Its manufacturing activity is delivered through Braime Pressings Limited, and the distribution activity is through the 4B division. Its electronics division specializes in level controls, intelligent sensors and safety control systems for bucket elevators and conveyors. Braime Pressings specializes in metal presswork, including deep drawing, multi-stage progression and transfer presswork. It manufactures precision stamped components for the automotive and industrial sectors, with automation capabilities such as pick and place, roll threading, washing and robotic welding. The 4B division develops material handling components for the agricultural and industrial sectors, from elevator buckets to forged conveyor chain and level monitors to hazard monitors. 4B works with its customers on new designs and on the upgrade of existing elevators and conveyor machines.

name: ME GROUP INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: ME Group International plc operates, sells and services a range of instant-service vending equipment, primarily aimed at the consumer market. The Company has more than 48,000 vending units in operation and focuses on principal areas: Photo.ME, Wash.ME, Print.ME, Feed.ME, Amuse.ME, Copy.ME, ME News, ME Event, ME Studio, and ME AI. Photo.ME provides photobooths and integrated biometric identification solutions. Wash.ME provides unattended laundry services and launderettes. Print.ME provides digital printing kiosks. Feed.ME provides vending equipment for the food service market. It also operates other vending equipment, such as children's rides, amusement machines, and business service equipment. The Company's segments include Asia Pacific, Continental Europe, and the United Kingdom & Ireland. Its equipment is located in areas of high footfall such as supermarkets, shopping malls (indoors and outdoors), transport hubs, and administration buildings (City Halls, Police and others).

name: JARVIS SECURITIES
businessSummary: Jarvis Securities plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company operates a number of retail stockbroking brands that provide nominee, certificated and individual savings accounts (ISA) to individuals. It also provides outsourced financial administration services to many investment firms. The Company’s services include settlement, execution and ISA plans. Its operations are principally carried out in the United Kingdom.

name: NUCANA
businessSummary: NuCana plc is a United Kingdom-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company. The Company is focused on developing treatment outcomes for patients with cancer by applying its ProTide technology. The Company's pipeline includes NUC-7738 and NUC-3373. NUC-7738 is an anti-cancer agent that disrupts Ribonucleic acid (RNA) polyadenylation, profoundly impacts gene expression in cancer cells and targets multiple aspects of the tumor microenvironment. NUC-7738 is in the Phase II part of a Phase I/II study which is evaluating NUC-7738 as a monotherapy in patients with advanced solid tumors and in combination with pembrolizumab in patients with melanoma. NUC-3373 is a chemical entity derived from the nucleoside analog 5-fluorouracil, a chemotherapy agent. NUC-3373 is being evaluated in a Phase Ib/II modular study (NuTide:303) of NUC-3373 in combination with the PD-1 inhibitor pembrolizumab for patients with advanced solid tumors and in combination with docetaxel for patients with lung cancer.

businessSummary: Chesterfield Special Cylinders Holdings Plc, formerly Pressure Technologies Plc, is a supplier of specialized, safety-critical high-pressure gas containment products and services in the defense, hydrogen, energy and industrial markets. The Company's high-pressure cylinders and storage packages are a critical component in many end user applications, including several high-pressure systems on naval submarines and surface vessels, safety systems on fighter jets, hydrogen storage and transportation for refueling and energy supply, air pressure vessels in offshore motion compensation systems, breathing air systems on dive support vessels and bulk storage and transportation of industrial gases. Its manufacturing is United Kingdom-based, with businesses serving a global blue chip customer base from four operational sites.

name: CLOSE BROTHERS GROUP
businessSummary: Close Brothers Group plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist banking company providing lending, deposit taking. The Company’s segments include Commercial, Retail, and Property. The Commercial segment lends to small and medium-sized enterprises through its in-house teams, where loans are originated via its direct sales force or introduced by third-party distribution channels. This segment includes invoice finance, energy, and intermediated asset finance. The Retail segment provides finance to individuals and businesses through a network of intermediaries. The Property segment provides residential development finance and loans to property developers and investors across mainland the United Kingdom (UK) and Northern Ireland, through its two brands, Close Brothers Property Finance and Commercial Acceptances. It also provides financial services and advice to small businesses and individuals.

name: RAMSDENS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Ramsdens Holdings PLC is a United Kingdom-based diversified financial services provider and retailer. The Company operates through four segments: Foreign Currency, Purchase of Precious Metals, Pawnbroking, and Retail of Jewelry & Watches. The foreign currency exchange segment comprises the sale and purchase of foreign currency notes to holidaymakers. The Pawnbroking segment consists of transaction an item of value, known as a pledge, (jewelry and watches), is held by the pawnbroker as security against a six-month loan. Through its precious metals buying service, the Company buys unwanted jewelry, gold and other precious metals from customers. The Company offers new and second-hand jewelry, including premium watches, for sale. It also offers additional services in cheque cashing, Western Union money transfer, credit broking and receiving franchise fees. It operates around 169 stores within the United Kingdom.

name: MANOLETE PARTNERS
businessSummary: Manolete Partners PLC is a United Kingdom-based insolvency litigation financing company. The principal activity of the Company is that of acquiring and funding insolvency litigation cases. The Company has invested in approximately 1635 United Kingdom insolvency litigation cases and completed over 1217 of them. The Company has worked with over 200 insolvency practitioner (IP) firms and their chosen legal advisers, often on multiple cases. The Company works with all kinds of insolvency solicitors' firms and in the UK insolvency market. It works in a three-way partnership with IPs and their lawyers to ensure meritorious claims are pursued and resolved.

name: CORAL PRODUCTS
businessSummary: Coral Products PLC is a United Kingdom-based specialist in the design, manufacturing and supply of plastic products. The Company, through its Flexibles and Rigids divisions, manufactures and distributes a range of specialized plastic products and services to a wide range of customers, across a diverse array of industries. Flexibles division manufactures and distributes extruded, thermoformed, and film/laminate products primarily in the food sector. The rigids division designs, manufactures and distributes plastic injection, vacuum-formed and extruded molded products into a diverse range of sectors, including personal care, food, household, healthcare, automotive, telecoms and rail. It provides customized solutions primarily for the food packaging, personal care, household, transport and communication sectors. Its subsidiaries include Tatra Rotalac Limited, Global One-Pak Limited, Film & Foil Solutions Limited, Alma Products Limited, Manplas Limited, Ecodeck Limited, and Ecodeck SL.

name: ROBERT WALTERS
businessSummary: Robert Walters plc is a United Kingdom-based global talent solutions business. The Company’s services include Specialist professional recruitment, which is encompassing permanent and temporary recruitment, interim management and executive search; Recruitment outsourcing services enabling organizations to transfer all, or part of, their recruitment needs to the Company either through recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) or contingent workforce solutions (CWS), and Talent advisory service supporting the growth of organization’s through market intelligence, talent development, and future of work consultancy. The Company’s client base ranges from blue-chip corporates through to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), and start-ups. The Company's subsidiaries include Robert Walters Pty Limited, Resource Solutions Corporation Pty Limited, Robert Walters Business Consulting (Shanghai) Ltd Company, Walters People Chile Empresa de Servicios Transitorios SpA, and others.

name: FRONTIER DEVELOPMENTS
businessSummary: Frontier Developments PLC is a United Kingdom-based company that develops and publishes video games for the interactive entertainment sector. The Company primarily uses its COBRA game development technology to create genre games for personal computers and videogame consoles. The Frontier Foundry is a gaming label for third party-publishing. The Company's games include Jurassic World Evolution 2, Planet Zoo, Jurassic World Evolution, Planet Coaster, Elite Dangerous, and others. The Company’s operations are based in the United Kingdom, with subsidiaries based in Canada and the United States. Its gameography includes Kinectimals, Zoo Tycoon, Lostwinds, Rollercoaster Tycoon 3, Disneyland Adventures, Lostwinds: Winter of the Melodias, Screamride, Tales from Deep Space, Coaster Crazy, Thrillville: Off the Rails, Thrillville, Wallace and Gromit and others. The Company's subsidiaries include Frontier Developments Inc., Frontier Games Limited and Complex Games Inc.

name: 3I GROUP
businessSummary: 3i Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based investment company, which is specialized in private equity and infrastructure. It invests in mid-market companies and core investment markets are Europe and North America. The private equity business is funded principally from its proprietary capital, with some funding from co-investors for selected assets. Its principal focus is on generating attractive capital returns. Private equity sectors include consumer & private label, healthcare, industrial, services & software. Its infrastructure business manages assets on behalf of third-party investors and its proprietary capital, with the objective of generating capital returns and earning fund management fees and portfolio income. Infrastructure sectors include communications, utilities, transport/logistics, social infrastructure, and energy.

name: CAFFYNS
businessSummary: Caffyns plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which offers deals on new cars and used vehicles. The Company is a car dealer in the southeast of England. It offers a stock of new and used vehicles for sale at approximately 20 locations across Sussex and Kent, including brands such as Volkswagen, Audi, SEAT, Skoda, Vauxhall, CUPRA, Volvo, MG and Lotus. Its operations include the Audi business, Volkswagen business, Volvo business, MG business and Vauxhall business. It offers a range of electric and hybrid vehicles in Battery Electric Vehicles (BEV) and Plug - In Hybrid Electric Vehicle (PHEV) types under the brands, including Audi, Volkswagen, Volvo, Skoda, CUPRA, SEAT, Vauxhall, MG and Lotus. It also provides a vehicle servicing facility offering fixed-price service, seasonal health checks, ministry of transport (MOT) test servicing, air conditioning service, battery checks & replacement, tire offers, service plans, and others. It also offers mobility services and accessories.

businessSummary: Fletcher King Plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides a comprehensive range of property services and expert advice throughout the United Kingdom, including property fund management, property asset management, rating, valuations and investment broking. The Company offers a range of services, including asset and property management, co-investment and capital markets. Its asset and property management offers rent collection, service charge management, landlord and tenant, lettings, refurbishment / redevelopment, and building surveying.

name: ENWELL ENERGY
businessSummary: Enwell Energy plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in the exploration and development of oil and gas projects, with assets in Ukraine. It has four fields in appraisal, development and production - three in the Poltava region and one in the Kharkiv region producing over 2,000 barrels of oil equivalent (BOE) per day. Its assets comprise four fields in the Dnieper-Donets basin in north-eastern Ukraine. It holds a 100% working interest in and is the operator of the Mekhedivsko-Golotvshchinske (MEX-GOL) and Svyrydivske Chervonolutske licence fields. Its two licences, located in Ukraine’s Poltava region, are adjacent and extend over a combined area of 269 square kilometers (km2), approximately 200km east of Kyiv and 170km north-west of Poltava. It also holds a 100% working interest in, and is the operator of, the Vasyshchivske (VAS) field. This covers an area of 97km2 which is located in the Lokhvytsia and Hadiachi districts of Poltava region in north-eastern Ukraine.

name: BICYCLE THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Bicycle Therapeutics plc is a United Kingdom-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a class of medicines, referred to as Bicycle molecules, for diseases that are underserved by existing therapeutics. Bicycle molecules are fully synthetic short peptides constrained with small molecule scaffolds to form two loops that stabilize their structural geometry. The Company is evaluating zelenectide pevedotin, a Bicycle Toxin Conjugate (BTC) targeting Nectin-4, a well-validated tumor antigen; BT5528, a BTC targeting EphA2, a historically undruggable target, and BT7480, a Bicycle Tumor-Targeted Immune Cell Agonist (Bicycle TICA) targeting Nectin-4 and agonizing CD137, in Company-sponsored clinical trials. Additionally, the Company is developing Bicycle Radio Conjugates (BRC) for radiopharmaceutical use and, through various partnerships, is exploring the use of Bicycle technology to develop therapies for diseases beyond oncology.

name: MINDFLAIR
businessSummary: Mindflair plc is a United Kingdom-based investment company providing investors with access to a portfolio of technology businesses focused on artificial intelligence (AI) with significant growth potential. The Company is engaged in building an investment portfolio of high-tech businesses focused on artificial intelligence, across such areas as Internet of Things, cyber security, machine learning, immersive technologies and big data. The Company invests directly and co-invests alongside British Business Bank & Enterprise Ireland in Sure Valley Ventures’ institutional funds that invest in private AI software companies. It has an AI-focused portfolio of 17 technology companies consisting of Cameramatics, Smarttech247, Nova Leah, Vividq, Captur, Getvisibility, Retinize, and others. Nova Leah offers cybersecurity for medical device manufacturers and healthcare providers.

name: ROBINSON
businessSummary: Robinson plc is a United Kingdom-based manufacturer specializes in custom packaging with technical solutions for hygiene, safety, protection and convenience. The Company manufactures injection and blow-moulded plastic packaging and rigid paperboard luxury packaging, operating within the food and beverage, homecare, beauty and personal care, and luxury gift sectors. It offers plastic packaging and paperbox packaging. Paperbox Packaging specializes in luxury gift rigid paperboard packaging, from rigid boxes and lids to folding cartons, clam packs, book jackets and trays. Its premium boxes are used in sectors such as confectionery, toiletries and cosmetics, and mobile phones. Its plastic packaging products include plastic bottles, pots, tubs and containers, caps, closures and overcaps, jars and custom packaging. Its paperboard products include shoulder boxes, box and lid, book jackets, clam packs, rigid trays and sleeves and folding cartons.

name: SECURE TRUST BANK
businessSummary: Secure Trust Bank PLC is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company’s principal activity is to provide banking services, including deposit taking and secured and unsecured lending. The Company’s segments include Real Estate Finance, Commercial Finance, Vehicle Finance, and Retail Finance. Real Estate Finance is engaged in lending secured against property assets to a maximum 70% loan-to-value ratio, on fixed or variable rates over a term of up to five years. Commercial Finance is engaged in lending predominantly against receivables, typically releasing 90% of qualifying invoices under invoice discounting facilities. Vehicle Finance includes hire purchase lending for used cars to prime and near-prime customers and Personal Contract Purchase lending into the consumer prime credit market, both secured against the vehicle financed. Retail Finance provides online e-commerce service to retailers, providing unsecured lending products to prime United Kingdom customers.

name: JD SPORTS FASHION
businessSummary: JD Sports Fashion Plc is a global omnichannel retailer of sports fashion and outdoor brands. The principal activity of the Company is the retail of multi branded, sports fashion and outdoor clothing, footwear, accessories and equipment. Its segments include JD, Complementary Concepts, and Sporting Goods & Outdoor. JD is a sports fashion, multichannel retailer of branded sports and casual wear, combining brands. The JD segment includes Finish Line, JD Gyms, Size?, Footpatrol, and Livestock brands. Its Complementary Concepts segment includes DTLR, Shoe Palace, and Sizeer. DTLR is an athletic footwear and apparel streetwear retailer with a connection with the communities where its stores are located. Shoe Palace is a retailer of branded sports footwear and apparel located on the West Coast of the United States. Shoe Palace has over 200 stores. The Sporting Goods & Outdoor segments include Sport Zone, Sprinter, Go Outdoors, Blacks, Naylors, Tiso, Ultimate Outdoors, and Fishing Republic.

name: CAVENDISH
businessSummary: Cavendish PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which operates as a full-service investment bank and trusted advisor to ambitious companies. The Company provides a range of services to both public and private companies, from equity raising in capital markets, to mergers and acquisitions (M&A), debt advisory and private growth capital. It specializes in providing its clients with access to equity, debt, and alternative financing, as well as offering cross-border M&A advice. It serves a range of sectors, including business services; consumer; energy, power and resources; financial services; industrial technology; life sciences, and technology. Its strategic advisory services include corporate finance advisory; debt advisory; investment companies; public company capital raising and IPO; private M&A; private growth capital; public M&A, and research & distribution. The Company also offers will writing, funeral, and probate services.

name: CELEBRUS TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Celebrus Technologies PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides a disruptive data technology platform. The Company is focused on improving the relationships between brands and consumers through better data. Its solutions include Celebrus Data Platform, Celebrus for Fraud, Celebrus Cloud, Celebrus Analytics and Reporting, Celebrus for Marketing, and Celebrus Digital Analytics. It is deployed across 30+ countries throughout the financial services, healthcare, retail, travel, and telecommunications sectors. It automatically captures, contextualizes, and activates consumer behavioral data in live time across all digital channels. Through the addition of behavioral biometrics and artificial intelligence, it enables brands to detect and prevent fraud before it occurs. Its data platform solutions include data capture, data model, single customer view, behavioral biometrics, mobile apps, marketing signals, sense and trace, anomaly detection, anonymized data collection, and others.

name: NORTHERN ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Northern Electric plc is a United Kingdom-based holding company engaged in the distribution of electricity, engineering contracting and smart meter rental in the United Kingdom. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, Northern Powergrid (Northeast) plc (Northern Powergrid), Integrated Utility Services Limited (IUS) and Northern Powergrid Metering Limited (Metering). Its segments include Distribution, Contracting, Metering and Other. The principal activity of Northern Powergrid is the distribution of electricity to approximately 1.6 million customers connected to its electricity distribution network (the Network) within its distribution services area in the northeast of England, which extends from North Northumberland, south to York and west to the Pennines. The Network includes over 42,000 kilometers of overhead and underground cables and over 28,000 substations. IUS provides engineering contracting services and Metering rents meters to energy suppliers.

name: VODAFONE GROUP
businessSummary: Vodafone Group Plc is a telecoms company. The Company provides mobile and fixed services to over 355 million customers in 15 countries, partners with mobile networks in over 40 more and has IoT platforms. In Africa, its financial technology businesses serve almost 92 million customers across seven countries. Its products include Unified Communications, Mobile Connectivity, Fixed Connectivity, Digital Applications, IoT Connectivity, Cloud & Edge, E2E Solutions, and Security. Its unified communications solutions include Microsoft Teams Voice, voice services, and recording services. Its digital applications include Gemini for Google Workspace, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 Business, and Copilot for Microsoft 365. Its Cloud & Edge services include cloud services, mobile private networks, and multi-access edge computing (MEC). It provides solutions for large and multinational business, small and medium business, international public sector, and carriers and digital service providers.

name: PALACE CAPITAL
businessSummary: Palace Capital plc is a United Kingdom-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company focuses on maximizing shareholder returns and actively manages assets and then sells assets at the right time to return cash to shareholders via share buybacks or other methods such as tender offers. The Company holds a diversified portfolio across different sectors, including office, retail, leisure, and residential. It specializes in owning property which can generate increasing returns from both income and capital. It has invested in university towns and city centers across different sectors in buildings either let to multiple tenants or single occupiers. Its portfolio includes Broad Street Plaza, Halifax; St James Gate, Newcastle; Sol Northampton; The Forum, Exeter and others.

name: BARRATT REDROW
businessSummary: Barratt Redrow PLC is a United Kingdom-based company engaged in housebuilding and commercial development. Its three consumer brands, Barratt, David Wilson, Redrow, and Barratt London, are engaged in offering a variety of homes for people at all stages of life. Barratt Homes provides homes perfect for first-time buyers and families, offering a range of properties across England, Scotland and Wales. David Wilson Homes provides larger homes designed for mover-uppers and families. Redrow is ideal for premium purchasers and downsizers. Barratt London is a residential developer with a portfolio in diverse and ranges from state-of-the-art apartments and penthouses to riverside communities, and complex, mixed-use regeneration schemes.

name: REACH
businessSummary: Reach plc is a United Kingdom-based commercial news publisher. The Company is focused on providing content that attracts the audience of any commercial news publisher in the United Kingdom (UK) and Ireland. The Company is engaged in delivering the latest news, entertainment and sport to communities throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland and around the world. It connects with people on and offline, through 120 trusted brands, from national titles like the Mirror, Express, Daily Record and Daily Star, to local brands like MyLondon, BelfastLive and the Manchester Evening News, Liverpool Echo, Irish Star, OK! magazine, WalesOnline, MyLondon and Curiously. The Company has approximately 120 brands, including Websites and print products; 17 books published from Mirror Books, and 168 active podcasts.

name: FORTIS FRONTIER
businessSummary: Fortis Frontier PLC, formerly MyHealthChecked PLC, is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is not engaged into any business.

name: S4 CAPITAL
businessSummary: S4 Capital PLC is a United Kingdom-based digital advertising, marketing, and technology services company. The Company operates through two segments: Marketing Services and Technology Services. Its Marketing Services segment includes creative content, campaigns, and assets at a global scale for paid, social and earned media - from digital platforms and apps to brand, full-service campaign management analytics, creative production and ad serving, platform and systems integration and transition, training and education. Its Technology Services segment includes digital transformation services, which deliver advanced digital product design, engineering services and delivery services. The Company’s customers are primarily businesses across technology, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) and media and entertainment. Monks.Flow is its Artificial Intelligence (AI) product solution that automates marketing workflows.

name: BILLINGTON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Billington Holdings Plc is a United Kingdom-based structural steel and construction safety solutions specialist, which is focused on structural steel and engineering activities throughout the United Kingdom and European markets. The Company's segments include Structural Steelwork and Safety Solutions. The Structural Steelwork segment includes the activities of Billington Structures Limited, Peter Marshall Steel Stairs Limited, and Specialist Protective Coatings Limited. The Safety Solutions segment includes the activities of Easi-Edge Limited and Hoard-It Limited. Specialist Protective Coatings Limited is a specialist treatment applicator. Easi-Edge Limited is engaged in the safety solutions business. Hoard-It Limited provides site hoarding solutions. The Company provides services across various sectors, including defense, commercial, education, health, industrial, infrastructure, leisure, residential, retail, distribution, energy, and data centers.

name: FORTERRA
businessSummary: Forterra plc is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bricks, dense and lightweight blocks, precast concrete, concrete block paving, and other complementary building products. It operates through three segments: Bricks, Blocks, and Bespoke Products. Its Bricks segment is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of bricks to the construction sector. Its Blocks segment is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of concrete blocks and permeable block paving to the construction sector. Its Bespoke Products segment is engaged in manufacturing and selling of bespoke products to the construction sector. The Bespoke Products range includes precast concrete (marketed under the Bison Precast brand), chimney and roofing solutions, each of which is made-to-measure or customized to meet the customer’s specific needs. The precast concrete flooring products are complemented by its full design and nationwide installation services. Its precast concrete products are sold under the Bison Precast brand.

name: SAVANNAH ENERGY
businessSummary: Savannah Energy PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent energy company. The Company’s principal activities are the exploration, development and production of natural gas and crude oil and the development of other energy-related projects in Africa. It holds an 80% economic interest in the exploration, development and production of gas within the Uquo Field, the Uquo Gas Project. It also holds a 49% non-operated interest in the Stubb Creek oil & gas field (Stubb Creek Field). Stubb Creek Field is located in Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria, and is a producing oil field with considerable undeveloped, non-associated 2C gas resources. The Company’s Accugas midstream business focuses on the marketing, processing, distribution, and sale of gas to the Nigerian market. It owns and operates the Cameroon Export Transportation System, comprising the Cameroon export pipeline, the Kome Kribi 1 floating storage and offloading unit (FSO) and related infrastructure.

name: STAFFLINE GROUP
businessSummary: Staffline Group plc is a United Kingdom-based recruitment company. The Company is engaged in the provision of recruitment and outsourced human resource services. The Company provides a pure-play recruitment platform with market reach across the United Kingdom and Ireland. Its division includes Recruitment GB and Recruitment Ireland. The Recruitment GB business provides flexible blue-collar workers, supplying c.30,000 staff per day on average from around 400 sites, across a range of industries, including supermarkets, drinks, driving, food processing, logistics and manufacturing. Recruitment Ireland is an end-to-end solution provider operating across multiple industries, ten branch locations and ten onsite customer locations, supplying c.4,500 staff per day on average, and offering RPO, MSP, temporary and permanent solutions across public and private sectors throughout the island of Ireland.

name: CURRYS
businessSummary: Currys plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is an omnichannel retailer of technology products and services, operating online and through over 708 stores in six countries. The Company’s segments include UK & Ireland and Nordics. UK & Ireland segment comprises the operations of Currys, iD Mobile, and business to business (B2B) operations. Nordics segment operates both franchise and own stores in Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark with further franchise operations in Iceland, Greenland, and Faroe Islands. In Nordics, the Company trades under the Elkjop brand. Its operations include repair facilities in Newark, United Kingdom, a sourcing office in Hong Kong and an extensive distribution network for delivery to stores and homes. Its subsidiaries include Connected World Services Distributions Limited, Carphone Warehouse Europe Limited, CPW Technology Services Limited, Currys Retail Group Limited, DSG International Holdings Limited, and others.

name: FIRST PROPERTY GROUP
businessSummary: First Property Group plc is a United Kingdom-based property fund manager and investor with operations in the United Kingdom and Central Europe. The Company’s focus is on higher yielding commercial property with sustainable cash flows. The Company operates through two segments: Fund Management Division and Group Properties Division. The Fund Management Division operates through its subsidiary, First Property Asset Management Ltd (FPAM), which earns fees from investing for third parties in property. FPAM manages approximately 11 funds which are invested across the United Kingdom, Poland and Romania. The Group Properties Division, which consists of principal investments by the Company to earn a return on its own capital, usually in partnership with third parties. The investments comprise six directly held properties in Poland, and non-controlling interests in 9 of the 11 funds managed by FPAM.

name: SOSANDAR
businessSummary: Sosandar plc is a United Kingdom-based holding company. The principal activity of the Company is being a clothing manufacturer and distributor through the Internet and mail order. It is engaged in women's fashion brands in the United Kingdom targeting style-conscious women. The Company offers an underserved audience fashion-forward, affordable, and quality clothing. The business sells predominantly own-label exclusive products designed and tested in-house. Its product range is diverse, providing its customers with an array of choice for all occasions across all women's fashion categories. The Company sells through Sosandar.com and has several high value brand partnerships, including with NEXT and Marks & Spencer. The Company’s clothing categories include dresses, tops, knitwear, jeans, trousers and leggings, jackets and coats, leathers and faux leather, shorts and skirts, swim and beachwear, suits and tailoring, and playsuits and jumpsuits.

name: PREMIER MITON GROUP
businessSummary: Premier Miton Group plc is a United Kingdom-based fund management company. The Company offers a range of funds and investment trusts, as well as a portfolio management service, covering equity, fixed income, multi asset and absolute return investment strategies. The Company’s product portfolio includes equity funds, fixed income funds, multi asset fund, and absolute return fund. It offers a range of genuinely active equity strategies that cover single country, regional and global investment areas, with access to different market capitalization and investment styles. The Company’s multi asset and multi manager absolute return funds offer actively managed solutions with one clear objective: to make positive returns in any condition over rolling three-year periods. Its Fixed income investments include corporate bond, strategic bond, financials and money market funds.

name: FLOWTECH FLUIDPOWER
businessSummary: Flowtech Fluidpower plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company operates as a supplier of fluid power products, systems and solutions. Its principal activities are distribution of engineering components and assemblies, concentrating on the fluid power industry. Its Great Britain segment supplies both hydraulic and pneumatic consumables, along with the delivery of specialist engineering solutions, services, and systems. Its Island of Ireland segment supplies specialist technical hydraulic components and systems predominantly into original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and consumer channels to all industry markets and supported by supply agreements direct to a range of manufacturer brands. Its Benelux segment supplies hydraulic and pneumatic components and systems to manufacturers of specialized industrial and mobile hydraulic OEMs. Its products include hose assemblies, mobile systems, industrial power packs, specialist process values / actuation, pneumatic components, and others.

name: TAVISTOCK INVESTMENTS
businessSummary: Tavistock Investments plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist wealth and asset management company focused on meeting the specific needs of private investors. The Company's businesses include its employed adviser business, Tavistock Private Client Limited, its protection business, Tavistock Protect Limited, and Tavistock Asset Management Limited. Tavistock Private Client Limited is a financial planning firm, providing services to predominantly higher net worth private clients. Tavistock Asset Management Limited delivers institutional portfolio management services at a retail price. It has a range of diversified, multi-asset mandates with a risk profile, levels of active management and portfolio structures tailored to suit client needs. Tavistock Protect Limited provides clients with a comprehensive range of life insurance and critical illness policies. It also operates an employee benefits business and educational finance portal, Tell Me How.

name: MAVEN INCOME AND GROWTH VCT 3
businessSummary: Maven Income and Growth VCT 3 PLC is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust. The Company’s objective is to achieve long-term capital appreciation and generate income for shareholders. The Company’s portfolio of investments across various sectors includes technology, industrials and engineering, services and healthcare. The Company’s regional funds consist of various types of funds, including, Finance Durham Fund, IFS - Maven Equity Finance, MEIF II - Debt Finance East and South East Midlands, North East Development Capital Fund, NPIF II - Maven Equity Finance, and SWIF - Maven Equity Finance. The Company's investment manager is Maven Capital Partners UK LLP.

name: FUTURE
businessSummary: Future plc is a global platform for specialist media. The Company is a platform for creating and distributing trusted, specialist content, to build engaged and valuable global communities. The Company operates approximately 175 brands in diversified content verticals, with multiple market positions and three core monetization frameworks: advertising, e-commerce affiliate and direct consumer monetization (subscriptions and newstrade magazine sales). Its content is published and distributed through a range of formats, including websites, email newsletters, videos, magazines and live events. Its distinct businesses include business to consumer (B2C), Go.Compare, business to business (B2B). The Company’s brands include Marie Claire, Tom’s Guide, Kiplinger, Decanter, THE FIELD, techradar, and others. The Company’s specialist media brands encompass various key industries, including technology, gaming, entertainment, fashion, lifestyle, sports, finance, business-to-business and beyond.

name: REACT GROUP
businessSummary: REACT Group plc is a United Kingdom-based support services provider to the facility management (FM) sector, operating across four key service propositions: LaddersFree, Fidelis Contract Services, REACT and 24hr Aquaflow Services. LaddersFree is engaged in commercial window cleaning businesses, delivering nationwide services. Fidelis Contract Services is a contract cleaning and soft facilities maintenance provider focused on long-term client partnerships. REACT, specializing in emergency and specialist cleaning solutions, offers both long-term framework agreements and rapid response services. 24hr Aquaflow Services is a commercial drainage and plumbing business serving clients across London and the Southeast of England. It serves various sectors, including education, emergency, facilities management, healthcare, highways, housing, industrial, justice and rail. The Company’s services include air duct cleaning, commercial window cleaning, crime scene decontaminations and deep cleaning.

name: EBIQUITY
businessSummary: Ebiquity plc is an independent media and marketing consultancy. The Company helps advertisers make smarter media investment decisions by providing data-driven insights, auditing, and advisory services.
