The Company specializes in IT solutions that solve commercial challenges and create opportunities for its clients, with an increasing focus on incorporating artificial intelligence into its platforms. Its range of B2B and B2C products validate the identity or health status of individual employees, service providers or customers. They also enable businesses to remotely schedule work shifts and tasks. Its products include Operating System, Monitoring Platforms, Intelligent Dashboarding, OnSite WorkID, OnSite TaskManager and OnSide. The Catenai Operating System comprises fully customizable Mobile Apps, intelligent dashboards and a fully secure system to manage data uploads and transfers. OnSite WorkID is a digital wallet that allows the service provider to prove their identity and status to a third party. OnSide is a centralized management tool specifically developed for local government and community groups.

name: DUNELM GROUP
businessSummary: Dunelm Group plc is a homewares retailer. It offers a range of products, spanning multiple homewares and furniture categories, and including services, such as made-to-measure window treatments. Its three focus areas are elevate its product offer, connect with more customers, and harness its operational capabilities. It offers multiple services to customers, including made-to-measure, click and collect and a range of takeback services. It offers various brands, including Dorma, Fogarty and Elements. It has over 184 stores across the United Kingdom and has developed an online offer through dunelm.com, which includes home delivery and click and collect options. 155 stores include Pausa coffee shops. It has built a comprehensive offer as The Home of Homes, including furniture, kitchenware, dining, lighting, outdoor, decoration and DIY. Its Home Focus at Hickeys brand offers a wide range of fabrics, ready-made curtains, curtain poles, blinds, bedding, haberdashery and craft supplies.

name: XP FACTORY
businessSummary: XP Factory plc is a United Kingdom-based experiential leisure business. The Company is the owner and operator of Escape Hunt, which offers escape-the-room experiences. Escape Hunt operates through a network of owner-operated sites in the United Kingdom and an international network of franchised sites across five continents, as well as through digitally delivered games which can be played remotely. Escape Hunt provides high-quality experiences for consumers, businesses and other organizations, catering for leisure and team-building occasions across groups of varying sizes. The Company has a strategy to grow Escape Hunt through the expansion of its owner-operated estate in the United Kingdom and internationally, alongside its franchise network and the continued development of high-quality games and experiences across multiple formats, including those incorporating branded intellectual property (IP) content.

name: CHECKIT
businessSummary: Checkit plc is a provider of intelligent operations management platform for operational leaders. The Company provides predictive operations for large facilities and multi-site locations, enabling operational agility and better decision-making in large, complex, and multinational organizations. Its main activities are the supply of connected workflow management, automated monitoring and building management, IoT, and operational insight-based products and services. Its subscription business model offers optional plug-ins for integrated sensor networks and workflow task management. Its solutions include operational monitoring, medical monitoring and food safety monitoring. Its solutions apply digital tools and monitoring to transform workforce management and incorporate physical assets into a digital ecosystem using integrated sensors and monitoring devices. It serves a range of industries, including hospitals and healthcare, senior living and care homes, pharmaceutical and others.

name: SOLID STATE
businessSummary: Solid State plc is a value-added component supplier and design-in manufacturer of computing, power, and communications products. It supplies commercial, industrial, and military markets with electronic components, assemblies, and manufactured systems designed for use in critical applications. It has a core focus on industrial and ruggedized computing, battery power solutions, antennas, secure radio systems, imaging technologies, and electronic components and displays. It operates through three divisions: Components, Systems, and Power. Systems division has capabilities in the design, manufacture, supply and through life support of high-performance systems. Components division's business provides products and services in three areas: own-brand manufactured components, franchised components, and the provision of value-added services such as sourcing and obsolescence management. Power division is focused on battery systems, and caters to robotics, drones, and naval maritime sectors.

name: KLARNA GROUP
businessSummary: Klarna Group Plc is a United Kingdom-based technology company focused on developing commerce networks. The Company is an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered global payments network and shopping assistant. It provides consumers and merchants with a range of solutions, including payment, advertising and digital retail banking, through several channels. Its online payments solution is designed to bridge uncertainty in the transactions between consumers and merchants by providing short-term credit to consumers interest-free. Its range of payment options allows consumers to purchase what they choose, both online and offline. Its payment solutions include Pay in Full, Pay Later and Fair Financing. Its Pay in Full instantly settles purchases at the time of the transaction. Its Pay Later enables consumers to purchase goods or services at the time of the transaction and pay the full amount at a later date. Its Fair Financing allows consumers to pay for their purchase over a longer duration.

name: BOOHOO GROUP
businessSummary: Boohoo Group Plc is a holding company. The principal activity of its subsidiary undertaking is that of online clothing retailers. The Company designs sources, markets and sells fashion clothing, home and beauty products to consumers globally. The diversity of its brands, including its five core brands, boohooMAN, PrettyLittleThing, Karen Millen and Debenhams, enable it to serve a broad customer base, globally. Its segments include Youth Brands, Debenhams & Labels, and Karen Millen. Youth Brands include three online retail brands, such as boohoo, boohooMAN, and PrettyLittleThing. Karen Millen is a digital first, premium global brand. Debenhams is an online department store. Its portfolio of labels includes Miss Pap, Coast, Oasis, Warehouse, Burton Menswear, Dorothy Perkins, and Wallis. Its brands design, source, market and sell clothing, shoes, accessories and beauty products targeted at 16 to 60-plus-year-old consumers in the United Kingdom and internationally.

name: TORTILLA MEXICAN GRILL
businessSummary: Tortilla Mexican Grill plc is a United Kingdom-based fast-casual Mexican restaurant brand with a fully customizable and authentic California-style Mexican menu. Its principal activity is the operation and management of restaurants trading under the Tortilla, Chilango, and Fresh Burritos brands. The Company is a specialist in Californian-inspired Mexican cuisine. It offers burritos, tacos, and quesadillas, which are prepared in-house, and toppings are prepared daily, free from artificial flavors of preservatives. The Company offers its customers dine-in, self-serve, take away, click, and collect and delivery options. The Company operates approximately 117 restaurants globally, including through franchise partnerships in the United Kingdom with SSP Group plc and Compass UK & Ireland, and in the Middle East with Eathos. Its subsidiaries include Mexican Grill Ltd, Chilango UK Ltd, Chilango Ltd, Mexican Grill International Franchise Ltd, California Grill Ltd, and others.

name: VICTORIAN PLUMBING GROUP
businessSummary: Victorian Plumbing Group plc is a United Kingdom-based bathroom retailer engaged in offering a range of over 36,000 products to business to consumer (B2C) and trade customers. The Company provides a one-stop shop solution for the entire bathroom with more than 150 own- and third-party brands across a spectrum of price points. The Company operates through two segments: Victorian Plumbing and Victoria Plum. The Victorian Plumbing bathroom collection provides a range of quality baths, pottery and brassware in a variety of designs to suit an array of settings. Its own brands include Arezzo, Brooklyn, Chatsworth, Stonehouse Studio and Bower. Its portfolio includes third party bathroom brands such as Hansgrohe and Ideal Standard, as well as niche and category-specific brands like Roman Showers. In addition, The Company stocks specialist products, including shower pumps from Salamander, plumbing components from Wirquin and tile trims from Genesis.

name: CRANSWICK
businessSummary: Cranswick plc is a United Kingdom-based vertically integrated supplier of premium, fresh and added-value food products. The Company’s segments include Food and Other. The Food' segment is engaged in manufacturing and supplying food products to the United Kingdom grocery retailers, the food service sector and other United Kingdom and global food producers. The Other segment represents all the activities of Cranswick Pet Products Limited. It offers a range of fresh products, including fresh pork, convenience, gourmet products and poultry. The Company’s food portfolio includes fresh pork, gourmet sausage, gourmet bacon and gammon, slow cook, fresh chicken, ready to eat chicken, coated chicken, gourmet pastry, charcuterie, houmous and dips, and cooked meats. Its brands include Ramona’s, Cypressa, and Bodega. It also produces pet food and supplies several brands, including own brands Vitalin and Alpha Feeds. It is also involved in the pig genetic business and pig farming operations.

name: WPP
businessSummary: WPP plc is a United Kingdom-based creative transformation company. The Company offers national and multinational clients a comprehensive range of communications, experience, commerce, and technology services. Its segments include Global Integrated Agencies, Public Relations, and Specialist Agencies. The Global Integrated Agencies segment includes creative agencies and media agencies. Its structure includes four operating units: WPP Media, WPP Production, WPP Enterprise Solutions and WPP Creative. WPP Media integrates media, data, and partnerships to provide personalized content across channels. WPP Production provides content delivery services and supports client marketing requirements. It provides customer experience, commerce, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), content transformation, and technology capabilities and others. The Public Relations and Specialist Agencies segment includes WPP agencies under a leadership structure and the WPP Open platform.

name: ALTITUDE GROUP
businessSummary: Altitude Group plc is an end-to-end solutions provider for branded merchandise across a variety of sectors, from the corporate and print vertical markets to the higher-education and collegiate sectors. It delivers products and services in two distinct areas, including Services and Merchanting. Services are derived from operating distributor/vendor networks in the promotional products' industry comprising technology and software applications, membership subscriptions, preferred partner programs, and marketing services programs. Its Merchanting programs focus on the sale of promotional products and includes AIM Capital Solutions (ACS) and its AMPs. Technology is at its core, and it supports its Services and Merchanting divisions with its technology platforms providing product search engines, order management tools, design applications, and e-commerce sites that deliver solutions. Its trading platform facilitates the execution of both offline and online transactions.

name: JAMES CROPPER
businessSummary: James Cropper PLC is engaged in advanced materials and paper and packaging, centered around four market audiences: energy solutions, composite solutions, luxury packaging and creative papers. Its advanced materials incorporate pioneering nonwovens and electrochemical coatings for its customers globally, including components in fuel cells and hydrogen electrolysis. In paper and packaging, they range from luxury packaging and creative papers, including bespoke colors and textures in paper and molded fiber packaging designed. It offers composite solutions and energy solutions. Its products include Abrasion Resistance, Carrier, Corrosion Resistance, Catalysts, Cell Separators, Electrodes, GDL Substrate, and others. It serves various markets, including aerospace, automotive, batteries, consumer electronics, marine and others. Its portfolio of products is in use on commercial aircraft, delivering surface finish solutions, improved processing, light weighting efficiency solutions, and more.

name: TT ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: TT Electronics plc is a provider of design-led, electronics technologies for performance-critical applications. The Company provides design and manufacturing solutions for a range of diagnostic, surgical and direct patient care devices critical to the identification, treatment and prevention of disease. Its brands are AB Connectors, Aero Stanrew, BI Technologies, Ferranti, IRC Components, and Optek Technologies. Its Aero Stanrew brand specializes in the design and manufacture of ruggedized electromagnetic components and electronics systems for safety-critical applications in aerospace and defense. The Optek Technologies brand designs and manufactures optoelectronic solutions for sensing and illumination applications. The Company’s products and services include power conversion, medical device coils, sensors, microelectronics, industrial and medical grade power supplies, and others. Its geographic regions include Europe, North America and Asia.

name: ROSSLYN DATA TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Rosslyn Data Technologies plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of spend intelligence and predictive analytics platform. The Company’s principal activity is the provision of a procurement intelligence solution via a cloud-based software as a service platform that incorporates data analytics software, data capture, data mining and workflow management. Rosslyn Platform helps organizations with diverse supply chains mitigate risk and make informed strategic decisions. It leverages automated workflows, artificial intelligence, and machine learning to extract and consolidate procurement data, providing visibility of complex supplier data, enabling suppliers to spend savings, and delivering a rapid return on investment. Its artificial intelligence classification engine (AiCE) automates the categorization and classification of extracted procurement data, which increases accuracy, expands the volume and complexity of data that can be incorporated and therefore shortens the time to insight.

name: BROOKS MACDONALD GROUP
businessSummary: Brooks Macdonald Group PLC is a wealth management company. The Company offers multi asset investment services to intermediaries and financial planning advice to private clients, benefitting from a strong local presence across the United Kingdom. Its UK Investment Management segment offers a range of investment management services to private high net worth individuals, pension funds, institutions, charities and trusts, as well as wealth management services to high-net-worth individuals and families, giving independent whole of market financial advice, enabling clients to build, manage and protect their wealth. The Company’s services include AIM Portfolio Service, Managed Portfolio Service, Centralized Investment Process, BM investment solutions, financial planning and others. The Managed Portfolio Service provides a choice of investment into a range of risk-managed model portfolios, each investing across a different mix of asset classes.

name: DISTIL
businessSummary: Distil plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which operates as an owner of premium drinks brands, such as RedLeg Spiced Rum, Blackwood's Vintage Gin, Blackwood’s Vodka, TROVE Botanical Vodka, Blavod Original Black Vodka, Diva Vodka and Jago's Vanilla Cream Liqueur. The Company markets and sells its brands in a number of international markets, including the United Kingdom, United States of America, Germany, Spain, and Australia. RedLeg is a premium Caribbean rum, infused with spices. Blackwoods Vintage Gin product range includes Blackwoods 40% Gin for the ultimate G&T, Blackwoods 60% Navy Strength Gin for recreating classic cocktails, and Blackwoods Vodka. Blavod is made using 100% grain vodka, triple distilled and double filtered. Gem Diva vodka is seven times distilled, removing impurities, resulting in a super smooth vodka. TROVE is a lower ABV Botanical Vodka spirit drink distilled with real fruit and botanicals. The Company's subsidiary is Distil Company Limited.

name: JUBILEE METALS GROUP
businessSummary: Jubilee Metals Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based diversified metals processing and recovery company. The Company has a portfolio of projects in Zambia. The Company focuses on retreatment and metals recovery from mine tailings, waste, slag slurry and other secondary materials from historical mining activities. Its segments include Copper and cobalt and Other. The Copper and cobalt segment is engaged in the processing of copper and cobalt-containing materials. Its projects include Project M, Zambia Sable Refinery, Munkoyo Project, and Roan Upgrade Project. Its Zambia copper operational focus, which prioritizes run-of-mine, historically mined and stockpiled material. The Other segment is engaged in exploration and corporate overheads. The Company's operations span over four countries: Australia, Mauritius, Zambia, and the United Kingdom.

name: HOWDEN JOINERY GROUP
businessSummary: Howden Joinery Group Plc is a United Kingdom-based specialist kitchen and joinery supplier company. It sells kitchens and joinery products to trade customers, primarily local builders. It operates over 893 UK depots and 81 international depots (including 61 in France, two Belgium, and 18 in the Republic of Ireland). Its product categories classified into kitchen, joinery, and appliances. The Company's kitchen product categories include worktops, sinks and taps, flooring, appliances, and handles. Its kitchen products include fitted kitchens, kitchen fittings, kitchen sinks and taps, appliances, kitchen storage, and others. It offers a range of joinery products, such as internal and external doors, including fire doors, flooring, stair parts, and general joinery items. The Company offers a range of Lamona appliances for cooking, cleaning, and cooling. It also offers various appliances from other market brands, including Neff, Bosch, AEG, Hotpoint, Zanussi, Beko and Rangemaster.

name: FUNDING CIRCLE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Funding Circle Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) finance platforms. The Company’s cutting-edge technology and data platform is constantly evolving, enabling more small businesses to access the funding they need to win. The Company’s proprietary technology platform is designed to provide customers with quick and easy access to finance. Its diverse product range enables businesses to borrow, pay later and spend. The principal reporting segments of its operations are UK Term Loans and FlexiPay. Its Other Loans business operations are included in the Term Loans businesses in Germany and the Netherlands. FlexiPay is a line of credit business products. It also offers Cashback credit card for everyday business spending. Its subsidiaries include Funding Circle Ltd, Funding Circle CE GmbH, Funding Circle Global Partners Limited, and others.

name: HBX GROUP INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: HBX Group International plc is a United Kingdom-based global business-to-business (B2B) travel technology company and the owner of brands, such as Hotelbeds, Bedsonline, The Luxurist, Roiback and The Civitfun. It offers a network of travel technology products and services, connecting travel businesses, such as online marketplaces, tour operators, travel agents, airlines, loyalty programs, destinations and travel suppliers. Its products and services include eCommerce, marketing suite, API suite and finance and insurance. Bedsonline is a B2B travel marketplace and booking engine. Hotelbeds is a go-to B2B solutions provider for wholesalers, supply partners and destinations. Roiback is a Hotel Tech company specializing in direct channel services and technology for both chains and independent hotels worldwide. The Company’s offer includes a booking engine focused on conversion, Web development, digital marketing services specialized in hotels and loyalty solutions.

name: MORTGAGE ADVICE BUREAU HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Mortgage Advice Bureau (Holdings) plc is a United Kingdom-based operator of consumer intermediary brands and specialist networks for mortgage advisers. The Company’s principal activity is the provision of financial services, in particular the provision of mortgage advice and advice on protection and general insurance products. The advisers provide expert mortgage advice, assisting customers with home purchases, refinancing, and property investments. They also help homeowners secure funds for improvements and ensure financial protection for their homes and families against unforeseen events such as illness, property issues, or loss of life. It has appointed representative firms (ARs) and advisers. It offers its ARs access to a comprehensive range of mortgage lenders, along with a dedicated panel of protection providers and insurers. Its proprietary technology, MIDAS Platform, is a major differentiator, along with its expertise in customer acquisition and retention.

name: MICROLISE GROUP
businessSummary: Microlise Group plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of technology solutions to the transport and logistics industry. The Company's fleet telematics products include fleet tracking, fleet utilization, driver performance, driver communications, trailer telematics and temperature monitoring. Its safety, health and compliance products include fleet safety management, multi-camera vehicle systems, tachograph management, bridge strike warning and vehicle health. Its journey management services include schedule management, route management, planning and optimization, customer communications, and workforce and resource management. Its delivery management products include electronic proof of delivery and sub-contractor management. Its Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) product offerings include distribution management, remote asset management and predictive maintenance. It serves approximately 400 enterprise clients globally, supporting businesses of all shapes and sizes.

name: PENNON GROUP
businessSummary: Pennon Group plc is an environmental infrastructure company focused on the United Kingdom water sector. The Company’s segments include Water and Non-household retail. The Water segment comprises the regulated water and wastewater services undertaken by South West Water Limited (South West Water) and the regulated water services undertaken by Sutton and East Surrey Water plc (SES Water). The Non-household retail business reflects the services provided by Pennon Water Services Limited and South East Surrey Water Services (SESWS). South West Water provides water and wastewater services in Devon, Cornwall and parts of Dorset and Somerset and water only services in parts of Dorset, Hampshire, Wiltshire and Bristol. SES Water provides water only services in the South East region. SESWS provides water and wastewater retail services to non-household customer accounts. Pennon Water Services Limited provides water and wastewater retail services to non-household customers across Great Britain.

name: TOWN CENTRE SECURITIES
businessSummary: Town Centre Securities PLC is a United Kingdom-based real estate investment trust. The Company has built a diversified, mixed-use portfolio with a tenant base focused on regional centers, primarily Leeds and Manchester, where approximately 88% of its portfolio by value is based on property investment and car parking operators. The Company has a portfolio around the United Kingdom comprising over 2.5 meters square feet of prime commercial, residential, car parking, office, leisure and retail accommodation. The Company’s properties include 123 Albion Street (Leeds), 75 Dale Street (Manchester), Carvers Warehouse (Manchester), Ducie House (Manchester), Merrion House (Leeds), Town Centre House (Leeds), Vicar Lane (Leeds), Wade House (Leeds), Weymouth Street (London), Burlington House (Manchester), AVRO (Manchester), Bath Street (Glasgow), Eider House (Manchester), Vicar Lane (Leeds), Weymouth Street (London), Z (Leeds), CitiPark (Leeds, Manchester, London and Watford) and others.

name: MORGAN ADVANCED MATERIALS
businessSummary: Morgan Advanced Materials plc is a manufacturer of specialist carbon and ceramic materials. Its Thermal Products segment comprises its thermal ceramics business. Its products and systems are used in high-temperature industrial processing of metals, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and glass, and by manufacturers of equipment for aerospace, automotive, marine and domestic applications. Its Performance Carbon segment specializes in carbon, graphite and silicon carbide products. Its product range includes semiconductor consumables, carbon brushes, collector strips, face seals, sliding bearings, and rotary vane pump components. Its Technical Ceramics segment designs bespoke ceramic and brazed alloy assemblies for high performance, high specification applications. Its product range includes ceramic cores, structural ceramic components, engineered coatings, ceramic tubes and rollers, laser products, ceramic-to-metal assemblies and others.

name: MORGAN ADVANCED MATERIALS
businessSummary: Morgan Advanced Materials plc is a manufacturer of specialist carbon and ceramic materials. Its Thermal Products segment comprises its thermal ceramics business. Its products and systems are used in high-temperature industrial processing of metals, petrochemicals, cement, ceramics and glass, and by manufacturers of equipment for aerospace, automotive, marine and domestic applications. Its Performance Carbon segment specializes in carbon, graphite and silicon carbide products. Its product range includes semiconductor consumables, carbon brushes, collector strips, face seals, sliding bearings, and rotary vane pump components. Its Technical Ceramics segment designs bespoke ceramic and brazed alloy assemblies for high performance, high specification applications. Its product range includes ceramic cores, structural ceramic components, engineered coatings, ceramic tubes and rollers, laser products, ceramic-to-metal assemblies and others.

name: EMPRESARIA GROUP
businessSummary: Empresaria Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company engaged in providing staffing and recruitment services. The Company provides recruitment and talent solutions across three core sectors, namely Professional, Information Technology (IT), and Healthcare, alongside an Offshore Services offering. Its services include temporary and contract staffing, permanent placement, executive search, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), managed service provision (MSP), and offshore support services. It operates across approximately six diversified sectors in 15 countries. It serves customers in the United Kingdom (UK), Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Americas. The Company operates through subsidiaries such as Ball and Hoolahan Limited, Become Recruitment Limited, ConSol Partners (Holdings) Limited, among others.

name: CUSTODIAN PROPERTY INCOME REIT
businessSummary: Custodian Property Income REIT plc is a United Kingdom-based real estate investment trust. The Company seeks to deliver an enhanced income return by investing in a diversified portfolio of smaller, regional properties let to predominantly institutional grade tenants across the United Kingdom. Its policy is to invest in properties between £2 million - £15 million. It offers investors the opportunity to access a diversified portfolio of the United Kingdom commercial real estate through a closed-ended fund. The Company may use gearing provided that the maximum loan-to-value (LTV) shall not exceed 35%, with a medium-term net gearing target of 25% LTV. It invests in a diverse portfolio of the United Kingdom commercial real estate, principally characterized by smaller, regional, core/core-plus properties. Its property types include office, industrial, retail, retail warehouse and others. The Company's investment manager is Custodian Capital Limited.

name: NATIONAL GRID
businessSummary: National Grid plc is a United Kingdom-based energy company. The Company's principal activities involve the transmission and distribution of electricity in Great Britain and of electricity and gas in the northeastern United States. Its segments include UK Electricity Transmission, UK Electricity Distribution, New England, New York and National Grid Ventures. The UK Electricity Transmission segment includes the high-voltage electricity transmission networks in England and Wales. The UK Electricity Distribution segment includes electricity distribution networks of NGED in the East Midlands, West Midlands and South West of England and South Wales. The New England segment includes electricity distribution networks, high-voltage electricity transmission networks and gas distribution networks in New England. The New York segment includes electricity distribution networks, high-voltage electricity transmission networks and gas distribution networks in New York.

name: ORCHARD FUNDING GROUP
businessSummary: Orchard Funding Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based finance company. The Company and its subsidiaries provide funding and funding support systems for insurance premiums, professional and equivalent fees and other leisure activities. The Company specializes in insurance premium finance, professional fee funding, finance for other service fees and secured property lending. It is also engaged in providing brokers with the ability to operate their own finance companies and provides a range of tailored services for all their clients. Its wholly owned subsidiaries include Bexhill UK Limited, Orchard Funding Limited, Orchard Finance Limited, Cherry Orchard Funding Limited, Open B Gateway Limited, and Orchard Bond Finance plc.

name: J SAINSBURY
businessSummary: J Sainsbury PLC is a United Kingdom-based merchandise retail company. Its segments include Retail-Food, Retail-General Merchandise and Clothing, and Financial Services. The Retail segment comprises the sale of food, household, general merchandise, clothing and fuel primarily through store and online channels. The Financial Services segment comprises banking and insurance services through Sainsbury’s Bank and Argos Financial Services. It is focused on food and convenient shopping, whether in-store or online is supported by its brands, including Argos, Nectar, Habitat, Tu, Sainsbury’s Bank and Smart Charge. Its Tu is a clothing retailer that offers a range of womenswear, menswear and childrenswear. Tu also offers a range of specialist sizes with its own branded petites and maternity offers. Argos is a digital retailer that offers a range of technology, home and garden, toys, appliances, and health and beauty products are available through its website, apps, and stores.

name: ZOO DIGITAL GROUP
businessSummary: ZOO Digital Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides end-to-end cloud-based localization and media services to the global entertainment industry. The Company's principal activities are engaged in the provision of a range of services to allow TV and movie content to be localized in any language and prepared for sale with all online retailers and to continue with ongoing research and development of productivity software in those areas. The Company’s segments include Localisation, Media services and Software Services. It provides media services through its platforms, which include ZOOstudio, ZOOdubs, ZOOsign, ZOOscripts and ZOOsubs. Its services include fast track, dubbing, audio post-production, audio description, subtitling, scripting, metadata, artwork, compliance, mastering and media services.

name: SURE VENTURES
businessSummary: Sure Ventures PLC is a United Kingdom-based venture capital fund which invests in early-stage software companies in the rapidly growing technology areas of artificial intelligence (AI), augmented reality (AR), virtual reality (VR) and the Internet of things (IoT). The Company's investment objective is to achieve capital growth for investors. The Company may invest directly in investee companies or obtain exposure to such companies through investment in collective investment vehicles, including the fund and any further funds, which have investment policies that are complementary to that of the Company. It is intended that the Company would ordinarily acquire a significant interest, consisting generally of between 20% and 50% of an investee company's equity capital. The Company will not seek to invest directly in quoted companies. No single investment of the Company will exceed 15% of net asset value. The Company's investment manager is Shard Capital AIFM LLP.

name: INVESTMENT
businessSummary: The Investment Company plc is a United Kingdom-based alternative investment fund. The Company’s investment objective is to maximize capital growth for shareholders over the long-term by investing in high-quality, quoted, United Kingdom small and mid-cap companies. The Company principally invests approximately 75 % of its funds in shares of companies which are listed on the Main Market or AQSE or traded on AIM, with a market capitalization of less than £250 million. The Company also invests approximately 25 % of its funds in some United Kingdom listed companies with larger market capitalization, for liquidity purposes. It invests in various sectors, including technology, financials, industrials, consumer, media, construction, support services, healthcare and resources. Chelverton Asset Management Limited is the investment manager of the Company.

name: CANDESSA AI
businessSummary: Candessa AI Plc, formerly Insig AI plc, is a United Kingdom-based data science and machine learning solutions company. The principal activity of the Company includes provision of ESG and data science services. Its solutions include core infrastructure, intelligence engine, and domain intelligence. Its Core Infrastructure solution turns documents into structured and searchable artificial intelligence (AI)-ready data, delivered through its platform or directly into existing systems. It offers full control over the data with traceable outputs and automation tools and offers a flexible foundation for dashboards, analytics, and decision-making. Its intelligence engine solutions automate complex analysis and generate custom outputs from dashboards and risk alerts, to reports and summaries. It offers data engineering, the corporate document dataset, the transparency and disclosure index, consultancy services, and the generative intelligence engine, a solution which incorporates generative AI.

name: KEYSTONE LAW GROUP
businessSummary: Keystone Law Group plc is a United Kingdom-based legal company. The Company is engaged in offering a full range of legal services demanded by its clients. The Company offers its legal services in the areas of banking and finance, capital markets, commercial, commercial property, construction and projects, corporate, data protection, dispute resolution, employment, EU and competition law, family and matrimonial, fraud and financial crime, immigration, insurance, intellectual property, investment funds and management, licensing and gambling, mediation and ADR, pensions and incentives, planning and environment, probate and estate planning, residential property, restructuring and insolvency, tax and technology. Its client base, comprising predominantly SME businesses as well as high and ultra-high net worth individuals, operates across a broad range of sectors. It provides services in various sectors, such as agriculture and rural affairs, aviation, charities and not-for-profit, and more.

name: PAYSAFE
businessSummary: Paysafe Limited is a United Kingdom-based payments platform provider. The Company's integrated payments platform offers the full spectrum of payment solutions ranging from credit and debit card processing to digital wallet, eCash and real-time banking solutions. Its segments include Merchant Solutions and Digital Wallets. Merchant Solutions segment offers a range of solutions, including a full range of PCI-compliant payment acceptance and transaction processing solutions for merchants and integrated service providers including merchant acquiring, transaction processing, and fraud and risk management tools. This segment includes Paysafe and Petroleum Card Services brands. Digital Wallets segment is the combination of its legacy Digital Wallet and eCash solutions and services markets in Europe, United Kingdom, North America and Latin America. It also provides digital commerce solutions for specialized industry verticals, including iGaming, gaming, digital goods and cryptocurrencies.

name: TESCO
businessSummary: Tesco PLC is a United Kingdom-based multinational retailer. The Company's segments include UK & ROI and Central Europe. The UK & ROI segment includes the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland. The Central Europe segment includes the Czech Republic, Hungary and Slovakia. The Company's businesses include Tesco UK & ROI, Tesco Insurance, Booker, dunnhumby, Tesco Czech Republic, Tesco Hungary and Tesco Slovakia. Tesco Insurance and Money Services provides insurance, travel money, automated teller machine (ATM) and gift cards. Booker is a food and drink wholesaler, serving retail and catering customers.

name: NEXT
businessSummary: NEXT plc is a United Kingdom-based retailer selling clothing, homeware, and beauty products. The Company’s segments include NEXT Online, NEXT Finance, Retail stores, Total Platform, and Other Business Activities. The NEXT Online segment includes NEXT Online (UK) and NEXT Online (International). Its Total Platform brands include Reiss, FatFace and Joules. Other Business Activities (all other segments) which include the Property Management segment which holds property and property leases. The Company’s subsidiaries include Agratech Limited, Bridgetown Holdco Limited, Lipsy Limited, Next Beauty Limited, Next Brand Limited, Next Distribution Limited, Next Holdings Limited, Next Manufacturing Limited, Next Near East Limited, Next Properties Limited, Next Retail Limited, The Next Directory Limited, Project Norwich Limited and others.

name: OPTIBIOTIX HEALTH
businessSummary: OptiBiotix Health Plc is a life sciences company. The Company is engaged in the development of microbial strains, compounds, and formulations, which are used as active ingredients and supplements. It is focused on the development of products which reduce hunger and food cravings, enhance the gut microbiome, and provide a healthy substitute for sugar. It is also developing its own range of consumer supplements and health products. Its areas of focus include obesity, cardiovascular health, and diabetes. Its products include SlimBiome, CholBiome, SweetBiotix, WellBiome, OptiBiotics and SlimBiome X3. SlimBiome offers a natural, scientifically supported, non-pharmaceutical approach to reducing hunger and cravings. CholBiome contains Lactobacillus plantarum LPLDL as the only active ingredient, focusing on healthy cholesterol maintenance and delivering tangible health benefits. SweetBiotix is a zero or low-calorie, prebiotic, and a smarter alternative to sugar and existing sweeteners.

name: REDCENTRIC
businessSummary: Redcentric plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is a provider of information technology managed services, offering cloud, communications, network, business resilience, and cyber security solutions. Its managed network service solution offers a comprehensive suite of networking solutions expertly managed and closely monitored. Its services include connectivity, software defined wide area networking (SD-WAN), local area networks, managed WAN, secure remote access, and others. The Company offers an array of meticulously managed cloud services encompassing migration, optimization, security, and ongoing maintenance of cloud infrastructure. Its services include cloud consultancy, infrastructure as a service, azure, amazon Web services, hybrid cloud, cloud migration, modern workplace 365, and platform-as-a-service. Through its Communications services, it offers services in hosted IP telephony, unified communications, omni-channel, sip trunks, call recording, and call reporting.

name: MICHAEL PAGE
businessSummary: Michael Page PLC, formerly PageGroup plc, is a global recruitment partner, connecting businesses with talent that makes a difference. The Company has operations in 34 markets. It offers recruitment services and career opportunities on a local, regional and global level. Its services and solutions include executive search, specialist recruitment services, and enterprise solutions. The Company enables organizations to find and develop the talent that makes a difference. From experienced professionals and senior leaders to large‑scale hiring solutions. It also offers executive search, assessment and advisory for C‑suite and senior leadership, across permanent and interim roles. It provides recruitment services for professional, management and specialist talent, across permanent, temporary, interim and project-based hiring. It solves large and complex talent challenges through scaled recruitment and outsourcing solutions.

name: CREO MEDICAL GROUP
businessSummary: Creo Medical Group plc is a medical device company. The Company is focused on the development and commercialization of minimally invasive electrosurgical devices, bringing advanced energy to endoscopy. It is engaged in the research, development and distribution of electrosurgical medical devices relating to the field of surgical endoscopy. The Company has developed the CROMA powered by Kamaptive full-spectrum adaptive technology, which provides optimized surgical capability and patient outcomes. The Kamaptive is a seamless, intuitive integration of multi-modal energy sources. Its CROMA delivers bipolar radiofrequency (RF) energy for precise localized cutting and focused high frequency microwave (MW) energy for controlled coagulation and ablation via a single accessory port. This technology, combined with its range of patented electrosurgical devices, is designed to provide clinicians with flexible, accurate and controlled clinical solutions.

name: BUILT CYBERNETICS
businessSummary: Built Cybernetics PLC is a property technology company, which delivers smart buildings and related services. It uses technologies and integrates these technologies into new smart buildings from the outset. It operates through two divisions: Smart Buildings division and Architecture division. Its Smart Buildings business comprises software products, including Smart Core, and a range of supporting activities. Additionally, its ecoDriver business offers energy management services and master systems integration services. Vanti is a master systems integrator, working with property owners, building operators, and commercial tenants to create smart spaces and intelligent buildings. Its Architecture division comprises Veretec and Auke Swanke. Veretec is an architecture studio, specializing in project delivery and providing detailed technical solutions. Its Aukett Swanke is an architecture, master planning, and interior design studio offering smart and sustainable design.

name: INSPECS GROUP
businessSummary: INSPECS Group plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of eyewear solutions for the global eyewear market. The Company produces a range of eyewear frames, low vision aids and lenses, covering optical, sunglasses and safety, which are either under license or under the Company’s own proprietary brands (Branded), or unbranded or private label on behalf of retail customers (OEM). The Company’s segments include Frames and Optics, which is involved in product distribution; and Manufacturing segment, which is engaged in OEM and manufacturing distribution. The Company has operations in the United Kingdom, Europe, the United States and China, including Hong Kong, Macau and Shenzhen, and manufacturing facilities in Vietnam, China, the United Kingdom and Italy. Its customers are global optical and non-optical retailers, global distributors and independent opticians, with its distribution network covering over 80 countries and reaching approximately 75,000 points of sale.

name: ANGUS ENERGY
businessSummary: Angus Energy plc is a United Kingdom-based independent onshore oil and gas company. The Company is engaged in the onshore, conventional production and development of hydrocarbons in the United Kingdom. The Company has an 80% interest in Brockham (PL235), 80% interest in Lidsey (PL241), 25% interest in Balcombe (PEDL244) and 100% interest in Saltfleetby Gas Field (PEDL005). The Saltfleetby Gas Field is located in the Humber sub-basin, the onshore equivalent of the Southern North Sea gas basin. The Company operates 3 licenses in the Weald Basin in southern England, containing the Brockham, Lidsey and Balcombe oil fields. The Brockham oil field is located on the northern flank of the Weald Basin. Lidsey field is on the southern flank of the Weald Basin near Bognor Regis. Balcombe oil field is located near Crawley in Sussex. The Company's subsidiaries include Angus Energy Holdings UK Limited, Angus Energy Weald Basin No.1 Limited, Saltfleetby Energy Limited, and others.

name: MARSTONS
businessSummary: Marston's PLC is a United Kingdom-based pub operator. The Company operates an estate of pubs nationally, comprising managed, partnership (franchised) and tenanted and leased pubs. The Company’s majority of pubs are located in suburban. The Company also operates a hotel business under the name Marston's Inns. The Company’s subsidiaries include Marston’s Estates Limited, Marston’s Operating Limited, Marston’s Pubs Limited, Marston’s Parent Limited, Marston’s Telecoms Limited, Marston’s Acquisitions Limited, anks’s Brewery Insurance Limited, Marston’s Corporate Holdings Limited, and Marston’s Trading Limited, among others.

name: MARSTONS
businessSummary: Marston's PLC is a United Kingdom-based pub operator. The Company operates an estate of pubs nationally, comprising managed, partnership (franchised) and tenanted and leased pubs. The Company’s majority of pubs are located in suburban. The Company also operates a hotel business under the name Marston's Inns. The Company’s subsidiaries include Marston’s Estates Limited, Marston’s Operating Limited, Marston’s Pubs Limited, Marston’s Parent Limited, Marston’s Telecoms Limited, Marston’s Acquisitions Limited, anks’s Brewery Insurance Limited, Marston’s Corporate Holdings Limited, and Marston’s Trading Limited, among others.

name: CAMBRIDGE COGNITION HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Cambridge Cognition Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based brain health software company, which is engaged in developing and marketing digital solutions to assess brain health, principally in the United Kingdom, the United States and Europe. The Company's operates through four market segments: Clinical Studies, Academic Research, Professional Healthcare, and Consumer Health & Wellness. Its products include CANTAB, Electronic Clinical Outcomes Assessment (eCOA), NeuroVocalix, Winterlight, Cognition Kit, Clinpal, eConsent, and AQUA. CANTAB Connect gives the control to manage and deliver a battery of touchscreen and voice assessments, as well as fully customizable electronic questionnaires and scales. The Company's therapeutic areas include attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), Alzheimer's Disease, Autism Spectrum Disorder, Depression, Down's Syndrome, Drug Abuse Liability, Epilepsy, Parkinson's Disease, Stroke and Cerebrovascular Disease, Traumatic Brain Injury, and others.

name: PLEXUS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Plexus Holdings plc is an IP-led company specializing in developing and providing wellhead systems and associated products and services for offshore operations. It focuses on providing wellheads for Jack-up rig operations such as exploration and appraisal drilling, Plug and Abandonment work and emerging markets for Carbon Capture and Storage, hydrogen production and storage and geothermal. It has a collaboration agreement with SLB to supply adjustable wellhead systems for Jack-up applications and supports these operations with a range of proprietary equipment and tools, and project engineering services, for which licenses have been sold to industry players such as SLB and TechnipFMC for limited applications. It offers POS-GRIP wellhead technology and HG metal-to-metal sealing systems. It develops products based on POS-GRIP technology for challenging surface production wellhead platforms, special projects and connector and subsea applications such as the Python subsea wellhead system.

name: KROMEK GROUP
businessSummary: Kromek Group plc is a developer of radiation detection and bio-detection technology solutions for advanced imaging and chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) detection segments. Its advanced imaging segment comprises the medical, security, and industrial markets. The Company provides its original equipment manufacturer customers with detector components based on its core cadmium zinc telluride (CZT) platform, to enable the detection of diseases such as cancer and Alzheimer's, contamination in industrial manufacture and explosives in aviation settings. In CBRN detection, it provides nuclear radiation detection solutions to the global homeland defense and security market. Its compact, handheld, high-performance radiation detectors, based on advanced scintillation technology, are primarily used to protect critical infrastructure and urban environments from the threat of dirty bombs. The Company is also developing bio-security solutions in the CBRN detection segment.

name: CAPRI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Capri Holdings Limited is a global fashion luxury company, consisting of brands, such as Michael Kors and Jimmy Choo. Its Michael Kors segment includes the sale of Michael Kors products through four primary Michael Kors retail formats: Collection stores, Lifestyle stores (including concessions), outlet stores and e-commerce sites, through which it sells Michael Kors products, as well as licensed products bearing the Michael Kors name, directly to consumers throughout the Americas, certain parts of EMEA and certain parts of Asia. It also sells Michael Kors products directly to department stores, primarily located across the Americas and Europe, to specialty stores and travel retail shops, and to its geographic licensees. Its Jimmy Choo segment includes the sale of Jimmy Choo luxury footwear, handbags and small leather goods through directly operated Jimmy Choo retail and outlet stores throughout the Americas, certain parts of EMEA and certain parts of Asia, through its e-commerce sites.

name: YOUGOV
businessSummary: YouGov plc is an international online research data and analytics technology group. The Company’s principal activity is the provision of market research, data analytics and related services. The Company’s divisions include Data Products, Consumer Panel Services (CPS), and Research. The Data Products division comprises its syndicated data products, which are available to clients on a subscription basis. The CPS division provides household consumer purchasing data across over 18 European countries. The Research division offers a wide range of quantitative and qualitative research that is tailored to meet client’s specific requirements. Its subscription-based data products suite includes YouGov BrandIndex and YouGov Profiles as well as newer behavioral products, such as YouGov Safe. YouGov BrandIndex allows users to continuously monitor over 16 fundamental metrics. CPS Consumer Tracking solutions provide regular tracking of purchasing trends for consumer segments, brands, among others.

name: GREGGS
businessSummary: Greggs plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is a food-on-the-go retailer, providing a wide menu of food and drink. Under the Company-managed retail activities segment, the Company sells a consistent range of fresh bakery goods, sandwiches and drinks in its own shops or via delivery. Under the Business-to-business channel, the Company sells products to franchise and wholesale partners for sale in their own outlets as well as charging a license fee to franchise partners. Its menu includes breakfast options, savouries and bakes, drinks and snacks, sandwiches and salads, sweet treats, and hot food. Its hot food range particularly includes Spicy BBQ Chicken Bites, Southern Fried Chicken Goujons, Mozzarella and Cheddar Bites, Southern Fried Potato Wedges and Tomato Soup. Its savouries and bakes include Chicken Roll, Margherita Pizza, Sausage Roll and others. Its Click + Collect service offers customers the ability to browse its menu, skip the queues and personalize their order.

name: SURGICAL INNOVATIONS GROUP
businessSummary: Surgical Innovations Group Plc is a holding company that is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of devices for use in minimally invasive surgery (SI Brand) along with its own label products through original equipment manufacturer (OEM) relationships including precision engineering markets. The Company’s segments include SI Brand, OEM, and Distribution. The SI Brand segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, and distribution of SI branded minimally invasive devices. The OEM segment includes research, development, manufacture, and distribution of minimally invasive devices for third party medical device companies through their own label or co-branding. It also includes research, development, manufacture, and sale of minimally invasive technology products for precision engineering applications. The Distribution segment is engaged in the distribution of specialist medical products sold by Elemental Healthcare Ltd.

name: APTAMER GROUP
businessSummary: Aptamer Group plc is a United Kingdom-based global developer of aptamer-based ligands. The Company develops custom affinity binders through its Optimer platform to enable new approaches in therapeutics, diagnostics and research applications. The Company's Optimer platform delivers aptamer tools that are enabling researchers and developers across the spectrum of the life sciences. Its Optimer binders have been developed for a range of applications, including therapeutic inhibitors and modulators, drug delivery vehicles, protein purification and separation, biomarker screening and validation, in vitro research, quality control analysis, pharmacokinetic and drug assays, and in vitro diagnostic assays. Its Aptamer Diagnostics division uses the Company's technology to support the development of diagnostic platforms, such as proteomics, lateral flow devices, biosensors and immunoassays, such as enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA).

name: NATIONAL WESTMINSTER BANK
businessSummary: National Westminster Bank PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which offers a range of retail and commercial banking products and services. The Company offers a range of personal products are offered including current accounts, credit cards, personal loans, mortgages and wealth management services. Its segments include Retail Banking, Private Banking & Wealth Management, Commercial & Institutional and Central items & other. Retail Banking segment serves personal customers in the United Kingdom and includes Ulster Bank customers in Northern Ireland. Private Banking & Wealth Management segment serves United Kingdom-connected, high-net-worth individuals and their business interests. The Commercial Banking segment consists of customer businesses reported under Business Banking, Commercial Mid-market and Corporate & Institutions. Central items & other segment include corporate functions such as treasury, finance, risk management, compliance, legal, communications and human resources.

name: DIGITAL 9 INFRASTRUCTURE
businessSummary: Digital 9 Infrastructure plc is a United Kingdom-based investment trust. The Company's investment objective is to undertake a managed wind-down of the Company and realize all existing assets in the Company's portfolio in an orderly manner. Its portfolio consists of Arqiva, Elio Networks, and SeaEdge UK1. Arqiva is the sole provider of national terrestrial TV and radio broadcasting infrastructure in the United Kingdom. Elio Networks owns and operates the highest capacity licensed microwave-based Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) network in metropolitan Dublin. SeaEdge UK1 is data center asset and subsea fiber landing station, located on the data center campus in Newcastle. The Company's investment manager is InfraRed Capital Partners Limited.

name: CLOUDCOCO GROUP
businessSummary: CloudCoCo Group plc is a United Kingdom-based provider of information technology (IT) services and communications solutions to the United Kingdon-based businesses. The Company operates through two segments: Managed IT Services and Value added resale. The Managed IT Services segment comprises the provision of recurring IT services which either have an ongoing billing and support element or utilize the technical expertise of its people. The Value added resale segment comprises the resale of one-time solutions (hardware and software) from its technology partners, including revenues from the MoreCoCo e-commerce platform. The Company's services include cybersecurity, connectivity, communication and collaboration, cloud and data center, Microsoft, hardware and software, professional services and IT consulting, and managed services. The Company's subsidiaries include CloudCoCo Holdings Limited, Systems Assurance Limited, CloudCoCo Connect Limited, More Computers Limited, and others.

name: CT AUTOMOTIVE GROUP
businessSummary: CT Automotive Group plc is a United Kingdom-based designer, developer and supplier of interior components to the global automotive industry. It provides interior finishes, such as dashboard panels and fascia finishes, and kinematic assemblies, such as air registers, arm rests, deployable cupholders and storage systems, as well as their associated tooling, for automotive original equipment suppliers (OEMs) and global Tier One manufacturers. It supplies component part types to over 55 different models for 22 OEMs. Its tailoring and trim department caters for and provides wrapped trim panels, shifter assemblies and lid consoles. It specializes in 2k tooling manufacturing and production supply of cabin comfort system components, including a broad range of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) doors and assemblies. Its key production facilities are located in Shenzhen and Ganzhou, China, complemented by additional manufacturing facilities in Mexico, Turkiye and Czechia.

name: ITHACA ENERGY
businessSummary: Ithaca Energy plc is an independent oil and gas operator focused on the United Kingdom Continental Shelf (UKCS). The Company operates a single class of business, being oil and gas exploration, development and production and related activities in a single geographical area, presently being the North Sea. Its operated assets are located in the Northern, Central and Southern North Sea, West of Shetland and Moray Firth areas of the UK Continental Shelf, which includes Alba, Alder, Cambo, Captain, Cook, Cygnus, Erskine, and Greater Stella Area. Its portfolio also includes a variety of non-operated assets, which include Britannia and Satellites, Brodgar, Brrom, Callanish, Dons, Ekgin/Franklin, Enochdhu, J area, Mariner, Monarb, Pierce, Rosebank, Schiehallion, and Seagull. The Company has a portfolio of over 39 producing UKCS fields and 10 operated producing fields.

name: TULLOW OIL
businessSummary: Tullow Oil PLC is a United Kingdom-based independent oil and gas, exploration and production company. The Company's primary activity is the discovery and production of oil and gas. The Company’s segments include Ghana, Non-operated, and Exploration. It has exploration, development and production assets in Africa and South America. Its Non-operated producing assets include Uganda. It has over licenses across countries, including Africa and South America, which include Cote d’Ivoire, Ghana, the United Kingdom and Argentina. Its operations are focused on its core producing assets in Ghana. The Company's subsidiaries include Tullow Group Services Limited, Tullow Oil Finance Limited, Tullow Oil Limited, Tullow Overseas Holdings BV, Tullow Oil SK Limited, and others.

name: J D WETHERSPOON
businessSummary: J D Wetherspoon plc owns and operates pubs throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland. The Company provides the Wetherspoon application, which allows anyone with a phone to order food and drinks from their table, without leaving their seat. The Company operates hotels in England, Ireland, Scotland and Wales. The Company's hotel rooms come in a range of sizes, including some family rooms. Its hotel is also attached to a Wetherspoon pub, serving breakfast, lunch and dinner, including its club deals, as well as its range of hot, soft, and alcoholic drinks. Each of its hotel rooms features a suite bathroom, complimentary tea and coffee-making facilities, hair dryer, flat-screen television with Freeview TV and unlimited free Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi). Its hotels include The Castle Hotel, Ruthin; The Catherine Wheel, Henley-on-Thames; The Crown Hotel, Biggleswade; The Pilgrim’s Progress, Bedford, among others.

name: SDI GROUP
businessSummary: SDI Group plc is a group of small to medium-sized companies with specialist industrial and scientific products in growth sector niches that help solve customers’ challenges. The Company specializes in the acquisition and development of companies that design and manufacture specialist products for use in lab equipment, industrial and scientific sensors, and industrial and scientific products. Its portfolio of businesses supplies the life sciences, healthcare, plastics and packaging, manufacturing, precision optics and measurement instrumentation markets. Its lab equipment business includes Safelab Systems, Monmouth Scientific, LTE Scientific, Synoptics, and Severn. Its industrial and scientific sensors business consists of Chell Instruments, Astles Control Systems, Sentek, MPB Industries, PRP Optoelectronics and Peak Sensors. Its industrial and scientific products business include Atik Cameras, Fraser Anti-Static Techniques, Applied Thermal Control, Graticules Optics, among others.

name: PHYSIOMICS
businessSummary: Physiomics PLC is a United Kingdom-based company, which provides consulting services to pharmaceutical companies in the areas of outsourced quantitative pharmacology and computational biology. The Company offer its services by utilizing its proprietary Virtual Tumour predictive software, industry standard tools (such as NONMEM and MATLAB), as well as developing bespoke models using the R programming language. Virtual Tumour is a predictive quantitative systems' pharmacology (QSP) model used worldwide by global pharmaceuticals to small biotech companies to support oncology Research and development (R&D). It is a semi-mechanistic model that incorporates an abstracted representation of the cell cycle, Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) damage/ repair and elements of the immune response. The Company is also developing its technology for use in the field of personalized medicine. The Company is focused on helping pharma and biotech clients.

name: VESUVIUS
businessSummary: Vesuvius plc is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in molten metal flow engineering and technology. The Company's segments include Steel and Foundry. The Steel Division includes Steel Flow Control, Steel Advanced Refractories, and Steel Sensors & Probes. Steel Flow Control unit supplies the global steel industry with consumable ceramic products, systems, robotics, and digital services. Steel Advanced Refractories supplies specialist refractory products designed to enable steel-making equipment to hold the molten metal. Steel Sensors & Probes supplies a range of products that enhance the control and monitoring of customers' production processes. The Foundry Division operates under the Foseco brand, which offers a range of foundry consumables and equipment to meet the requirements of iron foundries, steel foundries, and non-ferrous foundries. Its subsidiaries include BMI Refractory Services Inc., Brazil 1 Limited, CCPI Inc., Flo-Con Holding Inc, and others.

name: BOW STREET GROUP
businessSummary: Bow Street Group PLC, formerly Tasty plc, is a United Kingdom-based company, which is engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company operates two concepts in the casual dining market: Wildwood and dim t. The Wildwood has a number of leisure, retail and tourist locations. Its pan-Asian restaurant trades from six sites, serving a wide range of dishes, including dim sum, noodles, soup and curry. Its menu also includes ramen and soup, salads, noodles and rice, specialties, plant-based specialties, and sides. The Company trades in 32 locations (28 Wildwood restaurants & 4 dim t) across the United Kingdom. The Company has restaurants in Charlotte Street, Hampstead, Loughton, Victoria, Whiteley and Winchester. Its dishes are available for takeaway. The Company’s wholly owned subsidiary is Took Us a Long Time Limited (TUALT).

name: SIG
businessSummary: SIG plc is a United Kingdom-based pan-European supplier of specialist building products. The Company’s segments include UK Interiors, UK Roofing, UK Specialist Markets, France Interiors, France Roofing, Germany, Benelux, Ireland, and Poland. As a supplier of insulation and interior products to the construction industry in Europe, its key products include structural and technical insulation, construction accessories and fixings, cladding and facade systems, dry lining, ceiling tiles and grids, partition walls and door sets, and floor coverings. As well as specialist materials, it offers a range of accessories including tools and fixings, ventilation, access equipment and safety products. The Company's roofing and exterior products include tiles, slates, membranes; batten for pitched roofs; single-ply flat roof systems; industrial roofing; cladding systems; room-in-roof panel systems, and photovoltaic (PV) panels. Its key brands include SIG Distribution, LiTT, Wego/Vti and lariviere.

name: UNITED UTILITIES GROUP
businessSummary: United Utilities Group PLC is a water and wastewater company. The Company is engaged in providing water and wastewater services . It collects raw water from a variety of sources, including lakes, rivers and boreholes, but predominantly from open reservoirs. Its reservoir includes Thirlmere and Haweswater in the Lake District National Park. It owns and manages approximately 56,000 hectares of land. The Company collects used water from customers toilets, emptied sinks, baths, showers and household appliances. It has over 79,000 kilometers of wastewater pipes and sewers that transport it to one of its 583 wastewater treatment works, where it is separated and treated, before being returned to the natural environment through rivers and streams. It also provides household customer services, including meter reading, billing, account management services, and water efficiency support. It supplies about 1.8 billion liters of water every day to over 8 million people and businesses.

name: AVINGTRANS
businessSummary: Avingtrans PLC is an international engineering company. The Company designs, manufactures and supplies original equipment, systems and associated aftermarket services to the energy, medical and industrial sectors. The Company’s divisions include Energy Advanced Engineering Systems (AES) and Medical & Industrial Imaging (MII). Its AES division is engaged in the design, manufacture, integration and servicing of an extensive product portfolio including specialist motors, pumps, turbines, compressors, pressure vessels and containers. Its AES division consists of Hayward Tyler's units in the United Kingdom (in Luton and East Kilbride), the United States (in Vermont and Michigan), China and India, and Metalcraft, Ormandy, Composite Products, Booth Industries and Slack and Parr. Its MII division is engaged in the production of compact helium-free magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) systems, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) systems and 3D X-ray systems.

name: EMV CAPITAL
businessSummary: EMV Capital plc is a United Kingdom-based deep tech and life sciences venture capital (VC) investment group with an international portfolio of companies. The Company identifies, invests in, and builds high-growth companies in the United Kingdom and internationally. It focuses on generating returns for investors from the sectors and technologies. The Company has a portfolio of approximately 70 companies with a focus on life sciences, industrials, robotics & artificial intelligence (AI), and sustainability. Its portfolio includes AMR Bio, Wanda Health, Deeptech Recycling Technologies, EpiBone, Sofant Technologies, Q-Bot, and others. Its portfolio, Glycotest, is a liver disease diagnostics company commercializing novel and unique blood tests for life-threatening liver cancers and fibrosis-cirrhosis. ProAxsis Limited is a commercial biomarker-led research company supporting drug development and clinical research through specialist biomarker insights.

name: COPPA COLLECTIVE
businessSummary: Coppa Collective plc, formerly Various Eateries PLC, is a United Kingdom-based multi-format hospitality company. The Company operates three core brands across 23 locations: Coppa Club, Linwood Collection, and Noci. Coppa Club is a multi-use, all-day concept that combines a restaurant, terrace, cafe, lounge, bar and work spaces. The brand operates across three complementary formats: neighbourhood clubs for everyday use, multi-level townhouses in key market towns with distinct spaces for different occasions, and destination Clubhouses that combine dining, drinks and beautifully designed rooms with weddings, celebrations and larger events. Linwood Collection is a group of premium pubs with rooms across the Home Counties and the Cotswolds. Noci is a modern pasta-led concept which serves dishes. Its menu brings together fresh pasta, seasonal small plates, salads and dishes from the grill, offering a complete and contemporary take on Italian dining.

name: SKINBIOTHERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: SkinBioTherapeutics plc is a United Kingdom-based life science company focused on skin health. The principal activity of the Company is research and development focused on harnessing microbiomes for human health, and commercialization of these technologies, as well as the manufacture and sales of dermatological products through acquired entities. Its segments include Products and Services. Its platform technology, SkinBiotix, applies research discoveries made on the activities of lysates derived from probiotic bacteria when applied to the skin. It targets five specific skin healthcare sectors, such as cosmetics, skincare, food supplements for the treatment of skin conditions, medical skin care, infection control in both the home and the hospital environment and pharmaceuticals for the prescribed treatment of skin conditions. Its product, AxisBiotix-Ps, is a food supplement to address the symptoms of mild to moderate psoriasis, a chronic inflammatory condition of the skin.

name: GRESHAM HOUSE INCOME & GROWTH 2 VCT
businessSummary: Gresham House Income & Growth 2 VCT plc, formerly Mobeus Income & Growth VCT plc, is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust (VCT). The objective of the Company is to provide investors with a regular income stream, by way of tax-free dividends generated from income and capital returns, while continuing, at all times, to qualify as a VCT. The Company invests primarily in a diverse portfolio of the United Kingdom unquoted companies. The investments are made selectively across a number of sectors, principally in established companies. The investment adviser of the Company is Gresham House Asset Management Limited.

name: OCADO GROUP
businessSummary: Ocado Group plc is a global technology business redefining e-commerce, fulfilment, and logistics in online grocery and beyond. The Company’s segments include Logistics, and Technology Solutions. The Logistics segment provides the customer fulfilment centers (CFCs) and logistics services for customers in the United Kingdom (Wm Morrison Supermarkets Limited and Ocado Retail Limited). The Technology Solutions segment provides end-to-end online retail and automated storage and retrieval solutions for general merchandise to corporate customers both in and outside of the United Kingdom. Technology Solutions include Ocado Intelligent Automation (OIA). Its Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) is a configurable end-to-end e-commerce, fulfilment and logistics solution built to meet the demands of online grocery retail. OIA delivers warehouse automation technology that enables businesses in many industries to future-proof their warehouse operations.

name: BRITISH SMALLER COMPANIES VCT2
businessSummary: British Smaller Companies VCT2 Plc is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust. The Company’s objective is to maximize total return and provide investors with a long-term tax-free dividend yield whilst maintaining the Company’s status as a venture capital trust. The Company invests in United Kingdom businesses across a broad range of sectors that blends a mix of businesses operating in established and emerging industries that offer opportunities in the application and development of innovation in their products and services. The Company is focused on building a portfolio of investments in early-stage companies. The Company invests in various sectors, including data, tech-enabled services, new media, business services, application software, retail and brands, cloud and devops, and others. YFM Private Equity Limited is the manager of the Company.

name: FORESIGHT ENTERPRISE VCT
businessSummary: Foresight Enterprise VCT plc is a venture capital trust. The Company’s investment objective is to provide private investors with regular dividends and maintain capital value from a portfolio of investments in fast-growing unquoted companies in the United Kingdom. It intends to maximize tax-free income available to investors from a combination of dividends and interest received on investments, and the distribution of capital gains arising from trade sales or flotations. The Company also invests in a range of securities, including ordinary and preference shares, loan stock, convertible securities, fixed-interest securities, and cash. It invests in sectors including technology, media, and telecommunication (TMT), industrials and manufacturing, healthcare, business services, consumer and leisure, and others. Foresight Group LLP acts as the investment manager of the Company.

name: ALBION ENTERPRISE VCT
businessSummary: Albion Enterprise VCT PLC is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust. The principal activity of the Company is to select and hold a portfolio of investments. The investment objective of the Company is to provide investors with a regular source of income, combined with the prospect of longer-term capital growth. The Company invests in a portfolio of higher growth businesses across a variety of sectors of the United Kingdom economy, including higher-risk technology companies. It provides investors with access to entrepreneurs who build enduring businesses. The Company's portfolio of investments includes various sectors, such as cash and other net assets; healthcare, including digital healthcare; renewable energy; fintech, software and technology, and other, including education. Albion Capital Group LLP is the investment manager of the Company.

name: LPA GROUP
businessSummary: LPA Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based designer, manufacturer and supplier of light emitting diode (LED) lighting, electronic and electro-mechanical systems, and a distributor of engineered components. The Company’s segments include LPA Connection Systems (electro-mechanical), LPA Lighting Systems (lighting & electronics), and LPA Channel Electric (engineered component distribution). Its electro-mechanical segment is engaged in designing and manufacturing electro-mechanical systems and components to the rail, aircraft ground support and niche industrial markets. Its engineered component distribution segment is a service distributor and added value solutions provider to the rail, aerospace aircraft, and defense markets. Its lighting & electronics segment designs and manufactures LED lighting and electronic systems which serve the rail and other markets. Its products include aircraft ground power supply equipment, power converters and inverters, backshells, and others.

name: MAVEN INCOME AND GROWTH VCT 5
businessSummary: Maven Income and Growth VCT 5 PLC is a United Kingdom-based company engaged in venture capital trust (VCT) activities. It operates with the primary objective of achieving long-term capital appreciation and generating income for shareholders. The Company invests in a diversified portfolio of shares and securities in smaller, unquoted United Kingdom (UK) companies and Alternative Investment Market (AIM)/ Aquis Stock Exchange (AQSE) quoted companies that meet the criteria for VCT qualifying investments. The Company offers investment opportunities across various sectors, including software and technology, business services, learning and development and recruitment technology, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and healthcare, industrials and engineering, and marketing and advertising technology. It offers a range of investment opportunities and serves customers primarily in the United Kingdom. Its investment manager is Maven Capital Partners UK LLP.

name: OCTOPUS APOLLO VCT
businessSummary: Octopus Apollo VCT plc is a United Kingdom-based venture capital trust (VCT). The Company aims to provide shareholders with attractive tax-free dividends and long-term capital growth by investing in a diverse portfolio of predominantly unquoted companies. Its investments are made selectively, primarily in the technology sector. Its investment policy is designed to enable the Company to comply with the VCT qualifying conditions. It invests predominantly in unquoted smaller companies. The Company invests in higher risk smaller businesses that have already brought their product or service to the market. The Company offers investors access to a diversified portfolio of over 45 companies (focusing on business-to-business (B2B) software) with high growth potential. It invests in various sectors, such as cybersecurity, telecommunications, life sciences, travel, among others. The Company is managed by Octopus Investments Limited.

name: UNITE GROUP
