The Seals sector businesses provide gaskets, hydraulic hoses, and fittings for maintaining heavy machinery and vehicles, from tractors to wind turbines. The Life Sciences Sector provides medical equipment, lab products, and diagnostics equipment for use in hospitals and test labs. Its subsidiaries include Abbey Hose Company Limited, AMG (Brighouse) Limited, AMG Sealing Limited, Anti Corrosion Technology Pty Limited, Aquarius Plastics Ltd, Century Hose & Couplings Limited, and others.

name: KAINOS GROUP
businessSummary: Kainos Group plc is a United Kingdom-based information technology (IT) provider. The Company operates through three divisions, including Digital Services, Workday Services, and Workday Products. The Digital Services division develops and supports custom digital service platforms for public sector, commercial, and healthcare customers. Its services include digital advisory, cloud and engineering, data, and artificial intelligence (AI), low code, service and experience design, and managed services. Workday Services division specializes in the deployment of Workday, Inc.'s Finance, HR, and Planning products to organizations across Europe and North America. Workday Products division develops products that complement Workday. Its Smart product suite, including Smart Test, Smart Audit, and Smart Shield, are used by more than 350 customers globally to safeguard their Workday systems. It serves various industries, including insurance, payments, education, government, healthcare, and others.

name: AMICORP FS UK
businessSummary: Amicorp FS (UK) Plc is a United Kingdom-based international specialist fund services company. The Company's fund administration and investor services include fund accounting, fund administration, in-house net asset value calculation, investor services including register and transfer agency services, booking of subscriptions and redemptions and audit liaison/support. Its governance and compliance services include Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act and Common Reporting Standard reporting services, fiduciary, anti-money laundering officer services in compliance with international rules and regulations including administrative support to the board and committees of the board. The Company's business process outsourcing services include simplifying accounting and administration services through automated accounting processes and providing management insight into business operations through regular and consistent management reporting. It provides local and global expertise to over 560 funds.

name: RENEW ENERGY GLOBAL
businessSummary: ReNew Energy Global Plc is a decarbonization solutions company. The Company is a utility-scale renewable energy solutions provider in India. Its segments include wind power, solar power, hydro power, transmission line, and manufacturing. Its wind power segment includes utility-scale wind energy projects in India. Its solar power segment includes utility-scale solar energy projects in India. Its hydro power segment includes hydro energy projects in India. Its transmission line segment includes construction and maintenance of transmission lines. Its manufacturing segment includes manufacturing of solar panels and modules. It primarily operates wind, solar, and hydro energy projects. It provides clean energy solutions and value-added energy offerings through digitalization, storage, and carbon market services. It conducts business activities relating to the generation of power through non-conventional and renewable energy sources through ReNew Power Private Limited and its subsidiaries.

name: DIACEUTICS
businessSummary: Diaceutics PLC is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is engaged in research and development activities in the area of precision medicine data and platform software. It provides pharma and biotech companies with an end-to-end commercialization solution for precision medicine through data analytics, scientific and advisory services enabled by its platform DXRX - The Diagnostics Network. It has two separate products and service lines: Insight & Engagement Solutions (Data and related information services) and Scientific & Advisory Services (Professional services). Insight & Engagement Solutions includes access to the DXRX platform diagnostic testing data repository to utilize licensed data insight products, such as lab segmentation, physician segmentation, testing rate tracker and physician signal. Scientific Advisory Services comprise a range of services developed to help improve patient care by accelerating the development, delivery and uptake of precision medicine.

name: ROLLS ROYCE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based company that develops and delivers power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. The Company's segments include Civil Aerospace, Defense, Power Systems. The Civil Aerospace segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing and sales of commercial aero engines and aftermarket services. The Defense segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing and sales of military aero engines, naval engines, submarine nuclear power plants and aftermarket services. The Power Systems segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing, and sales of integrated solutions for onsite power and propulsors. Its subsidiaries include Aerospace Transmission Technologies GmbH and PT Rolls-Royce, PT Rolls Royce Solutions Indonesia, Amalgamated Power Engineering Limited, Nightingale Insurance Limited, Rolls-Royce Australia Pty Limited, Rolls-Royce Canada Limited, among others.

name: ROLLS ROYCE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based company that develops and delivers power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. The Company's segments include Civil Aerospace, Defense, Power Systems. The Civil Aerospace segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing and sales of commercial aero engines and aftermarket services. The Defense segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing and sales of military aero engines, naval engines, submarine nuclear power plants and aftermarket services. The Power Systems segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, marketing, and sales of integrated solutions for onsite power and propulsors. Its subsidiaries include Aerospace Transmission Technologies GmbH and PT Rolls-Royce, PT Rolls Royce Solutions Indonesia, Amalgamated Power Engineering Limited, Nightingale Insurance Limited, Rolls-Royce Australia Pty Limited, Rolls-Royce Canada Limited, among others.

name: HALMA
businessSummary: Halma plc is a global life-saving technology company. Its segments include Safety, Environment & Analysis, and Healthcare. The Safety segment provides products that protect people, assets and infrastructure in commercial, industrial and public spaces. This segment's solutions include fire safety solutions, public safety technologies, worker safety solutions, and infrastructure and asset safety technologies. The Environmental & Analysis segment provides solutions that monitor the environment and improve the availability of life-critical natural resources, which are used in materials analysis and optoelectronic applications. This segment includes optical analysis, water analysis & treatment systems, and environmental monitoring technologies. The Healthcare segment provides technologies to help quality of life for patients and improve the quality of care delivered by healthcare providers. It also designs and manufactures high-performance notification, initiation and detection devices.

name: ROSEBANK INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Rosebank Industries plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company's segments include electrical components industrial (ECI), CPM, and MW. The ECI segment offers industrial automation, electrified mobility, and energy transition technologies, including high voltage and low-voltage wire harnesses, complex control box assemblies, and engineered components for electric vehicles, robotics, data centers, artificial intelligence (AI) and other high-tech industrial applications. It also comprises ECI's appliance sector operations, supplying electrical distribution systems and smart control components for major home and commercial appliances. CPM comprises operations in the manufacture of highly engineered machinery and provision of aftermarket solutions for oilseed processing and animal feed production. Its MW components include MW Fasteners, Springs and Precision Components businesses, which consists manufacturing of engineered and bespoke metal components.

name: SPIRAX GROUP
businessSummary: Spirax Group plc is a thermal energy management and fluid technology solutions company. The Company’s business includes Steam Thermal Solutions, Electric Thermal Solutions and Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions. The Steam Thermal Solutions includes industrial and commercial steam systems, including condensate management, control and thermal energy management products and solutions. Electric Thermal Solutions includes electrical process heating and temperature management solutions, including industrial heaters and systems, heat tracing and a range of component technologies. Its Watson-Marlow Fluid Technology Solutions includes peristaltic and niche pumps and associated fluid path technologies, including pumps, tubing, specialty filling systems and products for single-use applications. It serves various industries, such as pharmaceutical and biotechnology, food and beverage, water and wastewater, mining and healthcare.

name: BYTES TECHNOLOGY GROUP
businessSummary: Bytes Technology Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company that provides information technology (IT) software offerings and solutions, with a focus on artificial intelligence (AI), cloud and security products. The Company enables technology sourcing, adoption, and management across software services, including in the areas of security, cloud and AI solutions. Its solutions comprise two brands: Bytes Software Services (BSS) and Phoenix Software (Phoenix). Bytes Software Services has a customer base that is made up of both private sector customers and public sector customers, whilst Phoenix's focus is on public sector customers. Its cyber security services include Managed Microsoft Sentinel, Managed Firewall Protection, Managed Endpoint Detection & Response, Managed Vulnerability Management, Bytes Incident Response and Penetration Testing & Assurance Services. Its modern workplace services include Managed Workspace, Bytes FastTrack Service, and Skills, Adoption and Change Management.

name: RASPBERRY PI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Raspberry Pi Holdings plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company is a designer of high-performance single board computers (SBCs), compute modules and semiconductors. Its products are used in industrial applications, by original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) who embed them into their own products, and by enthusiasts and educators. It offers a variety of accessories and a software stack, backed by long-term commitments to availability, security and engineering quality. Its SBCs provide industry-standard interfaces and plug-and-play simplicity, enabling rapid prototyping and product development. Its compute modules take the same core technology into embedded environments, allowing customers to integrate Raspberry Pi directly into its designs. Its products are deployed across a range of industrial automation systems, supporting real-time monitoring, data acquisition, and process control.

name: WEIR
businessSummary: Weir PLC, formerly The Weir Group PLC, is a United Kingdom-based global mining technology company. The Company provides processing equipment, wear parts and equipment attachments. Its segments include Minerals and ESCO. The Minerals segment includes engineering, manufacturing and service processing technology used in abrasive, high-wear mining applications. Its differentiated technology is also used in infrastructure and general industrial markets. The ESCO segment includes ground engaging tools (GET), attachments, and artificial intelligence and machine vision technologies that optimize productivity for customers in global mining and infrastructure markets. The Division also includes Weir's Software Solutions business, which provides a suite of equipment agnostic planning and decision software (Micromine) and AI-powered monitoring technologies that optimize mine-to-mill performance. Its brands include ESCO, Warman, Enduron, GEHO, Cavex, Linatex, NEXT, MOTION METRICS and others.

name: NVENT ELECTRIC
businessSummary: nVent Electric plc is a global provider of systems protection and electrical connection solutions. The Company designs, manufactures, markets, installs and services high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. The Company operates through two segments: Systems Protection and Electrical Connections. The Company’s Systems Protection segment provides solutions to help protect electronics, systems and data in mission-critical applications, including data centers, that improve reliability and energy efficiency. It also includes enclosures, switchgear and bus systems businesses. Its Electrical Connections segment provides solutions that connect power and data infrastructure. Its offerings enhance end user safety, reduce installation time and provide resiliency for critical systems. Its robust portfolio of electrical product brands includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE.

name: IMI
businessSummary: IMI plc is a United Kingdom-based company. The Company provides fluid and motion control solutions. It is engaged in engineering bespoke solutions, including valves, actuators and controls. It delivers advanced valves and control systems for global energy systems. It provides clean energy transitions which include nuclear small modular reactors (SMRs), hydrogen, liquefied natural gas (LNG), as well as cooling and heating systems for buildings and data centers. It offers automation solutions for improving productivity, addressing labor shortages, and supports sustainable production through factory automation, packaging lines, smart building management and analytical instruments. Its technologies enable predictive monitoring, modular manufacturing and precision control across a range of applications. It also offers pneumatic and electric motion systems which help machine builders and end users to automate and optimize manufacturing and warehousing processes.

name: LONDON STOCK EXCHANGE GROUP
businessSummary: London Stock Exchange Group plc (LSEG) is a global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. LSEG operates through four divisions. Data & Analytics is a provider of financial markets data and infrastructure and has three businesses: Workflows, Data & Feeds, and Analytics. FTSE Russell is a provider of benchmarks and indices across asset classes and investment styles. Risk Intelligence offers a suite of datasets, products and services enabling businesses to manage their Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti Money-Laundering (AML) compliance, conduct third-party risk due diligence, and detect fraud. Markets provides platforms to raise or transfer capital through issuance and secondary market trading for equities, fixed income and foreign exchange, and includes the London Stock Exchange, LSE Alternative Investment Market, Turquoise, FXall, Matching, Tradeweb businesses, post-trade services, risk management, capital optimization and regulatory reporting solutions.

name: CORERO NETWORK SECURITY
businessSummary: Corero Network Security plc offers Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection solutions, specializing in automated detection and protection solutions with network visibility, analytics, and reporting tools. Its technology protects against external and internal DDoS threats in complex edge and subscriber environments and ensures Internet service availability. It operates through the Corero Network Security segment. Its security services are tailored to enhance the Corero SmartWall ONE solution’s defense against DDoS attacks. Its solutions include DDoS Mitigation, DDoS Protection, and DDoS Protection-as-a-service. Its DDoS Mitigation solutions work faster and with less impact than cloud services. The Company’s hardware appliance, the Network Threat Detector (NTD) 3400, is a 400G upgrade to the SmartWall ONE DDoS Protection Appliance. The Company’s operational centers are in Marlborough, Massachusetts, United States, and Edinburgh, the United Kingdom.

name: VERISURE
businessSummary: Verisure plc is a provider of professionally monitored security services with 24/7 response in Europe and Latin America. The Company works to protect its customers against intrusion, burglary, fires, physical attack, home occupation, theft from a business, life-threatening emergencies and other hazards that may risk the safety, well-being or condition of its customers and their properties. Its segments include Portfolio Services, Customer Acquisition and Adjacencies. The Portfolio Services segment provides a full security service to its customers for a monthly subscription fee. The Customer Acquisition segment develops, sources, purchases, provides and installs alarm systems for new customers in return for an upfront sales or installation fee. The Adjacencies segment includes remote monitoring and assistance, services for senior citizens as well as the sale of Arlo cameras, video surveillance services in retail and online channels across Europe.

name: OPTIMA HEALTH
businessSummary: Optima Health plc is a provider of technology-enabled corporate health and wellbeing solutions in the occupational health sector. Its service includes strategy & advisory, risk & compliance, performance & attendance, and engagement & wellbeing. It combines its proprietary digital platform with onsite and remote clinical delivery to provide scalable, data‐led services across diverse sectors, from public services and healthcare to logistics, construction, manufacturing and financial services. Its integrated model spans the full occupational health lifecycle, including pre‐placement assessments, statutory health surveillance, fitness for work assessments, mental health and musculoskeletal support, absence and case management, health promotion, and rehabilitation pathways. It has a team of over 800 occupational health practitioners in the United Kingdom. It also operates in Ireland under Optima Health Ireland, providing occupational health services to clients nationwide.

name: TRUSTPILOT GROUP
businessSummary: Trustpilot Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company that operates a digital platform that brings businesses and consumers together. The principal activity of the Company and its subsidiaries consists of developing and hosting an online review platform that helps consumers make purchasing decisions and businesses showcase and improve their service. The Company's platform creates a place where businesses and consumers can gain actionable insights and collaborate. Through its platform, consumers can share feedback, at any time, about any business with a Website and review feedback left by other consumers. The platform also gives consumers the opportunity to recommend businesses, products, services, and locations based on their experiences. Its consumers can search for reviews on any business by category and any business with a Website, whether operating online or offline, can receive a review. The Company’s subsidiaries include Trustpilot Ltd, Trustpilot, Inc., and others.

name: SAGE GROUP
businessSummary: The Sage Group plc is a United Kingdom-based company. It provides accounting, financial, human resources (HR) and payroll technology for small and mid-sized businesses. Its segments include North America, United Kingdom, Ireland, Africa and APAC (UKIA) and Europe. Its products include Sage Accounting, Payroll software, Sage Intacct, Sage X3, Sage HR, Sage People, Sage Earth, Sage Ai and Payments and Banking. Sage Accounting is designed to enable small businesses operating in any industry, and accountants and bookkeepers, to manage customer data, accounts, and people in a single solution. Sage Intacct helps growing mid-sized organizations thrive in with digital world with solutions across accounting, planning, and analytics. Sage People is an HR and people management solution for mid-sized businesses. Sage Payroll is an intuitive solution that helps small businesses to run their payroll reliably and flexibly. Sage People is an HR and people management solution for mid-sized businesses.

name: GENIUS SPORTS
businessSummary: Genius Sports Limited is the official data, technology and broadcast partner that powers the ecosystem connecting sports, betting and media. It operates through one segment, which consists of providing access to Betting Content Technology, Content and Services; Media Technology Content and Services; and Sports Technology and Services. It builds and supplies technology and services that allow sports leagues to collect, analyze and monetize their data with added tools to deepen fan engagement. It provides sports leagues with bespoke monitoring technology and education services to help protect their competitions and athletes from the threats of match fixing and betting-related corruption. It offers official data, outsourced bookmaking, trading/risk management services and live audio-visual game content that is derived from its streaming partnerships with sports leagues. Its offerings include Live sports data, Pre-game and in-game odds feeds, and BetVision, among others.

name: INTERCONTINENTAL HOTELS GROUP
businessSummary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based global hospitality company. The Company has a diverse portfolio of differentiated brands. With 20 hotel brands and IHG One Rewards, which is a hotel loyalty program, the Company has approximately 6,600 open hotels in more than 100 countries, and a development pipeline of over 2,200 properties. The Company’s brands include Six Senses Hotels Resorts Spas, Regent Hotels & Resorts, InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, Vignette Collection, Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, Hotel Indigo, voco hotels, HUALUXE Hotels & Resorts, Crowne Plaza Hotels & Resorts, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Hotels & Resorts, Garner hotels, avid hotels, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Candlewood Suites, Iberostar Beachfront Resorts, and Ruby. Ruby brand operates approximately 20 hotels (3,483 rooms) in cities across Europe and has another 10 pipeline hotels (2,235 rooms).

name: INTERCONTINENTAL HOTELS GROUP
businessSummary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC is a United Kingdom-based global hospitality company. The Company has a diverse portfolio of differentiated brands. With 20 hotel brands and IHG One Rewards, which is a hotel loyalty program, the Company has approximately 6,600 open hotels in more than 100 countries, and a development pipeline of over 2,200 properties. The Company’s brands include Six Senses Hotels Resorts Spas, Regent Hotels & Resorts, InterContinental Hotels & Resorts, Vignette Collection, Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, Hotel Indigo, voco hotels, HUALUXE Hotels & Resorts, Crowne Plaza Hotels & Resorts, EVEN Hotels, Holiday Inn Express, Holiday Inn Hotels & Resorts, Garner hotels, avid hotels, Atwell Suites, Staybridge Suites, Holiday Inn Club Vacations, Candlewood Suites, Iberostar Beachfront Resorts, and Ruby. Ruby brand operates approximately 20 hotels (3,483 rooms) in cities across Europe and has another 10 pipeline hotels (2,235 rooms).

name: LINDE
businessSummary: Linde plc is a United Kingdom-based global industrial gases and engineering company. The Company's segments include Americas, EMEA, APAC and Engineering. Its primary products in its industrial gases business consists of atmospheric gases, such as oxygen, nitrogen, argon, and rare gases and process gases, including hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, electronic gases, and acetylene, among others. The Company also designs and builds equipment that produces industrial gases and offers customers a range of gas production and processing services, such as olefin plants, natural gas plants, air separation plants, hydrogen and synthesis gas plants and other types of plants. It serves a diverse group of industries including healthcare, chemicals and energy, manufacturing, metals and mining, food and beverage, and electronics. Its Engineering business designs and manufactures equipment for air separation and other industrial gas applications specifically for end customers.

name: HELIOS TOWERS
businessSummary: Helios Towers plc is a United Kingdom-based independent telecommunications infrastructure company. The Company has broad tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. The Company builds, owns and operates telecom passive infrastructure, providing services to mobile network operators. The Company offers a comprehensive passive infrastructure solution that includes site selection and preparation, maintenance, security, power management and hosting of active equipment such as antennae. The Company's suite of services includes colocation, build-to-suit, sale and leaseback, managed services, in-building solutions and small cells / outdoor distributed antenna system (DAS). It owns and operates over 14,000 telecommunication tower sites in nine countries across Africa and the Middle East. The Company operates in various countries, such as Tanzania, Senegal, Malawi, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ghana, Congo Brazzaville, South Africa, Madagascar and Oman.

name: POLLEN STREET GROUP
businessSummary: Pollen Street Group Limited is an alternative asset manager company. The Company is engaged in investing in the financial and business services sectors across both Private Equity and Private Credit strategies. It has two operating segments: the Asset Manager segment and the Investment Company segment. The Asset Manager segment incorporates the activities of the Company that provides investment management and investment advisory services to a range of funds under management within Private Equity and Private Credit strategies. Fund management services are also provided to the Investment Company segment. The Investment Company segment holds the investment assets of the Company. The Investment Company invests in the strategies of the Company, delivering risk-adjusted returns and accelerating growth in third-party assets under management (AuM) of the Asset Manager through investing in Pollen Street funds. The portfolio consists of both direct investments and investments in funds.

name: INTERNATIONAL PUBLIC PARTNERSHIPS
businessSummary: International Public Partnerships Limited is a Guernsey-based closed-ended investment company. The Company's investment objective is to provide its investors with stable, long-term, inflation-linked returns, based on growing dividends and the potential for capital appreciation. It seeks to achieve this by investing in a diversified portfolio of infrastructure assets and businesses which, through its active management, meets societal and environmental needs. The Company invests in public or social infrastructure assets and related businesses located in the United Kingdom, Australia, Europe, North America and other parts of the world. The Company has approximately 140 infrastructure projects and businesses. The portfolio consists of utility and transmission, transport, education, health, justice and digital infrastructure projects and businesses, in the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, New Zealand and North America. Its investment adviser is Amber Fund Management Limited.

name: FORESIGHT GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Foresight Group Holdings Limited is a Guernsey-based company. The Company operates as an investment manager in real assets and capital for growth. Its segments include Real Assets and Private Equity. The Real Assets segment manages portfolios of renewable energy, infrastructure and natural capital assets across the United Kingdom (UK), Europe and Australia. It provides institutional investors with access to opportunities in the energy transition and natural capital. Its energy transition funds include Foresight Energy Infrastructure Partners (FEIP), Foresight Energy Infrastructure Partners II, Australian Renewables Income Fund (ARIF), and ForVEI II. Its Private Equity segment invests in small businesses across all sectors and transaction types, offering growth and buyout capital, venture capital and structured lending across the UK and Ireland. Its portfolio includes Hospital Services Limited, Oxford Space Systems, and Reward Finance Group.

name: SIRIUS REAL ESTATE
businessSummary: Sirius Real Estate Limited is a property company that owns and operates branded businesses and industrial parks providing conventional space and flexible workspace in Germany and the United Kingdom. The Company operates through two segments: Germany and the UK. Its Germany segment focuses on seven cities: Berlin, Dusseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich, Stuttgart, and other. Its Germany property includes traditional business parks, modern business parks, and office buildings. The Company’s UK sites operate under the BizSpace brand. BizSpace provides a range of workshops and small industrial units for businesses needing space for light industrial work, such as manufacturing, repairing, and packing, or warehouse space to store stock. BizSpace caters to the office needs of SMEs, ranging from small units to larger units. BizSpace's mixed sites combine workshop space and office space on site.

name: AMDOCS
businessSummary: Amdocs Limited is a provider of software and services to communications and media service providers of all sizes throughout the world. The Company's portfolio of software products and services is designed to leverage artificial intelligence (AI), drive digital transformation, accelerate cloud adoption, and enable intelligent network automation. Its comprehensive line of services is designed to address every stage of a service provider's life cycle and includes consulting, design, data, cloud, network services to delivery, quality engineering (testing), operations, systems integration, and content services. Its managed services provide managing information technology (IT) business processes and applications services, which include application development, modernization and maintenance, IT and infrastructure services, testing and professional services that are designed to assist customers in the selection, implementation, operation, management and maintenance of their IT systems.

name: SGHC
businessSummary: SGHC Limited is a holding company engaged in online sports betting and gaming. The Company operates through two business segments: Betway and Spin. Betway is the premier online sportsbook operating under a single brand, offering sports betting and casino entertainment. Betway has a global footprint, holding licenses throughout Europe, the Americas and Africa, with approximately 60 brand partnerships with teams and leagues worldwide. The Spin is a multi-brand online casino offering, with market leadership in high-growth markets. It has a diverse portfolio of approximately 16 casino brands, which offer a range of casino products. Its subsidiaries include Pindus Holdings Limited, Fengari Holdings Limited, and SG Media Limited.

name: ZIMPLATS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Zimplats Holdings Limited is a Guernsey-based integrated producer of platinum group metals (PGMs) with global operations. The Company is engaged in the production of PGMs, including platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium, and ruthenium, as well as associated metals such as nickel, gold, copper, cobalt, and silver. The Company operates mines and three concentrator plants in Ngezi, as well as a fourth concentrator plant and a smelter complex in Selous. The Company holds two mining titles: Mining Lease Number 36 (ML36) and Mining Lease Number 37 (ML37). ML36 covers the Hartley area, located approximately 80 kilometers west-southwest of Harare. ML37 encompasses the Ngezi mines, including the South Pit Mine (Portal 10), situated about 150 kilometers southwest of Harare in the Sebakwe sub-chamber. The Company, through its subsidiary, Zimbabwe Platinum Mines (Private) Limited, extracts PGMs from orebodies located on the Great Dyke, southwest of Harare, Zimbabwe.

name: TAYLOR MARITIME
businessSummary: Taylor Maritime Ltd, formerly Taylor Maritime Investments Limited, is a Guernsey-based commercial shipping company specializing in the geared dry bulk segment of the global shipping sector. It owns and operates a fleet of geared dry bulk carriers and has built a platform which encompasses investment and commercial ship management, as well as technical ship management services. The Company, through its subsidiaries, owns a fleet of approximately seven dry bulk vessels consisting of five Handysize vessels and two Supra/Ultramax vessels. The Company also has one vessel under a Joint Venture agreement and three vessels in its chartered in fleet. Its Handysize and Supra/Ultramax vessels carry a variety of dry bulk cargo, primarily necessity goods, such as food and basic building materials.

name: TAYLOR MARITIME
businessSummary: Taylor Maritime Ltd, formerly Taylor Maritime Investments Limited, is a Guernsey-based commercial shipping company specializing in the geared dry bulk segment of the global shipping sector. It owns and operates a fleet of geared dry bulk carriers and has built a platform which encompasses investment and commercial ship management, as well as technical ship management services. The Company, through its subsidiaries, owns a fleet of approximately seven dry bulk vessels consisting of five Handysize vessels and two Supra/Ultramax vessels. The Company also has one vessel under a Joint Venture agreement and three vessels in its chartered in fleet. Its Handysize and Supra/Ultramax vessels carry a variety of dry bulk cargo, primarily necessity goods, such as food and basic building materials.

name: JPMORGAN GLOBAL CORE REAL ASSETS
businessSummary: JPMorgan Global Core Real Assets Limited is a Guernsey-based closed-ended investment company. The Company's investment objective is to realize all existing assets in the Company's portfolio in an orderly manner and to make timely returns of capital to shareholders. The Company will pursue its investment objective by effecting an orderly realisation of its assets. It has constructed a diversified portfolio of real assets, including real estate, transport assets, infrastructure, and liquid real assets. The Company is invested in private funds or managed accounts that are managed or advised by entities within the JPMorgan Asset Management. The Company’s investment manager is J.P. Morgan Asset Management, Inc., and its alternative investment fund manager is JPMorgan Funds Limited.

name: TWENTYFOUR SELECT MONTHLY INCOME FUND
businessSummary: TwentyFour Select Monthly Income Fund Limited is a Guernsey-based closed-ended investment company. The Company’s investment objective is to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns, principally through income distributions, by investing in a diversified portfolio of fixed income credit products. The Company’s investment policy is to invest in a diversified portfolio of credit securities. Its portfolio comprises any category of credit security, including, without prejudice to the generality of the foregoing, bank capital, corporate bonds, high-yield bonds, leveraged loans, payment-in-kind notes and asset-backed securities and includes securities of a less liquid nature. It maintains a portfolio diversified by issuer and comprises approximately 50 credit securities. Its alternative investment fund manager is Apex Fundrock Limited.

name: RIVERSTONE ENERGY
businessSummary: Riverstone Energy Limited is a closed-end investment company. The principal activity of the Company is to act as an investment entity through partnerships and make investments in the energy sector. The Company’s investment objective is to generate long-term capital growth by making investments in the global energy sector. It conducts buyout and growth capital investments in the exploration and production (E&P), midstream, oilfield services, power and renewable sectors of the energy industry. The Company seeks to achieve risk-adjusted returns through investing in the energy sector, with a focus on the energy transition and decarbonization of the global economy. It invests in public or private securities, may hold controlling or non-controlling positions in its investments, and may make investments in the form of equity, equity-related instruments, indebtedness, or derivatives. Its investment manager is RIGL Holdings, LP.

name: CHRYSALIS INVESTMENTS
businessSummary: Chrysalis Investments Limited is a Guernsey-based closed-ended investment company. The investment objective of the Company is to generate long-term capital growth through investing in a portfolio consisting primarily of equity or equity-related investments in unquoted and listed companies. The Company invests primarily in equity and equity-related instruments (which shall include, without limitation, preference shares, convertible debt instruments, equity-related and equity-linked notes, and warrants) issued by portfolio companies. The Company also invests in partnerships, limited liability partnerships, and other legal forms of the entity where the investment has equity-like return characteristics. G10 Capital Limited is the alternative investment fund manager (AIFM) to the Company.

name: PEEL HUNT
businessSummary: Peel Hunt Limited engages in the integrated investment banking, research and distribution, and execution service businesses in the United Kingdom. The Investment Banking segment provides financial advisory and capital market services for equity capital markets, debt advisory, private and public mergers and acquisitions, investor relations, private equity, and corporate broking. The Research & Distribution segment offers equity research services for building and construction, consumer, economics, financials, healthcare and life sciences, industrials, insurance, investment companies, media, mining, oil and gas, real estate, renewables, retail, support services, technology, and travel and leisure sectors. The Execution Services segment provides dealing and execution services for institutional asset managers, registrars, private client wealth managers, and private banks. The company was formerly known as PH Capital Limited and changed its name to Peel Hunt Limited in September 2021. Peel Hunt Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Saint Sampson, Guernsey.

name: DUKE CAPITAL
businessSummary: Duke Capital Limited is a Guernsey-based provider of hybrid capital solutions for small and medium-sized enterprise (SME) business owners in the United Kingdom, Europe and North America, combining the features of both equity and debt. Its hybrid capital solution caters to the needs of underserved SME businesses without burdening the owners with a loss of control or refinancing risk. The Company is focused on generating attractive risk-adjusted returns for shareholders and has a record of achieving this across market cycles. Its three investment pillars are capital preservation, attractive dividend yield, and providing upside upon exit. It works with commercial, financial, and legal due diligence partners to ensure the standards of due diligence are adhered to in the investment process. Its flexible financing model enables multiple drawdowns to be used for bolt-on acquisitions.

name: PERSHING SQUARE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Pershing Square Holdings, Ltd. is a Guernsey-based investment holding company structured as a closed-ended fund. The Company is principally engaged in the business of acquiring and holding positions in a concentrated number of large capitalization companies. Its objective is to maximize its long-term compound annual rate of growth in intrinsic value per share. It invests primarily in large-capitalization securities, which are highly liquid under normal market conditions. The Company may make investments in the debt securities of a private company if there is an observable market price for such debt securities. It may invest in long and short positions in equity or debt securities of the United States and non-United States issuers; distressed securities, rights, options, and warrants; bonds, notes and equity and debt indices; and swaps, swaptions, and other derivatives, among others. Its investment manager is Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P.

name: EUROCASTLE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Eurocastle Investment Limited is a closed-ended investment company. The Company is focused on opportunistic real estate in Greece with a plan to expand across Southern Europe. The Company is in the early stages of pursuing its investment activities. The Company's investment manager is FIG LLC.

name: REGIONAL REIT
businessSummary: Regional REIT Limited is a Guernsey-based real estate investment trust (REIT). The Company’s commercial property portfolio comprises wholly income-producing United Kingdom assets, predominantly offices located in the regional centers outside the M25 motorway. The portfolio is geographically diversified, with approximately 123 properties, 1,248 units and 740 tenants. The Company may also invest in property portfolios in which up to 50% of the property is situated inside the M25 motorway. Its commercial property portfolio includes Capitol Park, Leeds; Orbis 1, 2 & 3, Derby; Eagle Court, Birmingham; Hampshire Corporate Park, Chandler's Ford, Eastleigh; Manchester Green, Manchester; Beeston Business Park, Nottingham, and others. Its subsidiaries include Beaufort Office Park Management Company Limited, Regional Commercial MIDCO Ltd, and others. It is managed by ESR Europe LSPIM Ltd., the Asset Manager, and ESR Europe Private Markets Ltd., the Investment Adviser.

name: SHURGARD SELF STORAGE
businessSummary: Shurgard Self Storage Ltd is a provider of self-storage in Europe. The Company owns and/or operates 352 self-storage facilities and approximately 1.8 million net rentable square meters in seven countries: the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, France, Germany, Sweden, Belgium and Denmark. Its segments include same-store facilities and non-same-store facilities. The same-stores facilities segment comprises self-developed stores. The non-same-store segment comprises any other self-storage facilities that it operates (excluding the properties operated under management contract). Its stores include Manchester Belle Vue; Altrincham; Eastbourne - Lottbridge Drove; Bolton; Barking – Dagenham; Stuttgart – Leinfelden; Manchester Ardwick; Dusseldorf – Neuss; Beverwijk; Stuttgart Wangen; Cologne Lovenich; Bromborough; Berlin Charlottenburg-Nord; Hamburg Harburg; Mainz; Mannheim Neckarau; Darmstadt; Hamburg Barmbek Bramfelder; Hedge End; Swindon; Milton Keynes-Kingston, and Bedford.

name: HARBOURVEST GLOBAL PRIVATE EQUITY
businessSummary: HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited is a Guernsey-based closed-end investment company. The Company’s investment objective is to generate shareholder returns through long-term capital appreciation by investing primarily in a diversified portfolio of private equity investments. It also makes investments in private market assets other than private equity where it identifies opportunities. It seeks to achieve its investment objectives primarily by investing in investment funds managed by HarbourVest Partners, LLC (HarbourVest), which invests in or alongside third party-managed investment funds (HarbourVest Funds). HarbourVest Funds include Primary HarbourVest Funds, Secondary HarbourVest Funds and Direct HarbourVest Funds. It invests in various sectors, such as technology and software, medical and biotech, consumer, financial, industrial and transport, business services and other, media and telecom, and energy and cleantech. Its investment manager is HarbourVest Advisers L.P.

name: GEMFIELDS GROUP
businessSummary: Gemfields Group Limited is a Guernsey-based miner and marketer of colored gemstones. The Company’s segments include Kagem Mining Limited (Kagem), Montepuez Ruby Mining Limitada (MRM), Development assets, Corporate and Other. The Kagem segment includes the Company's emerald and beryl mine, in Zambia, Africa. The MRM segment includes its ruby and corundum mines in Mozambique, Africa. The Development assets segment consists of the Company's exploration and evaluation assets accounted for under IFRS 6, in respect of exploration activities in Africa, including Megaruma Mining Limitada (MML), Eastern Ruby Mining Limitada (ERM), Campos de Joia Limitada (CDJ), Nairoto Resources Lda (Nairoto or NRL), and the Company’s projects in Ethiopia and Madagascar. The Corporate segment comprises sales of cut and polished gemstones, marketing, and technical and administrative services is based in the United Kingdom. The Other segment includes sales and marketing offices.

name: LANDORE RESOURCES
businessSummary: Landore Resources Limited, through its wholly owned subsidiary, Landore Resources Canada Inc., is engaged in mineral exploration and development in Canada. The Company is the 100% owner of the highly prospective BAM Gold Project in Northwestern Ontario, Canada, which has an NI 43-101 compliant resource estimate of 1.5m oz Au. The Company owns 100% of the Junior Lake Property, which consists of over 22,037 hectares in the province of Ontario, Canada, located approximately 235 kilometers north-northeast of the Thunder Bay Mining District, and it hosts the BAM Gold Deposit, the B4-7 Nickel-Copper-Cobalt-PGEs deposit and the adjacent Alpha PGEs zone. Junior Lake also contains the VW Nickel deposit and numerous other highly prospective mineral occurrences, including lithium. The Company’s other properties include Frond Lake, Wottam, Lessard, Swole Lake, and others.

name: BURFORD CAPITAL
businessSummary: Burford Capital Limited is a global finance and asset management company focused on law. The Company’s businesses include litigation finance and risk management, asset recovery and a range of legal finance and advisory activities. It provides capital, based on portfolio size, against the underlying value of litigation and legal assets. It operates through two segments: Principal Finance and Asset Management and Other Services. The Principal Finance segment funds capital to legal finance assets from its balance sheet, primarily as capital provision assets, and in limited scope through interests in private funds managed the Company. These capital provision assets and private fund interests generate its capital provision income. The Asset Management and Other Services segment manages legal finance assets on behalf of third-party investors, and it provides other services to the legal industry. Its clients are a range of litigants including a number of law firms and businesses.

name: PARTNERS GROUP PRIVATE EQUITY
businessSummary: Partners Group Private Equity Limited (PGPEL), formerly Princess Private Equity Holding Limited, is a Guernsey-based investment holding company. The Company mainly invests in private companies in the middle and upper middle market. PGPEL’s investment objective is to provide shareholders with long-term capital growth and dividend yield, through investment in a diversified portfolio of private companies. It invests in various sectors, such as healthcare, consumer discretionary, utilities, information technology, consumer staples, materials, financials, energy, industrials, telecommunication services and others. It invests in various geographies, such as North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Rest of World. Its investments by financing categories include buyout small/mid-cap, buyout large/mega-cap, special situations and venture capital. It invests across various sectors such as industrials, healthcare, consumer discretionary and others. PGPEL’s investment manager is Partners Group AG.

name: DP AIRCRAFT
businessSummary: DP Aircraft I Limited is a Guernsey-based holding company. The Company's principal activity is to purchase, lease and then sell Boeing 787-8 Aircraft (the Assets). The Company's investment objective is to obtain income returns and a capital return for its shareholders by acquiring, leasing and then, when the board considers it is appropriate, selling aircraft. The Company makes its investments in aircraft through its subsidiaries, DP Aircraft Guernsey III Limited, DP Aircraft Guernsey IV Limited, and DP Aircraft UK Limited. The Company's aircraft are two Boeing 787-8 fitted with Rolls-Royce engines. The Boeing 787, named the Dreamliner, is a twin-engine long-range aircraft with a new aircraft design. The Boeing 787 is a mid-sized aircraft which has a range of large passenger space. Its asset manager is DS Aviation GmbH & Co. KG.

name: PACSCO
businessSummary: PACSCo Limited is a Guernsey-based shell company. The Company is not generating any revenue and has no operations. The Company was focused on investment and sustainable development in Southern Africa.

name: CHARIOT
businessSummary: Chariot Limited is a Guernsey-based energy company. The Company’s segments include Upstream Oil & Gas, Renewable Power, Green Hydrogen, and corporate costs. The Upstream Oil & Gas segment is focused on building a growth chain within Africa. The Renewable Power segment is focused on providing reliable energy solutions across Southern Africa as well as progressing the development of its power-to-mining projects on the continent. The Company's Green Hydrogen project, named Project Nour, spans two onshore areas totaling approximately 5,000 square kilometers (km2), across northern Mauritania. The Company's assets in Morocco offer a range of near-term development assets and drill-ready exploration prospects that have commercial fundamentals. It holds direct equity in two large-scale wind assets, along with its material stake in Etana Energy's expanding electricity trading business. The Company's subsidiaries include Chariot Oil & Gas Investments (Namibia) Limited, among others.

name: MERCANTILE PORTS & LOGISTICS
businessSummary: Mercantile Ports & Logistics Limited develops, owns, and operates port and logistics facilities. The Company is implementing its project of developing a modern port and logistics facility at Karanja Creek in the Raigad District of Maharashtra. The port is being developed on approximately 200 acres of land with a sea frontage of over 1,000 meters at Karanja Creek. The multi-purpose terminal accommodates a variety of cargoes, including containers, bulk, break-bulk cargo, and roll-on/roll/off (Ro-Ro). The terminal is comprised of approximately 800 meters of quay, utilizing both sides of a 400-meter jetty, which is serviced by multipurpose cranes, and over 200-acre back-up area for cargo storage and logistics facility. The Karanja Terminal also focuses on housing a logistics complex spread over approximately 100 acres of land. The facility comprises logistics and warehousing facilities for storage of cargo, including cold and bonded storage, and value-add services.

name: RAINBOW RARE EARTHS
businessSummary: Rainbow Rare Earths Limited is a Guernsey-based mining company. The Company’s principal activity is the development of a rare earth minerals project in South Africa and the opportunity to utilize the associated processing technology at other global rare earth opportunities, including but not limited to opportunities in Brazil. The Company operates two reportable segments: Phalaborwa, a gypsum stack re-treatment project for the recovery of rare earths in South Africa, and Gakara, a rare-earth project in Burundi. The Company’s projects include Phalaborwa, Uberaba, Gakara, and OCP Morocco. The Company’s subsidiaries are Rainbow International Resources Limited, Rainbow Burundi SPRL, Rainbow Mining Burundi SM, Rainbow Rare Earths Zimbabwe (Private) Limited, and Rainbow Rare Earths (Proprietary) Limited.

name: RTW BIOTECH OPPORTUNITIES
businessSummary: RTW Biotech Opportunities Ltd is a Guernsey-based company focused on identifying transformative assets with high growth potential across the biopharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The Company invests in companies developing therapies and technologies that can significantly improve patients' lives. The Company seeks to achieve its investment objective by leveraging the Investment Manager's data-driven pipeline of assets to invest in life sciences companies across various therapeutic categories and product types (including genetic medicines, biologics, traditional modalities, such as small molecule pharmaceuticals and antibodies, and medical devices). It intends to create a diversified portfolio of investments across a range of businesses, each pursuing the development of superior pharmacological or medical therapeutic assets to enhance the quality of life and/or extend patient life. The Company's portfolio is managed by RTW Investments, LP.

name: DCI ADVISORS
businessSummary: DCI Advisors Ltd is a real estate investment company. The Company is focused on the early-stage, large-scale leisure-integrated residential resorts in the Eastern Mediterranean. The Company is engaged in the development of beachfront properties in the Eastern Mediterranean-Greece, Cyprus, and Croatia. Its projects include Scorpio Bay Resort, Lavender Bay Resort, Plaka Bay Resort, Apollo Heights Polo Resort, Aristo Developers, and Livka Bay Resort. Its Scorpio Bay Resort has a hotel and full-service spa, integrated with residential development and sea-related leisure facilities. The Company's subsidiaries include Scorpio Bay Holdings Limited, Scorpio Bay Resorts S.A., Xscape Limited, Golfing Developments S.A., MindCompass Overseas One Limited, MindCompass Overseas S.A., MindCompass Overseas Two S.A., Dolphin Capital Greek Collection Limited, D.C. Apollo Heights Polo and Country Resort Limited, and others.

name: FERRO ALLOY RESOURCES
businessSummary: Ferro-Alloy Resources Limited is a Guernsey-based holding company. The Company produces vanadium pentoxide, ferro-molybdenum, and nickel concentrates. The Company operates through three segments: Processing, Subsoil, and Corporate. The Company’s assets are primarily concentrated in the Republic of Kazakhstan. The Company carries on a mining and mineral processing business with operations located at the Balasausqandiq vanadium/polymetallic mineral deposit in the Kyzylordinskaya Oblast in southern Kazakhstan. The Balasausqandiq deposit is a black-shale deposit containing vanadium and valuable byproducts, such as uranium, molybdenum, aluminum, rare earth metals and carbon. In parallel with developing the Balasausqandiq vanadium deposit, the Company is also operating a processing plant, which is engaged in treating bought-in concentrates. It is also focused on production processing purchased vanadium-containing secondary materials to produce vanadium in the form of ammonium metavanadate.

name: EVOKE
businessSummary: Evoke plc is a betting and gaming company. It owns and operates internationally renowned brands, including William Hill, 888, and Mr Green. Its segments include Retail, UK&I Online, International, and Others. The Retail segment comprises all activity undertaken in LBOs including gaming machines. The UK&I Online segment comprises all online activity, including sports betting, casino, poker and other gaming products, along with telephone betting services that are offered within the United Kingdom and Ireland. The International segment comprises all online activity, including sports betting, casino, poker and other gaming products, along with telephone betting services that are offered within all territories excluding the United Kingdom. 888casino is an online casino that offers over 2,500 games from a combination of various games providers and its own games developed in house by its Section8 studio. Mr Green brand offers a range of casino and slot games, both online and through its app.

name: WISHBONE GOLD
businessSummary: Wishbone Gold Plc is a Gibraltar-based company, which is engaged in gold, silver, and copper exploration. It has approximately three exploration properties in Australia and three minor prospects. Two of these are located in the Pilbara region of Western Australia and the third is in the Mingela-Charters Towers region in Queensland. The Company’s projects include Red Setter, Cottesloe project, Anketell, Wishbone II, IV & VI, and White Mountain. Its flagship project is Red Setter, located approximately 13 kilometers (km) southwest of Newcrest’s Telfer operations. Red Setter is a Havieron style gold prospect. Cottlesloe project, which is approximately 35 km southeast of Red Setter, has deposits visible on the surface of silver and lead. The Anketell Project consists of a single exploration license application, covering an area of over 10 square kilometers. White Mountain is located west-southwest of Townsville, Queensland. White Mountain includes polymetallic historical mines.

name: ELVE
businessSummary: ELVE S.A. is a Greece-based company active in the apparel and renewable energy sectors. The Company specializes in the design, production, procurement, and distribution of uniforms, workwear, corporate clothing, functional garments, personal protective equipment (PPE), and related accessories. Its product portfolio includes uniforms and equipment for military, police, firefighters, and special forces, as well as corporate apparel, workwear, safety clothing, tactical gear, footwear, ballistic vests, and other protective equipment. Through its ELVE Uniforms division, the Company supplies public and private sector organizations, including government authorities, transportation operators, hospitality businesses, industrial companies, and large corporations. In addition, through its ELVE Energy division, the Company is engaged in electricity generation from renewable energy sources, primarily through solar power installations.

name: AS
businessSummary: AS Company SA is a Greece-based manufacturing and trading company that is active in the production and distribution of toys. The Company’s product categories are Educational, which includes scientific games, family board games, games for knowledge and toy computers; Bebe, which consists of baby blocks, cotton dolls and rattles; Art/Creative Toys, which includes puzzles, painting sets, karaoke kits and drawing sets; Boy, which includes activity toys, action figures, automotive toys and majorettes, and Girl, which includes the Lilou doll range. It operates a network of approximately 1,800 points of sale and a logistic center and offers more than 1,500 products. The Company’s other activities include the import and distribution of toys and children’s products through licensing and exclusive distribution agreements with international brands such as Chicco, Boppy, Bebe Confort and Safety 1st, as well as other global toy manufacturers.

name: ALPHA REAL ESTATE SERVICES
businessSummary: Alpha Real Estate Services SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in real estate industry. The Company's main activities include the management and exploitation of all types of real estate properties, ranging from simple plots and agricultural land to complex industrial facilities, residential complexes, modern shopping centers and hotel units. The Company provides technical consulting on related matters, undertakes construction projects and develops and operates hotel and tourism facilities. Additionally, Alpha Real Estate Services SA engages in real estate and brokerage activities, conducts various studies and offers general consulting services as well as performs property and machinery valuations for third parties. Through its subsidiaries, the Company, is active in Southeast Europe.

name: KARELIA TOBACCO
businessSummary: Karelia Tobacco Company Inc SA is a Greece-based company, which is specialized in the production and sale of tobacco industry products. The principal activity of the Company and its subsidiaries is the wholesale of tobacco products, such as cigarettes, cigars, hand rolling cigarettes and other duty free tobacco products. It subsidiary companies are Karelia Belgium Limited SPRL, Karelia Tobacco Co UK Ltd, Karelia Tutun ve Ticaret AS, Meridian Duty Free Specialists SA, Karelia Investment SA and Karelia Bulgaria EOOD Sofia. The Company’s brands include: George Karelias and Sons, Karelia Slims, Ome, Karelia Blue, American Legend, Leader, Karelia Royal, Wellington and Karelia. The Company exports its products to over 60 countries around the world.

name: INTERLIFE GENERAL INSURANCE
businessSummary: Interlife General Insurance Company SA is a Greece-based company, engaged in the general insurance sector. The Company carries all types of insurance claims, offering insurance products to individuals as well as to companies and professionals. Interlife General Insurance Company SA's personal insurance products include: car insurance, boat insurance, property insurance, personnel insurance, legal protection insurance and liability insurance. The Company's insurance products to companies and professionals includes: car insurance,bBoat insurance, property insurance, group insurance of persons, legal protection insurance, engineering insurance, liability insurance and transport insurance. Furthermore the Company offers financial products such as mutual funds, as well as managing claims on behalf of foreign insurance companies, such as loss of green cards, reimbursement claims, car damage assessment, transport and yacht, among others.

name: STEALTHGAS
businessSummary: StealthGas Inc. is a provider of international seaborne transportation services to liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) producers and users, as well as crude oil and product carriers to oil producers, refineries and commodities traders. The Company owns a fleet of LPG carriers. Its LPG carriers carry various petroleum gas products in liquefied form, including propane, butane, butadiene, isopropane, propylene and vinyl chloride monomer, which are all byproducts of the production of crude oil and natural gas. The medium range product carriers in its fleet are capable of carrying refined petroleum products, such as gasoline, diesel, fuel oil and jet fuel, as well as edible oils and chemicals, while its Aframax tanker is used for carrying crude oil. Its fleet consists of approximately 50 LPG carriers, including two chartered-in LPG carriers, two 2008-built product carriers, a 2009-built product carrier and a 2010-built Aframax crude oil tanker.

name: EUROSEAS
businessSummary: Euroseas Ltd. is engaged in the shipping business. The Company is an owner and operator of drybulk and container carrier vessels and is a provider of seaborne transportation for drybulk and containerized cargoes. Eurobulk Ltd. manages the Company's operations. The Company also owns and operates dry bulk carriers that transport major bulks, such as iron ore, coal and grains, and minor bulks, such as bauxite, phosphate and fertilizers. The Company has a fleet of 12 vessels, including Kamsarmax drybulk carrier, Panamax drybulk carriers and Handymax drybulk carrier, Intermediate containerships, Handysize containerships, and Feeder containerships. The Company’s five drybulk carriers have a total cargo capacity of 351,272 deadweight tons (dwt), and its seven containerships have a cargo capacity of 11,828 twenty-foot equivalent units (teu).

name: JUMBO
businessSummary: Jumbo SA is a Greece-based company, which is engaged in the retail trade of new items in specialized stores. It is mainly engaged in the retail sale of toys, baby items, seasonal items, decoration items, books and stationery. Furthermore a small part of the Company’s operations is the wholesale trade of toys and similar items to third parties. The Company operates in the following segments: Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria and Romania. The Company’s subsidiaries include: Jumbo ECR SRL, based in Romania; Jumbo Trading Ltd, based in Cyprus, as well as Jumbo EC.B EOOD Sofia, based in Bulgaria. The Company operates more than 70 stores in Greece, Cyprus, Bulgaria and Romania, as well as an online store e-jumbo.

name: AVAX
businessSummary: Avax SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the construction industry. The Company operates in several key sectors. In the construction sector, Avax SA undertakes civil engineering projects such as hospitals, sports centers, hotels, banks, educational institutions, parking facilities, airports, and other related projects. The Company is active in concessions and public-private partnerships focusing on highway and bridge constructions. In the energy and industrial sector, Avax SA is involved in the construction of power plants, natural gas projects, liquefied natural gas stations, refineries, petrochemicals, and environmental projects. Additionally, through its subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in real estate development, vehicle technical inspections, and facility management, including cleaning, disinfection, and waste management services.

name: QUEST HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Quest Holdings SA, formerly Info-Quest SA, is a Greece-based information technology (IT) and telecommunication solutions provider. Its main activities include the digital technology industry, with activities across the entire spectrum of the ICT market, from the manufacture and distribution of products to the design, application and support of Integrated IT Solutions for large organizations in the private and public sectors. Quest Holdings coordinates its activities in this market via the strongest companies in the field: Info Quest Technologies, Uni Systems and iSquare. In the Green Energy sector, the Group implements large investment projects on electricity production from renewable sources with licensed power exceeding 400 MW regarding more than 30 wind and photovoltaic parks. In this market, Quest Holdings is active through Quest Energy and its subsidiaries. At the same time, the Group is also active in the Courier Services sector, through ACS.

name: DANAOS
businessSummary: Danaos Corporation is a holding company and an international owner of containerships, chartering its vessels to a range of liner companies. The Company's principal business is the acquisition and operation of vessels. The Company conducts its operations through the vessel owning companies, whose principal activity is the ownership and operation of containerships that are under the management of a related party of the company. The Company's manager is Danaos Shipping Company Limited (Danaos Shipping). The Company has a fleet of over 50 containerships aggregating approximately 329,590 twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs). Its containership fleet includes approximately 53 containerships deployed on time charters and approximately two containerships deployed on bareboat charter. Gemini Shipholdings Corporation (Gemini), a company beneficially owned by the Company, owns approximately four additional containerships of over 24,000 TEU aggregate capacity.

name: EKTER BLDG RL EE
businessSummary: Ekter Building Real Estate Hotel Commercial Industrial SA is a Greece-based company operating primarily in the construction and engineering sector. The Company undertakes public and private construction projects, providing technical and contracting services for infrastructure, commercial, industrial, tourism and public-sector developments. Its activities include the construction and renovation of buildings, transportation and utility infrastructure, and other specialized technical works. Beyond construction, it is active in real estate development through property investments and the development of tourism-related assets. The Company also operates a hotel facility on the island of Paros, reflecting its presence in the hospitality sector. Through its construction expertise and real estate investments, EKTER combines contracting activities with property and tourism operations, while continuing to pursue new project opportunities in Greece.

name: DAIOS PLASTICS
businessSummary: Daios Plastika AVEE is a Greece-based company engaged in the production and wholesale of plastic films for agricultural applications. Its product portfolio consists of Vineyard Films, a thick-thin plastic film, used for viticulture applications; Greenhouse Film, such as flat or tubular plastic films, which have ultraviolet filters, tear and puncture resistance, and stabilized plastic films utilized in permanent sun exposure; Tobacco Drying Film with stress and strain resistance properties, used for drying tobacco leaves; Dalin Watermelon Film, for covering linear cultivations of watermelon, melon and tomatoes under low tunnels, as well as Dalin Pocket portfolio of films, which are used in the asparagus cultivation. Furthermore the Company is engaged in the production and wholesale of polyethylene pipes drip irrigation, in trading raw materials for manufacturing plastics, as well as in the hospitality sector through its subsidiary, operating a hotel/resort.

name: BLE KEDROS REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: BLE Kedros Real Estate Investment Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in real estate investment activities. The Company invests in commercial real estate that can be utilized immediately such as stores, offices and industrial buildings, as well as assets for future development such as plots of land. The real estate portfolio of the Company consists of 34 assets with total area of buildings of over 37,000 sq.m. and of plots of more than 96,000 sq. m.

name: ILYDA
businessSummary: Ilyda Societe Anonyme Commercial Construction Company of Information Technology Systems and Provision of Services is a Greece-based company engaged in the information technology field. The Company's range of activities includes the design, development, distribution and support of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and the development of software for specialized vertical markets, which targets pharmacies and points of sale programs for retail chains of stores. It also develops tailor made software for applications in education, the public sector, financial institutions and banks. Ilyda SA also provides services including customer training, after-sales support and maintenance services for the full range of its products. Some of the Company’s products include MegaTron ERP system for business resources management, MegaTron Pharma for medicine warehouse management, VitaCard, which is a consumer privilege card, and software information systems for payroll and personnel management.

name: ALTER EGO MEDIA
businessSummary: Alter Ego Media SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in media industry. The Company operates television channel Mega which contains news and entertainment programs, as well as radio channel MyRadio 104.6. Both channels are also available for streaming online. In addition to television and radio channels Alter Ego Media SA is also engaged in publishing of newspapers and news portals such as To Vima and Ta Nea, available both as printed newspaper and online at ToVima.gr and Tanea.gr respectively, Oikonomikos Tachydromos or OT which is a publication mostly focused on financial information and In.gr news online portal. The Company also offers a range of magazines such as Vimagazino, Vita, Grace, HELLO!, Diakopes and Greek Cuisine as well as digital magazines and entertainment and special-interest website including TLife, Argiro.gr, Zappit.gr, iMOMMY, OnAlert, Iatropedia, Perpetual.gr.

name: PAPOUTSANIS
businessSummary: Papoutsanis SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the production, import, export, promotion and marketing of consumer products. The Company’s products are divided into categories such as branded products, hotel products, third-party products and industrial sales of soap bars . Its product range includes glycerin bar soaps, pure olive bar soaps, shampoos, shower gels and liquid soaps. It also offers hand creams, hand wash, body oil, body lotion, hair masks and conditioners, as well as products marketed under brands such as Olivia, Natura, Aromatics and Karavaki. The Company operates an integrated production facility in Greece and produces a wide range of personal care products using natural raw materials and modern production technologies. It operates in both domestic and international markets through its commercial and export activities.

name: TECHNICAL OLYMPIC
businessSummary: Techniki Olympiaki AE is a Greece-based holding company active in multiple sectors, including construction, homebuilding, real estate development, tourism, wind power, and the construction and operation of marinas. The Company operates through a group of subsidiaries with activities in Greece and abroad, undertaking public and private construction projects and real estate development and exploitation. Its operations also include tourism activities through Porto Carras Grand Resort and Domaine Porto Carras, as well as the management and utilization of marinas across the country. In addition, the Company has expanded into renewable energy, particularly wind power, and is involved in shipping activities as part of its broader diversified business structure.

name: FLEXOPACK
businessSummary: FLEXOPACK S.A. is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture of flexible plastic packaging materials. The Company primarily serves the food industry, particularly the meat, poultry, cheese and fish sectors, while also supplying packaging solutions for non-food applications. Its product portfolio includes flexible packaging materials, technical films and sustainable packaging solutions. The Company's products comprise lidding films marketed under the FLEXOLID brand, shrink bags and films marketed under the FLEXOSHRINK brand, skin films marketed under the FLEXION brand, thermoforming films marketed under the FLEXOFRESH brand, cook-in packaging products marketed under the FLEXOCOOK brand, as well as foodservice and sustainable packaging products. The Company's packaging solutions are designed for food preservation, protection, transportation, shelf-life extension and product presentation across a variety of food packaging applications.

name: EINS
businessSummary: European Innovation Solutions SA is a Greece-based company operating as a provider of consulting services focused on innovation, technology management and sustainable socioeconomic development. The Company advises public and private sector organizations on management consulting, innovation and technology projects, digital transformation, finance and transaction advisory, project and programme management, business development, support for small and medium-sized enterprises, energy and environmental initiatives, information and communication technology, health, government and society, and regional development. It delivers projects across Greece and international markets, supporting governmental bodies, European institutions, international organizations and private enterprises through the design, implementation and management of development and innovation programmes.

name: ORILINA PROPERTIES AEEAP
businessSummary: Orilina Properties AEEAP is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the real estate investment sector. The Company together with its subsidiary Limar Etaireia Akiniton Makedonias AE is active in the leasing of investment properties through operating leases. The Company's investment portfolio includes more than 10 properties.

name: GENERAL COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: General Commercial and Industrial SA is a Greece-based company active in the distribution of industrial and hydraulic equipment. The Company supplies steel pipes, tubes, fittings, flanges, valves, fire protection systems, piping accessories and related industrial products. Its product portfolio serves a wide range of applications in industrial facilities, water and wastewater networks, infrastructure projects, energy installations, refineries, shipbuilding and marine operations. The Company provides carbon steel, alloy steel and stainless steel piping products, as well as hydraulic and building services equipment, drainage and water collection systems, and other industrial supplies for engineering and construction projects.

name: NOVAL PROPERTY REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Noval Property Real Estate Investment Co is a Greece-based company operating as a real estate investment company (REIC) engaged in the acquisition, development, redevelopment, leasing, management, and disposal of real estate assets. It owns and manages a portfolio comprising office buildings, retail properties, shopping centers, retail parks, logistics facilities, residential assets, hospitality properties, and selected industrial real estate in Greece. The Company generates income primarily from property leasing and undertakes development, refurbishment, and sustainability-focused enhancement projects across its portfolio. As part of the Viohalco group, it operates within a broader holding structure while maintaining a focus on real estate investment and asset management activities.

name: ELVALHALCOR
businessSummary: Elvalhalcor Hellenic Copper and Aluminium Industry SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the non-ferrous metal processing industry. The Company operates under two segments: Aluminium and Copper. In the Aluminium segment, the Company, together with its subsidiaries Symetal, Elval Colour, Vepal, Anoxal, and Viomal, offers a wide range of rolled and extruded products, including coils, sheets, strips, foil, and aluminium profiles. In the Copper segment, the Company, along with its subsidiaries Sofia Med (Bulgaria), Epirus Metalworks (Greece), and HC Isitma, produces copper tubes for water supply and industrial applications, as well as copper and brass sheets and strips, operating facilities in Greece, Bulgaria, Turkey, and the Netherlands.

name: GR SARANTIS
businessSummary: Gr Sarantis SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the consumer goods industry. The Company manufactures, distributes and trades a wide range of products, operating across several business segments, including Beauty, Skin and Sun Care, Personal Care, Home Care Solutions, Private Label, as well as Strategic Partnerships. Its activities include the production and distribution of fragrances, cosmetics and personal care products, household and cleaning products, food packaging solutions, and health-related products such as vitamins and food supplements. Additionally, the Company collaborates with international partners for the distribution of brands in the cosmetics and personal care sectors across its geographical markets.

name: EURONEXT ATHENS HOLDING
businessSummary: Euronext Athens Holding SA, formerly Hellenic Exchanges Athens Stock Exchange SA, is a Greece-based company that provides support services for the operation of the Greek capital market. It operates, together with its subsidiaries, Hellenic Central Securities Depository (ATHEXCSD) and Athens Exchange Clearing House (ATHEXClear) in the following segments: Trading, Clearing, Settlement, Data Feed, Information Technology (IT), Exchange Services, Depository Services, Clearing House Services, as well as Other.
