The Company’s purpose is the participation in companies and businesses having activities related to the support and operation of organized capital markets, as well as the development of activities and provision of services related to the support and operation of organized capital markets. Furthermore, its purpose is to organize and support the operation of the cash market and the derivatives market, as well as other financial instruments in Greece and abroad.

name: PERFORMANCE TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Performance Technologies SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in Information Technology (IT). The Company offers a range of IT and digital transformation services including cloud computing, cybersecurity, business automation and data analysis. Additional services include cloud infrastructure design, app modernization, Agile and Development Operations practices, cyber threat protection, data protection, business continuity and digital compliance. The Company also focuses on business process automation, low-code application platforms and enterprise content management to enhance operational efficiency and innovation. In the sector of professional computer training, Performance Technologies SA provides multiple training programs for IT professionals.

name: FOODLINK
businessSummary: Foodlink SA is a Greece-based company active in the logistics sector. The Company provides third-party logistics services, primarily through integrated warehousing and distribution operations. Its warehousing activities include palletization, storage management, inventory monitoring, and handling services, while its distribution segment supports nationwide deliveries through an organized transport network and scheduled inter-regional routes. It also offers complementary services such as order management, invoicing, reporting, repackaging, and transition support for client operations. The Company operates multiple logistics facilities in Attica and Thessaly, which support storage, cross-docking, and temperature-controlled transportation needs, enabling service coverage across Greece and supporting clients in sectors requiring controlled supply chain handling.

name: HELLENIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS ORGANIZATION
businessSummary: Hellenic Telecommunications Organization SA (OTE) is a Greece-based Company primarily engaged in the telecommunications industry. The Company offers a range of telecommunications services, including fixed-line and mobile telephony, broadband services, pay television and information and communications technology (ICT) solutions. Its segments include OTE, COSMOTE group, TELEKOM ROMANIA and Other. In Greece, the Company is also involved in maritime communications, real-estate and professional training. The Company's OTE segment provides fixed-line services, Internet access services, ICT services and television services in Greece. The COSMOTE group segment offers mobile telecommunications services in Greece and Albania. The TELEKOM ROMANIA segment provided fixed-line services, Internet access services, ICT services and television services in Romania (discontinued operations). The Other segment consists of other operations of the Company.

name: HELLENIC TELECOMMUNICATIONS ORGANIZATION
businessSummary: Hellenic Telecommunications Organization SA (OTE) is a Greece-based Company primarily engaged in the telecommunications industry. The Company offers a range of telecommunications services, including fixed-line and mobile telephony, broadband services, pay television and information and communications technology (ICT) solutions. Its segments include OTE, COSMOTE group, TELEKOM ROMANIA and Other. In Greece, the Company is also involved in maritime communications, real-estate and professional training. The Company's OTE segment provides fixed-line services, Internet access services, ICT services and television services in Greece. The COSMOTE group segment offers mobile telecommunications services in Greece and Albania. The TELEKOM ROMANIA segment provided fixed-line services, Internet access services, ICT services and television services in Romania (discontinued operations). The Other segment consists of other operations of the Company.

name: TRASTOR REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Trastor Real Estate Investment Company SA is a Greece-based closed-end fund investing in real estate property. The Company's real estate portfolio consists of eight bank branches and officers, 16 petrol stations under the British Petroleum (BP) brand name, the 'Cosmopolis Center' shopping center, and one car parking station at the Aithrio shopping center.

name: PREMIA REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Premia Real Estate Investment Company SA is a Greece-based company operating in the real estate sector, with activities focused on the acquisition, ownership, development, management and leasing of income-generating properties. Its investment portfolio spans logistics properties, hotels, schools and other social infrastructure assets, student housing and serviced apartments, office properties, wineries, and retail/commercial real estate. In addition to acquiring and managing real estate assets, it pursues portfolio expansion through property investments, asset repositioning and development projects aimed at generating long-term rental income. Its properties are leased to tenants under predominantly long-term lease agreements and are located across Greece. The Group conducts these activities both directly and through subsidiaries that own and manage real estate investments.

name: ELASTRON
businessSummary: Elastron SA is a Greece-based company operating in the processing, manufacture and distribution of steel products. The Company supplies a broad range of flat and long steel products, including sheets, plates, coils, structural sections, hollow sections and steel pipes, serving the construction, industrial, energy, transportation and infrastructure sectors. Its operations encompass steel processing activities such as cutting, slitting, profiling and fabrication, supported by production, storage and distribution facilities in the Attica region. The Company serves customers in both the domestic and export markets, with sales generated in Greece and abroad. In addition to its steel operations, it is active in the generation and sale of electricity through photovoltaic power plants, which are reported as a separate business segment. The Company conducts its activities through a network of subsidiaries and affiliated entities primarily located in Greece.

name: IMPERIAL PETROLEUM
businessSummary: Imperial Petroleum Inc is a Greece-based international shipping transportation company. The Company specialized in the transportation of various petroleum and petrochemical products in liquefied form. As of March 15, 2022, the Company's fleet consists of 4 vessels (oil product and crude oil tankers) with a total of more than 250 DWT.

name: VOYATZOGLOU
businessSummary: Voyatzoglou SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the wholesale distribution of retail, commercial, and warehouse equipment. The Company offers store fixtures, merchandising and display systems, warehouse racking, and storage solutions, alongside a broad portfolio of technical and do-it-yourself products. It also provides services including retail space planning, visual merchandising, warehouse design, and project implementation, operating as a one-stop-shop provider for retail and logistics customers. The Company acts as a systems integrator delivering turnkey fitting and intralogistics projects that combine equipment, layout design, and automation technologies, including automated storage and retrieval systems and material handling solutions for distribution centers and commercial environments. Through operations in Greece and Romania, it serves food and non-food retailers, industrial facilities, and logistics operators with integrated retail and supply-chain solutions.

name: ELTON INTERNATIONAL TRADING
businessSummary: Elton International Trading Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the supply of chemical products. The Company's activities include the distribution of chemical raw materials and services across a wide range of industries. In agriculture, the Company offers a range of products and solutions, providing plant nutrition, crop protection, propagation materials, animal nutrition products. Other products include chemical reagents and laboratory instruments, paints, adhesives, construction materials, food supplements, functional foods, rubber, wax, food and beverage ingredients, industrial cleaning products, metal processing chemicals, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, plastics, polyurethane systems, refrigerants, lubricants, leather processing, textiles, water treatment, environmental technologies and winemaking. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is present in Southeast Europe, Ukraine and Turkey.

name: MEDICON HELLAS
businessSummary: MEDICON HELLAS S.A. is a Greece-based company operating as a developer, manufacturer and distributor of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) products and healthcare solutions. The Company produces clinical chemistry, immunochemistry and hematology reagents, calibration and quality control materials, and supplies laboratory analytical systems and related equipment to hospitals, diagnostic laboratories and healthcare providers. It also imports and distributes diagnostic instruments from international manufacturers, develops laboratory and medical software applications, and provides diagnostic services through its laboratory network. In addition, the Company is active in the production of cosmetics and personal care products. MEDICON HELLAS serves customers in Greece and international markets through its manufacturing, research and distribution activities in the healthcare and diagnostics sector.

name: FAIS HOLDING
businessSummary: FAIS HOLDING S.A. is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the retail and wholesale distribution sector. The Company operates through a portfolio of international brands and is involved in the distribution, marketing, and retail sale of consumer products across multiple market segments. Its business activities include luxury fashion, fashion and lifestyle products, sports apparel and equipment, cosmetics, and wellness-related products and services. The Company operates through a network of standalone stores, multi-brand stores, shop-in-shop locations, outlet stores, and e-commerce channels. In addition, FAIS HOLDING S.A. maintains activities in commercial real estate and other complementary business sectors. The Company has operations in Greece and a presence in several international markets, including Cyprus, Bulgaria, Romania, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia.

name: MOTODYNAMICS
businessSummary: Cars Motorcycles and Marine Engine Trade and Import Company SA is a Greece-based commercial enterprise active in the retail sector. Its range of activities includes the representation, import and trade of motorcycles, scooters and mega scooters, snowmobiles, electric generators, outboard motors, wave runners and dinghies, four-wheeled vehicles, as well as electric and gasoline golf cars. It also offers the full range of the Yamaha Genuine accessories and spare parts, as well as motorcycle and ski jets lubricants. The Company offers all these products under the Yamaha brand name, as it is the exclusive representative of Yamaha in Greece. It also imports and trades products from other international companies including MBK, Alpinestars, Shark and Pirelli. As of April 2011, the Company is an exclusive representative of Porsche AG in Greece. On December 30, 2013, it announced the final solution of its subsidiary Motodiktyo Northern Greece SA, due to the termination of its liquidation.

name: EUROHOLDINGS
businessSummary: Euroholdings Ltd is a Greece-based holding company. The Company specializes in ownership of ocean-going vessels, each of which is owned through a separate wholly-owned subsidiary. The Company owns and operates two containership vessels that transport dry and refrigerated containerized cargoes, mainly including manufactured products and perishables, and have a total cargo carrying capacity of more than 40000 dwt. The Company's vessels provide scheduled service between ports. The Company focuses on ownership and operation of vessels of older vintage, typically older than 20 years of age, to the end of their useful life. The Company's fleet consists of Joanna and Aegean Express, both feeder type.

name: GLOBUS MARITIME
businessSummary: Globus Maritime Limited is a Greece-based company engaged in the provision of marine transportation services on a worldwide basis and operates through a holding structure for its shipping activities. The Company is active in the dry bulk shipping sector, focusing on the ownership and operation of vessels that transport iron ore, coal, grain, steel products, cement, alumina and other dry bulk commodities across global trade routes. It owns and manages a fleet of dry bulk vessels and deploys them in international markets. The Company conducts its operations through its wholly-owned subsidiary, Globus Shipmanagement Corp., which is responsible for the technical, commercial and administrative management of the fleet, supporting its worldwide shipping operations and overall business activities.

name: BANK OF GREECE
businessSummary: Bank of Greece operates as the central bank of Greece. The Bank’s tasks are divided into Eurosystem-related tasks and other tasks. Its Eurosystem-related tasks include: participating in the formulation of the single monetary policy of the euro area and implementing it in Greece; managing part of the European Central Bank’s (ECB) foreign exchange and gold reserves on behalf and in line with the instructions of the ECB, and oversees payment systems and instruments with a view to ensuring their soundness, reliability and efficiency, among others. The Bank’s other tasks include: carrying out prudential supervision of credit institutions and certain categories of enterprises in the financial sector; supervising and monitoring the insurance and reinsurance firms as well as insurance intermediaries, and being responsible for the management and operation of the System for Monitoring Transactions in Book-Entry Securities, among others.

name: MEVACO METALLOURGIKI INDUSTRIAL AND COMM
businessSummary: Mevaco Metallurgical Industrial And Trading Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in metal fabrication and construction. The Company offers a variety of services and products, including sheet metal fabrication for carbon steel, stainless steel and aluminum, producing customized items. Additionally, the Company manufactures photovoltaic support structures with diverse configurations for global delivery and produces military hardware, including welded aluminum, high-grade steel and stainless steel structures. Other activities include the fabrication of intricate metal assemblies, electronic information boards for stadiums, components for household appliances, heating industry parts, advertising structures and facades and aesthetic improvement works.

name: MOTOR OIL HELLAS CORINTH REFINERIES
businessSummary: Motor Oil Hellas Corinth Refineries SA is a Greece-based company, which operates in the energy sector. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates within multiple business segments: Refining Activity, Fuels' Marketing Activity, Power and Gas and Other. In the Refining Activity segment it processes crude oils of various characteristics and produces a range of petroleum products. In the Fuels' Marketing Activity, the Company focuses on the marketing of petroleum products through gas stations across Greece and abroad. In Power and Gas segment it focuses on the electric power production and distribution through thermal power and renewable sources as well as natural gas distribution. The Other segment includes all other activities and related services of the Company and its subsidiaries, such as lubricants regeneration, waste management, and energy production from waste.

name: AUTOHELLAS TOURIST AND TRADING
businessSummary: Autohellas Tourist and Trading SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the car, light truck and equipment rental, as well as car import, distribution and sales sectors. More specifically, its activities include short-term car rentals (under one year) and operating leasing and fleet management services (over one year). The Company holds exclusive franchise rights for the Hertz, Thrifty, Dollar and Firefly brands in Greece and a number of other countries in Southeast Europe, including Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia, Montenegro and Croatia. In the retail sector, it is the exclusive importer of Hyundai and Kia cars in Greece. The Company also operates in vehicle retail and after-sales services through its Velmar brand, which acts as an authorized distributor and repairer for several automotive brands, including BMW, MINI, Ford, Opel, Hyundai, Kia and others.

name: EUROBANK
businessSummary: Eurobank SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the banking industry. The Company's activities are divided into six business segments: Retail, focused on incorporating accounts of individual customers, deposits and investment savings products, credit and debit cards, consumer loans, small business banking and mortgages; Corporate, which provides accounts, deposits, overdrafts, loans, foreign currency and derivative products to corporate entities, custody and clearing, and other services; Global Markets & Asset Management, which provides financial advice and intermediation, mutual fund products, asset management and equity brokerage; International, which includes operations in Bulgaria, Cyprus and Luxembourg; Investment Property, which carries out activities related to commercial real estate assets; and Remedial and Servicing Strategy (RSS), engaged in management of non-performing and repossessed assets, and other activities.

name: ALUMIL ALUMINIUM INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Alumil Aluminium Industry SA is a Greece-based aluminum extrusion company and member of the Alumil Group. The Company’s range of activities includes the production and trade of aluminum billets, aluminum accessories, aluminum alloys, thermal processed products, mechanical equipment used in transforming billets into final products and trade of the mechanical and electrical equipment related to aluminum processing, as well as the participation in companies with similar purposes. Its product range includes architectural systems for architectural applications; automatic entrance door systems, automatic and folder doors for lifts, sliding, swing and curved automatic doors; solar protection products; security and resistant metal doors, and plastic products, as well as aluminum for industrial applications. On May 1, 2013, the Company closed and liquidated its subsidiary, Alumul Polska Srl and in October 2013, it established a new subsidiary in the United States, ALUMIL FABRICATION INC.

name: E PAIRIS
businessSummary: E. PAIRIS S.A. is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the plastic packaging manufacturing sector. The Company manufactures and markets plastic packaging products, including bottles, containers, caps, closures, and plastic waste bags. Its products are used in a range of end markets, including the food and beverage, cosmetics, pharmaceutical, lubricant, and household products industries. E. PAIRIS S.A. produces packaging using various plastic materials and supplies both standard and customer-specific products. Its operations include the design and production of plastic packaging for industrial and commercial applications. The Company operates production facilities in Greece and serves customers in domestic and international markets.

name: PYXIS TANKERS
businessSummary: Pyxis Tankers Inc is a Greece-based maritime transportation company primarily engaged in the shipping and marine transportation industry. The Company owns and operates a fleet of product tanker and dry-bulk vessels that transport refined petroleum products, including gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, naphtha, kerosene and fuel oil, as well as various dry-bulk commodities. Its activities encompass vessel ownership, chartering, commercial operation and fleet management through a network of vessel-owning subsidiaries and affiliated entities. The Company serves international shipping markets and generates revenue through the employment of its vessels under time charter and other transportation arrangements, supporting the movement of cargo across global trade routes.

name: PERFORMANCE SHIPPING
businessSummary: Performance Shipping Inc is a Greece-based global provider of shipping transportation services. It owns containerships and focuses on providing sourcing opportunities for vessel purchases and sales, newbuilding acquisitions, chartering and financing arrangements. The Company’s vessels are employed primarily on charters with liner companies carrying containerized cargo along worldwide shipping routes. The Company owns and operates vessels such as Panamax container vessel and Aframax tanker vessel. The Company’s fleet is managed by Unitized Ocean Transport Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary. The Company's customers include national, regional and international companies.

name: PETROS PETROPOULOS
businessSummary: Petros Petropoulos SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the manufacture, modification, distribution and support of vehicles, commercial transportation equipment, agricultural and industrial machinery, power generation systems, lubricants and related products. The Company represents a portfolio of international brands and operates across the vehicle, machinery, lubricants and automotive care sectors. Its activities include the sale of equipment and spare parts, technical support, maintenance and after-sales services through its service network. It also develops and markets Petrogen power-generation products and maintains investments in innovation-related activities. Through its subsidiaries, the Group has operations in Greece and Bulgaria and serves customers in sectors such as transportation, agriculture, construction, industry and energy.

name: LOULIS FOOD INGREDIENTS
businessSummary: Loulis Food Ingredients SA is a Greece-based company that is engaged in the production and trade of flour and flour related products. The Company offers its products under two main categories: milling and consuming products. Its milling products include such industrial products as flours in sacks and in bulk, and such sub-products as bran. Its consuming products include long-life consumer goods, such as packs of flour, packaged pasta, cakes, bread products, biscuits and corn flakes, short-life products like fresh bread and cheese pies, as well as frozen products such as cheese pies. In addition, the Company also focuses on the provision of professional education and training services, through its subsidiary, Greek Baking School of long term learning. The Company's sales network consists of three sales branches in Athens, Thessaloniki and Kavalla, as well as of its main store in Volos which also serves other areas. The Company has three plants in Greece and operates also in Bulgaria.

name: THRACE PLASTICS
businessSummary: Plastika Thrakis Plastics Holdings SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the production and trade of plastic products, textiles and packaging materials. The Company's range of products are divided into three categories: Technical Fabrics & Fibers, which includes such products as woven and non-woven geotextiles, ground covers, crop covers, nets, roofing membranes, staple fibers, concrete reinforcement fibers, geogrids, Mega bag components and carpet and industrial yarns; Consumer Packaging, which offers plastic containers and lids, cups, tubs, bottles, bags for liquid packaging, as well as plastic packaging for food products, and Industrial Packaging, which includes ropes and twines, big bags, films, woven polypropylene bags, bags for heavy duty, pallet covers, and stretch hoods. The Company operates through its local and international subsidiaries.

name: EVROFARMA
businessSummary: Evrofarma Viomichania Galaktos Anonymi Viomichaniki & Emporiki Etaireia SA (Evrofarma SA) is a Greece-based company engaged in the dairy industry. The Company offers several ranges of products: Milk, including fresh whole, semi-skimmed and skimmed milk, highly pasteurized milk and chocolate flavored milk as well as airan and kefir milk drinks; Yogurts, including traditional, cow-milk and strained yogurts including flavoured yogurts; Cheese products, such as telemes cheese, goat cheese, organic feta cheese and anthotiro cheese. The Company’s milk supplies come from various farmers and associates in Macedonia and Thrace. Evrofarma SA has a wholly owned subsidiary, Campus SA, which deals mainly with cow milk production.

name: BRIQ PROPERTIES REIC
businessSummary: BRIQ PROPERTIES REIC is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the real estate investment sector. The Company acquires, owns, leases, and manages commercial real estate assets. As a regulated real estate investment company (REIC), BRIQ PROPERTIES REIC operates a diversified portfolio of investment properties across multiple real estate segments. Its portfolio includes office and mixed-use office properties, logistics facilities and commercial warehouses, retail properties, hotels, and special-use properties, including an elderly care and accommodation facility and an educational institution. The Company generates revenue primarily through rental income and property-related investment activities.

name: HAIDEMENOS
businessSummary: Haidemenos S.A. is a Greece-based company active in the printing and graphic arts industry. Its product categories are Commercial printing, Digital printing, Silkscreen printing and Posters/banners. Commercial printing covers all types of commercial printing including magazines, company leaflets, newspaper and magazine inserts, advertisement leaflets, books, cards, calendars, boxes, travel information leaflets and maps. Digital printing uses modern methods to print on materials, such as paper, vinyl, canvass and carpets, and is used for various purposes, such as outdoor advertising, athletic installations and theatre and television sets. Silkscreen printing sector uses a five-color machine to print on materials, such as paper and cloth, mainly for advertising purposes. Posters/banners sector covers posters and banners of all sizes, including billboard posters.

name: PIRAEUS BANK
businessSummary: Piraeus Bank SA is a Greece-based commercial bank. The Bank offers banking services to private and corporate clients. Its services include cash-settlements, loans, deposits, pensions, insurance, leasing, brokerage and asset management, safe deposit boxes, American Express checks and cards, as well as debit and credit cards, Internet banking and other services in national and foreign currencies.

name: FOURLIS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fourlis Holdings SA is a Greece-based company operating as a holding entity engaged in retail activities through its subsidiaries. It operates in two main segments: home furnishing and household goods retail, and sporting goods retail. The home furnishing segment includes IKEA stores in Greece, Cyprus and Bulgaria, supported by e-commerce platforms, order points and related logistics activities. The sporting goods segment comprises INTERSPORT stores in Greece, Romania, Bulgaria and Cyprus, alongside digital channels, as well as Foot Locker stores in Greece, Romania and Bulgaria. The Group’s activities are supported by centralized services and are carried out through a network of physical stores and online platforms across Southeastern Europe.

name: THESSALONIKI WATER SUPPLY AND SEWARAGE
businessSummary: Thessaloniki Water Supply and Sewarage Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in water supply and sanitation sector. The Company's main activities consists of providing water and sewerage services, including the design, construction, installation, operation, management, maintenance, extension and renewal of water supply and sewage systems. The Company's projects encompass the pumping, desalination, treatment, storage, transportation, distribution and management of water, as well as the collection, treatment, storage and management of various types of wastewater. Additionally, the Company processes, distributes, disposes of and manages sewerage products. Thessaloniki Water Supply and Sewarage Company SA also engages in the exploitation of wastewater products, provision of telecommunications services through its networks and production and sale of electricity, primarily utilizing water from sources like springs, dams, aqueducts and pipelines.

name: HELLENIQ ENERGY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings SA is a Greece-based company, which operates in the energy sector predominantly in Greece, South Eastern Europe and the East Mediterranean. The Group’s activities include refining and marketing of oil products, production and marketing of petrochemical products and exploration for hydrocarbons. The Group also provides engineering services. Through its investments in DEPA and Elpedison, the Group also operates in the sector of natural gas and in the production and trading of electric power. The Company’s main business segments include: Refining, Supply and Trading; Marketing (Domestic and International); Production and Trading of Petrochemicals; Exploration and Production of Hydrocarbons, as well as Electricity Generation and Trading and Natural Gas.

name: SVRN
businessSummary: SVRN, Inc. (formerly OceanPal Inc.) is a Greece-based holding company focused on the NEAR Protocol blockchain ecosystem and related infrastructure. The Company manages a treasury of NEAR digital assets, generates yield through staking activities, and participates in network governance. SVRN also seeks to drive the commercial adoption of NEAR-based technologies through enterprise partnerships and blockchain-enabled applications. In addition, the Company acquires, develops and operates businesses providing blockchain infrastructure and data services. Through its subsidiary FastNEAR, SVRN, Inc. operates remote procedure call (RPC), archival and data infrastructure services that enable developers and applications to access blockchain data, submit transactions, and interact with the NEAR network. The Company also invests in and supports technology ventures focused on decentralized infrastructure, digital sovereignty and artificial intelligence.

name: AEGEAN AIRLINES
businessSummary: Aegean Airlines SA is a Greece-based company, which operates in the sector of public airline transportations. The Company provides transport of passengers and goods inside and outside the Greek territory, conducting scheduled and unscheduled flights. Furthermore it renders aviation services, technical support and ground handling aircraft services. The Company’s and the Group’s objectives include among others the following activities/operations: participation in any type of local or foreign company of similar nature of operations; establishment of subsidiaries and agencies, as well as import, trade, leasing of aircraft and spare parts. The Company’s subsidiaries are Olympic Air AE and Aegean Cyprus LTD.

name: THESSALONIKI PORT AUTHORITY
businessSummary: Thessaloniki Port Authority S.A. (ThPA S.A.) is a Greece-based company operating as a port infrastructure operator and provider of port services. It offers cargo handling, berthing, and storage services, as well as other related port operations. Its activities focus primarily on containerized cargo and conventional freight, including bulk cargo, general cargo, and RO-RO cargo. In addition, it serves coastal shipping and cruise passengers, leases and manages port areas for commercial, cultural, and other purposes, and provides rail services for the international transportation of containers. The Company holds the exclusive right to use and exploit the land, buildings, and facilities within the land port zone of the Port of Thessaloniki until 2051.

name: INTERTECH
businessSummary: Intertech S.A. is a Greece-based company active in the wholesale distribution of consumer electronics, technology products, and related solutions. The Company operates across multiple business segments, including the Consumer Products sector, where it distributes household electronics such as televisions, kitchen appliances, and mobile devices. In the Business Solutions and Telecommunications segment, it provides professional technology solutions, including networking equipment, security systems, broadcast video systems, and Internet of Things (IoT) related applications. Additionally, through its printing and document management segment, the Company offers hardware and software solutions. Intertech S.A. also engages in partnerships and representation agreements with international brands, such as Panasonic, supplying a range of audiovisual, consumer, and professional equipment to the Greek market.

name: ELINOIL HELLENIC PETROLEUM
businessSummary: Elinoil Hellenic Petroleum Company SA is a Greece-based company active in the energy sector through the trading, distribution and marketing of liquid fuels, solid fuels, lubricants, electricity and natural gas. The Company serves retail, commercial, industrial, marine and aviation customers through a nationwide fuel station network, wholesale operations and logistics infrastructure across Greece. Its activities include the supply of petroleum products, heating oil, marine fuels and lubricants, the processing and trading of solid fuels, international trading of energy products, and the provision of electricity and natural gas services. The Company also operates in the yachting and marine fuel supply markets and conducts export activities across multiple international markets. Through its subsidiaries, including elin Shipping Company, elin Stations and elin Techniki, it provides shipping, retail fuel station and technical services.

name: HOUSE OF AGRICULTURE SPIROY
businessSummary: House of Agriculture Spiroy SA is a Greece-based company operating as a producer and distributor of plant propagation material. It is active in the research, development, production, processing and marketing of seeds and seedlings for field crops and vegetables. Its product portfolio includes seeds for crops such as corn, cotton and alfalfa, alongside a broad range of vegetable seeds. The Company operates across plant propagation activities covering field crops and vegetable seeds, managing the full value chain from development to distribution. It maintains seed production and processing operations in Greece and distributes its products in domestic and international markets, including Southern Europe, the Balkans, North Africa, Turkey, the Middle East and Eastern Europe.

name: REVOIL
businessSummary: Revoil SA is a Greece-based company operating in the energy sector. The Company is primarily engaged in the trading, storage, distribution, and marketing of petroleum products, including gasoline, diesel, heating oil, marine fuels, asphalt, and related energy products. Its operations are supported by liquid fuel storage facilities in Aspropyrgos, Attica and on the island of Chios, as well as a nationwide network of branded fuel stations. The Company also produces and markets lubricants under its own brand. In addition, through subsidiaries, it invests in renewable energy projects, including solar and wind power generation. Revoil SA further operates in the heating, cooling, and solar systems market through its subsidiary MALTEZOS AVEE, which supplies solar heating equipment and related solutions.

name: ALPHA BANK
businessSummary: Alpha Bank SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the financial sector. The Bank is active in retail, corporate and private banking, wealth and asset management, treasury, capital markets and other activities. The Bank's business segments include: Retail, which offers deposit and bancassurance products, loan facilities, debit and credit cards, personal, individual and small business loans; Wholesale, which offers commercial banking and hospitality loans, working capital facilities, letters of guarantee, syndications, leasing products and factoring services, investment banking, commercial real estate, infrastructure and shipping loans, trading, treasury, activities of the Dealing Room in the interbank market, wholesale trade lending and transaction banking; Wealth Management, which consists of asset management services, as well as private banking, advisory and brokerage; and International, for its Cyprus and United Kingdom subsidiaries, and its Luxembourg branch.

name: NATIONAL BANK OF GREECE
businessSummary: National Bank of Greece SA is a Greece-based company, which provides a range of financial services. Its financial services include retail and commercial banking, asset management, brokerage, investment banking, insurance and real estate at a global level. The Group operates in Greece, Turkey, the United Kingdom, South East Europe (SEE) which includes Bulgaria, Romania, Albania, Serbia and Former Yugoslavian Republic of Macedonia (FYROM), Cyprus, Malta, Egypt and South Africa. The Bank operates through the following business segments: Retail Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, Special Asset Unit (SAU), Global Markets and Asset Management, Insurance, International Banking Operations, Turkish Banking Operations, as well as Other that includes real estate management, hotel and warehousing businesses.

name: ELLAKTOR
businessSummary: Ellaktor SA is a Greece-based company that operates, through its subsidiaries, mainly in constructions and quarrying, real estate development and management, wind power and environment, as well as concession sectors. The Company operates in the following business segments: construction and quarries, real estate development, concessions, wind farms, environment as well as other activities. The Company operates abroad in the Middle East countries, and more specifically in the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Jordan, as well as in other countries, such as Germany, Italy, Cyprus, Romania, Bulgaria, Albania, Serbia, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia (FYROM), the United Kingdom, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Turkey, the United States, Chile and Panama. It subsidiaries include Aktor SA, Aktor Concessions SA, Andromachi SA, Yialou Anaptyxiaki SA and Reds Real Estate development SA, among others.

name: BIOKARPET SA INDUSTRIAL AND COMMERCIAL E
businessSummary: Biokarpet Industrial and Commercial Enterprises SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the textile, metallurgy, information technology (IT) and energy sectors. In the textile sector, it is engaged in the production and trading of carpets, pile carpets, blankets and flokati rugs, as well as in the import and trade of hand tufted rugs, laminate flooring and products. In the metallurgy field, it is operational through its subsidiaries, Exalco SA, Exalco Bulgaria AD and Exalco Romania SRL, which are active in the production and trading of aluminum-extruded products, as well as the production, trading and installation of aluminum frames and glass panes. In the IT sector, it operates through Albio Data SA, which is engaged in the design and development of custom-made integral information systems for enterprises and organizations. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, is also active in the energy sector through the production and distribution of energy from renewable sources.

name: MOUZAKIS
businessSummary: El D Mouzakis Industrial Commercial Investing and Consulting Company SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the production, processing, and distribution of yarns and textile products. Its product portfolio includes sewing and embroidery threads made from cotton, polyester, and blended fibers, as well as cotton yarns for hand knitting, machine knitting, weaving, and lace-making applications. The Company operates spinning, dyeing, and finishing facilities and distributes its products in Greece and international markets. In addition to its textile activities, it engages in the trade, import, export, and representation of consumer goods, provides consulting services to industrial and commercial enterprises, and manages investment and real estate related activities. Through its participations and investments, the Company also undertakes holding and investment functions alongside its core manufacturing and trading operations.

name: MINERVA KNITWEAR
businessSummary: Minerva Knitwear SA is a Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise engaged in the clothing field. Its main activities include the production and trade of blouses, pajamas and t-shirts, as well as underwear for men, women and children. The Company’s collection includes such brands as Minerva Classic, Minerva Lady Line, Minerva Fimelle, Minerva Underworld, Minerva Seamless, Minerva Forward, Minerva Pyjamas and Sporties, as well as such brands for children as Minervakia, Disney, Barbie, Superman and Flintstones. Minerva Knitwear SA has a production unit located in the Thessaloniki area, Greece. Its subsidiaries include: Eleten SA, engaged in the production and trade of clothes for babies and children; Minco Romania SRL, which operates a clothing factory in Romania, and a subsidiary in Cyprus. Its network is comprised of a number of outlets in Greece and it is present in all large department stores.

name: PIRAEUS PORT AUTHORITY
businessSummary: Piraeus Port Authority SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the management and operation of the Port of Piraeus. The Company provides port services including vessel anchoring, cargo handling, loading and unloading, storage, and car transportation. It is also responsible for the maintenance and development of port infrastructure, as well as the provision of utilities and related services such as water, electricity, and telecommunications. Its activities further include passenger services, covering cruise and coastal shipping, and the leasing of port areas and facilities to third parties. Operations span segments such as container, cruise, car terminal, logistics, ship repair, and real estate, primarily in Greece.

name: SIDMA STEEL
businessSummary: Sidma Steel SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the steel industry. The Company's main activities involve the trading and industrial processing of steel products. In this sector, the Company offers a wide range of products including hot-rolled, cold-rolled, galvanized, pre-painted and plastic-coated coils and sheets, as well as corrugated and trapezoidal galvanized sheets and construction hot-rolled sheets, merchant bars, beams, crane rails and railway tracks. In the pipe manufacturing sector, Sidma Steel SA produces hollow sections, construction and scaffolding pipes, galvanized construction pipes and formed pipes. The Company also offers wire products including galvanized and black wire and galvanized fencing mesh and supplies polyurethane and polyisocyanurate panels, cold room panels, mineral wool panels, galvanized and pre-painted trapezoidal sheets and light-gauge sections.

name: TRADE ESTATES REIC
businessSummary: Trade Estates REIC SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in investments in commercial real estate for the purpose of leasing. The Company's portfolio consists of 13 properties, including: retail properties in Thessaloniki (Greece) and Sofia (Bulgaria); Rentis shopping center in Agios Ioannis Rentis; a retail park in Piraeus; retail properties in Nicosia (Cyprus) and Ioannina (Greece); Florida 1 retail park in Pylaia (Greece); a commercial property in Larissa (Greece); two logistics centers in Schimatari and Oinofyta (Greece); and Top Parks retail complexes located in Piraeus, Ioannina and Chalandri (Greece). The Company is a part of the FOURLIS Group and has subsidiaries in Bulgaria, Cyprus and Greece.

name: DUROS
businessSummary: Duros S.A. is a Greece-based company engaged in the apparel industry. The Company's range of activities includes the production and retail sale of menswear. The Company operates Dur Stores throughout Greece, as well as one store in Cyprus and one in the Czech Republic, Dur Outlets in Athens and Patras, as well as exclusive shops in Kefalonia, Kavala, Kilkis, Santorini and Athens. It also offers its products through the operation of an online shop. Duros S.A. is also engaged in the exclusive representation of foreign houses, as well as the participation in international fashion shows. It collaborates with the Italian house David Mayer.

name: TOP SHIPS
businessSummary: Top Ships Inc is a Greece-based international provider of worldwide oil, petroleum products, and chemicals transportation services. The Company owns and operates eco tanker vessels focusing on the transportation of crude oil, petroleum products (clean and dirty), and bulk liquid chemicals. The Company’s fleet consists of 3 product/chemical MR2 tankers of approximately 50,000 deadweight tonnage (dwt) each, namely ECO MARINA DEL REY, ECO YOSEMITE PARK, and ECO JOSHUA PARK; 5 crude oil Suezmax tankers of approximately 157,000 dwt each, namely ECO BEL AIR, ECO BEVERLY HILLS, ECO WEST COAST, ECO MALIBU, and ECO OCEANO CA, as well as 2 crude oil VLCC tankers of approximately 300,000 dwt each, namely JULIUS CAESAR and LEGIO X EQUESTRIS.

name: INTRACOM SA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Intracom SA Holdings is a Greece-based company that operates, through its subsidiaries and affiliates, in the Information Technology (IT) solutions and services, construction projects and defense electronics systems sectors. Its IT Solutions and Services segment offers Information and Communications Technology (ICT) solutions and integration services to over 500 organizations, including European Union (EU) institutions, national governments, telecommunications companies, banks and private sector enterprises in over 60 countries. Its Construction segment delivers construction projects, including civil engineering, infrastructure, telecommunications network, renewable energy, environmental and real estate development projects in both the public and private sectors. Its Defense segment is operated through its subsidiary Intracom Defense Electronics (IDE), which is an electronic, communications and hybrid energy systems provider in the defense and security areas.

name: OPTRONICS TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Optronics Technologies SA is a Greece‑based company primarily engaged in the telecommunications industry. The Company provides engineering and construction services, focusing on the design, installation, and maintenance of telecommunication networks and related infrastructure, particularly in fiber‑optic systems. Optronics Technologies SA acts as an engineering contractor and systems integrator, delivering integrated Information and Communication Technology (ICT) and Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) solutions. The Company operates primarily in Greece, serving sectors such as hospitality, technology, energy, defense, education, enterprises, construction, commercial and retail, and the public sector.

name: OKEANIS ECO TANKERS
businessSummary: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the maritime industry. The Company focuses on deep sea freight transportation, as it is charters and operates tanker vessels for transporting crude oil. The Company, through its subsidiaries, owns a fleet of various modern ECO-standard vessels that consume less bunker fuel, equipped with exhaust gas cleaning systems (scrubbers), and comply with ballast water treatment regulations. The fleet consists of multiple Suezmax and several VLCC vessels. The Company, through its customer network, retains an international presence in countries such as Singapore, the United Kingdom, Hong Kong, Switzerland, Turkey and Brazil, as well as the United States among others.

name: BIOTER
businessSummary: Bioter SA is a Greece-based construction company, which mainly undertakes civil engineering projects for the public sector. The Company’s range of activities includes the construction of buildings, industrial infrastructure and networks, as well as public transportation infrastructure projects. The building construction sector includes sports facilities, exhibition centers, public and governmental buildings, hospitals, hotels, housing complexes, parking stations, shopping malls and office buildings, as well as landscaping. The industrial infrastructure and networks projects include factories, power and electromechanical projects, power and telecommunications networks, refineries, industrial complexes and warehouses, military projects and recycling plants, waste and water treatment facilities, as well as water supply networks. In the field of the public transportation infrastructure projects, the Company undertakes the construction of ports, roads, tunnels, bridges and metro stations.

name: PRODEA REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Prodea Real Estate Investment Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in real estate. The Company is active in acquiring and managing real estate assets, including commercial properties such as offices and retail spaces, while also expanding into logistics, hospitality, and residential sectors. The Company's diverse portfolio comprises of over three hundred properties located mainly in urban areas both in Greece and Cyprus. The portfolio of the Company also includes selective investments in Italy and other Southeastern European markets among such as Romania and Bulgaria. Prodea Real Estate Investment Company SA complies with all relevant laws, providing an environment that supports the Company's growth.

name: DIANA SHIPPING
businessSummary: Diana Shipping Inc. is a Greece-based global provider of shipping transportation services. The Company specializes in the ownership and bareboat charter-in of dry bulk vessels. The Company's operating fleet consists of 40 dry bulk vessels, including 4 Newcastlemax, 11 Capesize, 5 Post-Panamax, 6 Kamsarmax, 8 Panamax, and 6 Ultramax. Its fleet combined carrying capacity is approximately 4.7 million deadweight tonnage (dwt) with a weighted average age of 10.16 years. The Company's fleet is managed by its wholly-owned subsidiary Diana Shipping Services S.A. and its established 50/50 joint venture with Wilhelmsen Ship Management named Diana Wilhelmsen Management Limited.

name: DIANA SHIPPING
businessSummary: Diana Shipping Inc. is a Greece-based global provider of shipping transportation services. The Company specializes in the ownership and bareboat charter-in of dry bulk vessels. The Company's operating fleet consists of 40 dry bulk vessels, including 4 Newcastlemax, 11 Capesize, 5 Post-Panamax, 6 Kamsarmax, 8 Panamax, and 6 Ultramax. Its fleet combined carrying capacity is approximately 4.7 million deadweight tonnage (dwt) with a weighted average age of 10.16 years. The Company's fleet is managed by its wholly-owned subsidiary Diana Shipping Services S.A. and its established 50/50 joint venture with Wilhelmsen Ship Management named Diana Wilhelmsen Management Limited.

name: PUBLIC POWER
businessSummary: Public Power Corporation SA (PPC) is a Greece-based company, which is engaged in the generation, transmission and distribution of electricity. PPC Group generates electricity from the over 60 main power generating stations of the parent company as well as from additional stations, such as wind parks, small hydro stations and photovoltaic plants that belong to its wholly owned subsidiary PPC Renewables. Furthermore the Company transmits electricity through its approximately 12,000 kilometers long high voltage system, out of which approximately 11,000 kilometers are owned by its wholly owned subsidiary Independent Power Transmission Operator (IPTO SA). In addition the Company distributes electricity to consumers through its approximately 200,000 kilometers long distribution network of medium and low voltage, which are managed by its wholly owned subsidiary Hellenic Distribution Network Operator (HEDNO SA).

name: ATHENS MEDICAL CENTER
businessSummary: Athens Medical Center SA is a Greece-based company operating as a provider of primary and secondary healthcare services through a network of hospitals, clinics and diagnostic facilities. It provides medical, hospital and diagnostic services across multiple medical specialties through healthcare facilities that include Athens Medical Center, Athens Pediatric Center, Medical Psychiko, Medical Palaio Faliro, Medical Peristeri, Medical Dafni and the Interbalkan Medical Center of Thessaloniki. The Company's activities focus on the delivery of healthcare services and the operation of medical units supporting patient care, diagnosis and treatment. As the parent of the Athens Medical Center Group, it oversees healthcare entities engaged in the provision of hospital, diagnostic and related medical services. Its operations are concentrated in Greece through facilities located in the Athens metropolitan area and Thessaloniki.

name: MATHIOS REFRACTORY
businessSummary: Mathios Refractories S.A. is a Greece-based company engaged in the development, production and marketing of refractory and related materials, along with the provision of engineering, installation, maintenance and industrial construction services for thermal processing industries. The Company focuses on refractory solutions, including refractory bricks, monolithic materials, mortars, raw materials, insulation products and prefabricated components, serving sectors such as steel, cement, energy, refineries and glass. It provides integrated services spanning research and development, engineering, production, procurement and on-site installation and maintenance of refractory linings. The Group also operates in building materials through reconstructed stone products and related construction solutions, while maintaining an international presence through exports and partnerships across multiple countries.

name: DROMEAS SA OFFICE FURNITURE INDUSTRY
businessSummary: DROMEAS S.A. OFFICE FURNITURE INDUSTRY is a Greece-based company operating in the office furniture manufacturing industry. The Company designs, manufactures, and markets office furniture and workspace solutions for corporate, public-sector, and institutional customers. Its product portfolio includes desks, office seating, storage units, partition systems, and customized furnishing solutions for commercial and large-scale projects. The Company also produces selected home furniture products. Manufacturing activities in Greece include wood processing, metal fabrication, aluminum casting, plastics production, painting, upholstery, and assembly. The Company serves both the domestic market and international customers through standard and project-based solutions.

name: STAR BULK CARRIERS
businessSummary: Star Bulk Carriers Corp is a Greece-based global shipping company. The Company owns and operates a diverse fleet of dry bulk vessels that transport bulk commodities, including iron ore, minerals and grain, bauxite, fertilizers and steel products, along worldwide shipping routes. The Company has a fleet of 112 vessels, with an aggregate capacity of 12.5 million dwt, consisting of Newcastlemax, Capesize, Post Panamax, Kamsarmax, Panamax, Ultramax and Supramax vessels with carrying capacities between 53,489 dwt and 209,537 dwt. The Company maintains executive offices in Athens, Greece and in Limassol, Cyprus.

name: TSAKOS ENERGY NAVIGATION
businessSummary: Tsakos Energy Navigation Ltd is a Greece-based provider of international seaborne crude oil and petroleum product transportation services. The Company operates through the maritime transportation of liquid energy-related products segment. The Company's fleet consists of 70 vessels, constituting a mix of crude tankers, product tankers, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, totaling more than 7 million dwt. It includes VLCC, Aframax, Panamax, handysize, handymax tankers, LNG carrier, and DP2 shuttle tankers, which allows the Company to serve its customers' international petroleum product and crude oil transportation needs.

name: TSAKOS ENERGY NAVIGATION
businessSummary: Tsakos Energy Navigation Ltd is a Greece-based provider of international seaborne crude oil and petroleum product transportation services. The Company operates through the maritime transportation of liquid energy-related products segment. The Company's fleet consists of 70 vessels, constituting a mix of crude tankers, product tankers, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, totaling more than 7 million dwt. It includes VLCC, Aframax, Panamax, handysize, handymax tankers, LNG carrier, and DP2 shuttle tankers, which allows the Company to serve its customers' international petroleum product and crude oil transportation needs.

name: NAFPAKTOS TEXTILE INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Nafpaktos Textile Industry SA is a Greece-based industrial enterprise engaged in cotton ginning and spinning, as well as the cultivation and processing of agricultural products. The Company focuses on the production of cotton yarns, including carded, combed, and compact types, supplying textile manufacturing applications. It operates within a vertically integrated framework, covering stages from raw cotton sourcing to yarn production, with emphasis on traceability and quality control across the supply chain. It also incorporates sustainability practices, including certified cotton production and responsible sourcing standards, supporting its positioning in both domestic and international textile markets.

name: EURODRY
businessSummary: EuroDry Ltd is a Greece-based company which operates in the dry cargo, dry bulk shipping markets. The Company's operations are managed by Eurobulk Ltd an affiliated ship management company and Eurobulk (Far East) Ltd. Inc, which are responsible for the day-to-day commercial and technical management and operations of the vessels. EuroDry Ltd employs its vessels on spot and period charters and through pool arrangements. The Company has a fleet of more than five vessels, including Kamsarmax drybulk carriers, Panamax drybulk carriers and an Ultramax drybulk carrier with a total cargo capacity of approximately 400,000 deadweight tonnage (dwt). The Company's subsidiaries are: Kamsarmax One Shipping Ltd, Kamsarmax Two Shipping Ltd and Eirini Shipping Ltd, among others.

name: SEANERGY MARITIME HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp is a Greece-based shipping company specializing in the worldwide seaborne transportation of dry bulk commodities. The Company operates Capesize and Newcastlemax vessels. Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp’s fleet includes such vessels as Titanship, Flagship, Hellasship, Patriotship as well as Squireship. The Company manages their vessels’ operations, insurances and bunkering and has the general supervision of their third-party technical and commercial managers. Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp’s subsidiaries include Seanergy Shipmanagement Corp, Squire Ocean Navigation Co, Pembroke Chartering Services Limited, Harbour Business International Corp as well as Friend Ocean Navigation Co and Seanergy Management Corp.

name: SPACE HELLAS
businessSummary: Space Hellas SA is a Greece-based company that operates in the Information Technology (IT) and infrastructure telecommunications sectors. It is a system integrator, as well as a solution and service provider in the field of telecommunications, IT and security. Its products and services include: wire line, wireless and satellite data; provision of telecommunications services and lines at national and international level; solutions, applications and IT services for enterprises; call centers, corporate telephone networks and services; security information systems and networks, studies, applications and certifications; electromechanical and network infrastructure, computer rooms; physical security systems and surveillance facilities; network infrastructure and computer operators, and research and development programs at national and European level, among others. It serves customers in the financial, telecommunications, private, public and defense sectors.

name: LANAKAM
businessSummary: Lanakam SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the distribution of apparel and accessories, as well as in the distribution of outdoor heating and cooling products. The Company has contracts with a number of apparel and accessories labels, such as Dolce Gabbana Industria Spa, Coccinelle, Guess, LIU JO, CHUNK, ANTIK BATIK, CHLOE, Gold Case, Dunhill, Frankie Morello, Daks of London, Danielle Alessandrini, Christina Effe, Flavio Castelani, Adele Fado, Relish, Bikkembergs, John Richmond, US Polo and Kathy Van Zeeland. In the apparel and accessories wholesale sector the Company has more than 700 customers in Greece and Cyprus and cooperates with department stores such as Attica, Notos, Debenhams and Hondos Center, among others. In the outdoor heating and cooling products wholesale sector the Company has contracts with Cloudburst Inc and Alfresco Heaters Ltd.

name: RUBICO
businessSummary: Rubico Inc. is a Greece-based shipping company engaged in the ownership and operation of tanker vessels providing international shipping transportation services. The Company specializes in the ownership of vessels serving global energy transportation markets through tanker shipping activities. Its operations include vessel ownership, chartering, fleet management and the acquisition of maritime assets and vessel-owning entities. The Company owns and operates tanker vessels and maintains interests in additional shipping assets acquired through corporate acquisitions. Revenue is generated primarily through chartering arrangements, including contracted employment agreements, and related shipping transportation services. The Company pursues fleet development through investments in tanker assets and maritime projects that support its presence in the international shipping industry.

name: OPTIMA BANK
businessSummary: Optima Bank SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the banking sector. The Company serves both individuals and legal entities and offers banking services, such as opening accounts, providing loans and accepting deposits, as well as brokerage services and investment banking services. The Company operates in Greece and has more than 25 branches, located in Psychiko, Ilioupoli, Aghia Paraskevi, Maroussi, Abelokikpi, Nea Smirni, Paleo Faliro, Kalithea, Kalamaria, Panepistimiou, Chalandri, Nikea, Korinthos, Ano Patissia, Glyfada, Tsimiski, Kifissia, Piraues, Nea Ionia, Evosmos, Peristeri, Egaleo, Pagrati, Kolonaki, Heraklion and Larissa. The Company's segments include Banking activities, Treasury activities, Brokerage activities and Others.

name: CREDIABANK
businessSummary: CrediaBank SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the financial sector. The Company provides a range of financial and banking services to individuals and companies. The Company's segments include Retail banking, Corporate banking and Capital management / Treasury. The Retail banking segment is engaged in provision of traditional banking services, as well as specialized investment services and products to individuals. The Corporate banking segment includes credit services offered to enterprises and corporations. Within the segment, the Company provides clients with a range of products and services related to consulting, financial and investment nature of business, as well as foreign exchange transactions. The Capital management / Treasury segment includes activities relevant to the Company's cash management and treasury function, management of the Company’s investment and trading portfolio, as well as intermediary services on mutual fund units disposals, and other services.

name: KORDELLOU BROS
businessSummary: Kordellou Bros SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the trade and processing of iron and steel products. The Company's main activities include the purchase, storage, processing and distribution of metallurgical products such as iron, steel, special steels and non-ferrous metals. Additional services include cold forming, sandblasting and painting of steel products. The Company operates steel service centers and distribution hubs in Attica and northern Greece. Their product range, among others, includes structural hollow sections, ERW structural hollow sections, galvanized welded pipes, water and gas pipes, cold formed circular welded hollow sections, hot rolled seamless pipes and hot rolled steel plates.

name: COSMOS HEALTH
businessSummary: Cosmos Health Inc. is a diversified, vertically integrated global healthcare company. The Company owns a portfolio of proprietary pharmaceutical and nutraceutical brands, including Sky Premium Life, Mediterranation, bio-bebe, C-Sept and C-Scrub. Through its subsidiary Cana Laboratories S.A., it manufactures pharmaceuticals, food supplements, cosmetics, biocides, and medical devices within the European Union. It also distributes a broad line of pharmaceuticals and parapharmaceuticals, including branded generics and over-the-counter (OTC) medications, to retail pharmacies and wholesale distributors through its subsidiaries in Greece and the United Kingdom. It also has research and development (R&D) partnerships targeting health disorders such as obesity, diabetes, and cancer, enhanced by artificial intelligence drug repurposing technologies, and focuses on the R&D of patented nutraceuticals, specialized root extracts, proprietary complex generics, and OTC products.

name: UNITED MARITIME
businessSummary: United Maritime Corp is a Greece-based international shipping company specializing in worldwide seaborne transportation services, marine freight and logistics. It operates a diversified fleet of six dry bulk vessels: one Capesize, two Kamsarmax, and three Panamax vessels, with a total cargo-carrying capacity of approximately 577,750 deadweight tons (dwt). The portfolio includes such vessels as M/V Cretansea, M/V Chrisea, M/V Nisea, as well as M/V Synthesea and M/V Exelixsea. United Maritime Corp's vessels transport various types of dry bulk, including iron ore and coal, minerals such as bauxite/alumina and phosphate rock, grains, as well as other minor bulks, on geographically dispersed global trade routes.

name: CENTRIC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Centric Holdings SA, formerly Centric Multimedia SA, is a Greece-based enterprise that is active in the online gaming and entertainment software market. It has four product divisions: the Video Games division includes representation and official distribution of games from companies such as Microsoft and Sony, as well as the participation in companies operating sports book and gaming Websites; the Educational Games division includes the distribution of games and digital media of educational and encyclopedic content; the Language Learning Software division includes software that help the user learn a foreign language, and finally the Hardware/Accessories division deals with the distribution of console and computer peripherals for video games. The Company owns 51% of ECN Management Ltd, which owns online entertainment companies. Through its subsidiary SEE Sports Holdings, the Company is a Joint Venture Partner of Sportingbet PLC for the operation of the Sportingbet Website.

name: ATTICA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Attica Holdings S.A. is a Greece-based company operating as a passenger shipping and transportation provider in the Eastern Mediterranean. Through its ferry operations, it offers passenger, private vehicle and freight transportation services, serving domestic Greek routes as well as international connections between Greece and Italy. The Company operates a fleet under the Blue Star Ferries, Superfast Ferries, Hellenic Seaways, and ANEK Lines brands, linking mainland Greece with the Cyclades, Dodecanese, North Aegean, Crete and other island destinations. In addition to sea transportation, it engages in related tourism and travel services through its distribution and booking network. The Company is listed on the Athens Exchange and focuses on ferry transportation as its core business, with operations spanning both domestic and international maritime routes.

name: GREEK MARBLE
businessSummary: Greek Marble Industry Technical and Tourist Company Iktinos Hellas SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the mining industry. The Company's activities include the extraction, processing, and trade of various type of marble products, operating a vertically integrated structure that includes quarries, production facilities, and distribution activities. In addition to its core operations in the marble sector, the Company together with its subsidiaries, is also active in the renewable energy sector, particularly wind energy, as well as in real estate development. Iktinos Hellas Greek Marble Industry SA activities are conducted both domestically and internationally, exporting its products in markets across Europe and other regions.

name: CAPITAL CLEAN ENERGY CARRIERS
businessSummary: Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp is a Greece-based shipping company. The Company offers maritime services and solutions in gas carriage globally, focusing on renewable energy sources. Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp operates a fleet of technologically equipped vessels, including liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers and Neo-Panamax container vessels. The Company's vessels are chartered to global counterparts such as BP, Cheniere, CMA CGM, Engie, Hapag-Lloyd, Hartree, HMM, Maersk Lines, MSC, ONE, and ZIM, aiming for stable cash flows. Capital Clean Energy Carriers Corp follows policies towards greenhouse gas emissions reduction and global energy transition through shipping practices and vessel technologies.

name: KEKROPS
businessSummary: KEKROPS S.A. is a Greece-based company active in the real estate sector. The Company is engaged in the development, construction, leasing and sale of real estate properties in Greece. Its activities focus on the exploitation and development of land holdings and real estate assets, primarily residential properties and housing projects. The Company has developed residential complexes and other projects on company-owned land. In addition to residential development activities, KEKROPS S.A. is involved in urban redevelopment projects and the management of real estate assets. The Company, also generates revenue through property leasing, real estate development and the sale of developed properties and land assets.

name: ATHENS WATER SUPPLY AND SEWERAGE
businessSummary: Athens Water Supply and Sewerage Company SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in water supply, sewerage and renewable energy sectors. The Company's main activity includes the delivery of drinking water, sourced from pristine areas free from agricultural and industrial activities. This water is transported using gravity, which minimizes energy consumption. In addition to water supply, the Company manages sewerage and wastewater treatment. For that end, the Company collects and treats wastewater, returning it to the environment free of pollutants, following international practices. Additionally, the Company is involved in renewable energy projects, including hydroelectric power generation, biogas and natural gas cogeneration and solar power projects.

name: HOLDING COMPANY ADMIE IPTO
businessSummary: Holding Company ADMIE IPTO SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the energy sector. The primary purpose of the Company is to promote the work as well as the management of the relations with investors and partners of its subsidiary company Independent Power Transmission Operator (IPTO S.A.), an electric power distribution company in Greece. The Company can also participate in the appointment of key management personnel and communicate the activities of IPTO S.A. to the shareholders and the broader investment community. The activities of the Company also include exercising the rights derived from its participation and involvement in the operation of other legal entities and the development of investment activities in Greece or abroad.

name: PROODEFTIKH TECHNICAL
businessSummary: Proodeftikh Technical Company SA is a Greece-based construction and infrastructure company engaged in civil engineering, general construction and renewable energy-related activities. The Company undertakes technical projects across the public and private sectors, including transportation and infrastructure works such as roads, railways, ports, airports and industrial facilities. In addition, it is involved in the development and construction of photovoltaic projects, energy-related activities, the provision of technical services, and real estate holdings. The Company also maintains interests in construction materials production and holds licenses for the execution of a broad range of engineering and infrastructure projects.

name: DIMAND
businessSummary: Dimand Societe Anonyme for The Use and Construction of Real Estate Constructions Services and Participations is a Greece-based company that is a real estate development and services provider. The Company operates both as proprietary and fee developers. The Company covers functions such as project and construction management, retail expansion management, technical advisory and facility management.

name: ONYX TOURISTIKI
businessSummary: Onyx Touristiki SA (formerly MED SA) is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the fashion industry. The Company's activities include production and marketing of swimwear, underwear, clothing and accessories for men, women and children, shoes, slippers, bags and similar items, towels, sunglasses, watches, cases for mobile phones, as well as other related products. The Company has subsidiaries in Bulgaria (Fashion Icon Ltd and MED Invest) and Italy (MED Srl) that are also engaged in the fashion industry. The Company's stores are located in multiple cities, including but not limited to Cannes (France), Istanbul (Turkey), Mikonos, Athens, Nea Ionia, Chalandri, Glyfada, Kalithea, Egaleo, Korydallos, Peristeri, Pylaia, Larissa, Volos, Serres, Ioannina, Patras and Heraklion.

name: BITROS HOLDING
businessSummary: Bitros Holding SA is a Greece-based entity operating as a holding entity. Through its subsidiaries, The Company is engaged in steel processing and trading, concrete reinforcement, real estate development, and energy operations. Its business activities include the processing and distribution of iron and steel products, steel stockholding, concrete reinforcement solutions and related services, construction and property development activities, as well as electricity generation from photovoltaic stations owned by Group companies. The Group operates primarily in Greece through subsidiaries including Bitros Opismos Skyrodematos S.A. and Bitros Kataskevastiki S.A., while also maintaining holdings in metallurgy and related industrial businesses.

name: LAMDA DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Lamda Development SA is a Greece-based company engaged, together with its subsidiaries, in the investment, development, leasing and maintenance of real estate projects. The Company operates in Greece, as well as in other neighboring Balkan countries mainly Romania, Bulgaria, Serbia and Montenegro. The Company’s development portfolio includes: commercial and leisure centers, The Mall Athens and Golden Hall in Athens and Mediterranean Cosmos in Thessaloniki, office buildings, residential complexes and Flisvos Marina in Faliro. Its subsidiaries include: LAMDA Estate Development SA, LAMDA Prime Properties SA, LAMDA Erga Anaptyxis SA, LAMDA Domi SA, LD Trading SA, LAMDA Leisure SA and GEAKAT SA, among others.

name: DOPPLER
businessSummary: Doppler SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the design, manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of heavy electric equipment. The Company primarily manufactures and sells a range of elevator components, as well as complete elevator packages. Its manufacturing plant is spread over a 9,500 square meter area located in the Polykastro Industrial Park, north of Thessalonica. The Company’s products are divided into three categories: Lift Components, which include parts for hydraulic lifts, parts for traction lifts, modernization kit for traction lifts, cabins, doors, and control systems; Complete Lift Packages, which include hydraulic lift with motor room, Machine Room Less (MRL) hydraulic lift, hydraulic home lift, hydraulic compact cargo lift, traction lift with motor room, and Machine Room Less (MRL) traction lift; Escalators and Moving Walks, and Park lifts.

name: ATHENS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
businessSummary: Athens International Airport S.A. is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the airport operations industry. The Company is responsible for the management and development of Athens International Airport (AIA), holding exclusive rights under a concession agreement to design, finance, construct, maintain, and operate the airport infrastructure. Its activities include the provision of aeronautical and non-aeronautical services, such as passenger handling, airline support, cargo operations, retail and commercial services, and real estate development. The Company also coordinates supporting services and facilities, including telecommunications, security, catering, logistics, maintenance, and any other transport-related activities necessary for airport operations.

name: PIPEWORKS L TZIRAKIAN PROFIL
businessSummary: Pipeworks L. Tzirakian Profil S.A. is a Greece-based company operating in the steel products industry. The Company is engaged in the production, processing, import and sale of steel products, with a primary focus on steel pipes, including hot- and cold-rolled construction pipes and galvanized pipes. Its activities also include the production of steel sheets and strips, as well as the trading and distribution of steel products, such as beams and steel sections. The Company offers a broad portfolio of steel products serving construction, industrial, infrastructure and technical applications, combining manufacturing operations with steel processing and commercial distribution activities. Its product range covers numerous steel pipe and flat steel specifications designed to meet the requirements of various structural, mechanical and fabrication applications.

name: QUALCO GROUP
businessSummary: Qualco Group SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in provision of software and technology solutions. The Company operates as a management holding company through its subsidiaries active Greece, United Kingdom, Cyprus, France and United Arab Emirates (the Group). The Group specializes in operational platforms, data-driven insights and customized digital experiences. The Group's portfolio includes technology and technology-enabled solutions across receivables management, credit/lending management, analytics, digital transformation and real estate. The Group's operations are structured across two business segments: Software and Platforms, comprised of Software and Technology, and Platform as a Service solutions, and Portfolio Management.

name: Y KNOT INVEST
businessSummary: Y/KNOT Invest S.A. is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the leisure and recreation sector.
