The Company, together with its subsidiaries and associated companies, operates in marine tourism through the chartering of owned and third-party recreational vessels, including sailing yachts and catamarans, serving the international professional and tourist charter market across Greece, France, Croatia, Italy and Montenegro. The Company is also engaged in the trading of newly built recreational vessels, the management and operation of tourist marinas and ports, and real estate activities through the ownership, management and exploitation of property assets in Greece. In addition, the Company is active into the dry bulk shipping sector through the operation of an ocean-going Handysize bulk carrier.

name: IDEAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Ideal Holdings SA is a Greece-based investment company. The Company invests in medium-sized enterprises domiciled in countries such as Greece and Cyprus, acquiring their majority stake. In particular, the Company invests in various sectors, including Information Technology (IT) and retail among others. Ideal Holdings SA focuses on its revenue growth through various means such as mergers and acquisitions, with a defined exit strategy. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is involved in trust services and cybersecurity, integrated IT solutions and technology hardware distribution, software development, customer communication management and the distribution of technology products, IT software and cybersecurity solutions as well the management of commercial department stores.

name: GEK TERNA
businessSummary: GEK Terna SA is a Greece-based company active in a number of sectors. The Company operates under the following segments: Construction, which refers to contracts for the construction of technical projects; Electricity from Renewable Sources of Energy, which refers to the electricity production from wind generators, from hydroelectric projects and other renewable energy sources; Electricity from Thermal Energy Sources and Trading of Electric Energy, which refers to the electricity production using natural gas as fuel, and to the trading of electric energy; Real Estate Development, which refers to the purchase, development and management of real estate; Industry, which refers to the production of quarry products and the exploitation of magnesite quarries; Concessions, which concerns the construction and operation of infrastructure, other public interest projects and other facilities, as well as Holdings.

name: Q&R
businessSummary: Quality and Reliability High Tech Applications Industrial and Commercial SA is a Greece-based company primarily active in the information technology (IT) industry. The Company provides digital transformation and integrated IT solutions, including system design and enterprise software services, to public and private sector clients. Its main segment focuses on IT solutions, including system integration, custom software development, cloud services, data analytics, and cybersecurity. A secondary segment involves the distribution of computer hardware and related equipment, carried out only alongside its IT services to support client projects. Additionally, through its subsidiary, the Company operates a third segment, mainly related to e-commerce activities such as ebook distribution.

name: MODA BAGNO
businessSummary: N Varveris-Moda Bagno SA is a Greece-based company engaged in the trade of interior design products and home and office furniture. Its product range includes tiles for bathroom, kitchen and flooring; bathroom items, including sanitary pieces, accessories and furniture; kitchen appliances and furniture, as well as office, home and outdoor furniture. The Company offers its products through a network of multiple stores across Greece. It is also active in the hospitality sector and operates a restaurant in Mykonos, as well as the real estate sector via land acquisition and building construction in Chalandri. N Varveris Moda-Bagno SA undertakes projects such as the furnishing and decoration of hotels, business centers, restaurants and yachts and retains subsidiaries in Cyprus and Turkey.

name: LAVIPHARM
businessSummary: Lavipharm SA is a Greece-based pharmaceutical and healthcare company engaged in the research and development of drug delivery solutions and the commercialisation of pharmaceutical, over-the-counter (OTC) and related healthcare products. It is active in the provision of prescription medicines, OTC products and food supplements, supported by integrated activities across research and development, manufacturing and commercial operations. It maintains a portfolio focused primarily on therapeutic areas including cardiology, central nervous system disorders, urology, oncology and chronic pain, supplying solutions designed for healthcare professionals and patients. The Company operates in both domestic and international markets and combines product development capabilities with market access and distribution activities, while acting as the parent entity of the Lavipharm Group through which its broader operations are conducted.

name: FRIGOGLASS SAIC
businessSummary: Frigoglass S.A.I.C. is a Greece-based company operating in the commercial refrigeration equipment industry. The Company focuses on the design, manufacture and distribution of beverage coolers, refrigerated display units and related cooling solutions used by beverage producers, retailers, supermarkets and foodservice operators. Its activities cover product development, engineering, production, sales and after-sales support for professional refrigeration equipment. The Company also provides maintenance, repair, refurbishment, spare parts, logistics and supply chain services that support the installation and lifecycle management of refrigeration assets. Through its international operating footprint, it serves customers across multiple markets in Europe, Africa and Asia, with a particular focus on the beverage sector.

name: N LEVENTERIS
businessSummary: N Leventeris SA is Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise active in the steel sector. The Company's activities include the production and trading of wires, wire ropes and accessories. Its product range consists of steel wires, steel wire ropes, combination ropes, steel wire rope slings, ropes and mooring ropes, fiber slings, chains, anchors and such accessories as hooks and shackles. The Company also represents the products of the houses Pfeifer, Crosby and Diepa in the Greek market. Its facilities are located in the industrial area of Volos, while its central warehouse is in the port of Piraeus, Greece.

name: CNL CAPITAL
businessSummary: CNL Capital EKES AIFM is a Greece-based company engaged in the investment management and fund operators sector. The Company is a corporate equity fund, alternative funding facility, for small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). CNL Capital EKES AIFM provides short-term liquidity to SMEs in Greece by investing in the bond loans it issues. The Company's financing solutions include Commercial Cycle Funding, Pre-financing of the Contract, Funding of Open Balances and Funding an Activity. The Company has investments in more than 30 corporate bonds and supports more than 17 different sectors of the Greek economy, such as catering, food processing and cosmetics manufacturing, among others. Its investment portfolio is managed by CNL AEDOEE.

name: LOGISMOS INFORMATION SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Logismos Information Systems SA is a Greece-based company active in the information technology (IT) sector. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of business software applications and providing integration system services. Software applications include the Momentum enterprise resource planning applications with management systems for such business fields as human resources, payroll budget, customer relationship, retail, e-orders and information administration, as well as Nemo Supply Chain Management applications with management applications covering manufacturing, warehouse, product and project management, orders, procurements, demand planning, assets and supplies and information administration. Integration system services include services for business software development and also for the supply, configuration and installation of software from third parties. It has a number of deals for offering its system services, such as the optical system notices of Macedonia airport.

name: FLOUR MILLS C SARANTOPOULOS
businessSummary: FLOUR MILLS C. SARANTOPOULOS S.A. is a Greece-based industrial and commercial enterprise active in the production and trade of flour and semolina products. Its product portfolio consists of a wide range of flour products and includes multiple product ranges: bakery flours of different grinding levels, such as 70% simple flour and 70% confectionery flour; flours for confectionery and bread production; flour and semolina from hard wheat; flours for industrial companies; and various flour by-products that are sold to fodder cooperatives and feed industries. FLOUR MILLS C. SARANTOPOULOS S.A. mainly produces its products for the bakery, confectionery, and pasta industries and has a sales network throughout Greece. In addition, the Company is engaged in real estate activities, including the ownership, management, exploitation, leasing, and sale of its investment properties.

name: UNIBIOS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Unibios Holdings SA is a Greece-based entity operating as a holding group focused on water treatment and sustainable development technologies. It conducts activities through subsidiaries engaged in the design, manufacture, trading, installation and maintenance of water treatment and desalination systems serving municipal networks, industrial facilities, hospitals, hotels and other infrastructure projects. The Group also has interests in renewable energy and sustainability-related activities through Neovent AE, while legacy heating and climate-control operations have been discontinued. Its main subsidiaries include Watera Hellas and Watera entities in Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Italy and Luxembourg. It maintains an international presence alongside its operations in Greece, with production and technical facilities in Attica and Volos.

name: DOMIKI KRITIS
businessSummary: DOMIKI KRITIS S.A. is a Greece-based company operating as a construction and infrastructure contractor with activities in public and private works, real estate development, and renewable energy. The Company undertakes a range of infrastructure projects including building construction, roadworks, port and hydraulic works, underground and electromechanical installations, energy facilities, environmental projects, and waste management infrastructure. It also engages in real estate development and participates in energy-related activities through renewable energy investments. Its operations are primarily focused on the Greek market, supported by engineering, technical, and equipment maintenance capabilities. The Company conducts its activities through its corporate structure, which includes interests in related construction and industrial operations.

name: AVE
businessSummary: AVE S.A. is a Greece-based company operating as a provider of retail, distribution, entertainment, and media-related products and services. The Company is active in the distribution and sale of consumer goods, video games, office supplies, and entertainment content, while also participating in film, television, music production, and related media activities. Through its subsidiaries, it develops retail and wholesale operations, including the Carrefour franchise network in Greece, office products distribution, and audiovisual production services. Its activities are primarily concentrated in Greece, with additional presence in selected international markets through subsidiaries and commercial partnerships. The Group includes entities such as Retail & More S.A., FBD S.A., Power Media Productions S.A., Ave Participation Ltd, and OFISMART S.A., supporting its operations across retail, distribution, and entertainment sectors.

name: PROFILE SYSTEMS & SOFTWARE
businessSummary: Profile Systems and Software SA is a Greece-based information technology (IT) company. The Company provides technology solutions to the Banking and Investment Management industries. The Company’s specialization lies in Private Wealth Management Software and Investment Portfolio Management Software, as well as a range of Banking Software solutions. It partners with global IT and software companies, providing integrated software solutions for the financial services sector covering banking, investment management, risk and compliance, and capital markets. In addition, the Company offers a range of services, including project management, consulting, customization, customer support and training. The Company operates offices in Geneva, Dubai, London, Singapore, Athens and Nicosia.

name: EVROPI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Evropi Holdings SA, formerly known as I Kloukinas I Lappas Construction and Commercial Co SA is a Greece-based holding company. Through its subsidiaries, such as Sysmerom Com Srl, Klsal Ltd, Klser Commerce Ltd and Wonder Nest Retail SA, the Group is engaged in the exploitation and management of real estate as well as in the purchase, import, manufacture and trade of clothing, footwear, baby and children's goods, toys, furniture, cosmetics and household goods. The Group's activities are divided in two business areas: Commercial sector and Property Exploitation sector. Evropi Holdings SA is also engaged in the provision of commercial and technical advice and the management of investments in relation to real estate.

name: AKTOR
businessSummary: Aktor Holding Company Technical And Energy Projects SA is a Greece-based company primarily undertaking technical projects. The Company focuses on the design, construction, and supervision of public and private projects, including civil engineering, metal constructions and telecommunications infrastructure. The Company handles significant projects in Greece and other countries. In the field of Real Estate, the Company operates a five star hotel in Athens, develops office buildings and residential properties. In the field of Renewable Energy, the Company manages wind farms and collaborates on large-scale energy projects. The Company also engages in Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) and concessions, participating in numerous strategic infrastructure projects, enhancing its portfolio and market presence.

name: KRI KRI MILK INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Kri Kri Milk Industry SA is a Greece-based company principally engaged in the production and trade of ice cream, yogurt and milk. The ice cream production includes five product lines: Cones, Ice Cream Cups, Scoop Ice Cream, Sticks, and Ice Cream Sandwiches. The yogurt production includes five product lines: Plain, Traditional, Catering, Fruit, and flavored yogurt for children under the brand name Scooby Doo. The milk production includes four products: Full cream pasteurized milk 3.5% Fat, Semi-skimmed pasteurized milk 1.5% Fat, Chocolate skimmed milk 0% Fat, and AYRAN (KEFIR) KRI-KRI. The Company also offers some of its products in family packs. KRI-KRI Milk S.A. is also active in the Balkans region through 71%-owned subsidiary KRI-KRI DOO Kumanovo, in Macedonia which has an autonomous production line of ice cream and yogurt, warehouses and cooling chambers. In February 2013, the Company dissolved its subsidiary in Bulgaria, KRI KRI BULGARIA A.D.

name: BALLYS INTRALOT
businessSummary: Bally's Intralot SA, is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the gaming sector. The Company offers a wide range of products and services, including lottery, betting and gaming solutions, both online and offline: the Lottery Solution, which includes software for game management, content, player and device management, customer touchpoints and a governance suite; the Betting Solution, which provides an omnichannel player experience platform, Managed Trading Services, terminals and online touchpoints; Gaming solutions that adhere to regulation compliance, Digital Transformation services, which help businesses' performance improvement using technologies. Other services include Managed Trading Services and Betting Consultation. The Company operates in multiple countries across five continents, including the USA, Peru, Argentina, Chile, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Turkey, Taiwan and Morocco.

name: REAL CONSULTING IT BUSINESS SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: Real Consulting SA is a Greece-based company primarily engaged in the information technology industry. The Company offers services, technologies, solutions, analytics and artificial intelligence tools across various industries through collaboration with global business software providers such as SAP, Microsoft and Salesforce. Real Consulting SA serves customers and undertakes projects both domestically and internationally. These services include Customer Experience, Employee Experience, Enterprise Resource Management, Enterprise Management and Enterprise Performance Management. The Company's customer network spans industries such as Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Consumer Products, Manufacturing, Retail, Public Sector and Financial Services, driving efficiency, innovation and transformation through technology.

name: LAMPSA HELLENIC HOTELS
businessSummary: Lampsa Hellenic Hotels SA (Lampsa) is a Greece-based company engaged in the establishment, operation and management of hotel complexes. The Company owns Grande Bretagne, a five-star hotel located in the city center of Athens. The hotel’s complex facilities include 262 luxury rooms and 59 suites, including a Presidential and Royal suite. The room features include cable television, direct dial telephone, Internet access and voice mail services. It offers restaurant and bar facilities, a business center, as well as sports and spa facilities. The hotel unit is managed by Starwood Hotels. Lampsa also owns 51% of the shares of Hyatt Regency Hotel in Belgrade. The hotel’s complex facilities include: 301 luxury rooms; a Presidential, Royal, Executive and Diplomatic Suite, and comprises luxury areas for recreation, dinning and support services. In 2008, it acquired 70% stake of Excelsior Hotel in Belgrade and 50% stake of Touristika Theretra SA, owning company of the Sheraton Rhodes Resort.

name: GROENLANDSBANKEN
businessSummary: Groenlandsbanken A/S is a Denmark-based bank engaged in consultancy and financial services in Greenland. The Bank’s products and services are provided to private customers and commercial enterprises. It offers home banking, mortgage loans, savings accounts, pension funds, insurance, payment transfers, and investment advisory services among others. Furthermore, the Bank also operates an electronic banking platform, named Netbank, which enables the access to a range of facilities, such as payments, transfers and invoices. The Bank collaborates with companies involved in the financial sector, including the Bankers' Information Technology (IT) Centre (BEC), Nykredit, DLR Kredit, Letpension, MasterCard, Visa, Narsaq OMX Nordic, Nordea Invest and Carnegie Worldwide. It controls a number of branches, which are located in Nuuk, Qaqortoq, Maniitsoq, Sisimiut, Aasiaat, Ilulissat, Appaaraq and Tasiilaq.

name: COMPAGNIE AERIENNE INTER REGIONALE EXPRE
businessSummary: Compagnie Aerienne Inter Regionale Express SA, (also CAIRE), is a French Guiana-based airline company. The Company operates flights within French Guiana under the Air Guyane Express name and also operates another airline, Air Antilles Express, which flies from Pointe a Pitre, Guadeloupe, to Martinique and other Caribbean destinations.

name: MIDLAND HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Midland Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of property agency services for residential, commercial and industrial properties and shops. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of property, the operation of Internet Website and the provision of immigration consultancy services, administration and treasury services to group companies, as well as professional surveying consultancy and valuation services in Hong Kong through its subsidiaries. The Company's principal subsidiaries include Astra Profits Limited, Guangzhou Midland Property Agency Company Limited, HKP Estate Agency (Macau) Limited and Hong Kong Property Services (Agency) Limited.

name: TASTE GOURMET GROUP
businessSummary: Taste . Gourmet Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company principally provides Japanese, Chinese, Western, Vietnamese food. The Company also provides dessert and kiosks. The Company’s restaurant brands include Nabe Urawa, Dab-Pa, La’taste, Rakuraku Ramen, Yakiniku Guu, Parkview, Takano Ramen, Moments Together, Sankinn, Tirpse, Urawa, Wasyokuya Yamaichi, Say Cheese, Say Cheese Kiosk, Sweetology, Xianghui, Same Same.

isin: 85|CHINA ELECTRONICS HUADA TECH|0085.HK|China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited
name: CHINA ELECTRONICS HUADA TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design and sale of integrated circuit chips in the People's Republic of China. It provides smart cards and secure element chip products, and application solutions for use in FinTech, network communication, Internet of Things, internet of vehicles, intelligent transportation, and smart manufacturing industries. The company is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong. China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited is a subsidiary of Huada Semiconductor Co., Ltd.

isin: 0340.HK|Tongguan Gold Group Limited|0340.HK|Tongguan Gold Group Limited
name: TONGGUAN GOLD GROUP
businessSummary: Tongguan Gold Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in gold mining operations in China. It is involved in sale of mine-produced gold, including gold concentrate, gold bullion, and related products  gold exploration, mining, processing, and smelting operations  gold recycling  and refining and sale of gold bullion. The company was formerly known as China Mining Resources Group Limited and changed its name to Tongguan Gold Group Limited in April 2018. Tongguan Gold Group Limited is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

name: IN CONSTRUCTION HOLDINGS
businessSummary: IN Construction Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in foundation works and other associated works. The Company's works include demolition works, site formation works, ground investigation field works and general building works. The Company' s subsidiaries include In Construction (BVI) Limited and In Construction Limited.

name: CHINA TAIPING INSURANCE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: China Taiping Insurance Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the insurance business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Life Insurance Business segment provides insurance products including individual and group life insurance, health insurance, accident insurance and annuity. The People’s Republic of China (PRC) Property and Casualty Insurance Business segment provides motor insurance, marine insurance and non-marine insurance in the PRC. The Reinsurance Business segment primarily provides property damage, life, marine cargo and hull and miscellaneous non-marine insurance products. The Overseas Property and Casualty Insurance Business segment provides insurance services in Hong Kong, Macau, the United Kingdom, Singapore, and Indonesia. The Other Businesses segment is engaged in the asset management business, insurance intermediary business, financial leasing, property investment business, securities dealing and broking business.

name: EMPEROR WATCH & JEWELLERY
businessSummary: Emperor Watch & Jewellery Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sales of watches and jewelry. The Company is a retailer of European brand watches and self-designed jewellery products under its own brand Emperor Jewellery. The Company operates its stores across Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China, Singapore and Malaysia, as well as its online shopping platform. The Company’s watch products mainly include watches from different kinds of European brands, such as Rolex, Tudor, Tag Heuer, Zenith, Vacheron Constantin, among others. The Company’s Jewellery products include rings, necklaces, pendants, bangles, bracelets, earrings, brooches.

name: PICO FAR EAST HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Pico Far East Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of exhibition, event and brand activation services. The Company operates its business through four main segments. The Exhibition, Event and Brand Activation segment provides exhibitions, events and brand activation services, including exhibition planning, promotional event design and video content production. The Museum and Themed Entertainment segment is mainly engaged in the design and decoration of museums and theme parks. The Visual Branding Activation segment is mainly engaged in providing digital experience and decoration services for retail stores in industries such as automobiles. The Meeting Architecture Activation segment is engaged in the management of conferences and exhibitions.

name: SUN HUNG KAI &
businessSummary: Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of consumer finance services. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Consumer Finance segment is mainly engaged in the provision of consumer, small and medium enterprises and other financing. The Investment Management segment is mainly engaged in the portfolio investments business and provision of term loans, structured and specialty financing services. The Group Management and Support segment is mainly engaged in the provision of liquidity, management, supervisory and administrative functions to all business segments. The Mortgage Loans segment is mainly engaged in the provision of mortgage loans financing services. The Alternative Solutions segment is mainly engaged in the provision of external fund solutions and fund management service.

name: G & M HOLDINGS
businessSummary: G & M Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of design and builds solution service for podium facade and curtain wall works. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of one-stop design and build solutions in relation to podium facade and curtain wall works. The Company is also engaged in the provision of repair and maintenance services.

name: PRINX CHENGSHAN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Prinx Chengshan Holdings Ltd, formerly Prinx Chengshan (Cayman) Holding Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of tire products. The Company develops, manufactures and sells tires and provides tire full-life-cycle services. The Company's tire products include all steel radial tires, semi-steel radial tires and bias tires, which are mainly used in intermediate and long distance transportation, buses, mixed road or off-road vehicles, light trucks, passenger cars, pickup trucks and sport utility vehicles (SUVs), vehicles for agricultural and industrial off-road conditions, among others.

name: ZIJIN GOLD INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Zijin Gold International Co Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the mining of gold and non-ferrous metal business. The Company is mainly engaged in the exploration, mining processing, and sales of gold and non-ferrous metal. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of gold bars, alloy gold, gold concentrate and other products.

name: CATHAY PACIFIC AIRWAYS
businessSummary: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the provision of international passenger and cargo air transportation. Together with its subsidiaries, the Company operates business through its four operating segments. The Cathay Pacific and Cathay Dragon segment provides full service international passenger and cargo air transportation under the Cathay Pacific and Cathay Dragon brands. The Air Hong Kong segment provides express cargo air transportation offering scheduled services within Asia. The HK Express segment provides a low-cost passenger air transportation offering scheduled services within Asia. The Airline Services segment provides supporting airline operations services include catering, cargo terminal operations, ground handling services and commercial laundry operations.

name: WASION HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Wasion Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the advanced metering infrastructure business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Power Advanced Metering Infrastructure segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of smart power meters and provision of respective system solutions. The Communication and Fluid Advanced Metering Infrastructure segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of communication terminals and water, gas and heat metering products and provision of respective system solutions. The Advanced Distribution Operations segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of smart power distribution devices and providing smart power distribution solutions and energy efficiency solutions.

name: QUEEN S ROAD CAPITAL INV
businessSummary: Queen's Road Capital Investment Ltd is a financier to the global resource sector. The Company is a resource-focused investment company, making investments in privately held and publicly traded resource companies. name: HYPEBEAST
businessSummary: Hypebeast Limited is an investment holding company primarily engaged in media, e-commerce, and retail business. The company operates its businesses through two segments. The Media segment is mainly involved in global media properties offering editorial and advertising services. The E-commerce and Retail segment focuses on the sale of fashion and lifestyle products through its online and retail channels.

name: TEN PAO GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Ten Pao Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sales of electronic charging products. The Company operates through six segments. The Smart Charger and Controller segment produces and sells smart chargers and controllers. The Telecommunications segment produces and sells switching power supplies for telecommunications equipment. The New Energy Business segment produces and sells energy storage products for electric vehicles. The Media and Entertainment segment produces and sells media and entertainment-related power supply products. The Lighting segment produces and sells power supply products related to lighting products. The Other segment produces and sells other power supply products.

name: CHINA HIGH SPEED
businessSummary: China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Co Ltd is an investment holding company engaged in the wind and industrial gear transmission equipment business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Wind and Industrial Gear Transmission Equipment segment is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and distribution of mechanical transmission equipment used in wind power and industrial applications. The Rail Transportation Gear Transmission Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and distribution of gear transmission equipment used in rail transportation. The Trading Business segment focuses on bulk commodity and steel industry chain. The Others segment principally comprises services on lighting projects, municipal landscape projects and engineering procurement construction projects.

name: CITIC RESOURCES HOLDINGS
businessSummary: CITIC Resources Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and coal in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Australia, Europe, other Asian countries, and internationally. The company operates in four segments: Aluminum Smelting  Coal  Crude Oil  and Import and Export of Commodities. The Aluminum Smelting segment operates a Portland aluminum smelter which sources alumina  and produces aluminum ingots in Australia. The Coal segment operates coal mines  and sells coal in Australia. The Crude Oil segment explores, develops, and operates oilfields, as well as sells crude oil in Indonesia and China. The Import and Export of Commodities segment exports various commodity products  and imports other commodities and manufactured goods. It also engages in alumina refinery  financing  oil technology development  and property holding activities. In addition, the company provides consulting and management services  invests in bauxite mining  and trades in oil and gas. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong. CITIC Resources Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of CITIC Limited.

name: C MER MEDICAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: C-Mer Medical Holdings Ltd, formerly C-Mer Eye Care Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the medical services business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The HK Medical Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of ophthalmic, dental and other medical services and sales of vision aid products in Hong Kong. The Mainland China Dental Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of dental services in Mainland China. The Sales of Medical Consumables segment is mainly engaged in the sales of medical consumables in Hong Kong business. The Mainland China Ophthalmic Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of ophthalmic services and sales of vision aid products in Mainland China.

name: LITU HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Litu Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the printing and manufacture of packages and related materials. The Company mainly operates its business through two segments. The Printing and Manufacturing of Paper Packages and Related Materials segment is engaged in the printing and manufacture of cigarette packages as well as others. The Leasing of Investment Properties segment is engaged in the leasing of properties.

name: TIANJIN DEVELOPMENT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tianjin Development Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the supply of electricity, water, heat and thermal power. The Company operates its business through six segments. The Utilities segment engages in distribution of electricity, water, heat and thermal power. The Pharmaceutical segment engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products and the provision of pharmaceutical research and development services as well as design, manufacture and printing for pharmaceutical packaging. The Hotel segment provides hotel operation services. The Electrical and Mechanical segment engages in the manufacture and sale of presses, mechanical and hydroelectric equipment as well as large scale pump units. The Port Services segment provides port services including container and cargo handling services. The Elevators and Escalators segment engages in the manufacture and sale of elevators and escalators.

isin: 3613|BEIJING TONG REN TANG CHINES|3613.HK|Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Company Limited
name: BEIJING TONG REN TANG CHINESE MEDICINE
businessSummary: Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, retail, and wholesale of healthcare products and Chinese medicine products to wholesalers and individuals. It operates through Hong Kong, Mainland China, and Overseas segments. The company also offers Chinese medical consultation and treatment services. It markets its products under the Tong Ren Tang brand name. It also operates retail outlets in Hong Kong and in other countries and regions in Asia, the Oceania, North America, and Europe. The company was founded in 1669 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

name: S A S DRAGON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: S A S Dragon Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the distribution of electronic components and semiconductor products. The Company is mainly engaged in the distribution of electronic components and semiconductor products used in mobile phone products, consumer electronics products, computer and network products, and telecommunication products. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the sale of light-emitting diode (LED) lighting and display products, distribution of business equipment and provision of related ancillary services, contract works of LED lighting and display products and properties investment business.

name: LUNG KEE GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Lung Kee Group Holdings Ltd, formerly Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of mould bases business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of mould bases and related products. The Company is also engaged in the provision of enterprise management services. The Company sells its products in China, America and Europe.

name: DAH SING BANKING GROUP
businessSummary: Dah Sing Banking Group Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of banking, financial and other related services in Hong Kong, Macau and the People’s Republic of China. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Personal Banking Business segment is engaged in deposits from individual customers, the extension of residential mortgage lending and personal loans. The Commercial Banking Business segment is engaged in the acceptance of deposits from and the advance of loans and working capital finance and trade financing. The Treasury Activities segment is engaged in the provision of foreign exchange services and centralized cash management for deposit taking and lending, interest rate risk management. The Overseas Banking Businesses segment is engaged in the provision of personal banking and commercial banking business activities. The Others segment is engaged in other corporate investments and debt funding.

name: TOP WEALTH GROUP HOLDING
businessSummary: Top Wealth Group Holding Ltd is a company principally engaged in the supply of caviars. The Company is principally engaged in the caviar wholesale business. The Company distributes its caviar products within domestic market and to overseas markets. The Company is engaged in the distribution of caviars under the brand name of Imperial Cristal Caviar.

name: TIANNENG POWER INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Tianneng Power International Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the battery manufacturing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Manufacturing Business segment is engaged in the manufacturing of lead-acid battery products, renewable resources product, lithium-ion battery products and others. The Trading segment is engaged in the trading business.

name: WULING MOTORS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Wuling Motors Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in automotive businesses. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Automotive Components and Other Industrial Services segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive components and accessories, trading of steels, and provision of water and power supply services. The Commercial Vehicles Assembly segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of specialized vehicles such as new energy vehicles. The Vehicles’ Power Supply Systems segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of engines and engine related parts and other power supply products. The Other segment is mainly engaged in the property investment and other business.

name: LUK FOOK HOLDINGS INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Luk Fook Holdings (International) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the sale of jewelries. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Retailing-Hong Kong, Macau and Overseas segment is engaged in the retail of jewelries in Hong Kong, Macau and overseas. The Wholesaling-Mainland segment is engaged in the wholesale of jewelries in mainland of China. The Retailing-Mainland segment is engaged in the retail of jewelries in mainland of China. The Wholesaling-Hong Kong segment is engaged in the wholesale of jewelries in Hong Kong. The Licensing segment is engaged in the trademark licensing business.

isin: 658|CHINA HIGH SPEED TRANSMISSIO|0658.HK|China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Co., Ltd.

businessSummary: China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, manufacture, and sale of various mechanical transmission equipment in the People's Republic of China, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Wind and Industrial Gear Transmission Equipment  Rail Transportation Gear Transmission Equipment  Trading Business  and Others. The company offers mechanical transmission equipment for use in wind power and industrial applications  gear transmission equipment for use in rail transportation fields  and gears, gear boxes, and fittings. China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong. China High Speed Transmission Equipment Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Five Seasons XVI Limited.

name: EPI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: EPI (Holdings) Limited, an investment holding company, primarily engages in the exploration and production of oil and gas in Canada and Hong Kong. It is also involved in money lending, and invests in security and management activities, as well as generates and sells electricity through solar energy. The company was formerly known as Great Wall Cybertech Limited and changed its name to EPI (Holdings) Limited in September 2006. EPI (Holdings) Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

name: FAIRWOOD HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fairwood Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in restaurants operation business. The Company mainly operates two businesses. The fast-food restaurants operation business is mainly engaged in the restaurants operation business including sale of food and beverages. The property investment business is mainly engaged in leasing of investment properties business. The Company mainly operates its business in Hong Kong and mainland China markets.

name: VSTECS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: VSTECS Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development of information technology product and the provision of technical solution integration services. The Company mainly operates through three segments. The Enterprise Systems segment provides enterprise system tools, including middleware, operating systems, Unix/NT servers, databases and storage for information technology (IT) infrastructure and IT infrastructure design and implementation, training, maintenance and support services. The Consumer Electronics segment provides finished IT products, including computer, mobile phone, drone, smart sports watch, three-dimensional (3D) printer, game console among others. The Cloud Computing segment provides cloud computing solutions and services.

name: JINHUI SHIPPING AND TRANSPORTATION
businessSummary: Jinhui Shipping and Transportation Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of marine transportation services. The Company is principally engaged in the ship chartering and ship owning businesses. The Company is also engaged in the ship management business. In addition, the Company is engaged in the operation of fleets of dry bulk carriers which are either used for carrying cargoes or time chartered-out to other shipping operators. Besides, the Company is engaged in the other shipping operating business, investment properties business, disposal of properties, plants and equipment and others. The Company operates its business in domestic and overseas markets such as Singapore, Ireland, South Korea, Thailand and others.

name: SHOUGANG FUSHAN RESOURCES GROUP
businessSummary: Shougang Fushan Resources Group Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in coking coal mining, producing and distribution business. The Company mainly engages in five businesses. The coal mining business includes the mining and exploration of coal resources and the production of raw and clean coking coal products. The coal processing business mainly operates independent coal preparation plants. The sales of self-produced clean coking coal business distribute self-produced coal products. The sales of self-produced by-products distribute self-produced coal by-products. The trading of products business mainly engages in trading of all products.

name: CHINA OVERSEAS PROPERTY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: China Overseas Property Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of property management services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Property Management Service segment is mainly engaged in the provision of property management services such as security, repairs and maintenance, cleaning and garden landscape maintenance for residential communities, commercial properties, government properties and construction sites. The Value-added Service segment is mainly engaged in the engineering, review of building plans, equipment and facility selection advice to property developers and other property management companies. The segment is also engaged in the operation of community assets, home living services and commercial services. The Car Parking Space Trading Business segment is engaged in the sale and purchase of parking spaces.

name: CHINA STATE CONS
businessSummary: China State Construction International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the construction business. The Company is principally engaged in the construction business, infrastructure project investments, toll road operation, provision of project consultancy services and facade contracting businesses. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the reconstruction of industrial plants, sale of building materials, leasing and rental of machinery and investment properties, general contracting business, thermoelectricity business and operations management.

name: KLN LOGISTICS GROUP
businessSummary: KLN Logistics Group Ltd, formerly Kerry Logistics Network Ltd, is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of logistics and freight forwarding services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The International Freight Forwarding segment provides international freight forwarding services within Asia, between Asia and Europe, and between Asia and America, transporting goods by air, sea and cross-border land transport services. The Integrated Logistics segment provides integrated logistics services in Asia, including warehousing, inventory and other value-added services, land transportation and distribution, returns management and sales of goods.

name: BRIGHTSTAR TECHNOLOGY GROUP
businessSummary: Brightstar Technology Group Co Ltd, formerly In Technical Productions Holdings Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of visual display solutions services. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Provision of Visual Display Solution Services segment is engaged in the provision of visual display solutions services for concerts and events and equipment rental business. The Information Technology Consulting Services segment is engaged in the provision of one-stop technical consulting services and solutions for e-commerce business platforms as well as the metaverse technology business.

name: INSPUR DIGITAL ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Inspur Digital Enterprise Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Internet of Things (IoT) Solution segment is mainly engaged in the provision of sales of IT peripherals and software business. The Management Software segment is mainly engaged in the provision of software development and other software services. The Cloud Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of cloud services including financial cloud, human resource cloud, procurement cloud, collaborative cloud, travel cloud, tax management cloud, marketing cloud and others.

name: GET NICE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Get Nice Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company primarily engaged in financial businesses. The Company operates its business through eight segments. The Securities Margin Financing segment mainly engages in the provision of securities margin financing services. The Broking segment mainly engages in the provision of stockbroking, futures and options broking and underwriting and placements. The Money Lending segment is mainly engaged in the provision of mortgage and consumer loans services. The Property Investments segment engages in holding of investment properties. The Financial Instruments Investments segment mainly engages in the investment in financial instruments. The Corporate Finance segment mainly provides corporate advisory services. The Auction Business segment mainly provides artwork auction services. The Asset Management segment mainly provides asset management services.

name: J LONG GROUP
businessSummary: J-Long Group Ltd is a holding company principally engaged in the distribution of reflective and non-reflective garment trims. The Company's products include heat transfers, fabrics, woven labels and tapes, sewing badges, piping, zipper pullers and drawcords.

name: NORTH MINING
businessSummary: North Mining Shares Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploitation, exploration, and production of molybdenum concentrate in the People's Republic of China. The company is also involved in property management operations. North Mining Shares Company Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.

name: EPRINT GROUP
businessSummary: eprint Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the paper printing business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Paper Printing segment is mainly engaged in the provision of leaflets, booklets, business cards, stationery and other paper printing products. The Banner Printing segment is mainly engaged in the provision of roll-up banners, mountings, stickers, posters, flags, promotional tables, outdoor banners and other digital printing products. In addition, the Company is engaged in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) online design platform.

The company is involved in the trading and distribution of plastic and industrial products, semiconductor equipment, electronics components, printed circuit boards, and other related products  and trading, distribution, and installation of turnkey manufacturing facilities. In addition, the company provides marketing, engineering, travel ticketing, and maintenance and after-sales services  travel and other related services  and machine installation and parts support services, as well as turnkey manufacturing services for OEM. Further, it offers OEM green manufacturing, electronic equipment, engineering, and medicine and health products and services. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Kowloon Bay, Hong Kong.

name: NANYANG HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nanyang Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in financial investments business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Financial Investments segment is mainly engaged in the holding and trading of investment securities. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the investment in and leasing of industrial and office premises.

name: YUE YUEN INDUSTRIAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yue Yuen Industrial Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of footwear products. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of athletic shoes, outdoor shoes, casual shoes, sports sandals, soles, components and other footwear products. The Company is also engaged in the retail and distribution of sportswear and footwear products. Retail operation also includes provision of commercial spaces to retailers and distributors.

name: LEES PHARMACEUTICAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Lee's Pharmaceutical Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, manufacturing, marketing and sales of pharmaceutical products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Imported Products segment is engaged in the sale of imported products. Its imported products include Keyan injection, Fipril oral solution and others. The Proprietary Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of self-developed products. Its R&D products include Resilicon Tablets, ADASUVE Inhalation Powder and others. The Company's medicines cover the fields of cardiovascular and infectious diseases, dermatology, oncology, gynecology and ophthalmology. The Company mainly operates its business in mainland China, Hong Kong and Taiwan.

name: EC HEALTHCARE
businessSummary: EC Healthcare is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of medical and healthcare services. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Medical Services segment provides medical services,dental services and others. The Aesthetic Medical and Beauty and Wellness segment provides aesthetic medicine, traditional beauty, hair care and supplemental wellness services and sale of skin care, health and beauty products. The Other segment provides marketing and related services and veterinary services.

name: APAC RESOURCES
businessSummary: APAC Resources Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in trading of commodities. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Commodity Business segment is mainly engaged in trading of iron ore and other commodities. The Principal Investment and Financial Services segment is mainly engaged in the provision of loan financing and investments in financial assets and receiving interest income from these financial assets. The Resource Investment segment is mainly engaged in trading of and investment in listed and unlisted securities of energy and natural resources companies.

name: PAX GLOBAL TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Pax Global Technology Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the development and sales of e-payment terminals products. The Company is engaged in the provision of maintenance and installation and payment solution services as well. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of android smart e-payment solutions, unattended solutions, classic e-payment solutions and commercial electronic point of sale (EPOS) solutions.

name: GME GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: GME Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of underground construction and engineering services. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of excavation, shotcreting, shutter design as well as fabrication and other tunnel construction services. The Company is also engaged in the provision of construction and refurbishment of underground public utility works such as road and drainage works. Additionally, the Company is engaged in the provision of structural works related to tunnel construction as well as construction of service buildings and support structure. The Company is engaged in the provision of program design, costing and management for underground construction services as well.

name: OSGH
businessSummary: Orange Sky Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the film business. Its business includes film exhibition, video disc and television copyright, film and television series distribution, cinema and theater operation, provision of publicity and advertising services, and agency services. The Company operates through four business segments: Hong Kong, Mainland China, Taiwan and Singapore.

name: HONG KONG FERRY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Hong Kong Ferry Holdings Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property development. The Company operates through five segments. Property Development segment is engaged in the development and sales of properties. Property Investment segment is engaged in the leasing of properties. Ferry, Shipyard and Related Operation segment is engaged in the operation of dangerous goods vehicular ferries, as well as the provision of cruise vessels, ship repair and ship maintenance services. Medical, Healthcare and Beauty Service segment is engaged in provision of medical, healthcare and beauty services. Securities Investment segment is engaged in debt and equity securities investment.

name: NAMESON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nameson Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of knitted apparel products. The Company provides manufacturing services including raw material sourcing, product design, production and delivery. The Company’s knitted products include sweaters, pullovers, cardigans, vests and related accessories.

name: CROSS HARBOUR HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Cross-Harbour Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the motoring school business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Motoring School Operation segment is engaged in the investment in subsidiaries which operate driver training centers. The Electronic Toll Operation segment is engaged in the investment in a joint venture which operates an electronic toll collection system, provides telematics services, and intelligent transportation and surveillance system solutions. The Tunnel Operations segment is engaged in the investment in associates which operate the Western Harbour Tunnel franchise. The Treasury segment is engaged in the investing activities to receive dividend income and interest income, and manages an investment portfolio including unlisted funds, equity securities, debt securities, and bank deposits and cash.

name: CHINA ENERGY DEVELOPMENT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: China Energy Development Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in exploration, production and distribution of natural gas businesses. The Company operates through three segments. The Exploration, Production and Distribution of Natural Gas segment is engaged in the exploration, development, production and sales of natural gas and the usage of pipeline for distribution of natural gas. The Sales of Food and Beverages Business segment is engaged in the sales of food and beverages. The Money Lending Business segment is engaged in provision of loans to third parties.

name: ORIENT OVERSEAS INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Orient Overseas (International) Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in container transport and logistics businesses. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Container Transport and Logistics segment is engaged in the provision of global containerized shipping services in major trade lanes, covering Trans-Pacific, Trans-Atlantic, Asia/Europe, Asia/Australia and Intra-Asia trades. In addition, this segment also provides integrated services over the management and control of effective storage and flow of goods. The Others segment is involved in the commercial properties.

name: BANK OF EAST ASIA
businessSummary: Bank of East Asia Ltd is principally engaged in banking business. The Company operates through nine segments. Personal Banking covers branch operations internet banking consumer and property loans MPF and credit cards. Chinese Mainland Operations cover subsidiaries and associates in Mainland China and Hong Kong support. Wholesale Banking covers corporate lending syndicated loans asset financing commercial lending securities financing and trade services. Overseas Macau and Taiwan Operations cover overseas branches subsidiaries and associates and Hong Kong support. Treasury Markets cover treasury operations and securities trading. Wealth Management covers private banking investment products advisory and brokerage. Corporate Management covers regulatory capital costs and interest income from capital-funded activities. Inter-segment Elimination covers elimination of inter-segment transactions. Others cover trust services and Hong Kong back-office support.

name: NISSIN FOODS
businessSummary: Nissin Foods Company Limited engages in manufacturing and selling instant noodles in Hong Kong, Mainland China, Canada, Australia, the United States, Taiwan, Macau, and internationally. The company also manufactures and sells retort and frozen foods, beverages and snacks, and vegetables, as well as fruit juices, cup noodles, and sauces. In addition, it manufactures packaging materials instant noodles products  and provides publicity services. The company also trades in instant noodle, vegetable, and packaging material products, and imports beverages and food products, noodle and confectionery  as well as provides administrative management and human resource services. It operates under the Demae Iccho, Cup Noodles, Nissin Viet Signature, and Nissin Donbei, KEMY, ABC Pastry, KOIKEYA, Hokkaido Iccho, Nissin Raoh, Nissin U.F.O. Fuku, NISSIN, and Doll brand names. Nissin Foods Company Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Tai Po, Hong Kong. Nissin Foods Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Nissin Foods Holdings Co.,Ltd.

name: FOUNTAIN SET HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fountain Set Holdings Ltd is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company principally engaged in the textile businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Production and Sales of Dyed Fabrics and Yarns segment mainly engages in the manufacture and sale of pure cotton, other pure fibers, knitted fabric and dyed yarns. The Production and Sales of Garments segment mainly engages in the garments manufacturing and sale business.

name: YIPS CHEMICAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yip's Chemical Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in chemical businesses. The Company operates through four segments. Coatings segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of and trading in coatings and related products. Inks segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of and trading in inks and related products. Lubricants segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of and trading in lubricants products. Properties segment is mainly engaged in the property investment.

name: ORBUSNEICH MEDICAL GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: OrbusNeich Medical Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the development, production and sales of medical equipment and machineries. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture, distribution and sale of interventional medical devices for the treatment of coronary heart disease and peripheral vascular diseases. The Company's main products include percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and percutaneous transluminal angioplasty (PTA) balloons. In addition, the Company's products also include semi-compliant balloons and scoring balloons for pre-dilatation and lesion preparation, coronary stents for implantation, non-compliant balloons for post-dilatation and specialty catheters. The Company mainly conducts its businesses in domestic and overseas markets.

name: TAUNG GOLD INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Taung Gold International Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the trading and exploring of minerals, and development and mining of gold and associated minerals in Hong Kong and South Africa. The company operates through Gold Exploration and Development  and Trading of Minerals segments. Its flagship properties comprise Evander project located in the Witwatersrand Basin  and Jeanette project located in the Free State province of South Africa. The company was formerly known as Taung Gold Limited and changed its name to Taung Gold International Limited in September 2011. Taung Gold International Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.

name: CHINA EDUCATION GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: China Education Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the provision of private higher education services. The Company operates its business through three segments: the Higher Education segment, the Vocational Education segment, and the Global Education segment. The Company operates higher education and vocational education institutions in the People's Republic of China (the PRC) and provides education services in Australia and the United Kingdom (UK).

name: Q P GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Q P Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of paper products. The Company operates its business through two segments. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of greeting cards, tabletop games, educational items and premium packaging items. Web Sales segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of playing cards, tabletop games and puzzles.

name: LEE & MAN CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Lee & Man Chemical Co Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in the manufacture and sales of chemical products. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Chemical segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products. The Company‘s products include polymers, basic chemicals, food and water additives, paper additives and lithium ion battery additives. The Property segment is mainly engaged in the development and sale of properties, properties rental and related properties services provision business.

name: CAFE DE CORAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Cafe De Coral Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in food and beverage businesses. The Company is principally engaged in operation of quick service restaurants, casual dining chains, institutional catering, as well as food processing and distribution. In addition, the Company is engaged in the development of ordering platforms, mobile ordering applications (Apps) and provision of quick response (QR) code ordering for takeaway and pre-orders services. The Company mainly operates its business in China.

name: SHENGUAN HOLDINGS GROUP
businessSummary: Shenguan Holdings (Group) Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the collagen products business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of edible collagen sausage casing products, collagen food products, collagen skin care products and polymer collagen medical biomaterials. Additionally, the Company is engaged in the provision of maternal-infant products. The Company mainly sells its products in domestic and overseas markets.

name: TAO HEUNG HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tao Heung Holdings Limited is an investment holding company principally engaged in food and beverage businesses. The main businesses of the Company include the provision of food catering services through chain restaurants, the operation of bakeries, the distribution of foods and other products, among others. The brands under the Company include Tao heung, Tao Square, Hak Ka Hut, HITEA and Tai Cheong Bakery, among others. The Company operates businesses in Hong Kong and Mainland China markets.

name: TVB
businessSummary: TVB Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in terrestrial television broadcasting, digital media services, and other television-related activities. It operates through TV Broadcasting  Digital Media  Chinese Mainland Operations  and International Operations segments. The TV Broadcasting segment is involved in the broadcasting of television programmes and commercials on terrestrial TV platforms  production of programmes  music entertainment, and operation of e-Commerce business. The Digital Media segment operates myTV SUPER OTT service, online social media platform, digital marketing, and other digital-related businesses in Hong Kong. The Chinese Mainland Operations segment co-produces dramas  and distributes television programmes and channels to telecast, video, and media operators in Mainland China. The International Operations segment offers pay television and OTT services to subscribers  and distributes television programmes and channels to telecast, video, and media operators in Malaysia, Singapore, and internationally. It operates through the Distribution Business and System Integration Solutions Business segments. The company also provides IT implementation services, as well as IT maintenance and support services, and related IT infrastructure solutions  and distributes or procures IT products. MTT Group Holdings Limited was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.

name: BOYAA INTERACTIVE INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Boyaa Interactive International Limited is an investment holding company primarily engaged in online game-related businesses. The company operates through three segments. The Online Game Related business segment primarily engaged in mobile and computer games development, operations and the related advisory service. The Web3 Related Business segment, which primarily engages in crypto-currencies related investments. The Property Investment Business segment primarily engages in property investment.

name: CM ENERGY TECH
businessSummary: CM Energy Tech Co., Ltd., formerly CMIC Ocean En-Tech Holding Co., Ltd., is in the business of offshore wind power installation and operation and maintenance, clean green energy and core equipment technology, products, and services. The Company serves the oil and gas exploration industry, as well as offshore engineering asset management business. It provides drilling packages for entire offshore platforms and offers infrastructure solutions for production platforms, workover platforms, and other ancillary platforms required for offshore oil and gas fields after drilling Jack-up platform solutions. The Company also develops, designs, manufactures, installs and debugs almost all high-end equipment for various offshore drilling platforms or land drilling rigs. It provides drilling fluid circulation management system (EFMS) that enables zero slurry discharge during drilling. The Company also offers rig maintenance and repair supply and global rig services.

name: SSY GROUP
businessSummary: SSY Group Ltd, formerly known as Lijun International Pharmaceutical Holding Co Ltd, is an investment holding company principally engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company’s main products include finished medicines of mainly intravenous infusion solution to hospitals and distributors, bulk pharmaceuticals and medical materials. The Company’s products mainly include non-PVC (Polyvinyl chloride) soft bag infusion solution, PP (Polypropylene) plastic bottle infusion solution and Glass bottle infusion solution. The Company’s products also include Hydrochloride Betahistine, Hydrochloride Ambroxol and Doxofylline as well as bulk pharmaceuticals including caffeine, theophylline, aminophylline, metronidazole and nifedipine.

name: ASIA STANDARD INTERNATIONAL GROUP
businessSummary: Asia Standard International Group Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in property development and investment business. The Company operates its business through five segments. The Property Sales segment is responsible for the development and sale of properties. The Financial Investment segment is engaged in the investment in securities and other financial assets to generate interest and dividend income. The Hotel Business segment is responsible for the operation and management of hotels. The Property Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of properties and provision of related management services. The Other segment covers management services and other miscellaneous business.

name: LIU CHONG HING INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Liu Chong Hing Investment Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in property investment business. The Company operates its business through six segments. The Property Investment Segment is engaged in property investment and leasing business. The Property Development Segment is engaged in property development and sales business. The Property Management Segment provides property management services. The Financial Investment Segment is engaged in trading and investment in securities and other financial instruments. The Trading and Manufacturing Segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of magnetic products. The Hotel Operation Segment is engaged in hotel management and operation and catering business.

name: KARRIE INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Karrie International Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company principally engaged in metal and plastic business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Metal and Plastic Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of metal and plastic parts and enclosures, including moulds, server chassis and household products. The Electronic Manufacturing Services Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of magnetic tape data storage, point-of-sale (POS) systems and other computer peripherals. The Real Estate Business segment is engaged in urban renewal, real estate project investment and property leasing and development businesses.
