Its platform allows its users to recommend any of the hundreds of millions of products available to their friends and across the network by writing reviews and uploading their own content in picture or video format.

name: UPLAND RESOURCES
businessSummary: Upland Resources Limited is a Jersey-based upstream oil and gas company. The Company is primarily focused on developing opportunities in Sarawak, Malaysia. It operates in one business segment: the exploration and development of oil and gas assets. The Company's assets include Sarawak SK334, North Sea Inner Moray Firth, and Hardstoft. Its Block SK334, which has a size of approximately 6,685 square kilometers (km), is located in the northern region of onshore Sarawak, Malaysia. Its North Sea Inner Moray Firth is located in the North Sea and comprises the Dunrobin Prospect, which consists of a large, rotated fault block covering up to approximately 45 square kilometers (km). The Company has a 25% interest in Hardstoft (Block SK46c), located in the East Midlands Oil Province. The Company's subsidiaries include Upland Resources (UK Onshore) Limited and Upland Resources (Sarawak) Sdn Bhd.

name: CLEANTECH LITHIUM
businessSummary: CleanTech Lithium PLC is a Jersey-based exploration and development company advancing sustainable lithium projects in Chile. The Company’s assets consist of four lithium projects, spanning approximately 1,250 square kilometers (km2) in the lithium triangle in Chile. Its projects include Laguna Verde, Francisco Basin, Llamara, and Arenas Blancas. Its Laguna Verde and Francisco Basin projects are located 300 kilometers (km) by road from the mining center of Copiapo in the Atacama region of Chile. The Laguna Verde Project features a hypersaline lake covering approximately 15.2 km2 and consists of 108 mining licenses at the low point of the basin with a large sub-surface. Francisco Basin Project has a total exploration license area of over 127 km2. Llamara is a greenfield lithium exploration project with a license area totaling approximately 344 km2 located in the Pampa del Tamarugal basin. Arenas Blancas project covers a total area of over 377 km2.

name: PHOENIX SPREE DEUTSCHLAND
businessSummary: Phoenix Spree Deutschland Limited is a Jersey-based investment company specializing in Berlin residential real estate. The Company invests in residential and commercial property in Germany. The Company's segments include Investment property- Rental, and Investment property- Disposals. The Investment property- Rental segment comprises properties held and operated for medium-term rental purposes. The Investment property- Disposals segment comprises properties that are also held for long-term rental income and capital appreciation. It is primarily investing in the residential market in Berlin, supplemented with selective investments in commercial property. The majority of commercial property within the portfolio is located within residential and mixed-use properties. Its portfolio consists of approximately 73 properties, 2,081 units and 146.5 thousand square meters. Its subsidiaries include Phoenix Spree Deutschland I Limited, Phoenix Spree Deutschland VII Limited, and others.

name: JERSEY OIL AND GAS
businessSummary: Jersey Oil and Gas plc is a Jersey-based upstream oil and gas company. The Company’s activities are focused on the region of the North Sea of the United Kingdom. The Company’s operations include Greater Buchan Area, Buchan Redevelopment, J2 & Verbier, and Exploration. The Greater Buchan Area’s the Buchan field is to be produced through over five gas-lifted production wells, supported by two water injection wells. The Buchan Redevelopment consists of the P.2498 Buchan licence. The Buchan oil field lies in approximately 110 meters of water and is located in United Kingdom Continental Shelf (UKCS) blocks 20/05a and 21/01a, 150km northeast of Aberdeen in the United Kingdom North Sea. The J2 oil discovery is located in the P.2498 Buchan licence area (Block 20/05a and 21/01a). The Verbier oil discovery is located in Blocks 20/5b and 21/1d in licence P.2170. Its Exploration operations include Cortina, Wengen, and Verbier Deep exploration prospects.

name: IMAGING BIOMETRICS
businessSummary: Imaging Biometrics Limited is a Jersey-based company. The Company is engaged in the provision of clinical treatments to patients in the field of medical imaging diagnostics, based on technology. The Company's segments include Holding company, Medical Software, and Oral gallium maltolate (GaM). Its flagship imaging products include IB Neuro, IB Delta T1 and IB FTB Express (FTBx). Its subsidiaries include Imaging Biometrics, LLC, Stone Checker Software Limited, and Kirkstall Limited. Imaging Biometrics LLC develops ready-to-use software applications for the healthcare industry. Stone Checker Software Limited is a supplier of technology solutions in the field of kidney stone analysis and kidney stone prevention. Its Kirkstall Limited has developed Quasi Vivo, a patented organ-on-a-chip platform, addressing the accelerating global shift away from animal testing toward human-relevant research models.

name: GRANDSTAND
businessSummary: Grandstand Limited, formerly Gambling.com Group Limited, is the intelligence layer powering informed decisions for consumers and partners across sports, gaming and entertainment. The Company's brands include OddsJam, OpticOdds, RotoWire, Gambling.com and Casinos.com. Its partner solutions span Sports Data, Advertising, Audience Monetization and Entertainment & Tickets. Sports Data solutions include real-time odds data, line movement, injuries and sports content that powers decisions across sportsbooks, trading desks, market makers, fantasy platforms and sports media through OpticOdds and RotoWire. Advertising solutions include adtech and commercial solutions. Audience Monetization solutions include technology and commercial support platform that gives media companies, apps, communities and influencers the infrastructure to monetize their audiences. Entertainment & Tickets solutions include ticketing and experiences for Las Vegas venues, casinos and hotels through Spotlight.Vegas.

name: PREDATOR OIL & GAS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Predator Oil & Gas Holdings Plc is a Jersey-based oil and gas company. It is engaged in the operation of an oil and gas development business in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago and an exploration and appraisal portfolio in Ireland and Morocco. Its portfolio consists of upstream exploration, appraisal and development, and near-term producing assets onshore Morocco, offshore the Republic of Ireland and onshore Trinidad. It operates through the exploration, appraisal and development of oil and gas assets segment. It has interests in three geographical segments: Africa (Morocco), Europe (Ireland) and the Caribbean (Trinidad and Tobago). It has 75% interest in the Guercif License together with its partner ONHYM, the State oil company. In Trinidad, it has 100% interest in the Cory Moruga license. It is the operator of three producing fields, all onshore Trinidad. It has three subsidiaries: Predator Oil & Gas Trinidad Ltd, Predator Gas Ventures Ltd, and Predator Oil and Gas Ventures Ltd.

name: NIHON SEIKO
businessSummary: Nihon Seiko Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells antimony products and metal powders in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It offers antimony trioxide, which is used as a flame-retardant additive for various plastic material and polyester polymerization catalysts. The company also provides antimony metal for use in raw materials for semiconductors, film for optical memory disk, or thermo-electron converter, as well as for storage batteries, bearing metals, hard lead castings, cables sheathing, type metals, and sheet and pipe alloys  antimony metal powder for glass fining agents and alloys  and antimony metal shots for alloys. The Company's products include parts for heat exchangers, such as radiators, exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) coolers, oil coolers and fuel coolers, among others; as well as automobile body components, such as oil pans, vacuum tanks, fuel tanks and selective catalytic reduction (SCR) tanks, among others. It mainly operates through three business segments: Japan, China and Asia.

name: TOLI
businessSummary: TOLI Corporation manufactures and sells floor coverings, wallpapers, drapes, and related installation accessories in Japan and internationally. It offers vinyl tiles and sheets, carpets, wall coverings and wainscoting, curtains, baseboards, adhesives, and other materials. The company was formerly known as TOYO LINOLEUM and changed its name to TOLI Corporation in October 1991. TOLI Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Itami, Japan.

name: PARKER
businessSummary: PARKER CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, steel, machinery and equipment, parts, materials and chemicals. The Company operates through five business segments. The Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of food machinery, shoemaking machinery, automotive equipment and other equipment. The Chemical Product segment provides sealing materials, undercoats, body weight reductions, hollow foam members as rigidity auxiliary materials, and glass sealing materials for automotive production lines. The Chemicals segment provides industrial cleaning agents and steel equipment. The Industrial Materials segment provides soundproofing materials for automobiles and home appliances. The Chemical Industry segment provides liquid crystal-related chemicals, car wash chemicals, other industrial chemicals and industrial hot air blowers. The other business is involved in petroleum-related products and real estate leasing business.

It also offers live music venues, artist management, labels agency, on-demand, digital marketing, fan clubs, e-commerce and merchandise. The company was formerly known as Space Shower Networks Inc. and changed its name to Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. in April 2024. Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

businessSummary: Uchida Yoko Co., Ltd. provides government and education, office, and information system solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates schools and universities  design, manufacture, supply, and install ICT devices and systems  manufacture and supply educational equipment and systems  design internal layouts and supply furniture and fittings for educational facilities  and provides mission-critical administration services. The company also designs and installs mission-critical systems and associated business software programs  supplies software licensing and IT asset management services  and designs, supplies, installs, and maintains IT equipment and networks. In addition, it designs, manufactures, and supplies office furniture and fittings  designs and builds office layouts  and manufactures and supplies office equipment, and hobby and craft products, as well as supplies OA equipment and products. The company also involved in the education and training, temporary staffing, real estate rental, and various services. The company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: CHUGAI MINING
businessSummary: Chugai Mining Co., Ltd. collects, processes, refines, and retails precious metals in Japan and internationally. The company's Precious Metal Business division procures and recycles precious metals, such as gold and platinum  refines, processes, and sells bare metals  and purchases and sells diamond and jewelry. Its Real Estate Business division engages in procuring, brokering, renting, and managing urban real estate properties, including condominiums, single family homes, land, business properties, and investment properties, as well as in the planning and development of properties. The company's Content Business division is involved in the planning, production, and sale of animation, comics, and game characters, and focuses on planning and development of licensed animated TV characters. Its Machinery Business division procures and sells machine tools comprising mother machinery items, including NC lathes and machining centers  plating machinery, such as punching machines and laser machines  and various pressing machinery for processing and molding. This division also procures and sells pre-owned machine tools and sheet metal processing machinery. Chugai Mining Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Mochikoshi Mine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Chugai Mining Co., Ltd. in April 1936. The company was incorporated in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

businessSummary: Shin Nippon Air Technologies Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides engineering systems to control air, water, heat, and other areas of air conditioning, electrical, and sanitary facilities in Japan and internationally. The company offers engineering solutions focusing on air conditioning for office buildings, commercial facilities, hotels, hospitals, and cultural facilities. It also engages in the installation of industrial air conditioning system in factories, clean rooms, and data centers  as well as design, construct, maintenance, and refurbishment of various nuclear related facilities, including BWR-style nuclear power plants. In addition, the company is involved in the construction of district heating and cooling systems. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NCS&A
businessSummary: NCS&A CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of integrated information services, including the design, development, operation support and maintenance of systems. The systems development business is engaged in the design of systems, the development of software, and the sale of customized packaged software products. The services business is engaged in the provision of maintenance services for computer equipment and other hardware, and system support services for enterprise computer systems, as well as the operation of inbound and outbound call centers for distribution and mail order fields. The system equipment sales business is engaged in the sale of computer equipment and peripherals, and packaged software products.

name: MARS GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Mars Group Holdings Corporation, formerly Mars Engineering Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of entertainment machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. The Amusement-related segment is engaged in the development, manufacturing and sale of products for amusement facilities. The Automatic Identification system-related segment is engaged in the proposal and sale of automatic identification systems utilizing RFID (radio frequency identification device) and bar code. The Hotel-related segment is engaged in operating hotels.

name: YUSHIRO
businessSummary:
Yushiro Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells metalworking oils and fluids, and building maintenance products in Japan, the Americas, the United States, China, Southeast Asia, and India. The company offers cutting and grinding oils and fluids, including water miscible cutting and grinding fluids, and straight cutting and grinding oils  forming oils and fluids comprising water miscible cold rolling oils, straight rolling oils, hot rolling oils for seamless pipes, and non-graphite hot forging oils, as well as drawing, pressing oils and cold forging oils  and surface treatment agents, such as rust preventives, metal cleaners, car paint protective coatings, and car body protective waxes. It also provides water miscible cutting fluids for inner diamond blade saws  straight slurry bases for multi blade and multi wire saws, fire resistant water miscible slurry bases for multi wire saw, and water miscible slurry bases for multi wire saw  grinding fluids for aluminum and glass disks, and diamond slurries for magnetic heads  aluminum and magnesium diecast lubricants, urethane foam mold release agents, and plunger tip lubricants  aquaous quenchant products  fire resistant hydraulic fluids  and deodoran products. machinery and equipment, and transportation equipment. The company was formerly known as Yushiro Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yushiro Inc. in April 2025. Yushiro Inc. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

name: JESCO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Jesco Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the renewable energy-related, electrical wireless, and electrical communications facility construction business. The company engages in the design and construction of high-voltage mega-solar power plants  private solar power generation systems  and high-voltage substation and power transmission, as well as substation-related and high-voltage transmission line construction. It also provides support information infrastructure, such as mobile base stations, CCTV monitoring systems, disaster prevention radio communication, expressway information communication systems, ITV/CCTV industrial surveillance camera systems, and paging system. In addition, the company undertakes electrical installation works for public facilities, including factories, theaters, amusement facilities, and sports facilities, as well as video and audio systems, ground lighting, ground scoreboard, plumbing and instrumentation construction, and theater lighting and electrical equipment. Further, it offers electrical systems for international airports and disaster management information system, as well as condominium electrical, air conditioning, sanitation, and fire protection systems. The company was formerly known as JESCO Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JESCO Holdings, Inc. in September 2004. Jesco Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: TAISEI ONCHO
businessSummary: Taisei Oncho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. It operates through four regional segments including Japan, the United States, China, and Australia. The equipment construction business designs and constructs heating and cooling, water supply and drainage sanitation, electricity, constant temperature and humidity, dehumidification, heat exchange, and refrigeration and freezing. The construction business designs and constructs buildings and ancillary facilities. The real estate business rents out land and buildings for commercial and residential use. The other businesses include the sale of heating and cooling equipment, solar power generation, and others.

name: HIGASHI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Higashi Holdings Co., Ltd. provides transportation and logistics services in Japan. The company operates through Shipping, Warehouse, Product Sales, and Welfare segments. It provides transportation and delivery, warehouse storage, logistics processing, and industrial waste management activities  provision of BPO solution, such as in-house document logistics management/mail room management, sorting/shipping of forms with personal information, confidential document storage and recycling under security management, etc.  and office relocation activities. The company also offers logistics services in the building  operates shops in the building under the Hills 21 name  PC kitting/IT related services  rents and sells welfare equipment comprising beds and wheelchairs  and sells hygiene products consisting of adult disposable diapers. In addition, it is involved in the temporary staffing and parking lot management activities. The company was formerly known as Higashi Twenty One Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Higashi Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Higashi Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

businessSummary: K&O Energy Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, production, supply, and sale of natural gas and iodine in Japan. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Mobara, Japan.

name: TACHI S
businessSummary: Tachi-S Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive seats and seat components. The Company operates through six regional segments including Japan, North America, Central and South America, Europe, China, and Southeast Asia. In the Japan segment, it handles automotive seats and seat components, as well as real estate leasing. Its automotive seat products include those for HONDA, NISSAN, MITSUBISHI, TOYOTA, HINO, and others.

name: DAIICHI JITSUGYO
businessSummary: Daiichi Jitsugyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale and rental of various machinery, tools and parts. It operates through seven business segments. Plant & Energy Business segment sells energy development and production, gas and oil refining, chemicals, engineering, construction, and paper and pulp related products. Energy Solutions Business segment sells lithium-ion battery manufacturing related products. Industrial Machinery Business segment sells plastics, rubber, steel, and food related products. Electronics Business segment sells electronics, information and communications, electrical equipment, precision machinery, optics, audio, and musical instruments related products. Automotive Business segment sells automobile-related products. Healthcare Business segment sells pharmaceutical and pharmaceutical-related products. Aviation & Infrastructure Business segment sells aviation and disaster prevention related products. It also rents various machinery and tools.

name: FOCUS SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Focus Systems Corporation provides IT services for public and private clients in Japan. The company also engages in the service of information security products  investment, development, and acting as intermediaries for companies and venture businesses  consulting and contract computer system development  systems operation and maintenance  development and distribution of information security technology and associated products, as well as software packages  planning and production of web content  temp staffing services  and other computer-related services. It serves communication, finance, social security, aviation, automobile/transportation, trade/transportation, electronic administration, and local government fields. Focus Systems Corporation was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: MANSEI
businessSummary: MANSEI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of electrical equipment and industrial systems, electronic devices and information communication equipment, and related services. The Company operates through four business segments. Electrical Equipment and Industrial System segment provides rotating machines, industrial fans, switches, watt-hour meters, transformers, indicators, generator and substation systems, measurement control systems, and other industrial mechatronic systems and equipment. Electronic Device and Information Communication Equipment segment provides semiconductors, optical equipment, liquid crystal panels, personal computers, printers, video equipment, embedded microcomputer software, and electronic manufacturing services. Equipment segment provides air conditioners, refrigerators, chillers, electric water heaters, lighting equipment, elevators, and related construction, maintenance, installation services. Photovoltaic segment provides power.

name: RIKEN TECHNOS
businessSummary: Riken Technos Corporation engages in compound, film, and food packaging businesses in Japan, Thailand, the United States, China, Europe, and internationally. The company offers flexible and rigid polyvinyl chloride, thermoplastic elastomers, electro-conductive compounds and anti-static, biomass plastics, general purpose plastic compounds, etc. for use in extrusion and injection molding applications. It also provides building and decorative, commercial and advertisement, steel plate, window, and car films, as well as films for optics and semiconductors, electrical materials, medical supplies, agriculture, etc. In addition, the company offers food wrap films made from polyvinyl chloride resin under the RIKEN WRAP and HI-WRAP brand names, as well as heat-resistant cooking sheets, plastic bags, cooking papers, cooking gloves, etc. Its products are used in automobiles, industrial components, home appliances, toys, medical supplies, building materials, and construction materials, as well as in IT industries. The company was formerly known as Riken Vinyl Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Riken Technos Corporation in October 2001. Riken Technos Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: TRAD
businessSummary: T.RAD Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of heat exchangers for automobiles, construction and industrial machines, air conditioners, generators, and others in Japan, the United States, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers radiators, oil and EGR coolers, charge air coolers, fin coils for air conditioners, and other heat exchangers. It also engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of environment-related equipment  and provision of solutions utilizing thermal energy conversion technology and information technology. The company was formerly known as Toyo Radiator Co., Ltd. and changed its name to T.RAD Co., Ltd. in April 2005. T.RAD Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: ID HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ID Holdings Corporation provides information technology (IT) services in Japan. The company operates through system management, application development, IT infrastructure, cyber security, consulting and education, and other businesses. It offers IT system operation and management  system planning, design and development, operation and maintenance, and project management support services  and IT platform design and construction. The company also provides security system construction, implementation support, and operation  security audit and consulting service, vulnerability diagnostic service, and information leakage  business process reengineering, IT governance, and project management consulting, and training and development work. In addition, it offers network security and consulting  administrative support, personnel recruitment and training  local market research  information gathering, and outsourced office administration services  IT staff support, office IT environment improvement  and engages in plant factory management  sells cultivated products. The company was formerly known as Information Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ID Holdings Corporation in April 2019. ID Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

businessSummary: Japan Cash Machine Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells of currency handling machines and equipment for amusement facilities in Japan and internationally. It operates through Global Gaming, Overseas Commercials, Domestic Commercials, and recreation hall equipment segments. It offers banknote recycler, banknote recycler with four denomination recycling, coin recycler, coin recycler with double sided insertion slot, modular banknote recycler, bill validator, recycler unit, bill validator with banknote storage box, plasma cluster Ion generating unit systems for spacious areas, cash/ cashless multi payment machine flexcom pay, and access control systems. It serves retail, transportation, casinos/gaming, environment, clinic, and system products markets. Japan Cash Machine Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KIMURA UNITY
businessSummary: Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. provides logistics, mobility, information, and staffing services in Japan, China, North America, and internationally. The company provides logistic services, such as distribution center operations, container equipment production, shipping operations, as well as warehousing and packing. It also offers vehicle management, maintenance, rental services, vehicle leasing, and insurance agency services. In addition, the company provides consulting/system development, and system maintenance. Further, it provides recruitment, temporary staffing, recruitment support services, and introduction dispatching. The company was formerly known as Kimura Unity and changed its name to Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. in November 1990. Kimura Unity Co., Ltd. was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

The company offers automotive soundproofing materials and anti-corrosion coatings  and paints and coatings for aircraft and building. It is also involved in the insurance agency business. The company was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

name: MAXVALU TOKAI
businessSummary: Maxvalu Tokai Co.,Ltd. operates and manages a chain of supermarkets in Japan. The company's supermarkets mainly offer food products such as groceries. It also operates online supermarkets. The company was formerly known as K.K. Wada Shoji and changed its name to Maxvalu Tokai Co.,Ltd. in 2002. Maxvalu Tokai Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan. Maxvalu Tokai Co.,Ltd. Operates as a subsidiary of Aeon Co., Ltd.

name: FUJII SANGYO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fujii Sangyo Holdings Corporation, formerly Fujii Sangyo Corporation, is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of electrical construction materials, electrical equipment, machine tools, information equipment, and construction machinery. The Company also conducts general construction, facilities installation, construction materials works, and mega-solar power generation. The Material Innovations Company segment engages in the sale of electrical construction materials, information equipment, construction and civil engineering materials. The Infrastructure Solutions Company segment engages in the sale of control equipment and machine tools, general construction, and the design of industrial solar power systems. The Komatsu Tochigi segment engages in the sale, maintenance, and leasing of construction machinery. The Other segment engages in renewable energy power generation and management, electricity supply and maintenance services, road milling works, and others.

name: SOMAR
businessSummary: SOMAR CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the high functional materials business, environmental materials business and food materials business. The Company has three business segments. The High Functional Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of films and other coating products, electrical insulation resins and other high functional resin products, circuit board materials and other electronic materials, as well as heat curable resins and other functional resin products. The Environmental Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial fungicides and other fine chemicals, as well as paper coating binders and other paper manufacturing chemicals. The Food Material segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of thickener, stabilizer, dehydrated vegetables and food ingredients. The Company is also engaged in the golf courses operation business, real estate rental management business, and insurance agency business.

name: SHINNIHON
businessSummary: Shinnihon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business and development business. It operates in two segments. The Construction segment undertakes, plans, designs, and constructs architectural and civil engineering works, as well as architectural and civil engineering works using mainly precast and prestressed concrete members, earthquake-resistant reinforcement work using the out-frame construction method, and large-scale repair work for condominiums. The Development segment acquires land, constructs buildings, and sells them in lots or as a package. This segment also owns and rents office buildings, manages condominiums and buildings, and owns and rents Shin-Nihon building and apartment complexes.

The company also offers sensors  switches  relays  other control units  combinations of LCD devices  connectors  condensers  and other electrical components. In addition, it develops pipe covers, insulated copper tubes, and other products for air conditioners under the INABA DENKO brand  multimedia-compatible wiring systems for newly built digital age residences under the ABANIACT brand  and provides LED status indicating lights, sound alarms, and visual and audible communication network systems and solutions under the PATLITE brand. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: EDIA
businessSummary: Edia Co., Ltd. engages in the intellectual property (IP) and publishing businesses. It engages in the IP licensing business comprising planning, development, and operation of game applications  planning, production, sales, and distribution of game, and anime-related music and drama CDs  planning, development, and provision of practical service content and applications for mobile devices  production and sales of anime and game-related goods, and online lottery services. The company also publishes light novels, comics, and e-books. Edia Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: HOCHIKI
businessSummary: Hochiki Corporation engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, consulting, engineering, design, and maintenance of fire alarm systems, fire extinguishing, crime prevention systems, and network and security systems. The company's fire alarm systems comprise automatic fire alarm systems, emergency alarm systems, fire reporting devices, fixed water sprinkler systems, apartment house automatic fire alarm systems, high sensitivity aspirating smoke detection systems, smoke control systems, and residential use smoke alarms. Its information and communication systems include TV master antenna, public address, intercom, ITV, LAN, and network camera systems. The company's security systems include intruder detection and alarm, access control, and key management systems. Its fire-extinguishing systems comprise sprinkler, hydrant, foam fire extinguishing, CO2 fire extinguishing, N2 fire extinguishing, water cannon, and tunnel fire prevention system. The company operates in Japan and internationally. Hochiki Corporation was formerly known as Tokyo Hochiki Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hochiki Corporation in July 1972. Hochiki Corporation was incorporated in 1918 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: JAPAN PETROLEUM EXPLORATION
businessSummary: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the exploration and production (EP) business. The Company operates through four regional segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the EP business in Japan, which explores, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas, as well as the sale of crude oil. The Infrastructure and Utility business is engaged in the sale of natural gas and liquefied natural gas (LNG), power generation and sales of electricity, sales of biomass fuel, and contracted transportation of natural gas. The North America segment is engaged in the EP business in North America, which explores, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas. The Europe segment is engaged in the EP business in Europe, which explores, develops, produces, and sells crude oil and natural gas. The Middle East segment is engaged in the EP business in the Middle East, which develops, produces, and sells crude oil.

name: MBS
businessSummary: Mbs Inc provides renovation services in Japan. The company offers exterior and interior renovation services for houses and buildings. It also provides Home Makeup, a system that restores the aesthetic appearance, as well as protects buildings by providing resistance to various kinds of environments  skeleton disaster prevention coating construction  the construction department, a system for new construction, renovations of interiors, plumbing, and exterior extensions  and Mobapro Check, a camera-equipped mobile phone that photographs construction status of a building for each process with a camera mobile phone and sending an email to a server on the Internet. In addition, the company undertakes construction works  develops and sells functional paintings  and offers consulting services. Mbs Inc was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Ube, Japan.

name: HOKURIKU GAS
businessSummary: Hokuriku Gas Co.,Ltd. operates gas business in Japan. The company produces, sells, and supplies gas. It also undertakes gas construction contracts  and sells gas appliances. In addition, it provides fire safety and food education classes  workplace experience programs  and factory tours, environmentally conscious cooking classes, and carbon offset events. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

name: TPR
businessSummary: TPR Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sale of engine components in Japan, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers powertrain parts, such as piston rings, cylinder liners, carbon scraper rings, valve seat, valve guide, sintered/steel seal ring, and shock absorber parts. It also provides industrial rubber parts, resin seal rings, home equipment, temperature control valves, infrared heater/related equipment, aluminum products  EV related products, such as driver and battery related products, as well as surface treatment products. In addition, the company offers carbon nano tube and nano porous material  exterior resin parts comprising radiator grille and millimeter wave radar covers  metal/molding parts, such as window molding/SUS molding and roof rails  electrical and electronic parts, including radiator grilles with illumination and telematics communication units  shock absorber parts  automotive related equipment  home equipment, life support/service related services  and CoRoMoCo, a communication support robot for use in nursing care facilities, that can measure heart rate and feelings when held. The company was formerly known as Teikoku Piston Ring Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TPR Co., Ltd. in October 2011. TPR Co., Ltd. was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KANEMITSU
businessSummary: KANEMITSU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of steel sheet pulleys for automobiles, agricultural machinery and general machinery. Steel sheet pulleys, the main product of the Company, are divided into four categories, consisting of single pulleys, double pulleys, poly-V pulleys and flat pulleys, according to the forms and cross-sectional surfaces of the belts used in the engines of automobiles. These are installed in water pumps, crankshafts, alternators, power steering, air compressors and tension regulators of the engines of automobiles. The pulleys are also used in agricultural and general machinery. Using the plastic forming technology from the development of pulleys, the Company also develops and manufactures other automobile parts for airbags and transmissions, as well as gear products, among others.

name: KYORITSU ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Kyoritsu Electric Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the intelligent factory automation (FA) system business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate properties, and other business.

name: GREENS

In addition, the Company engages in leasing and property management activities for certain owned real estate properties.

name: DAI DAN
businessSummary: Dai-Dan Co., Ltd. engages in the design, supervision, and construction of electrical, air conditioning, water hygiene, and firefighting facilities works and machinery in Japan. The company offers Hot Cure, a hospital room for immunocompromised patients  All-in-one CP unit, a cell culture processing facility  air conditioning system for hybrid operating room  MonoBooker, a system which makes the location of temporary equipment visible  brightness design solutions  CV4D, a Construction Visualizer 4D for field survey support  artificial intelligence solutions  REMOVIS, a building monitoring and management solutions  ZEB, which reduces energy consumption in buildings  and Enefice Kyushu, Enefice Shikoku, and Enefice Hokkaido buildings. name: DOSHISHA
businessSummary: Doshisha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wholesale of lifestyle-related products. It operates through two business segments. The Development Type Business Model segment sells uniform products such as audio and video (A&V) related products, home appliances and household goods, storage related products, clothing, food and alcoholic beverages. The Wholesale Type Business Model segment sells watches, bags, and assorted gifts. It also engages in real estate, licensing, logistics, nursing care and welfare services, trading, and professional services.

name: SISHIMITSU &
businessSummary: S.Ishimitsu & Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, processing, import, and sale of coffee, tea, alcoholic beverages, and foodstuffs in Japan and internationally. It imports and exports green coffee beans and manufactured coffee products from various countries, instant coffee, tea, prepared frozen foods, canned fruits, fresh and processed vegetables, seafoods, pasta, olive oil, japanese food ingredients, japanese alcoholic beverages, and others. The company is also involved in the Importation, production, processing, and sales of coffee beans of various regions  tea, alcoholic beverages, other foodstuffs, importation, exportation, and sales of liquors, foodstuffs, confectionery, and commission trade. name: LECIP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: LECIP HOLDINGS CORPORATION is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of transportation machines. The Company operates in two business segments. The Company is also engaged in electronics manufacturing service (EMS) business mainly for mounting printed circuit boards. The other business is engaged in real estate leasing business.

name: TENOX

The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business and the leasing of construction machinery. The Civil Engineering and Construction Consulting and Others segment is engaged in the provision of consultation services for civil engineering and construction, as well as brokerage services for construction properties. businessSummary: Yahagi Construction Co.,Ltd. engages in the construction, civil engineering, and real estate business in Japan. Yahagi Construction Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: TOENEC

name: MEEQ
businessSummary: MEEQ Inc. engages in the mobile IoT support business in Japan. MEEQ Inc. was formerly known as Sony Network Communications Smart Platform Inc. and changed its name to MEEQ Inc. in December 2022. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: LECIP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: LECIP Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, plans, designs, develops, manufactures, sells, and maintains transportation and industrial equipment in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers fare boxes, liquid crystal displays, and LED destination indicators, as well as automated fare collection system, transit management system, and automotive lighting, including fluorescent lamps for trucks and passenger cars. It also provides chargers and power supply equipment, as well as power solutions, such as forklifts, automated guided vehicles, emergency uninterruptible power supplies, and others. In addition, the company offers product introduction support, maintenance, and maintenance services  mount and assemble printed circuit boards. It serves buses, railways, consumer, automobiles, and industrial equipment industries. The company was formerly known as LECIP Corporation and changed its name to LECIP Holdings Corporation in October 2010. LECIP Holdings Corporation was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Motosu, Japan.

name: NANYO
businessSummary: NANYO Corporation, a general machinery trading company, distributes and rents various machineries in Japan and internationally. It operates through Industrial Equipment Business, Construction Machinery Business, and Crushed Stone Business segments. The company offers semiconductor production equipment, inspection equipment, AI and labor-saving equipment, speed reducer and hydraulic system, logistics equipment, and environment-related and other equipment  precision parts processing, FA mechatronics, and ship-related equipment  semiconductor manufacturing equipment  and fluid control systems and electronic components. It also provides various construction machineries, attachments, vehicles/trucks, forestry machinery, environment-related equipment, cranes, and other machines. In addition, the company offers ultraviolet rays irradiation systems for dicing films removal, as well as cutting robots in main sewers under the NANYO brand. Further, it manufactures and sells crushed rock. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

It also provides bathroom vanity and interior, towel rack, mirror cabinet, paper roll, and handrail products. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

businessSummary: Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. produces and sells vacuum equipment and components for quartz devices, optical thin films, and electronic devices in Japan, China, Taiwan, and internationally. Its products are used in smartphone, automobile, medical, energy, virtual reality, space, and decorative industries. The company was formerly known as Showa Shinku Kikai (Showa Vacuum Machinery) Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. in 1978. Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

The PC and Game segment is mainly involved in the sale of PCs and games; provision of support services and field services for PCs, as well as contract development of software. The Cosmetics and Sundries segment is involved in the retail of cosmetics and sundries. The Publication and Advertising segment is involved in the publication of information magazines and planning books, and the proposal of the whole advertisement and promotion services for companies.

name: TAKARA STANDARD
businessSummary: Takara Standard Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells housing equipment and fixtures in Japan. It offers kitchen products, including enamel, wooden, and compact kitchen systems  enamel kitchen panels, heating equipment, and range hoods  bathroom products comprising bath system, shower units, and standalone bathtubs. The company also provides bathroom vanity products, such as enamel vanity, wooden vanity, compact hand wash, enamel clean wash panels, residential toilet panels, enamel clean toilet panels, hand washing basins, and various storage devices. The Company also provides various maintenance, repair, and other ancillary services, as well as long-term warranty services. In addition to directly managed stores, the Company sells directly to customers through franchise stores and e-commerce.

name: ITFOR
