name: MEIHO ENTERPRISE
businessSummary: MEIHO ENTERPRISE CO., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Real Estate Allotment Sale segment is engaged in the allotment sale of condominiums developed by the Company, the renovation and sale of pre-owned condominiums, the development of attached house and town house, as well as the allotment sale of properties as its joint venture business. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases condominiums and buildings. The Real Estate Brokerage segment is involved in the brokerage business of land for condominium use, as well as other brokerage businesses. The Others segment provides real estate leasing-related services, such as the acquisition of construction management fee and other various consulting reward.

name: OTEC
businessSummary: OTEC CORPORATION is mainly engaged in the sale of pipe equipment and materials. The Company operates in three business segments. The Pipe Equipment and Material Sales segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of steel pipes, joints, valves, sanitary ware and housing equipment. The Construction segment is engaged in the instrumentation works, electric works and maintenance works for both new and existing buildings. The Environment-related Equipment Sales segment is engaged in the sale of environment-related equipment. As of March 31, 2015, the Company had six subsidiaries, one associated company and one affiliated company.

name: SANKYO
businessSummary: Sankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pachinko machine related business, pachislot machine related business, and replenishment equipment related business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Pachinko Machine-related Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pachinko machines and gauge boards for pachinko machines, the sale of related parts, and acquisition of royalties income related to pachinko machines. The Pachislot Machine-related Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pachislot machines, the sale of related parts, and acquisition of royalties income related to pachislot machines. The Supply Equipment-related Business segment is engaged in the sale of pachinko/pachislot supply equipment, card system equipment, hall equipment peripheral equipment. It also provides mobile content services, real estate rental, sales of general molded parts.

name: JAPAN INSULATION
businessSummary: Japan Insulation Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of calcium silicate products in Japan. It also manufactures and sells non-combustible building materials  sells heat-retaining and cold-insulating materials, as well as designs and carries out heat-retaining, cold-insulating, insulating, and fire-resistant construction work. The company also offers thermal insulation materials for plant equipment, fire-resistant cladding materials for plant equipment, fire-resistant cladding materials for the design of general buildings, non-combustible interior materials for the design of general buildings, mold material for CFRP, humidity conditioning building materials, board for carving out letters and sculptures, and lightweight inorganic powder. Japan Insulation Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: NAKABAYASHI
businessSummary: Nakabayashi Co., Ltd engages in the business process solution, consumer-communication, office appliance, energy, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Business Process Solutions Business, Consumer Communications Business, and Energy Business segments. The Business Process Solutions Business segment offers BPO services, such as printing, data printing, bookbinding, library, and building solutions, as well as temporary staffing services  and manufactures and sells notebooks. The Consumer Communications Business segment offers notebooks, albums, files, storage and organization supplies, gadget accessories, printer paper, child seats, shredders, bookbinding machines, electronic medical record carts, IV stands, and others. It also sells office furniture, and wooden furniture, as well as recycles wastepaper. The Energy Business segment offers wood biomass power generation and solar power generation. The company offers shredder, note tool, PC peripheral equipment, smartphone, silver, the game relation, digital camera relate, office supplies, digital stationery, stuffed animal and child seat, character series products, store and arrangement, document scanning, and disaster prevention security. Nakabayashi Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Nakabayashi Bookbinding and Printing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nakabayashi Co., Ltd. in October 1970. Nakabayashi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: MORIYA
businessSummary: MORIYA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, civil engineering business and other related business. The Company operates through three business segments. Construction segment and Civil Engineering segment is involved in the construction business, civil engineering business and conducts contract business related to other general construction work. Real Estate segment is engaged in business related to real estate such as purchase, sale, rental and mediation of real estate. The Company is also engaged in the management of golf courses.

name: TACHIKAWA
businessSummary: Tachikawa Corporation designs, manufactures, markets, sells, and installs various window covering products, centered around blinds and room partitions primarily in Japan. The company offers vertical and venetian blinds, roller blinds, roman shades, transitional blinds, pleated blinds, wood blinds, partition walls, accordion doors, curtain rails, and other window coverings and interior finishing products for home, office, and public buildings. It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of parking systems, geared motors, motorized panel louvers, and movable partitions, as well as offers residential, office, and public facility solutions. The company was formerly known as Tachikawa Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tachikawa Corporation in October 1947. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

isin: 7283.T|Aisan Industry Co., Ltd.|7283.T|Aisan Industry Co., Ltd.
name: AISAN INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Aisan Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers fuel pumps, fuel pump modules, throttle bodies, EGR valves, intake manifolds, canisters and fuel tank close valves, and engine valves for internal combustion engines. It also provides injector, titanium engine valves, and charcoal canisters for motorcycles  and hydrogen supply unit, air valve, and gas fuel systems for LPG and CNG, as well as offers engine calibration tests. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Obu, Japan.

isin: 6929.T|Nippon Ceramic Co., Ltd.|6929.T|Nippon Ceramic Co., Ltd.
name: NIPPON CERAMIC
businessSummary: Nippon Ceramic Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells ceramic sensors, modules, and other products in Japan and internationally. It offers pyroelectric IR, and thermopile infrared sensors  closed and open type ultrasonic sensors  automotive and industrial equipment current sensors  NDIR CO2 sensors  and InSb and GaAs hall elements, as well as Hall IC, a magnetic sensor. The company also provides active infrared sensors  human detection sensors for light control  human detection sensor modules  LED power supplies and modules  remote transmitters  infrared flame detection sensors  and original sensor lights. It serves automotive, home electronics, and housing sectors. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tottori, Japan.

name: DAIKO TSUSAN
businessSummary: DAIKO TSUSAN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the purchase and sale of various products for cable television (CATV) and information communication network. The Company is involved in the manufacture of various goods purchased from domestic and foreign manufacturers, such as wire and cable manufacturers, telecommunications machine equipment manufacturers and metal product manufacturers, for communication construction contractors, telecommunications carriers, electric power companies and government agencies. The products purchased by the Company are classified mainly as cables, materials, and equipment, and are used for indoor communication work, outdoor communication work, electric power construction at the sales destination. Cable products include local area network (LAN) & wide area network (WAN) cable, coaxial cable, optical cable. Material products include connecting materials, overhead wire hardware, and in-house lead-in & wiring materials.

name: KOYOU RENTIA
businessSummary: KOYOU RENTIA Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the rental business, space design business and product sales business. The Company has three business segments. The Rental Related segment is engaged in the rental of furniture, fixtures and equipment (FF&E) and office automation (OA) equipment for construction site offices, events and corporations, as well as the provision of solar power generation systems rental services, information and communication technology ( ICT) environmental maintenance work and interior work, office relocation services and real estate brokerage services, and the storage, maintenance, delivery and sale of rental products. The Space Design segment is engaged in the rental of furniture for condominium galleries, the design and construction of condominium galleries, the interior modification work and condominium renovation work. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of office furniture and equipment to government agencies.

name: MATSUI CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: MATSUI CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction work, real estate business and sales of building materials. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the construction and civil engineering businesses, including contracting for construction work, ordering part of construction work and receiving orders for construction work. The Real Estate segment is involved in the sale of the real estate land and buildings, the leases housing and rental offices business , the sale of building materials, as well as the private finance initiative (PFI) business.

name: FUJIKURA COMPOSITES
businessSummary: FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber components in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Materials, Fabric Processing Products, Sporting Goods, and Other segments. The company manufactures and sells industrial materials, including pneumatic control equipment, anti-vibration table and peripheral equipment, electrical and electronic equipment, rescue and lifesaving equipment, and carbon golf shafts. It also offers gas/water housing equipment, connection materials, and materials for speakers. In addition, the company provides automobiles, such as check valves  automotive parts  calendared rubber  industrial equipment, including duct quarter vent rubber/butterfly, and BF and AB cylinders  calendared rubber, such as anti-vibration system, rubber coated fabric, and pressure regulator  ultra-low hardness material and anti-vibration rubber products  paper roll airbags  conductive rubber, and textile/material for clothing. Further, it offers emergency magnesium air batteries  blade protective sheets for wind turbine  various functional tapes and molded products, cold shrink tube, and conservators for electric  LIM molded products  dialyzers, infusion, and blood circuits  check valves  regulator  flow control valve  latex products  disaster-relief tents, air tents, and inflatable life rafts and jackets  golf shaft for golf clubs  caravan shoes for trekking, hiking, trail running, and nordic walking  stream walking and climbing  and climbing/bouldering shoes. The company was formerly known as Fujikura Rubber Ltd. and changed its name to FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. in April 2019. FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: SPACE
businessSummary: SPACE CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the environmental production, exhibition and display of commercial facilities, as well as the planning, development, design, supervision, and construction of cultural and sports facilities, complex commercial facilities, corporate identity (CI) and graphics. The Company operates Display business. The Company provides interior and exterior works, event and exhibition works, architectural work, maintenance work, planning, design and interior supervision service. By market segment, the Company includes complex commercial facilities and general supermarkets, food supermarkets and convenience stores, various specialty stores, restaurants and services.

isin: 6994.T|Shizuki Electric Company Inc.|6994.T|Shizuki Electric Company Inc.
name: SHIZUKI ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Shizuki Electric Company Inc. provides capacitors, and related equipment and facilities in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It offers power factor correction products, harmonic filters, and voltage sag compensators  and AC and DC filter capacitors, and snubber capacitors for automotive inverters, power electronics circuits, and home appliances. The company also provides electrical machinery and equipment. Shizuki Electric Company Inc. was founded in 1939 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.

name: HELIOS TECHNO HOLDING
businessSummary: Helios Techno Holding Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the lamp business and the manufacturing equipment business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Lamp segment manufactures and sells industrial lamps and light-emitting diode (LED) lamps. The Manufacturing Equipment segment manufactures and sells alignment film printing equipment, specialty printing machines, light source units for ultraviolet (UV) exposure equipment, and inspection and measurement equipment.

name: NIPPON INFORMATION DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Nippon Information Development Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the embedded solution business, information and communication technology (ICT) innovation business, financial system business, network solution business and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. The Embedded Solutions segment is engaged in the development and design of embedded software to customers. The ICT Innovation Business is engaged in the design and development of communication systems for customers. The Financial Systems segment provides financial business software to customers in the fields of life and non-life insurance, credit and securities, information and services. The Network Solution segment provides services such as system construction, infrastructure construction, security services, system maintenance and operation. The Others segment is involved in three businesses including data solutions business, product business and staffing business.

name: RYOYU SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Ryoyu Systems Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in provision of information services. The Company's main business can be divided into the design, development, operation and maintenance of information communication systems, the sale of information communication system related equipment. The Company is also engaged in the design, analysis and simulation of industrial products, as well as provision of information processing services using information communication systems.

name: SPORTSFIELD
businessSummary: Sportsfield Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in sports personnel recruitment support business. The Company is engaged in sale support business, human resource introduction business and recruitment outsourcing business with its subsidiaries. Sports personnel recruitment support business can be divided into new graduate business (for new graduates) and mid-career business (for graduates). The new graduate business is for active athlete students, and mid-career business is for adults with experience in sports and competitions and retired professional and amateur athletes. The business is classified into event business for new graduates, human resource introduction business for new graduates, and human resource introduction business for existing graduates. Through these businesses, the Company is involved in the match of sports people with companies that want to hire sports people.

isin: 3486.T|Global Link Management Inc.|3486.T|Global Link Management Inc.
name: GLOBAL LINK MANAGEMENT
businessSummary: Global Link Management Inc. operates as a real estate solution company in Japan. The company engages in investment, design, development, sales, and management of mansions. The company is also involved in management of properties and rental management business. It engages in real estate building, land planning, revitalization and development business. The company constructs hotels, office buildings, and commercial facilities. Global Link Management Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PROGRIT
businessSummary: PROGRIT Inc. provides English coaching and subscription-based English learning services in Japan. It offers Progrit, an English coaching service  Progrit FOR ENTERPRISE, a custom-made English training for corporations that provides a range of services, including identifying issues, conducting training, and follow-up support  Shadow Ten, a subscription shadowing and correction service to improve listening skills  Spiffle, a subscription service to improve English speaking skills through oral English composition and one-minute speeches  and Dear Talk, an English conversation service. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: OKUMURA ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Okumura Engineering corp. engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of various valves for industrial, building, and marine applications. It offers butterfly, high-performance butterfly, knife gate, pinch, and check valves. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Yasu, Japan.

name: DMS
businessSummary: DMS Inc. engages in direct mail service business in Japan. It offers direct marketing services, including planning and production, direct mail target optimization, mailing, personalized direct mail, and delivery services  web marketing services, such as Website and mobile site development  and logistics services, which includes shipping service for E-commerce and mail order businesses, gift campaign logistics services, and logistics for sales promotion support. The company also provides back-office support services, such as call center, data entry, telephone communication services, and other back-office solutions. In addition, it offers sales promotion solutions comprising POP display, poster, and vertical banner advertisement creation  promotional item creation  flyer delivery services  sample product delivery services  and niche media covering enclosed advertisements, etc. Further, the company is involved in planning, producing, creating, and managing sales promotion, sports and cultural, and campus events, as well as leasing services. It also designs planning, performance, production and operations for sporting events, local government projects, exhibitions, fireworks shows, ceremonies and contests, and school events. DMS Inc. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: HALOWS
businessSummary: Halows Co.,Ltd. engages in the operation of food supermarkets. It operates in Hiroshima, Okayama, Kagawa, Ehime, Tokushima, Hyogo, Yamaguchi, and Kochi prefectures. The company was formerly known as Fuchu Supermarket Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Halows Co.,Ltd. in March 1988. Halows Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Tsukubo, Japan.

name: KONOIKE TRANSPORT
businessSummary: Konoike Transport Co.,Ltd. engages in logistics business in Japan and internationally. The company also provides value-added services in the steel industry  repair and maintenance services of manufacturing facilities  design, creation, and processing of plant equipment, as well as installation and maintenance work  receiving and preparing raw materials, packaging, and conducting equipment inspection  temperature-controlled logistics services  and support services at airports. In addition, it is involved in contract operations of maintenance, construction, and manufacture of chemicals, gases, and housing facilities  storage and distribution of various materials, general apparel merchandise, and daily necessities  refurbishment and coating of industrial air conditioners  provision of renewable energy services  solar power generation and other PPA projects  transportation of industrial gas tank trucks and machine tools  inspection, maintenance, and mechanic support for imported automobiles  manufacture and sale of frozen fishery processed foodstuff. Further, the company engages in the import/export cargo warehousing and transportation of cargo  railway transportation of containers and automobiles  cleaning and sterilization outsourcing of medical devices  contracting operations of in-hospital logistics  operating room assistance  sales of various systems  and provision of management support and other services. Konoike Transport Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1880 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 3201.T|The Japan Wool Textile Co., Ltd.|3201.T|The Japan Wool Textile Co., Ltd.
name: JAPAN WOOL TEXTILE
businessSummary: The Japan Wool Textile Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of apparel textile products in Japan. It operates through four segments: Textiles, Industrial Equipment, People and Future Development, and Lifestyle Distribution. The company offers uniform materials for schools, private companies, and government offices  clothing materials  yarns  bedding, airline blankets, and disaster supply blankets  lifestyle appliances and miscellaneous goods  goods for 100-yen shops  furniture  privacy filters for tablets and laptops  stamping ink and stamps  equestrian equipment  and knitting yarn. It also provides FA equipment, interior materials and cushioning, thread for airbags and seatbelts, and motor binding materials for automotive industry  filters for environmental industry  OA and home appliance materials, semiconductor-related and imaging equipment, and carpets for homes, offices, and trade shows for other industries  and racket sports, fishing, materials for musical instruments, and medical nonwoven fabric for lifestyle related industries. In addition, the company is involved in management of shopping centers  real estate leasing  sales of solar energy  construction business  childcare and after-school childcare services  nursing care and sports related services  and sale of containers, as well as operates insurance agency. The Japan Wool Textile Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: ALPHAPOLIS
businessSummary: AlphaPolis Co., Ltd. engages in site management and books publishing businesses in Japan. The company publishes light novels, anime, and paperbacks, as well as other books comprising general novels, manga, and other content  and translation publications of overseas books. It also operates Alphapolis, a platform for viewing content, such as novels. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 5021.T|Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd.|5021.T|Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: COSMO ENERGY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the petroleum business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Petroleum, Petrochemical, Oil Exploration and Production, and Renewable Energy. The Petroleum segment produces and sells gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, crude oil, lubricating oil, liquefied petroleum gas, and asphalt. The Petrochemical segment produces and sells ethylene, mixed xylene, and petrochemical solvents. The Oil Exploration and Production segment develops, produces, and sells crude oil. The Renewable Energy segment supplies and sells electricity generated by wind power. It is also involved in planning in the energy exploration and production business  imports and exports, refining, storage, and sales of crude oil and petroleum products, etc.  sells oil products  vehicle leasing and low-carbon solutions  marine transportation and shipping agency business. In addition, the company engages in the provision of oil storage, receiving, shipping works  manufacture, storage, transport, sale, import, and export of LP gas  oil receiving and shipping  waste incineration management, experiment, inspection, guard and security  distribution terminal, port, operation of service stations  electricity retailing  accounting, finance, purchasing, general affairs, and human resources related business outsourcing services  wind power generation business  engineering, construction and maintenance for industrial facilities  and general trading. Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: YAMAU HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yamau Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Yamau Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of concrete products. The Company has seven business segments. The Concrete Product Manufacturing and Sale segment provides civil engineering products and landscape products. The Floodgate and Weir Manufacturing, Construction and Maintenance segment provides steel structures such as floodgates, and construction and maintenance services. The Geological Survey, Consultant and Civil Engineering segment provides geological survey services. The Information Equipment Sale and Maintenance segment sells and maintains processing support equipment. The Concrete Structure Inspection, Investigation and Repair segment provides inspection, investigation and repair services for concrete structures. The Real Estate segment leases real estate. The Bridge and Elevated Road Telescopic Device Manufacturing, Sale and Installing segment provides telescopic devices for bridges and elevated roads.

name: AUTO SERVER
businessSummary: Auto Server Co., Ltd. provides internet based used car distribution services in Japan. The company operates ASNET, a car distribution platform that offers web based services, including auction agency services, such as bidding, POS push bids, price negotiations, and other related services  brokering trade sales of instore inventory  and retail support services, as well as e commerce services. It is also involved in buying and listing cars  car part sales  and convenient services comprising direct search, market price information, automatic land transport arrangement, e mail service, English mode, auto loans, and used car warranties. In addition, the company plans, develops, sells, and maintains computer systems. It serves automobile sales, auto maintenance, auto parts suppliers, and gas station industries. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: NIPPON RIETEC
businessSummary: Nippon Rietec Co.,Ltd. engages in the railway electrical equipment construction business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Electrical Equipment Construction  Sideline  and Real Estate Rental. The company offers signal equipment, train track equipment, power generation and transformation equipment, electric light and power equipment, and information and communication system constructions, as well as transmission line equipment. It also constructs signage and landscape signs, traffic signals, and road information control systems. In addition, the company provides indoor/outdoor electric installation work, and solar power generation systems  and overhead power line and information and communication facilities, as well as leases land and buildings. Nippon Rietec Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOGAMI ELECTRIC MFG
businessSummary: Togami Electric Mfg. Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric machinery and other general machinery and equipment, as well as the provision of the undertakes construction work and incidental business activities. The Company is engaged in the provision of total support business from design and proposal of solar power generation system to construction and inspection including high voltage control equipment, exploration and measurement equipment, switchboards and environmental equipment business. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of electronic controllers, high-voltage switches for distribution, switchboards and system equipment, as well as the development of the software for electronic controllers, switchboards and system equipment. The Company is also involved in the provision of the dispatch information processing engineers and the training for computer personnel.

name: TKC
businessSummary: TKC Corporation operates as a specialized electronic data processing center for accounting firms and local governments in Japan. It operates through Accounting Firm Business, Local Government Business, and Printing Business segments. It is involved in the provision of information processing, software, and consulting services, as well as desk services  and sale of office equipment and supplies. It also provides printed continuous business forms  manufactures office supplies  development and sale of software  publishes books and monthly magazines on business management, taxation, and accounting  and provides security, maintenance, and repair services for buildings. In addition, the company manufactures and sells general office forms  and provides data printing services. The company was formerly known as Tochigi Prefecture Computing Center Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TKC Corporation in December 1986. TKC Corporation was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

name: MITANI
businessSummary: MITANI CORPORATION is a Japan-based manufacturing company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Information Systems-related segment is engaged in the sale of information systems equipment, the development of software, as well as the maintenance of equipment and devices. The Corporate Supply-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction materials, petroleum products and liquefied petroleum (LP) gas products, the manufacture and sale of gondola machinery, wind power generation business, sales and processing of plastic products, processing and sales of spices, as well as the rental business. The Lifestyle and Regional Services-related segment is engaged in the provision of information communications services such as cable television and Internet provider services, the operation of nursing homes, car dealerships, the production and sales of ready-mixed concrete, gas station operations, sales of LP gas and housing equipment, among others.

name: INNOTECH
businessSummary: Innotech Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the import and sale of electronic design automation software, electric components, and semiconductor products in Japan, China, and internationally. The company also develops and sells testers and CPU boards. It provides industrial boards/embedded systems, environmental boards/systems, EDA and OrCAD software, servers/storage solutions, noise analysis solutions, model-based development solutions, digital media analysis and inspection solutions, testers/probe cards, face recognition AI solution, and robot automation services. In addition, it is involved in the sale of quality verification software for media workflows  noise analysis  and model-based development consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: LIFE
businessSummary: Life Corporation operates a chain of supermarkets in Japan. The company sells food products, daily necessities, and clothing. It is also involved in the credit card business. The company was formerly known as Lifestore Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Life Corporation in May 1991. Life Corporation was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: OYO
businessSummary: OYO Corporation provides geological survey services in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Disaster Prevention and Infrastructure, Environment and Energy, and International. The Disaster Prevention and Infrastructure engages in surveying and restoration design of areas damaged by natural disasters  forecasting damage, such as earthquakes, tsunamis, fires, etc. related to national and local governments disaster prevention plans  consulting on natural disaster risk surveys, loss forecasting, and countermeasures related to corporate business continuity plans  and building, installing, and updating monitoring systems related to natural disasters, including seismometer networks and volcano monitoring systems. This segment also offers inspection, diagnosis, and maintenance services for social infrastructure  survey, design, and measurement services for the development of resilient infrastructure  develops, sells, constructs, installs, and renews non-destructive testing products used for inspections and diagnoses  and constructs, installs, and renews environmental monitoring systems. The Environment and Energy segment provides consulting on surveys and countermeasures focusing on soil and groundwater contamination, asbestos, waste, etc.  surveys and consulting for global warming countermeasures and biodiversity conservation  geological survey consulting related to the construction, installation, and renewal of environmental monitoring systems  methane hydrate development research  support for the commercialization of renewable energy  Undersea3D resource exploration services  and develops and sells resource exploration equipment and systems. The International segment develops, manufactures, and sells non-destructive testing equipment and seismic observation systems, geophysical exploration equipment  and offers survey, design, and construction management services. OYO Corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 9543.T|Shizuoka Gas Co., Ltd.|9543.T|Shizuoka Gas Co., Ltd.
name: SHIZUOKA GAS
businessSummary: Shizuoka Gas Co., Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells city gas in Japan. It operates through Gas, and LPG and Other Energy Services segments. The company sells and supplies gas and liquefied natural gas  liquefied petroleum gas and related equipment  and provides on-site energy services. It is also involved in equipment installation and contract work. Further, the company sells gas appliances  and undertakes contracts for gas related construction works. The company was incorporated in 1910 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

name: CANARE ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Canare Electric Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cables, harnesses, connectors, equipment (passive and electronic) and supplementary equipment for broadcasting and communication applications. The Company operates through six geogrephical segments, including Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, Taiwan and Singapore. The Company’s main products include broadcasting cables and connectors such as optical transmission systems, cables, connectors, patch panels and others, AV & console solutions such as lecture desks, AV wagons, terminal boards, AV outlets and others, Digital network products such as network storage and AV-over-IP system, optical devices such as beam profilers and laser-related products.

name: FJ NEXT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: FJ Next Holdings Co Ltd operates primarily in the Tokyo metropolitan area, focusing on real estate sales. The Company operates in four business segments. The Real Estate Development segment mainly develops, sells, and leases the Gala Condominium Series, as well as the Gala Residence Series, and also sells, brokers, acquires, and leases used condominiums in the Tokyo metropolitan area. It also develops, sells, brokers, acquires, and leases real estate in the Izu area. The Real Estate Management segment mainly undertakes rental management for condominium unit owners and building management contracts for management associations. It also manages villa areas in the Izu area. The Construction segment mainly designs, constructs, inspects, and renovates buildings. The Japanese Inn segment operates the hot spring inns in the Izu area of ​​Shizuoka Prefecture.

name: AXIAL RETAILING
businessSummary: Axial Retailing Inc. operates supermarkets in Japan. It also offers information processing and software development, cleaning, insurance agency, and manufacturing and printing services, as well as engages in the planning and production of various media, real estate management, and advertising agency activities. The company was formerly known as Harashin Narus Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Axial Retailing Inc. in October 2013. Axial Retailing Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Nagaoka, Japan.

name: ENDO LIGHTING
businessSummary: ENDO Lighting Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the lighting equipment-related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Lighting Equipment-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various lighting equipment. The Environment-related segment is involved in the sale of energy saving products, as well as the rental of lighting equipment and energy saving products. The Interior Furniture segment is engaged in the sales of interior furniture and supplies.

name: NICHIRIN
businessSummary: Nichirin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of various automotive hoses, including steering, braking, and air conditioning hoses. The Company operates in five segments based on region: Japan, North America, China, Asia, and Europe. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive hoses and non-ferrous metal materials (molybdenum, vanadium and others). The North America, China, Asia, and Europe segments manufacture and sell automotive hoses.

name: DAIKYONISHIKAWA
businessSummary: DaikyoNishikawa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Company operates in four segments based on region. It procures raw materials from trading companies and manufactures automotive parts such as instrument panels and bumpers, and housing parts such as bus unit components, and sells them to automobile manufacturers and housing equipment manufacturers. The Japan segment develops, manufactures, and sells automotive plastic parts, manufactures and sells housing equipment, designs and produces molding dies and precision jigs, provides life and non-life insurance agency services, and provides temporary staffing services. The North America segment and the ASEAN segment manufacture and sell automotive plastic parts. The China and Korea segment manufactures and sells automotive plastic parts, and designs and develops plastic parts, including automotive part design and technical services.

name: KYOKUTO BOEKI KAISHA
businessSummary: Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. is mainly engaged in businesses related to the Industrial Equipment, Industrial Materials and Machinery Components segments. The Company operates through three business segments. The Industrial Equipment segment sells heavy electrical equipment, steel, resource development and other related products. The Industrial Materials segment sells resins and coatings, composite materials, food-related products and thermal spray materials. The Machinery Components segment sells precision fasteners (screws), related machinery, equipment and tools, and marine repair parts, as well as manufactures and sells constant force springs and other products.

name: EAGLE INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, and sells mechanical seals, special valves, and other sealed products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through the Automobile and Construction Machinery Industries, General Industrial Machinery, Semiconductor Industry, Marine Industry, and Aerospace Industry segments. It offers mechanical, gas, aerospace, magnetic fluid vacuum, segmented, stern tube, brush, and lip seals. The company also provides metal gaskets, O-rings, accumulators, actuators, aerospace, bearings, tanks, coupling, joint, valves, filters, metal bellows, thin-walled metal parts, supply systems, hydraulic regeneration systems, and flow meters. It serves oil and gas  construction, agriculture, and transporter  automobiles  energy  aerospace  pulp and paper  housing equipment  food and beverage and pharmaceutical  water and irrigation  refinery and petrochemical  marine  steel  and semiconductor industries. The company was formerly known as Nihon Sealol Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. in June 1978. Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Eagle Industry Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of NOK Group Corporation.

name: YURTEC
businessSummary: Yurtec Corporation operates as a facility engineering company in Japan and internationally. It designs, constructs, maintains, and manages construction of electrical power facilities  information and telecommunication facilities for private companies, public offices, and electrical power companies  infrastructures for living and community environments  and air conditioning and plumbing facilities, such as water supply, drainage, and sanitary facilities. The company also designs, installs, maintains, and manages electrical facilities in various buildings, including office buildings, factories, public facilities, hospitals, schools, and shopping malls  develops renewable energy facilities  and renews aged facilities. Yurtec Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

name: KAWADA TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: KAWADA TECHNOLOGIES, INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in bridge, steel structure, civil engineering, and construction-related businesses. The Company operates through four reportable segments. Its Steel Structures segment designs, manufactures, erects, and sells steel bridges, structural steel frames, and steel products. Its Civil Engineering segment provides the design, manufacture and erection of prestressed concrete (PC) bridges and pre-stressed beam bridges, as well as bridge maintenance works. The Construction segment is engaged in the design and construction of general buildings and modular buildings. The Solutions segment is engaged in the development and sale of software and system equipment, structural analysis and design of bridges and other structures, and the manufacture and sale of industrial robots.

name: SAKATA INX
businessSummary: Sakata INX Corporation manufactures and sells various printing inks and auxiliary agents in Japan, Asia, the America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers gravure inks, flexographic inks, powder color toners, offset inks, industrial inject inks, functional coating materials, newspaper inks, and pigment dispersion for color fillers  and metal inks for equipment, machines, and consumables. It is also involved in the sale of printing plate-making and related equipment, and electronic apparatus and information-related equipment  manufacture and sale of various printing inks and auxiliary agents, and manufacture and sale of digital and specialty products. Sakata INX Corporation was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
