name: NISSEI ASB MACHINE
businessSummary: Nissei ASB Machine Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, manufacturing, and distribution of production machines for PET and other plastic bottles worldwide. It provides stretch blow molding machines, molds, and auxiliary equipment and parts. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Komoro, Japan.

isin: 6617.T|Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd.|6617.T|Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd.
name: TAKAOKA TOKO
businessSummary: Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in power equipment, metering, GX solutions, and applied optical inspection equipment businesses. It manufactures and sells applied macromolecular electric equipment and components  SCADA systems for electric power networks  and electric equipment, as well as undertakes electrical engineering and construction works, and power lines and telecommunication construction works. The company also engages in the transportation and logistics business  installation of high-voltage instrument transformers  and development, manufacture, and sale of electric power meters, gas instrument transformers, and mold products. In addition, it manufactures and sells thin client systems and develops custom computer software, as well as develops computer and embedded software  rents real estate, such as buildings  and offers energy measurement and control devices, chargers for electric vehicles, and three-dimensional inspection equipment. The company was formerly known as Takaoka Toko Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd. in April 2014. Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of TEPCO Power Grid, Incorporated.

name: TAIKISHA
businessSummary: Taikisha Ltd is principally engaged in the environmental systems business and painting systems business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Environmental Systems segment offers general air-conditioning facilities for offices, schools, hotels, stores, research institutes, theaters, halls, hospitals and residential homes, as well as the industrial air-conditioning facilities for clean rooms in factories that manufacture semiconductors, electronic components, precision machinery, pharmaceuticals, foodstuffs and others. The Painting Systems segment provides the painting facilities for factories that manufacture vehicle bodies, bumpers, railway vehicles, construction vehicles and airplanes.

name: NIHON SUIDO CONSULTANTS
businessSummary: Nihon Suido Consultants Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water supply and sewerage related construction consulting business. In the development of social infrastructure such as lifelines such as water supply and sewerage, and disaster prevention related to rivers and erosion control, the Company mainly receives orders from public agencies and other public institutions and provides technical consulting related to surveys and designs. The Company is also engaged in the construction consulting business for river, environment, architecture, and the mechanical and electrical. Overseas, the Company also operates in Southeast Asia, India, and Africa.

name: KASUMIGASEKI CAPITAL
businessSummary: Kasumigaseki Capital Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company provides services related to real estate development, asset management, and real estate investment. The Company operates through a single Real Estate Consulting Business segment. Its hotel business focuses on the development and operation of brands such as fav, FAV LUX, and BASE LAYER HOTEL. The logistics business involves the development of refrigerated and frozen warehouses, including automated frozen storage facilities. The healthcare business entails the development and operation of healthcare facilities, such as hospice residences. Its overseas operations center on residential and real estate development projects, primarily in Dubai. Additionally, the Company provides fund management, project management, and asset management services for development and real estate funds.

name: JANOME
businessSummary: JANOME Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells sewing machines in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Household Appliances, Industrial Equipment, IT-Related, and Others. The company offers sewing and embroidery machines, overlocker, and CoverPro  and desktop robots, servo presses, and die-cast products. It also engages in IT software and information processing services  and real estate rental. The company was formerly known as Janome Sewing Machine Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JANOME Corporation in October 2021. JANOME Corporation was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Hachioji, Japan.

name: SHOWA PAXXS
businessSummary: SHOWA PAXXS CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaging-related products. The Company has five business segments. The Heavy-duty Packaging Bag segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bags for petroleum chemical products, cement and ceramic products, chemical agents, agricultural products, fertilizers and food products, among others. The Film Product segment manufactures and sells film products for thermal contraction packaging, pallet packaging, agriculture use and secondary processing use. The Container segment provides flexible containers, bulk containers and others. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of buildings and warehouses. The Other segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of packaging materials, machinery and other related products, as well as the management of buildings and the non-life insurance agency business.

isin: 8167.T|Retail Partners Co., Ltd.|8167.T|Retail Partners Co., Ltd.
name: RETAIL PARTNERS
businessSummary: Retail Partners Co., Ltd. engages in the management and operation of supermarket businesses in Japan. The company was formerly known as Marukyu Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Retail Partners Co., Ltd. in July 2015. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Hofu, Japan.

name: TANABE ENGINEERING
businessSummary: TANABE ENGINEERING CORPORATION is a company mainly engaged in the provision of facility construction works. The Company operates in two business segments. The Facility Construction segment is engaged in the construction of industrial plant facilities, such as plant facilities, environmental equipment, various laborsaving device systems and automatic equipment; plant maintenance facilities, electricity instrumentation, power transmission and piping works. The Surface Treatment segment is engaged in the surface treatment activities in Thailand. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of industrial furnaces for metal casting, as well as the import and sale of industrial equipment.

name: AI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Ai Holdings Corporation operate in security equipment, card machines and other office equipment, information equipment, measuring instruments, telecommunications, architectural design, and other business sectors in Japan, the United States, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers surveillance cameras and recorders for banks, governmental facilities, shopping districts, retail shops, and other facilities, as well as installation and after-sales services  card issuing system and specialized CAD software for steel structures  and systems for medical institutions to general-purpose systems, such as magnetic card readers, ID cards, and cards with embedded IC chips. The company also provides cutting plotters for professional and home use  measuring instruments for voltage, current, temperature, humidity, pulse, and data captures  cloud storage products  and office-oriented business phones for general corporate offices, nursing care facilities, medical facilities, factory plants, mass retailers, and commercial facilities, as well as an optimal communications system for small-to-large-scale business establishments. In addition, it develops, manufactures, and sells the Ai-Glies demand control and energy conservation systems, which reduce electric power consumption and power usage fees for air conditioners  and offers architectural design and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing engineering services, as well as engages in the IoT promotion business, such as IoT, high-speed communications (5G/6G), digital transformations (DX), and AI-based automation. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: JVCKENWOOD
businessSummary: JVCKENWOOD Corporation manufactures and sells products in the mobility and telematics services, public service, and media service sectors in Japan and internationally. The Mobility & Telematics Services Sector segment manufactures and sells car AV systems, car navigation systems, car audio systems, dashcams, in-vehicle devices, etc., as well as telematics solutions. The Safety and Security segment manufactures and sells Professional radio equipment, amateur radio equipment, professional video surveillance equipment, and professional audio equipment, etc., as well as engages in manufacturing and sales of medical image display monitors. The Entertainment segment offers Projectors, headphones, home audio equipment, portable power supplies, and professional video equipment  cameras  CDs and DVDs (packaged software), etc.  and production of cage software, and audio and video software, content distribution, etc. The Others segment provides service parts, etc. The company also provides contract manufacturing services of electronic devices. The company sells its products under the JVC, Victor, and KENWOOD brands. The company was formerly known as JVC KENWOOD Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to JVCKENWOOD Corporation in August 2011. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: TSUBAKIMOTO CHAIN
businessSummary: Tsubakimoto Chain Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of drive chains, conveyor chains, reducers, linear actuators, engine timing chain systems, and conveying, sorting, and storage systems. The Company operates four segments. The Chain segment includes drive chains, small conveyor chains, large conveyor chains, plastic modular chains, top chains and others. The Motion Control segment includes reducers, linear actuators, shaft couplings, fasteners, clutches, electrical control devices, mechanical overload protection devices, and others. The Mobility segment includes engine timing chain systems (cam drives, accessory drives), transfer case chains and others. The Material Handling segment provides systems for the logistics industry, life sciences, newspaper printing plants, automotive, and other transport, sorting, and others. The Company also engages in building maintenance, insurance agency services, and new business ventures.

name: TAKIHYO
businessSummary: Takihyo Co., Ltd. engages in the apparel, retail, textile, lifestyle, real estate, and material businesses in Japan and internationally. The company plans, designs, produces, markets, and ships ladies, babies/kids, men's, and relaxation wear. It also operates the sportswear brand ZOY, the men's wear brand BOB, and the G/FORE and WAAC brands for golf gloves, shoes, accessories, and apparel  operates a boutique under the Melangetop brand name  and produces and sells woolen fabric, synthetic cotton blends, and knits to apparel manufacturers and trading companies. In addition, the company offers natural cosmetics products under L'ERBOLARIO brand  operates Komeda Coffee Shop as a franchisee  and rents and manages real estate properties. Further, it provides packaging films  synthetic resins for automobile, electronic equipment, electric appliances, and space and aviation instruments, as well as for food packaging materials and daily necessities items  and industrial materials to process interior furniture, miscellaneous goods, and building materials. Takihyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1751 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: MIXI
businessSummary: MIXI Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital entertainment business, sports business and lifestyle business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Digital Entertainment Business segment is engaged in the provision of games for smart devices, the implementation of related events, and the production and sale of goods. The Sports Business segment is engaged in the investment in sports team management and public sports related businesses. The Lifestyle Business segment is engaged in the management of services that are related to people's lives using the Internet. The main services include Kazoku Album Mitene, a photo and video sharing application for families, and minimo, a salon staff direct reservation application.

name: TOYO TIRE
businessSummary: Toyo Tire Corporation manufactures and sells tires in Japan, North America, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Tires and Automotive Parts. The company provides tires for passenger vehicles, lights trucks, cars, SUVs, and buses under the Toyo Tires and Nitto. It also offers automotive parts, including engine/motor, member/differential, strut, and exhaust mounts  bush/couplings and constant velocity universal joint boot  and anti-vibration rubbers cars. Toyo Tire Corporation was formerly known as Toyo Tire & Rubber Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Tire Corporation in January 2019. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Itami, Japan.

name: DEAR LIFE
businessSummary: Dear Life Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate business and sales promotion business. The Company has two business segments. The Real Estate Business segment is engaged in real estate development and planning, investment and management of income-generating real estate, hotel ownership and management, and solutions. The Sales Promotion Business segment is engaged in staffing and referral for sales support positions in the real estate, insurance, and financial industries, as well as call center operations.

isin: 7868.T|KOSAIDO Holdings Co., Ltd.|7868.T|KOSAIDO Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: KOSAIDO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: KOSAIDO Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a printing company in Japan. The company offers printing, IT and digital solutions, and IT services  campaign, D2C business, and digital promotion support  and business process outsourcing services. It also involved in operation of crematoriums and funeral falls  provision of planning for funeral services, including wakes and farewell services  estate planning services  financial services, such as inheritance tax returns  real estate sales and purchases, loans, and asset management. In addition, the company provides HR services comprising HR media, HR media agency, environmental information magazine publication, and newspaper rack agency  HR tech services  and temporary staffing, recruitment, HR development, education, training, recruitment process outsourcing, and foreign HR services. The company was formerly known as Kosaido Co., Ltd. and changed its name to KOSAIDO Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2021. The company was founded in 1949 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PEERS
businessSummary: Peers Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business in the telecommunications industry. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services, human resource solution services and information technology (IT) solution services. The consulting services are mainly engaged in the proposal of original training programs about management issues and sales issues for career shops and home appliance mass retailers, as well as the educational support services. The human resource solution services are mainly engaged in the holding of sale promotion events at sale sites, as well as the provision of educational support and dispatch services for foreign workers. The IT solution services are mainly engaged in the provision of sale skills and know-how services through video contents and applications.

name: JADE GROUP
businessSummary: JADE GROUP,Inc engages in the operation of an online shoe and fashion store in Japan. The company operates e-commerce mall sites and various brands. It also provides proprietary logistics and IT infrastructure systems to external brands. In addition, the company is involved in the online sale of women's and men's clothing and leather products  sale of accessories, sporting goods, and daily necessities  publication and sale of books, magazines, and web media  warehouse leasing  and consulting services. The company was formerly known as LOCONDO, Inc. and changed its name to JADE GROUP,Inc in June 2023. JADE GROUP,Inc was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: IMV
businessSummary: IMV Corporation manufactures and sells vibration simulation systems and measuring systems in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States of America, and internationally. The company offers vibration simulation systems  test and solution services  and measuring devices, such as vibration measuring and monitoring devices, earthquake monitoring devices, and environmental reliability evaluation systems. It also offers quality control services to automobiles, aerospace, defense, and electronics industries. In addition, it provides vibration controllers  rental vibration testing machine  seismometers  vibration pick-up and sensors  and insulation degradation evaluation test equipment. It also develops, produces, repairs, and maintains vibration and environmental test systems. In addition, it offers test house, measuring analysis, and other consulting services for vibration tests. Further, the company leases vibration test machine. IMV Corporation was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: ASAHI KOGYOSHA
businessSummary: Asahi Kogyosha Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment. The Company has two business segments. The Equipment Construction Business segment focuses on the design, supervision, and construction of air conditioning and sanitary equipment, with its core technology. The Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business segment, together with the Equipment Construction Business segment, utilizes its air conditioning and temperature and humidity control technologies to manufacture and sell environmental equipment, primarily precision environmental control equipment for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment.

name: HIMACS
businessSummary: HIMACS, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of value solution services. The Company mainly provides value-added solutions for computer and software systems. The Company provides two types of services. The system solution service is engaged in the provision of consulting services, the design, development, testing and implementation of operation systems. The system maintenance service is engaged in the provision of maintenance services for systems after operation.

name: TRINITY INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: TRINITY INDUSTRIAL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of equipment and automobile components. The Company has two business segments. The Equipment segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of coating plant equipment such as pre-treatment systems, electrolytic coating systems, painting booths, drying ovens, air ventilation devices, exhaust-gas treatment equipment and conveyers, coating equipment such as electrostatic equipment, automatic coating systems, coating supply systems, automatic paint recoloring equipment and others, as well as industrial machines such as heat treating furnaces, autoclaves, electrostatic oiling machines, coating dryers, washers, leak testers, ultra filter (UF) and reverse osmosis (RO) equipment. The Automobile Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive interior and exterior products such as steering handles, door switch bases, center clusters and side mudguards.

name: CAC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: CAC Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides information technology services in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, IT and Overseas IT. The company constructs and operates information systems. It also offers systems development, integration, operation, management, consulting, and maintenance, as well as BPO/BTO services  develops and sells packaged software  and plans, develops, and sells production management systems. In addition, the company engages in the development of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and application, as well as new business  aquaculture using IoT and AI  development of mobile telecommunications products and communication systems, as well as registered telecommunications services  financial services and IT consulting  BPO services for waste management  help desk services  and software development. Further, it is involved in engineering and research and development services, outsourced product development, IT infrastructure management, managed services, and enterprise applications for banking, telecom, and manufacturing industries  and sale and maintenance of software products. The company was formerly known as CAC Corporation and changed its name to CAC Holdings Corporation in April 2014. CAC Holdings Corporation was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: KAJI TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Kaji Technology Corporation manufactures and sells high-pressure air and gas piston compressors worldwide. It offers gas, trunk-piston, hydrogen, CNG, and PET compressors  water-cooled/air-cooled type, lubrication/oil-free/oil-less, petrochemical and industrial gas, and PET bottle molding compressors  and SF6 recovery systems, as well as compressors for electric power/test/general industries. The company also provides natural gas vehicle compressors for fuel filling  compressors for fuel cell vehicle filling  and various gas collection and refining equipment. The company was formerly known as Kaji Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kaji Technology Corporation in 1991. Kaji Technology Corporation was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

name: FURYU
businessSummary: FURYU Corporation engages in planning, developing, manufacturing, and selling photo sticker machines in Japan. The company is also involved in the planning and development of mobile services for young women  planning, development, manufacturing, and selling of amusement prizes  and planning, development, and selling of video games and animation. In addition, it produces, sells, and distributes of various animations and related products  and D2C e-commerce, including apparel, cosmetics, and miscellaneous goods. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SINANEN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the energy and non-energy related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Energy wholesale and retail related businesses, Energy Solutions Business, and Non-energy business segments. It provides products and services related to energy, such as LP gas and kerosene, and electricity  and solutions, including renovation and housing equipment, as well as housework and house cleaning services. The company also sells petroleum products to corporate customers that include gasoline, kerosene, diesel oil, fuel oil, lubricating oil, and LP gas  delivery services  sales support, such as kerosene home delivery  and sales support for service stations. In addition, it is involved in the development of power sources, including solar power generation  sale, maintenance, and operation of renewable energy products for individuals and corporations  electricity supply, sale, and demand management  plumbing maintenance  and rental services. Further, the company engages in the comprehensive building maintenance business, such as residential buildings and non-residential buildings maintenance, hospital and funeral home facility management  management of condominium management associations  design, construction, and maintenance of air-conditioning and floor-heating equipment  import and sale of bikes  bike retail store  share cycle business comprising bike-sharing  system business, which includes cloud-based LP gas ERP system, power CIS, account transfer payment collection service, and centralized monitoring system  and antimicrobial business, including silver-based inorganic antimicrobial agent, anti-odor and odor adsorbent, and functional additives. The company was formerly known as Sinanen Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2015. Sinanen Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: BSN MEDIA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: BSN Media Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the broadcasting business and general broadcasting business. The Company is engaged in the planning, production, and sales of broadcast programs. The Company is engaged in the planning, production, sales, and entertainment of various events including art, music, sports, movies, theater, performing arts, and science. The Company is also engaged in the planning, publishing, and sales of publications.

name: TYK
businessSummary: TYK CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractories. The Company operates through four geographic segments including Japan, North America, Europe and Asia. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractory bricks for steel, amorphous refractories, graphite crucibles for non-ferrous metals, and new ceramics. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the sale of environment-related products, the manufacture and repair of ceramics and machinery, construction and repair business, transport business, as well as the operation of sports facilities.

name: NARASAKI SANGYO
businessSummary: NARASAKI SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of electric appliances, materials and fuel. The Company has five business segments. The Electric Appliances Related segment is engaged in the sale of motors, control equipment, heavy electrical equipment, refrigeration equipment, precision processing equipment and others. The Machinery-related segment is engaged in the sale of food manufacturing equipment, laborsaving logistics equipment, grain storage equipment and others. The Material and Fuel-related segment is engaged in the sale of cements, concretes, concrete piles, autoclaved lightweight concrete (ALC) plates, petroleum, gas, asphalts and others. The Marine Transportation-related segment is engaged in the provision of marine transportation, customs, harbor operation, trucking, warehousing and other services. The Construction machinery-related segment is engaged in the sale of concrete pump trucks, rotary snow plows and road cutting pavement equipment.

name: HOSHI IRYO SANKI
businessSummary: HOSHI IRYO-SANKI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the medical gas business and household medical business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Medical Gas-related segment is engaged in the sale of medical oxygen gas, anesthesia gas and other general medical gases. The Household Medical-related segment is engaged in the rental and sale of oxygen generator for home use, equipment for continuous positive pressure respiratory therapy, home respirators and others. The Medical Gas Equipment Work-related segment is engaged in the design and construction of medical gas piping works, and the maintenance and inspection of medical gas plumbing facilities. The Nursing Welfare-related segment is engaged in the rental and sale of nursing welfare-related products, housing renovation, the operation of home-visit nursing and home care support offices, and related businesses. The Facility Care-related segment is engaged in the operation of pay nursing home and others.

isin: 6653.T|Seiko Electric Co., Ltd.|6653.T|Seiko Electric Co., Ltd.
name: SEIKO ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. operates in the field of power system, and environmental energy and control system in Japan. It offers power system business unit, environmental energy control business unit, environmental energy and control systems business unit, power electronics unit, IT system solution business unit, electronic control devices unit, liquid crystal film for optical shutter, and service and engineering business unit. The company also offers power receiving, transforming, and monitoring/control systems for water and sewage facilities, lighting control systems for expressways, energy storage systems, battery power conditioners, and solutions for renewable energy and AI data centers  cloud services (SaaS) for ports, healthcare, and e-learning, as well as business support systems utilizing artificial intelligence and IoT  sales of digitalization and decarbonization products, including electrical machinery, energy-saving equipment, and robots, along with engineering, construction, and maintenance services  and control equipment, electronic devices, light control films, electrical work, and machinery installation services. The company serves central and various government offices  electric, gas, and environmental plant companies  automobile, ship building, iron, steel, nonferrous metal, electrical machinery plants  science, chemical, food products, and paper manufacturing companies  and construction companies. The company was formerly known as Seiko Shokai and changed its name to Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. in 1960. Seiko Electric Co., Ltd. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: SANSEI TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Sansei Technologies, Inc., formerly SANSEI YUSOKI CO., LTD., is primarily engaged in the manufacture and installation of stage machinery, gaming machines, elevating machines and others. The Manufacture segment manufactures and installs stage machinery and elevating machinery for theaters and culture halls, art equipment such as electric decoration devices in television stations, events and concert venues, gaming machines such as roller coasters and towers, and elevating machinery such as elevators, escalators and packing devices. It also purchases products and conducts maintenance work. In addition, the Company is also involved in operation and provision of leisure facilities in amusement parks, and management of parks owned by the Company.

name: SANSHIN ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: SANSHIN ELECTRONICS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales of electronic devices and the providing of information technology (IT) solutions. The Company mainly operates in two segments. The Device segment is engaged in the sales of semiconductors and electronic components to electronics manufacturers, besides, it also provides technical support such as software development and module development. The Solution segment is engaged in information and telecommunications network business which provides infrastructure design, construction, operation and maintenance services to private enterprises, government agencies and municipalities.

name: YOSHICON
businessSummary: Yoshicon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company has four business segments. The Residence segment is engaged in the planning and sale of condominiums and single family houses. The Real Estate Development segment is engaged in the planning, development, sale, brokerage and construction of real estate such as condominiums, houses, commercial and industrial facilities. The Rental and Management segment is engaged in the rental of condominiums, commercial and industrial facilities and parking lots, the management, design and construction of condominiums, as well as the power sales business. The Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete products for construction, precast concrete (PC) components for houses, as well as the civil engineering and construction business. The Company is also engaged in the beverage manufacturing business, food business, clothing sales business, advertising and insurance agency business.

name: NIPPON SHARYO
businessSummary: Nippon Sharyo, Ltd. engages in the railway rolling stock, construction machinery, transportation equipment and steel structures, engineering, and other businesses in Japan, the United States, Asia, and internationally. The company offers electric trains, diesel railcars, hybrid vehicles, and passenger cars  and bullet, intercity and express, suburban and commuter, and exported train, as well as metro and subway, AGT, LRV, and monorail. It also provides pile drivers, full rotary tubing equipment, earth drills, obstacle removal machines  pilling, soil stabilizing, mini piling, earth drilling rigs, as well as casing rotator and crawler crane  and tank trucks, tank trailers, tank containers, storage tanks, large land vehicle carriers, automated guided vehicles, and freight cars. In addition, the company manufactures, and construct new road and railway bridges, as well as machinery and equipment for railway operators, agricultural plants, and paper-related equipment  and provides repairs and maintenance of existing bridges. The company was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. Nippon Sharyo, Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Central Japan Railway Company.

name: MARUZEN
businessSummary: MARUZEN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures, purchases and sells commercial kitchen equipment. The Bakery Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures, sells and maintains bakery equipment such as bakery factories. The Building Leasing segment leases buildings such as business hotels and nursing care-type nursing homes.

name: TSUZUKI DENKI
businessSummary: Tsuzuki Denki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information network solution services business. The Information Network Solution Services segment provides proposals, construction, operation and maintenance services for various solutions related to information networks. Services include sales of information and communication equipment, consulting, design, development and construction technology provision, operation and maintenance of information and communication equipment and software, and monthly cloud services.

name: KSK
businessSummary: KSK CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the support of semiconductor design, embedded software development, software development, and network construction. The Company operates in three business segments. The System Core segment is engaged in the development and design of large-scale integration (LSI), the design of hardware systems, and the development of embedded software. The IT Solutions segment is engaged in the development of packaged software, the contract development of application software, the development of computer-aided design (CAD) systems and Website systems, data entry service, operator dispatch, as well as nursing-care and welfare service. The Network Service segment is engaged in the building, site adjustment, the operation and maintenance of communications and computer related systems, the operation and management of CAD systems, and support center business.

name: LANDIX
businessSummary: Landix Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of one-stop solutions from real estate purchase to sale, sale brokerage, custom-made housing matching and after-sale follow-up after construction. The Company operates in two business segments. The SUMUZU segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of residential land, the brokerage of real estate, as well as the provision of introduction services for custom home construction. The Company is also engaged in the operation of own portal site SUMUZU. The Leasing segment is engaged in the purchase of profitable real estate. The Company is also engaged in the rental property management business and the insurance agency business.

name: LOADSTAR CAPITAL KK
businessSummary: Loadstar Capital K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate investment business in Japan. The company invests in various real estate properties, including middle sized office buildings and hotels  sources, procures, invests, and manages assets  and operates OwnersBook, a real estate investment crowdfunding platform. It is also involved in asset management  money lending  real estate rental  hotel management contract  and financial products trading businesses, as well as development and provision of blockchain infrastructure and digital securities. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: ISAMU PAINT
businessSummary: Isamu Paint Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints and related products. The Paint segment is divided into automobile repair, industrial, and architectural applications. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various paints, thinners, aerosol products, the process of semi-finished products, the filling and subdivision work of products, and purchase and sale of related products. The Company is also engaged in the management of real estate rentals and parking lots.

isin: 9347.T|NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd.|9347.T|NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd.
name: NIPPON KANZAI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. provides building management and operations services in Japan and the United States. The company also engages in security services  environmental facility management, including water supply, sewage treatment, and waste management and disposal facilities  residential management comprising managing condominiums, public housing, etc.  and real estate fund management businesses. In addition, it provides security  staffing  and payroll outsourcing and consulting services, as well as event planning and management, print design, bookbinding, and real estate finance. NIPPON KANZAI Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.

name: KAWAGISHI BRIDGE WORKS
businessSummary: Kawagishi Bridge Works Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of steel frames and other steel structures. The Company’s contracted steel works mainly include site construction, design, and cost estimation for construction work in East Japan. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture, sale and installation of precast concrete products for construction.

name: WESCO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Wesco Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in general construction consulting business. The Company operates through five business segments. The General Construction Consulting segment involves in the provision of construction consulting, construction design, compensation consultant, environmental assessment, general survey, aerial survey and geological survey services. The Copy Bookbinding segment involves in the positive image printing, copy drawing, printing and bookbinding. The Real Estate segment involves in the subdivision and rental of real estate, as well as housing sales. The Sporting Facilities Operation segment involves in the operation of sporting facilities and related facilities. The Designated Management segment involves in the management of Suma Aqualife Park.

name: SPK
businessSummary: SPK Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the trading of automotive spare parts and accessories, and industrial vehicle parts in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Central and South America, North America, the Middle East, Africa, Europe, and internationally. The company supplies automotive aftermarket parts and accessories  and machinery equipment parts and components, including multifunction displays, integrated switches and dials, telematics equipment, and electrical components to the manufacturers of industrial vehicles. It also offers turbo chargers, expanders, liners and sleeves, valve stem seals, break master cylinders, calipers, oil jet check valves, drain cocks, bushes, piston pins, drive shafts, toolboxes, brake pads and shoes, brake disc rotors, batteries, engine oil, torque rod bushes, ignition coils, radiators, bulbs, hose clamps, wipers, bead creams, brake lining rivets, LED work lamps, and CV joints. In addition, the company provides fuel pump, throttle body, intake manifold, engine valve, timing chain, gasket, washer, oil seal, power steering seal, timing kit, water pump, fan clutch, piston ring, cylinder liner, ignition coil, engine bearing, bushing thrust washer, thermostat, and thermos sensor  drivetrain parts comprising CV joint, drive shaft, propeller shaft, axle shaft, differencial, and universal joint  oil and chemicals consisting of brake fluid and coolant  disc pad, brake shoe, wheel cylinder, brake lining control arm, oil pump, master and wheel cylinder, clutch master cylinder, brake/air conditioning/power steering hose, rubber bushing, shock absorber, ball joint, tie rod end, rack end, stabilizer link, control cables, bolt, center bearing, and engine mounting products  and electrical and air conditioning parts. The company was formerly known as Daido Automobile Enterprising Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SPK Corporation in January 1992. SPK Corporation was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: AINAVO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: AINAVO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., is a Japan-based company involved in the large-sized property business and the detached house business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Detached House segment is engaged in the sale and construction of various tile products such as interior and exterior tiles, floor tiles, exteriors and other related products, and housing related products such as bathtubs, water heaters, system kitchens, sanitary equipment, solar power generation systems and other products. The Large-sized Property segment is engaged in the interior tile, exterior tile and floor tile construction works, the housing equipment construction works such as unit baths, system kitchens, bathtubs and others, the large ceramic tile works made of stones and dry methods, and the air conditioning and sanitary equipment works.

name: TOHO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Toho Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products in Japan. It operates in four segments: Pharmaceutical Wholesaling Business, Dispensing Pharmacy Business, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Sales Business, and Other Peripheral Businesses. The company distributes pharmaceuticals, narcotics, reagents, medical equipment and devices, medical materials, and over-the-counter products to hospitals, clinics, and dispensing pharmacies. It also provides customer support systems for patients and medical institutions comprising Future ENIF, an information terminal for pharmaceutical ordering  LXMATE HeLios Cloud, a medical care appointment system  and MIZAR, a centralized administration system of pharmacy operations, as well as L1MON, a patient home delivery service for specialty products. In addition, the company engages in the management of the dispensing pharmacies and health insurance dispensing pharmacies  provision of support home medical care and data processing services  and real estate agency business. Further, it provides generic and injection drugs on consignment  contract manufacturing of ampoule and vial formulations  and contract testing for pharmaceutical quality control and stability testing. Additionally, the company engages in site management organization  planning and sale of information processing equipment  software development and sales  corporate and medical management and consulting  internet business related to pharmaceuticals  general motor truck transportation  cashless payment and factoring  remote detailing  and manufacture and sale of hygienic materials. The company was formerly known as Toho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toho Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2009. Toho Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: OHMORI
businessSummary: Ohmori Co.,Ltd. engages in the civil engineering and construction work in Japan. The company undertakes construction of water supply and sewerage systems. It also buys, sells, and rents real estate  sells photovoltaic power generation equipment  and provides closet rental services. In addition, the company is involved in leasing of OLY equipment  steel processing  and maintenance and management of communication lines. Ohmori Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: MINO CERAMIC
businessSummary: MINO CERAMIC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial refractory products, the design and construction of plants and the sale of flooring and paving materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Refractory segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of bricks, irregular refractory products and others, as well as the production of ceramic products. The Plant segment is engaged in the design and construction of industrial kilns and automated systems. The Construction and Paving Materials segment is engaged in the construction and sale of construction materials, as well as the manufacture and provision of paving materials and processed products. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices. The Company is also engaged in the sale of outsourced goods.

name: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: Meisei Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the construction business, mainly focusing on thermal insulation work, and the boiler business. The Company has two business segments. The Construction Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and construction of materials, both domestically and overseas, including thermal insulation work, building material construction (clean rooms), and refrigeration and low-temperature equipment construction. The Boiler Business segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction, sale, and installation of boilers and industrial machinery and equipment both domestically and overseas.

name: MORITA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Morita Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of ladder trucks, fire trucks, and specialty vehicles in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Fire truck, disaster prevention, Industrial machinery, and Eco-friendly vehicles. It offers fire trucks, including ladder trucks, aerial platforms, chemical/water tenders, rescue truck, aircraft rescue and fire fighting vehicles, multi-purpose fire fighting vehicles, CAFS/water pumps, and maintenance. It also provides recycling machines comprising shredder plants, scrap shears, and scrap baling presses. In addition, the company offers environmental conservation vehicles, such as cesspit emptiers, garbage collectors, container lifters, cleaning vehicles, vacuum tanks, lumbar support wear, and home-visit bathing service cars. Further, it provides fire extinguishers, fire protection-related equipment  hydraulic equipment  designs and constructs waste recycling facilities and other waste disposal facilities  electronic applied machinery and information processing machinery  FRP cabins and bodies for fire trucks  sells portable pumps, fire alarm detectors, and fire trucks and equipment  platform ladders and aerial platforms  and maintenance and aftercare services, as well as engages in the trading, fabrication, repair, and sale of specialized vehicles. The company was formerly known as Morita Corporation and changed its name to Morita Holdings Corporation in October 2008. Morita Holdings Corporation was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: NJS
businessSummary: NJS Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water and sewerage business, and the environment business. The Company has two regional segments. The Company is mainly engaged in the construction consulting business, the development and provision of consulting services and software through the life cycle of water and sewage infrastructures, the provision of research, design, construction management and operation consulting services, the provision of disaster prevention and mitigation measures, environmental planning and environmental assessments, the provision of support services for water and sewage operation business, the provision of residents services, financial accounting and facility management services, and public-private partnership services, management improvement support services, the water and sewage consulting business in overseas, as well as the leasing, sale and management of real estate. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets.

name: MUGEN ESTATE
businessSummary: MUGEN ESTATE Co.,Ltd. purchases and resells pre-owned properties in Japan. The company's property portfolio includes investment type properties, such as condominiums and office blocks and residential type properties, including detached houses for families. It engages in the development, leasing, and selling of real estate properties and interior and exterior construction business that includes renovate and refurbish stores, offices, office buildings, rental apartment complexes, and residential properties. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: YAMABIKO
businessSummary: Yamabiko Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural machinery in Japan, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through Outdoor Power Equipment, Agricultural Machinery, and General Industrial Machinery segments. The company manufactures, sells, and rents handheld forestry and landscape maintenance machinery, such as chain saws for limbing, felling, and pruning trees  trimmers and brush cutters for grass cutting, mowing, and clearing  and power blowers for blowing, collecting, and shredding leaves and debris  provides boom sprayers for large-scale farm and crop operations  speed sprayers for fruit trees  mounted equipment for cropland pest control management, such as labor-saving pest control equipment for paddy fields, and soy and potato harvesters  generators, welding machines, lighting equipment, and high-pressure washers. Further, it manufactures and sells agricultural drainage pipe burying machinery  contract logistics  and manufactures and sells prototype parts for automobiles. It serves forests and agricultural fields, construction sites, parks, and homes under the Kioritz, Shindaiwa, and ECHO brand names. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ome, Japan.

name: YOSSIX HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yossix Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food business includes direct management of pub chain stores and franchised store development as well as construction business centered on restaurant construction. The Company operates pub chains under various brands, including Nipachi, Yataiya, Yataizushi, Sento, Koreya, Yakiniku Genki, providing Sushi, iron-plate cooking, chicken black charcoal and others.

name: NIPPON INSURE
businessSummary: Nippon Insure Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services related to the guarantee business. The guarantee business includes rent obligation guarantee service, nursing care expense obligation guarantee service, and hospitalization expense obligation guarantee service. The rent obligation guarantee service provides guarantees for rent obligations in rental housing and other properties. The nursing care expense obligation guarantee service is a guarantee product that assumes the risk of nonpayment of nursing care facility fees by concluding a guarantee consignment contract between a nursing care facility user and the company, and acting as a joint guarantor for the facility user. The hospitalization expense obligation guarantee service is a guarantee product that assumes the risk of nonpayment of hospitalization expenses by concluding a guarantee consignment contract with hospitalized patients and becoming a joint guarantor.

name: WASEDA ACADEMY
businessSummary: Waseda Academy Co., Ltd. operates and manages schools for elementary, junior high, and high school students. The company operates schools  and franchise schools under the Kobetsu Shingakukan brand. Waseda Academy Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NIPPON GEAR
businessSummary: Nippon Gear Co., Ltd. provides manufacturing and selling of various types of gears and related maintenance services Japan and internationally. The company offers electric and manual valve actuators under Nippon Gear and Flowserve Limitorque brand names  trapezoidal and ball screw jacks, and other jacks  vertical and horizontal mixers  cylindrical gears  speed-up gears  straight and spiral bevel gears  hypoid gears  gear measurement equipment  encoders  digital controllers  and fan drives. It is also involved in designing, manufacturing, and sale of measuring instruments, data transmission instruments, control equipment, and software  installation, maintenance, repair, and inspection of valve actuators, reduction gears, speed-up gears, mixers, jacks, measuring instruments, data transmission instruments, and control equipment. In addition, the company designs, supervise, and implement machinery and equipment installation and electrical works. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: INABA SEISAKUSHO
businessSummary: Inaba Seisakusho Co., Ltd. engages in the engineering, manufacture, sale, and support of office furniture and outdoor storage sheds in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Steel Storage Units and Office Furniture. The Steel Storage Units segment sells and rents storage facilities such as storage sheds, garages, warehouses and bicycle parking areas. The office furniture segment products include desks, meeting tables, office chairs, office partitions, storage cabins, and other items. The company was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOKAI
businessSummary: TOKAI Corp. provides various healthy life services in Japan. It operates through Health and Life Services, Pharmacy Services, and Environmental Services segments. The company engages in hospital-related business that includes rental of hospital bedding and white coats, linen supply, nursing assistance, and in-hospital logistics management. It is also involved in the rental and sale of nursing care products and home renovation services under the nursing care insurance system  operation of MIC Health Forest day service facility for the rehabilitation for the elderly  development and manufacture finishing process machinery and equipment for dry cleaning factories  provision of meal services comprising regular and therapeutic meals  and water delivery business under the Aqua Clara brand. In addition, the company engages in the operation of Tanpopo Pharmacy specialty dispensing pharmacy and Drugmic drugstore chain  rental of environmental beautification products under the Leaskin brand  cleaning and management of hospital and other buildings  and solar business. Further, it is involved in the production of business reports, individual surveys, brochure creation, and booklets, as well as the operation of business information. Additionally, it serves medical institutions and nursing care facilities. TOKAI Corp. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.

name: NSW
businessSummary: NSW Inc, formerly Nippon Systemware Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing information technology (IT) solutions, service solutions and product solutions. The Company operates through three segments. The IT Solution segment consists of the business solutions business, the financial and public solutions business, and the system equipment sales business. The Service Solution segment consists of the digital solution business and the cloud/infrastructure service business. The Product Solution segment consists of the embedded development business and device development business.

name: NAGOYA ELECTRIC WORKS
businessSummary: NAGOYA ELECTRIC WORKS CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the manufacture and sale of information devices and testing instruments. The Company operates in two business segments. The Information Device segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of light-emitting diode (LED) information systems for roads and rivers, disaster prevention systems for tunnels, mobile information vehicles, vehicle-mounted indicators, systems for parking lot information, information providing system under the name Michi no Eki, weather and disaster monitoring systems and variable regulatory sign systems and other systems, as well as the provision of maintenance and management services. The Testing Device segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of appearance testers for printed circuit boards (PCBs) and hardware testing devices.

name: CHIYODA INTEGRE
businessSummary: CHIYODA INTEGRE CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production and sale of mechanical parts and functional parts. The Company operates through three regional segments including Japan, Southeast Asia and China. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture of mechanical and functional parts for office automation (OA) equipment, audio and video (AV) equipment, communication equipment, automobiles and other products, and the sale of products mainly to electric manufacturers, as well as the sale of raw materials to subsidiaries, and the provision of royalties. The Company is also engaged in the reception of orders mainly from manufacturers of handicrafts and accessories, and the process and sale of felt products through a subsidiary.

name: NIHON KAGAKU SANGYO
businessSummary: Nihon Kagaku Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals and building materials in Japan and internationally. It offers various inorganic metal products, including copper, tin, nickel, cobalt, bismuth, chromium, manganese, antimony, zinc, iron, and lithium compounds  organic metal compounds, such as metal acetylacetonate, metallic soaps, PUCAT, and PA series products  surface treatment agents  and other compounds. The company's chemical products are used in various industries, such as optical/precision instruments, electronics, ceramics, petrochemical catalysis, healthcare, and battery materials. It also develops fireproof, waterproof, and ventilation building materials  fabricated metal products  and heat exchangers, as well as offers stainless steel handrails and residential eaves  and pipe space covers and exterior products. The company was incorporated in 1924 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: NICHIWA SANGYO
businessSummary: NICHIWA SANGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mixed feed products with grains as the main ingredients, and other livestock products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Feed segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mixed feed products for broilers, pigs, beef cattle, dairy cows, fishes, ducks, ostriches and rabbits, as well as the purchase and sale of livestock products. The Livestock Products segment is engaged in the production and sale of livestock products, the production of piglets, as well as the rearing and sale of pigs.

businessSummary: Mitsubishi Steel Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel products, construction machinery parts, automotive parts, and machinery and equipment in Japan, North America, rest of Asia, Europe, and internationally. It provides steel products, including structural carbon steel and alloy steels, spring steels, non-heat treated steels, high carbon chromium bearing steels, and others  coil, heavy-duty coil, and leaf springs, stabilizer bars, springs for railway vehicles, and precision parts  as well as special alloy powders, precision castings, machined metal parts, special materials and machined products, and wear-resistant cast steel products. The company also offers forging presses, forging manipulators, ring rolling mills, cold forging presses, magnetic separators, link conveyors, buckets, vibration isolators, scaling systems, other industrial machineries, outer casings for gas turbines, pressure vessels, and steel working products. In addition, it provides research and development services  and sells automotive parts, construction machinery parts, wear resistant teeth for shellfish harvesting, and wood processor tire chains. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ITOCHU ENEX
businessSummary: Itochu Enex Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in home-life business, car-life business, industrial business, and power and utility business. The Company operates through four segments. The Home Life Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, kerosene, electric power, life-related equipment and smart energy equipment. The Car Life Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of gasoline, kerosene, light oil, electric power, and automobiles. The Industrial Business segment is engaged in the sale and provision of services of gasoline, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, LP gas, and gas-to-liquid (GTL) fuel, the import and export of petroleum products, and the lease of terminal tanks. The Power & Utility Business segment is engaged in electric power generation, steam, district heating service, comprehensive energy service, electric heat supply service, asset management, and rental car business.

name: NIHON YAMAMURA GLASS
businessSummary: Nihon Yamamura Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass bottles, plastic containers, and glass for electronics, as well as the design, production, and sale of various related equipment and plants, as well as transportation, storage, and on-site operations. The Company operates through four segments. The Glass Bottle-Related Business segment manufactures and sells glass bottles, various packaging materials and machinery, bottle-making machines, and conveying equipment. The Plastic Container-Related Business segment manufactures and sells plastic caps. The Logistics-Related Business segment transports, stores, and performs on-site operations for products. The New Glass-Related Business segment manufactures and sells glass for electronics and glass parts for electrical and electronic devices. The Company also produces, processes, and sells agricultural products.

name: TOA CORP HYOGO
businessSummary: TOA Corp is a Japan-based company operates manufacturing, sales, and related businesses mainly in the audio and video fields. The Company sells audio and video equipment and others through five segments: Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe and Middle East and Africa, America, China and East Asia. Additionally, the Japan segment produces audio equipment, video equipment. The Company’s products include emergency broadcast equipment, commercial broadcast equipment, wireless systems, intercom systems, sound systems and loudspeaker equipment and others.

name: RAIZNEXT
businessSummary: RAIZNEXT Corporation engages in providing engineering and maintanance services in Japan. The company is involved in production, procurement, maintenance, sales, leasing, designing, supervising, and constructing of equipment and machinery  and maintenance of installations and equipment. It also provides installation, civil engineering, electrical instrumentation, and plumbing services  and research, development, technical support, and its consignment. The company serves oil, petrochemicals, gas, general chemicals, non-ferrous metals, metal processing, electronic materials, resource recycling, electricity, nuclear power, renewable energy, distributed energy, iron manufacturing, coal, desalination, fodder, biochemical, food products, pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, medical care, information/communications, shipping/transportation, distribution, stockpiles, air conditioning/plumbing, pollution control, accident prevention, and environmental conservation industries. RAIZNEXT Corporation was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: ESPEC
businessSummary: Espec Corp. manufactures and sells environmental test, energy device, and semiconductor-related equipment worldwide. It operates through three segments: Equipment Business, Service Business, and Other Business. The company offers temperature and humidity chambers, rapid-rate thermal cycle chambers, thermal shock chambers, temperature chambers, and network products. It also provides secondary battery-related equipment  measurement and evaluation systems, and semiconductor-related equipment, as well as testing equipment  HALT and HASS systems, and indoor farm and growth chambers. In addition, the company offers laboratory testing and consulting services  and calibration services for measuring equipment. Further it is in involved in the rental and resale of environmental test equipment. Espec Corp. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

isin: 4668.T|MEIKO NETWORK JAPAN|4668.T|Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd.
name: MEIKO NETWORK JAPAN
businessSummary: Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd. provides education services in Japan. It operates individual tutoring cram schools  programming school  soccer schools  Japanese language school  and individual English school instructed by bilinguals. The company also offers childcare and nutrition staffing, digital marketing and DX, university education, university entrance examination, after school, human resource, recruitment, and dispatch services, as well as services related to employment of foreigners. In addition, it engages in the event and travel business, as well as offers career change support for nursery and dietitians. The company was formerly known as Meiko Gijuku Corporation and changed its name to Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd. in December 1986. Meiko Network Japan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: MS&AD INSURANCE GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: MS&AD Insurance Group Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the insurance business. The Company has six business segments. The domestic non-life insurance business includes three segments: Mitsui Sumitomo Insurance, Aioi Nissay Dowa Insurance, Mitsui Direct General Insurance. The business is engaged in the sale of fire insurance, marine insurance, accident insurance, automobile insurance and other non-life insurance products in Japan. The domestic life insurance business includes two segments: Mitsui Sumitomo Aioi Life Insurance and Mitsui Sumitomo Primary Life Insurance. The business is engaged in the sale of personal insurance, personal annuity insurance, group insurance and other life insurance products in Japan. The Overseas Business segment is engaged in the insurance business in the United States, Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Australia and other regions. The Company is also engaged in the financial services business and risk related business.

name: FINANCIAL PARTNERS GROUP
businessSummary: Financial Partners Group Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in fund management business. It operates through three business segments. Lease Fund segment involves the formation and management of operating lease projects and the sale of limited partnership interests, general partnership interests, and trust beneficiary rights to investors. Operating lease projects are operating lease projects for shipping containers, aircraft and ships, and are mainly offered in the form of limited partnerships or money trusts. Domestic Real Estate Fund segment involves entrusting target properties to FPG Trust Co., Ltd. and selling the trust beneficiary rights to investors. Overseas Real Estate Fund segment involves the formation and management of general partnerships that invest in projects that own and lease overseas real estate, and the sale of general partnership interests to investors. Its businesses also include aviation business, jointly owned platform business and others.

name: SUGIMOTO &
businessSummary: Sugimoto & Co., Ltd. engages in the sale, import, and export of machinery and apparatus in Japan and internationally. The company offers measuring instruments  tester cutting tools  machine tools  pneumatic tools  hydraulic/pneumatic equipment  electric tools  power transmission parts  work tools  pipework equipment  and OA equipment. It also provides environmental and surveying instruments  conduction and drive equipment  plumbing equipment  electrical and electronic components  environmental and physical chemistry products  packing materials  optical and scientific instruments  work machinery and equipment  tools  transportation, logistics, cargo handling, and storage equipment  grinding wheels and rivets  chemical products  safety equipment and protective gear  and housing, office automation, and research supplies. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: NITTOSEIKO
businessSummary: Nittoseiko Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial fasteners and tools, industrial machinery and precision equipment, measurement and control equipment, and medical equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Fastener  Industrial Machinery  Control  and Medical segments. The Overseas segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of interior materials overseas.

businessSummary: Business Brain Showa-Ota Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consultation and development of business system. The Company operates through two business segments. Management Service (BPO) segment is involved in the outsourcing of personnel, salary, labor, accounting and finance, system management, the dispatch of information technology (IT) engineers, medical office workers and others, as well as the provision of system support for insurance agencies of non-life insurance companies and system support for financial institutions.

The Construction Business segment constructs rental housing and other properties based on construction orders, and contracts for the construction of custom-built detached houses. The Rental Brokerage Business segment brokers real estate rentals. The Sales and Purchase Brokerage Business segment brokers real estate sales. The Real Estate Management Business segment manages and rents real estate. The Condominium Sales Business segment sells houses and other properties. The Publishing Business segment operates a publishing business, the Hotel and Leisure Business segment operates hotels and inns, travel agencies, and restaurants. The Elderly Support and Childcare Business segment provides nursing care services, elderly support housing, and childcare services. It also has Finance and Consulting Business segment, Retail and Cultural Business segment.

businessSummary: Last One Mile Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the last mile business. The Company is engaged in the operation of Marutto Change, a new life support platform for the mobile one-stop service. Marutto Change is a service in which the Lifeline Concierge uses a telephone or short message service (SMS) to act on behalf of or guide customers to lifeline and other new life procedures.

name: T&D HOLDINGS
businessSummary: T&D Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life insurance business. The Company operates four business segments. The Taiyo Life Insurance segment provides life insurance services to the household market. The Daido Life Insurance segment provides life insurance business to the small and medium-sized business market. The T&D Financial Life Insurance segment operates with the boarding agency market as its respective sales market and has different sales products under its own sales policy. The T&D United Capital segment is engaged in strategic business investments in the life insurance business and new growth business areas.

The Company is also engaged in the provision of maintenance services for dishwashers, and hygiene management support services, as well as the purchase of kitchen and bath supplies such as food packaging wraps, paper towels, body soaps, rinse-in shampoos and others.

businessSummary: Japan Oil Transportation Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation of petroleum products, high-pressure gas and petrochemical products, and the leasing and rental of shipping containers. The Chemical-related Products segment involves in the production and sale of plastics and chemicals. The Real Estate Rental-related segment leases real estate properties.

Its MM Bridge segment engages in the design, manufacture, erection, sale, and repair of bridges and coastal structures, as well as civil engineering and building construction contracting, engineering, and project management services.

The Architecture Business segment is involved in all architectural works both domestically and overseas. The Group Business segment is involved in the sale and leasing of construction materials and the construction of civil engineering and architectural works through consolidated subsidiaries. The Company also includes survey and research contract work.

The company offers press-related products  ultra-high-tensile steel plates and hot stamp pressed product  and constant temperature logistics products for light vehicles and heavy vehicles, as well as compact, 2t, 3t, and 4t trucks. Sales to domestic customers are mainly direct sales. Sales to overseas customers such as the United States, Taiwan, Mainland China, and South Korea are conducted through local agents.

The Company is also engaged in the management and operation of fitness clubs, the leasing, management, trading and asset management of real estate, the planning and production of computer graphics, movies and television programs, as well as the planning, production and sales of character products.

businessSummary: A.D.Works Group Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the management of the business of group companies and other related operations as a holding company. Through a wholly owned subsidiary and its affiliated companies, the Company operates two businesses, including profitable real estate sales business and stock-type fee business. The profitable real estate sales business seeks out and raises properties with high profitability, and operates the business through the process of property selection, purchase, value increasing and sales, centering on residential real estate with less than 500 million yen per building. The stock-type fee business supports all aspects of the management of real estate properties, and provides property management, real estate effective utilization consulting and real estate appraisal due diligence.

name: MARUFUJI SHEET PILING
businessSummary: MARUFUJI SHEET PILING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturer of construction materials. The Company is principally involved in the sale, leasing, process and transportation of steel sheet piles, H-section steel, earth retaining steel materials, lining boards, temporary system bridges, reinforced soil wall materials and processed iron frames for buildings, as well as the related construction works. The Company has three business divisions. The Sales division is engaged in the purchase and sale of materials. The Factory division specializes in the storage of leased materials, as well as the provision of repair, maintenance, manufacture and processing services. The Transportation division provides product transportation services.

The Overseas Measurement and Control segment manufactures and sells watt-hour meters, smart meters and related systems, and measurement and control equipment. The Real Estate segment is involved in the real estate leasing business.

The Information Processing Services segment handles software development, IT engineering services.

The Company is also engaged in environmental sanitation, facility management, hotel management, real estate rental, and solar power generation businesses.
