The company also provides financial instruments transactions such as the buying and selling of securities, as well as underwriting and secondary distribution of securities. The company was formerly known as Iwai Securities Co., Ltd. and changed its name to IwaiCosmo Holdings, Inc. in July 2010. IwaiCosmo Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: NISSO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NISSO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd provides human resources solutions services in Japan. The company engages in the provision of General Human Resources Services for the manufacturing industry, including temporary staffing, manufacturing process outsourcing, and engineering personnel services, as well as administrative staffing and placement  and development of production management and equipment maintenance systems. It also operates facility and home care  develops contract and packaged software  constructs network systems  and offers consulting services and outsourcing business for various security services. In addition, the company offers manufacturing dispatch and contracting services  BPO  and home-based nursing care, as well as incidental or related operations services. NISSO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: ARCS
businessSummary: ARCS COMPANY,LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the supermarket business. The retail business includes supermarkets mainly selling food products, home centers selling household goods, retail of pharmaceuticals, manufacturing and selling bread, manufacturing and selling prepared foods, producing and selling fresh flowers and plants, and selling marine products. It also operates other businesses such as travel agencies, comprehensive building maintenance including facility cleaning and equipment maintenance, real estate leasing, non-life and life insurance agencies, food wholesale of products handled by a joint centralized purchasing organization, industrial and general waste collection and transportation business, and construction business that designs and constructs the interior and exterior of buildings.

name: YODOKO
businessSummary: Yodoko Ltd, formerly Yodogawa Steel Works Ltd, is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, processing and sale of iron and steel products. The Company operates through four segments. The Steel Sheets-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled steel sheets, polished steel strips, hot-dip galvanized steel sheets, painted galvanized steel sheets, and other steel sheets, the manufacture and sale of building materials and exterior products, as well as the design and construction of construction works. The Roll segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel rolls and non-ferrous rolls. The Grating segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gratings. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and trading of real estate. The Company is also engaged in transportation and warehousing, golf course management, machinery plant sales, solar power generation electricity sales, and software design and development.

name: DENYO
businessSummary: Denyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial electrical machinery and equipment, including engine generators, engine welders, and engine compressors, as well as the sale of related repair parts and after-sales services. The Company operates through regional segments in Japan, America, Asia, and Europe. The Japan segment manufactures and sells engine generators, engine welders, engine compressors, and other products, as well as manufacturing and selling generators for disaster prevention and emergency use. The America segment manufactures and sells engine generators. The Asia segment processes manufacturing parts, manufactures engine generators, and sells and leases/rents engine generators and engine welders. The Europe segment sells engine generators and engine welders in Europe.

name: ICOM
businessSummary: ICOM INCORPORATED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wireless communication equipment and network equipment. The Company operates through four geographical business segments including Japan, North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Company’s main product categories include land-based radio communication equipment, amateur radio communication equipment, marine radio communication equipment, other radio communication equipment, network equipment, among others. The Company is engaged in the provision of products including SATELLITE PTT, aviation radio, IC-M37J, IC-M36J and others for marine systems, IC-7851, IC-7700 and others for fixed equipment, wireless Local Area Network (LAN) terminals, communication function expansion units and other products.

name: NITTO KOGYO
businessSummary: NITTO KOGYO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of switchboard-related products, as well as the purchase and sale of information and communication equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Switchboard-related segment manufactures and sells switchboards, cabinets, breakers, switches and parts, among others. The Information and Communication related Distribution segment purchases and sells information communication equipment and other materials. The Works and Services segment is engaged in the construction of electrical equipment and network systems, and the provision of maintenance service.

name: RS TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: RS Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the silicon wafer reclamation business. It operates through three business segments. The Wafer Reclamation segment reclaims, processes, and sells semiconductor silicon wafers, as well as provides oxide film deposition processing services. The Prime Silicon Wafer Manufacturing and Sales segment manufactures and sells prime silicon wafers, as well as new monitor wafers, dummy wafers, and silicon ingots. The Semiconductor-Related Equipment and Materials segment sells semiconductor-related equipment and consumables, manufactures and sells storage battery electrolytes, and manufactures and sells in-vehicle camera modules. It also engages in solar power generation business and technical consulting business.

name: SHINNIHONSEIYAKU
businessSummary: Shinnihonseiyaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development and sale of cosmetics and healthcare products. The Company conducts business through direct mail order, wholesale distribution, and overseas sales channels. Major products and brands include cosmetics such as PERFECT ONE and PERFECT ONE FOCUS, as well as healthcare products including Fun and Health and Wellness Food. Wholesale sales distribute cosmetics and healthcare products nationwide to customers through wholesale to retailers such as drugstores, general supermarkets, variety stores, and sales agents. Overseas, sales focus primarily on e-commerce (EC) in East Asia including China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, as well as in Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, and other regions. In the United States, the Company is conducting test sales through both offline mail-order and EC channels.

name: JAPANIACE
businessSummary: Japaniace Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of advanced engineering business that provides on-site development support and contract development. The Company participates in projects in four fields, such as software, infrastructure, mechatronics, and electronics. The Company is engaged in the provision of technology for projects in new areas such as artificial intelligence (AI), cloud, and next generation communications. Contracts with client companies are mainly dispatch contracts, but also partial contract contracts and quasi-delegation contracts. Business areas include software, infrastructure, mechatronics, electronics, and AI.

name: NAGANO KEIKI
businessSummary: Nagano Keiki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of pressure gauges, pressure sensors, measurement and control equipment, die-casting, as well as related businesses and the manufacture and sale of application products. The Company has four business segments. The Pressure Gauge Business segment manufactures and sells pressure gauges, pressure switches, and thermometers. The Pressure Sensor Business segment manufactures and sells pressure sensors. The Measurement and Control Equipment Business segment manufactures and sells pneumatic equipment, air leak testers, pressure testers, pressure generators, and other application-developed products. The Die-Casting Business segment manufactures and sells die-cast products. The Company also operates real estate rental and automotive electrical equipment businesses.

name: TAKUMA
businessSummary: TAKUMA CO., LTD. is a company that is active in four business segments. The Domestic Environment and Energy segment is engaged in the design, construction, sale, operation and maintenance of general waste treatment plants, industrial waste treatment plants, resource recovery plants, sewage disposal plants, sludge incineration plants, biomass electric generation plants and generation gas turbine systems. The Overseas Environment and Energy segment provides waste power generation plants and biomass power generation plants. The Civilian Heat Energy segment offers miniature through-flow boilers and vacuum hot-water supply heaters. The Facilities and Systems segment is involved in the sale and maintenance of building facilities, semiconductor industry-use facilities and clean systems.

name: CE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: CE Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, develops and sells electronic medical record systems in Japan. The company engages in the development, implementation, operation, and maintenance of medical information systems  develops MI RA Is, an electronic medical record system  develops, implements, operates, and maintains nursing work systems  offers clinical development support services using imaging technology  and dispatches skilled personnel for clinical development. It also provides industrial health, human resource, and marketing services  and offers digital marketing implementation support, as well as trains digital marketing personnel. The company was formerly known as CEI Corporation and changed its name to CE Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2013. CE Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

name: COLUMBIA WORKS
businessSummary: Columbia Works Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of real estate development services and related business activities such as real estate leasing and management services, hotel management services, and asset management services. The Real Estate Development Business segment mainly includes residences (rental condominiums), offices, and hotels, and develops residences under the Blance and LUMIEC brand names and offices under the BIASTA brand name. Real estate leasing and management services mainly involve leasing and managing commercial facilities, offices, and residences. Hotel management services provide hotel management services through the creation of art hotels and other spaces. Asset management services provide asset formation, asset management, and asset preservation services on behalf of investors.

name: WAGOKORO
businessSummary: Wagokoro Co., Ltd. engages in retail, services, and OEM businesses in Japan. The company operates stores, which offers Japanese accessories, hairpins, Japanese umbrellas, and yukatas  and sells its products through physical stores, e-commerce sites, mail order sites, and exhibition halls. It also rents Kimono  manufacture and sells silver accessories, stone bracelets, medals and pin badges, sunglasses/glasses, emblems, buckles, boxes, hats, jewelry, leather products, and chopsticks  and provides luggage storage services. In addition, the company renovates vacant houses  and operates real estate leasing and accommodation facilities. Wagokoro Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: SANKO
businessSummary: SANKO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precision components manufacturing and units processing business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of press products, hinge products, mechatronics products such as liquid crystal monitor constant-speed opening and closing mechanisms, and car navigation monitor opening and closing mechanisms, as well as plastic products such as insulators, resin frames and resin gears for automotive-related products, housing equipment-related products, office equipment-related products and digital appliance-related products. The Company is also engage in the insurance agency business.

name: KIMURA CHEMICAL PLANTS
businessSummary: KIMURA CHEMICAL PLANTS Co., Ltd. is engaged in the engineering, chemical machinery, and energy and environment businesses. The Engineering segment designs, manufactures, processes and sells various evaporation devices, crystallization devices, cleansing devices, stirring equipment, pressure containers, as well as stainless, steel and resin piping works. The Chemical Machinery is engaged in the design of various plants, the management and contract construction works of machinery manufacturing, existing facility removal, installation, piping, painting, thermal insulation, test operation adjustment and maintenance. The Energy and Environment segment is involved in the design, manufacture, process and sale of atomic fuel transportation casks and storage containers, nuclear fuel concentration equipment and irradiation-related facilities, among others.

name: RICOH
businessSummary: RICOH COMPANY,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, production, sales, and service activities for digital services, digital products, graphic communications, industrial solutions and others. The Digital Services segment sells equipment—including multifunction printers (MFPs), printers, printing presses, wide-format machines, fax machines, and scanners. The Digital Products segment manufactures and sells (including via OEM) equipment such as MFPs, printers, printing presses, wide-format machines, fax machines, and network-related devices (along with related consumables). The Graphic Communications segment manufactures and sells equipment such as cut-sheet production printers (PP), continuous-feed PP, and inkjet heads. The Industrial Solutions segment manufactures and sells products such as thermal paper, thermal media, and precision equipment components. The Other segment encompasses businesses involving digital cameras, 360-degree cameras, and others.

name: CENTRAL GLASS
businessSummary: Central Glass Co Ltd is engaged in the electronic materials, energy materials, life and healthcare, and glass businesses. The Company conducts its operations through these four segments. The Electronic Materials segment primarily manufactures and sells high-purity gases for semiconductor processes. The Energy Materials segment manufactures and sells electrolytes for lithium-ion batteries. The Life & Healthcare segment primarily manufactures and sells medical chemicals, specialty chemicals, and fertilizers. The Glass segment primarily manufactures and sells architectural glass, automotive glass, and glass fiber. The Company also engages in trading and other businesses.

name: BUNKA SHUTTER
businessSummary: Bunka Shutter Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of shutters, and housing and building materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Shutter-related Products segment offers lightweight shutters, heavy shutters, over-sliding doors, panel shutters and window shutters. The Construction Material-related Products segment offers exterior products, cross-cut weatherboardings, doors, partitions and other related products. The Service segment is engaged in maintenance and repair of existing shutters and building materials. The Reform segment is engaged in the renovation of housing.

name: SANYO TRADING
businessSummary: Sanyo Trading Co., Ltd. is engaged in the trading of rubber, chemicals, machinery equipment, scientific equipment and automobile parts. The Company operates in four segments. The Chemical segment offers synthetic rubber, auxiliary materials for rubber, natural rubber, medical-related materials, plasticizer, resin tube, reclaimed rubber, adhesives, synthetic resins, ink, industrial gases, pesticides, ceramics, various films, pigment, pharmaceutical intermediates, perfumes and surfactants, among others. The Machinery and Equipment segment offers environment-related equipment, test equipment, measuring equipment, industrial instrumentation, thermal processing equipment and others. The Overseas Subsidiary segment offers synthetic rubber, natural rubber, medical-related materials and various films, among others. The Domestic Subsidiary segment offers industrial drugs, oil drilling devices and others. The Domestic Subsidiary segment provides oil, natural gas and geothermal drilling products.

name: OKAMURA
businessSummary: Okamura Corp is a company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of office environmental equipment, commercial environmental equipment and logistics system equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Office Environmental segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of office furniture, communal facility furniture, security products and health care products. The Commercial Environmental segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of store shelves, freezer showcases, refrigerated showcases and store counters. The Logistics System segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of logistics equipment, such as storage racks for factories and warehouses, logistics automatic equipment and facilities. The Company also manufactures and sells fluid transmissions for industrial vehicles and construction machinery.

name: SEIBU ELECTRIC & MACHINERY
businessSummary: Seibu Electric & Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of transport machinery, industrial machinery and precision machinery, sale aftermarket service activities, as well as the sale of machinery parts and multi-story parking equipment and operation of parking lots. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transport Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of logistics systems and transport equipment. The Industrial Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of valve actuators and gate drive devices. The Precision Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ultra-precision and high-precision wire electric discharge machines and ultra-precision and high-precision numerical control (NC) lathes. The Company is also engaged in the sale of mechanical equipment parts and multi-story parking equipment, as well as parking lot management and other businesses.

name: NIPPON TELEVISION HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nippon Television Holdings, Inc. is a certified broadcast holding company. The Company operates in three business segments. The Content Business segment is engaged in the sale of television advertising frames, the licensing of program contents, the production and publication of movies, the organizing of events, mail order business and the publishing and sale of publications, program broadcasting operations, homepage design and Website operation, as well as advertising and marketing business, among others. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases offices and commercial tenants and lands, and provides building management services. The Company is also engaged in ecology related business, the operation of stores and other businesses.

name: ICHIKAWA
businessSummary: Ichikawa Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells paper making and industrial felts in Japan and internationally. It offers paper making press felts and belts, and shoe press and transfer belts  industrial products, such as heat-resistant conveyance equipment and cushioning materials for use in the car bodies, internet of things, 5th generation, carports, consumer electronics, smartphones, tablets, aluminum sash products, printed circuit boards, flexible boards, and clothing  and felts for slate. The company also offers weaving, sewing and other processing of textiles  cargo handling and storage of products and other services. Ichikawa Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS
businessSummary: SHINOBU FOODS PRODUCTS CO., LTD. is engaged in the production and sale of prepared food products, such as sushi, rice balls, lunch boxes, prepared bread and other perishable food products. Through its subsidiary, the Company also engaged in leasing of real estate.

name: WIN PARTNERS
businessSummary: WIN-Partners Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the medical equipment supply business through its subsidiaries. The Company is mainly in the provision of medical device, such as catheters used in ischemic heart disease, pacemakers used in cardiac rhythm management area, artificial blood vessels used for cardiovascular surgery area, embolization coil used in peripheral vascular disease and brain surgery, as well as the provision of large -scale medical equipment, such as computed tomography equipment (CT) used in the radiology department and the operating room.

name: TRE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TRE Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the waste treatment and recycling business, renewable energy business, environmental engineering business and resource recycling business. The waste treatment and recycling business includes collection and transportation, intermediate treatment, recycling and final disposal site. The renewable energy business operates a woody biomass power plant that mainly uses forest resources as fuel. The environmental engineering business develops, manufactures and sells environmental equipment, plants and specially equipped vehicles. The environmental consulting business includes measurement certification business, environmental measures business, hazardous waste investigation and analysis business. The resource recycling business includes metal recycling business, automobile recycling business, industrial waste treatment business, home appliance recycling business and other businesses.

name: OVAL
businessSummary: OVAL Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly operates in sensors manufacturing business. The sensors division manufactures and sells industrial measuring equipment and related equipment. The systems division manufactures and sells instrumentation and control and management equipment. The service devision is responsible for the maintenance of industrial measuring instruments and equipment, and the calibration of flow meters. Products include flow meters, electronic meters, peripheral and related equipment and system equipment.

name: DAIICHI LIFE GROUP
businessSummary: Daiichi Life Group Inc, formerly Dai-ichi Life Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based insurance holding company that mainly operates in the insurance business and owns domestic and overseas life insurance companies as subsidiaries, and manages the subsidiaries. The Company operates through three business segments. The Domestic Insurance segment is engaged in the provision of individual insurances, individual annuity insurances, group insurances, group annuity insurances and other life insurances, the non-life insurances, as well as the life insurance related business, such as the acquisition of securities, real estate and monetary claims. The Overseas Insurance segment is engaged in the insurance business overseas. The Other segment is mainly engaged in the management of group companies and non-insurance businesses such as asset management business and new businesses.

name: TOYODA GOSEI
businessSummary: TOYODA GOSEI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts. It operates through six segments, including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Africa, China, Asia, and India, and conducts businesses related to automotive parts and other products. The automotive parts business manufactures and sells automotive parts and related molds and machinery, including safety system products such as various airbags and steering wheels, interior and exterior parts such as instrument panels and components, and radiator grilles, functional parts such as plastic fuel filler pipes and plastic turbo ducts, and weatherstrip products such as door glass runs and opening trim weatherstrips. The other business is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of materials and equipment for pipeline rehabilitation methods, as well as hoses for firefighting and fire hydrants.

name: NSD
businessSummary: NSD Co., Ltd. provides various IT solutions in Japan. The company plans, designs, and develops systems  constructs IT infrastructure  and offers IT-utilized and IT consulting services. It also provides IT infrastructure services, including planning and procurement services comprising consulting and IT infrastructure sales support  design, development, and installation services, such as cloud, platform, network, storage, virtualization infrastructure, and security infrastructure design and development support services, as well as application development support services  and operation and maintenance services, such as system operation management and maintenance, system operation, lifecycle management, and helpdesk services. In addition, the company offers all-purpose software and duty-specific software products, and software development services. It serves finance, manufacturing, commerce, construction/real estate, service, transportation, telecommunication, and utilities industries. NSD Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: BROTHER INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Brother Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of office equipment and supplies. The Company operates in six business segments. The Printing and Solutions segment manufactures and sells communication and printing equipment like printers, multifunction devices and electronic stationery, among others. The Personal and Home segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of household sewing machines. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells industrial sewing machines, garment printer, machine tools, reducers and gears, among others. The Network and Contents segment is involved in the manufacture, sale and service of commercial karaoke equipment, as well as the provision of contents delivery services. The Domino segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial printing equipment. The Others segment is involved in the real estate business.

name: PRESTIGE INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Prestige International Inc. provides business process outsourcing services in Japan and internationally. The company offers roadside assistance services for nonlife insurance companies, car manufacturers, and car dealerships  and property assistance services, such as home and parking assistance services for real estate management companies, parking lot operators, and car sharing service stations. The company also provides insurance services, including travel insurance claim agent services  financial guarantee services for rent, child support expenses, nursing care expenses, and medical expenses  supply chain management, IT, and mobile solutions  CRM and temporary staffing solutions  and childcare service under the Orangery name. In addition, it offers pet consultation, emergency calls and reporting, towing, co-signing, rental property business management, living support, rehabilitation day, and value-added services, as well as sales promotion systems, and support for implementing supply-chain management  rental property management services  rent guarantee insurance services  and rental warranty and co-signing services. Prestige International Inc. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FEED ONE
businessSummary: Feed One Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in livestock feed business, aquatic feed business, and food business. It operates through three segments. The Livestock Feed segment manufactures and sells compound feed, produces and sells pig and chicken eggs, and operates dairy farming business for the purpose of compound feed research. The Aquatic Feed segment manufactures and sells compound feed, purchases and sells marine products, and operates aquaculture business for the purpose of compound feed research. The Food segment purchases, processes, and sells meat and eggs. The Company is also engaged in overseas business, as well as the leasing and management of real estate.

name: OKI ELECTRIC INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Oki Electric Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in public solutions, enterprise solutions, component products, electronic manufacturing services (EMS) businesses. It operates through four business segments. Public Solutions segment manufactures and sells communication equipment for road-related systems, aviation-related systems and others and provides system construction and solutions. Enterprise Solutions segment manufactures and sells automated teller machines (ATMs), cash processing machines, branch terminals, reservation and issuing terminals, check-in terminals, foreign currency exchange machines and others and provides construction and maintenance services. Component Products segment manufactures and sells edge devices, sensor networks, private branch exchanges (PBX) and others. EMS segment manufactures and sells design and production contract services, printed wiring boards, cables and others. It also promotes activities aimed at creating future businesses.

name: RION
businessSummary: Rion Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and service of particle counters, medical equipment and environmental equipment. It operates through three segments. The Particle Counter segment manufactures and sells particle counters such as liquid particle counters and airborne particle counters. The Medical Equipment segment manufactures and sells hearing aids and medical testing equipment. The Environmental Equipment segment manufactures and sells sound and vibration measuring instruments such as sound level meters, vibration meters, seismometers and frequency analyzers.

name: MARUZEN SHOWA UNYU
businessSummary: Maruzen Showa Unyu Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the lorry transportation business, port transportation business and on-site work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Logistics segment is involved in the lorry transportation business, freight transportation business (lorry, railroad, ocean shipping, coastal shipping, and air transportation), port transportation business (general port transportation, port cargo handling (onboard and coastal barge transportation), warehouse Business, customs clearance, packing, marine transportation and air transportation agency. The On-Site Work and Machinery Cargo Handling segment is engaged in the transportation, assembly, replenishing, storage and cargo handling of raw materials, products, heavy cargos and precision machinery in factories, as well as the leasing of machinery. The Company also provides services such as construction, security, real estate, insurance agency and car maintenance.

name: YAGI &
businessSummary: YAGI & CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the trading, import and export of textile products. The Company operates business through raw material field, textile field and textile secondary products field. The Company is also engaged in the textile processing business, real estate business and other businesses.

name: CTI ENGINEERING
businessSummary: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of construction consulting services for public works such as rivers, dams, roads, the environment, and information. The Company operates in two business segments. The Domestic Construction Consulting segment is conducts comprehensive consulting business such as planning, survey, planning, design, orderer support, construction management, operation and maintenance of public works in Japan, and associated system development, maintenance management, general office work consignment and others. The Overseas Construction Consulting segment provides comprehensive consulting services for all construction projects such as excavation of projects overseas, the formulation, planning, investigation, design, construction management, operation and maintenance of master plans, and building-related businesses including structural design and equipment design.

name: SEIREN
businessSummary: Seiren Co.,Ltd. manufactures and markets textile products, industrial machines, and electronic parts in Japan and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Vehicle Upholstery Materials, High Fashion Materials, Electronics Materials, Environmental & Life Materials, and Medical Materials. The Vehicle Materials segment offers interior materials for automobiles, railway cars, etc., as well as seat materials, air bags, and decorative parts. The High Fashion Materials segment engages in textile processing, and various clothing products. The Electronics Materials segment offers conductive materials, industrial wiping cloths, Viscotecs systems and supply, wafer deposition and processing, artificial satellites  electronic devices, film deposition on silicon wafer. The Environmental & Life Materials provides building materials, interior materials, health and care products, and environmental/civil engineering materials. The Medical Materials offers medical supplies, cosmetics, and water treatment materials. It provides digital production systems  and civil engineering, construction, and industrial materials. The company also offers environmentally-friendly materials  beauty/health care materials  medical/nursing care materials  and life/interior materials. In addition, it engages in the automotive interior, clothing materials, and textile finishing materials businesses, as well as provides sales promotion. The company was formerly known as Fukui Seiren Kako Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Seiren Co.,Ltd. in 1973. Seiren Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

name: NIPPON AQUA
businessSummary: Nippon Aqua Co., Ltd. engages in the development, sale, and installation of insulation materials in Japan. It offers a waterproofing material that is used to prevent leaks, cracks, and deterioration in various buildings, condominiums, multi-story parking garages, warehouses, and wooden houses under Aqua Hazikun brand name. The company is also involved in spray-applied rigid polyurethane foam insulation on buildings apartment buildings, factories, etc. that are made of reinforced concrete, steel-reinforced concrete, or steel-framed construction  and installation of spray-on rigid urethane foam for detached houses. In addition, it offers insulation construction machinery, urethane raw materials, and other auxiliary materials, as well as includes construction projects, such as condominiums, hospitals, schools, office buildings, factories, data center buildings, cold storage warehouses, grain warehouses, and other. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Nippon Aqua Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hinokiya Group Co.,Ltd.

name: COSMOS INITIA
businessSummary: Cosmos Initia Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the residential business, solutions business, accommodation business, construction business, and related businesses. It operates through four business segments. The Residential segment sells new condominiums, detached houses and renovated condominiums, brokers condominiums, provides real estate management services, and develops condominiums for sale in Australia. The Solutions segment sells income-generating real estate, manages and operates real estate rentals, brokers income-generating real estate and commercial land, provides property consulting, and renovates and sells used income-generating real estate in the United States. The Accommodation segment sells and operates hotel facilities and plans and operates outdoor resorts. The Construction segment provides office relocation and interior construction, architecture and renovation work, and condominium gallery construction.

name: DAITRON
businessSummary: Daitron Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, manufacture, and import and export of electronic devices and components, as well as manufacturing equipment. The Company has three business segments: domestic sales, domestic manufacturing, and overseas operations. Electronic devices and components include electronic components and assembly products, semiconductors, embedded systems, power supplies, imaging-related equipment and components, information systems, and other electronic devices and components. Manufacturing equipment includes optical device manufacturing equipment, large-scale integrated circuit (LSI) manufacturing equipment, flat panel display manufacturing equipment, electronic material manufacturing equipment, and energy device manufacturing equipment.

name: SYSTEM RESEARCH
businessSummary: SYSTEM RESEARCH CO., LTD. involves in system integration and software development. The Company operates software related business. Its SI Services segment involves in planning, design, development of information systems. The software development business, centering on major companies, engages in system development and maintenance. Software project business creates, sells, and maintains programs for unspecified users. Product sales business conducts purchase and sale of products such as information equipment, software and others. Others include website management, cloud service.

name: SUZUKI MOTOR
businessSummary: Suzuki Motor Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles, automobiles, outboard motors and electric wheelchairs, and is also engaged in logistics and other services related to each business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Four-wheel Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of mini vehicles, compact vehicles, and standard-sized vehicles. The Two-wheeled Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of motorcycles and buggy cars. The Marine Business segment manufactures and sells outboard motors. The Others Business segment is engaged in the electric wheelchair, solar power generation, and real estate businesses.

name: CHUBUSHIRYO
businessSummary: Chubushiryo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the feed business. The Feed segment manufactures and sells livestock feed for chickens, pigs, and cattle, as well as aquatic feed for fish. In addition, the Company is also involved in the sale of livestock and marine products to consumers, the sale of livestock equipment, the manufacture and sale of compound fertilizers, the leasing of real estate for utilizing former factory sites, insurance agency business, and egg business.

name: JSP
businessSummary: JSP Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic products with enhanced functionality and economic efficiency, mainly using foaming technology. The Company operates business through two business segments. The Extrusion segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polystyrene, polyethylene, polypropylene sheets, boards and others, using extrusion foam technology as its core. The Beads segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of foamed polypropylene, foamed polyethylene, and foamed polystyrene products based on bead foaming technology. The Company also operates businesses related to the sale of general packaging materials.

name: INFRONEER HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Infroneer Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive infrastructure services. The construction business develops construction work centered on apartment buildings and office buildings. The civil engineering business develops construction work centered on bridges and tunnels. The pavement business develops construction work such as pavement work. The manufacturing business revolves around the manufacturing and sales of construction equipment. The infrastructure management business operates renewable energy business and the concession business. name: HOSOYA PYRO ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Hosoya Pyro-Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of pyrotechnic products in Japan. The company offers small smoke flares for mountaineering  mountain markers for stream and shower climbing  diver markers smoke flares for scuba diving and underwater work  pollution-free smoke flares for airtightness testing  rainbow smoke golf balls for golf competitions  bird cracker, a firework used to deter birds  emergency signal lights for aircraft  emergency signal kits  and ignition wires for fireworks. It also rents out various facilities, such as large commercial stores, large laboratory buildings, and powder magazines. The company was formerly known as Hosoya Bussan Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hosoya Pyro-Engineering Co., Ltd. in January 1954. Hosoya Pyro-Engineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Akiruno, Japan.

name: NIPPON FINE CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Nippon Fine Chemical Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of industrial, pharmaceutical and cosmetic chemicals as well as household products. The Company operates in two segments. The Industrial Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing, sales and purchasing of cosmetic raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, resin additives, leather oils, vegetable fats and oils, synthetic resin products etc. The Household Products segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of industrial detergents, medicated soap solution, eradication and disinfectant, and insect repellent etc. Other businesses include real estate operation and consignment business of pharmacology and safety test.

name: SUN LIFE HOLDING
businessSummary: SUN LIFE HOLDING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of group companies which conduct ceremony, nursing care and other related business. The Company provides hotel & bridal service, funeral & Buddhist sermon service, nursing care service and other related services, for regional customers and mutual aid association members in the members' system (mutual benefit association). The Company’s subsidiary SUN LIFE CORPORATION operates in four business segments: hotel business, ceremonial business, other business and company-wide (common).

name: A&D HOLON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: A&D Holon Holdings Co Ltd, formerly A&D Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring instrument, medical and healthcare equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Measuring Instrument segment provides measuring, control and simulation systems, electron guns for semiconductor exposure apparatus, analog to digital (AD) and digital to analog (DA) converters, testing machines, environmental measuring instrument, electronic balances, platform scales, indicators, counting scales and load cells. The Medical and Healthcare Equipment segment offers digital hemopiezometers for home use, blood pressure monitors, full automatic hemopiezometers, precision weighing scales and ultrasonic inhalators.

name: NOHMI BOSAI
businessSummary: NOHMI BOSAI LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of fire alarm systems and firefighting equipment as well as the maintenance of these devices. The Company operates in three segments. The Fire Alarm Devices segment is engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, and smoke extinguishing facilities, etc. The Firefighting Equipment segment is engaged in manufacturing, sales and installation of various sprinkler equipment, foam fire extinguishing equipment, plant disaster prevention equipment, tunnel disaster prevention equipment etc. The Maintenance and Inspection segment is engaged in the maintenance, inspection and repair of various disaster prevention equipment. Other business includes construction and maintenance of parking lane traffic control systems as well as manufacture and sales of crime prevention equipment operated by its affiliate companies.

name: ALTECH
businessSummary: Altech Corporation is a Japan-based company that principally engaged in the provision of outsourcing services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Outsourcing Service segment is engaged in the dispatching of technicians for mechanical, electrical and information processing and designing; the undertaken of technology projects, as well as staffing and contracted operation of office support and computer-aided design (CAD) business. The Global segment is engaged in the installation and maintenance of industrial machinery and equipment for overseas Japanese factories, as well as the provision of human resource services. The Company has four subsidiaries.

name: S&B FOODS
businessSummary: S&B FOODS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, processing and distribution of foodstuffs, with a focus on manufacturing and processing food products that use spices as raw materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Foodstuff segment is involved in the production and sale of various spices and condiments, instant curry, tube products, retort curry and others, as well as the procurement of related raw materials. The Cooked Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cooked food.

name: URBANET
businessSummary: Urbanet Corporation Co.,Ltd. engages in the development and sale of real estate properties in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Real Estate Business and Hotel Business. It is involved in development and sale of condominiums for investment and sales  development and sale of detached houses  acquisition and sale of business land  development and sale of entire urban rental apartment buildings  and real estate leasing and brokerage, as well as contract work, including design, design supervision, and construction management  and financial instruments business. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KANDENKO
businessSummary: Kandenko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the facilities construction business, the electric equipment sales business, the real estate business, the leasing business and the power generation business. The Equipment Engineering segment is engaged in the business related to electricity, pipe work and other equipment. This segment is also engaged in construction security business, as well as design and calculation business. The Company is engaged in the real estate business and the power generation business, the electrical equipment sales business and the leasing business. The Company is also involved in lease business of land, buildings and vehicles. The Company is also involved in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of software for cable television operators.

name: ERI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ERI Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the evaluation, rating, and inspection businesses. The Company operates through three segments. The Building Confirmation and Inspection and Related Business segment is engaged in the inspection and confirmation of buildings, and the structural evaluation of high-rise buildings. The Housing Performance Evaluation and Related Business segment is engaged in the housing performance evaluation of new and existing homes, and technical review work related to the certification of long-term excellent homes. The Solution Business segment is engaged in due diligence work, inspection work, housing and consumer work. The Company conducts inspections for housing defect liability insurance, Flat 35 compliance certification, and technical reviews of low-carbon buildings. It also provides regular architect training, exam courses, seminars, and contract development of architectural computer-aided design (CAD) and cost estimating systems.

name: DAIDO SIGNAL
businessSummary: Daido Signal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of railway signaling equipment and industrial equipment, and the provision of maintenance and repair service to these equipment, as well as installation work of railway signaling equipment, the manufacture and sale of metal surface treatment and mold, and leasing of real estate. The Company operates through three business segments. The Railway Signal-related Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and installation of railway signal security equipment. The Industrial Equipment-related Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of information and communication equipment, traffic signal equipment, railroad vehicle supplies, gas detectors, plastic molded products, metal surface treatments, and molds. The Real Estate-related Business segment mainly rents real estate.

name: HOKUTO
businessSummary: Hokuto Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the domestic mushroom business, overseas mushroom business, processed products business and chemical products business. It operates through four segments. The Domestic Mushroom segment is engaged in the domestic production and sale of mushroom products, mainly Bunashimeji, Eryngii and Maitake. The Overseas Mushroom segment is engaged in the overseas production and sale of mushroom products, mainly Bunashimeji, Eryngii and Maitake. The Processed Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods using mushrooms, various retort pouch foods such as curry and soup, and sales of supplements. The Chemical Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaging materials and agricultural supplies.

name: KURABO INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Kurabo Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in textile business, chemical products business, environmental mechatronics business, food and service business, and real estate business. It operates through five segments. The Textile segment manufactures and sells yarn, textiles, and textile products. The Chemical Products segment manufactures, processes, and sells soft urethane, functional resin products, residential building materials, nonwoven fabrics, and functional materials. The Environmental Mechatronics segment manufactures, sells, and maintains information system equipment, inspection and measurement systems, designs, manufactures, constructs, and sells various environment- and energy-related plants, operates biomass power generation, and manufactures and sells bio-related products. The Food and Service segment manufactures and sells freeze-dried foods and operates hotels and driving schools. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate.

name: TSURUMI MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: Tsurumi Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pumps. It operates through four regional segments including Japan, North America, Asia, and Europe. It manufactures, purchases, sells (including imports and exports), and leases various pumps, mainly submersible pumps, environmental equipment, and related equipment, as well as provides repair and after-sales services. It also engages in machinery and equipment installation, civil engineering, electrical work, piping, waterworks, cleaning facilities, steel structure construction, secondhand goods sales, fixed asset leasing, and the casting, manufacture, purchasing and sale of various pump parts. It is also engaged in real estate rental and machinery, office equipment and vehicle leasing business.

name: FUKUDA DENSHI
businessSummary: FUKUDA DENSHI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture, purchase and sale of medical electronic equipment. The Company operates in four business segments. The Biopsy Device segment mainly involves in the manufacture, trading and sales of electrocardiographs, ultrasound diagnostic imaging equipment, automated hemocytometers, etc. The Biological Information Monitoring segment involves in the manufacture, trading and sale of biological information monitors. The Therapy Apparatus segment involves in the manufacture, trading and sale of defibrillators, ventilators, pacemakers, catheters, home rental business, etc. The Consumable Supplies and Others segment provides the consumable goods of equipment for all segments as well as repair and maintenance services.

name: ESLEAD
businessSummary: Eslead Corporation develops and sells family-type and urban condominiums in Japan. The company provides commercial and business facilities, which includes commercial facilities, hotels and vacation rentals, offices, hospices, logistics facilities, nursing homes, and roadside store development  and housing business offers apartment and detached houses. It also engages in the general construction business, which includes apartment, factory, and pavilion construction  and real estate management business offers, rental, electricity supply, large scale repair and renovation, brokerage, hotel operation and management, securitization, and cleaning and security management businesses. In addition, the company engages in solar power generation and digital marketing business. Eslead Corporation was formerly known as Nihon Eslead Corporation and changed its name to Eslead Corporation in October 2019. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Osaka, Japan. Eslead Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Mori Trust Co., Ltd.

isin: 6741.T|Nippon Signal Co., Ltd.|6741.T|Nippon Signal Co., Ltd.
name: NIPPON SIGNAL
businessSummary: Nippon Signal Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops technologies for railway signal systems in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Transportation Infrastructure Business and ICT Solution Business segments. It offers railway signal safety systems, road traffic safety systems, station service automation systems, security solutions, parking lot system, robotics, platform safety systems, ground penetrating radars, and 3D laser ranging image sensors and MEMS scanners. The company is also involved in manufacture, sale, and maintenance of railway signaling equipment and road traffic safety systems  and manufacturing, sale, and maintenance services of automatic flood control equipment and parking equipment. Nippon Signal Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: DAIWA SECURITIES GROUP
businessSummary: Daiwa Securities Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities related business and other investment and financial business. The Company operates through four business segments. Retail segment is engaged in the provision of financial products and services for individuals and unlisted corporates. Wholesale segment is engaged in the global markets business, including the sale and trading of stocks, bonds and others, as well as the global investment banking business, including securities underwriting, merger and acquisition (M&A) advisory and others. Asset Management segment is engaged in the establishment and management of investment trusts, and the provision of investment advisory and management services for pension assets. Investment segment is engaged in the provision of investment recovery in existing projects, and the creation of new investment funds. The Company is also engaged in the management, banking, information and real estate leasing business.

name: EXEDY
businessSummary: Exedy Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of manual and automatic transmission-related automobile components. The Company has two business segments. The Manual Transmission (MT) Related segment provides clutch discs, clutch covers and two-mass flywheels, among others. The Automatic Transmission (AT) Related segment provides torque converters and automatic transmissions parts. The others business provides motorcycle clutches, power shift transmissions and related parts, brakes, retarders and mechanical equipment, among others. This segment also provides transportation services.

isin: 4979.T|OAT Agrio Co., Ltd.|4979.T|OAT Agrio Co., Ltd.
name: OAT AGRIO
businessSummary: OAT Agrio Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells agrochemicals and fertilizers in Japan and internationally. The company provides Cyflumetofen, a plant protection product  Kaligreen, a fungicide to control a range of fungal diseases in fruits, vegetables and flowers  and Flutianil, plant protection product against the fungal pathogens. It also offers Samppi/Kemppi fertilizer, which contains a biostim power composition  Atonik, a plant growth regulator and biostimulant  Potatol a product with components that promotes photosynthesis and maintains plant growth in various plant cultivation  and Misaki, which is designed for cut flowers. OAT Agrio Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Otsuka Chemical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to OAT Agrio Co., Ltd. in 2014. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: BROADBAND TOWER
businessSummary: BroadBand Tower, Inc. provides computer and media solutions platforms in Japan. It operates in two segments, Computer Platform Business and Media Solutions Business. The Computer Platform Business segment engages in the lease of real estate for data centers and installation of data center facilities  operation, maintenance support, construction of multi-cloud environments, MSP monitoring and operation services, and SaaS-based security solutions  provision of maintenance services for storage devices and related software products  and development and sale of information leakage prevention software products. Its Media Solutions Business segment includes content platform, a multi-channel program and in-house channel distribution service for cable TV operators  and information platform, a data broadcasting distribution service for community channels for cable TV operators and regional disaster prevention services for local governments. The company also offers JC-HITS, a multichannel broadcast streaming platform service for regional cable TV providers, and JC-DATA, a data broadcasting service. BroadBand Tower, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 4658.T|Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd.|4658.T|Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd.
name: NIPPON AIR CONDITIONING SERVICES
businessSummary: Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. provides general building facility maintenance services in Japan and internationally. The company develops equipment maintenance plans  maintenance and management/maintenance and renewal  diagnosis and evaluation of equipment  and validation support. It also offers radiation dose measurement  measurement of radioactive material concentration in wastewater  as well as technical training services. Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: GAKKYUSHA
businessSummary: Gakkyusha Co.,Ltd. operates and manages cram schools in Japan. It provides educational support services for students preparing to enter junior high school, high school, and university. In addition, it also offers online examination services and educational information distribution services. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA
businessSummary: UNIVERSAL ENGEISHA CO.,LTD is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the green business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Green business segment is engaged in rental green business and horticulture related products handled business throughout Kansai area, Kanto area and overseas area. The Wholesale business segment is engaged in sales of artificial flower, exterior stone and decorative plant. The Retail business segment is engaged in sales of plant, decorative plant and gardening materials in shops.

name: TOKUDEN
businessSummary: TOKUDEN CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the welding and welding-related businesses. The Company operates in two segments. The Works segment is involved in the welding of manufacturing machinery for the steel making, petrochemical, cement, home electrical appliance, automobile and food industries, as well as facility maintenance-related welding for the steel and non-ferrous metal industries. The Welding Materials segment purchases, manufactures and sells special welding materials, including flux wires, coated electrodes, various wire rods and pulverized materials. The Company is also involved in the sale of aluminum die-casting machine parts, including plunger sleeves, sprue bushes, plunger chips and ladles for automotive industry, the manufacture and sale of deodorization equipment, forced-air cooling apparatus.

name: ARTIENCE
businessSummary: artience Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture of chemical products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Color Materials and Functional Materials-Related Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of organic pigments, processed pigments, colorants for plastics, color filter materials, inkjet materials and lithium ion battery materials. The Polymer and Coating-Related Business segment manufactures and sells paints for cans, resins, adhesives, adhesives, coating materials, natural materials and medical products. The Package-Related Business segment manufactures and sells gravure ink, flexo ink and gravure cylinder plate making. The Printing and Information-Related Business segment manufactures and sells offset ink, metal ink, printing machinery, printing equipment, prepress systems, printing materials, and others. The Company also sells raw materials.

name: ADEKA
businessSummary: ADEKA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products and food ingredients. The Company operates through three business segments. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells resin additive products such as flame retardants; information and electric chemical products such as ultrapure semiconductor materials, light curing resin and others; functional chemical products such as additives, fire retardant, interfacial active agents and kitchen cleaning agents and others. The Life Sciences segment manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals, pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, veterinary medicines, wood medicines, and medical materials. The food segment manufactures and sells margarines, fats and oils for chocolate and others. The Company is also involved in the equipment plant design, construction and construction management, equipment maintenance, logistics, warehousing, leasing of vehicles, real estate, insurance agency and others.

name: HAGIHARA INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Hagihara Industries Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic and industrial machinery products in Japan, Indonesia, Asia, and internationally. The company offers synthetic resin processing products, including flat yarns, monofilaments, sheets and sandbags, commercial printing and masking adhesive tapes, meltac cloths, base fabric for flexible container bag, artificial turf and carpet backing cloths, and barchips. It also provides engineering products, such as slitters, rewinders, yarn winders, plastic recycled pellet manufacturing equipment, extruder-related equipment, and GX line. The company exports its products. Its products are used in disaster prevention, architecture and civil engineering, industry and livestock farming, and household goods applications. Hagihara Industries Inc. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Kurashiki, Japan.

isin: 3465.T|Ki-Star Real Estate Co.,Ltd|3465.T|Ki-Star Real Estate Co.,Ltd
name: KI STAR REAL ESTATE
businessSummary: Ki-Star Real Estate Co.,Ltd operates as a real estate company in Japan. The company is involved in the construction and sale of detached housing, custom-built housing, and land  and real estate transactions, property management, and residential land development businesses. It also engages in real estate leasing and brokerage businesses. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Honjo, Japan.

name: COMSYS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Comsys Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the telecommunications carrier, information technology (IT) solutions, and social systems-related business. The Company has eight business segments. The Nippon COMSYS Group segment is engaged in the construction of telecommunications facilities focusing on Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corporation (NTT) group. The SANWA COMSYS Engineering Group segment is engaged in the construction of telecommunications facilities focusing on new common carriers (NCCs). The TOSYS Group segment, TSUKEN Group segment, NDS Group segment, SYSKEN Group segment and Hokuriku Denwa Kouji Group segment are engaged in the telecommunications facility construction business in the Shinetsu, the Hokkaido, the Tokai and Hokuriku, the Kyushu and the Hokuriku areas. The COMSYS JOHO SYSTEM Group segment is engaged in the information processing business. The Company is also engaged in the staffing business and the shared service business.

name: IKK HOLDINGS
businessSummary: IKK Holdings Inc, formerly known as IKK Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the wedding business, nursing care business, food business, photo business, and marriage brokerage business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Wedding segment provides planning and management services related to wedding ceremonies and receptions. The Nursing Care segment operates paid nursing homes and provides nursing care services. The Food segment is engaged in the planning, development, and sales of gifts, confectionery, and gift products. The Photo segment provides planning and operating services of photo weddings and photo studios. The Marriage Brokerage segment provides planning and management services related to marriage brokerage.

name: METAWATER
businessSummary: METAWATER Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the design, construction, repair, maintenance and operation management of mechanical and electrical equipment for water purification plants, sewage treatment plants, waste treatment facilities and recycling facilities. The Company operates its business in two business segments. The Plant Engineering segment involves in the design, procurement and sale of mechanical and electrical equipment used in water purification plants and sewage treatment plants. The Service Solution segment involves in the repair, maintenance and operation management of mechanical and electrical equipment used in water purification plants and sewage treatment plants, providing equipment inspection, repair, maintenance and other services.

name: CITIZEN WATCH
businessSummary: Citizen Watch Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in watch business, machine tools business, device business, electronic machinery business and others. The Company consists of four business segments. The Watches and Clocks Business segment produces and sells watches and movements. The Machine Tool Business segment produces and sells computer numeric control (NC) automatic lathes and other equipment. The Devices Business segment provides light-emitting diodes (LEDs), automotive parts, quartz devices, and small motors. The Electronic Equipment and Others Business segment provides printers, health care equipment, and other items.

name: MIZUNO
businessSummary: Mizuno Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sporting goods. It manufactures and sells sports shoes, sportswear, baseball and golf products through four segments, including Japan, Europe, Americas, and Asia & Oceania. The Japan segment is also engaged in the construction of sports facilities, the operation and contract operation of sports facilities, school business, as well as the manufacture and sale of sports equipment, lifestyle products, and working products in Japan. The Asia & Oceania segment is also engaged in the construction of sports facilities.

isin: 5463.T|Maruichi Steel Tube Ltd.|5463.T|Maruichi Steel Tube Ltd.
name: MARUICHI STEEL TUBE
businessSummary: Maruichi Steel Tube Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel pipes, surface treated steel sheets, and poles in Japan, North America, and Asia. The company offers structural steel pipes  steel tube for piping  steel conduit and accessories  tubes and accessories for cable protection  synthetic resin-coated tubes for cable protection  lighting and signal pols, and equipment mounting column  and steel sheets. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: RESORTTRUST
businessSummary: Resorttrust, Inc. engages in the hotel and restaurant business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Membership business, Hotel and Restaurant business, and Medical business. The company sells loans to hotel membership purchasers, and the construction of membership-based hotels. It also operates 43 resort hotels and city hotels and 1 in Hawaii  14 golf courses, 30 medical facilities, and 23 senior residences. In addition, the company is also involved in the operation of hotels and restaurants, hotel cleaning, and member services. insurance agency services, manufacturing and sales of hair accessories, and total beauty services. Further, it offers medical memberships, lending of money to medical membership purchasers, establishment and operation/management consulting business, medical equipment leasing business, and home care service business, as well as develops medical equipment and research equipment. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: SINKO INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Sinko Industries Ltd. manufactures, sells, and installs air conditioning equipment in Japan and internationally. The company provides air conditioners, air handling unit, air handling terminal type, air handling compact type  heat pump air handling unit  data center air handling unit  heat exchanger  fan coil unit  and unit heater. It also offers large air volume fan coil unit  and special model fan coil unit. In addition, the company's products are used in central air conditioning systems, offices, factories, hospitals, and hotels. Sinko Industries Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 1950.T|Nippon Densetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd.|1950.T|Nippon Densetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd.
name: NIPPON DENSETSU KOGYO
businessSummary: Nippon Densetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in contracting, planning, designing, estimating, and supervising electrical equipment construction work in Japan. The company offers railway electronics construction, including electric train line construction, including overhead line construction, which provides electricity to trains  power generation and substation construction, which is the foundation of the power network for railway companies  power transmission line construction for transmitting electricity from power plants to substations  electric light power construction, for lighting facilities in station buildings, etc.  and railway signal construction. It also offers general electronics construction departments, such as installation works on electrical equipment in a broad range of buildings, including government buildings, hospitals, station buildings, airports, and road facilities. In addition, the company offers the construction of information and communications systems, including mobile communication-related fields, such as mobile phone base station construction for telecommunication carriers, infrastructure-sharing projects, network infrastructure building-related fields, including network system construction for local governments, hospitals, and universities, IC card system construction, as well as railway communication fields, such as surveillance cameras and train radio construction. Further, it engages in renewable energy, ZEB/energy-saving, air conditioning equipment, and plumbing and sanitary equipment businesses. The company was formerly known as Railway Electric Industries Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Densetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. in 1949. Nippon Densetsu Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: RIKEN KEIKI
businessSummary: Riken Keiki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial measuring instruments, as well as related business activities. It manufactures and sells gas detection and alarm equipment and provides after-sales maintenance services related to the equipment. Its products include portable gas detectors, fixed gas detectors, and other measuring instruments. Portable gas detectors include multi-gas detectors and single-component gas detectors. Fixed gas detectors include detectors, alarms, analyzers, and other components. It also offers analytical instruments, including atmospheric photoelectron yield spectroscopy instruments and portable multi-X-ray analyzers. Its industrial gas detectors are used in places where gas is likely to be generated and in industries that use gas, including semiconductor manufacturing, oil refining, steelmaking, power generation, city gas, waterworks and sewerage, food manufacturing, and others.

name: SEIKA
businessSummary: SEIKA CORPORATION is engaged in sale of mechanical equipment in electric power, chemical and energy, industrial machinery, materials and measurement fields, as well as the related services. The Electric Power segment provides power generation facilities, environmental conservation facilities and the related equipment. The Chemical and Energy segment provides power generation equipment, environmental protection equipment and related equipment, as well as manufacturing equipment for processes. The Industrial Machinery segment provides machinery in medicine, food and beverage, brewing, plant engineering, textiles, publishing and printing fields, and the maintenance services. The Material and Measurement segment provides various materials, textile raw materials and other raw materials, as well as measuring instruments. The Global segment provides pumps, wastewater treatment equipment, textile and chemical equipment, raw materials and electronics packaging related equipment.

name: A TIE
businessSummary: A-tie Co.,Ltd. engages in grave construction and management business. The company plans, designs, and constructs tree burials/permanent memorial graves and cemeteries. It also offers customer acquisition and sales agency services for cemetery users  and temple management consulting services. A-tie Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FURUNO ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Furuno Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine electronic devices and industrial electronic devices based on sensor technology centered on ultrasonic waves and electromagnetic waves. The Company operates through three business segments. The Marine Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of navigation equipment, fishing equipment, wireless communication equipment and others. The Industrial Business segment is engaged in the provision of medical equipment, intelligent transportation systems (ITS) equipment, global positioning system (GPS) equipment and aircraft electronics. The Wireless Local Area Network (LAN)/Handy Terminal Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wireless LAN systems and handy terminals. The Company is also engaged in the electromagnetic environment test business, and digital communication business for the shipping industry.

isin: 7172.T|Japan Investment Adviser Co., Ltd.|7172.T|Japan Investment Adviser Co., Ltd.
name: JAPAN INVESTMENT ADVISER
businessSummary: Japan Investment Adviser Co., Ltd. provides various financial solutions in Japan. It offers aircrafts and ships and containers operating lease, private equity investment, human resource, real estate investment, wealth management, and investment banking services, as well as provides mergers and acquisitions advisory services. The company also provides IR support services to listed companies  life and non-life insurance products  recruitment services  and operates Nihon Securities Newspaper, a securities and financial magazine. In addition, the company engages in power generation and parts out conversion business. Japan Investment Adviser Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TORISHIMA PUMP MFG
businessSummary: Torishima Pump Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of various pumps, pump plants, environmental equipment, small hydroelectric power generation facilities, mechanical seals, and other pump-related equipment, as well as installation work, services, and electricity supply operations. The pump business primarily involves the manufacture and sale of pumps, pump plants, mechanical seals, and other pump-related equipment, as well as installation work and services. The environmental and new energy business primarily involves the manufacture and sale of environmental equipment, the planning, manufacture, and sale of recycled products from various types of waste, and the sale, installation work, and services for small hydroelectric power generation equipment, along with electricity supply services.

name: KAMIGUMI
businessSummary: Kamigumi Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the logistics service business. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Domestic Logistics segment is engaged in the harbor transportation business, the warehouse business, the freight automobile transportation and other domestic transportation-related business. The Overseas Logistic segment is engaged in the international transportation business. The Company is also involved in the heavy construction machinery work business, the real estate leasing business, the sale and leasing of goods, the finance business, as well as the development, sale and maintenance of software, among others.

name: ZERIA PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Zeria Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of ethical drug business, consumer healthcare business and other business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Ethical Drug segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of ethical drugs. The Consumer Healthcare segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, health foods, quasi drugs and cosmetics related to self-medication.
