The others include insurance agency business and real estate business, as well as various maintenance business such as purchasing and sale of promotional materials.

name: OUG HOLDINGS
businessSummary: OUG Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale of marine products in Japan. The company distributes marine products primarily to wholesalers, mass retailers, supermarkets, restaurants, hotels, and stores. It is also involved in the aquaculture of yellowtail, sea bream, and amberjack  processing farmed fish fillets and local seafood  sale of live fish  sale of processed products, such as fresh fish, rice, and vegetables  logistics and distribution business  purchase and sale of fresh and frozen shrimp  sale of salt-dried sockeye salmon, mentaiko, cod roe, salmon roe, other fish roe, seafood bowl, and sushi products  and online sale of shrimps, crabs, and eel products. In addition, the company manufactures and sells food products for hotels and restaurants, as well as offers cooking agency services. Further, it is involved in the insurance agency and leasing businesses, and warehousing and logistics business. The company was formerly known as Osaka Uoichiba Co., Ltd. and changed its name to OUG Holdings Inc. in October 2006. OUG Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: OSAKA ORGANIC CHEMICAL INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of organic industrial chemicals. It operates in three segments. The Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells special acrylic esters and acrylic acid for paints, adhesives, and inks. Products include acrylic esters, methacrylic esters, and acrylic acid. The Electronic Materials segment manufactures and sells electronic materials, mainly for displays and semiconductors. Products include photoresist materials for liquid crystal display panel processing, photoresist raw materials for semiconductors (acrylic esters), and other functional polymers for electronic materials. The Functional Chemicals segment manufactures and sells raw materials for cosmetics, and functional materials. Products include cosmetic materials, functional materials, acetate esters, and special solvents.

isin: 9076.T|Seino Holdings Co., Ltd.|9076.T|Seino Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: SEINO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Seino Holdings Co., Ltd. provides transportation services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Transportation Services, Automotive Sales, Goods Sales, and Real Estate Leasing Services segments. It offers timed and cash on delivery/settlement services  charter delivery, letter and courier services, bicycle event and transport services, and bin services  and moving, shopping, and logistics services. The company also engages in the sale and repair of trucks, passenger cars, and automobile parts  and provision of shipping and office work support services, and reverse logistics/return management services. In addition, it sells fuel, paper, and paper products, as well as other products  and operates in the information-related services, temporary staffing services, construction contracting, and housing sales, as well as freight forwarding and warehousing business. Further, it offers non-life insurance agency, customs clearance, international multimodal transport business, administrative support services, advertising agencies, taxi services, travel agencies, temporary staffing services, housing sales, and printing services. The company was formerly known as Seino Transportation Co., Ltd. Seino Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Ogaki, Japan.

name: TOMOKU
businessSummary: Tomoku Co., Ltd. engages in the corrugated container and display carton, housing, transportation, and logistics businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells corrugated sheets, corrugated cases, and printed paper containers. It also engages in the construction and sale of Swedish style houses  and sale of domestic and overseas materials and machinery and insurance brokerage business, as well as provision of transportation, operation, warehousing, and recycling of food containers. In addition, the company sells machinery  import-export procedures for housing-related materials  renovates, extends, and reconstructs general houses and condominiums  and provides wooden truss of roofs and floors for small houses. Further, it provides transportation and logistics, and automobile-inspection services, as well as warehousing, factory works, and worker dispatching services  manages food and beverage distribution center, and delivery operation  and manufactures housing components for Sweden house. The company was formerly known as Toyo Wood Products Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tomoku Co., Ltd. in January 1971. Tomoku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TAKASHIMA &
businessSummary: Takashima & Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, proposal, process, material sale, and distribution of construction and building products in Japan. The company offers wall materials, foundation piles, insulation materials, solar panels, interiors, and various other products related to construction and building. it also provides construction management services  textile and resin products  textile materials  sales promotion materials  apparel products  motor vehicle related parts and materials  wood products, rubber goods  environmentally friendly products  and industrial materials. In addition, it offers refrigerant gas for air conditioner, freezer, refrigeration equipment, and other products. Takashima & Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Takashimaya Kogyou Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Takashima & Co., Ltd. in 1949. Takashima & Co., Ltd. was founded in 1915 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NARERU GROUP
businessSummary: Nareru Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides engineer outsourcing services for the construction industry in Japan. The company offers engineer dispatching services, construction DX consulting, architectural drawing for the construction and plant industries  and recruitment services, as well as operates a human resource matching platform. It also dispatches engineers for the IT industry and offers system engineering services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 4997.T|Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd.|4997.T|Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd.
name: NIHON NOHYAKU
businessSummary: Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals in Japan, Asia, North America, Central America, South America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Pesticides, Chemicals Other Than Pesticides, and Others. It offers crop protection products, including fungicides, insecticides, and herbicides  crop aid and adjuvant products, such as biostimulants, adjuvants, and soil conditioners  termiticides and other chemical products  pharmaceuticals comprising topical antifungal drugs  flea/tick control agents for animals  wood preservatives  and agricultural materials. The company also engages in landscaping and greening construction  real estate rental  logistics services  and pesticide residue analysis. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan. Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Adeka Corporation.

name: YONDENKO
businessSummary: Yondenko Corporation engages in the electrical, and electrical power transmission and distribution facilities, construction activities in Japan. It operates through three segments: Equipment Construction Business, Leasing Business, and Solar Power Generation Business. The Equipment Construction Business segment undertakes and executes power distribution construction, power transmission and civil engineering construction, electrical and instrumentation construction, air conditioning and piping construction, and information and communication construction. The Leasing Business segment leases construction machinery, vehicles, and equipment. The Solar Power Business segment leases solar power generation equipment and sells electricity generated by solar power. In addition, it is involved in the development and sale of CAD software  and provides designated management services, and sells construction materials. The company was formerly known as Shikoku Electric Construction Corporation and changed its name to Yondenko Corporation in November 1989. Yondenko Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

name: MULLION
businessSummary: Mullion Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in providing real estate leasing related service business. The Company is engaged in real estate rental service business, real estate securitization service business and real estate sales business. The real estate rental service business is maintaining properties for residents, especially lease real estate in metropolitan areas and providing rental services. The real estate securitization service business is providing investor service with investment income that supplements public pensions through investment in real estate securitized products. The real estate sales business is engaged in the sales of properties as part of the exit strategy of the property owned by this company.

name: CRESCO
businessSummary: CRESCO LTD. is primarily engaged in the information technology (IT) services business and the digital solutions business. The Company conducts its business through these two segments. The IT Services segment primarily provides comprehensive services—including consulting, as well as IT planning, development, and maintenance—for enterprise systems, financial systems, embedded systems, artificial intelligence (AI) systems, mobile systems, platforms, agile development, nearshore development, offshore development, robotic process automation (RPA) implementation support, data analytics, and user experience (UX) design. The Digital Solutions segment primarily provides a suite of solutions consisting of products and services that support customers in achieving digital transformation (DX), including cloud, robotics, AI & data, security, and UX/user interface (UI).

name: KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Kozo Keikaku Engineering Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of engineering consulting and product services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Engineering Consulting segment provides structural design and structural analysis consulting, environmental assessment and disaster prevention consulting, system development in the housing and construction field, decision support consulting, and information and communications technology consulting. The Product Services segment provides manufacturing-related services, architecture and civil engineering-related services, information and communications-related services, and other cross-industry services.

name: WITZ
businessSummary: WITZ Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in provision of software. The Company operates in three business segments. The Embedded Systems segment is engaged in the provision of software development services for control devices, such as automobiles and industrial machinery. The Systems Engineering business segment is engaged in the provision of model-based technology for automobiles and virtual simulation technologies, such as automatic operation. The Functional Safety Development segment is engaged in the provision of consulting services to support functional safety measures of control devices using computers.

name: TAKASAGO THERMAL ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Takasago Thermal Engineering Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in equipment construction business as well as manufacturing and sales of equipment. The Company has two segments. The Equipment Construction segment involves in the maintenance and general management of equipment, the design and construction of air conditioners, water supply and drainage facilities, technical assistance to overseas subsidiaries as well as the manufacturing, sales and installation of cleanroom related equipment and interior materials. The Equipment Manufacturing and Sales segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing and sales of air conditioners. Other business involves in the sales and leasing of real estates and insurance agency business.

name: AOYAMA ZAISAN NETWORKS
businessSummary: Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company,Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in asset consulting business. The Asset Consulting Business includes asset consulting and real estate transactions. Asset consulting includes asset succession, providing consulting for individual asset owners on pre- and post-inheritance planning, effective utilization of owned real estate and others, business succession, supporting business owners in succession planning, organizational restructuring, financial improvement and others, and product development, providing consulting on asset management and asset management for clients through the operation and management of ADVANTAGE CLUB and private voluntary partnerships, provision of operating lease products, operation and management of regional revitalization projects and others. As part of asset consulting, real estate transactions involve acquiring real estate, developing real estate-related products, and selling them to our own clients.

name: WORLD
businessSummary: World Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the brand business, digital business and platform business. It operates through four business segments. The Brand segment sells women's, men's, and children's clothing and accessories both domestically and internationally. The Digital segment, which consists of business-to-business (B2B) solutions and business-to-consumer (B2C) neo-economy, proposes digital solutions such as operating e-commerce malls specializing in fashion and providing information and logistics systems, and develops and deploys new digital-based services. The Platform segment operates platform businesses such as the production, procurement, and trading of clothing and accessories, as well as space creation support through the manufacture and sale of fixtures. The Common Department segment covers corporate-related operations, such as providing management and guidance to subsidiaries and covering staff expenses with revenue from management guidance fees.

name: FREEBIT
businessSummary: FreeBit Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides internet-related services primarily to businesses and individuals, leveraging its strengths in accumulated technical expertise such as developing core internet technologies and operating large-scale systems. It conducts business through three segments. The 5G Infrastructure Support segment provides business support services for Internet Service Providers (ISPs), mobile virtual network operator business support (MVNE) services, and cloud services for corporations. The 5G Lifestyle Support segment offers mobile communication services for individuals, internet connectivity services for individuals, internet connectivity services for apartment complexes, real estate-related services, and Web3-related platforms. The Corporate & Creator 5G Digital Transformation (DX) Support segment provides internet marketing services, ad technology services, and support platforms for creators. It also engages in startup investment and incubation.

name: AICHI STEEL
businessSummary: Aichi Steel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel materials, forged products, electronic functional materials and parts, and magnetic application products. The Company operates through five segments. The Steel (Hagane) Company segment manufactures and sells special steel, produces steelmaking materials, and transports and stores steel products. The Stainless Steel Company segment manufactures and sells stainless steel and titanium, processes and sells special steel and stainless steel, and rolls, processes, and sells stainless steel. The Forging (Kitaeru) Company segment manufactures and sells die-forged products and forging die processed products. The Smart Company segment manufactures and sells electronic functional materials and parts, magnetic application products, plant activators, and metal fibers. The Other Businesses segment provides computer software development, product sales and greening services.

name: HAPPINET
businessSummary: Happinet Corporation operates as an entertainment trading company in Japan. It operates through Toys Business, Video Games Business, Video and Music Business, and Amusement Business. The company manufactures and sells toys, trading cards, electronic toys, and other toys, as well as audio-visual software  and plans, develops, and sells video and music, and video game software and hardware-related products. It also sells arcade game machines and amusement arcade-related products  and installs and operates toy vending machines and operates capsule toy specialty stores. The company was formerly known as Tosho Corporation and changed its name to Happinet Corporation in October 1991. Happinet Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NIPPON ELECTRIC GLASS
businessSummary: Nippon Electric Glass Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of glass and other specialty glass products and glass manufacturing machinery, primarily in the electronics and information fields. In the electronics and information field, the Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of special glass products for displays and electronic devices. In the functional materials field, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of composite materials, medical, heat-resistant, architectural and other special glass products, as well as glass manufacturing machinery.

name: H2O RETAILING
businessSummary: H2O Retailing Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business, food business, commercial facility business and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Department Store Business segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, mainly selling clothing, personal items, household goods, and food products. The Food Business segment is engaged in the operation of food supermarkets, as well as food manufacturing, food purchasing agency business, and individual home delivery business. The Commercial Facility Business segment is engaged in the rental management of commercial real estate, the operation of commercial facilities, the management of hotels, the maintenance and management of building facilities, and other businesses. The Other Businesses segment is involved in interior construction work, friendship associations, temporary staffing, restaurants, information processing services and other businesses.

name: TOKYOTOKEIBA
businessSummary: Tokyotokeiba Co.,Ltd. engages in rental of horse racing facilities in Japan. The company is involved in rental of auto racetracks, as well as provision of Oi Racecourse, a racecourse that holds night races. It also engages in management of amusement park  and rental of warehouse, commercial, and logistics facilities, as well as betting systems. In addition, the company offers construction management services and maintenance services for air conditioning equipment. Further, it manages and operates shopping malls and office buildings. Additionally, the company operates restaurants. Tokyotokeiba Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KONDOTEC
businessSummary: Kondotec Inc. engages in the manufacture, procurement, import, sale, wholesale, and export of industrial materials primarily in the retail hardware business in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Industrial Materials, Steel Construction Materials, Electrical Equipment Materials, and Scaffolding Construction. Its products include turn buckles, braces, scaffolding chains, screws, anchor bolts, construction materials, and machinery and equipment  and merchandise comprising hardware, chains, wire ropes, screws, lighting equipment, panel boards, air-conditioning equipment, and eco items. The company is also involved in the manufacturing, procurement and sale of structural steel materials for steel fabricators  and procurement and sale of electrical equipment for electrical work operators and electrical appliance stores. In addition, it designs and manufactures various types of machines and equipment  provides equipment and transport devices. Kondotec Inc. was formerly known as Kondo Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kondotec Inc. in January 1989. Kondotec Inc. was founded in 1947 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

name: RASA INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Rasa Industries, Ltd. is a Japan-based comprehensive manufacturer engaged in the chemical products, machinery, and electronic materials. It operates through three segments. The Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells high-performance, high-purity chemicals for the electronics industry, such as high-purity phosphoric acid, anhydrous phosphoric acid, strong phosphoric acid, and phosphates, as well as coagulants for water treatment, deodorizers, and raw materials for capacitors. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells crushers, sorting machines, municipal and industrial waste treatment machinery, various plants and tunneling machines, electron beam welding, and cast steel products. The Electronic Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity inorganic materials, resist strippers, and radioactive iodine adsorbents. The Company also operates a catalyst recycling business for petroleum refining and a real estate leasing business.

name: TOKAI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TOKAI Holdings Corporation engages in energy, information and communications, and related businesses in Japan and internationally. The company supplies liquefied petroleum gas for individuals, automotive, and corporations  solar power, and other high-pressure gases  and provides electricity to individuals and corporations, information and communications services to individual and corporate customers, including optical internet connection, mobile services, data center, corporate communication, and system development services  CATV services, such as broadcasting and communication services. It also provides residential construction, condominium sales, real estate development, home security, and insurance  remodeling services  returnable bottle and one way bottle services. Further, it offers insurance, bridal and restaurants, nursing care, ship repair, childcare support, operates campground and hot springs facility. TOKAI Holdings Corporation was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.

name: SHINMAYWA INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: ShinMaywa Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of special-purpose vehicles. The Company operates five business segments. The Special-purpose Vehicles segment manufactures and sells special-purpose vehicles such as dump trucks, tailgate lifters, and garbage trucks, as well as forestry machinery. The Parking Systems segment manufactures, sells, maintains, and repairs mechanical parking facilities and aircraft passenger boarding bridges. The Industrial and Environmental Systems segment manufactures and sells automatic wire processors, vacuum products, and waste disposal facilities and equipment. The Fluids segment manufactures and sells pumps and water treatment-related products. The Aircraft segment manufactures and sells flying boats and aircraft parts for overseas aircraft manufacturers. The Company also engages in construction, real estate, and software businesses.

name: PREMIUM WATER HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Premium Water Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural mineral water and home office delivery business which manufactures natural mineral water. The main product is 12L natural mineral water, which includes in-house production and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) production in Fujiyoshida City, Yamanashi Prefecture; Asago City, Hyogo Prefecture; Asago City, Hyogo Prefecture; Omachi City, Nagano Prefecture; Hamada City, Shimane Prefecture and Minamiaso Village, Aso County, Kumamoto Prefecture. The Company provides mineral water delivery services centered on the brand PREMIUM WATER mainly through the three sales methods of direct sales, distributors, original brand name (OEM) and through demonstration sales, WEB and telemarketing. The Company lends water servers to customers of direct sales, distributors and special agents, and wholesales water servers to customers of agents. The Company also conducts as a sales representative.

name: BIPROGY
businessSummary: BIPROGY Inc. provides cloud computing and outsourcing services in Japan. It also engages in the sale/rental of computer and network system  development and sale of software  and provision of system related services. In addition, the company provides digital transformation, workstyle reforms, artificial intelligence, robot deployment, blockchain, IoT, service design, agile development and support, DevSecOps framework, environment and energy, travel and inbound tourism, BCP, disaster measure, remote monitoring, security, marketing, cashless payment, customer experience management, customer relationship management, and data usage services. Further, it offers SRM, electronic procurement and purchasing, logistics, enterprise resource planning, workplace/facility management, storage service platform, and corporate training services. Additionally, the company provides cloud services, system platform, digital business ICT infrastructure, web development platform, O and M, dev support, integration platform, unified application platform, UI/UX design, information security, centralized authentication, account management, IT platform optimization, and thin clients  system optimization comprising ICT discovery, construction, installation, support, operation, and training  and hardware, middleware, and related services. It offers solutions for various industries, including financial services, manufacturing, agriculture and livestock, distribution, transportation, energy, central and local governments, pharmaceutical, healthcare, travel, leasing, education, media, and social insurance. The company was formerly known as Nihon Unisys, Ltd. and changed its name to BIPROGY Inc. in April 2022. BIPROGY Inc. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KUSURINOMADOGUCHI
businessSummary: Kusurinomadoguchi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and marketing of solutions primarily for pharmacies and healthcare. The media business operates EPARK Kusuri no Madoguchi, a search site and application for pharmacies such as dispensing pharmacies and drugstores, and EPARK Oyaku Techo, an electronic medication registry application. The Minnano Oyakubako business operates the Minnano Kyodo Shupply Service, which negotiates purchase prices of pharmaceuticals with pharmaceutical wholesalers on behalf of pharmacies and medical institutions, the e-Order System, which functions as an inventory management system and automatic ordering system for pharmaceuticals at pharmacies and medical institutions, and the Minnano Oyakubako application, which is a pharmaceuticals trading application. The core system business sells office processing systems and information systems required by medical institutions, pharmacies, and nursing care facilities.

name: ARATA
businessSummary: Arata Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the wholesale of cosmetics, daily used products, household products and pet products. The Company's main business is the wholesale of daily necessities, cosmetics and others, mainly to drugstores, home improvement centers, supermarkets, and general merchandise stores. Health and beauty products include cosmetics, shampoo, soap, bath additives, and oral care products. Household products include laundry detergent, kitchen detergent, dishwashing detergent, and household cleaners. Home care products include insecticides, air fresheners/deodorizers, and batteries. Paper products include household paper, tissues, toilet paper, and disposable diapers. Household goods include plastic wrap/toilet paper, sponges/scrubbing brushes, cooking utensils, and cleaning supplies. Pet supplies include pet food and pet supplies.

name: NICHIDEN
businessSummary: NICHIDEN Corporation operates as a trading company in Japan and internationally. The company offers transmissions, chain transmission, belt transmission, gear transmission, couplings, other transmission-related products, bearings, rings, LINEAR motion devices, bearing units, other bearing-related products, metal materials, synthetic materials, ceramics, and new materials. It also provides transport equipment, vibrators, lifting and hoisting equipment, storage-related equipment, transport systems, structural system equipment, packaging and packaging systems, other material handling, transportation-related products, environmental equipment, fans, dust collection and cleaning equipment, pumps, other machinery and tools. In addition, the company offers Hydraulic equipment, pneumatic equipment, vacuum equipment, hoses, tubes, joints, sequencers, displays, actuators, switches, encoders, image, processing, measuring equipment and instruments, panel equipment, robots, nut runners, mechatronics parts, piping, equipment, communication and network equipment, uninterruptible power supplies, and other control equipment related products. NICHIDEN Corporation was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: EDION
businessSummary: EDION Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of home electric appliances, and the operation of home electronics mass retailers from Hokkaido to Okinawa. The Company is engaged in the sale of home appliances through directly managed stores, mobile phone specialty stores, mail-order stores and franchise stores. The other business is involved in the operation of software specialty stores, the operation and development of information systems, the sale and construction of solar power generation systems, home remodeling, the purchase and sale of used information and communication equipment, and processing and sale of useful metals, the sale of office supplies, daily necessities, the sale of alcoholic beverages, the management of a professional soccer team, as well as the operation of programming classes.

isin: 9045.T|Keihan Holdings Co., Ltd.|9045.T|Keihan Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: KEIHAN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Keihan Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the transportation and various other businesses in Japan. It operates through Transportation, Real Estate Business, Distribution Industry, Leisure Service Industry, and Other Business segments. The Transportation segment is involved in railroad and bus operations. The Real Estate Business segment engages in real estate sales and rentals, and wholesale of building materials, as well as offers surveying and design services. The Distribution Industry segment manages department stores, retail stores, and shopping malls. The Leisure Service Industry segment engages in hotels and sightseeing boats businesses. The Other Business segment is involved in sustainability business. The company was formerly known as Keihan Electric Railway Co., Ltd. Keihan Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KIKUKAWA ENTERPRISE
businessSummary: KIKUKAWA ENTERPRISE, INC. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of woodworking machineries and machine tools. The woodworking machineries include machines which can process logs into square timbers, plates and small split materials, and machines which can secondary process timbers, plates, small split materials, plywood and fiberboards into products. The machine tools refer to machines processing irons, non-ferrous metals and other new materials.

name: TANABE CONSULTING GROUP
businessSummary: Tanabe Consulting Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management consulting business. The management consulting areas include strategy consulting, digital transformation (DX) consulting and brand & design consulting. The services in the strategic consulting area include domain consulting, function consulting, human resources (HR) Consulting, mergers & acquisitions (M&A) alliance consulting, regional consulting, strategic domain & function study group and first call company (FCC) seminar. The services in the DX consulting area include digital marketing, management DX, branding DX, marketing DX and FCC academy cloud. The services in the brand & design consulting area include marketing strategy planning, branding, customer experience (CX) design, creative, and Web promotion. The sales promotion products include sales promotion tools, blue diaries and calendars.

name: NEOJAPAN
businessSummary: NEOJAPAN Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software business and system development service business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Software segment is engaged in the development of software centering on groupware, the operation of cloud services, as well as the sale, maintenance and consulting of licenses. The System Development Service segment is engaged in the development and maintenance of core systems and information systems for companies, and development of embedded systems for companies. The overseas business is engaged in the provision of Desktops-as-a-Service (DaaS) cloud services for enterprises, local market research business, as well as the exploration partner companies.

name: NIRECO
businessSummary: NIRECO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of facility equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Process segment offers process control equipment, automatic identification printing equipment, edge position control equipment for metal, level gauges for vortex molten steel and wide board gauges, among others. The Web segment provides edge position control equipment for printing and films, tension control equipment, registration control equipment and starch equipment. The Inspection Equipment segment offers plain inspection equipment, image processing and analyzing equipment, near-infrared analyzing system and fruit sorting equipment, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had three subsidiaries.

name: HUMAN TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Human Technologies, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of software as a service (SaaS) for attendance management. The main business is the development and sale of cloud services centered on attendance management and human resources/payroll. Management resources are concentrated on the cloud-based attendance management and human resources/payroll system, KING OF TIME. Key functions include overtime management, schedule and shift management, administrator privileges, and workflow (application and approval). It also promotes integration with external services such as human resources management systems and payroll systems.

name: SHIN MAINT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Shin Maint Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of maintenance services for various facilities and equipment in stores. Main customers are major restaurant chains and retail chains. The one-stop maintenance services provide an emergency maintenance service that responds to sudden troubles in various facilities and equipment, and a preventive maintenance service that regularly checks, maintains, and cleans various facilities and equipment. The maintenance outsourcing service provides support to improve the maintenance capability of the kitchen equipment manufacturer by providing a maintenance system. The emergency maintenance service accepts repair requests 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The preventive maintenance services provide tailored maintenance based on store conditions.

name: TOTECH
businessSummary: Totech Corporation engages in the sale of air conditioning equipment in Japan. It is involved in the design, installation, maintenance, and repair of automatic control equipment. The company also offers the installation of electric devices, as well as linking control of various environmental systems and streamlining operations. In addition, it is involved in low voltage electrical facilities, such as automatic control systems, access control systems, and surveillance cameras  sale of HVAC systems, automatic control and monitoring facilities, energy-related equipment, and refrigeration and freezing equipment  maintenance, repair, and renewal of various facilities and equipment  design, installation, maintenance, repair, and offering proposals for the renewal of automatic control systems and central monitoring systems  and instrumentation work and maintenance business. Totech Corporation was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOKYO ENERGY & SYSTEMS
businessSummary: TOKYO ENERGY & SYSTEMS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in design and construction of electric power facilities and general electric facilities. The facility construction business is engaged in the construction and maintenance of thermal power generation facilities, nuclear power generation facilities, hydroelectric power generation facilities and solar power generation facilities, as well as the design and construction of substation facilities, general electric facilities, information communication facilities, and air conditioning equipment. The Company also involves in leasing and management of real estate, leasing and rental of tools, fixtures and vehicles, as well as provision of insurance agency business.

name: EXEO GROUP
businessSummary: EXEO Group Inc, formerly Kyowa Exeo Corp, is mainly engaged in the engineering solution business and the system solution business. It consists of four business segments: Kyowa Exeo Group, C Cube Group, Seibu Denki Group and Nippon Dentsu Group. The segments are mainly engaged in the construction of equipment and urban infrastructure for communication carriers, network integration, and system integration, centering on their respective construction areas. The engineering solution business includes communication carriers that build and maintain communication infrastructure equipment, and urban infrastructure that builds and maintains various communication infrastructure equipment for local governments, government agencies, railway companies, private companies and others. The system solution business builds systems and provides system integration for various companies such as telecommunications carriers, finance and manufacturing. The Company also operates pipe work business.

name: TODA
businessSummary: Toda Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engages in construction, civil engineering, domestic investment and development, domestic group companies, overseas group companies, and environment and energy. It has six business segments. The Construction Business segment engages in construction work both domestically and overseas. The Civil Engineering Business segment engages in civil engineering work both domestically and overseas. The Domestic Investment and Development Business segment engages in independent real estate development, sales, and leasing. The Domestic Group Companies Business segment includes construction, civil engineering, real estate management, hotel services and others. The Overseas Group Companies Business segment includes construction work and related businesses overseas conducted by overseas consolidated subsidiaries, independent real estate development, sales, and leasing, hotel services. The Environment and Energy segment engages in power generation and sales.

name: 2ND RETAILING
businessSummary: 2nd RETAILING Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of various used and new product stores in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. The company operates 2nd STREET, a store that buys and sells fashion items, furniture, household electrical appliances, and daily necessities  OKURA, a store for luxury products procured from commercial auctioneers through e-commerce and online auctions  Luck Rack, an off-price store for second-hand goods  GEO, a store that offers amusement products such as DVDs, CDs, video games, and books  and Mobile, an outlet that provides smartphones, tablets, earphones, smartwatches, SIM cards, and other smartphone peripherals. It is also involved in the development of a platform that consists of digital content, as well as production and sale of content  operation of amusement facility such as crane games, arcade games, token-based parlor games, and karaoke  wholesale and trading of fashion and lifestyle goods  and system development activities. In addition, the company operates Pleasure, a store that purchases used agricultural machinery  Kotaro, a store that purchases antiques and works of art  2nd STORAGE, a self-storage service with free home pick-up and delivery  and GEO Are Kore Rental, a rental service for cameras, smartphones, home appliances, and other items. The company was formerly known as Geo Holdings Corporation and changed its name to 2nd RETAILING Co., Ltd. in October 2026. 2nd RETAILING Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: SATO FOODS INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: SATO FOODS INDUSTRIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food processing business. The Food Processing segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tea extracts, natural seasonings, plant extracts and powdered sakes.

name: KRAFTIA
businessSummary: Kraftia Corporation engages in design, construction, and installation of power infrastructure construction business in Japan. The company offers distribution line and underground line works  and electrical work for commercial buildings, office buildings, factories, educational and cultural facilities, resort facilities, and renewable energy power plants. It is also involved in the design, construction, and maintenance of HVAC equipment, water and wastewater sanitary equipment, and disaster prevention equipment, as well as resource recycling facilities  renewable energy generation business  and provision of building out FTTH networks that supply broadband connectivity to residences, updating cable TV equipment, and building base stations for mobile phone carriers, as well as fiber optic cable and communication cable installation services. In addition, the company engages in ecological, private finance initiative, overseas, and olive businesses  and provision of teleradiology systems. The company was formerly known as Kyudenko Corporation and changed its name to Kraftia Corporation in October 2025. Kraftia Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

isin: 7245.T|Daido Metal Co., Ltd.|7245.T|Daido Metal Co., Ltd.
name: DAIDO METAL
businessSummary: Daido Metal Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of bearings in Japan, North America, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers metal-polymer plain bearings used in various applications, including office and construction equipment, high-speed vehicles, trains, domed stadiums, and others, as well as hydro, thermal, and nuclear power plants. It also provides metallic bearings  engine bearings, such as half shell bearings, bushings, thrust washers, and turbocharger bearings for use in passenger cars, buses, ships, and building machinery  and turbomachinery bearing systems comprising turbine and supercharger bearings for propulsion steam turbines and large marine engines, power-generating turbine bearings, waterwheels for generator and water treatment pump bearings, and compressor and pump bearings. In addition, the company offers modular products consisting of small assembly products, insert molding products, and specialty-shaped products  RP-pumps and drum feeders  centralized lubrication products  and capacitors. It serves automotive, motorcycle, marine, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, industrial, energy, infrastructure and transportation, leisure, and household industries. Daido Metal Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: KINDEN
businessSummary: KINDEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. Electrical engineering works include power distribution work, general electrical work for buildings and factories, power transmission line construction, and work on power generation and substation facilities. Information and communication construction works include telecommunications and instrumentation work. Environmental construction activities include air conditioning and plumbing construction. It also engages in water supply and drainage sanitary construction, interior facility installation, civil engineering, and other related businesses, including the leasing and sale of vehicles and other equipment, non-life insurance agency services, real estate maintenance and leasing, the sale and engineering of information and communication system equipment, wind power generation, the maintenance and management of facilities such as energy storage stations and others.

name: NS GROUP
businessSummary: NS Group, Inc. provides rent guarantee services in Japan. The company offers rent guarantee and collection agency services. The company offers collection agency services to collect rent and other payments on behalf of real estate companies and property lessors. It also provides screening services. The company was formerly known as BCJ-54 Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NS Group, Inc. in October 2023. NS Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

name: NIFCO
businessSummary: Nifco Inc is a Japan-based manufacturing company primarily engaged in synthetic resin business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Molded Synthetic Resin segment manufactures and sells industrial plastics, fasteners, plastic precision molding components and molds. The Bed and Furniture segment is engaged in the production and sale of beds, the import and sale of furniture, and reclining chair business.

name: ABC MART
businessSummary: ABC-Mart Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of shoes and the planning and development of its own products. It operates through two geographical segments including domestic and overseas. It operates shoe retail stores ABC-MART nationwide and sells mainly shoes. In Japan, it sells its own products, mainly shoes, under its own brands such as HAWKINS, Danner, ABC Select, and White's Boots, as well as national brand products, through retail stores such as ABC-MART, ABC-MART GRAND STAGE, and ABC-MART SPORTS located throughout the country, providing products that incorporate market needs and trends. It also plans and develops its own shoes, produces these products at contract factories both in Japan and overseas, and supplies them to the domestic market.

name: RESOL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the hotel and golf operation businesses in Japan. The company operates RESOL NO MORI sports and do resort, which provides relaxation, health, sports, and outdoor activities  golf courses  management of resort condominiums, spa, and villas  and tourist hotels under the RESOL HOTELS brand name. It also engages in development of solar power generation facilities  domestic and international travel  provision of Life Support Club, a welfare services  and investment recovery business. The company was formerly known as Resort Solution Co., Ltd. and changed its name to RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in October 2016. RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOYO SUISAN KAISHA
businessSummary: Toyo Suisan Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based food manufacturing company. The Company operates through six business segments. The Seafood segment is engaged in the purchase, processing and sale of seafoods in domestic and overseas markets. The Overseas Instant Noodles segment provides cup and bag noodles mainly in the United States and Mexico. The Domestic Instant Noodles segment provides cup and bag noodles in Japan. The Low Temperature Food segment manufactures and sells steamed and roasted buckwheat noodles, raw ramen, boiled noodles, frozen noodles and commercial cocking products. The Processed Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods such as aseptic packaged rice, retort rice, soup, dashi-no-moto, bonito flakes, and paste products in Japan. The Frozen and Cold Storage segment is engaged in the provision of storage and freezing services. The Company also involves in the bag lunch, prepared food businesses.

name: SHARINGTECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Sharingtechnology, Inc. provides matching services between stores and users in Japan. The company offers Seikatsu 110 ban, a service platform where customers can search, compare, and inquire about household problems services  and Vertical Media, a website that provides customers information on specific subject, as well as operates as a call center. It also offers Mover, a system that enables real-time matching between customers and professional service providers through scheduling and GPS functions. Sharingtechnology, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: NISSHIN SEIFUN GROUP
businessSummary: Nisshin Seifun Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour milling business, food business, and prepared meals and prepared foods business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flour Milling segment manufactures and sells flour, bran, and flour-related products. The segment also sells frozen foods and their ingredients, operates restaurants using flour-related commercial products, and sells packaging materials. The Foods segment manufactures and sells premixes, wheat flour for home use, pasta, pasta sauce, frozen foods, food ingredients for baking and other uses, biochemical products, drug discovery research support business, and health foods. The Mid-market Foods and Prepared Foods segment manufactures and sells prepared foods such as boxed lunches, prepared foods, and cooked noodles, and operates directly managed department stores. The Company also operates businesses related to engineering, mesh cloth, and cargo handling and storage businesses.

name: SHO BOND HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sho-Bond Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company that formulates the group's management strategies and manages the business operations of its subsidiaries, and its consolidated subsidiaries, organized by region and business type, engage in civil engineering and construction work and product manufacturing and sales. The Domestic Construction segment is primarily engaged in repair and reinforcement work for public structures and product sales. It also engages in overseas construction, product manufacturing and sales, and domestic and international product sales.

name: ANABUKI KOSAN
businessSummary: Anabuki Kosan Inc. engages in the real estate business in Japan. The company operates through Real estate related business, Human resource services, Facility management business, Nursing care related business, Energy-related business, Tourism business, and Others. It is involved in development and sale of condominiums and detached houses, orders for custom-built homes, and real estate leasing and brokerage  temporary staffing, outsourcing, recruitment, and hiring support  operation of facilities such as hotels and golf courses  operation of paid nursing homes and medical-related services  operation of supermarket  operation of a variety of facilities, including hotels, golf courses, fitness gyms, and service areas  travel planning services  and engaged electricity supply service  and involved in sale of travel arrangements. Anabuki Kosan Inc. was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Takamatsu, Japan.

name: I NE
businessSummary: I-ne CO., LTD. engages in the planning, development, operation, manufacturing, and sale of cosmetics, beauty appliances, and other beauty-related products in Japan and internationally. It offers a range of products for haircare, skin care, beauty devices, pre-makeup, night care, gray hair dye, pre-skincare, and eye makeup products under BOTANIST, SALONIA, DROAS, YOLU, Qurap, TOUTVERT, WELLP, ennthy, murphy, Tearal, Aquall, awairo, mythm, WrinkFade, Curuput, Salanaru, and CAROME brand names. The company is also involved in the planning, administration, and management of retail shops  planning, development, and sale of daily necessities and healthcare-related products  and e-commerce business. In addition, the company offers shampoos, conditioners, hair milk, oils, body washes, and body milks  and health foods, functional teas (Teaflex), fabric softeners (ReWEAR), fasting programs (Befas), and collagen protein supplements (Collatein). The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: MARUBUN
businessSummary: MARUBUN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company primarily sells electronics-related products such as semiconductors, electronic components, and electronic application equipment both domestically and internationally. It operates through three segments. The Devices Business segment sells semiconductors and electronic components such as analog integrated circuits (IC), memory ICs, and application-specific ICs. The Systems Business segment sells aerospace equipment, industrial equipment, laser equipment, and medical equipment. The Entrepreneurship Business segment sells information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, software, and artificial intelligence (AI) robots.

name: KITZ
businessSummary: KITZ Corporation engages in the manufacturing and selling of valves, other flow control devices, and related products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Valve Business, Copper Products Business, and other segments. The Valve Business segment manufactures and sells bronze valves, steel valves, other valve-related products, filtration-related products, and their accessories. The Copper Products Business manufactures and sells copper rolled products and processed copper products. The Other segment operates a resort hotel in Suwa city, Nagano Prefecture. It offers its products under the KITZ brand name. KITZ Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: MORINAGA&CO
businessSummary: Morinaga&Co., Ltd. manufactures, purchases, and sells confectionaries, food, frozen desserts, and jelly drinks in Japan and internationally. It offers chocolates, biscuits, snacks, caramel, and milk caramel crunch bars  cocoa, cake mix  ice cream, and health products. It offers its products under the Morinaga Milk Cocoa, Morinaga Ramune, Morinaga Biscuits, Chocoball, Amazake, Carré de chocolat, DARS, HI-CHEW, Morinaga Cocoa, Vanilla Monaka Jumbo, Itachoko Ice Cream, ICEBOX, Oishii Collagen Drink, Oishii Aojiru, Morinaga Collagen Drink, in BAR, and in Jelly brands. In addition, the company engages in the real estate rental and golf course management businesses. Morinaga&Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TKP
businessSummary: TKP Corporation engages in the space revitalization and distribution business in Japan and internationally. The company offers meeting rooms, banquet rooms, rental spaces, and short-term offices  selection of event or exhibit venues, arrangement of equipment, direction of acoustics and lighting, and operation on event days  and employee training, arrangement of accommodation facilities, meals, and transportation. It is also involved in the operation of hotels and training facilities  provision of catering services to business functions, meetings, working lunches, events, parties, and social gatherings  restaurant and café operation  arranging manufacture of box lunches  recruitment reception agency  call center operation  secretariat agency services  and business process outsourcing business. In addition, the company engages in lilycolor business  and novarese escrit business. TKP Corporation was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. TKP Corporation operates as a subsidiary of RIVER FIELD co,.ltd.

name: MIMAKI ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Mimaki Engineering Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells computer devices and software in Japan and internationally. It offers inkjet printers, including roll to-roll, print and cut, flat bed, textile, DTF, and option printers  cutting plotter/vinyl cutter, such as roll to-roll, flat bed, and apparel cutter  laminator products  desktop modeling plotters  and 3D printers, including GDP and FFF system. The company also provides software products comprising RIP software  software for color management  and software products for cutting. In addition, the company develops custom automation equipment, PCB mounting and inspection equipment, and semiconductor manufacturing solutions. Its products are used in smartphone case, glass/acrylic, sticker/magnet, stationery/novelty, apparel and textile, bottle, window film, daily necessities, DIY/building materials, outdoor, sports, container/package, and other item applications. Mimaki Engineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Tomi, Japan.

name: AMANO
businessSummary: Amano Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of time information systems and environment-related system equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Time Information System segment is involved in the manufacture, sale and export sale of information system equipment, mainly employment information systems and payroll systems, and time management equipment, mainly time clocks, the sale of parking system equipment, as well as parking lots operation management, software products development and others. The Environmental-related System segment provides dust collectors, powder and granular material pneumatic conveying systems, high-temperature poisonous gas removal systems and electrolyzed water generation equipment and cleaning equipment. This segment also provides welfare services, non-life insurance agency services, work environment measurement, environmental measurement certification business and related consulting services.

name: DTS
businessSummary: DTS Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operations & solutions, technology & solutions, and platform & services businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Operations & Solutions segment includes consulting for system implementation, system design, development, operation, and maintenance (including the design and construction of infrastructure and networks), and the creation of industry-specific solutions. The Technology & Solutions segment includes consulting for system implementation, system design, development, operation, and maintenance (including design, construction, and integration of infrastructure and networks), and installation, operation, and maintenance of solutions (in-house and other companies). The Platform & Services segment includes the introduction of cutting-edge information technology (IT) equipment, the construction of IT platforms, the operation design and maintenance of total information systems including cloud services.

isin: 8153.T|Mos Food Services, Inc.|8153.T|Mos Food Services, Inc.
name: MOS FOOD SERVICES
businessSummary: Mos Food Services, Inc. operates MOS BURGER hamburger franchise and other restaurant businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates Mother Leaf specialty black tea stores, which provide fresh black tea, sweets, waffles, pasta, sweets, and seasonal Japanese cuisine. It also operates MOSDO stores and restaurants under AEN brand. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KIMURA KOHKI
businessSummary: Kimura Kohki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of air conditioning equipment and other related works. The Company is mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing and sales of air conditioning system equipment. The main products are air handling units, fan coil units, and factory zone air conditioners. The air handling unit is a device that separately provides a heat source device necessary for cooling and heating, and cools and heats air using water and a refrigerant gas as a heat medium. The fan coil unit is a device provided with a separate heat source device necessary for cooling and heating, and performs cooling and heating using cold water, hot water, steam and others. The factory zone air conditioner is a device for air conditioning a relatively large space such as a factory or a hall.

name: SYSTEM SUPPORT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: System Support Holdings Inc, formerly System Support Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in cloud integration, system integration and outsourcing business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Cloud Integration segment provides technical support for the migration and use of cloud services (ServiceNow, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud) and resales of licenses. The System Integration segment provides technical support for the introduction and use of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) packages, infrastructure construction such as databases, and consulting, design, development, operation and maintenance of information technology (IT) systems. The Outsourcing segment provides database services such as private clouds, data analysis and input. The Product segment develops and sells software. The Overseas segment provides system integration overseas, outsourcing of payroll and accounting work, recruitment services, and media management.

name: B LOT
businessSummary: B-Lot Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate and financial advisory businesses in Japan. The company offers real estate brokerage, including sales and purchase support, leasing brokerage, and consulting services  real estate development, such as market research, construction planning, management, and leasing after completion  real estate revitalization  and leasing of offices and stores, as well as property management and administrative services. It also provides real estate funds  and securitization and asset management services. B-Lot Company Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: ZENHOREN
businessSummary: Zenhoren Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rent debt guarantee business. The rent debt guarantee is a service that guarantees rent payment to lessors. The Company makes the subrogation payment on behalf of the lessee and collect the subrogated rent from the lessee at a later date for the lessee who fails to pay the rent. The Company provides rent obligation guarantee service that guarantees the payment of rent to the lessor, a joint guarantor is not required, and the lessee can smoothly conclude a lease contract. The Company provides the rent obligation guarantee service through property management companies and real estate brokerage firms that sign guarantee business agreement contracts.

name: FINTECH GLOBAL
businessSummary: FinTech Global Incorporated provides various financial services in Japan. The company offers investment banking, including financial arrangements, financial advisory services, and consulting services on public accounting system implementation  documentation support services for public facility management  real estate asset management and aviation business, such as aircraft technology services, remarketing of aircraft/engines, and aircraft operating lease. It also engages in public accounting and public facilities management support activities  sale of public accounting software  consulting and system configuration, and operation services related to asset management of networked infrastructure  planning, design, configuration, maintenance, operation, and management of information processing systems for infrastructure and utilities  consulting for information processing systems, including data collection, recording, conversion, updating and management, and applied in database creation  and sale and rental of computers, peripheral equipment, communication devices, and software packages and services. In addition, the company engages in the real estate development, purchase and sale, exchange, leasing, management, agency, brokerage, and consulting services  internet-based information services business  and planning, operation, and management of websites. Further, it operates and manages a theme park. FinTech Global Incorporated was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: GLOBE ING
businessSummary: Globe-ing Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in consulting and artificial intelligence (AI) businesses. The Company has two business segments. The Consulting Business segment supports strategy and digital transformation (DX) as a companion to chief and officer (CxO)-class executives and provides hands-on services to execute and promote clients' businesses and reforms through joint initiative (JI) consulting. The AI Business segment develops cloud products that incorporate consulting know-how and develops and provides AI agents that replace the main tasks of consultants.

name: WADAKOHSAN
businessSummary: Wadakohsan Corporation engages in the development and sale of condominiums, detached houses, and residential land in Japan. The company also rents, leases, and manages condominiums, offices stores, and parking lots. Wadakohsan Corporation was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the construction business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the research, survey, planning, drafting, designing, supervision, and operation of civil engineering, construction work and contracting, as well as regional development, urban and marine development, and environmental improvement  mediation of corporate acquisitions, mergers, company splits, share exchanges and transfers, business transfers, capital alliances, and business alliances  computer-based information processing and hardware and software development  and mediation related to corporate management strategies, organizational and business restructuring, and corporate revitalization, as well as non-life insurance agency, insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses. It also engages in housing, real estate transaction, and real estate leasing businesses  planning, drafting, designing, holding, maintenance, management, operation, and management of public facilities  supply of energy, such as electricity and heat  contract maintenance and management of buildings and facilities incidental to buildings  entrustment of security and security  acquisition, licensing, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights, and know-how  planning, design, manufacture, and sale of plant factories  and research and development related to the production of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products. In addition, the company manufactures, procures, sells, and leases construction machinery and equipment, civil engineering, and construction-related materials  produces, processes, and sells agricultural, forestry, and fishery products  provides temporary staffing and paid employment placement  and engages in projects related to the remediation of environmental pollution. TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 4635.T|TOKYO PRINTING INK MFG|4635.T|Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd.
name: TOKYO PRINTING INK MFG
businessSummary: Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty chemicals in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Ink Business  Chemical Products Business  Processed Products Business  and Real Estate Rental Business. The company offers offset and gravure inks, inkjet inks, paints, printing machines, and printing materials. It also engages in the manufactures and sells masterbatches and resin compounds, and uniaxially oriented film. In addition, it offers plastic meshes and packaging materials and civil engineering materials. Further, it is involved in the leasing of real estate, and sales of civil engineering and agricultural materials. Additionally, it provides dry colors  colorants for thermosetting resins  functional additives for plastics  compounds  detergents  powder resins  and functional products, such as 3D printers and radiation measurement. Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

name: MIRARTH HOLDINGS
businessSummary: MIRARTH Holdings,Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of condominiums. It operates through three segments. The Real Estate segment encompasses its core business of developing and selling new condominiums, as well as the sale of new detached houses, condominium renovation and resale, an asset liquidation business (selling income-generating properties such as residences and offices), and real estate leasing and management services. The Energy segment generates stable revenue by selling electricity produced from renewable sources such as solar, wind, and biomass to utility companies. The Asset Management segment leverages the Group's extensive expertise, know-how, and networks in real estate and renewable energy to manage assets such as Japanese real estate investment trusts (J-REITs) and private placement funds, thereby providing investment opportunities and asset management services. The Company is also engaged in construction and hotel operations.

name: CENTRAL SPORTS
businessSummary: Central Sports Co., Ltd. manages sports clubs and related business in Japan. The company manages fitness, swimming, gymnastics, tennis, and other sports facilities, as well as wellness and yoga club. It is also involved in corporate fitness promotion, marine leisure planning and management, care prevention, travel operations, ski school operations, management and guidance related activities, license accreditation and dispatch, children's school, esthetic, facilities building and repair works, bus transportation and management operations, and security businesses. In addition, the company procures and supplies sports machines  and operates as a social physical education instructor. Further, it manages golf course club. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: STAR MICA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Star Mica Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in renovation apartment business, investment business and advisory business. The renovation apartment business is engaged in purchase of family type apartments mainly from the metropolitan area and lease to tenants as portfolio. After the tenants leave, the Company will renovate to increase asset value, and then sold as residences to end users through house agents. The investment business conducts investments activities including leasing and sale of real estate mainly in the metropolitan area and investment development business centering on securities. The advisory business is engaged in real estate brokerage, rental brokerage, rental management, building management, operation of monthly apartments, etc. and fee operation of renovation apartment business and investment business.

name: SHIN ETSU POLYMER
businessSummary: Shin-Etsu Polymer Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electronic devices business, precision molded products business, and housing and lifestyle materials business. The Company operates through three segments. The Electronic Devices segment manufactures and sells input/output components and peripheral parts for automobiles and electronic equipment. The Precision Molded Products segment manufactures and sells precision molded products such as semiconductor wafer and electronic component handling materials, and parts for office automation (OA) equipment and medical devices. The Housing and Lifestyle Materials segment manufactures and sells resin-processed products like food packaging materials and housing-related materials, as well as functional materials used in automotive and machine tool parts and electronic components. The Company also engages in construction-related businesses.

name: ONWARD HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Onward Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, production, and sale of men's, women's, and children's apparel in Japan and worldwide. The company operates through two segments: Domestic Business and Overseas Business segments. It offers company and school uniforms, medical wears, jewelry, sundries, accessories, health-related and cosmetic products, gift items, and gift catalogs  pet supplies, and other product lines  stage, theater, and ballet and dance supplies  and inner wear and related products, as well as sells promotion goods. The company also engages in the operation of e-commerce site of women's apparel  management, purchase, sale, and rental of real estate  organizing and holding of special event sales, branding services, and consulting services  and operation and management of Lakeland Country Golf Club, as well as operates and manages Onward Talofofo and Onward Mangilao Golf Club. In addition, it is involved in the digital marketing and IT solution business  and operates an e-commerce site for gourmet foods. It provides its products through directly managed stores and department stores, as well as through e-commerce stores. Onward Holdings Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Onward Kashiyama Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Onward Holdings Co., Ltd. in September 2007. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SOFTMAX
businessSummary: Softmax Co., Ltd engages in the development, sale, implementation, and maintenance of comprehensive medical information systems and systems for businesses in Japan. The company offers web-based electronic medical record systems, web-based ordering systems, medical accounting systems, rehabilitation department systems, health checkup systems, radiology information systems, surgical department systems, nursing work schedule management systems, and solution systems. It serves medical institutions. Softmax Co., Ltd was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: MABUCHI MOTOR
businessSummary: Mabuchi Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of small motors. The Company operates through four regional segments including Japan, Asia, the Americas and Europe. The Company’s products are primarily used in automotive electrical equipment and life and industrial devices. The life and industrial devices mainly include health and medical equipment, home appliances and tools, precision and office equipment, as well as audio and visual equipment.

name: BASE
businessSummary: BASE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software. The Company is engaged in the provision of system development services, enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions and other solutions. The system development services are engaged in the provision of total system development services including requirements definition, basic design, detailed design, program design, programming, various tests, migration, release, operation and maintenance services for the financial, distribution and manufacturing fields. The ERP solution services are engaged in the provision of services in the ERP, customer relationship management (CRM), company-specific middleware component software and other areas. The other solution services are engaged in the provision of Nippon Individual Savings Account (NISA) opening services, card number recognition services using optical character recognition (OCR) function, as well as business process outsourcing ( BPO) services.

name: OBAYASHI
businessSummary: Obayashi Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate businesses. It has five business segments. The Domestic Construction segment is engaged in the acceptance and construction of construction work, interior construction, sales and rental of construction materials and equipment, and comprehensive building management. The Overseas Construction segment is engaged in the construction work in North America and Southeast Asia. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the acceptance and construction of civil engineering work. The Overseas Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering work in North America and Southeast Asia. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the buying and selling and leasing of real estate, and development business. It is also engaged in the private finance initiative (PFI) business, renewable energy business, information and communication technology (ICT) related business and financial business.

name: AUCNET
businessSummary: Aucnet Inc is primarily engaged in online auctions and related businesses for used cars, used digital devices, branded goods, flowers, used motorcycles, and used medical equipment as a circular market design company. The Lifestyle Products segment consists of services related to the distribution—including those for consumers—of used digital devices such as used smartphones and used PCs, as well as services related to the distribution—including those for consumers—of primarily brand-name goods such as bags, watches, precious metals, and clothing. The Mobility & Energy segment consists of auctions for used cars and used motorcycles, a shared inventory market, live-streamed auctions, bid proxy services, and vehicle inspection services. The Company also conducts flower auctions, circular commerce operations, and overseas business operations.
