The company provides security products, such as for next-generation endpoint protection and next-generation firewalls, SASE and ZTNA authentication, and EDR, XDR, and SOAR solutions. It also provides security solutions, network/storage, medical image management system, business intelligence solutions, digital communication, and market-based business management systems for financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Nichimen Data Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TechMatrix Corporation in November 2000. TechMatrix Corporation was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: SOLITON SYSTEMS KK
businessSummary: Soliton Systems K.K., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of IT security-related products in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: IT Security, Video Communication, and Eco New Business Development. It offers authentication-based logon control, data access control, log collection system, and network isolation  and cybersecurity measures, cyber threat intelligence, data breach investigations, and CSIRT-related services. The company also develops and sells Smart-telecaster, a real-time image transmission system using 4G and 5G mobile lines  remote control of vehicles and heavy machinery  mixed analog and digital semiconductor devices  and special video transmission system. In addition, it provides various solutions, including security measures for educational and local government information systems  management of IT assets  telework and healthcare solutions  and internet isolation. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: BUYSELL TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: BuySell Technologies Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the reuse business for kimonos and branded items in Japan. The company purchases and sells art and antiques, Chinese yuan, kimonos, precious metals, bags, jewelry, watches, alcohol, cameras, and short-term baby and children's items through its EC sites, stores, sales events, and B2B auctions. It also engages in the reuse franchise business  and the recycling of branded goods and precious metals. BuySell Technologies Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: JBCC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JBCC Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) services in Japan. It operates through Information Solutions Business  and Product Development and Manufacturing Business segments. The Information Solutions segment provides building, operation, and maintenance services for corporate information systems focusing on ultra-high-speed development, cloud computing, and security, which are classified into system development (SI), services, and systems. The Product Development and Manufacturing segment develops and provides software and product management systems, including cloud linkage platforms  and manufactures and sells various hardware, such as printers. The company also provides staff service agency services  and IT utilization services comprising consulting, application and system development, monitoring, and outsourcing services. JBCC Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: NITTO FUJI FLOUR MILLING
businessSummary: NITTO FUJI FLOUR MILLING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour manufacture and food business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flour and Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of flour, mix flour, food products, as well as the design and construction of flour manufacture and noodle making factories, as well as the wheat and wheat silo machines. The Restaurant segment operates Kentucky Fried Chicken (KFC) restaurants as franchisee, and also operates other kinds of restaurants. The Transportation segment is involved in the transportation of wheat and other products.

isin: 3139.T|Lacto Japan Co., Ltd.|3139.T|Lacto Japan Co., Ltd.
name: LACTO JAPAN
businessSummary: Lacto Japan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, trades in agricultural and livestock products, processed products, food additives, food processing machinery, pharmaceuticals, quasi-pharmaceuticals, liquor and other beverages, and food products in Japan and internationally. The company offers whole milk powder, skimmed milk powder, butter, ice cream, whey powder, whey protein concentrate, casein, caseinate, powdered milk mixtures, prepared butter mixtures, cocoa preparations, other milk preparations, lactose, condensed milk, processed egg products, natural cheese, processed cheese, processed meat products, fresh meat, processed food, and functional food ingredients. It also provides agency and brokerage services. The company serves food manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers  and sports nutrition, and beauty and health industries. Lacto Japan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NHK SPRING
businessSummary: NHK Spring Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sale of automotive-related parts, such as suspension springs, seats and seat components, and precision components. It also manufactures and sells information equipment-related products, and engages in logistics activities. The Company operates in five segments. The Suspension Springs segment manufactures and sells coil springs, leaf springs, stabilizers, accumulators, torsion bars, stabilizer links and stabilizer linkers. The Seating segment manufactures and sells automotive seats, seat structural parts. The Precision Components segment manufactures and sells mechanical parts for hard disk drives (HDDs), wire springs, thin leaf springs, motor cores, fasteners, and precision-machined products. The DDS segment manufactures and sells HDD suspensions and semiconductor inspection probe units. The Industrial Equipment and Others segment manufactures, sells, and transports semiconductor process parts, ceramic products and others.

name: STANLEY ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Stanley Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive equipment products, component products and electronic applied products. The Company operates through three segments. The Automotive Equipment segment mainly manufactures automotive lighting products, which are sold to automobile manufacturers. The Components segment mainly manufactures electronic device products that are sold to manufacturers related to electrical machinery and automobiles. The Electronic Applied Products segment mainly manufactures electronic applied products such as units and modules that meet the specifications of customers, such as liquid crystal backlights, and operation panels that are sold mainly to electrical equipment, automobiles, and automobile-related manufacturers. In addition, the Company is also engaged in business activities such as promotion of employment of people with physical disabilities and financial and management services for groups.

isin: 6742.T|Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd.|6742.T|Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
name: KYOSAN ELECTRIC MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. provides railway signaling and traffic management solutions in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Signal Systems Business and Power Electronics Business. It offers railway signaling solutions, including train control and detection equipment, interlocking equipment, block systems, field equipment, level crossing control equipment, total traffic control systems, maintenance equipment, power supply for signaling systems, and railway-related equipment. The company also provides safeguards for passenger transfer areas, such as partial-height platform screen doors, gap fillers, falling detection devices, and warning devices  passenger information display devices and funeral hall display systems  and traffic management solutions comprising road traffic control systems, road traffic signal controllers, road traffic signal units, traffic sensors, information displays, additional devices, transmission systems, and disaster prevention products. In addition, it offers power electronics solutions consisting of digitally controlled RF systems and DC converters  uninterruptible power supplies for signal  and power supplies for industrial equipment. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: MAKINO MILLING MACHINE
businessSummary: Makino Milling Machine Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing, sale and repair of machine tools. The Company operates through four business segments. The products include machining centers, numerically controlled (NC) electric discharge machines, NC milling machines, laser processing machines, computer-aided design (CAD)/computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) systems, as well as flexible manufacturing systems (FMS). The after-sales services include troubleshooting support, machine installation and test runs, explanations of operation methods and functions, as well as reinstallation and operation checks following factory equipment relocations and layout changes. The Company sells its products in Japan, the United States, other parts of North, Central and South America, China, other parts of Asia, Europe and other regions.

name: SIGMAXYZ HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SIGMAXYZ Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based company that provides consulting services to businesses. It operates through a single Consulting segment. It supports companies in their digital transformation (DX), service transformation, and management transformation. It provides services such as business strategy formulation, business model design, operational reform, system implementation, and operational support. Furthermore, it leverages its network with client companies, business partners, and investment targets to build ecosystems, create new businesses, promote innovation, and support the resolution of social issues.

name: NITERRA
businessSummary: Niterra Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to its automotive-related and component solutions businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automotive-related segment manufactures and sells components primarily installed in automobiles, such as spark plugs and exhaust gas sensors. The Component Solutions segment manufactures and sells cutting tools, industrial equipment components, parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, semiconductor packages, fuel cells, silicon nitride products, and medical oxygen concentrators. It also sells materials and provides welfare services.

name: PROPERTY DATA BANK
businessSummary: Property Data Bank, Inc. is engaged in development of software for real estate and facility management, as well as provision of integrated asset management cloud service under the name @property. The cloud service mainly engages in provision and maintenance of @property, and support of users. It receives monthly usage fee and maintenance service fee by customer-based billing according to the number of registered building data on a monthly basis from customers. The solution service engages in business efficiency improvement for customers, who already introducing @ property or planning to introduce it. It also engages in provision of solution services according to customer specific needs.

name: SUMITOMO DENSETSU
businessSummary: Sumitomo Densetsu Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment work business. The Company provides electric power supply work, general electric work, information communication work, plant and air conditioning work and other equipment work, as well as related engineering services. The electric power supply work is mainly engaged in the design, construction and supervision of transmission and distribution equipment. The general electric work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of electrical installation work and environment related work. The information communication work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of telecommunication equipment work. The plant and air conditioning work is engaged in the design, construction and supervision of plants and air conditioning sanitary tubes. The Company is also engaged in the insurance agency business, the manufacture and repair of equipment, and the manufacture and sale of water heaters.

name: BUSINESS ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Business Engineering Corporation, formerly Toyo Business Engineering Corporation, is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Solution segment is involved in the design, development and installation of corporate information systems, with the use of enterprise resource planning (ERP) packages developed by other companies. The Product segment is engaged in the sale of self-developed ERP packages through partner companies, as well as the design, development and installation of corporate information systems using its products. The System Support segment provides support services for system operation and maintenance, to companies with ERP system installed.

name: USONAR
businessSummary: uSonar Co., Ltd. engages in the development of a corporate database,  LBC,  that offers B2B data. The company operates a customer data integration solution platform,  Usonar,  that provides information on capital affiliations and headquarters/business unit relationships, as well as list extraction considering news, implemented services, and website visit data. It provides mSonar, a business information and business card management application and Plansonar, a management strategy platform. It offers customer data integration solution for corporate activities including marketing and management. The company was formerly known as Landscape Co., Ltd. and changed its name to uSonar Co., Ltd. in July 2022. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

isin: 1961.T|Sanki Engineering Co., Ltd.|1961.T|Sanki Engineering Co., Ltd.
name: SANKI ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Sanki Engineering Co., Ltd. provides various social infrastructure services in Japan. It provides facilities construction services in the areas of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), as well as plumbing services for buildings, which cover HVAC systems, water supply and drainage plumbing systems, disaster prevention systems, kitchen systems, district heating and cooling plants, and nuclear power related facilities. The company also provides facilities construction services in the areas of industrial HVAC systems, which cover semiconductor and flat panel display manufacturing systems  and manufacturing facilities for medical, pharmaceutical, and food products, as well as environmental control, and freezing and refrigeration. In addition, it provides services in the areas of electrical systems, telecommunications, and civil engineering services  smart building solutions comprising central monitoring and automated control systems, ICT systems, crisis management solutions, IP-phone systems, and security systems  and facility systems, which cover dealing room facilities for financial institutions, relocation projects, and business continuity management facilities. Further, the company provides services in the areas of machinery systems that include factory automation and clean conveyance, material handling, airport baggage and cargo handling, control and information, and standard conveyor systems  and environmental systems, including water supply/sewage treatment facilities, general and industrial waste treatment and recycling systems, and environmental facilities for industries, as well as plant facilities for the food, chemical, and other industries. Additionally, it leases land and buildings  and provides building maintenance and management services. Sanki Engineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: GOLDWIN
businessSummary: Goldwin Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various sporting goods, mainly textile products. The Sporting Goods Related Business segment provides outdoor-related brand products such as mountaineering wear, marine wear and outdoor goods, athletic-related brand products such as training wear, fitness wear, swimwear, rugby wear and golf wear, winter-related brand products such as ski wear and snowboard wear, as well as functional underwear and high-tech wear (dustproof clothing). The Company is also engaged in logistics business, non-life insurance agency business, real estate-related business, venture investment business, and golf course management.

name: MATSUKIYOCOCOKARA &
businessSummary: MatsukiyoCocokara & Co. is a Japan-based company mainly operates chains of drugstores and insurance-dispensing pharmacies. The Matsumoto Kiyoshi Group Business segment manages drugstore and prescription pharmacy chains; opens and operates prescription pharmacies; develops franchise operations; and supplies products to franchisees. The Cocokara Fine Group Business segment manages drugstore and prescription pharmacy chains; opens and operates prescription pharmacies; operates nursing care facilities; provides home-visit nursing care services; rents and sells nursing care equipment; and supplies products such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and daily necessities. The And Company Business segment manages drugstore and prescription pharmacy chains and opens and operates prescription pharmacies. The Administrative Support Business segment handles management and oversight; undertakes outsourced administrative functions; plans and develops private-brand products; manages and utilizes assets.

name: TERRASKY
businessSummary: TerraSky Co.,Ltd. provides cloud products and solutions in Japan and internationally. The company offers cloud integration services comprising Salesforce, AI agent implementation support, MuleSoft Anypoint, Amazon Web services, Heroku, contact center, SAP migration, B2B commerce, and financial services cloud and marketing cloud solutions, as well as solutions for manufacturing industries. It also provides cloud consulting services comprising digital marketing support, DX promotion consulting, AppExchange consulting, marketing tool implementation support service, production support solutions, and data utilization support service  development support tools, such as mitoco X, flosum, ACCELQ, DCSpider, skyvisual editor, and Elements.cloud services  and cloud services, including mitoco ERP, mitoco, Mitoco accounting, mitoco Work, mitoco AI, Fujitsu GLOVIA OM, Soask for subscription management, CloudSign for Salesforce, Salesforce Field Service, Insurance Agency Solution for insurance agents, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Salesforce Data Cloud, OMLINE-I, OMLINE-O, ChoiceRESERVE Reservation Integration, SVF Cloud for Salesforce, MotionBoard Cloud for Salesforce, and invoiceAgent for to digitizing paper documents. The company was formerly known as Head Solutions Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Terasakai Co.,Ltd. in February 2007. TerraSky Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 3395.T|Saint Marc Holdings Co., Ltd.|3395.T|Saint Marc Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: SAINT MARC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Saint Marc Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the restaurant and cafe business in Japan. It also operates franchise chain systems. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

name: ASIRO
businessSummary: Asiro Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of legal media sites for lawyer industry. The Company operates through two business segments. Legal Media-related Business segment is classified into legal media, which provides marketing support services to lawyers, and derivative media, which provides marketing support services to advertisers other than lawyers. Legal media includes divorce, traffic accident, inheritance, labor problem, criminal case, debt collection, debt consolidation, information technology (IT), and corporate legal lawyer navigations. Other derivative media include Carism, a career change agent media site, Uwaki Investigation Navigation, a field-specific detective media site, and Hitosagashi, a field-specific detective media site. The Legal Human Resources (HR) Business segment is engaged in the provision of job change support services for qualified lawyers, and operation of a specialized job change site NO-LIMIT for lawyers.

name: RAKUMACHI
businessSummary: RAKUMACHI,Inc. operates a real estate investment portal site under the Rakumachi name in Japan. Its site offers services that enables users to learn about real estate investment, search for real estate, and sell real estate. The company was formerly known as Firstlogic,Inc. and changed its name to RAKUMACHI,Inc. in October 2024. RAKUMACHI,Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: YAMATANE
businessSummary: Yamatane Corporation engages in the wholesale, import, export, and sales of foodstuffs and related products in Japan. It also provides warehousing, cargo handling, customs brokerage, port transportation, and freight forwarding services. In addition, the company designs, develops, sells, and rents computers, computer software and other information equipment  and provides contracted operation and management services for computer systems. Further, the company involved in the trading, buying, brokering, renting, managing, and selling of real estate  and buying, selling, brokerage of artworks and other items. The company was formerly known as Yamatane Sangyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yamatane Corporation in 1995. Yamatane Corporation was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: WA
businessSummary: WA, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the plan and sale of women's shoes. The plan and sale of women's shoes business is involved in the product planning and development business, the product inspection business and the product sale business. The product sale business is involved in the retail sale at physical stores and EC sites, as well as wholesale and sale at other fashion brands. The Company is engaged in the sale of products under the brands of ORiental Traffic, WA ORiental Traffic, NICAL and OR KIDS.

name: KING
businessSummary: KING Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly involved in fiber products business. The Company has two business divisions. The Apparel division is involved in the wholesale of ladies apparels, fashion goods, apparel accessories, promotion materials, the planning, sale, logistics and clerical work agency businesses, as well as the sale of apparel store promotion items. The Textile segment is involved in the wholesale of textile products, through its subsidiary.

name: SECOM
businessSummary: Secom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of security services. The Company operates in six business segments. The Security Services segment provides comprehensive security services, focusing on centralized systems for offices and homes. The Fire Protection Services segment provides various types of fire protection systems. The Medical Services segment provides various medical services, including home medical services, operation of senior residences, and sales of electronic medical records. The Insurance Business segment develops and sells insurance products. The Geospatial Information Services segment provides geospatial information services, geospatial information services, and other services. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Information and Communication Technology (ICT) segment provides information security services, large-scale disaster response services, data center operations, and BPO services.

name: POLARIS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Polaris Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Kachikaihatsu Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the hotel business and the real estate business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Hotel segment is involved in the hotel management, consultancy, operation and franchise business. The Real Estate segment operates in five kinds of businesses. The real estate leasing business is involved in the leasing and operation of office buildings and condominiums. The real estate trading business is involved in the purchase and sale of office buildings and condominiums. The real estate development business is involved in the provision of information collection, survey, analysis, planning and construction services. The real estate investment business is involved in the investment of silent partnership in special purpose company (SPC) that holds trust beneficiary rights. The real estate management business is involved in the trust of the operation management business.

isin: 3491.T|GA technologies Co., Ltd.|3491.T|GA technologies Co., Ltd.
name: GA TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: GA technologies Co., Ltd. operates a real estate brokerage platform. The company offers Renosy, an AI real estate investment platform  Shenjumiaosuan, a platform that connects Japanese real estate brokerage companies with investors living in the Greater China region  dearlife, a rental estates platform for expatriates in Thailand  ITANDI BB, a site between real estate agents that allows search for properties and make reservations for previews and move-in applications  ITANDI Rental Brokerage, a sales support service for real estate rental brokerage  and ITANDI Sales PropoCloud, a sales support system for real estate sales and purchase brokerage companies. It also provides Urban luxury real estate platform  BtoB SaaS PropTech product series  and industry-specific m and a brokerage counseling. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 5817.T|JMACS Japan Co., Ltd.|5817.T|JMACS Japan Co., Ltd.
name: JMACS JAPAN
businessSummary: JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells instrumentation cables, control cables, communication cables, disaster prevention cables, optical fiber cables products in Japan. It offers field bus cables, optical cables, offshore wind power generation cables, traffic signal and control cables, and eco-material products  and electric wires. JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Nihon Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JMACS Japan Co., Ltd. in September 2015. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Kato, Japan.

name: SHOEI FOODS
businessSummary: Shoei Foods Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, procures, processes, manufactures, sells, and imports food products in Japan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers fruits, including prunes, raisins, cranberries, blueberries, strawberries, mandarin oranges, lemons, mangoes, grapefruits, figs, dates, cherries, apples, apricots, grapes, raspberries, goji berries, pineapples, papayas, goldenberries, gingers, bananas, cherry tomatoes, aloes, mixed fruits, peaches, and pears  and nuts such as almonds, almond milk, walnuts and processed walnut products, macadamia nuts, cashews, hazelnuts, pecan nuts, pistachio nuts, coconuts, pine nuts, and sunflower and pumpkin seeds. It also provides confectionery and bread making ingredients comprising candied chestnuts, chestnut pastes, processed chestnut products, candied plums, sweet potato and chocolate processed products, maple syrups, baked confectioneries, powdered sugar, almond frost, custard powder, nata de coco and tapioca, fruit jam and filling, and fruit pickles and puree  and dairy products, which include butter, imported mozzarella and cream cheese, imported dairy products and preparations, condensed and fermented milks, cafe and confectionery ingredients, dairy lactic acid bacteria beverages, powder products, reconstituted concentrated milk, formulated milk powder, soft mix, and caramel products. In addition, the company offers foodservice ingredients, such as pasta, olive oil, tomatoes, table olives, cones, tuna processed products, processed potato products, mushrooms, steamed beans, fruit magic dolce and sauce, dessert syrups and jellies, and topping ingredients  and home products comprising prune small bags, nuts and seeds sachets, dried fruit packets, and other retail items. Further, it operates and manages walnut, prune, and almond farms. The company was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: SYUPPIN
businessSummary: Syuppin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of used and new goods through Internet or retail stores. It has four business segments. Camera segment operates Map Camera, selling used and new models, including Leica, Rollei, Hasselblad and Zeiss, as well as domestic and international digital cameras, film cameras and interchangeable lenses. Watch segment operates GMT, providing used and new mechanical watches, including Patek Philippe, A. Lange & Sohne, Rolex and Breitling. Under the trade name BRILLER, it offers women's watches, including Rolex, Cartier and Chanel, as well as designer bags. Writing Instruments segment operates KINGDOM NOTE as a writing instrument store stocking both new and used items, including brand-name fountain pens and ballpoint pens. Bicycle segment operates CROWN GEARS as a road bike store stocking both new and used items, including road bikes, mini-bikes, mountain bikes and others, as well as related parts and accessories.

name: SBS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SBS Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company that plans and decides on group strategies and monitors group companies and provides various shared services to group companies. It operates through three business segments. The Logistics Business segment provides comprehensive logistics services, primarily in the field of business-to-business (B2B) logistics. This segment offers third-party logistics (3PL) and fourth-party logistics (4PL) services, food logistics services with a nationwide network covering three temperature ranges, transportation services, rapid delivery services, international logistics services, and logistics consulting services. The Real Estate Business segment consists of the rental of owned facilities for use as offices, residences, warehouses and others, as well as the development and sale of logistics facilities. The Other Business segment consists of human resources business, environmental business, marketing business, and solar power generation business.

name: SAPPORO BREWERIES
businessSummary: Sapporo Breweries Ltd, formerly Sapporo Holdings Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of alcoholic beverage and food and beverage businesses. The Company consists of two business segments. The Alcoholic Beverage segment manufactures and sells beer, sparkling wine, wine, and other alcoholic beverages, and sells wine and other spirits in stores and through mail order. It also operates various types of restaurants, including Lion Chain beer halls and restaurants. The Food and Beverage segment manufactures and sells drinking water and food products.

name: TAMRON
businessSummary: Tamron Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of photographic, surveillance and factory automation (FA), mobility, healthcare and other optical products. The Company has three segments. Photographic Products segment manufactures and sells interchangeable lenses for mirrorless and single-lens reflex cameras. Surveillance & FA Products segment manufactures and sells lenses for surveillance cameras, FA and machine vision systems and television (TV) conferencing, as well as camera modules. Mobility & Healthcare and Other Products segment manufactures and sells lenses for automotive cameras, video cameras, digital cameras, drones and medical applications, as well as other optical device components.

name: MITSUI E&S
businessSummary: Mitsui E&S Co Ltd, formerly Mitsui E&S Holdings Co Ltd, is primarily engaged in ship, marine development, machinery, and engineering businesses. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Ship segment provides ships, naval vessels, high-speed passenger ships, offshore structures, underwater equipment, design engineering services, ship-related equipment and machinery, and steel structures. The Marine Development segment provides floating offshore oil and gas production, storage, and offloading facilities. The Machinery segment provides marine and land-use diesel engines, marine equipment, gas engines, steam turbines, blowers, compressors, gas turbines, among others. The Engineering segment provides power generation projects and general overseas civil engineering and construction work. The Company also engages in land-based diesel power plant business, information and communication equipment business, system development business, gas-related engineering, among others.

name: KURASHIRU
businessSummary: Kurashiru, Inc. engages in the platform business in Japan, Singapore, and internationally. It offers advertising services, including Kurashiru, a recipe video platform  Receipt Challenge by Kurashiru, a smart savings app  Kurashiru AI OS, an AI agent platform for CPG brands, wholesalers, and retailers  TRILL, a lifestyle information media  and LIVEwith, a creator management agency. The company was formerly known as dely Inc. and changed its name to Kurashiru, Inc. in October 2025. Kurashiru, Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: AVIC
businessSummary: AViC Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital marketing business. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides high-quality digital marketing services mainly to clients with medium to small advertising budgets. The Company provides internet advertising services such as purchasing advertising space from media management companies, measuring advertising effectiveness, and acting as an advertising operation agent for clients. The Company also provides search engine optimization (SEO) consulting services that measure the effectiveness of SEO measures, such as optimizing the internal structure of target websites and creating content to be posted on them, and then provides comprehensive solutions and appropriate information dissemination for clients.

name: ANYCOLOR
businessSummary: Anycolor Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the video content-related business. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of the virtual youtuber (VTuber) group Nijisanji, which is centered on the live streaming domain of video distribution on YouTube, as well as the commerce domain (sales of VTuber goods and other content and events), which expands the range of VTuber activities by providing contact points other than video distribution. The Company also develops business in the promotion domain, where uses the intellectual property (IP) it owns related to its VTubers to promote the products and services of its corporate clients. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the operation of overseas VTuber business as a new business domain.

name: TREASURE FACTORY
businessSummary: Treasure Factory Co.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and operation of reuse stores in Japan. The company's reuse products include unused items and items that have been disposed of by manufacturers, such as clothing, home appliances, furniture, household goods, branded goods, sports and outdoor equipment, musical instruments, and hobby products. It also purchases and sells reuse items through online. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KAGOME
businessSummary: Kagome Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of foods at home and abroad. The Company operates through four business segments. The Processed Foods segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages and seasonings. The main products are the Vegetable Life 100 series, tomato juice, tomato ketchup, tomato seasonings, sauces, and products for mail order and gifts. The International Business segment is engaged in the tomato seed development and agricultural production, as well as product development, processing, and sales. The Agriculture segment is engaged in the production and sale of fresh vegetables. Products include fresh tomatoes, baby leaves, and others. The Other segment is engaged in the real estate business and outsourcing business.

name: SATO
businessSummary: Sato Corp, formerly Sato Holdings Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of automatic identification technology products like mechatronics products and supply products. The Company operates in three segments. The Automatic Identification Solution Japan segment is mainly engaged in the planning of the group management strategies, managements, asset lending, the manufacture and sales of mechatronics products and supply products as well as the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber products, synthetic resins, and radio frequency identification device (RFID) tags and labels. The Automatic Identification Solution Overseas segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of mechatronics products and supply products, as well as the manufacturing and sales of RFID tags and labels overseas. It is also engaged in the construction and civil engineering works.

name: BRIDGESTONE
businessSummary: Bridgestone Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the tire business. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the premium tire business, the solutions business, and the chemicals and diversified products business. The China, Asia, and Oceania segment is engaged in the premium tire business and the solutions business. The Americas segment is engaged in the premium tire business, solutions business, and diversified products business. The Europe, Russia, Middle East, India and Africa segment is engaged in premium tire business and solution business. The Others segment is engaged in other businesses.

isin: 6539.T|MATCHING SERVICE JAPAN CO LT|6539.T|Matching Service Japan Co., Ltd.
name: MATCHING SERVICE JAPAN
businessSummary: Matching Service Japan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the human resource business in Japan. The company offers recruitment agency services for business administration positions and professionals, which include accounting, finance, law, general and legal affairs, human resources, certified public accountants, attorney/lawyer, tax accountants, corporate planning, and other areas  direct recruitment services  and staffing and recruitment services in Australia for various areas, such as finance, accounting, business support, banking, taxation, risk and compliance, IT systems, and others. It also operates Manegy, an internet media website for gathering information about daily work. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: STRIKE GROUP
businessSummary: Strike Group Co Ltd, formerly Strike Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the brokerage of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) (corporate mergers, corporate acquisitions, inter-company capital alliances). Its M&A business includes business succession type M&A, growth-strategy M&A, which is an M&A transaction primarily aimed at the aggressive growth and business expansion of company, and innovation-type M&A, which is a strategic M&A that aims to accelerate innovation by incorporating innovative elements that the company lacks. It provides financial advisory services, due diligence services, and corporate valuation services, and supports M&A-related tasks to enable sound management decisions, including corporate restructuring support, issues related to business succession within families, and value and risk assessments of target companies for investment. It also provides strategic consulting services.

name: ISTYLE
businessSummary: istyle Inc. operates a beauty portal site @cosme in Japan and internationally. It operates through Support Business, Retail Business, and Global Business segments. The company operates @cosme shopping and @cosme store, a cosmetics specialty store  @cosme Career, a talent service focused on the cosmetics industry  @cosme blog, a beauty blog site where beauty professionals and people with a keen sense of beauty can share and share information, @cosme point, a site on which users can earn points  @cosme Q&A, a site at which members can share knowledge and tips on cosmetics and beauty. It offers BeautyTech.jp, a media site that provides information on innovations in the beauty industry from the perspectives of technology, marketing, science, business, etc.  Glowpick, a beauty community site  and BeautyTech.jp, a digital magazine. The company was formerly known as I-Style Co., Ltd. and changed its name to istyle Inc. in April 2000. istyle Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: AZBIL
businessSummary: Azbil Corporation is engaged in the manufacture of automation equipment. It has three segments. The Building Automation (BA) segment offers network building automation systems, wide area management systems, actuators and control valves, as well as building and energy management, maintenance and consulting services. The Advanced Automation (AA) segment offers supervisory control systems, solution packages, controllers, combustion safety control equipment, etc. The Life Automation segment provides various gas meters, safety maintenance equipment, supply equipment, etc. The Company also conducts insurance agency business.

name: FINDEX
businessSummary: FINDEX Inc. offers medical devices in Japan. It operates through Medical Business, Public Business, and Healthtech Business segments. The company provides Claio image filing system, C-Scan paper and digital document management system, DocuMaker document creation system, PDI+MoveBy referral information management system, C-Note medical record writing system, MapleNote perinatal system, REMORA electronic medical record, ID-Cam/Claio-Cam digital camera solution, UniversalSearcher medical big data search system, FAXde regional collaboration FAX referral management system, LIS endoscope system endoscopy department system, LIS ultrasound system ultrasound department system, ProRad RS radiology reporting system, gateway system, RemoTalkCloud, remote sharing app for medical information, C-Nys / C-Nys ME Nystagmus analysis support system, Cloud backup service security service, PiCls Medical Avenue for patient information app, PiCls On-examination online medical support system, PiCls AAdE-report electronic tracing report service, PiCls booking assistant first appointment online reservation service, PiCls connect medical institution collaboration service, WebeLi, and CocktailAI, a generative AI for medical text generation  and DigiWorker, an RPA tool for healthcare. It also offers REMORA+Claio, an ophthalmology solution  G-QuICC DB Program, a glaucoma protocol  ENT package  DocuMaker Cloud, a medical certificate and other document creation service  REMORA Cloud, a cloud-based electronic medical record  C-Note + Claio, an ophthalmology solution  ClaioDashboard integrated viewing system  DocuMaker office, a document management system for administrative department  DocuMakerShelf, an electronic bookkeeping solution  and GAP-screener, line-of-sight analysis type perimeter for medical examination facilities. The company was formerly known as PSC Inc. and changed its name to FINDEX Inc. in November 2014. FINDEX Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: ZIGEXN
businessSummary: ZIGExN Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in life media platform business which integrates the information on multiple media. The Company operates in two business segments. Its Life Media Platform segment is engaged in the development, operation and maintenance of media that integrate information from multiple Internet and paper media, specialized media that matches users and customers for specific industries and regions, as well as application Service provider (ASP) services. The Life Media Platform segment includes three fields: human resources field, real estate field and living field. The Others segment is engaged in the plan, development, operation and maintenance of new development services centered on the user billing model, leveraging the knowledge of the existing life media platform business.

name: WOLVES HAND
businessSummary: WOLVES HAND Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the veterinary hospital business. The main businesses are the operation of veterinary hospitals and pet salons, provision of software for veterinary hospitals, distribution of veterinary medical education seminars, and the manufacture and sale of medical equipment and instruments. The veterinary hospital operation business provides veterinary medical care at veterinary hospitals. The pet salon operation business provides grooming services and operates pet hotels. The veterinary hospital software provision business develops and sells the customer management system Wantaro for veterinary hospitals. The veterinary medical education seminar distribution business operates the information site VMN for veterinarians and creates seminar content. The medical equipment manufacturing and sales business researches, develops, manufactures, sells, leases, and imports and exports medical equipment and medical instruments.

name: TECHNOFLEX
businessSummary: Technoflex Corporation offers flexible metal hoses, expansion joints, and multi-layer pipes. The company also sells flexible and fluoroplastic hoses, formed bellows, and vacuum components. Its products are used for various applications, such as construction pipes, city water pipes, semiconductors, iron manufacturing, shipbuilding, city gas, LP gas, electricity, thermal power, nuclear power, and general plants. Technoflex Corporation was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: DUSKIN
businessSummary: Duskin Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental hygiene and food businesses in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the rental and sale of cleaning and hygiene products  leasing, sale, and cleaning of uniforms  sale of natural cosmetics and health foods products  and comprehensive event support. The company offers cleaning/beautification-related items such as mats, mops, cabinet towels, and air purifiers. The company provides professional cleaning  pest control and comprehensive hygiene management  home cleaning and helper  plant and flower upkeep  and home repair services comprising fixing scratches and dents, as well as emergency locksmith service  support services for seniors  and rental and sale of assisted-living products. In addition, it operates hamburger and donut shops, and pork cutlet restaurants. Duskin Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 4928.T|Noevir Holdings Co., Ltd.|4928.T|Noevir Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: NOEVIR HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Noevir Holdings Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells cosmetics, toiletries, medical supplies, and food products in China, Taiwan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, the United States, and Canada. The company's Cosmetics segment develops, produces, and sells skincare products under various brands, including Noevir and Nameraka Honpo  excel make up line products and NOV hypoallergenic cosmetics, as well as provides contract manufacturing services for cosmetics and quasi drugs. Its Pharmaceutical and food business segment produces and sells Nanten Nodo Ame cough drops  functional drinks, such as the Min Min Da Ha  and over-the-counter pharmaceuticals comprising cold remedies, eye drops, and digestive aids, as well as nutritional supplements, and other products. The company's Other segment sells and leases apparel, body fashion, aircraft and ships, air transportation and pilot training business, etc. The company also provides market research. The company sells its products through drug stores and variety stores, and dermatology and medical institutions, as well as Noevir beauty studios and own retail stores. Noevir Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: HITACHI CONSTRUCTION MACHINERY
businessSummary: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction equipment, and the provision of related services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction Machinery Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic excavators, ultra-large hydraulic excavators, wheel loaders and the provision of other related toral life cycle. The Specialized Parts & Services Business segment is involved in the development, manufacture, sale and provision of after-sales service solutions for mining equipment and machinery.

name: SHIBUSAWA LOGISTICS
businessSummary: Shibusawa Logistics Corporation provides logistics and warehousing services in Japan and internationally. The company provides strategic logistics services, such as warehousing and distribution processing for various types of cargo  truck transportation services, including transportation, and ocean freight container transportation for customer's logistics  ocean and air import and export handling services comprising customs clearance, overland transport, and warehouse storage at departure and arrival ports and airports  document storage and trunk room storage  and moving &household goods storage. It is also involved in EC fulfillment services  customs clearance  trade/intermediary business/management/leading of real estate  packaging/indication/storage of pharmaceuticals/quasi-drugs/cosmetics and medical equipment  planning/development/sales/operation management of information systems  employment agency  and life support of non-covered long-term care insurance. The company was formerly known as The Shibusawa Warehouse Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shibusawa Logistics Corporation in January 2025. Shibusawa Logistics Corporation was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

name: TOKYO ELECTRON DEVICE
businessSummary: Tokyo Electron Device Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the semiconductor and electronic device business and the computer system-related business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor and Electronic Devices segment sells semiconductor products, boards and electronic components, software and services, as well as manufactures and sells private brand (PB) products. The Computer System-related segment sells network-related products, storage-related products, and security-related products, as well as provides maintenance and monitoring services.

name: TOKYU FUDOSAN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tokyu Fudosan Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Urban Development segment develops, leases, operates and sells office buildings and commercial facilities, and develops, leases and sells condominiums and rental housing. The Strategic Investment segment develops, leases, operates and sells renewable energy power generation facilities and logistics facilities. It also manages real estate private placement funds, and asset management and investment. The Management and Operation segment is involved in the management of condominiums and buildings, renovation work, sales of member-only resort hotels, management of hotels, golf courses and ski resorts, corporate welfare contracting, environmental greening and landscaping. Real Estate Distribution segment is involved in real estate brokerage, sales agency, management and operation of rental housing and student apartments and subleasing business.

name: JAPAN PROPERTY MANAGEMENT CENTER
businessSummary: Japan Property Management Center Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of property management business nationwide, centered on lump-sum lease business. The Company rents real estate properties (rental housing such as rental condominiums and rental apartments) from real estate owners and subleases them to general residents. The Company is engaged in the rental management on behalf of landlords. Construction work, remodeling work, real estate property management and brokerage, and management of elderly housing are operated by partner companies (real estate management companies, construction companies, remodeling companies, and long-term care companies) nationwide. The Company is also engaged in the delinquency guarantee business, insurance business, broadband business (JPMC Hikari), sales business of building materials, and contract for renewal, remodeling and renovation work in the metropolitan area.

name: NO 1
businessSummary: No.1 Co.,Ltd engages in the planning, development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance of information security equipment and OA related products in Japan. It offers multifunction printers, business phones, and file servers. It also engages in the sale and maintenance of information and communication equipment  wifi devices  develops, manufactures, and sells OEM/ODM supplies  electricity  information security and office equipment  IT engineering  semiconductor  system designs  energy products  call centers  printers  provides network infrastructure, data centers, ICT support services  and application services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: QUANTS RESEARCH INSTITUTE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Quants Research Institute Holdings Inc, formerly M&A Research Institute Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The M&A Brokerage Business segment provides hybrid M&A brokerage services using technology centered on artificial intelligence (AI) and the support of M&A advisors. The Other segment is mainly engaged in consulting and asset management consulting businesses.

name: WATAMI
businessSummary: Watami Co., Ltd. engages in the food service, home meal service, environmental, and agriculture businesses in Japan, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, and the United States. It is involved in the operation of restaurants  provision of home delivery meals  retail of electricity  dairy and livestock farming  sale of dairy products  and wind power generation business. The company was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: HOSIDEN
businessSummary: Hosiden Corporation is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Company has four business segments. The Mechanical Component segment provides connectors, jacks and switches. The Acoustic segment offers microphones, headphones, headsets, speakers and receivers. The Liquid Crystal Display Device segment provides passive liquid crystal display devices. The Composite Part and Others segment offers remote controllers and solenoids.

name: MACBEE PLANET
businessSummary: Macbee Planet, Inc. engages in the lifetime value (LTV) marketing business in Japan. It operates through LTV Marketing and Others segments. The company offers LTV marketing, a digital marketing solution that utilizes data to maximize user spending and retention  Honeycomb, a data analysis platform  and Robee, a web hospitality tool. It also provides performance-based advertising/solution proposals  capital-participating marketing firm  SNS marketing  strategic PR  3DCG advertising platform  SNS consulting  Pretia AR, an AR production and distribution platform  DX/business development  and retention marketing/voice and data analysis solutions, as well as consulting services for online advertising. Macbee Planet, Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: TAIHO KOGYO
businessSummary: Taiho Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells bearings in Japan. It offers engine parts, such as vacuum pumps, exhaust valves, turbocharger parts, engine parts top, and engine bearings  drive auxiliary bearing and compressor parts  and noise damping PCU covers, stack manifold and pressure plates, and adhesive gaskets, as well as fuel cell power generation contract testing products. The company also offers aluminum die-cast products and precision molds. Taiho Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Toyota, Japan.

name: JFE SYSTEMS
businessSummary: JFE Systems, Inc. engages in the planning, designing, developing, operating, and maintenance of information systems in Japan. The company also offers various business solutions, such as system integration, supply chain management systems, data science, AI, business system and low code development, ERP, BI, e-commerce, system coordination, digital form systems, cost management systems, procurement management systems, HR/payroll systems, and quality information management and manufacturing method management systems for the food products industry. In addition, it provides infrastructure solutions comprising cloud, server virtualization, network construction, virtualization technology, information security support, and voice cloud service  office solutions, manufacturing solutions, and platform construction support services  and systems development and maintenance for sales, production, logistics, accounting, costs, purchasing, supply and demand, quality, accounting, and pensions, etc. The company was formerly known as Kawasaki Steel Systems R&D Corporation and changed its name to JFE Systems, Inc. in 2004. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. JFE Systems, Inc. is a subsidiary of JFE Steel Corporation.

name: TOSEI
businessSummary: Tosei Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in real estate revitalization, real estate development, real estate leasing, real estate fund and consulting, real estate management, and hotel businesses. It operates through six segments. The Real Estate Revitalization segment revitalizes and sells properties with deteriorated asset value. The Real Estate Development segment is engaged in the sale of condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, as well as the sale of rental condominiums and office buildings to investors. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and condominiums. The Real Estate Fund and Consulting segment provides asset management services for real estate funds. The Real Estate Management segment provides comprehensive property management services. The Hotel segment operates hotels.

name: SHOEI
businessSummary: Shoei Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the helmet-related business, primarily manufacturing and selling motorcycle helmets. Products include helmets and related products. It mainly manufactures and sells motorcycle helmets and helmets for government use, and sells helmet parts. Through its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in agency management and marketing in Europe, sales of helmets and helmet parts, market research, and marketing in Southeast Asia, China, and Japan.

isin: 7610.T|Tay Two Co., Ltd.|7610.T|Tay Two Co., Ltd.
name: TAY TWO
businessSummary: Tay Two Co., Ltd. engages in the buying and selling of used goods in Japan. It is involved in the sale and purchase of secondhand books, home video games, trading cards, hobbies, smartphones, CDs, DVDs, and clothing. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

name: NEW COSMOS ELECTRIC
businessSummary: NEW COSMOS ELECTRIC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of gas sensors, the development, manufacturing and sales of gas alarms and detectors, as well as the maintenance of its products.

name: KYOWAKOGYOSYO
businessSummary: KYOWAKOGYOSYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of bolts for construction machinery. The Company manufactures hexagon bolts, hexagon socket head bolts and special bolts, and sells products to the industries of construction machinery, automobile related and industrial machinery. It has four departments. The construction machinery division manufactures hexagon bolts, shoe bolts and nuts, hexagon socket head bolts, flathead bolts, special bolts, and swing machinery shafts. The automobile-related department manufactures forged products, including transmission input shafts, continuously variable transmission shafts, hollow parts, pinion shafts. The industrial machinery division manufactures JIS standard (JIS B 1180) hexagon bolts and JIS standard (JIS B 1176) hexagon socket head bolts. The other division manufactures special bolts for internal combustion engines of ships and generators, and for large scale buildings such as gymnasiums and stadiums.

name: IMAMURA SECURITIES
businessSummary: Imamura Securities Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the investment and financial services business with financial instruments trading business as its core business and provides a wide range of services to its customers in both financing and asset management. The principal business is trading of securities, market derivatives transactions or foreign market derivatives transactions, intermediary, agency or agent for trading of securities, intermediary, agency or agent for brokerage of trading of securities in the exchange-traded financial instruments market, underwriting of securities, offering of securities or private placement of securities, the underwriting of securities, the offering or secondary offering of securities and the handling of the offering or secondary offering of securities, or the handling of private placements of securities. The Company is also engaged in businesses incidental to the financial instruments business, gold bullion trading, insurance sale.

name: SIOS
businessSummary: SIOS Corporation develops and sells software products and SaaS application services in Japan. It operates through three segments: Products & Services, Consulting & Integration, and Software Sales & Solution. The company provides Software as a Service, a software licensing and distribution model  subscription business model  open-source solutions  and API, a set of protocols that enables different software programs and applications. It also offers Gluegent Gate, a cloud-based management of user IDs  Gluegent Flow, a cloud-based workflow system  Gluegent Apps group scheduler that adds schedule management function to Google calendar  and consulting service for supporting RAG implementation projects. In addition, the company engages in infrastructure construction, operational support, and IT system development business, as well as involved in document management software applications. Further, it provides customer support for OSS products and assist financial institutions  contracted development of enterprise information systems  implementing generative AI solutions  and resells and support OSS products. The company was formerly known as SIOS Technology, Inc. and changed its name to SIOS Corporation in October 2017. SIOS Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NIPPON BS BROADCASTING
businessSummary: Nippon BS Broadcasting Corporation engages in the BS digital broadcasting business in Japan. The company sells the broadcast time slots of programs to advertisers, and broadcast programs provided by advertisers and their commercials  time slots between programs to advertisers in seconds, and broadcast advertiser's commercials  and programs to local terrestrial stations. Its program categories include news, educational, entertainment, advertisements, shopping, and other programs. The company also engages in the program production  Internet distribution business of programs and related content  and publishing business of children's books, including picture books, reading materials, and educational materials. The company was formerly known as Nippon BS Broadcasting Kikaku Corporation and changed its name to Nippon BS Broadcasting Corporation in February 2007. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Nippon BS Broadcasting Corporation is a subsidiary of Bic Camera Co., Ltd.

name: SK ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: SK-Electronics CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells large-format photomasks in Japan and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Service Business and Solution Business. The company provides photomasks for use in liquid crystal displays, plasma display panel, OLEDs, TSPs, semiconductor packages, light guides, micro electromechanical systems, and other components and tools for equipment inspections. It also offers radio frequency identification products  and healthcare/medical devices, including electrical stimulators and stethoscopes and percussion hammers. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

isin: 8097.T|San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd.|8097.T|San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd.
name: SAN AI OBBLI
businessSummary: San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd. wholesales and retails petroleum products and liquefied petroleum (LP) gas. The company operates through five segments: Aircraft-Related Business, Chemical-Related Business, Gas-Related Business, Aviation-Related Business, and Other Business. It is also involved in the storage and related operation of petroleum products  and gas utility and pipeline service businesses. In addition, the company engages in the aviation fuel storage facilities operation  provision of aircraft refueling services  design, and consultation of airport fuel storage facilities and hydrant systems  sale and operation of energy-saving devices  and generation and sale of electric power. Further, the company sells chemical products, including solvent and industrial chemicals, biocide products, microbial commissioned testing, car wash, microbial measuring equipment, and other chemical products, as well as fire extinguishing agents. The company was formerly known as San-Ai Oil Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd. in April 2022. San-Ai Obbli Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: SHINWA
businessSummary: Shinwa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of production equipment and materials in the manufacturing industry. The Company operates in four regional segments. The Company is engaged in the sale of metal joints, industrial equipment, factory automation (FA) system related products, the provision of cover welding and spraying services, soldering services and maintenance works, the manufacture and sale of FA systems, as well as the logistics business, the real estate management business, the insurance agency business, and the manufacture and sale of resin products. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the United States, Southeast Asia and China.

name: LIB CONSULTING
businessSummary: LiB Consulting co.,ltd provides management consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers services for IT  telecommunications  media  finance  industrial goods  trading companies  consumer goods  healthcare and life sciences  construction and real estate  mobility and energy  car dealer  housing and real estate  and venture and startups sectors. LiB Consulting co.,ltd was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: SANYU
businessSummary: SANYU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of brass bar steel and cold headed steel wires. Company has two business segments. The Brass Bar Steel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of brass bar steel, as well as the precision machining of these products. The Cold Headed Steel Wires segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold headed steel wires. This segment also leases land, buildings and equipment, among others.

name: NAKAYAMA STEEL WORKS
businessSummary: Nakayama Steel Works Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of iron and steel. It operates through three segments. The Steel segment manufactures and sells primary iron and steel products and secondary processed products. Its main products include steel plates such as hot-rolled steel strips, thick plates and intermediate plates, steel bars such as wire rods, bar-in coils and rebar, steel slabs and by-products. The Engineering segment accepts orders and sells steel fish farms and aquaculture farms, rolls, valves, and other products, as well as processes and assembles machinery. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the rental and sale of owned real estate, real estate buying and selling and brokerage, and other service businesses.

name: AXYZ
businessSummary: AXYZ Co.,Ltd. is a Japn-based company mainly engaged in the provision of chicken. The Company operates through two business segments. The Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed chicken products such as fried chicken, liver stewed chicken, and chicken nuggets, using chickens raised by non-medication and directly managed fattening facilities breeding. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of zeolite products and shirasu balloons, and the sale of non-chemical fertilizer-reduced pesticide vegetables. The Restaurant segment operates Kentucky Fried Chicken and Pizza Hut franchise stores.

name: NITTOKU
businessSummary: Nittoku Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, sells, and services automatic winding machines, related machinery, and parts in Japan, China, rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, North America, Central America, South America, and internationally. The company offers unwinding / winding machine, stranded wire winding machine, shield horizontal winding machine, taping equipment, and cable processing equipment  bobbin coil winding machines  bobbinless coil and air coil winding machines  chip winding machines  motor related machines  processing machine, including diamond wire saw, cutting machine, chamfering machine, and slicer  connector related equipment  film/web transfer equipment  medical related automatic machine  and various automated machinery. It also provides RFID IC card. The company was formerly known as Nittoku Engineering Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nittoku Co.,Ltd. in August 2019. Nittoku Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

name: ECOS
businessSummary: Eco's Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of food supermarkets in Japan. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Akishima, Japan.

name: METALART
businessSummary: Metalart Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision die-forged products, and its products are mainly automobiles and construction machinery parts. The Company manufactures, processes and sells hot forged products and precision stamped and forged products used in automobiles, construction machinery, agricultural machinery, ships and other general industrial machinery. The Company provides parts shapes from forging to machining, centering on engine parts, suspension parts, transmission gears and other industrial parts.

name: HANWA
businessSummary: Hanwa Co., Ltd. sells metals, food, energy and living materials, housing materials, and machinery in Japan, Asia, the Americas, Europe, Africa, and internationally. The company offers steel bars, ferrous raw materials, rebar processing, steel shapes, and project development  steel sheets sales, heavy plates, structural steel sheets, pipes and tubes, stainless steel and aluminum sheets, and automotive steel products  and steel pipes, wire products, special steel, and titanium products. In addition, the company offers copper and aluminum scrap  Zinc, lead, tin ingots and scrap, stainless steel, and high-performance raw material scrap  nickel, cobalt, lithium, palladium, platinum, rhodium, vanadium, silicon, rare earths, magnesium, and other metals, and chemical raw materials  and nickel pig iron, stainless steel semi-finished products, chrome ore, manganese ore, iron ore, coal, ferrochrome, ferrosilicon, silicomanganese, metallic manganese, ferrovanadium, ferroniobium, ferrotitanium, manganese chemical raw materials, and sulfuric acid. Further, it provides heavy oil, kerosene, LPG, LNG, industrial gas, shipping fuel oil, gasoline, diesel, lubricants, PKS, wood pellets, recycled heavy oil, RPF, waste tires, construction waste chips, PAO, PIB, esters, additives, chemicals, paper products, and wastepaper  and synthetic resins. Additionally, the company offers food products. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: JM HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JM Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the supermarket business in Japan. The company is involved in the restaurant, event-related, and outsourcing businesses, as well as wholesale and retail of meat. In addition, it engages in the facility operation and management, and rice retail businesses. JM Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Japan Meat Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Tsuchiura, Japan.

name: CROPS
businessSummary: Crops Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in mobile communication business, store sublease business, stationery packaging and materials wholesale business. It operates through five business segments. Mobile Communications segment is engaged in the operation of au shop in Aichi, Mie, Gifu, Shizuoka, Tokyo, and Kanagawa, and the operation of UQ Mobile in Aichi and Mie. Store Sub-Lease segment is engaged in the provision of store opening and closing support services and store management service centered on restaurants. Stationery Packaging Materials Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning and wholesale of stationery and packaging materials for 100 yen shops, mail order stores, wholesale stores and others. Building Maintenance segment is engaged in the provision of cleaning, facility management and security services for commercial facilities and office buildings. Temporary Staffing segment is engaged in the general worker and specific worker dispatch, and business contracts.

name: MIRRATIV
businessSummary: Mirrativ Inc. develops and operates live streaming platform. Its platform offers Emomo, an avatar feature that creates alter ego  Ranking, an event that ranks users and live streams within Mirrativ based on various metrics  and Live Gaming, an interactive game feature on Mirrativ that allows streamers and viewers to play together during live broadcast. The company was formerly known as Emomo Inc. and changed its name to Mirrativ Inc. in April 2018. Mirrativ Inc. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Meguro, Japan.

name: SEMITEC
businessSummary: SEMITEC Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company offers temperature sensors, IR sensors, wind sensors, surge absorber, current regulating diode, and power thermistor. It also provides thermal barometric pressure and micro pressure sensors, narrow view angle thermopile, rectangular sensor for motors, compact vacuum sensor, thin-film FT thermistor, ultra-thin glass substrate thin-film thermistor sensors, and refrigerant gas sensor module. The company was formerly known as Ishizuka Electronics Corporation and changed its name to SEMITEC Corporation in March 2011. SEMITEC Corporation was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
