name: NEW JAPAN CHEMICAL
businessSummary: New Japan Chemical Co., Ltd. produces and sells chemical products in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, the United States of America. It provides oleo-chemicals, including hydrogenated oils, fatty acids and esters, glycerin, alcohols, non-ionic and anion surfactants, and amphoteric surfactants  and plasticizer, such as phthalate and non-phthalate plasticizers, and specialty plasticizers. The company also offers plastic and coating materials, which include clarifiers and nucleating agents, epoxy resin curing agent, epoxy resins, raw materials for resins, methacrylate, and antistatic agents  and lubricants, such as evaporation-resistant and low-viscosity lubricants, dibasic acid esters, and aromatic lubricants. In addition, it is involved in commissioned hydrogenation business. New Japan Chemical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: FORVAL
businessSummary: Forval Corporation engages in the provision of information telecommunications consulting services to small-and medium-sized companies in Japan. The company also offers management consulting services, including consulting, overseas expansion, human resources/education, environment, business succession, etc. In addition, it provides information communications consulting services, such as IP integrated system, information security, web construction, etc. Forval Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: YAMAYA
businessSummary: Yamaya Corporation primarily engages in the wholesale and retail sale of alcoholic beverages and food products through stores and mail order in Japan. The company also operates restaurants. Yamaya Corporation was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

name: SANSO ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Sanso Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of motors, pumps, and system solution products in Japan, China, and internationally. The company's products include magnetic drive, self-priming magnetic drive, self-priming centrifugal, cast-iron line, automatic shallow-well, and centrifugal pumps, as well as desalion and sansolver systems. Sanso Electric Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Himeji, Japan.

name: TOYOTA BOSHOKU
businessSummary: Toyota Boshoku Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells automotive interior systems in Japan, the United States, China, Asia, Europe, Africa, and internationally. The company engages in manufacturing and sale of automotive filters and powertrain components, and other automotive components, as well as fabric products. It also provides automobile, aircraft, and railway seats. In addition, the company offers interior and exterior products, which includes door trims, headliners, floor carpets, and luggage and exterior components comprising bumpers, fender liners, and engine undercovers. Further, it provides filter products including air, oil, and cabin air filters  air induction systems and cleaners, intake manifolds, cylinder headcovers, oil mist separator, and timing chain covers  and electric powertrain related products, such as motor core constitute and fuel cell parts, separators, and ion exchangers, as well as weets. Additionally, the company offers curtain-shield airbags, straps and seatbelt webbings, and seat fabrics. Toyota Boshoku Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Kariya, Japan.

name: MORY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: MORY INDUSTRIES INC. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufactures and sells stainless tube, stainless bars, processed stainless products and steel tubes. The Indonesia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless tubes. The Company also sells automobile-related products and mail-order goods.

name: TAKI CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the chemicals, water treatment, and functional materials businesses in Japan. The company operates through Agriculture, Chemicals, Building Materials, Oil, Real estate, and Transportation segments. It provides water treatment chemicals, including polyaluminum chloride for drinking and industrial water treatment, urban sewage treatment, effluent treatment from civil engineering works, industrial wastewater treatment, coagulation in production process, and organic sludge filtration and dehydration. The company also offers functional chemical materials, such as water-soluble aluminum compounds, including takiceram, aluminum phosphate-based binders, and takibine  hydrated silica  and high-purity metal oxide consist of high-purity tantalum and niobium pentaoxide. In addition, it develops high-purity biodegradable polymers for medical applications  and colloidal materials that make use of the unique properties of nano-size particles for photocatalysts, ultraviolet absorbing agents, and electroconductive materials. The company serves customers in various fields, including agriculture, chemicals, functional materials, and biotechnology. The company was formerly known as Taki Fertilizer Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. in 1974. Taki Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Kakogawa, Japan.

businessSummary: Ship Healthcare Holdings, Inc. engages in the medical, healthcare, welfare, and nursing care businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Total Pack Produce Business, Medical Supply Business, Lifecare Business, and Dispensing Pharmacy Business. The Total Pack Produce segment sells medical devices and medical equipment based on bulk orders, as well as physicochemical  offers consulting services on medicine, healthcare, welfare, and nursing care facilities  operates veterinary hospitals  develops, sells, and maintains medical information systems  builds management business  and leases real estate to medical facilities and other tenants. It also manufactures, constructs, and maintains medical gas piping equipment, operating room interiors, shadowless lights for surgery, rehabilitation equipment, special bathtubs, etc.  and provides renovation services. The Medical Supply segment offers medical supplies and equipment to medical facilities. The Life Care segment operates nursing homes, group homes, and multi-purpose facilities, as well as power rehabilitation facilities  provides meal services  and operates and supports services for day service. The Dispensing Pharmacy segment operates dispensing pharmacies. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

name: JGC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JGC Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general engineering and functional materials manufacturing businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Integrated Engineering segment is engaged in the planning, design, procurement, construction and testing of equipment, appliances and facilities for petroleum, petroleum refining, petrochemicals, gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) and others, as well as the water and power generation business. The Functional Material Manufacture segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of products in the catalyst field, nanoparticle technology field, clean and safety field, electronic materials, high-performance ceramics field and the next generation energy field. The Company is also involved in consulting, office support, desalination, and crude oil and gas production and sales.

name: QUALTEC
businessSummary: Qualtec Co.,Ltd. provides defect analysis and reliability testing of electronic components in Japan. It offers analysis and fault analysis  reliability testing  power cycle testing  reproduction experiment  project evaluation  research and development, and consulting  commissioned research  microfabrication  sample preparation  and biopharmaceutical-related testing services. It is also involved in factory management that focuses on quality control  provision of consulting on mounting technology  laser processing and surface treatment  and design, development, manufacturing, and sales of testing equipment. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

name: SONOCOM
businessSummary: SONOCOM CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of screen masks and photo masks for electronic industry. The Company operates through two business segments. The Screen Mask segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of screen masks for electronic components producing and printed circuit board surfaces mounting. The Photo Mask segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of photo masks for display element production. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of printing machine, squeegees and other screen printing equipment.

name: DAI ICHI CUTTER KOGYO KK
businessSummary: Dai-Ichi Cutter Kogyo KK is a Japan-based construction company mainly engaged in cutting and drilling works. The Company has three business segments. The Cutting and Drilling Construction segment is engaged in cutting work necessary for dismantling, cutting and drilling necessary for dismantling and removing concrete structures. The Building Maintenance segment is engaged in maintenance and inspection of water supply and drainage facilities, cleaning of water tanks, and cleaning of miscellaneous drainage pipes in housing complexes and office buildings. The Reuse and Recycling segment is engaged in the reuse and recycling services, including the purchase and collection of information technology (IT)-related equipment and used office automation (OA) equipment, data erasure services, sales to corporations and individuals, and office installation services for telecommunications equipment.

name: NATOCO
businessSummary: NATOCO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints, fine chemical products and thinners. The Company operates through three business segments. The Paint segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of synthetic resin paints and paint-related products. The Fine Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of highly functional resins and various functional fine particles. The Thinner segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pure and recycled thinners, as well as the collection, transportation and disposal of industrial waste.

name: HAKUDO
businessSummary: Hakudo Co., Ltd. processes and sells plates, bars, aluminum tubes, elongated copper products, stainless steels, and plastics in Japan and internationally. It offers high performance alloys  lead less and cadmium less copper and aluminum  aerospace standard compliant material  aluminum  stainless steel  copper  special steels  titanium/others  plastics  high precision aluminum plates  and annealed copper and stainless steel. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SHIMADAYA
businessSummary: Shimadaya Corporation manufactures and sells noodles and related food products in Japan. The company offers udon, buckwheat, ramen, cold ramen/cold dipping noodles, yakisoba and other fried noodles, pasta, and broth and ingredients. It sells its products under flowing noodles  healthy noodles  true hit  honjo  ryusui-men, shinuchi  kenbimen  noukou kaiwai  clock tower  teppan noodles  local Chinese restaurant  and momiuchi brands. In addition, it exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ROBOT HOME
businessSummary: Robot Home, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the AI/IoT and robot home businesses in Japan. The company an automated property management platform  consulting services with a focus on public affairs  property management services  platform for the consideration, purchase, management, and sale of income-producing real estate  rent guarantee, collection, reminders, and tenant support for rental property owners  and restoration and cleaning services. It also develops and sells IoT devices. The company was formerly known as TATERU, Inc. and changed its name to Robot Home, Inc. in April 2021. Robot Home, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: NASU DENKI TEKKO
businessSummary: Nasu Denki Tekko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to the electric power and telecommunications infrastructure business and the transportation infrastructure business. The Company operates two business segments. The Electric Power and Telecommunications Infrastructure Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel towers and steel structures, steel pipe columns, overhead line materials, and information and telecommunications materials, as well as telecommunications tower facility construction. The Transportation Infrastructure Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of transportation system materials, road equipment construction, underground line equipment construction, and hot-dip galvanizing wage processing.

name: NITTOC CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Nittoc Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the construction industry. Through its subsidiaries, it engages in civil engineering and materials sales, with the Company handling procurement of materials and other supplies. Focusing on specialized and special construction projects, it contributes to the development of comprehensive social infrastructure. It undertakes construction of roads, bridges, dams and power transmission networks supplying electricity, as well as water supply and sewerage systems handling large volumes of stormwater.

name: NS UNITED KAIUN KAISHA
businessSummary: NS United Kaiun Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the shipping industry and related maritime businesses. The Company mainly operates through two segments. The Overseas Shipping segment transports iron ore, coal, steel products, non-ferrous ores, and other bulk commodities using bulk carriers. The Segment also transports liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and other liquids using tankers and engages in vessel chartering and related businesses. The Domestic Shipping segment transports steel products, limestone, cement, and other goods using bulk carriers within domestic waters. The Segment also transports LPG, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and other liquids using tankers and engages in vessel chartering and other businesses. The Company also provides information services and other related businesses.

name: ANA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ANA Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the aviation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aviation segment conducts regular and irregular air transportation of passengers and cargo domestic and international flights. The Aviation-related segment provides services associated with air transportation such as airport handling and maintenance, and various services at the airport to customers and provide reservation information services by telephone. The Travel segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged travel products, mainly made from airline tickets and accommodation. The Trading Companies segment mainly engaged in the import and export of aviation-related materials and mail orders. The Company is also engaged in the building management and temporary staffing business.

name: BUFFALO INC CHIYODA
businessSummary: Buffalo Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the information technology (IT) related business and the food business. The Company operates its business through two segments. The IT-related segment is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of digital home appliances and computer peripherals, construction, installation and maintenance of network infrastructure, data recovery services, development and sale of network storage software, as well as direct marketing. The Food segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of noodles and related food products. The Company also engages in the management business of the entire company.

name: ANA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ANA Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in the aviation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aviation segment conducts regular and irregular air transportation of passengers and cargo domestic and international flights. The Aviation-related segment provides services associated with air transportation such as airport handling and maintenance, and various services at the airport to customers and provide reservation information services by telephone. The Travel segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged travel products, mainly made from airline tickets and accommodation. The Trading Companies segment mainly engaged in the import and export of aviation-related materials and mail orders. The Company is also engaged in the building management and temporary staffing business.

name: NF HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NF Holdings Corporation provides measurement instruments, power supply and power control products, function modules, and customized products in Japan. The company offers measurement instruments, including signal generators, LCR meters, impedance analyzers, AC voltmeters/noise meters, lock-in amplifiers/preamplifiers, filters, measurement systems, and frequency response analyzers  and power supply and power control products comprise AC power sources, power amplifiers, electronic loads, and power test instruments. It also provides function modules, such as filters, amplifiers, oscillators, and phase detectors  and customized products comprise grid-connection testing systems, high-speed bipolar power amplifiers for testing vehicle electronic components, simulated regeneration power supplies, etc. Its products are used in various applications, such as automobiles, digital appliances, electronic devices, fuel cells, solar power, and other clean energy technologies  and nanotechnology, as well as in satellite, rocket, and other aerospace technologies. NF Holdings Corporation was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: TAKAHASHI CURTAIN WALL
businessSummary: TAKAHASHI CURTAIN WALL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of building exterior walls. The Company operates in two business segments. The Precast Concrete (PC) Curtain Wall segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of building exterior walls, mainly precast concrete curtain walls. The Aqua segment is engaged in the design and construction of bathing facilities and sports facilities. The other businesses include real estate leasing business and recreation facility management of the Company.

name: NPR RIKEN
businessSummary: NPR-Riken Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the management and administration of its subsidiaries and group companies, as well as other businesses incidental or related to such management and administration. The Company conducts its business through subsidiaries such as RIKEN and Nihon Piston Ring. The Riken Group is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive and industrial machinery parts, anechoic chambers, industrial furnaces and heating materials, construction-related parts, construction contracting, environmental maintenance, and factory repair and maintenance. Nippon Piston Ring Group is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive-related products, marine and other products, as well as logistics, services, and other business activities related to each business.

name: KOMAIHALTEC
businessSummary: Komaihaltec Inc. designs and constructs steel bridges, steel frameworks, and wind energy generating systems. The company also manufactures and installs construction machinery. It develops, constructs, and installs wind turbine systems. Komaihaltec Inc. was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KUNIMINE INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: KUNIMINE INDUSTRIES CO., LTD is a Japan-based company engaged in the raw mineral business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Bentonite segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of litter for civil engineering and construction, castings and pets, the purchase, sale and transportation of mud conditioning formulation and others. The Agriculture segment is engaged in the processing of agricultural chemicals, the manufacture, processing, sale and transportation of raw materials for agricultural base and processing products, agricultural materials, soil conditioners, and purified bentonite for pesticide applications. The Chemical Products segment manufactures and sells refined bentonite, environmental preservatives, and other products.

name: TRANSCOSMOS
businessSummary: transcosmos Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of one-stop, high-value-added services both domestically and overseas. The Company has three business segments. The Individual Services Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by the Company itself. The Domestic Affiliated Companies Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by domestic group companies. The Overseas Affiliated Companies Business segment is responsible for the outsourcing business developed by overseas group companies.

name: TECHNO MEDICA
businessSummary: Techno Medica Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in development, manufacture, sale and export of analysis device for clinical examination equipment and other medical equipment, as well as devices repair services. The blood collection tube preparation apparatus business provides blood collection peripheral equipment, such as blood and urine collection automation reception equipment, among others, as well as blood tube preparation systems. The laboratory test apparatus business provides blood gas analysis apparatus, electrolyte analyzers, erythrocyte sedimetation rate measuring machines, among others. The consumable goods business provides blood collecting tubes, labels, sensor cards, calibration packs, among others, as well as maintenance services.

businessSummary: Tamagawa Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the electronic and communication equipment business and renewable energy. The company offers high-frequency electronic components, including attenuators, splitters, couplers, switches, and filters  and optical and electronic application equipment, such as optical transmission equipment, frequency converters, amplifiers, frequency synthesizers, digital signal processing devices, video and monitoring systems, and various test devices, as well as develops, manufactures, and sells millimeter-wave products. It is also involved in the sale of power plants for sale  sale of electricity generated by small wind farms and other renewable energy power plants  and sale of owned power plants. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOUBUJYUHAN
businessSummary: Toubujyuhan Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in real estate related business. The Company provide used real estate for reformed detached houses. It has four business segments. The Real Estate Trading segment involves in the sale of properties owned by the Company, and the brokerage sale of properties owned by others. The Real Estate Rental segment involves in the brokerage sale and rental management business of properties owned by other companies, as well as the sale of properties owned by the Company. The Real Estate-related segment involves in the contracting of remodeling of properties, agency sale of insurance such as fire insurance, as well as real estate-related goods sale through Internet. The Others segment involves in the sale of welfare related goods, the provision of equipment rental, silver renovation construction contracting and others.

name: TOKYO ROPE MFG
businessSummary: Tokyo Rope Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells wire ropes, steel cords, and carbon fiber composite cables (CFCCs) in Japan, China, and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Steel Code-Related  Steel Cord Related  Development Product-Related  Industrial Machinery-Related  and Energy Real Estate-Related. It offers its wire ropes that are used in cranes, elevators, forestry and fisheries, rope slings, and cableways  galvanized wires and strands for use in electric power and communication fields  and steel cords, including steel tire cords that are used in steel radial tires, hose wires to reinforce high pressure hose, and saw wires to produce wafers and chips. The company also provides engineering, bridge and structural cable, and carbon fiber composite cable products, as well as aluminum conductor fiber reinforced products. In addition, it designs and constructs road safety devices, such as rock fall prevention nets  and environment protection products, including sound insulation walls, and bridges and cable-suspended bridges, as well as manufactures and sells various industrial machinery and metal fibers. The company was incorporated in 1887 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NISHIMATSUYA CHAIN
businessSummary: Nishimatsuya Chain Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail of baby and children's lifestyle products. The children's clothing includes baby outerwear, underwear, and pajamas, boys' outerwear, underwear, and pajamas, and girls' outerwear, underwear, and pajamas. The Company also offers childcare and clothing accessories, baby formula and weaning supplies, hygiene and general merchandise, bedding, strollers and car seats, indoor items such as mats, chairs, racks, and walkers, hats, shoes, rain gear, and other clothing accessories, toys, and gift sets. The baby and maternity clothing includes newborn clothing, maternity products, and Japanese clothing. The Company also offers vending machine products. The Company’s products are sold primarily directly to customers through stores and online sales, primarily for cash or other payment. It also sells Nishimatsuya Chain Gift Cards for gifting.

name: AIZAWA SECURITIES GROUP
businessSummary: Aizawa Securities Group Co., Ltd. operates financial securities business in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Financial instrument securities business, Asset management business, and Investment business. It also engages in the financial product intermediation business. Aizawa Securities Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: YOROZU
businessSummary: Yorozu Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells auto parts, agricultural machinery parts, and manufacturing equipment in Japan, the United States, Mexico, Brazil, China, and internationally. The company offers front and rear suspension members, rear beams, links, brake pedals, and oil pans, as well as other parts, such as suspension modules, engine mounts, splash guards, body parts for cars, trucks, and tractors. It also provides dies and production equipment. The company was formerly known as Yorozu Automotive Works and changed its name to Yorozu Corporation in June 1990. Yorozu Corporation was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: SANKO TECHNO
businessSummary: SANKO TECHNO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in fastening business and functional materials business. The Company operates in two business segments. Fastening segment is mainly involved in the manufacture and sale of post-installed anchor, drills and fasteners. The segment also conducts construction management related to construction of earthquake-resistant reinforcement business, maintenance and conservation business, as well as solar related business. Functional Materials segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of sheets made of fiber-reinforced plastics (FRP), electric hydraulic tools, measuring instruments, as well as electronic printed circuit boards for display boards and observation machines of vehicles, among others.

name: TENSHO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Tensho Electric Industries Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and molds, as well as the real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Japan Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive parts, logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and molds. The China Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of logistics industry materials, mechanical parts and dies. The American Molding segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical parts and dies. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the leasing of buildings.

name: ARTNATURE
businessSummary: ARTNATURE INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. The Company operates in three business segments. The Men’s Business segment is engaged in the provision of custom-made wigs and other products and services to male customers. The Women’s Business segment is engaged in the provision of custom-made wigs, as well as other products and services, to female customers. The Women’s Ready-Made Business segment is engaged in the provision of ready-made wigs and other products and services to female customers. It also engages in activities such as product planning, development, and sales, as well as medical-related support services.

name: YOKOGAWA BRIDGE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. engages in the design, fabrication, and construction of steel structures in Japan and internationally. It operates through five segments: Bridge Business, System Building Business, Engineering Business, Advanced Technology Business, and Other Businesses. The company designs, fabricates, and erects steel bridge projects  and maintains, repairs, and retrofits existing structures. It is also involved in the supply of structural steel buildings for factories, storehouses, shops, and sports facilities  fabrication of port and offshore structures  and construction of high-rise buildings and dome-type sports stadiums, as well as provision of machinery for the infrastructure sector, such as water gates, shiplift facility, and sewage treatment. In addition, the company supplies metal frames for use in the production of semiconductors and flat panel displays  and provides software for the total design system for steel bridges and simulation systems for the erection of steel structures, etc. Yokogawa Bridge Holdings Corp. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

businessSummary: Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the drug store, prescription drug store, nursing care, and related businesses in Japan. The company sells medical and health products, medical devices, health foods, cosmetics, baby products, daily necessities, pet supplies, food products, and other items  and operates paid assisted living facilities and related businesses. It is also involved in operation of SALONDAY, a rehabilitation-type adult day care service  CREATE SD Nursing Care Support Center, a home care support service  sells food and daily necessities  operates supermarkets/real estate leasing  cleaning and landscaping services for stores and other facilities  sales support services for stores  clerical support and related operations  and plans and develops private brand products. Create SD Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: NAIGAI TEC
businessSummary: Naigai Tec Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales business and contract manufacturing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Sale business purchases various components and equipment such as pneumatic equipment, vacuum equipment and temperature control equipment which are used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, and electronic equipment from domestic manufacturers, and sells to domestic users. The Contract Manufacturing business is engaged in the contract manufacture of equipment assembly, contract processing, process management, information equipment assembly, and maintenance services, and main business partners are semiconductor manufacturers, semiconductor manufacturing equipment manufacturers, FPD manufacturing equipment manufacturers, and electronic equipment manufacturers.

name: EBRAINS
businessSummary: EBRAINS,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of backplanes, bus racks, and system chassis for industrial and industrial computers. The products are mainly used in application fields including communication equipment, electronic application equipment, electrical measuring instruments, traffic related equipment, and defense and others. The main applicable equipment includes Base station communication device, broadband related device, broadcast image device, power related, plant, medical device, super computer (HPC), semiconductor / integrated circuit (IC) measuring instrument, factory automation (FA) equipment, robot, intelligent road Transportation system related equipment (ITS), train onboard equipment, vehicle, ship, aircraft onboard equipment, air traffic control equipment, military vehicle, ship, aircraft onboard equipment, surveillance camera system, assembly machine, equipment, and among others.

name: F CODE
businessSummary: f-code Inc. engages in the digital transformation and consulting business in Japan. The company offers digital marketing solutions, such as CODE marketing cloud, f-tra EFO, einclo, hachidori, KaiU, and EF. CUBE. It also offers digital marketing support business, AI and technology support business, and online school and human resource development business. f-code Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: PRESS KOGYO
businessSummary: Press Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automotive-related business and the construction machinery-related business. It operates through two segments. The Automotive-related Business segment manufactures and sells automotive parts and automotive molds. Products include hassis frames, axle, resin parts, axle housings, axle units, panels, press molds, automatic welding equipment, and other automotive parts. The Construction Machinery-related Business segment manufactures and sells cabins for construction machinery and other parts for construction machinery. The Company also manufactures and sells construction-related parts and multi-story parking systems.

name: DAYTONA
businessSummary: DAYTONA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and sales of motorcycle parts and accessories. The Company operates in three business segments. The Domestic Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and wholesale of motorcycle parts and accessories in Japan and overseas markets. The Asia Wholesale segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and wholesale of motorcycle parts and accessories, mainly in Southeast Asia areas. The Retail segment is engaged in purchase of motorcycle after parts and supplies, as well as sales to end user. The other business is engaged in the solar power generation business.

name: SBI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SBI Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial business. The Company operates five business segments. The Financial Services segment engages in various finance related businesses, centered on securities related, banking, and insurance businesses in Japan and overseas. The Asset Management segment is engaged in investment management, including the establishment, offering, and management of investment trusts, investment advisory services, and provision of financial products information. The Investment segment includes investment in domestic and overseas information technology (IT), fintech, blockchain, financial, and biotechnology related venture companies. The Crypto-asset segment provides crypto-asset exchange and trading services. The Non-financial segment is engaged in various businesses such as bio-healthcare & medical informatics business, Web3 related business, renewable energy business, and businesses developing in new overseas markets such as Africa.
