businessSummary: Iriso Electronics Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, develops, and sells multi-pin connectors for automotive (in-vehicle) equipment, digital equipment, and industrial equipment in Japan, the rest of Asia, Europe, and North America. The company offers board-to-board, FPC/FFC, wire harness, socket, pin header, input/output, and card edge connectors  compression terminals for cable connections, interface connectors, and signal connections  and electrostatic discharge protector chips. It also provides automation connectors comprising connectors for ADAS sensing devices, powertrain connectors, and infotainment connectors  connectors for home and commercial appliances  and connectors for industrial equipment. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: NANSIN
businessSummary: NANSIN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters and dollies. The Company operates in three business segments. The Malaysia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters in Malaysia. The China segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of casters and dollies in China. The Britain segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate in Britain.

name: MORESCO
businessSummary: MORESCO Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals including special lubricating oil, synthetic lubricating oil, materials and hot melt adhesives. The Company operates in four geographical segments. Japan segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of the Company’s main products, as well as brake fluid and antifreeze for automobiles. China segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of special lubricants and hot melt adhesives through the Company’s subsidiaries in China. Southeast and South Asia segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of special lubricants and hot melt adhesives through the Company’s subsidiaries in Southeast and South Asia. North America segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of specialty and synthetic lubricants.

name: ISB
businessSummary: ISB CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in information service business and security system business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Information Service segment is engaged in development of embedded software for mobile, medical and automotive; verification of mobile equipment; software development in core system; data center service; the construction, operation, design and operation of infrastructure such as cloud; maintenance service; system operation service; the development and sale of commercial package products; the development of system and sale of equipment accompanying software development. The Security System segment is engaged in manufacture, sale and maintenance of access control system, electric lock and numeric keypad.

isin: 6516.T|Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd.|6516.T|Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd.
name: SANYO DENKI
businessSummary: Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd. engages in cooling systems, power systems, servo systems, electrical equipment sales, and electrical works contracting businesses in Japan and internationally. It offers cooling systems, which includes cooling fans and cooling fan units under the San Ace brand name  power systems products that comprises uninterruptible power supplies, inverters, engine generators, and power conditioners under the SANUPS brand name. The company provides servo motors and amplifiers, stepping motors and drivers, and motion controllers under the SANMOTION brand name. In addition, it sells industrial electrical equipment, control devices, and electrical materials for medical, information and communications, industrial, environmental preservation, home automation, and energy utilization sectors. Further, the company's products are used in base stations, ICT equipment, government agencies, public services, transportation, charge/discharge devices, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, robots, and mold injection machines. The company was formerly known as Sanyo Shokai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd. in April 1942. Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SYSTEMEXE
businessSummary: SystemEXE,Inc. engages in the system integration business. It provides business system development, scratch development, IT infrastructure construction, cloud integration, AI solutions, database services, data utilization, operations and maintenance, PMO support, system migration, DX (digital transformation) solutions, offshore development, groupware workflow, and IoT services, as well as data analysis infrastructure construction and report-based DX promotion solutions. The company serves real estate, manufacturing, non-life and life insurance, medical care, petroleum, chemical, and other industries. SystemEXE,Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

isin: 6654.T|FUJI ELECTRIC INDUSTRY|6654.T|Fuji Electric Industry Co., Ltd.
name: FUJI ELECTRIC INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Fuji Electric Industry Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells control switches, connection devices, indicator lights and displays, and electronic devices in Japan and internationally. The company offers control switches, pilot lamps and indicators, terminals, connectors, control center parts, test terminals, and electronic devices. It also provides TT type test switches, BHL type discrepancy switches, SPSR type, and SPSL type semaphore indicators. It offers its products to various markets, such as power industry, and to develop general industrial markets, railways, rolling stock, automobiles, and machine tools. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

name: DENA
businessSummary: DeNA Co Ltd mainly provides Internet services for mobile and personal computers (PC). The Company operates in five business segments. The Game segment provides mobile game-related services such as Mobage, which distributes game applications in Japan and overseas. The Live Streaming segment provides live streaming services such as Pococha and IRIAM in Japan and overseas. The Sports segment provides sports related services such as Yokohama DeNA BayStars and Yokohama Stadium, and Kawasaki Brave Thunders and Sports Club Sagamihara in Japan. The Healthcare and Medical segment provides health big data related services and healthcare and medical related services such as Join, which is a medical digital transformation (DX) related service, in Japan and overseas. The New Business and Other segment provides new businesses and other services in Japan, such as e-commerce (EC) business and other new businesses.

name: RISO KAGAKU
businessSummary: Riso Kagaku Corporation operates in printing equipment, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Printing Equipment Related Business and Real Estate Business. The company offers production printers, full-color inkjet printers, digital duplicators, and digital screen makers, as well as inkjet print engine under the VALEZUS, ComColor, GOCCOPRO, and RISOGRAPH names. It also engages in the leasing of buildings  the print creation and digital communication business  and the application software business. It offers its products to educational institutions, government and public agencies, companies, and local communities. Riso Kagaku Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ASTI
businessSummary: ASTI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of in-car electrical components, home electronics, communications and control equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The In-car Electrical Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronics control units, air condition control systems, in-car and marine wire harnesses. The Home Electronic segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale electronic control boards for washing machines, dish washers and drying tumblers. The Communications and Control Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of communication switch units and industrial robot controller boards. The Company is also engaged in the power electronics business and the medical business.

isin: 4958.T|T. Hasegawa Co., Ltd.|4958.T|T. Hasegawa Co., Ltd.
name: T HASEGAWA
businessSummary: T. Hasegawa Co., Ltd. produces, sells, imports, and exports fragrances, flavors, aromatic chemicals, food additives, and foods in Japan, China, the rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company provides flavors for use in various processed foods, such as beverages and confectionaries  and fragrances for use in fine fragrances, cosmetics, and household items. T. Hasegawa Co., Ltd. was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: PRINTNET
businessSummary: PRINTNET INC. mainly engages in the mail order business of printing materials and printing materials through the Internet. In its main business, the Company receives orders from customers on websites that include printing specifications and fees, receives printing data, conducts printing and processing businesses in domestic factories, as well as sends to customers. The Company provides pamphlets, free papers, leaflets, newspaper folding leaflets, company name envelopes, election posters, calendars and others on the company website.

name: SHINSHO
businessSummary: Shinsho Corporation imports, exports, and trades in iron and steel, ferrous raw material, nonferrous metal, machinery, information industry, and welding products worldwide. The company provides iron and steel products, including half-finished steel, special steel, construction material, casting and forging, carbon steel, wire rod, titanium and nickel alloy, and casting material and cast products  ferrous and recycling material units such as materials for making iron and steel, and other products comprising titanium sponge, coke breeze, slag products, slag powder for blast furnaces, cement, refuse paper and plastic fuel, secondary cement products, iron sand, plastics, chemical products, titanium scrap, new materials, and other auxiliary materials  and nonferrous metals, which includes aluminum and cast products, aluminum and copper material, copper, and processed aluminum and copper products. It also offers machinery and electronics that include chemicals and food processing equipment  iron and steel, and non-ferrous metal related equipment  electronic and IT equipment  environment and energy-related equipment  and general industrial equipment. In addition, the company provides welding products, such as welding materials and welding-related equipment, and production materials. Shinsho Corporation was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: FUJI CORP MIYAGI
businessSummary: Fuji Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of car accessories. The Company focuses on tires and wheels, and sells them through three sales formats: retail sales, mail order sales, and dealer sales. Retail sales are in suburban locations, mostly located along major roads. Mail order sales are conducted through sales Websites on the Company's own Website and online shopping malls, and sales are conducted both in Japan and overseas. Dealer sales involve direct sales to fellow retailers of car accessories, car dealers, home improvement centers, gas stations, as well as through wholesalers. The Company handles national and private brand wheels, which are procured directly from both within Japan and overseas and sold through retail sales, mail order sales, and dealer sales. The Company handles top domestic tires such as Yokohama, Dunlop, and Bridgestone, as well as imports luxury tires such as Michelin and Pirelli.

name: NAGASE BROTHERS
businessSummary: Nagase Brothers Inc. provides educational services in Japan. The company operates cram and preparatory schools for students preparing for entrance exams, as well as swimming lessons and fitness clubs. It also provides educational programs for elementary, junior high, and high school students  educational services for university students and working adults  tutoring and individualized instruction services for elementary, middle, and high school students  digital education content, such as IT passport preparation courses for large corporations  language and DX human resource development training  and online lessons and tests. In addition, the company engages in educational book publishing  online school  English language schools for children  and international business activities. Nagase Brothers Inc. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Musashino, Japan.

isin: 7914.T|Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd.|7914.T|Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd.
name: KYODO PRINTING
businessSummary: Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the prepress, printing, bookbinding, and related ancillary businesses in Japan. It operates through Information Communication, Information Security, Living and Industrial Materials, and Other segments. The company engages in the planning and production of weekly, monthly, and quarterly magazines. It also offers paperbacks, collected works, textbooks, posters, calendars, advertising and promotional materials, decorative displays, and electronic books, as well as periodicals, books, general commercial printings, digital and in-store media, and digital communication services. In addition, the company provides bankbooks, business forms, securities, various cards, data printing, BPO, and payment solutions  paper containers, flexible packaging, blow bottles, metal and building material printing, electronic device components, and high-performance materials  and laminated tubes and tube containers for cosmetic, pharmaceutical, toothpaste, and food products. Further, it offers logistics, real estate management, packaging, transportation, and system development services. Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

name: INPEX
businessSummary: INPEX CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in oil and natural gas (O&G) operations, primarily in the exploration, development, production, and marketing of oil and natural gas globally, as well as investments and loans to companies engaged in these activities. The Domestic O&G segment is involved in the Minaminagaoka gas field and the Naoetsu liquefied natural gas (LNG) terminal. The Overseas O&G segment is involved in the Ichthys Project, including Ichthys in Australia and surrounding exploration, as well as other oil and natural gas projects in Australia (excluding Ichthys), Southeast Asia, Europe, and Abu Dhabi. The Other segment engages in renewable energy and power-related businesses, carbon capture and storage (CCS) and hydrogen businesses, as well as crude oil sales agency and brokerage services.

name: SOLVVY
businessSummary: Solvvy Inc. provides warranty services and software as a service (SaaS) products. The company offers warranty, inspection, and maintenance services, comprising home appliance warranty, long-term building guarantee, earthquake guarantee, ground compensation, warranty for used homes, maintenance fund accumulation service, home manager and bot, repair, and contact center services  system development consulting services  and SaaS products, such as home manager, home BOT, Genba assist, KROX, my class, and other products. It also develops products and services in the renewable energy and education ICT fields. In addition, it offers factoring services and escrow services. The company was formerly known as Japan Living Warranty Inc and changed its name to Solvvy Inc. in November 2024. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PR TIMES
businessSummary: PR TIMES Corporation engages in the press release distribution business in Japan. It operates PR TIMES, a platform that connects companies, media, and consumers through news  PR TIMES STORY platform for individuals within companies and organizations to officially share behind-the-scenes stories and insights  PR TIMES TV, a video production and distribution service for public relations and PR  and MARPH for artists, galleries, museums, and other organizations to create and distribute press releases for solo exhibitions, events, and other information. The company also offers Jooto, a cloud-based task and project management tool  Tayori, a customer support tool  BRIDGE, a blog media for technology news  STRAIGHT PRESS, a news site  PR EDGE, a database site for advertising and promotional case studies  and PR TIMES MAGAZINE, a web media for public relations knowledge. PR TIMES Corporation was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: FIRST JUKEN
businessSummary: First Juken Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in developing and selling detached houses and contract work. The Detached Housing segment is engaged in the planning, development and sale, and contractor work of detached housing, and additionally insurance agency and other related business. The Others segment is engaged in condominium business, including development and sale of new condominiums, renovation and sale of existing condominiums, condominium rental and related business. The condominium business sells new condominium buildings and sells second-hand condominiums after renovation. The construction of new condominiums business engages in the purchase of land for sale, construction management, distribution and sale of various constructions.

name: TECHNO QUARTZ
businessSummary: Techno Quartz Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of quartz products for semiconductors. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chromatograph equipment and consumables. Quartz glass products include quartz rings, large-diameter chambers, reactors, and cells for spectrophotometers. Processed products of crystalline silicon materials include gas shower plates and large plates.

name: KUMAGAI GUMI
businessSummary: Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the construction business and related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Civil Works segment is engaged in the investigation, survey, planning, design, supervisor of construction works, and the provision of general engineering. The Construction segment is engaged in the investigation, survey, planning, design, supervisor of construction of apartment houses, offices and government buildings, factories, power stations. The Subsidiaries segment conducts construction business, the manufacture and sale of equipment for construction, and provision of construction technology products.

name: NIKKATO
businessSummary: NIKKATO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the ceramics and engineering business. The Company has two business segments. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of functional ceramics such as thermal heating elements, oxygen sensors and ceramics filters, abrasion resistant ceramics such as ball mills and crushing balls, heat resistant ceramics such as thermocouple protection tubes, insulation tubes, core tubes, transportation rollers and heat treatment equipment, as well as physical and chemical ceramics such as evaporating dishes, crucibles and ceramics for experimental purposes. The products are mainly used for electronic parts, food, medicines, paints and others. The Engineering segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of heating equipment such as electric furnaces, vacuum furnaces and thermal treatment equipment, as well as measuring equipment such as temperature sensors, stress measurement equipment and measurement controllers.

name: POPPINS
businessSummary: Poppins Corp, formerly Poppins Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly operates home service business including nanny service and babysitter, nursery service and housekeeping service, educare business including management of childcare facilities, and other service businesses including education training and research business, recruitment and dispatch business, and day service for seniors. The Company operates through two business segments. The Home Care Service segment mainly provides childcare and elderly care services by visiting homes such as childcare service business, elderly care service business, and housework support service business. The Educare segment mainly operates kindergarten and elementary school facilities. The other service businesses provide services for domestic training, overseas training, and others.

name: SIIX
businessSummary: SIIX Corporation primarily sells and distributes electronic components in Japan, China, the rest of Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company offers automotive electronic components, such as automotive exteriors, meters, ECU, switches, quasi-millimeter wave radars, ABS, cameras, battery sensors, car multimedia, etc., as well as industrial equipment, such as engine ignition devices for power tools, battery packs, aircraft-borne electronic devices, inverters, medical devices, smart meters, industrial sewing machines, etc. It also provides home appliances, such as digital appliances, air conditioners, refrigerators, educational toys, healthcare equipment, electronic musical instruments, etc.  information devices, including office equipment, OA equipment, projectors, etc.  and automobile wire harness, motorcycles, inks, and other electronic components, etc. In addition, the company is involved in plastic molding and die manufacturing, and circuit board mounting, as well as provision of materials procurement, assembly, and processing of devices and components  and logistics services. SIIX Corporation was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KINJIRO
businessSummary: Kinjiro Co.,Ltd. provides human resource management (HRM) solutions. The company operates in HRM Business and Real Estate Leasing segments. It develops integrated HRM solutions, such as employment, HR, payroll, healthcare, and labor cost management system solutions  and offers system implementation, investment consulting, and post-implementation support services, as well as engages in the installation work for time recorders and work terminals, LAN wiring installation, and electrical facility construction operations. The company was formerly known as Nittsusystem Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Kinjiro Co.,Ltd. in March 2021. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ALMADO
businessSummary: Almado, Inc. engages in the planning, development, and sale of cosmetics and supplements in Japan. The company offers skin care products, including serum  serum for whitening  moisturizing eggshell membrane  wrinkle-reducing, moisturizing, firmness, and glow  facial cleansing and makeup removal with electrolyzed water  brightening lotion and cream  and hyaluronic acid spicules products. It offers beauty, beauty drink, and hair growth supplement products. In addition, it is involved in the contract manufacturing activities. The company markets its products under the Ode and CELLULA brands. It sells its products to TV shopping channels, OME manufacturing companies, drug stores, hairdressers, and mail order companies, as well as operates an e-commerce website. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: SERAKU
businessSummary: SERAKU Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company that provides information technology (IT) and digital transformation (DX) support services. It operates through three reporting segments. The Digital Transformation segment provides IT solutions, including system development, infrastructure construction, and cloud implementation and operational support. The Midori Cloud segment offers DX solutions and cloud services for the primary industry. The Mechanical Design Engineering segment provides design and technical support services in the machinery and hardware fields. Additionally, the Company offers on-site technical support and IT personnel training services to client companies.

name: HAMMOCK
businessSummary: Hammock Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions that solve customers' issues, needs, and problems using information technology (IT). The Company provides three solutions. Network solution develops and sells the AssetView series, which is software that comprehensively manages IT assets such as corporate personal computers (PCs) and PC networks from the perspective of security measures and provides solution services to comprehensively solve various issues surrounding IT asset management and operational support services. Sales digital transformation (DX) solution provides development, sales, and operational support services for Hot Profile and Hot Approach. Artificial intelligence (AI) data entry solution provides solutions for streamlining data entry operations based on AI optical character reader (AI OCR) technology, and its main products are AnyForm OCR and WOZE.

name: PRONI
businessSummary: PRONI, Inc. owns and operates a business to business (B2B) ordering platform. The company's platform offers business matching service, navigation system, DX navigation system, DX ultimate navigator, IT ranking, and PRONI magazine. It also provides characteristics, achievements, and services of suppliers, subcontractors, and outsourcers, and information and price quotes. The company was formerly known as unilabo, Inc. and changed its name to PRONI, Inc. in August 2023. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: LOOK HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Look Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, import and sale of apparels and related products. The Company has seven segments. The Apparel Related segment includes four regional segments: Japan, South Korea, Europe, and Other Overseas. The Apparel Related segment is engaged in the planning, production and sale of apparels, the purchase and import of products, the sale of products through directly managed stores, department stores, shopping centers and electronic commerce, as well as the planning, production and sale of leather products in Japan, South Korea, Europe, Hong Kong, China and the United States. The Production And Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) segment is engaged in the OEM production and processing of apparel related products, and trading business. The Logistics segment is engaged in the inspection, shipment and storage of apparel products. The Restaurant segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gelato products.

name: KONICA MINOLTA
businessSummary: Konica Minolta Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital workplace, professional print, healthcare, and industry businesses. The Company operates four business segments. The Digital Workplace segment develops, manufactures, and sells multi-functional peripherals and related consumables, and provides information technology services and solutions. The Professional Print segment develops, manufactures, and sells digital printing systems and related consumables for the commercial and industrial printing markets. The Healthcare segment develops, manufactures, and sells diagnostic imaging systems for medical use, digitizes and networks medical sites, provides diagnostic services and solutions, and offers genetic testing and drug discovery support services. The Industry segment develops, manufactures, and sells measuring instruments, industrial and professional lenses, industrial inkjet heads, functional films used in displays, network cameras, and video-related equipment.

name: SODICK
businessSummary: Sodick Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the machinery business. It operates through three segments. The Machine Tool segment is involved in the development, manufacture, and sale of products such as electrical discharge machines, machining centers, metal three-dimensional (3D) printers, and laser processing machines. The Industrial Machine segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of plastic injection molding machines. The Food Machine segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of food processing machinery, including noodle production plants, and noodle-making machines. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture of molds and plastic molded products; the development, manufacture, and sale of linear motor-based products and their control equipment, magnets for motors, ceramic products, and light emitting diode (LED) lighting; and the development of hardware and software for numerical control (NC) units used in machine tools.

name: OZU
businessSummary: Ozu Corporation imports, processes, sells, and exports nonwoven fabrics and disinfectants in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers electronics and clean room products, including nonwoven, disinfecting wipers, thick paper, and sterile wet wipers, as well as clean room masks, mops, sterilant, and other products. It also provides disposable sheets, cleaning towels, examination gowns, masks, storage products, and point sheets. In addition, the company offers oil absorbents and glass wipes. Additionally, it is involved in the real estate rental business. It serves electronics, cosmetics, medical, industrial materials, and decontamination industries. The company was founded in 1653 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NIPPON SEISEN
businessSummary: Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel wires in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It offers stainless-steel wires, such as spring, micro, cold heading, shaft, weaving, and high alloy/titanium wires for use in vehicles, aircraft, office automation appliances, electric appliances, medical instruments, commodities, and leisure goods, as well as screws, steel nettings, etc. The company also offers filament yarn, cloth, tape, belt, felt, knit, sleeve, chop, and other metal fibers under the NASLON brand name. In addition, it provides filters, such as metal filters, including NASLON filters, NPM filters, EXCEL PORE, FINE MET, and re-washable systems for synthetic fiber, film, resin, nuclear and thermal power generation, petroleum refining, medical, and other applications  and semiconductor gas filters for process and bulk gases, component protection, integrated gas panels, and diffusers. Further, the company offers palladium alloy roll-plated hydrogen separation membrane for high purity hydrogen gas production and purification  high-strength copper-alloy wire for optical pickup and camera module  stainless steel wire for high corrosion resistant and heat resistant springs  hydrogen embrittlement resistant stainless steel spring wire  duplex stainless-steel wire for corrosion resistant springs, ropes, fasteners, wire mesh, etc.  and co-based alloy for medical use. The company was formerly known as The Sanshin Special Wire Manufacturing Company and changed its name to Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. in October 1956. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. Nippon Seisen Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Daido Steel Co., Ltd.

name: TEIKOKU SEN
businessSummary: Teikoku Sen-I Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the disaster prevention, textile, and real estate leasing businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Disaster Prevention segment manufactures, purchases, and sells fire hoses, chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, and explosive (CBRNE) disaster prevention equipment, rescue vehicles, special disaster prevention vehicles, and airport chemical fire trucks. The Textile segment manufactures, processes, and sells textile materials for government agencies and high-performance textile materials such as Nomex for industrial use for private demand. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases land for shopping centers, and others. The Other segment provides insurance agency services.

name: SEKISUI KASEI
businessSummary: Sekisui Kasei Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells products in the human life and industry sectors in Japan, the Czech Republic, Germany, rest of Europe, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers ESLEN beads, ESLEN sheets, ESLEN wood, INTERFOAM, TECHEATER, returnable and food container, ESLEN cup, fruits/vegetable trays, thermal cover, ESLEN block, lightweight rooftop greening method, AQUAROAD, FJ-ring, thermal insulation materials for housing equipment, lightweight interior/exterior decoration, ESLEN TYK FORM, and other foamed/molded products for use in agricultural and marine product containers, food containers, distribution materials, construction materials, and civil engineering materials. It also provides PIOCELAN, LIGHTLON, NEOMICROLEN, CELPET, TECHPOLYMER, ST-gel, ST-Eleveat, NEOSHIKILON, ST-FOAMAC, seat core, toolbox/tire spacer, floor spacer, bumper core, tibia pad, door pad, packaging, neo flat board, DUOMASTER, TECHEATER, ELASTIL, and other foamed/molded products for use in automotive components, packaging materials for transporting automotive parts, industrial components, industrial packaging, electric part materials, and medical and health care materials. The company was formerly known as Sekisui Plastics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sekisui Kasei Co., Ltd. in June 2020. Sekisui Kasei Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: VISION
businessSummary: Vision Inc is mainly engaged in the global wireless fidelity (WiFi) and information and communication services business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Global WiFi segment is engaged in WiFi router rentals in Japan and overseas. The Information and Communication Services segment provides various telecommunication services such as subscription agency services, mobile communication equipment sales, office automation (OA) equipment sales, website production, and conference room space rental. The Glamping and Tourism business segment operates glamping facilities. The Company is also engaged in media business, catalog sales, and other businesses.

name: AI CROSS
businessSummary: AI CROSS Inc. is a Japan-based technology company. The Company provides messaging service, business chat service and artificial intelligence (AI) analytics service. The messaging service is a distribution platform service for delivering short message service (SMS) to mobile terminals owned by end users to domestic and foreign operators mainly engaged in business-to-consumer (B2C) business. The business chat service is a service that is intended to be used for business communication and business communication in companies. The AI Analytics service conducts research to enhance Engagement using AI technology. The other business is engaged in the development of system.

name: GREMS
businessSummary: grems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides energy consulting services to all electricity consumers, from low-voltage to high-voltage customers, as well as various energy-related products and services, grid battery storage businesses, renewable energy development businesses, and electricity retail. There are two business segments. The Energy Solutions Business segment focuses on businesses related to reducing energy costs, primarily through the sale of goods, which are flow revenues, such as commercial solar power generation systems, storage batteries, and energy-saving equipment, as well as grid battery storage businesses and renewable energy development businesses, which are stock revenues. The Retail Electricity Business segment mainly sells electricity to corporate customers, generating stock revenues.

name: LEOPALACE21
businessSummary: Leopalace21 Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction, leasing, and sale of apartments, condominiums, and residential housing in Japan. It operates in three segments: Rental Business, Senior Care Business, and Other Businesses. The Rental Business segment is involved in the leasing and management of apartment rooms buildings and other properties  maintenance work  a solar power generation business  and real estate brokerage activities. This segment also provides broadband and company housing agency services, as well as small-amount short-term insurance. The Senior Care Business segment operates nursing care facilities. The Other Businesses segment operates resort facilities in Guam, which include golf courses, a hotel, and other facilities. The company was formerly known as MDI Corporation and changed its name to Leopalace21 Corporation in July 2000. Leopalace21 Corporation was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 4994.T|TAISEI LAMICK GROUP|4994.T|Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd.
name: TAISEI LAMICK GROUP HEAD QUARTER & INNOV
businessSummary: Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd. develops and sells liquid and paste packaging systems in Japan. The company offers films, including XA-series, rev spec series, environmental series, film technology, and other products  and filling machines, such as DANGAN series products and filling peripheral equipment, as well as IoT cloud and product maintenance services. It also provides a filling training program. The company was formerly known as Taisei Lamick Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd. in April 2025. Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Shiraoka, Japan.

name: OPEN HOUSE GROUP
businessSummary: Open House Group Co Ltd, formerly Open House Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the real estate related business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Detached House-Related Business segment engages in brokerage (Open House), detached house sales (Open House Development), detached house subdivision (Hawk One), and construction contracting (Open House Architect). The Condominium Business segment develops and sells new condominiums. The Income-Producing Real Estate Business segment acquires, manages, and sells income-producing real estate in Japan. The Others segment is engaged in the U.S. real estate business, including sales, consulting, property management, and financial services related to U.S. real estate. The Pleasant Corporation segment plans, develops and sells mainly studio and family condominiums.

name: TOYO SEIKAN GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Toyo Seikan Group Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based container manufacturer. The Company operates in five segments. The Packaging Container segment manufactures and sells containers made primarily from metal, plastic, paper, and glass. The Engineering, Filling, and Logistics segment manufactures and sells packaging container-related machinery and equipment, contracts the manufacture and sale of beverage filling products, aerosol products, and general filling products, as well as truck transportation and warehousing. The Steel Plate-Related segment manufactures and sells steel plates and processed steel plate products. The Functional Materials-Related segment manufactures and sells functional materials such as aluminum substrates for magnetic disks, optical functional films, glazes, pigments, gel coats, and trace element fertilizers. The Real Estate-Related segment rents out office buildings and commercial facilities. The Company also manufactures and sells automotive press dies and others.

name: KS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: K'S Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of electronics retail stores, providing home appliances, computers, computer peripheral equipment and mobile phones. The Company mainly provides electronic products, petroleum equipment, gas equipment, cooling and heating machines, watches, cameras, measuring equipment, medical equipment, communication equipment, education equipment, office equipment, computers and mobile phones, and others. The Company is also involved in the general freight vehicle transportation business and electrical construction business.

name: OSG
businessSummary: OSG Corp is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision machine tools, such as cutting tools, rolling tools, measuring tools, machine tools, and machine parts. The Company's cutting tools include thread cutting tools such as taps and dies, milling cutters such as end mills and indexable tools, and drills and other cutting tools such as drills and diamond tools. Its rolling tools include thread rolling dies and trimming dies. Its measuring tools include thread gauges. Other products include machine tools such as rolling machines, tooling tools, raw materials, and line head (LH) sticks. The Company primarily produces and sells precision machine tools. The Company conducts the domestic sales of precision machine tools, and overseas sales in the Americas, Europe and Africa, and Asia, as well as other local subsidiaries. The Company operates in four segments including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Africa, and Asia. It mainly produces and sells precision machinery tools.

name: PILOT
businessSummary: Pilot Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of stationery items such as writing instruments and toys. The Company operates through four geographical segments: Japan, Americas, Europe, Asia (including Africa and Oceania). The Company’s main business is the manufacture and sale of writing instruments. Its main products include writing instruments such as fountain pens, ballpoint pens, mechanical pencils, multifunction pens, color pens, felt-tip pens, markers, drawing materials and drawing pens; stationery items such as business bags, correction items, office stationery, whiteboards, and notebooks. In addition to stationery supplies, the Japan segment is also involved in the manufacture, purchasing and sale of toys, precious metal accessories such as rings, and ceramic parts.

name: MOBILE FACTORY
businessSummary: Mobile Factory,Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in mobile service. The Company provides social application service and contents service. Social Application Service is focus on delivering services of game application through SNS platforms and application markets. Contents Service mainly provides sites, such as ringer melody and divination sites, which are operated by telecommunication carriers.

isin: 4008.T|SUMITOMO SEIKA CHEMICALS|4008.T|Sumitomo Seika Chemicals Company, Limited.
name: SUMITOMO SEIKA CHEMICALS COMPANY LIMITED
businessSummary: Sumitomo Seika Chemicals Company, Limited. engages in the manufacture and sale of absorbent polymers, functional chemicals, and gases in Japan, Asia, China, Europe, and North America. It operates through the Super Absorbent Polymers and Functional Materials segments. The Super Absorbent Polymers segment offers a super absorbent polymer, AQUA KEEP, used in water absorbent materials for hygiene products, including disposable diapers, baby diapers, sanitary napkins, and incontinent pad  industrial materials comprising water blocking tape for power and optical cables and water-swelling rubber  and other applications, such as water absorbent pad, freshness agent, water retention agent for agricultural and horticultural use, anti-dewing agent, pet sheets, and water absorbent sheets. Its Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells water soluble polymers, emulsions, particulate polymers, pharmaceutical products, functional products, electronics gases, standard gases, industrial chemicals, medical gases, and chemical gases, as well as designs, manufactures, and sells gas generation equipment, including PSA system for oxygen, nitrogen, and hydrogen etc. The company was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: MIGALO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: MIGALO HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates in two segments, DX Promotion Business and DX Real estate Business. The company is involved in development and sale of condominiums and other properties  real estate brokerage  property and rental management  and apartment and building management activities, as well as the real estate crowdfunding business. It also engages in face recognition platform, system contract development, and cloud integration businesses. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: JAPAN ELECTRONIC MATERIALS
businessSummary: Japan Electronic Materials Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of semiconductor testing components and electron tube components. It operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor Testing Components Related Business segment provides cantilever-type probe cards such as C-type probe cards, including CE series, and advanced probe cards such as V-type probe cards, including the VT series of vertical contact probe cards, the VS series of vertical spring contact probe cards, and the VE series of vertical + cantilever hybrid probe cards, and M-type probe cards, including the MC series, ML series, and MT series. The Electron Tube Components Related Business segment mainly provides cathodes and filaments.

name: NAKANO REFRIGERATORS
businessSummary: NAKANO REFRIGERATORS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of frozen and refrigerated showcases for food stores. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of showcases for stores, the construction and maintenance of showcases for food stores, as well as the sale, construction and maintenance of showcases for food stores.

name: MIRAIT ONE
businessSummary: Mirait One Corp is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the nippon telegraph and telephone (NTT) business, multicareer business, environment and social innovation business, as well as information communications technology (ICT) solution business. The Company operates through seven segments, including MIRAIT, MIRAIT Technologies, Lantrovision, TTK, Solcom and Shikokutsuken, Seibu Construction. The seven segments are involved in the information communication engineering, electrical equipment works and air condition maintenance business. The Company is also engaged in the communication infrastructure business, global business, and mobile network business.

name: WISE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacture, and sale of metal products in Japan, Thailand, Asia, and internationally. The company offers tapping fasteners for metals, resin, plastic, and thin plates  aluminum alloy zipper, CFRP fasteners, anti-loosening fasteners, crimp bolts, washer assembled screws, and head shape products  and custom-made products, such as neck tight screws and small metal parts. It also provides contract test and consulting services. The company serves car, home appliances and industrial equipment, medical equipment, robot, and architecture industries. The company was formerly known as Yamashina Corporation and changed its name to Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2024. Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

name: ZENRIN
businessSummary: Zenrin Co., Ltd. engages in the collection and management of a range of geospatial information worldwide. It manufactures and sells maps, including residential maps, map databases, and other content  and map database maintenance services, as well as provides map services, map software, in-car navigation software, and related IT services. The company also manufactures and sells printed materials  development and sales of web systems  research and development of software  development of map database  development and sales of package system  provides marketing and business solutions  and location-based services. In addition, it is involved in the development of software and services related to Zenrin integrated geospatial system, and corporate venture capital business. Further, the company offers easy sales promotion map, and building point data services  residential map for web, planned maps / custom-made maps, and drone  and 3D map data, logistics services, and ScanX services, as well as engages in mobility solutions business. Zenrin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

name: THASEGAWA
businessSummary: T.Hasegawa Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fragrances and related businesses. The Company operates through three segments, including Japan, Asia, and the United States, and operates in the Fragrance division and the Food division. The Fragrance division includes fragrances used in cosmetics such as perfumes and creams, toiletries such as shampoos and soaps, and household products such as detergents. The Food division includes essences, food oil-based flavors, food powder flavors, seasonings, fruit processed products, and natural colors used in beverages, sweets, frozen desserts, desserts, and instant noodle soups.

name: ARIAKE JAPAN
businessSummary: Ariake Japan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural seasonings. Together with its subsidiaries, the Company is also engaged in the production and sale of natural soups in domestic market; lease part of head office building and operation of convenience store; the manufacture and sale of natural seasonings in China, Taiwan, Southeast of Asia and European markets; as well as the production of agricultural products.

name: KH NEOCHEM
businessSummary: KH Neochem Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various petrochemical products. It has three business areas. Functional materials business manufactures and sells special diols used as raw materials for refrigeration oil and cosmetics. Products include KYOWANOIC - N, octic acid and 1,3-butylene glycol, used in lubricants, adhesives, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and others. Electronic materials business manufactures and sells high-purity solvents used in the manufacture of liquid crystal displays, semiconductors and photoresists. Products include propylene glycol monomethyl ether-P (PM-P) and propylene glycol monomethyl ether acetate-P (PMA-P), used in display materials and semiconductors. Basic chemicals business manufactures and sells solvents, plasticizer raw materials, resin raw materials used in various industries. Products include butanol, octanol, OXOCOL 900 and butyl acetate, used in paints, inks, plasticizers, and cleaning agents.

name: ODK SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: ODK Solutions Company, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of information processing outsourcing services to school corporations, securities companies and general business corporations, as well as the provision of system integration for securities finance companies and others. The Company provides comprehensive information services, such as the operation, development and maintenance of information systems. The Company's main services include information processing outsourcing services, contract calculation services, software development, network construction services and office automation (OA) equipment sales.

name: NAC
businessSummary: Nac Co., Ltd. engages in rental and sale of dust control products in Japan. The company involves in the manufacture and sale of home delivery water, purified water servers, and hypochlorous acid solutions. It also rents and sells dust control products, nursing care products, and welfare equipment, as well as pest control devices, regular cleaning services, and restoration work. In addition, it sells and constructs construction-related know-how products and construction materials to local builders, consulting services, and housing franchise business  involves in the construction contracting for custom-built detached houses  sales of condominiums  and provides related financial services. Further, it manufactures and sells cosmetics, health food, beauty materials, and pharmaceuticals. Additionally, the company offers financial services related to custom-built detached houses  import and sale of alcoholic beverages and Korean food products  and buys and sells used goods. The company was formerly known as Duskin Tsurugawa Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nac Co., Ltd. in 1977. Nac Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: BUSHIROAD
businessSummary: Bushiroad Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and acquirement of intellectual property (IP). The Company operates in two business segments. The Entertainment business segment is composed of five departments including trading card game department, mobile online games department, music department that engages in plan, production and management of music content and live performances and events, merchandising (MD) department that plans and releases goods related to IP, as well as media department that engages in book publishing and Internet radio operating. The Sports business segment is composed of the box office department, MD department that plans and sells goods, as well as the content department that product and distributes video content.

name: YAMASHIN FILTER
businessSummary: Yamashin-Filter Corp. operates as a filter manufacturer in Japan, Asia, the United States of America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Filter Business and Air Filter Business. The company manufactures, develops, and sells filters for construction and agricultural machines, drive-trains, fuel systems and various filter products for industrial and precision machines, and industrial filter related parts  and nano filter products. Its construction machinery filters, including hydraulic fluid filters to protect hydraulic equipment, such as cylinders  engine oil filters that are used in various types of engines to filter fine dust in engine oil  fuel filters used to construction machinery to remove dust and moisture contained in fuel for diesel engines  transmission filters for transmission mechanisms such as bulldozers and wheel loaders  industrial filters to filter hydraulic and lubricating oils, and other liquids in a range of industrial machinery  and process filters, which are used for filtration and separation in manufacturing processes across a range of industries, including electronic parts, precision components, LCD displays, and food products. The company also provides various types of air filters for a range of settings, such as office buildings, factories, equipment, and vehicles  and medical-grade masks and replacement inner sheets that are made using YAMASHIN NANO FILTER. The company was formerly known as Yamashin Industry Inc. and changed its name to Yamashin-Filter Corp. in October 2005. Yamashin-Filter Corp. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: KOJIMA
businessSummary: Kojima Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sales of home appliances and other products. The Company operates the Product Sales business segment of audio-visual products, home appliances, information and communication equipment products, and others. The Company also repairs and installs home appliances and electrical products. The audio-visual products include cameras, televisions, recorders and video cameras, audio products and others. The home appliances include refrigerators, washing machines, cooking appliances, seasonal appliances, hairdressing appliances and others. The information and communication equipment products include personal computers, computer peripherals, computer software products, mobile phones and others. Other products and services include games, watches, sporting goods, toys, pharmaceuticals and daily necessities, construction work including housing equipment and others.

name: AVANT GROUP
businessSummary: Avant Group Corp engages in the development, sales, and maintenance of software systems, as well as the provision of software-based consulting and business process outsourcing services. The Consolidated Financial Reporting segment develops and maintains DivaSystem, the Company’s proprietary software package for consolidated management support and consolidated accounting and provides outsourcing services for consolidated and non-consolidated financial reporting using this software. The Digital Transformation Promotion segment provides, through consulting and system development, data platforms for leveraging all data surrounding a company, as well as artificial intelligence and business intelligence solutions for analyzing, forecasting, and visualizing that data. The Management Solutions segment offers one-stop support from consulting to system planning, construction, implementation, operation, and maintenance with a focus on group management, consolidated accounting.

name: T&S GROUP
businessSummary: T&S Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides system development and operation/maintenance services in Japan. It offers artificial intelligence (AI) software development solutions comprising software solutions for Hailo Edge AI processors, Generative AI-assisted software development support, AI algorithm research and development support, and AI software development services  system development solutions, including business and cloud applications, and medical and embedded systems development, as well as software acceleration solutions  and information technology (IT) infrastructure construction solutions, such as server and network design and construction services. The company also provides system maintenance and operation solutions comprising migration support, version up, and maintenance and operation services  software engineering services, including IT support, infrastructure maintenance, and operation services, as well as information security services  and system verification solutions, such as on-premises and cloud applications verification, embedded system verification, and performance testing and test automation tools. The company was formerly known as T&S inc. and changed its name to T&S Group Inc. in June 2024. T&S Group Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: ROBOT PAYMENT
businessSummary: Robot Payment Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet payment agency services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Payment segment is engaged in the provision of Internet payment services mainly for electronic commerce (EC) of business-to-consumer (BtoC) businesses, and business-to-business (BtoB) businesses. The Financial Cloud segment is engaged in the provision of cloud services that streamline and automate billing, collection, application and reminder operations for BtoB and BtoC businesses.

name: KOMERI
businessSummary: KOMERI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the home center business. The Company is engaged in the sale of hardware, tools and construction materials, as well as the green products such as horticulture, plants and agricultural materials. The Company is engaged in the store operation of Power and Home Center, which sell life related products, and the operation of Hard & Green, which is engaged in the sale of hardware and horticulture products. The Company is also engaged in the product storage and delivery business, information processing and software development business, credit card and related business, insurance agency business, renovation work, cleaning, repair and maintenance work. It is also engaged in the delivery of fuel to group companies, the sale of liquefied petroleum gas, gasoline, kerosene and related equipment, the sale of books, and real estate leasing business.

name: ZEON
businessSummary: ZEON CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and development of synthetic rubber for automotive tires and high-performance resins. The Company has two segments. Elastomer Materials segment produces and sells synthetic rubber, synthetic latex and chemical products. The products include synthetic rubber, synthetic latex, C5 petroleum resins, thermoplastic elastomers and other chemical products. Specialty Materials segment produces and sells high-performance resins, high-performance components, electronic materials, battery materials, toners, chemicals and medical devices. The products include synthetic fragrances, organic synthetic chemicals and other chemicals, electronic materials, battery materials, toners, high-performance resins, high-performance components and medical devices. The Company also sells reaction injection molding (RIM) compounds, coatings and other products.

name: NSK
businessSummary: NSK Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of bearings, automobile-related products and precision machinery products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Industrial Machinery Business segment manufactures and sells bearings, precision equipment-related products, condition monitoring systems, and other products for general industry. The Automotive Business segment manufactures and sells bearings, automatic transmission parts, and other products for automobile and automobile parts manufacturers. Major products include ball bearings, hub unit bearings, tapered roller bearings, ball screws, linear guides, condition monitoring systems, and components for automatic transmissions. The Company also manufactures and sells steel balls and machinery and equipment.

isin: 9233.T|ASIA AIR SURVEY|9233.T|Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd.
name: ASIA AIR SURVEY
businessSummary: Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. provides aerial surveying services and products in Japan and internationally. It offers geospatial survey services, including space-borne remote sensing, aerial photography, airborne and mobile LiDAR surveying, UAV aerial surveying services, etc. The company also engages in the map-making, GIS data preparation, 3D models creation and visualization, LiDAR data analysis and visualization, administration-support GIS, and mapping system and 3DViewer system development activities, as well as the provision of red relief image maps. In addition, it provides disaster management services, including erosion control, volcanic disaster prevention, and river disaster prevention consulting, as well as regional planning for disaster prevention  and environmental management services, such as biodiversity conservation, environmental assessment, forest resources management, soil contamination investigation, support for environmental rehabilitation, and renewable energy development. Further, the company offers infrastructure asset management services, including urban and regional planning  planning and designing of public facilities, such as roads, ports, bridges, rivers, and lifeline facilities  maintenance engineering services comprising investigation, diagnosis, analysis, monitoring, and reinforcement  and system and database for facility management. Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Asia Airlines Measurement Ltd and changed its name to Asia Air Survey Co., Ltd. in 1963. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: AIN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Ain Holdings Inc. engages in the management of pharmacies, cosmetic stores, and interior shops in Japan. The company operates and manages dispensing and insurance pharmacies  and sells generic drugs. It is also involved in the provision of management consulting services for medical institutions  dissemination of information on hospital management  and introduction and dispatch of medical personnel, etc. In addition, the company operates cosmetic stores under the AINZ & TULPE  and interior furnishing shops under the Francfranc brand name. Further, it manages convenience stores. The company was formerly known as Ain Pharmaciez Inc. and changed its name to Ain Holdings Inc. in November 2015. Ain Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

name: SERIA
businessSummary: Seria Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail and wholesale business specializing in 100-yen shops. The Company is involved in the retail of consumer products through stores, as well as the wholesale of products to franchises, and overseas agents. The Company provides makeup and face care products, accessories, hygiene and health products, bath and toiletry products, cleaning and laundry products, detergents, kitchen cooking utensils, tableware, confectionery supplies, outdoor goods, interior materials, interior decorations, purpose-specific storage, general storage, character goods, party supplies, bags and small cases, key rings and straps, toys, merchandise for fans, rain gear, smoking accessories and Buddhist altar items, car and bicycle supplies, clothing, paper products, writing instruments, stationery accessories, files and stationery storage, school supplies and hobby supplies, stickers, office and store supplies, seals, gardening decorations and others.

name: DATA APPLICATIONS
businessSummary: Data Applications Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software related business. The Company is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of basic software products, supporting the business processes of companies centered on data exchange middleware, and the provision of introduction and operation service of software products. The Company operates through Software-related segment. Products include an enterprise data linkage platform ACMS Apex, an integrated electronic data interchange (EDI) server ACMS B2B, EDI clients ACMS Lite Neo and ACMS/WS, and a Web-EDI system platform ACMS Web Framer, file exchange ACMS Web/deTrade II and others.

isin: 8244.T|KINTETSU DEPT STORE|8244.T|Kintetsu Department Store Co., Ltd.

businessSummary: Kintetsu Department Store Co., Ltd. operates department stores in Japan. The company operates through Department Store Business  Wholesale/Retail  Interior Industry  Real Estate Business  and Other Business segments. It engages in sale of clothing, food, personal products, groceries, household goods, and restaurants and cafes through department stores  wholesale/retail of automobiles  leasing/rental of commercial and logistics properties, and apartments  interior business  and worker dispatch businesses. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Osaka, Japan.Kintetsu Department Store Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.

name: INTERMESTIC
businessSummary: Intermestic Inc. sells eyeglasses and sunglasses in Japan. It also sells cases, cleaners, and other related accessories of eyeglasses and contact lens. It sells its products through stores and online. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Minato, Japan.

name: SUMISEKI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sumiseki Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the coal business. It operates through three segments. The Coal segment is engaged in related transactions related to the purchase and sale of coal. The New Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of industrial artificial diamonds. The Quarrying segment is engaged in the extraction, processing and sale of rocks.

name: DAISEKI
businessSummary: Daiseki Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environment-related business. The Company is engaged in the collection, transportation and intermediate treatment of industrial wastes, the investigation and treatment of contaminated soil, the collection, transportation and recycling of used batteries, the refining of lead, the sale of non-ferrous metal raw materials, tank washing and related services, the collection of volatile organic compounds (VOC) gases, the sludge reduction works, the sale of crude oil washing (COW) machines, as well as the manufacture and sale of petrochemical products.

name: MIURA
businessSummary: MIURA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacturing of boilers. The Company operates in three business segments. The Japan segment offers products and services including steam boilers, hot water boilers, electric boilers, thermal fluid boilers, waste heat boilers, exhaust gas boilers, marine auxiliary boilers, ballast water treatment systems, marine waste oil incinerators, marine fresh water generators and others. The Americas segment offers steam boilers, hot water boilers, electric boilers, waste heat boilers, exhaust gas boilers, closed-loop condensate recovery systems, heat pumps and others. The Asia and Other segment offers steam boilers, hot water boilers, electric boilers, thermal fluid boilers, waste heat boilers, exhaust gas boilers, steam-driven air compressors, heat-recovery electric air compressors, heat pumps, flash steam generators, filtration systems, water softeners, boiler chemicals and others.

name: BEAGLEE
businessSummary: Beaglee Inc.is a Japan-based company engaged in the content platform business which provides content distribution service and an environment for creators. The main service provided by the content platform business is involved in the operation of a comic distribution Website Manga Okoku. The Company is also involved in some new related business with the assets and know-hows cultivated from the operation of Manga Okoku, such as the provision of the illustration distributed media ETOPICA, the manga-specialized crowd-funding service FUNDIY, as well as the native application business.

name: RINNAI
businessSummary: Rinnai Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of thermal equipment. The Company operates in six segments based on region: Japan, the United States, Australia, China, South Korea, and Indonesia. Domestically, the Company sells directly to customers, such as city gas companies, propane fuel distributors, housing equipment manufacturers, house builders, and pipe and building material distributors (some of which are supplied as original equipment manufacturers (OEM)), while subsidiaries sell to some customers.

name: ALPS ALPINE
businessSummary: Alps Alpine Co Ltd isa Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to the components, sensors and communications, and modules and systems businesses. The company operates through three business segments. The Components Business segment manufactures and sells electronic components such as switches, actuators, and haptics. The Sensors and Communications Business segment manufactures and sells electronic components for sensors and communication devices. The Modules and Systems Business segment manufactures and sells automotive modules, infotainment, display, and sound products. The Company also operates businesses related to system development, office services, finance and leasing, and logistics.

name: PERSOL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: PERSOL HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based comprehensive human resources service company providing staffing, recruitment, business process outsourcing (BPO), and information technology (IT)/engineering-related services. It operates through five segments. The Staffing segment provides temporary staffing services. The BPO segment offers business process outsourcing, customer support, digital transformation (DX) support, and consulting services. The Technology segment provides IT/DX solutions, engineering services, and technical staffing services. The Career segment operates recruitment services and job media businesses. The Asia Pacific segment provides staffing, recruitment, outsourcing, and facility management services across the Asia-Pacific region. Additionally, the Company engages in education and training, employment support for individuals with disabilities, digital solutions for talent development and management, and the creation and incubation of new businesses.

name: TOHOKU STEEL
businessSummary: Tohoku Steel Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of specialty steel products, as well as the real estate leasing business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Specialty Steels segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various specialty steel products such as heat-resistant steels for automotive, and magnetic materials, the processing and heat treatment of equipment parts and tools, as well as the rental, cleaning and security of factory land. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the rental and maintenance of commercial facilities such as shopping centers, and rental houses, as well as the leasing of former factory land.
