It operates through DX New Construction Real Estate Business  DX Regeneration Real Estate Business  DX Real Estate Value Improvement Project  Real Estate Leasing  and Others segment. The company is involved in the procurement, development, and sales in development operations  sale of individual renovated condominiums, buildings, and new condominiums  purchasing, reselling, interior design, and sales of real estate  operations, procurement in investment operations, land development, and land planning  leasing and managing real estate  and real estate brokerage, land value enhancement, and investment services, as well as purchase and resale of newly built condominiums and apartments  custom-built housing business  pre-built housing business  and welfare-related facility business. It also operates as a real estate sales agent. LA Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: QLS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: QLS HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd is mainly engaged in childcare business, nursing care business and temporary staffing business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Childcare segment is engaged in the operation of childcare facilities, such as daycare centers. The Nursing Care segment is engaged in the operation of nursing care facility that provides home care support and home care. The Temporary Staffing segment is engaged in the provision of professional staffing service. The other business is engaged in the sale of communication equipment, such as mobile phones under contract.

name: CYBERBUZZ
businessSummary: CyberBuzz, Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the advertising and marketing business through social media such as blogs, Twitter, Facebook and Instagram. The NINARY service and Ripre service is involved in the advertising and marketing business by influencers who have a certain number of readers and followers in social media. The Pochicome service operates a monitor Website that anyone can use if they use social media. The to buy service operates an online media where influencers introduce their personal items and services as original articles. The SNS Account Management service supports the operation of social media accounts that are officially operated by client companies. In addition to sales of services operated by the Company, the Internet advertising agency sales service also sells advertising products centered on social media-related advertisements such as YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and LINE.

name: ODAWARA AUTO MACHINE MFG
businessSummary: ODAWARA AUTO-MACHINE MFG.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of bus fare collection equipment and the provision of maintenance services for its products. The Company's products and goods include bus fare collection equipment-related products, such as fare collection equipment with immediate calculating function and general function, and safes and software for fare collection equipment, card equipment-related products, such as magnetic card systems, noncontact integrated circuit(IC) card systems and software for card equipment, as well as other equipment for bus, such as numbered ticket issuing equipment, checkout devices, data management servers, liquid crystal display (LCD) fare displays and related software, among others. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of light-emitting diode (LED) fare displays, routing display systems, roll paper for numbered ticket issuing equipment.

name: NIHON FALCOM
businessSummary: NIHON FALCOM CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development, production and sale of game software. The Company operates in two business divisions. The Product division is engaged in the planning, development, production and sale of role-playing game software, the production and sale of Japanese version of overseas game software, and the planning, production and sale of music compact discs (CDs). The License division is engaged in licensing permission for the development and sale of family game software in Japan, the localization and local marketing of the Company's software to overseas markets, the provision of services through mobile phones using its game software and game music, the download and sale of its game software online and the production and sale of books.

name: WASHINGTON HOTEL
businessSummary: Washington Hotel Corporation engages in the hotels business in Japan. The company operates Washington Hotel Plaza, and Washington R & B Hotel. It also operates restaurants in golf course clubhouses. Washington Hotel Corporation was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

isin: 7840.T|FRANCE BED HOLDINGS|7840.T|France Bed Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: FRANCE BED HOLDINGS
businessSummary: France Bed Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides medical services in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Medical Services Business, and Home Furnishing and Health Business. It engages in the manufacturing, procurement, rental, and retail/wholesale sale of medical and nursing care beds, as well as welfare equipment  supply of linen to medical and welfare facilities, as well as hotels  and provision of facility solutions for medical and welfare facilities. The company is also involved in the design of mattresses  operation of showrooms for product experience and sleep consultation  and supply of beds, mattresses, and related products to hotels, inns, and other lodging operators. In addition, it engages in the sale of sundries  exhibition sale of furniture, fashion, and jewelry  manufacturing and sale of assorted beds and beddings, as well as special needs and home health equipment  maintenance, inspection, and repair of nursing-care and special needs equipment  storage of products and control of inventory  long-term care insurance welfare equipment rental business  daily-life care services in specified facilities  communal living care services for elderly with dementia  rental housing for elderly  and home renovation for home care. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

isin: 9740.T|CENTRAL SECURITY PATROLS|9740.T|Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd.
name: CENTRAL SECURITY PATROLS
businessSummary: Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. provides security services in Japan. The company operates through Security Business, and Building Management and Real Estate Business segments. The company offers on-site security, including facility security, fire and disaster prevention safety management, and VIP personal protection services  mechanical security, such as online and home security  and transport security consisting of security, escort and transportation services for cash, valuables, etc., as well as sells non-life insurance products linked to mechanical security contracts. It also sells and installs surveillance cameras and image monitoring systems  access control systems  and installation and sales of security, fire prevention, and disaster prevention equipment and facilities. Further, the company provides image analysis VACS system, image browsing system, SecurityPlatform ladder, CSP security robot, drone services, Biz Guard S and Biz Guard Revo office security, access control system centrics, apartment security safe room, NEW HiSCT total apartment security, intercom renewal service, unmanned reception system for apartment buildings, AED, safety confirmation service, CSP life support mail, camera malfunctioning monitoring, transport security, comprehensive building management, insurance, mobile emergency reporting system, cyber-attack countermeasures, pest repellent device, and fire hose reel. It also engages in real estate leasing services. It serves hotel, sports gym, coworking spaces, unmanned stores, logistics facilities, small office, building, nursery schools and kindergartens, clinic, restaurant, station, railway depots and substations, apartment, urban commercial facilities, suburban commercial facilities, stadium, factory, and shrines and temples. Central Security Patrols Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NMS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: nms Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human solution (HS) business, the electronics manufacturing services (EMS) business and the power supply (PS) business. The Company operates in three business segments. The HS segment is engaged in the provision of production dispatch services, contract manufacturing services and repair customer services. The EMS segment is engaged in the provision of mounting and assembly services for electronic device boards in Japan and overseas. The PS segment is engaged in the design, development, manufacturing and sale of products in the power supply field.

name: SHIMAMURA
businessSummary: Shimamura Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operating as a chain store group that sells soft goods, primarily clothing. It operates through two geographical segments, including Japan and Overseas. It operates through its flagship store Fashion Center Shimamura. Fashion Center Shimamura is a comprehensive clothing store targeting women aging from 20 to 60 and their families, offering everything from the latest trendy fashions to practical clothing, bedding and interior goods for everyday use. Avail is a young casual specialty store targeting people aged from teens to 40, offering total coordination of women's and men's clothing, shoes and accessories. Birthday is a specialty store for baby and children's goods offering a variety of products for all occasions. Chambre is a specialty store for miscellaneous goods and women's fashion targeting women aged from teens to 60. Divalo is a specialty store for fashion goods targeting women aging from 20 to 50 and their families.

isin: 9936.T|Ohsho Food Service Corp.|9936.T|Ohsho Food Service Corp.
name: OHSHO FOOD SERVICE
businessSummary: Ohsho Food Service Corp. operates and franchises a chain of Chinese restaurants under the Gyoza no OHSHO brand name in China. The company serves Chinese cuisine  sells Chinese ingredients  and other products. Ohsho Food Service Corp. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

isin: 9757.T|Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated|9757.T|Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated
name: FUNAI SOKEN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated provides consulting services for various industries in Japan. It offers logistics services, including consulting, trading, and transportation  management consulting, marketing and executive training, financial advisory, and digital marketing services  and digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Funai Consulting Incorporated and changed its name to Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: FEEDFORCE GROUP
businessSummary: Feedforce Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides support to companies in solving their problems and improving productivity in the fields of digital marketing and e-commerce by utilizing technologies such as performance-based advertising agency, data feeds, and identity (ID) integration. The Company operates through three segments. The Professional Services segment consists of two main services, Anagrams and DF PLUS, and provides marketing support and solutions using data feeds and listings. The Software as a Service (SaaS) segment consists of three main services, Social PLUS, dfplus.io, and EC Booster, and provides social login support tools, data feed marketing management tools, and automatic ad distribution tools. The Digital Transformation (DX) segment consists of five main services, App Unity, Rewire, FRACTA, TePs, and Shippinno, and provides services to support companies' DX through e-commerce business support services using Shopify and Shopify app development.

name: BROADMEDIA
businessSummary: Broadmedia Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the multimedia distribution business. The Company has six business segments. Education segment operates the wide-area correspondence high schools, the Renaissance Japanese Language Institute and programming schools. Media Content segment sells television broadcasting rights, video-on-demand (VOD) rights and others. Studio Production segment produces Japanese subtitles and dubbing. Broadcasting segment provides programs to broadcasters, and undertakes video production, and operates the Fishing Vision Club and provides fishing content to video content providers. Technology segment provides Akamai services (content delivery network (CDN) services, security services), cloud solutions, digital cinema services, and other solution services. The Other segment operates the e-sports team CAG OSAKA, plans and manages e-sports-related events, and plans, develops, and sells games for the Nintendo Switch and virtual reality (VR) software.

name: USER LOCAL
businessSummary: User Local Inc is a Japan-based company that provides platform services utilizing big data and artificial intelligence (AI) to support client companies in decision-making and workstyle reform through improved operational efficiency. The Company has a data cloud business segment. The Segment offers services including the comprehensive digital marketing tool User Insight, the social media analytics tool Social Insight, the inquiry response support tool Support Chatbot, as well as the generative AI tool for corporate clients User Local ChatAI.

name: INUNEKO SEIKATSU
businessSummary: INUNEKO-SEIKATSU Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pet food products in Japan. The company sells pet food, pet supplements, pet snacks, and homemade meals for dogs and cats through direct-to-consumer e-commerce, marketplace, and wholesale channels under the INUNEKO-SEIKATSU brand name. The company also provides veterinary service through home-visit and clinic operation, grooming salon service, and pet-related event activity. The company was formerly known as Honest Food Co., Ltd. INUNEKO-SEIKATSU Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: ALPEN
businessSummary: Alpen Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of sporting goods in Japan. The company offers golf equipment  sports and casual wear and sports shoes  training, fitness, and bicycle equipment  racket equipment  baseball, soccer, and other game balls  outdoor wear  and camping and trekking, marine, and ski and snowboard equipment. It also operates golf courses, ski resorts, and fitness clubs. The company sells its products through retail stores and online stores. Alpen Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: JTEKT
businessSummary: JTEKT Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to the automotive, industrial machinery and bearings, and machine tools businesses. It operates its business through three segments. The Automotive segment manufactures and sells products for the automotive industry, including steering and driveline components such as electric power steering, hydraulic power steering, and electronically controlled 4WD couplings. The Industrial Machinery & Bearings segment manufactures and sells bearings for industrial machinery such as roller bearings, ball bearings, and bearing units. The Machine Tools segment manufactures and sells machine tools such as grinding machines, machining centers, cutting machines, control devices, and industrial heat treatment furnaces.

name: HOWA MACHINERY
businessSummary: Howa Machinery,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, pneumatic hydraulic equipment and electronic machines, firearms, building materials and specially equipped vehicles. The Company operates through six business segments. The Machine Tool-related segment is engaged in the production of machining centers, various special-purpose machines, and pneumatic hydraulic equipment. The Firearms segment is engaged in the production of rifles, mortars and hunting rifles. The Domestic Sales Subsidiary segment is engaged in the sale of steel and other products. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the production of aluminum sash doors, steel sash doors, and waterproof boards. The Specially Equipped Vehicle segment is engaged in the production of road cleaning vehicles, industrial cleaning machines, automatic floor cleaning machines. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the leasing of land and buildings.

name: SUGI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sugi Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the drug store and pharmacy business. Through its subsidiaries, it sells pharmaceuticals, health foods, cosmetics, and daily necessities, operates drug stores with pharmacies that provide prescription dispensing and home medical care in cooperation with local medical professionals, provides various services to consistently support customers' health maintenance and prevention, manages subsidiaries specializing in medical and healthcare-related businesses such as visiting nursing services and medical institution start-up support services, engages in trading and domestic wholesale businesses that export Japanese products, mainly drug store materials such as pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities and food, and manages subsidiaries specializing in prescription dispensing.

name: NGK
businessSummary: NGK Corporation, formerly NGK INSULATORS, LTD., is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the environment, digital society and energy & industry business. It operates through three business segments. The Environment Business segment manufactures and sells automotive exhaust gas purification components, sensors and general industrial ceramic products and equipment, corrosion-resistant equipment for the chemical industry, membrane separation equipment for liquids and gases, heating equipment and refractories and low-level radioactive waste treatment equipment. The Digital Society Business segment manufactures and sells products for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, electronics industry products and others. The Energy & Industry Business segment manufactures and sells sodium-sulfur (NAS) batteries, power insulators and equipment and others, and sells electricity utilizing NAS batteries. Other businesses include insurance agency services and golf course management.

name: FP
businessSummary: FP Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the disposable food container business segment, focusing on the manufacture and sale of tray containers, lunch boxes, and similar products, while also handling the sale of packaging materials associated with these products. The Company operates through Disposable Food Container business segment. Its main activities include the manufacture and sale of synthetic resin disposable food containers, the sale of packaging materials and packaging machinery, and recycling operations converting collected containers into recycled raw materials. Through subsidiaries, it also handles the procurement and sale of packaging materials related to food container sales, the manufacture and sale of plastic film, printing, and various printing-related processing. Other businesses include the manufacture and sale of recycled products from collected PET bottles and the manufacture of corrugated cardboard.

name: BELLSYSTEM24 HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Bellsystem24 Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the customer relationship management (CRM) business mainly including contact center operations. The Company has two business segments. The CRM segment is engaged in the traditional inbound and outbound call business, as well as the provision of customer support services, sales support services, technical support services and business process outsourcing (BPO) services for client companies through telephone, Web and social medias. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of content for general consumers on a monthly basis, and weather forecast content for businesses through mobile personal computers (PCs), as well as the general affairs and administrative business.

name: HOUSE FOODS GROUP
businessSummary: House Foods Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products, and restaurant management business. The Company operates through five segments. The Spice/Seasoning/Processed Food segment manufactures and sells household products such as roux curry, roux stew, retort curry, spice products, and starch noodles in Japan. The Health Food segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, and mail-order sales of health foods and functional beverages such as Ukon No Chikara, and C1000 in Japan. The International Food segment manufactures and sells soybean-related products such as tofu, curry products, and functional foods, mainly in the United States, China, and Southeast Asia. The Restaurant segment plans and operates restaurants around the world, including Curry House CoCo Ichibanya, which offers Japanese-style curry. The Other Food Related Business segment manufactures and sells prepared dishes, imports and sells ingredients, and analyzes food.

name: NH FOODS
businessSummary: NH Foods Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Processing Business Headquarter segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ham, sausages and processed foods, as well as the manufacture and sale of marine products and dairy products in Japan. The Meat Business Headquarter segment is mainly engaged in the production and sale of meat, the breeding and raising of pigs and broilers, and the sale of meat products in Japan. The Overseas Business Headquarters segment is mainly engaged in the production, manufacture and sale of ham, sausages, processed foods and meat. The ballpark business is engaged in the operation of professional baseball teams and stadiums.

name: MAKITA
businessSummary: Makita Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric tools, air tools, horticultural equipment, household equipment. The Company operates in four regional segments including Japan, Europe, North America and Asia. The Company provides lithium-ion series products, high-pressure air tool series products, dust collector series products, wireless interlocking series products and disaster preparedness series products.

name: ONO PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Ono Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription and over-the-counter drugs. The Company has been particularly focused on research and development of prescription drugs, positioning them as its core business. The Company’s products include injectables, oral medications, and patches.

name: HOSHIZAKI
businessSummary: Hoshizaki Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale and maintenance services for food service equipment. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan, the Americas, Europe and Asia. The Company is engaged in the research and development of food service equipment, as well as the provision of consistent research system from product planning to commercialization. The Company is also engaged in the development of new product and advanced technology, improvement and improvement of existing products, as well as the provision of series development activities and cost reduction activities. The Company provides a system to utilize information obtained from sales and maintenance service activities and market quality information for product development.

name: CASIO COMPUTER
businessSummary: Casio Computer Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of developing and producing consumer and system products through to sales and service. The Company operates through four business segments. The Watches and clocks segment is engaged in the provision of watches and clocks. The Consumer segment is engaged in the provision of electronic dictionaries, calculators, electronic stationery, electronic musical instruments. The Systems segment is engaged in the provision of handheld terminals, electronic cash registers, management support systems. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of molded parts and molds.

name: AS ONE
businessSummary: AS ONE Corporation engages in the sale of research instruments and equipment, nursing and care products, and other scientific instruments in Japan and internationally. The company offers scientific instruments comprising temperature/humidity control and measuring/surveying instruments, as well as universal products used for cooling, heating, mixing, absorption, pressurization, and conveyance  microscopes, glass slides, and tissue culture products for biotechnology  magnifying glasses indispensable for precision work, plus filters, and dispensing devices required for analysis technology  equipment indispensable for research facilities, such as experimental platforms, fume hoods, and pharmaceutical depositories, as well as storage equipment, wagons, laboratory chairs, and conveyance equipment  containers required for storage or preservation of samples, reagents, materials, and others  glass or plastic beakers, flask indispensables, hoses, tubes, and joints  tapes and labels  and timers, packaging machines, tools, office supplies, and other equipment for laboratories. It also provides industrial instruments, such as dehumidifying storage products  equipment for organization, conveyance, etc.  equipment for sterilization/disinfecting and cleaning, including ultrasonic cleaners for washing/drying, detergents, and drying tools  glasses, masks, and gloves  and tools and containers used in clean rooms, as well as dust-proof and anti-static products comprising clean room clothes and mats indispensable. In addition, the company offers hospital/nursing instruments, such as white gowns, masks, and gloves  rack systems for installing in nursing stations  various products, supplies, and equipment required for hospital nursing and care  and sterilizers and sterilization lockers, as well as care cars and beds, and bathing and sanitary products. Further, it engages in warehouse management and cargo handling. The company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: HOSOKAWA MICRON
businessSummary: Hosokawa Micron Corporation provides powder and plastic processing equipment in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers powder processing equipment for grinding, classifying, blending and drying powder materials and products used in various industries  dust collection equipment for environmental protection and product recovery  and chemical hazard prevention equipment for the protection of workers during pharmaceuticals development and manufacture. It also provides machines for milling, mixing, particle design, agglomeration, feed and discharge, laboratory technology, bag filters, protection and production isolation, and engineering, as well as after-sales, toll processing, analysis, and preventive maintenance services. In addition, the company is involved in the contract research, development, manufacture, and sale of new materials, cosmetics, and hair growth products based on nanocomposite particle technology. Further, the company engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and system engineering of multi-layered performance films for use in food packaging  protection of electronic equipment  and single-layer film manufacturing equipment. It provides its products for energy, IT, automobile, chemicals, minerals, pharmaceuticals, food, polymer drying/SSP, containment, and metal industries. The company was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Hirakata, Japan.

name: INTER ACTION
businessSummary: INTER ACTION Corporation develops, manufactures, purchases and sells light source device, solar power-related products, and image inspection devices. The Company has three business segments. The Light Source Equipment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of light source device for testing in the production process of imaging semiconductors (charge coupled device (CCD) and complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS)), and display devices. The Solar Power-related Product segment develops, purchases and sells solar simulators, cell testers, solar power modules. The Imaging Inspection segment develops, manufactures and sells Internet protocol (IP) modules, discrete fourier transformation (DFT) test systems, camera module test equipment and related components. As of May 31, 2014, the Company had five subsidiaries.

name: SAAF HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SAAF Holdings Co Ltd, formerly ITbook Holdings Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in the ground investigation and improvement business, human resources business, system development business. The Company operates in seven segments. The Ground Investigation and Improvement segment provides ground investigation and surveying, ground improvement, and real estate services. The Human Resources segment provides technician dispatch, human resources dispatch and teacher dispatch. The System Development segment provides new system development, hardware sales, and others. The Consulting segment provides reorganization and reconstruction of business and information systems. The Warranty and Inspection segment provides ground guarantee, housing completion guarantee. The Construction Tech segment is engaged in the rental and sale of geotechnical survey equipment. The Overseas segment is engaged in geotechnical surveys and ground improvement. Other businesses include financial services and others.

name: NEXON
businessSummary: Nexon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, production and distribution of online games for personal computers (PCs) and mobile games. The Company operates through five business segments: Japan, Korea, China, North America and Others. The PC online business is mainly engaged in the production, development and distribution of PC online games. Game titles include MapleStory, Arad Senki (Dungeon&Fighter) and EA SPORTS FC ONLINE. The consulting business provides consulting services related to the construction and management of billing systems, business strategy, game operation and marketing in China. In Korea, the Company also provides customer support and internet cafe operation services for PC online games and mobile games, and provides advertising platforms and operation management services. The Merchandising business produces and sells products using game characters. The mobile business develops and distributes mobile games played on the smartphones and tablets.

name: SIGMAKOKI
businessSummary: Sigmakoki Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides optical component products in Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers opto-mechanics/manual stages and holders, which include stages, holders, bases, rods, poles, clamps, and cage systems stages  and optics/coating products, including multi-element optics, mirrors, beam splitters, filters, lenses, prisms, polarizers, laser crystals, nonlinear crystals, substrates, and windows. It also provides motion control application systems comprising automatic positioning devices, optical measurement devices, and software for positioning and measurement  and laser system products, including optical modules, lens units, laser processing systems, laser application system products, etc. In addition, the company offers bio-medical related products, such as micromanipulation systems, motorized stage system for microscopes, core unit for microscopy, and bio and medical devices  and optical application system products consisting of optical fiber alignment systems, optical systems for observation, and contracted and custom-made products. Sigmakoki Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Hidaka, Japan.

name: USHIO
businessSummary: Ushio Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of products related to its Industrial Process, Visual Imaging, Life Science, and Photonics Solution businesses. The Company operates through four segments. The Industrial Process segment focuses on the semiconductor market, producing and selling exposure lamps, office automation (OA) lamps, and optical devices. The Visual Imaging segment focuses on the cinema and general imaging markets, producing and selling projector lamps and imaging equipment. The Life Science segment concentrates on environmental hygiene solutions and the healthcare market, producing and selling UV therapy devices and light sources. The Photonics Solution segment produces and sells solid-state light sources.

name: INTAGE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: INTAGE HOLDINGS Inc., formerly INTAGE Inc., is a provider of marketing research and consulting services. The Market Research and Consulting segment is engaged in marketing research operations, including customer panel research, retail shop panel research and other research activities; customized research services, including Internet research, mail survey, visiting interview survey and qualitative research, as well as the provision of related consulting services. The System Solution segment is engaged in the development and sale of software, the operation of systems and data centers, and the provision of various related consulting services. The Drug Development Support segment is engaged in the contract research organization (CRO) business. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had 24 subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: &DO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: &Do Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates in the real estate industry in Japan. The company engages in real estate management, investment, leasing, selling, brokerage, and renovation activities  commercial real estate consulting business  and franchisee and financial activities. It also plans and manages the house lease  house, and asset leaseback activities. The company was formerly known as HOUSE DO Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to &Do Holdings Co.,Ltd. in January 2022. &Do Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: WORKMAN
businessSummary: Workman Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of specialty retail stores in Japan. The company offers family clothes, such as underwear, socks, military boots, hats, towels, and aprons  casual wear, including polo shirts, T-shirts, high neck shirts, blousons, and sportswear  and working wear comprising work jackets, work pants, overalls, construction worker clothing, and outdoor wear. It also provides uniforms, including white coats, office uniforms, non-woven fabrics, and women's clothing  safety shoes, work boots, tabi boots, rubber boots, and cloth shoes  and work supplies, such as work gloves, leather gloves, processed gloves, rainwear, helmets, and belts. The company sells its products through stores and online stores. Workman Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: WACOM
businessSummary: Wacom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sale of brand products and technology solution products, as well as service operations. The Company operates through two business segments. The Technology Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of digital pens, sensors, touch panel components and modules. They are used for mobile devices such as tablet computers, e-books and mobile terminals. The Branded Products segment provides three kinds of services. Creative business provides pen tablets, mobiles and displays. The consumer business provides stylus pens, smart pads, and digital stationery. They are mainly used for illustration and memo making on digital terminals. Business solutions provides pen tablets. They are mainly used in the fields of education, medical care, and digital signatures.

name: FURUYA METAL
businessSummary: Furuya Metal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial precious metal products. The Company operates through five business segments. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells electronic components used in the manufacturing process of electronic products. The Thin Film segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precious metal targets used in thin film formation. The Thermal segment manufactures and sells temperature sensors mainly used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Fine Chemicals and Recycling segment manufactures and sells precious metal compounds and recovers and refines precious metals. The Supply Chain Support segment sells major precious metal raw materials that are not related to product orders. Other businesses mainly sell purchased products, and others.

name: YAMAICHI ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: Yamaichi Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechanical components such as integrated circuit (IC) socket products used in semiconductor inspection processes and connector products for electronic and electrical equipment. The Company operates through three segments. The Test Solutions segment provides burn-in sockets, test sockets, and semiconductor test-related services. The Connector Solutions segment manufactures and sells high-speed transmission connectors, card connectors, interface connectors, board connectors, pressure-welded connectors, mounting IC sockets, various other connectors, and YFLEX (high-speed transmission cables and mounting boards). The Optical-related Business segment manufactures and sells red, green, and blue (RGB) filters, ultraviolet (UV)/infrared (IR) cut filters, dichroic filters/mirrors, fluorescent dichroic filters, short/long-pass filters, band-pass filters, and semiconductor laser light sources.

name: GMO INTERNET
businessSummary: GMO internet, Inc. engages in internet infrastructure business in Japan. The company offers cloud /hosting, membership management, internet connection, and domain registration services. It is also involved in online advertisement business. The company was formerly known as GMO AD Partners Inc. and changed its name to GMO internet, Inc. in January 2025. GMO internet, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: AIR U
businessSummary: AIR-U Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of seamlessly connected services based on telecommunications business. The network and carrier resale business is engaged in postpaid communication service mainly for domestic users, including foreign residents, and medium to long-term users. The cloud service operation business uses the cloud SIM system for domestic postpaid communication mainly for travelers from Japan to overseas, travelers from overseas to overseas, and medium to long-term users. The brand resale business is a prepaid communication service mainly for inbound tourists from overseas and short-term domestic users. The Company is mainly engaged in outsourcing of sales operations such as development of new sales channels and sales of smartphones and tablets.

name: TOTO
businessSummary: TOTO Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of restroom, bath, kitchen and washroom products. The Company operates through six business segments. The Japan Housing Equipment Business segment, the Mainland China Business segment, the Asia and Oceania Business segment, the Americas Business segment and the Europe Business segment are engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary ware, heated toilet seats, unit bathrooms, system kitchens and washstands, faucets, electric water heaters, handrails, bathroom ventilation heaters and dryers, faucets, seats for seated toilets, plastic and rubber molded parts, plastic bathtubs and marbright counters, and others. The Company provides after-sales services such as repair work for these products. The Company also installs, sells, designs and contracts housing equipment. The New Area Business segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic products. The Company is also engaged in the office buildings rental business.

name: SHIMADZU
businessSummary: Shimadzu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of scientific and precision equipment. The Company has four segments. Testing and Measuring Instruments segment is engaged in the provision of chromatographic analysis systems, mass spectrometry systems, light analysis systems, thermal analysis systems, bio-related analysis systems, water quality measurement systems and others. Medical Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of X-ray television (TV) systems, angiography systems, X-ray imaging systems and others. Aircraft Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of flight control systems, air management systems, cockpit display systems and others. Industrial Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of turbomolecular pumps and others. The Company is also engaged in the leasing and management of real estate business.

name: HASEKO
businessSummary: HASEKO Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in construction-related, real estate-related, management and operations and overseas businesses. It operates through four business segments. Construction-Related segment is engaged in the planning, design and construction of condominiums, construction contracting, the sale and rental of construction materials and equipment and others. Real Estate-Related segment engages in the condominium development projects, the sale and leasing of condominiums, sales agency services for condominiums, real estate brokerage, condominium renovation and interior product sales. Management Operations segment oversees condominium management operations, manages condominium buildings, handles the leasing and lease management of condominiums and other properties and others. Overseas segment engages in real estate development and sales, as well as the operation of commercial facilities, in the United States.

name: ESOL
businessSummary: eSOL Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in operation system (OS) development for embedded devices and contract development of embedded software. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Embedded Software segment is mainly involved in the development and sale of real-time operating system (RTOS) and development support tools, as well as the provision of engineering services. The Sensing Solution segment is involved in the development and sale of automotive printers, cold handy terminals, environmentally handicapped handy terminals, sales support software, as well as the proposal of the sensor network system to the markets where information and communication technology (ICT) is behind, such as agriculture and fishery business.

name: COTA
businessSummary: Cota Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells hair care cosmetics and quasi-drugs for beauty salons in Japan. The company offers shampoo and conditioner, scalp care, styling, leave-in treatment, salon treatment, and color and perm products. It also provides toiletries, including shampoos and treatments  hair styling products, including lotions, sprays, foams, waxes, etc.  hair dyes  hair growth tonics  perming solutions  and other related items. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

name: SYSTENA
businessSummary: Systena Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in information technology (IT) services. The Company has seven segments. Next-generation Mobility segment provides automotive engineering and mobility services. Project Management Design segment supports the development and testing of products, telecom, Web services, Internet of things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics services. Digital Integration segment develops financial, public and corporate systems and provides digital transformation (DX), infrastructure and consulting services. IT&DX Services segment provides project management, DX support, system and network operations, testing, help desk and IT outsourcing services. Business Solutions segment sells IT products and provides infrastructure, virtualization, robotic process automation (RPA) and business intelligence (BI) solutions. DX & Stock-type Business segment provides proprietary and cloud services. Other segment provides mobile technology and others.

name: NIFTY LIFESTYLE
businessSummary: NIFTY Lifestyle Co., Ltd. provides action support platforms and solutions in Japan. The company operates myhome.nifty.com, a real estate information service that allows searching for rental and purchased properties listed on various real estate sites  onsen.nifty.com, which offers hot spring facility information, such as one-day hot springs and super public baths, as well as hot spring information where user can search for coupons  and gaiheki-madoguchi.com, a platform service that allows to check the fair market price for exterior wall painting, as well as sumaisagashi-madoguchi.com, a housing search window. It also operates dm.niftylifestyle.co.jp/dfo, a data feed optimization solution tool for web advertisement placement used by recruitment, real estate, and travel sites, as well as operators of EC  giraffe-co.jp, a web advertising optimization solution tool for operators of e-commerce, job posting, real estate, and travel websites  and online-naiken.com, an online real estate preview solution tool specialized in real estate optimized for online previews, consultations, and IT emphasis. In addition, the company offers consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. NIFTY Lifestyle Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of NIFTY Corporation.

name: IZAWA TOWEL
businessSummary: Izawa Towel Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacturing, import/export, and sales of towel products in Japan. The company offers its products under the Towel Research Institute brand name. It serves convenience stores, entertainment companies, e-commerce businesses, discount stores, home centers, general merchandise stores, and drugstores. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: SEIKO EPSON
businessSummary: Seiko Epson Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the printing solutions business, visual communication business, as well as wearable and industrial products business. The Company has three business segments. The Printing Solutions Business segment includes office and home inkjet printers, serial impact dot matrix printers, page printers, color image scanners, dry office paper machines, and commercial and industrial inkjet printers, inkjet print heads and other products. The Visual Communications Business segment provides products such as liquid crystal projectors and smart glasses. The Manufacturing and Wearables Business segment provides products such as industrial robots, small injection molding machines, watches, watch movements, quartz devices, semiconductors, metal powders, and surface treatment processing.

name: NIHON KOHDEN
businessSummary: NIHON KOHDEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of medical electronic equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and repair services. The Company mainly operates medical electronics related business. The Company offers electroencephalograph, electromyographic, evoked potential testing equipment, electrocardiographs, cardiac catheterization equipment, diagnostic information systems and related consumables (paper, electrodes, catheters and others), biological information monitors, clinical information systems, artificial respiration, artificial ear, hemocytometer, ultrasonic diagnostic equipment, research equipment and transformers, among others. The Company is also engaged in the sales promotion for its products, as well as the general affair-related and manpower dispatching businesses.

name: SEKISUI JUSHI
businessSummary: Sekisui Jushi Corporation is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the transportation and landscape related products, sports facilities related products, living and construction products, integrated logistics materials related products business. The Company operates in two segments. The Public segment manufactures, processes and sells soundproof wall materials, traffic safety products, signs, thermal insulation pavement, protective fence, high field, shelter, artificial turf and others. The Private segment manufactures, process and sells mesh fences, artificial timber, meta color building materials, aluminum resin laminated composite boards, packaging bands, stretch films and others.

name: SHIN NIPPON BIOMEDICAL LABORATORIES
businessSummary: Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd., a contract research organization, engages in the pharmaceutical development, transactional research, and medipolis businesses in Japan and internationally. It offers non-clinical testing and non-clinical regulatory consulting for the development of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, or regenerative medicine products, including safety and pharmacology testing, and pharmacokinetic studies. The company also engages in licensing activities for proprietary products which utilize unique intranasal formulation delivery technology, discovery of future seeds, and business promotion activities  and development of artificial seed production for Japanese eels. In addition, it operates hotels accommodations facilities under the Villa Amafuru Oka and HOTEL Freesia names  and develops and operates geothermal and hot spring thermal power plants. Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Kagoshima, Japan.

name: NICHICON
businessSummary: Nichicon Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and production of electrical components in Japan, the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It offers chip aluminum electrolytic capacitors  conductive polymer aluminum solid electrolytic capacitors  conductive polymer hybrid aluminum solid electrolytic capacitors  large can aluminum electrolytic capacitors  and miniature aluminum electrolytic capacitors. The company also provides film capacitors for xEV  lithium titanate rechargeable batteries for use in space-constrained IoT applications  switching power supplies  capacitors for power utilities  special power supplies  and function modules. Its products are used in automotive, power supply and lighting, information and communications, industrial, DC link capacitors, asset tracking, energy harvesting, internet of things, wireless sensors, RFID, smart pallet, and pick to light applications. The company was formerly known as Nichicon Capacitor Ltd. and changed its name to Nichicon Corporation in October 1987. Nichicon Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

name: CYBERAGENT
businessSummary: CyberAgent Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media business, Internet advertising business, game business, investment development business and others. The Company operates in five business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the operation of ABEMA, a new television (TV) of the future, WINTICKET, an Internet voting service that allows users to watch live footage of bicycle and auto races and place bets online, the blog service Ameba, and tapple, a love-matching application that connects people through hobbies. The Internet Advertising segment is engaged in the advertising business, artificial intelligence (AI) business and others. The Game segment is engaged in the games business for smartphones. The Investment Development segment is engaged in the venture capital business. The Other segment is engaged in the crowdfunding management business.

name: ATOM LIVIN TECH
businessSummary: ATOM LIVIN TECH Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development and distribution of interior hardware products which focuses on furniture hardware and architectural hardware products. The Company sells its products to house makers, housing facility and equipment makers, architectural material manufacturers and architectural hardware stores under the brand name ATOM. The Company operates its business as a fabless manufacturer. The Company is engaged in the provision of door locks, hinges, sliding hinges, hinged doors, sliding door locks, sliding door hardware products, overhead hanging sliding door fittings, moving partition fittings, folding door fittings, indoor aluminum fittings, handles, slide rails, wire baskets, storage and hanging brackets and others. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: TO BOOKS
businessSummary: TO Books Inc is a Japan-based company that creates and develops intellectual property (IP). The Company operates an IP production structure that integrates IP discovery, editing, and comic book adaptation, as well as planning for audio, stage, and anime adaptations, and merchandise development. It also operates a reproducible creation model that starts with web novels, primarily discovering works from Web novels posted on free novel submission sites, and developing them into books and comic book adaptations. It employs an integrated production system for the creation, production, and development of audio content and the planning and production of stage and anime productions. It has sales channels that allow direct contact with readers and viewers through its official online store and official Web manga site, Corona EX.

name: MARUO CALCIUM
businessSummary: Maruo Calcium Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various types of calcium carbonate used in synthetic resins, paints, reinforcing fillers for rubber, and chemicals and food additives calcium carbonate and related business. The Company engages in the manufacture and sale of calcium carbonate, as well as related operations. The main products are compounded calcium carbonate and heavy calcium carbonate. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of inorganic chemicals such as talc and silica.

name: J MAX
businessSummary: J-MAX Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automobile body and precision press parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers automotive parts, including auto body, front pillar inner upper and middle, roof arch, and center pillar outer products  safety augmentation parts comprising front bumper beam  battery covers and cases, binding bars, and battery frames  and functional parts, including hood hinges and tailgate hinges. It also provides precision parts consisting of tamper springs, drum sun gears, planetary carriers, drum forward clutches, pulsar plates, and rotor pulsars  dies  and inspection jigs. The company serves to finished vehicle manufacturers, automotive parts suppliers, and automotive battery manufacturer. The company was formerly known as MARUJUN Co., Ltd. J-MAX Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Ogaki, Japan.

name: NS TOOL
businessSummary: NS Tool Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production and sale of end mills, which are cutting tools that are attached to machining centers (machine tools) to process metals. The Company operates in two business segments. End Mill segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cutting tools centering on carbide small-diameter end mills. Others segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic moldings focusing on tool cases. The product sizes include end mill (6mm or less), end mill (over 6mm), and end mill (others).

name: BULL DOG SAUCE
businessSummary: Bull-Dog Sauce Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells brown sauces and other seasonings in Japan. The company offers dressings and sauces under the Bull-Dog, and &Bull-Dog brand name. The company was formerly known as Bull-Dog Foods Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Bull-Dog Sauce Co., Ltd. in 1962. Bull-Dog Sauce Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: IKEGAMI TSUSHINKI
businessSummary: Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of broadcast equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers broadcast cameras, including studio and portable camera systems, digital cameras, HDTV camera systems, camera control units, base station, IP extension unit, fiber camera adaptors, OLED and LCD viewfinders, system expanders, operation control panels, portable viewfinder, tripod mounting plate, relay/broadcasting system/news gathering equipment, command converters, and helicopter tv system  medical equipment, such as output and medical grade cameras, LCD color monitors, and digital video recorders  inspection equipment, including tablet inspection equipment, color visual tablet inspection equipment  color powdered/granulated medicine inspection equipment, tablet inspection machine, inkjet tablet printing system, plane and single sheet visual, inspection equipment for checking surface of films, panels, and metal foils  and security camera systems. Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Ikegami Tsushinki Seisakusho and changed its name to Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. in 1951. Ikegami Tsushinki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is based in Ota, Japan.

name: NITCHITSU
businessSummary: NITCHITSU CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the machinery-related business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Machinery-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine equipment and industrial equipment, the installation and sale of mechanized equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of air preheaters and elements of air preheater. The Resource-related segment is engaged in the mining, processing and sale of crystalline limestone, the manufacture and sale of purified silica powders, the purchase and sale of siliceous sandstone, crushed stone, sand and gravel. The Real Estate-related segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings. The Materials-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat-resistant paints, and purchase, processing and sale of Linatex which is a high-purity natural rubber.

name: VITABRID JAPAN
businessSummary: Vitabrid Japan Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells wellness products. The company's products include face brightening powder, shampoo, wrinkle serum, wrinkle cream, cleansing balm, and age-defying and firming mask. It sells its products through the internet. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Vitabrid Japan Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Vector Inc.

name: NAKAYAMAFUKU
businessSummary: NAKAYAMAFUKU CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the wholesale business about household goods such as kitchen goods and dining goods, as well as the manufacture and sale business about horticulture and interior goods. The Company operates through five geographic segments including Hokkaido & Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kinki and Chugoku & Kyushu. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of kitchen goods, dining goods, sanitary goods, storage goods and season goods to retailers in Japan (home centers, supermarkets, mail order dealers, co-ops, specialty retailers). In addition, the Company is also engaged in the Internet mail order business, import and sale business of interior related products, as well as the manufacture and sale business of horticulture and interior goods.

name: MITSUBOSHI
businessSummary: MITSUBOSHI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of rubber electric wires, plastic electric wires, extruded synthetic resin products and electrical heating wires. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electric Wire segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of natural rubber-sheathed flexible cables, synthetic rubber-sheathed flexible cables, polyethylene cables, welding cables, control cables, plastic-sheathed flexible cables and plastic cords. The Polymatech segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of extruded synthetic plastic products, injection synthetic products, vacuum synthetic products and high performance tubes. The Electrical Heating Wire segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electrical heating wires and ribbons.

name: DKK TOA
businessSummary: DKK-TOA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in measurement instrument business and real estate leasing business. The Company operates its business through two business segments. Measurement Instrument Business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of environmental and process analysis instruments, scientific analysis instruments, industrial gas detection alarms, as well as electrodes and standard solutions. The segment also provides maintenance services. Real Estate Leasing Business segment owns one rental building adjacent to the Company in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo and conducts real estate leasing business.

name: NISSHINBO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nisshinbo Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the wireless and communications, microdevices, brakes and other businesses. The Company has seven business segments. The Wireless and Communication segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of wireless communication equipment. The Microdevice segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The Brake segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of friction materials for automobile brakes. The Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of mechatronics products and plastic molded products. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of rigid urethane foams, carbon products and others. The Textile segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cotton yarns, spandex products and clothing. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of real estate. The Company also sells food and industrial materials and provides telemedicine services.

name: G 7 HOLDINGS
businessSummary: G-7 Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the automobile, supermarket, and meat-related businesses in Japan. The company operates franchised store that provides car supplies under the AUTOBACS brand  and motorcycle specialty shops that offer motorcycle supplies, parts, and accessories, as well as repair and maintenance services under the Bike World brand name. It also operates supermarkets under the Gyomu Super and Rico's brand names  and Megumi no Sato, a farm shop. In addition, the company builds stores, including proposals for store design, designing interior facilities, and managing construction, as well as commercial facilities, stores, and environment and commercial spaces. Further, it engages in the wholesale, retail, and processed meat business  automobile export business  and planning, developing, producing, and selling food products. Additionally, the company offers frozen and processed foods  operates RJ market, an outlet shop, and curves, a fitness class for women  is involved in the specialty food, agriculture, mini supermarket, and real estate leasing businesses  import/export activities  and trades in trilateral. The company serves through online channels. G-7 Holdings Inc. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: FUKUI COMPUTER HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fukui Computer Holdings, Inc. is engaged in the development and sale of computer-aided design (CAD) software. It has two business segments. The Architecture CAD segment is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of architecture CAD software, as well as the provision of Web service and other software services. The Measurement Civil Engineering CAD segment is engaged in the development, sale and maintenance of measurement CAD software and civil engineering CAD software.

name: NAGAILEBEN
businessSummary: Nagaileben Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture, and sale of various medical wear, as well as shoes and other products. It sells medical wear used by medical professionals and caregivers, which are products that it plans and develops itself, supplied by its manufacturing subsidiary. For some medical wear, it purchases and sells products produced overseas and domestically from its manufacturing subsidiary and general business partners. It also purchases and sells shoes from general business partners.

name: WAIDA MFG
businessSummary: Waida MFG. Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Company develops, manufactures, sells, and repairs computer numerically controlled (CNC) grinders, mainly for the mold-related and cutting tool-related industries. Its main products and services include mold-related grinders, cutting tool-related grinders, other machinery, and after-sales services. Its mold-related grinders include form grinders and jig grinders. Its cutting tool-related grinders include indexable insert grinders and axial tool grinders. Its other machinery includes other metal processing machinery and auxiliary equipment. Its after-sales services include after-sales service, parts sales, and overhauls. The Company operates mainly in Japan, Mainland China, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, South Asia, the United States, Europe, Africa, and other regions.

name: HEIWA PAPER
businessSummary: HEIWA PAPER CO.,LTD. is engaged in the Japanese paper and Western paper wholesale business. The Japanese and Western paper wholesale business sells Japanese and Western paper. The warehousing and paper processing business is involved in the delivery, storage and packing of its products, as well as the paper processing business.

name: ASAHI DIAMOND INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: Asahi Diamond Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of diamond tools, as well as related business. It manufactures and sells diamond tools (including cubic boron nitride (CBN) tools and grinding wheels) mainly for the electronics and semiconductor, transportation equipment, machinery, stone and construction industries. The types of tools include grinding tools, precision cutting tools, cutting tools, wear-resistant tools, wire drawing tools and dressers. It distributes products mainly to Japan, Asia & Oceania, Europe, North America and Central America.

name: POLA ORBIS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Pola Orbis Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells cosmetics and related products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Beauty Care, Real Estate, and Others segments. The company offers beauty and health products under the POLA, ORBIS, Jurlique, THREE, DECENCIA, and FUJIMI brand names. It is also involved in the leasing of office buildings in urban areas, as well as management and operation of buildings. Pola Orbis Holdings Inc. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FABRICA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fabrica Holdings Co Ltd, formerly known as Fabrica Communications Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of the Internet service business centered on the used car sales business support cloud service symphony and the short message service (SMS) distribution platform Media SMS. The Company operates in four business segments. The U-CAR Solution Group segment is engaged in the provision of the used car sales business support cloud service symphony, as well as the support of businesses related to automobile after-sales service. The SMS Solution Group segment provides the SMS transmission service Media SMS for corporations. The Internet Service Group segment is engaged in the operation of automobile web magazines and the provision of used car batch assessment services. The Auto Service Group segment provides one-stop services for tow trucks and automobile maintenance business at designated factories.

name: FULLCAST HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fullcast Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the human resource outsourcing business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Short-term Business Support segment is engaged in the provision of short-term, events-related human resource services and payroll management service, among others. The Sales Support segment includes agency sales and call center business. The Security and Others segment is engaged in the security guard business for public facilities and general corporations.

name: QB NET HOLDINGS
businessSummary: QB Net Holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the hair cutting business in Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Canada, Taiwan, the United States, and internationally. It operates haircut specialty stores under the QB HOUSE, QB PREMIUM, and FaSS brand name  and engages in the franchise business. QB Net Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FOR STARTUPS
businessSummary: for Startups,Inc. provides talent agency services and acceleration services. Talent agency services mainly provide human resources support services to startup companies, and acceleration services mainly provide open innovation services to major companies. The Company operate Growth Industry Support business segment. Talent agency services include recruitment services, recruitment support services, and entrepreneur support services. Acceleration services include open innovation services and recruitment branding services, and operate the STARTUP DB.

name: NEIS
businessSummary: NEIS Co.,Ltd. operates as a franchisor and operator of children's gymnastics clubs. The company provides child development support and after-school day services and assists children with developmental disabilities. It also manufactures classroom equipment, apparel, and other goods. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. NEIS Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Minami no Shima Co., Ltd.

name: CHOFU SEISAKUSHO
businessSummary: Chofu Seisakusho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of water heaters, air-conditioning equipment, system equipment, as well as solar devices. The Company operates through the residential-related equipment manufacturing and sales business segment. Water heater products include oil-fired water heaters, oil bath boilers, gas water heaters, gas bath boilers, electric water heaters and EcoCute systems. Air-conditioning products include oil stoves, gas stoves, hot water heating systems, geothermal heat pumps and snow-melting systems. System equipment includes system baths, artificial marble bathtubs and system kitchens. Solar devices include solar water heaters, solar hot-water supply systems and solar-powered underfloor ventilation fans.

name: EZAKI GLICO
businessSummary: Ezaki Glico Co., Ltd.is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products. The Company operates in five business segments. Confectionery & Food segment provides chocolate, gum, biscuits, snacks, curry roux, and retort products. Frozen Confectionery segment provides ice creams and other products. Dairy Products segment provides milk beverages and Western confectionery. Food Ingredients segment provides starch and pigments. Overseas segment provides confectionery and frozen desserts in other countries. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of health-related foods, the sale of confectionery in office, as well as the maintenance and development of information systems.

name: IZUMI
businessSummary: IZUMI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general retail business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Retail segment is engaged in the sale of clothing, housing-related goods and food products through its shopping centers, general merchandise stores (GMSs) and supermarkets. The Retail-related segment is engaged in the credit and finance business, the management of shop facilities, as well as the operation of restaurants. The Company is also engaged in the wholesale business and the real estate leasing business.

name: PROPERTY TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Property Technologies Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides technology solutions and other housing-related services in Japan. It offers KAITRY, a platform with AI assessment model for the purchase and sale of used housing, used detached housing, and renovated used housing, as well as used condominiums. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: YAMATO KOGYO
businessSummary: Yamato Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. It operates through four segments. The Steel (Japan) segment manufactures and sells H-beams, channel steel, I-beams, steel sheet piles, checkered H-beams, shipbuilding steel, castings, ship canning products, and heavy machinery processed products. The Steel (Thailand) segment manufactures and sells H-beams, channel steel, I-beams, and steel sheet piles. The Steel (Indonesia) segment manufactures and sells H-beams, channel steel, and equal-leg angle steel. The Track Supplies segment processes and sells turnouts, expansion joints, non-gap electron beam welded (NEW) crossings, adhesive insulated rails, derailment prevention guards, tie plates, and bolts. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of counterweights, transportation, medical waste disposal, and real estate businesses.

name: TOC
businessSummary: TOC Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates through the Real Estate Business and the Linen Supply and Laundry Business segments. The company is involved in the leasing, management, and operation of rental showrooms, exhibition halls, conference rooms, and parking lots  rental and cleaning of various textile products such as yukata and sheets, as well as hotel, restaurant, and sports linens  and provision of laundry services. It also engages in the pharmaceutical business, which involves manufacture and sale of gastrointestinal medicines and health foods  sports club and hot spring facility businesses  building management related services provides interior construction work, vending machines, and other equipment  insurance agency business  and information processing related business. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: EM SYSTEMS
businessSummary: EM Systems Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, sells, and maintains various IT systems for pharmacies, clinics, and care/welfare other business in Japan. The company operates through Dispensing Systems Business, Medical Systems Business, Nursing Care/Welfare System Business, and Other Business segments. It develops and sells IT systems for pharmacies, such as medical fee receipt computers and electronic medication record systems  IT systems for clinics, including medical accounting and electronic medical record systems  and office processing systems for care/welfare providers. In addition, the company offers staffing, pharmacy management, cashless, and development and operation of statistical information analysis services. EM Systems Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

name: FINE SINTER
businessSummary: Fine Sinter Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automobile parts, railway vehicle parts, and hydraulic units worldwide. It offers automotive parts, including engine, drivetrain, motor-related, shock absorber, and other automotive parts that are used in engines, transmissions, steering systems, and various sensors. The company also offers parts for railway vehicles, such as piston rod packing, collecting contact strip, grounding brush, and brake lining products  and parts for industrial machinery comprising flanges, sintered vents, spherical seats, bushing families, and hydraulic parts for construction machinery, as well as copiers, cameras, electric tools, and others. In addition, it provides hydraulic unit products for medical field comprising chairs, operating tables, diagnostic imaging equipment, and others. Fine Sinter Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kasugai, Japan.

name: CRASUS CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Crasus Chemical Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the petrochemical business. The Company operates through petrochemical business segment, which is divided into four businesses based on product type including olefins, organic chemicals, synthetic resins, and other businesses. The olefins business, centered on naphtha, produces and sells basic petrochemical products such as ethylene, propylene, and butadiene. The organic chemicals business produces derivatives such as ethyl acetate, vinyl acetate, and allyl alcohol, using basic products like ethylene and propylene as raw materials, and sells them to domestic and overseas customers. The synthetic resins business produces polypropylene with properties through polymerization processes that react polypropylene under high temperature and pressure using catalysts, and granulation processes that add additives to create rice-grain-shaped pellets. The other businesses supply utilities such as electricity, steam, and water.

name: EARTH
businessSummary: Earth Corporation engages in the manufacture, marketing, import, and export of pharmaceutical products, quasi-drugs, medical tools, and household products in Japan and internationally. It operates in two segments, Household Products Business, and Comprehensive Environmental Hygiene Business. It provides household insect control products  gardening supplies  daily necessities, such as mouthwash, denture-related products, toothpaste products, bath salts, deodorant air fresheners, etc.  pet products  epidemic prevention/agricultural, forestry, and livestock chemicals  and raw materials. The company also offers various insects and rodent control, cleaning, and cleaning services to hospitals, restaurants, and office buildings. It markets its products under the Earth Red, Earth No-mat, Earth Jet, Earth Mosquito Coil, Saratect, Gokiburi Hoi-Hoi, Goki Jet Pro, Black Cap, Earth Mushi Yoke Net EX, Mondahmin, Bath Roman, Onpo, Pirepara Earth, Sukki-ri!, Earth Garden, Polident, Aquafresh, and other brand names. Earth Corporation was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ONE CAREER
businessSummary: ONE CAREER Inc. engages in the career data platform business. The company operates ONECAREER, a media that supports new graduate recruitment, as well as combines content that gathers information on job-hunting experiences  ONE CAREER PLUS, a job-seeking website  and ONE CAREER CLOUD to support the promotion of digital transformation in recruitment activities. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TRIPLA
businessSummary: Tripla Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the hospitality solution business.
