The Company provides information technology (IT) services for accommodation facilities including tripla Book, tripla Bot, tripla Connect, and tripla Pay. tripla Book is a cloud-based official Website reservation system for accommodation facilities. tripla Bot is a service that displays a chatbot on the official Website of accommodation facilities, and automatically answers questions from users (guests) using artificial intelligence (AI) developed in-house. tripla Connect is a customer relationship management (CRM) and marketing automation (MA) tool specialized for accommodation facilities. tripla Pay is a service that provides a local payment system specifically for accommodation facilities.

name: JAPAN EYEWEAR HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Japan Eyewear Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of eyeglasses through its subsidiaries. The Company operates in two business segments. The Kaneko Optical Business segment encompasses the businesses of each brand category under the Kaneko Optical brand and provides fashionable eyeglasses based on trends. The Four Nines business segment encompasses business by brand category under the Four Nines brand, designs and sells luxury brand eyeglasses, and has an sales network of directly managed stores and dealers.

name: SANRIO
businessSummary: Sanrio Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engages in character licensing, planning and sales of gift products, and theme park operations. The Company is comprised of five regional segments: Japan, Europe, North America, South America, and Asia. The main activities of character licensing are the licensing and management of merchandising rights. The main activities of planning and sales of gift products are the planning and sales of gift products, greeting cards, and publications, as well as the production and sale of video software. The main activities of the theme park business are the operation of theme parks and the planning and performance of musicals. The main activities of other businesses include the sale and rental of robots, rental of automobiles, and non-life insurance agency services.

name: INVINCIBLE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Invincible Investment Corp is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to manage its assets primarily through investment in real estate and other assets and achieve steady growth and securing stable profits from a medium- to long-term perspective. The Fund mainly invests in real estate in capital region (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba and Saitama prefectures), designated cities, major cities across the country and their surrounding areas, as well as overseas. Its property portfolio includes Nisshin Palacestage Daitabashi, Growth Maison Gotanda, Growth Maison Kameido, AEON TOWN Sukagawa, Hotel MyStays Kanda, Hotel MyStays Asakusa, Hotel MyStays Kyoto-Shijo and others. The asset manager of the Fund is Consonant Investment Management Co Ltd.

name: FUJITA KANKO
businessSummary: Fujita Kanko Inc. engages in the tourism business in Japan and internationally. The company operates a portfolio of hotels, wedding and banquet venues, restaurants, and leisure facilities. It also provides supplementary services, such as hotel room cleaning, flower provision and arrangement, garden care and landscaping, and photography. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ARENT
businessSummary: Arent Inc. engages in the development of SaaS based solutions for construction industry in Japan. It offers Lightning BIM software for architecture and structure industry  PlantStream software for plant/piping and plants/process applications  PROCOLLA, a cloud-based progress management system  BizGenie, a generative AI platform, PlantStream Aide, a plant piping design  BUILD, a structural design  Genba Navi Progress Management, a process management, Genba Navi 3D Rebar, a reinforcement design  Shinsei-kun F Series, an administrative registration  Dot Genka Series, a cost management system  Tsukaeru Cloud Construction Ledger  Tsukaeru Cloud Work Attendance Management  and Let's Cost Management Go2 Series. It also provides consulting and system development services. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: M UP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: m-up holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in planning, producing and operating Websites and providing content for smartphones, other mobile devices and personal computers (PCs). The Company has two segments. Content segment provides paid content for smartphones and PCs, distributes smartphone applications and sells artist merchandise, compact discs (CDs) and other packaged products online. Electronic Ticket segment provides electronic tickets, ticket trading and related services for smartphones. Other activities are engaged in the subsidiary operations, include korean artist fan club sites, cross-border electronic commerce (EC) intermediation, planning, sales and production, virtual reality (VR) planning, production and sales, artist fan sites and fan clubs, applications and services that enhance fan engagement for professional sports teams and artists, investment in companies and funds, and operation and management of the DearU bubble platform service in Japan.

name: JAPAN SYSTEM TECHNIQUES
businessSummary: Japan System Techniques Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the software business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Software segment is engaged in the development of software that is tailor-made to meet the individual needs of customers. The GAKUEN segment is engaged in the development and sale of school business reform packages and related services. The System Sale segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of information technology (IT) equipment, hardware and software, as well as the building of information and communication infrastructure. The Medical Big Data segment provides services for automatic inspection, analysis, and notification of medical expenses for receipts.

name: CYBOZU
businessSummary: Cybozu Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of software. It is primarily engaged in the development and license sales of groupware, the provision of software as a service (SaaS), cloud-based groupware, and internet services, and the provision of high-value-added system integration (SI). Its software products include Kintone, Cybozu Office, Garoon, and Mailwise.

name: MAX
businessSummary: Max Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial, office, and HCR equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers pneumatic nailers, hand tackers, screw driving machines, staples, nails, screws, air compressors, laser markers, rebar tying tools, battery-operated wire mesh cutter, pin insertion machines for concrete, gas nailers, hammer drills, battery-operated impact drivers, battery-operated pin nailers, vegetable binders, tape binding tools, bag closing machines, battery-operated pruning scissors, heater-ventilator-dryers for bathrooms, 24-hour ventilation systems, floor heating systems, disposer systems, and residential fire alarms. It also provides staplers, staples, paper-made staple staplers, electronic staplers, electric staple removers, auto staplers, automatic binding machines, numbering machines, punches, stamp pads, red ink pads, time recorders, timecards, checkwriters, sign-making machines, label printers, tube markers, signboard creation software, signboard creation machines, and parallel rulers. In addition, the company offers HCR equipment, such as wheelchairs and other welfare equipment. The company was formerly known as Max Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Max Co., Ltd. in 1964. Max Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: U NEXT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. provides entertainment services. It operates through five segments: Content Distribution Business, Store Services Business, Communications Business, Business Systems Business, and Energy Business. It offers video distribution services  and provides, sells, and installs store solutions, including music distribution, as well as develops and manages music copyrights. The company also provides business management services for hotels, hospitals, golf courses, etc., as well as develops, manufactures, and sells management systems and automatic payment machines. In addition, it provides electricity to stores, buildings, and commercial facilities  sells high and low voltage electricity and gas  and provides green energy. The company was formerly known as USEN-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in April 2024. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. U-NEXT HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of UNO-HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.

name: HIDAY HIDAKA
businessSummary: Hiday Hidaka Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of a chain of restaurants that mainly serve ramen, gyoza, and Chinese cuisine. It operates stores called Hidakaya, a name derived from its name. Menu items include Chuka Soba and Yasai Tappuri Tanmen. Stores with the Hidakaya name include two variations, including Chuka Soba Hidakaya and Chuka Shokudo Hidakaya. Rairaiken is included in the Hidakaya category as its menu is highly similar to that of Chuka Shokudo Hidakaya. Other store formats include Chinese restaurant Chuka Ichiban, yakitori restaurant Yakitori Hidaka, izakaya restaurant Taisho Sakaba Hidaka, snack and set meal restaurant Taisho Shokudo Hidaka, Taiwanese street food restaurant Yatai Ryori Tainan, and chicken white soup restaurant Ramen Hidaka.

name: S&J
businessSummary: S&J Corporation provides cybersecurity services in Japan. The company operates through SOC service and Consulting Service segments. The company offers security monitoring solutions, including SOC outsourcing, active directory monitoring service, monitoring service for Microsoft 365 E5, professional services for Microsoft 365 E5, My SOC 365 service, Darktrace alert analysis and monitoring service, KeepEye, keepEye RansomSafe, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and Apex One. It also provides security assessment solutions, such as web application diagnostics, API diagnostics, smartphone app diagnostics, platform diagnosis, AWS/Azure/GCP configuration diagnostics, web AI diagnosis, and tack surface management. In addition, the company offers consulting services related to security advisory, security evaluation, security assessment quick assessment, suspicious email training, CSIRT construction and operation support services, and support services for the Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry's SCS evaluation system. Further, it offers security measures solutions comprising CrowdStrike, Joe Sandbox, and BlueVoyant. Additionally, the company provides corporate security personnel development course and incident response training service  and incident response, support, and investigation services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Minato, Japan.

name: VALUENEX JAPAN
businessSummary: VALUENEX Japan Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in algorithm business. The Company includes ASP service, which provides analysis tool for big data based on algorithm, as well as consulting service and sale of report. The ASP type license service consists of TechRadar Scope, TechRadar Vision and DocRadar. The consulting service includes research consulting and coaching. The research consulting is performed by using TechRadar and DocRadar technology on research and analysis according to customer's request. The coaching is engaged in nurturing human resources for information analysis for customer.

name: CYPRESS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. operates and manages a food store that offers various Japanese food brands in Japan. The company provides seafood, sushi, yakitori, noodles, fast food, western food, Chinese food, and cafes. It offers its products under the Tsukiji Shokudo Genchan brand name. Cypress Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Minato, Japan.

name: BRONCO BILLY
businessSummary: BRONCO BILLY Co.,LTD. engages in the restaurant business in Japan. Its restaurant is involved in the production of steaks, hamburgers, sauces, dressings, cakes, and gelato, as well as seasonings and side dishes. The company also offers pork cutlets, tonkatsu, alcohol, meat, and Obanzai. BRONCO BILLY Co.,LTD. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: TOBILA SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Tobila Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the junk information filter business and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Junk Information Filter segment develops Tobilaphone to prevent malicious nuisance calls and fraudulent phone calls, and utilizes the Tobiraphone phone number database and nuisance phone number analysis algorithm to provide applications and services for mobile terminals such as smartphones and feature phones and fixed lines, selling TobiraphoneBiz for optical lines for corporate customers, developing products and services for unwanted information filters. It provides three kinds of services, including mobile filter service, fixed phone filter service, and business phone filter service. The Other Business segment is engaged in the sale of Website production management support system HP4U and commissioned development of systems.

name: JAC RECRUITMENT
businessSummary: JAC Recruitment Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the recruitment business both domestically and internationally. It operates through three business segments including Domestic Recruitment Business, Domestic Recruitment Advertising Business, and Overseas Business. Recruitment business introduces candidates, primarily for permanent positions, to companies seeking employees, and serves as an intermediary for international recruitment, meeting various domestic and international human resources needs. Recruitment advertising business posts job postings, primarily for permanent positions, received from companies seeking employees on the recruitment advertising Website CareerCross, and works to acquire recruitment advertisements primarily from foreign and Japanese companies requiring bilingual personnel.

name: TOMY
businessSummary: TOMY Company, Ltd. plans, together with its subsidiaries, plans, manufactures, and sells toys, toy-related products, and baby products in Japan, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania. The company offers various toy products, including cars, miniature cars, trains, dolls, fashion, role-playing items, house play, capsule toys, amusement machines, trading card games, hobby products, pretend play, care, plush toys, educational toys, robots, figures, transformation/combination, collectibles, card games, trading card games, battle, game, app games, programming, blocks, edutainment, English, drawing, making toys, communication, party, toy smartphone, toy PCs, eco toys, and accessible-design toys brands such as Tomica, Plarail, Licca-chan, Beyblade, and Transformers under brands such as Tomica, Plarail, Licca-chan, Beyblade, and Transformers. It also provides general merchandise and baby care products. In addition, the company engages in real estate rental activities. TOMY Company, Ltd. was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Katsushika, Japan.

name: NORTHSAND
businessSummary: Northsand, Inc. provides IT consulting and business consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers various services from IT strategy and planning to implementation and operations, including design considerations and reducing IT operating costs. It also provides business improvement, strategy formulation, and execution support in non-IT areas, such as marketing, sales, and human resources  and provision of Notion services. Northsand, Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Chuo, Japan.

name: CELSYS
businessSummary: CELSYS Inc, formerly ArtSpark Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business management of subsidiaries that plans, develops, sells, licenses, and maintains and manages computer software and peripherals, as well as related businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The Creator Support segment promotes the research and development and practical application of graphic technology, and expands the product lineup that supports new content production techniques and new devices. The User Interface (UI)/User Experience (UX) segment develops products centered on the in-vehicle software development platform CGI Studio and the UI authoring software group UIConductor, with a focus on the automotive (four-wheel and two-wheel) sector.

name: OTSUKA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Otsuka Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in medical, nutraceutical, consumer and other business activities in Japan and overseas. The Company operates in four business segments. The Medical Business segment produces and sells therapeutic drugs and infusions. The Nutraceutical segment produces and sells functional beverages, quasi-drugs and nutritional supplements. The Consumer Products segment produces and sells mineral water, beverages and food products. The Others segment manufactures paper containers, manufactures synthetic resin molded products, stores products, provides storage space, and produces and sells chemicals and liquid crystal evaluation equipment, spectroscopic analysis equipment, and other products.

name: VISIONAL
businessSummary: Visional Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the incubation and HR Tech business. The Company operates through two business segments. The HR Tech segment operates BIZREACH, a professional human resource platform, HRMOS platform that enables the utilization of human resources based on evidence by centralizing and visualizing information from hiring to success after joining the companies, Careertrek, a job change site, Bizreach Campus, a visit network service, BINAR, a career change platform, and Stanby, a job search engine. The Incubation segment analyzes the industry structure and trends in the leading markets and conducts new businesses in areas with market potential that can promote digital transformation. It provides TRABOX, a logistics digital transformation (DX) platform, BizReach SUCCEED, a business succession merger and acquisition (M&A) platform, BizHint, a business-to-business (B2B) lead generation platform, and yamory, an open source vulnerability management cloud.

name: CORE CONCEPT TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Core Concept Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. The main business of the Company is to support the digital transformation of the manufacturing and construction industries by combining consulting capabilities and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The company is also engaged in the supply of support for other industries, such as wholesale, retail, and information and communications, as well as digitization (adding new value through digital technology) support, customized Salesforce implementation support, and IT engineer procurement support.

name: LIVING TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Living Technologies Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of real estate platform. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of matching services and branding services. The matching services are mainly engaged in the provision of real estate sale services, rental management services, renovations services, custom housings services, recruitment services and other Internet matching services for end users and member companies. The branding services are mainly engaged in the provision of advertisings services through Livin Match which is a vertical media operated by the Company to offer real estate companies comparison, as well as the advertisings sale services of other Internet advertising medias.

name: TOYOKUMO
businessSummary: Toyokumo Inc is mainly engaged in the development and sale of cloud services for corporations. The Company provides two types of services, including the development and sales of safety confirmation service, which is a cloud service designed to easily share information in an emergency, and kintone linkage service, a cloud service in cooperation with kintone, a business application construction service. The safety confirmation service is a cloud service that confirms the safety of employees and others in the event of a disaster using mobile phones, smartphones, and personal computers. The kintone linkage services include services such as print creator, form bridge, kBackup, kViewer, kMailer, time stamp for kintone and data collect, among others.

name: FUJIBO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fujibo Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells polishing pads, industrial chemical products, and apparel products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three Abrasives Business, Chemical Industrial Products Business, and Life Clothing Business segments. It provides POLYPAS polishing pads for precision polishing of silicon wafers, as well as for various types of semiconductor materials, metals, and glasses  fine chemical intermediates, spinning, textiles and apparel  and functional non-woven fabrics, functional films, non-woven polyester fabrics and artificial leathers. The company offers organic synthesis intermediates to produce raw materials for medicines, agricultural chemicals, electronic materials, and functional chemicals  and functional fibers, spun yarns, and knitted fabrics. In addition, it is involved in the business of injection molding of digital cameras, medical equipment, and automobile parts. Fujibo Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NICHIAS
businessSummary: Nichias Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of heat insulating and sealing materials for plants and housing, fluororesin products, filter products and others. The Company operates in five segments. The Construction and Sales for Plants segment is engaged in the construction and maintenance of hot insulation works, fire-retardant works, soundproofing works and disaster prevention works. The Industrial Products segment is engaged in the provision of gasket packing, fluorine resin products, heat insulating materials and filters. The Advanced Product segment offers pipes and machinery for handling heat, liquid chemicals and gas. The Automobile Parts segment offers cylinder head gaskets and other parts. The Construction Material segment offers noncombustible matters and adiabatic materials.

name: ROUND ONE
businessSummary: Round One Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the comprehensive amusement business. The Company operates through Japan and United States two geographic segments. The Company is engaged in the operation of indoor leisure complex with bowling alleys, arcade games, karaoke, billiards, and Spo-Cha (a sports-themed facility with time-based admission). The Company also operates indoor complex leisure facilities in China, operates food and beverage businesses in the United States, and sells prizes.

name: TWOSTONE&SONS
businessSummary: TWOSTONE&Sons Inc. engages in the IT service business in Japan. It offers engineer matching services, in-house production consulting, branding career services, web marketing consulting, M&A advisory, and closed ASP services  engineer recruitment services, programming education services, strategic consulting, IT consulting, and B2C platform services  contract development services, carecon, engineer platform services  and strategic consulting, B2C platform services, and war consulting services. TWOSTONE&Sons Inc. was formerly known as Branding Engineer CO.,LTD. and changed its name to TWOSTONE&Sons Inc. in June 2023. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: CUYEMURA &
businessSummary: C.Uyemura & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in surface finishing materials, surface finishing machinery, plating processing and real estate leasing. The Company has four segments. Surface Finishing Materials segment mainly manufactures and sells plating chemicals and sells industrial chemicals and nonferrous metals, including plating chemicals for printed circuit boards and aluminum magnetic disks. Surface Finishing Machinery segment mainly manufactures, purchases and sells plating machinery for printed circuit boards and aluminum magnetic disks. Plating Processing segment provides plating processing for plastics and printed circuit boards. Real Estate Leasing segment leases office buildings, condominiums and industrial land.

name: SRS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of Japanese food restaurant in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Washoku Sato, Tendon & Tempura Honpo Santen, Nigiri CHOJIRO, Miyamoto Munashi, Katsuya, Kazokutei, Umaihirekan, Tokutoku, Himawari, Torisho, Gyuno Fuku, and Karayama brand names, as well as operates a Japanese traditional café under the Meotozenzai name. The company was formerly known as Sato Restaurant Systems Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. in October 2017. SRS Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: OPEN UP GROUP
businessSummary: Open Up Group Inc, former BeNext-Yumeshin Group Co, is a Japan-based company engaged in human resource services, mainly dispatching engineers and business contracting. The Company operates in four business segments. The Mechanical and Electrical, Information Technology (IT) Domain segment consists of mechanical, electrical and electronic engineers such as development, design and manufacturing technology at domestic manufacturers, and construction and development of networks, servers, software at IT companies. Dispatch and contract work by IT engineers for operation system. The Construction Domain segment mainly dispatches construction management engineers and computer-aided design (CAD) engineers to companies in the domestic construction industry. The Manufacturing Domain segment mainly dispatches and outsources work in the manufacturing process for domestic manufacturers. The Overseas Domain segment is engaged in dispatch, recruitment, and personnel consulting.

name: GLORY
businessSummary: Glory Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of currency processing equipment, and the provision of electronic payment services and face recognition solutions. The Company has four business segments. Financial Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic financial institutions, original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and others. Distribution and Transportation Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic supermarkets, department stores, security transport companies, railway companies, tobacco manufacturers, hospitals, local governments and companies. Amusement Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to domestic amusement halls. Overseas Market segment is engaged in the sale and maintenance of products to overseas financial institutions, security transport companies, retail stores, casinos and OEMs. It also provides unmanned payment system solutions.

name: NITTO DENKO
businessSummary: Nitto Denko Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the industrial tape business, the optronics business and the life science business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Industrial Tapes segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of basic functional materials such as bonding materials and protective materials, as well as automotive materials. The Optronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of information functional materials, printed circuits and process materials. The Human Life Science segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of nucleic acid contract manufacturing, nucleic acid synthesis materials, nucleic acid drug discovery, medical-related materials and other life sciences, membranes such as polymer separation membranes, and personal care materials such as functional films for hygiene materials. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of new businesses and other products.

name: MONOGATARI
businessSummary: Monogatari Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurant business through direct management and franchise. The Company mainly operates large suburban-type restaurants in Japan under the brand name of Yakiniku Kingu, Marugen Ramen, Marugen II, Aged Soy Sauce Ramen Kyabeton, Okonomiyaki Honpo, Sushi & Shabu Shabu Yuzuan, Fish & Shellfish Samai Genya, Shabu Kani Genji So Honten, Gyutan Loving Yakiniku Happii, Aged Yakiniku Niku Gen, Yakitate Karubi, Kajitsuya Coffee and Thick Chinese Soba Gyoza Marufuku. The Company also operates a franchise business that collects royalties, franchise fees, and outsourcing fees from franchisees on a percentage-of-sales basis.

name: SAIZERIYA
businessSummary: Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan, Australia, Indonesia and Asia. It operates Italian wine and cafe restaurants under the Saizeriya brand name. Saizeriya Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Yoshikawa, Japan.

name: DAITO TRUST CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Daito Trust Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive services through building leasing businesses. It operates through four business segments. Real Estate Leasing Segment engages in bulk leasing, brokerage, and leasing of real estate, provision of rental property information, guarantor services for tenants of rental properties, and others. Construction Segment proposes plans for effective land utilization, concludes construction contracts, carries out design and construction and others. Real Estate Development Segment engages in the development and sales of logistics facilities, hotels and others. Financial Segment includes construction financing, trust services, consulting services, sales of insurance for landlords and tenants and others. Other businesses include the sale of fuel (liquefied petroleum (LP) gas), operation of day care centers and childcare facilities, provision of home care and nursing services and others.

name: SKYLARK HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Skylark Holdings Co Ltd, former Skylark Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the restaurant business and also engaged in the development of businesses such as food sales and support for group companies. In the restaurant business, in addition to developing family restaurants and buffets in Japan and selling food products, The Company also develops restaurants overseas. The restaurant brands include Gusto, Bamiyan, Syabuyo, Jonathan's, Yumean, Steak Gusto, Karayoshi, Aiya, Musashi No Mori Coffee, Grazie Gardens, Totoyamichi, chawan, Tonkaratei, La Ohana and others. Other businesses include food sales, food delivery, store cleaning and maintenance, store product delivery, and linen supply support businesses for group companies.

name: SUMITOMO ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Sumitomo Electric Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and servicing of business products related to environmental energy. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Environment and Energy-related Business segment provides electrical conductive products, wires, cables, and equipment for power transmission and distribution. The Information and Communication Related Business segment provides optical fiber cables, communication cables and equipment, optical fusion splicers. The Automotive Business segment provides network and system products such as wire harnesses, anti-vibration rubber and automotive hoses. The Electronics-related Business segment provides electronic wires, electron irradiation products, and flexible printed circuits. The Industrial Materials & Others segment provides steel wires for precision springs, steel cords, carbide tools, sintered parts, and semiconductor heatspreader substrates.

name: YOKOGAWA ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Yokogawa Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of control equipment. The Company operates in three segments. The Control segment provides comprehensive solutions ranging from on-site sensors such as flow meters, differential pressure/pressure transmitters, and process analyzers to production control systems, programmable controllers, industrial recorders, and various software to improve productivity and services to minimize plant life cycle costs. The Measuring Instruments segment provides waveform measuring instruments, optical communication-related measuring instruments, signal generators, and power, temperature, and pressure measuring instruments. The New Business and Others segment provides services utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI), manufacture and sales of biomass materials, and research, development, and contract manufacturing of bulk pharmaceuticals and other products.

name: MITSUI KINZOKU
businessSummary: Mitsui Kinzoku Co Ltd, formerly Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in functional materials business, metal business, mobility business and others. The Company operates in four segments. The Functional Materials segment provides copper foils such as ultra-thin copper foils with carriers and electrolytic copper foils for plant wiring boards, functional powders such as metal powders for electronic materials and tantalum oxide, battery materials such as hydrogen storage alloys, sputtering targets such as indium tin oxide, and ceramic products. The Metals segment manufactures and sells zinc, lead, copper, gold, and silver, as well as engages in resource recycling. The Mobility segment manufactures and sells exhaust gas purification catalysts, automotive door locks, die-casting products, and powder metallurgy products. The Other segment manufactures and sells drawn copper products and pearlite products, as well as engages in industrial plant engineering.

name: SAGAMI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sagami Holdings Corporation develops and operates a chain of Japanese and noodle restaurants in Japan, Vietnam, and Italy. It operates restaurants under the Sagami, Ajino Mingei, Don Don An, Aiso-Ya, CHOSUKE, NIDAIME CHOSUKE, SUIZAN, JINJIN, SAGAMI, BINMUGI, BUBUKA, Sagami Issha, SAGAMI VIETNAM, and SAGAMI Milano Centrale names. The company is also involved in the management of restaurants  manufacturing, processing, and sale of noodles  franchise business  management of overseas outlets  management of the Tenobe Udon specialty restaurant, Ajino-Mingei restaurant, and other specialty restaurant chains  manufacture, processing, sale, and import/export of ingredients, food and restaurant-related materials, cut vegetables, sauces and soups, and delicatessen  provision of sales support and business promotion services  and product development work. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: VALTES HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Valtes Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Valtes Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly provides software testing services, web/mobile application development services, and offshore services. The Company operates through three segments. The Software Testing Services segment provides manufacturers and software vendor clients with effective testing services from a third-party neutral standpoint by accurately following up on a wide range of activities, including test planning, test design, test case creation, test execution, and test summary reports. The Web/Mobile Application Development Services segment provides web/mobile app development and web security diagnosis (vulnerability diagnosis) for web apps and mobile apps. In the Offshore Services segment, the Company's group company, VALTES Advanced Technology, Inc. provides testing services and contracted system development to support client companies in improving the quality of their products by sharing its know-how with group companies.

name: SUMITOMO
businessSummary: Sumitomo Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in diversified business activities in response to the diverse needs of its customers. The Company operates in nine segments. The Steel segment handles steel pipes and products. The Automotive segment trades vehicles, tires, and related items. The Transportation & Construction Systems segment deals with ships, aircraft, and construction machinery. The Infrastructure & Urban Development segment covers real estate, construction materials, logistics, insurance, and infrastructure. The Media & Digital segment provides digital solutions and telecom infrastructure. The Lifestyle segment includes retail, food, and healthcare business. The Mineral Resources segment engages in development, production, and trading of metals and derivatives. The Chemicals, Electronics & Agriculture segment handles plastics, chemicals, and agrochemicals. The Energy Transformation segment engages in infrastructure business.

name: MEC
businessSummary: MEC Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for electronic substrates and electronic components, as well as the sale of machinery and materials for electronic substrates. Through six segments, namely Japan, Taiwan, Zhuhai (China), Suzhou (China), Thailand, and Europe, the Company develops, manufactures, and sells chemicals for manufacturing electronic substrates and electronic components, and sells related machinery and materials. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals for electronic substrates and electronic components, including adhesion enhancers, etching agents, and other surface treatment agents, machinery for electronic substrates, including chemical treatment machinery and various pre- and post-treatment machinery, the sale of materials for electronic substrates, including copper foil and dry film, and the provision of machinery repair services.

name: J FRONT RETAILING
businessSummary: J.Front Retailing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the department store business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Department Store segment is engaged in the sale of apparel, general merchandise, household goods, foodstuffs, and others. The Shopping Center (SC) segment develops, manages, administers, and operates shopping centers. The Developer segment develops, manages, and operates real estate, and conducts interior decoration work and others. The Payment and Finance segment is engaged in the issuance and operation of credit cards. The Company is also engaged in wholesale trade, parking lot business, and leasing business.

name: FUJI ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Fuji Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in business activities such as product development, production, sales, and services in the fields of energy, industry, semiconductors and food distribution. The Company operates through four segments. The Energy Segment provides geothermal power generation, hydroelectric power generation, thermal power generation, fuel cells, substation equipment, power storage systems, energy management systems. The Industry Segment provides products and services such as inverters, measuring instruments, sensors, drive control and measurement control systems, nuclear power related equipment, radiation equipment and systems, drive systems and door systems for rolling stock, systems for ships and harbors. The Semiconductor segment provides power semiconductors for industrial and automotive applications. The Food Distribution segment provides beverage vending machines, food and goods vending machines, store equipment, and money machines.

name: SONY GROUP
businessSummary: Sony Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the games & network services (G&NS), music, movies, entertainment technology & services (ET&S), imaging & sensing solutions (I&SS) and other businesses. It has seven business segments. G&NS segment is involved in network service business, the manufacture and sale of home video game consoles and software. The Music segment mainly includes music production, music publishing and video media platform businesses. The Movies segment mainly includes film production, television program production and media network businesses. The ET&S field mainly includes the television business, audio, video business, still image, video camera business, smartphone business and Internet-related service business. The I&SS segment mainly includes the image sensor business. The Financial segment is involved in the insurance business and banking business. The Other segment consists of activities such as disc manufacturing business and recording media business.

name: SONY GROUP
businessSummary: Sony Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the games & network services (G&NS), music, movies, entertainment technology & services (ET&S), imaging & sensing solutions (I&SS) and other businesses. It has seven business segments. G&NS segment is involved in network service business, the manufacture and sale of home video game consoles and software. The Music segment mainly includes music production, music publishing and video media platform businesses. The Movies segment mainly includes film production, television program production and media network businesses. The ET&S field mainly includes the television business, audio, video business, still image, video camera business, smartphone business and Internet-related service business. The I&SS segment mainly includes the image sensor business. The Financial segment is involved in the insurance business and banking business. The Other segment consists of activities such as disc manufacturing business and recording media business.

isin: 8179.T|ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.|8179.T|ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.
name: ROYAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates a chain of restaurants in Japan. It operates through Restaurant Business  Contract Business  Hotel Business  Food Business  and Others segments. The company operates restaurants under the Royal Host, TENYA, Sizzler, Shakey's, Royal Garden Cafe, Mrs. Elizabeth Muffin, and Standard Coffee brands  beer restaurants, cafes, and various specialty shops  and hotels under the Richmond Hotel brand. It is also involved in food manufacturing, purchasing, distribution, logistics, and other infrastructure-related functions  and manufacture of frozen meals under the Royal Host Deli brand, as well as meals for sale by large retailers and other companies. In addition, it develops and operates various eating and drinking establishments on a contractual basis at airport terminals, highway service and parking areas, convention centers, office buildings, medical and nursing facilities, department stores, and government offices. Further, it offers in-flight catering and real estate rental services. ROYAL HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

isin: 3543.T|KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd.|3543.T|KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: KOMEDA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd. operates a coffee shop franchise business under the Komeda Coffee and Okagean brand names in Japan. It also involved in the real estate leasing activities. KOMEDA Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: FUSO CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Fuso Chemical Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells life science and electronic material products. The company offers malic acid and derivatives, citric acid and derivatives, L-tartaric acid and derivatives, lactic acid and derivatives, gluconic acid and derivatives, other acid derivatives, ascorbic and isoascorbic acids, and amino acid and derivatives, as well as water soluble rust proof agents/water soluble grinding and cutting fluids. It also provides ultra-high purity colloidal silica and high purity organo silica sol  and functional chemical products that consist of oxidation products, as well as benzoic acid derivatives. Its products are used in additive, cosmetics, surface treatment agent, concrete admixture, and industrial applications  abrasive raw material  and plastics, paints, and fragrances. Fuso Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: SUMITOMO BAKELITE
businessSummary: Sumitomo Bakelite Company Limited is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor-related materials, high-performance plastics, and quality-of-life-related products. It operates through three segments. Products of the Semiconductor-Related Materials segment include epoxy resin molding materials for semiconductor encapsulation, photoresists for semiconductors, bonding pastes for semiconductors, and semiconductor substrate materials. Products of the High-Performance Plastics segment include industrial resins, molding materials, molded products, laminated boards, and aircraft parts. Products of the Quality of Life-Related Products segment include medical devices and pharmaceuticals, diagnostic agents and biotechnology-related products, films and sheets, industrial functional materials, and waterproof sheet-related products. The Company is also engaged in contract testing and research, contract basic research, and land leasing.

name: ZUKEN
businessSummary: ZUKEN INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of printed circuit board design, electrical and electronic design, and information technology (IT) solutions, as well as related services. The Company operates through four geographical segments including Japan, Europe, the United States and Asia. The Company provides solutions covering processes from design to manufacturing, primarily for the electronics, automotive and industrial equipment industries, as well as consulting and client services. The Company also provides contracted embedded software development, support for printed circuit board design and manufacturing, technical assistance including personnel dispatch, sales of network-related products, software maintenance and other support services.

name: TAIYO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Taiyo Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the electronics business and the medical and pharmaceutical business. The Company has two business segments. The Electronics Business segment develops, manufactures, sells, and purchases chemical materials for electronic components, including printed circuit board materials. The Medical and Pharmaceutical Business segment manufactures, sells, and undertakes contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals. The Company also manufactures and sells dyes, pigments, chemicals, and inks, operates natural energy power generation businesses, operates restaurants, provides system engineering services, and develops systems.

name: ES CON JAPAN
businessSummary: ES-CON JAPAN Ltd. engages in the condominium business in Japan. It operates through four segments: Housing Sales Business  Real Estate Development Business  Real Estate Leasing Business  and Asset Management Business. The company plans, develops, and sells condominiums and detached houses under the Le JADE, Grand Le Jade, TOPAZ, DIAMAS Hayama, and SEVENS VILLA brands, as well as commercial facilities under the tonarie brand, logistics facilities under the LOGITRES brand, rental condominiums, hotels, offices, senior residences, clinic malls, and data center sites. It also undertakes land readjustment projects  leases commercial facilities and rental condominiums  and operates and manages an ossuary. In addition, the company offers property, real estate assets, and condominium management services  residential services  and real estate planning, brokerage, and consulting services. Further, it engages in overseas investment activities. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. ES-CON JAPAN Ltd. is a subsidiary of Chubu Electric Power Company, Incorporated.

name: ICHIGO
businessSummary: Ichigo Inc. is a real estate company. The Company has four business segments. The Asset Management segment involves in the sourcing of target real estate, funding, property management, facility management and others. The Shinchiku segment aims to improve asset value by maximizing the use of the Company’s real estate technology and know-how, and after the completion of value improvement of real estate. The Clean Energy segment involves in the effective utilization of real estate, as well as the solar business. The Others segment involves in the sales of investment securities, as well as other financial related business.

name: HULIC
businessSummary: Hulic Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business and insurance business. It operates through two business segments. Real Estate segment has three kinds of business. The real estate leasing business manages approximately 250 rental properties (excluding real estate for sale) that are owned and managed mainly near stations in the 23 wards of Tokyo. Real estate development business is performed according to the characteristics of the property location. Asset management business is entrusted with asset management business. It also provides real estate rental, building management and cleaning business. The Insurance segment is engaged in non-life insurance agency business such as fire insurance and automobile insurance, life insurance such as fixed-term insurance and endowment insurance, and solicitation business. It is also engaged in the design, repair and construction work on owned buildings, hotel and inn management and agricultural production in Vietnam.

name: STAR ASIA INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Star Asia Investment Corporation is a Japan-based closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT) that primarily engaged in real estate investment and management. With a primary focus on hotels, it acquires, holds, and manages properties—including offices, commercial facilities, logistics facilities, and residential properties—as well as trust beneficiary interests in real estate. It manages a real estate portfolio in Japan, aiming to secure stable earnings through rental income and the enhancement of asset value. Its asset manager is Star Asia Investment Management Co., Ltd.

name: MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Electric Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the industry mobility, life and other businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Infrastructure segment is engaged in the social systems, power systems, defense and space and systems businesses, and provides electrical equipment for railway vehicles, wireless communication equipment and others. The Industry & Mobility segment is engaged in the factory automation (FA) system business and the automotive equipment business. The Life segment is engaged in the building system business and the air conditioning and home appliances business. The Business Platform segment is involved in the information systems and services business. The Semiconductor Device segment is involved in the electronic devices business. The Other segment provides materials procurement, logistics, real estate, advertising and publicity and finance.

isin: 3463.T|Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation|3463.T|Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation
name: ICHIGO HOTEL REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as Ichigo Investment Corporation). Based on the Act (Act No. 198 of 1950, including subsequent amendments, hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Law), Ichigo (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended  the Investment Trust Act), with Ichigo Investment Advisors Co., Ltd. Established as a sponsor on July 22, 2015 (investment amount: 300 million yen, number of shares issued: 3,000), and issued shares on November 30 of the same year. The Company will be listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (hereinafter referred to as the Tokyo Stock Exchange) Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market. Ichigo Hotel REIT Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2015 in Japan.

name: HORIBA
businessSummary: Horiba Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring instruments. The Company operates in five business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the provision of engine exhaust gas measuring devices, driveline test systems, engine test systems, brake test systems and other products. The Environmental and Process segment is engaged in the provision of flue gas analyzers, water quality measuring devices, air pollution monitoring analyzers and other products. The Medical segment is engaged in the provision of blood cell counting devices, immunoassay devices and other products. The Semiconductor segment is engaged in the provision of mass flow controllers, chemical solution concentration monitors and other products. The Scientific segment is engaged in the provision of water quality measuring device, particle size distribution measuring device and others.

name: MARUBENI
businessSummary: Marubeni Corp is engaged in the import, export and transaction of various products through domestic and overseas networks. The Company has sixteen segments. The Lifestyle segment includes apparel, footwear, daily necessities, sporting goods. The Information Solutions segment includes services utilizing digital technology in the ICT and logistics fields. The Food 1 segment includes dairy products, sugar, processed foods and beverages. The Food 2 segment includes feed grains, soybeans, wheat. The Agri segment includes agricultural materials sale business. The Forest Products segment includes papermaking raw materials and paperboard. The Chemicals segment includes petrochemicals and electronic materials. The segments also include the Metals, the New Energy Development Promotion Department, the Energy, the Electricity, the Infrastructure Projects, the Aviation and Ship, the Finance, Leasing and Real Estate, the Construction & Industrial Machinery, Next Generation Business Development.

name: CURVES HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Curves Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of Curves, a fitness facility for women. The Curves segment is mainly engaged in the fitness club business. The domestic curve business is engaged in the introduction of system necessary for management guidance and business operation for franchisees (FC), the provision and sale of technology, equipment, product and printed matter, as well as the performance of support operations such as opening stores for franchisees and sale operations for members. The Company is also engaged in the development of directly managed stores. The overseas curves business is engaged in the management of royalties and sale of equipment used at stores to master franchisees around the world, including Japan, as well as the provision of operation support services to franchise member stores.

name: WEATHERNEWS
businessSummary: Weathernews Inc is a Japan-based company that collects meteorological, oceanographic, geological, hydrological and astronomical data together with customers and supporters and provides both corporate and individual clients with countermeasure content created based on highly accurate forecasts. The Company operates comprehensive content delivery services centered on weather information business segment. The Company provides weather services to a range of companies, including those in transportation and infrastructure across land, sea and air domains for corporate clients (B2B). The Company delivers weather services through applications and media platforms for individual clients (B2S).

name: TOKYO TATEMONO
businessSummary: Tokyo Tatemono Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate business. The Company operates three business segments. The Building Business segment develops, sells, leases, operates, and manages office buildings, commercial facilities, and logistics facilities. The Residential Business segment develops, sells, leases, and sells condominiums. The Asset Services segment is engaged in real estate sales, brokerage, consulting, and the development and operation of parking facilities. The Company also operates quality life business, asset management business, overseas business, and real estate appraisal business.

name: NIPPON GAS
businessSummary: Nippon Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the gas business and related businesses, such as the production, supply, and sale of city gas, the sale of liquefied petroleum gas and gas equipment, and the construction of gas piping. It operates in four segments. The City Gas segment is engaged in the production, supply, and sale of city gas. The Liquefied Petroleum Gas segment sells liquefied petroleum gas and equipment for liquefied petroleum gas. The Order Construction and Gas Equipment segment is engaged in the construction of pipelines for the supply of city gas and liquefied petroleum gas, the sale of equipment and housing-related facilities. The Electricity segment is engaged in the sale of electricity. The Company is also engaged in the maintenance and construction of information and communications infrastructure, the operation of sports clubs, the management and operation of designated management facilities, and the sale of plants and agricultural products.

name: JAPAN AIRPORT TERMINAL
businessSummary: Japan Airport Terminal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the facilities management and operation business, product sales business, and food and beverage business. The Company operates three segments. The Facilities Management and Operation segment is engaged in the leasing, maintenance, operation, and other services for airline passengers at Haneda Airport's passenger terminal facilities. The Product Sales segment is engaged in the sale of goods to airline passengers, wholesale of goods to airport terminal building companies, and other related businesses. The Food and Beverage segment is engaged in the provision of food and beverage services to users of Haneda Airport and Narita Airport, the manufacture and sale of in-flight meals, and other related businesses.

name: ASTELLAS PHARMA
businessSummary: Astellas Pharma Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sales of pharmaceutical products. The Company mainly operates Pharmaceutical Products business segment. The main products include XTANDI, BETANIS, MIRABETRIC, BETMIGA and new products ZOSPATA, EVERENZO and ENHOLTUMAB VEDOTIN, among others.

name: TISI
businessSummary: TISI Inc, formerly TIS Inc, provides outsourcing services, cloud services, software development, solutions, and related consulting services. It is comprised of five business segments. The Offering Services segment provides knowledge-intensive information technology (IT) services. The BPM segment provides solutions to address business process challenges. The Financial IT segment supports business development by jointly considering and promoting business and IT strategies based on specialized business and operational know-how specific to the financial industry. The Industrial IT segment supports business development by jointly considering and promoting business and IT strategies based on specialized business and operational know-how specific to various industries other than finance. The Wide-Area IT Solutions segment provides professional IT services, including regional and customer sites, accumulating and deploying its know-how as solutions to support problem solving.

name: JAPAN MATERIAL
businessSummary: Japan Material Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronics-related business, graphics solution business and solar power generation business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Electronics-related segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture of special gas supply equipment, design and construction of supply piping, sale management of special gas, as well as the provision of technical services. The Graphics Solution segment is mainly engaged in the sale of graphic boards and digital signage related products. The Solar Power Generation segment is engaged in the sale of electricity to electric power companies by solar power generation.

name: VEGA
businessSummary: Vega Corporation Co.,Ltd. operates EC platforms for furniture and interior products in Japan. The company operates LOWYA, which offers e-commerce services, as well as furniture designs  and DOKODEMO, a cross-border e-commerce platform. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: ITOCHU
businessSummary: Itochu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the trading business. Food segment produces, distributes and sells food products. Energy & Chemicals segment trades and operates in the fields of energy, chemicals and electricity. Living & Lifestyle segment operates in the fields of living materials and logistics, as well as real estate. Machinery segment engages in the infrastructure-related business, power generation and other businesses. Metals segment engages in metal mineral resource development, steel product processing, trade of iron, ore and coal, non-ferrous metals and light metals and steel products. Information & Financial segment engages in information technology (IT) solutions, mobile distribution and services in the information and communications field, as well as financial services and insurance businesses. Textile segment engages in global business in goods from textile raw materials, yarns and fabrics to clothing. Eighth segment collaborates with other segments.

name: CANON
businessSummary: Canon Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business activities ranging from development and production to sales and service in the fields of printing, medical, imaging, and industrial. The Company consists of four business segments. The Printing Business Unit segment provides digital continuous ledger printers and digital cut sheet printers. The Medical Business Unit segment provides diagnostic ultrasound systems and X-ray systems. The Imaging Business Unit segment is engaged in the provision of interchangeable lens digital cameras, interchangeable lenses, and compact digital cameras. The Industrial Business Unit segment is engaged in the provision of semiconductor lithography equipment. The Company also provides handy terminals and document scanners.

name: ROHTO PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Rohto Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of eye care (eye drops, eyewash), skin care (external medications, lip balm, sunscreen, functional cosmetics), oral medication (gastrointestinal medicines, herbal medicines, supplements), and other products and services (in vitro diagnostic reagents) in the health and beauty care field. The Company operates through four regional segments. The Japan segment manufactures and sells eye care, skin care, oral medication, and other products (services). The Americas segment and the Europe segment mainly manufacture and sell skin care products (services). The Asia segment mainly manufactures and sells eye care and skin care products (services), as well as oral medication products (services).

name: PILLAR
businessSummary: PILLAR Corp, formerly Nippon Pillar Packing Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fluid control related equipment products, mainly PILAFLON products (fluororesin products), mechanical seal products, and gland packing and gasket products. The products are used in industrial fields such as semiconductors and liquid crystal, as well as electricity, petroleum, automobiles, chemicals, ships, civil engineering and construction, food, and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates through two business segments. The Electronic Equipment Related Business segment mainly produces and sells resin-related products such as PILAFLON products. The Industrial Equipment Related Business segment produces and sells mechanical seal products, gland packing and gasket products. The Company also operates office building rental businesses, insurance agency businesses, and electricity sales businesses.

name: SUMITOMO REALTY & DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to real estate. The Company operates its business through five business segments. The Real Estate Leasing segment leases and manages office buildings and condominiums, and operates and manages hotels, event halls, and commercial facilities. The Real Estate Sales segment sells condominiums and detached houses. The Construction Completion segment is engaged in contracting for construction and renovation of detached houses and condominiums. The Real Estate for Sales segment engages in real estate brokerage and sales agency services. The Others segment is engaged in the fitness club business, restaurant business.

name: WINGARC1ST
businessSummary: WingArc1st Inc is engaged in the development and sale of corporate software and services. The Company is engaged in data empowerment business, including form and document management solutions and data empowerment solutions. In the form and document management solution, the Company provides software used in Japan as a business foundation for forms and solutions based on them. It is used for creating, outputting, and managing forms in various places in society, from business forms such as invoices, delivery notes, shipping slips, and e-tickets to various certificates issued by public institutions. Main products include SVF, SVF Cloud and SPA. The data empowerment solution mainly sells software, provides cloud services, and provides maintenance support to end users. The main software and services include Dr.Sum and MotionBoard. The Company is also engaged in the provision of professional services.

name: KEWPIE
businessSummary: Kewpie Corp is engaged in manufacture and sale of food products. The Company operates in six business segments. The Retail Market segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings, pasta sauces, delicatessen foods, packaged salads, baby foods, nursing care foods and others in the retail market. The Food Service segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings, vinegar, liquid eggs, frozen eggs, dried eggs, egg processed food and others in food service market. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells mayonnaise, dressings in China, Southeast Asia, North America markets. The Fruit Solutions segment manufactures and sells jams for household use and processed fruit products for industry use. The Fine Chemicals segment manufactures and sells hyaluronic acid and egg yolk lecithin as an ingredient for pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and foods. The Common segment sells food and food manufacturing machines.

name: AMADA
businessSummary: Amada Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of metal processing equipment and metal machine tools, as well as the provision of related services. The Company operates in two segments. The Metal Processing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of products such as laser machines, punch and laser combined processing equipment, press brakes, bending robots, shirring, plate processing system lines, factory automation (FA) computers and software, as well as welding equipment such as precision laser equipment and resistance welding equipment. The Metal Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cutting products such as metal cutting saws, shape steel cutting equipment, drilling equipment and metal cutting saws, press products such as mechanical presses, as well as machine tools such as grinding machines. The Company is also engaged in the real estate leasing business.

name: MCDONALDS HOLDINGS COMPANY JAPAN
businessSummary: McDonald's Holdings Company Japan Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation of hamburger restaurants business through its subsidiaries and affiliated companies. The Company's main business is formulating and executing consolidated management strategies for group companies and real estate rental. Through its affiliates, the Company operates hamburger restaurant business through franchisees as well as directly managed stores. The Company pays royalties on licenses. In Japan, the Company grants sub-licenses of know-how and trademarks to franchisees who operate franchise stores, and receives royalties from the franchisees.

name: ORACLE CORP JAPAN
businessSummary: Oracle Corp Japan is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of software including database, middleware and application, hardware including servers, storage and network equipment, the provision of cloud services and the support for product introduction and use. The Company operates in three business segments. The Cloud & License segment is engaged in the sale of database management software, middleware, application software used in corporate activities, and the provision of services for these software and hardware through the Internet, as well as the provision of software license renewal rights and technical support. The Hardware Systems segment is engaged in the sale of servers, storage, engineered systems, network equipment, as well as the provision of technical support, repair service and maintenance for hardware products. The Service segment provides consulting services, advanced customer support services.

isin: 8958.T|Global One Real Estate Investment Corp.|8958.T|Global One Real Estate Investment Corp.
name: GLOBAL ONE REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Global One Real Estate Investment Corporation (GOR) is a Japanese Real Estate Investment Trust (J-REIT) listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange with the goal of pursuing maximum returns for unitholders. GOR cautiously selects prime properties at prime locations with an eye to (stronger and sustainable competitiveness in the marketplace). The three key watchwords in selecting properties are: (1) Convenience  (2) Year built  and (3) Property size. Global One Real Estate Investment Corp. was established on April 16, 2003, and incorporated in Japan.

name: NOMURA REAL ESTATE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nomura Real Estate Holdings Inc is a real estate holding company. The Company operates in five business segments. The Housing segment is engaged in the development and allotment of condominiums, detached houses and residential properties, the development of housing for seniors, as well as the contracting of reform work business. The Urban Development segment is engaged in the development, leasing and sale of office buildings, logistics facilities and commercial facilities. The Asset Management segment provides asset management services for private placement funds, REITs and real estate securitized products. The Brokerage and CRE segment is engaged in the brokerage and consulting of real estate. The Operation Management segment is engaged in the management of office building and condominiums. The Company is also engaged in trading and leasing of land and buildings.

isin: 3387.T|create restaurants holdings inc.|3387.T|create restaurants holdings inc.
name: CREATE RESTAURANTS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: create restaurants holdings inc. plans, develops, and manages food courts, izakaya bars, dinner-time restaurants, and bakeries in Japan. It operates a range of restaurants, including Japanese, Western, Chinese, and ethnic cuisines primarily under the Hina-Sushi, Shabu Sai, MACCHA HOUSE, PRECIOUS BUFFET, Kagonoya, RIO GRANDE GRILL, Nanxiang Mantou Dian, Iccho, Yasai-ya Mei, Yuzuru, and Hainanese Chicken Rice Restaurant brands. The company also operates Omotenashi Toriyoshi, a restaurant that offers chicken dishes  Isomaru-suisan, a seafood and rice restaurant  and Go no Go, a casual pub. In addition, it provides bakery products under the Saint-Germain and L'airbon brands  operates JEAN FRANÇOI, a bakery and café  and operates Bread & Coffee IKEDAYAMA, a bakery that serves house made bread and house roasted coffee, etc., as well as operates Italian restaurants and highway rest areas. Further, the company operates restaurants and other facilities on a contract basis, including cultural and recreational facilities, such as golf courses, baseball stadium, aquarium, and art museums. create restaurants holdings inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: MITSUI FUDOSAN
businessSummary: Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the leasing, sales, management and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. The Leasing Business segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and commercial facilities. The Sales Business segment sells condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, and sells rental housing and office buildings to investors. The Management Business segment is engaged in non-asset businesses such as property management, brokerage and asset management. The Facility Sales Business segment is engaged in hotel and resort business, and sports and entertainment business. The Other segment is engaged in the design, construction supervision and construction contracting of new housing, renovation work for homes and renewal work for offices and commercial facilities, golf course business, retail of flowers, seeds and seedlings, gardening supplies, specified power transmission and distribution, and others.

name: MITSUBISHI ESTATE
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in commercial real estate, Marunouchi, housing, overseas, investment management, and design supervision and real estate services. The Company operates through six business segments. The Commercial Real Estate Business segment develops, leases, operates, and manages various asset types, as well as parking lots and district heating and cooling. The Marunouchi Business segment develops, leases, operates, and manages office buildings in the Otemachi, Marunouchi, and Yurakucho areas, as well as district heating and cooling. The Housing Business segment constructs, sells, leases, manages, renovates, and brokers condominiums and detached houses, and others. The Overseas Business segment develops, leases, and manages real estate overseas. The Investment Management segment manages real estate investments. The Design Supervision and Real Estate Services segment engages in the design and supervision of architecture, and others.

name: CKD
businessSummary: CKD Corporation is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic machinery and equipment. The Automatic Machinery segment offers automatic packaging systems, image processing inspection systems, lithium-ion battery manufacturing systems, three-dimensional solder printing inspection machines, lighting manufacturing systems and capacitor manufacturing systems. The Machinery segment offers index units, direct drive motors, pick-and-place units, pneumatic directional control valves, manual switching valves, pneumatic cylinders, cylinders with valve, special cylinders, electric actuators, cylinders with multi-function, filters, regulators, lubricators, fittings, speed controllers, refrigeration type dryers, dry type dryers, membrane type dryers, mainline filters, flow sensors, pressure sensors and various valves. The Company also involves in the insurance agency and factoring businesses.

name: SHIN ETSU CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Shin-Etsu Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Life Environment Materials segment is engaged in the provision of polyvinyl chloride resin, caustic soda, methanol, chloromethane, and poval. The Electronic Materials segment is engaged in the provision of semiconductor silicon, rare earth magnets (for electronics industry and general use), semiconductor encapsulants, packaging materials for light-emitting diodes (LEDs), photoresists, mask blanks, and synthetic quartz products. The Performance Materials segment is engaged in the provision of silicones, cellulose derivatives, metallic silicon, synthetic sex pheromones, polyvinyl chloride-vinyl acetate copolymer resins, liquid fluoroelastomers, and pellicles. The Processing, Trading, and Technical Services segment is engaged in provision of resin processing products, technology and plant exports, product imports and exports, and engineering.

name: HAKUTO
businessSummary: Hakuto Co.,Ltd. is primarily engaged in the sale and import/export of electronic and electrical equipment and electronic components, as well as the manufacture and sale of industrial chemicals. The Company operates through four segments. The Electronic Components segment sells semiconductor devices and general electronic components. The Electronic and Electrical Equipment segment mainly sells and provides services for printed circuit board (PCB) related equipment and semiconductor manufacturing related equipment. The Chemicals segment manufactures, sells, and provides services for industrial chemicals and cosmetics. Other segment include the company's overall logistics management, insurance agency services, solar power generation business, new businesses, and the business of CLEARIZE Co., Ltd.

name: KURITA WATER INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Kurita Water Industries Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of water treatment-related products, technology and maintenance services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Water Treatment Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of water treatment related chemicals and related equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance services. The Water Treatment Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of equipment and facilities related to water treatment, the provision of ultra-pure water, the provision of chemical cleaning and precision cleaning services, the purification of soil and groundwater, as well as the provision of maintenance services such as operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities.

isin: 4369.T|Tri Chemical Laboratories Inc.|4369.T|Tri Chemical Laboratories Inc.
name: TRI CHEMICAL LABORATORIES
businessSummary: Tri Chemical Laboratories Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells high-purity chemicals for semiconductor manufacturing in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers Si semiconductors, coating, optical fiber, compound semiconductor, and reagents. It also provides analyses services, such as purity measurement, impurity measurement, and thermal stability tests, film-forming tests, stainless steel container with valve and overseas specifications, metal seamless container for high pressure gas, sealed glass ampoule, polyethylene container, glass screw cap bottle, glass vials bottle, and pipe cleaning. Tri Chemical Laboratories Inc. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Uenohara, Japan.

isin: 2607.T|Fuji Oil Co., Ltd.|2607.T|Fuji Oil Co., Ltd.
name: FUJI OIL
