businessSummary: Fuji Oil Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food and processed soybean ingredients in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Southeast Asia, and China. The company operates through the Vegetable Oils and Fats, Commercial Chocolate, Emulsified and Fermented Ingredients, and Soybean Processed Ingredients segments. It offers hard butter for chocolate, confectionery oils and fats, frying and spraying oils, fats for frozen confectionery, emulsified oils and fats, powdered oils and fats, and lubricating/releasing oils. The company also provides industrial chocolates, including couverture chocolates, chocolates for ice cream coating and bread, chocolate chips, and stick chocolate for confectionery and bakery items  whipping cream, fillings, margarine, soymilk products, and cheese-flavored ingredients  and soy-based ingredients consisting of soy protein ingredients, soy protein products, and soluble soy polysaccharides. Furthermore, as a result of an absorption-type merger (hereinafter the Merger) whereby the Investment Corporation is the surviving corporation and Nippon Healthcare Investment Corporation (hereinafter NHI) is the absorbed corporation on April 1, 2020, upon which the trade name was changed from Japan Rental Housing Investments Inc. to Daiwa Securities Living Investment Corporation and healthcare facilities were added to the portfolio, the Investment Corporation is now managed as a REIT that comprehensively provides comfortable living spaces that support life and lifestyle of everyone suited to each life stage. Daiwa Securities Living Investment Corporation was established on October 07, 2005 and incorporated in Japan.

name: HEIWA REAL ESTATE
businessSummary: Heiwa Real Estate Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in redevelopment and building projects in major cities across the country. The Company operates through two segments. The Building Business segment develops, rents, manages, and sells stock exchanges, offices, commercial facilities, and housing. It also engages in property management. It focuses on urban development in Nihonbashi Kabutocho and Kayabacho, where its head office is located, and the Sapporo redevelopment project. The Asset Management Business segment manages assets and brokers real estate.

name: TOKAIDO REIT
businessSummary: Tokaido Reit, Inc. invests in industrial real estate properties. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 8960.T|United Urban Investment Corporation|8960.T|United Urban Investment Corporation
name: UNITED URBAN INVESTMENT
businessSummary: United Urban Investment Corporation was established on November 4, 2003 in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended  hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act), and was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market (J-REIT Market) on December 22, 2003. JRF defines real estate that can ensure stable profitability over the medium to long term as real estate with intrinsic value. As a diversified J-REIT with an investment policy of aiming for a diversified portfolio without limiting (use) and (investment area), JRF has sought to ensure stable profitability over the medium to long term by investing in carefully selected properties while assessing the (intrinsic value) of each property from a wide range of investment targets. Furthermore, on December 1, 2010, NCI merged with Nippon Commercial Investment Corporation (NCI) as the surviving corporation (Merger). After the Merger, NCI continued to acquire assets by raising funds through borrowings and public offerings, and as a result, its asset size (based on acquisition price) is one of the largest in the J-REIT market. The Investment Corporation has made cash distributions every fiscal period from the 1st fiscal period (ended May 2004) to the 41st fiscal period (ending May 2024). In the current fiscal period (42nd fiscal period ending November 2024), the Investment Corporation made cash distributions of 3,937 yen per unit. United Urban Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2003 in Japan.

name: CALBEE
businessSummary: Calbee, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of potato-based, wheat-based, and corn-based snacks and cereal foods. The Food Manufacturing and Sales Business segment manufactures and sells snacks and cereal foods, procures raw materials, manufactures primary processed products, and procures and sells potatoes and sweet potatoes. The Company is also engaged in the logistics business. The Company conducts business activities in Japan and overseas.

name: CHATPLUS
businessSummary: ChatPlus Co.,Ltd. develops and provides SaaS-based subscription-based chatbot systems in Japan. The chatbot system is a service that supports companies in improving operational efficiency and productivity by automating and reducing the manpower required to handle inquiries from both inside and outside the company. It offers ChatPlus, a chatbot that supports the automation of corporate inquiry handling and communication, employing a format  AI Agent Plus, a chatbot that integrates generation AI such as ChatCPT with Chat Plus to generate optimal responses on the spot in addition to registered answers, enabling it to handle complex inquiries and diverse expressions  and FAQPlus, a system for creating, organizing, and managing articles of frequently asked questions and answers, so that users can easily find the answers they need. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

isin: 8966.T|Heiwa Real Estate REIT, Inc.|8966.T|Heiwa Real Estate REIT, Inc.
name: HEIWA REAL ESTATE REIT
businessSummary: Heiwa Real Estate REIT, Inc., is an investment corporation. Under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent revisions, hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act) by the founder (the former Canal Investment Trust Co., Ltd., now, Heiwa Real Estate REIT Asset Management, Inc., the Asset Management Company). Heiwa Real Estate REIT is an externally managed real estate fund, established as an investment corporation. Heiwa Real Estate REIT Asset Management, Inc., as Heiwa Real Estate REIT's asset management company, is engaged in acquiring, managing, leasing, and renovating office properties, residential properties and commercial properties. HEIWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD. (Heiwa Real Estate REIT) currently own 100% of Heiwa Real Estate REIT Asset Management, Inc. Investment units in Heiwa Real Estate REIT have been listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Section (J-REIT Section) of the Tokyo Stock Exchange since March 8, 2005. As of May 31, 2025, Heiwa Real Estate REIT has ownership or trust beneficiary interests in 131 properties with approximately 326,131.40 square meters of rentable space and has leased space to 6,167 tenants. The occupancy rate for the properties is approximately 97.1%. Heiwa Real Estate REIT, Inc. was established on January 31, 2002 and incorporated in Japan.

name: KUBOTA
businessSummary: Kubota Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of agricultural machines, engines and construction machines. The Company operates in three business segments. Machinery segment manufactures and sells agricultural machines and agricultural products, such as tractors, tillers, combine harvesters, rice planters, lawn mowers. The Segment also provides construction machinery and engines for agricultural machinery, construction machinery, industrial machinery and generators. Water & Environment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pipe systems such as ductile iron pipes and synthetic pipes, industrial equipment such as reaction pipes, spiral steel pipes, air conditioning equipment, and various environmental plants, pumps, and other products related to the environment. Others segment mainly provides logistics and financial services, roofing materials and exterior wall materials.

name: MICROAD
businessSummary: MicroAd Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data platform business. The Data Platform business segment is mainly comprised of three services: data solution services, overseas consulting services, and digital signage services. Its main products include UNIVERSE DATA PLATFORM, a data platform; UNIVERSE Ads, an advertising platform; MicroAd COMPASS, an advertising revenue maximization service for media companies; COMPASS-FIT, an advertising platform, and MONOLITHS, an advertising distribution service.

name: HULIC REIT
businessSummary: Hulic Reit, Inc. with Hulic Reit Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the, which is entrusted with the management of the assets of the Investment Corporation. As the organizer under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan (hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act). On November 25, 2013, the Investment Corporation was registered with the Director-General of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau (registration number: Director-General of the Kanto Local Finance Bureau No. 88). The Investment Corporation issued new investment units through a public offering with the payment date on February 6, 2014, which were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities (J-REIT) Market of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. on February 7, 2014. New investment units were issued through a third-party allotment on March 7, 2014. The Investment Corporation recently carried out capital increases through its eighth public offering after its listing on October 27, 2021 and a third-party allotment on November 22, 2021. As a result, the number of investment units issued as of August 31, 2025 (hereinafter, the end of the reporting period) was 1,440,000. The Investment Corporation primarily invests in and manages office buildings and retail facilities. Hulic Reit, Inc. was established in November 07, 2013 and incorporated in Japan.

name: SEIBU HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Seibu Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company operates in the real estate, hotel and leisure, and urban transportation and railway-related businesses. The Company has three business segments. The Real Estate segment consists of development and leasing, investment management, management, and other businesses. The Hotel and Leisure segment consists of domestic hotel operations (ownership and leasing), domestic hotel franchises and management contracts (MC and FC), overseas hotel operations (ownership and leasing), overseas hotel operations (MC and FC), sports operations (ownership and leasing), sports operations (MC and FC), and other businesses. The Urban Transportation and Railway-related Business segment consists of railway operations, bus operations, railway-related lifestyle services, sports operations, and other businesses. It also includes the Izu-Hakone business, the Omi business, sports operations, and new businesses.

isin: 8976.T|Daiwa Office Investment Corporation|8976.T|Daiwa Office Investment Corporation
name: DAIWA OFFICE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Daiwa Office Investment Corporation is a public investment firm. DOI is an externally managed real estate fund, established as an investment corporation. The company primarily invests in office buildings located in Tokyo's five central wards and other major urban areas in Japan. It generates revenue through rental income and property management activities while seeking to enhance unitholder value through portfolio expansion, asset repositioning, and active real estate management. The company is externally managed by Daiwa Real Estate Asset Management Co., Ltd. and was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2005.

name: JAPAN EXCELLENT
businessSummary: Japan Excellent, Inc. (hereinafter, JEI) under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan, is a real estate investment corporation which primarily invests in office buildings. JEI is externally managed by a licensed asset management company, Japan Excellent Asset Management (JEAM). JEAM was originally owned 45% by NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD., 20% by The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, 15% by Sekisui House, Co., LTD., and 20% by other corporations. Due to the transfer of ownership by Sekisui House, Co., LTD., on May 12, 2014, ownership interests of 9% and 6% were each acquired by NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD., and The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, respectively. Due to the transfers of ownership by The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, THE DAI-ICHI BUILDING CO., LTD., and SOHGO HOUSING CO., Ltd., from June 25, 2025, to June 27, 2025, an ownership interest of 36% was acquired by Dai-ichi Life Holdings, Inc. JEI was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on June 27, 2006. As of June 30, 2025, JEI held 33 properties with 302,340.95 square meters of total leasable space and had leases with 610 tenants excluding residential tenants. Japan Excellent, inc. was established in February 20, 2006.

name: FUKUOKA REIT
businessSummary: Fukuoka REIT Corporation is Japan's first region-focused real estate investment trust. In accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951 , including subsequent amendments), leveraging the regionality (locality) that is a characteristic of the real estate industry, with the entire Kyushu region (including Okinawa Prefecture) with Fukuoka at its center, and Yamaguchi Prefecture (hereinafter referred to as the Fukuoka-Kyushu Region) as its investment target area. On November 9, 2004, it acquired a total of four commercial facilities and office buildings and began substantial operations and was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. and the Fukuoka Stock Exchange, a securities membership corporation (stock code 8968), on June 21, 2005. As of the end of the fiscal period under review (as of February 28, 2025), we are managing a total of 35 properties, including 10 commercial facilities, 13 office buildings, and 12 other properties (including quasi-co-ownership interests in real estate trust beneficiary rights, as well as leasehold land for commercial facilities and office buildings). Fukuoka REIT Corporation was established and incorporated on July 2, 2004 in Japan.

name: TOKIO MARINE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tokio Marine Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the domestic non-life insurance business, domestic life insurance business, overseas insurance business, and financial and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business segment is engaged in no-life insurance underwriting business and asset management business in Japan. The Domestic Life Insurance Business segment is engaged in life insurance underwriting and asset management services in Japan. The Overseas Insurance Business segment is engaged in overseas insurance underwriting and asset management services. The Financial and Other Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of investment advisory services, investment trust outsourcing services, staffing services, as well as real estate management and nursing care business.

name: JINS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JINS HOLDINGS Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, manufacturing, sales, and import/export of eyewear in Japan and internationally. It also engages in agricultural work contracting and farm management activities. JINS HOLDINGS Inc. was formerly known as JINS Inc. and changed its name to JINS HOLDINGS Inc. in July 2019. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: CHIMNEY
businessSummary: Chimney Co., Ltd. operates and franchises a chain of restaurants in Japan. It is involved in liquor sales business  food and sub-contracted catering business  and mail order business. Chimney Co., Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Sumida, Japan. Chimney Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Yamaya Corporation.

name: DIGITAL ARTS
businessSummary: Digital Arts Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops and markets internet security software and appliances in Japan. The company offers i-FILTER, a web security product  m-FILTER, a mail security product  FinalCode, a file encryption and tracking solution  DigitalArts@Cloud, a comprehensive cloud security product that covers web browsing, email, and files  f-FILTER, a data protection and transfer solution  a-FILTER, an integrated authentication platform  and Z-FILTER, a network security product. It also provides D-SPA, a proxy appliance product  StartIN, a single sign-on ID and ID management solution  and Desk, a chat and online conference tool. The company serves the enterprise, public, and consumer sectors. Digital Arts Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: PLUS ALPHA CONSULTING
businessSummary: Plus Alpha Consulting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the visualization engine business, the customer rings business and the talent palette business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Visualization Engine segment is engaged in the development and operation of Visualization Engine, a customer experience feedback system. The Customer Rings segment is engaged in the development and operation of CustomerRings, an integrated marketing platform. The Talent Palette segment is engaged in the development and operation of Talent Palette, a talent management system.

name: GMO INTERNET GROUP
businessSummary: GMO Internet Group Inc, formerly GMO Internet Inc, is engaged in Internet infrastructure business, Internet advertising and media business, Internet finance business, crypto asset business and incubation business. The Company operates through five segments. The Internet Infrastructure segment is engaged in domain business, cloud hosting business, electronic commerce (EC) support business, security business, and access business. The Internet Advertising and Media segment is engaged in Internet advertising business, Internet media business, and Internet research business. The Internet Finance segment provides financial instruments trading services such as online securities trading services and foreign exchange margin trading services. The Crypto Asset segment is engaged in the business related to crypto asset exchange and mining. The Incubation segment invests in unlisted companies, mainly Internet-related companies. The Company is also engaged in the mobile entertainment business.

The company provides radio frequency plasma generator, automatic impedance matching boxes, digital power tracer, DC power supply products, and microwaves. Its products are installed on tools for LCD panels and semiconductor processes. The company was formerly known as Adtec Co. and changed its name to Adtec Plasma Technology Co., Ltd. in December 2000. name: SEKISUI HOUSE REIT

For residential real estate, the Fund invests mainly in the Tokyo 23 Wards, a key investment area for the Tokyo metropolitan area, where it believes there is abundant rental demand and a supply of high-quality properties. For commercial real estate, the Fund invests mainly in the three major cities (Tokyo 23 Wards, Osaka City, and Nagoya City), a key investment area for the three major metropolitan areas, where it believes there is strong demand as bases for tenant companies' business activities and where it believes there is potential for stable management. And investments in overseas real estate, the Fund limits its investments to residential real estate. The asset management company is Sekisui House Asset Management, Ltd.

name: RAKUS
businessSummary: Rakus Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) services. It operates through two business segments. The Cloud Business segment plans, develops and operates various cloud services, including the expense settlement system Raku-Raku Seisan, the electronic invoice issuance system RakuRaku Meisai, the sales management system Rakuraku Hanbai, the attendance management system RakuRaku Kintai, the email sharing and management system Mail Dealer, and the email marketing service HaiHai Mail. The IT Human Resources Business segment provides full-time staffing services specializing in IT engineers. Staffing services include system development, infrastructure construction and operation, machine learning, and quality control.

name: BRANU
businessSummary: BRANU Inc. engages in the provision of IT solutions for small and medium-sized construction companies. The company offers Careecon, a matching platform specialized for the construction industry that allows to search for construction partner companies and place orders for projects  Careecon Plus, an integrated business tool for the construction industry that handles from marketing to recruitment management, construction management, and business management  and DX consulting services which provides marketing aspects, such as market research and sales strategies to visualization of operational issues and productivity enhancement through on-site management. BRANU Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: TSURUHA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tsuruha Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of product sale business centered on pharmaceuticals and cosmetics. The Company is engaged in the management of drug stores that sell pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, the sale of pharmaceuticals, the sale of pharmaceuticals based on pharmacy and store sales business in Kanto area, Hokkaido area, Kanto Koshinetsu, Tohoku area, Chugoku, Kyushu area, Shizuoka prefecture, Aichi prefecture, Hiroshima prefecture, the management of drug store management subsidiary, product procurement and logistics planning, business negotiations, procurement operation business, the planning, development and sale promotion of private brand products, the mail order business for the products handled by telephone and Internet, the insurance agency business and management guidance management, real estate leasing business, as well as the rental of vending machines and sale of beverages.

name: COVER
businessSummary: Cover Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the character intellectual property (IP) development of virtual entertainers VTuber who are active using motion capture technology and anime look avatars, and the management of hololive production. The Company operates through the VTuber business segment, which is divided into four business areas. The distribution/content business provides video content through the video distribution platform, and also provides music content through the music streaming service. The live/event business provides offline or online events such as live concerts, fan meetings, and domestic and overseas exhibitions. The merchandising business sells character goods and digital contents based on VTuber IP. The licensing/tie-up business provides the right to use proprietary IP to manufacturers of external products or contents, and provides promotion and media appearances of other companies by VTuber through tie-up advertisements.

name: SHIFT
businessSummary: SHIFT Inc. provides software quality assurance and testing solutions in Japan. The company offers CAT, a software test management tool to evaluate software testing aptitude  a quality platform  and software consulting services. The company also engages in the nursery business  support services for the employment, retention, and active participation of people with disabilities  and planning, development, and sales of products and services that contribute to solving social issues. SHIFT Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ANYMIND GROUP
businessSummary: AnyMind Group Inc., a technology company, provides a platform for brand building, production management, media operations, e-commerce site development and management, marketing, and logistics management in Japan. The company provides AnyAI, an AI platform for collecting, visualizing, and utilizing brand data  AnyLive, an AI live commerce platform  AnyX, an e-commerce management platform that enables centralized management of multiple e-commerce channels  AnyTag, an influencer marketing platform  AnyManager, a one-stop platform for web and app publishers  and AnyCreator, supports a various areas including content creation, monetization, and channel and account growth. It offers AnyLogi, a logistics management platform  AnyChat, a platform for customer engagement for buying opportunities  AnyShop, a platform to build and operate brand.com sites  AnyFactory, Platform that connects brands with manufacturers  and AnyDigital, a digital marketing platform that enables centralized management, including ad serving, and management and analysis of online and offline media. In addition, the company offers solutions for brands, publishers, and creators. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. AnyMind Group Inc. operates as a subsidiary of AnyMind Group Pte Ltd.

name: RIDGE
businessSummary: Ridge-i Inc. engages in the consulting and development of artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning technologies. The company offers AI utilization consulting and AI development, satellite data AI analysis, data & analytics, generative AI consulting & development, and digital marketing services. Ridge-i Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: RAKUMO
businessSummary: Rakumo Inc is engaged in information technology (IT) solution business. The Company’s main business includes Software as a Service (SaaS) service, which provides license services; solution service, which centered on installation support and business support related to license services; IT offshore development service that develops lab-type IT systems based in Vietnam. The SaaS service develops and sells the groupware product rakumo for companies, as well as selling agents of other company's licenses. rakumo is a general term for a group of services in corporate groupware for which the group handles planning and development. The solution service sells hardware of other companies related to the license service, in addition to solution services such as installation support and business support of own and other company’s SaaS services. IT offshore development services provides IT offshore development services based on its Vietnam subsidiary rakumo Company Limited.

name: KANAMIC NETWORK
businessSummary: Kanamic Network Co Ltd is a Japan-based Company mainly engaged in the construction of information sharing platforms and healthcare platforms in the medical, nursing care, and health fields. It operates in three segments. The Medical and Nursing Care Cloud Platform business segment is engaged in the construction of information sharing platforms and healthcare platforms in the medical, nursing care, and health fields. The Healthy Life Expectancy Extension business segment is engaged in the provision of services that contribute to extending healthy life expectancy through the operation of 24-hour fitness gyms. The Solution Development business segment is engaged in the planning and development of web services characterized by speedy development in line with the needs of companies, the provision of development of various systems, and consulting and maintenance services for the introduction of backend systems such as sales management, inventory management, and accounting management.

name: FORUM ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Forum Engineering Inc. operates the engineer dispatch and introduction business. The clients cover eight major industries in the mechanical and electrical fields, including automobiles, transportation machineries, industrial machineries, precision equipment, electrical equipment, home appliances, electronic components, and information and communications. The Company dispatches technical staffs to client companies for design and development, experiment and evaluation, production technologies, and quality assurance. The engineer dispatch service has three features, including management of client companies by department, skill-based matching using artificial intelligence, and recruitment of human resources through a unique route. The Company also conducts engineer introduction and other businesses, and provides human resources services including engineer dispatch service, electromechanical engineer recruitment service, as well as human resource management services.

name: CKD
businessSummary: CKD Corporation develops, manufactures, sells, and exports automation machinery and components in Japan and Internationally. The company offers components products, such as electric actuators, direct drive actuators, pneumatic cylinders, hand and chucks, assistive devices, software, directional control valves, refining and pressure adjusting components, speed control valves check valves, auxiliary equipment, gas generators, fluid control components, sensors, controllers, vacuum system components, and mechanical indexer, as well as components for chemical liquids, high vacuum and special gas, and controllers for primary industries and irrigation. It also provides automatic machinery, including automatic packaging systems and lithium-ion battery winding machine. The company was formerly known as Chukyo Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CKD Corporation in July 1979. CKD Corporation was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Komaki, Japan.

name: TENO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: teno.Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of childcare services. The Company is engaged in the operation of public childcare schools and consignment childcare schools. The Company operates in two business segments. The Public Child Care segment is engaged in the operation of licensed nursery schools, certified nursery schools and others. The Entrusted Childcare segment is engaged in outsourcing childcare projects in places such as workplaces and hospitals. The Company is involved in the dispatch of nursery teachers to other kindergartens and nursery schools, the provision of babysitting services and house services, the operation of tenoSCHOOL, the operation of unlicensed daycare centers, small-scale licensed daycare centers and long-term care facilities. The Company also operates a long-term care business and housing for the elderly.

name: JUSTSYSTEMS
businessSummary: Justsystems Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, and provision of software and related services. The Company is primarily engaged in the development and domestic sales of software. It provides software such as the Japanese input system ATOK and word processing software Ichitaro to individuals, and solutions such as document creation, data management, and business support to corporations. The Company also develops and provides software in the United States and Canada.

name: LIGHTWORKS
businessSummary: Lightworks Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human capital management (HCM) cloud service business. The Company is engaged in the provision of HCM platform provision service and online English conversation service utilizing HCM cloud. The HCM platform provision service operates CAREER SHIP, a human resources development platform, by providing HCM solutions for enterprises and education fields as cloud services. The online English conversation service utilizing HCM cloud provides online English conversation under the OLECO brand in the cloud as content that can effectively utilize the learning management platform provided for cram schools.

name: KOBE BUSSAN
businessSummary: Kobe Bussan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of products for gyomu super stores. The Company operates gyomu super stores under a franchise chain (FC) model and engages in restaurant, prepared food and renewable energy businesses. The Company has three business segments. Gyomu super segment plans, develops and procures products as the FC headquarters of gyomu super and manufactures food products through subsidiaries in Japan and overseas. The products include national brand (NB) products and private brand (PB) products and partner factories. Restaurant and Prepared Food segment operates Kobe Cook World Buffet restaurants, Premium Karubi order-style yakiniku restaurants and Chisona prepared food stores directly and under the FC model. Eco Renewable Energy segment engages in solar power and woody biomass power generation using renewable energy. The Company also engages in tourism and other businesses.

name: EGUARANTEE
businessSummary: eGuarantee, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the credit guarantee business. The Company is involved in the analysis and screening of information based on the corporate credit information database, as well as the promotion of liquidation for transference of credit risks. The Company provides guarantee services for industrial corporations, including the entrusted business for risks with bad debts, such as trading and contract agreements, as well as guarantee services for financial corporations, including the entrusted businesses for risks with financial obligations, advanced payment debts and repayment claims. The Company operates its business through community banks, major city banks, trust banks, security companies, commercial firms, major financial institutions, leasing companies, nonbanks, and insurance agents in Tokyo, Osaka, Kyushu and Nagoya Prefectures.

name: TOEI ANIMATION
businessSummary: Toei Animation Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the video production and sales business, copyright business, and product sales business. It operates through three segments. The Video Production and Sales segment is mainly involved in the planning and production of various anime works for theaters and television, the sale of broadcasting rights and video rights for works, and video distribution services for personal computers and mobile devices. The Copyright segment licenses merchandising rights for characters that appear in the works it produces. The Product Sales segment develops and sells character products. The Company also plans and manages various events such as costume shows and musicals.

name: I GRID SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: i GRID SOLUTIONS Inc. develops and operates platforms that enable the integrated utilization of distributed energy resources in Japan. It operates through GX Solution Business and Energy Trading Business segments. The company develops and operates on-site solar power plants, as well as provides related support and consulting services. It also provides various services related to promoting green transformation, including battery storage and EV-related services  and offers energy trading services for the use and circulation of renewable energy resources. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: KAMAKURA SHINSHO
businessSummary: Kamakura Shinsho, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life ending services business and the life ending related books publishing business. The Life Ending Services segment is engaged in the funeral business, the Buddhist altar business and the grave business. The businesses are mainly engaged in the provision of funeral, Buddhist altar and grave information to users through portal sites e-sogi, e-butsudan and e-ohaka. The life ending related books publishing business is engaged in the production and sale of books related to life ending.

name: AEON
businessSummary: AEON CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in complex business centered on retail. It operates eight business segments. General Merchandise Store (GMS) segment operates general merchandise stores and uniform-price general merchandise retailers. Supermarket (SM) segment operates supermarkets, convenience stores and small supermarkets. Discount Store (DS) segment operates discount stores. Health & Wellness segment operates drugstores, pharmacies. Integrated Financial Services segment operates credit card businesses, fee-based businesses and banking services. Developer segment develops and leases shopping centers. Services & Specialty Stores segment operates comprehensive facility management services, amusement facilities, restaurants and specialty stores. International Business segment operates retail businesses in the ASEAN region and China. It also engages in mobile marketing and digital businesses.

name: GOLDCREST
businessSummary: Goldcrest Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in real estate development and related businesses, primarily in popular areas of the Tokyo metropolitan region. The Company operates through four business segments. The Real Estate Sales segment plans, develops and sells new condominiums under brands including Crest City and Crest Form. The Real Estate Leasing segment engages in the rental of office buildings, condominiums and other properties. The Real Estate Management segment provides comprehensive management services for condominiums and other properties. The Hotel segment operates and manages hotels. The Company is also involved in real estate brokerage, sales agency services, loan administration and advertising and promotional services.

name: RELO GROUP
businessSummary: Relo Group, Inc. provides property management services in Japan. The company is involved in the leased corporate housing management business, including consulting on dormitories and corporate housing, unattended house management services, rental brokerage, and other real estate services. It also offers global relocation support services, such as consulting and training regarding overseas transfers and business trips, support for the acceptance of foreign employees, and services related to overseas transfer regulations and compensation  solutions for HR activities  research, sales, and consulting on various indices  and serviced apartment operation and management. In addition, the company provides consulting of fringe benefit and customer treatment, immediate living assistance, outsourcing, and travel services, as well as consulting for insurance. The company was formerly known as Relo Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Relo Group, Inc. in July 2016. Relo Group, Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MACNICA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Macnica Holdings, Inc. imports, sells, and exports electronic components in Japan. The company provides semiconductors and integrated circuits  and is involved in the related operations. It also engages in the cybersecurity and cyber-physical systems solutions business. The company was formerly known as Macnica Fuji Electronics Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Macnica Holdings, Inc. in August 2022. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: KAMEDA SEIKA
businessSummary: Kameda Seika Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rice crackers and snacks in Japan and internationally. It produces rice flour bread  and offers plant-based and long-term preservation food, and rice congee. The company offers its products under the KAMEDA Kaki no Tane, Tsumami Dane, Kameda Usuyaki, Happy Turn, KAMEDA Magari Senbei, Potapota Yaki, Soft Salad, Age-Ichiban, Teshioya, Waza no KodaWari, Katabutsu, and HaiHain brand names. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Niigata, Japan.

name: MITSUI SOKO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Mitsui Soko Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the warehouse business, port transportation business and global flow business. The Company operates in two business segments. Logistics segment provides logistics services. These services include warehouse storage & handling, port work & transportation, overseas logistics & multiple integrated transport, air freight transport, third-party logistics (3PL), supply chain management support, as well as land freight transport services, among others. Real Estate segment provides services centered on the building leasing business.

name: NET ONE SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Net One Systems Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the system construction of information and communications technology (ICT) and related services. The Company operates in four segments. The ENT segment offers products and services to general private companies. The SP segment offers products and services to telecommunication companies. The PUB segment offers products and services to central ministries, municipalities and companies providing social infrastructure. The Partner segment offers specialized products and services in collaboration with partner companies. Other businesses include server services and others. The Company has two product groups, the equipment product group which is engaged in purchasing and sales of networks and platforms for ICT systems as well as service product group which provides support and services on equipment and systems.

name: NIPPON KODOSHI
businessSummary: NIPPON KODOSHI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of aluminum electrolytic capacitor separators and battery separators. Aluminum electrolytic capacitor separators are used in liquid crystal display television, inverter air conditioners, solar power generation systems, and automobiles. The separator for an electric double layer capacitor is used for industrial machines, cranes and other transport machines, precision equipment production lines, electric buses, wind power generation systems. Battery separators are used for primary batteries and secondary batteries. It also produces pulp. The Company sells products to Japan, China and Europe.

name: MENTAL HEALTH TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Mental Health Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the mental health solution business, medical career support business and digital marketing business. The Company operates through three segments. The Mental Health Solution segment develops the mental health care service ELPIS and provides services to customers. The Company packages the service provision service provided by industrial physicians and public health nurses and various cloud-type services ELPIS related to the physical and mental health management of workers, and provides them under the name of Industrial Physician Cloud. The Medical Career Support segment is a paid employment agency business based on the Employment Security Law, and mainly provides recruitment support services to introduce doctors to medical institutions. The Digital Marketing segment provides services for medical societies and web marketing support services.

name: NIPPON PAINT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nippon Paint Holdings Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of coating materials and fine chemicals products. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals. The Company operates in four business segments. The Japan segment conducts paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals business. The Asia segment conducts paint for automobile-, general- and industrial-uses, as well as fine chemicals business in China Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Korea, Southeast Asian countries, India. The Oceania segment conducts paint business, such as paint for general-, industrial-uses, and paints peripheral businesses. The Americas segment conducts paint for automobile business and contruction coating materials business.

In addition, the company engages in electricity retail business. beABLE CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Futaba, Japan.

name: KIKKOMAN
businessSummary: Kikkoman Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces, seasonings, beverages, wines and other food products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces and seasonings, processed tomato products under the brand name Del Monte, cans, vegetable and fruit juices, soy milk drinks, wines, sweet cooking rice wines, commercial food materials and others. The Domestic Other Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of drugs and chemical products, as well as the real estate, logistic and indirect business. The Overseas Food Manufacturing and Sale segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soy sauces, processed tomato products under the brand name Del Monte, cans and health food products in oversea markets. The Overseas Food Wholesale segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of oriental food products.

The Company is engaged in the manufacture of vacuum chambers and electrodes used in flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The products include semiconductor manufacturing equipment related parts, FPD manufacturing equipment related parts, and other equipment parts. The semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts are vacuum parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and inspection equipment. The FPD manufacturing equipment parts are vacuum devices for manufacturing equipment apparatus and inspection apparatus used in liquid crystal and organic electro luminescence (EL). The other parts consist surface processing equipment for smart phone housing, solar cell manufacturing equipment parts, motorcycle racing parts, industrial equipment parts for camera and microscope, as well as parts for medical equipment.

businessSummary: Suntory Beverage & Food Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of beverages and food. It operates through four geographical segments. Japan segment manufactures and sells mineral water, coffee drinks, tea drinks, carbonated drinks, sports drinks and others, and engages in marketing and product planning for soft drinks in Japan. European segment manufactures and sells carbonated drinks Orangina and Schweppes, fruit juice drinks Oasis and Ribena and energy drinks and sports drinks Lucozade in Europe. Americas segment manufactures and sells soft drinks, spirits, beer, wine and others and operates restaurants in North America.

The Company operates through two business segments. The Vacuum Equipment Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of sputtering equipment for liquid-crystal displays, organic electroluminescence (EL) manufacturing equipment, take-up type vacuum vapor deposition equipment, sputtering equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, vacuum pumps and measuring equipment. The Vacuum Application Business segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance for vacuum-applied products including sputtering target materials and analytical equipment.

businessSummary: Pigeon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of childcare and nursing products. It has six business segments. Domestic Baby and Mom segment manufactures and sells childcare and women’s products. Products are mainly weaning related products, skin care products, wet tissues, baby foods and outing products. China segment manufactures and sells products in China, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, Russia. Lansinoh segment manufactures and sells products in United States, Germany, United Kingdom, Turkey, China. Singapore segment manufactures and sells products in ASEAN countries such as Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Malaysia, as well as India, Australia and Middle East. Healthcare and Nursing Care segment manufactures and sells products and provides nursing care services. Products are incontinence products, care facility products. The Children segment provides childcare services such as licensed daycare centers, certified daycare centers, small-scale daycare centers, and sick child care rooms.

businessSummary: Kubota Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of agricultural machines, engines and construction machines. The Company operates in three business segments. Machinery segment manufactures and sells agricultural machines and agricultural products, such as tractors, tillers, combine harvesters, rice planters, lawn mowers. The Segment also provides construction machinery and engines for agricultural machinery, construction machinery, industrial machinery and generators. Water & Environment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pipe systems such as ductile iron pipes and synthetic pipes, industrial equipment such as reaction pipes, spiral steel pipes, air conditioning equipment, and various environmental plants, pumps, and other products related to the environment. Others segment mainly provides logistics and financial services, roofing materials and exterior wall materials.

businessSummary: M&A Capital Partners Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of brokerage business of mergers and acquisitions (M&A), as well as the provision of related services. The Company is mainly targeting middle and small-sized enterprises, providing M&A agency service, using the business model that makes free debut money and promoting business expansion. The Company operates M&A related service business, including brokerage business, brokerage and advisory services, as well as database provision and media management business. In addition, the Company also operates administrative and general management consulting services.

businessSummary: MANI Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of surgical related products, eyeless needle related products, and dental related products. It operates through three business segments. The Surgical Related Products segment provides surgical equipment, including skin sutures, ophthalmic knives, deep sutures, bone saws, vascular knives, ophthalmic trocars, and vitreous forceps. The Eyeless Needle Related Products segment provides surgical needle-attached sutures, eyeless suture needles (materials for surgical needle-attached sutures), and eyed suture needles (surgical suture needles). The Dental Related Products segment provides dental root canal treatment equipment, including reamers, files, nickel titanium (NiTi) files, cleansers, and broaches, dental rotary cutting equipment, including diamond burrs, carbide burrs, stainless steel burrs, and peeso reamers, and dental materials, including dental restorative materials.

businessSummary: TOYO Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the solar solution. The Company is mainly engaged in designing, manufacturing and selling of solar cells and solar modules and related businesses. The Company is a solar solution service provider that integrates the upstream production of wafer and silicon, midstream production of solar cell, downstream production of photovoltaic modules, and potentially other stages of the solar power supply chain.

name: ICHIKEN
businessSummary: ICHIKEN Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in construction business, such as construction, civil engineering and interior finish construction, as well as real estate business. The Company opreates its business through two business segments. Construction segment is involved in the operation of the business related to general construction, civil engineering and other construction work. Real Estate segment is involved in the sale and leasing of real estate, as well as other business related to real estate.

name: SANRIN
businessSummary: SANRIN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy related business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Energy Related segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of petroleum, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas, general high-pressure gas, charcoal, solar power generation systems and housing equipment, as well as the insurance agency business. The Ice Making segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of ice. The Fruit and Vegetable segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of vegetables and fruits. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the building lots and buildings transaction business. The Company is also engaged in the transportation business, the construction business, as well as the management and rental of LP gas related equipment.

name: MATSUDA SANGYO
businessSummary: Matsuda Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precious metals-related business and the food-related business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Precious Metals-related Business segment is engaged in the recovery and refining of precious metals, the sale of precious metal bullion, chemical products, electronic materials and others, and the collection, transportation, and disposal of industrial waste. The Food-related Business segment is engaged in the sale and transportation of raw materials for food processing, such as seafood, agricultural products, and livestock products.

name: OPEN GROUP
businessSummary: OPEN Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a technology company. It offers BizRobo, a software robot that performs for creating digital labor that offers various routine tasks  PRESCO, a performance-based advertising service  and RoboRobo, a cloud-based back-office efficiency tool. The company engages in the sales outsourcing  medical automation business. The company was formerly known as RPA Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to OPEN Group, Inc. in June 2024. OPEN Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ENEOS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ENEOS Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the energy business, oil and gas development business, and metal business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Energy segment is engaged in refining and sale of petroleum, the provision of lubricants, basic chemicals, functional chemicals, gas, coals, electricity, new energy and other products. The Oil and Natural Gas Development segment is engaged in the exploration, development and production of petroleum and natural gas. The Metal segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of copper foil, precision rolled products, precision processed products, thin film materials, development and mining of non-ferrous metal resources, non-ferrous metal products, as well as the industrial waste treatment, titanium and electric wires. The Company is also engaged in group common businesses such as asphalt paving, civil engineering work, construction work, land transportation, real estate rental and fund raising.

name: VALUECOMMERCE
businessSummary: ValueCommerce Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the provision of effective marketing solutions, from attracting customers to retaining customers, in order to maximize the performance of its customers, which are commerce businesses, in terms of gross merchandise value and investment efficiency. The Companyoperates through three business segments. The Marketing Solutions segment provides solutions to support customer acquisition and sales promotion for commerce businesses. Its main service is performance-based advertising affiliate. The EC Solutions segment provides pay-per-click advertising and customer relationship management (CRM) tools for online mall stores. The Travel Tech segment provides solutions to support customer acquisition and digital transformation (DX) for accommodation facilities.

name: WOWOW
businessSummary: Wowow Inc. provides broadcasting and related services in Japan. It procures and produces programs through broadcast satellite, as well as offers services through cable television, communication satellite, and IPTV. The company also provides telemarketing, and streaming services. The company was formerly known as Satellite Broadcasting, Inc. and changed its name to Wowow Inc. in December 2000. Wowow Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SHINAGAWA REFRA
businessSummary: Shinagawa Refra Co Ltd, formerly Shinagawa Refractories Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily manufactures and sells refractories, insulation materials, and fine ceramics, and performs furnace construction work. The Company operates through four segments. The Refractories segment mainly manufactures and sells shaped refractories, unshaped refractories, molded powder, quicklime, chemical products, and others. The Insulation Materials segment manufactures and sells refractory insulating bricks and ceramic fibers. The Advanced Materials segment manufactures and sells fine ceramics, inorganic coatings, and inorganic adhesives. The Engineering segment performs construction work for blast furnaces, converters, incinerators, and other facilities, as well as the design and construction of industrial furnaces. The Company also operates a real estate leasing business.

name: TAOKA CHEMICAL
businessSummary: TAOKA CHEMICAL COMPANY, LIMITED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemical business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical intermediates, agricultural chemicals intermediates, electronic components materials, resin raw materials, dyes and other fine chemicals, adhesives, rubber additives and other functional chemical materials, processed resins, varnishes and other functional resins, as well as plasticizers, methyl esters and other chemical products. The Company is also engaged in the chemical analysis contract business.

name: CHUGOKUKOGYO
businessSummary: CHUGOKUKOGYO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of high-pressure gas containers, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas storage tanks and equipment, steel structure equipment products and facility equipment products. The Company operates through four business segments. The High-Pressure Equipment segment manufactures and sells high-pressure gas containers, LP gas equipment, LP gas storage tanks and other high-pressure gas storage tanks, as well as designs and constructs high-pressure gas-related equipment. The Steel Structure Equipment segment manufactures and sells inner covers and other various steel structure products for steel manufacturers. The Facility Equipment segment manufactures and sells feed tanks and containers, wastewater treatment equipment, livestock machinery, chemical tanks, deodorizers and various other reinforced plastic (FRP) products. The Transportation segment includes general area freight forwarding, moving and warehousing.

name: MARVELOUS
businessSummary: Marvelous Inc. is a Japan-based entertainment company that operates in the game, amusement, and music and video content businesses. It operates through three segments. The Digital Content Business segment plans, develops, sells, and operates game content for home consoles, smartphones, and personal computers, and also undertakes game development on behalf of other companies. The Amusement Business segment plans, develops, and sells commercial equipment and products for amusement facilities, as well as planning and developing original game machines. The Music and Video Business segment focuses on music and video content, primarily animation.

name: STREAM
businessSummary: Stream Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the Internet retail business. It operates in three business segments. The Internet Retail segment is engaged in the sale of products through its Websites (e-commerce (EC) CURRENT, eBEST and TOKKA COM) and mobile sites. The products offered by the Company include personal computers (PCs); computer peripheral equipment, such as monitors, printers and digital cameras; home electrical appliances, such as televisions, refrigerators, washing machines and vacuum cleaners; software, such as business and game software, as well as new products such as watches, miscellaneous goods and others. This segment also provides warranty extension and repair agency services. The Beauty & Healthcare business conducts sales business for daily necessities including cosmetics and health foods. The Others segment is involved in the sales support business and online game business.

name: NADEX
businessSummary: NADEX CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronics components, sales of industrial machinery, factory automation (FA) system business and welding solution business of resistance welding equipment. The Company operates in four segments: Japan segment, the Americas segment, China segment and Thai segment. The Company’s welding equipment & materials business includes resistance welding, arc welding, laser and industrial robots, etc. The factory automation business includes automatic and labor-saving car parts manufacturing facilities, electronic devices, manufacturing facilities, inspection and meters. The electronic control equipment business includes electronics, control components and equipment, power supply modules. The information technology (IT) solutions include manufacturing execution system (MES) solutions, equipment management solutions, energy management solutions and image inspection solutions, etc.

name: JK HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JK Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plywood, the processing and sale of wood, and the wholesale and retail of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Company has three business segments. The General Building Material Wholesale segment is mainly engaged in the wholesale of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Plywood Manufacturing and Wood Processing segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of structural plywood, long plywood, laminated wood and assembled processed products, and the processing and sale of wood. The General Building Material Retail segment is mainly engaged in the retail of plywood, plywood secondary products, building materials and housing equipment. The Company is also engaged in the franchise, real estate leasing, warehouse, transportation, construction and travel business, and the insurance agency business.

name: CREAL
businessSummary: CREAL Inc. operates an asset management platform in Japan. It operates CREAL, a real estate fund online market  CREAL PB, an asset management service platform for individuals  and CREAL Pro, a platform that provides real estate investment management services to institutional investors and high-net-worth investors. The company also provides real estate crowdfunding platform and rental management services. CREAL Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: GOODPATCH
businessSummary: Goodpatch Inc conducts business activities with the aim of making people's lives more convenient and easier through design. The Company operates in two business segments. The Design Partner provides experience design (UI / UX) design support, and UX designers and UI designers design projects for client companies (clients) who mainly want to advance the design development of digital products such as websites and smartphone applications. It carries out the design process while leading the way and support the realization of the UI / UX design that client companies really need. The Design Platform segment is engaged in the support of UI / UX design support provided by the design partner business from various aspects. It supports the process from the effective use of design to the release as a product from the viewpoint of software, in-house design personnel, and design business environment, and functions as a platform that supports the design partner business.

name: KYOEI STEEL
businessSummary: Kyoei Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic steel business, overseas steel business and environmental recycling business. The Company has three business segments. The Domestic Steel segment manufactures and sells steel products mainly for domestic civil engineering and construction steel products. The products include deformed steel bars, flat steel and I-shaped steel. The Segment also trades and transports steel products. The Overseas Steel segment manufactures and sells steel products mainly for overseas civil engineering, construction and ore-crushing steel products. The products include deformed steel bars, threaded bars and wire rods. The Environmental Recycling segment operates intermediate and final treatment of medical and industrial waste and engages in the reclaimed stone business. The Company is also engaged in port business, foundry business, civil engineering material sales business and insurance agency business.

name: NANKAI PLYWOOD
businessSummary: NANKAI PLYWOOD CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden building interior materials, as well as the sale of electric wires and electrical equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Wood Related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of ceiling materials, storage materials, plywood and others, as well as the handling, packaging and transportation of raw materials and products. The Electric Wire Related segment is involved in the sale of electric wires and electrical equipment. The Company is also involved in the production and process of industrial and household synthetic resin products, as well as the real estate rental business.

name: HOKURIKU ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: HOKURIKU ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the equipment construction business. The Company provides two kinds of services. The electric power facility construction work is engaged in the electrical construction related to power supply facilities such as power distribution facilities. The electrical and air-conditioning pipe work is engaged in the power equipment work, telecommunication work, pipe work, water supply work, fire-fighting work, and civil engineering work. The Company is also engaged in the rental of real estate.

name: JDC
businessSummary: JDC Corporation engages in the construction business in Japan and Asia. The company is involved in the construction of dams, bridges, tunnels, roads, water supply and sewerage, landfills, stadiums, office buildings, apartments, and logistics facilities  and architectural design and business planning, building value regeneration, and food factory and seismic isolation engineering solutions. It also engages in the manufacture, sale, repair, and rental of construction and mining machinery  provision of coal ash mixed materials, refuse concrete, acetic acid absorbents, and adhesives  and operation of agricultural solar power plants and cemeteries. In addition, the company is involved in the development of electric power, transportation, ports and harbors, afforestation, flood control, irrigation, land reclamation, underground resources, and land  design, contractual, and management services related to civil engineering and building construction  provision of construction and stone materials, and chemical products  development, sale, rental, brokerage, management, and appraisal of real estate  investment, trading, brokerage, and management of investment equity  investment advisory  land and marine transportation and warehousing  quarrying  ownership, rental, and management of golf courses and ski resorts  travel agency  and environmental conservation activities, including soil and water remediation, as well as the collection, transport, processing, disposal, and recycling of municipal, industrial, and construction waste. Further, it engages in the provision of agricultural products and consulting services  generation and supply of electricity and heat  worker dispatching  and monetary loans, financial guarantees, factoring, and general leasing activities. JDC Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: PUNCH INDUSTRY
businessSummary: PUNCH INDUSTRY CO., LTD. is principally engaged in the manufacture and distribution of molds. The Company's main products are comprised of plastic molds, which are used for the manufacture of plastic products, such as the outer frame of digital cameras and mobile phones, as well as pressed molds, which are manufactured by pressing machinery. The main products manufactured by the Company include sprue bushings, gate bushings, ejector pins and other plastic molds, as well as guide bushes for die sets, punches, stripper guides and other pressed molds.
