name: VITAL KSK HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Vital KSK Holdings, Inc. engages in the wholesale and retail sale of pharmaceutical products in Japan. The company sells poisonous or deleterious substances, narcotics, quasi-drugs, medical equipment and devices, sanitary materials, hygiene goods, nursing care products, and beverages  and test reagents, agricultural chemicals, epidemiological agents and materials, industrial chemicals, veterinary drugs, paints, pigments, dyes, regenerative medicine products, and other chemicals, as well as well as chemicals for scientific use. It is also involved in the operation pharmacies  provision of medical management consulting services for medical institutions such as hospitals, nursing care providers, and local governments  wholesale of agricultural chemicals and agricultural materials  nursing care-related business  rental and sales of welfare equipment and home modification  general freight vehicle transportation activities  and insurance agency, real estate management, and parking lot operation businesses. Vital KSK Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Setagaya, Japan.

name: KEIWA
businessSummary: KEIWA Incorporated is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of functional films and solutions that meet customer needs by adding Ultra Precision to the core technologies of sheeting, laminating and coating. The Company operates through two business segments. The Optical Sheets segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale and process of light diffusion films for flat panel displays. The Functional Products segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and process of various products such as industrial packaging materials, industrial process paper, clean energy materials, building materials and agricultural materials.

name: O WELL
businessSummary: O-WELL CORPORATION is engaged in the sales of products related to Paint Related business segment and Electrical and Electronic Parts business segment. The Company supplies various products and services related to paints and electric and electronic parts to various industries. The Paint Related business segment includes paints and surface treatment agents such as general purpose paints and industrial paints; chemical products and goods such as soundproofing materials, plastic sheets, heat-resistant ceramic products, adhesives, synthetic resin products, coating materials, measuring instruments; painting equipment and measuring instruments; completion works such as painting line related works and interior and exterior renovation related works. The Electrical and Electronic Parts business segment includes hall intergrated circuits (IC) and light-emitting diode (LED) lighting products.

name: SAKURA RUBBER
businessSummary: Sakura Rubber Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty rubber products in Japan. The company offers firefighting products, including fire hoses, firefighting suction hoses, toxic substances measuring instruments, firefighting training and rescue apparatus, advanced rescue apps, air respirators, water rescue tools, air rescue equipment, hydraulic rescue tools, powered impact tools, emergency lifesaving tools, air lifting bags, community disaster prevention apparatus, couplings for large diameter hoses, MVU fans and blowers, and rescue support systems, as well as labor safety equipment. It also provides aerospace products, such as tube assemblies  PTFE and lightweight hoses, dynatube fittings, AM products, machined parts, one hoses, Parker-Stratoflex division products, molded and extruded rubber, silicone and chloroprene rubber ducts, rubber sheets, inflatable rubber seals, thermal insulations, and honeycomb mats. In addition, the company offers industrial rubber products comprising tank vapor seals  oil-resistant hoses for petrochemical plants  suction delivery hoses  gate seals  joints  radar sheets  pressed back products  molded rubber  and insulation hoses for hydroelectric dams and levees, as well as civil engineering-related rubber products and molds for manufacturing rubber products. Further, it engages in the real estate business, such as leasing and operation of shopping malls. Sakura Rubber Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: TOHOKUSHINSHA FILM
businessSummary: Tohokushinsha Film Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the advertising production, content production, media, and property. The Company operates through four business segments. The Advertisement Production segment is involved in the production of commercial messages (CMs) and sales promotion. The Content Production segment is engaged in digital production work, movie and program production, Japanese version production. The Media segment is engaged in the operation of communications satellite (CS) and broadcast satellite (BS) channels, program procurement, organization, and outsourcing of broadcasting related work. The Property segment is engaged in the co-planning and production of video contents, copyright business, as well as distribution of theaters and television. The Company is also engaged in the sale of video media, interior goods, and sake brewing and sales.

name: TOPY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Topy Industries Ltd is an automobile and industrial machinery parts manufacturing company. It operates in two business segments. The Steel segment produces steel using electric furnaces and rolls bar steel. H-beams, general shaped steel, and deformed steel bars are sold domestically and internationally, while deformed steel is supplied to the automotive and industrial machinery parts division. The Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts segment provides automotive steel wheels, aluminum wheels, steel wheels for construction machinery, automotive press products, industrial fasteners, and industrial machinery parts. Industrial fasteners include automobiles, home appliances, and industrial machinery. The Industrial Machinery Parts segment provides undercarriage parts for bulldozers and power shovels, tip fittings for blades and buckets, and cutting edges. Other businesses include the wholesale sale of electricity, the manufacture and sale of synthetic mica and others.

name: FORSIDE
businessSummary: Forside Co.,Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in prize, content, event, master rights, AI-related, and logistics-related businesses in Japan. The company involved in the planning, manufacturing, and selling of prizes for crane games and other prize games  operates Mobibook, an e-book distribution site  and publishing business. It also exhibits and sells famous content at event venues in commercial facilities. In addition, the company engages in the development of business tools  sale of GPU servers  general freight trucking and freight forwarding businesses  human resources services  and provision of temporary staffing, contract work, IT solutions, and transportation services, as well as act as a sales agent. The company was formerly known as SmartEbook.com Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Forside Co., Ltd. in April 2015. Forside Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: JAPAN POST INSURANCE
businessSummary: JAPAN POST INSURANCE Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company that underwrites life insurance and manages assets. It operates through Life Ensurance segment. It underwrites individual life insurance, individual annuity insurance, and reinsurance. It also conducts asset management through investments in securities, real estate, monetary claims, and loans. It provides insurance products through a nationwide sales network and manages insurance contracts and pays insurance claims and benefits. It primarily provides life insurance and annuity insurance services to individual customers in Japan.

name: GREE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Gree Holdings Inc, formerly Gree Inc is a Japan-based company that manages the business operations of group companies. The Company operates five segments. The Game and Animation Business segment operates and develops various smartphone games on GREE, as well as WFS, Pokelabo, and GREE Entertainment. The Company also creates, develops, and produces IP. The Metaverse business segment develops and operates the smartphone metaverse REALITY and operates a VTuber office that manages and produces talents. The DX business segment provides DX support to client companies mainly in marketing fields. The Commerce Business segment develops the media business centered on the aumo excursion information media, as well as the software as a service (SaaS) business and the digital gift business. The Investment business segment invests mainly in the Internet and IT in Japan and overseas through fund investments and startup investments. The Others segment includes new development and other businesses.

name: WDB HOLDINGS
businessSummary: WDB HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manpower dispatching business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Human Resource Service segment is engaged in the work of client customers mainly through temporary staffing and contracting contracts. The CRO (Contract Research Organization) business segment acts on and supports experimental work in basic research of pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, cosmetics and development work after clinical trial. The other business is engaged in the contracted manufacture of organic chemicals, as well as the product development and sale, and the research of the aquaculture and breeding of clams, fishes and algae, among others.

name: NORITZ
businessSummary: Noritz Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of household appliances and equipment in Japan. The company provides water heaters, and heating ventilation and air conditioning systems, such as gas water and oil water heaters  hybrid water and space heating systems  solar heating systems  waste heat recovery systems for fuel cells  hydronic floor heating systems  and gas fan heaters, as well as bathroom heating, drying, and ventilation systems. It also offers kitchen appliances, including built-in and counter-top gas cookers, gas ovens, and range hoods. In addition, the company provides after-sales and product installation services. The company was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: NANKAI CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Nankai Chemical Company,Limited manufacturers and sells chemical in Japan and internationally. The company offers inorganic industrial chemicals, water treatment disinfectants, water treatment agents, healthy foods, sulfuric acid recycling, and pesticides, as well as salt. It is also involved in the manufacturing and distribution of chemical industry products, pharmaceuticals, pesticides, cosmetics, quasi-drugs, and food additives  development and analysis of chemical industry products, pharmaceuticals, pesticides, cosmetics, quasi-drugs, foods and food additives  collection, transportation, and intermediate treatment of industrial waste  manufacturing, processing, and distribution of salt  distribution and recovery of precious metals, non-ferrous metals, and other bullions and their salts  distribution of precision machinery, textile machinery, plating equipment, paint equipment, and building materials  import/export of technologies and products  equipment engineering and management maintenance business  parking lot, and real estate management and warehousing  and consignment and agency services of accounting, general affairs, and personnel affairs research, development, production, and sale of agricultural, livestock, and marine products  freight transport and handling  calibration  management and operation of power generation  and electricity supply and sales business. Nankai Chemical Company,Limited was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: SCROLL
businessSummary: Scroll Corporation engages in the mail-order and e-commerce businesses in Japan. It operates through Solution Business, Mail Order Business, and E-Commerce Business segments. The company engages in the mail order agency business, such as logistics and payment agency, marketing support, and BPO services  mail order business, including apparel, underwear, and miscellaneous goods. It also offers e-commerce business for individuals comprising branded clothing accessories, outdoor goods, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, disaster prevention goods, and travel. It is also involved in the logistics and real estate rental businesses. The company was formerly known as Mutow Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Scroll Corporation in October 2009. The company was founded in 1939 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.

name: DMW
businessSummary: DMW CORPORATION is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, installation and sale of wind and water equipment. The Company’s main business is the manufacture and sale of wind and water equipment, energy recovery equipment for seawater desalination, wastewater treatment equipment, waste treatment equipment, switchboards, electrical instrumentation control equipment and telecommunication control equipment, as well as other related works. The Company’s main products include pumps including industrial pumps, large pumps, centrifugal pumps and submersible pumps, blowers including fans and blowers, as well as valves, among others.

name: AVEX
businessSummary: Avex Inc., an entertainment company, engages in music, artist management, animation, visual content, and other businesses in Japan. It operates through three segments: music, anime & visual content, and overseas segments. The company plans, produces, and sells musical content  publishes and distributes music  and plans, produces, and manages concerts and events. It also manages artists, talents, and creators  operates and manages fan clubs  and sells tickets. In addition, the company is involved in planning, developing, and managing e-commerce sites  planning, producing, sale, and distribution of digital content  planning and production of game software  artist management  supplying animation titles to video distribution services and film distribution activities, as well as planning, producing, and distributes entertainment content. The company was formerly known as Avex Group Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Avex Inc. in November 2017. Avex Inc. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NAKANISHI MFG
businessSummary: NAKANISHI MFG.CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in manufacture and sale business of the commercial kitchen equipment and the real estate leasing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacture and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial kitchen equipment for group canteens such as school canteens of school, hospital and company. The main products of this segment include dishwasher, rice cooker and tableware disinfection storage machines. The Company is also engaged in shipping of products from the Nara plant to the users. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in operation of office rental and parking lot rental for business persons.

name: HIRAGA
businessSummary: HIRAGA CO., LTD. is engaged in the sale promotion-related business. The Company is engaged in comprehensive printing business, sales promotion, planning and management of sales promotion management system, digital marketing of WEB and social networking service (SNS). The Company is also providing service including flyers printing, sticker printing, store sales promotion, sorting, packing, management, delivery, material printing, reservation systems, inventory management systems, campaign systems, digital flyers, novelty seal promotion, and LINE official account opening and operation support.

name: KOMATSU WALL INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Komatsu Wall Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, sale, and installation of partition products in Japan. It offers movable, fixed, retractable, low, and school partitions, as well as lightweight steel doors, interior metal works, toilet booths, and other related products. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Komatsu, Japan.

name: SUMINOE
businessSummary: SUMINOE Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacturing, and sale of interior products and automotive interior materials in Japan, North and Central America, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Interior Business  Automotive & Vehicle Interior Business  and Functional Material Business. The Interior Business segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of carpets, curtains, wallpaper, and various flooring materials, as well as handle design, construction, and supervision of interior construction. Its Automotive & Vehicle Interior Business segment offers interior materials for automobiles, buses, railway vehicles, etc. The Functional Materials Business segment manufactures and sells hot carpets, bathroom flooring, deodorizing products, aircraft interior materials, and aircraft interiors. It also offers artificial grass. The company was formerly known as Suminoe Textile Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SUMINOE Co., Ltd. in December 2024. SUMINOE Co., Ltd. was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: GUNOSY
businessSummary: Gunosy Inc. engages in the operation of news and information applications in Japan. The Media Business segment includes Gunosy, a mobile application that provides information curation service  au Service Today, an all-in-one application that provides news, weather, transit information, fortune-telling, etc.  and operates domestic and international Game8 media businesses. The G Holdings Business segment involves publishing social games, such as anime and manga. The New Businesses segment offers IR Hub, a timely disclosure support service for information disclosure  operates store and commerce business, such as S8 Shops, a service for building and managing external payment websites  and Game8 Store, an e-commerce service within Game8 that enables the sale of in-game items and game download keys. The company also offers News Lite, a news and information application available  and YOU IN, a wellness application. It is also involved in growth investment  investment business and consulting  and media, advertising, and entertainment businesses. Gunosy Inc. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: TDSE
businessSummary: TDSE Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in big data and artificial intelligence (AI) solution business. The business is divided into two categories, including consulting business centered on AI know-how and product business based on AI products. The consulting business centered on AI know-how provides integrated solutions centered on AI for companies aiming for data management, providing services including digital transformation and artificial intelligence (DX/AI) assessment, DX/AI consulting, analysis design/analysis, system construction/implementation, maintenance/tuning, and education. The product business based on AI products promotes the sale of its own AI products TDSE series and other companies' AI products, as well as services that provide business-specific AI modules to client companies.

name: WDB COCO
businessSummary: WDB coco CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the contract development of pharmaceutical companies. The Company is engaged in the provision of safety information management service as an agent and support for drug development, document support service, development support service and clinical development support service. The safety information management service provides support services such as input, evaluation drafting and report drafting. The document support service provides support services from QC (quality assurance) and translation of documents and materials necessary for marketing approval to PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency) to the creation of approval application called CTD (Common Technical Document). The development support service provides services such as survey form management, filing of survey-related documents and call center operations. The clinical development support service provides support services for clinical trial related work.

name: FB CARE SERVICE
businessSummary: FB Care Service Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the nursing care business. The Company operates through two segments. The Welfare Equipment segment provides welfare equipment rental and sales based on the Long-term Care Insurance Law, and home care support. The Long-term Care segment includes pay nursing homes with nursing care, residential pay nursing homes, group homes, small-scale multifunctional home care, nursing small-scale multifunctional home care, day services, home-visit care, home-visit nursing care, and long-term care non-insurance services. The Company provides welfare equipment, home care support, and dominant care services in the Shinetsu and Kita-Kantou areas.

name: SHOEI YAKUHIN
businessSummary: SHOEI YAKUHIN CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemicals business. The Company mainly operates in three segments. The Chemicals segment is engaged in the sale of chemicals, including oleochemical, such as fatty acids, fatty amines, fatty alcohols and glycerin, as well as surfactants, among others. The Daily Necessities segment is engaged in the plan, development and sale of detergents, cosmetics and various ideas miscellaneous goods. The Civil Engineering and Construction Materials segment is engaged in the sale of ground improvement chemicals, repair materials, and environmental improvement chemicals.

name: IFUJI SANGYO
businessSummary: Ifuji Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the liquid eggs and related business in Japan. It provides liquid, frozen, and processed eggs to confectionery, bread, and frozen food manufactures, as well as restaurant industry. The company also offers egg-based processed food products to the restaurant and delicatessen industries. In addition, it manufactures and sells pork, chicken, beef, squid, shrimp, sea bream, and other powdered and granulated seasoning products for commercial use  purchases and sells organic and other natural products through its e-commerce site  and engages in the solar power generation business. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: ARAYA INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: Araya Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Steel Pipe-Related Business, Bicycle-Related Business, and Real Estate Leasing Business. The company offers ordinary steel pipes, stainless steel pipes, deformed steel pipes, various shaped steel pipes, and precision parts for OA machines. It also offers wheelchair suspension wheels, wing arms, wheelchair with absolex, and industrial absolex, as well as bicycle rims  and imports and sells bicycles. In addition, the company engages in real estate rental business, including leasing of lands, buildings, and warehouses. Further, it offers welfare equipment. Araya Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1903 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

name: BRIDGE INTERNATIONAL GROUP
businessSummary: Bridge International Group Corp, formerly Bridge International Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of various solution services that solve corporate sales challenges, with a focus on inside sales. The Company operates through three business segments. The Inside Sales Outsourcing Business segment conducts sales activities to prospective customers without meeting them face-to-face, using telephone, email, online conferencing tools, and also provides inside sales outsourcing services. The Process Technology Business segment provides consulting services, system solutions, operation support, and network solutions for corporate marketing and sales activities. The Training Business segment provides digital talent development training for companies.

name: YUKEN KOGYO
businessSummary: YUKEN KOGYO CO., LTD. is a company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic, system products and environment equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Japan segment, Asia segment and Europe segment are engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic equipment, including hydraulic products, system products and environment equipment. The hydraulic products division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of oil pumps and motors, pressure-control valves, flow-control valves, directional-control valves and various hydraulic control equipment. The system products division is engaged in the manufacture, sale and maintenance of hydraulic systems for industrial machinery, standard hydraulic units and hydraulic cylinders. The environment equipment division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic cutting compression machines, automatic polyethylene terephthalate (PET) bottles volume reduction machines, as well as automatic multi-compactors.

name: SAKAI HEAVY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Sakai Heavy Industries Ltd mainly manufactures and sells road paving equipment, road maintenance and repair equipment, and water trucks both domestically and internationally. The Company also sells industrial machinery manufactured by other companies, conducts research and development activities including the development of new products, and develops other services related to each business. It designs, manufactures, sells, and repairs construction machinery, industrial machinery, and their parts, procures and sells used construction machinery, and designs, constructs, supervises, and contracts road paving and repair work. Major products include earthwork vibratory rollers, tire rollers, road rollers (macadam rollers), paving vibratory rollers, small compaction machines, road maintenance, subgrade improvement, and water trucks, as well as information and communication technology (ICT) products. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Indonesia, and China.

name: SUN WA TECHNOS
businessSummary: Sun-Wa Technos Corporation engages in the distribution of electrical machinery, electronics, and general machinery in Japan, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. The company operates through Electronic Components Division, Control Devices Division, Industrial PC Division, and FA Solutions Division segments. It sells industrial electronics- and mechatronics-related equipment, devices and parts. The company also sells electronic components, electronic equipment, office automation equipment, factory automation systems, communication and information equipment. In addition, it engages in the sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, industrial robots, clean robots, FA industry-related equipment and devices, printed circuit board and related apparatus, logistical transportation equipment, automotive electronic products, and various inspection equipment. It also provides electrical construction and engineering support for improvement of efficiency of production facilities. The company was formerly known as Yamada Kogyo Corporation and changed its name to Sun-Wa Technos Corporation in April 1993. Sun-Wa Technos Corporation was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: NITTO KOHKI
businessSummary: NITTO KOHKI CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of quick-connecting fuild couplings, machine tools and others. The Company operates in four business segments. The Quick-connecting Fluid Couplings segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of quick-connecting fluid couplings. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Linear Motor Driven Pumps segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of linear motor driven pumps. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction machinery.

name: GALILEI HOLDINGS CO LTD
businessSummary: Galilei Holdings Co.Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sale of commercial refrigerators and freezers, frozen showcases, and other equipment in Japan and internationally. It offers ice makers, blast chillers and shock freezers  dough conditioning equipment  commercial dishwashers  medical cool boxes, low temperature incubators, and ultra-low-temperature freezers  CO2 refrigeration systems  and tunnel and spiral freezers. The company also provides inspect, repair, and maintenance services. It serves its products to in food service industry, supermarkets, drugstores, convenience stores, and medical and life science research. The company exports in 11 countries in China and Southeast Asia. The company was formerly known as Galilei Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Galilei Holdings Co.Ltd. in July 2026. Galilei Holdings Co.Ltd. was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 8508.T|J Trust Co., Ltd.|8508.T|J Trust Co., Ltd.
name: J TRUST
businessSummary: J Trust Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of various financial services in Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. It engages in the credit guarantee  finance business for consumers and businesses  debt collection business  securities  credit card  individual credit purchase mediation  banking  consulting  real estate  investment  rent guarantee  holding  and system development businesses. J Trust Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: HIROSHIMA GAS
businessSummary: HIROSHIMA GAS Co.,Ltd. engages in the gas business in Japan. The company operates through Gas Business, LPG Business, and Other Activities segments. It engages in the production, supply, and sale of gas  wholesale supply of gas to other gas companies  sale of gas devices  and installation of gas equipment associated with gas devices, as well as safety inspection and gas meter data collection activities. The company is also involved in the sales of LPG and LPG devices  refilling of LPG tanks  installation of LPG pipes  and construction of gas pipes and lines, as well as gas appliances. In addition, it engages in the engineering  machinery installation  fees collection and call center operation  and information distribution activities, as well as provision of services for seniors. The company was formerly known as Hiroshima Gas Electric Railway Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HIROSHIMA GAS Co.,Ltd. in 1942. HIROSHIMA GAS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1909 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

name: NISSAN TOKYO SALES HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NISSAN TOKYO SALES HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in automobile-related businesses centered on automobile dealerships. The Company has one segment. Automobile-related segment sells new and used vehicles, parts and accessories, and provides vehicle maintenance services. The services also include optional parts and insurance products offered when vehicles are purchased, regular maintenance and other after-sales services and support for customers' car life. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate.

name: NIHON ENTERPRISE
businessSummary: Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and operates content for smartphone and other multi devices. It offers Women's Diary, a health care app for women  and Inaseri Ichiba website for general consumers that sells fisheries products, fruits, and vegetables. The company also provides business support services, such as kitting support, traffic information, and sound solution services  and system development and operation services for enterprise customers to streamline their business operations, as well as advertising agent services. In addition, the company engages in the renewable power generation business. Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: HONYAKU CENTER
businessSummary: Honyaku Center Inc. provides translation services in Japan and internationally. The company offers translation for patent documents comprising application-related, court-related, and others  and medical documents, including basic research/non-clinical development, clinical development, regulatory submission, and post-marketing. It also provides financial and legal translations comprising finance, legal, disclosure and related documents, and corporate and other documents  and translation services for IT related documents and manuals documents. In addition, the company offers translation of industrial documents, such as R&D, planning, and design documents  production, quality assurance, implementation, and maintenance service documents  sales and marketing documents  and non-manufacturing industry related documents. Further, it provides medical writing, grammar check, transcription, staffing, multilingual contact center, interpreting, foreign patent application services  proofreading and back translation, and foreign patent application services, as well as services related to computer games, apps, and Websites  and prepares drawings. Additionally, the company offers translation services for VISA application documents required to apply for marriage, work, residency, study abroad, and other visas  and DTP, printing, document, and e-book translation related services, as well as pamphlets and catalogues, press releases and newsletters, and presentation documents. The company serves clients in a range of industries, such as auto, mechanical, electronics, pharma, patent, law, finance, R&D, education, and other fields. Honyaku Center Inc. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: NOVAC
businessSummary: Novac Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering and construction work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Civil Engineering Business segment is engaged in social infrastructure construction work (road construction, river construction, water supply and sewage construction, and land development work) mainly for public agencies such as local governments and highway companies. The Building Construction Business segment mainly carries out apartment building construction work ordered by private companies, and construction projects ordered by government agencies, such as schools, welfare facilities, government buildings, offices, and highway service areas. The Company also operates real estate rental business, renovation work and other businesses.

name: YAMADA CONSULTING GROUP
businessSummary: YAMADA Consulting Group Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the management consulting business, real estate consulting business and other businesses. The Company operates in four business segments. The Management Consulting segment conducts management consulting business, merger and acquisition capital consulting business, overseas business consulting business and others. The Real Estate Consulting segment provides real estate consulting, real estate sales brokerage and other businesses. The Educational Training and Financial Planner (FP)-related segment includes sales of FP-qualified courses, corporate training, and others. The Investment and Fund segment conducts the formation, operation, and investment of investment business associations.

name: CASA
businessSummary: Casa Inc. engages in the rent guarantee business in Japan. The company offers guarantee, benefit, and consultation services for residents, as well as manages rental properties for landlords. It also provides food, housing, employment, and public support services to residents. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TAKIGAMI STEEL CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Takigami Steel Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of steel structure products. The Company operates in five business segments. The Steel Structure Products Manufacturing segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and construction of steel bridges, iron frames and other steel structure products and the development and sale of precast concrete products for bridges, and sale of asphalt additives. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing and management of real estate properties. The Materials Sale segment is engaged in processing and sale of steel sheets and various steel materials. The Transportation segment is engaged in transportation of goods and other related business. The machine tool manufacturing segment is engaged in the design, manufacture and sale of machine tools, automotive machine tools, and jigs and tools. The Company also operates a solar power generation business.

name: TANSEISHA
businessSummary: Tanseisha Co., Ltd. engages in the research, planning, design, layout, production, construction, and operation of commercial, public, hospitality, event, and business and cultural spaces in Japan. The company's research and planning services comprise consulting, research and analysis, planning, coordination, branding, and project management  and design and layout services comprising design concept, basic layout, and execution design, as well as the proposal for creative media spaces. Its production and construction services comprising design supervision, production and construction, and technical direction for chain stores, such as fashion and fast-food stores, and multimedia spaces  and operation services, which include operational planning and maintenance, and promotional planning, as well as assessment, inspection, and effectiveness measurement. In addition, the company engages in rental and sales of office equipment, human resources support, website utilization, advertising, and information provision services. Tanseisha Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SATA CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Sata Construction Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company is primarily engaged in the construction of civil engineering works and building construction works. In its construction business, the Company involves in the order entry and construction of works, as well as the sale of asphalt mixtures. Through one of its subsidiaries, the Company also involves in the provision of rental services of construction materials and equipment.

name: BESTERRA
businessSummary: Besterra Co., Ltd. provides demolition works in Japan. It executes demolition works for large-size plants, including oil refining, petrochemical, ironmaking, steelmaking, and gas sectors, as well as ancillary and small-scale facilities containing hazardous or toxic materials  and provides design and consulting services for worker dispatch, employment placement, and 3D measurement businesses. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

name: S FOODS
businessSummary: S Foods Inc., a meat company, engages in manufacture, wholesaling, retailing, and food servicing of meat-related food products in Japan. It offers products under the Kotechan brand. The company was formerly known as Stamina Foods Inc. and changed its name to S Foods Inc. in August 2000. S Foods Inc. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Nishinomiya, Japan.

name: SUCCEED
businessSummary: Succeed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of educational services and human resources services. It has three business segments. The Education Human Resources Support segment introduces and dispatches human resources related to education such as home teachers, information and communication technology (ICT) support staff, school teachers, club activity instructors, Japanese language teachers to general households, private cram schools, school corporations and local governments. The Welfare Human Resources Support segment introduces and dispatches welfare-related human resources such as nursery teachers, nutritionists, after-school care instructors, social workers, and care staff to nursery schools, kindergartens, after-school care facilities, and care facilities. The Individualized Instruction Classroom Business develops a cram school Individual Guidance Academy Succeed that provides individualized learning guidance and a schoolchildren's club Pentas Kids.

isin: 4534.T|Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.|4534.T|Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
name: MOCHIDA PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and healthcare products in Japan. The company offers pharmaceuticals products for the treatment of cardiovascular, obstetrics, gynecology, dermatologists, psychiatry, and gastroenterological, including Realda and Collagen for the treatment of ulcerative colitis  Goofis and Movicol for the treatment of chronic constipation  interstitial pulmonary hypertension for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension  Treprospermid, for pulmonary hypertension associated with ulcerative lung disease  Uris, for gout and hyperuricemia  and Clorox, for ulcerative colitis  Epadel for hyperlipidemia and obstructive arteriosclerosis  Treprost for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension and pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease  Atelec, a calcium channel blocker antihypertensive drug  Heparin Na anticoagulants  and Onboard, ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease treatment agents. In addition, it develops medical devices, including dMD-002, which is used for the treatment of cavernous nerve injury  and dMD-003 for adhesion prevention material. Further, the company engages in the development, production, distribution, sale, and marketing of skincare products, as well as academic research and marketing. Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

isin: 6763.T|TEIKOKU TSUSHIN KOGYO|6763.T|Teikoku Tsushin Kogyo Co., Ltd.
name: TEIKOKU TSUSHIN KOGYO
businessSummary: Teikoku Tsushin Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company offers resistance sensors, potentiometers, trimmer potentiometers, encoders, switches, fixed resistors, antifreeze-heaters, and customized products. Its products are applied in automotive, game/toy, home appliances, and medical and healthcare, as well AV, musical/acoustic, house, and office supply/industrial equipment. The company was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

name: PACK
businessSummary: The Pack Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells paper products, film packaging, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company offers tote bags, paper bags, plastic bags, parcel delivery bags, sewn bags, garment bags, and other bags  paper boxes, paper trays, clear cases, and other types of boxes in various shapes  and corrugated shipping boxes, large-corrugated boxes for packing major appliances, and cushioning materials. It also provides gift boxes, drawstring bags, wrapping papers, seals, tags, ribbons, and other products for store supplies  film and flexible packaging products for food products, daily necessities, hygiene products, pharmaceuticals, and other product categories  and eco products. In addition, the company offers offset rotary printing and gravure printing services for shopping bags, decorative corrugated boards, paper containers, and other products  and printing services for paper containers, paper bags, wrapping papers, posters, pamphlets, flyers, product catalogs, magazines, books, shopping bags, packaging, seals, and others. Further, it prints, manufactures, and sells processed paper products. The Pack Corporation was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: YAMADA
businessSummary: YAMADA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refueling equipment and related products. The Company operates in five regional segments. The main products include automotive equipment such as hand pumps, bucket pumps, lubricators and other lubrication equipment and tire service equipment, exhaust gas emission systems, freon gas collection equipment and other environmental maintenance equipment for automobile maintenance shops and gas stations, as well as industrial equipment such as air pumps and double diaphragm pumps that transport chemicals, inks, adhesives and paint fluids. The Company is also engaged in the sale and repair of service parts. The Company operates within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the United States, Netherlands, China and Thailand.

name: PASONA GROUP
businessSummary: Pasona Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly provides human resources (HR) solutions. It has six segments. The Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Solutions segment accepts or undertakes tasks from clients and processes them through a system of employees and workers who have signed employment contracts to carry out the tasks. The Expert Solutions segment recruits and registers temporary staff and dispatches them to companies. The Career Solutions segment recruits and registers job seekers and job seekers, while also collecting job information and conducting a fee-based employment placement business to match mutual needs. The Global Solutions segment provides a full range of HR related services overseas, including recruitment, temporary staffing and contract work, payroll, and education and training. The Life Solutions segment engages in childcare support and education, nursing care, and life support businesses. It also has the Regional Revitalization and Tourism Solutions segment.

name: KITAGAWA
businessSummary: Kitagawa Corporation manufactures and supplies synthetic metals, machine tool accessories, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers standard and advanced chucks, jaw force testers, manual chucks, rotary cylinders, chuck parts, NC rotary tables, power vises, work grippers, robot accessories, vise parts, and other peripheral equipment for machine tools such as turning centres and vertical machining centres. It also provides tower cranes for building construction, concrete mixing plants, multi-story car parking, and bridge erection machines, as well as recycling plants  and components for automotive industry. The company was formerly known as Kitagawa Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Corporation in June 2018. Kitagawa Corporation was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

name: FUJISASH
businessSummary: FUJISASH CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of building materials and aluminum profiles. The Company operates through three business segments. The Building Materials segment manufactures and sells curtain walls, sash and doors for buildings, sash and doors for mid- to low-rise buildings, sashes for renovation, sashes for houses, sliding doors and doors, interior fittings, and exterior products. The Shape Material Sales segment manufactures and sells aluminum shapes and precision processed aluminum products for external sales. The Environmental segment designs, manufactures and constructs a municipal garbage incineration facility fly ash treatment plant and associated chemicals, and a municipal garbage recycling facility. The Company is also involved in the real estate, transportation and storage management business.

name: ALTECH
businessSummary: ALTECH CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the purchase and sale of industrial machine and equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of plastic bottle preforms and plastic caps. The company operates through two business segments. The Business Firm segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of industrial machinery, equipment, as well as the provision of related services. Main product of this segment is plastic bottle related inspection equipment, plastic bottle molding dies, security related devices and synthetic resin materials, among others. The Preform segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic bottle preforms and plastic caps, as well as the provision of related services.

name: TANAKEN
businessSummary: Tanaken Inc, formerly Tanaken, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in demolition work of the building structure and supervision of various constructions incidental thereto. The Company provides overall business, including current situation survey, proposal of construction method, design, construction plan, neighbor correspondence and others. The Company also provides supervise construction work related to building construction demolition work, mountain work, basic demolition work and pile removal work. It proposes and provides various dismantling works in cost, construction term and safety concerning removal of harmful pollutants such as polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB), groundwater purification and soil improvement. The Company carries out work supervision, safety control, neighbor communication, guides and supervises cooperative companies, and carries out demolition work.

name: CHUO SPRING
businessSummary: Chuo Spring Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of springs, control cables, building materials and equipment, and automotive products in Japan, North America, China, and Asia. The company offers chassis springs, such as coil springs, stabilizers, leaf springs, torsion bars, and ODDS, an on demand disconnectable stabilizer  and precision springs, including precision coil springs, valve springs, heat-resistant springs, power back door springs, spiral springs, wire springs, knitted mesh springs, and assembly products. It also provides transmission cables, parking brake cables, opener cables, door lock cables, and power sliding door cables  and customized springs to aftermarket specifications. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: ALUE
businessSummary: Alue Co., Ltd. is mainly engaged in the human resource development business. The Company provides corporate service and individual service. In the corporate service, the Company conducts business skill training, mind training and language research, promotes the growth of corporates and individuals, provides classroom-based research, overseas dispatch training, overseas classroom training and corporate ALUGO for government agencies, private enterprises, school corporations and local governments. In the individual service, the Company provides ALUGO of English conversation service provided for corporate customers for individuals to improve homework and counseling learning support, builds an accompanying system, provides services in the form of ALUGO.

name: KYB
businessSummary: KYB Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of hydraulic shock absorbers and hydraulic equipment, as well as the provision of services related to each business. The Company operates through three segments. The Automotive Components (AC) segment produces hydraulic equipment for automobiles, mainly hydraulic shock absorbers for automobiles and motorcycles, and power steering products. The Hydraulic Components (HC) segment produces industrial hydraulic equipment mainly for construction machinery, stage mechanisms, naval equipment, and vibration damping devices. The Aviation Equipment segment produces takeoff and landing gear, steering gear, and control equipment for aircraft. The Company also manufactures and sells concrete mixers, powder and granule transport vehicles, and special function vehicles.

name: HAYASHIKANE SANGYO
businessSummary: Hayashikane Sangyo Co.,Ltd. produces and sells food products in Japan. The company operates through Food Business and Feed Business segments. The Food Business segment manufactures, purchases and sells functional ingredients, processed foods, and meat. The Feedstuff Business segment manufactures and sells compound feed, water, marine, and aquatic products. It offers fish meat products, fish ham and sausage, and functional foods, as well as fish and livestock feed. The company also leases real estate and provides storage services. In addition, the company engages in information processing, refrigerated warehouse, and real estate related activities. Hayashikane Sangyo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan.

name: ESTIC
businessSummary: ESTIC CORPORATION is engaged in manufacture, sale, repair and inspection of nut runners, hand nut runners, servo press and screw tightening equipment. The nut runner consists of alternating current (AC) turbo motors, sensors and controllers. It uses AC servomotor as the driving source, analyzes information from sensor though computer and controls the motor to tighten screws of bolts and nuts. The hand nut runner is a hand tool for tighten. The servo press is a press machine, consisting of AC servo motor, sensor and controller. The machine is applied in nut runner technology, uses AC servomotor as the driving source, presses object by changing the rotational force of the motor to linear motion through ball screw. The repair and inspection business provides repair of nut runners, hand nut runners, servo press, as well as inspection of accuracy for screw tightening.

name: FENWAL CONTROLS OF JAPAN
businessSummary: Fenwal Controls of Japan, Ltd. is mainly engaged in development of products based on heat control technology. The Company operates in four business segments. Fire Prevention and Extinction segment develops, manufactures and sells fire detection equipment, firefighting equipment, fire alarm systems, explosion control system, high sensitivity smoke detection (SAS) system and overheat alarm system, as well as engages in provision of services of the systems. Temperature Control segment develops, manufactures, sells, designs and services temperature controller, hot plate and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, thermocouple for high temperature furnace and other temperature control equipment and services this system. Medical segment develops, designs, manufactures and services artificial kidney dialysis equipment and medical equipment. Printed Circuit Board segment engages in artwork design, noise countermeasure and printed circuit board mounting assembly.

name: HOKUETSU METAL
businessSummary: Hokuetsu Metal Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, processing and sale of steel products. The Company mainly provides steel bars, wire rods, shaped steels, ultra-high yield (UHY) hoops, fab decks, meshes, lock bolts, turn buckles, UN bolts, deformed bolts, UND self-drilling bolts, spring chains, among others.

isin: 3193.T|Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd.|3193.T|Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd.
name: ETERNAL HOSPITALITY GROUP
businessSummary: Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants under the Torikizoku, Yakitori Daikichi, Toriki Burger, zoku, HASU, and mozu brands in Japan and internationally. It also engages in the franchise development of the Yakitori Daikichi brand. The company was formerly known as Torikizoku Holdings Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. in May 2024. Eternal Hospitality Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 4112.T|Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd.|4112.T|Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd.
name: HODOGAYA CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sale of organic industrial chemicals in Japan. The company operates through five segments: Functional dyes, Functional Resins, Basic Chemicals, Agroscience, and Logistics. The Functional dyes segment offers charge control agents for toners, organic photoconductor materials, organic EL materials, Biomaterials, various dyes, etc. The Functional resins segment provides urethane raw materials, adhesives, release agents urethane-based materials for various building and timber applications, waterproofing and water-stopping work and various intermediates for pharmaceutical resin materials and electronic materials. The Basic Chemicals segment offers Hydrogen peroxide and its derivatives, and other basic industrial raw materials. The Agroscience segment provides herbicides, insecticides, oxygen supply agents. The Logistics segment offers warehousing, cargo handling, iso tank container storage. The company was formerly known as Hodogaya Soda Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. in 1939. Hodogaya Chemical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 1968.T|Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd.|1968.T|Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd.
name: TAIHEI DENGYO KAISHA
businessSummary: Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the plant construction business in Japan and internationally. The company constructs and maintains clean energy, steelmaking, petrochemicals, cement, waste disposal, recycling facilities, and theme parks, as well as thermal, nuclear, and geothermal power stations  and renewable energy power generation, such as biomass, geothermal and solar, and fuel cell power plants. It is also involved in mechanical design, electrical and instrumentation design, work planning, technical development, civil and construction design, and field engineering  maintenance and major overhaul works and decommissioning works  and petrochemical plants, steel manufacturing, and paper manufacturing. In addition, the company provides equipment installation services for building facilities, amusement facilities  operation and maintenance services  and education and training programs. Further, it is involved in the construction and maintenance of gas-turbine, diesel engine, combined cycle and wind power plants  design and production of steel mill, sugar refining, cement and other industrial plants  refuse incineration, dioxin treatment, sludge treatment and waste recycling plants  design, manufacture, installation and maintenance of various electrical system, sub-station, control system, optical fiber communication system, building electrical facilities  design and construction of heat ventilation and air conditioning system, and utility sanitary system  and design, procurement and fabrication of machined products, tanks, piping, class-2 pressure vessels, electrical and control panels. Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KATO SANGYO
businessSummary: Kato Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food wholesale, logistics and other services. It operates through four business segments. The Ambient Temperature Distribution Business segment sells instant foods (including canned and retort foods), dried foods and grains, beverages, luxury items, seasonings, and other products. The Low Temperature Distribution Business segment wholesales low-temperature foods. The Alcohol Distribution Business segment sells alcoholic beverages. The Overseas Business segment is based overseas and mainly engages in wholesale of processed foods. Other businesses include logistics, insurance agency services, operation of restaurant franchises, and the supervision, management, and operation of some overseas affiliated companies.

name: MEDIKIT
businessSummary: MEDIKIT CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company involved in the development, manufacture and sale of medical equipment. Its major products consist of artificial diagnostic equipment, which includes indwelling needles that are used for artificial dialysis purposes; indwelling venous needles (anesthesia type), which are used for blood and fluid transfusion purposes, and angiography equipment, which includes introducers and angiographic catheters.

name: TESEC
businessSummary: TESEC Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor test equipment in Japan, China, Taiwan, Malaysia, the Philippines, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers DC static characteristics and inductive load one-pass test system for SiC/GaN power semiconductors  power device test system  IPD/IPM test system  thermal resistance tester  inductive load tester  and dynamic test system. It also provides various handlers comprising tri-temp lead frame strip test, film frame test, gravity, MEMS, and TAB handlers, as well as die sorters. In addition, it offers after-sales services, such as tester calibration, overhaul, and training services, as well as spare parts, warranty, maintenance, and resale services. The company was formerly known as TES Corporation and changed its name to TESEC Corporation in 1980. TESEC Corporation was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Higashiyamato, Japan.

name: OKABE
businessSummary: Okabe Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction equipment and materials, and also focuses on developing other business fields. The Construction-related Products segment develops, manufactures, and sells temporary and formwork products, civil engineering products, and structural equipment products, and uses its sales network to purchase and sell building materials from other companies. In the United States and Indonesia, it manufactures and sells building materials and also manages commercial real estate. Other businesses include the manufacture and sale of industrial machinery products, the development, manufacture, and sale of marine materials, the planning and sale of bolts and nuts for automobiles in the United States, and tenant leasing.

name: DKK
businessSummary: DKK Co Ltd, formerly Denki Kogyo Co Ltd is a company mainly engaged in the electric communication- and high frequency-related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Electric Communication segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction and sale of various antennas, reflector plates, steel towers and steel structures, plating processing of various telecommunications equipment and steel frames, as well as construction of electric communication facilities. The High Frequency-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of high frequency induction heating equipment, various high-frequency power supplies for plasma, as well as processing of High-frequency heat treatment. The Company is also involved in the equipment lending business and solar power distribution business.

name: KAGA ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: Kaga Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly manufactures and sells electronic components. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electronic Components Business segment develops, manufactures and sells semiconductors, general electronic components, electronics manufacturing service (EMS) and others. The Information Equipment Business segment sells finished products including personal computers, personal computer (PC) peripherals, home appliances, photo and video related products, as well as original brand products. The Software Business segment produces computer graphic (CG) videos and plans and develops amusement-related products. The Other Business segment repairs and supports electronics equipment, manufactures and sells amusement equipment and sells sporting goods.

name: CUBE SYSTEM
businessSummary: CUBE SYSTEM INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of system solutions and services. It has three kinds of services. The system integration services are engaged in the provision of system user interface design, environment design, basic design, programming design and system testing services for customer's information system construction. The system outsourcing services are engaged in the services’ provision for system operation and evaluation, mechanism reform and system replacement. The professional services are engaged in the provision of systematization consulting service, database efficiency service, system monitoring service and other technical services by development tools and technology levels.

name: UEX
businessSummary: UEX,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of stainless steel and other metal materials, the manufacture and sale of stainless steel and other metal processed products, and the manufacture and sale of mechanical equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Stainless Steel and Other Metal Materials Sales business is engaged in the cutting and sale of metal materials such as stainless steel plates, steel pipes, steel strips, and stainless steel pipes for semiconductor devices, the processing and sales of fake products, forged products, machined parts. The Stainless Steel and Other Metal Materials Manufacture and Sales business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless steel weather covers and stainless steel pipe products. The Machinery Manufacturing and Sales and Engineering business is engaged in the design and manufacture of general industrial equipment mainly for food and chemicals, and the provision of engineering services.

name: YOTAI REFRACTORIES
businessSummary: YOTAI REFRACTORIES CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of refractory products, as well as the furnace installation engineering business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Refractory Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various refractory bricks such as basic bricks, high alumina bricks, clay bricks and silica bricks, and unshaped refractory products for irons and steels, nonferrous metals, cements, glass, furnaces and environmental equipment related kilns uses. The Engineering segment is engaged in the design and construction of various industrial kilns and environmental facilities that use refractories, as well as the contacted maintenance business.

name: NIPPON HUME
businessSummary: Nippon Hume Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of pipes and concrete piles in Japan. It offers pipeline products, such as hume tubes, composite steel-concrete pipes, JIP pipes, super large diameter propulsion tubes, box culverts, arch culverts, precast utility tunnels, prefabricated manholes and connection holes, wellman systems, antibacterial concrete products, and fiber-optic-compatible concrete products  concrete piles  RC segments  and PC and composite wells, and press casts and PRC hollow piers. The company also provides modular arch systems, precast guard fences, EMC wall railings, and quick wall railings  and valve boxes, infiltration box culverts, precast flood control basin, and eco concrete products. The company was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: YAMAZEN
businessSummary: Yamazen Corporation provides production equipment and consumer goods in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. The company offers industrial robots, machining centers, CNC lathes, grinding, and milling  electrical discharge, CAD/CAM, lamination devices, measuring and automation peripheral equipment, accessories, conventional machine tools, injection molding and laser processing, other metal sheet forming and processing machines, etc.  industrial solutions/tool and engineering  metal forming/plate machines, die-cast molding machines, and machine tools accessories  and home appliances, interiors, exteriors, gardening and outdoor products, daily goods, healthcare and sanitary goods, industrial tools, car parts, etc. It also provides kitchen, cooking, bathroom, washbasin, and sanitary appliances  water boiling, air conditioning and ventilation, solar power generation, storage batteries, floor heating, solar thermal water heating, stored-heat heating systems, office, home, nursing care, IoT, BCP-related, and construction equipment  interior and exterior architectural, electrical equipment, and construction materials  window and structural building frames  foundations  and plumbing equipment and materials. In addition, it offers logistics, sales promotion, event, PR, media advertising, marketing, housing magazine publication, and consulting services  accident/life insurance agency services  industrial machinery, FA systems, and logistics services. The company engages in editing, producing, and printing various publications  design and manufacture of industrial equipment  marketing and research works  and planning and supporting seminars and exhibitions. It is also involved in planning, engineering, and consulting of FA systems  and provision of automated plants, production lines, automated and labor-saving, industrial robot systems, measuring, cleaning, and others equipment. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KOMORI
businessSummary: KOMORI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing equipment, as well as the provision of related materials, finance services and real estate management services. The Company operates in three regional segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of securities printing equipment and other printing equipment in Japan, Latin America and Asia, as well as the purchase and sale of small printing equipment, the provision of inks, paper, folding machines, electrical equipment and other equipment parts and printing materials. The North America segment is mainly engaged in the sale of printing equipment in the United States. The Europe segment is mainly engaged in the sale of printing equipment in Western Europe, Eastern Europe and the Middle East, as well as the manufacture and sale of paper printing equipment . The Company also operates in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia and India.

name: DAINICHISEIKA COLOR & CHEMICALS MFG
businessSummary: DAINICHISEIKA COLOR & CHEMICALS MFG. CO., LTD. is a Japan-based comprehensive manufacturer of high-tech and color science. The Company operates in five business segments. The Chemical Product segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of paints and printing inks, inorganic and organic pigments and processed pigments for information display and recording, as well as colorants for fibers. The Chemical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sales of colorants for plastics such as master batches and resin compounds, as well as UV electron beam curable coating agent. The Macromolecule segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of urethane resin and nature polymeric products. The Printing Integrated System segment provides manufacturing and sales of printing ink and products and services incidental to the business. The Others segment is real estate leasing and financial business.

name: SEIKAGAKU
businessSummary: SEIKAGAKU CORPORATION is principally engaged in the research, development, purchase, manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products and limulus amebocyte lysate (LAL). The Company operates in two business segments. The Pharmaceutical business segment provides hyaluronan-based medicines for joint function improvement, ophthalmic operation boosters and submucosal injection materials for endoscopes, as well as drug substances for various pharmaceuticals. The LAL business segment provides reagents for measuring endotoxin.

name: DAIICHI KENSETSU
businessSummary: DAIICHI KENSETSU CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and real estate business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and brokerage of real estate.

name: IDOM
businessSummary: IDOM Inc. engages in the sale of used cars in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the buying and selling used cars through a network of stores  and new car sales business. The company was formerly known as Gulliver International Co. Ltd. and changed its name to IDOM Inc. in July 2016. IDOM Inc. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: FUDO TETRA
businessSummary: Fudo Tetra Corporation engages in the civil engineering, ground improvement, and blocks and environment businesses in Japan. The company undertakes land civil engineering works, including roads, railways, dams, rivers, water supply and sewage, and energy facilities  and marine civil engineering works, such as ports, airports, fishing ports, coastlines, and artificial islands, as well as offers environmental solutions. It also provides settlement reduction, stability increase, liquefaction mitigation, cut-off wall, building foundation, and other ground improvement technologies. In addition, the company offers 3D block, flat, staircase shaped, upright wave-dissipating, and permanent formwork blocks, as well as environmental landscaping products  sells aquatic environment and landscape products, such as filter units and reef mats  and provides technical and design services, including the creation of cross-sectional and layout drawings using CAD, and proposals for optimal structures based on experiments and numerical simulations. Fudo Tetra Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ZENKEN
businessSummary: Zenken Corporation provides IT, language education, and real estate services in Japan. It provides content marketing, media, overseas IT talent recruitment, and AI services  and language training services for corporations, study abroad placement, and Japanese language education services. The company also engages in renting out buildings  and offers nursing care services. In addition, it operates media platforms such as BiPro, which introduces job opportunities in the beauty industry. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: AICHI TOKEI DENKI
businessSummary: Aichi Tokei Denki Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of measuring equipment and other special equipment. The Measuring Instrument segment carries four types of products: gas-related equipment, which include utility gas meters, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas meters, industrial meters, pressure equipment, gas meter systems and others; water work-related equipment, including various water supply meters, industrial water meters and sewage meters, bill management systems, emergency report systems for elderly housing and others; civil sensors and systems, including flow instrument and flow sensors, as well as instrumentation which include measuring, monitoring and control systems. The other businesses include the manufacture and sale of special equipment, such as precision molds.

name: MITSUBISHI KAKOKI KAISHA
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Kakoki Kaisha, Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in engineering, standalone machinery, and GX businesses. The Company operates through these three segments. The Engineering segment handles city gas and petroleum-related plants, various chemical industry plants, hydrogen production equipment, sewage treatment equipment, industrial wastewater treatment equipment, various water treatment equipment, and corrosion-resistant containers made of fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP). The Standalone Machinery segment handles products such as oil purifiers, various separators and filters, dust removal equipment for seawater intake, and agitators. The GX segment comprises strategic business areas and consists of new businesses, as well as the development of new applications and improvements to existing technologies and products.

name: TOKYU CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: TOKYU CONSTRUCTION CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Construction (building) segment is engaged in the construction of offices, commercial facilities, educational facilities, cultural and social facilities, sports facilities, government office buildings, research institutes, training facilities, housing, medical and welfare facilities, logistics facilities. The Construction (civil engineering) segment is engaged in the construction of railways, dams, environmental sanitation facilities and roads. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sales and leasing of real estate properties. It also provides information and communication technology (ICT) services, undertakes projects such as the redevelopment of the Osaka Prefectural Fire Academy, and invests in venture companies.

name: TSUBAKIMOTO KOGYO
businessSummary: Tsubakimoto Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of machine parts, automation and labor-saving equipment and industrial materials. The Company has four business segments. East Japan Headquarters segment covers Hokkaido, Tohoku, Koshinetsu and Kanto. West Japan Headquarters segment covers Hokuriku, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku and Kyushu. Central Japan Headquarters segment covers the Tokai. The three segments handle products including power transmission components and equipment systems. Power transmission components include drive parts including speed reducers, conveyor chains, conveying parts, control devices, sensors, electronic equipment and others. Equipment systems include clean energy-related facilities, pharmaceutical-related equipment, chemical machinery, water treatment systems, food machinery, environmental equipment, machine tools, industrial robots, conveyors and others. Development Strategy Headquarters segment handles industrial materials and new products.

The company offers processed and natural cheese, condensed and skim milk, butter, powdered milk, and margarine  nutrition products, including infant formula and functional food  and other products. It also provides milk and milk beverages, yogurt, fruit and vegetable juice, soft drinks, and desserts  and infant formula and functional food. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacture and sale of cattle feed, and pasture forage/crop and vegetable seeds  landscaping business  and distribution center services, real estate rental, and other businesses. MEGMILK SNOW BRAND Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
