It also manages securities, such as debt and equity securities, and investment trusts. In addition, the company offers deposits and loans, foreign exchange, securities-related, agency, custody/safe deposits and other services. FIDEA Holdings Co. Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

name: HAMEE
businessSummary: Hamee Corp. engages in the e-commerce and platform businesses for mobile accessories in Japan, Asia, Oceania, North America, and internationally. It is involved in the manufacture, purchase, wholesale, and sale of gaming accessories related products and services  development of cosmetic products and gaming monitors  and development and provision of Next Engine, a cloud-based back-end solution for e-commerce businesses. The company was formerly known as Macrowill Company. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Odawara, Japan.

name: NAKAKITA SEISAKUSHO
businessSummary: NAKAKITA SEISAKUSHO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of automatic control valves, butterfly valves and remote controllers for ships and power plants. The Company offers three types of products: automatic control valves, which include auto actuated valves, servo actuated control valves, remote control valves, cylinder valves, safety valves, air purge-type automatic regulatory equipment, actuators, valves for nuclear plants, superheated steam pressure reducers and attemperators, other special automatic control valves and controlling equipment; butterfly valves, which include manual butterfly valves, remote control butterfly valves, and butterfly valves for low-temperature use, and remote controllers, which include cargo handling and ballast remote controllers and remote water level indication and warning equipment for ships.

name: DAIWA
businessSummary: DAIWA INDUSTRIES LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of freezers, refrigerators, showcases and ice machines, purchase and sales of cooling and heating equipment for commercial uses, and provision of inspection, repair and leasing services of its equipment. The Company is also engaged in design and construction of stores and kitchens, leasing of freezers, refrigerators and others.

name: VERTEX
businessSummary: Vertex co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in real estate consulting, real estate planning and development, real estate sales and leasing brokerage, property management, real estate investment management and real estate fund operations. The Company operates through the real estate segment. The Real Estate segment provides real estate consulting services and property management services. The real estate consulting services business develops and sells the VERXEED and VERXEED STAIR condominium series, acquires and sells pre-owned condominium units and provides real estate-based asset-building consulting. The business also operates the VERFUND real estate fund service. The property management Services business provides tenant recruitment, rent collection, lease administration, complaint handling, restoration, rent guarantees, subleasing, building maintenance, cleaning, statutory inspections and support for condominium management associations.

name: TOKYO KISEN
businessSummary: Tokyo Kisen Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services such as tugboat business, passenger ship business, stand and cafeteria business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Tugboat segment is involved in tugboat business, charter business, disaster prevention-related business and others. The Passenger Ship segment is engaged in tourism, car ferry and transportation ship businesses. The Stand and Cafeteria segment is engaged in the sale of goods associated with the car ferry business and restaurant cafeteria business.

name: A&A MATERIAL
businessSummary: A&A Material Corporation is primarily engaged in manufacture and sale of building materials and various industrial products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction and Building Materials segment provides non-combustible materials and design and construction work, two-layer tubes, and design and construction work of steel frame refractory coating. The Industrials Products and Engineering segment manufactures and sells non-combustible textiles, equipment and materials for vessels, sound insulating materials, expansion joints and others, friction materials, seal materials, heat insulating materials, and design and construction work of thermal insulation, cold insulation, air conditioning, heat insulation, sound insulation, fireproofing. Additionally, the Company is also involved in real estate rental business.

name: CK SAN ETSU
businessSummary: CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of brass rod and wire products in Japan, China, and Taiwan. It operates through Copper extension, Precision parts, and Piping and Plating segments. The company also offers brass tubes  camera mounts and synchro rings  iron pipe fittings for residential use  and piping equipment under the CK brand  precision parts through forging and machining activities  and hot-dip galvanized products. It serves copper alloys, precision parts, piping, mirrors, gold, and related industries. The company was formerly known as SAN-ETSU METALS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. in October 2011. CK SAN-ETSU Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is based in Takaoka, Japan.

name: ISHII HYOKI
businessSummary: ISHII HYOKI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, production, sale and service of electronic equipment parts manufacturing equipment, displays and electronic parts products. The Company operates through two business segments. The Electronic Equipment Parts Manufacturing Devices segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of printed circuit board manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, inkjet coaters and others. The Display and Electronic Components segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of membrane switch panels, silk printing and nameplates. The Company is also involved in the sale of products through its subsidiaries.

The Company operates in three business segments, including Financial-related segment, Public-related segment and Industrial-related segment, which focus on financial institutions, local public authorities and general corporations, respectively. The Company involves in the customized development of application software, the development and sale of packaged software, the operation of system consulting business, the contracted calculation processing, the provision of application service provider (ASP) services, computer center management and operation services, business support services for financial institutions, data inputting services, housing services and hosting services, and computer maintenance services. The Company also involves in the maintenance of computers, the sale of various supplies, and the sale of various computers and other devices.

businessSummary: NIPPON KINZOKU CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled stainless steel strips, specially polished steel strips and processed products, as well as the development of related business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Polished Steel Strip segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of cold-rolled stainless steel strips and polished specialty steel strips. The Processed Product segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of mold steel and stainless precision steel.

name: DAIHO
businessSummary: Daiho Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, focusing on civil engineering and architectural works. The Company operates in three business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in all civil engineering works. The Construction segment is engaged in all architectural works. The Others segment is engaged in real estate sales and rentals, as well as the sale and rental of construction materials.

name: KEIHIN
businessSummary: Keihin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of logistics business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Domestic Logistics segment is engaged in the warehousing storage business, warehouse cargo handling business, distribution and processing business, land transportation business, home delivery business and marine container transportation business, as well as the development of logistics system software, and the information processing business. The International Logistics segment is engaged in the international and air transportation business, customs clearance business, marine port operation business, and the ship agency business.

name: SEIBU GIKEN
businessSummary: Seibu Giken Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, and provision of installation and other services for desiccant dehumidifiers and volatile organic compounds (VOC) concentrators. Desiccant dehumidifiers dehumidify air by adsorbing moisture inside a honeycomb using adsorbent materials such as silica gel or zeolite. Since air does not need to be cooled, it is characterized by its ability to dehumidify even at low temperatures or in low dew-point environments where there is little moisture in the air. VOC concentrators selectively adsorb volatile organic compounds, collectively known as benzene and toluene, which cause air pollution generated from paint, into the VOC concentrator rotor to make it possible to detoxify exhaust gas emissions by selectively adsorbing VOC concentrating rotors. Product-related services is engaged in the provision of installation, maintenance, and rotor replacement services.

name: KYOEI SECURITY SERVICE
businessSummary: Kyoei Security Service Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly providing security service. The Company’s Security Service segment includes service on facility and patrol security field as well as service on crowd control and traffic guard field. The facility and patrol security field includes services such as facility security service, reception/concierge service, parking lot security service and airport fire service. The crowd control and traffic guard field includes services like traffic guarding security service, event security service and highway security service. Other businesses include bodyguard service, parking lot management service, apartment management service, building and facility management service, among others.

name: GROWTH XPARTNERS
businessSummary: Growth xPartners Inc, formerly Growth X Partners Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the enterprise digital transformation (DX) business. The enterprise DX business includes the DX promotion support business, the DX support product and service business, and the digital service co-creation business. The DX promotion support business provides comprehensive support, including consulting and application development and cloud utilization, to help customers realize business transformation. The DX support product and service business sells products and services to support customers in promoting DX and earns scalable revenues through license revenues. The digital service co-creation business co-creates digital services to expand customers' businesses and increase revenues. The customers are enterprise companies that are leading companies in various industries, such as healthcare, retail and distribution, mobility, communications, construction, manufacturing, and finance.

The AI/DX Solutions segment develops services such as social networking service (SNS) marketing and provides total support services from AI agent construction to in-house development support aimed at establishment and training.

It also provides machining equipment, process-specialized equipment, and customized machine tools  wire saw machines  inspection and measuring machines, including semiconductors/electronic components, bare chips, ceramic substrate, green sheet, substrate, sheet, magnetic materials, motor, battery, and customization products, as well as sample test solutions  assembly machines, such as inverter assembly machine, sheet rewinding machine, rubber seal assembling machine, and variable valve timing assembly machine  and environmental equipment comprising air pumps and disposers. businessSummary: NIHON DENKEI CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale, repair and calibration of electronic measuring instruments. The Company operates in three regional segments including Japan, China and Others. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale and manufacture of electronic measuring instruments, various system equipment, electronic components, as well as leasing and rental business. The business items include electronic measuring instruments, measuring instruments for communication, computers and peripherals, automatic and labor-saving equipment, measuring instruments for physics and chemistry, industrial application equipment, measuring instruments for production processes, environmental testing instruments, optical measuring instruments, and educational experiments, electronic parts, mechanical parts, measuring instrument leasing and rental services, curio dealers, building construction, jumping and construction business.

name: DAISHI HOKUETSU FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Daishi Hokuetsu Financial Group, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which operate as a bank obeying banking laws, as well as other related business. The Company is engaged in business related to financial services and centering on banking business, such as leasing business and securities business. The banking business is the Company’s main business. The headquarters of the Daishi Bank and other domestic branches focus on deposit business and lending business and conduct securities investment business, domestic exchange business, foreign exchange business, as well as windows sales business of public bond, investment trust and insurance. The Company is also involved in computer related business, credit guarantee business, credit card, venture capital and consulting business.

name: AIRMAN
businessSummary: Airman Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of construction machinery, and industrial machinery including construction equipment in Japan and internationally. The company also engages in the manufacture and sale of air compressors under the AIRMAN brand. In addition, the company offers engine compressors, engine generators, aerial work platforms, motor compressors, emergency generators, scissors lifters, and mini excavators. The company was formerly known as Hokuetsu Industries Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Airman Corporation in April 2025. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Tsubame, Japan.

name: MAZDA MOTOR
businessSummary: Mazda Motor Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and distribution of automobiles and automobile parts. The Company operates through four segments, including Japan, North America, Europe and Other Regions. The Company is engaged in the manufacture of passenger cars and the sale of passenger cars and trucks. The Company's main product lines include passenger cars, mini vehicles, special edition vehicles, commercial and special purpose vehicles, and welfare vehicles. The Company also handles used vehicles.

name: TOBISHIMA
businessSummary: Tobishima Holdings Inc manages the business of group companies and performs related business. Through subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in construction and development business. The construction business is mainly engaged in general construction business with civil engineering and architectural business, and through subsidiaries, it is engaged in construction work orders, earthquake reinforcement design, manufacturing and sales of materials, civil engineering work and diving work. The development business is engaged in real estate development, sales and rental, and through subsidiaries, it is also engaged in insurance agency business, boat sales, insurance and repair, real estate sales, rental and brokerage, real estate sales agency, information technology (IT) system development and maintenance, and through affiliated companies, it is engaged in digital transformation (DX) total support business.

name: FCC
businessSummary: F.C.C. Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of two-wheeled vehicle clutches and four-wheeled vehicle clutches. The Company operates through two business segments. The Four-wheeler Clutch segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clutch products for automatic vehicles and manual vehicles. The Two-wheeler Clutch segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clutch products for motorcycles, scooters, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) and general-purpose machine clutches, as well as other parts and components for two-wheeler and four-wheeler products.

isin: 7744.T|Noritsu Koki Co., Ltd.|7744.T|Noritsu Koki Co., Ltd.
name: NORITSU KOKI
businessSummary: Noritsu Koki Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells audio equipment and peripheral products in Japan, China, the United States, Europe, Central and South America, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers DJ and club equipment, such as flat-top DJ CD players under the Pioneer DJ and AlphaTheta brands  and headphones and earbuds for sports, work, children, and gaming applications under the JLab brand. The company also provides pen nibs, cosmetics, and air freshener sticks  and metal parts for transportation and medical equipment. In addition, it offers personal technology products, such as web cameras and keyboards for remote working, as well as construction products and equipment, and related construction services. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FALCO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: FALCO HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the clinical testing business and the dispensing pharmacy business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Clinical Testing segment is engaged in the contracted clinical specimen testing business for hospitals and clinics, as well as the development and sale of electronic medical charts and other medical information systems, and the wholesale of in-vitro diagnostic drugs. The Dispensing Pharmacy segment is engaged in the operation of dispensing pharmacies.

name: SUNNEXTA GROUP
businessSummary: Sunnexta Group Inc operates corporate housing management, condominium management, and other related businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Corporate Housing Management segment provides services such as outsourcing of corporate housing management administration and related system implementation, as well as cost reduction and operational efficiency services and system development for management departments. The Condominium Management segment provides facility management and repair work for condominiums, etc. The Incubation segment provides call center and insurance services, as well as monitoring security services, insurance agency services, and condominium management digital transformation (DX) support services.

name: ENPLAS
businessSummary: Enplas Corporation engages in the semiconductor, life science, network, display, and energy saving solution businesses in Japan. It offers energy saving solutions, including turbo impeller, mesh filter, and wesco pump, as well as double helical, crowing, face, and high precision gears  and semiconductor solutions comprising general-purpose IC socket and burn in sockets. The company also provides optical solutions, such as optical devices that include lens array for parallel communications and plastic barrels  display solutions, including luminous flux control technology, optical design simulation, precision measurement technology, and precision processing technology  and life science products comprising microfluidic chips and endotoxin-free products. Enplas Corporation was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: IMAGE MAGIC
businessSummary: Image Magic Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in developing its business as a digital transformation (DX) company for manufacturing that utilizes the system. The On-demand Print Solution (ODPS) segment provides on-demand print services for products such as apparel and miscellaneous goods using the Internet, and provides on-demand print mechanisms to businesses such as apparel makers and printing companies. The on-demand print service is a service that prints and delivers the data submitted by the customer through the Internet site in a short delivery time from the order received, and is promoted by two channels, in-house sales and orders from partner companies. ODPS provides a production management system that has been improved with DX know-how as a cloud service, and sells hardware (printers, folding machines, packing and shipping machines) related to the production and shipping processes cultivated through the on-demand print service.

name: TSUKUBA BANK
businessSummary: Tsukuba Bank, Ltd. provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company also offers deposits and loans  insurance  and asset management and consulting services. Tsukuba Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Tsukuba, Japan.

name: RHEON AUTOMATIC MACHINERY
businessSummary: Rheon Automatic Machinery Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of food processing machinery, as well as other food manufacturing and sales businesses. Food processing machinery manufacture and sale business operates through Japan, North and South America, Europe and Asia regional segments. It develops, manufactures and sells food forming machines and bread making lines, as well as provides repairs services and purchased products (ovens, mixers, packaging machines). Food manufacture and sale business operates through North and South America and Japan regional segments and engages in the manufacture and sale of highly processed frozen foods such as croissants, Danish pastries, pies, cookies, and frozen roll-in dough and natural yeast bread starters. Food forming machines include universal automatic packaging machines, Cornucopia, Robot EP and others. Bread making lines include the Stress Free V4 System, Stress Free VM System and others.

name: ISHIHARA SANGYO KAISHA
businessSummary: Ishihara Sangyo Kaisha Ltd is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical industrial products in the organic chemical field, centered on agrochemicals, and the inorganic chemical field, centered on functional materials and titanium oxide, as well as other businesses. The Company operates three segments. The Organic Chemical segment includes agrochemicals such as herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides, veterinary medicines, pharmaceuticals, and organic intermediates. The Inorganic Chemical segment includes functional materials, titanium oxide, and other chemical products. The Others segment is engaged in trading and construction businesses. The trading business sells organic and inorganic chemical products and procures raw materials, as well as purchases and sells general chemical industrial products. The construction business constructs and repairs production facilities, and outsources the construction and repair of plants.

name: YAKUODO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yakuodo Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates a retail business dealing in pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, groceries, daily necessities and other lifestyle-related products. The Company operates the drugstore business segment. The Drugstore Business segment operates drugstore chain shops and dispensing pharmacies.

name: FUKUDA
businessSummary: Fukuda Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in construction and real estate businesses, and also provides non-construction related services. It operates through two segments. The Construction business segment is engaged in the acceptance and execution of construction work, as well as the rental and manufacturing/sale of construction-related equipment and materials. The Real Estate business segment is engaged in the sale, rental and development of real estate. The Company also rents and sells products and provides services other than those related to construction work, and operates welfare facilities.

name: NIPPON LIGHT METAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of alumina and chemical products, ingots, plates, extruded products, processed products, foil, and powder products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Alumina and Chemical Products and Ingots segment manufactures and sells alumina, aluminum hydroxide, various chemical products, and aluminum ingots and alloys. The Plate and Extruded Products segment manufactures and sells aluminum plates and aluminum extruded products. The Processed Products and Related Businesses segment manufactures and sells transportation-related products, freezers and refrigerator panels, and other aluminum processed products, as well as provides services such as transportation, information processing, and insurance agency services. The Foil and Powder Products segment manufactures and sells foil and powder products.

name: PIOLAX
businessSummary: PIOLAX, Inc. designs, develops, produces, and sells various parts and products for the automotive, medical, and consumer and security industries in Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. It offers valves and fuel parts for filling, storing, and providing petrol  connectors for piping used around radiators  compact filters for fuel and oil systems  evapo-tube ASSY products  and connectors with the invented resin tubes. The company also provides powertrain parts, which include various springs that are used for transmissions, and snap rings used for holding parts  open-close parts, including air dampers, latches, and cushions for glove boxes  resin and metal fasteners for fixing automobile interior/exterior parts and connecting pipes to car body  and harnesses for bundling electric wires. In addition, it offers precision parts comprising retainers and tension springs to hold wheel caps  injection-molded parts for automotive interior/exterior  and visor-related parts and luggage board handles, as well as plate clamps and screw clamps. Further, the company provides medical appliances, such as spiral catheters and stents  and consumer and security products, including springs for combination faucets, and security parts to seal money bags or container vehicles, as well as hot water blocking valves and headphone wire bands. The company was formerly known as Kato Hatsujo Inc. and changed its name to PIOLAX, Inc. in October 1995. PIOLAX, Inc. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: FREAKOUT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: FreakOut Holdings, inc., through its subsidiaries, offers advertising solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates through Advertising Business, Investment Business, Influencer marketing business, and Other Businesses segments. The company develops and sells DSPs and DMPs  data mining, development, and sale of ad applications  and advertisement consultation business. It is also involved in IoT-based digital signage business  global app marketing and public relations  provision of trading desk and monetization platform for digital media  and development and operation of retail in-store media, as well as digital creative and performance agencies businesses. In addition, it operates a data-driven digital agency that specializes in software development, data science, and robot automation. FreakOut Holdings, inc. was formerly known as FreakOut, inc and changed its name to FreakOut Holdings, inc. in January 2017. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TABAYA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TABAYA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, buying, and sale of men's and women's apparel, accessories, and other products in Japan. The company operates under store brands, such as UNITED ARROWS, BEAUTY&YOUTH UNITED ARROWS, UNITED ARROWS green label relaxing, DRAWER, BLAMINK, conte, H BEAUTY&YOUTH, ASTRAET, UNITED ARROWS & SONS, 6, steven alan, monkey time, ODETTE E ODILE, ATTISESSION, CITEN, NICE WEATHER, California General Store, UNITED ARROWS Golf, and OSOI brands. It also offers products under LOEFF, Pheeta, AEWEN MATOPH, SOVEREIGN, EMMEL REFINES, PREEK, MARW, SY, TO, Lepidos, TABAYA, UNITED ARROWS BEAUTY, and District UNITED ARROWS labels, as well as UNITED ARROWS outlets. The company was formerly known as United Arrows Ltd. and changed its name to TABAYA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in October 2026. TABAYA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: ARGO GRAPHICS
businessSummary: ARGO GRAPHICS Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the product lifecycle management (PLM) business and electronic design automation (EDA) business. The PLM segment consists of PLM solution business, system building support business and hardware maintenance and other business. The PLM solution business is engaged in the provision of PLM solutions, which target at the productivity improvement in manufacturing processes. The system building support business provides system building support services for the servers and personal computer (PC) clusters of manufacturers. The hardware maintenance (HM) and other business maintains the machines provided by the PLM solution and the system building support businesses. The EDA segment sells computer aided design (CAD) systems for electronic components and micro fabrication, including large scale integrated circuits, liquid crystal displays and other flat panel displays (FPD), magnetic head and micro machine.

name: MITSUBOSHI BELTING
businessSummary: Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of belts and construction materials. The Company operates through three business segments. The Domestic Belts segment manufactures and sells automotive belts, industrial machinery belts, and conveyor belts primarily within Japan. The Overseas Belts segment manufactures and sells belts for automobiles, general industry, office automation (OA) equipment and other use in overseas markets. The Construction Materials segment manufactures and sells waterproofing sheets for buildings, impermeable sheets for civil engineering, and related products, and also carries out civil engineering waterproofing work. The Company also involves in industrial machinery, products purchased from other companies, engineering structural foam, electronic materials and services.

name: TOKYO STEEL MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of steel products. The Company’s products are divided into two categories: building materials and steel plate products. Building materials products include H-beams, high-standard electric furnace H-beams, special-sized H-beams, U-shaped steel sheet piles, I-beams, striped H-beams, channel steel, and deformed steel bars, which are steel materials mainly used in construction work. Steel plate products mainly include hot coils, pickled coils, hot-dip galvanized coils, striped coils, cut sheets, thick plates, and high-standard electric furnace steel plates.

name: MODEC
businessSummary: Modec Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction of floating oil production facilities and the provision of various related services. Its primary business is the provision of engineering, procurement, construction, and installation (EPCI) services and charter services (leasing and operation services) for floating production, storage, and offloading facilities, such as floating production, storage, and offloading (FPSO), floating storage, and offloading (FSO), and tension-moored platforms (TLP), used in the midstream of offshore oil and gas production. Its primary clients are government-affiliated and private oil and gas development companies overseas. It also provides after-sales services, such as parts supply and engineering support, for FPSOs and other facilities it builds and delivers to oil and gas development companies, as well as management and operational support to affiliates and joint ventures.

name: ALFRESA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Alfresa Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the wholesale of drugs. The Company operates in four business segments. The Pharmaceutical Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of medical products, test reagents, as well as medical equipment and materials. The Self Medication Wholesale segment is engaged in the wholesale of general drugs. The Pharmaceutical Manufacture segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, test reagents, medical equipment and implements, as well as pharmaceutical powders. The Medical-Related segment is mainly engaged in operation of pharmacies. The others business is engaged in the information system business, the transportation business, the warehousing business, the insurance agency business, the real estate management business, the sale of miscellaneous goods, as well as the manpower dispatching business, among others.

name: INABATA &
businessSummary: Inabata & Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the sale and manufacture of products in the fields of information and electronics, chemicals, consumer goods, synthetic resins, and other fields. The Company's main businesses are the buying and selling of goods, manufacturing and selling of products, and provision of services. It also develops domestic and overseas strategies. It operates in four segments. The Information and Electronics segment sells semiconductors and liquid crystal materials, machinery and equipment, dyes and pigments for copiers and printers, and materials. The Chemicals segment sells raw materials for automotive parts, resins and rubber, paints, inks and adhesives, papermaking chemicals, dyes and dyeing and weaving materials, wood and laminated lumber. The Consumer Goods segment sells pharmaceutical and agrochemical ingredients, fine chemicals, insecticides and toiletry ingredients. The Synthetic Resins segment sells general-purpose resins, engineering plastics and others.

name: J OIL MILLS
businessSummary: J-Oil Mills, Inc. manufacture and sell vegetable oils and fats in Japan. The company operates through Oils and Fats Business, Specialty Foods Business, and others segments. It is involved in manufacturing, processing, and sales of oils and fats, fats and oil cake, starch, feed and fertilizer, and other various foods  cultivation, development, processing, and sales of agricultural products  sale of food manufacturing equipment  and real estate rental business. The company also offers proteins. J-Oil Mills, Inc. was founded in 1826 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: AOYAMA TRADING
businessSummary: AOYAMA TRADING Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business related to clothing items. The Company operates in six business segments. The Business Wear business sells men's and women's business wear and related western goods, commissions correction processing of ready-made clothes, plans for in-store and outside performances, and plans sales consumables. The Casual business is engaged in the sale of casual clothing. The Card business is engaged in the provision of retail finance and credit services. The Printing and Media business is engaged in the printing various flyers and catalogs, publishing magazines, printing and sending direct mail. The Miscellaneous Goods Sales business sells daily miscellaneous goods and processed foods and operates Daiso & Aoyama 100 Yen Plaza. The Comprehensive Repair Service business provides comprehensive repair services such as shoe repair and key duplication. The Company is also engaged in reuse business and restaurant business.

name: TOAMI
businessSummary: TOAMI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of civil engineering and building materials. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various wire meshes such as welded wire meshes, rebar grids, welded wire meshes for reinforcing openings, stainless steel welded wire meshes, one-way meshes and solid foundation rebar units, reinforced processed products such as TOAMI hoops, spiral hoops, power rings, polygonal hoop bars for circles and spiral bars for seismic reinforcement, wire meshes for glass, mesh fences, as well as special welded wire mesh products such as C panels and blank panels. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of reinforcing steels, gabions, square gabions and other products.

name: TVE
businessSummary: TVE Co Ltd, formerly Toa Valve Engineering Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of various industrial valves, as well as the decontamination and decommissioning business. The Company has three business segments. The Valve segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, dismantlement, inspection, repair and maintenance of high temperature and high pressure valves for power plants such as nuclear power plants and thermal power plants, and various industrial valves and parts for ships, petrochemical plants and others, as well as the manufacture of cast steel parts for valve products. The Steelmaking segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cast steel products for construction equipment and other industries. The Decontamination segment is engaged in the radioactive removal business in Fukushima Prefecture.

name: OLBA DVX HEALTHCARE
businessSummary: OLBA DVx HEALTHCARE, Inc., formerly OLBA HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS, INC., is a Japan-based company engaged in the medical equipment business, the SPD business, the nursing care products business, and other operations. The Company operates through three reportable segments. The Medical Equipment segment sells medical devices. The SPD segment provides inventory and information management, procurement management services, and medical device sales to medical institutions and other organizations. The Home Care Products segment sells and rents home care beds and supplies.

name: YAMAHA
businessSummary: Yamaha Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the musical instruments business, the audio equipment business and other businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The Musical Instruments Business segment manufactures and sells musical instruments, operates music schools and other facilities, and produces and sells music and video software. The Audio Equipment Business segment provides various solutions for both consumer and commercial use. It consists of a wide range of products from home audio equipment, music production and distribution equipment, professional audio equipment, and network equipment. The Company also engages in components and equipment business, consisting of electronic devices, automotive interior components, and factory automation (FA) equipment, as well as the golf goods business and resort business.

name: RIKEN VITAMIN
businessSummary: Riken Vitamin Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of food products. It operates through three business segments. The Domestic Food segment manufactures and sells household foods (processed foods for general households), commercial foods (processed foods for the commercial market), and processed food ingredients (ingredients for processed foods, food improvers, and vitamins for the food industry). The products include seaweed products, dressings, extracts and seasonings, food improvers, vitamins, and health functional products. The Domestic Chemical Products and Others segment manufactures and sells chemical product improvers and feed additives. The Overseas segment manufactures and sells food improvers, chemical product improvers, extracts, and seasonings, and distributes its products in Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Middle East, Oceania, Europe, Africa, North America, Central and South America, China, Taiwan, and South Korea.

name: AICHI
businessSummary: Aichi Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of specially equipped vehicles, including hole drilling cars and aerial work platform vehicles for electric power, electricity and communication construction, aerial work platform vehicles for construction and cargo handling, as well as the dealing of components, repair and training service. The Company operates in two business segments. The Special Purpose Vehicles segment is engaged in sale of new aerial work platform vehicles. The Parts and Repair segment provides after-sales service business for high aerial work platforms. The others business provides sale and educational businesses for used aerial work platform vehicles.

name: ZACROS
businessSummary: ZACROS Corporation manufactures and sells products for wellness environmental solutions, information electronic, and industrial infrastructure in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Wellness Business  Environmental Solutions Business  Information and Electronics Business  and Industrial Infrastructure Business. The company offers wellness products, including MediTect IV Bag, a non-adsorbing, low-leaching packaging for ready-to-use (RTU) drugs  BioPhas, a customized service that is used in single-use products for biopharmaceuticals manufacturing  and Total Thrombus-formation Analysis System, a flow chamber system. It also provides environmental solutions, such as flexible refill pouches  liquid containers  and high performance / high clean packaging. In addition, the company offers protective films  coating commissioned processing services  and free standing electrode, as well as adhesive films, release liners, tab seal film, and industrial laminate film. Further, it engages in industrial infrastructure activities. The company was formerly known as Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ZACROS Corporation in October 2024. ZACROS Corporation was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

name: TADANO
businessSummary: Tadano Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction and vehicle-mounted cranes, aerial work platforms, and transport machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers all-terrain, rough terrain, crawler, truck, and cargo cranes  aerial work platform machines, including hyper and super deck, and skyboy truck and self-propelled  and aerial work platform lineup for electrical work, communication and general construction, heavy load construction, and shipbuilding. It also provides vehicle transport, industrial vehicle transport, elevated road/bridge inspection, Pole digger, Orbital land vehicle, illuminated vehicle, marine crane, all-terrain crane detachable lifter, lifter, and lift house. The company was formerly known as Tadano Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tadano Ltd. in 1989. Tadano Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

name: AXELL
businessSummary: AXELL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sales of semiconductor products. The Company is engaged in the sale of light-emitting diode (LED) driver LSIs and memory modules while positioning graphic large-scale integration (LSI) as a core product for pachinko and pachislot machine market. The Company also sells graphics LSIs for liquid crystal display devices mounted on factory automation (FA) equipment, medical equipment, large construction equipment. The Company is also engaged in the development of evaluation boards and support software to reduce the development burden of customers. The Company is also engaged in the early commercialization activities in middleware, machine learning, blockchain and security four new areas.

isin: 1762.T|Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd.|1762.T|Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd.
name: TAKAMATSU CONSTRUCTION GROUP
businessSummary: Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd. engages in the construction business in Japan. The company operates in Construction, Civil Engineering, and Real Estate Segments It is involved in designing and construction of various architectures such as condominiums for rental purpose, buildings, factories and condominiums for senior citizens with care services  renovation, repairs and building maintenance  administration of buildings and condominiums, as well as overall real estate business  high end exclusive furniture, design and construction of renovation of residential and commercial facilities. The company also offers design and construction of shrines, temples and religious facilities  repairs and refurbishment of national treasures and important cultural architecture  wooden detached housing business, wooden apartment business, and wooden land utilization business. In addition, it designs, constructs, and renovates business of condominiums, offices, and stores  manufacturing facilities, warehouses, hotels, data centers, remodeling, PFI-related projects  excavation, research, analysis and preservation of archaeological resources  harbor, marine and environment protection civil engineering, designing and construction of residential, cultural and business-related facilities. Further, the company offers reclamation, dredging, harbor and river civil engineering, maritime logistics  slope protection, ground improvement, blasting construction, cooling and fireproofing utilities  sales of fireproof materials  property development  and real estate and investment operations on single-family and multifamily residential properties. Takamatsu Construction Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 4531.T|YUKI GOSEI KOGYO|4531.T|Yuki Gosei Kogyo Co., Ltd.
name: YUKI GOSEI KOGYO
businessSummary: Yuki Gosei Kogyo Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and markets amino acids, chemical products, and pharmaceuticals in Japan and internationally. It offers food additives, and industrial and agricultural chemicals  and glycine, glycine compounds, nicotinic acid amide, active pharmaceutical ingredients, nicotinamide, isoniazid, drug intermediates, and cosmetic ingredients. The company also provides pyridine, piperidine, silicon, and other compounds  DNA, nucleoside, and protamine  and active pharmaceutical ingredients. In addition, it engages in the contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals and chemical products. Yuki Gosei Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: COMTURE
businessSummary: Comture Corporation provides cloud, digital, business, platform and operation, and digital learning solutions in Japan. It offers cloud services, such as collaboration and CRM  and consulting, and integration services. The company also provides analysis solutions using big data and AI tools, as well as support services for the automation of business processes. In addition, it engages in the construction, operation, modernization and consulting of accounting, human resources, fintech, and other core systems. Further, the company is involved in the design, construction, and operation of virtual network environment  remote surveillance of IT systems  and help desk operation activities. Additionally, it offers education services using various online platforms  and IT training services. Comture Corporation was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MERCURY INC SHINJUKU
businessSummary: Mercury Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operating in the real estate marketing solutions business segment. Based on the business concept of real estate big data x technology, the Company operates two businesses, the platform business and the digital marketing business, as well as other services. The platform business develops and provides services tailored to the business models of both new and used condominiums based on the real estate big data it possesses. The digital marketing business supports customer acquisition in condominium sales through Web marketing. Other services include the contract development of a direct mail delivery service system that distributes advertisements by assuming household attributes based on the floor plan and sales price of the condominium from a real estate database.

name: TOKYO SANGYO
businessSummary: Tokyo Sangyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the electric power business, the chemical and environment business, the electronic precision equipment business and the life related business. The Company operates through four business segments. Electric Power segment is engaged in the provision of power generating equipment, power distribution equipment and other electric power related equipment. Chemical and Environment segment is engaged in the provision of plants and equipment for chemical, petroleum refining, pharmaceutical, textile, rubber, nonferrous metals and other industries. Electronic Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of precision equipment, measuring devices, air conditioning and other related equipment. Life Related segment is engaged in the provision of water-saving automatic flusher, plastic bags and garbage collection bags. The Company is also engaged in the management and operation of buildings, and the real estate leasing business.

isin: 9274.T|Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd.|9274.T|Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: KPP GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd., a trading company, sells paper, paperboard, wastepaper, and other paper-related materials worldwide. It operates through Northeast Asia, Europe/Americas, the Asia Pacific, and Real Estate Leasing segments. The company distributes newsprints, printing papers, and information-related papers  container and folding box boards  surface materials, adhesives, and release papers and films  pulp and recovered papers  packaging materials, including corrugated, air cushions, honeycomb panels, bag type air cushioning materials, foam and paper cushions, gap filing buffer materials, and corrugated foam products  ink large format inkjet printers  and media for signage, interior decoration, and car wrapping. It also owns real estate  leases warehouses  and manufactures paper yarn fibers. In addition, the company offers town ecomo, a system in which paper from households is brought into collection boxes in supermarkets and retail stores to be recycled as paper raw material  office ecomo, a system for safely and securely collecting confidential documents from offices in dedicated boxes to be recycled as paper raw material  ecomo closed recycle service, a service spanning from the proposal to development of sustainable, rational, and feasible closed recycling schemes  and BMecomo, a system aimed to help operation control, facilities management, and business administration of biomass power plants. The company was formerly known as Kokusai Pulp&Paper Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2022. Kpp Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1924 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: PLANT
businessSummary: PLANT Co., Ltd. is a company mainly involved in the operation of discount stores. The Company operates three types of stores under the names JOYFUL STORE, HOME CENTER and SUPER CENTER. The JOYFUL STORE is located in the urban areas, and primarily provides small-sized and small-sum groceries and other daily consumable goods. The HOME CENTER is found in the suburbs, and principally supplies Do-It-Yourself (DIY) items, garden supplies, food products excluding fresh food, as well as clothing. The SUPER CENTER is located in the rural areas, and mainly provides daily living-related products including fresh food and others.

name: LIFULL
businessSummary: LIFULL Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of real estate related information services. The Company has two business segments. The HOME’S Related segment is engaged in the operation of the real estate information Website LIFULL HOME'S, the advertising agency business, the system development and Web production business, the provision of customer relationship management (CRM) services for real estate companies, and data management platform (DMP) service for developers, as well as the Internet marketing business. The Overseas segment is engaged in the operation of the aggregation site Trovit and overseas real estate information sites. The Company is also engaged in the operation of a series of Websites for nursing facilities searching, insurance shops searching and reservation, moving estimate and reservation, rental storage space information searching, as well as the insurance agency business and other businesses.

name: KYOKUTO KAIHATSU KOGYO
businessSummary: Kyokuto Kaihatsu Kogyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the special vehicle, environmental and parking businesses. It operates through three business segments. Special Vehicle Business segment manufactures and sells special vehicle equipment, manufactures, installs and sells special equipment for automobiles, manufactures and sells parts for special equipment and repairs specially equipped vehicles. It also engages in the sale of used special purpose vehicles, provision of after-sales services and others. Environmental Business segment constructs various recycling facilities, manufactures and sells recycling equipment, and manufactures, sells and provides general services. It also engages in the service, operation and management of these facilities and others. Parking Business segment manufactures, installs, sells and maintains multi-story parking systems for condominiums and operates coin parking lots. It also engages in real estate rental business and others.

name: INTEGROUP
businessSummary: Integroup Inc is a Japan-based company that provides mergers and acquisitions (M&A) brokerage services mainly to small and medium-sized companies. The Company operates in the M&A Brokerage business segment. The M&A Brokerage service provides one-stop support to business owners who wish to sell their companies, from initial consultation, assessment of the expected sale price, proposal of potential buyers and transfer schemes, preparation of necessary materials, selection of potential buyers, proposal to potential buyers, meeting with potential buyers, negotiation of terms and conditions, arrangement of basic agreement and final contract. The service is remunerated only when an M&A transaction is concluded.

name: TERASAKI ELECTRIC
businessSummary: TERASAKI ELECTRIC CO., LTD. is a company engaged in the manufacture and sale of marine and industrial systems, as well as electrical equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The System segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of power distribution systems, monitoring and controlling systems, group starter panels, cogeneration systems and medical equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance and after services and engineering services for its products. The Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of low voltage breakers, such as air circuit breakers, electrical circuit breakers and leakage circuit breakers.

name: FUJIPREAM
businessSummary: Fujipream Corporation engages in the precision laminating and high-functional composite materials business in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments: Precision Laminating and High-Performance Composite Materials, and Environmental Living Space and Engineering. The Precision Laminating and High-Performance Composite Materials segment produces touch panel sensor substrates and components for liquid crystal displays, as well as manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Environmental Living Space and Engineering segment includes solar cell modules, solar power generation system-related products, insulation generation systems, and film-laminated glass for general use and shatter-proofing. This segment also engages in logistics-related operations, and operates a mechanical electronics business. It also offers packing materials, such as plastic products  sheets, covers, and bags  packing boxes and molded trays  corrugated plastic sheets  moisture-proof sheets for packaging  and other products, such as curing tapes, stretch film, color stretch film, OPP tape, and PP band, as well as pallet products, and cushioning materials and processed products. In addition, the company provides functional films, including anti-scattering films, decorative films, heat shielding films, UV cut films, anti-reflection films, antibacterial and anti-viral films, etc. Fujipream Corporation was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Himeji, Japan.

isin: 8614.T|Toyo Securities Co., Ltd.|8614.T|Toyo Securities Co., Ltd.
name: TOYO SECURITIES
businessSummary: Toyo Securities Co., Ltd. provides financial products trading services in Japan. The company offers asset management and investment advice  consultancy on capital policies  support for IR  and other services. It is also involved in the buying and selling of securities  entrustment of buying and selling  underwriting and secondary distribution of securities  handling of public offering and secondary distribution of securities  and other financial instruments business activities. In addition, the company offers life insurance services. The company was formerly known as Hiroshima Shoken Shoji K.K. and changed its name to Toyo Securities Co., Ltd. in December 1971. Toyo Securities Co., Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

isin: 8550.T|The Tochigi Bank, Ltd.|8550.T|The Tochigi Bank, Ltd.
name: TOCHIGI BANK
businessSummary: The Tochigi Bank, Ltd. provides various banking products and services for individual and corporate customers in Japan. It offers various savings accounts, ordinary and fixed term deposits  housing and renovation, mortgage, car, student, and living support loans  and pension plan, insurance, and trust services  and fundraising support and foreign exchange services. The company was formerly known as Tochigi Mutual Bank Co., Ltd. and changed its name to The Tochigi Bank, Ltd. in 1989. The Tochigi Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1942 and is headquartered in Utsunomiya, Japan.

name: COSMO ENERGY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Cosmo Energy Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, import, refining, storage and sale of crude oil. The Company operates in four business segments. The Oil Development segment is engaged in the development and production of crude oil. The Petroleum segment is engaged in the production and sale of volatile oil, naphtha, kerosene, light oil, heavy oil, crude oil, lubricating oil and liquefied petroleum gas. The Petrochemical segment is engaged in the production and sale of petrochemical products such as ethylene, mixed xylene, paraxylene, benzene, toluene, and petrochemical solvents. The Renewable Energy segment is engaged in wind power generation business. The other businesses include real estate sales and management, construction and insurance, accounting, finance, purchasing, general affairs and human resources related services.

name: HEIWADO
businessSummary: HEIWADO CO., LTD. is mainly engaged in the retail sales and peripheral businesses. It has three segments. The Retail segment is engaged in sales of food products, clothing products, and daily goods. The Retail Peripheral segment involves rental of stores, management of commercial infrastructure and maintenance of buildings. The Others segment is engaged in management of suburban restaurants, family restaurants, amusements, bowling alleys, as well as development, sales and maintenance of real estate.

isin: 4404.T|MIYOSHI OIL FAT|4404.T|Miyoshi Oil & Fat Co., Ltd.
name: MIYOSHI OIL & FAT
businessSummary: Miyoshi Oil & Fat Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food and oil products in Japan. The company provides margarine, shortening, lard, powdered fats and oil, whipping cream, and other edible processed fats and oils. It also provides fatty acids, glycerine, industrial soaps, other industrial fats and oils, textile treatment agents, antifoaming agents, cosmetic raw materials, heavy metal scavengers, heavy metal fixing agents, and other various surfactants. Miyoshi Oil & Fat Co., Ltd. was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ENVIPRO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ENVIPRO HOLDINGS Inc. is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the recycling of resources. The Company mainly collects metal scrap and industrial wastes discharged from corporations or dismantled properties, and transports them to intermediate treatment plants owned by its subsidiaries. In the intermediate treatment plants, the recycled wastes are treated through various processes, including shearing and cutting, dismantling, crushing and sorting, and solid fuel production to produce various products. The Company's products include iron scrap, non-ferrous (copper, aluminum, and stainless steel) scraps, and plastics. The Company also collects recycled resources from other recyclers. The Company's products are distributed to both domestic and overseas markets. It also conducts disabled welfare services, operation of photovoltaic power stations, recycling of rubbers, manufacturing and sales of rubber products.

isin: 8562.T|The Fukushima Bank, Ltd.|8562.T|The Fukushima Bank, Ltd.
name: FUKUSHIMA BANK
businessSummary: The Fukushima Bank, Ltd. provides banking products and services in Japan. The company offers car, education, card, housing, apartment, renovation, tax accountant, and business loans, as well as reverse, unsecured, and consolidated plan mortgages  investment trusts  fixed deposits  and insurance products, including pension, life, variable, education, endowment, income protection, health and medical, pet, and automobile. It also provides web transfer acceptance  electronic money and smartphone payment  pay-easy account transfer  ATM  foreign currency exchange  corporate internet banking  cloud deposit and withdrawal management  and bank account transfer data transmission services. In addition, the company leases and purchases construction, machining, transportation, communication, office, home electrical, and medical equipment, as well as precision machinery and others. Further, it is involved in the credit card and credit guarantee activities  development, maintenance, and contracting of computer software  sale, brokerage, and rental of computers and related equipment and consumables  operation and contracting of computer systems  acquisition, holding, and sale of securities  and consulting and business matching services for investment target companies. The company serves individual and corporate customers. The Fukushima Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Fukushima, Japan.

name: GALILEI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Galilei Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Galilei Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of food service equipment, medical and scientific equipment, refrigerated display cases, large-scale food processing machinery, and both large and small refrigeration panel systems. The Company also provides related service and maintenance support. Its products include commercial refrigerators and freezers, display cases, ice makers, pharmaceutical refrigerators, low-temperature incubators, tunnel freezers, small prefabricated storage units, food processing plants, large refrigerators and others. Its services include equipment maintenance, inspection and others.

name: NAIGAI TRANS LINE
businessSummary: NAIGAI TRANS LINE LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the international freight transportation business. The Company provides four types of services. The Less than Container Load (LCL) Export services include the nonstop consolidated marine transportation services connecting ports in Japan, as well as the consolidated marine transportation services through hub ports for the countries without nonstop ships. The Full Container Load (FCL) Export services include the freight transportation services in unit of containers. The LCL Import services include the cargo transportation services from abroad. The FCL Import services provide freight transportation services in unit of containers.

name: KOKEN
businessSummary: Koken Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells occupational personal protective and environmental quality improvement equipment in Japan. It operates through Mask-Related Business, Environmental-Related Businesses, and Other Business segments. The company offers clean air solutions, including KOACH, a clean zone creator  and KOKENLAMINAR, a push-pull ventilation system. It also provides surgical masks. In addition, the company offers respirators, including particulate respirators, chemical cartridge respirators, and gas masks for industrial use  and respirators for general consumers  and protective clothes, earplugs, and face shields. The company was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SHOFU
businessSummary: Shofu Inc. manufactures and sells dental materials and equipment worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Dental Business, Nail Care Business, Other Businesses. Its products include CAD/CAM materials, artificial teeth, porcelain, impression material, cement, primer, temporary sealant, wax, dental resin, dental crown resin, room temperature curing resin and flooring resin, metal, plaster and investment material, grinding and polishing material, root canal treatment equipment, dental models, medical equipment and machines, technician instruments/machines, books and patient handbooks, self-care products for patients, sanitary equipment, whitening, orthodontic, and other products. The company also manufacture, sale, and service of beauty and health equipment and cosmetics related to nails  and manufacture and sale of industrial materials and equipment. The company was formerly known as Shofu Dental Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shofu Inc. in 1983. Shofu Inc. was incorporated in 1922 and is based in Kyoto, Japan.

name: DIVE GROUP
businessSummary: Dive Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the tourism human resources (HR) business, regional revitalization business, and information system business. The Company operates through three segments. The Tourism HR Business segment provides HR services specializing in resort jobs, and provides temporary staffing and placement services to resort hotels and inns, restaurants, theme parks, leisure facilities, ski resorts, and other tourist facilities throughout Japan. The Regional Revitalization Business segment operates lodging facilities such as glamping facilities in five locations throughout Japan. The Information System Business segment provides general support services for clients' information systems.

name: SHIGEMATSU WORKS
businessSummary: SHIGEMATSU WORKS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of occupational safety and health protection equipment. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of various occupational safety and health protection equipment such as respiratory protective equipment with electric fans, dust masks, gas masks, air supply masks, self-contained respirators, evacuation and rescue products, protective clothing, protective gloves, soundproof protective equipment, protective glasses, N95 masks and other products. The Company is also engaged in the agency sale of self-contained respirators, as well as the maintenance, inspection and repair of various protective equipment.

name: NIPPON CARBON
businessSummary: Nippon Carbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of carbon and silicon carbide products. The Company operates through three segments. The Carbon Products segment produces artificial graphite electrodes, impermeable graphite products, isotropic high-purity graphite products, mechanical graphite products, general-purpose carbon fibers and graphite fibers, resin-containing graphite fiber packing, flexible graphite sealing materials, and lithium-ion battery anode materials. The Silicon Carbide Products segment produces silicon carbide continuous fibers. The Other segment manufactures industrial machinery, repairs machinery, and rents parking lots.

name: WILLPLUS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Willplus Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the distribution of new cars and used cars, as well as the vehicle maintenance and general insurance agent business. The Imported Vehicle Sales-related segment is engaged in the sale of new cars purchased from each importer, the sale of high-year-low-running used cars of each brand, the sale of other brands used cars in auto auction, the provision of vehicle maintenance services such as maintenance, repair and inspection services, as well as the sale of compulsory automobile liability insurances and optional insurances, and the sale of new cars from importers.

name: NISSO GROUP
businessSummary: Nisso Group Co Ltd, formerly Nisso Pronity Co Ltd, is mainly engaged in metal processing, rubber processing, construction, and tile business. The Company operates its business through four segments. The Metal Processing segment is engaged in planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sales of various metal products in the construction, energy, and machinery and equipment fields. The Rubber Products segment is engaged in the planning, design, processing, manufacturing, and sales of various rubber products in the housing, machinery, and public infrastructure fields. The Construction segment is the construction business associated with the above businesses. Tile segment is engaged in planning, designing, processing, manufacturing, and sales of exterior and interior tiles for houses and buildings. It also provides manufacturing web services, contracted system development, and wood processing.

isin: 7707.T|PRECISION SYSTEM SCIENCE|7707.T|Precision System Science Co., Ltd.
name: PRECISION SYSTEM SCIENCE
businessSummary: Precision System Science Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells automated systems and instruments, other physicochemical instruments, software, and other products in Japan, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers magLEAD 12gC LiNK, an automated nucleic acid extraction system. It also provides extraction reagents comprising MagDEA Dx SV, a prefilled reagent cartridge for magnetic bead-based nucleic acid extractions  MagDEA Dx MVII, a highly concentrated nucleic acid extraction reagent for viral nucleic acid extraction of cfNDA extraction  and MagDEA Dx SV RNA, a total RNA extraction reagent, as well as MagDEA Dx LV. In addition, the company offers fully automated PCR systems consisting of geneLEAD XII plus and geneLEAD VIII, which are fully automated sample-to-sample result instruments for molecular testing. Further, it provides research reagents, including LeeChip 45-uni, a lectin microarray for glycan profiling analysis  plastic consumables  and electronic equipment. The company's products are used for research and development, as well as for the in vitro diagnosis (IVD) testing market, including genetic and protein tests. Precision System Science Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Matsudo, Japan.

name: PROGRESS TECHNOLOGIES GROUP
businessSummary: Progress Technologies Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides solutions and services for the manufacturing industry in Japan. The company offers consulting and digital engineering services. It is also involved in undertaking product development  and research and development products, such as joint research and development, and contract development and design development. In addition, the company provides support product development  and design and development, and consulting and digitalization in the design and development field. Further, it offers formulation of product development designs, system designing, tool implementation support, operational familiarization, stabilization, and execution services for implementing those designs  virtual testing environments, development and evaluation of plant models, and proposal of plans for reforming the development process  and engineering services. The company was formerly known as PTS HD Inc. and changed its name to Progress Technologies Group, Inc. in February 2023. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

name: NIPPN
businessSummary: Nippn Corp, formerly Nippon Flour Mills Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the flour milling business and the food business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Flour Milling segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of wheat flour, bran, buckwheat flour and premix products. The Food segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of household wheat flour, premix, pasta, frozen food, prepared food and rice flour products. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate, the manufacture and sale of pet food products, the design, manufacture and installation of equipment for food industry, the freight transportation business, the development of information processing systems, the sale of health food products, as well as the operation of donut shops.

name: D I SYSTEM
businessSummary: D I System Co Ltd is a Japan-based independent information service company engaged in conduction of system integration business and education service security solution business. The Company operates in two business segments. The system integration business is engaged in design and development of business applications, design and construction of infrastructure systems, and operation and maintenance of business application infrastructure systems. The educational service security solution business provides educational services such as computer languages, databases, servers, and networks. The Company also develops, sells, introduces, and maintains security products.

name: SATO SHO JI
businessSummary: SATO SHO-JI CORPORATION is a Japan-based trading company engaged in the domestic sale, import, and export of steel, non-ferrous metals, electronic components, machinery, tools, consumer goods, jewelry, construction materials, and environmental products. It operates through six segments. Steel sells ordinary and special steel, construction materials, and equipment. Non-ferrous Metals handles aluminum, zinc, silicon metal, copper alloys, and related products. Electronics supplies printed circuit board laminates and auxiliary materials. Lifestyle Sales offers tableware, cutlery, jewelry, kitchenware, promotional goods, personal karaoke systems, DANSK products, and items designed by Sori Yanagi. Machinery & Tools sells machine tools, equipment, imported machinery, cutting tools, and grinding wheels, and provides factory automation solutions. Sales Development works with technology-focused manufacturers to develop and propose environmentally friendly, advanced products.

name: EKITAN &
businessSummary: Ekitan & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company providing information contents services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Consumer business develops a transit guide service Station Search Transit Information for individuals through mobile phones including smart phones. The Business for Corporate Users provides transit guidance services provided by the Company as application service provider (ASP) service for corporations such as mobile carriers, railroad companies and map companies.

name: SALA
businessSummary: SALA Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the energy supply and solution business in Japan. The company operates through Energy & Solutions Business, Engineering & Maintenance Business, Housing Business, Car Life Support Business, Animal Health Care Business, and Property Business segments. It provides natural gas and LP gas/petroleum products  sells heat and electricity  and generates biomass power, as well as engages in the transportation of gas and petroleum, and delivery services for private homes. The company also engages in the water delivery, renovation, and cultural lectures and cooking classes businesses. In addition, it develops social infrastructure facilities, including office buildings, hospitals, schools, condominiums, parks, roads, bridges, and harbor facilities  manufactures and sells construction materials  offers infrastructure maintenance services to urban functions, such as gas, water supply/sewage, civil engineering, paving, and harbor construction  and provides integrated services comprising electric, air conditioning, and plumbing design, as well as construction and maintenance. Further, the company engages in the system development business for various industries, including factories and universities  develops houses  operates automobile dealerships  provides automobile inspection and maintenance services  and sells pet pharmaceuticals, as well as provides dietetic treatment for unwell or obese animals for recovery and health management. Additionally, it operates restaurants under the SHISEN HANTEN and XIÈ XIÈ names  and hotels and sports clubs, as well as offers real estate leasing and brokerage services. The company also provides various insurance/financing products and credit cards  and manufactures electronic equipment for automobiles and motorcycles. SALA Corporation was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Toyohashi, Japan.

name: PRONEXUS
businessSummary: PRONEXUS INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production of corporate disclosure and investor relations (IR) related documents. The Company is involved in the provision of four kinds products. Listed companies disclosure-related products include the production support for the legal disclosure documents and contents of listed company. Listed companies IR-related products include the production support for the IR tools and contents of listed company. Financial products disclosure-related products include the production support for the legal disclosure documents and sales promotion tools for investment trust and real estate investment trust management companies. Database-related products include database for the searching of corporate information, financial information and legal information.

name: SUN FRONTIER FUDOUSAN
businessSummary: Sun Frontier Fudousan Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a range of real estate-related businesses. The Company operates its business through three business segments. The Real Estate Revitalization Business segment is mainly engaged in property repositioning and rental building operations. The Real Estate Services Business segment provides property management, building maintenance, real estate sales brokerage, leasing brokerage, conference room rental, and delinquent rent guarantee services. The Hotel and Tourism Business segment is engaged in hotel development and hotel operations. The Company is also engaged in overseas development and construction businesses.

name: IIDA GROUP HOLDINGS
