businessSummary: Iida Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management and operation of subsidiaries engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, condominium sales, contract construction. It has six business segments. The Ichiken Group Business segment is engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, condominium sales, contract construction and others. The Iida Sangyo Group Business segment is engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, condominium sales, contract construction, real estate rental, hotel business, money lending, golf course business, and others. The Toei Housing Group Business segment is engaged in the businesses of detached house sales, contract construction and others. The Tact Home Group Business segment, Ernest One Group Business segment, and ID Home Business segment are engaged in the sale of detached houses, contract construction and others. It’s also engaged in the manufacture and sale of building materials such as concrete blocks.

name: NIKKO
businessSummary: Nikko Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of asphalt plants, concrete plants, environmental and conveying machinery, and crushers. It also conducts manufacturing contracting, real estate leasing, and home renovation sales. The Company operates through five segments. The Asphalt Plant-Related segment handles the production and maintenance services for asphalt plants, recycling plants, and related equipment. The Concrete Plant-Related segment handles the production and maintenance services for concrete plants and related equipment. The Environmental and Conveying-Related segment produces environmental and recycling plants, various conveyor systems, and related equipment. The Crushing Equipment segment manufactures and sells self-propelled crushers, jaw crushers, and similar equipment. The Manufacturing Contracting segment provides contract services including sheet metal fabrication, welding, and assembly. The Company also conducts temporary equipment.

name: KROSAKI HARIMA
businessSummary: Krosaki Harima Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and development of refractories. It operates through four business segments. The Refractories segment manufactures and sells refractories mainly used in various industrial kilns. The Furnace segment designs, constructs, and repairs various kilns. The Ceramics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of various industrial ceramics, as well as the sale of landscape materials. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the construction and leasing of stores and warehouses on company-owned land.

name: YAMATO
businessSummary: YAMATO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in facility works. The Company is involved in the design, supervision and construction work of construction facilities such as industrial air conditioning and hygiene equipment, general air conditioning and hygiene equipment, cold and frozen storage equipment for food distribution facilities, living-related processing equipment for environmental facilities. Through its subsidiaries, the Company also provides repair and maintenance services, as well as operation and repair management of water supply and sewerage facilities, among others.

name: TRUSCO NAKAYAMA
businessSummary: Trusco Nakayama Corporation, a trading company, engages in the wholesale of work, measuring, and cutting tools in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Factory Route, E-Business Route, and Home Center Route Overseas Route segments. It serves machine tool dealers, online retailers, and home improvement stores. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ENDO MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: ENDO MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of operating golf club heads, stainless products and forging parts. The Company operates in three segments. The Golf segment is engaged in the planning, development, manufacture and sale of golf club heads, as well as the assembly of golf clubs. The Stainless segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of stainless metal sleeves for office automation (OA) equipment and others. The Automobile Forging Part segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of forging components for automobiles and others.

name: FUJI SEAL INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: FUJI SEAL INTERNATIONAL, INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, proposing, developing, manufacturing and sales of packaging systems centered on shrink sleeve labels, self-adhesive labels (pressure sensitive labels) and spouted pouches. The Company operates in five segments: Japan segment, the Americas segment, Europe segment, PAGO segment and Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) segment. The Company is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of packaging products, packaging machinery and related machinery as well as providing maintenance services. The Company’s products are used in food, beverages, dairy, home and personal care and pharmaceutical products, etc.

name: OVERLAP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: OVERLAP Holdings,Inc. engages in the planning, production, and sale of entertainment IP contents of manga, novels, comics, and animations. It is also involved in the cross-media development and licensing business. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: KYOKUYO
businessSummary: Kyokuyo Co., Ltd. engages in the marine products, fresh produce, food, and logistics service businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Fishery Products Business, Fresh Food Business, Food Business, Logistics Services, and Other segments. The company purchases, processes, and sells seafood  processes and sells raw food products, such as sushi toppings and sashimi, fishing and farming of bonito, tuna  as well as fishing, cultivating, and breeding and purchasing. It also manufactures and sells frozen food for commercial use, frozen food for retail use, seafood delicacies  and canned food products. In addition, the company is involved in refrigerated warehouse operations  and is involved in the insurance agency business. Kyokuyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: GLOBERIDE
businessSummary: Globeride Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of fishing equipment, golf equipment, and racket sports equipment. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Americas, Europe, Asia and Oceania. The Japan segment manufactures and sells equipment, repairs, provides employee welfare services, and handles warehouse cargo. The Americas segment sells equipment. The Europe segment and Asia and Oceania segments manufacture and sell equipment.

name: SHIMANE BANK
businessSummary: The Shimane Bank,Ltd. provides various banking products and services for individual and corporate customers in Japan. It offers various deposit services  and loans, including car, card, education, mortgage, and multipurpose. It also provides whole life, individual pension, medical, cancer, income protection, disability, fire, and corporate insurance products  investment trusts  financial product brokerage  and Internet banking services. In addition, the company is involved in finance and auto leasing services. The Shimane Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1915 and is headquartered in Matsue, Japan.

isin: 2429.T|World Holdings Co., Ltd.|2429.T|World Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: WORLD HOLDINGS
businessSummary: World Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in human resources and education, information and telecommunications, real estate, and agricultural park businesses in Japan. The company offers subcontracting, business process outsourcing, temporary staffing services, research and development, manufacturing, electromechanical design development, information technology system design development, and medical and biotechnology research and development services. It is also involved in the planning, development, and sale of condominiums  renovation of condominiums and detached houses  rental property brokerage and real estate brokerage businesses  development, manufacturing, sale, and rental of prefabricated houses  real estate fund management  and the management and collection of receivables. In addition, the company engages in the operation of mobile phone stores and call centers  management of agricultural parks  electronics manufacturing services  power supply businesses  and electronic device repair services. The company was formerly known as WORLD INTEC Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: GLTECHNO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: GLtechno Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of analytical instrument-related products, semiconductor-related products, and contactless integrated circuit (IC) card-related products, the procurement and sales of similar products, as well as the research and development and technical services related to each of these businesses. The Company operates through three segments. The Analytical Instrument segment manufactures and sells gas chromatographs and liquid chromatograph products. The Semiconductor segment manufactures and sells quartz jigs for semiconductors, optical polishing, and quartz cell products for spectrophotometers. The Automatic Recognition segment develops, manufactures, and sells peripheral devices using contactless IC cards, access control systems, embedded devices for other companies' equipment, and reagent management systems.

name: JAPAN PROCESS DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Japan Process Development Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the system development and information service business. The Company has six business segments. The Control System segment is engaged in the development of energy systems, traffic systems and information processing systems. The Automotive System segment is engaged in the development of vehicle control systems and advanced driving assistance systems (ADAS). The Specific Information System segment is engaged in the development of satellite image processing systems and disaster prevention systems. The Embedded System segment is engaged in the development of systems embedded in storage devices and medical equipment. The Industrial and Public System segment is engaged in the development of systems for member and content management, integrated circuit (IC) cards and satellites. The Information Technology (IT) Service segment is engaged in the provision of services such as systems construction, maintenance and operation.

name: EBARA FOODS INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Ebara Foods Industry Inc is mainly engaged in food business, logistics business and others. The Company operates in two business segments. The Food segment includes household products and commercial products, and is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sauce for various meat, such as barbecued meat sauce and chicken sauce, sauce for stew, such as Korean pickled cabbage hot pot sauce, and sauce for vegetables, such as pickle sauce, as well as the manufacture and sale of other food, including curry flakes, konjac and seaweed salads. The segment also involves in the manufacture and sale of soup, such chicken-bone soup and noodle soup. The Logistics segment operates warehousing and freight forwarding services. The others business is engaged in the advertising business, temporary staffing business and others.

name: WANTEDLY
businessSummary: Wantedly, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in operation of business social networking service(SNS) platform named Wantedly. The number of users per month at the end of May 2017 is 1,514,842. The Company operates through one segment: Business SNS. The segment provides company visit matching service Wantedly Visit, business card management application Wantedly People, business use specialized chat tool Wantedly Chat, media platform Wantedly and others. The company has one subsidiary.

name: TOKYO KIKAI SEISAKUSHO
businessSummary: TOKYO KIKAI SEISAKUSHO,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing machinery and the press control systems that operate them, as well as the provision of services related to its various business operations. The Printing Machinery-Related Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of printing machinery and peripheral equipment, as well as the provision of maintenance services for them.

name: TOAGOSEI
businessSummary: TOAGOSEI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the chemicals business and polymer and oligomer businesses. The Company operates through five business segments. The Core Chemicals segment manufactures and sells electrolytic products such as caustic soda, caustic potash, and sodium hypochlorite, industrial gases and acrylic monomers such as acrylic acid and acrylic acid esters. The Polymer and Oligomer segment manufactures and sells acrylic oligomers such as acrylic polymers, polymer flocculants, and light-curing resins. The Adhesive Materials segment manufactures and sells instant adhesives and functional adhesives. The High-Performance Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity inorganic chemicals and inorganic functional materials. The Resin Processed Products segment manufactures and sells environmental infrastructure system products, building materials and civil engineering products. It also conducts new product research and development, transportation.

name: C CHANNEL
businessSummary: C Channel Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media business, electronic commerce (e-commerce) business and overseas business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Media segment is engaged in the provision of native video advertising services that plans, produces and distributes video advertising content for corporates, as well as the advertising and ad network services, event holding services, sample product sales services and influencer marketing services through the video media application C CHANNEL and mama+ in Japan. The E-commerce segment is engaged in the sale of apparel products, beauty equipment and cosmetic products in Japan through applications and social networking services (SNS). The brands include KOBE LETTUCE, Isn't She?, N WITH., and BELL PALETTE. The Overseas segment is engaged in the overseas expansion of the C CHANNEL business mainly in the Asian regions such as China, Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia and Vietnam.

name: DAIWABO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Daiwabo Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture, processing and sale of textile products, sale of information equipment, manufacture and sale of machine tools. It has four business segments. Information Technology Infrastructure Distribution business sells computer and peripheral equipment, provides one-stop services of logistics and technical services, provides solution business of system development, network construction. Textiles business is engaged in manufacture, processing and sale of synthetic cotton, non-woven products, industrial materials products, textiles, knits, secondary products. Industrial Machinery business manufactures and sells machine tools, automatic machines. It is also engaged in hotel business, real estate leasing and management, provision of general affairs, personnel and financial services, development and operation of information processing systems, civil engineering and construction, insurance agency and finance business.

isin: 8541.T|The Ehime Bank, Ltd.|8541.T|The Ehime Bank, Ltd.
name: EHIME BANK
businessSummary: The Ehime Bank, Ltd. provides banking products and financial services in Japan. It operates in two segments, Banking and Lease. The Banking business segment includes banking services, such as deposits, loans, and domestic and foreign exchange. The Leasing business segment involves leasing operations. It is also involved in computer-related, credit card, guarantee, and support services. The Ehime Bank, Ltd. was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Matsuyama, Japan.

name: NIPPON KAYAKU
businessSummary: Nippon Kayaku Co Ltd is engaged in the mobility & imaging business, fine chemicals business and life sciences business. The Company operates in three segments. The Mobility & Imaging segment includes safety systems, such as airbag inflators, micro gas generators and squibs, and polatechno, which produces components for liquid crystal displays (LCDs), LCD projectors, and X-ray analyzers. The Fine Chemicals segment provides functional materials such as epoxy resins, maleimide resins, curing agents, reactive flame-retardant resins, acrylic esters, Ultraviolet (UV)-curable resins, resists for microelectromechanical systems, cleaners for LCDs and semiconductors, sealants, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, dyes for inkjet printers, dyes for inkjet textile printing, industrial inkjet inks, materials and dichroic dyes for light-control glass. The Life Science segment includes pharmaceutical-related products such as anti-cancer agents, biological products, and real estate rental business.

isin: 8395.T|The Bank of Saga Ltd.|8395.T|The Bank of Saga Ltd.
name: BANK OF SAGA
businessSummary: The Bank of Saga Ltd. provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company offers web account, fixed term deposits, foreign currency deposits, and investment trusts  home, auto, educational, card, easy, agriculture, syndicated loans, and other loans for corporate and sole proprietor customers  medical, nursing care, personal pension, single payment, and internet insurance  and internet banking. It also provides venture business collaboration and support system, private placement bonds, project finance, credit card, and subsidy application support  corporate internet banking service, web invoice creation service, corporate FX IB Services, EB services, direct payment service for national and local taxes, electronic bill of exchange service, utility billing service, cashless merchant service, overseas business consulting, and web account transfer and fund transfer services. In addition, the company offers consulting services, recruitment, market development, business succession support, crowdfunding, carbon neutral services, listing support, advertising services, and zero carbon system. The company was founded in 1882 and is headquartered in Saga, Japan.

name: BML
businessSummary: BML Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the testing business. Data processed in the host core system is reported to customers as test results. Customer unit price data and specimen testing performance data held by the host core system become billing data for customers, which is then linked to the automatic recording of sales. Other businesses include the medical information systems business. The testing business segment undertakes contract work such as clinical testing, while the medical information systems business segment manufactures and sells system equipment for medical institutions and provides medical information services.

name: KOGI
businessSummary: Kogi Corporation manufactures and sells casting roll-related products, environmental equipment, and friction materials for automobiles, railways, and industrial machinery in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Casting Field, Environment Field/Environmental Engineering, and Environment Field/Functional Materials segments. It offers castings for press dies, TGC 600, industrial machinery related casting, steel related casting  ACE automatic molding machine, V process automatic molding machine, gray cast iron, spheroidal graphite cast iron. In addition, it sells steel sheets, wires, bars used as materials for automotive parts, screws, nails, and other automotive components  H-beams, angle steel, channel steel, and deformed steel bars for construction, as well as slabs, billets, beam blanks. The company also offers dense bar  blower, transvector, and environmental equipment  functional materials  sand casting, and mold casting. Further, it engages in the research and development activities. Kogi Corporation was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Himeji, Japan.

name: MUTOH
businessSummary: MUTOH HOLDINGS CO., LTD. is primarily involved in the development, manufacture and sale of information graphics-related equipment. The Company operates in four business segments. The information graphics-related Equipment segment offers large-format inkjet printers for graphic arts, computer aided design (CAD) plotters, industry-specific plotters, imaging scanners, 3D printers and other related supply products. The Information Services segment provides services for CAD and related software, as well as software development and system integration services. The Design Measuring Equipment is engaged in the provision of drafting and design equipment, optical measuring equipment. The Real Estate Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate. The Company also offers sports support goods and restaurants business.

name: BOOKING RESORT
businessSummary: Booking Resort Co., Ltd. operates accommodation facilities. The company operates resort-glamping.com, a reservation platform for glamping and resort facilities  and Inuyado, a booking platform for pet tourism. It also engages in accommodation development, operation, and customer acquisition support for glamping, resort villas, and pet-friendly accommodations  accommodation facility revitalization projects  owns and operates various brands in categories, such as hot springs, dog-friendly accommodations, and private stays  directly managed businesses  Facility Regeneration and Resale Business  and Pet Travel service through rHEBELIAN NET.J. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 9832.T|Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd.|9832.T|Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd.
name: AUTOBACS SEVEN
businessSummary: Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates a chain of retail stores for automotive goods and services in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: AUTOBACS Business  Consumer Business  Wholesale Business  and Expansion Business. The AUTOBACS Business segment engages in the wholesale of car accessories, such as tires, wheels, and car electronics to franchisees. The Consumer Business segment sells car accessories through physical stores, websites, and official apps, as well as offers installation, vehicle maintenance, and vehicle inspections services, and bodywork services  and purchases and sells vehicles. The Wholesale Business segment engages in the wholesaling of lifestyle brands and other private brands, etc. The Expansion Business segment engages in credit-related businesses, insurance agencies, as well as provides financing, property and location development, and motorized bicycles. The company was formerly known as Fuji-Syokai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd. in March 1980. Autobacs Seven Co., Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 7173.T|Tokyo Kiraboshi Financial Group, Inc.|7173.T|Tokyo Kiraboshi Financial Group, Inc.
name: TOKYO KIRABOSHI FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Tokyo Kiraboshi Financial Group, Inc. provides financial services for small and medium-sized enterprises in Japan. It operates through two segments: Banking and Lease. The Banking segment offers a variety of deposit products, including current, savings, notice, and time deposits, as well as negotiable certificates of deposit. It provides lending services such as commercial loans, housing loans, and consumer loans  conducts securities investment and trading  and offers domestic and foreign exchange services, trust business, and credit guarantee services. The Lease segment handles general leasing operations, including office equipment, industrial machinery, and automobiles. The company also provides services, including securities brokerage, consulting, advertising planning and production, fintech, credit card payment, system development, fund transfer, and debt collection. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of various management consultations, seminars, etc.  and development and provision of services utilizing fintech and construction of new businesses, etc. Further, it provides loan guarantee and home loan services  and offers digital banking services. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SURUGA BANK
businessSummary: Suruga Bank Ltd. is a Japan-based bank engaged in the banking business, as well as the provision of other financial services such as leasing business, loan business and guarantee servive. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposit services, loan services, and domestic and foreign exchange transactions services, as well as the counter sale of securities, investment trust and insurance. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of loans, leasing services, manpower dispatching services, credit guarantee services, system development services and credit cards services, among others.

isin: 4082.T|Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd.|4082.T|Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd.
name: DAIICHI KIGENSO KAGAKU KOGYO
businessSummary: Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical industrial products in Japan, North America, Europe, East Asia, and South and Central Asia. The company provides zirconium oxide, electromelting stabilized zirconium oxide, complex oxide, zirconium compounds, cesium flux wires, rings, zirconium silicate, various sol, and non-oxide zirconium products, as well as oxides for electrolytes  and zirconia for advanced ceramics and solid oxide fuel cells. It also provides other inorganic compounds, including cesium compounds and rare earth compounds. The company's products are used in automotive and industrial catalysts  advanced ceramics  dental materials  electronic materials  refractories and brake materials  fuel cells and oxygen sensors  coatings and metal surface treatment materials  and aluminum brazing materials. Daiichi Kigenso Kagaku Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

isin: 7350.T|Okinawa Financial Group, Inc.|7350.T|Okinawa Financial Group, Inc.
name: OKINAWA FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Okinawa Financial Group, Inc. provides various financial services in Japan. It operates through two segments, Banking and Leasing. The Banking segment offers deposit, lending, foreign exchange, and securities investment services  over-the-counter sales of government bonds  and trust services  etc. The Leasing segment provides leasing and related business activities. It also offers trading and credit card services, securities, credit guarantee and various consulting services, debt management, cash reckoning and settlement services, debt and collection, and computer related services. In addition, the company provides cash inspection and sorting work, financial and economic survey and research, and business management consultation services, etc., as well as sales channel development support services. Okinawa Financial Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Naha, Japan.

name: OKURA INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: Okura Industrial Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the processing, manufacturing and sales of various polyethylene and polypropylene products, various optically functional film products, processed plywood, particle board and processed board, land development and building construction and sales, as well as hotel management and real estate leasing. It operates through three segments. The Synthetic Resin segment produces and sells synthetic resin products such as polyethylene film and polypropylene film. The New Materials segment produces and sells liquid crystal display-related materials such as optical functional films. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the production and sales of building materials such as particle board and processed board. The Company is also engaged in hotel business, information processing system development business, non-life insurance agency business, cable television broadcasting business, and real estate leasing business.

isin: 6844.T|Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.|6844.T|Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
name: SHINDENGEN ELECTRIC MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductors, electrical equipment, and power supply products in Japan. It operates in three segments: Power Device Business, Power Unit Business, and Power Systems Business. The company offers DC quick charger, AC charger for EV, wireless charging system, engine and motor control, battery power supply, damper, power steering, and lighting control products  and energy storage systems ad inverters, electrical storage inverters, inverter units, PV inverters, monitoring systems, O&M service, and other products. It also provides industrial equipment, LED lighting, AC/DC power supplies, internet infrastructure, data centers, telecommunication power supplies, and semiconductor power. In addition, it serves the mobility, energy, industrial equipment, telecommunication, and home appliance markets. Shindengen Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 3553.T|KYOWA LEATHER CLOTH|3553.T|Kyowa Leather Cloth Co., Ltd.
name: KYOWA LEATHER CLOTH
businessSummary: Kyowa Leather Cloth Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells synthetic leather cover materials in Japan. The company's products are used in automotive interiors, housing and building materials, fashion and lifestyle. It sells its products under the Sobagni brand. Kyowa Leather Cloth Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Hamamatsu, Japan.

name: SUMITOMO CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Sumitomo Chemical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates the chemical business. The Company has five segments. Essential & Green Materials segment manufactures and sells synthetic resins, raw materials for synthetic fibers, industrial chemicals, methacrylate, processed synthetic resin products, aluminum and alumina and synthetic rubber. Advanced Medical Solutions segment handles process development and contract manufacturing for pharmaceuticals and others. Information and Communication Technology (ICT) & Mobility Solutions segment handles optical products, semiconductor process materials, compound semiconductor materials, touch sensor panels, chemical products, engineering plastics and battery materials. Agro & Life Solutions segment handles agricultural chemicals, fertilizers, agricultural materials, pest control insecticides and materials for tropical disease control. Sumitomo Pharma segment handles small molecule pharmaceuticals. The Company also provides other businesses.

name: PS CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: PS Construction Co Ltd, formerly P.S. Mitsubishi Construction Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering business, construction business and manufacturing business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the construction of prestressed concrete (PC) and civil engineering works, the manufacture and sale of PC products, the operation of pavement, repair and foundation works of civil engineering structures, and the management of civil engineering equipment. The Building Construction segment is engaged in operation of PC works and other general construction works, as well as the manufacture and sale of PC products. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of concrete products. The Others segment is engaged in the sale, leasing and brokerage of real estate, and the provision of non-life insurance brokerage services.

name: SUMIDA
businessSummary: Sumida Corporation researches, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components in Japan, the United States, China, Hong Kong, Germany, the rest of the Asia Pacific, the rest of the European Union, the rest of North America, and internationally. The company offers power inductors, rod core chokes, RF coils, and RF chip inductors, including surface mount, through-hole, and LPF coils for digital amplifiers  and power transformers, such as surface mount, through-hole, and PoE transformers, as well as switching mode power supplies, reactors, and wireless power transfer coils. It also provides signal transformers and magnetics comprising pulse and xDSL transformers, RF/communication, RFID, antennas, and other products  EMC coils consisting of AC and DC power line, and normal and common mode chokes  and sensors and actuators, including rotor position sensors, ABS coils, and solenoid coils. In addition, the company offers automotive modules comprising choke modules for inverters, module components, component carriers, power conversion, and other components and modules  magnetic materials, such as ferrites, powder cores, and nanocrystalline materials  filters  feedthrough capacitors and ceramics, which consist of filter plates, trimmer capacitors, and ceramic mounting elements  flexible connections  electronic manufacturing services  low-voltage transformers, chokes, LCL-filters, AFE and EMC filters, and MF-transformers for the power industry  and components for medical equipment, including network isolation and isolation transformers. The company's products are used for audio/visual, OA, automotive, and industrial applications. The company was formerly known as Sumida Electric Co., Ltd and changed its name to Sumida Corporation in June 2000. Sumida Corporation was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: IWATANI
businessSummary: IWATANI CORPORATION is a gas company. The Total Energy Division provides household, commercial and industrial liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), LPG supplying equipment, liquefied natural gas(LNG), gas products, and household kitchen appliances. The Industrial Gas and Machinery Division provides gas, helium, gas supplying equipment, welding equipment, industrial machinery and robots, pumps and compressors, as well as semiconductor and electronic parts manufacturing equipment, pharmaceutical and food machinery and environmental equipment. The Materials Division provides steel, nonferrous metals, functional films, display materials, electronic material, ceramic raw materials and biomass fuel. The Natural Industry Division provides frozen foods, health food, livestock systems, agricultural materials and equipment. The Others segment involves in finance, insurance, transportation and information processing businesses.

name: LIKE
businessSummary: LIKE Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in childcare support services, comprehensive human resources services, and nursing care-related services. It has three business segments. The Comprehensive Human Resources Services segment provides staffing services, outsourcing services, recruitment services, and recruitment and education support services to client companies. The Childcare Support Services segment provides public childcare services, such as operating licensed nurseries and after-school clubs, and contract childcare services, operating on-site childcare facilities set up by hospitals, companies, universities and others. The Nursing Care-related Services segment operates paid nursing homes and other nursing care facilities with 24-hour nursing staff on-site, providing nursing care and nursing services to residents.

name: ITOHAM YONEKYU HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Itoham Yonekyu Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed meat products (ham, sausage, cooked processed foods) and meat products. The Company operates through two segments. The Processed Food segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed meat products such as ham, sausage, and cooked processed foods. The Meat segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of meat and cooked processed foods. In addition, the Company also provides administrative agency services, logistics services, and human resources and payroll-related services.

name: ZETT
businessSummary: ZETT CORPORATION is principally engaged in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of sports products, as well as the provision of related services. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company operates Sport Business segment, which has four business divisions. The Wholesale division is engaged in the wholesale of sports equipment. It purchases products from approximately 300 companies and sells the products to retailers and mass merchandisers nationwide, the segment also sells baseball products in China. The Manufacturing division designs and develops baseball products and sports wears, it also designs, manufactures and sells health supplies. The Retail division sells products through directly-managed stores to general customers. The Others division provides logistic services to the Wholesale and Manufacturing divisions, and operates sports facilities.

name: ENBIO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: EnBio Holdings, Inc is a holding company principally engaged in the environmental business. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, operates through three business segments. Soil Contamination Countermeasures segment is engaged in the investigation of soil contamination, design and construction of purification work, and risk consulting to its customers. Soil Contamination Related Equipment And Materials Sales segment is engaged in the import and sale of equipment, materials and purification agents used in onsite investigation and remediation. Brown Field Utilization segment is engaged in the purchase of polluted land and resale of it after purification. As of March 31, 2013, the Company had three subsidiaries and one associated company.

name: SUMITOMO MITSUI TRUST GROUP
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group Inc, formerly Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking, asset management, asset administration, and real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through seven business segments. The Personal Business segment provides services to individual customers. The Corporate Business segment provides services to corporate customers. The Investor Business segment provides services to investor customers. The Real Estate Business segment provides real estate business services. The Market Business segment provides marketing, market making, investment, and financial management services. The Operation Business segment provides asset management services. The Other Business segment includes income and expenditures for capital procurement and policy stock dividends, costs of the business management headquarters, and eliminations of internal transactions.

name: JMS
businessSummary: JMS Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, export, and import of medical devices and pharmaceuticals in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, China, South Korea, Thailand, and internationally. It offers infusion and nutrition solutions, which includes needless access port, closed drug mixing and infusion system, infusion pump, and oral and enteral nutrition system for treatment and laboratory testing  and dialysis solutions including dialysis equipment for hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis solution, and APD equipment that automatically performs the injection and discharge of peritoneal dialysis solution, as well as offers hemodialysis machines. It also provides surgical treatment solution comprising products that are used in cardiac surgery and cardiovascular internal medicine, such as membrane oxygenator and cardiopulmonary blood pump systems. In addition, the company offers blood management and cell therapy solutions, which includes serum collection sets and blood bags. Further, it provides logistics and other equipment  and offers maintenance works and sanatorium services. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

name: NIPPON SHOKUBAI
businessSummary: Nippon Shokubai Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals. It has two business segments. The Materials Business segment includes acrylic acid, acrylic esters, ethylene oxide, ethylene glycol, ethanolamine, special esters, superabsorbent polymers, maleic anhydride, and process catalysts. The Solutions Business segment includes polymers for concrete admixtures, glycol ethers, secondary compounds, alcohol ethoxylates, water-soluble polymers such as detergent raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, electronic information materials, iodine compounds, resins for adhesives and paints, ethyleneimine derivatives, adhesive products, automotive catalysts, denitrification catalysts, dioxin decomposition catalysts, exhaust gas treatment equipment, wet oxidation catalysts, and battery materials.

name: GEECHS
businessSummary: geechs inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in information technology (IT) staffing business and games business. The Company operates through six segments. The IT Staffing segment is engaged in introducing IT freelances to companies in need. The IT Talents Development segment is engaged in school business for training IT engineers who are active in global. The Game segment collaborates and partner with game distributors to entrust the planning, development and operation of native application games for smartphones based on Unity. The Video segment entrust video and video production related to promotion on the Internet. The Internet segment operates Gridge, a specialized golf information site which can also deliver advertisements of golf equipment manufacturers and apparel companies. The Global Recruiting segment introducing foreign students studying in Japan and Japanese students studying abroad with companies in need of global talents.

isin: 8303.T|SBI SHINSEI BANK LTD|8303.T|SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited
name: SBI SHINSEI BANK
businessSummary: SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited provides banking and financial products and services to individual customers, corporations, public-sector entities, and financial institutions in Japan. The company offers retail banking, home mortgages, investment trust, consumer finance, unsecured personal loans, shopping credit and credit cards, loans secured by real estate, fundraising services, corporate and syndicated loans, acquisition and ship finance, healthcare finance, renewable energy finance, finance for start-ups, private equity, real estate non-recourse finance, and project finance services. It also provides asset and wealth management services, business succession, credit guarantee, credit trading, M&A advisory, and foreign exchange and derivatives services. The company was formerly known as Shinsei Bank, Limited and changed its name to SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited in January 2023. SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited was founded in 1952 and is based in Chuo, Japan. SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited operates as a subsidiary of SBI Regional Bank Holdings Co., Ltd.

name: TEIKOKU
businessSummary: Teikoku Corp, formerly Teikoku Electric Mfg. Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in pump business. The Pump Business manufactures and sells canned motor pumps, metering pumps, and other types of pumps. Canned motor pumps include canned motor pumps for chemical equipment, high-pressure gas equipment, refrigeration and air conditioning equipment, semiconductor equipment, and power-related equipment. Metering pumps include metering pumps for chemical equipment, high-pressure gas equipment, semiconductor equipment, and foaming equipment. Other pumps include power-related equipment pumps and other types of pumps. It also provides specialized equipment such as permanent magnet generators.

name: TSUMURA &
businessSummary: Tsumura & Co. engages in the production and sale of Kampo extract intermediates and granular Kampo formulations in Japan and internationally. The company offers products for female problems, proneness to fatigue, skin problems, gastrointestinal problems, obesity, constipation and hemorrhoids, as well as body aches, children's sickness, stress, urinary problems, and cold, cough, and nasal/throat inflammation symptoms. It is also involved in manufacturing and sales of prescription drugs and over-the-counter Kampo medicines. In addition, it produces and sells alcoholic beverages and food products. Tsumura & Co. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: UPR
businessSummary: UPR Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in rental and sales of pallets and other distribution equipment. The Company operates two segments. The Distribution segment is engaged in rental and sales of wooden and plastic pallets, metal distribution equipment such as nesting racks and basket cars, assist suits, other distribution equipment and related products. The Connected segment is engaged in rental and sales of location information solutions, services for remote monitoring solutions, rental and sales of related equipment, management, rental, sales and operation of car sharing business.

name: ALINCO
businessSummary: Alinco Incorporated develops, manufactures, and sells scaffolding equipment in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Retail Business, Rental Related Business, Household Equipment Related Business, and Electronic Equipment Related Business. It offers scaffolding materials and logistics storage equipment  steel hardwear  home equipment, such as ladders, stepladders, stationary elevated workbenches, resin moldings, trolleys, folding carts, fitness-related products, surveying and laser equipment, aluminum bridges, fitness equipment, and various type of carts and folding handcarts  and wireless communication devices. The company is also involved in the sale and rental of scaffolding materials for low-rise and medium to high-rise buildings, and temporary bleachers and oct systems. In addition, it undertakes assembly and processing of electronic equipment  develops, manufactures, and sells do-it-yourself products, aluminium mold, electronic devices, printed and multi-layer printed wiring boards, metal and related products, and health care and beauty equipment  and develops and manages real estate properties. Further, it manufactures and sells steel racks for logistics warehouses, and steel floor materials. Alinco Incorporated was formerly known as Inoue Iron Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Alinco Incorporated in March 1983. The company was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: AOZORA BANK
businessSummary: Aozora Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company also engages in business related to financial services such as financial products trading business and others, as well as debt management and collection business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Institutional Banking Group segment includes loans, deposits, sales of financial products, private equity investment, and other businesses. The Structured Finance Group segment includes acquisition finance, environmental project finance, rehabilitation finance, and real estate finance. The International Business Group segment includes overseas investment and financing. The Market Group segment includes the sale and trade of derivatives and foreign exchange products, and other businesses. The Customer Relation Group segment includes the sale of loans, deposits, and financial products to corporate clients, and the sale of deposits, mutual funds, and insurance to retail clients.

name: SHIBUYA
businessSummary: Shibuya Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products related to packaging plant business, mechatronics system business and agricultural equipment business. It has three business segments. Packaging Plant segment's products are bottling systems such as filling, capping, and labeling systems, case-forming and packaging systems, pharmaceutical equipment systems including pharmaceutical manufacturing systems and isolators, food processing systems, washing equipment systems, and regenerative medicine systems. The Mechatronics System segment’s products include semiconductor manufacturing systems such as solder ball mounters, wire bonders, and light emitting diode (LED) inspection equipment, medical devices, cutting and processing systems, ultrasonic generators, and hydraulic presses. The Agricultural Equipment segment includes agricultural fruit and produce sorting systems. The Company also engages in temporary staffing and travel agency businesses.

businessSummary: Ryoden Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of factory automation (FA) system products, refrigeration building system products, information and communication technology (ICT) system products, and electronics products, and the provision of services incidental to each business, as well as insurance agency business. The Company operates through four segments. The FA System business segment provides servo systems, inverters, and numerical control (NC) devices. The Refrigeration Building System business segment provides packaged air conditioners, chilling units, refrigerators and elevators. The ICT System business segment provides video and image information systems, medical facilities, and plant factory systems. The Electronics business segment provides memories, microcomputers, power devices, materials, and fabricated materials.

name: SLOGAN
businessSummary: Slogan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human resources creation business in new industrial areas. The Company develops business in the carrier service field and software as a service (SaaS) field. In the career service field, The Company operates a carefully selected job-hunting platform Goodfind for new graduate students, operates a consulting job hunting platform Fact Logic for new graduate students and provides job-hunting services that specialize in foreign-affiliated and Japanese consulting firms, operates a long-term intern referral platform for students, Intern Street, which specializing in recruiting start-ups and venture companies. In the media and SaaS field, The Company operates FastGrow, a business media for young innovation human resources that provides services that support recruitment public relations, branding, and service recognition of companies in new industrial fields, operates a SaaS-type human resources service TeamUp.

name: EDULAB
businessSummary: EduLab Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of testing development, implementation, analysis, educational services for English and other tests. The Company operates through five segments. The Testing and Other Licensing segment provides testing services and learning services centered on languages to educational institutions, private companies, and individuals. The Educational Platform segment provides and operates learning services such as Stagia Eiken, Stagia Kanken, and Stagia Math Test, as well as media services. The Test Center segment establishes test centers nationwide and provides test centers for various qualifications, certification exams, and university entrance exams. The Artificial Intelligence (AI) segment provides services and products using AI technology researched and developed in-house. The Test Operation and Outsourcing segment provides services related to test question creation, system construction, management, operation, and scoring.

name: KANEKA
businessSummary: Kaneka Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemical-related businesses. It operates through four segments. The Material Solutions Unit segment includes general-purpose vinyl chloride resins, caustic soda products, special polyvinyl chloride resins, modifiers, epoxy masterbatches, biodegradable polymers, and modified silicone polymers. The Quality of Life Solutions Unit segment includes styrene-based foam resins and molded products, styrene-based foam extrusion boards, polyolefin foams, solar circuit construction methods, polyimide films, optical materials, graphite sheets, and solar cells. The Health Care Solutions Unit segment includes medical devices, low-molecular-weight pharmaceutical raw materials, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). The Nutrition Solutions Unit segment includes functional food ingredients, lactic acid bacteria, margarines, shortenings, baker's yeasts, spices, antifreeze ingredients, dairy products, functional fertilizers, and feeds.

name: SANIX HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sanix Holdings Incorporated engages in the environmental sanitation business primarily in Japan. The company engages in the termite examination  termite Inspection and estimate process  pest control  underfloor and attic ventilation system  and foundation repair and renovation work. It also involved in the underfloor and ceiling insulation and heat shielding in the ceiling space  house reinforcement system  home renovation  seismic diagnosis and renovation activities  and drain pipe cleaning, residential fire alarm, crime prevention and monitoring security, house cleaning, and connected home services. In addition, the company provides equipment maintenance  water supply and drainage pipe  water tank cleaning and sterilization, water tank interior and exterior protective coating, direct water supply, water supply pumps, exterior wall construction, and roof top water proofing work  regular equipment review  inspection of water supply and drainage pipes  and arsenic removal systems. Further, it engages in the solar power generation and battery storage business. The company was formerly known as Sanix Incorporated and changed its name to Sanix Holdings Incorporated in March 2025. Sanix Holdings Incorporated was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: CMK
businessSummary: CMK Corporation develops, produces, and markets various printed circuit boards in Japan, China, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automotive PCB  high heat dissipation or high current copper base and composite metal PCBs  semi-flex and rigid-flex PCB series  high frequency correspondence PCBs  high-multi-layer-PCB  PPBU series  through-hole PCBs  and double-sided multilayer PCBs. The company's products are used in automotive, medical, telecommunications, and aerospace industries. CMK Corporation has a strategic alliance with Guangdong Ellington Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. The company was formerly known as Chuo Meiban Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CMK Corporation in 1984. CMK Corporation was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: TAKANO
businessSummary: TAKANO CO.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of living related equipment, inspection and measurement equipment, industrial equipment and exterior products, as well as the sale of machine and tools. The Company operates through five business segments. The Living Related Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of office chairs, as well as chairs for medical and healthcare facilities. The Inspection and Measurement Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of atomic force microscope (AFM) equipment and film inspection equipment. The Industrial Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of solenoid actuators and unit components. The Exterior Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of flip-up gates, carports, terraces and awnings. The Machine and Tool segment is mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of machine and tools.

name: CEL
businessSummary: CEL Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rental housing business, which provides consulting and solutions for apartment management; the rental development business, which develops and sells real estate; and the rental management business, which provides property management services. The Company operates business through three segments. The Apartment Construction Subcontracting segment is engaged in the plan, design, construction, and contracting of apartments for single persons, specializing in the Tokyo area. The Stock segment is mainly engaged in the leasing and management of apartment buildings on a lump-sum lease basis, apartment management services such as rent collection, and repair work. The China Leasing segment operates a serviced factory business in Ningbo City, which takes advantage of the advantages of large factory buildings to provide size categories and functions that meet the needs of clients, and a serviced office business in three locations in Shanghai.

name: MIC
businessSummary: MIC Co., Ltd. provides retail sales promotion support services in Japan. It offers support services from manufacturing to delivery, and display of promotional tools  PromOS, a cloud-based platform that manages systems and information related to sales promotion  Co.HUB, a joint delivery service that consolidates promotional tools from each manufacturer at a promotion management center and delivers them to stores  and designer on-site support services. The company also provides business improvement consulting, system development, BPO, creative designing, printing, fulfillment, and field supporting services. MIC Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. MIC Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of M2 Corporation.

name: HS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: HS Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the securities business. The Company operates in five segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit business and lending business. The Securities segment is engaged in the brokerage and commission of securities and derivative products, underwriting and sales of securities, handling of recruitment, sales of securities, handling of private offerings of securities, as well as other securities business. The Accounts Receivable Management business is engaged in the collection of perform credit management. Information Technology (IT) business is engaged in the development of mobile application and distribution of digital contents. The Other business is engaged in venture capital business and merger & acquisition business.

name: SEKISUI CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Sekisui Chemical Co Ltd is mainly engaged in housing business, environment and life line business, high-performance plastics business and medical business. The Company operates in four segments. The Housing segment is engaged in the manufacture, construction and sale of steel-frame and wood-frame modular housing, the sale of land for sale, renovation, real estate brokerage, rental management, interior and exterior sales and construction. The Environment & Life Line segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and construction of polyvinyl chloride pipes and fittings, polyethylene pipes and fittings, plastic valves and others. The High-Performance Plastics segment manufactures and sells liquid crystal particles and photosensitive materials. The Medical segment manufactures and sells clinical diagnostic reagents, automatic analyzers and blood collection tubes. The other businesses include the provision of services for film-type lithium-ion batteries and products.

The company was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: DIAMOND ELECTRIC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Diamond Electric Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic control devices such as ignition coils and electrical components for automobiles. The Energy Solutions segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for power conditioners for solar power generation and hybrid systems for energy storage. The Electronic Devices segment is engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, and supply of maintenance services for ignition devices for home heating and cooling systems and hot water supply systems, electronic control devices, and other products.

businessSummary: Aica Kogyo Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sales of chemical products and building materials. The Company operates in two segments. The Construction Material and Equipment segment offers melamine facing plates, coated plywood boards, doors, interior materials, counters and nonflammable dressed lumbers. The Company operates its businesses in Japan and overseas.

The company offers incinerators for waste liquids containing solid particles, incinerators for halide wastes, equipment for waste plastics liquefaction plants, cyclone melting furnaces for sewage sludge, acid gas incinerators, tail gas incinerators for sulfur recovery units, re-heating systems for exhaust gas desulfurization plants, deodorization plants, inert gas generating plants, and reaction furnaces for various process plants. name: ATLED

The main products are package softwares X-point and Agileworks, and cloud services providers X-point Cloud and ATLED WorkPlatform. X-point and X-point Cloud are targeted at small to medium-sized enterprises, Agileworks is targeted at medium to large enterprises, and ATLED WorkPlatform is targeted at software vendors and system development companies.

name: AOKI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: AOKI Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the sale of fashion products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Anniversaire Bridal segment is engaged in the operation of a wedding hall under the name ANNIVERSAIRE OMOTESANDO. The Karaoke Room Operation segment is engaged in the operation of karaoke bars under the name COTE D'AZUR. The Complex Cafe segment is engaged in the operation of cafes under the name KAIKATSU-CLUB. The Company is also engaged in the leasing of real estate and non-life insurance agency business.

name: TOYOBO
businessSummary: Toyobo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the film and functional resin business, industrial material business, and textile and commerce business. It has five business segments. Film and Functional Resin segment manufactures, processes and sells packaging films, industrial films, industrial adhesives, engineering plastics and optical functional materials. Industrial Materials segment manufactures, processes and sells automotive fiber materials, super fibers, non-woven fabrics. Textile and Trading segment manufactures and sells functional clothing, apparel products, clothing textiles, and clothing fibers. Healthcare segment manufactures, processes and sells bio products, pharmaceuticals, medical membranes, medical devices, aqua membranes, and functional filters. It is also engaged in the assembly and sale of seawater desalination modules. The Real Estate segment sells, rents and manages movables. It also designs and constructs buildings and machinery and sells equipment.

name: BELC
businessSummary: Belc CO., LTD. manages a chain of food supermarkets in Japan. The company offers meat products, seafood products, fruit and vegetable products, eggs and dairy products, processed and frozen food products, Japanese daily distribution and paste products, prepared food and bread, sweets and desserts, general merchandise, and other goods, as well as beverages and alcohol. It also provides various recipes such as potatoes dishes, snacks, meat dishes, pan pizza, desserts, salad, rice dishes, soup, flour based foods, vegetables side dished, seafood dishes, noddles and pasta, and drinks. Belc CO., LTD. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tsurugashima, Japan.

name: YOKOWO
businessSummary: Yokowo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of various electronic devices, including vehicle communication comfort & safety (VCCS) products, circuit testing connector (CTC) products, fine connector and medical device (FC&MD) products, and incubation center products. It operates through four business segments. VCCS segment develops and provides antenna systems that utilize antenna, microwave, and modularization technologies. CTC segment globally develops and provides semiconductor testing connectors for all front-end and back-end inspection processes. FC&MD segment's FC business manufactures and sells fine spring connectors. MD business provides original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) guidewires, medical catheters, and other products. Incubation Center segment works on developing products in new fields such as advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), and others.

name: JICHODO
businessSummary: JICHODO Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, manufacturing, and sales of uniforms and men's wear in Japan and internationally. It also offers men's casuals wear, medical white coats, and safety shoes. It sells its products through retail stores. The company was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Fukuyama, Japan.

name: CMK
businessSummary: CMK Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of printed wiring boards. The Company develops, manufactures, and sells various consumer and industrial printed wiring boards and electronic devices. It operates through four geographic segments. The Japan and China segments manufacture and sell printed wiring boards. The Southeast Asia segment manufactures and sells printed wiring boards (including sales support). The Europe and the United States segment sells printed wiring boards (including sales support). Its products include high-frequency boards, rigid-flex boards, metal core boards, semi-flex boards, thick copper boards, metal-based boards, build-up high-density interconnect (HDI) high-density boards, solder crack suppression boards, and multi-layer through-hole boards.

Food Distribution Business segment consists of the seafood trading unit, which has a sales network including procurement and market distribution of seafood, food distribution unit, which manufactures and sells marine products and commercial products to various business types and agriculture and livestock unit, which handles livestock and agricultural products. Processed Food Business segment consists of the processed food unit, and fine chemical unit. Other businesses include storage, transportation, and delivery of frozen foods and feed, as well as real estate.

name: KOKYO

The laser-related product sales business is engaged in sale of laser-related products to companies, universities, and research institutes, with overseas and domestic manufacturers, the development and sale of laser-related products in-house, and mainly outsources manufacturing and assembly to subcontractors to sell original laser products. The other laser-related business operates the information sites Optipedia and Optinews regarding light and lasers, as well as disseminate information.

name: POLE TO WIN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Pole To Win Holdings Inc, formerly Poletowin Pitcrew Holdings, Inc., is a holding company mainly engaged in the provision of Internet-related debug and verification services. The Internet Supporting segment is engaged in the detection of illegal and harmful information. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the publishing and media businesses.

businessSummary: Ryobi Limited operates as a die casting manufacturer in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. It operates through Die Castings Business, Housing Equipment Business, and Printing Equipment Business segments. The company offers die-cast auto parts, including cylinder blocks, transmission cases, subframes and other chassis parts, and electric car parts  and builder hardware products, including door closers, floor hinges, hardware products, and automatic door operators. It also provides printing equipment, such as offset printing presses and automated printing operations via smart assist printing. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

businessSummary: IRRC Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in insurance sales business, solution business and system business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Insurance Sales business segment is engaged in insurance sales for individuals and corporations. The Solution business segment is engaged in the provision of insurance solutions to insurance agencies and other insurance sales companies. The System business segment is engaged in development, maintenance and sales of software.

name: GOODDAYS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Gooddays Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) and real estate businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The distribution and retail business develops point-of-sale (POS) systems and store systems for mass retailers, department stores and specialty stores. The service business is engaged in the sale of hardware and software, as well as the configuration and maintenance of server environments and terminals. The Living segment is engaged in renovation work, plans for utilizing idle real estate, operation of goodroom, a customer attraction media, and goodoffice, a lifestyle residences, work lounges and shared office.

name: DAIDO STEEL
businessSummary: Daido Steel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides special steel products, functional and magnetic materials, automotive and industrial machinery parts, engineering, and distribution and services. It operates through five segments. The Special Steel Products segment manufactures and sells special steel products. The Functional and Magnetic Materials segment manufactures and sells stainless steel products, rare earth magnets, high-alloy products, materials for electrical and others. The Automotive and Industrial Machinery Parts segment manufactures and sells die-forged products, steel machinery products for trucks, band saw materials and others. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells steel equipment and environmental equipment. The Distribution and Services segment engages in real estate, insurance, the group's employee welfare business, golf course management, analysis of steel and ceramics, development and maintenance of information systems, and building rental.

name: JAPAN HOSPICE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Japan Hospice Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the home hospice business in Japan. It provides nurses, therapists, and caregivers at hospice housing for patients with terminal cancer and incurable diseases  home nursing services  and home care services, including day care services, nursing small-scale multifunction home care, and regular visits and on-demand home care nursing services facilitated by certified care workers and caregivers. The company also provides housing management and nursing care services for elderly. In addition, it is involved in the construction and consultation business. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: H ONE
businessSummary: H-One Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and motorcycle parts, and dies and welding equipment in Japan, North America, Asia, and China. The company offers automobile frames, including front bulkhead, front side frame, rear frame, rear wheelhouse comp, and pillar comp, as well as door beams. It also provides motorcycle and power products, such as control levers, yoke rotors, and pushrods  and metal separators and 3DQ body frames, as well as dies and welding equipment. The company was formerly known as Hirata Technical Co., Ltd., and changed its name to H-One Co.,Ltd. in April 2006. H-One Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

name: HARD OFF
businessSummary: Hard Off Corporation Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the purchase and sale of reused goods. It operates through two segments. The Reuse segment operates the reuse shops Hard Off, Off House, Mode Off, Garage Off, Hobby Off, Liquor Off, and Book Off (Franchisee). Hard Off buys and sells computers, audio and visual equipment, musical instruments, and watches. Off House buys and sells brand-name products, furniture, and interior goods. Mode Off buys and sells women's and men's clothing, and bags. Garage Off buys and sells audio equipment, tires, dress-up products, and other automotive accessories. Hobby Off buys and sells trading cards and games. Liquor Off buys and sells alcoholic beverages, and glasses. Book Off buys and sells books, and compact discs (CDs). The Franchise (FC) segment operates the franchise chain business of the reuse shops Hard Off, Off House, Mode Off, Garage Off, Hobby Off, and Liquor Off. The Company is also engaged in systems development business.

name: HIT
businessSummary: Hit Co., Ltd., an advertising company, engages in outdoor and transit advertising business. The company is involved in planning, researching, constructing and maintaining sign. It also offers HIT-movi, a smartphone location-based advertising service that is linked to the placement of outdoor advertisements, as well as developing synchronized broadcasting media that allows multiple large-scale vision to be displayed, as well as planning and producing advertising videos for digital media. The company offers digital billboards in the areas of shibuya / omotesando / ikebukuro / miyamasu / ebisu-bashi / metropolitan expressway  and static billboards in the areas of metropolitan expressway / shibuya / downtown / roadside / others. Hit Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOHO BANK
businessSummary: The Toho Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Banking, Leasing, Credit Guarantee, and Others. It offers accounts  debit, credit, and cash cards  time and foreign currency deposits, investment trusts, government bonds, and securities trading  home, personal, card, and online-only loans  and whole life, medical and cancer, educational, personal pension, income protection/term life, internet-only, and home loan-specific fire insurance, as well as individual defined contribution pension plans, national pension funds, and inheritance and trust-related services. The company also provides web-based direct debit, pay-easy account transfer acceptance, safe deposit boxes, foreign currency exchange, international money transfer, electronic delivery, and free dial information request services  internet banking  fundraising  administrative rationalization  overseas business support  fund management  business consulting  mergers and acquisitions  corporate pension and retirement allowance systems  and densai services. In addition, it is involved in leasing services  computer software development and computer-based computing services  printing and binding services for documents and other forms  business succession support  IT-related services  and human resources-related businesses. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Fukushima, Japan.

name: STRIDERS
businessSummary: Striders Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate, hotel, investment, and other businesses primarily in Japan. It develops and sells vehicle management systems to support logistics operations. The company also offers residence, building management, rental brokerage, real estate sales, rent guarantee, interior design, hotel ownership and management, corporate restructuring and reorganization business, property and leasing management, business investment and group management. In addition, it provides advisory and consultancy services for mergers and acquisitions  online short-term home rental marketplace  healthcare, retail, and financial services  operates a platform to digitize smallholder farmers  restructuring, and fund-raising support services. Further, the company owns and operates the Narita Gateway Hotel in the Narita Airport Area and Kurashiki Royal Art Hotel. Striders Corporation was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: DAIHATSU INFINEARTH MFG CO
businessSummary: Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells marine engines, land engines, and industrial instruments in Japan, China, Asia, Central America, South America, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Marine Engine Related and Land Engine Related segments. It offers marine engine products, including propulsion systems, electric propulsion systems, auxiliary systems, and dual-fuel engines, as well as marine engines for nitrogen oxide regulations. The company also provides land diesel engines and gas turbines/gas engines for emergency power generation/pumping  and co-generation systems. In addition, it provides industrial instruments, such as aluminum wheels, oil mist detectors and monitors, and doughnut RD couplings. Further, the company is involved in real estate leasing business  transportation, warehouse management, precision components, and contracting businesses  and solar power generation business. The company was formerly known as Daihatsu Diesel Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd in May 2025. Daihatsu Infinearth Mfg.Co.,Ltd was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KOA
businessSummary: KOA Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of resistors, integrated circuits (ICs), composite components, and other circuit components for electronic devices both domestically and overseas. The Company operates through four regional segments: Japan, Asia, America, and Europe. Its main products include surface-mount resistors, low-ohmic resistors and power shunts, leaded resistors, temperature sensors and thermistors, inductors, fuses, varistors, low-temperature co-fired ceramics (LTCC) wiring boards and hybrid ICs, and others (check terminals and handling products).

name: NISSHIN OILLIO GROUP
businessSummary: The Nisshin OilliO Group,Ltd. engages in food and ingredients business in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Processed Oils and Fat Business  Oils, Fats, and Processed Foods/Materials Business  and Fine Chemicals Business. The company offers edible oil for use in household, commercial, and food processing applications  and food for the elderly and nursing care patients. It also provides processed palm oil products, confectionery fats, margarines, shortenings  and chocolate-related products, household-use salad dressing, wellness food, MCT, lecithin, tocopherol, edible soybeans, and soy protein. In addition, the company offers ingredients for cosmetics and toiletries, chemical products, plant-based industrial oils, detergents, antibacterial agents, and surfactants. Further, it is involved in the provision of information systems and sales promotions  temporary staffing  sports facility operations  non-life insurance agency  and real estate leasing activities. The Nisshin OilliO Group,Ltd. was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
