name: DYDO GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: DyDo Group Holdings, Inc. plans and develops beverages for beverage manufacturers in Japan and internationally. The company offers coffee, tea, carbonated drink, mineral water, and juice based products, as well as other products, such as soups and sweet bean porridge. It also exports milk coffee, brewed black, and brewed latte products. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of Chinese products, such as Barley Tea and Black Tea  OEM production of energy drinks  and offers fruit dessert jelly products. It sells its products under the DyDo, Saka, and Maltana brands. The company was formerly known as DyDo DRINCO, INC. and changed its name to DyDo Group Holdings, Inc. in January 2017. DyDo Group Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

name: GEOMATEC
businessSummary: GEOMATEC CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of vacuum film related products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of substrates for flat panel displays (FPDs), as well as vacuum film substrates of indium tin oxide (ITO) and metal, mainly for liquid crystal displays (LCDs) of smart phones, tablet terminals, mobile phones, touch panels, car navigation systems, digital cameras and others. The Company is also engaged in the provision of various products for measuring equipment, medical equipment, lighting equipment and other optical equipment parts, solar cell parts, transparent heaters, beam expander lenses, thermocouples and others. The main products include optical thin films, transparent conductive films, ITO films, thin metal film heaters, thin film flow sensors, drip-proof and anti-fouling films, shielding and transmission prevention films, decorative films, decorative coatings and others.

name: IDEMITSU KOSAN
businessSummary: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd is Japan-based company primarily engaged in fossil fuel-related businesses. The Company operates five business segments. The Fuel Oil segment is engaged in the production, sales, import & export, and trading of refined petroleum products. The Basic Chemicals Segment is engaged in the production and sale of olefins and aromatics products. The High Functional Materials segment is engaged in lubricants, functional chemicals, electronic materials, functional pavement materials, and agribio products. The Power & Renewable Energy segment is engaged in power generation (includes thermal, solar, wind), power sales, and solar cell operations. The Resources segment is engaged in exploration, development, production, and sales of energy resources such as crude oil, natural gas, and coal. The Company also conducts insurance and intra-group service businesses.

name: LEADER ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: LEADER ELECTRONICS CORPORATION is primarily engaged in the manufacture of electrical measuring instruments. The video-related equipment business includes video signal-related products for commercial and consumer video equipment, and others, such as video signal generators, waveform monitors, vector scopes and camera test systems. The radio wave-related equipment business includes high-frequency signal generators, television field-strength meters, and characteristic testers for electronic components, such as standard signal generators, television field-strength meters, automatic digital broadcasting related equipment. The others business provides basic measuring instruments, repair services, parts and others.

name: SOIKEN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Soiken Holdings Inc. is a Japan-based holding company. The Company operates in six business segments. The Biological Evaluation System segment is engaged in evaluation test of food and research support of medicine. The Healthcare Support segment is engaged in the provision of service about certain health guidance and healthcare insurance. The Cosmetics segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of cosmetics. The Dietary Supplements segment is engaged in sales of unique dietary supplements. The Marketing segment is engaged in the marketing research of health supplement and sales of energy drink. The Functional Material Development segment is engaged in development and sales of functional materials, such as lactoferrin.

name: YOKOHAMA FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Yokohama Financial Group Inc, formerly Concordia Financial Group Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company operates through the Banking segment. The Company is engaged in banking, securities, leasing, information services and research, venture capital, credit guarantee, credit card, securities investment trust management, investment consulting, investment banking, parts delivery, office agency, business administration, and other related businesses. The Company mainly operates in Yokohama and East Japan.

isin: 8609.T|Okasan Securities Group Inc.|8609.T|Okasan Securities Group Inc.
name: OKASAN SECURITIES GROUP
businessSummary: Okasan Securities Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in securities business in Japan. The company offers asset management  intermediation of securities transactions, handling of public offerings, handling of private placements of securities, and other  and securities trading services, such as buying and selling of securities, and brokerage of buying. It also engages in information processing services  administrative support  and real estate management businesses. The company was formerly known as Okasan Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Okasan Securities Group Inc. in October 2008. Okasan Securities Group Inc. was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KING JIM
businessSummary: King Jim Co., Ltd. engages in the stationery and electronic products businesses in Japan, China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Hong Kong. It provides a range of files and filing supplies for office and home use. The company also offers label writers and label printers, digital stationery, lifestyle products, desk and PC accessories, office environment improvement supplies, disaster prevention supplies, and file stationery products. The company was formerly known as Meikando Co., Ltd. and changed its name to King Jim Co., Ltd. in 1961. King Jim Co., Ltd. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KITAKEI
businessSummary: KITAKEI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of new construction materials, housing materials, housing equipment and related construction services mainly to timber stores, construction materials stores, construction companies, and housing companies. Interior building materials mainly include flooring, wall materials, ceiling materials, indoor doors, construction materials, stairs, handrails, counters, wall storage. Equipment includes kitchen, bath, vanity, toilet, water heater, ventilator, air conditioner, fireplace, floor heating, lighting equipment, door phones. Chemical products and hardware-related products include heat insulating materials, humidity control materials, waterproofing materials, soundproofing and sound insulating materials, gypsum boards, nails, screws, construction hardware, adhesives and paints. Exterior building materials include exterior wall materials, roofing materials, gutters, eaves, fences, gates, carports, tiles.

name: MRT
businessSummary: MRT Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of medical information platform based on Internet. The Medical Information Platform Business segment consists of medical human resources services and others. The medical human resources services include part-time and full-time physician introductions for physicians, mainly through physician referral websites, and part-time job introductions, career change introductions, and temporary placement services for nurses, pharmacists, clinical technologists, clinical engineering technologists, and radiology technologists, who are referred to as co-medicals. Others include provision of groupware to support medical office operations, provision of online medical treatment and health consultation services, provision of marketing and product development by physicians, publishing services, pharmaceutical promotion support for physicians, operation of registration and reception centers, and well-being services.

name: FUSO PHARMACEUTICAL INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Fuso Pharmaceutical Industries,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and medical equipment in Japan. The company offers injectable drugs and dialysis agents for artificial kidneys, as well as medical drugs and equipment. It also engages in the contract manufacturing of drugs  and real estate leasing businesses. The company was incorporated in 1937 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

name: AI STORM
businessSummary: AI Storm Co Ltd, formerly Gexeed Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) consulting and digital signage businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The IT Consulting Business segment provides system consulting, business consulting, Chief Information Officer (CIO)/Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) support, and Web marketing support. The Digital Signage Business segment sells light-emitting diode (LED) displays, liquid crystal display (LCD) displays, and operates ad trucks. The Company also develops artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, analyzes and optimizes data using AI, and applies AI to education and logistics. It also collects, transports, stores, processes, and disposes of various types of waste.

name: LIFENET INSURANCE
businessSummary: Lifenet Insurance Company provides life insurance products and services in Japan. It offers term life, medical, women's, cancer, disability, and dementia insurance products. The company sells its products and services directly to customers through the internet. In addition, it offers insurance underwriting and asset management services. The company was formerly known as Net Life Planning Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Lifenet Insurance Company in March 2008. Lifenet Insurance Company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: INTEGRATED DESIGN & ENGINEERING HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Integrated Design & Engineering Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business related to civil engineering and construction, urban space development such as urban planning and architectural design. The Company operates three businesses. Consulting business is engaged in research, planning, evaluation, and design of rivers and water resources, water supply and sewerage, agricultural and rural development, dams and power generation, traffic and transportation, urban and regional development in Japan and overseas. Urban spatial business is engaged in business composition, planning, design, and operation in the formation of urban spaces. Energy business is engaged in the manufacture and sale of power equipment and control devices, and planning and design of mechanical and electrical equipment and communication facilities.

name: SHIKOKU BANK
businessSummary: The Shikoku Bank, Ltd. is a Japan-based company that provides financial services, primarily in the banking sector. In addition to handling deposits, loans, and foreign exchange operations, it acts as a banking agent. The Company also engages in leasing, credit guarantees, computer-related services, research, investment fund management, and consulting. It provides financial services primarily to individual and corporate clients within Japan.

name: WASEDA GAKUSHUKENKYUKAI
businessSummary: Waseda Gakushukenkyukai Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cram school business. The Company operates cram schools through three divisions. The seminar division operates W Wasedazemi, a group instruction school for elementary and junior high school students. The high division operates W Wasedazemi High School, a group instruction school for high school students. The first kobetsu division operates First Kobetsu, a private tutoring school for elementary, middle school, and high school students.

name: KEL
businessSummary: KEL CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of connectors, racks, sockets and others. The connector business is involved in the manufacture and sale of connectors for electrical connection and disconnection between mounted printed circuit boards, devices, and between devices in electronic and electrical devices such as industrial devices and imaging devices. The socket business is involved in the manufacture and sale of integrated circuits (IC) sockets for IC into printed circuit boards. The rack business is involved in the manufacture and sale of racks that systematize storage of control boards and peripheral devices. The harness business is involved in the manufacture and sale of harnesses that connect connectors and cables.

name: ASUKANET
businessSummary: Asukanet Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital processing and production of photos and images. The Company operates in three business segments. The Memorial Design Services segment is engaged in the provision of digital processing services for portraits of deceased persons, the provision of funeral-related production services. The Personal Publishing Services segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of individual photo albums targeting at the professional photography markets and general consumer markets. The Aerial Imaging segment is engaged in the research and marketing activities related to aerial imaging technology.

name: YAPPLI
businessSummary: Yappli, Inc. engages in mobile technology and internet businesses in Japan. The company provides Yappli, a cloud-based platform for mobile app development, management, and analysis, as well as supporting various business scenes, including sales promotion and internal communications  and Yappli CRM, a no-code CRM which starts with mobile app. Yappli, Inc. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: SUMITOMO MITSUI FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on banking, leasing, securities, consumer finance, and system development and information processing. The Company consists of five business segments. The Wholesale Business segment provides services to large domestic corporations as well as small and medium-sized enterprises. The Retail business segment serves retail customers in Japan. The Global Business segment serves Japanese and non-Japanese clients overseas. The Market Business segment provides services for financial markets. The Headquarters Administration Business segment provides services that do not belong to any of the above business segments.

name: SANWA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sanwa Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of building materials for commercial buildings and residential buildings, as well as the provision of maintenance and service for these products. The Company operates in four geological segments, including Japan segment, North America segment, Europe segment and Asia segment. Its products and services include shutters and related products, industrial sectional doors, residential garage doors, garage door openers and closers, automatic doors, as well as maintenance and service businesses.

name: MORINAGA &
businessSummary: Morinaga & Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in food manufacturing, food wholesale, real estate and services etc. The Company operates in three segments. The Food Manufacturing segment is engaged in manufacturing of confectionaries, foods, frozen desserts, jelly drinks, etc. The Food Wholesale segment is engaged in wholesales of commercial food. The Real Estate and Services segment is engaged in real estate rental business and management of golf courses. Other business involves in the financial services and other activities.

name: SCALA
businessSummary: Scala Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the software as a service (SaaS) and application service provider (ASP) business, the sales force automation (SFA) business and others. The Company has four business segments. The SaaS/ASP segment is engaged in the provision of SaaS and ASP type services that support communication between companies and people such as i-search and i-ask. The SFA segment is engaged in the license sale of sales support systems, the provision of cloud services, customized development services, sales consulting and skill training services. The Field Marketing segment is engaged in the provision of field activities and market research services. The Customer Support segment is engaged in the provision of customer support consulting services for call centers. The Company is also engaged in the operation of electronic commerce (EC) sites, the planning, editing and publishing of business books, the provision of recruitment and employment services and others.

name: EREX
businessSummary: eREX Co.,Ltd. engages in the electric power business in Japan. The company operates biomass power plant, as well as hydrogen power generation demonstration project. It is also involved in the development and production of biomass fuels from wood pellets  carbon credit business  electricity trading  and electricity retailing to corporate and individual consumers. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: OKUMURA
businessSummary: OKUMURA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general construction and related businesses such as civil engineering and construction. The Company operates through three business segments. The Civil Engineering segment and Construction segment are engaged in civil engineering, construction and other general construction work. The Real Estate segment is involved in the sale and leasing of real estate. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of construction materials and equipment, as well as the Private Finance Initiative (PFI) business.

name: INTIMATE MERGER
businessSummary: Intimate Merger, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in the data management platform business. The Company uses its own data management platform IM-DMP to support both online and offline marketing of client companies by utilizing data. IM-DMP is constructed from information obtained from a Web browser used on a personal computer, a smarphone, a tablet, or the like as an attribute database of Internet users. The features of IM-DMP include an Internet user attribute database and a database for converting instant messenger identification (IM-ID) into different IDs.

name: SANWAYUKA INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Sanwayuka Industry Corporation engages in the disposal, recycling, and management of industrial waste, including used organic solvents, waste acids, and valuable metals in Japan. The company also manufactures and sells organic and inorganic chemicals  high purity chemicals  lubricants, such as oils and metalworking fluids  and industrial cleaning agents. It offers oil replacing and cleaning works  contract processing  and PCBs collection and transport services  and cleaning, dismantling, and removal of various types of equipment. Sanwayuka Industry Corporation was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Kariya, Japan.

name: TOKUYAMA
businessSummary: Tokuyama Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in chemical products, cement, advanced electronic materials, life science, and environmental business. It operates through five business segments. Chemicals segment provides caustic soda, soda ash, calcium chloride, sodium bicarbonate, sodium silicate, hydrogen, vinyl chloride monomer and others. Cement Segment engages in the manufacture and sale of cement, ready-mixed concrete and cement-based solidifying agents, and resource recycling. Advanced Electronic Materials segment provides polycrystalline silicon, fumed silica, silicon tetrachloride, aluminum nitride and others. Life Science segment provides medical diagnostic systems, in vitro diagnostic reagents and materials, dental equipment and others. Environmental Business segment provides ion-exchange membranes and recycles waste plasterboard. It also engages in the overseas sale of its products, as well as transportation and real estate management businesses.

The company was incorporated in 1899 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

The Company operates in five business segments. The Transportation segment encompasses railway and bus operations. The Real Estate segment engages in leasing and housing businesses. The Distribution segment operates retail stores and other related businesses. The Logistics segment handles international logistics and related operations. The Leisure and Service segment covers hotel, travel, and advertising businesses. The Company is also engaged in the integrated circuit (IC) card, automobile maintenance-related, construction and metal recycle business.

name: MITSUBISHI MATERIALS
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Materials Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed copper products, electronic materials, and cemented carbide products, as well as the smelting and sale of copper, gold, silver, palladium, and other metals. The Company operates in four business segments. The High Functional Products segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed copper products, functional materials, electronic devices, chemical products, sealing components, and other products. The Machined Components Business segment manufactures and sells cemented carbide products and other products. The Metals Business segment is engaged in smelting and sales of copper, gold, silver, palladium, and other metals. It also engages in smelting and refining. The Environment & Energy segment is engaged in geothermal and hydroelectric power generation and environmental recycling. The Company also operates cement and related businesses and engineering-related businesses.

name: JAFCO
businessSummary: JAFCO Co., Ltd., formerly JAFCO Group Co., Ltd., is a Japan-based company specializes in venture investments and buyout investments through fund management. The Company operates fund management business. The Company solicits investments from institutional investors and business companies once every three and a half years. The fund's management period is 10 years, with a two-year extension period. The Company seeks promising companies, accumulates new investments over a three and a half-year period, and builds a portfolio for each fund. The Company also increases its post-investment management involvement, working with entrepreneurs to grow businesses and improve corporate value. The Company aims for an exit through an initial public offering (IPO) or mergers and acquisitions (M&A). Its primary sources of revenue are management fees and success fees from funds, as well as capital gains on direct investments in funds. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Asia, and others.

name: SUMITOMO FORESTRY
businessSummary: Sumitomo Forestry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in businesses founded on forestry operations, including the procurement, manufacture, processing and sale of timber and building materials, the contracting and renovation of detached houses and other buildings, the sale of built-for-sale housing, the development of apartment buildings and mixed-use commercial facilities, real estate management and brokerage. The Company has four business segments. Timber and Building Materials segment handles timber and building materials. Housing segment handles housing construction, renovation and sales, and real estate development and management. Construction and Real Estate segment handles overseas housing, housing components, property development and construction. Resources and Environment segment handles renewable energy and forest resources. The Company also operates elderly housing and provides insurance agencies, civil engineering and construction services.

name: CHIYODA

The Engineering segment is engaged in the planning of various industrial and consumer facilities, as well as pollution control, environment improvement and disaster prevention facilities. This segment is also engaged in the design, procurement and installation of related devices and equipment, civil engineering and construction works, electrical works, instrument and pipe works, trial operation, as well as other related businesses. The other segment is engaged in the provision of travel services, air transportation services, consultation services on finance, accounting and tax, employee detachment and investigation, as well as the provision of education training and reemployment services.

name: BP CASTROL KK
businessSummary: BP Castrol KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of Castrol and bp brand automotive lubricants. The Company is engaged in product development, raw material procurement, marketing and sales activities. Its main products include gasoline engine oil, diesel engine oil, automotive gear oil, automatic transmission fluid (ATF) including continuously variable transmission (CVT) fluid, brake fluid and car care products. The automotive lubricants market is divided into the passenger car market, motorcycle market, and commercial vehicle market, and products are supplied through direct sales or agency sales. The consumer business in the passenger car market is centered on sales to car shops, home improvement centers, and tire shops, while the business-to-business (BtoB) business is centered on sales to domestic car dealers, imported car dealers, and auto repair shops.

name: TSI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TSI Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the apparel related business and other business. The Apparel Related segment is mainly engaged in the planning, manufacture and sale of fashion and apparel products such as women's clothing, men's clothing and fashion accessories, as well as the license brand business, and the production and logistics business. The Company is also engaged in the other businesses such as the sales agency and staffing business, the synthetic resin products manufacturing and sale business, the store design supervision business, the food and beverage business, as well as the import and sale of cosmetics and soaps. The brands include apparel brands such as ADORE, and wander, Apuweiser-riche, Arpege Story, AVIREX, BAIT, BOSCH, BEAVER and others, food and beverage brands such as Urth Caffe, Patisserie Slier and others, as well as licensed brands such as PRIVATE LABEL, VIVAYOU, Pinky Girls, VertDense, MATERIA, NOVESPAZIO, BRIGITTE and others.

businessSummary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on banking, leasing, securities, consumer finance, and system development and information processing. The shared point service business is engaged in the operation of the point service.

name: NIKKISO
businessSummary: NIKKISO CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial pumps, precision equipment and blood related products, among others. The Company operates in two business segments. Industrial Business segment conducts industrial business including the manufacture, sale and maintenance of industrial special pumps, as well as liquefied gas & industrial gas related equipment and devices. The Segment is also involved in precision equipment business, aerospace business and deep ultraviolet light emitting diode (LED) business. Medical Business segment’s products are dialysis-related products including hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis, such as artificial dialysis machines, dialyzers, blood circuits, and powder-type dialysis agents. The Segment also manufactures, sells and maintains products and medicines related to CRRT (acute blood purification therapy), artificial pancreas devices that manage blood glucose, and energy devices for microwave surgery.

name: SANSHA ELECTRIC MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: Sansha Electric Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductors and power equipment. The Company operates through two business segments. The Semiconductor segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of module products and discrete products for diode thyristor triac. The Power Equipment segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of direct current power equipment, metal surface treatment power equipment, alternating current uninterrupted power equipment, motor control power equipment, electric furnace power equipment, dimming devices, light source machine power equipment, arc welding equipment, dental equipment and alternating current power equipment. The Company is also engaged in the installation, test, repair, maintenance and construction of equipment.

name: DENKYO GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Denkyo Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, manufacturing, and sales of home appliances and daily necessities, as well as the leasing of owned real estate. The Company operates three business segments. The Home Appliance Sales segment procures products and sells them to consumer electronics retailers, specialty retailers such as home centers, mail-order companies, and others. The Daily Necessities Sales segment procures products and sells them to consumer electronics retailers, specialty retailers such as home centers, mail-order companies, and others. In addition, through consolidated subsidiaries, it plans and manufactures household goods such as stationery and daily necessities, as well as hygiene products. The Real Estate Leasing segment conducts real estate leasing business. Other businesses include the sale of electronic components, home appliance repair, logistics and delivery, electrical systemization, and real estate management.

name: WATAHAN &
businessSummary: Watahan & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the retail business, construction business and trading business. The Company operates in three segments. The Retail segment is dealing with the home center items, daily goods, processed foods, fresh foods, prepared dishes etc. It also provides a one-stop shopping center where shopping is completed at one place by having a wide range of everyday necessities. The Construction segment is engaged in various construction works such as interior and exterior work, multi-purpose parking lot construction, civil engineering construction work and sales of civil engineering materials, etc. The Trading segment is engaged in the import and sales of pharmaceutical raw materials such as witepzole, acetaminophen, dalteparin, nitroglycerin etc. as well as raw materials for chemical products such as candelilla, jojoba oil, yucca, chicle etc. Other business involves in real estate leasing business.

name: NITTETSU MINING
businessSummary: Nittetsu Mining Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in resource business, machinery & environment business, real estate business and renewable energy business. The Company operates in five business segments. Ore segment mainly sells limestone, crushed stones, processed products and other related products produced from limestone mines owned by the Company. Metal segment is involved in the smelting and sale of copper bullion and the sale of copper concentrate. Machinery & Environment segment is involved in the sale of water treatment agents and the manufacture and sale of environmentally-friendly products such as dust collectors. Real Estate segment is involved in the rental of office buildings, condominiums, stores, factories and warehouses, as well as the sale of real estate. Renewable Energy segment develops environment-friendly energy through the geothermal sector, solar power generation and hydroelectric power generation.

name: ARISAWA MFG
businessSummary: Arisawa Mfg Co Ltd is a Japan-based mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of electronic materials, display materials, electric insulation materials, and industrial structural materials. The Company operates through four segments. Electronic Materials segment produces materials for flexible and rigid printed wiring boards. Industrial Structural Materials segment produces filament winding (FW) moldings, aircraft honeycomb panels and prepregs, pultrusion moldings, fiber reinforced plastic (FRP) ski seats, and others. Electrical Insulation Materials segment produces glass cloth, glass tapes, and prepregs for electric insulation. Display Materials segment produces three-dimensional (3D) display filters, special optical components and others.

name: XEBIO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Xebio Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general retail business, primarily sporting goods and equipment and apparel. The sports business division operates large sporting goods specialty stores and golf specialty stores. It also offers casual apparel. The fashion apparel division includes the Next business, which has a tie-up with a British manufacturer and retailer and exclusively sells products designed by the Company in Japan, and the X'style and Rookie USA businesses, which develop their own fashion lineup. Other businesses include sports eyeglass and sunglass specialty stores, sports drug specialty stores, and fancy stationery and sundry specialty stores. The Company also operates sports marketing business, credit card business, website management business, marketing agency business, e-commerce (EC) business, overseas contact center business, and research and development (R&D) business.

businessSummary: Daikokutenbussan Co.,Ltd. engages in the supermarket business in Japan. It is also involved in the food manufacturing  consulting services related to store development and real estate leasing  trademark rights management  recycling-related work  store cleaning  dairy cow farming  dairy product manufacturing  noodle production  fish farming  raw milk production  vegetable production  import and sale of store fixtures and equipment  wholesale business  sushi and Japanese cuisine provision and sales  fish farming and sales  and vegetable production and sales. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Kurashiki, Japan.

businessSummary: Toho Zinc Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of non-ferrous metal products, the exploration, development and production of non-ferrous metal resources, the manufacture and sale of electronic parts, environment and recycle business, the logistics and other business. The Company operates in four businesses. The Smelting & Refining segment manufactures and sells zinc and lead products, electrolytic silver, and sulfuric acid. The Environment & Recycling segment manufactures and sells zinc oxide and waste treatment and reclamation. The Mineral Resources segment explores, develops, produces, and sells non-ferrous metal resources. The Electronic Components & Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells electronic components, electrolytic iron, plating, and equipment components. The Company also operates businesses related to soundproofing materials, civil engineering, construction, plant engineering, transportation, and environmental analysis.

name: SOMPO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sompo Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the non-life insurance business, life insurance business, and other businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Non-Life Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in non-life insurance underwriting, asset management, and related businesses in Japan. The Overseas Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in insurance underwriting and asset management businesses in the United States, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, China, Brazil, India, and other regions. The Domestic Life Insurance Business segment is mainly engaged in life insurance underwriting and asset management businesses in Japan. The Nursing Care and Healthcare Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of nursing care service and nursing care-related services. The Company is also engaged in asset management business, risk management business, defined contribution pension business and others.

The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Americas) primarily manufactures and sells dairy products. The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Asia and Oceania) primarily manufactures and sells dairy products. The Beverages and Food Products Manufacturing and Sales business (Europe) manufactures and sells dairy products. Other businesses include the cosmetics manufacturing and sales business, the pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales business, and professional baseball operations.

The company is also involved in golf course management. YONEX Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

The Office Hikaru 119 segment is engaged in the sale of the Company’s brand Office Hikaru 119 which provides the one-stop office-related services including optical collaboration service to small medium enterprise (SME) and individual employers, besides it is also doing business as an agent of the NTT Group to handle optical line services. The Office Solution segment is engaged in the sale of information communication equipment such as business phones, unified threat management (UTM) equipment, network compatible multifunction machines, light emitting diode (LED) lighting equipment, electric lights and the providing of Rentakun services. The Financial Planning segment is engaged in the visiting shop insurance brokerage. Other business includes real estate leasing business.

TOMONY Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Takamatsu, Japan.

Its Sales Outsourcing segment involves in the hybrid dispatch, general dispatch, and business contracting business, providing staff engaged in products sales, staff management, collection and report of sales information. Its Call Center Outsourcing segment involves in hybrid dispatch and general dispatch business, providing staff engaged in information providing and delivery, after services and claim handling to communication company. Its Factory Outsourcing segment involves in staff dispatch to companies in food, electrical equipment industries, among others. The Nursing Care Support segment provides nursing staff to companies operating nursing care facilities to provide stable operation of nursing care facilities. The Overseas HR segment develops human resources service business. Others segment involves in the general staff dispatch, among others.

The Company's products include thermal transfer media, such as thermal transfer ribbons and thermal carbon copies; impact ribbons, including encompassing cloth ribbons, film ribbons and link units; tapes, including correction tapes and glue tapes; functional films, including FIXFILM and others, as well as various carbon papers.

The Mineral Products segment is engaged in the provision of limestone, dolomite and aggregate products. The Construction Material segment is engaged in the provision of concrete structure repair materials and admixtures. The Optoelectronics segment is engaged in the provision of optical communication components and optical measurement equipment. The New Materials segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic products, nanoparticle materials and functional paints. The Battery Materials segment is engaged in the provision of secondary battery cathode materials. The Other segment is engaged in the real estate leasing business, engineering business and software development business.

The Education segment is engaged in the operation of cram schools. The Sports segment is engaged in the operation of soccer schools. The Food segment is engaged in the home delivery of boxed lunches. The others businesses include the operation business of basket schools, the agriculture business, the sale of used golf club business and yakiniku restaurant business.

In addition, the company provides support at the airport and on board for elderly, disabled, and injured customers, as well as children. Further, it engages in the passenger transportation related, and adverting and promotion businesses  and training equipment rental business, which includes flight simulators and aircraft ground handling vehicles. Skymark Airlines Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

In addition, the company's projects include offices, government offices, dams, roads, railroads, airports and harbors, landscaping, energy, agricultural and river, and water supply and sewerage  and educational, cultural and social, medical, lodging, residential, commercial, sports and leisure, industrial, logistics, sports and leisure, industrial, and environmental facilities, as well as provides welfare facilities for senior citizens. businessSummary: Kanadevia Corp, formerly Hitachi Zosen Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacture, installation, sale, repair, maintenance, and operation of environmental equipment and plants, machinery and equipment, and infrastructure facilities. The Environmental Business segment engages in the manufacture of various plants, such as waste incineration power generation and recycling facilities. The Machinery and Infrastructure Business segment engages in the manufacture of automobile press machines, boilers, plastic machinery, food machinery, pharmaceutical machinery. The Decarbonization Business segment engages in the manufacture of marine engines, denitrification catalysts, various process equipment such as pressure vessels, nuclear power-related facilities, and wind power generation. The Other Business segment engages in the operation and management of facilities such as dormitories and company housing.

name: CUC
businessSummary: CUC Inc. offers healthcare services in Japan and internationally. It provides medical institution operations support, including strategic, administrative, marketing, HR/recruiting, and procurement support, as well as support for IT, accounting, general affairs, etc.  medical institution revenue growth assistance services, such as M and A, post-merger integration, hospital bed conversion, and clinic launches  and medical institution cost optimization support. The company also provides meals to hospitals, welfare facilities, and hospice facilities  and leases and maintains real estate for medical institutions. In addition, it operates a hospice specializing in care for people in the terminal stages of cancer or with intractable diseases, as well as a home nursing and care business under the ReHOPE brand name. Further, the company offers home nursing  day care services, in-home nursing care support  and in-home clinical trials and in-home monitoring services. The company provides its support service to in-home, hospital, dialysis, and outpatient care. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. CUC Inc. is a subsidiary of M3 Inc.

name: FERROTEC
businessSummary: Ferrotec Corporation is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of products used in semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, thermo-modules, as well as silicon products, magnetic fluids, sensors and their application products. The Company operates through three segments. The Semiconductor and Other Equipment Related segment is engaged in the production of vacuum seals, metal fabricated products for various manufacturing equipment, quartz products, ceramics products, chemical vapor deposition (CVD)-silicon carbide (SIC) products, silicon parts, quartz crucibles, and equipment parts cleaning. The Electronic Devices segment produces thermo-modules, substrates for power semiconductors, magnetic fluids, and sensors. The Automotive segment manufactures thermo-modules, substrates for power semiconductors, and sensors. It also manufactures saw blades, machine tools, and silicon products for solar cells.

Other services include fund management, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) and consulting, credit card services, credit guarantee services, and collateral valuation services.

businessSummary: FUJIX Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of sewing thread, embroidery thread and various handicraft threads. The Company is involved in the manufacture and sale of textile products such as sewing thread, knitting thread, embroidery thread and other accessories, the sale of various kinds of textile and intermediate products such as raw and twisted yarns, the supply and sale of electricity by solar power generation, as well as the related business. The main products include RSS, Wooly Rock Glam, Quilter Soft, Silver Thread, Sparkle Glam, Fine Sewing Thread, Mochite, RSS50.

It operates through five business segments. Industrial Materials segment sells and installs rubber and resin products for construction and agricultural machineries, ships flooring and power plants. It is also engaged in design, development and manufacture of urea selective catalytic reduction (SCR) sensors. Sports and Construction Materials segment sells and installs construction materials such as rubber, plastic, braille tiles and metals. Other segment is engaged in the sale of sports apparel of brand MONTURA and dust control related products, the technical research and products development, and real estate management business. North America segment sells industrial hoses made of rubber, resin and metal. European segment manufactures and sells rubber lay flat hoses, industrial and firefighting hoses and nozzles in Europe and South America.

businessSummary: Fuji Pharma Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of hormone medicines for obstetrics and gynecology department, as well as injectable drugs for radiological department such as radiopaque dye for urinary tracts and blood vessels through its branches. The Company's products are primarily used to treat dysmenorrhea, endometriosis, pregnancy and childbirth, and menopause.

The company provides food products through Oisix stores  Oisix order services that enables consumers to order hard to find seasonal products  Daichi wo mamorukai, a household delivery services for organic agricultural products  Radish Boya, a premium subscription delivery service  Oitoku, a regular delivery services that provides customers with registered products at discounted prices  seasonal vegetable novelty items  advertising services  meal services for childcare facilities. The Company operates door-to-door sale and mail order sale business through its business members, via home party-style fitting sessions for membership and general consumers.

It's consulting services is engaged in supporting the marketing activities of client companies in education industry. The main features of the media service are a locomi stock model, a large volume of customers, and a performance-based billing system.

The Fine Business segment is engaged in the production and sale of pharmaceutical raw materials, functional raw materials, and functional foods. The Logistics Business segment is engaged in refrigerated warehouse business, delivery business and customs clearance business. The Company is also engaged in the construction, repair, operation and engineering of ships.

The Gas segment is engaged in the manufacture, supply and sale of gas, the reading of gas meters and the provision of gas charge recovery services. The Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), Electricity and Other Energy segment is engaged in the electricity business, the sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG), the supply of heat, the sale of LPG and LPG equipment, the provision of LPG piping works, as well as the sale of coke and petroleum products. The Construction and Equipment segment is engaged in the provision of piping works for gas supply and the sale of gas equipment. The other businesses include LNG entrusted processing, the leasing and operation of real estate, the design and construction and the provision of utility service for plants and facilities, the sale of household equipment and others.

The Company conducts business through three segments. The Molds and Machine Tools segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of press dies and surface grinders, and other products. The Electronic Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lead frames, and other products. The Electrical Components segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of motor core products, and other products.

name: HOKURIKU ELECTRIC POWER
businessSummary: Hokuriku Electric Power Company is a Japan-based company engaged in supply of electricity mainly to Toyama Prefecture, Ishikawa Prefecture, Fukui Prefecture and part of Gifu Prefecture. The Company is mainly engaged in general electricity business, such as supply of electricity. The segment is also engaged in the maintenance of power equipment, power related facility operation and management business, equipment maintenance and construction work business, manufacture and sale of materials and equipment, management and service of real estate, commercial business as well as information and communication business. The materials and equipment business is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of power products and equipment, such as concrete products, electricity meters, switches and transformers. The real estate management business includes the energy solution business, rental and management business of real estate, as well as staffing business.

name: RESTAR
businessSummary: Restar Corporation engages in the sale of semiconductors, electronic components, image sensors, cameras, peripheral equipment, and related products in Japan, China, South Korea, Vietnam, Taiwan, and internationally. It operates through Devices Business Unit, System Business Unit, and IT&SIer Business Unit segments. The company also offers system proposals with various line card combinations  high-value-added solutions and technical support for liquid crystal systems and overseas suppliers  LSI design, development, and support  contracted reliability test services  supply chain management for electronics  and electronics manufacturing services for mounting of electronic components, modules, and other electronic devices. In addition, it engages in the proposal, design, construction, and maintenance for video, audio, communications, and measurement  development and manufacture of cashless payment terminals and individual number card authentication-related devices  and operation and management services for the introduction and diffusion of renewable energy through solar power generation. Further, the company produces and sells vegetables  and provides power and system consulting services. Additionally, it is involved in software and application development  design and manufacture of industrial PCS  development and maintenance of in-house solutions  semiconductor design and testing  and other information service businesses. The company was formerly known as Restar Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Restar Corporation in January 2024. Restar Corporation was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: OKADA AIYON
businessSummary: Okada Aiyon Corporation engages in the manufacture, sale, and repair of construction machines in Japan. It offers hydraulic breakers, demolition crushers, demolition crushers/shears, demolition shears, demolition pulverizers, demolition and sorting grapples, vibratory hammers, hydraulic quick couplers, and recycling attachments. The company was formerly known as OKADA Rock Drill Co. and changed its name to Okada Aiyon Corporation in 1983. Okada Aiyon Corporation was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: SOLIZE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Solize Holdings Corp, formerly Solize Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering partnering of global product development through the use of 3D technology and other digital technologies. In addition to the production of prototypes, the Company also provides services such as research and development, design (styling), control, design, and analysis, which are the pre-production processes of prototypes, and production preparation, and the post-production process, such as production preparation and the production of final parts using 3D printers. The Company operates through two business segments. The Design segment is engaged in the support of product development and corporate business model transformation. The Manufacturing segment is engaged in the provision of evaluation and verification models for product development, as well as sales and operational support for 3D printers.

name: NISSIN SHOJI
businessSummary: Nissin Shoji Co.,Ltd. engages in the petroleum business in Japan. It provides biomass power generation fuel, such as palm kernel shell and empty fruit bunches pellets  energy saving solutions and marketing  lubricating and fuel oils  and service station solutions, including car wash and coating, vehicle inspection, repair, and insurance, as well as car sales, leases, and rentals. The company also offers functional chemicals, comprising synthetic resin raw, packaging, non-woven, and reflective materials  agricultural covering material  thermal shielding coated sheet for tunnels  thermal insulation material  and reflective materials under the Teru Teru, Warmth, Round Cool, and Warif brand names. In addition, it provides photosynthetic efficiency accelerator  CO2 application controller under the OCES-200S and Conductor brand names  agricultural houses, including steel frame, ap, and pipe houses  liquefied petroleum gas, such as propane and industrial gases  water heaters  built-in hob  industrial boilers  and disaster propane gas generator. Further, the company is involved in real estate leasing of office buildings and residences  new construction and acquisition of properties  and tenant management. Nissin Shoji Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TECMIRA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tecmira Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides content services in Japan, China, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Life Design Business, AI and Cloud Business, and IoT and Device Business. The company engages in the content planning, development, and sale of game software  publication of digital content  planning, development, operation, and maintenance of digital teaching materials and learning content  prepaid services for food, beverage, and retail industries  DX platform for medical care  health management apps and health support solutions  and services for organizational management and personnel recruitment. It is also involved in the provision of SaaS products, including AI chatbots and cloud address book services, as well as digital transformation and AI solutions  and development and manufacturing of ICT products, such as IoT devices and tablet PCs, as well as outsourced customer support services. The company was formerly known as JNS Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Tecmira Holdings Inc. in October 2023. Tecmira Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: YONEX
businessSummary: Yonex Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of sporting goods, including badminton, tennis, and golf goods, and also operates related sports facilities. It operates through five business segments. The Sporting Goods segment consists of four segments, including Japan, Asia, North America, and Europe, and is involved in the manufacture and sale of badminton, tennis, and golf goods. Products include badminton rackets, soft tennis rackets, tennis rackets (hard), golf clubs, snowboards, shuttlecocks, and strings. The Sports Facilities segment operates golf courses and tennis and golf driving ranges.

name: CHIYODA
businessSummary: Chiyoda Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the retail and wholesale of footwear. The Company operates in two business segments. The Shoes segment is engaged in retail and wholesale of shoes. The Clothing segment is engaged in the retail of clothing. Stores include TOKYO SHOES RETAILING CENTER, SHOE PLAZA, CHIYODA HAKI-GOKOCHI, Chiyoda, cloverleaf, SPC. The brands include HYDRO-TECH, CEDAR CREST, Bio Fitter, Cristiano Rossani, fuwaraku, cloverleaf, ChiffonFit, KIREI WALK, FILA, be GAIA, Regent Street, Shutte, ELLE SPORT, McGREGOR, TEXACO, OCEAN PACIFIC, Yukiko Kimijima, Zipper, SAVOY, GERRY COSBY, SURPLUS, reyn spooner and AMERICANINO EDWIN.

name: KASAI KOGYO
businessSummary: Kasai Kogyo CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive interior parts. The Company operates through Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia four geography segments. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of automotive interior parts, the manufacture, sales, and technical development of automotive resin interior parts, and the manufacture of automotive ceiling materials. The Company is also engaged in the provision of insurance agency services and business contracts.

name: SINTOKOGIO
businessSummary: Sintokogio,Ltd. is a company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of casting, surface treatment, environment, carrier, special machine business, and other equipment and components. The Company operates in five business segments. The Casting segment offers molding machines, casting sand processing devices, granular processing equipment and components. The Surface Treatment segment offers shot blasting machines, components of surface treatment equipment, as well as shot materials and abrasive materials. The Environment segment offers dust collectors, deodorization equipment, water processing equipment and other components. The Carrier segment offers lifting devices, conveyors and conveying system. The Special Equipment segment offers inspection and measurement devices, servo-cylinders, handling robot and ceramics products. The others engages in design of machinery, information-related business and welfare businesses.

name: PHC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: PHC Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare digital and precision technology solutions in Japan, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Diabetes Management, Healthcare Solutions, and Diagnostics & Life Sciences. It offers precision anatomical pathology for cancer, including tissue processors, digital pathology, and histology consumables  cell growth and preservation, such as CFC-free ultra-low temperature freezers, CO2 incubators, and live cell metabolic analyzer and cell expansion bioreactor system  and diagnostic testing comprising clinical testing, diagnostic reagents, and digital diabetes management solutions. The company also provides patient record and billing solutions, which include electronic medical record systems and receipt systems, systems for pharmacies, and wellness and prevention  diabetes management technology, such as blood and continuous glucose monitoring systems  and medical device and drug delivery comprising contract development and manufacturing services, drug delivery systems, and digital health. It serves patients, healthcare professionals, and researchers. The company was formerly known as Panasonic Healthcare Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to PHC Holdings Corporation in April 2018. PHC Holdings Corporation was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: PENTA OCEAN CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Penta-Ocean Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction and development business, equipment leasing business and shipbuilding business, as well as the sale of construction materials. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment conducts civil engineering works in the domestic markets. The Domestic Construction segment conducts construction works in the domestic markets. The Overseas Construction segment is involved in the provision of construction works in overseas markets. The Others segment engages in the independent development, sales and rental of real estate, as well as land and building leasing, shipbuilding, leasing of office equipment, and environmental-related businesses.

name: OSAKA GAS
businessSummary: Osaka Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic energy and gas, domestic energy and electric power, overseas energy and life and business solutions businesses. The Company consists of three business segments. The Domestic Energy Business segment is engaged in the production, supply, and sales of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping installation, liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, LNG transportation, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sales, industrial gas sales, and power generation and electricity sales. The Overseas Energy Business segment is engaged in development, investment, and energy supply related to natural gas, etc. The Life & Business Solutions segment develops and leases real estate, provides information processing services, and sells fine materials and carbon materials products.

name: UNIPRES
businessSummary: Unipres Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. It operates in four segments by region: Japan, Americas, Europe, and Asia. The body pressed parts business manufactures and sells body press parts, and outsources part or all of the manufacturing process to subsidiaries, who then receive materials from the Company and carry out production. The precision parts business manufactures and sells transmission parts, and outsources part or all of the manufacturing process to subsidiaries, who then receive materials from the Company and carry out production. The plastic parts business manufactures and sells plastic parts, and outsources part or all of the manufacturing process to subsidiaries, who then receive materials from the Company and carry out production. In the other businesses, subsidiaries design and construct the Company's factory plants, act as insurance agents, transport the Company's products domestically and others.

name: SEC CARBON
businessSummary: SEC CARBON,LIMITED is a Japan-based company that manufactures and sells carbon and steel products. Its business is centered on carbon products. It manufactures and sells cathode blocks for aluminum smelting, artificial graphite electrodes, specialty carbon products, fine powders, and other carbon products. It also engages in the processing, research and development, and sales of carbon products. In the steel products sector, it manufactures and sells steel products using electric arc furnace steelmaking.

name: SERENDIP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SERENDIP HOLDINGS Co Ltd operates Professional Solutions business, Investment business, and Manufacturing business. The Professional Solution business includes manager dispatch business, such as professional manager dispatch and management consulting (business succession and business revitalization), engineer dispatch business, such as the design, development and information technology engineer dispatch, and software development. The Investment businesses include investment, mergers and acquisition-related businesses, including funds, joint investment, and financial advisory. The Manufacturing business includes automotive suppliers including automobile interior and exterior parts (luggage room interior parts, exterior parts such as fender liners and rear wheel house liners) and automobile precision parts (automatic functional parts), as well as factory automation equipment including connector automatic assembly machines, and battery-related automatic assembly machines and others.

name: IDEC
businessSummary: IDEC CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the human-machine interface (HMI) business, industrial components business, automation & sensing business, safety & explosion-proof business, and systems business. It is organized into four regional segments: Japan, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), and Asia-Pacific. The HMI business manufactures and sells control switches, joysticks, indicator lights, and programmable displays. The industrial components business manufactures and sells switching power supplies, terminal blocks, control relays and sockets, and circuit protectors. The automation & sensing business manufactures and sells programmable controllers, and automatic identification equipment. The safety & explosion-proof business manufactures and sells safety-related equipment, explosion-proof equipment, and other products. The systems include various systems, collaborative robot systems, and solutions.

name: TOKYO GAS
businessSummary: Tokyo Gas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the gas, electricity, energy-related businesses and real estate businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Energy Solutions segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of city gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) sales, trading, electricity, engineering solutions (engineering, energy services) and others. The Network segment is engaged in the transportation and supply of city gas. The Overseas segment is engaged in the overseas resource development and investment, energy supply and others. The Urban Business segment is engaged in the real estate development and rental and others.

name: YUSHIN
businessSummary: Yushin Company is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of take-out robots for plastic injection-molded products and related equipment. The Company operates through four geographical segments including Japan, the United States, Asia and Europe. The Company develops, manufactures and sells take-out robots for injection-molded products and peripheral equipment, including labor-saving systems and provides after-sales services. The products include take-out robots, palletizing robots, attachment heads, stock systems and automation equipment.

name: GRAPHICO
businessSummary: Graphico Inc is mainly engaged in the planning and sales of health foods, cosmetics, sundries, and pharmaceuticals. The product categories are categorized into healthcare centered on health foods, beauty care centered on cosmetics, household products, ethical drugs and over-the-counter drugs, and others. The main sales channels are drug stores, general merchandise stores (GMS), home centers, and variety stores, and the Company also conducts mail-orders. Overseas, the Company sells through distributors in each country. The Company a fabless company that outsources manufacturing and logistics, focusing on product planning, development, marketing, promotion, and sales.

name: CCI GROUP
businessSummary: CCI Group, Inc. operates as a holding company for The Hokkoku Bank,Ltd. that provides various financial services in Japan. It operates through the Banking Business and Leasing Business segments. The company provides banking services, credit guarantee, consumer finance, credit card services, debt collection management services, system development, and operation management services. It also provides investment advisory services, consulting and administrative outsourcing services, and fund management services. The company was formerly known as Hokkoku Financial Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to CCI Group, Inc. in October 2025. The Leasing Business segment offers leasing services. The company was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Kanazawa, Japan.
