name: OITA BANK
businessSummary: The Oita Bank, Ltd. provides various banking products and services to individual and corporate clients primarily in Japan. The company offers general saving, fixed deposit, and foreign currency deposit accounts  mortgage  housing, business, free, card, car, education, renovation, and vacant house demolition and utilization loans  reverse mortgage  and insurance services. It also provides safe deposit box  internet banking  payment  foreign currency  mail order  web account transfer reception and fund transfer acceptance  automatic pension payment  forex web  debit and credit card  and foreign remittance services. In addition, the company offers management consulting, business consulting, financial advice, medical, nursing and welfare consultation, domestic exchange services  foreign exchange services  and business and management consulting services  and other ancillary services. Further, the company provides debt guarantee and computer-related businesses. The Oita Bank, Ltd. was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Oita, Japan.

isin: 7322.T|San ju San Financial Group,Inc.|7322.T|San ju San Financial Group,Inc.
name: SAN JU SAN FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: San ju San Financial Group,Inc. provides various banking products and services. It operates in two segments, Retail and Leasing. The company offers deposit, lending, domestic and foreign exchange services, sales of government bonds, investment trusts and insurance, and the acceptance and registration of corporate bonds services. It is also involved in leasing  credit card  and credit guarantee businesses. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Yokkaichi, Japan.

name: KANESHITA CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Kaneshita Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the construction business, as well as other businesses related to the construction business and the food and beverage business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Construction Business segment is engaged in the civil engineering, architectural and other general construction work related construction business. The Manufacture and Sale Business segment is engaged in the manufactures and sale of asphalt products, the intermediate process of the industrial wastes, the sale of other construction materials, and the operation of conveyor belt sushi restaurants. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of ready-mix concrete, and the maintenance and management of public housing, as well as construction consulting business, construction material sales business, and solar power generation business.

name: NEXTAGE
businessSummary: NEXTAGE Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the automotive sales business. The automotive sales business includes the business of used car sales, new car sales, maintenance services, insurance agency services, used car purchasing and on-site vehicle purchasing services, and others. Used car sales business operates a one-stop shop system, from sales to maintenance and trade-ins. It also operates large-scale specialty stores, such as SUV LAND, and large-scale used imported car specialty stores, such as UNIVERSE. New car sales business provides VOLVO, JAGUAR, BYD, AUDI and others. Maintenance business provides car accessories sales, insurance, vehicle inspections, and vehicle buyback. Insurance agency business acts as an agent for non-life insurance companies. Used car purchasing and on-site vehicle purchasing services business purchase trade-in vehicles when vehicles are sold, as well as vehicles brought in by customers. Car coating business applies coatings to vehicles sold.

name: KANSAI ELECTRIC POWER
businessSummary: Kansai Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the comprehensive energy and power provision business, the information and communication business, and the real estate business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Energy segment is engaged in the provision of solutions such as electricity, gas, and utility services. The Power Transmission and Distribution segment is engaged in the safe and stable supply of electricity. The Information Technology & Telecommunications segment is engaged in the provision of comprehensive information and telecommunications services. The Living & Business Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of real estate-related services and lifestyle and business-related services.

name: YASHIMA &
businessSummary: Yashima & Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based trading company mainly engaged in the sale of body products and electrical products to railway operators and others, as well as the electronic components to general industries. The railway business provides electrical products for railway vehicles, car body products, vehicle-mounted products, connectors and electronic parts. The general business provides connectors and electronic parts. In addition, the Company provides repair and modification products for thermal power plants overseas, various processed harness products, power devices such as power supply units, and water generators containing micro bubbles.

name: EIZO
businessSummary: EIZO Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells visual display systems, amusement monitors, and imaging system software in Japan and internationally. It provides LCD, color management, and home entertainment monitors  operating room solutions  and medical monitor solutions. The company also offers industrial monitors  and ATC visual display solutions, such as primary control monitors, tower monitors, encoding and streaming solutions, data capture and content management solutions, and graphics boards, as well as other accessories. In addition, it provides business enterprise, healthcare, creative work, security and surveillance, touch panel, maritime, air traffic control, and home entertainment solutions. The company was formerly known as Eizo Nanao Corporation and changed its name to EIZO Corporation in 2013. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Hakusan, Japan.

name: HIRAKAWA HEWTECH
businessSummary: Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. manufactures and sells cable and assemblies, electric and electronic equipment, and medical equipment and parts in Japan, the United States, China, Asia, and internationally. The company offers semi-flexible coaxial cords and semi-rigid coaxial cords for internal wiring and connection of high-frequency equipment  high speed cables  ultra-thin coaxial cables for medical precision equipment  interface cables for digital signals, including industry-certified products  factory automation cables  broadcast cables and optical fiber cables  UL/CSA standard wires  insulated wires and shield insulated wires for internal wiring of various electrical and electronic devices  power cords and power supply components  wiring protection tubes  harness for internal wiring materials for multimedia-related industrial equipment and connection wires between equipment  and other products. It also provides optical transmission devices, network equipment, optical camera modules, and AC normal charger for EV/PHEV. In addition, the company engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of special medical tubing, as well as related processed goods used in medical, analysis equipment, and other special industrial fields  design, execution, and management and contract work of electrical and telecommunications work  and leasing and management of real estate. Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. was formerly known as Hirakawa Electric Wire Corporation and changed its name to Hirakawa Hewtech Corp. in October 1990. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MEBUKI FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Mebuki Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of comprehensive financial services centered on banking business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of banking business, as well as other business related to financial services such as leasing business, securities business, credit guarantee business and credit card business.

name: TAIHEIYO CEMENT
businessSummary: Taiheiyo Cement Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement products. The Company operates in four business segments. The Cement segment provides concrete. The Resources segment provides aggregates and limestone products. The Environmental Business segment provides waste recycling and desulfurization materials. The Building Materials & Construction segment provides secondary concrete products and lightweight foamed concrete (ALC). The Company also operates businesses related to real estate, engineering, information processing, finance, transportation and warehousing, chemical products, sports, and electric power supply.

name: AS PARTNERS
businessSummary: As Partners Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the senior business and real estate business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Senior Business segment is engaged in the provision of nursing care services to elderly people who are certified as requiring nursing care or support through the operation of assisted living homes, day services, and short stays. The Real Estate business segment is engaged in the operation of a senior development business that develops nursing care homes in-house, a solution business that revitalizes real estate such as aging apartment complexes, and an income real estate business that owns rental condominiums and offices.

name: UNICON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Unicon Holdings Co., Ltd. provides construction and related business services in Japan. It also engages in civil engineering and building construction activities. The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

name: EN
businessSummary: en Inc. provides human resources service in Japan and internationally. The company operates job information sites, including en TENSHOKU for various recruitment and career change support services  en TENSHOKU WOMAN, a career-change support services for women  AMBI, a career change site designed for young people  MIDDLE NO TENSHOKU, an online recruitment website for career change in their 30s and 40s  en HAKEN, a job-search site for temporary employment  en BAITO, a recruitment website for part-time and casual job information  and en WOMEN WORK, a recruitment site for women professionals seeking opportunities as full-time employees. It also provides recruiting services, such as en AGENTS that offers professional and specialized support services  Lighthouse, a word-of-mouth site for company review sites  CAREER HACK, a career information site for professionals in web and IT industries  job information sites  and Video Interview, and on demand video interview platform to easily screen candidates. In addition, the company operates en JINJI NO MIKATA, a recruitment support services for HR professionals  en COLLEGE for employee education services  engage, a website for recruitment support tool  HR OnBoard, an employee retention risk identification tool  and 3E TEST for assessing the talent pool, as well as provides evaluation and education consulting services. The company was formerly known as en-japan inc. and change its name to en Inc. in October 2025. en Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: CLASSICO INC CLASSICO
businessSummary: Classico Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the planning, development and sales of medical apparel products for healthcare professionals including doctors and nurses. The product lineup includes lab coats, scrubs (two-piece medical wear), patient garments and related accessories. The Company operates under the medical apparel business segment. Products are sold through a range of channels including official online stores for domestic and international markets, physical retail locations including its store in Tokyo's Shin-Marunouchi Building and other commercial facilities in Osaka, Nagoya and Yokohama, pop-up stores, corporate sales within Japan and cross-border e-commerce platforms including Tmall for the Chinese market, as well as through overseas subsidiaries.

name: DIRECT MARKETING MIX
businessSummary: Direct Marketing MIX Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marketing business and on-site business. The Company has two business segments. The Marketing segment is engaged in the direct marketing business, consulting business and business process outsourcing business. The direct marketing business is engaged in the sale of products and services to end users on behalf of client companies through channels such as telephone contact, direct visit and Web contact by communicators. The consulting business is engaged in the provision of strategies and plans formulation services, system construction and actual operation services, as well as consulting services such as contact center operation and product development, training and market research. The business process outsourcing business is engaged in the labor saving and simplification support business. The On-Site segment is engaged in the temporary staffing business, including dispatch of communicators for marketing business.

name: ADVANEX
businessSummary: Advanex Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of precision springs in Japan and internationally. It offers wire springs, including compression, extension, torsion, conical, and wire forming springs  and flat springs, such as precision presses, multi formings, forging presses, and insert collars. The company also provides deep drawings  insert moldings  spring assemblies  and standard products comprising tangles inserts, tangles insert kits, LockOne, and instant lock products  and HEATNEX, a heating elements. The company was formerly known as Kato Spring Works Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Advanex Inc. in July 2001. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SANKO GOSEI
businessSummary: Sanko Gosei Ltd. molds and sells plastic products and plastic molding dies in Japan and internationally. The company offers automotive, including molded parts, exterior parts, and battery parts  industrial equipment, such as information equipment, molding, insert molding, automatic assembly machine, assembly line, ultrasonic welding machine, and clean booth  and home applications, including commercial and home air conditioning parts, refrigerator parts, power conditioner, industrial battery parts, fuel cell parts, and mold production. The company also manufactures and sells synthetic resin moldings  manufactures, assembles and processes any or all kinds of mechanical and electrical parts  designs, manufactures and sells molds and tools for synthetic resin molding  plans, design, pilot, make and sell any or all kinds of industrial products  designs, manufacture and sell any or all kinds of industrial robots and automatic control of any or all kinds of machines and systems  and carry on all business in connection with the above sub-clauses. Its products are used in industrial electrical equipment, information and telecommunication appliances, automobiles, household appliances, housing equipment, and nursing care products. Sanko Gosei Ltd. was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Nanto, Japan.

name: RENGO
businessSummary: Rengo Co Ltd is a paper box manufacturer. The Company operates in four segments. The Cardboard and Paper Processing-related segment manufactures and sells paperboards, corrugated boards and kraft pulps in domestic markets. The Soft-type Packaging-related segment manufactures and sells soft-type packaging products and cellophane in domestic markets. The Heavy Duty Packaging-related segment manufactures and sells heavy duty packaging products in domestic markets. The Overseas-related segment manufactures and sells paperboards, corrugated boards, corrugated boxes, soft-type and heavy duty packaging products in overseas markets. The other businesses include the manufacture of nonwoven cloth, the logistic business, insurance agency business, lease business and real estate business.

name: POWDERTECH
businessSummary: Powdertech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells powder products, such as ferrite powder and iron powder products, as well as oxygen scavengers. The Company operates in two business segments. The Carrier segment manufactures and sells electrophotography carrier for copy machine and printer industry. The Iron Powder segment manufactures and sells various iron powder for powder metallurgy use, as well as oxygen scavenger and oxygen sensing agents for food industry. The Company also engages in logistics services related to their business and purchases raw materials through non-consolidated subsidiaries and other affiliated companies.

name: KOSHIDAKA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Koshidaka Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the karaoke business. It operates through three business segments. The Karaoke Business segment operates and develops directly managed karaoke boxes in Japan under the brands Karaoke Manekineko and the solo karaoke specialty store One Kara and operates directly managed karaoke boxes in South Korea under the Manekineko brand. The Real Estate Management Business segment owns and manages rental buildings in Gunma Prefecture, Kanagawa Prefecture and others. The Other Business segment operates directly managed hot spring facilities in Japan under the Maneki no Yu brand, and restaurants that do not offer karaoke services, such as Gindako Highball and CAFE ECLA.

name: YAMAGUCHI FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Yamaguchi Financial Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company engages in securities brokerage, credit card, leasing, regional research and consulting, insurance agent, debt management and collection, investment management, fund management, employee benefits agency, welfare and benefits outsourcing services, and credit guarantee businesses. It is also involved in the agriculture and crowdfunding business, business growth and problem-solving support services, as well as wholesale and retail of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products. Yamaguchi Financial Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Shimonoseki, Japan.

name: JAPAN POST HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Japan Post Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in postal and logistics services, post office counter services, international logistics, banking, and life insurance. The Company has five business segments. The Postal and Logistics segment is engaged in the postal business, the logistics business and others. The Post Office Counter segment includes counter services related to postal and logistics services, bank counter services, insurance counter services, merchandise sales, real estate business, and affiliated financial services. The International Logistics segment is engaged in the express, forwarding and logistics business in the global markets centered on Australia. The Banking segment is engaged in the banking business such as fund management, financing and other business. The Life Insurance segment is mainly engaged in the life insurance business. The Company is also engaged in the group shared business, hospital business, accommodation business, and investment.

name: HIRANO TECSEED
businessSummary: Hirano Tecseed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacturing and sales of coating-related equipment, chemical processing equipment and other industrial machinery. The Company has three segments. The Coating Equipment segment manufactures and sells coating and laminating equipment for applications including secondary battery electrodes, magnetic tape, packaging composite films, adhesive tapes, synthetic leather, flooring materials, wallpaper, decorative boards and insulation boards, as well as drying and heat treatment equipment. The Chemical Processing Equipment segment manufactures and sells polymer processing machinery for applications including plastic film, film deposition, electronic printed circuit boards, ceramic sheet forming and high-temperature processing, as well as vacuum deposition equipment and drying and heat treatment equipment. The Other segment manufactures, sells, repairs and modifies dyeing and finishing machinery and equipment parts.

name: NICHIHA
businessSummary: Nichiha Corporation manufactures and markets exterior and interior building products for residential, and commercial and public facilities in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers exterior wall materials, roofing materials, eaves, fireproof baseboards, exterior materials, wall accessories, sealings, inner wall materials, and bearing face materials. It also provides fiberboards, as well as offers installation, maintenance, and repair services  manufacture and sells urethane insulation panels  templates  sells custom-built homes  engages in financial planning business  and provides home renovation services. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: AVAL DATA
businessSummary: Aval Data Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells industrial electronic equipment in Japan. It offers general communication equipment, industrial measuring instruments and control equipment, applied electronic equipment, and electronic equipment for physics, chemistry, medicine, and others. The company also provides image input boards, image processing devices, near-infrared cameras, software, and accessories  high-speed optical communication boards and matrix switches  A/D conversion boards  and CPU/MPU modules. In addition, it offers contract development and product customization services  and embedded services. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Machida, Japan.

name: ASAHI PRINTING
businessSummary: Asahi Printing Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and sale of printed packaging materials and systems in Japan. The company operates through  Printing and Packaging Materials Business, and Packaging Systems Sales Business segments. It offers printed packing for the pharmaceutical and cosmetics sectors, such as packaging, labels and seals, instruction leaflets and related materials, and systems solutions. The company also offers blister and sachet packing machines  powder, pouch, tube, liquid bottle, and tablet counting and filling machines  and capping machines. In addition, it provides PTP stacking and banding systems, pillow packaging, cartoning and sealing, labeling, palletizing, corrugated box packing, film packaging, bundling, and shrink film packaging machines. Further, the company engages in temporary staffing business. Asahi Printing Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Toyama, Japan.

name: CELLSOURCE
businessSummary: CellSource Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in regenerative medicine related business and consumer business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Regenerative Medicine Related business segment is engaged in the provision of contracted services for processing tissues and cells derived from fat and blood to medical institutions, and support services for regenerative medicine laws and regulations related to safety assurance such as regenerative medicine, as well as sales of medical equipment. The Consumer business segment is engaged in the sales of cosmetics and facial products to general consumers.

name: HIS
businessSummary: H.I.S. Co., Ltd. is involved in the arrangement, planning, and sales of overseas and domestic travel, as well as related businesses in Japan, the United States, the rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Travel Business, Hotel Business, and Kyushu Sanko Group. It also operates hotels, as well as engages in automobile transportation and real estate rental. In addition, the company owns and operates a theme park  provides non-life insurance services, focusing on overseas travel insurance  and develops and operates room reservation systems and related businesses. Further, it engages in facility management  machinery installation and maintenance  and infrastructure projects, such as construction and construction of new buildings. The company was formerly known as International Tours Co., Ltd. and changed its name to H.I.S. Co., Ltd. in 1990. H.I.S. Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MUSASHINO BANK
businessSummary: Musashino Bank Ltd mainly operates banking business, and financial services including leasing business and credit guarantee services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of deposit and loan services, exchange business and investment of securities business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of finance-related leasing services. The Credit Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of finance-related credit guarantee services. The other businesses include money lending, credit guarantee services related to card operations, the development, sales and maintenance of computer systems, research and study of the prefecture's economy and industry, management and tax consultations, the operation of seminars, the investment in venture companies, the management consultations, administrative agency services, regional trading company operations, consulting services, investment management and investment advisory services.

name: NAFCO
businessSummary: NAFCO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of home and furniture retail stores in Japan. It operates through three segments: Materials, DIY, and Gardening Supplies  Livingware  and Furniture and Home Fashion Items. The company offers home improvement products, including DIY, gardening, exterior, and pet supplies, car accessories, household goods, interior products, and other items  and furniture and home fashion products, such storage, dining, living room, wedding, study, and small furniture, as well as beds and beddings. It also provides carpentry tools  hardware  paint  plastering and plumbing supplies  room accessories  work supplies  electrical materials  seasonal and storage items  stationery  daily necessities  cooking appliances  footwear  food  health and beauty  and outdoor goods, as well as floor coverings  curtains  lighting  renovation materials  and flooring. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Kitakyushu, Japan.

name: JET
businessSummary: J.E.T. Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the design, development, manufacture, sale, and service of semiconductor cleaning equipment in Japan, South Korea, China, Taiwan, and internationally. The company offers batch type and single wafer cleaning equipment, as well as inspection and manufacturing equipment for lithium-ion batteries, such as electrolyte leak inspection devices and ultrasonic bonding systems. It also provides organic agricultural products. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Asakuchi, Japan. J.E.T. Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Zeus Co.,Ltd.

name: BANK OF THE RYUKYUS
businessSummary: Bank of The Ryukyus, Limited is a Japan-based regional bank mainly engaged in the provision of financial services for individual and corporate customers. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking business includes deposit business, lending business, domestic exchange business, and foreign exchange business, among others. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the cash scrutiny organize business, research businesses related to industry, economy and finance and others.

isin: 5341.T|Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd.|5341.T|Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd.
name: ASAHI EITO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of sanitary and washbasin equipment. It operates through Housing Business, Living Business, and Investment business segments. The company engages in the sale of architectural finishing coating materials  solar power generation and battery storage system installation  facility management  and real estate business. It is also involved in the drone school business, nursery school business, and building management association operation activities  and industrial gas business. The company was formerly known as Asahi Eito Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd. in May 2023. Asahi Eito Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: LAOX HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Laox Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic retail business, overseas business, lifestyle fashion business, and asset business. The Company operates through four segments. The Domestic Retail segment sells mainly food and cosmetics in domestic shops through real shops and online stores. The Overseas segment focuses on high-quality Japanese products and develops trade, global e-commerce (EC) and support for expansion into China through various channels and networks, whether direct-to-consumer (BtoC) or business-to-business (BtoB), real or online. The Lifestyle Fashion segment sells gift-related products through multiple sales channels. The Asset segment is engaged in the operation and management of commercial complexes, restaurants, and cultural events, and the sale and brokerage of real estate.

name: NITTA
businessSummary: Nitta Corporation engages in the provision of power transmission belts, conveyor belts and units, and other products in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, North America, South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Belt and Rubber Products Business  Hose and Tube Product Business  Chemical Products Business  Other Industrial Products Business  Real Estate Business  and Management Guidance Business. It offers power transmission and conveyor belts, including PolySprint, Polybelt, and Super Endless belts  curve belt list  and conveyor units, such as curve, spiral, non-snaking, and junction conveyor systems. It also provides Hose and tube products comprising thermoplastic hoses and couplings, tubing and tube fittings, clean tube fittings, speed controllers and valves, and disconnect couplings  and industrial wipers and molded rubber products. In addition, the company offers air and chemical filters  filter casting and clean system equipment  bacteria decontamination equipment  particle and microorganism measuring instruments. Further, it provides mechatronics products, including automatic tool changers and interface units  Intelimer tapes  and RFID magnetic sheets. Additionally, the company offers SOFTmatics, a robot hand used for handling objects  and thermoplastic tubes, tubes and fittings for air brakes, and air spring. The company also engages in leasing land and buildings, and management consulting services  and offers polishing pads and slurry, and construction and waterproofing materials. It serves civil engineering and construction, automobile, logistic and transportation, environment and energy, industrial machinery, semiconductor, liquid crystal and electronic components, food, medicine, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Nitta Belting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nitta Corporation in 1982. The company was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KYUSHU RAILWAY
businessSummary: Kyushu Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in transportation services, real estate and hotel, retail and restaurant, construction, as well as business services, primarily throughout Kyushu. The Company has five business segments. Transportation Services segment engages in railway and bus operations. Real Estate and Hotel segment engages in real estate leasing, including commercial facilities, offices and apartments, real estate sales, including condominiums, and hotel operations. Retail and Restaurant segment engages in retail, restaurant and agricultural businesses. Construction segment engages in construction, railway vehicle and machinery equipment work, electrical work and construction consulting. Business Services segment engages in construction machinery sales and rental, wholesale, cleaning and maintenance, advertising, as well as system-related businesses.

name: SYNCHRO FOOD
businessSummary: Synchro Food Co., Ltd. operates various platforms for the food and beverage industry. The company offers services and information to support restaurant owners through inshokuten.com  equipment and furniture included restaurant brokerage service through inuki-info.com  restaurant related job information through job.inshokuten.com website  tenpodesign.com that matches restaurant owners with interior designer  job.tenpodesign.com, a job search and career change website for the interior design industry  mobimaru.com, a kitchen car sharing and matching platform  part-time job search services and SNS short videos through gourmet-baito-chan.com  and agrijob.jp, a job information website for the agriculture, forestry, and fisheries industries. Synchro Food Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: AMVIS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Amvis Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Ishinkan business. The core business is the operation and management of paid nursing homes, consulting related to the management of paid nursing homes, and leasing of land and buildings for use as paid nursing homes. It operates through two business segments. Ishinkan segment organically combines visiting services such as visiting nursing, visiting care, and in-home care support with facility-based services such as paid nursing homes to develop Ishinkan. Its services include visiting nursing/preventive visiting nursing, visiting care/preventive care/comprehensive daily life support services, in-home care support, and in-home care/severe visiting care. Ishinkan also accepts people with disabilities and provides comprehensive support services for people with disabilities. Comprehensive Medical Support segment provides various support services to medical institutions, such as consulting.

name: AOI ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: Aoi Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic components. The integrated circuit business division is engaged in the manufacture and sale of integrated circuits (ICs), optical sensors, wafer-level packages, and light-emitting diodes (LEDs), as well as the plating processing of electronic components. The functional components business division manufactures and sells print heads and various sensors.

name: KYORIN PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Kyorin Pharmaceutical Co Ltd, formerly Kyorin Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceuticals business. The Pharmaceuticals segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, purchase, sales and testing of pharmaceutical products, the purchase of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, the evaluation of technologies, the inspection, analysis and negotiation of license affiliations, the operations related to clinical trials and information gathering such as searching for drug discovery seeds, as well as the drug candidate compound discovery research and compound evaluation business. The Company also conducts the diagnostic businesses and verifies and creates research targets that are directly linked to drug discovery.

name: WEST JAPAN RAILWAY
businessSummary: West Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of passenger railway transportation services. The Company has four business segments. The Mobility segment is involved in the railway business, passenger automobile transportation business, and ship business. The Company operates in the Hokuriku, Kinki, Chugoku, and northern Kyushu areas, and is engaged in intercity transportation using Shinkansen and conventional express trains. It also operates construction and cleaning and maintenance businesses. The Distribution segment operates department stores, as well as retail and food services at major stations. The Real Estate segment sells and rents real estate using its real estate holdings, as well as operates shopping centers and hotels. The Travel and Regional Solutions segment is involved in travel and regional solutions. It also operates advertising, civil engineering and construction consulting, spatial information consulting, and information services.

name: LEOCLAN
businessSummary: LEOCLAN Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in the sale of medical equipment and solutions for medical institutions. It operates four business segments. The Medical Total Solutions Business segment sells medical equipment for the construction, relocation, reorganization, and integration of medical institutions, and provides medical information systems, including magnetic resonance imaging, computed tomography, and electronic medical records. The Remote Diagnostic Imaging Services Business segment provides remote diagnostic imaging services. The Minimally Invasive Medical Equipment Sales Business segment sells cardiac pacemakers, arrhythmia treatment catheters, and coronary stents. The Rental Services Business segment provides rental services for televisions, bedside cabinets, air purifiers, and coin-operated laundry equipment. The Company serves medical institutions, nursing care facilities, and lodging facilities. It also conducts food service and hearing aid sales.

name: ARCLANDS
businessSummary: Arclands Corp, formerly Arcland Sakamoto Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in retail business, wholesale business, restaurant business and real estate business. The Company operates through four segments. The Retail segment sells household goods, household products, food products and other items to general consumers and professionals (contractors) through Home Centre Musashi, Super Center Musashi, Musashi Pro, NicoPet, Super Viva Home, Viva Home, arts and crafts specialist Ark Oasis, Vysees, and food specialty store Musashi Shokuhinkan. The Wholesale segment mainly sells do-it-yourself (DIY)-related products to home centers nationwide and group companies. The Restaurant segment operates restaurants such as Katsuya, a pork cutlet specialty restaurant. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate. In addition, the Company also operates a sports club JOYFIT and a fitness gym FIT365.

isin: 8337.T|The Chiba Kogyo Bank, Ltd.|8337.T|The Chiba Kogyo Bank, Ltd.
name: CHIBA KOGYO BANK
businessSummary: The Chiba Kogyo Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company offers deposit and lending, securities investment, and domestic and foreign exchange services, as well as trades in commodity securities. It also provides entrusted services for corporate bonds  card, car, renovation, home, mortgage, education, private practitioner, medical, agri-lawn, and business loans  IT and payment services  and business and management support services. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

name: SHINKO SHOJI
businessSummary: Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd. is principally engaged in the sale, import and export of electronic components and assembly products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Electronic Components segment offers integrated circuits, semiconductor devices, circuit components, liquid crystal displays (LCDs), and other electronic components. The main products include microcomputers, system large-scale integrated circuits, memories, semiconductors, capacitors, ferrite cores, color LCDs and general electronic components. The Assembly segment offers assembly products. The Others segment is engaged in the sale of electronic equipment and contract development of microcomputer software. The main products include workstation server and computer peripherals.

name: NIPPON FELT
businessSummary: Nippon Felt Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells press felts, shoe press belts, and industrial textile products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers papermaking felts and pulp-making felts  felt for slate and building materials manufacturing  synthetic textiles for paper making  filter cloths, heat-resistant felts, sanforized blankets, felt for pleat-making machines, felt for conveyor belts, felts for waste treatment, etc.  industrial tubular needle-felts for industrial use for heat resistance, spinning and weaving, tolerable for chemicals, etc. The company also provides industrial woven jackets  industrial detergents and chemicals  and high-pressure shower equipment for paper-making. It also engages in producing, finishing, and selling felt for making paper, pulp, slate, and other industrial applications  and industrial machinery and anti-pollution devices, as well as leasing and managing of real estate. Nippon Felt Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

name: UBE
businessSummary: UBE Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business related to chemicals, and molding machinery manufacturing. The Company operates through four business segments. The Performance Products segment manufactures and sells polyimide, separation membranes, ceramics, separators, and other products. The Resins & Performance Polymer Products segment manufactures and sells composites, nylon polymers, caprolactam, ammonium sulfate, industrial chemicals, fine chemicals, high-performance coatings, elastomers, and other products. The Machinery segment manufactures and sells die casting machines, extrusion presses, injection molding machines, industrial machinery, bridges and steel structures, and steel products. The Others segment manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals (active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediates), supplies electric power, and buys, sells, leases, and manages real estate.

name: TOKYO BASE
businessSummary: Tokyo Base Co Ltd is engaged in the retail of clothing, personal items, and miscellaneous goods. The Company provides two kind of products. The brand products include the products purchased by the Company’s buyers from Japanese local fashion brands. The original products are sold by the person in charge of product planning as original products in cooperation with domestic sewing manufacturers. Incorporating the opinions of the store staffs who interact with customers at the store, the prototype is produced. The Company’s products are divided into three types: those for STUDIOUS stores, those for UNITED TOKYO stores, and those for PUBLIC TOKYO stores. The actual store sales are operated in Harajuku, Tokyo and Minamihorie, Osaka in Japan, as well as Hong Kong and mainland China. The Internet sales are operated through its own directly managed Websites such as STUDIOUS ONLINE STORE, UNITED TOKYO ONLINE STORE, PUBLIC TOKYO ONLINE STORE, and the online mall ZOZOTOWN.

name: CADOS
businessSummary: Cados Corporation engages in the construction business in Japan. The company engages in the design, construction, and sale of commercial buildings, including restaurants, office and business locations, commercial facilities and stores, medical and nursing facilities, drugstores, supermarkets, electronics retailers, convenience stores, and others  and rental and sale of real estate lands and buildings. It is also involved in the civil engineering business  planning, design, and consultation for buildings and civil engineering activities  land utilization  solar power generation  and buying, selling, leasing, brokering, and managing of real estate properties. The company serves landowners. Cados Corporation was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Yamaguchi, Japan.

isin: 5461.T|Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd.|5461.T|Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd.
name: CHUBU STEEL PLATE
businessSummary: Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells steel plates in Japan. It operates through the Steel Related Business, Rental Business, Logistics Business, and Engineering Business segments. The company also engages in the installation, manufacture, and maintenance of equipment for steel manufacturers  metal processing  and warehouse business that focuses on storage and handling of hazardous goods, such as flammable substance, paint, and medicine. In addition, it is involved in the rental business and advertising business for making advertising signs, as well as offers rental grease-filters and maintenance service for kitchens. The company serves construction machinery, industrial machinery, machine tools and parts, factory equipment, industrial vehicles, infrastructure, construction, and transport sectors. Chubu Steel Plate Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: FIXER
businessSummary: FIXER Inc. engages in the development of application systems on cloud platforms in Japan. It offers new system development and cloud migration of existing systems  resale of cloud service licenses  and manage services. The company also develops SaaS business. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: NICHIREI
businessSummary: Nichirei Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in processed food business, fishery business, livestock business, low-temperature logistics business, real estate business and other businesses. The Company operates in five business segments. Processed Food segment is engaged in the manufacture, process and sale of frozen foods, processed agriculture products, retort foods and others. Marin Products segment is engaged in the process and trading of seafood products. Animal Husbandry segment is engaged in process and sale of poultry, breeds, as well as the sale of chicken for meat. Low-temperature Logistics segment is engaged in the third-party logistics business, the provision of storage, inventory control and others. Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of office buildings and parking lots. The Company is also involved in the bioscience business, the personnel salary related business services, as well as the business related to greening management and cleaning services.

isin: 9119.T|Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd.|9119.T|Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd.
name: IINO KAIUN KAISHA
businessSummary: Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the shipping and real estate businesses in Japan, Saudi Arabia, and internationally. The company operates through: Overseas Shipping, Domestic and Coastal Shipping, and Real Estate Business segments. The company operates oil tankers, including very large crude carriers(VLCCs) for the transport of crude oil and petroleum products  chemical tankers to transport liquid cargoes, such as petrochemical products, methanol, sulfuric acid, vegetable oil, ethanol, and lubricating oils  fleet of large and domestic gas carriers that transport liquefied gases comprising liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and liquefied natural gas(LNG)  medium and small gas carriers to transport LPG, vinyl chloride monomer(VCM), propylene  and dry bulk carriers to transport coal for electric power generation, coking coal, grains, wood chips for paper production, fertilizers, wood biomass fuel, and construction materials. It also offers real estate service  hall and conference center management  event space  and shipping agency services. In addition, the company provides photography studios and support for advertisers and magazine publishers. Iino Kaiun Kaisha, Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: JAIC
businessSummary: JAIC Co.,Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in education-integrated recruitment services. The college business is engaged in the provision of education-integrated human resource introduction services and educational opportunities for SMEs with less than 300 employees. The Company is also engaged in the provision of a wide range of detailed education and training services including Job College service, Women's College service, Second College service, New College service, Leader College service, Seven Habits training service, Harada Method training service, Discovery training service, and new employee training Basics of Work services.

isin: 9267.T|Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd.|9267.T|Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd.
name: GENKY DRUGSTORES
businessSummary: Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd. engages in the management and operation of food and drug chain stores in Japan. The company retails pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, miscellaneous goods, food, and other products. It also engages in food manufacturing, store development, and logistics business. Genky DrugStores Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

name: CHANGE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Change Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company primarily engaged in the NEW- information technology (IT) transformation business and public tech business. The Company operates through two business segments. The NEW-IT Transformation Business segment is divided into the areas of resolving labor shortages and cybersecurity and provides solutions that bring about change to the business operations and business models of Japanese companies through new technologies and digital human resource development, improving productivity and added value, as well as internet security services. The Public Tech Business segment is divided into the regional revitalization and public digital transformation (DX) areas and provides platform business for hometown tax donations and solutions for government agencies.

name: BANK OF NAGOYA
businessSummary: Bank of Nagoya Ltd is a regional bank that conducts business related to financial services, such as banking, comprehensive finance leasing, outsourcing, and credit card business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit, loan, domestic and foreign exchange, securities investment, commodity securities transactions, as well as bond registration services. The Leasing segment is engaged in the general finance leasing business. The Card segment is engaged in the credit card business and guarantee business. The other business activities include cash consolidation and scrutiny services, support for business succession, advice on initial public offerings and capital policies, and information and communication technology (ICT).

name: BOOKOFF GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: BOOKOFF GROUP HOLDINGS LIMITED is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the operation and management of subsidiaries which operate reuse store and book off online business, as well as other related business. The Company operates three kinds of business. The reuse store business is involved in the operation of head office and other chain and the reuse shop BOOKOFF which provides books and software. The BOOKOFF online business is involved in the operation of reuse shop BOOKOFF Online on the Internet. The Hugall business operates a reuse business that is not limited to store type business and purchases and sells products. The Company also involved in the operation of shops of the newly published bookstore Aoyama Book Center, Ryusui Shobo and yc-vox, the planning, designing and construction of its own stores’ interior and exterior works, processing of products to be sold at stores, as well as the operation of Internet review Website Booklog.

name: DEF CONSULTING
businessSummary: Def consulting, inc. engages in the consulting business in Japan. It offers strategy consulting services for strategy and planning, business portfolio optimization, organizational strategy, marketing strategy, new business development, efficiency and process optimization, technology strategy, risk management and crisis response, international expansion strategy, evaluation and monitoring, strategic partnerships, and M and A support services. The company also provides technology consulting services, such as system integration, security assessment, data management and analytics, cloud service implementation support, software development and customization, optimizing IT infrastructure, and digital transformation strategy. In addition, it offers operation consulting services for business process improvement, restructuring and reorganization, improved operational efficiency and cost reduction, business and growth strategies, talent management and leadership development, and risk management and compliance services. Further, it engages in digital asset treasury business. The company was formerly known as Success Holders, Inc. and changed its name to Def consulting, inc. in August 2024. Def consulting, inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: STARTLINE
businessSummary: Startline Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in employment support services and welfare services for people with disabilities. It develops new value-added services such as coffee roasting and plant cultivation and provides various options (services) for the employment and work of people with disabilities. The disability employment support services business offers the roastery-type disability employment support service BYSN, the indoor farm-type disability employment support service IBUKI, the satellite office service with employment support for people with disabilities INCLU, the satellite office service with employment support for people with disabilities INCLU ONE, the employment support services for people with disabilities with improved customer service quality RESQWO, TASKI (TASKI COFFEE), as well as training and consulting services. The disability welfare business offers FITIME and GOOD THE GOOD.

name: TOYO CONSTRUCTION
businessSummary: Toyo Construction Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the general construction business, including marine and land civil engineering and building construction, as well as real estate operations. The Company operates through four business segments. The Domestic Civil Engineering segment and the Domestic Building Construction segment are engaged in civil engineering and building construction projects within Japan. The Overseas Construction segment undertakes civil engineering and building construction projects outside Japan. The Real Estate segment engages in real estate sales and leasing in Japan. the Company is also involved in insurance agency services, sales and leasing of goods, vessel leasing, as well as the manufacturing and sales of sanitary equipment and indoor and outdoor toilet facilities.

name: JUROKU FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Juroku Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial services, with a focus on banking. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit operations, lending, trading of trading securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, corporate bond trusteeship, financial derivatives trading, and ancillary businesses, providing a diverse range of products and services as a regional financial partner. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing operations and meets the leasing needs of the region. The Company is also engaged in research and development, financial instruments trading, credit card services, payment and digital solutions, management succession and mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory services, investment limited partnership operation and management, and regional revitalization consulting, meeting the financial needs of both individual and corporate customers.

name: FLECT
businessSummary: FLECT Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of multi-cloud integration services for digital transformation in Japan. The company provides professional services of DX support, including planning and design, UI/UX design, cloud development, and operation by combining multiple public cloud services, such as Salesforce, Amazon Web Services, and Heroku. It offers its services in the areas of CRM/Salesforce, e-commerce, IoT/AI, integration/API orchestration, identity, AWS integration, and service design. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of Cariot, a cloud-based service that connects cars and companies. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SENSHU IKEDA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Senshu Ikeda Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in banking business, as well as securities business, leasing business, credit guarantee business and credit card business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Banking segment includes deposit business, lending business, commodity securities trading business, securities investment business, domestic foreign exchange business, foreign exchange business, trusteeship of corporate bond enrollment and registration business and incidental business. The Leasing segment is involved in the provision of leasing services for industrial machines, machine tools, electronic calculators and office equipment. The Company is also involved in the provision of cash settlement, printing and outsourcing service, temporary staff service, as well as assessment and survey of collateral real estate, development and operation of station automatic teller machines (ATM).

name: TOYO LOGISTICS
businessSummary: Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. engages in logistics and business in Japan. It operates through two segments: Logistics Business and Real Estate Business. It provides international logistics, such as import and export procedures, international transportation, overseas logistics, and port transportation  domestic logistics comprises logistics center operation, domestic transportation, mail order logistics, and distribution processing  and trunk room, including storage of various data media and artworks, document storage, books and book storage, document digitization services, and dissolving confidential documents. The company is also involved in regular and bonded warehousing and storage rooms  general port transportation, port loading, and unloading  ocean and coastal shipping  general cargo motor vehicle transportation, light cargo motor vehicle transportation, and port cargo handling  air cargo transportation agency activities  customs clearance  and non-life insurance and shipping agency activities. In addition, it engages in buying, selling, brokering, leasing, management, and utilization of real estate  construction design, supervision, contracting, distribution processing, etc.  software development and sale  and information processing. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. Toyo Logistics Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Toray Industries, Inc.

Tokyo Koki Co. Ltd. was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

name: TOSOH
businessSummary: Tosoh Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of basic raw materials and functional products such as petrochemicals and chemical products. The Company operates in four segments. The Petrochemicals segment manufactures and sells olefin products such as ethylene and propylene, low-density polyethylene, high-density polyethylene, processed resin products, and functional polymers. The Chlor-Alkali segment manufactures and sells caustic soda, vinyl chloride monomer, vinyl chloride resin, inorganic and organic chemicals, cement, and urethane materials. The Functional Products segment manufactures and sells inorganic and organic fine products, measuring and diagnostic products, electronic materials, and functional materials. The Engineering segment manufactures and sells water treatment facilities and engages in construction and repair businesses. The Company also engages in transportation and warehousing, inspection and analysis, and information processing.

name: NICHIBAN
businessSummary: NICHIBAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical products, adhesive tapes and adhesives, as well as related equipment. The Company has two business segments. The Medical segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals based on cloth, paper, cellophane and plastic, medical equipment, cosmetics, medical auxiliary tapes, taping tapes and other tapes for medical use. The Tapes segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of adhesive tapes, adhesive sheets and related equipment for home and office use, and industrial use.

name: PACIFIC METALS
businessSummary: Pacific Metals Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the nickel business and the gas business. It operates through two segments. The Nickel segment purchases and smelts some of the nickel ore, the main raw material for ferronickel products, and sells it as ferronickel products. It also purchases and sells slag generated during smelting. The Gas segment manufactures and sells gases. In addition, the Company is also involved in the purchase and sale of cast and forged steel products and various industrial machinery, environmental business related to waste recycling, the manufacture and sale of cast and forged steel products for industrial machinery parts such as power generation-related parts, rolls for hot-section steel rolling, and marine engine parts, real estate business, and retail electricity business.

name: JAPAN POST BANK
businessSummary: JAPAN POST BANK Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking business. It primarily engages in deposit business, lending business, securities investment business, exchange business, government bonds, investment trust and counter sales of insurance products, intermediary business as well as credit card business. The Bank's main businesses include fund management, financing, asset and liability management, as well as fee-based business.

name: GYET
businessSummary: Gyet Co., Ltd. operates chain stores for retailing clothing and other products in Japan. The company offers men's tops, such as outerwear, shirts, cut and sew, knitted for men  jeans, trousers, easy pants, and shorts for men  outerwear, shirts, cut sews, knitwear's for women  jeans, trousers, shorts, and skirts for women  outerwear, shirts, cut and sew, knits, jeans, shorts, skirts for kids  and inner legs  clothing and miscellaneous goods, such as bags, belts, and hats. It also operates online stores. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FUETREK
businessSummary: FueTrek Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the licensing of software. The License segment is engaged in converting what has been developed and designed into intellectual property rights. The Video and Media segment is a video production business and an advertising agency business that perform planning, production of video such as television programs. The Others segment is the basic business field that performs entrusted development and automotive software development, the transcription business field that provides services that transcribe voice data provided by customers in characters, and the international business field that performs inbound and outbound business.

name: SOCIALWIRE
businessSummary: Socialwire Co., Ltd. engages in the digital PR business in Japan, Singapore, and Asia. The company offers press release distribution services for articles and interviews under the @Press brand  influencer marketing platform under the Find Model Circle brand  and influencer PR services under the iHack brand. It also provides media including newspapers, magazines, and the web, SNS media posting and research services under @Clipping and Clip Master brand  and risk check services under the RISK EYES brand. Socialwire Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: KOKUYO
businessSummary: Kokuyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of furniture and business supply distribution businesses in the work style field, and stationery and interior retail businesses in the lifestyle field. It operates through four business segments. The Furniture Business segment is engaged in space design and consultation, as well as the manufacture, purchase, sale, and installation of office furniture. The Business Supply Distribution business segment is engaged in the purchase, logistics, and sale of office supplies. The Stationery Business segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of stationery. The Interior Retail Business segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of interior and lifestyle goods. It also operates antenna shops.

name: CRG HOLDINGS
businessSummary: CRG HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company principally engaged in temporary staffing introduction related business. The Company operates three kinds of business. The temporary staffing introduction business includes worker dispatch business and paid employment introduction business. The outsourcing manufacturing business is engaged in the outsourcing manufacturing of pet related products, such as pet foods and pet hygiene goods from business partner manufacturers and their accompanying business. The other business provides services to improve productivity in client business activities. The services include business process outsourcing (BPO), salary calculation agency, recruitment agency, robotic process automation (RPA), system solution, as well as information technology (IT) related services.

name: ICHINEN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the automotive leasing, chemical, parking, machine tool, synthetic resin, and agriculture businesses in Japan. The company is involved in automobile leasing, fuel sale, and automotive maintenance and outsourcing services  manufacturing of professional-use, techno, fine, and consumer chemical products  and operation of parking lots and plots for supermarkets and hospitals, parking garages affiliated with tenant buildings, and idle lands. It also engages in the development and sale of automotive, industrial machine, air conditioning, and do-it-yourself tools, as well as provision of third-party logistics services  design, manufacturing, and sale of synthetic resins and raw materials, amusement game peripherals, automotive decorative parts, and machinery and tools for processing molds  cultivation and sale of crops, as well as development, manufacturing, and sale of fertilizers  and manufacturing and sale of curved, tempered, laminated, insulating, and decorative glasses, as well as processed glass products. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Shoji Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd. in September 2008. Ichinen Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: KAWAI MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: KAWAI MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS MANUFACTURING CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of musical instruments, material processing and information-related business. It has two business segments. Musical Instrument Education segment is engaged in the sale of pianos, electronic musical instruments, musical instrument toys and wind, strings and percussion instruments, the operation of music and physical education classes, the provision of musical instrument tuning and repair service, and the publication and sale of music scores and books. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of software used in music education. Material Processing segment is engaged in metal materials processing for electronic and electrical parts, automotive parts, as well as the manufacture and sale of pig iron castings and materials of soundproof rooms and acoustic components. It is also engaged in information-related business, finance-related business, insurance agency business.

name: SCHOO
businessSummary: Schoo Inc is a Japan-based company that develops businesses mainly originating from learning and education. For learners, the Company offers Schoo for Business, a training service for corporations, and Schoo for Personal, a learning service for individuals, while for teachers at institutions of higher education and adult education providers, it offers Schoo Swing, a learning management platform service. Schoo for Business is an online training service for developing autonomous human resources. Schoo for Personal is an online learning service. Schoo Swing is a cloud-based learning management platform service.

name: NACHI FUJIKOSHI
businessSummary: Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. manufactures and sells machine tools, parts, and other products in Japan, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company provides cutting tools, including drills, taps, end mills, and precision tools  machine tools, such as skiving machining center for gears, broaching machines, precision roll forming machines, grinding machines, power finishers, and machining cells  and robots that include handling, palletizing, spot welding, heavy duty, cleanroom, and controllers. It also offers bearings, which include stop fake bearings, radial ball bearings, radial roller bearings, thrust ball bearings, thrust roller bearings, bearing units, plummer block housing, and bearings for specific application  hydraulic equipment, including valve, pump, motor, unit, rotary center joint, construction machines, machine tools, press and molding, and automobile  and automotive hydraulics, such as solenoid valve for automobile. Additionally, the company provides high grade special steels and thermotech, including industrial furnaces, degreasing machine, coating equipment, and coating services. Nachi-Fujikoshi Corp. was incorporated in 1928 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: JAPAN PURE CHEMICAL
businessSummary: JAPAN PURE CHEMICAL CO., LTD. is principally engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of precious metals plating chemicals, which are mainly used in the connections of print circuit boards, connectors and lead frames for electronic components. The Company is involved primarily in functional plating, focused on the three metals of gold, silver, and palladium. Gold is used for printed circuit board and semiconductor mounting substrate applications, while gold and palladium are used for connectors. The Company distributes the products in domestic market and to overseas markets.

name: AZ COM MARUWA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: AZ-Com Maruwa Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the logistics business that primarily includes third-party logistics (3PL) and transportation and delivery services. The Logistics Business segment is mainly engaged in center operation, general cargo transportation and warehousing business. Others provide services, including document storage rental business and real estate rental business. It conducts business activities in Japan.

name: STEMRIM
businessSummary: StemRIM Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the regenerative medicine business. The Company is engaged in the development and research of medicines based on new action mechanism to promote functional regeneration and healing of biological tissue damaged and lost function due to injury or illness. The Company’s main product is stem cell regeneration-inducing medicine. The stem cell regeneration-inducing medicine is a medicine which can obtain the same therapeutic effect as regenerative medicine only by administering the medicine without using living cells and tissues.

name: VT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Vt Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates as an automobile dealer in Japan. It operates through Automobile Sales-Related Business and Housing-Related Business segments. The Automobile Sales-Related Business segment engages in new car dealership business  sells new and used cars  repair of cars  car import  used car export  and car rental business. The Housing-Related Business segment sells condominiums and detached houses, as well as provides construction service and other services. Vt Holdings Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Honda Verno Tokai Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: MEDIROM HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies Inc is a Japan-based holistic health services provider. The Company is a franchiser and operator of healthcare salons across Japan and is a preferred platform partner for large consumer brands, healthcare service providers and government entities. The Company mainly operates in two business segments. The Relaxation Salon Segment is engaged in the development of relaxation studios nationwide, centered on Re.Ra.Ku for the purpose of health management services. The Digital Preventative Healthcare Segment is involved in the sampling business, which includes brand promotion and consumer analysis for third party brands of corporate clients, government-sponsored specific health guidance program, utilizing internally-developed on-demand health monitoring smartphone application Lav, as well as MOTHER Tracker for fitness applications, and preventative healthcare services utilizing digital application and devices.

name: KAKEN PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Kaken Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical and real estate businesses. The Company has two business segments. The Pharmaceutical Business segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and agricultural chemicals. The Real Estate Business segment is primarily engaged in the rental of real estate related to Bunkyo Green Court.

name: HONMA GOLF
businessSummary: Honma Golf Ltd is engaged in the manufacture and sale of golf-related products and provision of services related to products. The Company is engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sales of various golf clubs under the brand of Honma. The Company is also engaged in the provision of golf balls, bags, clothing and other accessories. The Company sells products in Asia, North America, Europe and other regions.

name: SHIKOKU ELECTRIC POWER
businessSummary: Shikoku Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electricity, information and communications, energy, and construction and engineering businesses. It has four segments. The Electricity Business segment is involved in power generation and sales, power transmission and distribution, and is engaged in power supply, wind power generation, nuclear power generation, thermal power generation, hydroelectric power generation, and solar power generation. The Information and Communications Business segment is involved in information system development, platform business, communications business, program production and broadcasting. The Energy Business segment provides comprehensive energy solution services, the design and construction of heat supply systems for buildings and factories. It also operates and manages biomass power plants and provides liquefied natural gas (LNG). The Construction and Engineering Business segment provides comprehensive engineering services.

name: YAMATO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yamato Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the home delivery, logistics and transportation businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Retail segment provides home delivery services to individual customers and small- and medium-sized corporate customers. The Corporate segment is engaged in transportation services for large corporate customers, planning and operation of distribution centers, customs clearance, and air freight forwarding agency services. The Others segment is engaged in information technology (IT) systems development, operation and management, automobile maintenance, fuel sales, non-life insurance agency, and freight trucking. The Company also develops information systems and provides fleet management services for carriers.

isin: 7130.T|Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.|7130.T|Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.
name: YAMAE GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yamae Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of food products in Japan. The company offers general processed foods, frozen food, confectionery, alcoholic beverages, livestock, bento boxes, shochu, marine products, feed, housing equipment, and construction materials. It is also involved in the leasing of real estate and other related businesses, such as transportation, fuel-related business, rental car business, information processing service business, and solar power generation business. The company serves the food manufacturing industry and restaurants. Yamae Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan.

name: LOGPROSTYLE
businessSummary: LogProstyle Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as a real estate developer and management company in Japan. It operates in three segments: Real Estate, Hotel, and Other. The company engages in real estate design, rental, renovation, and resale  sale of renovated condominium units under the Log Mansion brand  development of residential condominiums and ryokans  management of ryokan-style hotels in Tokyo, Yokohama, and Okinawa  sale of housing equipment and materials  operation of restaurants  and provision of information technology consulting and accommodation services. It sells its products through online platforms, including LogRenove, as well as through real estate brokers. The company serves individual and institutional customers, as well as individual travelers. Logprostyle Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: GMB
businessSummary: GMB CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of automobile parts. The Company operates in six business segments based on the regions. Each segment engages in manufacture and sale of automotive parts. The Company's main products include drive, transmission and control equipment parts, engine parts, and bearings. Drive, transmission and control parts include universal joints, steering joints, constant velocity joints and others. Engine parts include water pumps, water pump bearings and fan clutches. Bearings include tensioner and idler bearings, auto tensioner and idler bearings, ball bearings and others.

name: MEDIA LINKS
businessSummary: Media Links Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells video communication equipment for broadcast industry in Japan, the United States, Australia, and internationally. The company offers e-learning services  internet live streaming services  video/web conference systems  NICE Net Service, a distance education and video on demand learning service  video information network operation support services  filming and editing studio for rental and operational support services  and video, education, and web content planning and production services. It also provides cloud services for human resource development  and web design and operation support, and broadcasting-related system development and operation support services, as well as plans, designs, and constructs presentation, audio visual, and video production systems. The company serves telecommunications carriers and television broadcasting stations. Media Links Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Media Global Links Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Media Links Co.,Ltd. in June 2017. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: VALUENCE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Valuence Holdings Inc. engages in the purchase, auction, and sale of reused goods in Japan and internationally.
