It offers brand-name goods, fine arts, antiques, precious metals, watches, bullions, jewelry, and other articles through online and offline platforms. The company engages in app and systems development  investment and development of venture companies  purchase and sale of new and used cars  car maintenance  management and operation of sports teams  and real estate brokerage services. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Valuence Holdings Inc. is a subsidiary of SF Property Management Inc.

name: KITAZATO
businessSummary: Kitazato Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and markets medical devices, reagents, and related products for fertility treatment. It offers needles, catheters and cannulas, vitrification media and equipment, sperm processing medium/tools, IVF medium products, micro tools, and labware products. The company was formerly known as Kitazato Biopharma Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Shizuoka, Japan. Kitazato Corporation is a subsidiary of Kitasato Shoji Co., Ltd.

name: TAYCA
businessSummary: TAYCA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemical products and piezoelectric materials, as well as the transportation and storage of industrial chemicals. The Company has two segments. Electronic Materials and Chemicals segment manufactures and sells piezoelectric materials, conductive polymer agents, surfactants, sulfuric acid and environmentally friendly anticorrosive pigments. Functional Materials segment manufactures and sells titanium dioxide, ultrafine titanium dioxide, ultrafine zinc oxide and surface-treated products. The Company also provides warehousing and engineering services.

name: ORION BREWERIES
businessSummary: Orion Breweries, Ltd. manufactures and sells alcohol and soft drinks in Japan. The company also engages in the operation of hotels and facilities. In addition, it owns, rents, and manages tourist properties. It sells its beer under the Orion brand name. The company was formerly known as Okinawa Breweries, Ltd. and changed its name to Orion Breweries, Ltd. In January 1959. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tomigusuku, Japan.

name: KEIO
businessSummary: Keio Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation and distribution businesses. The Company operates in five segments. The Transportation segment mainly operates the passenger transportation, such as railway, bus and taxi, as well as the transportation and moving of cargo. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, stores business, the sales of books, shopping centers business, credit card business, the sales of household goods related products, the manufacture and sales of bread and desserts. The Real Estate segment rents and sells real estate. The Leisure Services segment offers services such as hotel, travel and advertising agency, sports and catering services, among others. The Others segment engages in building comprehensive management business, vehicle maintenance business, construction and civil engineering, information systems business, accounting agency and financial business, personnel agency services and other businesses.

name: NAIGAI
businessSummary: NAIGAI CO.,LTD. is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, import and export of textile products such as socks. The Company operates in two business segments. The Wholesale segment is engaged in the plan, manufacture and sale of textile products such as socks. The Company outsources socks production to subcontractors and purchased products, and also imported products from trading companies including overseas subsidiaries. In addition, it exports products to overseas. The Mail Order segment is engaged in the development of mail-order sales of textiles and leather products through television, catalogs, and the Internet. The Company’s brands include NAIGAI COMFORT, NAIGAI PERFORMANCE, NAIGAI STYLE, NAIGAI TRADITIONAL and other.

name: FAN COMMUNICATIONS
businessSummary: FAN Communications Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in offering affiliate advertising services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Cost Per Action (CPA) Ad Network Business is engaged in the provision of advertising service targeted at personal computer (PC) users under the name A8.net and cellular phone users under the name Moba8.net, as well as smart phone user under the name adcrops. The Cost Per Click (CPC)/Targeting Ad Network Business is engaged in the provision of service for operation type advertisement under the name nend and for retargeting advertisement distribution under the name nex8. The Company is also involved in the media business.

name: SHIBAURA MACHINE
businessSummary: Shibaura Machine Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of molding machines and machine tools. It operates through two business segments. Molding Machine segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, and maintenance of injection molding machines, extrusion molding machines and die casting machines. Products include all-electric injection molding machine EC-SXIII, EC-SX and EC-S series, hybrid type Injection molding machine ED and IS series, special specification injection molding machine, fine foam molding and control system. Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation and maintenance of machine tools. Products include high-speed shape machines MPJ-M and MPJ series, horizontal boring machines BTD-100R12 and BTD-110H.R13/R16, grinding machines KWA-D and KT-C series. It is also engaged in manufacture and sale of industrial robots, servo motors, computer numerical control (CNC) devices, sewerage-related measuring equipment.

isin: 5480.T|Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd.|5480.T|Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd.
name: NIPPON YAKIN KOGYO
businessSummary: Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells stainless steel sheets and processed products in Japan and internationally. The company offers corrosion resistant, heat resistant, controlled expansion, soft magnetic, and non-magnetic alloys  and high strength and neutron absorbing stainless, as well as corrosion resistant pure nickel  other stainless steel products  stainless steel floor plates, including POLKA and Checker plate  and manufacture ferronickel alloys. Its products are used for precision electronics, green technologies, marine structures, automotive, precision astronomical instruments, manufacturing and processing plants, and high-temperature environment industries, as well as in the protection of LNG, neutrons, and overlays applications. The company was formerly known as Nippon Kako Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. in 1942. Nippon Yakin Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: NIPPON THOMPSON
businessSummary: Nippon Thompson Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that manufactures and sells needle roller bearings, linear guide devices and other machine parts. The Company operates through the Manufacturing And Sale Of Bearings and Machine Parts Business segment. Needle roller bearings include needle bearings. Linear guide devices include the Linear series and Mechatronics series. The Company's products are used in electronics-related devices, precision instruments, industrial machinery, machine tools, transportation equipment and others.

name: MEDICAL NET
businessSummary: Medical Net, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in media platform business, medical institution management support business and medical business-to-business (BtoB) business. The Company operates through three business segments. Media Platform segment operates a dedicated portal that provides specific information about the body, health, beauty and parenting. Medical Institution Management Support segment provides search engine marketing (SEM) services that includes search engine optimization (SEO) services and listing advertising (search-linked advertising) operation agency services, corporate Website creation and maintenance services, as well as agency sales services. It also operates dental clinics and sells equipment, instruments and medicines to dental clinics. Medical BtoB segment operates a BtoB portal site that includes dental workers.

name: GLOBALWAY
businessSummary: Globalway, Inc. engages in the digital solution, career innovation, and sharing business activities in Japan. The company provides IT consulting and platform construction support services, including DevOps-related solutions  service cloud / field service lighting implementation  salescloud implementation  sales cloud fast start  service cloud fast start  salesforce security assessment  and B2B commerce / experience cloud implementation support services. It also offers system development infrastructure construction support  API infrastructure construction support  support for building a system integration platform  data analysis infrastructure support  IOT infrastructure construction  free Python education service  and workflow system infrastructure construction support services. In addition, it provides MuleSoft implementation support services. Further, the company offers Career Connection, a company review service  Career Connection Career Change, a job change/recruitment site  Career Connection News, a service news for business and careers  Career Connection Company Research  Risako, a useful information site for job changes and stock investments  Mid-career recruitment success, a software for corporate recruiters  NEXT DX LEADER, a useful information site  and Globalway high-class Agent, a high-class recruitment service site. Additionally, it provides TimeTicket, a sharing economy service  TimeTicket Pro, a service that allows to sell personal time between corporations and individuals  and CRiPT consulting, that tackles the various management and social challenges. Globalway, Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: YELLOW HAT
businessSummary: Yellow Hat Ltd. is involved in the retail of car and motorcycle accessories. It operates through two segments, Sales of Automotive and Motorcycle Parts and Rental Real Estate. The company offers tires and wheels, oil, functional and car wash products, chemicals, audio visuals, and car interior and exterior products. Yellow Hat Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: E GUARDIAN
businessSummary: E-Guardian Inc. is a company mainly engaged in the bulletin board post monitoring business. The social support business focuses on the development of new services such as monitoring, customer support, operation and analysis, and deep sales to existing customers. The game support business conducts multi-lingual customer support orders from Chinese and Korean overseas game companies entering the Japanese market. Ad space business conducts the expansion of provision services such as ad space management, drafting management, ad writing, etc. Other businesses include hiring and training of human resources.

name: CAVE INTERACTIVE
businessSummary: CAVE Interactive CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment business which focused on the planning, development, operation, and marketing of highly engaging entertainment content, including mobile media and other hobby-oriented digital offerings. The Company operates through two segments. The Game Business segment primarily focuses on the development and operation of mobile online games and is engaged in the development, operation, and contract production of smartphone games, as well as the planning, production, sale, and licensing of derivative works. The Video Streaming-Related Business segment is principally engaged in providing support and management services for video content creators, including internet advertising activities. Its operations include the production of video content, video streaming management and support services, and social media advertising.

name: SHANON
businessSummary: SHANON Inc. operates as a cloud solutions provider in Japan. It develops and sells SHANONMARKETING PLATFORM that supports marketing activities  Event Management System which allows to manage the operation and management of various events, from in-person and online seminars to large-scale exhibitions, from pre-event to post-event  sales negotiation management system  and vibit CMS which create and update pages. In addition, the company offers consulting services  engages in marketing activities. Further, it provides SHANON Ad Cloud, a demand-side platform for advertising distribution services  CMScloud, a content management system  and ZIKU, a metaverse event platform. SHANON Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Minato, Japan. As of January 20, 2025, SHANON Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Innovation Inc.

name: ASAKA RIKEN
businessSummary: Asaka Riken Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the precious metal, environmental, and other businesses in Japan. It collects precious metals, such as gold, silver, and white gold from circuit board scraps, defective products, and waste products  provides peeling, surface treatment, and precision cleaning of the film forming equipment  and recovers valuable metals from dentistry scrap. The company also collects and recycles waste solutions of ferric chloride. In addition, it offers filter materials for purified water, as well as designs/constructs filter systems  and develops, manufactures, and sells photocatalyst materials for environmental purification. Further, the company develops and sells measurement software systems and automatic measuring systems, as well as transportation of industrial waste, industrial chemicals, scraps, and other waste. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Koriyama, Japan.

name: HANDS
businessSummary: Hands Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of construction. The Company operates through three segments. The Construction segment mainly carries in and out materials at construction sites. The Engineering segment mainly carries out various construction work such as solar panel installation, steel frame construction, and platform door installation. The Repair segment mainly repairs interior scratches on detached houses and apartment houses.

name: UNITED
businessSummary: United Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in investment, education, talent matching, and ad tech/content businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Investment Business segment invests in startup companies and manages funds. The Education Business segment operates online education, smartphone app development, and private tutoring schools. The Talent Matching Business segment provides recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) services such as scouting and recruitment support, as well as recruitment placement and designer-specific matching. The Ad Tech/Content Business segment plans, develops, and operates advertising distribution platforms for advertisers and advertising agencies and advertising management platforms for media outlets, plans, produces, and operates digital content, and engages in fan business and sports marketing.

name: KINTETSU GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business. The Company operates in five business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the provision of railway, bus and taxi services, the railway facilities maintenance business and other transportation related business, as well as the operation of tourist facilities. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, leasing and management of real estate. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores, retail stores and station stores, as well as the food business. The Hotel and Leisure segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, movie theaters and aquariums, as well as the travel business. The Others segment is engaged in the general broadcasting business, the telecommunications business, the information processing business and the insurance agency business.

name: YASUDA LOGISTICS
businessSummary: Yasuda Logistics Corporation, formerly The Yasuda Warehouse Company, Limited, is a company principally involved in the logistics and real estate businesses. The Company operates in two business segments. The Logistics segment is engaged in the provision of warehousing, land transportation, as well as international freight and logistics management services. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing of real estate and the management of rental buildings. As of March 31, 2015, the Company had 12 subsidiaries.

name: ALLIED ARCHITECTS
businessSummary: Allied Architects, Inc. engages in the marketing DX support business in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company's products include Letro and Letro Studio, a video production tool service  Monipla, a platform for public relations and product development  and echoes, a service for instant win campaigns. It also provides solutions for SNS advertising and account management, web promotions, and fan marketing solutions. Additionally, the company offers advertising and other account and marketing support services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: ONOKEN
businessSummary: Onoken Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale, processing, import, and export of steel products in Japan. The company distributes steel plates, bars, and round steel  wire rods  ironware  construction machinery and materials  and civil engineering and building materials. It also engages in contracted construction work, such as steel frames and exterior walls  civil engineering  supply, processing, assembly, and construction management of materials  and real estate sale, leasing, and related activities. In addition, the company is involved in the sale, processing, levelling, and shearing of hot-rolled, checkered, pickled and surface-treated steel plates  architectural design and construction  sale and processing of deformed steel bars for steel-reinforced concrete, copper, and aluminum  steel reinforcement work  and steel flame cutting activities. It serves ironworks, equipment manufacturers, shipbuilders, and industrial machine makers. The company was formerly known as Ono Kenzai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Onoken Co., Ltd. in February 1957. Onoken Co., Ltd. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Kita-kyushu, Japan.

isin: 8032.T|Japan Pulp and Paper Company Limited|8032.T|Japan Pulp and Paper Company Limited
name: JAPAN PULP AND PAPER
businessSummary: Japan Pulp and Paper Company Limited engages in the manufacture, import, export, distribution, wholesale, and sale of paper, paperboards, pulp, and paper-related products in Japan, Europe, Asia, Oceania, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Japan Wholesaling  Non-Japan Wholesaling  Paper Manufacturing and Processing  Raw Materials and Environment  Real Estate Leasing and ICT system development. It sells graphic paper, packaging-related materials, sign and display related products, wholesales paper and packaging materials, media hardware and technical services for sign and display. The company also engages in the sale of paper, paperboard and non-woven fabric, graphic paper and provides shared services, IT and finance services. In addition, it manufactures, processes, recycles, and leases real estate businesses. Further, it is involved in the warehousing and transportation, manufacture and sale of corrugated board and packages, household paper products, hydroelectricity and biomass power generation. Additionally, the company engages in the generation and sale of renewable energy. Japan Pulp and Paper Company Limited was founded in 1845 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 4265.T|Institution for a Global Society Corporation|4265.T|Institution for a Global Society Corporation
name: INSTITUTION FOR A GLOBAL SOCIETY
businessSummary: Institution for a Global Society Corporation engages in the provision of assessment and education solutions worldwide. The company offers First GROW, an assessment service for young children that visualizes each child's traits and supports personalized guidance and development  Ai GROW is a non-cognitive skills assessment tool for elementary schools and universities, that visualizes each learner's strengths and growth. It also provides GROW360+ is an assessment tool that accurately measures employees traits, skills, and competencies to enable evidence-based talent management  Signals, an enterprise prediction market platform that enables organizations to use distributed knowledge for better decision-making  and India GCC Advisory supports Japanese companies in establishing Global Capability Centers. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PRIMA MEAT PACKERS
businessSummary: Prima Meat Packers, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of processed foods, and the processing and sale of meat. It has two business segments. The Processed Food Business segment engages in the sale of processed foods and other products manufactured and sold by organizations and group companies engaged in the manufacture and sale of ham, sausages, and processed foods, the manufacture and supply of prepared bread and deli foods, and the provision of services such as cleaning. The Meat Business segment engages in the sale of meat-related products raised, manufactured, and sold by the organization and group companies which procures and sells meat products, as well as logistics for the meat business. It also engages in contract physicochemical testing of products, the development, manufacture and sale of physicochemical equipment, as well as information processing, and human resources, insurance and real estate services.

name: SUNDRUG
businessSummary: Sundrug Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of pharmacies and the retail and wholesale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and daily necessities. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Drugstore segment primarily sells pharmaceuticals, cosmetics and daily necessities. The Discount Store segment mainly sells food products and household goods.

name: YAMAICHI REAL ESTATE
businessSummary: Yamaichi Real Estate Co Ltd, formerly Yamaichi Uniheim Real Estate Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the development, sale, leasing, management and brokerage of real estate. The Company operates through three business segments. The Real Estate Development and Leasing segment develops and leases residential and commercial real estate properties and operates a parking lot business. The Real Estate Development and Sales segment develops residential land, sells land, and contracts for construction of detached houses. The Condominium segment mainly plans and sells condominiums. The Company is also engaged in the lease, sale, and management of condominiums for seniors, home nursing care and in-home care support services, operation of Japanese restaurants, and management of hot spring facilities. The Company also provides non-life insurance agency services and electricity sales.

name: NARUMIYA INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: NARUMIYA INTERNATIONAL Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in planning and sale of baby and children's clothing as a specialty store retailer of private label apparel. The Company mainly sells through department stores, shopping centers, outlet malls in real stores, as well as ecommerce such as own online sites and other companies' online sites. The Company's brands contain mezzo piano, BLUE CROSS, petit main, Lovetoxic and Pupil House.

name: MIROKU
businessSummary: Miroku Corporation is primarily engaged in hunting rifle, machine tool and automobile-related businesses. The Company operates in three business segments. The Hunting Rifle segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of shotguns, sport rifles and shotgun-related products. The Machine Tool segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of deep hole processing machines, ultra-precision grinding machines and deep hole processing tools, among others. The Automobile-related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive handles, automobile-related products and others. The Company also purchases and sells woodworking products.

name: OJI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Oji Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to the paper manufacturing industry. The Company operates in four business segments. The Lifestyle and Industrial Materials segment is engaged in the containerboard and corrugated packaging business, white paperboard and folding carton business, packaging paper and bag-making business, household paper business, and disposable diapers business. The Functional Materials segment is engaged in the specialty paper, thermal paper, adhesive, and film businesses. The Resources and Environmental Business segment is engaged in the pulp business, energy business, and afforestation and wood processing business. The Printed Information Media segment is engaged in the newsprint business and the printing, publishing, and information paper business. The Company also conducts trading, logistics, engineering, real estate, and liquid paper container businesses.

name: MITSUBISHI LOGISTICS
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Logistics Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the logistic business. It has two business segments. The Logistic segment is engaged in the warehousing, land transportation, port transportation and international transportation handling businesses. The warehousing business involves depositing, storing, warehousing, unloading, and other operations. The land transportation business transports cargo and acts as a transportation agent. The port transportation business involves the loading and unloading of cargo, transportation, carrying in and out of sheds and other cargo handling areas, storage. The international transportation handling business involves development of international transportation systems, and handling of international transportation of goods. The Real Estate segment involves the rental and management of buildings, the management and operation of parking lots and shopping centers, the design and contracting of various construction works and real estate sales.

name: EBASE
businessSummary: eBase Co.,Ltd. engages in the planning, development, sale, and maintenance of content management software in Japan. The company offers Middleware eBASE, a comprehensive data management software  industry specific software for food, daily necessities, and housing industries  optional software for eBASE servers  and other software solutions. It also offers daily goods industry, housing industry, data pool, printing industry, sales support, data management, business agreement, order system, product planning and development, and complaint information management solutions. In addition, the company develops middleware solutions. eBase Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: TOKYO SOIR
businessSummary: Tokyo Soir Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the formal wear business and lifestyle business. The Company operates in two segments. The Formal Wear segment primarily manufactures and sells women's formal wear and sells related accessories. Products are mainly wholesaled to department stores and mass retailers nationwide, and some are sold directly through company-owned stores, including online sales. The Lifestyle segment primarily sells women's fashion accessories and sells directly through company-owned stores, including online sales.

name: GARDEN
businessSummary: Garden Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the restaurant business. The Restaurant Business segment is involved in the operation of restaurants, including ramen, restaurant, steak, and sushi restaurants, as well as franchise and real estate businesses related to its brands. Brands include Ichikakuya, Darumanome, Ichiryu, Terracho, Yamashita Honki Udon, Jonetsu no Sutameshidon, and Kaitenzushi Premium Kaiou. It conducts business activities in Japan and overseas.

name: KURARAY
businessSummary: Kuraray Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of chemicals. The Company operates through five business segments. The Vinyl Acetate segment provides functional resins and films such as poval, polyvinyl butyral (PVB), and EVAL. The Isoprene segment provides thermoplastic elastomer SEPTON, CLARITY, isoprene-related products, and GENESTA. The Functional Materials segment provides methacrylic resins, medical-related products, and carbon materials. The Textile segment provides synthetic fibers, artificial leather CLARINO, and non-woven fabrics. The Trading segment processes and sells synthetic fibers and artificial leather, and plans and sells other products. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sales of liquid crystal polymer film, rubber and resin processed products, design and construction of various plants, contracted production ancillary and logistics services, etc., warehousing and distribution and processing services, insurance, travel.

name: GRANDY HOUSE
businessSummary: Grandy House Corporation is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates in three segments. The Real Estate Sales segment is engaged in the purchase of land for sales, the authorization of development licenses, the management of residential land developing works, the design, construction and sale of housings, as well as the provision of maintenance services. The Construction Material Sales segment is engaged in the sale of construction materials and members with a focus on precut materials. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing of buildings and condominiums, as well as the parking business.

name: CHORDIA THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Chordia Therapeutics Inc is a Japan-based drug discovery venture company mainly engaged in the research and development of novel anticancer drugs for commercialization. The Company's main business is the research and development of small molecule breakthrough drugs (first-in-class) with novel actions in the field of oncology, where there is a high unmet medical need. The Company concentrates on management and research operations (exploratory, preclinical, and clinical research), particularly in the discovery, evaluation, optimization, and clinical testing of candidate compounds, and outsources basic research, active pharmaceutical ingredient and drug product manufacturing, distribution, and sales to its various external partners to advance its business.

isin: 2109.T|Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd.|2109.T|Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd.
name: MITSUI DM SUGAR
businessSummary: Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells refined sugar and functional food materials in Japan. It operates through the Sugar Business, Life Energy Business, and Real Estate Business segments. The Sugar Business manufactures and sells raw sugar, processed sugar, and sugar-related products  rock sugar, liquid sugar, brown crystal sugar, sugar stick sachets, powdered sugar, gum syrup, and soft drink concentrates  centrifugal sugar and black sugar  sweeteners and other food ingredients  and functional food. This segment also engages in the manufacture, sale, and cargo handling of product packaging materials. The Life Energy segment provides food colorings, flavorings, sugar cane extract, agar, food additives, bio-based products, nutritional care supplements, and nutritional products for patients with dysphagia, as well as life support, and home delivery lunch box services. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in the leasing of land, retail premises, and offices, as well as warehouse operations. The company was formerly known as Mitsui DM Sugar Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. in April 2025. Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PAYCLOUD HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Paycloud Holdings Inc. provides technology solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates through the Cashless Service Business, Digital Signage Related Business, Solution Business, and Other Businesses segments. The company provides end-user services, including house electronic money, points, and digital gift cards to customers who operate stores, such as supermarkets and restaurants. It also offers digital signage to shopping centers, restaurant chains, convenience stores, and online stores, as well as sale, installation, and maintenance services. In addition, the company provides a service with functions for message transmission and data security services, including personal information management solutions. Further, it offers P-Pointer, a data security solution  arara message, a high-speed email delivery solution  AR services, such as ARAPPLI  and QR code-related services. The company was formerly known as arara inc. and changed its name to Paycloud Holdings Inc. in March 2024. Paycloud Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: DATASECTION
businessSummary: Datasection Inc. provides AI data center/AI cloud, data science, marketing solutions, and system integration services in Japan, Asia, South America, and internationally. Its services comprising data infrastructure and BI tool development, consulting, data analysis and algorithm development, DX/AI human resources development, AI contract development, contract development for financial system and software, education and human resource development  Insight Intelligence Q, a tool that allows to search and analyze consumer voices on the web  and Social Monitor, a risk monitoring tool that constantly checks the consumer voices. The company also offers FollowUP, a tool that analyzes the behavior of the store visitors  and artificial intelligence solutions comprising data crawling, image processing, and social media data analysis. Datasection Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PROCREA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Procrea Holdings, Inc. operates as a holding company for the Aomori Michinoku Bank, Ltd. that provides banking products and services in Japan. The company operates through two segments, Banking and Leasing. The company's financial services include deposits, lending, trading of commodity securities, securities investment, and foreign exchange, as well as corporate bond underwriting and registration services, and related services. It also offers credit cards, credit guarantees, and debt management and collection businesses  and consulting, leasing, and real estate management and leasing services. In addition, the company engages in leasing of machinery, fixtures, and equipment. Procrea Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Aomori, Japan.

name: OKUMA
businessSummary: Okuma Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools. The Company operates through Japan, America, Europe and Asia-Pacific segment. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of machine tools, provision of after-sales service, and sales of parts machining and maintenance parts, as well as the manufacture of sheet metal parts for machine tools. The main products include numerical control (NC) lathes, machining centers, multi-tasking machines, NC grinders and other NC machine tools, NC equipment, factory automation (FA) products, servo motors and other general machines.

name: DENKA
businessSummary: Denka Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic and advanced products, life innovation, elastomers and infrastructure solutions, and polymer solutions. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electronics & Advanced Products segment provides electronic packaging materials, fine ceramics, fused silica, acetylene black, electronic circuit boards, and industrial tapes. The Life Innovation segment provides vaccines, diagnostics, and oncology virus products. The Elastomers and Infrastructure Solutions segment provides chloroprene rubber, cement, specialty admixtures, fertilizers, carbide, refractories, and environmental materials. The Polymer Solutions segment offers tylene monomers, polystyrene resins, clearenes, heat-resistant and transparent resins, poval, yarn for synthetic wigs, and food packaging materials. The Company also operates plant engineering and trading businesses.

name: TAISHO PHARMACEUTICAL HOLDINGS CO LTD PR
businessSummary: Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs, quasi-drugs, foods, medical supplies, hygiene products, and ethical drugs. The Company operates in two business segments. The Self-Medication segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs, quasi-drugs, foods, medical supplies, hygiene products. The Pharmaceutical segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of ethical drugs. The other business is engaged in the leasing and management of real estate, as well as hotel management business.

name: AGC
businessSummary: AGC Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sales of glasses. The Company operates through five segments. The Architectural Glass segment manufactures and sells products such as float plate glass, molded glass, and screened and polished plate glass. The Automotive segment provides automotive glass, cover glass for automotive displays, and other products. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells products such as glass substrates for liquid crystal displays, glass substrates for organic electroluminescence (EL), and peripheral materials for displays. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells products such as vinyl chloride, raw materials for vinyl chloride, and caustic soda. The Life Science segment provides synthetic pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates, bulk pharmaceuticals, and biopharmaceuticals. The Ceramics & Others business handles ceramics products, logistics and financial services.

name: ASAHI KAGAKU KOGYO
businessSummary: ASAHI KAGAKU KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based manufacturing company. Along with its subsidiary, the Company is engaged in the molding process of plastics products, the design and manufacture and molding dies for resins. The products of the Company are mainly used for electrical tools and automobiles. The Company operates its business in Japan, China and Thailand.

name: MITSUI CHEMICALS
businessSummary: Mitsui Chemicals Inc is engaged in life and healthcare solutions, mobility solutions, information and communication technology (ICT) solutions, and basic and green materials business. The Company operates in four business segments. Life and Healthcare Solutions segment manufactures and sells vision materials, nonwoven fabrics, oral care materials, personal care materials and agricultural chemicals. The Mobility Solutions segment manufactures and sells elastomers, functional compounds and polypropylene compounds, and supports the development of new products for industrial products. The ICT Solutions segment manufactures and sells semiconductor and electronic component process materials, optical materials, lithium-ion battery materials, next-generation battery materials and others. The Basic and Green Materials segment manufactures and sells ethylene, propylene, polyethylene, polypropylene, catalysts, phenols, high-purity terephthalic acid, polyethylene terephthalate resin and others.

name: DAI NIPPON PRINTING
businessSummary: Dai Nippon Printing Co Ltd is a Japan-based engaged in business activities related to smart communications, life & healthcare, and electronics, mainly in the printing and soft drink businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Smart Communications segment is engaged in the provision of books, magazines, textbooks, e-books, digital marketing support for sales promotion and customer analysis, catalogs, flyers, pamphlets, calendars, thermal transfer products, and library operations. The Life & Healthcare segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of lithium-ion battery materials, solar battery materials, materials for transporting electronic components, multifunctional heat insulation boxes, fruit juice, functional beverages, interior and exterior materials, and pharmaceuticals. The Electronics segment manufactures and sells optical films for displays, large-size photomasks for liquid crystal displays, photomasks for semiconductor products, and other products.

name: SAKURAJIMA FUTO KAISHA
businessSummary: Sakurajima Futo Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the port transportation business in Japan. The company operates through Bulk Cargo  Liquid Cargo  and Logistics Warehouse segments. It is involved in the bulk cargo handling, such as coal, coke, raw and industrial salt, soda ash, fertilizer raw materials, etc.  liquid cargo handling, including petroleum fuels, chemicals, and petrochemicals, as well as raw materials for pharmaceutical manufacturing, textile materials, and food additives  and owns and operates a distribution and processing facility, a refrigerated warehouse, a low-temperature logistics center, and a chemicals center, as well as engages in solar power generation and electricity sales businesses. Sakurajima Futo Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: TESS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tess Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the engineering and energy supply businesses in Japan. The company is involved in engineering, procurement, and construction of energy conservation and renewable energy-related facilities. It also engages in the operations and maintenance of renewable energy power plants and renewable energy power generation  energy management, remote monitoring, and fuel supply services, as well as energy resource aggregation services, including supply-demand adjustment capacity, imbalance avoidance, rate reduction, and output suppression avoidance to general power transmission and distribution operators, power retailers, and consumers. In addition, the company offers intelligent energy infrastructure. Further, it has installed capacity of approximately 398.6 MW for renewable energy power generation facilities, including 127 solar power plants, and 3 biomass power plants. The company was formerly known as Tess Techno Service Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tess Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2018. Tess Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: LAXUS TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Laxus Technologies Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of Luxus, a subscription-based sharing service for branded bags to general consumers in Japan. The Company provides the opportunities for general consumers to use high-quality branded bags through smartphone apps and Internet sites. The Company operates through a subscription service with a flat-rate fee. The age range of Luxus users is from their 20s to 50s, with the majority being in their 30s and 40s. The Company also allows users to purchase any rental bag they like, and also starts business to business/consumer (BtoB/C) sales, which selects the most appropriate sales destination from domestic reuse select shops, auctions, overseas e-commerce sites depending on the market value of the bag.

name: TOBU RAILWAY
businessSummary: Tobu Railway Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation, leisure, distribution, and real estate businesses and others. The Company operates through five business segments. The Transportation Business segment is involved in railway, bus and taxi, and freight transportation businesses. The Leisure Business segment is involved in amusement parks and tourism, sports, travel, hotels, and Skytree businesses. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in real estate rental, real estate sales, and Skytree Town businesses. The Distribution Business segment is involved in department stores, supermarkets, convenience stores and others. The Other Business segment is involved in construction, electrical work, and other businesses.

name: RAKUTEN BANK
businessSummary: Rakuten Bank Ltd is a Japan-based bank mainly engaged in the provision of online banking service. The Company is an Internet bank that provides banking services over the Internet without physical branches. The Company utilizes the Internet to provide services to both individual and corporate customers. In the individual business, the Company provides services related to personal life, including receipt of salary and bonuses; account transfers for utility bills such as electricity, gas, and water; cell phone bills; credit card usage fees, and repayment of loans; transfers to make various payments; money transfers; overseas remittances; and asset management. In the corporate business, the Company uses technology to provide banking services, including loans, deposits, and foreign exchange, tailored to customer needs. It also operates businesses related to the trust business and other businesses.

isin: 7516.T|Kohnan Shoji Co., Ltd.|7516.T|Kohnan Shoji Co., Ltd.
name: KOHNAN SHOJI
businessSummary: Kohnan Shoji Co., Ltd. operates and manages retail stores in Japan. The company's home center stores offer home improvement products, which include lumber, building materials, tools, hardware, pain supplies, working clothes and equipment, gardening tools and equipment, plants, material handling products, housing and plumbing supplies, and remodeling and renovating products  housekeeping products, such as kitchenware and dining, furniture and decor, bedding, electronics and lighting, household supplies, electrical appliances, health and personal care, footwear, clothing, cleaning, laundry products, and electrical appliances  and car and leisure products, which include automotive supplies and accessories, pet supplies, stationary and office supplies, cycling products, and sports and outdoor products. It also operates Home Center store, which offers daily necessities  KOHNAN PRO stores, which sell various items for professional customers  KOHNAN CustomReform, providing products and services tailored to different living spaces and requirements of each customer  and CAMP DEPOT stores, which offers camping goods. In addition, the company leases commercial facilities and other real estate properties. Kohnan Shoji Co., Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: TIEMCO
businessSummary: TIEMCO LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the planning, development, import, export and sale of fishing and outdoor products. The Company operates in three business segments. The Fishing Product segment provides lure fishing products, fly-fishing products and other fishing products. The Outdoor Product segment provides outdoor apparels under the brand Foxfire and other outdoor activity-related items. The Others segment is involved in the property and casualty insurance agency business and the real estate leasing business.

name: ATSUGI
businessSummary: ATSUGI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of socks and inner wear products. The Company has three business segments. The Textile segment is primarily involved in the manufacture, purchase and sale of textile products, as well as the provision of logistics services. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the sale and leasing of real estate properties. The Others segment is involved in the purchase and sale of nursing care products.

name: MEITEC GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: MEITEC Group Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering solutions business and engineer introduction business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Engineering Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of engineering solution services with a focus on engineer dispatch services. This segment includes high-end engineer dispatching business, middle-range engineer dispatching business, senior engineer dispatching business, registered staffing business whose main customers are the manufacturing industry, and general outsourcing business. The Engineer Introduction segment is engaged in the employment placement business for engineers. The Other segment is engaged in the business related to group management.

name: KYUDEN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: KYUDEN Holdings Inc. mainly engages in the management of group companies whose operations center on the domestic electric power business. The Power Generation and Sales business consists of power generation and retail electricity sales in Japan. The Transmission and Distribution business consists of general power transmission and distribution operations within the Kyushu region. The Overseas business consists of power generation, transmission, and distribution operations overseas. The Other Energy Services business consists of businesses that contribute to the stable supply of electricity, such as the construction and maintenance of electrical facilities, as well as gas and LNG sales, coal sales, and renewable energy operations. The ICT Services business consists of data communications, fiber-optic broadband, telecommunications construction and maintenance. The Urban Development business consists of real estate development and management, as well as public-private partnership projects.

name: NC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: NC Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the manufacture of conveyors and multi-story parking equipment, as well as the staffing business and software development business. The Company has four business segments. The Conveyor Related segment is involved in the manufacture, installation and sale of belt conveyors and auxiliary equipment. The Multi-Story Parking Equipment Related segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of multi-story parking equipment. It is also involved in the construction, maintenance and inspection of related works. The Temporary Staffing Related segment provides general worker dispatching and paid employment placement services. The Solar Power Generation System segment is involved in the sale of solar power generation plants, as well as the sale and installation of solar power generation system equipment.

name: CENTRAL JAPAN RAILWAY
businessSummary: Central Japan Railway Co is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the provision of railway services. The Company operates in three business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the operation of Tokaido Shinkansen railways and the conventional railways in the Tokai area, as well as the provision of bus services. The Distribution segment is engaged in the operation of department stores in JR central towers, as well as the merchandising business in train compartments and stations. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the leasing and sale of station buildings and other real estate. The Company also operates a hotel business, travel agency business, advertising business, railroad car manufacturing business, and construction business.

name: CHUBU ELECTRIC POWER
businessSummary: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a variety of businesses in its core area of energy business supplying electricity and gas, as well as overseas energy business, construction and manufacturing related to energy business, and real estate business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Mirise segment is engaged in the sale of electricity and gas and provides various services. The Power Grid segment provides power network services. The JERA segment is engaged in upstream and procurement of fuel, power generation, and sales of electricity and gas. The Company also operates businesses in renewable energy, business creation, global business, nuclear power, and administrative overhead.

name: NANTO BANK
businessSummary: Nanto Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking, leasing and credit guarantee and other financial business. The Company operates through two business segments. Banking segment is engaged in the deposits, loans, domestic exchange and foreign exchange. Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of leasing properties ranging from office equipment to large industrial equipment and automobiles for customers. The Company is also engaged in the provision of credit guarantee business, real estate leasing and management business, software development business, credit card business, employment service and securities business.

name: HOKUETSU
businessSummary: Hokuetsu Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the pulp and paper business and packaging and paper processing business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Paper and Pulp Business segment manufactures and sells paper and pulp products. The Packaging and Paper Processing Business segment is engaged in manufacture and sale of paper containers and liquid containers, and the manufacture, processing, and sale of paper products. The Company is also engaged in the timber business, construction business, machine manufacturing, sales, and maintenance business, transportation and warehousing business, and used paper wholesale business.

name: TOSHIBA TEC
businessSummary: Toshiba Tec Corporation offers retail and workplace solutions in Japan and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Retail Solutions Business and Workplace Solutions Business. It offers point-of-sale (POS) systems, multifunction printers and office systems, self-checkout systems, auto ID systems, and related products  sells and installs equipment. The company provides ICT maintenance, operation, and implementation and construction services  Automatic recognition system, label printer, RFID devices and systems and data utilization services. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Toshiba Tec Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Toshiba Corporation.

name: SANDEN
businessSummary: Sanden Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of automotive air conditioning systems and compressors in Japan, Europe, and internationally. It offers heat pump system products  system product components, such as compressors, HVAC units, heat exchangers, electric coolant heaters, and pipes for air conditioning. The company is also involved in provision of air conditioning systems for off highway vehicles  and intercoolers. The company was formerly known as Sanden Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Sanden Corporation in January 2022. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Isesaki, Japan. Sanden Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Hisense Japan Automotive Air-Conditioning Systems Corporation.

name: ALMEDIO
businessSummary: Almedio Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing and marketing of sub-materials for electronic parts, refractory materials, and related products in Japan. It operates through Insulation material business and Nano Material business segments. The Insulating Material segment offers ceramic, alumina, and biosoluble fiber  electric furnace and heater module  and molded products. The Nano Material segment develops, produces, and processes nanomaterial products, such as carbon nano fiber, carbon microfiber, synthetic graphene powder, CNF blended pellets for aviation / space, automobile, medical products, and sports / leisure goods industries. The company was formerly known as A-BEX and changed its name to Almedio Inc. in March 1997. Almedio Inc. was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Kunitachi, Japan.

name: HIKARI TSUSHIN
businessSummary: Hikari Tsushin Inc is a holding company mainly engaged in the corporate service business, personal service business, and agency sales business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Corporate Service segment is engaged in the sale of products planned and developed in-house, such as communication line services, electric power, and various systems, to small and medium-sized enterprises. The Personal Service segment mainly sells products planned and developed in-house, such as communication line services and home water distribution, to individuals. The Agency Sales segment is engaged in the sale of various products such as telecommunications carriers, insurance companies, and manufacturers.

name: SG HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SG HOLDINGS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based holding company that provides parcel delivery and comprehensive logistics services. It operates through four business segments. The Delivery Business segment offers parcel delivery, mail services, special correspondence delivery, moving services, food transport, and transport management system (TMS) services. The Logistics Business segment provides logistics system development, inventory storage and inbound/outbound management, logistics center operations, in-facility delivery, delivery agency services, and cold-chain logistics. The Global Logistics Business segment offers international air and sea freight, international parcel delivery, customs brokerage, warehousing, product inspection and needle detection, value-added logistics services, and cross-border e-commerce logistics. The Real Estate Business segment engages in real estate leasing and management, real estate development, asset management and operation, and renewable energy supply.

name: AISIN
businessSummary: Aisin Corp is a Japan-based company mainly manufactures and sells automotive parts. The Company manufactures and sells automotive parts through five geographical segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, China and Association of South-East Asian Nations (ASEAN) & India. The Japan segment also manufactures and sells energy solution-related equipment. The automotive parts include powertrain-related parts including automatic transmissions (AT) and manual transmissions (MT), driving safety-related parts including brake master cylinders and disc brakes, body-related parts including power sliding door systems and power back door systems, and sunroofs, as well as other connected and sharing solutions (CSS)-related parts including car navigation systems. The energy solution-related products include gas heat pump air conditioners (GHP), cogeneration systems and shower toilets, among others. The Company is also engaged in the automotive parts business in Brazil.

name: SENKO GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Senko Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based logistics company mainly engaged in the logistics, trading, life support, business support, and product businesses. The Company operates through five business segments. Logistics segment provides freight trucking, rail transport, sea transport, international freight forwarding, warehousing, packaging and moving of raw materials and products within shippers' premises services, and operation of logistics centers. Trading segment is engaged in the petroleum sales, trading sales, paper products and daily necessities sales. Life Support segment is engaged in the general wholesale and retail store operations, nursing care services, operation of facilities for the elderly and management of sports facilities. Business Support segment is engaged in information processing outsourcing and call center operations. Product segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sales of containers for food, storage, transport, medical use and others.

name: SOTETSU HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sotetsu Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in transportation business, distribution business and others. The Company mainly operates five business segments. Transportation segment provides railway, car business and others. Distribution segment involves in the operation of supermarkets and distribution business. Real Estate segment engages in the sale and leasing of properties. Hotel segment is engaged in the development and operation of hotels. The Others segment engages in the building maintenance business, the supply of heat and other businesses.

isin: 6040.T|NIPPON SKI RESORT DEVELOPMEN|6040.T|Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd.
name: NIPPON SKI RESORT DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manages and operates ski resorts in Japan. It also provides consulting and advisory services on ski resorts, including technical support, business support, designated management, rental business support, and other services  contract management of cableway  and rental of outdoor equipment, as well as manages parking lot. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kitaazumi, Japan. Nippon Ski Resort Development Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Nippon Parking Development Co., Ltd.

name: ASAHI YUKIZAI
businessSummary: ASAHI YUKIZAI CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of industrial resin and plumbing equipment products. The Company operates its business through three business segments. The Pipe System segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of piping materials made of synthetic resin such as vinyl chloride, as well as the design and construction of piping works. The Resin segment manufactures and sells casting resins, resin coated sand for castings, resins for general industrial use, resins for foam materials, resins and derivatives for electronic materials, and resin molding materials. The Water Treatment & Resource Development segment is involved in the design, construction, maintenance and management of water treatment facilities, as well as the design and construction of drilling wells.

name: GEEKLY
businessSummary: Geekly Inc is a Japan-based company which operates a recruitment agency specializing in the information technology (IT), web, and game industries. The Company operates through a single segment: Recruitment Agency. It provides support to both job seekers and companies seeking candidates, primarily for positions such as engineers, creators, and project managers. It also operates Geekly Media, which publishes information on job changes in the IT industry, career development support, industry trends, technology trends, and company interviews. It also operates Geekly Review, a platform that aggregates reviews and selection experience stories about companies in the IT industry, and provides information on companies and the selection process.

name: MINATO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: MINATO HOLDINGS INC. engages in the memory modules, ROM writing services, device programming, telework solutions, and digital-related equipment businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Digital Devices, Digital Engineering, ICT Products, and Others. It is involved in the design, manufacture, and sale of dual inline memory modules, which are computer memory modules for industrial equipment  the sale, maintenance, and distribution of video, audio, and cloud conferencing systems and related equipment  the operation of ROM writing centers  supply of device programming equipment and auto-handler programming systems  and provision of medium and large touch panels, as well as digital signages. The company also engages in the development of websites, business systems, applications, and sales promotions  web production, graphic design, video production, and web promotion, including event production and planning  and investment in digital-related fields. In addition, it offers system construction services  development services comprising software and hardware specifications design, mass production, image and audio processing systems. Further, it offers digital conferencing system-related equipment and services, e-sports-related products, memory and peripherals for digital devices, and enterprise mobility solutions. The company was formerly known as Minato Electronics Inc. and changed its name to MINATO HOLDINGS INC. in July 2015. MINATO HOLDINGS INC. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TERA PROBE
businessSummary: Tera Probe Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in contract wafer testing and final testing within the semiconductor manufacturing process. The semiconductor manufacturing process is generally divided into the front-end process, where semiconductor chips are fabricated on wafers, and the back-end process, where semiconductor chips are assembled and packaged. The inspection performed in the front-end process is called wafer testing, and the inspection performed in the back-end process is called final testing. The Group undertakes both testing processes. Furthermore, the Company contributes to reducing customers' wafer test costs through contracted program development and probe card design, comprehensive support from device evaluation to mass production, and proposals for improving test efficiency.

name: HOKKAIDO ELECTRIC POWER
businessSummary: Hokkaido Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in power generation and retail electricity businesses. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Hokkaido Electric Power Segment is engaged in corporate functions (group headquarters functions) and power generation and retail electricity business. The Hokkaido Electric Power Networks segment is engaged in electric power transmission and distribution. The Others segment includes electrical and telecommunications engineering, comprehensive real estate management, civil engineering and construction work, periodic inspection, maintenance, and repair work at power plants, and telecommunications business.

name: OPTIMUS GROUP
businessSummary: Optimus Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of comprehensive automotive-related service business internationally. It exports and sells used cars from Japan to overseas markets, provides comprehensive services, purchases used cars from Japanese auto auction operators, performs maintenance, decontamination and others for exports, and provides other services. It operates through five business segments. Import/Export segment purchases and sells used cars, with New Zealand as its primary market. Logistics segment focuses on marine transportation for used car exports from Japan and land transportation of new cars to Australia. Services segment provides a range of services for businesses such as used car dealers in New Zealand, and general consumers. Inspection segment provides inspection services necessary for used car exports. Retail/Wholesale segment operates retail and wholesale business for new and used cars, with Australia as its primary market.

name: ELAN
businessSummary: Elan Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the nursing care and medical care related businesses. It mainly provides care support (CS) sets, a service that combines the rental of clothes and towels with laundry service and the provision of daily necessities, to patients admitted to hospitals and users of nursing care facilities such as nursing homes for the elderly, special nursing homes for the elderly, private nursing homes for the elderly, group homes, and care houses. When introducing CS sets, the Company designs plans for the components, provides operational support to hospitals and nursing care facilities for the elderly, and arranges for the delivery of nightwear and other items to linen suppliers. After the introduction, the Company collects usage fees from users and responds to inquiries.

name: ASKUL
businessSummary: ASKUL Corporation engages in e-commerce business in Japan. The company operates ASKUL, a website for small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as SOLOEL ARENA, a website for mid-tier and larger companies that provides office supplies, living supplies, furniture, general medical, pharmaceuticals, and medical equipment products. It also provides various services comprising make printed materials, such as business cards, envelopes, stamps, and personalized novelty goods  office coordinate services  and support services on an e-commerce website where customers can get advice by professional staffs, as well as sells SaaS, communication tools, and seminars for beginners. In addition, the company sells maintenance, repair, and operation supplies  provision of purchase solutions for large companies, and e-commerce website of professional items for dentists  and engages in agent business. Further, it is involved in the operation of e-commerce site for pet and gardening products  provision of logistics and small-cargo transportation, product storage, warehouse management, and delivery services for manufacturers and direct-order companies  and produces and sells bottled natural mineral water. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 5194.T|SAGAMI RUBBER INDUSTRIES|5194.T|Sagami Rubber Industries Co., Ltd.
name: SAGAMI RUBBER INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Sagami Rubber Industries Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies condoms. The company offers polyurethane condoms  plastic products, including packaging tubes and films  assistive devices and daily necessities  and other products, as well as provides research and development services. Sagami Rubber Industries Co., Ltd. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Atsugi, Japan.

isin: 4092.T|Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd.|4092.T|Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd.
name: NIPPON CHEMICAL INDUSTRIAL
businessSummary: Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various chemical products in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company provides inorganic chemical products, including chromium compounds, phosphorus compounds, silicates and silica products, and other inorganic chemicals, such as lithium chloride solution N, sodium sulfate, sodium bisulfate, potassium permanganate, and cuprous oxides. It also offers specialty chemicals, such as electronic ceramic materials, barium compounds, circuit materials, battery materials, organic phosphorus compounds, pharmaceutical intermediates and agrochemicals, pigments and paints, semiconductor materials, as well as other specialty products comprising thiourea  and custom manufacturing. In addition, the company manufactures and sells phosphine derivatives, agricultural chemicals, battery materials, electronic ceramic materials, circuit materials, and high-purity electronic materials. Additionally, it engages in leasing land and buildings to hospitals and retail businesses. Further, the company exports its products to Southeast Asia and other countries. The company was formerly known as Nippon Seiren Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. in March 1944. Nippon Chemical Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 4960.T|Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd.|4960.T|Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd.
name: CHEMIPRO KASEI KAISHA
businessSummary: Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells chemicals in Japan and internationally. It operates through Chemicals Business and Home Industry Business segments. The company offers plastic additives comprising ultraviolet absorbers, which include benzotriazole, benzophenone, triazine, and benzoxazinone  light stabilisers consisting of benzoate and HALS  and antioxidants, such as hindered phenol and thioether. It also provides organic electronic materials, color developers, and corrosion inhibitors  papermaking chemicals  and intermediates for dyestuff, pharmaceutical, and agricultural chemical products. In addition, the company offers plastic additives. Further, it develops, manufactures, and sells wood preservatives, fungicides, and insecticides. Chemipro Kasei Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: WIZE
businessSummary: Wize Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in gaming business in Japan and internationally. It operates game platform. The company engages in the production business of games and digital contents  IP investment development projects  lifestyle Ip business  and digital IP business  and cooking contents business. The company was formerly known as Mobcast Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Wize Inc. in April 2026. Wize Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: COLOPL
businessSummary: Colopl Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment business, and investment and development business. It operates through two segments. The Entertainment segment mainly develops and operates smartphone games. Its main products are native smartphone apps such as Shironeko Project, and Quiz RPG: The World of Mystic Wiz. It also develops and operates blockchain games, plans and develops software for home game consoles and personal computer (PC) games, and undertakes the development of game software released by other companies. The Investment and Development segment invests in information technology (IT) and entertainment companies in Japan and Asia.

name: ALBIS
businessSummary: ALBIS Co.,Ltd. engages in food retailing business in Japan. The company manufactures prepared foods, and tofu products, as well as processes meat products. It is also involved in the reduction of plastic bottles and empty cans  washing of product transport trays and store shopping baskets, as well as general cleaning  bread dough production  and agriculture and welfare collaboration business. ALBIS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Imizu, Japan.

name: TRADERS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Traders Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in foreign exchange and securities trading activities in Japan. The company offers Minna no FX, which provides foreign exchange margin trading services  Minna no Option, which provides forex binary options trading services  LIGHT FX, which offers foreign exchange margin trading services  Minna no Shisutore, which offers system trading of foreign exchange margin trading services  and Minna no Coin, which offers cryptocurrency margin trading services. It is also involved in the investment advisory and agency business  development and maintenance of the financial system  and investment business. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOKYO ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tokyo Electric Power Company Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to electric power. The Company operates through five segments. The Holdings segment provides management support, common services to each core operating company, and nuclear power generation and other businesses. The Fuel & Power segment sells electricity generated by thermal power plants, procures fuel, develops thermal power sources, and invests in fuel businesses. The Power Grid segment supplies electric power through transmission, substation, and distribution, and constructs and maintains transmission, distribution, and communication facilities. The Energy Partner segment proposes total solutions in line with customer requirements, provides services, and conducts power supply procurement business. The Renewable Power segment sells electricity generated from renewable energy sources, maintains and manages facilities, and develops and invests in new renewable energy power sources.

name: TRUE DATA
businessSummary: True Data Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of data marketing-related services. The Company is a provider of data marketing-related services, including the provision of analysis and disclosure support tools that utilize point-of-sale (POS) data with customer identification (ID) from retailers nationwide, including supermarkets and drugstores. Services are divided into solutions for manufacturers, solutions for retailers, and solutions for all industries. The company provides services such as Eagle Eye and Dolphin Eye for manufacturers' solutions, and Shopping Scan for retail solutions. Solutions for all industries are services that provide data, analysis reports, and artificial intelligence (AI) related to consumer purchasing.

name: TOCALO
businessSummary: Tocalo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in thermal spraying, with peripheral areas including thermo-reactive deposition and diffusion (TD) processing, zinc-aluminum coating (ZAC) processing, plasma transferred arc (PTA) processing, and physical vapor deposition (PVD) processing. It operates through three segments. The Thermal Spraying Processing (Standalone) segment provides thermal spraying processing for semiconductor and flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment parts, and industrial machinery parts. The Domestic Subsidiaries segment provides PVD processing for cutting tools, blades, and automotive molds, and manufactures machine tool and precision machinery parts. The Overseas Subsidiaries segment provides surface modification processing, primarily thermal spraying and weld overlay, and thermal spraying, cleaning, and anodizing for semiconductor and FPD manufacturing equipment parts. The Company also provides TD processing, ZAC processing, and PTA processing.

name: SUMITOMO HEAVY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Sumitomo Heavy Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of general heavy machinery. It has four business segments. Mechatronics segment provides transmissions, motors, inverters, laser processing systems and precision positioning devices, and operates in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, China and Japan. Industrial Machinery segment provides plastic processing machinery, cryogenic freezers, accelerators, medical machinery and equipment, forging presses and others in Japan, North America and Europe. Logistics & Construction segment provides hydraulic excavators and road machinery, construction cranes, transport and loading machinery, logistics systems, parking systems and forklifts in Japan, China, Indonesia and North America. Energy & Lifeline segment provides boilers and air pollution control equipment, water treatment equipment, industrial turbines and pumps, reaction vessels, food machinery and ships. It also has real estate, software and other business.

name: NAGASE &
businessSummary: Nagase & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the import, export, manufacture and sale of a wide range of products. The Company operates through five business segments. Functional Materials segment offers raw materials for paints, inks, adhesives, and other products. Processed Materials segment offers dyes, pigments, functional pigments, resins, automotive repair and conductive paints and others. Electronics and Energy segment offers modified epoxy resins, fluorine products, and materials and equipment for semiconductor, display, as well as energy management system proposals, battery evaluation and healthcare services. Mobility segment offers general synthetic resins, and other materials and parts for automobile. Life-related segment offers raw materials for pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals, food additive, cosmetic additives, and radiation measurement service.
