The Company also offers logistics services, information processing and other professional services.

name: TAKASHIMAYA
businessSummary: Takashimaya Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in domestic and overseas department store businesses, as well as domestic and overseas commercial development, financial services, and building and interior finishing. It operates in six segments. The Domestic Department Store Segment and Overseas Department Store Segment primarily sell apparel, general merchandise, household goods, and food products. The Domestic Commercial Development segment and Overseas Commercial Development segment are engaged in commercial development, and the management and operation of assets and facilities. The Financial Services segment acts as an intermediary for financial products, issues credit cards, and conducts financial operations for group companies. The Building and Interior Finishing segment undertakes the contracting and execution of interior construction work. The Company is also involved in mail-order sales, wholesale, advertising, and restaurant businesses.

name: YONDOSHI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yondoshi Holdings Inc. engages in the planning, manufacture, wholesale, and retail of jewelry, apparel, bags, and other products in Japan and internationally. The company offers jewelry products primarily under the 4°C name. It also plans, designs, and manufactures men's and women's wear and luxury watches. In addition, the company engages in the operation of fashion specialty stores and real estate leasing activities. Further, it is involved in managing a network of apparel specialty stores under Pallet brand. The company was formerly known as F&A Aqua Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Yondoshi Holdings Inc. in September 2013. Yondoshi Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: BITCOIN JAPAN
businessSummary: Bitcoin Japan Corporation engages in the manufacture and wholesale of women's clothing products in Japan. It operates through Kimono, Lifestyle, Fashion, and Materials segments. The company plans, produces, and sells twisted yarns  offers women's clothing and home wear products  and wholesales kimono accessories and jewelry to department, specialty, and retail stores  produces gift catalogs for gift items, funeral items, etc. It also provides health products, which include bedding products. The company was formerly known as Marushohotta Co.,Ltd. and change its name to Bitcoin Japan Corporation in November 2025. Bitcoin Japan Corporation was founded in 1861 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Bitcoin Japan Corporation is a subsidiary of RIZAP Group Co., Ltd.

name: AMITA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Amita Holdings Co.,Ltd. develops and provides social design services in Japan and internationally. The company offers Cyano Project, a transition support services for sustainable management which includes carbon neutral, circular economy, and nature positivity promotion support. It also provides Co-Creation City, a sustainable urban development service  and environmental certification audit services based on third-party certification systems. In addition, the company supplies alternative resources to cement manufacturers as alternative raw materials and fuels for cement  and imports and export of alternative resources. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

name: ASAHI KASEI
businessSummary: Asahi Kasei Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the materials business, housing business and healthcare business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Materials segment provides styrene monomer, acrylonitrile, polyethylene, automotive-related fibers, electronic materials, mixed signal large scale integrated circuits (LSI), hall elements, deep ultraviolet light-emitting diodes (LEDs), pharmaceutical and food additives and others. The Housing segment provides construction contracting, renovation and other housing-related business, as well as lightweight aerated concrete (ALC), insulation materials and others. The Healthcare segment provides medical drugs, hemodialysis and apheresis related equipment, virus removal filters, cardiopulmonary resuscitation-related products and others. The Company also provides plant engineering, environmental engineering, various research and information provision businesses, and personnel dispatch and introduction services.

name: ENECHANGE
businessSummary: ENECHANGE Ltd. engages in the energy platform business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Gee Data  EV Charging  and Energy Distribution Platform. The company operates ENECHANGE, an electricity and gas switching service for consumers and ENECHANGE Biz, a platform for switching electricity and gas services for businesses  and cloud-based DX services for electricity and gas utilities and EV services. It is also involved in the provision of EV charging services under the EV Charging Enechange brand name. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: BEMAP
businessSummary: BeMap, Inc. engages in the mobile system integration business in Japan. It offers systems for railways, including route search services  and provides planning, development, and operation of services utilizing transportation IC cards based on the Travel Navigator technology and know-how, as well as content management system(CMS), a information delivery platform that delivers content through a wireless LAN  and offers solutions to various railroad companies. The company also develops and maintains CMS for Wi-Fi  and Wi-Fi authentication systems that supports public wireless LAN services for telecommunication carriers. In addition, it provides surveillance video system and remote access  and cloud-based digital video recording services. Further, the company offers on-air to online to offline solution  TV metadata services  API data service  and website/software development services. BeMap, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: GDEP ADVANCE
businessSummary: GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. engages in the system incubation business in Japan. The company distributes accelerator products, including NVIDIA graphics and computing boards, and XILINX FPGA boards  AI and GPU workstation products  Infiniband network products  servers, such as PCIe GPU, NVIDIA HGX and DGX, ARM-based GPU, and AMD INSTINCT servers  high-end storage products comprising NetApp unified data storage and DDN A3I solution  and file server and NAS QNAP storage products. It also sells software tools comprising Weights & Biases, an experimental management tool for model research  Altair Grid Engine, a distributed resource management system that provides job scheduling, resource management, and other functions  and Altair PBS Professional, a job scheduling software. In addition, the company offers NVIDIA AI Enterprise and NVIDIA Omniverse solutions  cloud rental services  and DX, subscription, implementation and operation support, hardware maintenance, continuous development environment update, support inquiries, maintenance parts stock, dispatch maintenance, performance benchmarks, and private lecture services. Further, it provides AI solutions  visualization solutions for XR and metaverse  storage solutions for big data  and construction and operation system based on customer requests, as well as cloud rental services. GDEP ADVANCE,Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

name: ISEKI &
businessSummary: Iseki & Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of agricultural machinery in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. It offers cultivating machineries, including tractors, tillers, high clearance multipurpose vehicles, and mowers  planting machinery, such as rice and vegetable transplanters  and harvesting machinery comprising combine harvesters and binders. The company also provides processing machinery, such as rice hullers, dryers, rice cleaners, rice graders, vegetable harvesting, and processing machinery  and implements, spare parts, agricultural facilities, as well as diesel engine. Iseki & Co., Ltd. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Arakawa, Japan.

name: GUNZE
businessSummary: GUNZE LIMITED is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture, process and sale of functional materials and machineries, the sale of innerwear, leg wear, textile materials, textiles, real estate business and other related business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Functional Solution segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of plastic-processed functional materials, medical materials and machinery. The Apparel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of clothing and textile materials. The Life Create segment is engaged in the operation of commercial facilities, operates sports clubs, the sale of green trees, and generates solar power business.

name: UNITED SUPER MARKETS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: United Super Markets Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the supermarket business and related support businesses. The Supermarket segment is engaged in the supermarket business, mainly selling food products, daily necessities, and clothing, as well as the fresh food processing business, food processing, manufacturing and sales, vegetable processing and packaging, and prepared food manufacturing. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the real estate business, product development business, quality control and quality inspection business, contract business, temporary staffing business, education business, retail store operation business such as cash registers, facility management business, store support contract business, and agricultural production business.

name: NIPPON PARKING DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Nippon Parking Development Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the parking lot business, the ski resort business and the theme park business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Parking Lots segment is engaged in the operation and management of parking lots, such as direct management, leasing, management, and monthly rental car businesses. The Ski Resorts segment is engaged in the operation and acquisition of ski resorts. The Theme Parks segment is engaged in the operation and acquisition of theme parks. The Company is also engaged in the car sharing business, education business, healthcare business, and renewable energy business, real estate business and other businesses.

name: KYORITSU MAINTENANCE
businessSummary: Kyoritsu Maintenance Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the dormitory management business, hotel business and others. The Company operates in five segments. The Dormitory segment is engaged in the operation of student and company dormitories. The Hotel segment is engaged in the operation of business and resort hotels. The General Building Management segment is engaged in the provision of management services for office buildings and residential buildings. The Foods segment is engaged in the restaurant business, the food catering business and the hotel restaurant business. The Development segment is engaged in the provision of construction, planning, design and brokerage services for real estate, as well as the condominium business and other development related businesses. The Company is also engaged in the management of homes for the elders, the provision of supporting services for single people, the insurance agency business and other related businesses.

name: SYSTEMSOFT
businessSummary: SystemSoft Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in technology business and open innovation business. The Company operates through two segments. The Technology Business segment mainly provides systems development and solution services. Leveraging its strengths in web technology-based system development, the segment has provided system development and solution services over many years to clients in the real estate, information and communications, life and non-life insurance, and education sectors. It also operates a rental real estate information website and offers software as a service (SaaS) solutions, including robotic process automation (RPA) solution services and the SS Cloud series. The Open Innovation Business segment provides consulting services to startup companies for business launch and operates shared office spaces to provide a venue for innovation.

name: VIXTON
businessSummary: VIXTON Corporation manufactures and retails cosmetics and wellness products through e-commerce and other channels. The company offers cosmetics products under the Ex:BEAUTE brand, which involves planning, development, sales, and synergies in regenerative medicine and communication  and beauty and wellness business develops and sells self-care products through TV shopping. It also engages in the regenerative medicine-related businesses, which involves adoption of human-derived cosmetic ingredients, sale of raw materials, and manufacturing OEM products. In addition, the company constructs and operates wood biomass power plants and sewage treatment system  utilizing microalgae cultivation technology  brokering, investing, and managing renewable energy project sites  and provides carbon credits. VIXTON Corporation was formerly known as Path Corporation and changed its name to VIXTON Corporation in September 2026. VIXTON Corporation was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FUJI DIE
businessSummary: Fuji Die Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of wear-resistant tools in Japan and internationally. The company provides die and plug  rolls  motor core, power compacting, and battery-related mold  car manufacturing, kneading and extruding, cold forgiving, precise cutting, steel, ceramic, and tungsten-based alloy tool. It offers tools for drawing, extruding, and rolling processes, which are used in transportation machinery, construction materials, and infrastructure-related facilities  tools and dies for manufacturing beverage and food cans  molds for manufacturing optical elements  forging molds and tools  and high-pressure tools, as well as cemented carbide for motor lamination stamping and nano grade cemented carbide. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MATERIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Material Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates three businesses: public relations (PR) consulting business, digital marketing business, and PR platform business. The PR Consulting Business segment provides support from strategy design to implementation of measures to deliver information on corporate brands, products, and services to consumers, consumers, and other stakeholders through the media and social networking service (SNS), and to increase awareness and transform perceptions, mainly through various PR methods and marketing communication measures, including advertising. The Digital Marketing Business segment provides support for the design and execution of marketing communication strategies in the digital domain, creative advertising production services, and sales of the Flipdesk web-based customer service tool. The PR Platform Business segment provides CLOUD PRESS ROOM, a platform for connecting with the media in real life and on the Web.

name: SHINWA
businessSummary: Shinwa Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of metal products. It operates through two business segments. The Temporary Materials Department segment provides temporary material rental services, consigned manufacturing of OEM products, with the main objective being the manufacture and sale of temporary materials used at construction sites. The Logistics Equipment segment mainly manufactures and sells physical distribution equipment used for storage and transportation of goods in factories, warehouses and construction sites.

name: CHUGOKU ELECTRIC POWER
businessSummary: Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electric power business, comprehensive energy supply business and information and communication business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Electric Power Business segment supplies electricity based on the Chugoku region as the basis for business development. The Comprehensive Energy Supply Business segment is engaged in the sale of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and provision of energy utilization services such as electricity and heat sales. The Information and Communications Business segment provides telecommunications services and information processing services that utilize information and communication technology (ICT). The Company also provides environmental harmony creation, business and life support, and electric power business support.

name: DAICEL
businessSummary: Daicel Corporation is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cellulose products, organic synthetic products, synthetic resin products, pyrotechnic products and others. The Company operates in five business segments. The Cellulose segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cellulose acetate, acetate tow for cigarette filters, carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC) and hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC). The Organic Synthesis segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of acetic acid derivatives, epoxy compounds, semiconductor resist materials and others. The Synthetic Resins segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of polyester resins, wrapping plastics and others. The Pyrotechnic segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of propellant powder and emergency evacuation systems for aircraft passengers, among others. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of production innovation services and other businesses.

name: ITMEDIA
businessSummary: ITmedia Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of specialized online media services, delivering news, technical commentary, and other professional information centered on information technology (IT). The Company operates through two business segments. The BtoB Media business provides services in the IT and business fields, including TechTarget Japan, Keyman's Net, @IT, ITmedia NEWS, ITmedia Marketing, ITmedia Enterprise, ITmedia Executive, and ITmedia AI+, as well as industrial technology fields including MONOist, EE Times Japan, EDN Japan, TechFactory, and BUILT. It also offers digital events, research, and consulting services. The BtoC Media business provides consumer-oriented media services, including ITmedia Mobile, ITmedia PC USER, Fav-Log, and other related media platforms.

name: TEKKEN
businessSummary: TEKKEN CORPORATION is a company primarily engaged in the civil engineering business and construction business. The Civil Engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering works. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction works. The Real Estate segment is engaged in businesses related to house and land development. The Ancillary segment engages in the sales of equipment and materials related to civil engineering work. The Others segment is engaged in the the operation of sports facilities, as well as private finance initiative businesses.

name: TMS
businessSummary: TMS Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of drug products, quasi-drugs, drug substances, medical devices, and medical commodities. The company is developing TMS-007, a stachybotrys microspora triprenyl phenol (SMTP) congener with prothrombolytic and anti-inflammatory/antioxidative activities, which has completed Phase 2a clinical trials for acute ischemic stroke treatment  and TMS-008, an SMTP congener with anti-inflammatory/antioxidative activities under nonclinical development for inflammatory complications, such as acute kidney injury and cancer cachexia. It is also developing TMS-009, a product candidate in preclinical development. In addition, the company has a collaboration with Hokkaido University to evaluate the potential of the drug candidate compounds as novel drugs. TMS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

name: DENSO
businessSummary: Denso Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of automotive parts in the areas of thermal systems, powertrain systems, mobility electronics, electrification systems, advanced devices, and non-automotive business. The Company operates through four segments, including Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. Thermal system products include passenger thermals and commercial thermals. Powertrain system products include injection equipment, and engine equipment. Mobility electronics products include electronics products, and safety system products. Electrification system products include electrification components, power mobility electronics, and motors. Advanced device products include mechatronics systems, and sensing systems. Non-automotive business includes AUTO-ID-related products, and factory automation (FA)-related products. The Company also operates business activities through local subsidiaries in South America and other regions.

name: ISHIKAWA SEISAKUSHO
businessSummary: Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. engages in paper converting machinery business in Japan. It offers corrugated cardboard box making and printing machines, cardboard weight packaging machines, and yarn twisting machines, as well as defense equipment. The company was formerly known as Ishii Iron Works and changed its name to Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. in July 1938. Ishikawa Seisakusho, Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Hakusan, Japan.

name: I CUBED SYSTEMS
businessSummary: i Cubed Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of management services for managing mobile terminals as Software as a Service (SaaS), and the investing activities. The Company operates through two business segments. The CLOMO business segment provides functions for visualizing the usage status of mobile terminals, setting and restricting functions, and security measures as licenses, centered on CLOMO MDM, a mobile device management (MDM) service that centrally manages and operates mobile terminals and mobile personal computers (PCs). The CLOMO business segment also sells licenses for CLOMO SECURED APPs, which are applications for mobile terminals. The main services include CLOMO service and SECURED APPs service. The Investment Business segment is engaged in investment activities through corporate venture capital (CVC) and mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The main investment targets include mobile, SaaS, security and others.

name: DAIKEN CORPORATION OSAKA
businessSummary: DAIKEN CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of eco-friendly materials, wooden interior building materials and housing equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of eco-friendly materials including insulation boards, die lawn, die light, medium-density fiberboard, tatami mats, eco-boards. The Building Materials segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of wooden interior building materials and housing equipment. The Engineering segment is engaged in interior construction of buildings, condominiums and stores, renovation and repair of houses, as well as apartment renovation business. The Company is also engaged in the purchase and sale of products such as plywood.

name: TBS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TBS Holdings Inc, formerly Tokyo Broadcasting System Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in broadcasting business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Media and Content segment is involved in the broadcasting-related business which conducts broadcasting, program production, video technology, audio technology, cable television broadcasting (CATV) investment, video investment and others; the planning production business which conducts video and audio software production, sales and distribution business, various events, program sales, video software production and sales, animation and music software planning and production. The Lifestyle segment is involved in the mail-order sales, general merchandise retailing, cosmetics manufacturing and sales business. The Real Estate and Others segment is involved in real estate leasing, maintenance and service business, studio management, heating and cooling management, insurance agency and other business.

name: FRUTA FRUTA
businessSummary: Fruta Fruta Inc. engages in the marketing and selling of fruits and foods in Japan. Its products include drinks, frozen purees, frozen desserts, confectionery, diet foods, freeze-dried powder, vinegar, granola, etc., and raw materials, such as fruit pulp, freeze-dried powder, concentrated extract, ground pulp, agroforestry cocoa beans, acai oil, fruit oils, etc. The company sells its products through retail, wholesale, direct sales, e-commerce, as well as operates stores. It also exports its products. Fruta Fruta Inc. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: HITOMILE
businessSummary: HitoMile Co Ltd, formerly Kakuyasu Group Co Ltd, is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in formulating management strategies and providing support to each group company for the sustainable growth of the Company's group. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Time Delivery business segment provides free delivery service 365 days a year and free of charge on a one-hour time frame to individual restaurants, general consumers, and corporate customers from locations such as small shipping warehouses and Nandemo Sakeya Kakuyasu stores. The Route Delivery business segment makes daily deliveries from distribution centers to customers such as restaurant chains, hotels and restaurants. The In-Store Sales business segment provides in-store sales to customers who visit the various Nandemo Sakeya Kakuyasu stores. The Company also engages in e-commerce (EC) business, wholesale business to other alcoholic beverage distributors, and logistics.

isin: 7183.T|ANSHIN GUARANTOR SERVICE|7183.T|Anshin Guarantor Service Co., Ltd.
name: ANSHIN GUARANTOR SERVICE
businessSummary: Anshin Guarantor Service Co., Ltd. engages in the rent obligation guarantee business in Japan. Its products include Anshin Plus, Life Anshin Plus, Anshin Plus AC, and APLUS Anshin Rent Guarantee. The company also provides online application and divided remittance services. Anshin Guarantor Service Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan. As of July 2, 2026, Anshin Guarantor Service Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Muninova Holdings Inc.

isin: 8558.T|The Towa Bank, Ltd.|8558.T|The Towa Bank, Ltd.
name: TOWA BANK
businessSummary: The Towa Bank, Ltd. provides various banking products and services. It offers deposit, lending, domestic foreign exchange services, foreign exchange services and other services. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Maebashi, Japan.

name: PARACA
businessSummary: Paraca Inc. operates and manages parking lots in Japan. The company operates and manages parking lots  engages in asset management and fundraising consulting and related services. It also engages in the solar, wind, geo thermal power generation business. Paraca Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Minato, Japan.

name: BEAUTY GARAGE
businessSummary: BEAUTY GARAGE Inc. is primarily engaged in selling beauty equipment, store design business and other solution business. The Company operates in three segments. The Merchandising segment sells beauty equipment and cosmetics through Internet site, mail catalog and show room. In addition to purchasing from manufacturers, it also develops its own original brand products, and purchases and sells used beauty equipment. The Store Design segment is engaged in store design and construction supervision. The Other Related Solutions segment is engaged in providing a range of resources services for beauty salon operation.

name: TAMURA
businessSummary: Tamura Corporation manufactures and sells electronic components, electronic chemical packaging, and information equipment in Japan, China, other Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers electronic components, including transformers, reactors, choke coils, gate drivers, isolated DC-DC converter module, current sensors, high voltage power supplies, bolt-clamped langevin type transducers, SOLIDFORMER relay, piezoelectric transformer, transducers, and ultrasonic sensors products. It also provides solder pastes, carbon pastes, joint reinforcement paste, solder sheet, photo-imageable solder masks, materials for display, photosensitive coverlay film, flux, and OSP  reflow oven and flow soldering systems, spray fluxer, and other related equipment  and broadcast studio and communication systems. Tamura Corporation was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: GUNGHO ONLINE ENTERTAINMENT
businessSummary: GungHo Online Entertainment Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of online games via the Internet. The Company is mainly engaged in the planning, development, operation and distribution of smartphone games. The main products in smartphone games are Puzzle & Dragons, Ragnarok M: Eternal Love, Puzzle Radar, Summons Board, Kerihime Sweets, Yokai Watch World, TEPPEN. The Company is also engaged in the planning, development, operation, distribution and sale of consumer game software for home-use game consoles and portable game consoles, the production of game software, as well as the sale of products to customers through wholesale trading companies, retail stores and content distributors.

name: HANKYU HANSHIN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Hankyu Hanshin Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in transportation, real estate and other businesses. It operates in six business segments. The City Transportation segment is involved in the railway, automobile, distribution, advertisement and city transportation businesses. The Real Estate segment is mainly engaged in the real estate leasing and sales businesses. The Entertainment and Communication segment is engaged in the sports, stage, communication media and leisure businesses. The Travel segment is involved in the provision of traveling. The International Transportation segment involves in the international transportation business. The Hotel segment is engaged in the hotel business. The Company is also involved in the businesses including construction and environment business, group cards business, group financial business, human resource and accounting agency business, among others.

name: TAIHEIYO KOUHATSU
businessSummary: Taiheiyo Kouhatsu Incorporated engages in the coal and mining equipment sale business in Japan. The company is also involved in the comprehensive management of condominium and buildings  leasing and brokerage of real estate  marine transportation  sales of construction materials and petroleum  and insurance agency services, as well as warehousing business  providing senior citizens with various services features such as urban hotels, peace of mind enlisting our attentive care, and tranquility reminiscent of home. In addition, it manufactures and sells biomass fuel, wood, and building made materials  offers general freight vehicle transportation services, warehousing, construction, and design of various plant equipment, as well as provides information processing services. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: EVERY
businessSummary: every,Inc. owns and operates various platforms that provide video media and advertising solutions in Japan. The company's platforms include Delish Kitchen, which delivers recipe videos  retail HUB, including Store DX, which involves installing digital signage in retail stores  Tomonite, which helps with child-rearing  and MOMENTH, which offers services that address companies' marketing challenges. It also offers advertising solutions, including tie-up ads, display ads, and store vision ads. every,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: NIPPO
businessSummary: NIPPO LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial materials and plastic molded articles. The Company has four business segments. The Mobility segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin molded products such as powertrain mechanical components and electronic control components for automobiles. The Electronics segment is engaged in the sale of electric materials, parts, jigs and equipment for manufacturers of electronic components and clean energy. The Precision Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of resin molded products for office automation equipment, digital imaging equipment and medical equipment. The Household Equipment segment is engaged in the sale of resin molded articles, control units for blinds and nursing beds, high functional materials and equipment. The Company is also engaged in the radio frequency identifier (RFID) business.

isin: 2170.T|Link and Motivation Inc.|2170.T|Link and Motivation Inc.
name: LINK AND MOTIVATION
businessSummary: Link and Motivation Inc. provides consulting and cloud services in Japan. The company operates through Development Division, Individual Development Division, and Matching Division segments. The company offers human capital management  motivation cloud, an HRTech (Human Resources x Technology) solution that helps resolve issues  and HR transformation services, including diagnostics and solutions covering all areas of recruitment, and training, and organizational. It also provides mid-career employee training, management training, training for young people, human resources recruitment services. In addition, the company offers ALT placement that support for matching individuals from overseas seeking to work in Japan with local governments and openwork, a recruiting platform, as well as IR support services, including support for helping companies improve investor engagement. Further, it operates career school programs to support career advancement by providing courses for obtaining qualifications, as well as courses for elementary, junior high, and high school students  cram school to support for improving the academic skills of elementary, junior high, and high school students  and venture incubation services. Link and Motivation Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KIYO LEARNING
businessSummary: KIYO Learning Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the e-learning and education business. The Company provides cloud services that use information technology (IT) to streamline learning to individuals and companies. The Company is involved in the STUDYing business, which is an online qualification course for individuals, as well as the AirCourse business, which is an employee education cloud service for corporations. STUDYing is a concept-based online qualification course which provides about 26 courses for business person on smartphones, tablets, personal computers (PCs) and others. AirCourse is involved in the provision of employee education, the creating and delivering training courses, as well as the provision of centralized management of in-house education.

name: FIRST BANK OF TOYAMA
businessSummary: First Bank of Toyama Ltd is mainly engaged in banking business and financial services related business such as leasing business. The Bank mainly operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in deposit business, lending business, domestic exchange business, foreign exchange business, and commodity securities trading business. The Company also conducts banking business, including bank administrative services. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing business. The Bank is also engaged in credit business, credit guarantee business and money lending business.

name: MITSUBISHI PENCIL
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Pencil Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the writing instruments and writing instrument peripheral products business and other businesses. It operates through two segments. The Writing Instruments and Writing Instrument Peripheral Products segment manufactures and sells writing instruments and peripheral products such as cosmetics, which utilize the technology cultivated in the writing instrument business. Products include ballpoint pens, multi-function pens and customized pens, mechanical pencils, felt-tip pens and markers, pencils and colored pencils, seals and name pens, office and school supplies, and green nets. The Other Business segment is mainly involved in the manufacture and sale of adhesive tape and the sale of handicrafts.

name: PIXELA
businessSummary: Pixela Corporation develops and sells digital devices and software in Japan and internationally. The company offers wellness products, TV tuner for PC/smartphone, SIM/SIM-free products, camera software, wearable IoT products, display, TV/video capture, and video editing/DVD authoring products. It also engages in the OEM and retail sale of digital TV capture hardware for PCs  sale of OEM digital TV broadcast viewing and recording application middleware  sale of hardware and software products, IP-STBs for CATV, and other devices  and OEM sale of full and one-segment reception application software and in-car tuner products. In addition, the company is involved in the provision of video editing application software, including MediaBrowser, VideoBrowser, and ImageMixer  development of AV home appliance products  and development of IoT-related products. Pixela Corporation was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

isin: 6495.T|Miyairi Valve Mfg. Co., Ltd.|6495.T|Miyairi Valve Mfg. Co., Ltd.
name: MIYAIRI VALVE MFG
businessSummary: Miyairi Valve Mfg. Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various valves in Japan. The company offers brass products, such as LP gas cylinder, screw-end globe, filling, screw-end ball, and safety valves, as well as couplings and valves for bulk system. It also provides steel products, including globe, Y-shaped, ball, check, strainer, safety, filling, and emergency shut-off valves. In addition, the company provides level indicators, manifold distribution systems, and other products. Its products are used in LP gas cylinders, LPG supplying lines, LP gas filling devices, bulk storage tanks, gas transportation, cryogenic valve for LNG, and storage tanks and piping applications. Miyairi Valve Mfg. Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: DAISHINKU
businessSummary: Daishinku Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic components and equipment in Japan, North America, Europe, China, Taiwan, and Asia. The company offers crystal resonators and oscillators, monolithic crystal filters, MEMS oscillators, and hermetic seal products. Its products are used in various applications, including wearable devices, smart phones, IoT, automotive electronics, semiconductor embedded, and FA equipment. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Kakogawa, Japan.

name: STG
businessSummary: STG Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the casting, processing and sale of metal parts. The Company is mainly engaged in the design of metal molds, as well as the casting, processing, finishing and chemical conversion of magnesium alloy parts and other metal parts. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of magnesium alloy parts and other metal parts for projectors, single-lens reflex cameras, automobiles, copiers and medical devices.

name: KYOTO FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Kyoto Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management of banks and companies that can be designated as subsidiaries under the Banking Act, as well as related businesses. It is primarily engaged in banking, leasing, credit card, and financial instruments trading businesses, and other financial services. The banking business includes deposits, lending, trading of commodity securities, securities investment, domestic foreign exchange, foreign exchange, and trust services. It also operates an e-commerce mall, provides consulting services, economic surveys and research, financial instruments trading, investment services, business rehabilitation and debt management, credit guarantee services, and investment management services through its subsidiaries.

name: TOKYU
businessSummary: Tokyu Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation business, real estate business, leisure service business, as well as hotel and resort business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Transportation segment is engaged in the operation of railways and airports, the provision of bus transportation services, as well as the railway related business. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the sale, management, leasing and brokerage of real estate, as well as the construction business. The Leisure Service segment in engaged in the operation of department stores, chain stores and shopping centers, as well as the credit cards business, cable television business, advertising agency business and video business. The Hotel and Resort segment is engaged in the operation of hotels and golf courses.

name: POPER
businessSummary: POPER Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of software as a service (SaaS) business management platform for educational providers, mainly for cram schools. The Company provides the SaaS business management platform Comiru, the online class and home study support service ComiruAir, and the labor management and communication service ComiruHR for instructors. The SaaS business management platform Comiru offers three plans, Comiru FREE, Comiru BASIC and Comiru PRO, to improve the efficiency of back office operations and strengthen communication with parents. The online class and home study support service ComiruAir supports online classes and home study for students. The labor management and communication service ComiruHR for instructors, efficiently adjusts shifts for instructors, aggregates salaries and labor, and communicates related to these.

name: MITSUBISHI GAS CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Co Inc is a Japan-based chemical company. The Company operates in two business segments. The Green Energy & Chemicals segment manufactures and sells methanol, methanol and ammonia-based chemicals, life science products, general aromatic chemicals, special aromatic chemicals, foam plastics, and electricity. The Performance Chemicals segment manufactures and sells inorganic chemicals, engineering plastics, optical materials, electronic materials, and oxygen absorbers. The other businesses include procurement and sales.

name: OSAKA STEEL
businessSummary: Osaka Steel Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company group is comprehensively engaged in the production and sale of ordinary steel products, as well as their transportation. It is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products such as steel sections, bars, and flat steel, as well as steel billets and processed steel products, as well as the transportation and on-site work of steel products.

name: SAN IN GODO BANK
businessSummary: San-in Godo Bank Ltd operates business related to financial services such as leasing, and credit guarantee, with a focus on banking. The Bank operates in two business segments. The Banking segment is engaged in the deposit, loan, securities investment, domestic exchange, foreign exchange, bond and bond registration businesses through the head office and branches. The Leasing segment is involved in the leasing business. The others business is engaged in the banking, leasing and credit guarantee business.

name: EARTH INFINITY
businessSummary: Earth Infinity Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the energy business and electronic equipment businesses. The energy business outsources supply and demand management to intermediaries, and uses electricity procured from private power plants and electricity procured through market transactions with the Japan Electric Power Exchange using the power transmission and distribution network owned by general power transmission and distribution business operators, supplies electricity to customers in each business area. In addition, the business conducts sales activities centered on direct sales by employees. The electronic equipment business mainly offers energy cost reduction proposals and consulting by manufacturing, selling, and installing electronic breakers (breakers with built-in computers) for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: AI INSIDE
businessSummary: AI inside Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in artificial intelligence (AI) business. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of DX Suite which is an AI-OCR service with a user interface. DX Suite includes applications called Intelligent OCR, Elastic Sorter and Multi Form. Intelligent OCR is a service that reads standard forms and converts them into digital data based on handwritten character recognition technology. Elastic Sorter is an option of Intelligent OCR that selects and sorts the same type of forms when multiple types of forms are scanned in random order. Multi Form is an option of Intelligent OCR that reads non-standard forms other than standard forms and converts them into digital data including structured data. In addition, the Company is also engaged in the development of AI inside Cube which is an edge computing hardware that performs AI processing without requiring access to the cloud.

name: KATO WORKS
businessSummary: KATO WORKS CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of construction cranes, hydraulic excavators, and other products. The Company operates through Japan, China, and other region three geography segments. Products are cargo handling equipment, including all hydraulic truck cranes, rough terrain cranes, all terrain cranes, on-board truck cranes, crawler cranes; construction equipment, including hydraulic excavators, earth drills for foundation work, mini excavators, crawler carriers; industrial machinery, including vacuum suction road sweepers, universal suction trucks, snow sweepers; and forestry machines, including forwarders and tower yarders.

name: NIPPON CHEMI CON
businessSummary: Nippon Chemi-Con Corporation manufactures and sells aluminum and other capacitors, precision mechanical components, and electronics equipment in Japan, China, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers aluminum electrolytic capacitors, multilayer ceramic capacitors, supercapacitors, metal oxide varistors, coils and cores inductors, camera modules, wafers, and modules, as well as design tools. The company was founded in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ADVANCE CREATE
businessSummary: Advance Create Co., Ltd. engages in the insurance agency, ASP, media, media rep, reinsurance, and BPO businesses in Japan. The company offers life and non-life insurance products  and short-term insurance, including medical, pension, corporate, fire, automobile, and other types of insurance products to general customers and corporations through direct marketing, telemarketing, face to face sales, and collaborative sales. It is involved in advertising sales  operation of insurance Market website  provision of reinsurance contract for medical insurance  sale of cloud services, such as customer management systems  and undertakes various insurance maintenance work. Advance Create Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: J LEASE
businessSummary: J-Lease Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the guarantee-related business, with a focus on rent guarantees for rental housing, offices and tenants, as well as the real estate related business and information technology (IT) related business. It operates through three business segments. The Guarantee Related Business segment provides rent guarantees for residential properties, commercial properties, parking lots and rental boxes, medical expenses guarantee services for medical institutions' unpaid medical receivables and child support guarantee services for single-parent households. The Real Estate Related Business segment provides rental brokerage services for foreign nationals looking for housing in Japan, rental management services for real estate owners and real estate rental services. The IT Related Business segment sells environmental inspection systems, develops software on a contract basis, and sells systems.

name: OHMOTO GUMI
businessSummary: OHMOTO GUMI CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in civil engineering and construction works. The Company operates in two business segments. The Construction segment is involved in the provision of construction work. The Civil Engineering segment is involved in the provision of civil engineering works. The others business includes the environmental improvement business, as well as the insurance agency business.

name: PASSLOGY
businessSummary: Passlogy Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in development and sale of authentication security software which based on identity authentication technology. The Company is mainly engaged in own product development business. PassLogic is an authentication security software for enterprises and organizations that has been commercialized as an authentication system using the pass logic method of the its own authentication technology. It provides PassLogic products to customers mainly through distributors and service providers.

name: SAWAI GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sawai Group Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of medical and over-the-counter drugs. The Company operates in two segments. The Japan segment is engaged in medical and healthcare-related businesses such as manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals and medical devices, as well as various related businesses. The America segment is engaged in the sale of manufactured pharmaceutical products to wholesale stores in America. The company is also engaged in the research and development of pharmaceutical products.

name: HOWTELEVISION
businessSummary: Howtelevision, Inc. mainly operates carrier platform business through the operation and management of the recruiting platform gaishishukatsu.com, Liiga and Elite Youth Recruiting DSP. The gaishishukatsu.com is a new graduate student recruitment platform, posting the recruiting information of companies. Liiga aims to support the skill development and career development of young working people who are registered members through columns, case studies and industry research. The DSP service collects fees by advertising distribution companies through the management of Elite Youth Recruiting DSP, an advertising distribution platform specialized for Elite Youth.

name: ITO EN
businessSummary: Ito En Ltd is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tea and drinks. The Company operates in three business segments. The Leaf and Drink related segment purchases and manufactures tea leaf products, and sells them throughout Japan, mainly green tea, barley tea, and oolong tea. This segment also plans and develops beverage products, outsources production to manufacturers outside the group, and then purchases the finished products and sells them nationwide. The Food and Drink related segment operates and franchises restaurants of specialty coffee in Japan. The Others segment is involved in the manufacture and sell of supplements in United States.

name: HACHIJUNI NAGANO BANK
businessSummary: Hachijuni Nagano Bank Ltd, formerly Hachijuni Bank Ltd, is mainly engaged in the provision of financial services, including banking business and leasing business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit, loan, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and others. This segment is also engaged in the provision of credit card services, credit guarantee services, and debt management and collection services through its subsidiaries. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of leasing services. The Company is also engaged in securities trading, investment, investment management, regional trading, and electric power (power generation) businesses.

name: SAIBU GAS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells natural gas in Japan. It operates through four segments: Gas, LPG, Electricity and Other Energy, and Real Estate. The Gas segment includes the production, supply, and sale of city gas, sales of gas appliances, gas piping construction, LNG sales, and renovation services. The LPG segment covers the sale of LPG, LPG equipment, and related construction work. The Electricity and Other Energy segment comprises electricity sales, heat supply, and solar power generation, as well as international energy business such as overseas LNG shipments. The Real Estate segment involves the sale, leasing, and management of real estate, including residential construction and land development. The company also provides information processing services, investment activities, restaurant operations, and manufactures and sells carbon materials, paints, and chemical products. The company was formerly known as Saibu Gas Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. in April 2021. Saibu Gas Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: JCU
businessSummary: JCU Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the chemicals business and the equipment business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Chemicals segment handles plating chemicals for printed circuit boards, electronic components, semiconductors, automotive parts and housing materials. The Equipment segment handles plating equipment for printed circuit boards and automotive parts, cleaning equipment for printed circuit boards utilizing plasma technology, power sales from solar power generation and liquid management systems. The Company is also involved in the cultivation and sale of grapes and seedlings for wine production.

name: KUREHA
businessSummary: Kureha Corporation manufactures and sells functional materials, specialty chemicals, and plastics in Japan and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Advanced Materials, Specialty Chemicals, Specialty Plastics, Construction, and Other Operations. The Advanced Materials segment offers polyphenylene sulfide, polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), processed polyglycolic acid products, carbon fiber, and bead-shaped activated carbon products. The Specialty Chemicals segment provides therapeutic agents for chronic kidney disease, agricultural and horticultural fungicides, caustic soda, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, monochlorobenzene, para-dichlorobenzene, and ortho-dichlorobenzene. The Specialty Plastics segment offers household plastic wraps, drain bags for kitchen sinks, plastic food containers, cooking sheets, PVDF fishing lines, polyvinylidene chloride film, automatic filling and sealing machines for food packaging. The Construction segment provides civil engineering and construction contracting, and construction supervision services. The Other Operations segment offers industrial waste treatment and environmental processing facilities  physiochemical analysis, measurement, testing, and inspection services  and transportation and warehousing, and medical services. It serves to various application such as agriculture, fishery, medical and welfare, energy, infrastructure, transportation, construction industry, automobile, daily necessities, packaging materials, home appliances, interior, and factory. The company was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NISSAN MOTOR
businessSummary: Nissan Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles and parts, as well as the provision of sales financial services. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles, compact cars, light cars, minivans, commercial vehicles, trucks, micro buses and other automobiles, as well as related parts. The Sales Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business and the leasing business to support sales activities of automobile business.

name: MILBON
businessSummary: Milbon Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, as well as related service businesses. The products it manufactures or handles are divided into five categories, including hair care products, hair dyes, permanent wave products, cosmetics, and others. Hair care products include shampoos, hair treatments, hair tonics, hair creams, liquid and foam hair styling products, setting lotions, and hair sprays. Hair dyes include oxidative hair dyes, acidic hair dyes, hair dyes, and hair bleaches. Permanent wave products include thioglycolic acid-based permanent wave products, cysteine-based permanent wave products, and hair straighteners. Cosmetics include skin care and makeup cosmetics. Others include health foods and beauty equipment.

name: ASULINA
businessSummary: ASULINA Co.,Ltd. engages in the renewable energy business in Japan. It is also involved in the purchasing of solar power plants  sale of electricity generated at solar power plants  emergency generator business  OEM supply of sterilization equipment for the purpose of infection prevention  and manufacture and sale basic cosmetics and health food. The company was formerly known as G Three Holdings Corporation and changed its name to ASULINA Co.,Ltd. in February 2026. ASULINA Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: REMIXPOINT
businessSummary: Remixpoint Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital asset management business, energy business, and energy storage solutions business. It operates through four business segments. The Digital Asset Management Business segment is engaged in investment and financing related to cryptocurrency investment, stock investment, and loans. The Energy Business segment is engaged in electricity trading. The Energy Storage Solutions Business segment is engaged in energy saving support consulting, storage battery sales, and infectious disease prevention products sales. The Other Business segment is engaged in marketing consulting.

name: KIYO BANK
businessSummary: Kiyo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to financial services, centering on the banking business. The Banking business is engaged in deposit, lending, domestic and foreign exchange, and other services. The Company is also engaged in office work agency services, job placement services, credit guarantee services, leasing services, venture capital services, investment services, credit card services, program creation and sales, and contracted computing services.

name: 77 BANK
businessSummary: 77 Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of banking services, leasing services, and financial services such as credit card services. The Company operates through the Banking Business segment. Banking business includes deposit business, lending business, commodity securities trading business, securities investment business, domestic foreign exchange business, foreign exchange business, corporate bond trust business, agency business, debt guarantee (payment acceptance), government bonds, investment trust, over-the-counter sales of insurance products. The leasing business is engaged in financial-related leasing activities. It is also engaged in credit guarantee business, credit card business, financial product transaction business, research and consulting business, outsourcing of calculation business using electronic computing equipment, fund management business, and investment business.

name: HALMEK HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Halmek Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the platform business for seniors, publishing the magazine Halmek, developing and selling products, and providing services such as travel and courses. The Company operates through two segments. The Halmek business segment is engaged in the publication of Halmek, a magazine for senior women, mail order business Halmek, advertising business, cultural business such as events, external sales of newspapers, and store operation business. The Nationwide Mail Order business segment is engaged in the mail order business Cotose for senior women and the advertising business.

name: KURODA PRECISION INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Kuroda Precision Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells drive, mold, and machinery and measurement systems in Japan. The company offers support tools, precision ground ball screws, and custom ball/JIS standard screws  ball screw actuators  line motion guides, support-units, greases, and feed screws  surface grinding machines  laminated precision press tools for motor core  and precision metal press products/motor core products. It also provides parallel thread, taper thread/taper pipe thread, oil country, master/plain, and taper gauges  gauge blocks, test bars, and measuring instruments  wafer flatness measuring systems, wafer flatness/SORI measuring systems, and surface and flatness measuring systems, as well as surface and flatness measuring systems for large discs. In addition, the company offers hydraulic tools  and minimal quantity lubrication systems, as well as clamping force tester and machine gauge. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Gauge Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kuroda Precision Industries Ltd. in June 1965. Kuroda Precision Industries Ltd. was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

name: MUROMACHI CHEMICALS
businessSummary: Muromachi Chemicals Inc. plans, produces, and distributes pharmaceuticals, health foods, and chemicals in Japan. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediate synthesis products  commissioned processing services for pharmaceuticals  and import and sale of active pharmaceutical ingredients  and radioisotope. The company also provides ion-exchange resins  separation membranes  water-treatment products  and contract processing services, as well as engages in the manufacturing and sales of urea solutions. In addition, it provides functional adhesives, functional pastes, greases, conductive adhesives, UV-curable adhesives, Blut-Z serum and plasma separation materials, static electricity control products, liquid removal rolls, screen printing machines, UV irradiation machines, laminator equipment, and adhesive and functional paste contract manufacturing, processing, and filling services. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Omuta, Japan.

name: DMG MORI
businessSummary: DMG Mori Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of solutions covering machine tools such as machining centers, turning centers, multi-tasking machines, 5-axis machines, additive manufacturing machines, and other products, software such as user interfaces, technology cycles and embedded software, measuring equipment, repair and restoration support, applications, and engineering. The Company operates in two business segments. The Machine Tools segment manufactures and sells machine tools. The Industrial Services segment provides services and solutions related to machine tools, manufactures and sells measuring equipment, and develops and sells software, image processing hardware.

name: SILICON STUDIO
businessSummary: Silicon Studio Corporation develops game engine and middleware products in Japan and internationally. It operates through two segments, development promotion and support business and human resources business. The company offers YEBIS, an optical effects middleware  Enlighten, process global illumination in real time while minimizing the load on GPU  Mizuchi, the real-time rendering engine used in gaming and virtual reality (VR), video and animation, product and architectural visualization, etc.  Motion Portrait, a CG technology to create facial animation from a digital photo  and Enlighten, a lighting technology that delivers real-time global illumination over mobile, desktop, and VR platforms. It offers human resource services comprising development, consulting, outsourcing, and staffing, including temporary, temporary-to-permanent, and full-time placement services. In addition, it offers various solutions comprising training image solutions for machine learning  game engine use in the industrial field  3D digital twin/industrial metaverse  urban space visualization  design review solution  driving simulator compatible solution  digital twin solutions using point clouds and photogrammetry  online, cloud development solutions  and game development environment construction support. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: IYOGIN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Iyogin Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in financial services such as leasing, with a focus on banking operations. It operates through two business segments. The Banking segment is involved in deposit services, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, banking agency services, credit guarantee services, credit card services, and investment fund management. The Leasing segment is involved in leasing services. It is also involved in information processing contracting, software development, and securities businesses.

name: ASIAQUEST
businessSummary: AsiaQuest Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital transformation (DX) business that supports system development, process improvement and business model transformation of client companies. The Company is engaged in the provision of Internet of Things (IoT) and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, Web system and mobile application development services and cloud infrastructures. The IoT and AI solution service is engaged in the development of systems that utilize sensors, AI and big data. The Web system and mobile application development service is engaged in the development of Web systems and mobile applications, and the provision of interface design services, system architecture design services and others. The cloud infrastructure construction and operation service is engaged in the provision of cloud integration services such as migration works and cloud environment construction works, and the design, construction and operation of various cloud infrastructures.

businessSummary: Kyoei Tanker Co., Ltd. engages in ship operation and ship chartering businesses in Japan and Singapore. In addition, the company provides shipping, worker dispatch, and warehousing services  and loan, collateralizing, and investments. Kyoei Tanker Co., Ltd. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: RESONA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Resona Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services such as banking and trust services, credit card services and venture capital services. The Company operates in four segments. The Retail Division segment is mainly engaged in consulting services related to personal loans, asset management, and succession of assets, etc., for individual customers. The Corporate Division segment is mainly engaged in business for corporate clients, focusing on support for business growth, including corporate lending, asset management using trusts, real estate operations, corporate pensions, and business succession. The Market Division Segment is mainly engaged in financing and investment of funds, foreign exchange, bonds, and derivatives through financial markets. The Kansai Mirai Financial Group segment is engaged in banking business in the Kansai region, including deposit and lending business.

name: TS TECH
businessSummary: TS Tech Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile and motorcycle parts. It operates through four regional segments, including Japan, Americas, China, and Asia & Europe. Japan, Americas, and Asia & Europe segments are mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile seats and interior parts, and motorcycle seats and plastic parts. China segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobile seats and interior parts.

name: TOKAI CARBON
businessSummary: TOKAI CARBON CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of graphite electrodes, carbon black, fine carbon, smelting and lining products, industrial furnaces and related products, friction materials and anode materials. The Company has five segments. Carbon Black segment manufactures and sells carbon black for rubber products, black pigments and conductive applications. Fine Carbon segment manufactures and sells specialty carbon products, solid silicon carbide (SiC) and SiC-coated products. Smelting & Lining segment manufactures and sells cathodes for aluminum smelting, blast furnace blocks and carbon electrodes. Graphite Electrodes segment manufactures and sells graphite electrodes for electric arc furnaces used in steelmaking. Industrial Furnaces and Related Products segment manufactures and sells industrial electric furnaces and silicon carbide heating elements.

name: AXXZIA
businessSummary: AXXZIA Inc. manufactures and sells cosmetics and supplements in Japan. The company offers eyecare, skincare, supplements and drinks, salon care, hair care, hair styling, and beauty device products under the AXXZIA, AGtheory, LisBeau, LisBlanc, The B, Le Ciel de L'aube, Aither, NICE GLOW, Medullux, Venus Recipe, and RevWell brand names. It also provides products online. AXXZIA Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: GRANTOMATO
businessSummary: Grantomato Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the agri solution business. For store sales, the Company carries out a multi-store retail business of Grantomato stores that sell agricultural materials, agricultural equipment, agricultural materials such as pesticides, fertilizers and direct products, and FOODMART stores that sell groceries. There are two types of FOODMART stores: business supermarkets and FOODMART Grantomato. At FOODMART Grantomato, based on the purchasing network the Company builds a food mart system that is operated by focusing on pursuing originality, such as promoting sales of private brand products developed. For agricultural distribution, the Company cultivates rice, mandarin oranges, seed garlic, potatoes, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplant seedlings, and flower seedlings through direct transactions with agricultural producers. For Fukushima Distribution Center (FDC) and Internet sales, the Company operates e-commerce business to provide products.

name: UT GROUP
businessSummary: UT Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of temporary staffing and contract work services. It operates through four business segments. Motor Energy Business segment specializes in human resources services for major automobile manufacturers, providing just-in-time labor supply services to major clients and related companies in the automobile, auto parts manufacturers and battery-related industries. Semiconductor Business specializes in human resources services for major semiconductor manufacturers, systematizing job and career development for major clients and related companies in the semiconductor field. Agent Business segment provides temporary staffing and contract work, acts as a recruitment agent for job seekers and operates a paid job placement business. Next Career Business segment supports human resources strategies specializing in solving management issues and provides new workplaces where talent from major companies can utilize their skills.

It operates through Accommodation Business and Other Investment Business segments. The company is involved in the planning, development, operation, and management of hotels and inns. It also engages in the rental of stores and parking lots  supply of hot spring water  real estate rental  real estate development of housing  operation of cemeteries  and securities investment activities. The company was formerly known as Tokai Kanko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AGORA Hospitality Group Co., Ltd in April 2012. AGORA Hospitality Group Co., Ltd was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: SPACEMARKET
businessSummary: Spacemarket Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the platform SPACEMARKET where any space can be rented and borrowed, the provision of the public facility reservation management system Spacepad, as well as the operation of spaces on behalf of the owner. SPACEMARKET is a platform where any space can be rented and borrowed, and provides a service that allows anyone to rent and borrow space easily and conveniently over the Internet or smartphone. The Company also supports the operation of shared spaces, and upon request from owners, selects, orders, and installs furniture and equipment suitable for the shared space, and prepares the interior, takes promotional photos, writes listing text, sets prices, creates rules for use, and lists the space on SPACEMARKET. It also handles reservations and rentals, cleaning, replenishing equipment, responding to inquiries, and brushing up the listing content on behalf of the owner.

name: TOYO ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Toyo Engineering Corporation engages in the engineering and construction of industrial facilities in Japan, India, China, and internationally. It also provides various services, such as research and development support, planning, technical research, design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical assistance for industrial facilities, including oil and gas, petrochemicals and chemicals, water treatment, power generation, advanced production systems, pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals, biotechnology, environmental solutions, resource development, artificial intelligence. Toyo Engineering Corporation was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

name: MUSASHI SEIMITSU INDUSTRY
businessSummary: Musashi Seimitsu Industry Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automotive powertrain parts, suspension parts, steering parts, and transmission parts. The Company operates its business through five geographical segments: Japan, Americas, Asia, China and Europe. Its products are used in industries such as automobiles, machine tools, and industrial machines. Powertrain (PT) products includes planetary gear assemblies, differential gear assemblies, bevel gears, ring gears, camshafts, and balance shafts. The linkage and suspension (L&S) products include suspension arm assemblies, suspension ball joints, steering ball joints, and various joints for connection. Motorcycle products include motorcycle transmission gear assemblies, motorcycle camshafts, motorcycle kick starter components, other motorcycle drivetrain components, and general-purpose engine components.

name: FLIGHT SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: FLIGHT SOLUTIONS Inc. engages in the SI, payment, and EC businesses in Japan. The company offers Payment Meister and Incredist Premium II, which are applications and payment terminals that enable payments via tablet  Taipon, a touch payment solution for Android devices  payment solutions for unmanned automated payment machines and personal computers  and myVerifist, a solution for identity verification using number cards  . It also provides IT services, such as IT and system consulting, system operation, support for system development using cloud services, and design and development support  Scenaria for Pepper and Sota  Elite Stalion  and cloud integration and robot solutions, as well as Incredist Trinity, all in one payment terminal platform. In addition, the company offers EC-Rider B2BJ Series, a B2B EC site construction package, as well as consulting services related to package implementation, and system development and maintenance services. It serves logistics and finance companies. The company was formerly known as Flight System Consulting Inc. and changed its name to FLIGHT SOLUTIONS Inc. in June 2013. FLIGHT SOLUTIONS Inc. was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: SUMITOMO WAREHOUSE
businessSummary: Sumitomo Warehouse Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the integrated logistics business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Logistics segment is engaged in the warehousing, harbor transportation, international transportation and land transportation, as well as the development of software related to its logistics business. The Marine Transportation segment is engaged in the freight transportation using ships, and the operation of marine transportation agents. The Real Estate segment is engaged in the trading, leasing and management of business offices and lands.

name: NAGOYA RAILROAD
businessSummary: Nagoya Railroad Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a range of service businesses centered on railway operations, including transportation, logistics, real estate, leisure, retail, aviation-related services, and facility maintenance. The Transportation segment operates railways, bus services, and taxis. The Logistics segment provides trucking and shipping services. The Real Estate segment is engaged in property development, leasing, and management. The Leisure and Services segment operates hotels, restaurants, tourist facilities and travel services. The Retail segment operates department stores and conducts merchandise and petroleum product sales. The Aviation-Related Services segment provides airline services and in-flight catering. The Other segment includes facility maintenance, information processing, and insurance agency services.

name: JAPAN BUSINESS SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Japan Business Systems Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing cloud services, consulting and information technology (IT) services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Cloud Integration segment mainly supports the introduction of Microsoft's cloud products Azure (Microsoft Azure) / M365 (Microsoft365) / D365 (Dynamics365) and peripheral cloud services. The Cloud Service segment undertakes maintenance, operation, and improvement in cloud utilization, including Azure / M365 / D365, and provides consistent support. The License & Products segment mainly provides cloud solutions such as Microsoft's Azure, M365, and D365, which are the basis of customer system development, and licenses and related equipment as resale. In addition, the Company also rents real estate.

Global Markets Business Group provides foreign exchange, funding and other services. It also operates the Other segment.
