businessSummary: eMnet Japan Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the internet advertising business. The Company is involved in the provision of services such as search advertising, operational display advertising, social media advertising, video advertising, affiliate advertising, ad network advertising, digital signal processor (DSP), data management platform (DMP), smartphone advertising, native advertising, application advertising and net advertising. The Company also provides one-stop advertising including planning, operation, analysis and improvement, and provides comprehensive services as a consultant on internet advertising. The Company also gains know-how from the experience of advertisement operation on the client's electronic commerce (EC) sites and receives the creative production order at its own company.

name: LEIFRAS
businessSummary: Leifras Co Ltd is a Tokyo-based company mainly engaged in the children's sports school business and school club support business. It operates in two divisions. The sports division includes the sports school business, event business, and alliance business. The sports school business operates sports schools. The event business aims to develop children's human skills and revitalize local communities through sports and other experiential activities and events. The alliance business partners with professional sports teams and operates joint schools. The social division includes the school club support business, which provides sports coaching in school club activities and physical education classes, the community collaboration business, which promotes local sports, the LEIF after-school day care service business, which supports children with disabilities and developmental characteristics through soccer therapy, and the healthcare business, which provides exercise programs for the elderly.

name: ROLAND
businessSummary: Roland Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the electronic musical instrument business. The Company is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic musical instruments. The main products include electronic pianos, electronic drums, synthesizers, guitar related equipment, dance and disc jockey (DJ) related equipment, video related equipment, effectors, musical instrument amplifiers and others. The Company is also engaged in the development and sale of software products for music and media producers, the sale of headphone products, as well as the manufacture and sale of electronic organs.

name: PIA
businessSummary: PIA Corporation engages in the ticketing, publishing, planning, production, and operation of concerts and events in Japan. The company distributes tickets through online computer ticketing system for music, sports, theater, movie, leisure events, etc., including internet, convenience stores, shops, telephone, and member services. It also publishes books and magazine books  and provides business solutions for corporate clients, including planning sales services and customer management strategies to promotional activities for promoters, event and concert organizers, sports organizations, theater companies, halls, and stadiums. In addition, the company is involved in organizing, planning, producing, and managing various entertainment events, such as music, sports, theater, and movies  and develop contents for the leisure and entertainment fields through various platforms. Further, the company manages halls and arenas  and manages ticket sales. PIA Corporation was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: LEDAX
businessSummary: Ledax Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the purchase, sale, and distribution of automobiles in Japan, Asia, Oceania, Africa, and internationally. It operates through Automobile distribution business, and Leaseback related business segments. The company engages in the purchase and sale of used cars through its retail stores  management of the service shops  sale of various property and casualty insurance products comprising car insurance  wholesale and distribution of spare parts and accessories of automobiles through online shop  management of automobile aftermarket parts of online distribution  and export of used cars through internet site, PicknBuy24.com. It also offers management consulting, M&A advisory, outsourcing, and investment services. The company was formerly known as Carchs Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Ledax Co.,Ltd. in September 2024. Ledax Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

TeamSpirit Leaders is one of the family products of TeamSpirit, and it is the project of project cost management that is used in combination with TeamSpirit as the main business. Professional service is a premier support product, and it mainly consists of paid support work carried out by a consultant in charge for the customer's production operation and steady operation.

The Automotive segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric vehicles, compact cars, light cars, minivans, commercial vehicles, trucks, micro buses and other automobiles, as well as related parts. The Sales Finance segment is engaged in the sales finance business and the leasing business to support sales activities of automobile business.

The Company operates through the packaging materials manufacturing and sales business segment. The Segment manufactures and sells printed paper containers including confectionery boxes, seals, labels and flyers, as well as planning and design services. The Company also manufactures and sells tea bags, wrapping paper, paper containers and provides sales of containers, pallets, basket carts and steel fish boxes. The Company manufactures and sells polyethylene bags, corrugated cardboard and cushioning materials.

name: ACOM
businessSummary: Acom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in loan and credit card business, credit guarantee business, overseas financial business, debt management and collection business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Loan and Credit Card segment provides the unsecured loan business and the credit card business with MasterCard as the main product. The Credit Guarantee segment is engaged in credit guarantee business. The Overseas Financial segment includes unsecured loan business in Thailand and the Philippines, installation loan business in Thailand (individual credit purchase brokerage business), and banking business in Indonesia. The Debt Management and Collection segment provides servicer business including debt management and collection business. The others include contracting a contact center and dispatching human resources business.

The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kumamoto, Japan.

businessSummary: Mitsui Matsushima Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in a variety of businesses, including consumer goods, industrial products, and finance. The Company operates through four segments. The Consumer Goods segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of extendable straws, the purchase and sale of food and beverage supplies, and others. The Industrial Products segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of mask blanks, and others. The Finance and Other Businesses segment is primarily engaged in real estate-backed loans for businesses, and others. The Energy Business segment consists of the Coal Production segment, and the Coal Sales segment. Due to the closure of existing mining areas in the Australian coal mining business, the Coal Production and Coal Sales segments of the Energy Business segment were discontinued at the end of the fiscal year ending March 2024.

Through its subsidiaries, the Company conducts contract the manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and purchases, manufactures and sells diagnostic reagents. The products and services include microbial testing reagents, urine testing reagents, immuno-serological test reagents, biochemical testing reagents and instrument food environment-related media. The Company sells its products in Japan and overseas markets.

The Company operates in three business segments. The Entertainment segment is engaged in the planning, development and operation of games and tool applications for smartphones, tablet terminals and other smart devices. The Lifestyle Support segment is engaged in the planning, development and operation of comparison sites and information sites that provide information closely related to life events and daily life. The EC segment is engaged the planning, development and operation of multiple E-Commerce sites that handle a variety of products, including lujo, RESP, and OBREMO.

name: RIVER ELETEC
businessSummary: River Eletec Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, and sells quartz crystal units, crystal oscillators, resistors, and other components in Japan, China, Taiwan, the United States, and South Korea. The company offers AT-cut, tuning fork, and KoT-cut OPAW crystal units  and KoT-cut OPAW, MHz, and kHz crystal oscillators. Its products are used in smartphones, in-vehicle, wireless communication, audiovisual equipment, and medical/healthcare fields. The company was formerly known as Fuji Sangyo Company and changed its name to River Eletec Corporation in October 1991. River Eletec Corporation was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Nirasaki, Japan.

The company offers custom made clothing products, knitted yarns, worsted fabrics, apparel, and other. It also provides OEM, as well as import and export services. In addition, the company manufactures, sells, and retails yarns, fibrous materials for apparel, and apparel. Further, it sells its products under the NEWYORKER, Brooks Brothers, and House Tartan brand names. Further, the company is involved in the leasing of real-estate properties, such as shopping center stores, office buildings, and commercial facilities. The company was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: CHUGIN FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Chugin Financial Group,Inc. provides banking services in Japan. It operates through Banking, Leasing, and Securities segments. The Banking segment offers financial services, such as deposit taking and lending services. The Leasing segment engages in leasing and installment sales of properties and goods. The Securities segment offers brokerage services for financial instruments. Chugin Financial Group,Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

name: CHIBA BANK
businessSummary: Chiba Bank Ltd is a Japan-based bank mainly engaged in the banking business and the financial services business. The Bank is engaged in the banking business, stores maintenance and management business, accounting business, employment placement business, receivables management and collection business, securities business, credit guarantee business, collection business, credit card business, leasing business, software development and information processing business, venture capital business, investment management and advisory business, research and consulting business, fintech research business, as well as the planning and development of financial services.

name: DAIO PAPER
businessSummary: Daio Paper Corporation is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of paper products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Paper and Paper Board segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of papers, paper boards, newsprint paper, printing paper and related materials. The Home and Personal Care segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of sanitary paper products, disposable diapers, feminine care products, wet wipes.

name: AEON HOKKAIDO
businessSummary: Aeon Hokkaido Corporation is mainly engaged in the retail business. The Company operates a chain of general merchandise stores (GMSs) in Hokkaido. The Company provides clothing, residential and leisure products, food products and others. The Company operates GMS, small supermarkets and bicycle specialty stores in Hokkaido area.

name: SUBARU
businessSummary: Subaru Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture of Subaru automobiles. The Company operates through two business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and repairing of mini cars, small cars, ordinary cars and their parts. The Aerospace segment is engaged in the manufacture, sale and repairing of aircraft, space-related equipment and parts. The Company is also engaged in real estate leasing business.

name: UNIVERSAL ENTERTAINMENT
businessSummary: Universal Entertainment Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and sells pachislot and pachinko machines in Japan and the Philippines. It develops and provides Falcon X, a peripheral system  Hot Stadium, a digital signage system  Universal Kingdom, a members-only mobile website  Slot Street, a social casino game for smartphones  Fun, amusement equipment  and Pachislot and Pachinko machines and related equipment, as well as operates OKADA MANILA, a casino resort in the Philippines. It also offers Okada Maa, the integrated resort facilities in Manila, the Philippines. The company was formerly known as Aruze Corp. and changed its name to Universal Entertainment Corporation in November 2009. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Universal Entertainment Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Okada Holdings Limited.

name: DAIHEN
businessSummary: DAIHEN Corporation manufactures, sells, and repairs plasma generation power supplies in Japan. The company operates through Energy Management, Factory Automation, and Material Processing segments. The company offers transformers, welding machines, and power sources. It also offers distribution equipment, power distribution equipment, solar inverters, and others  and welding/cutting machines, such as CO2/MAG, TIG, MIG, DC/AC, plasma welding and cutting, submerged arc, and resistance welding machines, as well as welding and cutting torches, peripheral devices for welding, thermal spray machines, and welding accessories. The company also provides robots, teach pendants, sensors for robot welding, positioners and sliders, PC software, and welding power sources and welding peripherals for robots. In addition, it offers RF/MW generators and automatic matching units for plasma applications  clean transfer robot, such as wafer and FPD transfer robots, and wafer aligner  and wireless power transfer systems. Further, the company offers industrial robots, including teach pendant, sensors for robot welding, positioners and sliders, PC software, and welding power sources and welding peripherals for robot. The company was formerly known as Osaka Transformer Co., Ltd. and changed its name to DAIHEN Corporation in December 1985. DAIHEN Corporation was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: HYAKUGO BANK
businessSummary: Hyakugo Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly provides financial services such as leasing business mainly banking. The Company mainly operates through two business segments. The Banking segment provides deposit services, loan services, domestics exchange services and foreign exchange services. This segment is involved in the investment trust and insurance counter sales, financial product intermediation, merger and acquisition (M&A) and syndicated loans. This segment is also engaged in the examination and adjustment of cash, the storage and management of documents and accounting books, the survey and evaluation of real estate, the placement agency and personnel management business. The Leasing segment is engaged in the leasing business. The Company is also engaged in the trading of financial products, the credit card and credit guarantee business, the provision of regional industry survey- and consulting-related services, as well as the processing of information business.

name: ALPHAPURCHASE
businessSummary: AlphaPurchase Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of various required solutions to achieve indirect cost reduction. The Company operates two segments. Maintenance Repair and Operations (MRO) segment is mainly engaged in the sale of MRO products such as equipment and machinery repair supplies, stationery, office supplies on closed information technology platforms. Facility Management (FM) segment is mainly engaged in the provision of construction and other materials for new construction, renovation, and maintenance of commercial facilities, as well as maintenance and management of facilities and equipment. The Company also conducts business related to the collection, processing and provision of various types of information, as well as computer-based provision of information.

name: GUNMA BANK
businessSummary: Gunma Bank Ltd is a Japan-based regional bank mainly engaged in the banking business. The Company operates in two segments. The Banking Business segment is engaged in deposit and lending operations as well as securities investment, domestic and foreign exchange, over-the-counter sales of public bonds, investment trusts, and insurance products, and trust services, to provide financial products and services to local customers. The Leasing segment is engaged in the provision of financial services, including leasing services, mainly to customers in the local community. The Company is also engaged in the transportation of goods and maintenance of automatic teller machines, securities business, management consulting services, fund formation and management, guarantee services, credit services, system development, sales, and investment trust management services.

name: SANYO ELECTRIC RAILWAY
businessSummary: Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. engages in transportation and real estate businesses in Japan. The company operates through Transportation Segment  Distribution Industry  Real Estate Business  Rental Service  And Other Segments. It is involved in operating trains, buses, taxis, etc.  sale of products mainly in the department store business  leasing and sale of buildings and land  and restaurant business. The company offers railway information, such as operation information, deferred certificates, diamond search, fare search, timetable search, route map and station information, and information on fares and tickets  outing information, comprises hiking info, vacationers, and escorts  and real estate information, including apartments for rent, commercial facilities and office buildings  parking lot / bicycle parking lot  trunk room, properties and condominium for sale, and recruitment of land for business. Sanyo Electric Railway Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Akashi, Japan.

name: TENTIAL
businessSummary: Tential Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the TENTIAL conditioning brand. The conditioning brand business develops and sells products that can be easily incorporated into daily life to support good health, including the BAKUNE line of nightwear designed to improve the quality of sleep when worn. The Company's main products are the BAKUNE RECOVERY WEAR series of nightwear using a special fiber with far-infrared radiation effect, the MIGARU series of comfort tech wear, INSOLE series, Recovery Sandals series, and Comforter series. The products are sold through the Company's e-commerce site tential.jp, Amazon, Rakuten Ichiba, Yahoo! Shopping and other e-commerce malls, TENTIAL stores, clothing stores, general merchandise stores and electronics retailers.

name: NIPPON COKE & ENGINEERING
businessSummary: NIPPON COKE & ENGINEERING COMPANY, LIMITED is principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of coke, general coal and powder and granular equipment, as well as the call center business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Coke segment manufactures and sells coke. The Fuel Sales segment is engaged in purchasing and sale of coal and petroleum coke, and call center business. The Comprehensive Engineering segment is engaged in manufacture, sale and maintenance of chemical equipment and other equipment, as well as collecting, transportation and processing of industrial waste. The others business includes cargo handling business, real estate sales and leasing business.

isin: 3676.T|DIGITAL HEARTS HOLDINGS CO L|3676.T|DIGITAL HEARTS HOLDINGS Co., Ltd.
name: DIGITAL HEARTS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: DIGITAL HEARTS HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in debugging, media, and other businesses. It provides debug testing and reporting services for consumer games, mobile and online games, arcade games, etc.  one-stop solutions, such as translation, LQA, and marketing support for game makers to develop overseas markets  and support services in creating content, including game development and CG video creation, etc. The company also operates 4Gamer.net, a website for distributing information about computer games and online games, and hardware  and publishes news, as well as distributes movies, free trials, weekly publications, and other content. In addition, it offers testing services for IT-related software, including websites and operations systems  solutions for the development of AI applications and testing automation  and security services. Further, the company provides various IT services, such as system development, maintenance, and operation support for IT systems. The company was formerly known as Hearts United Group Co., Ltd. and changed its name to DIGITAL HEARTS HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in July 2018. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. As of September 24, 2026, DIGITAL HEARTS HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was taken private.

name: BEWITH
businessSummary: Bewith, Inc. engages in the provision of Contact Center and BPO services in Japan. The company offers Omnia LINK, an advanced cloud-based PBX  customer relationship management systems (CRM)  outbound contact center dialer  AI-FAQ system  online customer service/electronic contracts  online training/monitoring  automatic response quality evaluation and education platform  and omni-channel solutions. It also provides homebased call center services under Bewith Digital Work Place  clerical and digital BPO  as well as consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Bewith, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Pasona Group Inc.

name: INCLUSIVE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Inclusive Holdings Inc, formerly Inclusive Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the media & content, planning & production, and food-related businesses. The Company operates through three business segments. The Media & Content Business segment attracts users online through a wide range of information dissemination formats, including media, manga, and newsletters, and earns revenue from corporate clients through advertising or charges for selling content and services to individual users. The Planning & Production Business segment primarily serves corporate clients and provides planning related to corporate and group branding, promotion-related services, spatial design, construction services, and system development support. The Food-Related Business segment provides various food-related services based on the Shimogamo Saryo brand. The Company also engages in space-related businesses.

name: NIHON DEMPA KOGYO
businessSummary: Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of crystal-related products in Japan, China, the United States, Germany, South Korea, Mexico, Romania, and internationally. The company also offers crystal units, crystal oscillators, frequency synthesizers, signal generators, millimeter-wave converters, synthetic quartz crystals, optical components, QCM outgas analysis system and real-time process monitor, outgas analysis systems, ultrasonic transducers, and SAW devices. ts products are used in various applications, space, infrastructure/industrial equipment, automotive, mobile, AV/OA, medical, healthcare, household appliance, and connectivity sectors. The company was formerly known as Nanbu Shoko Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. in 1950. Nihon Dempa Kogyo Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: REPROCELL
businessSummary: ReproCELL Incorporated provides stem cell research and drug discovery services in Japan. It offers stem cell reagents, including RNA reprogramming, small molecules, growth factors and cytokines, antibodies and staining kits, cell substrates, cryopreservation media, dissociation solution, and transfection reagents  differentiated induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) and related reagents, feeder cells, pluripotent stem cells, StemEdit gene edited iPSCs, mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), and new immortalized cell lines and related reagents  and iPSC-derived exosomes. The company also provides Alvetex 3D, a cell culture system  Alvetex, an advanced tissue bioengineering system  EZSPHERE Multiwell Dishes and Plates  KOKEN atelocollagen  ABLE Biott bioreactor systems  and 2mag stirrer systems. In addition, It offers research stem cell, genomics, clinical stem cell research, preclinical and drug discovery, precision medicine, human tissue samples, clinical laboratory, and gene editing services. ReproCELL Incorporated was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Yokohama, Japan.

name: LIVING PLATFORM
businessSummary: Living Platform,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the life care business. The Life Care segment is engaged in the development of nursing care business, support services for people with disabilities, childcare business and other businesses. The nursing care business provides paid nursing homes with nursing care, residential paid nursing homes, housing for the elderly with services, cohabitation care for people with dementia, home care support, day care, short-term nursing home life care, home care and consulting services. The support business for persons with disabilities provides employment continuation support, consultation support, independence training and cohabitation support services. The daycare business operates licensed daycare centers and company-led daycare centers. Other businesses provide catering services, job advertisement services, real estate holding and leasing business and joint purchasing business.

name: KITAZATO CORP SHIZUOKA
businessSummary: Kitazato Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in medical equipment business. The Company specializes in reproductive engineering technology in artificial insemination, in vitro fertilization, cell cryopreservation, and regenerative medicine, and manufactures and sells consumables such as medical equipment and reagents that support infertility treatment. The products are mainly research reagents and medical equipment used in vitro fertilization and intracytoplasmic sperm injection. Medical devices related to infertility treatment are divided into media, cryo devices, medical devices, and micro tools. The Company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of medical equipment parts, genetic testing, sale of medical equipment for the elderly, market research and acquisition of local licenses, and contract management of living cells. It distributes products to markets around the world, including Japan, Europe, the United States, China, and India.

name: SINOPS
businessSummary: sinops Inc., formerly Link Inc., operates software package group sinops series to optimize inventory of retail, wholesale and manufacturing industries. The Company operates sinops (strategic inventory optimum solution) business. The Company provides package sales, rental sales, implementation support service and support service. The package sales service provides sinops series in batch sales type. The rental sales service provides the sinops series in usage fee type. The implementation support service provides system construction and operation construction services to maximize the implementation effect of sinops. The support service supports daily operation of sinops. The Company owns two types of sales, including direct sales to end users and sales by sales partners.

name: VALQUA
businessSummary: Valqua, Ltd. designs, manufactures, processes, and sells fiber, fluorocarbon resin, rubber, and other materials in Japan, rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. It operates through the Seal Products Business and Functional Resin Products Business segments. The company offers seal products, including soft gaskets, metallic/semi-metallic gaskets, molded and gland packing, metallic bellows, and supplement products for seal, as well as other seals comprising oil sheets, other gaskets, and alliance products. It also provides resin products, such as materials and blocks, films/tapes/sheets, tubes, processed and molded products, lining pipes and tank parts, and substrates  and heat insulation materials, such as flame-resistant carbonized and head-resistant glass fiber textile products, as well as bearings and lubricants. In addition, the company provides piping products comprising fluorocarbon resin vessels, valves, expansion joints, and mechanical seals  and lined devices/equipment. It serves industrial equipment, chemical, machinery, energy, communication equipment, semiconductors, automobiles, aerospace, and other industries. The company was formerly known as Nippon Valqua Industries and changed its name to Valqua, Ltd. in October 2018. Valqua, Ltd. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NAGAWA
businessSummary: NAGAWA Co., Ltd. plans, designs, manufactures, and sells system and modular buildings, and unit houses under the Super House name in Japan. The company is involved in renting surveillance camera  plant repair and renovation business  and sale and purchase of second-hand products. It also rents and sells construction machinery and equipment, office equipment, and fixtures. The company was formerly known as Nagawa Sekiyu Corporation and changed its name to NAGAWA Co., Ltd. in March 1978. NAGAWA Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SRE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: SRE Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the AI x Real solution business that provides real estate distribution services utilizing agent system and artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The Company is engaged in the real estate business, information technology (IT) platform business and AI solution business. The real estate business is engaged in the acquisition and operation of profitable real estates, the development of assets such as smart homes that combine Internet of Things (IoT) and AI technology, as well as the provision of consulting and other real estate distribution services. The IT platform business is engaged in the provision of a real estate trading platform Ouchi Direct that based on IT and AI technology, and the IT platforms for various industries. The AI solution business is engaged in the provision of consulting services for various industries such as financial tech (Fintech) and real estate tech (RET) fields.

name: SOFTTEX
businessSummary: Softtex Co.,Ltd. engages in the computer system design and software development business. It operates through two segments, Software Development Services and Medical IT Services. It offers disaster prevention equipment manufacturers, computer manufacturers, system integrators, and information systems. The company also offers internet-related system services  consultation and education on computer usage  development, sales, and support of software packages  and construction and support of medical systems. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Nagoya, Japan with additional offices in Tokyo, Sapporo, and Okinawa, Japan.

name: HONDA MOTOR
businessSummary: Honda Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the motorcycle business, the automobile business, the financial service business and the life creation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Motorcycle segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), side-by-side vehicles and related parts. The Automobile segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of automobiles and related parts. The Financial Service segment is engaged in the sales financing and leasing of its products. The Power Products and Other Business segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of power products and related parts.

name: VISASQ
businessSummary: visasQ Inc. operates the knowledge platform business. The Company provides service that matches customers with advisors with business knowledge and sets up hourly telephone calls and face-to-face interviews according to customer needs. The services provided by the knowledge platform business include visasQ interview, visasQ expert survey, visasQ outsourcing, visasQ project, visasQ web exhibition in the full support format visasQ, and visasQ lite in the self-matching format visasQ lite. The registrants include manufacturing, retailing, eating and drinking, living, medical and healthcare, business support, finance, education, media, construction and real estate, energy infrastructure, agriculture, forestry and fisheries, among others. It covers a wide range of industries and occupations, including management departments, information technology (IT) and systems, new businesses and research and development (R&D), overseas businesses, professionals, and production and procurement.

name: NANKAI
businessSummary: Nankai Co Ltd, formerly Nankai Electric Railway Co Ltd, is primarily engaged in the transportation business. The Company operates through six business segments. The Transportation segment consists of railway operations, tramway operations, bus operations, shipping, freight transport, and vehicle maintenance. The Real Estate segment consists of real estate leasing and real estate sales. The Distribution segment consists of shopping center management, station business operations, and other businesses. The Leisure and Service segment consists of travel agencies, hotels and inns, boat race facility leasing, building management and maintenance, funeral services, and other businesses. The Construction segment consists of construction operations. The Other Business segment consists of information processing outsourcing and accounting outsourcing.

name: MITSUI OSK LINES
businessSummary: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the shipping business. The Company operates in six business segments. The Dry bulk Carrier segment is engaged in the operation of dry bulk carriers. The Energy Transportation segment owns and operates coal carriers that transport coal for thermal power generation, oil tankers, offshore businesses, and tramp ships, including liquefied natural gas (LNG) carriers, and is engaged in marine cargo transportation. The Product Transportation segment owns and operates pure car carriers and transports marine cargo. The Well-Being Life segment is engaged in real estate business, including land and building rental and building management, passenger and cargo transportation, and cruise business. The Associated segment is engaged in tugboat business and trading company business. The Other segment is engaged in ship management of ships other than transport ships and LNG ships, financial business such as group fund raising and others.

name: SHIMA SEIKI MFG
businessSummary: SHIMA SEIKI MFG., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of flat knitting equipment, design systems, gloves and socks knitting equipment. The Company operates in three business segments. The Flat Knitting Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer flat knitting equipment and semi jacquard flat knitting equipment. The Design Systems Related segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of computer design systems, as well as apparel computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) systems. The Gloves and Socks Knitting Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of seamless gloves and socks knitting equipment. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture, sale and trading of textile materials, the planning, manufacture and sale of textile products, the operation of hotels, the manufacture and sale of knitting equipment and design system parts, as well as the repair and maintenance business.

name: TORAY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: TORAY INDUSTRIES, INC. is a Japan-based company engaged in the textile business, functional chemicals business, carbon fiber composite materials and other businesses. It has five business segments. Textile segment provides yarns, staple fibers, spun yarns, woven and knitted fabrics, non-woven fabrics, artificial leather and apparel products. Functional Chemicals segment provides resins and molded resin products, polyolefin foams, films and processed film products, raw materials for synthetic fibers and plastics, fine chemicals and others. Carbon Fiber Composite Materials segment provides carbon fibers, carbon fiber composite materials and carbon fiber molded products. Environment and Engineering segment provides functional membranes and related equipment for water treatment, comprehensive engineering services and others. Life Sciences segment provides the pharmaceuticals and medical equipment. It also provides analysis, investigation and research services.

name: MIZUHO FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking, trust banking, securities, and other financial services. The Company operates through five business segments: Retail & Business Corporations Company (RBC), Corporate & Investment Banking Company (CIBC), Global Corporate & Investment Banking Company (GCIBC), Global Markets Company (GMC), and Asset Management Company (AMC). The CIBC segment operates for clients of large corporate corporations, financial corporations and public corporations in Japan. The GCIBC segment operates for clients of overseas-affiliated Japanese companies and non-Japanese companies. The GMC segment is engaged in investment business in interest rates, equity, among others. The AMC segment is engaged in the development and provision of products that meet the asset management needs of clients from individuals to institutional investors.

name: SEKISUI HOUSE
businessSummary: Sekisui House Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the detached house business, rental and commercial building business, civil engineering business and other related business. It has seven business segments. The Detached House segment designs, contracts and sells detached houses. Rental and Commercial Building segment designs, contracts and sells rental housing and commercial buildings. Architecture and Civil Engineering segment designs and contracts for construction and civil engineering work for commercial buildings. Rental Housing Management segment leases and manages rental housing. Remodeling segment remodels detached houses and rental housing. Development segment includes the brokerage and real estate business, condominium business and urban redevelopment business. International Business segment sells detached houses overseas, develops and sells residential land, and develops condominiums and rental apartments. It is also engaged in non-life insurance agency business.

name: JFE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JFE Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning of business strategy, the management of business and risk, as well as the presentation of group investor information. The Company mainly operates its business through three segments. The Steel segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of steel products, processed steel products and raw materials, as well as the delivery, facility maintenance and construction businesses. The Engineering segment is engaged in engineering, recycling, and electric power retailing businesses related to energy, urban environment, steel structures, and industrial machinery. The Trading segment purchases, processes, and sells steel products, raw materials for steelmaking, non-ferrous metal products, and food products.

name: KITANOTATSUJIN
businessSummary: Kitanotatsujin Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the e-commerce business. The Company is mainly engaged in the sale of health foods and beauty-related products through Internet, and the operation of related businesses, such as the order receipt and shipment business, the production of mail order Websites, the plan and production of sales promotion tools, as well as the development of systems. The Company provides its products through mail order Websites http://www.kaitekikobo.jp/ and http://www.kaitekikobo.jp/sp/ operated by the Company.

name: ELECTRIC POWER DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Electric Power Development Co Ltd is mainly engaged in electricity generation business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Electricity segment engages in power generation business including hydroelectric power generation, thermal power generation and wind power generation, as well as provision of electricity. The Electricity-Related segment engages in design, installation, maintenance and repair of electrical power equipment, the port operation of fuel and coal ash, the coal mine development, the import of coal, the procurement and manufacture of biomass fuel, the operation of public health facilities, as well as the provision of computer services. The Overseas Operation segment is in the operation of electrical power generation investment business and other related businesses, engineering and consulting businesses in overseas. The Others segment engages in new electricity business, environment-related business and others.

name: OPTORUN
businessSummary: Optorun Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and sales of optical thin-film deposition equipment. The Company has the film deposition equipment business segment. The Company’s products include optical thin-film forming systems, anti-fouling film deposition systems, reactive plasma deposition systems, sputtering deposition systems for optical films, sputtering deposition systems for semiconductor optical films, plasma atomic layer deposition systems and ultra-multilayer thin-film forming systems. The products are used in applications including touch panels and housings for smartphones and tablets, biometric sensors, camera modules, light emitting diode (LED) light sources, automotive cameras and surveillance cameras.

name: NIDEC
businessSummary: Nidec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision small motors, in-vehicle products, home appliances, commercial and industrial products, equipment, electronic and optical components. The Company operates through 10 segments. The SPMS segment manufactures and sells motors for hard disk drives (HDDs) and other small motors. The AMEC segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The MOEN segment, ACIM segment and Nidec Techno Motor segment manufacture and sell home appliances, commercial and industrial products. The Nidec Instruments segment manufactures and sells equipment, in-vehicle products, electronic components and other small motors. The Nidec Mobility segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The Machinery Business Headquarters segment and the Nidec Advanced Technology segment manufacture and sell equipment. The Other segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products, equipment, electronic components, other small motors.

name: TAKATORI
businessSummary: Takatori Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and liquid crystal related equipment, multi wire saws and textile machinery, and medical devices primarily in Japan and internationally. The company offers precision cutting machinery for sapphire, SiC, and GaN substrates  solar panels  quartz crystals  LT and LN products  GaAs, Gap, and InP products  magnets  ceramics  and materials for research and development. It also provides semiconductor equipment for LED/RF devices, TAIKO processes, wafer protection tape lamination and removal machines, wafer mounters, UV irradiation equipment, film resist lamination machines, package mounters, substrate(H-WSS) processing equipment, and MEMS. In addition, the company provides display equipment for LCD panel surface cleaning, polarizer attaching, and touch panel bonding process machines  vacuum lamination for large substrates  carbon fiber/thin film solar cell sheet and apparel-related textile equipment  and medical devices. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Kashihara, Japan.

name: DOWA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: DOWA Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the recycling and metal processing business. The Company operates five business segments. The Environment and Recycling segment is engaged in waste disposal, soil remediation, resource recycling, and logistics. The Smelting segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of gold, silver, copper, lead, zinc, zinc alloys, indium, platinum. The Electronic Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity metal materials, compound semiconductor wafers, conductive materials, battery materials, magnetic materials, and reduced iron powder. The Metal Processing segment manufactures and sells copper, brass, and copper alloy products. The Heat Treatment segment is engaged in heat treatment and surface treatment of metal materials for automotive parts, and manufacture, sales, maintenance of heat treatment processing equipment. The Company also operates real estate leasing, construction, management, and technical support services.

name: KOBE STEEL
businessSummary: Kobe Steel Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the steel business. The Company has seven business segments. The Steel and Aluminum segment includes steel strips, steel sheets, aluminum rolled products, steel billets, and pig iron for castings. The Profile segment includes steel castings and forgings, aluminum alloys, and magnesium alloy castings and forgings. The Welding segment includes welding materials, welding robots, welding power sources, and various welding robot systems. The Machinery segment is engaged in energy and chemical-related equipment, nuclear power-related equipment, and tire and rubber machinery. The Engineering Segment is engaged in various types of plants and civil engineering works. The Construction Machinery segment is engaged in hydraulic excavators, mini excavators, wheel loaders, and crawler cranes. The Electric Power Segment is engaged in electric power supply. The Company also engages in high-pressure gas container manufacturing, superconducting.

name: IKUYO
businessSummary: ikuyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells interior and exterior components for the automotive industry in Japan. The company offers synthetic resin products  aluminum die-cast products  fluid, thermal, and sealing products using polymer and metallic materials. It also engages in the development of green hydrogen production and utilization technologies  digital asset and financial business  autonomous driving business  and manufacturing and selling small-scale commercial EVs. The company was formerly known as Ikuyo Coating Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ikuyo Co., Ltd. in April 1974. ikuyo Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Atsugi, Japan.

name: YOSHIMURA FOOD HOLDINGS KK

name: SECURE
businessSummary: Secure, Inc. engages in the security solution business in Japan. The company provides access control systems, such as card readers, fingerprint and facial recognition for offices, stores, factories, etc.  surveillance camera systems, that comprises various devices with AI and image recognition applications, including face recognition  and image analysis solutions that analyzes and predicts the degree of congestion in commercial facilities, event venues, evacuation centers, etc. It engages in research, development, and sales of artificial intelligence, cloud systems, and IoT devices. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

name: YOKOHAMA RUBBER
businessSummary: The Yokohama Rubber Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires for cars and other automotive products. The Company operates through two business segments. The Tire Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of tires for passenger cars, trucks and buses, light trucks, agricultural machinery, industrial vehicles, mining and construction vehicles and forestry equipment, as well as tubes, aluminum wheels, and automotive accessories. The Multiple Business (MB) segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of conveyor belts, various hoses, fenders, oil fences, marine hoses, and aviation parts. The Company is also engaged in the provision of sporting goods and information processing services.

name: HONDA MOTOR
businessSummary: Honda Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the motorcycle business, the automobile business, the financial service business and the life creation business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Motorcycle segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of motorcycles, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), side-by-side vehicles and related parts. The Automobile segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of automobiles and related parts. The Financial Service segment is engaged in the sales financing and leasing of its products. The Power Products and Other Business segment is engaged in the research and development, production and sale of power products and related parts.

name: SOURCENEXT
businessSummary: Sourcenext Corporation develops and distributes various software products in Japan and internationally. The company offers Internet of Things products, including PC software, smartphone applications, and hardware. It also sells POCKETALK, an AI-powered translation device  Kyousoku, a software that required no operation  Tokuda, a typing learning software that did not use keyboard images  ZERO, an antivirus software  and IKINARI PDF products. It offers its products through smartphone carriers, consumer mass retail stores, and app stores, as well as SOURCENEXT eSHOP, an online shop. Sourcenext Corporation was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SANBIO
businessSummary: SanBio Company Limited engages in the development, production, and sale of regenerative cell medicines for the central nervous system in Japan and the United States. It develops SB623 that has completed a phase 2 clinical trial to treat traumatic brain injury. The company's research pipeline products also comprise SB623 for chronic disease, age-related macular degeneration, retinitis pigmentosa, spinal cord injury, Parkinson's disease, Alzheimer's disease, etc.  SB618 to treat peripheral nerve damage  SB308 for muscular dystrophy disease  MSC1 for cancer  and MSC2 for inflammatory disease and optic neuritis. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SUMITOMO METAL MINING
businessSummary: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in resource development, manufacturing and sales of non-ferrous metal products, and manufacturing and sales of battery materials and functional materials. The Company operates through three business segments. The Mineral Resources segment is engaged in the exploration, development, production and sales of non-ferrous metal resources and products in Japan and overseas. The Smelting & Refining segment smelts and sells copper, nickel, ferronickel, zinc and other metals, and smelts and sells gold, silver, platinum, palladium and other precious metals. The Materials segment manufactures, processes, and sells battery materials, powder materials, crystal materials, and tape materials, as well as lightweight foamed concrete, automotive exhaust gas treatment catalysts, chemical catalysts, and petroleum refining desulfurization catalysts. The Company also operates businesses related to real estate and engineering.

name: KEISEI ELECTRIC RAILWAY
businessSummary: Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that operates transportation, logistics, real estate, leisure service, construction and the other business segment. The Company operates in six segments. The Transportation segment operates railways, buses and cabs. The Distribution segment is involved n the sale of products through stores, department stores. The Real Estate segment sells, leases and manages properties. The Leisure Service segment operates hotels, travel services. The Construction segment is engaged in contracting of civil engineering and building construction work. The Others segment is involved in maintenance of rolling stock, automobiles and others.

name: LAND
businessSummary: LAND Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based real estate company. The Company operates through Real Estate business segment. The Company is mainly engaged in the trading and investment of real estate properties, including renewable energy related investment such as photovoltaic power plants, real estate related consulting business, as well as other real estate business aimed at acquiring fee through brokerage business. The Company mainly operates in domestic market.

name: GS YUASA
businessSummary: GS Yuasa Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of batteries, power supply devices, lighting equipment, and other battery and electrical equipment. The Company operates through four segments. The Automotive Batteries (Japan) segment manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries for automobiles and motorcycles, and automotive-related equipment. The Automotive Batteries (Overseas) segment manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries for automobiles and motorcycles overseas. The Industrial Batteries and Power Supplies segment manufactures and sells lead-acid batteries, small lead-acid batteries, alkaline storage batteries, rectifiers, and general-purpose power supplies. The Automotive Lithium-ion Batteries segment manufactures and sells automotive lithium-ion batteries. The Company also provides battery-related equipment, battery manufacturing facilities, environmental equipment, and mobile communication batteries.

isin: 6226.T|Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.|6226.T|Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd.
name: MORIYA TRANSPORTATION ENGINEERING AND MA
businessSummary: Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, manufacturing, maintenance, upgrade and repair, renewal, and installation of elevators, vertical automatic conveyors, and other transport machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers elevators, freight elevators, ship elevators, and maclifter. Its products are used in government agencies, public corporations, freezers and refrigerated warehouses, seafood, manufacturing, trading companies, commercial businesses, real estate sector, Construction company, ship, and warehouse and transportation industries. Moriya Transportation Engineering and Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: CYBERSTEP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: CyberStep Holdings, Inc. develops online games in Japan. It operates through Online Game Business, Entertainment Business, and Others segments. The company offers GetAmped, Steel Chronicles C21 and C21, GetAmped 2, Cosmic Break, Onigiri, Cosmic Break 2, Cosmic Break Sora no Sentai, Online Crane Game Toreba 2D, Q&Q Answers, Touch! Gudetama ~3rd Time's the Charm~, Elysion of Conflict, Akatsuki no Breakers, E-commerce service Mireba, KDJ-ONE, Tomotoru ~Hello Kitty and Happiness Life~, GetAmped Mobile, CosmicBreakUniversal, Happy Kuzutopia, Onigiri HEROES, CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH, Terabit, and BLACK STELLAPTOLOMEA online games. It is also involved in receiving orders for sound production for theatrical films, animations, and other video works, as well as serving on production committees  art, manufacturing, and wholesale businesses  and operation of e-commerce sites via the internet and the planning of digital content. In addition, the company engages in development of network entertainment software, distributed network libraries, research and development of 3D graphics engines, and licensing and operation of online game services. The company was formerly known as CyberStep, Inc. and changed its name to CyberStep Holdings, Inc. in December 2025. CyberStep Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Suginami, Japan.

name: INTLOOP
businessSummary: INTLOOP Inc. provides system development, network construction, infrastructure implementation, and IT human resources services in Japan and internationally. The company also offers PMO, web services, professional recruitment support and human resource utilization service, technology solutions. In addition, it operates QEEE, comprehensive portal site  and BOOSTA, a human resource development service. Further, the company offers FUKURINT, a tax support application system. Additionally, it is involved in apparel sales businesses. INTLOOP Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: LANCERS
businessSummary: LANCERS,INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the platform business. The Company is engaged in the operation of a freelance platform Lancers that matches freelances and companies online. The Company is engaged in the provision of services in online stuffing platform area and crowdsourcing area. The online stuffing platform is a service in which clients can request work from specific lancers either directly or through agents and directors. The main work includes work with a high unit price such as system development and operation, design and creative production, article creation and others. The Company develops and provides directly order to freelancers services and selected freelancers introduction services in the area. The crowdsourcing is a service that requests work from an unspecified number of lancers and orders work based on deliverables. The main work includes work with relatively low unit costs such as data entry, article creation, logo design and others.

name: TOKAI TOKYO FINANCIAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Tokai Tokyo Financial Holdings, Inc. operates as a securities company in Japan. The company offers foreign and domestic equities  foreign, municipal, and structured bonds  derivatives  investment trust services  forex  and investment banking services, such as IPOs, public stock offerings, secondary sales, and mergers and acquisitions. It is also involved in the financial instruments business  research on economic conditions and corporate performance  creation and management of funds, and self-financed and fund investments  consulting on handling of testamentary trusts and inheritance property  asset management  education and training  provision of transfer agency, merchandising, printing, real estate rental management, and insurance agency services  and outsourced back-office operations. In addition, the company offers information, investment and securities management, advisory, and agency services. The company was formerly known as Tokai Tokyo Securities Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tokai Tokyo Financial Holdings, Inc. in April 2009. Tokai Tokyo Financial Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: RECOMM
businessSummary: Recomm Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, leases and sells information and communication equipment in Japan, China, India, and the ASEAN region. It operates through Domestic Solutions Business, Overseas Solution Business, and Business Process Re-Engineering (BPR) Business segments. The company engages in the sale of LED lighting  commercial air conditioners  SPACECOOL radioactive cooling materials  business phones  digital multifunction machines, such as copiers, printers, image scanners, and fax machines  energy-saving equipment  RoboWorker  UTM integration threatening control systems, MSG mail security, AI servers, and security endpoint products  virus sterilization equipment  robotic process automation products  other IT equipment  and telecommunications equipment. It also provides installation and maintenance services. In addition, the company offers outsourcing services for clients  business reform proposal consulting services  and contract management services. The company was formerly known as RECOMM Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Recomm Co., Ltd. in June 2013. Recomm Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: NIKON
businessSummary: Nikon Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the imaging, video, precision machinery, healthcare, components, and digital manufacturing businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Imaging Business segment provides products and services such as interchangeable lens digital cameras, digital cameras with integrated lens and interchangeable lenses. The Precision Equipment Business segment provides products and services for flat panel display (FPD) lithography equipment and semiconductor lithography equipment. The Healthcare Business segment provides products and services of biological microscopes and ultra-wide-angle scanning laser ophthalmoscopes. The Components Business segment provides products and services such as optical components, optical parts, encoders and materials processing. The Digital Manufacturing Business segment provides products and services of industrial microscopes and measuring instruments. The Others segment engages in other businesses.

name: ENIGMO
businessSummary: Enigmo Inc. is mainly engaged in operation of social shopping Website BUYMA. The Company operates though two business segments. The Social Commerce segment is in the operation of the social shopping Website BUYMA, users can use it to introduce, exhibit and sell of topics items. The Media segment is engaged in operation of media 4meee! for women use and media 4yuuu!for housewives and mothers use. Its media acts as advertising medium, expanding users by transmitting latest trends and earning sales mainly though advertising business.

name: TOMEN DEVICES
businessSummary: Tomen Devices Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the trading of semiconductors and electronic components. It conducts business through two segments which are Japan and Overseas. The Company's main products include semiconductor memory such as DRAM, NAND FLASH, multi-chip packages (MCPs), and solid-state drives (SSDs), and system-on-chip (SoC), display driver integrated circuit (DDI), complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) image sensor (CIS), power management integrated circuit (PMIC), system-in-package (SiP), foundry, and other large-scale integrated circuits (LSI), and displays such as liquid crystal panels (LCDs) and organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), and light-emitting diodes (LEDs), multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), batteries, and equipment.

name: GENERATION PASS
businessSummary: Generation Pass Co.,Ltd. offers e-commerce marketing services in Japan. It builds and operates e-commerce sites, as well as provides support services for new businesses, e-commerce operations, and business automation. It also offers interior and fabric products. In addition, the company operates Recommenddo, an internet shopping site which sells furniture, household goods, apparel, sporting goods, home appliances, food, and alcohol. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOPPAN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TOPPAN Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the information and communication, lifestyle and industry, and electronics business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Information and Communication segment provides gift card application service provider (ASP) services, radio frequency identification (RFID) solutions, payment-related services, digital content production, back-office operation and customer contact services, securities, integrated circuit (IC) cards and others. The communication media business provides sales promotion (SP) tools and manages events. The Lifestyle and Industry segment provides flexible packaging materials, various containers, ink and others. The Electronics Business Segment is involved in provision of color filters for displays, anti-reflective films, small and medium-sized thin-film transistor (TFT) liquid crystal display panels, and light control films, as well as photomasks and flip-chip ball grid array (FC-BGA) substrates.

name: HEPHAIST
businessSummary: HEPHAIST Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells linear motion devices and precision parts in Japan, China, and internationally. The company offers high-precision positioning stage, including XY ?, ultra-precision, Z-tilt, and Z-axis stages  linear bearing products, such as linear ball blushing, shaft holder, and miniature ball screw spline  ball spline with integrated rotary bearing  and spherical bearing, short shaft type, and sliding spherical bearing. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Hephaist Seiko Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to HEPHAIST Co., Ltd. in June 2020. HEPHAIST Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Kawagoe, Japan.

name: ORIX
businessSummary: ORIX Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the financial industry. It has 10 segments. The Corporate Sales and Maintenance Leasing segment engages in financial and various fee businesses, as well as leasing and rental of automobiles and electronic measuring instruments and information and communication technology (ICT) related equipment. The Real Estate segment engages in real estate development. The Business Investment and Concession segment engages in corporate investment and concessions. The Environmental Energy segment engages in domestic and international renewable energy, electricity retail, energy conservation services. The Insurance segment engages in life insurance. The Banking and Credit segment engages in banking and consumer loans. The Transportation Equipment segment engages in aircraft investment and management, and ship-related investment, financing, management, and brokerage. It also includes ORIX USA, ORIX Europe, Asia and Australia segments.

name: KIBUN FOODS
businessSummary: Kibun Foods Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, procurement, and sale of processed foods in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Domestic Food Business, Overseas Food Business, and Food-Related Business. The company offers processed seafood products  prepared foods, including gyoza dumplings, zero- carbohydrate noodles, tofu Somen-style noodles, rolled omelets and boiled eggs, and Japanese sweets  seafood delicacies  Osechi New Year's dishes, tiered box, and set  and other food products under various brand names. It sells its products through stores and online. The company was formerly known as Yamagataya Rice Shop and changed its name to Kibun Foods Inc. in January 1975. Kibun Foods Inc. was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: TOWA PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: TOWA PHARMACEUTICAL CO., LTD. is engaged in the manufacture and sale of ethical pharmaceutical products. The Company operates through two segments. The Domestic segment manufactures pharmaceutical products and sells them directly to medical institutions through its sales offices, as well as to agents, pharmaceutical wholesalers and other pharmaceutical manufacturers. Through its subsidiaries, the Company engages in businesses such as the research and manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients, the production of soft capsules, and the planning, development, and contract manufacturing of health foods and pharmaceuticals. The Overseas segment consists of a holding company that consolidates the generic pharmaceutical business in Europe and the United States. Its group companies have research and development and manufacturing bases in Europe, and are engaged in the generic pharmaceutical sales business and contract research and development and manufacturing business.

name: DIGITAL GRID
businessSummary: Digital Grid Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in power platform (PF) business, renewable energy PF business, adjustment power business, and decarbonization education business through the provision of the Digital Grid Platform (DGP). DGP is an energy trading platform that allows power generators and consumers to trade directly. The Company operates in three segments. The Power PF business segment covers non-renewable energy sources of electricity traded on the DGP. The Renewable Energy PF business segment covers renewable energy sources of electricity traded on the DGP. The Other segment is engaged in the decarbonization education business and adjustment power business. The decarbonization education business provides the online learning content GX navi to help practitioners acquire knowledge. The adjustment power business is a business that controls and operates independent stationary storage batteries.

name: SPEEE
businessSummary: Speee, Inc. engages in digital transformation business in Japan. It operates through Legacy Industry DX, DX Consulting, and Financial DX segments. The company offers UZOU, an ad distribution platform  Bantner, a marketing support services that utilize data integration methods and predictive analysis technology  Spec, provides business strategy planning and new service planning  as well as Comple, a system that automates tasks related to internal task requests and their collection. It also operates Ieuru, a site that supports real estate sales  Nurikae for requesting a quote for renovation  Sumai Step, a real estate sales bulk appraisal service  Caresuru, a matching service in the nursing care field  and Nurica, a consultation for customer service. In addition, it provides blockchain data platforms and back office services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: AND FACTORY
businessSummary: and factory, inc mainly engages in Smartphone APP business and Internet of Things (IoT) business. The Company operates three segments. The Smartphone APP segment develops and operates a bulletin board application called strongest series that seeks the strategy of popular smartphone game applications managed by other companies and recruits partners of multiplayer, as well as provides saevices through distribution platform such as App Store. The IoT segment develops IoT platform applications that enable operation of multiple IoT devices, develops accommodation area related technology, and provides IoT service. The Other segment operates the advertising agency business related to advertisement distribution service using the smartphone application or media managed by the company as a publication medium.

name: LIFEDRINK
businessSummary: LIFEDRINK COMPANY, INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of soft drinks and tea products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of soft drinks such as water drinks, tea-based drinks and carbonated drinks, as well as tea products such as green tea products, oolong tea products and barley tea products.

name: KEIKYU
businessSummary: Keikyu Corp is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in transportation, real estate, leisure and services, and distribution businesses. It operates through four business segments. Transportation segment is engaged in the management and operation of railway stations, bus business, as well as the taxi business. Real Estate segment sells and rents land and buildings. Leisure and Service segment is engaged in the operation of hotels and inns, leisure facilities, golf courses, and restaurants. Distribution segment sells products mainly through department stores and retail stores. It is also engaged in construction, civil engineering, and electrical equipment work, repair and modification of transportation equipment, building management services, and driving school operations.

name: STAR SEEDS
businessSummary: Star seeds Co.,Ltd. operates fashion apparel retail stores in Japan. It also provides grid-use battery storage, and GPU servers  and is involved in the energy-related business, planning and sales of apparel and fashion-related products, and procurement and sales of AI servers for data centers. The company was formerly known as C'sMEN Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Star seeds Co.,Ltd. in November 2024. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: KAWASAKI KISEN KAISHA
businessSummary: Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the marine transportation business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Dry Bulk segment is engaged in the dry bulk transportation business. The Energy Resource segment is engaged in liquefied natural gas carrier business, electric power business, oil tanker business, and offshore business. The Product Logistics segment is engaged in the car carrier business, the logistics business, the near sea and inland shipping business, and the container ship business. The Company is also engaged in the ship management business, the travel agency business, as well as the real estate leasing and management business.

name: OKAYA ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: OKAYA ELECTRIC INDUSTRIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic products. Along with its subsidiaries, the Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of noise-related products, such as noise suppression, capacitors, noise filters and others; surge products, including surge absorbers and others; display-related products, such as light-emitting diodes (LEDs), liquid crystal display (LCDs), field sequential products and others; as well as sensor-related products. The Company mainly operates its business in domestic and overseas markets.

name: KAJIMA
businessSummary: Kajima Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the civil engineering business, the construction business and the real estate development business. The Company operates through five business segments. The Civil engineering segment is engaged in the civil engineering business. The Construction segment is engaged in the construction business. The Development segment is engaged in the general real estate development business, the design, structural design and other design business, as well as the general engineering business. The Domestic Affiliates segment is engaged in the sale of construction materials and equipment, the contract of specialized work, as well as the general leasing business and the building leasing business in Japan. The Overseas Affiliates segment is engaged in the construction business and the real estate development business in overseas regions such as North America, Europe, Asia and Oceania.

name: OHMORIYA
businessSummary: OHMORIYA Co., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the food production and sale business covering all food products mainly including seaweed, as well as the real estate leasing business. The Food Production and Sale segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial laver products such as home laver, advanced products and sprinkles, both in Japan and overseas. Main products include seasoned laver, grilled laver, sprinkle, ochazuke, soup, among others.

name: TORIDOLL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: TORIDOLL Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates and manages restaurants in Japan and internationally. It operates through Marugame Seimen, Domestic Others, and Overseas Business segments. The company operates restaurants under the Marugame Seimen, BANPAIYA, Niku no Yamagyu, TORIDOLL, Butaya Ton-Ichi, Tempura Makino, Tonya Ton, Torido Ichiru, Nagata Honjoken, Toridon, Yamagyu General, Freshly Baked Koppe Pan, MONSTERCURRY, Kona's Coffee, ZUNDO-YA, MARUGAME UDON, WOK TO WALK, The Original Boat Noodle, SHORYU, Pokeworks, Tamjai Yunnan Mixian, TAMJAI SAMGOR, TAJMAI SAMGOR MIXIAN, and FRANCO MANCA brands. It also engages in the sale of agricultural products and household goods. The company was formerly known as Toridoll.corporation and changed its name to TORIDOLL Holdings Corporation in October 2016. TORIDOLL Holdings Corporation was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
