name: HOTLAND HOLDINGS
businessSummary: HOTLAND HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company is also involved in the development of Takoyaki shops and specialty stores, as well as bar business  staple food development business  manufacture, wholesale, and sale of frozen Takoyaki  and wholesale of seafood, as well as hosting of Japanese food events. In addition, it engages in the planning and graphic design  architecture, interior and exterior design, and sign construction  store promotion support  new business development  management of stores and restaurants  import/export/processing/sale of food and other merchandises  and development of education, restaurant, and other businesses, as well as provision of packaging services. The company was formerly known as HOTLAND Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to HOTLAND HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. in April 2025. HOTLAND HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SHIMANO
businessSummary: Shimano Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of bicycle components and fishing tackle. The Company conducts business through three segments. The Bicycle Components segment manufactures and sells drivetrain components such as derailleurs, braking components such as brakes, other bicycle parts, and related accessories. The Fishing Tackle segment manufactures and sells reels, rods, and fishing gear. The Other segment manufactures and sells rowing-related equipment and other products.

name: FUJIFILM HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fujifilm Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the healthcare, materials, business innovation, and imaging businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Healthcare segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services medical system equipment, contract manufacturing and development of biopharmaceuticals, drug discovery support materials such as cells, culture media, and reagents, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and supplements. The Materials segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services electronic materials, display materials, industrial materials, fine chemicals, graphic communication system materials, and inkjet materials. The Business Innovation segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services digital multifunction devices, solutions, and services. The Imaging segment develops, manufactures, sells, and services instant photo systems, color films, color paper, services, and equipment for photo printing, digital cameras, and optical devices.

name: TRIIS
businessSummary: TriIs Incorporated engages in the construction consulting and fashion brand businesses in Japan and internationally. The company provides support in the areas of planning, research, analysis, testing, planning and construction management of water-related projects, such as dams, rivers, and coastlines. It is also involved in planning, manufacturing, sale, and internet sale of women's clothing, handbags, and other leather products. In addition, the company engages in leasing and selling real estate  and real estate and securities investment businesses. TriIs Incorporated was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan

name: THECOO
businessSummary: Thecoo Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the fan community platform management business, the influencer marketing business and the online advertising business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Fanicon segment is engaged in the distribution, operation and management of fan community application platform Fanicon for general users. The Corporate Sales segment is engaged in the influencer sales business, the online advertising business, and the online marketing consulting business.

name: NITTO BOSEKI
businessSummary: Nitto Boseki Co Ltd is principally engaged in the electronic materials business, medical business, composite materials business, materials and chemicals business, insulation materials business, and other businesses. The Company operates in six business segments. The Electronic Materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for electronic materials. The Medical segment develops, manufactures, and sells in-vitro diagnostic reagents. The Composites segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for plastic reinforcement materials. The Materials and Chemicals segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass fiber products for industrial materials, chemical products, interlining products, functional materials, and dishcloths. The Insulation Materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells glass wool products for insulation, heat retention, and sound absorption. The Other segment designs industrial machinery and equipment.

name: JN GROUP
businessSummary: JN Group Inc. operates metaverse digital content, IoT solutions, and crypto asset and blockchain business in Japan, Hong Kong, and internationally. It engages in the planning, development, and sale of nursing care and AI robots  and agricultural ICT business. The company primarily focus on metaverse and digital content, including electronic registry business development  sales and marketing of computer software Information gathering on services and situations in the metaverse field development  and operation of commission platforms and web services. It also provides IOT solution, a system with various objects connected to a network exchange information with each other and perform various controls automatically  involved in cryptocurrency and blockchain business  data communication, M2M, and AI products  fleet management solutions, including acquires and manages vehicle information in real time  contract development and services, such as system development, developing support and consulting, various drivers and software development, localization of overseas products, examination, certification, and testing agency, and onsite and send back maintenance. In addition, it supplies, total solutions to logistics and restaurant chains  content production and support for virtual spaces and digital content comprising e-books, and other digital content  plans, produces, and sells various packages and promotional tools to retail chains such as cosmetic shops. Additionally, it engages in the wholesaling and retailing of food products  import and export of daily necessities  sales of miscellaneous goods  travelling related services  plan and implement corporate communication strategies  and consulting and engineering services. The company also offers a cryptocurrency exchange platform. The company was formerly known as NCXX Group Inc. and change its name to JN Group Inc. in March 2026. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Hanamaki, Japan.

name: ADISH
businessSummary: Adish Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of customer relations services, including support for social applications (Apps), social risk posting monitoring and cyber bullying countermeasures. The Company provides four kinds of services. Social app support provides customer support services that respond to inquiries from users on behalf of client companies. Internet monitoring provides a service that monitors posts made by users 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, and responds to alerts, reports, warnings, non-display, when inappropriate posts are found. School guardian provides consulting services to monitor writing and potential personal information breaches on the Internet that could be an issue in school life and use them in student guidance. Front support provides services for companies to maintain and improve connections with users and form a fan community by interacting with users using social media.

name: IPS
businessSummary: IPS, Inc. provides IT and telecommunications services in Japan and the Philippines. The company provides internet and data carrier services  domestic telecommunications services comprising toll-free services, service for MVNO businesses, trunk, and value-added services, as well as software, infrastructure, and telecom services. It also offers CloudSigma, a cloud computing services  and AmeyoJ, a contact center management software, as well as business process outsourcing services. In addition, the company operates clinics, which are specialized in cosmetic dermatology, and myopia correction surgery, as well as medical checkup and health checkup centers for preventive medical care. IPS, Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: INFCURION
businessSummary: Infcurion, Inc. develops a finance platform for all payment needs. The company provides payment infrastructure that enables digital wallets, issues international brand cards, and integrates with bank APIs. It also offers consulting services. Infcurion, Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: AIAI GROUP
businessSummary: AIAI Group Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates nursery school and child development support, and provides after school day services in Japan. The company operates licensed nursery schools, small-scale childcare facilities, certified daycare centers, and management facilities. It also offers child development support, medical child development support, after-school day care services, and visiting support for disabled children. In addition, the company provides human resource services, and engages in childcare facility management outsourcing business. The company was formerly known as global bridge HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AIAI Group Corporation in January 2022. AIAI Group Corporation was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: TAISEI
businessSummary: Taisei Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the civil engineering business, the construction business and the development business, as well as other business further associated with each business. The Company operates in three business segments. Civil Engineering segment operates business related to the construction of civil engineering works. Construction segment operates business related to general construction of buildings. Development segment operates business related to real estate in general, including sale, leasing, management and placement of real estate. The Company also operates businesses related to the construction industry, such as contract research, technology provision, and environmental measurement, as well as logistics, leisure-related, and other service businesses.

name: DAIKOKUYA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. operate pawnbroker business in Japan. It operates through the Electrical Equipment Business and Pawnbroking and Secondhand Goods Sales Business segments. The company offers industrial lighting fixtures, which include explosion-proof type and sealed anti-corrosion lighting equipment, hand lamp and emergency /portable explosion proof lighting equipment  industrial electric circuit plumbing fittings, such as explosion-proof type, sealed and waterproof electric circuit piping fixture, pull box, and waterproof flexible tube. It is also involved in providing control equipment, such as connectors  and various OEM products. The company also engages in the purchase and sale of second-hand branded goods, which include bags, watches, and jewelry. The company was formerly known as Asia Growth Capital, Ltd. and changed its name to Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. in August 2016. Daikokuya Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: COSMOS PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Cosmos Pharmaceutical Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the retail of pharmaceuticals and cosmetics. The Company’s products include pharmaceuticals such as over-the-counter medicines, energy drinks, oral care products, nursing care products, vitamins, health foods, diet foods, and prescriptions, cosmetics such as cosmetics, men's cosmetics, hair care products, and bath additives, miscellaneous goods such as baby products, detergents, insect repellents, air fresheners, bath and toilet supplies, cooking supplies, gardening supplies, car supplies, and clothing, general foods such as processed foods, daily necessities, seasonings, sweets, beverages, alcohol, and tobacco.

name: WITH US
businessSummary: With us Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of educational services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Tutoring School segment is engaged in the operation of tutoring schools with a focus on group and individual tutoring for elementary, middle and high school students. The High School Career Support segment involves in the operation of wide communication system high schools, examination guidance for obtaining various qualifications, the provision of examination guidance services for passing the high school level certification exams, as well as management of Japanese language schools. The others business is involved in the provision of information and communication technology (ICT) education and capacity development business, language services, as well as development of internal training portal sites.

name: TAUNS LABORATORIES
businessSummary: Tauns Laboratories Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the business of developing, manufacturing and marketing in vitro diagnostic products and research reagents. The Company operates its business in the in vitro diagnostic products business segment. The Company’s main product is antigen test kit that uses immunochromatography to enable rapid diagnosis at the patient's side without the need for special equipment. The products include ImunoAce Flu, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2 II, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2 Saliva, ImunoAce SARSCoV-2/Flu, ImunoAce Adeno, ImunoAce Strep A Neo, ImunoAce hMPV, ImunoAce Mycopiasma, ImunoAce RSV Neo and ImunoAce Noro.

name: TOYOTA TSUSHO
businessSummary: Toyota Tsusho Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in trading, manufacturing, processing, sales, investment and services in Japan and overseas. The Company has eight business segments. Metal+(Plus) segment handles automotive steel and aluminum, steel pipes and building materials. Circular Economy segment handles metals, battery materials, scrap, recycled resin and chemicals. Supply Chain segment engages in logistics, mobility parts, technoparks, airport operations and environmental solutions. Mobility segment imports and sells vehicles and parts. Green Infrastructure segment engages in machinery, renewable energy, fuels and infrastructure. Digital Solutions segment handles automotive and electronic components, software, networks and cybersecurity. Lifestyle segment handles food, textiles, medical and housing products, insurance, hospitals and hotels. Africa segment engages in mobility, infrastructure, healthcare and retail. The Company also provides group support services.

name: TEAR
businessSummary: TEAR Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the funeral business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Funeral segment is in the operation of directly-managed funeral hall, under the name Funeral Hall Tear in Tokai, Kanto and Kansai. It engages in implementation of funeral ceremonies at directly-managed funeral halls, individual homes and temples, as well as in the provision of Buddhist memorial services for end of mourning and anniversary of death after the funeral ceremonies. This segment also established a unique membership system under the name Tear’s Association. The Franchise segment provides Funeral Hall Tear business nationwide, signs a franchise agreement for business companies of different industries. It is engaged in the provision of entrance know-how to the funeral service industry, development of properties, provision of operational guidance with supervisors, as well as sales of funeral incidental products.

name: NISSIN FOODS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nissin Foods Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly focuses on the manufacturing and sales of instant foods, primarily instant noodles, and aims to expand into related businesses such as other food businesses and logistics. There are six business segments. The Nissin Foods Business segment offers major brands such as Chicken Ramen, Demae Itcho, and Nissin Yakisoba in cup noodles, cup rice, and bagged noodles. The Myojo Foods Business segment offers soupless noodles, the Myojo Ippei-chan Yakisoba series and Myojo Bubuka Abura Soba in cup noodles, and the Myojo Charumera series in bagged noodles. The Chilled and Frozen Beverage Business segment offers the Frozen Nissin Spa King Cafe and Frozen Nissin Chinese series, the Pilkul Miracle Care series following the peak of the sleep boom, the launch of new autumn products Pilkul Immune Style and Pilkul Aging Life, and Tokachi Drinking Yogurt. It also includes three business segments: Confectionery, Americas Region, China Region.

name: SEGA SAMMY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sega Sammy Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the gaming machine business, entertainment content business and resort business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Gaming Machine segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of pachislo machines and pachinko machines. The Entertainment Content segment is engaged in the development and sale of packaged games and amusement equipment centering on digital games, the development and operation of amusement facilities, the planning, production, sale of animation movies, as well as the development, manufacture and sale of toys. The Resort segment is engaged in the development and operation of hotels and golf courses in integrated resort business and other facilities business.

name: BROADBAND SECURITY
businessSummary: BroadBand Security, Inc. is a Japan-based company engaged in security service business. The Company’s services include security audit consulting service, vulnerability diagnosis service and information leakage IT countermeasure service. Information Disclosure In the security equipment management service in IT countermeasure services, it sells security equipment to customers and purchase them from manufacturers. In addition, it receives license from overseas security software company in secure mail service and malware detection service. Vulnerability assessment service sometimes outsources a part of vulnerability diagnosis for smart phones.

name: VERITAS IN SILICO
businessSummary: Veritas In Silico Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceutical discovery platform business. The main business is small molecule drug discovery targeting messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA) using the ibVIS platform, which integrates digital technology including in silico ribonucleic acid (RNA) structural analysis technology and drug discovery technology, through joint drug discovery research with pharmaceutical companies to create mRNA-targeted small molecule drugs.

name: EISAI
businessSummary: Eisai Co Ltd is a Japan-based pharmaceutical company mainly engaged in the research and development, manufacture, sale, import and export of pharmaceuticals. The Company operates in two business segments. The Pharmaceutical segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals for medical use, generic drugs, general medicines, among others. The segment operates in five regions including Japan, Americas (North America), China, EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa, Russia, Oceania), Asia and Latin America (Korea, Taiwan, India, ASEAN, Latin America). The Others segment is involved in license revenues and pharmaceutical raw materials business. The Company is also engaged in the provision of brands such as the anticancer drugs Lembima and Halaven on the nerve and oncology areas.

name: SHARP
businessSummary: Sharp Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of telecommunications equipment, electrical equipment and components. It operates through five business segments. The Smart Life & Energy segment provides refrigerators, superheated steam ovens, microwave ovens, small cooking appliances, air conditioners, washing machines, vacuum cleaners, air purifiers, fans, dehumidifiers, humidifiers, electric heating equipment, plasma cluster ion generators, and hairdressing equipment. The Smart Office segment provides digital multifunction devices, information displays, and business projectors. The Universal Network segment provides televisions, Blu-ray Disc recorders, audio equipment, cell phones, tablet terminals, routers. The Display Devices segment provides display modules, in-vehicle cameras. The Electronic Devices segment provides camera modules, sensor modules, opto sensors, opto-devices, wafer foundries, semiconductor lasers.

isin: 6166.T|Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd.|6166.T|Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd.
name: NAKAMURA CHOUKOU
businessSummary: Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells precision equipment, chemical fiber spinning nozzles, and therapeutic science-related products in Japan. The company operates through Special Precision Equipment Business  Chemical Fiber Spinning Nozzle Business  D-Next Business  and Materials Science Business segments. It offers DINA-PRISM, a diamond wire cutting tool for the slicing process of electronic materials used in solar batteries, LEDs, etc.  PHX-01, a diamond wire manufacturing equipment  and high-precision equipment comprising wear-resistant parts for use in the manufacturing of bearings, electronics, and machine tools  adsorption nozzles that are used to pick and place electronic parts, automatic nozzle cleaners for electronic part adsorbing nozzles  and micro reactor items, including automated flow reactors, micromixers, and mass flow controllers for gaseous reagents, as well as automatic nozzle cleaner. The company also designs, manufactures, and sells spinnerets, precision parts, and machinery units for synthetic and chemical fibers, and meltblown and spunlace nonwoven fabrics  manufactures and sells industrial equipment, such as shower plates, fuel injectors, and medical devices, as well as filters  and sells spinneret cleaning equipment and detergents. In addition, it is involved in the design and distribution of diamond-wire production machine and diamond-wire for semiconductor  design, manufacture, and distribution of chemical fiber spinning nozzle and its peripheral parts, nonwove-fabric production machine, and nonwoven-fabric peripheral nozzles  design, manufacture, and distribution of high-precision parts and tools  and development, manufacture, and distribution of nano-size zeolites powder. Nakamura Choukou Co., Ltd. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

name: GRCS
businessSummary: GRCS Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the protection of companies from the complex external environment by improving the efficiency of information management, mainly through the use of technology. The Company focuses on the perspectives of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) and security, and develops businesses to solve corporate issues arising from changes in the external environment. At present, the Company mainly operates in the security domain. By introducing dedicated tools for risk management, regulatory/policy management, internal audit, incident management, and other operations, the Company is able to help improve the efficiency of information management and achieve cross-company understanding and management. The company has a single segment, GRC Solutions, which is divided into Solutions and Product divisions based on the content of services.

name: NIKKON HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nikkon Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the transportation, warehousing, packaging, and testing businesses. It has four segments. The Transportation Business segment transports completed four-wheeled and two-wheeled automobiles and auto parts, housing equipment, agricultural machinery. The Warehousing Business segment stores completed four-wheeled and two-wheeled automobiles and auto parts, housing equipment, agricultural machinery. The Packaging Business segment provides distribution processing, delivery agency services for auto parts, and export packaging. The Testing Business segment tests completed four-wheeled and two-wheeled automobiles and auto parts, agricultural machinery. Other businesses include customs clearance, vehicle repair and maintenance, petroleum product sales, non-life insurance agency services, real estate sales, rental and intermediary management, waste disposal and collection, power generation and sales, and others.

isin: 9115.T|Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd.|9115.T|Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd.
name: MEIJI SHIPPING GROUP
businessSummary: Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the maritime business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Ocean Shipping Business, Hotel-Related Business, and Real Estate Rental Business. It owns crude and product oil, methanol, and chemical tankers, as well as LNG, LPG, car, container, chip, and bulk carriers that are operated under time charter parties with shipping companies. The company also offers ship management, crew manning, supervision of new shipbuilding construction, etc. In addition, it develops hotels, golf courses, and restaurants  and engages in the development office building, housing rental, insurance agency business, nursery school business, nursing home business and other properties. The company was formerly known as Meiji Shipping Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd. in October 2023. Meiji Shipping Group Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1911 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: OPTIM
businessSummary: OPTiM Corp is a Japan-based company that mainly engages in providing management services (administration and operation services) and information technology (IT) support services (assistance with the use and management of information devices IT applications and services). The Company operates the license sales and maintenance support services (optimal) business segment. The X-Tech services offer integrated platforms and industry-specific digital transformation (DX) solutions utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) and the Internet of things (IoT). The mobile management services enable unified management and security measures for smart devices and personal computers (PC) through cloud-based solutions. Other services include remote support, AI-powered camera analytics and electronic book services, among a diverse range of products.

name: INFORMATION STRATEGY AND TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Information Strategy and Technology Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital transformation (DX)-related business. The DX-Related Business segment consists of Tier 0 system development, which realizes DX for customers, and the WhiteBox service, which realizes DX for the system development industry. Tier 0 system development is an agile development method in which customers and engineers collaborate on development through repeated proposals and consultations, and can be changed in response to changes in business conditions. WhiteBox is a service that can be used by system development companies or freelancers who apply to use the service and are accepted as members.

name: SHIGA BANK
businessSummary: Shiga Bank Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of financial services centered on the banking business. The Bank is engaged in the provision of deposits, loans, domestic exchange, foreign exchange and securities investment services. The Bank is also involved in the finance leasing business, installment sales business, venture capital investment business, credit card business, cashing business, the operation of automated teller facilities outside its offices, as well as the provision of document storage and management services, real estate assessment services, data processing services, mortgage guarantee services and business operation-related consulting services.

name: HIRAMATSU
businessSummary: Hiramatsu Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the management of restaurants, cafes and hotels. The Company is engaged in development of restaurant business, wedding business, catering business, wine business and hotel business. The Company operates stores mainly in Tokyo, Kanagawa, Sapporo, Kanazawa, Nagoya, Osaka, Kyoto, Nara, Fukuoka, Okinawa and Paris. The overseas subsidiary is mainly engaged in the provision of food and beverages to the Company, as well as the operation and management of Restaurant Hiramatsu Paris in Paris.

name: CYND
businessSummary: CYND Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and provision of a cloud-based reservation management system for hairdressing and beauty stores. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of BeautyMerit, which is a cloud-based reservation management system that supports the connection between stores and customers. The system provides services that support the construction of optimal customer experience (CX) and digital transformation (DX) such as attracting customers, reservations, treatments, accounting and after-sales follow-up services.

name: KICHIRI HOLDINGS &
businessSummary: KICHIRI HOLDINGS & Co.,Ltd., a food service company, operates and manages restaurants and related operations in Japan. It is involved in franchising and licensing business. The company also sells and develops interview platform under the name Interview Cloud  and operates boutique hotel under name of Plataran Hotels & Resort. KICHIRI HOLDINGS & Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SAKIGAKE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Sakigake Holdings Co Ltd, formerly Kairikiya Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of food and beverage business. The Company operates the food and beverage business, including Kyoto Kitashirakawa Ramen Kairikiya, which features Kyoto-style pork back fat soy sauce ramen as its main product, and opens stores in suburban roadside locations and food courts in commercial facilities. Brands include Kyoto Kitashirakawa Ramen Kairikiya, Tsukemen Specialty Shop Mita Seimenjo, Sapporo Miso, and Karatamaya.

name: FUJI CORP AICHI
businessSummary: Fuji Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic component mounting robots and machine tools. It operates through two business segments. The Robot Solutions segment is engaged in the production of electronic component mounting robots and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Machine Tools segment is engaged in the production of machine tools. It is also engaged in the manufacture of control equipment, electronic equipment, and image processing development.

name: BALNIBARBI
businessSummary: Balnibarbi Co.,Ltd. operates and manages restaurants in Japan. It operates through the Restaurant and Estate Build-Up Business segments. The company offers consulting services for restaurant planning and management. It also engages in the manufacture, processing, and sale of food and beverages  planning and management of weddings, parties, banquets, and other events  and manufacture of sweets. In addition, the company is involved in the promotion of regional revitalization network formation and real estate development projects  home dining business, which includes takeout, delivery, markets, etc.  e-commerce business  and restaurant studio rental businesses. Balnibarbi Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: KONOSHIMA CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Konoshima Chemical Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells building materials, chemicals, and ceramics in Japan, Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers residential and non-residential ceramic siding, eaves, gable boards, and fireproof panels  and non-combustible building materials for residential and non-residential buildings. It also provides chemicals, such as magnesium oxide, magnesium hydroxide, and magnesium carbonate  synthetic magnesite, taichite, analcime, and boehmite  calcium carbonate  and thermally conductive filler. In addition, the company develops, manufactures, and sells functional ceramics. Konoshima Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: INTRANCE
businessSummary: Intrance Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Real Estate, Hotel Management, and Others. The company is involved in the revitalization, investment, management, development, purchase, and sale brokerage of real estate properties, including commercial, residential, and office buildings  and development, management, and operation of hotels, as well as provision of management consulting services. It also engages in hotel investment fund formation and management, as well as property acquisition and operation  and inbound tourism operation business. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: CARNA BIOSCIENCES
businessSummary: Carna Biosciences, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, researches and develops drug therapies to treat unmet medical needs in Japan. It offers kinase proteins and other protein products, including tyrosine, serine/threonine, lipid, inactive kinase, and pseudokinase  GST-tagged and Biotinylated  Protein Substrate  and Luciferase PPI Stable Cell Lines, such as GPCR and protein-protein interactions. The company also provides activity-based biochemical screening/profiling assay services comprising mobility shift assay/IMAP and AFP-Glo assay  and cell-based assay services which include NanoBRET TE intracellular kinase assay and split luciferase protein-protein interaction detection assay. In addition, it engages in developing monzosertib, an orally bioavailable small molecule inhibitor of cell division cycle 7 (CDC7) kinase that is in Phase 1 to treat various cancer cell lines, including solid and blood cancers  docirbrutinib, an orally bioavailable, non-covalent pan-inhibitor of wild type and mutant Bruton's tyrosine kinases for the treatment of chronic lymphocytic leukemia and other B-cell malignancies  and sofnobrutinib, a non-covalent Bruton's tyrosine kinases which is in clinical development to treat inflammatory and immune disorders. Carna Biosciences, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

name: NULAB
businessSummary: Nulab Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cloud services business. The Cloud Services Business segment is primarily engaged in service development and marketing. Its main products include Backlog, a tool to manage, Cacoo, a visual collaboration tool, Typetalk, a business chat tool, and Nulab Pass, a tool to facilitate ID management and improve information security and governance in organizations. The Company operates within Japan market and overseas market.

name: SUSMED
businessSummary: SUSMED,Inc. develops and sells therapeutic applications and platform systems in Japan. It operates through DTx product business, and DTx platform business segments. The company develops smartphone-based therapeutic apps for diseases, such as insomnia, breast cancer, and kidney disease. It also develops and provides clinical trial systems with blockchain technology. In addition, the company offers medical data analysis and consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: WEST HOLDINGS
businessSummary: West Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, construction, sales, operation and maintenance (O&M) of public and industrial photovoltaic power generation systems, the west esco business of energy-saving services, and the sales of electricity to companies and local governments. The Company operates through four business segments. The Electric Power segment is engaged in the new electric power (PPS) business, power generation and sales business using solar power generation systems. The Renewable Energy segment is engaged in the construction and sales business of public and industrial photovoltaic power generation systems and the construction, sales and wholesale business of environment-friendly remodeling. The Energy-Saving Business segment provides total energy-saving services. The Maintenance Business segment is engaged in the comprehensive management and maintenance business for photovoltaic power generation systems and related equipment.

name: HAMAMATSU PHOTONICS KK
businessSummary: Hamamatsu Photonics KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and selling optoelectronic products, including photomultiplier tubes, imaging equipment and light sources, optical semiconductor devices, image processing and measurement equipment, laser equipment, and laser components. The Company operates four business segments. The Electron Tube Business Segment manufactures and sells photomultiplier tubes, imaging equipment, and light sources. The Optoelectronic Semiconductor Business Segment manufactures and sells optoelectronic semiconductor devices and other products. The Image Processing and Measurement Equipment Business Segment manufactures and sells image processing and measurement equipment and other products. The Laser Business Segment manufactures and sells laser equipment and laser equipment components, among other products. In addition, the Company also engages in the hotel business and operations related to proprietary products.

name: KIPS
businessSummary: Kips Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company engaged in venture finance business and event media business. The Company operates in two business segments. In the Venture Finance business segment, the advisor business advises on capital policies of venture companies; the investment business provides investment and advice to venture capital firms. In the Event Media business segment, the event business is responsible for managing events related to support for venture companies in local governments and business companies; in the media business, the company produces articles and publishes advertisements for the monthly information magazine THE INDEPENDENTS published by the company.

name: ABEJA
businessSummary: ABEJA Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in digital platform business. The Company operates through the digital platform business. The Company is classified into two main areas base on ABEJA Platform. In the transformation area, introducing the ABEJA Platform and providing professional services that meet the digital transformation needs of companies. In the operation area, various systems built on the ABEJA Platform are provided as general mechanisms and services.

name: KYUSHU LEASING SERVICE
businessSummary: KYUSHU LEASING SERVICE CO., LTD. is a Japan-based comprehensive financial services company engaged in the provision of a diverse range of products and services centered on leasing and installment sales, but also encompassing finance, real estate and fee-based businesses in an integrated manner to a broad customer base. It operates through five business segments. Leasing and Installment Sales segment engages in the leasing and installment sales of machinery and equipment. Finance segment handles money lending, the purchase of receivables, and credit guarantees. Real Estate segment conducts real estate leasing and sales, as well as investments in silent partnerships. Fee Business segment carries out activities such as soliciting life insurance, referring automobile leases, and acting as an agent for non-life insurance. Environmental Solutions segment operates businesses such as electricity sales and light emitting diode (LED) lighting rentals. It also engages in the sale of goods.

name: MITSUBISHI MOTORS
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Motors Corp is engaged in the development, production and sale of automobile and related parts, as well as the financial business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automobile segment is engaged in the manufacture of general and small-sized passenger vehicles and light vehicles, the sale of parts, new car inspection, maintenance and logistics of parts in domestic markets, and the manufacturing and sales in overseas market. Its major products include electric vehicles, sports utility vehicles (SUVs) and pickups, passenger cars and minivans, and light vehicles. The Financing segment is engaged in the automobile leasing business and sales finance business.

isin: 5597.T|BLUE INNOVATION CO LTD|5597.T|Blue Innovation Co., Ltd.
name: BLUE INNOVATION
businessSummary: Blue Innovation Co., Ltd. provides inspection, disaster prevention, education, and logistics solutions in Japan and internationally. It offers Blue Earth Platform, a software platform that controls and manages drones and robots for various solutions. The company also provides inspection solutions, including drone power line inspection, inspection and surveying, underwater inspection, sewer inspection, and inspection starter pack, as well as inspection outsourcing plan and robot-based automated patrol inspection  and port solutions, such as drone disaster prevention, automated patrol, and port information management system, as well as portable and fixed drone ports. In addition, it offers education and pilot support solutions comprising plant inspection specialist training course, drone flight log creation and information management service, dedicated drone flight support map service, and compensation  and robot cleaning solutions for offices. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

name: ISUZU MOTORS
businessSummary: Isuzu Motors Ltd is a Japan-based automobile manufacturer. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of automobiles, parts, and industrial engines, and provides logistics and other services related to these products. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and sale of commercial vehicles and light commercial vehicles (LCVs), such as large-sized trucks, buses, small-sized trucks and pick-up trucks, as well as automobile components and industrial engines.

isin: 7771.T|Nihon Seimitsu Co., Ltd.|7771.T|Nihon Seimitsu Co., Ltd.
name: NIHON SEIMITSU
businessSummary: Nihon Seimitsu Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells watch bands and eyeglass frames in Japan. The company also offers titanium processing for fish rod components and ion plating surface treatment processing. In addition, it manufactures keypad-operated electronic locks. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Kawaguchi, Japan.

name: ARE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ARE Holdings Inc, formerly Asahi Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the precious metals business and environmental conservation business. The Company operates two businesses. The Precious Metals segment is engaged in the recycling and sale of precious and rare metals such as gold, silver, palladium, and platinum from scrap metal containing precious metals, and refining and processing of precious metals, mainly gold and silver. The Environmental Conservation segment is mainly engaged in the collection, transportation, and intermediate treatment of industrial waste.

name: FUJI OIL CO LTD OSAKA
businessSummary: Fuji Oil Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of vegetable oils and fats, chocolate for commercial use, emulsified and fermented ingredients, and processed soybean ingredients. It operates its business through four segments. The Vegetable Oils and Fats business segment manufactures and sells edible processed oils and fats, edible oils, and oils and fats for chocolate made from palm oil, palm kernel oil, and other basic ingredients. The Commercial Chocolate business segment manufactures and sells chocolate, compounds, and cocoa products. The Emulsified and Fermented Ingredients segment manufactures and sells cream, margarine, and fillings. The Processed Soy Ingredients business segment manufactures and sells soy protein ingredients, soy protein foods, and water-soluble soy polysaccharides. In addition, the Company also develops business activities such as logistics and other services related to each business segment.

name: ANICOM HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Anicom Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of non-life insurance, pet Internet services, veterinary clinic management, and health innovation businesses. The Company has four business segments. The Non-life Insurance Business segment includes pet insurance and pet liability insurance. The Pet Internet Services Business segment operates breeder matching sites and foster parent matching sites for adoptions. The Veterinary Clinic Management Business segment operates veterinary clinics. The Health Innovation Business segment promotes animal health checks and develops and sells oral and intestinal care products based on various tests. The Company also provides veterinary clinic support, insurance agency services, and genetic testing.

name: GENKI GLOBAL DINING CONCEPTS
businessSummary: Genki Global Dining Concepts Corp, formerly Genki Sushi Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in restaurant-related businesses. The Company operates through two segments. The domestic business operates sushi restaurants. The overseas business operates overseas franchises and sushi restaurants. The Company also purchases ingredients.

name: COLOWIDE
businessSummary: Colowide Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in restaurant management business in Japan and internationally. It also engages in purchasing and selling various foodstuffs and processing sales, as well as tobacco and alcoholic beverages. The company also manufactures and sells confectioneries, baked goods, and chocolates, as well as sauces for commercial and consumer use  sells and distributes liquors and other related beverages  and provides catering services. In addition, it is involved in the planning, operation and maintenance of IT systems, call center administration services  and product development, procurement, manufacturing, and logistics for various food products, as well as provides catering services. Further, the company operates the Wolfgang Puck restaurant  and Izakaya, Japanese, and Italian Cuisine. The company operates its restaurants under the Doma Doma, Kamadoka, Gyu-Kaku, Shabu Shabu On-Yasai, Tonkatsu Kagurazaka SAKURA, FRESHNESS BURGER, Gyu-Kaku Yakiniku Shokudo, Gyu-Kaku Buffet, Ajifurai Kagurazaka SAKURA, Steak MIYA, KALUBI TAISHO, GANKO-TEI, NIGIRI-NO-TOKUBE, KATSUDOKI, KAISEN ATOM, Wagyu Steak SAKURA, CHIISANA MORI COFFEE, Grillé Mia, Kamakura Kabuto, OOTOYA Gohan-Dokoro, NAGISA BASHI CAFÉ, CANTINA, TEMPURA MATSUI, and Mitsumori names. It also provides management and franchises, as well as sells products, and supplies ingredients and other materials. Colowide Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: KLAB
businessSummary: KLab Inc. provides mobile online games in Japan and internationally. It engages in the planning, development, operation, and sale of mobile online games, as well as anime investments. The company operates GPU AI cloud business  AI entertainment business  AI creative production. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: WINTEST
businessSummary: Wintest Corp. engages in the provision of automatic testing of semiconductors and sensors in Japan. The company offers LCD, PDP, and OLED driver IC test equipment  digital output CMOS image sensor and standard logic test equipment  OLED, LCD, LCOS Array, CCD, and CMOS image sensor test equipment  analog mixed signal IC test equipment  and other test related products. It is also involved in the design and construction, inspection, maintenance, and assurance to solar power generation systems  agent or representative of solar panel monitoring  and provision of cleaning and coating services, as well as insurance handling services and consulting services  and sale and maintenance of environmental equipment. In addition, the company designs and manufactures signal generators for LCD and OLED panels, automatic machines and handlers, and AOI test systems  and automatic test equipment for semiconductor integrated circuit and flat panel display. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: YAMANASHI CHUO BANK
businessSummary: Yamanashi Chuo Bank Ltd is mainly engaged in the financial service business including banking business and credit card business. The Banking segment is engaged in the deposit, loan, securities trading, investment securities, domestic and foreign exchange business, as well as the over-the-counter sales of corporate bond trustee services, government bonds and other public bonds, investment trust and insurance, and the consulting business through the head office and branches. Through consolidated subsidiaries, the Bank provides credit guarantee services to complement lending operations. The others business is engaged in the leasing business, credit card business, as well as the provision of general consulting, venture capital and other banking related businesses.

name: KADOKAWA
businessSummary: KADOKAWA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the publishing and intellectual property (IP) creation business, and others. The Company operates through five business segments. The Publishing and IP Creation Business segment publishes and sells books, e-books, e-magazines, and magazines, sells online advertisements, and plans and sells other IP creation-related products. The Animation and Live-Action Video Business segment plans, produces, and distributes anime and live-action video, licenses video distribution rights, and sells video package software. The Game Business segment plans, develops, and sells game software and network games. The Web Services Business segment operates video community services, plans and manages various events, and distributes mobile content. The Education and EdTech Business segment plans and manages online education and vocational schools. The Company also plans and sells character goods, and others.

name: MUNINOVA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Muninova Holdings Inc. engages in the consumer finance and credit guarantee business in Japan. It offers loans for individuals and businesses  credit cards, prepaid cards, individual credit purchase arrangements, and deferred payment options  credit guarantees  and pet insurance, as well as investing in a range of businesses. The company is also involved in leaseback, corporate restructuring, small amount short-term insurance business, venture capital, and SES business, rent guarantee, and crowdfunding businesses, as well as the provision of system development, maintenance, and operation services for its clients. Aiful Corporation was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

name: MWCC
businessSummary: MWCC Inc. engages in the microwave chemical-related business in Japan. The company conducts research and development, engineering, actual machine manufacturing, and manufacturing support for microwave-based manufacturing processes. It uses a platform to develop and provide the microwave solutions for various industries. The company is also involved in installing DPS cartridges into customers existing drainage lines and recovering the value of low-concentration precious metals. The company was formerly known as Microwave Chemical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to MWCC Inc. in October 2026. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

name: PHOTOSYNTH
businessSummary: Photosynth Inc mainly develops services that utilize Internet of Things (IoT) devices such as smart locks and cloud-type authentication platforms, and provides them through a subscription model. The Company mainly operates Akerun business. The Akerun business develops related services centered on personal authentication and security using edge terminals such as smart locks that connect to the cloud and the Internet for corporations and housing toward the realization of a keyless society. The Akerun business is provided as Hardware Enabled Software as a Service (HESaaS) based on a subscription model, has access authentication platforms and cloud security systems, and owns value as an authentication platform that utilizes the access authentication platform.

name: KEY COFFEE
businessSummary: Key Coffee Inc. engages in the coffee business in Japan and internationally. The company produces and markets coffee, food ingredients and tea products for commercial, household  and food and beverage services at directly managed stores include providing customers with drinks, food, sweets, etc. It also operates a plantation business. In addition, the company offers home-brewed and professional-use products. It serves consumers, restaurants, food wholesalers, beverage manufacturers. The company was formerly known as Kimura Shotten and changed its name to Key Coffee Inc. Key Coffee Inc. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ATOM
businessSummary: ATOM Corporation engages in the restaurant business in Japan. It manages owned and franchised restaurants, including steakhouses, izakaya, conveyor-belt sushi, yakiniku, Japanese, western, and tonkatsu restaurants, as well as cafes establishments. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: FUKUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Fukuoka Financial Group, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company that provides comprehensive financial services centered on banking operations. It engages in banking and other business activities. Banking operations are conducted through the head office and various branches, encompassing deposit-taking, lending, and domestic and foreign exchange services. Other business activities include securities services, credit guarantee services, business revitalization support, credit management and collection, and leasing operations.

name: CYFUSE BIOMEDICAL KK
businessSummary: Cyfuse Biomedical KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of cell products. The Company is engaged in the development of pipelines for obtaining approval for regenerative medicine products and contract research cell products in the field of regenerative medicine. The Company is engaged in the development of cell products as tools for drug discovery support for pharmaceutical companies in the drug discovery support field. The Company is engaged in the development and sell of three-dimensional cell stacking system equipment equipped with basic technology, apply technology for cell product development, and develop new technology in the device field.

name: TAKARA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Takara Holdings Inc is Japan-based alcoholic beverage manufacturing holding company. The Company operates three segments. The Takara Shuzo segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages, including shochu, sake, and soft alcoholic beverages, as well as alcoholic seasonings such as mirin, food seasonings, and raw alcohol in Japan. The Takara Shuzo International Group segment exports alcoholic beverages from Japan, manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages overseas, and wholesales Japanese food ingredients. The Takara Bio Group segment develops bio-drug discovery technology through its reagent and equipment business and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) business. The Company also engages in freight transportation, wine import and sales, and real estate rental businesses.

name: CCREB ADVISORS
businessSummary: CCReB Advisors Inc. provides corporate real estate (CRE) solution in Japan. It develops real estate tech systems to support businesses, such as real estate investment, real estate buying and selling, rental brokerage, consulting, and project management. The company also offers CCReB GATEWAY, a B2B portal site that provides the latest management trends and essential information for corporate management  CCReB AI, a CRE sales support system  CCReB CREMa, a commercial real estate matching system  CCReB PROP, a fixed asset data extraction tool  CCReB Clip, an information support tool that creates target lists based on computer disclosure documents, including prospect lists, market statistics, and other analytical datasets  CCReB BI, a real estate research tool  and CCChat, a chat system utilizing generative AI. CCReB Advisors Inc. was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: HU GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: H.U. Group Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in engages in businesses such as contracted clinical testing, the manufacture and sale of clinical testing reagents, and sterilization and surgery-related services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Testing and Related Services segment provides comprehensive testing services to medical institutions and includes clinical testing, outsourced health checkup services, and testing services for food, the environment, and cosmetics. The Clinical Testing Reagents segment manufactures and sells clinical testing reagents, including operations include the Lumipulse business, Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) and raw material supply businesses, and other products. The Healthcare-Related Services segment engages in sterilization and surgery-related businesses, as well as home-based services.

name: KUBELL
businessSummary: kubell Co Ltd, formerly Chatwork Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of business communication tools developed in-house and sales agent of security software. The Company operates in two segments. The Chatwork segment is mainly engaged in the development and provision of business chat tool Chatwork. It is also engaged in the provision of advertising service and various services using Chatwork as a service platform. The sgement also develops and provides cloud storage services, such as Secure SAMBA. The Security segment purchases and sells security software. The Security Segment is engaged in the purchases and sales of security software. The Company’s sales site uses web advertisement and affiliate programs to attract customers and sell software.

name: G NEXT
businessSummary: G-NEXT Inc provides Discoveriez, a platform for digital transformation (DX) of customer service, mainly in the cloud format for companies of various sizes and industries. The Company operates Customer DX platform business segment. Discoveriez is a software unifying the contents of calls, emails and chats from customers received at the call center, sharing information with stakeholders such as internal departments and outside the Company, approving and recording response processing by workflow, risk management, quality control and new product development information, aggregation and analysis in a cloud format. The Company provides two services, including the cloud business, which provides a versatile platform Discoveriez that sublimates the know-how cultivated through conventional on-premises customer service counters into a cloud type, and the on-premise business, which is an on-premise customer service counter service.

businessSummary: Architects Studio Japan Inc. provides design and construction support services in Japan. The company supports architects in designing and constructing buildings such as residences, commercial facilities, and apartment complexes. It also provides furniture, tableware, watches, precious metals, premium food products, specially selected ingredients, and luxury branded items sold through EG sales. In addition, the company holds events and seminars for registered architects  and provides housing, renovation, and commercial construction services, as well as offering loans to customers. Further, the company involves network, production, renovation, business support, creative, merchandising, investment-related and overseas business. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: GNI GROUP
businessSummary: GNI Group Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of pharmaceuticals and biomaterials in Japan, China, and the United States. It operates in two segments, Pharmaceutical Business and Medical Equipment Business. The company offers ETUARY for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis  H-GENIN Crush-Mix for the treatment of bone defects  AltiPly for the treatment of acute and chronic wounds  and orthobiologics products. Further, it develops CG001419 which is in Phase Ia clinical trial for the treatment of acute and chronic pain  CG001419 which is in Phase Ia clinical trial for the treatment of solid tumors  and CG009301 which is in Phase Ia clinical trial for the treatment of leukemia and MYC+ cancers. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: MIDAC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Midac Holdings Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the waste disposal business. The Company operates through three major business segments. The Waste Disposal segment is engaged in the provision of waste disposal services via its facilities. The Waste Collection and Transportation segment is mainly engaged in the collection and transportation of waste. The Brokerage Management segment provides operator introduction services to the processing company. The Waste Disposal segment consists of intermediate disposal of waste and final disposal of waste.

name: SUMITOMO PHARMA
businessSummary: Sumitomo Pharma Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates through three geographical segments. The Japan segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of prescription drugs, purchase and sale of medical devices, undertakes development and manufacture in the field of regenerative medicine and cellular medicine, and the manufacture of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and regenerative medicine products that have been developed through joint development in the field of regenerative medicine. This segment also provides storage and delivery service of pharmaceuticals. The North America segment is engaged in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of prescription drugs. The Asia segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of prescription drugs (small packaging), and the import, purchase and sale of prescription drugs in Southeast Asia and Taiwan, as well as the provision and collection of information on products.

name: EUGLENA
businessSummary: Euglena Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that sells food and cosmetics using microalgae including Euglena (Japanese name: Midorimushi) and develops and manufactures biofuels. The Company operates through three business segments. The Healthcare Business segment is mainly engaged in the planning and sales of healthcare products including food and cosmetics, the supply of original equipment manufacturers (OEM), as well as the development and production of raw materials. The Biofuel Business segment is mainly engaged in research and development, production and sales of biofuels, as well as the development of cultivation technology for microalgae, primarily Euglena. The Other Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacturing and sale of organic compound fertilizers, genetic analysis services, social business, as well as research and development in new fields.

name: NISHI NIPPON FINANCIAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nishi-Nippon Financial Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the banking service and other financial services. The Banking segment is engaged in the provision of financial products and services to local customers through deposits, lending, securities investment, foreign exchange, and over-the-counter sales of investment trusts and insurance products. The Company also provides finance-related services such as credit guarantees, credit cards, and financial instruments trading, as well as information systems services.

name: LITALICO
businessSummary: Litalico Inc is a Japan-based real estate company that provides employment and learning support services in the field of disability welfare. The Company operates through four business segments. The Employment Support Business segment provides comprehensive support to people with disabilities seeking employment, from employment to workplace setup. The Child Welfare Business segment provides child development support services, after-school day care services and nursery school visit support services. The Platform Business segment operates a matching media platform and provides recruitment services for facility users and staff and provides software as a service (SaaS) product for facilities. The Overseas Business segment operates a publicly funded group home for people with severe behavioral disorders in Nebraska and provides services related to housing and daytime activity support in other areas.

It offers aircraft engine parts, servo press machines, fully chrome-free coating, dies and molding, and automotive parts. In addition, the company provides dies-molding, and extrusion dies for aluminum and ceramic honeycomb. Further it engages in surface treatment of aircraft engine components, gas turbine components, and automobile-related items, chromium-free coating  and creating mechatronics products, making, and manufacturing of related items, and commissioning of press composite processing system, digital servo press, and press parts. Hoden Seimitsu Kako Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: ASTERISK
businessSummary: Asterisk Inc. provides sensors, barcode readers, RFID reader writer, infrared communication devices, and facial recognition systems. It also provides infrared, wireless communication, and image recognition products and accessories  and mobile POS systems, logistics systems, and inspection work systems. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: SOLASIA PHARMA KK
businessSummary: Solasia Pharma K.K. develops, markets, imports, and exports pharmaceutical products and medical devices in Japan, China, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers Episil (SP-03), an oral liquid for oral mucositis/stomatitis  DARVIAS (SP-02), an antineoplastic agent injection for relapsed or refractory peripheral T-cell lymphoma  and Sancuso (SP-01) for chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting. The company was formerly known as JapanBridge, Inc. and changed its name to Solasia Pharma K.K. in September 2008. Solasia Pharma K.K. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: KRINGLE PHARMA
businessSummary: Kringle Pharma, Inc. engages in research and develops therapeutic agents for the treatment of intractable diseases in Japan. The company develops HGF products for the treatment of acute spinal cord injury, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, vocal fold scar, and acute kidney injury. Kringle Pharma, Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kita, Japan.

name: SHIBAURA MECHATRONICS
businessSummary: SHIBAURA MECHATRONICS CORPORATION is a Japan-based manufacturer primarily engaged in fine mechatronics business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Fine Mechatronics segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of flat panel display (FPD) manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, maintenance equipment for railroad tracks and vacuum pumps. The Mechatronics System segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of FPD manufacturing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, vacuum application equipment, secondary battery manufacturing equipment, precision parts manufacturing equipment and automatic equipment, among others. The Distribution Equipment System segment is engaged in the provision of vending machines, automatic ticket machines and others. The Real Estate Leasing segment is involved in the leasing and management of real estate properties.

name: NEC CAPITAL SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: NEC Capital Solutions Limited provides financial services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Leasing Business, Finance Business, Investment Business, and Other Business. The Leasing Business segment is involved in the leasing, rental, and installment sale of information communication equipment, office equipment, and other various facilities and equipment  and sale of goods related to leasing, sale of properties due to expiration or early cancellation, maintenance services for leased equipment, etc. The Finance Business segment comprises money lending, factoring, securities investment, etc. for the purpose of receiving dividend income. The Investment Business segment engages in investment in venture companies for the purpose of receiving proceeds from the sale of securities, etc., as well as assets, real estate, and advisory businesses. The Other Business segment includes businesses in the field of energy, tourism, agriculture, healthcare, PFI/PPP business, generation and sale of solar power, and other services. The company offers financial services, such as factoring, settlement and collection agency, and receivables flow management. It serves government agencies, local governments, large corporations, and small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was formerly known as NEC Leasing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NEC Capital Solutions Limited in November 2008. NEC Capital Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SOJITZ
businessSummary: Sojitz Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the buying, selling, and trading of goods, the manufacture and sale of products, the provision of services, the planning and coordination of projects, and financial activities. The Company operates in seven business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in the wholesale of automobiles. The Aviation Industry and Transportation Projects Segment is engaged in aviation, transportation, and social infrastructure projects. The Infrastructure & Healthcare segment is engaged in the environmental infrastructure business. The Metals, Mineral Resources & Recycling Segment conducts mineral resources and resource recycling businesses. The Chemicals Segment provides various chemical raw materials and products. The Living Essentials & Agribusiness segment provides various food raw materials. The Retail & Consumer Services segment provides food and consumer goods distribution and convenience store operations.

name: ZENSHO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Zensho Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the food industry. The Company has six segments. The Global Sukiya segment operates the beef bowl chain Sukiya domestically and overseas. The Global Hama Sushi segment operates the sushi chain Hama Sushi domestically and overseas. The Global Fast Food segment operates various fast food businesses, including takeout sushi, domestically and overseas. The Restaurant segment operates the restaurant business domestically and overseas. The Retail segment operates supermarkets, etc. The Headquarters and Support segment provides support services for each business type. Other businesses are mainly external sales manufacturing and wholesale, nursing care, and livestock and fisheries businesses.

name: VECTOR HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Vector HOLDINGS Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of downloadable PC software and other internet businesses in Japan. The company operates through ICT Business and Other Businesses segments. It is also involved in the operation of Quickpoint, a point utilization site that uses PayPay as a payment method  site advertising sales  provision of ASP services  and sale of heat shielding films and SDG-related products. The company also operates VectorSign, a software for electronic signature services. The company was formerly known as Vector Inc. and changed its name to Vector HOLDINGS Inc. in June 2023. Vector HOLDINGS Inc. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: NTN
businessSummary: NTN Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of axle bearings, constant-velocity joints and precision equipment for automobile, industrial machinery and repair commercial markets. The Company operates through four geographic segments, including Japan, the United States, Europe, Asia and others. The Company is engaged in the production of bearings, ball screws and other mechanical components, as well as gears, motors, sensors and other peripheral components.

The company offers standard roller, self-lubricating, extra heavy duty, mini pitch, corrosion and heat resistance, plastic, leaf, hollow pin, double pitch, attachment, top roller, bai speed, conveyor, circular side bow, and cable chains. It also provides OCM MX series standard and agricultural chains, roller chain with outboards, sprockets, pre-threaded attachment chains, PLT chains, ND selube chains, and TLH chains. name: PICOCELA
businessSummary: Picocela Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacturing, installation, and services for enterprise wireless mesh solutions. The sales of product equipment business is engaged in the development of mesh Wi-Fi access point devices, PCWL series, utilizing the proprietary patented wireless mesh communication technology software PicoCELA Backhaul Engine (PBE), which enables wireless Wi-Fi and mesh communication by linking a chain of multiple wireless Wi-Fi access points by radio communication not by cabling. The Software as a Service (SaaS), maintenance and others business is engaged in the provision of a cloud portal service, PicoManager, which enables users to monitor connectivity and communication traffic at each of the mesh Wi-Fi access points. PicoManager also serves as a platform for customers to install their proprietary edge-computing software into PCWL series. The Company also license the patented wireless mesh technology to third-party manufacturers.

name: ONCOTHERAPY SCIENCE
businessSummary: OncoTherapy Science, Inc. engages in research and development of anti-body drugs  and the genome analysis of cancer, liquid biopsy, and development of new immunotherapy in Japan. The company's development pipeline includes OTS167, a small molecular compound that targets the maternal embryonic leucine zipper kinase inhibitor that is in Phase I/II clinical trials for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia, as well as in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of breast cancer  and OTS964, a small molecule TOPK inhibitor currently under non-clinical stage. Its pipeline also comprises cancer peptide vaccines, including S-588410, which completed Phase III clinical trials for the treatment esophageal cancer, as well as Phase II clinical trials for the treatment of bladder cancer  S-488210, which is in Phase I/II clinical trials for the treatment of head and neck cancer  S-588210, which is in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of solid tumor  and OTSGC-A24, currently in Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of gastric cancer. OncoTherapy Science, Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

name: MIZUHO LEASING
businessSummary: Mizuho Leasing Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in leasing and installment sales transactions involving information-related equipment, real estate, industrial and machine tools, and other assets, as well as a variety of financial services. The Leasing and Installment Sales segment provides leasing and installment sales for real estate, industrial and machine tools, information-related equipment, transportation equipment, and environmental and energy-related facilities. The Finance segment offers loans, investments, factoring services, and other financing solutions in areas including real estate, shipping, aviation, and environmental and energy projects. The Other segment engages in the sale and purchase of used assets and power generation businesses.

name: WELBE
businessSummary: Welbe, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in provision of disability welfare services. The employment transition support business provides employment training, including preparation and correction of application forms, mock interview and practical training in workplace. The business also provides specific consultation support and independence training for people with disabilities. The rehabilitation business provides instruction for growth and development for pre-school children with developmental disorders and lesson support for primary school students, junior high school students, and high school students after school classes and during long vacation.

The Domestic Wedding Business segment is involved in the planning and operation of domestic house weddings and restaurant weddings, as well as various product planning. The Company is also involved in the finance and credit business, travel business and childcare business.

The Leasing and Finance segment is engaged in the provision of finance leases, operating leases, installment sales and credit for office and information-related equipment, medical equipment, industrial machine tools, measuring instruments, as well as corporate loans, industry-specific loans, housing loans, condominium loans. The Services segment is engaged in the provision of invoicing and accounts receivable collection services, medical and nursing care reimbursement factoring services, factoring services for the Ricoh Group, and relocation management services. The Investment business includes solar power generation, housing leasing, and real estate related businesses.

businessSummary: Plaid Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of customer experience (CX) platform KARTE to businesses operating websites and smartphone applications in a cloud format. The Company is engaged in the development of the CX platform KARTE. By incorporating KARTE into websites and smartphone applications operated by businesses, businesses collect and analyze data on the behavior of users who visit those websites and smartphone applications, organize and visualize data on a user-by-user basis, and personalize communication via websites, smartphone applications, emails and chats to each user or user segments. name: NISSHA

The Devices segment includes film touch sensors, force sensors, and gas sensors. The Medical Technology segment is engaged in contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) of minimally invasive medical surgical equipment and medical wearable sensors, as well as the manufacture and sale of its own brand products.

The Real Estate Solutions segment is engaged in the purchase real estate from property information of various sources, raises asset value by applying value up, as well as sales properties to high net worth individuals. The Real Estate Solutions segment includes detached housing, land effective utilization, residential development, commercial development, and renovation. The Real Estate Rental segment is engaged in the rental of real estate owned by the Company. Besides traditional hard and soft contact lenses, the Company manufactures and sells disposable contact lenses, including daily disposable, biweekly, and monthly replacement contact lenses.
