The Company also manufactures and sells contact lens care products, which are solutions for cleaning, disinfecting, and storing contact lenses. The Company also offers a flat-rate membership system called Menicon Eye Life Support Plan. By paying an initiation fee and a fixed monthly membership fee, the Company offers coverage for loss, damage, and prescription changes, allowing users to continue wearing contact lenses safely and optimally. Other businesses include the development and sale of veterinary medical products, materials for promoting rice straw decomposition and others.

name: GOOD COM ASSET
businessSummary: Good Com Asset Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, development, sales, and management of new investment condominiums under its own brand, the GENOVIA series. The Company operates through four business segments. The Wholesale segment sells new condominiums under its own brand to domestic and overseas corporations. The Retail Sales segment sells new condominiums under its own brand to domestic and overseas individual investors. The Real Estate Management segment manages rental properties and buildings for sold condominiums, as well as collecting rents and guaranteeing rent obligations before handing them over to customers. The Other segment provides investor relations (IR) and capital policy consulting for new listings and post-listings, sells real estate fractionalized products, Good Com Fund, and operates real estate fund business.

name: TOYOTA MOTOR
businessSummary: TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automotive business, as well as financial services and other businesses. It operates through three business segments. The Automotive segment designs, manufactures, and sells automobiles, including sedans, minivans, compact cars, sport utility vehicles (SUVs), and trucks, as well as related parts and accessories. The Financial Services segment provides financing and vehicle leasing services to complement the sales of automobiles and other products manufactured by itself and its affiliates. The Other segment is engaged in information and communications services. It also oversees manufacturing and sales companies, conducts public relations and research activities, oversees financial companies, and develops various mobility products, primarily software.

name: PRISM BIOLAB
businessSummary: PRISM BioLab Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the drug discovery business. The Company operates through Japan drug discovery business segment. The Company builds a new drug discovery platform and develops new drugs. The Company conducts research and development of pharmaceuticals using their owned drug discovery platform technology PepMetics technology. There are two business models. The in-house development business is engaged in the select of drug discovery targets and creates programs in-house. The joint development business creates programs using their owned technology to target drug discovery targets for pharmaceutical companies.

name: JACCS
businessSummary: JACCS Co., Ltd. operates as a consumer finance company in Japan and internationally. The company provides installment credit and other settlement methods for automobiles, home renovation, solar systems, dental, and education. It also issues credit cards and prepaid cards  and offers rental guarantee, bill collection, reimbursement, personal and housing loan guarantees, non-life and life insurance agency, leasing, automatic, and claim management and collection services. The company was formerly known as Depart Sinyohanbai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JACCS Co., Ltd. in April 1976. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ORIENT
businessSummary: Orient Corporation is a Japan-based consumer credit company. The Company operates in consumer credit business through four business segments. The Personal Installment segment is engaged in the provision of installment services for personal consumption such as school expense and housing improvement loans through reimbursement and credit guarantee methods. The Card and Financing segment operates in company own card business, affiliated credit card business, cashing service business, loan card business and other businesses. The Bank Guarantee segment is engaged in the provision of joint and several guarantee services for consumer’s financing activities. In addition, the Company is also involved in the credit management and collection business, as well as consumer credit peripheral business. The Settlement and Guarantee segment performs rent settlement guarantee, accounts receivable settlement guarantee, retail lease guarantee and collection agency.

isin: 5721.T|S Crypto Energy Inc.|5721.T|S Crypto Energy Inc.
name: S CRYPTO ENERGY
businessSummary: S Crypto Energy Inc. engages in crypto asset, metal, and real estate business in Japan. It operates through Nickel Business, Real Estate Business, Education Business, Smart DX Solutions Business, Crypto Asset Business, and Other segments. The company's products include S pellets anodes, nickel balls anode, plating nickel chips, nickel sulfate, nickel chloride, and P pellets and anodes. It is also involved in treasury business, advisory services, and grid business, as well as development of real estate projects. The company was formerly known as S Science Company, Ltd. and changed its name to S Crypto Energy Inc. in April 2026. S Crypto Energy Inc. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: SHIZUOKA FINANCIAL GROUP
businessSummary: Shizuoka Financial Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in banking business, and other financial services such as leasing and financial instruments trading. It operates in two segments. The Banking segment is engaged in banking business, focusing on deposits, lending, securities investment, and foreign exchange. The Leasing segment is engaged in leasing business, focusing on finance and leasing transactions. In addition, the Company is also engaged in management consulting, payment collection, initial public offering support, small and medium-sized enterprise revitalization support, financial instruments trading, marketing support, advertising agency, paid employment placement, investment advice for real estate private placement funds, and consulting.

name: JEOL
businessSummary: JEOL Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance, development and research of scientific instruments, semiconductor related equipment, industrial and medical equipment, and related products and parts. It operates through three business segments. Science and Measurement Equipment segment manufactures and sells three types of equipment. Electron optical devices include electron microscopes, peripheral devices and others. Analytical instruments include nuclear magnetic resonance equipment, electron spin resonance equipment and others. Measurement and inspection equipment include scanning electron microscopes, analytical scanning electron microscopes, peripheral equipment and others. Industrial Equipment segment manufactures and sells electron beam lithography equipment, linear electron guns and power supplies and others. Medical Equipment segment manufactures and sells clinical test information processing systems, and automatic amino acid analyzers.

name: VELTRA
businessSummary: VELTRA Corporation is engaged in the operation of domestic and overseas experienced optional tour online reservation site VELTRA. The Company operates travel related business that manages the travel online service of the local experience tours. The Company mainly operates three departments. The overseas travel department provides services mainly for Japanese overseas trips. The inbound department provides services for visitors to Japan. The global department provides services all over the world for global travelers. VELTRA operated by the Company operates websites that correspond to four languages, including Japanese, English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional) and Korean, and the sites of the local experience tour corresponds to all over the world. The Company contracts directly with domestic and overseas operating companies and offers services in various lineups including sightseeing tours, cultural experiences, gourmet tours, shows, museums, cruises, restaurants and others.

isin: 559A.T|UMENOYADO BREWERY CO LTD|559A.T|Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd.
name: UMENOYADO BREWERY
businessSummary: Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. engages in the production, sale, and product development of sake, liqueurs, and assorted beverages in Japan and internationally. The company offers alcoholic beverages, including Japanese sake and fruit-infused sake liqueurs through the Aragoshi and Umenoyado no Umeshu brands. Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Katsuragi, Japan.

name: DIGITAL GARAGE
businessSummary: Digital Garage, Inc. primarily engages in the platform solutions business. The Company operates through three segments. Its Platform Solutions segment comprises a payment business which operates a comprehensive payment platform offering a wide range of electronic payment methods, including credit card payments, QR code payments, and convenience store payments, as well as a business providing payment-related services and digital marketing services for financial institutions. The Long-Term Incubation segment conducts strategic business operations aimed at accelerating the expansion of the payment platform by leveraging the Company’s unique business infrastructure and the customer assets of Kakaku.com, Inc, which operates one of Japan’s largest media platforms. The Global Investment Incubation segment operates an investment incubation business focused on strategic business support, centered on investing in and nurturing startups and other companies.

name: MINEBEA MITSUMI
businessSummary: Minebea Mitsumi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of machined components and electronic equipment. The Company operates through four segments. The Machined Components segment mainly provides ball bearings, rod end bearings, pivot assemblies for hard disk drives (HDD) and other mechanical parts, as well as aircraft screws. The Electronic Equipment segment includes liquid crystal display (LCD) backlights, measuring devices and other electronic devices, HDD spindle motors, stepping motors, direct current (DC) motors, fan motors, precision motors and special equipment. The Mitsumi segment mainly includes semiconductor devices, optical devices, mechanical components, high-frequency components, and power supply components. The Yushin segment's main products are automotive parts such as key sets, door latches, and door handles, as well as parts for industrial equipment.

isin: 7711.T|Sukegawa Electric Co., Ltd.|7711.T|Sukegawa Electric Co., Ltd.
name: SUKEGAWA ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Sukegawa Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells energy and industrial systems in Japan. It offers mineral insulated cables, including simple and multi-core coaxial, two and four-core double-sheathed, two and four-core twisted, and banded-type cables  temperature sensors comprising thermocouples, resistance bulbs, sheathed wires, and heat flux sensors  micro heaters for general type industrial plants and various apparatuses for experiments and also facilities related with vacuum components  and sheathed heaters that are used as the heat source for various devices. The company also provides a range of vacuum components, such as steping motors, aluminum alloy ultra vacuum chambers, vacuum systems, vacuum furnaces with carbon heater, hot plate with cold systems, and vacuum heat treating furnaces  and molten metal systems comprising electromagnetic pumps, Pb-Bi test loops, liquid level indicators, and electromagnetic flowmeters and pump type sand mold casting systems, as well as induction type level meters and control panels. In addition, it offers various apparatuses for making experiments, control system, fuel rods simulators, boiling water capsules, electromagnetic sensors, fuel cell gas heating units, fuel cell test facilities, and electromagnetic horns for use in the energy field. Further, its products are used in manufacturing equipment for semiconductors, FPDs, automobiles, steel  and safety confirmation testing equipment for research institutions, and nuclear power. Sukegawa Electric Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Takahagi, Japan.

name: SHIONOGI &
businessSummary: Shionogi & Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company is mainly engaged in the research and development, purchasing, manufacturing, sales, and related activities of ethical pharmaceuticals. The Company is engaged in research and development, purchasing, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceuticals for the treatment of gram-negative bacterial infections, influenza virus infections, new coronavirus infections, invasive aspergillus infections, complicated urinary tract infections including pyelonephritis, Alzheimer's disease, chronic pain, cancer of the esophagus, bladder, head and neck, solid tumors, and other diseases. The Company provides products and services in Japan, Europe, North America, and other regions.

isin: 4967.T|Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.|4967.T|Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
name: KOBAYASHI PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells OTC pharmaceuticals, guasi-drugs, deodorizing air fresheners, and sanitary products in Japan, the United States, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers Ammeltz, an anti-inflammatory pain relief medicine  Dent, an effervescent denture cleaning agent  Ekitai Bluelet Okudake, a toilet bowl cleaner  Naicitol, a Chinese herbal medicine that promotes the breakdown and metabolism of fat  BreathCare, an oral breath freshener capsule  Netsusama sheet, a cooling gel sheet  and deodorizing air fresheners, lens cleaners, and oral hygiene products. It also manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, fragrances, deodorants, cosmetics, health food, synthetic resin processed products, paper products, and hand warmers  and sells daily necessities. In addition, the company engages in transportation, real estate management, advertising planning and production, sales promotion and market research, promotional goods production and sales, and asset management activities, as well as in pharmacy, retail, and cleaning industries. Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: JAPAN ENGINE
businessSummary: Japan Engine Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, maintains, repairs, sells, and licenses marine internal combustion engines and related components in Japan, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. It offers UE engines used in bulk carriers, tankers, car carrier ships, container ships, and other vessels. The company also engages in the manufacture and sale of shield machine components for subway construction and tunnel boring  and machining and assembly of large sized products, including injection molding machines and testing devices. In addition, it provides pressure-relief control valve blocks, cylinder covers, piston crowns, piston heads and metallic sliding bearings, bedplates and shield machines, and resin granulators. The company was formerly known as Kobe Diesel Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Japan Engine Corporation in April 2017. Japan Engine Corporation was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Akashi, Japan.

name: OSAKA TITANIUM TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Osaka Titanium Technologies Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the titanium business and the high-performance materials business. The Company operates through two segments. The Titanium segment manufactures and sells sponge titanium, titanium ingots, titanium tetrachloride, and titanium tetrachloride aqueous solution. The Advanced Materials segment manufactures and sells high-purity titanium, silicon monoxide (SiO), spherical titanium powder (TILOP), and powdered titanium.

name: KOURAKUEN
businessSummary: Kourakuen Corporation engages in the chain expansion of ramen restaurant under the Korakuen name in Japan and internationally. It is also involved in the franchise business. The company was formerly known as Kourakuen Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Kourakuen Corporation in October 2024. Kourakuen Corporation was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Koriyama, Japan.

name: YAMADA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yamada Holdings Co Ltd is mainly engaged in the business of selling home appliances and information appliances. The Company operates through two business segments. The Denki segment is engaged in the sale of home appliances such as televisions, refrigerators, and washing machines, as well as information appliances such as PCs and cell phones, and home renovation, furniture, interior design, and other products related to the home. The Housing Construction segment is engaged in the sale of detached houses and other housing units, and manufacture and sale of bathrooms, kitchens, and other housing equipment. It also operates environmental businesses, financial businesses, and businesses related to building materials.

name: MITSUBISHI HC CAPITAL
businessSummary: Mitsubishi HC Capital Inc, formerly Mitsubishi UFJ Lease & Finance Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the financial business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Customer Finance segment is engaged in the finance lease and installment sale of machinery, equipment and fixtures, as well as the provision of monetary loan services and other related financial services. The Asset Finance segment is engaged in the operating lease of machinery and transportation equipment, the investment and loan businesses related to real estate, the management of securities, the finance business related to aircrafts and ships, as well as the leasing of office buildings.

name: SKY PERFECT JSAT
businessSummary: SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in space and media businesses. The Company has two segments. Space Business segment provides satellite communications services, including data and mobile communications. The Segment also provides satellite capacity to pay multichannel broadcasters. The Segment also analyzes images, location information and provides solutions for social issues and industrial advancement. Media Business segment provides pay multichannel broadcasting services via communications satellites, as well as customer management, advertising, signal digitalization and encryption services for broadcasters. The Segment also provides terrestrial, broadcasting satellite (BS) and communications satellite (CS) retransmission services via satellites and optical fiber networks and video transmission, distribution and other media solutions for corporate customers. The Company also engages in investment, financing and management consulting.

name: OKAMURA FOODS
businessSummary: Okamura Foods Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the salmon aquaculture business, processing business (domestic and overseas processing), and overseas wholesale business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Aquaculture Business segment is engaged in the farming and sale of adult salmon in Aomori and Denmark. The Domestic Processing Business segment is engaged in the processing and sales of fish egg products such as sardines and salmon roe at domestic factories. The Overseas Processing Business segment is engaged in processing and sales of seafood such as salmon and mackerel at overseas factories. The Overseas Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the overseas wholesale of Japanese food products, including seafood.

name: EDGE TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: EDGE Technology Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm business. The AI algorithm business provides AI solution services, AI education services, and develops and sells AI products. AI solution services incorporate AI algorithms into existing businesses and systems, and implement and operate them. AI education services include services such as education courses for individuals specializing in AI technology, corporate training, and paid employment agencies specializing in the AI field. AI product service is a service that sells products that implement AI.

name: REFINVERSE GROUP
businessSummary: REFINVERSE Group, Inc. operates as a material recycling company in Japan. It operates in two segments, Materials Business and Resource Business. The Materials Business segment offers collection and disposal services for used carpet tiles  recycling of used carpet tiles  sale of recycled resin  sale of recycled resin produced from automotive airbag manufacturing scraps and used fishing nets through cutting, washing, thermoplasticizing, and extrusion  and recycled raw materials for manufacturing products. The Resource Business segment engages in intermediate treatment/recycling business of industrial waste  and provides collection and transportation services, as well as demolition work of offices and condominiums. It also offers refine powder, steelmaking materials, REAMIDE, and regenerative polio (leffin). REFINVERSE Group, Inc. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: TOKYO METRO
businessSummary: Tokyo Metro Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company that develops subway operations, real estate, and life and business services businesses. It comprises three business segments. The Transportation Segment operates a nine-line subway network primarily in the Tokyo metropolitan area and conducts the maintenance and management of railway facilities. The Real Estate Segment engages in the development, leasing, and management of real estate, including office buildings and hotels, as well as the management of investment corporation assets. The Life and Business Services Segment operates in-station commercial facilities such as Echika and provides advertising and telecommunications-related services.

name: ZETA
businessSummary: Zeta Inc. engages in digital marketing solutions business in Japan. The company offers ZETA SEARCH, an e-commerce product search and site search engine  ZETA AD which allows to set up ad space on various pages, such as search result pages, product detail pages, and cart pages  ZETA GEO, a solution that optimizes e-commerce sites for AI-generated searches  ZETA HASHTAG, analyzes text, including product descriptions and reviews, and extracts keywords related to the product as hashtags  ZETA VOICE that implement review content on website. It also provides ZETA ENGAGEMENT, a loyalty improvement engine  ZETA BASKET, a service that allows users and company staff to take the lead in generating content  ZETA LINK, a generative AI connectivity platform that seamlessly links AI chat with the ZETA product suite through agentic search mechanisms  ZETA CLICK, connects stores that provide experiences with EC that provides information, realizing a new consumer experience in the digital transformation era  ZETA RECOMMEND, uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to predict needs and provide personalized recommendations  ZETA TALK, an AI chat for e-commerce  ZETA SEARCH IMAGE EXTENSION, an image search engine  and ZETA DMP, a prediction and personalization solution. Zeta Inc. was formerly known as Scigineer Inc. Zeta Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: TOKYO CENTURY
businessSummary: Tokyo Century Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in businesses related to leasing and financing. The Domestic Leasing Business segment provides leasing and financing and related services for information and telecommunications equipment, office equipment, transportation equipment, and commercial and service equipment. The Auto Mobility Business segment provides auto leasing, car rental, car sharing, and other services for corporate and individual customers. The Specialty Business segment provides domestic and overseas lease financing and related services for products such as ships, aircraft, and real estate. The International Business segment provides lease financing and related ancillary services in East Asia, ASEAN countries, North America, and Latin America, as well as automobile business. The Environmental Infrastructure Business segment engages in power generation business, lease financing, and related ancillary services in Japan and overseas related to renewable energy.

name: ROHM
businessSummary: Rohm Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily manufactures and sells electronic components. The Company operates through three business segments. The Large-Scale Integration (LSI) segment produces LSIs including analog, logic and memory. The Semiconductor Device segment produces transistors, diodes, power devices, light-emitting diodes and semiconductor lasers. The Module segment produces print heads and optical modules. The Company is also engaged in the resistor business.

name: KISSEI PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: Kissei Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates through four segments. The Pharmaceutical segment manufactures and sells prescription drugs, and also purchases and sells healthcare foods such as prescription drugs and foods for special medical purposes. The Goods Sales segment is engaged in the development, production and sale of noodles, the sale of various equipment, vehicles and fuel, as well as insurance agency business. The Information Services segment operates in three areas including system integration services, system resource services such as information-related equipment rental and network construction, and medical system development and sales. The Construction and Facility Maintenance segment provides comprehensive construction services ranging from building construction to the maintenance and management of equipment and facilities.

name: NOMURA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nomura Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company that provides investment and financial services centered on securities-related businesses. The Company operates through four segments. Its Wealth Management segment provides asset management and wealth succession services primarily to individual investors. Its Investment Management segment offers the management and administration of investment trusts and institutional investment funds, as well as investment solutions. Its Wholesale segment provides sales and trading services in fixed income, equities, derivatives, and foreign exchange products, along with underwriting, securities distribution, and mergers and acquisitions(M&A) advisory services. Its Banking segment provides trust banking and private banking services.

name: CONVANO
businessSummary: Convano Inc. engages in the management and franchising of nail salons in Japan. The company provides its services under the FASTNAIL, FASTNAIL PLUS, and FASTNAIL LOCO brand names, as well as handles CONST and Legaly brands. It also develops the FASTNAILTOWN platform for online reservation. In addition, the company engages in the wholesale and sales of medical care products, medical digital transformation support, and MA and investment businesses. Further, it provides consulting businesses, healthcare businesses, and investment & advisory businesses. Convano Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: LASALLE LOGIPORT REIT
businessSummary: LaSalle LOGIPORT REIT (LLR) pursuant to the Investment Trusts Act, and was listed on the J-REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (Securities Code: 3466) on February 17, 2016. The financial statements for the fiscal period ended February 28, 2025 (18th fiscal period) were recently completed, and the total number of issued and outstanding investment units as of the end of this fiscal period is 1,810,620 units. LaSalle LOGIPORT REIT was established on October 9, 2015 and incorporated in Japan.

name: YOKOREI
businessSummary: Yokorei Co.,Ltd. engages in the food distribution and refrigerated warehouse businesses in Japan and internationally. It imports, exports, processes, and sells marine products, such as scallop, yellowtail and salmon, octopus, fish roe, crab, squid, mackerel, fish, trout species, saury, shrimp, sardines, and others to wholesalers, food product manufacturers, marine product processing companies, volume retailers, ready meal vendors, restaurants, catering-related businesses, and others  livestock products, including pork, chicken, and beef to manufacturers, wholesalers, volume retailers, and restaurant chains  and agricultural products comprising potatoes, onions, and pumpkins to frozen food product manufacturers, restaurant chains, and wholesalers. The company provides logistics outsourcing services consisting of customs clearance, storage, and delivery  information and communication technology services  and electronic data interchange services. In addition, it engages in the real estate leasing, freight forwarding and trucking, restaurant and coffee shop management, food and drink sales, and other related businesses. The company was formerly known as Yokohama Reito Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Yokorei Co.,Ltd. in December 2021. Yokorei Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: CREDIT SAISON
businessSummary: Credit Saison Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the payment, leasing, finance, and real estate-related businesses. The Company operates through six business segments. The Payment Business segment is engaged in the credit card business, servicer (debt collection) business, and various peripheral businesses. The Leasing Business segment is engaged in the leasing business, mainly leasing office equipment. The Finance Business segment is engaged in the credit guarantee business and finance-related business. The Real Estate-related Business segment is engaged in the real estate business, real estate rental business, and servicer (debt collection) business. The Global Business segment is engaged in the lending business and investment business. The Entertainment Business segment is engaged in the amusement business, mainly operating amusement facilities.

name: MEIJI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Meiji Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based holding company engaged in the management of subsidiaries that manufactures and sells food and medicines. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Food segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of yogurt, milk, beverages, cheese, butter, margarine, cream, ice cream, frozen food, chocolate, gummi, gum, sports nutrition, powdered milk, liquid food, beauty food, general medicine, sugar, saccharified flour and others. The Pharmaceuticals segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of ethical pharmaceuticals, and animal drugs.

name: KYOCERA
businessSummary: Kyocera Corp is mainly engaged in the provision of products in the semiconductor, information and telecommunications, industrial machinery, automotive, and environment and energy-related markets. It operates through three segments. The Core Components segment provides various fine ceramic components such as components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, automotive camera modules, and ceramic/organic packages that protect electronic components and integrated circuits. The Electronic Components segment provides various electronic components and devices such as capacitors, crystal components, connectors, and power semiconductors. The Solutions segment provides cutting tools, pneumatic and electric tools, office printers and Multifunction Peripherals, document management systems, commercial and industrial printers, and telecommunication terminals and telecommunication solution services for corporate customers. The Company also offers smart energy-related products and services.

name: PIALA
businessSummary: PIALA INC. is mainly engaged in the Electronic Commerce (EC) support business. The Company promotes EC transformation. The EC support business provides clients with EC marketing and advertising marketing services specialized mainly in beauty, health and food fields such as cosmetics and health foods. The EC marketing mainly focuses on customer attracting, provides Key Performance Indicator (KPI) guarantee service using RESULT Series, operates through marketing support business related to advertising agency and customer support service, conducts RESULT Series solution including RESULT MASTER equipped with Data Management Platform (DMP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI). The advertising marketing provides fee-based services, conducts EC support service by proposing various media and methods from ordinary media to niche media such as local newspapers and area-limited magazines in accordance with client's direct marketing issues.

name: ANGES
businessSummary: AnGes, Inc. engages in the research and development of gene-based medicines. It develops HGF gene therapy product for the treatment of chronic arterial occlusive disease  NF-KB decoy oligonucleotide for chronic discogenic lumbar back pain  and DNA vaccines for the treatment of hypertension, as well as tie2 agonists for COVID-19/ARDS and drugs for chronic hepatitis B. AnGes, Inc. was formerly known as AnGes MG, Inc. and changed its name to AnGes, Inc. in July 2017. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

name: TECNISCO
businessSummary: Tecnisco, Ltd. engages in the precision products business in Japan. It offers Metal products, such as metal diamond composites, microchannel coolers, high pressure seamless microchannels, insulation type Cu-AlN-Cu submount, CuW submount, and mounts and carriers. The company also offers glass products, including through glass via, microfluidic, mesh, chemically strengthened, micro-hole, cavity and cap, and spacer  and drilling tool products. In addition, it serves industrial equipment, automotive, optical and wireless communication, life sciences, aerospace, and environmental energy markets. Tecnisco, Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Tecnisco, Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Disco Corporation.

name: 3 D MATRIX
businessSummary: 3-D Matrix, Ltd. developing, manufacturing, and selling self-assembling peptide technology in Japan and internationally. It offers PuraMatrix, a self-assembling peptide hydrogel for use in the regenerative medicine, cell therapy, drug delivery systems, and other uses in various fields  and surfactant-like peptide, as well as High Concentration PuraMatrix, a high concentration hydrogel  and GMP Grade PuraMatrix. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FUYO GENERAL LEASE
businessSummary: Fuyo General Lease Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of the leasing of machinery, equipment, and fixtures, real estate leasing, installment sales, and financial transactions such as loans. It has three segments. The Leasing and Installment Sales segment is engaged in the leasing of information-related equipment, office equipment, industrial machine tools, and other items (including property sales upon the expiration or cancellation of lease transactions), real estate leasing, and installment sales of commercial facilities, production facilities, and hospital facilities. The Finance segment is engaged in the lending of money, the management of securities held and the formation of anonymous partnerships to generate financial revenue for business purposes. The Other segment is engaged in environmental energy-related services, commissions, business process outsourcing (BPO), and mobility business services.

name: NIDEC
businessSummary: Nidec Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision small motors, in-vehicle products, home appliances, commercial and industrial products, equipment, electronic and optical components. The Company operates through 10 segments. The SPMS segment manufactures and sells motors for hard disk drives (HDDs) and other small motors. The AMEC segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The MOEN segment, ACIM segment and Nidec Techno Motor segment manufacture and sell home appliances, commercial and industrial products. The Nidec Instruments segment manufactures and sells equipment, in-vehicle products, electronic components and other small motors. The Nidec Mobility segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products. The Machinery Business Headquarters segment and the Nidec Advanced Technology segment manufacture and sell equipment. The Other segment manufactures and sells in-vehicle products, equipment, electronic components, other small motors.

name: SYNSPECTIVE
businessSummary: Synspective Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the satellite data business using satellite constellations and data analysis technology. It develops, manufactures and operates synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites. It operates satellite constellations through the development and manufacture of small SAR satellites and related systems, sells the acquired data, and develops and sells solutions. It has two services. Data sale service sells data acquired from small SAR satellite StriX series. Customers are governments. The demand is for public security, disaster prevention/mitigation, infrastructure/land development and others. Solution provision services include ground movement monitoring, flood damage analysis and other solutions. Customers are governments, and companies involved in non-life insurance, infrastructure development and others, and the Company responds to demand for damage assessments, safety management of equipment and construction, environmental surveys and others.

name: TOYO ENGINEERING CORP CHIBA
businessSummary: Toyo Engineering Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) business. The EPC business involves research and development cooperation, planning, design, equipment procurement, construction, commissioning, and technical guidance for plants in oil, gas, petrochemicals, general chemicals, water, power generation, advanced production systems, pharmaceuticals, fine chemicals, biotechnology, the environment, resource development, artificial intelligence and other industries. With a global structure, it operates a comprehensive engineering business that meets changing customer needs. It also engages in temporary staffing, real estate management, travel, and insurance agency services.

name: ORGANO
businessSummary: ORGANO CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the water treatment engineering business and functional products business. The Company operates through two business segments. The Water Treatment Engineering segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, maintenance and management of filtration equipment, pure water system equipment and other water treatment related equipment. The Functional Product segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of standard water treatment equipment, water treatment chemicals and food additives. The Company is also engaged in the chemical plant construction business.

name: POWERX
businessSummary: PowerX,Inc. manufactures and sells energy storage systems. It provides stationary energy storage systems, including PowerX Mega Power  PowerX cube for grid-mounted batteries, renewable energy-integrated batteries, and industrial and commercial batteries  and PowerX Hypercharger for commercial EV charging/public charging infrastructure applications, as well as battery tankers for maritime business. The company also offers electricity supply and aggregation services, as well as electric vehicle charging services. In additionit provides its services through PowerX app. PowerX,Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Tamano, Japan.

isin: 8511.T|Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd.|8511.T|Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd.
name: JAPAN SECURITIES FINANCE
businessSummary: Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides loans for margin transactions, securities financing, and securities investment in Japan. It operates through Securities Finance Business, Trust Banking Business, and Real Estate Rental business. The Securities Finance Business segment engages in lending and borrowing transactions, security finance, and securities investment services. The Trust Banking Business engages in the trust services for securities and other financial instruments, as well as banking services, such as lending. The Real Estate Rental Business engages in the leasing and management of real estate. The company was formerly known as Tokyo Securities Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd. in December 1949. Japan Securities Finance Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: PLAT HOME
businessSummary: Plat'Home Co., Ltd. offers computer related products and services in Japan. It manufactures and sells computers and peripheral equipment  and provides related services. The company also provides OpenBlocks IoT VX2, an intelligent edge Internet of Things (IoT) gateway software, as well as provides OpenBlocks IoT BX1G, an IoT gateway for connecting various sensors, beacons, and devices to the cloud for applications in medical, wellness, and healthcare  energy monitoring and management  industrial automation  storage monitor and control  building monitoring  security monitoring for homes, objects, and people  vehicle telematics and battery management  digital signage  classroom and education  and tracking, such as trade shows, restaurants, meeting rooms usage, etc., as well as agriculture and connected livestock. In addition, it purchases and sells various network-related parts. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: KOMATSU
businessSummary: KOMATSU LTD. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the research, development, sale, sales finance of products such as construction machinery. The Company operates in three business segments. Construction Machinery & Vehicle segment provides excavators, loading equipment, grading and roadbed preparation equipment, hauling equipment, forestry machinery, underground construction and mining machinery, environmental recycling equipment, industrial vehicles, castings, engines, components, other machinery, and logistics-related services. Retail Finance segment provides leasing and installment sales for construction and mining machinery. Industrial Machinery & Others segment engages in the provision of forging machinery, sheet metal machinery, machine tools, defense-related equipment, temperature control equipment, and optical machinery.

name: BRIGHTPATH BIOTHERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: BrightPath Biotherapeutics Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of pharmaceutical products. The Company is a biopharmaceutical venture company focused on developing cancer immunotherapeutic. The Companies business model covers drug discovery research and early clinical development of cancer immunotherapy; conducting of early-phase clinical trials; and development, manufacturing, and launching of the drugs as commercial products in Japan and abroad. The Company also generates the revenues from license fees from the pharmaceutical companies.

name: ELEMENTS
businessSummary: ELEMENTS Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development of image recognition engines and data analysis platforms. The Company is engaged in the development and provision of personal authentication solutions such as LIQUID eKYC, an online identity verification service and personal optimization solutions in food, clothing, and housing utilizing biometrics, image analysis, and machine learning technologies. Personal authentication solutions include the biometric authentication business, which develops authentication services using biometric information. Personal optimization solutions include the behavioral analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for offices and residences, and the body shape analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for women's shoes and personal optimization services for clothing, as well as the purchase analysis business, which develops personal optimization services for food retail.

name: FREEE KK
businessSummary: freee KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and provision of software as a service (SaaS) services to improve the back-office productivity of small businesses. Freee accounting is an integrated cloud accounting software for sole proprietors and corporations. Freee human resource management is an integrated cloud human resource management software for corporate clients. Freee sales is integrated cloud sales management software for sole proprietors and corporations. Freee tax return is a cloud-based tax filing software that seamlessly integrates with freee accounting and is offered to accounting firms and small corporations. Freee sign is an electronic contract service offered to sole proprietors and corporations. In addition, the Company offers freee card and freee card Unlimited as financial services designed to improve the cash flow of small businesses.

name: METAPLANET
businessSummary: Metaplanet Inc. is a Japan-based company that operates Bitcoin-related businesses and hotel businesses. It operates through two segments. The Bitcoin-related Business segment engages in Bitcoin holding and management, Bitcoin derivative trading, option premium income, and other Bitcoin-related services. The Hotel Business segment operates hotel facilities and provides accommodation services.

name: ASTROSCALE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Astroscale Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in research and development of technologies related to on-orbit services such as debris removal, and in-space demonstrations. The Company provides four services, including end-of-life (EOL) service, active debris removal (ADR) service, life extension (LEX) service, and in-situ space situational awareness (ISSA) service. EOL service is a removal service to prevent satellites that have finished operating from becoming debris. ADR service is a service to remove existing debris by launching a servicer of the Company's group, capturing the existing debris, descending its orbit, and burning it in the atmosphere. LEX service is a service to extend the operational period of a satellite or to transfer it to another orbit. ISSA service launches observation satellites, safely approaches objects at close range, and acquires data on the target object, which can be used to analyze the cause of failures and to understand the target object.

name: ROBOT CONSULTING
businessSummary: Robot Consulting Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of platform service focusing on human resource solutions with an intention to expand into legal technology and the metaverse. The Company’s major product is Labor Robot, a cloud-based human resource management system that helps users track employee attendance and sales orders and journalize accounting items. The Company provides the information relating to grant applications with Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW), which provides grants to small and medium-sized businesses to enhance their working conditions and employee welfare. The Company also supports users who want to apply for a subsidy with Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) for the information technology(IT) system installation subsidy by connecting users interested in applying for a subsidy with partners specializing in subsidy applications.

name: INSTINCT BIO TECHNICAL COMPANY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc. is a vertically integrated biotechnology holding company that works in stem cell and regenerative medicine-related fields, wellness and beauty. It operates through subsidiaries. The core activities include research and development in regenerative stem cell cosmetics that focus on regenerative stem cell technology for advanced skincare and personal care formulations, raw materials and supply chain management including procurement, distribution and logistics of raw materials essential for stem cell-conditioned media, original equipment manufacturer and original design manufacturer (OEM/ODM) cosmetic products provision, brand franchising, branding and creative design solutions provision, influencer and celebrity brand collaborations and e-commerce platforms operation. Its product categories include skincare, body and hair care, inner care and supplements, and professional line. Its brands include MANOROL, HAKUA, VIVEA, GENREVER and others.

name: DELTA FLY PHARMA
businessSummary: Delta-Fly Pharma, Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company's development pipeline includes anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-10917 whose target disease is refractory or recurrent acute myelogenous leukemia, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-14323 whose target disease is lung cancer, anti-cancer drug candidate compound DFP-11207 whose target disease is solid cancer, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-14927 whose target disease is solid cancer or blood cancer, anticancer drug candidate compound DFP-10825 whose target disease is peritoneal dissemination metastatic cancer.

name: HEALIOS KK
businessSummary: Healios KK is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business in the somatic stem cell regenerative medicine field and in the iPSC regenerative medicine field, which involves research, development and manufacture of regenerative medicine products (iPSC regenerative medicines) utilizing technologies related to induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells, iPSCs). The somatic stem cell regenerative medicine field develops and markets cell therapy drugs for acute stroke and acute respiratory distress syndrome using MultiStem, a somatic stem cell product for which the Company holds patent and patent licensing rights. The iPSC regenerative medicines include the creation of universal donor cells (UD), next-generation iPSCs that reduce the risk of immune rejection regardless of human leukocyte antigen (HLA) type using gene editing technology.

name: NANO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nano Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the micellar nanoparticle technology to develop innovative pharmaceuticals, focusing on anticancer drugs that encapsulate small molecule drugs within nanoparticles. The Company operates through a single segment encompassing the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of pharmaceuticals and related services. The Company conducts non-clinical and early-stage clinical trials, then licenses the resulting development candidate assets to pharmaceutical companies, thereby developing an RNA drug discovery business that efficiently brings RNA medicines to the market. In promoting RNA drug discovery, the Company leverages its experience in drug delivery system anticancer drug development and manufacturing, nucleic acid drug research and development, and a variety of DDS selection options based on this experience, creating and licensing assets that enable rapid progress in pharmaceutical development.

name: QPS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: QPS Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the earth observation satellite data business. The Company is engaged in the development and manufacture of small synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites and provides earth observation satellite data and images acquired by these satellites. The Company researches, develops, designs, manufactures, sells, operates, manages, and maintains satellites, onboard equipment, precision instruments, electronic devices, ground facilities, software, and information and communications networks. The Company also plans and manages space technology research groups, workshops, and seminars, and provides satellite-related technical consulting, operational support, contract work, development guidance, lectures, education, and writing services.

name: TERRA DRONE
businessSummary: Terra Drone Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business of industrial drones and flight operation management. The Company operates its business through two business segments. The Drone Solution segment is engaged in the provision of solutions that combine hardware, software, and services, including industrial drones. The services of the Drone Solution segment are mainly divided into surveying, inspection, and agriculture businesses. The operation management segment is engaged in the development and construction of unmanned aircraft system traffic management (UTM) and manages drone operations through these systems. The Company also engages in capital and business alliances that are expected to generate business synergies, such as public-private funds that support the construction of air infrastructure using drones and flying cars, and energy companies that have needs for drone inspections.

name: MODALIS THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Modalis Therapeutics Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the research and development of gene therapy drugs using the core platform CRISPR-GNDM technology. The Company develops gene therapy drugs that use CRISPR-GNDM technology, which is a unique platform technology, for genetic diseases caused by errors in the genetic code and epigenetics. The Company has two business models. Collaborative model pipeline opens CRISPR-GNDM technology to partners, and develops therapeutic drugs with partners' funds for the targets selected by the partners. In-house model pipeline selects targets using the Company's own CRISPR-GNDM technology and develops therapeutic agents. The Company's pipeline consists of a collaborative model pipeline of 5 items such as MDL-201 and an in-house model pipeline of 2 items such as MDL-101.

name: NEXT GENERATION TECHNOLOGY GROUP
businessSummary: Next Generation Technology Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in providing support for the successive acquisition of manufacturing and manufacturing-related companies and the management of the acquiring companies. As a serial acquirer, the Company grows by conducting a series of mergers and acquisitions (M&A) of manufacturing companies at appropriate valuations. In acquiring companies, the Company receives referrals of potential acquirers primarily from corporate M&A advisors and financial institutions, for which it pays a fee. The Company provides various types of management support to the acquired companies, including the dispatch of executives, for which it receives a management support fee from each company.

name: FISCO
businessSummary: FISCO Ltd. is engaged in the provision of information services. It mainly operates through nine business segments. The Information Service business provides corporate information for corporations and individuals, providing financial information and virtual currency information, real time distribution, Internet distribution, outsourcing, among others. The ICT IOT Device business includes agricultural ICT business and, research and development of robot business, among others. The FinTech System Development business includes system development, cloud services, and ASP services for nursing care establishments. The Internet Travel business includes e-market place management of travel related products. The Advertising Agency Services business includes advertising agency work, planning, editing, production and issuance of advertisement publications. It also engages Consulting business, Brand Retail Platform business, Virtual Currency / Block Chain business as well as Other business.

name: SUN
businessSummary: Sun Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and sales of global data intelligence, entertainment-related, new information technology (IT) related, and wellness businesses. It operates through four segments. The Global Data Intelligence segment develops, manufactures, and sells mobile data transfer devices and related services for sale to criminal investigation agencies and similar entities (Digital Intelligence Business). The Entertainment-Related segment develops, manufactures, and sells pachinko machine components, such as control boards, primarily sold to pachinko machine manufacturers. The New IT-Related segment primarily develops, manufactures, and sells machine-to-machine (M2M) communication devices and Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, and develops and sells business support systems for B2B applications. The Wellness segment develops and sells products and services primarily aimed at improving sleep quality within the digital health field.

name: CELLSEED
businessSummary: CellSeed Inc. is mainly engaged in the regenerative medical business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Regenerative Medical Support segment is engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of temperature-responsive cell incubators. The Cell Sheet Regeneration Medical segment is involved in the research and development of cell sheet regenerative medical products.

name: NOMURA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nomura Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based holding company that provides investment and financial services centered on securities-related businesses. The Company operates through four segments. Its Wealth Management segment provides asset management and wealth succession services primarily to individual investors. Its Investment Management segment offers the management and administration of investment trusts and institutional investment funds, as well as investment solutions. Its Wholesale segment provides sales and trading services in fixed income, equities, derivatives, and foreign exchange products, along with underwriting, securities distribution, and mergers and acquisitions(M&A) advisory services. Its Banking segment provides trust banking and private banking services.

name: J PHARMA
businessSummary: J-Pharma Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged primarily in pharmaceutical research and development, grounded in drug discovery targeting solute carrier (SLC) transporters. The Company operates the research-driven drug discovery business segment. The Company focuses on the L-type amino acid transporter 1 (LAT1), originally identified by its founders, and promotes the development of LAT1 inhibitors that address the unmet medical needs of patients with cancers and autoimmune diseases who have limited treatment options. The Company’s clinical development pipeline consists of Nanvuranlat (JPH203) and JPH034.

name: TOYO GOSEI
businessSummary: Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells photosensitive materials and polymer products in Japan, China, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers negative photosensitive materials for use as a cross-linking agent for photo-curing resins  positive photosensitive materials for microfabrication of semiconductor integrated circuits and liquid crystal displays  chemically amplified photoacid generator for microfabrication of semiconductor integrated circuits  and acrylic polymer for resist. It also provides chemicals products, such as alcohols, aldehydes, acids, ketones, esters, ethers, hydrocarbons, and nitrogen compounds. In addition, the company offers logistic services, including ship receiving systems  shipping systems  chemical transport services  and storage equipment comprising fully automated dangerous goods 3d automatic warehouse, drum filling station, dangerous goods refilling equipment, blending equipment, temperature control system, analysis room, Ichikawa distillation equipment, and deodorization tower. The company was formerly known as Nihon Acetylene Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. in May 1961. Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MARUCHIYO YAMAOKAYA
businessSummary: Maruchiyo Yamaokaya Corporation operates ramen restaurants in Japan. It operates restaurants under the Ramen Yamaoka-ya name. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

isin: 3487.T|CRE Logistics REIT, Inc.|3487.T|CRE Logistics REIT, Inc.
name: CRE LOGISTICS REIT
businessSummary: CRE logistics REIT, Inc was established by CRE REIT Advisers, Inc. (the Asset Manager) as the organizer pursuant to the provisions of the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments) and its units were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the TSE on February 7, 2018. As of the end of the current fiscal period, CRE REIT owned 20 properties, with a total acquisition price of 157,425 million yen. CRE logistics REIT, Inc was established on May 12, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.

name: MIRAI
businessSummary: MIRAI Corporation (hereinafter MIRAI) is diversified REIT. It has a capital contribution of 150 million yen (750 units), by Mitsui Bussan & IDERA Partners Co., Ltd. (hereinafter the Asset manager) as the founding planner and was listed on the REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 16, 2016 (securities code: 3476). As of October 31, 2025, the numbers of investment units issued and outstanding are 1,907,440 units and MIRAI owns 44 properties (total acquisition price of 180,155 million yen). MIRAI positions assets located in the three major metropolitan areas of Japan with high population concentrations as its main investment targets and aims to obtain mid-to-long term stable cash flows and sustained growth in unitholders value by building a portfolio centered on its Core Assets. MIRAI Corporation was founded on December 04, 2015 and incorporated in Japan.

name: NAGAHORI
businessSummary: Nagahori Corporation engages in the manufacture, import, export, manufacture, and sale of gemstones, pearls, and precious metals in Japan and internationally. The company also offers various jewelry items, such as fashion accessories and high-end label products. It serves department stores, specialty stores, and distributors. Nagahori Corporation was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: SPIDERPLUS &
businessSummary: SpiderPlus & Co. engages in developing and providing construction tech app in Japan. It offers SPIDERPLUS, an architectural drawing and site management application for the construction industry. The company was formerly known as Regolith, Inc. and changed its name to SpiderPlus & Co. in September 2020. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: FUJI MEDIA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Fuji Media Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the core broadcasting business, the media and content business, and the urban development and tourism business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Media and Content segment is engaged in the production of broadcast programs, movies, anime, games and events, the sale of video and music software, the publication of music, magazines and newspapers, as well as television broadcasting, radio broadcasting, mail order sales and advertising business. The Urban Development and Tourism segment engages in the rental and sale of residences, offices and logistics facilities, the operation of hotels and marine leisure facilities, as well as events and interior decoration and building management business. The Company also engages in movable property leasing and product sales, software development, and restaurants and shops business.

name: IHI
businessSummary: IHI Corp is engaged in the resources, energy and environment, social infrastructure, industrial systems and general machinery, and aerospace and defense. The Company operates in four business segments. Resource & Energy & Environment segment provides land-use prime mover plants, marine engines and other prime movers, carbon solutions, and nuclear power equipment. Social Infrastructure segment provides bridges and sluices, transportation systems, shield systems, concrete construction materials, and urban development. Industrial System & General-Purpose Machinery segment provides vehicle turbochargers, parking, rotating machinery, heat and surface treatment, material handling equipment, and logistics and industrial systems machinery. Aerospace & Space & Defense segment provides aero engines, rocket systems and space applications, and defense equipment systems. The Company also provides services for equipment and devices for communications, electronics, electrical measurement.

name: TOYOTA MOTOR
businessSummary: TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the automotive business, as well as financial services and other businesses. It operates through three business segments. The Automotive segment designs, manufactures, and sells automobiles, including sedans, minivans, compact cars, sport utility vehicles (SUVs), and trucks, as well as related parts and accessories. The Financial Services segment provides financing and vehicle leasing services to complement the sales of automobiles and other products manufactured by itself and its affiliates. The Other segment is engaged in information and communications services. It also oversees manufacturing and sales companies, conducts public relations and research activities, oversees financial companies, and develops various mobility products, primarily software.

name: DAIICHI SANKYO
businessSummary: Daiichi Sankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The Company is involved in the research, development, manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals, as well as the provision of intermediates and basic materials for pharmaceutical producing in Japan, the United States, Europe and other markets. The Company is also engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of over-the-counter drugs and vaccines, the provision of administrative services such as human resources and accounting services, real estate leasing and insurance agency business.

isin: 8953.T|Japan Metropolitan Fund Investment Corporation|8953.T|Japan Metropolitan Fund Investment Corporation
name: JAPAN METROPOLITAN FUND INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Japan Metropolitan Fund Investment Corporation was established under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan. It was the first investment corporation in Japan to specifically target retail real estate assets. It was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (securities code: 8953) on March 12, 2002. After that, JMF effected an absorption-type merger (the Merger) effective on March 1, 2021, with JMF as the surviving corporation and MCUBS MidCity Investment Corporation as the dissolving corporation and changed the corporation name from Japan Retail Fund Investment Corporation to Japan Metropolitan Fund Investment Corporation. JMF seeks to enhance its total return (Distribution Per Unit and Net Asset Value) by expanding its growth cycle driven by internal growth and return of gains on sales and acquired two properties and disposed of five properties (including partial dispositions) during the fiscal period ended August 31, 2025. As a result, the total assets managed by JMF at the end of the 47th fiscal period (fiscal period ended on August 31, 2025) amounted to 1,262.0 billion yen (the total acquisition price for 145 properties). The total acquisition price including investment securities such as the silent partnership interests and the investment units of domestic real estate investment corporation is 1,282.4 billion yen. Japan Metropolitan Fund Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2001 in Japan.

name: APPIER GROUP
businessSummary: Appier Group, Inc., operates as AI-native SaaS company in Japan and internationally. The company offers ad cloud products, such as RETARGETING, an AI-powered segmentation re-engages high-value users, driving conversions and sustainable growth  AIBID, an AI-driven bidding optimization product  AdCreative.ai, an all-in-one AI platform for enterprises  and AIXPERT for campaign decisions. It also provides personalization cloud products, including AIQUA, a machine learning marketing cloud for personalized customer experiences  AiDeal, which converts visitors into immediate shoppers  and BotBonnie, a no-code instant messaging solution for brands. In addition, the company offers data cloud products comprising AIXON, a data augmentation platform  AIRIS, a customer data platform  and data cloud, which connects, enriches, and activates customer data using AI-powered agents. It serves e-commerce, retail, finance and insurance, gaming, and automobile industries. Appier Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SMILE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Smile Holdings Inc, formerly Kids Smile Holdings Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in early childhood education business. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of subsidiaries, the operation of accredited daycare centers and preschool integrated daycare centers, as well as childcare and early childhood education business for raising children. The Company is mainly engaged in the management of nursery schools and development of early childhood education programs. The Company provides childcare and education services through the operation of Kids Garden and Kids Smile, and the KIDS GARDEN PREP SCHOOL, an unlicensed preschool integrated nursery, Kids Garden Classrooms which are preschool classroom, and after-school care and after-school programs for school-age children. The Company operates childcare facilities approved by local governments, unlicensed childcare facilities, preschools, swimming schools, and global schools mainly in the Tokyo metropolitan area.

name: DENTSU GROUP
businessSummary: Dentsu Group Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the provision of communication-related services with a focus on advertising. The Company operates in four business segments, including Japan, Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and Asia Pacific (APAC). The Company's advertising business involves the handling of advertising work for newspapers, magazines, radio, television, the Internet, sales promotion, movies, outdoor, transportation and other areas, as well as the planning, production and marketing of advertising expressions, public relations (PR) and content services. The Company's information services business involves the sale of information services and information-related products. Other businesses include the provision of specialized functions in the corporate field, office rental and building services. Through its affiliated companies, the Company is engaged in advertising and advertising-related services, information services and other services.

name: TOKYU REIT
businessSummary: TOKYU REIT, Inc. was incorporated to invest in real estate on June 20, 2003 under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan (Law No. 198 of 1952, as amended), or the Investment Trust Law. Such corporations are commonly referred to as Japanese Real Estate Investment Trusts, or J-REITs. Tokyu REIT, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 in Japan.

name: NET PROTECTIONS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Net Protections Holdings, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the payment solutions business. It provides buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) payment services that guarantee credit risk. Its key feature is that customers can outsource a series of payment-related operations in a one-stop service. Payment-related operations include credit checks, invoice issuance, payment confirmation and reconciliation, dunning and collection, and bad debt handling, and there are specialized companies for each of these operations. As a comprehensive provider of BNPL payment services, it provides BNPL payment services regardless of the transaction type, including individuals, corporations, e-commerce (EC), and face-to-face sales. The services include NP Atobarai, atone, NP Atobarai air, and AFTEE, which are services for business-to-consumer (B2C) transactions, and NP Kakebarai, which is a service for business-to-business (B2B) transactions.

name: UNICHARM
businessSummary: UNICHARM CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of personal care, pet care, and related products. It operates through three business segments. The Personal Care segment manufactures and sells wellness care, feminine care, and baby care products. The Pet Care segment manufactures and sells pet food and pet toiletry products. The Other segment manufactures and sells industrial materials. The Company conducts business both domestically and internationally.

name: SWCC
businessSummary: SWCC Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric wires and cables. The Company operates through three segments. The Energy and Infrastructure Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of electric wires, power cables, power equipment, engineering, aluminum wire, electrical materials for equipment, and seismic isolation devices. The Electrical Equipment and Components Business segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of magnet wires, bare wires, oxygen-free copper wires, copper alloy wires, and automotive electric wires. The Communications and Industrial Devices Business segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of communication cables, wire harnesses and precision devices. The Company is also engaged in logistics, recycling, administrative management, research and development of materials, research and development of superconducting technology, and sales of network solutions.

name: SAMTY RESIDENTIAL INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Samty Residential Investment Corporation was established in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts. With Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended), with Samty Asset Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter, the Asset Management Company) serving as the organizer, and was registered with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau on April 6, 2015 (registration number: Director of Kanto Local Finance Bureau No. 101). Subsequently, on June 30, 2015, Samty Residential was listed on the real estate investment trust market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (securities code: 3459). With rental housing (hereinafter referred to as (rental housing) or residential properties) as the main investment target, Samty Residential manages its assets by conducting diversified investments in wide-ranging cities throughout Japan centering on major regional cities (Note), aiming to enhance unitholder value over the medium to long term. As of the end of the fiscal period ended January 2026 (hereinafter, the end of the 21st fiscal period), Samty Residential owned real estate, etc. consisting of 189 properties in total (total acquisition price: 171,472 million yen), with the total number of investment units issued and outstanding at 852,726 units. Samty Residential Investment Corporation was established on March 16, 2015.

name: POSTPRIME
businessSummary: PostPrime Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in financial and economic information platform business. It operates the social networking service PostPrime. PostPrime specializes in content centered on finance and economics. PostPrime is a platform that allows users to register as members free of charge, and once registered, they can choose from a variety of methods to transmit information, including text, images, audio, video and live streaming, and post for free, while also viewing and browsing the posts of other users. PostPrime offers prime registration, membership and other free and paid features. By meeting certain requirements and becoming a prime creator, users can set some of their posts as paid posts, enabling them to earn revenue by disseminating information. The Company also operates a YouTube channel.

name: LIV UP
businessSummary: Livenup Group Co Ltd, formerly known as Liv-up Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company engaged in the real estate development and sale business. The main businesses are residential real estate business and income real estate business. The residential real estate business engages in the sale of detached houses and detached house land (residential land), including overall planning, building planning and design, construction supervision, sale, and after-sales maintenance of single-family homes, as well as the resale business. The income real estate business is engaged in the development and sale of apartments and the acquisition and resale of used income properties. The Company develops apartments as income-generating real estate and sells them to customers with investment purposes who collect rent from tenants. The Company also engages in rental sales and brokerage commission income collected from tenants, as well as rental management business.

name: KANSAI PAINT
businessSummary: KANSAI PAINT CO.,LTD. is a Japan-based company which is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of paints and related services. Its operations are organized into four regional segments based on production and sales structures: Japan, India, Asia, Africa, and Europe. The Company manufactures and sells products such as automotive paints, automotive refinish paints, industrial paints, architectural paints, and anti-corrosion paints. It also conducts painting-related services and coating-related businesses.

name: PEPPER FOOD SERVICE
businessSummary: Pepper Food Service Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company operates through four business segments. The Ikinari! Steak Business segment is engaged in the operation of charcoal-grilled steak restaurant Ikinari! Steak, operated directly by the group, a franchise, or a consignment business. The Pepper Lunch Business segment has three businesses: franchise business, direct management business and consignment business. It operates stores such as Pepper Lunch, Pepper Lunch Diner, 92's and food court type Charcoal-grilled Hamburg Steak Kuni, Tokyo 634 Burg, Musashi Hamburg. The Restaurant Business segment operates custom-cut steak restaurants, tonkatsu stores, beef tongue restaurants and others as a direct management, franchise and consignment business of the group. The Product Sales Business segment sells ingredients such as tonkatsu sauce, frozen pepper rice, dressing, and lux ham, as well as chopsticks.

name: BALMUDA
businessSummary: Balmuda Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the planning, design, development and sale of home appliances in Japan and overseas. The main products include air conditioner-related products such as electric fans, humidifiers and air purifiers, kitchen-related products such as steam toasters, electric kettles, rice cookers and microwave ovens, as well as other products such as solar light emitting diode (LED) desk lights, portable LED lanterns, wireless speakers and hover cleaners. The Company is also engaged in the production of content such as photos and videos related to product promotion.

name: CASY
