businessSummary: CaSy Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the housekeeping service business. The Company operates a matching platform that provides cleaning services, cooking services, and other lifestyle services (house cleaning services and storage services) in the service areas of nine prefectures (Tokyo, Kanagawa, Saitama, Chiba, Osaka, Hyogo, Kyoto, Aichi, and Miyagi). The cleaning services provides services such as house and room cleaning and tidying. The cooking services include food preparation, kitchen cleanup, and food shopping. The other lifestyle services include house cleaning services (cleaning services by specialized companies for air conditioners, ventilation fans) and tidying and storage services (advice on tidying and storage, including consulting on decluttering). The Company also sells online gift certificates for housekeeping services.

name: REVOLUTION
businessSummary: Revolution Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the real estate, investment, real estate credit, and crowdfunding businesses. The Company operates through four business segments. The Real Estate Business segment is engaged in the sales and brokerage of real estate, primarily in major metropolitan areas such as Tokyo. The Investment Business segment aims to earn investment returns through investments in special purpose companies (SPCs) that invest in domestic and international companies and financial products such as securities. The Real Estate Credit Business segment operates a money lending business that provides funds secured by real estate. The Crowdfunding Business segment operates a crowdfunding business. It raises funds, primarily from an unspecified number of individuals, for investment targets such as real estate, and then invests in them.

isin: 8961.T|MORI TRUST REIT, Inc.|8961.T|MORI TRUST REIT, Inc.
name: MORI TRUST REIT
businessSummary: MORI TRUST Reit, Inc., a Japanese real estate investment corporation, was incorporated on October 2, 2001, under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan, or the Investment Trust Law. MTR was originally formed by Mori Trust Co., Ltd., and commenced operations on March 28, 2002, by acquiring a property. MTR is provided professional asset management services of properties of various types by a licensed asset management company, MORI TRUST Asset Management Co., Ltd. MTAM is currently owned 95% by MORI TRUST Co., Ltd., and 5% by Mori Trust Hotels & Resorts Co., Ltd. On February 13, 2004, MTR was listed on the J-REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of August 31, 2025, MTR owned a portfolio of 20 properties with a total rentable area of 506,295.29 sq. meters occupied by 121 tenants. The occupancy rate was 99.8%. MORI TRUST Reit, Inc was incorporated in Japan in 2001.

name: HEARTSEED
businessSummary: Heartseed Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in research and development of regenerative medicine products. The Company has established cardiac regenerative medicine, a therapy in which microtissue (cardiomyocytes) derived from iPS cells are transplanted into the heart, and conducts business activities for patients with severe heart failure. Target diseases include dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), old myocardial infarction (OMI), and dilated-phase hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (D-HCM). Except the pipeline's leading cardiac treatment HS-001 (administration of regenerated myocardium derived from allogeneic iPS cells to the myocardium), the Company also conducts research into the creation of myocardium using autologous iPS cells that do not pose immune rejection reactions and iPS cells with HLA knockout.

name: TSUKUBASEIKO
businessSummary: TSUKUBASEIKO Co,.Ltd. is mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electrostatic chucks. The electrostatic chucks generate high adsorption power at low voltage and realize cordless and thin Carrier type electrostatic chucks. The Company's products include supporters, stages and others. The supporters is a system of electrostatic chuck which can maintain adsorption power for a long time even if it is separated from a power supply unit, and generate adsorption by using power supply units when adsorbing the materials. The stages is a system of electrostatic chuck to which a power supply unit belongs, supplies power when adsorbing the materials and stops power supply when releasing the material to be attracted. The other products include small electrostatic chucks, including other applied products of electrostatic chucks, embedded in handling materials for semiconductor wafers.

name: CHIOME BIOSCIENCE
businessSummary: Chiome Bioscience Inc. is a company mainly engaged in the research and development of antibody drugs, and the provision of development support services. The Company operates in two business segments. The Drug Discovery segment is engaged in the research and development of specific antibodies based on new antigens and mechanisms and licensing to pharmaceutical companies. The Drug Discovery Support segment is engaged in development of lead antibodies for therapeutic drugs in collaborating with pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas.

name: DEXERIALS
businessSummary: Dexerials Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of optical materials, electronic materials and bonding materials. The Company operates in two business segments. The Optical Material Products segment is divided into three categories: optical films, optical resin materials and optical solutions. Main products are ultraviolet curable resins for optical discs, optical elastic resins and antireflection films. The Electronic Material Products segment is divided into four categories: bonding materials, anisotropic conductive films, surface mount fuses and microdevices.

name: JALCO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JALCO Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in rental and management of real estate properties in Japan. The company is also involved in money and social lending activities, as well as the sale and rental of pachinko and pachinko equipment. In addition, it provides M&A advisory, management, accounting, general and legal affair, and internal control services. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: SQUARE ENIX HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Square Enix Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in digital entertainment, amusement, publishing, and rights/property businesses through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through four segments. The Digital Entertainment segment provides interactive digital content for home video game consoles ,including handheld consoles, and personal computers, smartphones, and other platforms. The Amusement segment is engaged in the operation of amusement facilities, as well as the sale and rental of amusement equipment for such facilities. The Publishing segment is involved in the publication and licensing of comic magazines, comic books, game-related books, and other materials. The Rights and Properties segment is engaged in the planning, production, sales, and licensing of derivative works.

name: GOODSPEED
businessSummary: Good Speed Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally involved in the sale of used cars and motorcycles, automobile sales, and related businesses. The Company provides used car sales, car purchasing, maintenance and body repair, insurance agency, rental car, and gas station services. The used car sales business operates MEGA specialty stores for used cars, domestic car specialty stores, and imported car specialty stores. The car acquisition business acquires cars through batch acquisition assessment sites operated by multiple companies. The maintenance and sheet metal business provides services such as the maintenance of sold cars and car inspections. Insurance agency business provides agency service of general insurance companies. The car rental business provides vehicle rental services.

name: CYBERTRUST JAPAN
businessSummary: Cybertrust Japan Co., Ltd. engages in the certification authority and security, IoT, and Linux/OSS businesses in Japan. The company provides trust services, IoT embedded, and server solutions. It also offers commercial digital authentication services covering SSL/TLS server certificate, client certificate, and related consulting as a comprehensive security service. In addition, the company provides a secure authentication platform enabling vulnerabilities at production to be detected  and measures for security implementation and distribution of software upgrades. Further, it offers Linux OS/integrated monitoring tool and backup software based on open-source software  and provides embedded Linux and digital signage solutions. Cybertrust Japan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. Cybertrust Japan Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of SB Technology Corp.

name: MORI HILLS REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Mori Hills Reit Investment Corp is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid- to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate asset like office building, housing and commercial facilities. Its property portfolio includes Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, Ark Mori Building, Roppongi Hills Mori Tower, Ark Mori Building, Koraku Mori Building, Akasaka Tameike Tower, Holland Hills Mori Tower And Roppongi view tower. The asset manager of the Fund is Mori Building Investment Management Co., Ltd.

name: GREENENERGY &
businessSummary: GreenEnergy & Company Inc. engages in the sale, construction, and maintenance of solar power generation facilities and compact houses equipped with solar power generation. The company construction management services, including quality, safety, schedule, and cost management for solar power generation facilities and housing projects. It offers soler power generation, grid storage station, net-geo energy storage, and maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Fit Corporation and changed its name to GreenEnergy & Company in May 2024. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: DAIEI KANKYO
businessSummary: Daiei Kankyo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in environment-related businesses centered on waste treatment and resource recycling. The environment-related segment is engaged in the provision of one-stop services for waste collection, transportation, intermediate treatment, recycling, and final disposal, as well as total solutions for contaminated soil, from investigation to remediation. The environment-related business is divided into seven categories: waste treatment and resource recycling, soil remediation, energy creation, forest conservation, facility construction and operation management, consulting, and others. The Company also operates a valuable resources recycling business consisting of aluminum pellets and recycled plastic pallets.

name: ORIX JREIT
businessSummary: Orix JREIT Inc is real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in real estate-related assets that are used in offices located in major cities across the country. Its property portfolio includes Round Cross Mita, Shibuya Pine Building, Round Cross Akihabara, Orix Ikebukuro Building and Hamamatsu Act Tower, among others. The asset manager of the Fund is ORIX Asset Management Corporation.

name: LIBERTA
businessSummary: Liberta Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning and sale of beauty products, household and daily miscellaneous goods, and functional clothing products in Japan and internationally. The company offers health and beauty products, including foot care items, deodorant cream, toothpaste, adult scents, and makeup under the Baby Foot, Quick Beauty, DENTISTE, Slowbliss, Dext, and COSCOS brands  functional apparel under the FREEZE TECH, heatmaster, DEODRIZETECH, and ThermOne brands  household detergents, mold remover, and washing machine drum removers under the KABIDASH, Kabi Tornado, SHWATCH, and Mama La Clean brands  foods and general goods under ThinOptics and ATHMEAL brands  and watches under Luminox and Libenham brands. It is also involved in PR marketing and other businesses  mail order businesses  beauty salons, and other businesses, as well as water purifiers and medical equipment from Waterworks, military watches, Oral Doctor, and LaLuna. The company sells its products through department stores, mass retailers, drug stores, as well as ecommerce. Liberta Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: KEIHANSHIN BUILDING
businessSummary: Keihanshin Building Co.,Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the rental of land and buildings, as well as the building management, construction contracting business. The Land and Building Leasing segment is involved in the rental of office buildings, data center buildings, Windsville, commercial buildings and other commercial buildings, as well as the maintenance and cleaning of buildings and machinery. The Company is also involved in the construction, equipment contracting and real estate brokerage business.

name: PKSHA TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: PKSHA Technology Inc. provides algorithmic solutions in Japan. The company offers demand forecasting and optimization, shelf allocation automation and optimization, and shift optimization solutions for retail and distribution industries  VIN recognition, parking DX, urban security, and mobile-related solutions for automotive and urban development industries  and fraud detection and credit AI scoring solutions for lending and banking industries. It also provides insurance fraud claims detection, business efficiency, and risk prediction solutions for insurance industry  learning history utilization, business automation, online calling solutions for education industry  and diagnostic aids, pharmaceutical marketing support, personalized medicine and personal health record utilization, and operational DX solutions for medical and healthcare industries. In addition, the company offers PKSHA ChatAgent, an AI-powered conversational automation solution  PKSHA FAQ, which enables customers to self-resolve inquiries  PKSHA VoiceAgent, an automated AI voice conversation solution  PKSHA Speech Insight, an AI voice transcription and call analysis solution  and PKSHA Knowledge Stream, a solution to create FAQs from documents and interaction logs. Further, it provides PKSHA AI helpdesk for internal inquiries  no-code RPA solutions  and Yomel by PKSHA that automatically transcribe meetings and create minutes with AI speech recognition. PKSHA Technology Inc. was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: JAPAN HOTEL REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Japan Hotel Reit Investment Corp is a Japan-based closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT). Its basic policy is to manage its assets with the aim of achieving steady growth and securing stable profits from a medium- to long-term perspective. As a real estate investment corporation specializing in hotels, it primarily invests in hotel properties, and in principle, invests in hotels classified as limited-service hotels, full-service hotels, and resort hotels. Investment properties include Kobe Meriken Park Oriental Hotel, Oriental Hotel Tokyo Bay, Namba Oriental Hotel, Hotel Nikko Alivila, Oriental Hotel Hiroshima, The Beach Tower Okinawa and others. The asset manager of the Fund is Japan Hotel Reit Advisors Co Ltd.

name: FIT EASY
businessSummary: Fit Easy Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates FIT-EASY, an amusement fitness club that incorporates not only fitness training equipment but also amusement elements, as well as franchise chains (FCs). The Fitness Club Management segment is primarily involved in the development of stores and services that utilize the know-how of amusement fitness clubs, the operation and planning of stores that will become third places (a third place neither at home nor at work), and franchise expansion. Amusement fitness clubs aim to create spaces that can be enjoyed with all five senses, where customers can use amusement facilities such as FIT-GOLF (simulation golf) and FIT-SAUNA (private sauna), FIT-RACE (a full-scale racing simulator supervised by a professional driver), FIT-LOUNGE (a co-working space where customers can bring their own personal computers (PCs) to work or have online meetings), and self-beauty treatments according to their own hobbies and preferences.

name: INTERNET INITIATIVE JAPAN
businessSummary: Internet Initiative Japan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of Internet business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Network Services and System Integration (SI) segment is mainly engaged in the provision of a combination of network services and system integration services, which mainly consist of Internet connection services, wide area network (WAN) services and outsourcing services, as well as the provision of comprehensive solutions. The Automated Teller Machine (ATM) Operation segment is engaged in the operation of bank ATMs and network systems.

name: BANDAI NAMCO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Bandai Namco Holdings Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital business, toys and hobby business, intellectual property (IP) producing business, and amusement business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Digital Business segment plans, develops, and distributes network content, and plans, develops, and sells home video games and other products. The Toys and Hobby Business segment plans, develops, manufactures, and sells toys, capsule toys, cards, confectionery and food products, apparel, household goods, plastic models, premiums, stationery. The IP Production Business segment plans, produces, and operates animation and other visual and music content, manages and operates copyrights and copyrighted works, discovers and develops artists, and operates live entertainment businesses. The Amusement Business segment plans, develops, and provides after-sales service for amusement machines, and plans and operates amusement facilities.

name: TSUDAKOMA
businessSummary: Tsudakoma Corp. produces and sells textile machinery and machine tool attachments in Japan, Asia, North and south America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Textile Machinery Business and Machine Tool Related Business. The company offers textile machinery comprising air jet looms, water jet looms, and preparatory machines. It also provides composite machinery, such as prepreg slitters, automated fiber lay-up machines, auto lay-up machines, multi-axial UD auto lay-up systems, auto edge welding machines, profile molding machines, carbon fiber rapier looms, and drape forming systems. In addition, the company offers machines, including NC rotatory tables, machine vises, and manual tables. Further, it provides castings for textile machinery and preparation machinery, machine tool attachments, and various industrial machinery. The company was formerly known as TSUDAKOMA Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tsudakoma Corp. in 1982. Tsudakoma Corp. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Kanazawa, Japan.

name: LIB WORK
businessSummary: Lib Work Co., Ltd., formerly SK home Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the detached residential business. The Company is engaged in the planning, design, sale, construction and supervision of custom homes such as residential houses, condominiums and others. The Company is also engaged in the real estate sale business, and the renovation and remodeling businesses in association with the detached residential business.

name: UNIPOS
businessSummary: Unipos Inc, formerly Fringe81 Co Ltd, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and consultation of Internet advertising technology, as well as the provision of Website services mainly in human resources (HR) tech fields. The advertising business includes advertising agency service, media growth service and solution service. The advertising agency service is involved in the sale of Internet advertisements. The media growth service is involved in the provision of planning, development and operation of advertising goods for smartphone media including applications. The solution service is involved in the provision of advertising strategy’s decision-making support products for advertisers who receive Internet advertising. The Unipos business is involved in the provision of a service named Unipos for mutual evaluation and praise.

name: JAPAN ASIA INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Japan Asia Investment Company, Limited is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the investment business in Japan and other areas of Asia. The Company is engaged in the investment through its funds such as investment partnerships and others, which are established by institutional investors and other investors and by the Group's own investment. The Company operates through three investment businesses. The management and operation business is involved in the conduction, management and operation of funds, as well as the provision of services of undertakes accounting and in-kind management. The investment business is involved in the investment in private equity and projects such as renewable energy, healthcare and smart agriculture. The other business in involved in the provision of peripheral services such as provides various types of information and services for supporting investee companies and investing in projects.

isin: 9861.T|Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd.|9861.T|Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd.
name: YOSHINOYA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, operates and manages fast-food restaurants in Japan and internationally. The company operates gyudon beef bowl restaurants under the Yoshinoya brand  Japanese noodle restaurants under the Hanamaru Udon, Umagena, Sanuki Noodle Restaurant, Tsurusaku, Takamatsu Chokushi, Chikusei, Zuzuzu, Zuzuzu (kishimen), and Hoshigaoka Seimenjo brands  and ramen restaurants under the Setagaya, Hirugao, Fukumori, Oreshiki, Fukumi, Gankuro, The Gyorou, Shinsen, Ramen Hide, Kamiyagura, Bariuma, Torinosuke, Fuunmaru, Buchiton, Kirameki no Tori, and Takara Sangyo brands. It also operates specialty stores under the Karubi no Toriko, Mou Toriko, Deikara, Cha-o, Tori-sen, Senkichi, and Kayabar brands  and share restaurants under the Share restaurant and Atotsugi restaurant names. In addition, the company engages in the development of ostrich meat and ostrich oil products under the Speedia brand, as well as ostrich breeding  management advisory for franchised stores  and business investment, fund management, and franchisee recruitment activities. Yoshinoya Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

name: PRO SHIP
businessSummary: Pro-Ship Incorporated is primarily engaged in the development and marketing of package systems, the entrusted development, and the operation management business of systems. The Company operates in two business segments. The Package Solution segment is involved in the operation of package solution business, ranging from the consultation to the implementation and maintenance of fixed assets systems and sales management systems. The Others segment is involved in entrusted development and operation management business.

name: MARUI GROUP
businessSummary: Marui Group Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the retail and fintech business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Retailing segment is engaged in the purchase and sales of clothing, decorative items, household products, the leasing and operation of commercial facilities, the interior decoration of stores, advertising, the subcontracting of fashion product logistics, the maintenance and management of buildings. The Fintech segment specializes in credit card business, as well as the provision of consumer loans, rental guarantee, information system services, the leasing of real estate, investment trust sales, and small-amount short-term insurance business.

isin: 8955.T|Japan Prime Realty Investment Corporation|8955.T|Japan Prime Realty Investment Corporation
name: JAPAN PRIME REALTY INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Japan Prime Realty Investment Corporation (JPR) under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended), and was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Section of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (the Tokyo Stock Exchange) on June 14, 2002, with 289,600 outstanding investment units. With the subsequently implemented public offerings and other capital raising measures by JPR, the number of investment units issued and outstanding totals 4,048,256 units as of the end of the 48th fiscal period (December 31, 2025). JPR has assigned the asset management of its portfolio to Tokyo Tatemono Realty Investment Management, Inc. (hereafter the Asset Management Company), through which JPR aims to maximize unitholder value by efficiently managing the portfolio primarily comprising office properties and retail properties. Japan Prime Realty Investment Corporation was established on September 14, 2001.

name: DYNAMIC MAP PLATFORM
businessSummary: Dynamic Map Platform Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in generating and selling high-precision three-dimensional map data for use in automatic driving and advanced driver assistance systems. The Company operates its business through two geographic segments, domestic and overseas. The Domestic segment measures and maps freeways, highways, and ordinary roads in Japan, and integrates them to generate and sell High Definition Map (HD map) useful for automatic driving and advanced driving support systems, and also provides solutions. The Overseas segment measures and maps highways and ordinary roads in North America, Europe, the Middle East and South Korea, and generates and sells HD map for automatic driving and advanced driving support systems in the same way as the domestic automotive business.

name: J GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: j-Group Holdings Corp., together with its subsidiaries, operates restaurants in Japan. It operates through Food and Beverage Business, Real Estate Business, and Others segments. The company operates izakayas, food courts, driver's corners, and cafes  and shopping corners that sell souvenirs. It also provides development, operation, rental, and management and administration services for real estate properties. In addition, the company engages in bridal  wholesale of food products  and personnel dispatching and temporary staffing activities. The company was formerly known as j-Project Corp. and changed its name to j-Group Holdings Corp. in September 2012. j-Group Holdings Corp. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: KAWASAKI HEAVY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Kawasaki Heavy Industries Ltd is general engineering manufacturer. The Company operates in six business segments. The Aerospace Systems segment manufactures and sells aircraft, aircraft engines, and space-related equipment. The Rolling Stock segment manufactures and sells rolling stock, snow removal equipment, and other products. The Energy Solution & Marine segment manufactures and sells energy-related equipment and systems, hydrogen-related equipment, marine propulsion-related equipment and systems, plant-related equipment and systems, ships, and crushers. The Precision Machinery & Robotics segment manufactures and sells hydraulic equipment, industrial robots, and other products. The Powersports & Engines Segment manufactures and sells motorcycles, off-road vehicles (SxS, ATV), personal watercraft (PWC) jet ski, general-purpose gasoline engines, and other products. The Others segment is engaged in commerce, sales and order brokerage, and management of welfare facilities.

name: MEIKO ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: Meiko Electronics Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the design, manufacturing and sales of electronic circuit boards and other related electronics-related businesses. The printed circuit board business designs and manufactures printed circuit boards. The electronic equipment business focuses on electronics manufacturing services (EMS), providing total solutions that cover all processes from pattern design to manufacturing, component procurement, mounting, inspection and shipping. Products include double-sided and multi-layer through-hole boards, build-up boards, flexible boards, flex-rigid boards, high electric current boards, heat dissipation boards, component-embedded boards, metal masks, mechatronics equipment, video equipment and video systems.

name: TSUKURUBA
businessSummary: Tsukuruba Inc is a Japan-based company develops by combining Information and communication technology and design. The Company operates in two business segments. Cowcamo segment is involved in the provision of services, such as property information distribution services through online media, broker services by the Company’s own agents, as well as support services for sellers and business utilizing customer needs and property data. The segment provides its services through the renovation and second-hand housing distribution platform cowcamo. Shared Workplace segment develops business centered on the sharing service of workspaces that provides working place combining services with renovated office spaces as a subscription type service. The Segment provides Co-working space co-ba, whose main customers are people and organizations such as startups, individual business owners and creators, as well as HEYSHA, which can rent office space flexibly according to the growth and change of Company.

name: W SCOPE
businessSummary: W-Scope Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of separators for lithium-ion secondary batteries. Microporous membranes made of polyolefin are generally used for the separators of main products, and their role is to separate the positive and negative electrode materials while ensuring lithiumion conductivity between the positive and negative electrodes. In addition, when the battery becomes abnormally hot and reaches a high temperature, the safety mechanism (shutdown property) in which the polyolefin melts and closes the pores plays an important role in stopping the movement of lithium ions and safely stopping the battery's function, responsible for battery safety.

name: KOZO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: KOZO Holdings Co.,Ltd. is mainly engaged in the retail, restaurant and distribution businesses, and, as a franchisor of its business brands, supplies raw materials and provides management guidance to franchisees. The Company operates through three business segments. The Retail segment operates directly managed stores and sells takeaway sushi under the Kozo Sushi and Chagetsu brands. It also enters into agreements with franchisees under the Kozo Sushi Chain franchise system and grants them the use of its trademarks. The Restaurant segment operates dine-in restaurants. It also enters into agreements with franchisees under the franchise systems of the Tori-Tetsu, Tori-Den, Dosanko, Jidori-tei and Kimukatsu brands and grants them the use of its trademarks. The Distribution segment is engaged in the home delivery of in-house prepared food products and the wholesale of food ingredients for commercial use.

isin: 7774.T|JAPAN TISSUE ENGINEERING|7774.T|Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd.
name: JAPAN TISSUE ENGINEERING
businessSummary: Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the regenerative medicine business in Japan. The company operates through Regenerative Medicine Product, Regenerative Medicine Contract, and Lab Site Project segments. It offers autologous cultured epidermis, cartilage, corneal epithelium, and oral mucosal epithelium to medical institutions for the purpose of medical treatment. The company also provides tissue-engineered medical products. In addition, it offers EPI-MODEL, a reconstructed human epidermis model. Further, the company offers regenerative medicine contract development and manufacturing services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Gamagori, Japan. Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Teijin Limited.

name: SOFTFRONT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Softfront Holdings provides communication software and services in Japan. The company is also involved in the development and sale of products and services of real-time communication-related products and services using audio, video, and messaging  planning, development, and sales of web-based products and services  retail electricity, specified wholesale supply, and VPP businesses  and brokerage and sales of IT solutions. In addition, it provides related contract development  website construction and utilization support  and energy resource development and implementation services. Further, the company offers commubo, a natural conversation AI platform  telmee, a cloud-based telephone service  and SITE PUBLIS that allows creation, management, and updating of websites and content. The company was formerly known as Softfront Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Softfront Holdings in August 2016. Softfront Holdings was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

name: MITSUBISHI
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in metal resources, natural gas, consumer industry and other businesses. It has ten business segments. Natural Gas segment engages in production and development of natural gas and crude oil. Comprehensive Materials segment engages in sales transactions of carbon, steel products. Chemical Solutions segment engages in sales, business development and investment in chemical-related fields. Metal Resources segment engages in investment and development of metal resources. Industrial Infrastructure segment conducts business in energy infrastructure and industrial plants. Automobile and Mobility segment provides value chain businesses. Food Industry segment conducts sales transactions in food related production. Consumer Industry segment provides products and services in the retail and apparel. Electric Power Solution segment provides power. Complex Urban Development segment conducts urban and real estate development.

name: AHC GROUP
businessSummary: AHC GROUP INC. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the welfare, nursing care and restaurant business. The Company operates in three business segments. The Welfare segment is engaged in the operation of after school day service offices, child development support offices, employment support offices, consultation support offices and cohabitation support offices, the provision of advice and guidance related to welfare, the management business, and the licensing of welfare brands, including apuri, TODAY, A plus and Beetle. The Nursing Care segment is engaged in the operation of day service offices, the provision of advice and guidance related to nursing care, the management business, and the licensing of welfare brands, including Greenday, Aidearu and Tricolore. The Restaurant segment is engaged in the operation of izakaya and bistros, the provision of advice and guidance, the processing and sale of food products, and the licensing of brands, including Sanzo, TERIYAKI and others.

name: MOVIN STRATEGIC CAREER
businessSummary: Movin' Strategic Career Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that provides recruitment services to professional firms, focusing on the human resources consulting industry. The Company operates through the recruitment business segment. The Recruitment Business segment focuses on supporting management consultants in recruiting. The recruitment service introduces full-time candidates to companies seeking full-time positions. Career advisors obtain job details from companies seeking full-time positions and match candidates who meet the job requirements from a registered user database (or external job-hunting Websites). Career advisors also conduct interviews with registered users who wish to change jobs, provide career consultations on desired job types, confirm their intentions to change jobs, introduce job openings that match the registered user's career aspirations, send resumes and other information and provide support and advice from the job interview to joining the company.

name: MTG
businessSummary: MTG Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells health, beauty, and wellness products in Japan and internationally. The company offers its products under the ReFa, SIXPAD, NEWPEACE, GOTO no TSUBAKI, MEGLY, ReD, MDNA SKIN, PLOSION, ON&DO, e-3X, Style, PAO, INBEAUTE, CAXAUP, Obleu, and TAIKAN STREAM brands. It markets its products through stores, as well as online. The company was formerly known as MTG BLAZE Corporation and changed its name to MTG Co., Ltd. in August 1999. MTG Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

name: CYBERSOLUTIONS
businessSummary: CyberSolutions Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and sales of cloud-based email and email security services for corporate clients. The Company operates the digital communication and cybersecurity business segment. The security solutions business plans and sells products and services related to security and risk management, including email sanitization, threat protection and information leakage prevention. The email security products and services include Cloud Mail SECURITYSUITE, MailGates, CyberMail-ST, Cybermail-CDR and Enterprise Audit, a messaging archive solution. The communication solutions business plans and sells products and services related to business communication including email, business chat and groupware. The Company’s products and services include CyberMail, CYBERMAIL, CYBERCHAT, EMERGENCYMAIL, SecureDrive (cloud storage service), SecureBoard (cloud groupware service) and SecureCommunicationONE (integrated collaboration service).

name: NIPPON AVIONICS
businessSummary: Nippon Avionics Co., Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures and sells data processing systems and related electrical equipment in Japan. The company offers data processing equipment, aviation equipment, communication equipment, image processing equipment, manufacturing equipment, medical equipment, electrical measuring equipment, electronic devices and hybrid IC's, software related to data processing systems and electronic computers, and related equipment and parts. It also provides ultrasonic handheld, automatic seam, and ultrasonic small metal welders for semiconductors and optical devices  security solutions for IoT devices  high-performance welding monitor  resistance, laser, and seam welders  ultrasonic equipment  pulse heat unit  pulse heat fusing unit  micro joining equipment  joining monitors  and high-frequency induction heaters. In addition, it offers infrared thermal imaging cameras and radiation hardened point of load DC/DC converters. Further, it engages in designing, superintendence, and contracting electric power and electric telecommunication implementation. Nippon Avionics Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Nippon Aviotronics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Avionics Co., Ltd. in April 1980. Nippon Avionics Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Yokohama, Japan.

name: SMAREGI
businessSummary: Smaregi Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the cloud service business. The Company is mainly engaged in the provision of cloud systems for companies to manage and analyze information necessary for business management, including Sumaregi, a cloud-based point-of-sale (POS) register used by restaurants and retail stores to manage and analyze sales information. The Company is also engaged in the sale of peripheral devices for cash registers, such as tablets and receipt printers, used by users of cloud services.

name: FUTURE INNOVATION GROUP
businessSummary: Future Innovation Group, Inc. engages in the IoT and machines businesses in Japan. The company development, sales, rental, and leasing of mobile management systems, as well as associated communication and application services and maintenance, etc.  development, operation, and maintenance of multimedia systems for hotel operators, semiconductor substrate business, and manufacturing equipment business  and research, development, manufacturing, construction, maintenance management, sales, and import/export of unmanned aircraft and robot control systems. It also engages in the development and sales of in-house call recording systems and system contract development  development of logistics systems and virtual reality systems related solutions  development of payments, robotics, and information technology  maintenance and management of information and communications systems  tourist taxi/bus business and flat-rate taxi business  and rental/lease of Mobile Create products. In addition, the company is involved in the manufacturing and sales of Mobile Create products  provision of location information services in the transportation and logistics industries  and sales of hotel multimedia systems and procurement of materials. Further, it engages in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor and automobile related manufacturing equipment, dies, transport robots, etc. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Oita, Japan.

name: HEIWA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Heiwa Holdings Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells pachinko and pachislot machines in Japan. It is involved in the golf course operation and management business. The company also manufactures and sales gaming machines. Heiwa Holdings Inc. was formerly known as Heiwa Corporation and changed its name to Heiwa Holdings Inc. in October 2026. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

name: YASKAWA ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Yaskawa Electric Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, installation, maintenance, and engineering of electrical equipment. The Company operates through three business segments. The Motion Control segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for alternating current (AC) servo motors, control devices, and inverters. The Robotics segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for industrial robots. The System Engineering segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides maintenance services for environmental and social systems and industrial automation drives.

name: RYOHIN KEIKAKU
businessSummary: Ryohin Keikaku Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in sale of products under the brands of Mujirushi Ryohin and MUJI. The Company has four segments including Domestic segment, East Asia segment, Europe and Americas segment as well as Southeast Asia and Oceania segment. The Domestic segment is engaged in sale and supplement, the operation of camp sites and house sale business. The East Asia Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in East Asia. The Southeast Asia & Oceania Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in Southeast Asia and Oceania. The Europe and America Business segment is engaged in product sales and restaurant business in Europe and America. The Company is also involved in food and beverage sale under Cafe&Meal MUJI brand, the operation of camp sites, sale of houses and sale of IDEE brand products.

name: GIFTEE GROUP
businessSummary: Giftee Group Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engages in the management of its group companies and related operations. The Company conducts business through its e-gift platform business. Through its subsidiaries, the Company offers the following services. Giftee is a service enabling individual users to purchase e-gifts online. Giftee for Business is a service allowing corporations to purchase e-gifts for use in campaigns and other promotional activities. EGift System is a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform that enables e-gift issuers such as restaurants and retail stores to manage the creation, distribution, sales, payment processing, and performance tracking of e-gifts. The Company also provides a digital local currency solution.

name: AIFUL
businessSummary: Muninova Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company that manages the business operations of group companies engaged in consumer finance and credit card businesses. It engages in finance and other businesses. Finance business operates loans, credit, credit guarantee, debt management and collection, deferred payment settlement and electronic money businesses. Loan business includes consumer finance business and business finance business. Credit business includes comprehensive credit purchase intermediation business and an individual credit purchase intermediation business. Credit guarantee business provides credit guarantees for loans. Debt management and collection business provides management and collection of various debts. Deferred payment settlement business provides deferred payment services. Electronic money business provides prepaid electronic money settlement services. It also operates venture capital, rent guarantee and small-amount short-term insurance businesses.

name: ONE REIT
businessSummary: One REIT, Inc. owns Mizuho REIT Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the Asset Management Company). The firm is a member of the Mizuho Financial Group, as its asset management company, and sets middle-sized office buildings as its focal investment target while incorporating other office buildings, etc., aiming to construct a portfolio that both ensures stable income in the medium to long term and exhibits growth potential. Furthermore, One REIT strives for further growth with the aim of maximizing unitholder value under the basic policies of (continuous growth of distributions) and (disciplined external growth while considering the portfolio and financial structure), alongside obtaining various support in terms of property acquisition, management, and financial aspects from our sponsor, Mizuho Trust & Banking Co., Ltd., which has an abundant track record in the Japanese real estate market. One REIT was incorporated, pursuant to the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations, on June 25, 2013, with the Asset Management Company as the organizer and listed on the J-REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on October 9, 2013. With public offerings, etc. that have followed, the total number of investment units issued and outstanding as of the end of the period under review stands at 268,468. One REIT, Inc. was incorporated in 2013 in Japan.

name: SORACOM
businessSummary: Soracom Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Internet of Things (IoT) platform business. The IoT Platform Business segment mainly provides SORACOM, an IoT platform that solves common issues faced by client companies when introducing and operating IoT. It provides IoT devices, IoT subscriber identity modules (SIM), communication lines required for IoT, data storage and visualization applications required for IoT services, and network services as platform services. The Company also provides consulting services and undertakes contract work such as technology development support.

name: KOHOKU KOGYO
businessSummary: Kohoku Kogyo CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells lead terminals for aluminum electrolytic capacitors, optical components and devices, and precision components in Japan, England, Asia, China, the United States, and internationally. It offers lead terminals, including standard type, burr-free type, edge-free type, one-side rib type, round 4-corner type, vibration-resistant type, front-back discriminative type, welded resin coating, and round bar resin coating, as well as rounding and anodic oxidation processing, and lead terminal materials. The company also provides optical communication components and devices, such as inline optical isolators, hybrid optical isolators, optical filter devices, optical circulators, variable optical attenuators, polarization maintaining optical fiber assembled with capillary and metalized fiber, optical fiber array assembled with hermetic feedthrough, specially assembled multi-channel optical fiber array, faraday rotators, high purity silica glasses, and optical fiber preforms, as well as optical components for submarine cable. In addition, it offers devices for space, photonics, and electronics convergence. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Nagahama, Japan.

name: KURADASHI CO
businessSummary: KURADASHI.Co.,Ltd. engages in the management of social good market under the Kuradashi brand in Japan. It sells products online, as well as through stores and pop-up shops. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

name: TDK
businessSummary: TDK Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of passive components, sensor application products, magnetic application products and energy application products. The Company operates through four business segments. The Passive Components segment is engaged in the provision of ceramic capacitors, aluminum electrolytic capacitors, film capacitors, inductive devices, high frequency components, piezoelectric material components and circuit protection components. The Sensor Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of temperature and pressure sensors, magnetic sensors and micro electromechanical system (MEMS) sensors. The Magnetic Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of hard disk drive (HDD) heads, HDD suspensions and magnets. The Energy Application Products segment is engaged in the provision of energy devices and power supplies. The Company is also involved in the provision of mechatronics and micro actuators products.

isin: 8956.T|NTT UD REIT Investment Corporation|8956.T|NTT UD REIT Investment Corporation
name: NTT UD REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: NTT Urban Development REIT Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the Investment Corporation). In accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act) and was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on September 10, 2002 (stock code 8956). Since then, the company has steadily expanded its asset base, and the total acquisition cost (Note 1) of its properties has increased from 49,021 million yen (11 properties) at the end of the first fiscal year (April 30, 2003) to 295,266 million yen (62 properties, including one preferred equity certificate) as of the end of the current fiscal year (April 30, 2026). This investment corporation aims to secure stable returns over the medium to long term by diversifying its investments in real estate primarily used for office and residential purposes, with its investment area centered on the Tokyo economic zone (Note 2). Since its first fiscal period in April 2003, it has distributed profits 46 times up to the 46th fiscal period of the previous fiscal year. NTT UD REIT Investment Corporation was established on May 2, 2002, and incorporated in Japan.

name: NS GROUP
businessSummary: NS Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly operates a rent guarantee business mainly through its subsidiaries, which offers a rent guarantee service that reports on delinquency payments, and a collection agency service. The rent guarantee service involves acting as a joint guarantor for tenants and promising to guarantee rent. If the tenant fails to pay rent, the Company will make a subrogation payment and later collect the subrogated rent from the tenant. The rent guarantee business is primarily for residential properties, commercial properties (offices and stores), and others (parking lots, leased land, factories and others). The collection agency service involves partnering with financial institutions that provide collection agency services to collect rent on behalf of real estate companies and property lessors.

name: ONE CAREER
businessSummary: One Career Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the career data platform business, which supports the promotion of digital transformation (DX) of recruiting activities and human resources (HR) operations. The Career Data Platform is a platform that allows job seekers to access all the information they need to make employment decisions at once, whereas previously they would have had to cross multiple channels to do so. It accumulates career data that was not previously available to the public and provides both job seekers and companies with the information they need to make decisions about employment and hiring. The career data platform provides the new graduate recruitment support media ONE CAREER and mid-career recruitment support media ONE CAREER PLUS to the job seekers, and the DX support solution ONE CAREER Cloud Series to companies.

name: DENTSU SOKEN
businessSummary: Dentsu Soken Inc. provides information technology solutions. It operates through four segments: Financial Solutions, Business Solutions, Manufacturing Solutions, and Communication IT. The Financial Solutions segment offers IT solutions that support various financial operation at financial institution and other companies. The Business Solutions segment provides human capital management and accounting management solutions. The Manufacturing Solutions segment develops performance evaluation methods for air mobility, researches and develops solutions in product lifecycle management. The Communication IT segment provides software services. Dentsu Soken Inc. was formerly known as Information Services International-Dentsu, Ltd. and changed its name to Dentsu Soken Inc. in January 2024. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Dentsu Soken Inc. operates as a subsidiary Dentsu Group Inc.

isin: 8967.T|Japan Logistics Fund, Inc.|8967.T|Japan Logistics Fund, Inc.
name: JAPAN LOGISTICS FUND
businessSummary: Japan Logistics Fund, Inc. is the first J- REIT dedicated to logistics properties with real estate and other assets used for logistic facilities primarily in the Tokyo Metropolitan, Osaka, Nagoya and Fukuoka areas as investment targets. Based on the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951 including revisions enforced thereafter) (hereinafter, the Investment Trust Act), JLF was founded on February 22, 2005 with Mitsui & Co., Logistics Partners Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as MLP) as the founding planner, and was listed on the REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter, Tokyo Stock Exchange) on May 9 of the same year. As of January 31, 2026 (the end of the 41st Period), JLF owns 52 properties under management with a total acquisition price of 293,467 million yen and total assets of 274,137 million yen.

name: SAPEET
businessSummary: Sapeet Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI) solutions and products in Japan. The company's services include sales AI agent construction service, generative AI consulting/development support, planning and support for store DX and OMO measures, DX support for customer service standardization, AI posture and motion analysis, and new business support in the healthcare and wellness fields. It also offers Culticloud, a cloud service that streamlines communication between business owners and their customers. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

isin: 7421.T|Kappa Create Co., Ltd.|7421.T|Kappa Create Co., Ltd.
name: KAPPA CREATE
businessSummary: Kappa Create Co., Ltd. engages in the management of restaurants in Japan. The company operates in two reportable segments, Conveyor Belt Sushi Business and Delicatessen Business. The Conveyor Belt Sushi Business segment is involved in the operation of the conveyor-belt sushi chain under the Kappa Sushi name. The Delicatessen Business segment engages in the manufacture and sale of sushi and prepared bread products for convenience stores and supermarkets. It is also involved in processing and selling food products. Kappa Create Co., Ltd. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: SUMCO
businessSummary: Sumco Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of high-purity silicon. The Company operates the high-purity silicon business, which is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of silicon wafers to semiconductor manufacturers. Semiconductor silicon wafers are used as substrate materials by semiconductor manufacturers when manufacturing various semiconductors such as memory and logic. The Company manufactures polished wafers of various diameters and epitaxial wafers with further special processing on their surfaces. The Company operates in Japan, the United States, Taiwan, Singapore, South Korea and the United Kingdom and other regions.

name: GIFT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: GIFT Holdings Inc, formerly GIFT Inc, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in food business. The Company operates directly managed stores mainly based on Yokohama family ramen, provides food materials and operation skills to producer stores. The directly managed store division consists of the domestic directly operated store business division and overseas directly managed business division. The produce business division concludes a basic transaction contract with the store owner who is going to start a new ramen shop and continuously purchases noodles, sauce, soup and ingredients from the store owner's produced store.

name: RORZE
businessSummary: Rorze Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of semiconductor-related equipment and flat panel display (FPD)-related equipment. The Company has two business segments. Semiconductor and FPD-related Equipment segment develops, manufactures and sells clean transfer equipment for the semiconductor and liquid crystal display industries. The semiconductor-related products include atmospheric wafer transfer systems and standalone wafer transfer units. The analytical equipment includes fully automated vapor phase decomposition (VPD) systems. The FPD-related products include large glass substrate transfer systems and glass cutting machines. Life Science segment develops, manufactures and sells cell culture equipment for the drug discovery and related industries. The life science-related products include incubators for cell culture.

name: FANUC
businessSummary: Fanuc Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of computer numerical control (CNC) systems used in production systems through automation and their application products based on CNC system technology, as a comprehensive supplier of factory automation (FA). The FA division is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of FA products, such as CNC systems and laser products. The Robot division is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of robot systems and other robotic products. The Robot Machine division is engaged in the development, manufacture, and sale of small cutting machines, electric injection molding machines, wire electrical discharge machining tools, and other products.

name: PANASONIC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Panasonic Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture of electronic products. The Connect segment develops, manufactures, and sells products such as in-flight entertainment systems and communication services, electronic component mounting systems, welding equipment, and projectors. The Electric Works segment develops, manufactures, and sells lighting fixtures, lamps, and wiring devices. The HVAC & CC segment develops, manufactures, and sells residential and commercial air conditioners, heat-pump water heaters and heating systems. The Energy segment develops, manufactures, and sells cylindrical lithium-ion batteries for automotive use, and primary batteries (dry cells, micro batteries). The Industry segment develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components, motors, factory automation (FA) devices, and electronic materials. The Smart Life segment develops, manufactures, and sells refrigerators, microwave ovens, rice cookers, and others.

name: SAKURA INTERNET
businessSummary: SAKURA Internet Inc. provides cloud computing services in Japan. The company operates data centers. It also engages in the development of software for telecommunications  operation of telecommunication systems and consulting for telecommunications carriers  security consulting and vulnerability assessment  planning, production and sales of multimedia  planning, management, operation, and sale of rental servers (VPS)  analysis and distribution of disaster and weather information  information services provision through the internet  planning, production, and sales of multimedia  web design, development, design, management, planning, operation and sale  internet services business  service integration business  consulting business  virtual offices and shared offices business  system integration  leasing, maintenance, and management of telecommunication facilities  and development, sales, rental, maintenance, and management of computer hardware and software products. SAKURA Internet Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: AZOOM
businessSummary: AZoom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in idle asset utilization business and visualization business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Idle Asset Utilization segment operates the monthly parking lot portal site CarParking and provides a monthly parking lot introduction service that introduce parking lots, as well as renting vacant parking lots from parking lot owners and subleasing them to users as monthly parking lots. The Company's business focuses on monthly parking sublease services. The Company also offer SMART KUKANYOYAKU, a Web reservation system that supports the operation of rental spaces such as conference rooms, gyms, studios and others, Coupa Search, a portal site for hourly parking lots, AdWall, a search site for outdoor advertising spaces. The Visualization segment utilizes specialized skills 3D computer graphics (3DCG) technology to help explain how buildings and spaces are used and how to visualize the finished product.

name: RINGER HUT
businessSummary: Ringer Hut Co.,Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan and internationally. It operates restaurants under the Nagasaki Champon Ringer Hut, Tonkatsu Hamakatsu, and Nagasaki Takufu Hamakatsu brands. The company was formerly known as Hamakatsu Corporation and changed its name to Ringer Hut Co.,Ltd. in August 1982. Ringer Hut Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: BRAINS TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Brains Technology, Inc., an enterprise AI software company, develops and provides data search and data analysis products and services using AI and machine learning. It offers Impulse, an anomaly detection solution  and Neuron ES, an enterprise search engine. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NIPPON SANSO HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Nippon Sanso Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of gas and related equipment. The Company operates in five segments which are Japan Gas segment, the United States Gas segment, the Europe Gas segment, the Asia and Oceania Gas segment, and the Thermos segment. The Company provides gas products, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, carbon dioxide, helium, hydrogen, acetylene, medical gas, liquefied petroleum (LP) gas and special gas; equipment and materials, including electronic related equipment, fusing equipment, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, welding materials, medical equipment, air separation equipment; the assembling, processing, inspection and maintenance of electronic components; and stainless steel thermos bottles.

name: AIMECHATEC
businessSummary: AIMECHATEC, Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells flat panel display equipment, optical devices, and semiconductor packages in Japan, Taiwan, China, South Korea, and internationally. It operates through three segments: IJP Solutions Business, Semiconductor Related Business, and LCD Business. The company offers plasma asher, etcher, UV equipment for power semiconductor production, wafer handling systems, and solder ball mounters and equipment for power semiconductors. It also provides seal applications, liquid crystal dropping, and vacuum lamination equipment used in the production process of liquid crystal display panels for televisions and smartphones. In addition, it provides after-sales services. Further, it offers life cycle support services, such as process support, proposal for the latest equipment and mechanisms, renewal and maintenance, research and development, and training  and spare parts. AIMECHATEC, Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is based in Ryugasaki, Japan.

name: MITSUI FUDOSAN RETAIL FUND INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Frontier Real Estate Investment Corporation was established pursuant to the Investment Trust. As the Investment Corporation Act of Japan (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments  the Investment Trust Act) by Mitsui Fudosan Frontier REIT Management Inc, (formerly Frontier REIT Management Inc. (the Asset Management Company) on May 12, 2004. The Investment Corporation's investment units were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust (J-REIT) Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on August 9, 2004 (Securities Code: 8964). The Investment Corporation is a (REIT specializing in retail facilities) investing primarily in real estate properties (including real estate in trust) used as retail facilities in Japan with the aim of securing stable earnings over the medium to long term. As a result of steadily building up a track record in management over the 21 years since its establishment, as of June 30, 2025, the Investment Corporation managed a total of 42 real estate properties (total acquisition price: yen 375,738 million). Frontier Real Estate Investment Corporation was established on May 12, 2004 incorporated in Japan.
