name: MITSUI FUDOSAN LOGISTICS PARK
businessSummary: Mitsui Fudosan Logistics Park Inc. (MFLP-REIT), a Japanese real estate investment corporation. Under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments  the Investment Trust Act), by Mitsui Fudosan Logistics REIT Management Co., Ltd. (the Asset Management Company) as the organizer with investments in capital of 300 million yen (600 investment units). Registration with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau of the Ministry of Finance of Japan was completed on March 25, 2016. The investment units were listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market (J-REIT section) of Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. on August 2, 2016. MFLP-REIT started acquisition of properties on August 2, 2016. With Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. (Mitsui Fudosan) as a sponsor, MFLP-REIT invests primarily in logistics facilities with a particular focus on MFLP facilities, that is, leading-edge logistics facilities with Mitsui Fudosan quality. This focus has been chosen considering MFLP-REIT's goal of establishing a portfolio that emphasizes location, quality and balance. As of January 31, 2026, MFLP-REIT held 45 properties with the total acquisition price of 546.1 billion yen. Mitsui Fudosan Logistics Park Inc. was established in March 04, 2016 and incorporated in Japan.

name: LINK U GROUP
businessSummary: Link-U Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of a server platform business that provides one-stop data distribution based on original servers designed in-house, as well as artificial intelligence (AI) solutions that appropriately store, analyze, and process that data. The Internet service business includes recurring service, initial development and maintenance development service, and other services that occur on-site. The recurring service provides server maintenance operation including server procurement, system construction, and data center installation. The initial development and maintenance development service provides contracted development for acquiring recurring service projects. Other services mainly consist of spot development projects such as Website development.

name: USS
businessSummary: USS Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the auto auctions business. The Company operates in two business segments. The Auto Auction segment is engaged in the operation of auto auctions with used car dealers as members, the management of motorcycle auctions with used motorcycle dealers as members, the provision of auto auction connection services by satellite TV line and Internet, the provision of used car information services, the land transportation agency of exhibited cars and successful cars of auto auction, as well as the provision of financial services for auto auction members. The Used Automobile Purchase and Sale segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of used cars and accident-affected vehicles. The other business is engaged in the recycling of used vehicles, the provision of agency services for used vehicles, the sale of solar power generation systems and rental cars, as well as production and sale of recycled plastics.

name: SQUEEZE
businessSummary: SQUEEZE Inc. designs and develops an artificial intelligence (AI)-based platform for hospitality and tourism industry. The company's platform offers accounting management, revenue management, property management, cloud reception, cleaning and housekeeping, and facility operations services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Kitahiroshima, Japan.

name: ICHIBANYA
businessSummary: Ichibanya Co., Ltd. operates and franchises curry specialty stores in Japan, South Korea, the United States, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, and internationally. The company operates directly managed and franchised restaurants under the CURRY HOUSE CoCo ICHIBANYA and Pasta de CoCo brands. It also engages in the provision of management support to business companies  store management guidance and trade business  and lending of its trademarks to food manufacturers. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Ichinomiya, Japan. Ichibanya Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of House Foods Group Inc.

name: KITAGAWA SEIKI
businessSummary: Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of press machines, laminators, factory automation equipment, and transfer machines in Japan, China, Malaysia, Thailand, and internationally. The company offers press machines for laminating copper-clad laminates and printed circuit boards  high temperature vacuum press machines  test press machines  prepreg cutting machines  and press machines for laminating IC cards. It also provides storage shelf for heavy goods, such as steel material  transport automation equipment specialized for various sites  floor lift  and automated warehouse. In addition, the company offers carbon fiber reinforced thermoplastic resin automatic stacking machines  and laminators for solar panels and other laminators. The company was formerly known as Kotobuki Seisakusho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. in September 1960. Kitagawa Seiki Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

name: PREMIUM GROUP
businessSummary: Premium Group Co., Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the credit related business. The Company provides four types of businesses. The auto credit business is engaged in the provision of sale activities specialized for used auto suppliers. The Company sends or receives documents by post when using auto credits, for the purpose of improving business efficiency. The warranty business is engaged in the provision of repair free service when cars break down within the scope of warranty. It also provides prime warranty, car sensors after-sales guarantee and other automotive warranty products. The maintenance business is developed for the purpose of in-housing business of automobile repair work that occurs in the warranty business. The other business is engaged in the operation of finance and warranty business related to automobile sales on abroad.

name: EWELL
businessSummary: eWeLL Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of home-visit nursing dedicated electronic medical record iBow. The Company is engaged in the provision of cloud service and business process outsourcing (BPO) service. The cloud service is engaged in the provision of a variety of services mainly to home-visit nursing stations to solve problems in all aspects of the work of home-visit nursing stations. The BPO service is engaged in the provision of iBow office management agency service.

name: HUTZPER
businessSummary: Hutzper Inc. provides artificial intelligence services for the manufacturing industry in Japan. It offers Mekikibite, an AI solution for visual inspection and quality control in manufacturing  Custom Hutzper AI for contract development services  Skill Puzzle, an AI solution for optimizing personnel allocation in the manufacturing industry  Laclag, a local LLM solution. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: NINTENDO
businessSummary: Nintendo Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of entertainment products in the field of home entertainment. The Company develops, manufactures, and sells hardware and software for portable and home console games. Its main products are game consoles, which are computer-based entertainment devices, and character goods and playing cards. Game consoles are hardware and software for handheld and home console games, which are developed by the Company and its affiliates, manufactured by the Company, and sold mainly by its affiliates in Japan and overseas. The Company also develops businesses utilizing its intellectual property (IP), such as video content and mobile applications.

name: ISE CHEMICALS
businessSummary: ISE Chemicals Corporation engages in the iodine and natural gas, and metallic compound businesses in Japan. It offers iodine products, such as ISEFLO, a prilled iodine  crude iodine  potassium, sodium, and cuprous iodide, as well as hydroiodic acid. The company also provides metallic compounds, including nickel chloride, cobalt chloride, cobalt hydroxide, and tricobalt tetraoxide  and extracts and supplies natural gas to gas companies and factories. Its products are used in medical, feed additives, disinfectants, and electronic component industries. The company was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan. ISE Chemicals Corporation is a subsidiary of AGC Inc.

name: YAMAHA MOTOR
businessSummary: Yamaha Motor Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the land mobility, marine, robotics, financial services and others. The Company operates in four business segments. The Land Mobility Business segment manufactures and sells motorcycles, intermediate parts, parts for overseas production, four-wheeled buggies, recreational off-highway vehicles, electrically assisted bicycles, electrically assisted bicycle drive units (e-Kits), electric wheelchairs, automobile engines, automobile components. The Marine Business segment manufactures and sells outboard motors, water vehicles, boats, fishing boats and Japanese-style boats. The Robotics Business segment manufactures and sells surface mounters, semiconductors manufacturing post-engineering equipment, industrial robots and industrial unmanned helicopters. The Financial Services Business segment provides sales financing and leasing for its products. The Company also provides golf cars, generators, general-purpose engines and snowplows.

name: NS SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: NS Solutions Corporation is mainly engaged in the provision of information services. The Company operates in two business divisions based on the services offered to customers, including business solution business and service solution business. The business solution business provides solutions in total system lifecycle to meet customer needs based on knowledge and experience of business types and business operations. The service solution business provides information technology (IT) infrastructure solutions and outsourcing services, which combine platform construction technology and operation know-how to meet mission critical requirements.

name: TOKYO SEIMITSU
businessSummary: Tokyo Seimitsu Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and precision measuring equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of processing and inspection equipment for the manufacture of semiconductor, such as wafer probing machines and wafer dicing machines, as well as the provision of after-sales services and the development of related software. The Measuring Equipment segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision measuring equipment for three-dimensional (3D) vision systems, as well as surface roundness and profile shape measuring instruments including 3D coordinate measuring machine, true degree and column shape measuring machine, surface roughness measuring machine, wheel shape measuring machine and others.

name: HIROSE ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Hirose Electric Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacture and sale of multi-pole connectors, coaxial connectors, and other electronic components. The Company operates through two business segments. The Multi-Pole Connector segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of round connectors, square connectors, and connectors for printed wiring boards. The Coaxial Connector segment is engaged in the provision of coaxial connectors and optical connectors. It is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of electronic medical devices and micro switches.

name: SYMBIO PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: SymBio Pharmaceuticals Limited is a Japan-based pharmaceutical company. Along with medicine specialists, contract research organizations (CROs) and other pharmaceutical companies, the Company is engaged in the design and operation of clinical tests, the manufacture and sale of new drugs specializing in three therapeutic areas: cancer, blood diseases and autoimmune diseases. The Company develops new medicines using chemical compounds proofed by preclinical tests and clinical tests. The Company manufactures and sells medicines through domestic and foreign pharmaceutical companies. The Company's pipelines include anticancer drugs, such as SyB L-0501, SyB L-1101 and SyB C-1101.

name: LINKX
businessSummary: LiNKX, Inc. operates as a financial technology company in Japan. The company specializes in modernization and reconstruction through cloud-based and AI-based technologies. It offers design and implementation methods to support the development of systems such as accounting systems, API gateways, and data infrastructure for the financial sector, including banks. Its products include LabHub, a platform which supports productivity improvement for researchers, including pharmaceutical companies  and shikAI, a navigation system for the visually impaired, as a social contribution project. The company was formerly known as Links Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LiNKX, Inc. in November 2020. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: BATONZ
businessSummary: Batonz Co., Ltd. plan, develops, and operates an M&A support platform to offer business succession matching services via the Internet in Japan. The company offers internet-based M&A matching, management consulting, website planning, production, operation, and management consulting websites using the internet. It provides services such as, M&A Platform, includes matching service, sourcing support services, and FA support services  and M&A SaaS, includes partner program, B MASS, and customer management system. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: JCR PHARMACEUTICALS
businessSummary: JCR Pharmaceuticals Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the pharmaceutical business. It manufactures, purchases, and sells prescription drugs, regenerative medicine products, and pharmaceutical raw materials. Through its subsidiaries, it is also engaged in purchasing business, procurement and sales of medical and research equipment, facility management, market research, management and supervision of outsourced clinical trial operations, management of intellectual property and licensing, clinical operations, regulatory affairs, and development in Brazil and Europe, and distribution management of pharmaceuticals and their raw materials.

name: NISSAN CHEMICAL
businessSummary: Nissan Chemical Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the agricultural chemicals business, functional materials business and wholesale business. The Company operates through six business segments. The Agrochemicals Business segment provides herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, plant growth regulators, and other agrochemicals, as well as bulk veterinary pharmaceuticals. The Functional Materials Business segment provides display materials, semiconductor materials, and inorganic colloids. The Wholesale Business segment is engaged in the wholesale of chemical products. The Chemicals Business segment provides basic chemicals such as sulfuric acid, nitric acid, and ammonia, and fine chemicals such as specialty epoxies for encapsulants. The Pharmaceuticals Business segment provides bulk pharmaceuticals for hypercholesterolemia treatments and fine chemicals. The Others segment provides fertilizers, landscape gardening, transportation, plant engineering, and other services.

name: OTSUKA
businessSummary: OTSUKA CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the sale of system equipment, the installation support and maintenance services. The Company operates through two business segments. System Integration segment conducts consulting, hardware and software sales, contract software development, equipment installation and network construction. Service & Support segment provides office supply, maintenance services, as well as business support services. The Company is also involved in the car maintenance business and insurance business.

name: RESONAC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Resonac Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based comprehensive chemical company. The Company operates through five segments. The Semiconductor & Electronic Materials segment manufactures and sells semiconductor front-end materials, semiconductor back-end materials, and device solutions. The Mobility segment manufactures and sells resin-molded products, friction materials, powder metallurgy products, and functional aluminum components. The Innovation Materials segment manufactures and sells resin materials, functional chemicals, coating materials, and ceramics. The Chemicals segment manufactures and sells chemical products, industrial gases, and graphite. The Crasus Chemical segment manufactures and sells olefins, organic chemicals, and synthetic resins. In addition, the Company is also engaged in other manufacturing and sales activities not included in these segments.

name: SANTEC HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Santec Holdings Corp, formerly Santec Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of optical component-related and optical measuring instrument-related products. The Company operates through two business segments. Optical Components Related segment is engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of optical components for optical transmission equipment. Products include optical monitors, optical attenuators, optical filters, and spatial light modulators (SLM). Optical Measuring Instrument Related segment is engaged in development, manufacture and sale of optical transmission equipment, measuring instruments for evaluation and inspection of optical parts, optical coherence tomography, and optical intraocular dimension measuring equipment. Products include wavelength tunable light sources, wavelength tunable filters, high-speed scanning lasers, optical coherence tomography (OCT) and others. It is also engaged in the system solution business.

name: SINFONIA TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductors, aerospace, automobile, mobility, and industrial electrical equipment in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company offers clean transport systems, including 300mm FOUP load port, 300/200MM auto switch load port, 200MM SMIF load port, EFEM, panel FOUP load port, and tape frame FOUP load port  testing systems, such as high-speed dynamometer and power train testers  vibrating equipment, including vibrating conveyor, vibrating drier and cooler, and small vibrating equipment  parts feeders, such as dual-motion parts feeder, high speed parts feeder, and vibrating transporting table  and lifting magnets. It also provides electrical equipment and central monitoring system for waterworks and sewage work, and plant factory system using only artificial light  electrical components for aircraft, thrust vector control electrical actuator system, and electrical components for space station  automotive electrical components  transportation and power control systems, such as speed generators and controllers for industrial vehicles  printer systems, such as color stream S3, color stream CE1, and CHC-C300  and clutches and brakes, including holding brake for industrial robots and ultra-compact electromagnetic brakes. In addition, it offers automated cell culture system and intelligent cell processing system  and one-board controller, analog input board, and sensor node relay. The company was formerly known as Shinko Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. in April 2009. Sinfonia Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: CHUGAI PHARMACEUTICAL
businessSummary: CHUGAI PHARMACEUTICAL CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale, import and export of pharmaceutical products. The pharmaceutical products and medical devices for patients include ACTEMRA, Avastin, ALECENSA, Kadcyla, GAZYVA, CellCept, Zelboraf, Xeloda, Tamiflu, Tarceva, Tecentriq, Herceptin, Perjeta, cancer gene panel testing and others. These products are primarily used to treat conditions such as cancer, kidney disease and kidney transplantation, bone and joint diseases (rheumatoid arthritis), neurological and muscular diseases (neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorders, spinal muscular atrophy, and Duchenne muscular dystrophy), blood disorders (hemophilia and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria), and eye diseases (retinal disorders). It also engages in administrative operations, the provision of scientific information on pharmaceuticals, investment activities, and the provision of influenza information services.

name: MERCARI
businessSummary: Mercari Inc is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the operation of consumer-to-consumer (CtoC) platforms. The Company operates through two segments. The Japan Region segment operates Marketplace, which operates the Mercari flea market app in Japan, as well as payment and finance and cryptocurrency-related businesses in Japan. The US segment operates the Mercari flea market app in the United States. The Company also engages in sports business and other businesses.

name: KIRIN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Kirin Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the integrated beverage business and the pharmaceutical business. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Beer and Spirits segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of beer, low-malt beer, new genre products, wines and other liquor products in Japan. The Domestic Beverages segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of soft drinks in Japan. The Oceania Alcoholic Beverages segment manufactures and sells beer, Western-style liquors in Oceania and other regions. The Pharmaceuticals segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. The Company is also engaged in the domestic wine business, North American beverage business, and the biochemical business.

name: UNERRY
businessSummary: unerry, Inc. operates a consumer behavior data platform business in Japan. The company operates Beacon Bank, a consumer behavior big data platform that utilizes location information, GPS data, beacon data, and AI analytics. It provides analysis and visualization services, including Shopper Mieru  behavioral change services, including Beacon Bank AD  and one-to-one services, including Beacon Bank 1to1. The company also offers location information services, advertising distribution services, data integration services, customer behavior analytics, retail DX support services, retail media services, smart city support services, original application development services, customer data platform construction services, and system operation and maintenance services. In addition, it provides location-information platform services and related analytics, advertising distribution, and data integration services. unerry, Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: DATA HORIZON
businessSummary: Data Horizon Co.,Ltd. develops and provides data health related services to insurers and other organizations in Japan. The company offers various services comprising data health planning and analysis for planning, such as support for creating data health plans, potential analysis, dental care cost analysis, and health management analysis report creation. It also provides support for creating specific health checkup implementation plans  specific health checkup encouragement program  information to improve the rate of participation in specific health checkups  and analysis of the effectiveness of specific health checkups and specific health guidance. In addition, the company offers services to prevent severe illness  optimizing medical consultation behavior  encouraging consultation with a medical institution  promoting the use of generic drugs  and optimization of drug use. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan. Data Horizon Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of DeNA Co., Ltd.

name: KOTOBUKI SPIRITS
businessSummary: Kotobuki Spirits Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of confectionery. It operates through six business segments. The Sucrey segment offers shop brands such as The MAPLE MANIA, Tokyo Milk Cheese Factory, and Francais. The KCC segment offers shop brands such as LeTAO and Now on Cheese. The Kotobuki Seika/Tajima Kotobuki segment offers shop brands such as Okashi no Kotobukijo and KanoZA. The Sales Subsidiary segment offers shop brands such as KONDITOREI KOBE. The Kujukushima Group segment offers shop brands such as Akaifusen and Ivorish. The Other segment engages in non-life insurance agency business, health food sales, and confectionery sales.

name: SEIKO GROUP
businessSummary: Seiko Group Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the management of operating companies involved in watches, device solutions, system solutions, clocks, luxury jewelry, apparel and miscellaneous goods and facility clocks. The Company has three business segments. Emotional Value Solutions segment engages in the manufacture, wholesale and retail of watches, as well as the retail of luxury jewelry, apparel and miscellaneous goods. Device Solutions segment engages in the manufacture and sale of electronic devices. System Solutions segment engages in the development and sale of products related to systems, including information technology (IT) performance management, the Internet of Things (IoT) and payment-related businesses, as well as the provision of maintenance services for products sold and custom software development services, and the sale of large-scale display boards and sports timing equipment. The Company also engages in real estate leasing and shared services.

name: FIXSTARS
businessSummary: Fixstars Corporation primarily provides support for software optimization and the development and application of artificial intelligence (AI). The Company operates through two business segments. The Solution segment provides software development and optimization services for real-time image processing, large-scale simulations, and big data analysis and storage, as well as related hardware. The SaaS business develops and provides multiple services as SaaS based on the expertise the company has cultivated over the years, including Fixstars Amplify, a platform for developing and running programs for quantum computers; METIS Eye, an AI-powered breast cancer image diagnosis support program; and Fixstars AIBooster, a performance engineering platform for AI development and operations. The Company also operates a corporate venture capital (CVC) business.

name: ASAHI INTECC
businessSummary: Asahi Intecc Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of products in the medical and industrial equipment fields. It operates through two business segments. The Medical Business segment develops and manufactures minimally invasive treatment products (treatment guidewires and catheters) primarily used for intravascular treatment and sells them to hospitals and other facilities primarily through direct sales in Japan, mostly through distributors in overseas, and primarily through direct sales in the United States, France, Germany, and Italy. The Device Business segment develops and manufactures components for the medical and industrial equipment fields and sells them to manufacturers both in Japan and overseas. Products are used as medical equipment in areas such as circulatory system, abdominal, peripheral and cerebrovascular systems, as well as industrial equipment in a wide range of fields, including leisure, construction and automobiles.

name: JAPAN DISPLAY
businessSummary: Japan Display Inc.is a Japan-based company that develops, designs, manufactures, and sells displays and related products. It develops, designs, manufactures, and sells liquid crystal displays and related components. It provides displays for automotive equipment, digital cameras, and industrial equipment. It also develops various electronic components and related solutions utilizing display technology. It primarily supplies products to the automotive, electronics, and industrial equipment markets.

name: RYOJBABA
businessSummary: rYojbaba Co., Ltd. provides consulting and health services to various customers in Japan. It operates through two segments: Consulting Services and Health Services. The Consulting Services segment provides labor and corporate consulting services to labor unions, companies to support the practice of whistleblowing and stress checks, and companies and labor unions to resolve disputes. The Health Service segment offers health services through osteopathic clinics and beauty salons to alleviate physical ailments primarily created by work related stress. rYojbaba Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Sakai Seikotsuin Co., Ltd. and changed its name to rYojbaba Co., Ltd. in October 2021. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Fukuoka City, Japan.

name: HARMONIC DRIVE SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Harmonic Drive Systems Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the speed reducers business. The Company is mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of precision speed reducers, precision actuators and control devices. The Company is mainly engaged in the production of speed reducers, rotary actuators and linear actuators. The Company distributes its products within the domestic market and to overseas markets, including the Americas and Europe.

name: ORIENTAL LAND
businessSummary: Oriental Land Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the operation of theme parks and hotels. The Company operates in two business segments. Theme Park segment is engaged in the management and operation of the theme parks. Hotel segment is engaged in the operation of hotels, such as Disney Ambassador Hotel, Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta and Tokyo Disneyland Hotel. The Company also operates the IKSPIARI business, the monorail business, and the Group's employee cafeteria operation business.

name: CYBER SECURITY CLOUD
businessSummary: Cyber Security Cloud , Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Web security business. The Company is engaged in the development and subscription of Web security services utilizing artificial intelligence (AI) technology. It is also engaged in the research of cyber attacks, and research and development of AI technology. Products include the cloud-based Web application firewall (WAF) Cyneural, AWS WAF's rule automatic operation service WafCharm, and AWS WAF's Managed Rules. Cyneural is a cloud-based security service that detects, blocks, and visualizes cyber attacks on Web applications. WafCharm is a service that attacks patterns and automatically operates AWS WAF rules. AWS WAF Managed Rules is a selected AWS WAF security rules set that are created independently by a security specialist.

name: MARUWA
businessSummary: MARUWA Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of ceramic components, including electronic components, and lighting equipment. The Company operates through two segments. The Ceramic Components segment manufactures and sells electronic components, ceramic substrates, and products related to semiconductor manufacturing equipment. The Lighting Equipment segment is involved in the production and sale of the lighting equipment that uses light emitting diode (LED) in addition to conventional lighting equipment. The Company is also involved in the business of supporting foundation activities.

name: KEYENCE
businessSummary: Keyence Corp is a Japan-based manufacturing company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of electronic applied equipment. The Company mainly manufactures and sells automatic controlling equipment, measuring instrument, information equipment and other electronic application equipment, as well as related systems. The Company also develops software for its products. Its products include sensors, meters, projectors, image processing devices, programmable logic controllers and touch panels, among others. In addition, the Company is also engaged in advertising and marketing businesses through its subsidiaries.

name: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO
businessSummary: TOKYO OHKA KOGYO CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of materials and equipment. The Company operates in two segments. The Materials segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing and sales of electronics functional materials and high purity chemicals. The Equipment segment is mainly engaged in manufacturing, sales and maintenance of processing equipment for semiconductors and displays. The Company operates in Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, etc.

name: SAMCO
businessSummary: SAMCO INC. is a Japan-based company that develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor and other electronic component manufacturing equipment. It provides chemical vapor deposition (CVD) equipment, atomic layer deposition (ALD) equipment, etching equipment, cleaning equipment, and surface treatment equipment. It also handles parts sales and maintenance services. The Company's products are used in the manufacturing processes of compound semiconductors, silicon semiconductors, micro electromechanical systems (MEMS), sensors, high-frequency devices, electronic components, and healthcare-related devices. Its main sales regions are Japan, China, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, and Southeast Asia.

isin: 3492.T|MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Corporation|3492.T|MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Corporation
name: MIRARTH REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Corporation is formerly known as Takara Leben Real Estate Investment Corporation. With MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Advisory Co., Ltd. (formerly Takara PAG Real Estate Investment Advisory Co. Ltd. hereinafter referred to as the Asset Management Company) as the organizer, in accordance with the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, including subsequent amendments  hereinafter referred to as the Investment Trust Act). Registration with the Kanto Regional Financial Bureau was completed (Registration No. Kanto Regional Financial Bureau Director-General No. 129). After that, on July 27, 2018, the company was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter referred to as the Tokyo Stock Exchange) Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market. After six public offerings, the total number of investment units issued as of the end of the fiscal period under review (February 28, 2025) is 910,820 units, and the total investment amount is 87,255 million yen. MIRARTH Real Estate Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2017 in Japan.

name: REIWA ACCOUNTING HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the consulting business with a focus on ongoing consulting services related to accounting (Long). The consulting business provides accounting consulting services to organizations that require specialized knowledge and expertise. Consulting services (Long) provides support and advisory services related to the formulation of accounting policies and the preparation of vouchers, general ledgers, trial balances and other documents by journalizing from original ledgers. Consulting services (Short) include due diligence related to accounting, valuations such as stock value evaluation, and initial public offering (IPO) support. The education, temporary staffing, and placement business related to accounting practices includes an education business that provides professional accounting department schools and corporate training, and a temporary staffing and placement business that specializes in accounting personnel.

name: TOKYO ELECTRON
businessSummary: Tokyo Electron Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of industrial electronics products, primarily semiconductor production equipment and flat panel display (FPD) production equipment. The Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment segment provides wafer-compatible batch-type thermal processing equipment, wafer-compatible semi-batch-type deposition equipment, wafer-compatible single wafer deposition equipment, wafer-compatible coater/developers, wafer-compatible plasma etch systems, and semiconductor test systems. The Company also provides logistics, facility management, and insurance services.

name: DISCO
businessSummary: Disco Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of semiconductor manufacturing devices and precision processing tools, as well as the maintenance and related services business. The Company is engaged in the provision of dicing saws, laser saws, grinders, polishers, surface planers and other precision processing equipment, as well as dicing blades, grinding wheels, dry polishing wheels, grindstones for grinding and cutting and other precision processing tools.

name: MITSUBISHI HEAVY INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of energy, plants and infrastructure systems, logistics, heating and cooling, drive systems. The Company operates through four segments. Energy Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of thermal power generation systems, nuclear power generation systems, wind power generation systems, aircraft engines. Plants & Infrastructure Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of steelmaking machinery, merchant ships, engineering, environmental equipment and mechanical systems. Logistics, Thermal & Drive Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of logistics equipment, heat and cooling products, engines, turbochargers and others. Aircraft, Defense & Space Segment is engaged in the design, manufacturing, sales, services and installation of civil aircraft, defense aircraft and others.

name: M3
businessSummary: M3 Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of services centering on the platform of healthcare. The Company has five business segments. Medical Platforms segment conducts marketing-related businesses in Japan utilizing the Internet and real operations centered on medical employee specialized site m3.com. Evidence Solution segment is engaged in the contract research organization (CRO) business that supports clinical development work and research, and site management organization (SMO) business that manages the clinical trial operations. Career Solutions segment is engaged in human resource services for healthcare professionals. Site Solution segment provides operational support for medical institutions and home-visit nursing services. Overseas segment provides services of medical related marketing support, research and careers, utilizing the medical employee specialized sites in the United States, the United Kingdom, China, Korea, India, France, Germany and Spain.

name: FICHA
businessSummary: Ficha Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the image recognition software development business. The Company is mainly engaged in the development of Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) that supports the driving operation of automobile drivers that detect pedestrians, vehicles, lanes, signs, mainly for in-vehicle cameras and drive recorders. The main customers are auto parts manufacturers and drive recorder manufacturers called companies that directly supply parts to automobile manufacturers (Tier 1). In addition, the Company is also engaged in the installation of software for Driver Monitoring System (DMS), which can detect face recognition and sight, dangerous driving, sleepy driving, in the vehicle through an automobile parts manufacturer.

name: ADVANTEST
businessSummary: ADVANTEST CORPORATION is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of test system products and mechatronics-related products, such as test handlers and device interfaces, as well as related research and development, maintenance, and service activities. It operates through two segments. The Test System business segment provides products including system on chip (SoC) test systems for SoC semiconductor devices, memory test systems for memory semiconductor devices, test handlers (mechatronics-based products for handling semiconductor devices), and device interfaces (which serve as the interface with the device under test), as well as solutions for system-level testing of semiconductors and modules. The Service and Other segment is engaged in providing comprehensive customer solutions related to the above businesses, as well as offering nanotechnology-related product lines, support services, and the sale of consumables.

name: EVIXAR
businessSummary: Evixar Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the research and development of software based on sound signal processing (acoustic communication / sound synchronization and authentication technology) and provision of unique acoustic communication solutions based on these results. The Company develops Audio Fingerprint technology and Audio Watermark technology, and provides acoustic communication solutions centered on these core technologies. The Audio Communication Solution segment provides solutions mainly in the areas of entertainment, TV viewing measurement and IoT / M2M.

name: MEGACHIPS
businessSummary: MegaChips Corporation is a Japan-based company engaged in the design, development, manufacture and sale of system large-scale integrations (LSIs) based on the basic technologies of image, audio and telecommunication sectors, and electronic components and system machinery equipped with its system LSIs. The Company’s main products Include LSIs for entertainment devices such as game consoles, image processing LSIs for digital cameras, LSIs for liquid crystal display (LCD) panels, and video surveillance system equipment for security field, among others. As of March 31, 2014, the Company had four subsidiaries.

name: MONEY FORWARD
businessSummary: Money Forward,Inc. is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the platform service business. The Company provides two services. The money forward cloud service is involved in the provision of a cloud enterprise resources planning (ERP) service platform. The platform provides management support for medium-sized and small enterprises to improve efficiency of management and back office operations based on data. The personal financial management (PFM) service is involved in the operation of Money Forward ME platform for solving problems and issues related to personal money through various services.

name: CYBERDYNE
businessSummary: Cyberdyne Inc is engaged in the research, development, manufacture, sale, and maintenance management related to Cybernics technology. The Company mainly uses human and the Internet of Things (IoH/IoT), robots, and artificial intelligence (AI) Cybernics technology to develop Cybernic systems. It develops the Cybernics treatment service business and the training service business that utilize Cybernics technology. The Company develops in various fields centered on HAL. HAL is a robot treatment device for the purpose of improving and regenerating the physical function of patients, a welfare device and life support device for the purpose of supporting independence, and a work support equipment. It can be used for various purposes by being worn and used by people. The Company is also involved in the productization of AI-equipped transport robots; cleaning robots; Cyin, which is used for communication with people with disabilities, and electrocardiography devices.

name: NOTE
businessSummary: note Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the media platform business and intellectual property (IP) content creation business. The Company has two business segments. The Media Platform Business segment operates the consumer to consumer (CtoC) media platform named note, the software as a service (SaaS) for corporate information dissemination named note pro, and provides corporate-sponsored contests on note, among other corporate services. The IP and Content Creation Business segment is involved in planning and representing creators' works, content production and sales, and contracted planning and content production from external companies.

name: MONOTARO
businessSummary: MonotaRO Co Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in mail-order sales primarily through e-commerce, an internet-based distribution channel, selling industrial supplies to customers mainly consisting of domestic and international businesses. Products procured from domestic and international wholesalers and manufacturers are listed in the Company's online catalog on its website and in paper catalogs distributed to individual customers, and are sold directly to end users both domestically and internationally. The Company conducts its business through the Factory Indirect Materials Sales segment. The products handled primarily consist of factory indirect materials, such as consumables and repair supplies used routinely within factories.

name: SCIENCE ARTS
businessSummary: Science Arts Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sale of Buddycom, a live communication platform that connects deskless workers. The Company operates through two segments. The Buddycom segment is engaged in the development and sale of Buddycom, a live communication platform that connects deskless workers, and sale of accessories such as earphone microphones and headsets. The ALTIBASE segment is engaged in the sale of licenses and supply of support for ALTIBASE, a hybrid database.

name: BRAINPAD
businessSummary: BrainPad Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of data analysis services for companies. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Analytics segment is engaged in the provision of data analysis services and optimization operations for companies aiming to support clients’ activities. The Solutions segment is engaged in the selection and provision of software products necessary for policy execution based on data accumulation, analysis and analysis results, and system development and operation. The Marketing Platform segment develops its own proprietary software from the data analysis algorithm mainly in the digital marketing field and provides products centered on Software as a Service (SaaS) type services, and maintenance service.

name: KAO
businessSummary: Kao Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of consumer products and chemical products. The Company operates in five business segments. The Hygiene & Living Care segment provides fabric care products, home care products, and sanitary products. The Health & Beauty Care segment provides skin care products, hair care products, and personal health products. The Life Care segment is mainly involved in the provision of commercial hygiene products, health drinks and other life care products. The Cosmetic segment produces counseling cosmetics and self-cosmetics. The above four business segments are included in the consumer products business. Chemical segment provides oil and fat products, such as oleochemical alcohols, oleochemical amines, fatty acids, and edible oils and fats for commercial use, functional material products, such as surfactants, additives for plastics, and high-performance water reducers for concrete, as well as specialty chemicals products.
