On November 1, 2023, we merged with Kenedix Residential Next Investment Corporation and Kenedix Retail REIT Corporation, and have changed our name to (KDX Realty Investment Corporation). Following the merger, we seek to achieve sustainable growth by expanding our investment universe while adapting to environmental changes. We will continue to invest in properties utilizing not only support from the sponsor Kenedix, Inc., but also the unique network of the asset management company, Kenedix Real Estate Fund Management Inc. to achieve sustainable growth in our AUM (assets under management) and expand our portfolio.

name: FFRI SECURITY
businessSummary: FFRI Security, Inc. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in cybersecurity business and software development and testing business. It operates through two business segments. Cybersecurity segment provides security services ranging from investigation and analysis of security threats and vulnerability testing to education and training services for developing security personnel, consulting on security issues and provision of security information, investigation of the security robustness of computer systems and the impact of actual cyberattacks and others. It also provides security investigations, analyses, and research and offers targeted attack countermeasure product FFRI yarai and the malware automated analysis tool FFRI yarai analyzer. Software Development and Testing segment dispatches engineers involved in tasks such as software design, development, evaluation and analysis and provides planning, design and execution of tests.

name: CENTRAL REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: CENTRAL REIT Investment Corporation Investment Corporation was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market on February 15, 2018. CENTRAL REIT Investment Corporation is a diversified and publicly traded Japanese real estate investment trust (J-REIT) that has the sponsor support of the XYMAX Group, a leading company in the real estate management industry. As one of the pioneers in the property management business in Japan, the XYMAX Group boasts one of Japan's most prominent track records in real estate management and has been supporting the real estate investmentincluding J-REITmarket from the aspects of real estate management even from before. Based on the understanding that real estate management strengths are essential for generating stable revenue over the medium to long term in real estate investment, CENTRAL REIT Investment Corporation will utilize the insights and know-how accumulated to date by the XYMAX Group to conduct portfolio management focused on stability of cash flows and thereby maximize the true value of real estate with an aim to maximize unitholder value. CENTRAL REIT Investment Corporation was incorporated in 2017 in Japan.

name: RAKUTEN GROUP
businessSummary: Rakuten Group Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Internet services, FinTech, and mobile business. The Company operates through three business segments. The Internet Service segment is mainly engaged in the operation of electronic commerce (EC) sites, including Rakuten Ichiba, as well as online cashback sites, travel reservation sites, portal sites, digital content sites and messaging services. It is also involved in the sale of advertisements on these Websites, and the operation of sports facilities. The FinTech segment is engaged in the provision of credit card-related services, banking and securities services, cryptocurrency (virtual currency) intermediation, insurance services and electronic money services. The Mobile segment is engaged in the provision of communication services and messaging services, as well as operation of digital content Websites. The Company also operates marketing support business, Rakuten delivery business and real-time takeout business.

name: FUJIKURA
businessSummary: Fujikura Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in business activities such as manufacturing, sales, and services of products across the Information Technology, Electronics, Automotive, Energy, and Real Estate business divisions. The company operates in five business segments. The Information Technology segment provides optical fiber, optical cables, telecommunication components, optical components, optical related equipment, network equipment, and construction work. The Electronics business segment provides printed circuit boards, electronic wires, hard disk components, and various connectors. The Automotive Business segment provides wiring harnesses, electrical components, and other products for automobiles. The Energy Business segment provides power cables, communication cables, aluminum wires, coated wires. The Real Estate business segment leases real estate.

name: KATITAS
businessSummary: Katitas Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the used housing rehabilitation business. The Used Housing Rehabilitation segment purchases mainly used detached houses, renovates them, and then sells them. The used housing rehabilitation business includes purchasing, commercialization, and sales. Properties are purchased through purchase or auction. Commercialization business involves planning and carrying out plumbing replacement such as kitchens, toilets, sinks, and unit baths, wallpaper and floor replacement, layout changes, exterior wall painting, and exterior construction such as parking lot expansion. Sales are conducted through the Company itself and through intermediary sales.

name: RENESAS ELECTRONICS
businessSummary: Renesas Electronics Corp is a Japan-based semiconductor manufacturer mainly engaged in the research, design, development, manufacture, sale and servicing of semiconductor products. The Company operates in two business segments. The Automotive segment is engaged in vehicle control business which provides semiconductors for controlling the engine and body of automobiles, and vehicle information business which provides semiconductors for in-vehicle information devices such as car navigation systems. The segment mainly provides microcontrollers, system-on-chip (SoC), analog semiconductors and power semiconductors. The Industry, Infrastructure and Internet of Things (IoT) segment is engaged in the industry business that supports the smart society, the infrastructure business and IoT business. The segment mainly provides microcontrollers, SoCs and analog semiconductors. The Company is also engaged in the development and contracted production of semiconductors.

name: TOYOKOH
businessSummary: TOYOKOH Inc. operates as a painting and waterproofing contractor in Japan. The company offers SOSEI, a spray-coating three layers of special resin to restore strong roofs  and CoolLaser, a laser-based system for removing rust and pain from aging infrastructure. It offers waterproofing, insulation and reinforcement work for roofs  and paint and rust removal services. TOYOKOH Inc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Fuji, Japan.

name: MICRONICS JAPAN
businessSummary: MICRONICS JAPAN CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of semiconductor measuring instruments, as well as semiconductor and liquid crystal display (LCD) testing equipment. The Company operates in two business segments. The Probe Card segment develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor measuring instruments, and provides related maintenance service. The Testing Equipment (TE) segment develops, manufactures and sells LCD testing equipment and semiconductor testing equipment, and provides related maintenance service.

name: GALA
businessSummary: GALA INCORPORATED is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and operation of applications for smartphones and tablet personal computers (PCs), and online games. The Company has two regional segments. The smartphone applications operation and development business is engaged in the sale agency of licenses for smartphone applications, tablet PC applications and online games, as well as the planning, development and operation of applications for smartphones and tablet PCs for general consumers. The online game publishing business is engaged in the development of massively multiplayer online role playing games (MMORPGs) for general consumers, the creation and operation of portal sites for online games, as well as the provision of developed online game licenses to publishers in various countries. The Company operates in the domestic market and Korea market.

name: NTT
businessSummary: NTT Inc, formerly Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp, is engaged in the comprehensive information and communications technology (ICT) business, the regional communications business, and the global solutions business. The Company operates through four business segments. The Comprehensive ICT Business segment is engaged in the mobile phone business, inter-prefectural communications services in the domestic telecommunications business, international communications business, solutions business, system development business, and related businesses. The Regional Communications Business segment is engaged in the provision of intra-prefectural communications services in the domestic telecommunications business and related businesses. The Global Solutions Business segment is engaged in the system integration, network systems, cloud, global data centers, and related businesses. The Other (Real Estate, Energy) segment includes real estate business, energy business and others.

name: FUJITSU
businessSummary: Fujitsu Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in a total solutions business in the field of information and communications technology (ICT), providing a variety of services, as well as comprehensive services ranging from the development, manufacture, and sales of products and electronic devices that support these services, to maintenance and operation. The company operates in four business segments. The Service Solutions segment provides consulting services, cloud services, and other services. The Hardware Solutions segment provides system products, mainly sales and maintenance services for hardware such as servers and storage systems that form the foundation of ICT, as well as communications infrastructure such as cell phone base stations and optical transmission systems. The Ubiquitous Solutions segment mainly develops, designs, manufactures, and sells personal computers. The Device Solutions segment mainly provides electronic components such as semiconductor packages and batteries.

name: ZOZO
businessSummary: ZOZO Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged mainly in the operation of the fashion e-commerce site ZOZOTOWN and the fashion media site WEAR. The ZOZOTOWN business consists of purchase and manufacturing sales, consignment sales, and USED sales. USED sales is a secondary distribution business that buys used fashion merchandise, mainly from individual users and sells it while maintaining its own inventory. LINE Yahoo Commerce business sells products through online shopping malls and online auction services. The business-to-business (BtoB) business provides services to support various fulfillment-related operations, including e-commerce site system development, design production, logistics contracting, and marketing support. The advertising business provides advertising space by utilizing the user reach base of ZOZOTOWN and WEAR. The Company also operates businesses related to shipping and settlement fee revenues.

name: CAULIS
businessSummary: Caulis Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the money laundering and cyber security business. The Money Laundering and Cyber Security Business segment is mainly engaged in the provision of Fraud Alert, a cloud-based unauthorized access detection service for corporate clients. Fraud Alert consists of three services: Fraud Alert login detection service, Fraud Alert deposit and withdrawal detection service, and Fraud Alert new account opening detection service.

isin: 8975.T|Ichigo Office REIT Investment Corporation|8975.T|Ichigo Office REIT Investment Corporation
name: ICHIGO OFFICE REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Ichigo Office REIT Investment Corporation is a specialized office REIT that focuses on mid-size offices, an asset class that offers both return stability and upside potential. Ichigo Office seeks to drive higher earnings and sustainable growth for its shareholders by increasing the value of its assets through a broad array of value-add activities, including tailored tenant services, structural building improvements, and targeted tenant leasing. Ichigo Office is managed by Ichigo Investment Advisors, the asset management subsidiary of Ichigo, a major Japanese real estate owner/operator. Ichigo Investment Advisors works to grow value on behalf of shareholders by deploying its deep experience and know-how in developing, operating, and managing Japanese real estate. The mid-size offices in which we invest produce stable cashflows, supporting stable dividends for shareholders. Also, this economically-sensitive asset class provides upside for shareholders via the possibility of higher rent income as the Japanese economy shows signs of emerging from multiple decades of deflation. Furthermore, because the market for mid-size offices in Japan is relatively inefficient and has less participation by other major real estate companies, who tend to focus on larger assets, there is a significant opportunity to add value and increase the profitability of the assets we acquire.

name: JTEC
businessSummary: JTEC Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells X-ray mirrors for synchrotron facilities in Japan. The company designs, develops, manufactures, and sells automated System and cell culture systems  and surface processing system for various materials. It also offers support services related to regenerative medicine. In addition, the company manufactures thermal desorption analyzers. JTEC Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

isin: 8984.T|Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation|8984.T|Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation
name: DAIWA HOUSE REIT INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation is a real estate investment trust (J-REIT) whose sponsor is Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. The asset manager is Daiwa House Asset Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as the Asset Manager), a wholly owned subsidiary of Daiwa House. DHR was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (hereinafter referred to as the Tokyo Stock Exchange) on March 22, 2006, and then later merged with New City Residence Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as NCR) on April 1, 2010 (hereinafter referred to as the merger with NCR). Subsequently on December 1, 2011, the corporate name was changed to Daiwa House Residential Investment Corporation (the corporation prior to change of corporate name to Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation is hereinafter referred to as the former DHI) and accordingly changed its investment targets to residential properties. The former Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation (the Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation, which was dissolved upon having merged with DHR as of September 1, 2016, is hereinafter referred to as the former DHR) was established on September 14, 2007, whose asset manager was Daiwa House REIT Management Co., Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Daiwa House. The former DHR was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Market on November 28, 2012, as a REIT that targets investment in logistics and retail properties. On September 1, 2016, the former DHI and the former DHR (hereinafter collectively referred to as the Investment Corporations) conducted an absorption-type merger (hereinafter referred to as the Merger) whereby the former DHI was the surviving corporation and the former DHR was the absorbed corporation, shifted to a diversified portfolio strategy that targets investment in new asset classes such as hotel and office properties, in addition to those that the Investment Corporations had targeted for investment in the past, and changed its corporate name from Daiwa House Residential Investment Corporation to Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation. Daiwa House REIT Investment Corporation was established on June 07, 2005 and incorporated in Japan.

name: NOMURA RESEARCH INSTITUTE
businessSummary: Nomura Research Institute Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of consulting services, development and product sales, operational services, and product sales services. The Company operates four business segments. The Consulting segment provides policy recommendations, strategic consulting, operational consulting, and systems consulting. The Financial IT Solutions segment provides system consulting, system development and operation services, IT solutions such as joint-use systems, and business process outsourcing (BPO) services, mainly for financial industry clients. The Industrial IT Solutions segment provides IT solutions such as system consulting, system development and operation services to the distribution, manufacturing, service, and public sectors. The IT Platform Services segment provides data center operations and management, IT infrastructure and network construction, and other services.

name: FUJITSU
businessSummary: Fujitsu Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in a total solutions business in the field of information and communications technology (ICT), providing a variety of services, as well as comprehensive services ranging from the development, manufacture, and sales of products and electronic devices that support these services, to maintenance and operation. The company operates in four business segments. The Service Solutions segment provides consulting services, cloud services, and other services. The Hardware Solutions segment provides system products, mainly sales and maintenance services for hardware such as servers and storage systems that form the foundation of ICT, as well as communications infrastructure such as cell phone base stations and optical transmission systems. The Ubiquitous Solutions segment mainly develops, designs, manufactures, and sells personal computers. The Device Solutions segment mainly provides electronic components such as semiconductor packages and batteries.

name: OOTOYA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: OOTOYA Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, plans, manages, and operates a chain of restaurants in Japan and internationally. Its restaurants offer set meals and bento lunches. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

name: OMRON
businessSummary: Omron Corp is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of electrical machinery and equipment, electronic application machinery and equipment, precision machinery and equipment, and medical machinery and equipment. It operates through five business segments. Industrial Automation Business (IAB) segment provides programmable controllers, motion control equipment, sensor equipment, industrial cameras and code readers, inspection equipment and others. Healthcare Business (HCB) segment provides electronic blood pressure monitors, nebulizers, low-frequency therapy devices, electrocardiographs and others. Social Systems Solutions & Services Business (SSB) segment engages in energy business, station service systems, traffic management systems and others. Device & Module Solutions Business (DMB) segment provides relays, switches, connectors and others. Data Solutions Business (DSB) segment engages in data healthcare business, corporate health business, and other businesses.

name: ACTIVIA PROPERTIES
businessSummary: Activia Properties Inc invests primarily in urban retail and Tokyo office properties. API seeks to increase unitholder value by building and operating a portfolio of properties that are competitive in the medium to long term. To build a portfolio with a stable and sustainable demand from our customers, we believe that in addition to the location, use, scale, and quality of properties, reducing our environmental footprint and contributing to the surrounding communities and environment are important. API aims to further promote its sustainability initiatives through issuance of green bonds and invite new investors to its investment corporation bonds by stimulating their demand who have interest in ESG investment. Activia Properties Inc was established in September, 07, 2011 and incorporated in Japan.

name: SMS
businessSummary: SMS CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the businesses and related operations aimed at building information infrastructure suitable for an aging society. It has four business divisions. The career division includes recruitment and qualification schools for care workers, recruitment for nurses, recruitment for childcare workers, and a cross-occupation direct recruiting platform. The care and disability welfare business division includes management support platform for care and disability welfare businesses. The overseas division includes medical platform businesses and global career businesses. The business development division includes remote health guidance services for health insurance associations, remote industrial health services for companies, renovation contractor information services, funeral home referral services and others.

name: KIOXIA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Kioxia Holdings Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture, sale, research and development, and other services of memory and related products. The business is classified into solid state drive (SSD) & storage, smart devices, and other by application based on the use of the products. SSD & storage includes SSD products and memory products mainly for personal computers (PCs), data centers, and enterprises. Smart devices include embedded memory products with control functions used in consumer devices such as smartphones, tablets, and televisions, as well as in-vehicle and industrial applications. Others include retail products such as SD memory cards and universal serial bus (USB) memory.

name: AMIYA
businessSummary: Amiya Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the data security business and network security business. The Company operates two business segments. The Data Security segment is involved in the development, sale and maintenance of log management software products, as well as the construction, auditing and operation support of information security management systems. The Network Security segment is involved in the consulting, design, construction and operation agency of network security systems, as well as the development and sale of cloud network services. The segment is also involved in the sale and rental of network equipment to build network security systems and provide services.

name: GOURMET KINEYA
businessSummary: Gourmet Kineya Co.,Ltd. operates a chain of restaurants. The company operates through Restaurant Business, ODM/OEM Business, Real Estate Leasing Business, and Transportation Business segments. It also offers in-flight meals  operates wholesale market and engages in real estate rental business  operates railway services and road passenger transport services. The company is also involved in wholesale of fresh seafood and processed seafood products and rice  commercial frozen food manufacturing  selling grains, processing and cooking food, and food products  manufactures and supplies ready-to-eat food. In addition, it offers food under Udon, Buckwheat, Western, Japanese, Asia and other region categories. The company was formerly known as Ryogoku Foods Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Gourmet Kineya Co.,Ltd. in September 1986. Gourmet Kineya Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

name: PORT
businessSummary: Port Inc is a Japan-based company that operates through a single contract support business segment engaged in the energy, human resources, and new and other sectors. In the energy sector, the Company operates matching platforms, including Enechoice and Hikkoshi Tetsuzuki.com and this connect users with electricity and gas providers, and provides sales promotion support services to utility companies. In the human resources sector, the Company operates job search and career-related platforms, providing matching services between job seekers and employers, as well as recruitment and hiring support services. In the new and other sector, the Company operates the card loan information website Manet, providing financial information and matching services.

name: SANKEI REAL ESTATE
businessSummary: Sankei Real Estate Inc is a closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to manage its assets primarily through investment in real estate and other specified assets, and its basic policy is to manage its assets with the aim of securing stable profits over the medium to long term and achieving steady growth in its managed assets through continuous investment. It aims to build a portfolio centered on investments in office buildings and invests in properties other than office buildings to diversify use and increase investor value. Its real estate properties include S-GATE NIHONBASHI-HONCHO, S-GATE AKIHABARA, Hibiya Sankei Building, Hatchobori Sankei Building, Hotel Intergate Tokyo Kyobashi, Hotel Intergate Hiroshima, SANKEILOGI Settsu, Hotel Intergate Kyoto Shijo Shinmachi and others. Its asset manager is Sankei Building Asset Management Co Ltd.

name: HUMAN MADE
businessSummary: HUMAN MADE Inc is a Japan-based company that operates the lifestyle brand HUMAN MADE and the additive-free curry shop CURRY UP, which uses original spices. The Company globally engages in a range of collaborations and production activities, including corporate branding support, product development and spatial design. The Company operates under the branding business segment. The product planning and production business involves designing and producing high-value-added items. These include products under the HUMAN MADE brand, as well as collaborations with creators, artists, musicians and domestic and international brand companies. The Company disseminates product information globally. The Company sells products via retail and wholesale through its own e-commerce Website and physical stores. The Company operates dining establishments and licenses out its owned intellectual property (IP).

name: KUDAN
businessSummary: Kudan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the artificial perception (AP) project. The AP is a technology advocated and developed by the company group. It is a series of software that mathematically processes the data acquired by the camera and three-dimensional (3D) sensor by a computer program, outputs the stereoscopic effect and kinesthetic sense in real time and performs storage and collation. The Company develops AP technology by reconstructing the existing technology called computer vision (a set of basic technologies for sensors and image processing centered on two-dimensional processing) and using it as a foundation.

name: OPEN DOOR
businessSummary: Open Door Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of travel related services. The Company is engaged in the operation of travel products comparison Website TRAVELKO which provides online search, comparison, reservation, inquiry services of package tours, hotels, airline tickets and other travel products for users. The Company is also engaged in the operation of the hotel reservation Website Hoterea for individual customers and the airline tickets reservation Website Traverea, as well as the sale of travel products for corporate customers.

name: NORTHSAND
businessSummary: Northsand Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in comprehensive consulting. It primarily provides information technology (IT) consulting and business consulting. IT consulting business provides support to business divisions and information systems departments in various industries that execute business strategies, from IT strategy and planning to implementation and operations. Business consulting business provides business improvement, strategy formulation and execution support in non-IT areas. Through collaboration with consulting in the digital and IT fields, it provides strategies to maximize customers' business results and supports them through the execution phase. It is also a distributor of Notion, an all-in-one information sharing tool provided by Notion Labs, Inc. Notion is a platform that is evolving as a virtual office, remote collaboration, and no-code tool. It established a dedicated department to support the implementation of Notion.

name: PEPTIDREAM
businessSummary: PeptiDream Inc. is a Japan-based bio-venture company started by the University of Tokyo and principally engaged in the discovery and development of non-standard peptide therapeutics. The Company operates the Peptide Discovery Platform System (PDPS), a drug development platform system and conducts research and development (R&D) on new drug candidates based on the joint R&D with pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas. The Company is involved in the business centered on drug development based on special peptides. The Company's businesses include drug discovery joint R&D, PDPS technology loan (PDPS technology license) and expansion of its own pipeline through strategic alliance (strategic alliance or in-house drug discovery).

name: ACSL
businessSummary: ACSL Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of drone-related businesses. The business model is divided into three parts: proof of concept (PoC) to verify the usefulness of drones for customers, mass production of drones to introduce and deploy them in customer environments, and subsequent operation and implementation support, including the expansion of data analysis systems and operational systems for each application. In proof of concept, based on the customer's drone introduction needs, the Company provides paid services related to PoC using its test aircraft to solve problems. In platform aircraft sales, the Company produces and sells its own platform aircraft.

name: SEVEN & I HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Seven & i Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the distribution business, primarily in domestic convenience store operations, overseas convenience store operations, superstore operations, and finance-related operations. The Company operates in four business segments. The Domestic Convenience Stores segment is engaged in convenience store operations through direct management and franchise system. The Overseas Convenience Stores segment is engaged in convenience store operations through both directly managed and franchised stores. The Superstore segment is engaged in the retail business that provides a comprehensive range of daily necessities such as food and daily necessities. The Finance-related segment is engaged in banking, credit card, leasing, and other businesses. The Company also operates businesses related to department stores, specialty stores, and real estate.

name: ASAHI GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Asahi Group Holdings, Ltd. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of alcoholic beverages, beverage and food products in Japan and overseas. The Company operates through four regional segments including Japan & East Asia, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. The Japan & East Asia segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, food products, and pharmaceuticals. The Europe segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages. The Asia-Pacific segment manufactures and sells alcoholic beverages and soft drinks. Other operations include the alcoholic beverage business in South Korea and the animal feed business.

name: AI ROBOTICS
businessSummary: Ai Robotics Inc. engages in advertising business in Japan. The company offers SELL, an AI system that automates advertising operations, operates video distribution service related to lifestyles for women and distributes advertisements through the service. It also sells skincare products, beauty appliances, hair dryers, and other products under the Yunth, Brighte, Straine, LOEM TOKYO, ELEKI BRUSH, and SHOWER DRYER brand names. The company was formerly known as HowTwo! Inc. and changed its name to Ai Robotics Inc. in July 2020. Ai Robotics Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: MATSUI SECURITIES
businessSummary: MATSUI SECURITIES CO., LTD. is a Japan-based securities company engaged in financial product trading business. The Company conducts stock brokering and underwriting operations through Internet transactions. The Company mainly conducts stock brokering business for individual investors and provides online securities trading service Net Stock. The Company provides services such as consignment trading and underwriting of stocks, futures and options, offering and sale of market derivatives, as well as foreign exchange margin trading, among others.

name: NOMURA REAL ESTATE MASTER FUND
businessSummary: Nomura Real Estate Master Fund Inc is a real estate investment trust (REIT) company. It aims to achieve sustainable growth in asset and stable earnings from mid-term to long-term perspectives. The Fund mainly invests in commercial buildings and logistic facilities located in the three major metropolitan areas (metropolitan area, Chukyo area and Kinki area), other major cities including ordinance-designated cities or surrounding areas. The Fund manager is Nomura Real Estate Asset Management Co., Ltd.

isin: 3282.T|Comforia Residential REIT, Inc|3282.T|Comforia Residential REIT, Inc
name: COMFORIA RESIDENTIAL REIT
businessSummary: Comforia Residential Investment Corporation (the Investment Corporation) an investment corporation under the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (Act No. 198 of 1951, as amended  the Investment Trust Act), investing primarily in real estate used for residential purposes. It was registered with the Prime Minister on June 30, 2010 (Registration Number: Kanto Local Finance Bureau Director-General No. 71) under Article 187 of the Investment Trust Act and began operations in August 2010. Subsequently, the Investment Corporation issued new investment units through a public offering on February 6, 2013, and was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc. (the Tokyo Stock Exchange) (Securities Code: 3282). At the start of operations, the Investment Corporation had 11 properties under management with a total acquisition price of 15,508 million yen. However, in accordance with the basic policy of asset management set out in the Investment Corporation's Articles of Incorporation (which aims to maximize unitholder value and manage assets with the aim of securing stable earnings and steady growth of managed assets from a medium- to long-term perspective), the Investment Corporation has subsequently acquired and sold additional properties. As a result, the Investment Corporation's assets held as of the end of the fiscal period under review (hereinafter referred to as the Acquired Assets) are 175 properties with a total acquisition price of 339,193 million yen. Comforia Residential REIT, Inc was established on June 08 2010 in Japan.

name: KUSURI NO AOKI HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Kusuri No Aoki Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the neighborhood-type retail business of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, foods, and dispensing pharmacies. The Company operates drugstore business with an assortment of products that include daily necessities, with pharmaceuticals and cosmetics as core products. The Company provides five types of products. Health products include pharmaceuticals, health foods, and medical supplies. Beauty products include counseling cosmetics, face care products such as face wash, body care products, hair care products, and oral care products. Life products include baby-related products, nursing care products, sanitary products, detergents, household products, pet food, clothing products, and home appliances. Food products include processed foods, daily foods, fresh foods, seasonings, confectionery, beverages, liquor, and other foods. Pharmaceutical products include pharmaceuticals prescribed at pharmacies.

name: YUKIGUNI FACTORY
businessSummary: Yukiguni Factory Co Ltd is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the production and sale of mushrooms and processed mushroom foods, including maitake mushrooms, eringi mushrooms, buna shimeji mushrooms, mushrooms, hon shimeji mushrooms, and hatake shimeji mushrooms. The Company operates its business through the Mushrooms business segment. The Mushrooms business segment is engaged in the production and sale of mushroom products such as maitake mushrooms, eringi mushrooms, and bunashimeji mushrooms. Other businesses include the outsourced production and sale of health food products, operation of a product store, and the sale of culture medium activator.

isin: 9010.T|Fuji Kyuko Co., Ltd.|9010.T|Fuji Kyuko Co., Ltd.
name: FUJI KYUKO
businessSummary: Fuji Kyuko Co., Ltd. operates amusement parks, hotels, golf courses, ski resorts, outdoor and travel businesses, and campgrounds in Japan. The company engages in the transportation, tourism, distribution services, real estate, civil engineering and construction, and information technology businesses. It also offers transportation services, including Fujikyu railway and bus, share-ride buses, highway buses, reserved buses, etc., as well as real estate services, such as building leasing, condo/villa subdivision, etc. In addition, the company offers accommodation services. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

name: RAQUALIA PHARMA
businessSummary: RaQualia Pharma Inc. engages in the research and development of pharmaceutical compounds worldwide. The company human products portfolio includes tegoprazan for gastroesophageal reflux disease  and grapiprant for cancer and pain management  RQ-00000008 for the treatment of osteoarthritis autoimmune disorders  RQ-00000010 to treat gastroparesis. It also provides veterinary products, such as capromorelin to treat anorexia in dogs and weight management in cats  grapiprant for osteoarthritis in dogs  RQ-00000008 to treat osteoarthritis and others  RQ-00317076 for pain  and RQ-00000010 for gut motility disorders, gastroparesis, functional dyspepsia, and chronic constipation. In addition, it provides RQ-00433412 for constipation, and cancer-related anorexia/cachexia syndrome  RQ-00000009 to treat alzheimer's  RQ-00466479, RQ-00350215, and RQ-00434739 to treat chronic pain  RQ-00310941 to treat D-IBS, IBD-remission stage symptoms  RQ-00201894 for gastroparesis, functional dyspepsia, and post-operative ileus  tamibarotene to treat higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome and acute myeloid leukemia  and FIM-001 for cancer. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

isin: 3563.T|Food & Life Companies Ltd.|3563.T|Food & Life Companies Ltd.
name: FOOD & LIFE COMPANIES
businessSummary: Food & Life Companies Ltd. operates a chain of sushi restaurants. It also operates restaurants under Sugidama, Kyotaru, Conveyor Belt Sushi Misaki, Kaisen San, and Sushiro brands. The company was formerly known as Sushiro Global Holdings Ltd. and changed its name to Food & Life Companies Ltd. in April 2021. Food & Life Companies Ltd. was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Suita, Japan.

name: SANSAN
businessSummary: Sansan Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development and sales of digital transformation (DX) services that change the way people work. The Company operates through two business segments. The Sansan/Bill One Business segment is engaged in the provision of the sales DX service Sansan and the accounting DX service Bill One. The Eight Business segment is engaged in the provision of the business card app Eight and the event transcription service logmi series.

name: TOHO
businessSummary: Toho Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly involved in the film business, intellectual property (IP) and animation business, theater business, real estate business, and other businesses. There are four business segments. The Film Business segment handles domestic distribution to movie theaters, use and licensing of theatrical films and other video content, movie theater management, and art production related to video works. The IP and Animation Business segment handles the use and licensing of television anime works and other video content, use and licensing of merchandising rights, and sales of merchandise. The Theater Business segment handles the production and performance of theatrical works. The Real Estate Business segment handles real estate leasing, road maintenance and cleaning, and property maintenance and management. The Company also includes the management of sports facilities.

isin: 8951.T|Nippon Building Fund Inc.|8951.T|Nippon Building Fund Inc.
name: NIPPON BUILDING FUND
businessSummary: Nippon Building Fund Inc. is an investment corporation under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan. With Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd., Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited. and Nippon Building Fund Management Ltd, (hereinafter NBFM) acting as sponsors. Registration with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau of the Ministry of Finance was completed on May 10, 2001 and NBF started acquisition of office properties on May 23, 2001. NBF is an externally managed real estate fund, formed as an investment corporation. NBFM, as NBF's asset management company, is engaged in acquiring, managing, leasing, and renovating office properties. Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. currently owns 46% of NBFM while Sumitomo Life Insurance Company owns 35% and the remaining 19% is mainly owned by financial institutions. On September 10, 2001, NBF had raised approximately 50,000 million yen through an initial public offering of units. Those units are listed on the J-REIT section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of June 30, 2025, NBF had ownership or beneficiary interests in 68 office properties containing approximately 1,207,586 square meters of rentable office space. As of June 30, 2025, NBF had leased office space to 1,545 tenants engaged in a variety of businesses. The occupancy rate for office properties was approximately 98.6%. Nippon Building Fund Inc. was incorporated in 2001 in Japan. Nippon Building Fund Inc. was established on March 16, 2001.

name: GLP J REIT
businessSummary: GLP J-REIT is a Japan-based closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT). The basic policy is to manage assets primarily as investments in real estate and other assets (real estate, real estate leasehold rights, surface rights, and beneficial interests in trusts that entrust only these assets), investing in the assets targeted for asset management as defined in the regulations, and aiming to secure stable returns over the medium to long term and to achieve steady growth of managed assets. The Fund may invest in preferred securities and limited partnership interests issued by special purpose companies. It primarily invests in real estate-related assets, either as the principal or backed by logistics facilities or real estate associated with or related to logistics facilities. Investment properties include GLP Tokyo, GLP Higashi-Ogishima, GLP Akishima, GLP Tomisato and others. The asset manager of the Fund is GLP Japan Advisors Inc.

name: TRIAL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Trial Holdings Inc is a Japan-based holding company mainly engaged in the distribution and retail business and retail artificial intelligence (AI) business through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through two business segments. The Distribution and Retail segment mainly operates discount stores under the Trial brand that mainly provide daily necessities, home appliances, apparel goods, hobby goods, among others. Store formats include mega center, supercenter (SuC), smart and small store. The Retail Artificial Intelligence (AI) segment mainly provides products and solutions to retailers and food and consumer goods manufacturers that help improve customers' shopping experiences, physical store operations, and the efficiency of advertising and sales promotion activities. The Company also engages in resort-related businesses such as inn facilities and golf course management, as well as construction and real estate management business.

name: SHISEIDO
businessSummary: Shiseido Co Ltd is a Japan-based company engaged in the manufacture and sale of cosmetics, cosmetic tools, beauty foods and pharmaceuticals. The Company operates through six business segments. Japan Business Segment conducts brand-category-based businesses (prestige, fragrance, premium and others) and healthcare businesses (sales of beauty foods and over-the-counter drugs) in Japan. China and Travel Retail Business Segment conducts brand-category-based businesses (prestige, fragrance, cosmetics and others) in duty-free areas in China and worldwide. Asia Pacific Business Segment conducts brand-category-based businesses in Asia and Oceania, excluding Japan and China. Americas Business Segment conducts brand-category-based businesses in the Americas. Europe Business Segment conducts brand-category-based businesses (prestige, fragrance and others) in Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Other Segment conducts food and beverage businesses.

name: NIPPON PROLOGIS REIT
businessSummary: Nippon Prologis REIT Inc is a Japan-based closed-end real estate investment trust (REIT). The Fund aims to manage assets primarily through investments in specific assets. The basic policy is to manage assets primarily by investing in real estate, real estate leasehold rights, surface rights, and beneficial interests in trusts that hold only these assets, with the aim of securing stable returns over the medium to long term. It aims to maximize investor value by securing stable returns, expanding the scale of its assets, and increasing their value with logistics facilities as its primary investment target. To achieve this, it focuses its investments on Class A logistics facilities, which are of particularly high quality. Investment properties include Prologis Park Ichikawa 1, Prologis Park Zama 1, Prologis Park Kawajima, Prologis Park Osaka 2, Prologis Park Maishima 3, Prologis Park Kasugai and others. The asset manager of the Fund is Prologis REIT Management KK.

name: VRAIN SOLUTION
businessSummary: VRAIN Solution Inc is a Japan-based company primarily engaged in the provision of artificial intelligence (AI) systems and digital transformation (DX) consulting businesses that utilize technologies such as AI and Internet of things (IoT) technologies for the manufacturing industry. The Company operates through two businesses. The AI system business plans, researches, and develops AI systems as a solution to improve productivity. The Company also provides them in combination with peripheral hardware such as imaging equipment, depending on the manufacturing environment of the production line and problems for customers. Its main products include the AI visual inspection system Phoenix Vision/Eye. The DX consulting business provides services that support DX promotion for customers.

name: JAPAN EXCHANGE GROUP
businessSummary: Japan Exchange Group Inc is a Japan-based financial instruments exchange holding company that lists securities and derivatives, provides trading venues, clearing and settlement services and index and information services. It operates through the Financial Instruments Exchange Business segment. Spot market is centered on the stock market. Derivatives market offers trading of index futures, index options, government bond futures, government bond futures options, securities options and commodity futures. Trading systems include arrowhead for the spot market and J-GATE for the derivatives market. Information services provide real-time information on securities trading and derivatives transactions, as they occur and change, as well as index information calculated based on stock price information and various statistical information. It provides self-regulatory functions and clearing and settlement. It also handles the transfer of securities between securities companies, banks and others.

name: ISPACE
businessSummary: ispace Inc is primarily engaged in lunar development business. The Company provides payload services, data services, and partnership services using its own landers and rovers. In the payload service, the Company loads the customer's cargo, which is the goods to be transported to the moon, onto the Group's landers and rovers, and provide transportation to the moon. In addition to direct data collection, the data service confirms the customer's need to collect data using the Company's payloads, send the results back to earth as data, analyze them, and utilize them in the next stage of research and development (R&D). The partnership service is a partnership program in which the Company sells a package that includes rights to use the Company group's activities as content, exposure of its logo in advertising media, and data usage rights, and collaborates in technological and business development.

name: GMO FINANCIAL GATE
businessSummary: GMO Financial Gate Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of face-to-face payment services in the cashless payment market. Sales are divided into four categories including initial, stock, fee, and spread, depending on the content of the service. It provides two kinds of services. The payment processing service provides connection services to the payment information processing centers of payment service providers. It provides credit center terminal (CCT) and operates payment information processing center CCT Center. It also operates a 24/7 help desk. It has four business models. It is a payment service that can handle contact-type credit card payments, debit card payments, contactless electronic money payments, and code-type payments that can be displayed and read on a smartphone. The payment agency service has two business models, including comprehensive merchant contract and merchant agency contract.

name: DAIKIN INDUSTRIES
businessSummary: Daikin Industries Ltd is a Japan-based company principally engaged in the manufacture and sale of air conditioners, refrigerators and chemical products. The Company operates in two business segments. Air Conditioner & Refrigerator segment manufactures, constructs and sells residential, commercial, marine air conditioners and refrigerator products. Chemical segment is involved in the manufacture and sale of chemical products, such as fluorocarbon gas, fluororesin and chemical machinery. The Company also conducts oil machinery business, special machinery business and electronic system business.

name: HENNGE KK
businessSummary: Hennge KK is a Japan-based company engaged in the provision of services to customers mainly in the form of software as a service (SaaS). The HENNGE One business develops HENNGE One, which reduces security risks without compromising the convenience of cloud services for companies that introduce cloud services to improve business efficiency. The Professional Services and Others business develops email delivery package software that delivers large volumes of email securely at high speed. The Customers Mail Cloud is a cloud-based email delivery service that delivers large volumes of email at high speed to mobile phones, personal computers (PCs), and smartphones.

name: THK
businessSummary: THK Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of linear motion (LM) guides and ball screws, as well as transportation equipment components such as link balls and suspension ball joints. The Company operates in five segments including Japan, Americas, Europe, China, and Others. The industrial equipment business primarily manufactures and sells mechanical components, mainly linear motion systems, and industrial machinery. The transportation equipment business primarily develops, designs, manufactures, and sells steering parts, suspension parts, and brake parts for transportation equipment such as automobiles and motorcycles. Linear motion systems are mechanical components used in linear motion of machinery. It directly sells to manufacturers and distributors of industrial machinery, including machine tools, industrial robots, and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, while other companies sell to other manufacturers and distributors.

isin: 3777.T|Environment Friendly Holdings Corp.|3777.T|Environment Friendly Holdings Corp.
name: ENVIRONMENT FRIENDLY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Environment Friendly Holdings Corp. engages in the renewable energy and resource recycling business. It operates in three segments, Resources and Energy Business  Reuse Business  and Environmental Business. The company is involved in multi-story parking garage operations, building maintenance, construction, and real estate businesses  development and operation of renewable energy power plants, and biomass power  solar power generation  sales of environmental equipment  development and commercialization of solar cells  software business  and purchase and sale of gold, platinum, jewelry, and industrial and other products, as well as provides asset management services. It also engages in green finance, energy, and recycling business. The company was formerly known as FHT holdings Corp. and changed its name to Environment Friendly Holdings Corp. in April 2024. Environment Friendly Holdings Corp. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

name: LIBERAWARE
businessSummary: Liberaware Co Ltd is a Japan-based company that mainly provides digital transformation (DX) solutions for infrastructure facilities and equipment using hardware technology centered on drones and software technology for processing, processing, and managing captured images and video. The Company operates its business through infrastructure DX business segment. The Drone business provides data that contributes to surveying, inspecting, and measuring infrastructure and plants using drones, and manufactures and sells drones. The Digital Twin business constructs and provides digital images, three dimensions (3D) data, and information that contributes to the detection of abnormalities, using image processing technology for data acquired by drones. The Solution Development business develops new solutions based on its technological capabilities and know-how.

name: FURUKAWA ELECTRIC
businessSummary: Furukawa Electric Co Ltd is a Japa-based company mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of products that develop and apply technologies developed in the infrastructure, electrical & electronics, and functional products businesses. The Company operates four business segments. The Infrastructure segment provides optical fiber, optical fiber cables, metal communication cables, optical related components, and optical semiconductor devices. The Electrical and Electronics segment provides automotive components, batteries, windings, copper and copper alloys, plated products, processed products for electronic components, and specialty metal materials. The Functional Products segment provides cable conduit materials, foam products, tapes for semiconductor manufacturing, electronic components and heat-dissipating products. The Services, Development segment mainly provides hydroelectric power generation, new product research and development, and real estate leasing.

name: FINATEXT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Finatext Holdings Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the provision of cloud-based core systems for financial business, and data analysis services. The Company operates through three business segments. The Financial Infrastructure segment is engaged in the provision of core systems required to operate financial services as a cloud-based software as a service (SaaS) type. The FinTech Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of support services for digital transformation and digital marketing for financial institutions. The Big Data Analysis segment is engaged in the promotion of data utilization, and the provision of data analysis services.

name: DAIFUKU
businessSummary: Daifuku Co Ltd is primarily engaged in the manufacture and sale of material handling systems and equipment, as well as the manufacture and sale of car wash machines, industrial personal computers and interface boards. The Company operates in five business segments. The Daifuku segment manufactures and sells material handling systems and equipment, and car wash machines, and provides after-sales services. The Contec segment develops, manufactures, sells, and provides after-sales services for personal computer (PC) peripherals and industrial computer network equipment. The DNA segment manufactures and sells material handling systems and equipment, mainly in North America. The CFI segment manufactures and sells clean room transport systems, mainly to semiconductor manufacturers in South Korea, and provides after-sales services for clean room transport systems, mainly to semiconductor manufacturers in China. The other businesses include after-sales services.

name: LY
businessSummary: LY Corp, formerly Z Holdings Corp, is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the Softbank business. The Company operates in three segments. The Media Business segment provides services such as LINE advertising and Yahoo advertising. It operates platforms such as LINE VOOM, LINE NEWS, Talk List, Talk Head View, Talk Head View Custom, LINE Official Accounts, LINE Promotion Stamps, Lived Blog, LINE Stamps, LINE GAME, LINE Divination, LINE LIVE and other platforms. The Commerce Business segment includes electronic commerce (EC) for goods sales, including shopping business, reuse business, ASKUL stand-alone business-to-business (BtoB) business, and service EC. It operates platforms such as Yahoo! Shopping, PayPay Mall, ZOZOTOWN, LOHACO, Charm, LINE Shopping, LINE FRIENDS, LINE GIFT, and MySmartStore. The Strategic Business segment conducts Fintech business and provides PayPay Consolidated, PayPay Bank, and other financial services. The Company also provides cloud-related services.

name: GENDA
businessSummary: Genda Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in management guidance and other management oversight as a pure holding company. The Company operates through two segments. The Entertainment Platform business segment is positioned as the domain connecting intellectual property (IP) content with fans, primarily centered on amusement facility operations, including karaoke and food & beverage (F&B). The Entertainment Content business segment is broadly divided into Character Merchandising (MD) and Content & Promotion, and is positioned as the upstream business domain of the Entertainment Platform business.

name: TIMEE
businessSummary: Timee Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of the Timee short-term work service. The Company has the Timee business segment. The Segment has three services, including the Timee short-term work service, the Timee Career Plus full-time employment service and other services. Timee matches available working hours and supports direct, one-day employment between workers and clients. Timee Career Plus mainly introduces registered Timee workers to companies for full-time positions and supports their employment and career changes. Other services include project support for local governments, worker onboarding support and workplace training, and business process outsourcing (BPO) operations through Logi Hero, a staffing platform for logistics warehouses.

name: ASAKUMA
businessSummary: ASAKUMA CO., LTD. is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of restaurants. The Company is mainly engaged in the operation of Asakuma and Yappari-Asakuma restaurants which offer steaks and hamburgs. The Asakuma restaurants are mainly engaged in the provision of steaks, hamburgs and salads. The Yappari-Asakuma restaurants are mainly engaged in the provision of steaks and hamburgers as fast food. The Company is also engaged in the operation of various restaurants, including Farmers Garden, Yebisusan, Orandazaka Coffee, Surabaya and Wayang Bali.

isin: 4570.T|Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd.|4570.T|Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd.
name: IMMUNO BIOLOGICAL LABORATORIES
businessSummary: Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and supply of various immunological research reagents worldwide. The company offers ELILSA, an assay kit to quantitatively measure targeted substances  and support research services on Alzheimer's disease, metabolic syndrome, and cancer, as well as customized services for production of customized antibodies and development of ELISA systems. It also provides LipoSEARCH, a customized services for profiling and analyzing of lipoprotein through gel-filtration high performance liquid chromatography method that can profile various clinical samples, such as tiny plasma or serum samples from both small animals and human beings for broad range of research fields including lipid metabolism, development of drugs for life-style related diseases, development of functional supplemental foods, and clinical studies. In addition, the company offers LipoTEST, a support tool for diagnostic and health checks at animal clinics  and customized biomarker testing services for Life-style related diseases. Further, it operates protein production business using transgenic silkworms for manufacturing of antibodies for research reagents and diagnostic products  human collagen for cosmetic materials  development of proteins for use in drugs  and other proteins production. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Fujioka, Japan.

name: GO INC TOKYO
businessSummary: Go Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the operation of mobility-related businesses, including the provision of ride-hailing systems. It operates GO business and other businesses. GO business includes app-based ride-hailing and taxi-related services. App-based ride-hailing includes the taxi app GO, the premium vehicle dispatch service GO PREMIUM, and the corporate taxi app GO BUSINESS. Taxi-related services include payment, advertising, terminals, taxi tickets, and other services associated with the taxi app. Other businesses include new businesses (incubation businesses) related to transportation and mobility, and as green transformation (GX) related services, it is engaged in the provision of vehicles and charging services for the introduction of electric vehicle (EV) taxis, and energy management. It also develops and operates the rapid charging spot search, reservation, and payment service GO Charge and the taxi ride-sharing service GO Economy and other businesses.

name: JIG SAW
businessSummary: JIG-SAW INC., a software technology company, provides IoT data control services in Japan. It offers auto sensing and auto control technology platform and services  end-to-end automatic data control services  and big data, cloud, servers, networks, various applications, various platforms, security software, IoT devices, communication modules, various equipment, devices, cells, organisms, etc. The company also provides secure data control and interactive control services on the mobile edge computing (MEC) platform  research and development of autonomous driving software, next-generation real-time OS, next-generation modules, etc.  direct control of cells and organisms using software  and automation, decentralization, and sharing of all industries based on operation technology (OT). In addition, it offers edge computing, embedded software, and system management services. Further, the company offers NEQTO.ai, IoT-OPS, NEQTO, and puzzle platforms and services. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

isin: 6834.T|SEIKOH GIKEN Co., Ltd.|6834.T|SEIKOH GIKEN Co., Ltd.
name: SEIKOH GIKEN
businessSummary: SEIKOH GIKEN Co., Ltd. engages in design, manufacture, and sale of optical components and lens, and radio over fiber products in Japan and internationally. It offers precision and optical disc molds  injection molded components and precise manufacturing technology products  and optical communication components, such as connectors, ferrules, adaptors, jumper cables, optical packaging parts, attenuators, and crimping tools, as well as uniboot connectors. The company also provides optical manufacturing equipment, interferometers, endface cleaners, and field use equipment  lens  isotropic optical e-field sensor heads/optical probe heads, and optical probes for malfunction noise  and X-ray CT scanners, as well as non-destructive testing services. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Matsudo, Japan.

name: AEROEDGE
businessSummary: AeroEdge Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly based in the processing, manufacturing and sale of aircraft engine parts and other products. The Company operates through two businesses. Thr aircraft engine parts processing business is engaged in the processing, production and sale of titanium-aluminum low-pressure turbine blades mounted on commercial aircraft and aircraft engines. Aircraft engine mainly consists of fan, low pressure compressor, combustor, high pressure compressor, high pressure turbine and low pressure turbine. The other processing business is engaged in the commissioned processing of parts for electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, flying cars, and parts for gas turbines.

name: HITACHI
businessSummary: Hitachi Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, manufacturing and sales of products and provision of services. The Company has five business segments. Digital Systems & Services segment provides services such as system integration, consulting and cloud services, information technology (IT) products and software and automated teller machines (ATMs). Green Energy & Mobility segment provides power grids, renewable energy, nuclear power and rail systems. Connective Industries segment provides elevators and escalators, home appliances and air conditioning, measurement and analysis systems for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and medical analysis equipment, industrial and distribution solutions, water and environmental solutions, and industrial equipment. Automotive Systems segment offers powertrain, chassis, advanced driver assistance and systems for two-wheelers. The Others segment is engaged in the management, sale and rental of real estate.

name: PLUSZERO
businessSummary: pluszero, Inc. engages in the provision, development, maintenance, operation, and sale of solutions that integrate AI, natural language processing, software, hardware, and other technologies in Japan. The company offers task-specific services, such as OCR's+ that read and recognize documents and drawings to automate and enhance business processes  a chatbot for responding to customer questions and applications  CRM optimization for website/app management and sales activities  check job ads  privacy-preserving data mining, which enables secure utilization of personal information  and electronic voting platform solution. It also supports research activities and administrative work of universities, companies, and professional organizations, including NLP annotation services and student performance evaluation system  and provides consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

name: ALBALINK
businessSummary: AlbaLink Co.,Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. It is also involved in the purchase and resale of vacant houses and properties  purchase and leasing of land  and consulting services related to real estate, as well as provides information on real estate investment through real estate investment forest website. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SEIWA HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Seiwa Holdings Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the business succession for domestic small and medium-sized manufacturing companies through mergers and acquisitions (M&A). The Company operates business succession issues through M&A and manages group companies through the Seiwa Platform. The Company operates the Manufacturing Business Segment. It is a business succession platform provider specializing in the manufacturing industry, continuously acquiring small and medium-sized companies without successors. Through the Seiwa Platform, it achieves growth for the entire group by centralizing functions. Through the Seiwa Platform, it provides business support for improving productivity through strategy formulation for sales, manufacturing, and development, and the pursuit of group synergies. Capital generated from this growth is used to strengthen competitiveness by investing in Information Technology (IT) to improve management efficiency.

name: NEC
businessSummary: NEC Corporation is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the information technology (IT) services and social infrastructure businesses. The Company operates through two business segments. The IT Services segment provides system integration (system construction and consulting), support (maintenance), outsourcing and cloud services, and system equipment and software services. The Social Infrastructure segment provides network infrastructure (core networks, cell phone base stations, optical transmission systems), software and services for telecommunications carriers, and system equipment, system integration (system construction and consulting) and support (maintenance) in the aerospace and defense domain. It also engages in the development, manufacturing, and sales of system equipment.

name: AXELSPACE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Axelspace Holdings Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development of small satellites. The Company operates through two business segments. The AxelLiner Business segment provides development, manufacturing, and operation services for small satellites, as well as commissioned testing and research services related to space development from government agencies. The AxelGlobe Business segment provides image data of the earth's surface obtained from its small satellites, analysis services for that image data, and solution services based on the analysis results.

name: ANRITSU
businessSummary: Anritsu Corp is a Japan-based company principally engaged in development, manufacture, and sale of electronic measuring instruments, food and pharmaceutical quality assurance systems, environmental measuring equipment and devices. It has three business segments. Communications Measurement segment offers measuring instruments for digital communications and Internet Protocol (IP) networks, optical communications, mobile communications, general-purpose radio frequency (RF), microwave and millimeter wave band measuring instruments. PQA segment offers automatic weighing machines, automatic electronic scales, foreign object detectors and comprehensive quality management and control systems. Environmental Measurement segment offers electric vehicle (EV) and battery testing equipment, support services for local 5th generation mobile communications systems (5G) and monitoring solutions. It also engages in sensing and device services, logistics, welfare services, real estate leasing and others.

name: EXAWIZARDS
businessSummary: ExaWizards Inc. develops AI-enabled services for industrial innovation and social problems solutions in Japan. It operates through AI products and AI solution segments. The company provides AI solution services  and services for AI understanding, planning, design, development, operation, and usage. It also develops and offers AI products to solve generic industrial and social issues. ExaWizards Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: SIMPLEX HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Simplex Holdings, Inc. provides IT solutions related to system consulting, system development, and system operation and maintenance in Japan. The company offers strategic/dx consulting, including forming management strategy, business strategy formation, organizational reform, and business process transformation  and shared service/software as a service. It is also involved in subscription and licensing activities  and sells goods, such as hardware and middleware. Simplex Holdings,Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: MEDLEY
businessSummary: Medley Inc is a Japan-based company engaged in the development and provision of various Internet services in the medical healthcare field. It operates through three business segments. Human Resources Platform Business segment operates and provides JobMedley, a performance-based recruitment system; Guppy, a pay-per-view recruitment system and JobMedley Academy, an online training service for the nursing care field. Medical Platform Business segment operates and provides CLINICS, a cloud-based medical support system; Pharms, a family pharmacy support system; MEDLEY, a medical information service; MALL, an electronic medical record system for hospitals; Dentis, a cloud-based dental business support system and @link, a reservation system for hospitals and clinics with beds. New Services segment operates and provides the Kaigo-no-Honne, a nursing care facility search site for those looking for nursing care facilities and Medley Soki Shikin Support.

name: OKINAWA CELLULAR TELEPHONE
businessSummary: OKINAWA CELLULAR TELEPHONE COMPANY is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the telecommunications business. The Company is engaged in the provision of mobile services, domestic and international communication services, and Internet services. The Company also provides dedicated services, au mobile phone services, au mobile phone terminal sales, renting and maintenance of communication equipment, and outsourcing lines. The Company is also engaged in the production and sales of agricultural business, and tourism business.

name: KDDI
businessSummary: KDDI Corp is a Japan-based telecommunications company. The Company operates in two segments. The Personal segment provides services to individual customers. In Japan, the segment mainly provides 5G communication services under the multi-brands of au, UQ mobile, and povo. Overseas, the segment provides telecommunication services, financial services, and entertainment services such as video for individual customers in Myanmar and Mongolia. The Business segment provides a variety of solutions for corporate customers in Japan and overseas, including smartphones and other devices, networks, and cloud computing, as well as data center services under the Telehouse brand. The Company also provides services such as construction and maintenance of communications facilities, and research and development of information and communications technology.

name: TREND MICRO
businessSummary: Trend Micro Inc is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the development, sales and provision of computer security products and related services. The Company operates through four geographic segments: Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Solutions include cyber risk management, cloud-native application protection, protection of hybrid cloud environments and others. Platforms include enterprise cybersecurity platforms, cloud security, endpoint security, network security and others. Services include incident response services and others.

name: MURATA MANUFACTURING
businessSummary: Murata Manufacturing Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the production of semi-finished products, which are intermediate products of various electronic components. The Company operates through three segments. The Components segment provides capacitors, inductors, and electromagnetic interference (EMI) rejection filters. The Devices and Modules segment provides high-frequency modules, surface wave filters, lithium-ion rechargeable batteries, and sensors. The Others segment is engaged in the provision of healthcare equipment, solution business. The Company also provides employee benefits, leases real estate, and develops and sells products and software.

name: OBIC
businessSummary: OBIC Co., Ltd. is an information technology (IT) company. The Company operates in three business segments. The System Integration segment is engaged in the manufacture and sale of total information systems for customers. The System Support segment is engaged in the provision of hardware maintenance and system operational support services. The Office Automation (OA) segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of general OA equipment and computer products. The Company is also engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaged software for financial accounting and other purposes through its associated companies.

name: KONAMI GROUP
businessSummary: Konami Group Corp is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the entertainment and sports businesses. The Company operates in four business segments. The Digital Entertainment segment is engaged in the production, manufacture and sale of mobile games, card games, home games and other digital contents. The Amusement segment is engaged in the production, manufacturing and sales of amusement machines. The Gaming and Systems segment is engaged in the production, manufacturing and sales of gaming machines and casino management systems, as well as the provision of related services. The Sports segment is engaged in the operation of fitness, swimming, gymnastics, dance, soccer, tennis, golf schools and other schools, as well as the sales of sports related products.

name: CAPCOM
businessSummary: Capcom Co Ltd is a Japan-based company mainly engaged in the digital content business, amusement facility business, as well as amusement equipment business. The Company operates its business through three segments. The Digital Content segment develops and sells home video games and mobile content. The Amusement Facility segment operates stores equipped with game machines. The Amusement Equipment segment develops, manufactures and sells gaming machines to store operators. The Company also engages in character content-related businesses.

name: SYSMEX
businessSummary: SYSMEX CORPORATION is a Japan-based company engaged in the development, manufacture, sale, servicing and import/export of clinical testing instruments and reagents for the medical field. It proposes solutions to address the diverse challenges faced by medical institutions by integrating a wide range of products and services, including software, maintenance for clinical testing equipment, and academic support. It operates business through four segments centered on regional controlling entity, including Headquarters, Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA), China and Asia-Pacific (AP). Headquarters segment operates with the Company itself acting as the controlling entity, responsible for product development, manufacture and others, consolidated subsidiaries within this segment handle the development and manufacturing of certain products, as well as domestic and overseas sales. Americas, Europe, EMEA, China and AP segments operate business in their respective regions.

name: HOYA
