The distribution segment offers control and measuring equipment and software, as well as measuring system design and technical support. The Company with its subsidiaries and affiliated companies forms a capital group which covers three business sectors including services, distribution and production.

name: APLISENS
businessSummary: Aplisens SA is a Poland-based measuring instruments manufacturer. The Company produces implements and services miscellaneous control and measurement products, such as differential pressure transmitters, hydrostatic level probes, level transmitters, valves, digital indicators, power supplies, separators and gauges, among others. The Company owns production units in Warsaw, Ostrow Wielkopolski and Krakow, Poland and one in Belarus. The Company is present through numerous branch offices in Poland and abroad: in Eastern Europe (Russia, Ukraine and Belarus), the European Union and Asia. On July 4, 2014, the Company established new subsidiary, Aplisens Srl.

name: 4MASS
businessSummary: 4Mass SA is a Poland-based company, which operates in the cosmetics industry in the production and distribution segment of make-up as well as disinfectants and personal protection products. The Company operate on many levels and reach every category of clients both on the mass market (drugstores, hypermarkets, discount stores), professional (beauty salons, SPA) and through recommendation marketing. The entity is also importer of accessories and products used in the cosmetics industry, including from Germany, France, Korea and Vietnam.

name: ATM GRUPA
businessSummary: ATM Grupa SA is a Poland-based company active in the film and television (TV) industry. The Company's production covers television series, featured films, TV theater productions, talk shows and game shows. It also provides production infrastructure and equipment services, online video content and computer software for children. The Company’s products are aired by such Polish broadcasters, as Telewizja Polsat, Telewizja Polska, Polskie Media and Polski Instytut Sztuki Filmowej, among others. Additionally, the Company rents television equipment and offers maintenance, as well as rendering post production services, such as, editing and scoring, among others. It operates three TV studios. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated six subsidiaries, including ATM System Sp. z o.o., ATM Studio Sp. z o.o., Profilm Agencja Filmowa Sp. z o.o., Baltmedia Sp. z o.o., Studio A Sp. z o.o. and ATM FX Sp. z o.o.

name: ACTION
businessSummary: Action SA, formerly known as Action SA w restrukturyzacji, is a Poland-based company mainly engaged in distribution of information technology (IT), electrical appliance and office equipment. Its offer includes personal computers, servers, workstations, Moving Picture Experts Group Layer-3 Audio (MP3) players, monitors, notebooks, power supply units and household-type electrical appliances. The Company provides equipment of a number of brands, including Acer, AMD, ASUS, Bosch, Candy, Canon, Gigabyte, Hewlett-Packard, Intel, JVC, LG, LIEBHERR, Microsoft, Nikon, Panasonic, Philips, Samsung, Sony, Sharp, and Toshiba, among others. The Company cooperates with a number of local dealers. Action SA is also present on the Ukrainian market.

name: AUTO PARTNER
businessSummary: Auto Partner SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the auto, truck and motorcycle parts industry. The Company is an importer and distributor of spare parts for cars and light commercial vehicles. Auto Partner SA is an enterprising entity with its headquarters as well as logistic and distribution centre located in Bierun near Tychy. The Company has approximately 60 branch offices across the domestic markets and some representative offices in neighboring countries, in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Ukraine and Belarus, among others. Auto Partner SA distributes stabilizer links, steering rod end sets, steering rods, suspension arms, pins, rubber - metal parts, power steering pumps and steering gears, among others.

name: LENTEX
businessSummary: Lentex SA, formerly Zaklady Lentex SA, is a Poland-based floor covering and nonwovens manufacturer. The Company’s product portfolio includes residential and commercial polyvinyl chloride (PVC) floor coverings, nonwovens, such as flat, fluffy and spun lace fabrics applied in various industries, as well as sport floor coverings systems. Additionally, the Company provides quilting services. It distributes its products through retail networks of Castorama, Komfort, Leroy Merlin, PSB, and Praktiker. It also sells its products in Ukraine, the Russian Federation, Kazakhstan, Lithuania and Latvia, among others. The Company is a parent entity of a capital group, consisting Zaklady Tworzyw Sztucznych Garmat SA and Lentex Marketing Sp z o o and Baltic Wood SA.

name: ZUE
businessSummary: ZUE SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and maintenance of urban transportation infrastructure. The Company is focused on the design and implementation of railway and tram lines, as well as of accompanying infrastructure. It provides also full range of earthworks and construction of drainage systems, facilities, as well as whole stations. ZUE SA offers also construction and modernization of power systems of the entire tram infrastructure, as well as construction and modernization of tram and railway tractions. Its activities consist of regular maintenance and service systems for urban infrastructure, including tracks, traction power supply systems and lighting. Moreover, ZUE SA provides services for construction of power grids systems. In July 2013, it decided to merge with its 88.57% owned subsidiary ZUE Przedsiebiorstwo Robot Komunikacyjnych w Krakowie SA.

name: SONEL
businessSummary: Sonel SA is a Poland-based company that produces the electric test equipment and measuring instruments for the power industry and telecommunications. The Company’s meters are used to measure: fault loop resistance and impedance, insulation resistance, earth resistance and soil resistivity, residual current protections, current and voltage. Moreover, the Company manufactures: multifunctional meters which combine the above-mentioned features, low resistance meters, phase sequence testers, wire tracers, power quality analyzers, clamp meters, multimeters, pyrometers and illuminance meters. In addition, Sonel SA offers a range of accessories and software that enable transferring the measurement results into a computer and creating detailed reports, as well as maintenance and repair services. It operates through Sonel Instruments India Private Ltd and MEASUREMENT LLC.

name: AMBRA
businessSummary: Ambra SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the production, import and distribution of wines and non-alcoholic beverages in Central and Eastern Europe. It offers wines, sparkling wines, vermouths, mineral water and fizzy drinks, among others. The Company's offer includes such brands as Dorato, Cin&Cin, Faber, Gran Cazzano, Michelangelo, Canelli and Piccolo, among others. Additionally, the Company is engaged in importing alcoholic beverages manufactured by third parties. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated 13 subsidiaries, based in Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Romania. On June 26, 2013, the Company merged with its subsidiaries, Centrum Wina-Dystrybucja Sp. z o.o. and Capricorn Investments.

name: XTB
businessSummary: Xtb SA, formerly X Trade Brokers Dom Maklerski SA is a Poland-based company, that is a brokerage house. The Company is a provider of products, services and technology solutions for trading in financial instruments, specializing in the over-the-counter (OTC) market. The Company offer comprises foreign exchange market (FOREX) and contract for differences (CFD). The Company offers online trading and operates trading platforms. It also provides market analysis and trading updates. It has a number of branches across Europe, in the Czech Republic, France, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia and Spain, among others.

name: NOVITA
businessSummary: Novita SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the technical nonwoven textile and carpet sectors. The Company's activities include the production and sale of carpets; the production of needle-punched floor coverings and tufted floor coverings; the manufacture and sale of spun-lace fabrics for household and industrial applications; the production of textile for medical use, such as medical dressings, swabs and personal care products; and the provision of footwear and clothing nonwovens, such as shoe pads, undersoles, linings, shoulder inserts, among others. Its products are sold across Poland, as well as exported to the United States, Germany, the Russian Federation, France and Finland, among others.

name: KRYNICA VITAMIN
businessSummary: Krynica Vitamin SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the beverages industry. The Company is a producer of non-alcoholic and low-alcoholic beverages. It specializes in producing beverages for its own brands and providing bottling services for brand-name products. The Company's offer includes functional and energy drinks, such as isotonic and hypotonic drinks, beverages that support the metabolism, and vitamin dietary supplements. Krynica Vitamin SA also provides functional waters, modern mixed-fruit drinks, drinks with fruit pulp, alcopops, ciders, malt beverages and a selection of carbonated beverages. In addition, the Company is engaged in the research and development services for its products. It operates through Dent Blanche s r o.

name: HUB TECH
businessSummary: Hub.Tech SA, formerly Boruta Zachem SA is a Poland-based company, which manufactures dyestuffs and pigments. It also produces biosurfactants used in chemical and cosmetics industry as well as provides research and development of modern chemical solutions.

name: ULMA CONSTRUCCION POLSKA
businessSummary: ULMA Construccion Polska SA is a Poland-based company primarily involved in the development and production of construction products. The Company offers vertical and horizontal formwork systems, engineering systems, props and shoring systems, as well as scaffolding systems. ULMA Construccion Polska SA also provides engineering and construction services, such as bridge and road construction, public works and construction of commercial and residential buildings. Furthermore, the Company supplies containers for concrete transportation. As of December 31, 2011, the Company had subsidiaries: ULMA System SA in liquidation, based in Poland and engaged in the manufacturing of metal products and structures; ULMA Opalubka Ukraina, based in Ukraine, active in sale and rental of formwork as well as construction materials; and ULMA Opalubka Kazachstan sp. z o.o.., and one affiliated company ULMA Cofraje srl, based in Romania. The Company was 75.49%-owned by ULMA CyE, S. Coop.

name: SYGNITY
businessSummary: Sygnity SA is a Poland-based company active in the information technology (IT) sector. It focuses on IT consulting, software development and deployment, IT system integration, outsourcing, hardware delivery and installation, local area network (LAN) and wide area network (WAN) construction, technical support for software, trainings and others. The Company operates in two segments: IT and others. The IT segment covers mainly manufacture, purchase and sale of integrated IT systems, infrastructure and computer equipment for banking and finance, industry, telecommunications, public and public utilities sectors. The other segment includes such sectors as: geodesy, tele technical systems and maintenance activities. As of September 30, 2012, the Company had five subsidiaries, including Geomar SA, ID Comp Consulting Sp. z o.o., UAB Baltijos Kompiuteriu Centras and Sygnity Europe Sp. z o.o.

name: SYNEKTIK
businessSummary: Synektik SA is a Poland-based company active in the medical sector. It produces PACS software which allows running a diagnostic imaging laboratory. It runs a research laboratory which performs acceptance and specialist tests of X-ray equipment. The Company sells medical equipment and operates a services center for imaging equipment. Synektik SA is a partner of Siemens. On November 28, 2013, the Company raised its stake in Miedzynarodowe Centra Medyczne Inwestycje Sp z o o to 100%.

name: ASSECO POLAND
businessSummary: Asseco Poland S.A. is a Poland-based information technology (IT) company, which is primarily engaged in the development of software for companies from different sectors of the economy. The Company takes part in business acquisitions both in the domestic and foreign markets and develops organically as well. The Company’s portfolio includes proprietary products, execution of IT projects, and a customer base, including financial institutions, industrial enterprises as well as public administration bodies. The Company operates globally.

name: PASSUS
businessSummary: Passus SA is Poland-based company which is active in Information Technology (IT) industry. The Company is engaged in publishing of wide range of applications and network solutions. Additionally the Company provides IT security solutions and services related to network, application and data protection, detection of vulnerabilities, security information and event management systems. Another activity of the Company is design of cloud solutions, provides support for cloud environment and solutions to protect against financial abuse. The Company also provides tools for automating penetration testing or simulating cyber-attacks what potentially protects against cyberthreats. List of Company subsidiaries includes: Chaos Gears SA, Aisecurity Sp zoo, Wisenet Sp zoo. The Company is a member of Passus Group and it is located in Warsaw.

name: ASSECO BUSINESS SOLUTIONS
businessSummary: Asseco Business Solutions SA is a Poland-based information technology (IT) provider for small, medium-sized and large companies. The Company’s products portfolio consists of software developed under its own brands, including Asseco Softlab ERP, an integrated information system expediting the management of key company’s operations; Asseco Koma HR, a software system supporting work in the human resources (HR) area; Asseco Safo ERP, a system based on the Oracle technology of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) IT solutions, enhancing management processes in enterprises; Asseco Softlab SEOD, a system for optimizing the company's in-house processes; and Asseco WAPRO, a set of systems for management of small enterprises, supporting the functioning of sales, finance and accounting, HR, among others.

name: DOM DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Dom Development SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and sale of residential real estate. The Company's main activities include housing projects for the mass market, exclusive residences and single-family houses. Dom Development SA cooperates with various banks and independent financial advisors to develop apartment purchase programs, based on mortgage loans. It has one wholly owned subsidiary Dom Development Morskie Oko Sp. z o.o., one affiliated company, Dom Development Grunty Sp. z o.o, active in purchase of real estate for development activities of the Group. The Company also has stake in a joint venture company Fort Mokotow Sp. z o.o. As of December 31, 2011, Dom Development SA was controlled by Dom Development BV, which held a 61.91% stake in the Company. As of December 31, 2011, the Company’s subsidiary, Dom Development Morskie Oko Sp. z o.o., was liquidated.

name: XPLUS
businessSummary: XPLUS SA is a Poland-based company active in the information technology (IT) sector. The Company delivers end-to-end services, including strategic and process advisory, as well as implementation of enterprise level computer systems. The Company offers services of bespoke software development, end-to-end project management and implementation of enterprise software solutions, such as enterprise resource planning (ERP) and manufacturing resource planning (MRP). XPLUS SA is granted with the status of Microsoft Certified Business Solutions Partner and securing a Partner Contract with Microsoft. Additionally, the Company offers project management consultancy services. In September 2012, FCBSL 1 k.s, acquired 90.15% stake in the Company.

name: VOXEL
businessSummary: Voxel SA is a Poland-based company active in the healthcare sector. It provides services in the fields of diagnostic imaging, teleradiology and outsourcing, as well as information technology (IT) systems for hospitals and diagnostic centers. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated two subsidiaries, 95.24%-owned Alteris SA and wholly owned CDO Sp. z o.o. On November 7, 2012, the Company sold its entire stake in Centrum Diagnostyki i Terapii Onkologicznej Sp. z o.o.

name: ELEKTROTIM
businessSummary: Elektrotim SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of electric installations and automatic systems for the construction industry. The Company produces metal construction elements, machines and devices, as well as conducts and manages building projects. Its products portfolio consists of electric installations and networks, electric switchgears, industrial automatics products, road traffic engineering products, mechanic installations, power automatics products, low-current systems and others. The Company also provides project management services, as well as information technology (IT) solutions in the security management area. It operates through a number of subsidiaries, such as Mawilux SA, Eltrako Sp z o o and Enamor System Sp z o o.

name: BUDIMEX
businessSummary: Budimex SA is a Poland-based construction company. It operates as a general contractor, subcontractor and developer. Its main activities consist of the construction of roads, including highways, express roads and by-passes; construction of bridges and airports; the design, development, construction and maintenance of industrial plants, sewage treatment plants, chemical treatment plants and other environmental facilities; the construction of public and commercial facilities, and development of residential property. It is also involved in the production and assembly of various steel constructions, including gangways, frameworks, industrial and sports halls, storage umbrella roofs and hangars, cylinder and sphere-shaped tanks, boilers and high-pressure pipelines, cable railways, masts and telecommunication towers and other.

name: FABRYKA FARB I LAKIEROW SNIEZKA
businessSummary: Fabryka Farb i Lakierow Sniezka SA (Sniezka SA) is a Poland-based producer of paints and varnishes. The Company’s range of products includes indoor and outdoor paints, varnishes, emulsions, latex emulsions, acrylic enamels, glues, graphic paints and powder paints. Sniezka SA exports its products mainly to the Central and East European countries, such as Ukraine, Belarus, Lithuania, the Russian Federation and Moldavia. The Company operates through a number of subsidiaries, including Snezka Ukraina Sp z o o, Sniezka Sp z o o, based in Ukraine, Hadrokor Sp z o o, Sniezka - Belpol Sp z o o, based in Belarus, Sniezka Romania Sp z o o, IP Solutions Sp z o o, TM Investment Sp z o o and Fabryka Farb i Lakierow Proszkowych Proximal Sp z o o.

name: LPP
businessSummary: LPP SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the apparel and accessories industry. The Company specializes in the design and distribution of clothing, such as sweatshirts, shirts, jumpers, coats, trousers and dresses, as well as underwear, and accessories, such as shoes, gloves, scarves and caps, among others. LPP SA operates through a network of numerous shops in Central and Eastern Europe, as well as in Egypt and Qatar. It also offers online shopping to its brands, particularly in Poland. The Company owns several brands such as RESERVED, Cropp, House, MOHITO and SiNSAY. The Company operates departments in Gdansk, Cracow, Shanghai and Dhaka. LPP SA operates several national and numerous foreign subsidiaries.

name: ASSECO SOUTH EASTERN EUROPE
businessSummary: Asseco South Eastern Europe SA is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the provision of information technology (IT) consulting services. The Company is also involved in the infrastructure projects, third-party software tools delivery, trainings and professional services. Moreover, the Company proposes outsourcing services. Asseco South Eastern Europe SA offers its own software and solutions for such sectors as banking, mobile banking and authentication, telecommunication and general business. The Company also provides supplies, installation and maintenance services in the field of Automated Teller Machines (ATM) and payment terminals. It is also engaged in the provision and implementation of information and communication (ITC) systems and equipment. The Company operates numerous subsidiaries in Southern and Eastern Europe and forms Asseco South Eastern Europe SA Capital Group. As of September 14, 2012, it acquired 98.68% of shares of SigmSigma Danismanlik ve Uygulama Merkezi AS.

name: MLP GROUP
businessSummary: MLP Group SA (Millennium Logistic Parks Group SA) is a Poland-based company engaged in real estate sector. The Company specializes in the construction and management of warehouses and production centers. MLP Group SA offers consulting and property development services. It provides solutions for domestic and international customers. The Company operates four logistics parks: MLP Pruszkow I, MLP Pruszkow II, MLP Tychy, MLP Poznan. It also develops logistics park, MLP Bierun. The Company's major shareholder is Cajamarca Holland BV, the Netherlands.

name: ATENDE
businessSummary: Atende SA, (formerly ATM Systemy Informatyczne SA), is a Poland-based company active in Information Technology (IT) sector. The Company provides telecommunications solutions. It specializes in three segments: networks and information security, computing, and IT infrastructure. It offers IT outsourcing services, such as cloud computing as well as consulting services in the area of business continuity management (BCM). It cooperates with such IT providers as Cisco, HP, Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, SGI, EMC and Dell. On March 19, 2014, the Company acquired entire share capital of TrustIT Sp z o o.

name: RANK PROGRESS
businessSummary: RANK PROGRESS SA is a Poland-based company engaged in property investment and development. It operates in two main segments: real estate rental and real estate sales. Its business model is based on purchase of a real estate, land integration, administrative preparation for development, construction works and management or sale of a property. In addition, it also offers a rental space to shopping centers in main cities across Poland. The Company’s client portfolio includes Tesco, Carrefour, H&M, Empik, Leroy Merlin, Metro-Makro Cash & Carry, Praktiker and others. As of December 31, 2011, it operated through 34 subsidiaries. On November 14, 2012, the Company acquired 100% stake in Gemar - Umech Sp. z o.o. On November 16, 2012, the Company acquired a 100% stake in Rank Recycling Energy Sp. z o.o.

name: LC
businessSummary: LC SA, formerly Ampli SA is a Poland-based company, that operates as an importer of lighting fixtures and electrical equipment. The Company develops the distribution of induction luminaires, LED luminaires and electrical equipment imported under its own brand. Responding to market demand, the Company constantly expands the range of its products. The main products offered by the Company are light bulbs, lamps, induction and LED fixtures, as well as lighting control systems that minimize the amount of electricity through the ability to selectively control the lighting of a given facility. Due to its versatility and modular structure, it is perfect for controlling the lighting of production and warehouse halls, streets and buildings.

name: TRITON DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Triton Development SA is a Poland-based holding company, which is engaged in the real estate sector. It offers apartments of the luxury and higher standard located mainly in Warsaw, Poland, such as: Triton Winnica, Triton Kampinos, Triton Park and Triton Francuska, among others. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated eight subsidiaries engaged in real estate development and management, including Triton Investment Sp. z o.o., Triton Winnica Sp. z o.o. and Triton Kamponos Sp. z o.o., among others.

name: BOWIM
businessSummary: Bowim SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in steel industry. The Company distributes carbon steel products through its own sales network in the wholesale and retail trade. The Company owns a network of nine distribution outlets in Poland. Bowim SA also provides production of reinforcement prefabricated units and guides for mining industry. Additionally, the Company provides transport services of goods purchased by contractors using its own fleet of trucks as well as courses and examinations in welding. As of December 31, 2011, Bowim SA operated through its subsidiaries, including 75%-owned Bowim Podkarpacie Sp. z o.o., 90%-owned Beststal Sp. z o.o., wholly owned Passat-Stal SA and Betstal Sp z o o.

name: SEKO
businessSummary: SEKO SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the fish processing industry. The Company’s product portfolio consists of three groups: marinated fish, including fish products based on salted or fried herring in vinegar and tomato brine; salted fish, encompassing various kinds of herrings; and delicatessen fried fish products, featuring herring, cod and mackerel specialties. The Company also offers fish salads and more than 200 assortment proposals based on herring and mackerel imported from Island, Norway, Denmark and Ireland. SEKO SA has its own processing plant located in Chojnice, Poland. The Company’s products are marketed in Poland and exported to such countries as Germany, the Czech Republic, France, Ireland, England, Italy and the United States, among others.

name: STALPROFIL
businessSummary: Stalprofil SA is a Poland-based company, which is engaged in the steel industry. The Company distributes metallurgical products and semi-finished steel. The Company's product portfolio includes: angle sections, channel sections, flat bars, hot rolled steel profiles, hot rolled angles, cold formed profiles, reinforcing ribbed bars, sheets and plates, I-sections, T-bars, as well as wire rods and smooth rods. It operates its own distribution network through two warehouses in Dabrowa Gornicza and Katowice. Stalprofil SA mainly exports its products to the European Union countries, as well as to Norway, Turkey, Ukraine and Belarus. As of December 31, 1011, the Company had three subsidiaries: Izostal SA, which produces the polyethylene pipes and antirust coated steel pipes; ZRUG Zabrze Sp. z o.o, engaged in the construction of the gas, heating, water and sewage systems and KOLB Sp. z o.o., the producer of steel structures.

name: AMICA
businessSummary: Amica SA, formerly known as Amica Wronki SA, is a Poland-based manufacturer and wholesaler of household appliances. The Company's primary focus lies in the production and sale of electric and gas household appliances. This activity includes wholesale of free-standing cookers, hobs, ovens, hoods, refrigerators, coolers, dishwashers, warming drawers, washing machines and dryers. In addition, The Company is also involved in the trade of small household electronic appliances such as kettles, mixers, toasters, vacuum cleaners, as well as home and product accessories. Furthermore, The Company provides comprehensive service solutions, offering maintenance, repair, and customer support services for Its products.

name: WISE ENERGY
businessSummary: Wise Energy SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in energy sector. The Company offers sale of electricity and natural gas and have a range of telecommunications services. Wise Energy SA is also engaged in management of the group, creating and managing activities of its subsidiaries, planning and implementation strategy for the group as a whole, organization of financing for development projects, as well as oversight of investments.

name: MONNARI TRADE
businessSummary: Monnari Trade SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the apparel and fashion retail industry. The Company focuses on the design, marketing, and sale of women's clothing, handbags, and fashion accessories through its Monnari and Femestage brands. Its activities are structured into two reportable segments: sales of apparel and accessories, and investment real estate. The apparel and accessories segment represents the Company's primary business and includes retail and online sales of fashion products. The investment real estate segment comprises subsidiaries that own, manage, acquire, and develop investment properties. The Company operates primarily in Poland through a network of physical stores and e-commerce channels.

name: GIELDA PRAW MAJATKOWYCH VINDEXUS
businessSummary: Gielda Praw Majatkowych Vindexus SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of debt recovery services for both private and corporate clients. The Company's operations are based on the stock exchange model and the main good traded is receivables. Gielda Praw Majatkowych Vindexus SA offers services in both trading in various kinds of debt, as well as debt recovery. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was a participant and owner of 100% of the certificates of a closed-end securitization fund GPM Vindexus Niestandaryzowany Sekurytyzacyjny Fundusz Inwestycyjny Zamkniety that is primarily engaged in the purchase and trade of receivables.

name: FASING
businessSummary: Fabryki Sprzetu i Narzedzi Gorniczych Grupa Kapitalowa Fasing SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the production of link chains. Its product portfolio includes round and flat link mining chains, combined cutter loader chains, chain assemblies, locks, lifting chains, hoist chains, trawl chains, and other general purpose chains. The Company provides services in the area of mechanics and automatics, including maintenance and repairs. Its main customers are companies active in the mining, power, building, transport, agriculture and fishing industry. The Company operates through Zavody gornowo oborudowanija i instrumenta Fasing OOO and FASING Sino-Pol (Beijing) Mining Equipment and Tools Co Ltd.

name: LUBELSKI WEGIEL BOGDANKA
businessSummary: Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of hard coal. It is engaged in the excavation of the hard coal used for the generation of electric and thermal energy as well as for cement production. The Company’s main customers are: power stations, cement plants, plants producing fertilizers and thermal power stations located in the East or Northern-East of Poland. The mine Bogdanka has been located in Central Coal District, which is situated in Lubelskie Coal Basin. The Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka SA's mine performs its mining operations within the mining area of a surface of 57 square kilometers. As of December 31, 2012, it operated one subsidiary, Leczynska Energetyka Sp. z o.o., and it held a 24.41% stake in Kolejowe Zaklady Maszyn KOLZAM SA. The main shareholder of the Company is Enea SA.

name: IZOSTAL
businessSummary: Izostal SA is a Poland-based company active in the steel industry. It is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of steel pipes, metallurgical products and steel fixtures. It offers external anticorrosive coatings for steel pipes used mainly for constructing transmission pipelines, such as single layer epoxy coatings, three layer epoxy-copolymer-polyethylene coatings and three layer epoxy-copolymer-polypropylene coatings. Apart from anticorrosive coatings, its product portfolio comprises a range of steel pipes, including seamless pipes, pipes welded with high frequency current, spiral-welded steel pipes and longitudinally welded steel pipes; long and flat metallurgical products, such as angles, bars, cold-formed profiles, cold- and hot-rolled steel sheets of various formats. As of December 31, 2011, its main shareholder was Stalprofil SA, with a 60.3% stake in the capital.

name: WITTCHEN
businessSummary: Wittchen SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the apparel and accessories industry. The Company is active in the market of leather accessories. It designs, manufactures and sells woman's bags, briefcases, travel luggages, belts, purses, valets, gloves, umbrellas, shawls, ties, scarves, overcoats, jackets and sheepskin, as well as shoes and fragrances. Wittchen SA operates through numerous own-brand stores in the Eastern European market, particularly in the Russian Federation, Ukraine, and Belarus, as well as markets its products through the Internet, chain of Salons and brand stands all over Poland. Wittchen SA's products are marked with the Company's logo, which highlights of each product.

name: FIRMA OPONIARSKA DEBICA
businessSummary: Firma Oponiarska Debica SA is a Poland-based producer, wholesale and retail trader of passenger and commercial tires. The Company mainly targets the markets of whole-steel heavy truck tires, as well as tires for all-terrain vehicles, off-road tires, agricultural machinery and equipment tires. The Company exports its products to more than 60 countries, mostly to Germany, Slovenia, Luxembourg, the Russian Federation, Romania, France and Italy, among others under the brand names Debica, Goodyear, Dunlop, Fulda and Sava. As of December 31, 2011, it had one affiliated company, Centrum Utylizacji Opon Organizacja Odzysku SA, engaged in the tires utilization process. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was 66.05%-owned by Goodyear SA.

name: JRH ASI
businessSummary: JRH ASI SA, formerly JR Holding SA, is a Poland-based company active in the real estate sector. The Company is engaged in buying, renovating, and rental of commercial and retail real estate in such Polish cities as Cracow, Bielsko-Biala, Katowice and Zielona Gora.

name: JWW INVEST
businessSummary: JWW Invest SA, located in Katowice, Poland, provides power equipment repair and maintenance services. It was founded in 2012.

name: OPTEAM
businessSummary: OPTeam SA is a Poland-based information technology (IT) solutions and services provider. The Company provides IT solutions and services as well as tailor-made applications designed for businesses. Its OPTI series products range includes: corporate card system (OPTIpass), loyalty card system (OPTIcard), electronic student's card (OPTIcamp) and electronic purse system (OPTIcash). Applications of the OPTI series are implemented at client's premises or hosted at the OPTeam SA Data Centre. In addition, the Company produces and implements software that utilizes payment terminals; creates information communications technology (ICT) networks; implements data security policy solutions, management systems of the enterprise resource planning (ERP) class and cash register systems along with a comprehensive maintenance offer, and supports integration projects through training courses offered by the Company's training centre.

name: ULTIMATE GAMES
businessSummary: Ultimate Games SA is a Poland-based company engaged in software development sector. The Company is focused on creation and production of computer games, such are Ultimate fishing simulator, Bouncy BOB, Darkest Hunters and Earthworms.

name: ESOTIQ & HENDERSON
businessSummary: Esotiq & Henderson SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the fashion industry. The Company aims at designing, producing and selling clothes and cosmetics for female and male. Its product’s portfolio encompasses lingerie, swimsuits, pajamas and robes, as well as t-shirts, shorts, blouses, bags and dresses. In addition, Esotiq & Henderson SA provides cosmetics products, such as shower gel, lotions, peelings, creams, shampoos, conditioners, lips ticks as well as fragrances, among others. The Company operates in the domestic market, though franchising business model and internationally, through dealers in Slovakia, Lithuania, Estonia, the Russian Federation, Ukraine, Moldova, Kazakhstan and Latvia.

name: ZAKLADY MAGNEZYTOWE ROPCZYCE
businessSummary: Zaklady Magnezytowe Ropczyce SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction materials industry. The Company’s activity is diversified into two main segments: chemical segment, comprising production and sales of refractory materials; and service segment, offering services to manufacturers of refractory materials and metallurgic works and servicing in the segment of steel structures. Its product portfolio comprises of fired shaped refractories, non-fired shaped frefractories, unshaped refractories, and special products, such as gas-purging plugs, tapping sets, biceramic sets and monolithic castable elements, among others. It operates two subsidiaries, ZM Service Sp. z o.o. and Mostostal-Energomontaz SA.

name: TALEX
businessSummary: Talex SA is a Poland-based company that supplies information technology (IT) products and services for medium-sized and large companies. The Company operates in three business areas: Integration, including design, implementation and maintenance of IT systems, as well as related consulting and customer's employee trainings services; Outsourcing, providing the customers IT infrastructure maintenance services basing on application of the data center owned by the Company; and Software, developing and deploying software to support and optimize business processes. The Company operates through branch offices located in Poland in such cities as Bialystok, Bielsko-Biala, Katowice, Krakow, Lublin, Lodz, Olsztyn, Rzeszow, Szczecin, Torun, Warsaw and Wroclaw, among others, and one branch office in Prague, the Czech Republic.

name: BETACOM
businessSummary: Betacom SA is a Poland-based company active in information technology (IT) sector. The Company produces computer programs, creates and implements IT solutions, and integrates computer systems. It also supplies e-learning systems, integrates network systems, builds up safety systems, and delivers computer equipment and programs. In addition, Betacom SA offers IT solutions consulting services.

name: ARCTIC PAPER
businessSummary: Arctic Paper SA is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the paper industry. The Company divides its business into three segments of graphic paper: Fine paper, Newsprint, and Magazine paper. The Company's main activities are manufacturing and sale of graphic fine uncoated and coated paper, under the brands: Amber, G-Print, Munken, Pamo, Arctic, L-Print and AP Tech, among others. It offers uncoated wood-free paper, coated wood-free paper, as well as uncoated wood-containing paper. The Company operates four paper mills, located in Kostrzyn, Poland, Munkendals and Grycksbo, Sweden, and Mochenwangen, Germany. Among the Company’s customers are printing houses, distributors, publishing houses and advertising agencies. The Company is a parent entity of the Arctic Paper Capital Group As of December 31, 2011 Arctic Paper AB, based in Sweden, held a 74.8% stake in the Company. On February 26, 2013, the Company increased its stake in Rottenros AB to 54.2%.

name: NTT SYSTEM
businessSummary: NTT System SA is a Poland-based producer and distributor of computer equipment and peripherals, as well as consumer electronics. It offers servers, computers, notebooks, and terminal adapters under its own brand, Corrino, as well as computer accessories and parts. Its product portfolio has three divisions: home series for individual users, office series for businesses and series for institutions. It distributes its product both in wholesale and retail trade.The Company cooperates with AMD, VIA Technolgies, Gigabyte, Asus, MSI, Samsung Electronics, Hyundai, Hynix, NEC, LG and Siemens. Its main customers include enterprises, institutions and sales networks such as Media Markt, Carrefour and Real, among others. It sells its products domestically through six branch offices, as well as exports them to the Czech Republic, Hungary, the Netherlands, Belarus, Ukraine and Lithuania, among others. As of December 31, 2011 NTT System SA had one wholly owned subsidiary NTT Technology Sp. z o.o.

name: MUZA
businessSummary: Muza SA is a Poland-based publishing company. It also runs a readers' club and an Internet bookstore. The Company takes part in national and international book fairs and cooperates with foreign book issuers, translators and editors. Muza SA offers such products as books, albums, atlases, encyclopedias, lexicons, manuals, handbooks, books for children, literature, tourist guidebooks, educational books and books for lawyers. On July 21, 2014, the Regional Court in Warsaw excluded from the register the Company's subsidiary, Polska Grupa Wydawnicza SA.

name: SANOK RUBBER
businessSummary: Sanok Rubber Company SA, known as Sanockie Zaklady Przemyslu Gumowego Stomil Sanok SA, is a Poland-based company focused on development, production and marketing of products made from rubber and rubber combined with metal and other materials. The Company’s business is divided into four segments: Automotive, Construction, Rubber Compounds and Industry and Agriculture. The Company manufactures a range of products used in such fields as car body sealing systems, car suspension and exhaust systems, electrical, power transmission, fuel and cooling systems, agriculture, household appliances and pharmaceutical industry.. The Company’s customers are: Fiat, General Motors, Ford Motor, Volvo Cars, Suzuki, Volkswagen Group, Volvo Trucks, Mack Truck and LDV, among others. The Company operates through Stomet Sp. z o.o., PST Stomil Sp. z o.o., Stomil Sanok Dystrybucja Sp. z o.o., PHU Stomil East Sp. z o.o., Stomil Sanok Wiatka satz, and Stomil Sanok Rus Sp. z o.o., among others.

name: HERKULES SA W RESTRUKTURYZACJI
businessSummary: Herkules SA w restrukturyzacji is a Poland-based company which is primarily engaged in crane rental services. The Company's activities are divided into three business segments: Crane rental, Telecommunications construction and Other. The Crane rental division is engaged in provision of crane services in the field of hydraulic, lattice ,as well as, tower cranes. The Telecommunications construction division provides comprehensive service for telecommunications and energy companies, including design and construction of telecommunications facilities ,as well as, energy facilities and full service of construction investments in the above sector. The Other division focuses on other incidental events occurring irregularly in the course of business activities.

name: MIRBUD
businessSummary: Mirbud SA is a Poland-based company active in the real estate sector. It acts mainly as a general contractor for the construction sector in Poland. The scope of construction and assembly services offered by the Company covers four areas: residential properties, including detached houses, townhouses and apartment buildings; public utility buildings; production, services and commercial facilities, encompassing production halls, logistic centers and shopping centers, and engineering and road construction works, consisting of roads and construction elements for municipal transport infrastructure, among others. It also renders transport and construction equipment rental services. The Company operates subsidiaries, JHM Development SA, Expo Arena SA, Marywilska 44 Sp z o o and Przedsiebiorstwo Budowy Drog i Mostow Kobylarnia SA.

name: ENEA
businessSummary: Enea SA is a Poland-based company active in the energy sector. It is engaged in the production and distribution of electricity. The Company’s business is divided into three segments: Trading, Distribution, and Production. Enea SA provides energy from fossil fuels and renewable sources, including biomass co-combustion and hydroelectric stations. In addition, the Company is involved in the construction, extension, modernization and renovation of power grids and installations; designing, construction, production and sales of electric devices and equipment, and services related to the maintenance of street lights and low-voltage grids, among others. Enea SA is the parent company of the Enea SA Group comprises a number of subsidiaries. The Company’s major shareholder is the Polish State. It operates through Lubelski Wegiel Bogdanka SA.

name: HARPER HYGIENICS
businessSummary: Harper Hygienics SA is a Poland-based producer of hygiene products and cosmetics. Its range of products includes cotton balls and pads, wet wipes, peeling wet wipes, baby wipes and accessories, cotton swabs and plaster strips. It offers its personal hygiene products under the brand names Ola and Cleanic, which includes such product lines as Cleanic, Cleanic Natural Beauty, Cleanic dzidzius, Cleanic Kindii, Cleanic Intimate, Cleanic Clean O’’Peel, and house cleaning wipes, such as multipurpose wipes and wipes for furniture, as well as for cars, under the name Presto Clean. As of December 31, 2011 the Company operated two wholly owned subsidiaries based in the Russian Federation, Harper Hygenics Rus OOO and Harper Production OOO. The Company's majority stakeholder was Central European Cotton Holdings Ltd. Ireland with a 74.59% stake in the capital.

name: KORPORACJA GOSPODARCZA EFEKT
businessSummary: Korporacja Gospodarcza Efekt SA is a Poland-based holding company primarily engaged in energy sector. The Company is active within two business sectors: commercial and services, as well as hospitality and tourism. In the commercial and services business segment, it offers non-residential rental and lease services, as well as wholesale and retail trade of solid and fluid fuels and building materials. In the hospitality and tourism field, the Company is engaged in managing hotels and restaurants, particularly with regard to urban and business tourism. It also organizes conferences, conventions and special events. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was operational through three wholly owned subsidiaries: Efekt-bis sp. z o.o., Efekt-Hotele SA and Lider Hotel sp. z o.o. As of June 25, 2012, the Company sold its entire stake in Efekt-bis Sp. z o.o.

name: UNIMOT
businessSummary: Unimot SA, formerly Unimot Gaz SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the energy industry. The Company focuses on the trading of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG). The Company offers petroleum gas in bottles and tanks, to be used for heating and industrial applications, providing with the energy such sectors as services, agriculture, industry, household and bulk consumers. The Company is a distributor and an importer of LPG in the domestic market. In addition, the Company offers components from vegetable oils for diesel fuel, to be used as a pure fuel or as bio-component in conventional diesel fuel. Moreover, it is engaged in the wholesale of diesel. The Company also offers energy trade in Poland and Czech Republic, as well as distributes electric power to individuals and business customers. The Company is a part of the Group Unimot. It operates through Energogaz Sp z oo and Tradea Sp z oo.

name: IPOPEMA SECURITIES
businessSummary: Ipopema Securities SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the capital markets industry. The Company focuses on providing brokerage, equity research, and investment banking services. Their key product is a portfolio and fund management platform, which is a financial services solution. It aims to support institutional and retail clients in managing investments, executing transactions, and accessing capital markets.

name: PCC ROKITA
businessSummary: PCC Rokita SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the chemicals industry. It divides its business into three segments: Chemicals that includes manufacture of such products as polyols, comprising polyether polyols for the production of polyurethane polymers, among others; chloralkali, including chlorine and soda lye; chlorobenzene, such as monochlorobenzene, dichlorobenzene and technical hydrochloric acid; phosphorus derivates; and naphthalene derivates; Energy engaged in the production and distribution of electric and thermal energy, demineralized water and compressed air; and Other Activities composed of assembly and maintenance of industrial armature, technical monitoring and consulting services, waste management, among others.

name: HELIO
businessSummary: Helio SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the confection, import and distribution of dried fruits, nuts, seeds and grains, as well as manufacturing of poppy seed products. The Company’s products are offered under three brands, including Helio, Sloneczne Owoce, and Helio Gold. The Company also sales its products in chain store brand names, such as, Auchan, Biedronka, Carrefour, EKO Holding, E.Leclerc, Intermarche, Makro Cash & Carru, Netto,, Piotr I Pawel, Real and Tesco stores. In addition the Company offers dried fruits and nuts in bulk. Its main customers include domestic chain stores, food wholesalers and retail stores.

name: AC
businessSummary: AC SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the automotive industry. The Company is a manufacturer of Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and Compressed natural gas (CNG) systems under STAG brand for cars, trucks and other mobile vehicles. It offers more than 200 auto-gas products, such as: controllers, emulators, switchers, fuel level indicators, reducers interfaces, diagnostics scanners, recorders and others. The products offered by AC SA are delivered to more than 30 countries all over the world, including Germany, Russia, Ukraine, Turkey and Thailand. It operates a network of Partner Service Points (PSP) across Poland that comprises 32 professional auto-gas workshops, for whom the Company provides marketing and technical support and a system of professional training. The Company also runs Research and Development Department, which works on the products offer.As of August 10, 2012, the Company sold its entire stake in Biazet SA.

name: STALPRODUKT
businessSummary: Stalprodukt SA is a Poland-based company engaged in steel industry. It produces and distributes highly processed steel products, such as cold-rolled electrical sheets and strips, cold-rolled sections, steel safety barriers, torodial transformer cores and cold-rolled sheets, among others. The Company has three industrial plants, based in Bochnia, Cracow and Tarnow. It sells its products directly as well as through its distribution network. Additionally, the Company provides repair services, galvanizing services, security services and maintenance of roads. The Company formed a capital group, consisting of several subsidiaries, including Stalprodukt-MB sp. z o.o., Stalprodukt-Wamech sp. z o.o., Stalprodukt-Centrostal sp. z o.o., Stalprodukt-Serwis sp. z o.o., and Stalprodukt Zamosc sp. z o.o., among others. On June 10, 2013, the Company announced dissolution of its subsidiary, Stalprodukt-Warszawa Sp. z o.o.

name: RAWLPLUG
businessSummary: Rawlplug SA, (formerly Koelner SA), is a Poland-based manufacturer and wholesaler of fixings for construction and industry sectors. Its range of activities includes the production and distribution of fixing systems, cable suspension systems, insulation fixings for facades and roofs, self-drilling screws, powder actuated and gas-driven fastening systems, accessories for drywall systems, wood connectors, ropes and rope accessories, as well as hand and power tools, including screw drivers, pliers, hammers, drilling and cutting tools, and others. It product portfolio includes about 40,000 items offered under such brand names as Koelner, Modeco, Rrawlplug, Globus and Rawlfixing. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated a number of subsidiaries based in Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Bulgaria, Romania, Lithuania, Ukraine, South Africa, Germany and Slovakia, among others. The Company major shareholder is Amicus Poliniae Sp z o o.

name: INC
businessSummary: INC SA, formerly Investcon Group SA, is a Poland-based company that specializes in investments and advisory services related to raising funds for investment projects. It offers business and management consulting services, managing business activities, auxiliary financial services to businesses, financial mediation, training and education. The Company's service is directed to small and medium companies aiming at the NewConnect Market and at the Warsaw Stock Exchange. INC SA operates through subsidiaries and affiliates, such as Inwest Consulting SA, Inwest e-Finance Sp z o o, Investcon Fund Sp z o o, Dom Maklerski INC SA and e-Misja Sp z o o.

name: MOSTOSTAL PLOCK
businessSummary: Mostostal Plock SA is a Poland-based company principally engaged in the construction and building sectors. It was created as a result of the reorganization of Plockie Przedsiebiorstwo Konstrukcji Stalowych i Urzadzen Przemyslowych (Plock Steel Structures and Industrial Equipment Company). The Company provides such services as manufacture, erection and design of steel structures, tanks, pipelines, and industrial plants, as well as construction, fitting, insulation and anticorrosion works. Additionally, Mostostal Plock SA offers welding services, overhaul and modernization of equipment, machinery, and industrial plants. The Company's main customers are PKN Orlen SA, Przedsiebiorstwo Eksploatacji Rurociagow Naftowych Przyjazn SA, Lotos SA and Anwil SA, among others. As of December 31, 2011, the Company's main shareholder was Mostostal Warszawa SA, holding a 48.66% stake in the Company’s share capital and 52.65% of the right votes.

name: MARVIPOL DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Marvipol Development SA is a Poland-based company. The company implements its own investment projects in the multi-family housing sector, covering the entire development process - starting with land acquisition, through design in cooperation with renowned architectural offices, to obtaining valid building permits, supervision of construction work, and forwarding of completed flats to clients and managing the whole object. The Company operates in two business areas: Property development, basic for the parent company and automotive activities in the field of import, sale, service and turnover of spare parts for Jaguar, Land Rover and Aston Martin cars.

name: PCC EXOL
businessSummary: PCC Exol SA is a Poland based company active in the chemicals sector. The Company manufactures and sells surfactants (surface active agents) for household chemicals, personal care, textile industry, paper industry and metallurgical industry, among others. It has two manufacturing units, for anionic and nonionic surfactants in Brzeg Dolny, and for ethoxylattion in Plock. It sells its products under the brand names: ABS acid, ABSNa, Sulforokanol, Rosulfany, Sulfobursztyniany, Rokafenol, Rokanol, Rokacet, Rokamid, Rodamin, Rokopol and Rokamina. On May 26, 2014, the Company established new subsidiary, PCC Exol Philippines Inc engaged in the production of semi-products, such as alcohols and fatty acids.

name: ECB
businessSummary: Ecb SA, formerly known as EC Bedzin SA, is a Poland-based company, which is primarily engaged in the energy sector. The Company is multi-utility provider, specializing in the generation and distribution of heat (water steam and hot water) and electricity for the industrial, municipal and household use. The Company specializes in providing thermal energy for heating, domestic hot water and industrial processes with primary energy source obtained from hard coal. The Company is active in the Zaglebie Dabrowskie region, Poland. The Company provides additional services such as construction and maintenance of distribution infrastructure, including pipelines, power lines, and telecommunications lines.

name: DELKO
businessSummary: Delko SA is a Poland-based company involved in household products distribution. The Company is principally engaged in the wholesale of fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), primarily cosmetics, personal hygiene and household cleaning products, as well as groceries and tobacco, across Poland. The Company’s partners include Unilever, Gillette, Bella, Lambi and Dove, among others. Moreover, the Company offers products under its own brands, such as Filip, Filip Fresh, Blue, Teak, Delikato, Oskar, Tanius, Granit, Domowy, Delko Professional and others. The Company operates through three segments: Wholesale, Retail through own grocery and chemist stores, and Retail through a franchising network. The distribution is conducted through regional sales representatives, the Company's own network of warehouses, as well as direct service for main retail clients.

name: MERCATOR MEDICAL
businessSummary: Mercator Medical SA is a Poland-based company engaged in medical supplies industry. The Company manufactures medical gloves and distributes disposable medical materials. It produces medical, latex, synthetic, surgical, diagnostic sterile, examination and protective and household gloves. Its dressing products line includes gauze dressing products, non-woven fabric dressing, medical adhesive tapes, surgical dressing, among others. In addition, the Company provides drapes such as bed sheets, sets, as well as apparel, including caps, masks, gowns, among others. It operates through subsidiaries: Mercator Medical Kft, Mercator Medical srl, Merkator Medikal TOB, Mercator Medical (Thailand) Ltd and VIVOFT LLP.

name: M FOOD
businessSummary: M Food SA is Poland-based holding company and a producer of honey. The Company manages the production assets and logistics of apiculture products- mainly honey. The Company divides its activity in to three segments: PRODUCTION OF RAW MATERIAL, DOWNSTREAM and RETAIL SALES. PRODUCTION OF RAW MATERIAL segment, control of raw material supply based on the Company's raw material production infrastructure; DOWNSTREAM segment includes: acquisition and contracting of raw materials from international markets, organization and management of the logistics and storage of raw materials on the basis of land and sea infrastructure, storage and packaging, organization and contracting markets for wholesale international markets. RETAIL SALES segment includes: sales organization of final products in the retail networks, infrastructure and logistics management, retail sales certificates.

name: QUANTUM SOFTWARE
businessSummary: Quantum Software S.A. is a Poland-based company specializing in the development, implementation, and maintenance of IT solutions for logistics and supply chain management. The Company provides software supporting warehouse management, transport management, production management, and related business processes. Its activities also include consulting, system integration, technical support, and software development services tailored to operational and logistics requirements. The Company delivers proprietary software solutions designed to support the organization and control of logistics and manufacturing operations.

name: MCR
businessSummary: Mcr SA, formerly known as Mercor SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the production and sale of fire protection systems. It is structured into four product divisions, including fire doors and partitions offering steel fire doors, timber fire doors, profiled fire doors and partitions, as well as steel sliding gates; smoke and heat exhaust ventilation systems providing such solutions as roof lights with integrated smoke vents and window-based smoke exhaust systems; fire ventilation systems focused on production of fire dampers, smoke exhaust fans; fire-proof solutions for buildings with intumescing coating systems Pyroplast and fire protection boards system Vermiculux. The Company operates through subsidiaries, based in Poland, the Czech Republic, Ukraine, Romania, Spain, Slovakia and the Russian Federation. It is active through Dunamenti Tuzvedelem Ipari Szolgaltato es Kereskedelmi Zrt.

name: AB
businessSummary: AB SA is a Poland-based distributor of computer hardware and information technology (IT) products. The Company sells computers and computer accessories, notebooks, office equipment, data carriers, software, network infrastructure, hardware, servers, television sets, mobile phones, cables, batteries and others in the retail and wholesale trade. It also renders services of assembly and certification of desktop of Personal Computers (PC) and advisory services in design of servers and integrated systems. The Company operates through subsidiaries, such as Alsen Sp z o o, Alsen Marketing Sp z o o, B2B IT Sp z o o, Optimus Sp z o o, Rekman Sp z o o and AT Computers Holding. It is active in the domestic market, Czech Republic and Slovakia.

name: IZOBLOK
businessSummary: Izoblok SA, formerly Izo-Blok SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the chemicals industry. The Company specializes in processing enhanced plastics, especially enhanced polypropylene (EPP). Its activity is mainly related to automotive industry and logistics. The Company provides car parts used in the production of bumpers, headrests, child seats, dashboards, armrests, among others. It offers reusable packaging and reusable transport containers, such as containers for automobile mirrors, brake calipers or steering gears. Electrostatic dischargeable types are available for packaging sensitive electronic goods. The Company’s clients and partners are Audi, Ford, Skoda, Jaguar, Kia, Hyundai, Volkswagen, LG Display, Ikea, Hutchinson, among others. It operates through SSW PearlFoam GmbH.

name: CAPITEA
businessSummary: Capitea SA, formerly known as GetBack SA w restrukturyzacji, is a Poland-based company engaged in the financial sector. The Company provides debt collection services. The Company's activities are divided into two segments: Proprietary Funds and Third-Party Funds. The Proprietary Funds division focuses on the recovery of liabilities for its own account using securitization funds and securitization firms owned by the GetBack Group, such as easyDebt NSFIZ, Universe 3 NSFIZ, GetPro NSFIZ, Open Finance Wierzytelnosci NSFIZ and Bakura Sp z o o. The Third-Party Funds division is responsible for the management of accounts receivable portfolios owned by securitization funds based on unit-linked funds, as well as provision of related advisory services, such as legal consulting and representation in court.

name: BNP PARIBAS BANK POLSKA
businessSummary: BNP Paribas Bank Polska SA, formerly Bank BGZ BNP Paribas SA and Gospodarki Zywnosciowej SA, is a Poland-based bank. The Bank divides its operations into three segments: Retail Banking includes sales of products and services for individuals, such as current and deposit accounts, term deposits, granting of housing loans and cash loans, mortgage loans, revolving loans, overdrafts, issuing debit and credit cards, service of foreign cash transfers, entering into foreign exchange transactions, among others; Institutional Banking includes sales of products and services for enterprises, companies and cooperatives, individual entrepreneurs, individual farmers, non-profit institutions and public sector entities; and Financial Markets, Assets and Liabilities Management covers activity in the area of financial markets and liquidity management.

name: PCF GROUP
businessSummary: PCF Group SA is a Poland-based Company is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in video-games production. The Company consists of a team of specialists, which are needed for computer game development. The Firm cooperates with specialists such as programmers, graphic designers, and game planners. The Company developed games such as Painkiller Bulletstorm, Gears of War: Judgment, Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition, Bulletstorm: Duke of Switch Edition, and Outriders. The Company operates multiple games studios on an international level. The Firm has studios in places such as Lodz in Poland, New York in the United States of America, Newcastle in the United Kingdom, and Montreal in Canada, Besides the activities of the main company, the Firm operates through its subsidiaries such as People Can Fly Phosphor in the United States of America.

name: DGA
businessSummary: DGA SA is a Polish consulting and investment company. Its business is divided into following segments: European Funds, including project managements, audit of investment projects, outsourcing of services, acquiring resources and public aid; Business consulting, offering enterprise strategy development, mergers and takeovers, management systems, business continuity management, fraud management, financial consulting and business ethics, among others; Public sector, including programs off revitalization and strategies of development, management systems, common assessment framework (CAF), anticorruption system and security of information; and IT products, offering business process management platform, management of an electronic system of document circulation and information technology (IT) consulting. On June 23, 2014, the Company sold all shares it held directly and indirectly in Audiobook.pl Sp z o o to Bezkartek.pl SA.

name: ENERGOAPARATURA
businessSummary: Energoaparatura SA is a Poland-based company engaged in specialty engineering, building and architectonic services. Energoaparatura SA undertakes projects in such fields as instrumentation and control, electric works, as well as building installations. The Company’s range of services includes the preparation of technical specification, delivery of instruments and equipment, programming of controllers and visualization of applications, on-site assembling, adjustment, measurement and start-up procedures, as well as personnel training and after-build services. Energoaparatura SA is also engaged in fiber optic works, including light pipe and gradient networks construction.

name: PKP CARGO SA W RESTRUKTURYZACJI
businessSummary: PKP Cargo SA w restrukturyzacji is a Poland-based company active in the transportation sector. The main activity of The Company is the provision of comprehensive logistics services, for which rail transport is a basic service complemented by a wide range of services related to transport, including: intermodal services, forwarding (domestic and foreign), terminal services, siding and traction services, repairs and maintenance of rolling stock and reclamation. The Capital Group, in which The Company is a parent entity, has licenses to provide rail freight services in 9 European Union countries: Lithuania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Austria, the Czech Republic, Germany, the Netherlands, Hungary and Poland. The Group also performs freight transport through the entity PKP CARGO International a.s., which performs transport mainly on the Czech market.

name: BANK HANDLOWY W WARSZAWIE
businessSummary: Bank Handlowy w Warszawie SA is a Poland-based commercial bank. It offers its products and services under Citibank Handlowy brand. The Bank operates through two segments: Corporate and Investment Banking; and Retail Banking. The Bank’s offer includes cash management, trade services, treasury services, corporate finance, debt instruments, syndicated loans, structured trade finance, securitization services, asset management services, management buy-outs and acquisitions advisory services, custodian services and brokerage. In addition, through its subsidiaries, the Bank is engaged in vendor leasing and other leasing activities; the management of pension funds; the provision of insurance, and the management of securities portfolios. The Bank’s parent entity is Citibank Overseas Investment Corporation (COIC).

name: ALIOR BANK
businessSummary: Alior Bank SA is a Poland-based commercial bank. The Bank divides its business into three segments: Individual Clients; Business Clients; and Treasury Activity. The operations of the Bank comprise accepting cash as demand deposits and keeping deposit accounts; maintaining other bank accounts; granting credits; giving and confirming bank guarantees and opening and confirming letters of credit; issuing banking securities; conducting banking settlements; granting cash loans; issuing payment cards; trading in securities; and pursuing brokerage services; among others. It operates through Bank BPH.

name: ATAL
businessSummary: Atal SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the residential real estate development industry. The Company specializes in the construction and sale of apartments in multi-family buildings. It also builds single-family houses. The Company operates wholly owned subsidiaries such as ATAL Construction Sp z o o and Atal Wysoka Sp z o o , among others. Atal SA operates domestically.

name: UNFOLD VC ASI
businessSummary: Unfold vc Asi SA, formerly Venture Inc Asi SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in investments in the information technology (IT) sector. It supports companies in the stage of development (start-up and seed phase), active in the area of Internet projects, Software as a Service (SaaS) and e-commerce, among others. The Company acquires shares in the initial phase with a goal to sell them in the last development phase to external investors or to gain partners for the project. The Company operates through a number of subsidiaries, such as Patent Fund SA, Best Capital Sp z o o and Inkubator Naukowo Technologiczny Sp z o o. It also has minority stakes in various other companies, including Hawira Sp z o o, Time Solutions Sp z o o and Loud Arts Sp z o o, among others.

name: EUROTEL
businessSummary: Eurotel SA is a Poland-based company active in telecommunications sector. It acts as an authorized dealer of the products of Polish mobile telephony operators, T-Mobile (formerly ERA) and Play. It operates a network of points of sale, offering such products as mobile phones and accessories, wireless connection services, prepaid card services and customer-tailored packages. Eurotel SA operates also a network of approximately 400 electronic terminals for the prepaid recharges of mobiles phones for such network operators as Heyah, Tak Tak, Pop, SIMPLUS, Sami Swoi and Play. In addition, it is an authorized partner for an operator of the satellite television, Telewizja Nowej Generacji n. On December 20, 2013, the Company acquired a business under Apple Premium Reseller (APR) agreement with Apple Inc, comprised of four APR sales points.

name: SANWIL HOLDING
businessSummary: Sanwil Holding SA is a Poland-based holding company that specializes in the production of coated fabrics, ecological leather, and other textiles. The Company produces a range of textile products for multiple business sectors such as the clothing sector, footwear sector, automotive sector, and medical sector among others. The Company's products include knitted fabrics, such as technical cotton and polyester, fur, terry fabrics, and uncut loops fabrics. Additionally, the Firm produces leather imitations. The Company’s products are used as fabrics for furniture coverings and footwear, clothing materials, fabrics for medical and sanitary use, and others. The Company operates through its subsidiaries, including Sanwil Polska Sp z o o, Strazyska Sp z o o, and Strazyska Sp z o o. The Company operates mainly in the domestic market, also in the European Union Countries, and in Belarus and Ukraine.

name: ARTIFEX MUNDI
businessSummary: Artifex Mundi SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the computer games development. The Company focuses on creating, publishing and distributing games for various platforms, such as Android, iOS, Windows, Mac, Linux, Xbox One and PlayStation 4. It specializes in developing the Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure (HOPA) game type, which is a combination of logic and adventure games. The Company's activities are divided into two areas: Premium games, which includes monetized games in the try-before-you-buy mode, and Free-to-play games, which offers free games. The Company's games portfolio comprises Nightmares from the Deep: The Cursed Heart, Abyss: The Wraiths of Eden and Time Mysteries: The Final Enigma, among others.

name: KOMPUTRONIK
businessSummary: Komputronik SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the distribution of hardware and software solutions, as well as consumer electronics products. The Company's product portfolio is comprised of notebooks, personal computers, monitors, computer peripherals and components, chargers and others. It operates through retail stores and a network of authorized dealers, Komputronik Partner, as well as runs an online shop and stores on a franchise basis. In addition, the Company is involved in the provision of other information technology (IT) services, such as customer-tailored business analysis tools and management support systems, including enterprise resource planning (ERM) and customer relationship management (CRM) solutions. It also sells equipment under its own brand names, including Geo PC brand for computers. On January 21, 2013, the Company established new subsidiary, Komputronik GmbH, Germany.

name: ORLEN
businessSummary: Orlen SA, formerly Polski Koncern Naftowy Orlen SA, is a Poland-based company active in the oil and gas sector. It specializes in the manufacture, distribution, wholesale and retail sale of refined petrochemical products. The Company’s business is divided into three segments: Refining, including refinery products processing and wholesale, oil productions and sale as well as supporting production; Retail segment, including sales at petrol stations; and Petrochemical segment, including production and wholesale of petrochemicals and production and sale of chemicals. Its product portfolio includes fuel and petrochemical products, as well as oil derivatives, such as petrol, heating oil, aviation fuel and plastics. It also produces and distributes electricity and thermal energy. It operates several refineries located in Poland, Lithuania and the Czech Republic and a number of gasoline stations. It operates Kicking Horse Energy Inc and FX Energy Inc.

name: GRODNO
businessSummary: Grodno SA is a Poland-based company active in the electric lighting sector. It is a distributor of electrical and lighting fixtures. It sells product in the wholesale and retail trade. The Company operates through a main office and a network of 36 local branches based in Poland. The Company also offers lighting and electrical installations design, technical consultancy, lighting maintenance, transportation and disposal of used lamps.

name: CFI HOLDING
businessSummary: CFI Holding SA, previously Intakus SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction sector. The Company’s activities include construction of multi- and single-family facilities, construction of industrial buildings, modernization and renovation of general building facilities, development of construction projects and regulations, rental and sales of tower cranes and building containers, machinery and vehicles and wholesale of construction materials. The Company operates such subsidiaries as Towarzystwo Budownictwa Spolecznego Nasze Katy Sp z o o, IMA Maszyny budowlane Sp z o o, BL8 Sp z o o SKA and Central Fund of Immovables Sp z o o.

name: LENA LIGHTING
businessSummary: Lena Lighting SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of lighting fittings. The Company’s offering comprises interior, machine, portable and exterior lighting, as well as floodlighting. The Company’s products portfolio includes also electro-technical articles, such as electronic transformers and extension leads. It undertakes lighting projects and provides expert consultancy. The Company also offers design software, Prometheus 3.0, which is used to design lighting in closed rooms. It distributes its products domestically, as well as to countries worldwide including Germany, France, Russia, Czech Republic, Sweden and Hungary. The Company operates such subsidiaries as Lena Lighting Hungary Kft, Lena Lighting GmbH and Luxmat Investment Sp z o o, among others.

name: SPOLKA AKCYJNA ODLEWNIE POLSKIE
businessSummary: Odlewnie Polskie SA is a Poland-based producer of foundry materials. The Company manufactures castings made of gray cast iron, nodular cast iron, vermicular cast iron, cast carbon steel, steel alloys and aluminum alloys for clients in such market sectors as machinery and automotive industry, plumbing and water-sewage fittings, heavy railway infrastructure, energy industry and others. The Company also runs trade activities within the foundry materials scope, including ferroalloys, foundry alloys and inoculants, steel shot, pig iron and dextrin. Odlewnie Polskie SA sells its products on the domestic market, as well as exports to Germany, the United Kingdom, Sweden and the United States, among others. As of December 31, 2011, the Company had one wholly owned subsidiary, Prima Sp. z o.o.

name: GAMING FACTORY
businessSummary: Gaming Factory SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in videogames development. The Company operates as an advisor for other companies that develop video games. The Firm provides the necessary finances for some projects and knowledge in the field of game development. The Firm cooperates with a team of specialists, which are needed for computer game development, such as programmers, graphic designers, and game planners. The Company focuses on developing programs for platforms such as personal computers (PC) and consoles such as Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox. The Company also engages in porting games to consoles and in board-game production. The Firm developed multiple titles such as Anthology of Fear, Bug Academy, City Eye, and Grave Keeper among others.

name: CDRL
businessSummary: CDRL SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the apparel and accessories industry. The Company specializes in the design, manufacture and distribution of children and infants clothing. Its offer includes underwear, apparel, as well as shoes. The Company sells its products under the brands COCCODRILLO and H@C. It also acts as a retailer of other manufacturers’ products, such as plush toys and accessories. The Company operates a chain of stores all over the world, in such countries as Austria, Hungary, Germany, Estonia, Slovakia, Russia, Libya, China, Brazil, Oman, among others. In addition, CDRL SA is engaged in retail of clothing and accessories through the Internet, via an online store http://pl.coccodrillo.eu/.

name: HOLLYWOOD
businessSummary: Hollywood SA, located in Sierpc, Poland, provides team management and consulting services in such areas as laundry service and professional uniform leasing. It is also a holding company. It operates through Konsorcjum Pralnicze Sp z o o.

name: BANK OCHRONY SRODOWISKA
businessSummary: Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA (BOS SA) is a Poland-based banking entity. The Bank divides its business activities into two divisions: Corporate and Public Finances division and Retail division. The Corporate and Public Finances division is divided into corporate segment, public finance segment and ecological fund segment, while Retail division is divided into individual segment, micro corporate segment, residential community segment and non-governmental organization (NGO) segment. Its main products and services include deposit accounts, lending accounts, commercial loan facilities, investment banking services, trade finance services and foreign exchange and fiduciary services. BOS SA also offers pro-ecological services, such as credit facilities for financing investments in the area of environmental protection. As of December 31, 2011, the parent entity to BOS SA was Narodowy Fundusz Ochrony Srodowiska i Gospodarki Wodnej.

name: KPPD
businessSummary: Koszalinskie Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Drzewnego S.A. (KPPD) is a Poland-based company specializing in the processing of wood and the production of timber and wood-based products.
