The Company's activities include sawmilling operations, the manufacture of softwood and hardwood sawn timber, and further wood processing such as drying, planing, gluing, impregnation, and steam treatment. KPPD supplies wood products to customers in the construction, furniture, woodworking, and landscaping sectors and markets its products both domestically and internationally. The Company also produces glued wood products and provides treated timber for industrial and commercial applications.

name: ZAMET
businessSummary: Zamet SA, Zamet Industry SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the manufacturing of industrial steel structures. The Company’s products include offshore drilling equipment, heavy steel equipment for subsea oil and gas exploration, lifting equipment and loading equipment, such as offshore and onshore cranes, materials handling equipment, steel structures for mining industry, as well as transportation systems for sea terminals, power stations, cement plants, steel plants, sugar factories and open pits, among others. The Company sells products to multinational clients in Norway, Germany, the United States, the Netherlands and Denmark, among others, and its devices manufactured in the Piotrkow plant are equipped on site with electric and hydraulic control systems and undergo functional tests.

name: FABRITY
businessSummary: Fabrity SA, formerly Fabrity Holding SA, is a Poland-based Internet marketing company, which focuses on offering new media and technology. The Company’s services include usability research and design, media planning, managed hosting, search engine marketing, electronic commerce (e-commerce) systems, performance marketing and loyalty programs, among others.

name: TORPOL
businessSummary: Torpol SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and engineering industry. The Company offers services in the construction and modernization of railway stations, tracks and lines, including implementation of tracks works within the scope of roadbed, track layout and associated works; construction of the overhead catenary system, power supply, train traffic and control systems; road and civil engineering structures. The urban infrastructure encompasses the modernization of the strategic travelways, present-day track beds and rapid transit tramway systems. Its project portfolio includes the reconstruction of a number of important sections of the railway lines E20, E30 and E65 which form the Polish part of the Pan-European transportation corridors, the modernization of Galkowek railway station, as a part of the reconstruction project of Warsaw-Lodz railway line and the construction of modern tram lines in the cities of Poznan and Gdansk.

name: GETIN HOLDING
businessSummary: Getin Holding SA is a Poland-based financial holding. The Company invests in ventures on the markets of Central and Eastern Europe. It divides its services into four segments: Banking Services, Leasing Services, Financial Intermediation and Holding Services. The Company’s main activities are connected to the investment in and management of the Capital Group, while the remaining units of the group deal with retail banking, leasing, financial intermediation and insurance intermediation and other financial activities. Among the Company’s brands are Idea Bank Polska, Tax Care, Idea Expert, MW Trade, Idea Leasing, Carcade, Kuban Bank, Idea Bank Ukraine and Idea Bank Belarus. The Company is operational in Poland, Ukraine, Belarus and the Russian Federation. In October 18, 2013, it acquired 95.5% stake in Bialoruski Bank Malego Biznesu ZAO (Belarusian Bank for Small Business). In June 2014, it acquired a 96.066% stake in OAO Investisionnyi Doveritel'nyi Yevropeyskiy Aktsionernyi Bank.

name: KGL
businessSummary: Kgl SA is a Poland-based company which is primarily engaged in wholesale of chemical products industry. The Company's activities are divided into two business segments: Production and Distribution. The Production division is engaged in the production of plastic products, i.e. mainly plastic packaging produced by thermoforming and foil produced by extrusion. The Production division produces foil and packaging from three main types of plastics corresponding mainly to the specifics of the food industry. The Distribution division carries out the distribution of plastic granulates and coloring agents. The Distribution segment is also focused on the sale of three categories of plastics - technical, polyolefin and styrene, which are used in various industries.

name: MEGARON
businessSummary: Megaron SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction materials industry. The Company manufactures and sells gypsum products. Its product portfolio includes gypsum plasters, finishing plasters, spatulas, reinforcement plasters and adhesives, among others. The Company distributes its products on the domestic market, as well as in Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Estonia, Latvia, the Russian Federation, Ukraine, the Czech Republic and Moldavia.

name: ENERGA S
businessSummary: Energa SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the electric power sector. It produces and distributes the electric power and participates in the electric power market in Northern and Central Poland. It divides its business into seven segments: Electricity Distribution consists of electricity distribution conducted by subsidiaries; Renewable Energy invests in renewable energy sources and produces electricity through hydro, wind and bio-energy plans; Baseload Power Plant consists of manufacturing and investment activities in the area of conventional power plants, service and repair activities related to the generation of electricity; Combined Heat and Power (CHP) includes manufacturing activity of power plants and the heat distribution; Sales is engaged in lighting services, trading of electrical energy and customer service; Services provides accounting, human resources (HR) and payroll services, among others; Other includes hotel and training centers, and transportation services.

name: MAKARONY POLSKIE
businessSummary: Makarony Polskie SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacture of pasta. It offers variety of pasta, produced with or without eggs, such as spirals, elbows, penne, farfalle, threads, shells, spaghetti, ribbons, waves and others. The Company sells its products under such brand names, as Sorenti (durum wheat pasta), Solare, Abak and Makaron Staropolski (traditional pasta). It also offers ready meals under the brand name Stoczek, as well as sauces under the brand name Sorenti. Additionally, it produces and distributes syrups, salads, pickles, jams and marmalades. The Company operates four production plants located in Rzeszow, Czestochowa, Plock and Stoczek Lukowski. The Company distributes its products through a sales network and hypermarkets in Poland, including Auchan, Tesco and exports it abroad. The Company operates through subsidiaries, such as MP Trade Sp z o o, Stoczek Sp z o o. As of April 20, 2012, the Company merged with its 100%-owned subsidiary, Stoczek Sp. z o.o.

name: BIG CHEESE STUDIO
businessSummary: Big Cheese Studio SA is a Poland-based company that operates in the video games market. The Company produces and publish simulation computer games for computers. The Company flagship production, namely the Cooking Simulator game with add-ons, is distributed mainly via the steam digital sales platform. Add-on to the base version of the game give users other capabilities. These include a mode inspired by Food Network shows, a pizza simulator or an pastry downloadable content (DLC) add-on that uses real recipes. To date the Company release's a number of updates, including several paid downloadable content (DLC) add-ons and a free LiveOPS.

name: TARCZYNSKI
businessSummary: Tarczynski SA is a Poland-based company active in the food industry. The Company is a producer of sausages, smoked meats, meat preparations and hams made from lean pork. It sells its products under brands Tarczynski and Dobroslawa. The Company operates three production plants, in Ujezdziec Maly, Slawa and Bielsko-Biala. The Company's major shareholder is EJT Investment sarl

name: PRIMA MODA
businessSummary: Prima Moda SA is a Poland-based company active in the footwear industry. It is engaged in the retail sale of men's and women's footwear, leather accessories, such as handbags, and shoe care measures, including shoe polish, shoe foams, and cleaning creams, among others. As of December 31, 2010 Prima Moda SA was selling its products through a network of 44 brand stores located mainly in shopping malls throughout Poland, in such cities as Warsaw, Gdansk, Cracow, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw, Szczecin, Lublin and Katowice, among others.

name: GAMES OPERATORS
businessSummary: Games Operators SA is a Poland- based company primarily engaged in software publishing. The Company outsourcing games creation to other companies, funding the full development process and marketing.

name: PGE POLSKA GRUPA ENERGETYCZNA
businessSummary: PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna SA is a Poland-based company active in the power sector. The Company is involved in production, sale and distribution of electricity. The main areas of the Company's activity comprise six business lines: Conventional Power Generation, Wholesale, Retail, Distribution, Renewable power generation and Nuclear power generation. PGE Polska Grupa Energetyczna SA is a vertically integrated group which includes lignite mines (therein KWB Belchatow), power plants and cogeneration plants (including power plants that produce energy from renewable sources, wind power and hydropower plants), distribution system operators, retail sales companies, a wholesale trading company, as well as a company active in telecommunications industry.

name: EUROCASH
businessSummary: Eurocash SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the industry of wholesale and retail distribution of food and distribution of fast moving consumer goods (FMCG). It operates through four segments: Wholesale, Retail, Projects and Others. The Wholesale segment is divided into Eurocash Distribution, including distribution and supporting franchise activities; Cash&Carry, which operates a national network of warehouses; Tobacco & Impulse, which distributes tobacco products, Alcohol Distribution, Eurocash Food Service and Other. The Retail segment operates the retails activities of Eurocahs group and the wholesale of Delikatesy Centrum franchisees. It also includes other retail operations under EKO, Mila and Inmedio brand names. The Project segment is dedicated to run the projects of the Eurocash Group. It cooperates with different partners including abc, Groszek, Delikatesy Centrum, Lewiatan, Euro Sklep or Gama.

name: TESGAS
businessSummary: Tesgas SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and renovation of gas networks. The Company provides comprehensive construction, utilization and repair services for natural gas transmission and distribution infrastructure, including high, medium and low pressure gas networks, boiler rooms, pressure vessels, microgeneration systems, as well as facilities associated with the extraction of natural gas and crude oil. In addition, TESGAS SA offers construction of the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) stations, as well as maintenance services for high and medium pressure gas stations and gas pipelines.

name: FAST FINANCE
businessSummary: Fast Finance SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the receivables market. The Company’s strategy is to purchase retail debts and then retrieve them on its own account. The Company’s clients comprise various financial institutions. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated one 50.12%-owned subsidiary, Columbus Factoring Solutions SA, engaged in financing and securing the cooperation with health care entities. It operates through FF Inkaso Sp z o o. Receivables held by FF Inkaso from the parent company Fast Finance S.A. in restructuring result from repayments made to the bondholders of Fast Finance S.A. from the funds the Company receives from debtors within the framework of its debt packages.

name: ERG
businessSummary: ERG SA is a Poland-based company active in the plastic processing industry. The Company is a manufacturer and wholesale trader of plastics products in three departments: Film Products, Injection Products, and Adhesive Tapes. The Company's product range includes laminating films, cold shrinkable films, deep drawing films, packaging films, thermo shrinkable films, garbage bags, battery cases, transporting containers, baskets, spools, cloaking tapes, self-adhesive tapes and polypropylene packaging tapes, among others. The Company operates through subsidiaries, including wholly own3ed Folpak Sp z o o, among others.

name: SESCOM
businessSummary: Sescom SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction services. The Company specializes in provision of management, technical maintenance and repair of buildings' heating, ventilation, air conditioning and electrical installation. Sescom SA provides its services into five business sectors: food trade, finance, telecommunications, construction and commerce. The Company provides services in facilities maintenance and fixed network throughout the domestic market, as well as in the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania and Germany. The Company’s client portfolio includes Reserved, Mohito, Gatta, Credit Agricole, Eurobank, Panasonic, Douglas, Jysk and The United Colors of Benetton brands, among others.

name: PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO PRODUKCYJNO HANDLOWE KO
businessSummary: Przedsiebiorstwo Produkcyjno Handlowe Kompap SA is a Poland-based company engaged in printing services and solutions. The Company’s range of activities includes the production and trade of printed forms, envelopes, paper for computer printers, leaflets, paper rolls, cash registered rolls, thermal, fax and self-adhesive rolls, brochures, catalogues, instruction sets to electronic equipment, labels and carton boxes, among others. It serves various sectors and industries such as insurance and financial, enterprises, public administration, chemical and pharmaceutical and electronics market. The Company's subsidiaries include OZGRAF Olsztynskie Zaklady Graficzne SA, Bialostockie Zaklady Graficzne SA, Komunikacja Masowa Sp z o o, and Imprimus Sp z o o.

name: MW TRADE
businessSummary: MW Trade S.A. is a Poland-based holding company focused on the development of businesses operating in the railway sector. The Company's activities involve managing and supporting its group operations, with a particular focus on freight rail wagon leasing through its subsidiary. MW Trade combines its background in financial services with expertise in the railway industry to support the development and financing of its business activities. The Company is involved in activities related to rail asset leasing, group development, and investment management within its operating segment. Its operations are focused on supporting the growth and financing of railway-related business activities.

name: KGHM POLSKA MIEDZ
businessSummary: KGHM Polska Miedz SA is a Poland-based company involved in the copper ore mining, copper production and the production of precious metals and other non-ferrous metals. The Company also produces salt and provides casting of light metals. It deals with geological and exploratory activities, as well as waste management. KGHM Polska Miedz SA has a multi-divisional organizational structure, which comprises its Head Office and several divisions: mines, smelters, the Concentrator Division, the Tailings division, the Mine-Smelter Emergency Rescue Division and the Data Center Division. Its products are sold domestically, as well as exported to Germany, the United Kingdom, France, China, and the Czech Republic, among others. Through a wholly owned subsidiary Bipromet SA the Company is also engaged in construction and engineering industry. The Company operates direct and indirect subsidiaries, as well as affiliated companies.

name: ECHO INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Echo Investment SA is a Poland-based company active in the real estate sector. The Company realizes investments in three operating segments: residential areas, providing leasing out and sale of residential and commercial space; shopping centers, providing leasing out and sale of commercial and entertainment space; and office buildings and hotels, providing leasing out and sale of office and hotel space. The Company manages the investment processes of given projects, starting from the purchase of property, through obtaining administrative permits, financing, implementation, supervision to putting the facility into service. The Company provides its services in Poland, Ukraine, Romania and Hungary. The Company operated 75 subsidiaries providing construction and engineering services, as well as rental and management of real estate properties. The main shareholder of the Company is Bafia Sp z o o. It operates through Compass Offices Management Poland Ltd Sp z o o.

name: MANGATA HOLDING
businessSummary: Mangata Holding SA, formerly known as Zetkama SA, is a Poland-based company that specializes in the manufacture and sale of industrial fittings and cast iron products. Mangata Holding SA produces valves and iron castings. The Company is offering over 2000 of different types of valves, such as stop valves, check valves, bellow valves, butterfly valves, strainers, ball valves, among others. It also manufactures backflow preventers, rubber expansion joints, gate valves, castings, among others. Its products are used in the heating plants and systems, air conditioning and ventilation, water and sewage plants, shipbuilding, among others. The Company operates as a part of Capital Group. The Company’s products are distributed to over 70 countries. The Company is controlled by Capital MBO SA.

name: SECO WARWICK
businessSummary: Seco/Warwick SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of heat treatment furnaces for metals. The Company’s operations are divided into six business segments: Vacuum, engaged in producing vacuum furnaces; Controlled Atmosphere Brazing (CAB), providing aluminum heat exchanger brazing systems; Aluminum Process, specialized in aluminum heat treatment systems; Melting Furnaces that includes metallurgy equipment used for melting and vacuum casting of metals and specialty alloys; Thermal, providing atmosphere furnaces, and Other. Its main customers are companies from automotive industry, aviation, as well as the machinery, equipment and aluminum metallurgy sectors. Seco/Warwick SA sells its products domestically and exports to over 40 countries around the world. The Company operates through subsidiaries, including Seco/Warwic Europe SA, Seco/Warwick Corporation, OOO Seco/Warwick Group Moscow, Retech Systems LCC, Seco/Warwick Retech Thermal Equipment Manufacturing Tianjin Co Ltd, among others.

name: PZ CORMAY
businessSummary: PZ Cormay SA is a Polish-based producer and wholesaler of diagnostic reagents and a distributor of the laboratory equipment. The Company is engaged in the design, manufacture and distribution of a range of products for clinical chemistry, hematology, electrophoresis, parasitology, cytology, coagulation and specific protein recognition. It offers drugs, biochemical rapid tests and devices such as vacuettes and tubes. PZ Cormay SA provides also biochemical analyzers: ACCENT-300, ACCENT-200, PRESTIGE 24i and LIVIA; hematological analyzers: MYTHIC 18, among others, and urinalysis apparatus: IChem 100. On September 1, 2014, Orphee SA acquired 100% stake in TT Management Sp z o o to enable execution of the restructuring plan of Cormay group which aims at transferring production and distribution activity of Cormay group to Orphee SA.

name: TRAKCJA
businessSummary: Trakcja SA, formerly Trakcja PRKiI SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in construction and engineering industry. The Company is primarily focused on the construction and modernization of railway and road infrastructure. The Company operates two business segments, Civil Engineering in Poland and Construction, Engineering and Concession Arrangements for Baltic countries. The main activity of the Company is the construction and assembly works in the scope of comprehensive modernization of railway and tram lines, railway and tram electric traction networks, power lines, industrial facilities, construction of bridges, viaducts, overpasses, culverts, tunnels, underground passages, retaining walls, roads and elements accompanying the railway and road infrastructure, as well as production of accessories for traction and power engineering.

name: EUROPEJSKIE CENTRUM ODSZKODOWAN
businessSummary: Europejskie Centrum Odszkodowan SA is a Poland-based company active in the financial sector. It provides services of recovering claims for payment due to indemnity or other payments resulting from damage. The Company conducts negotiations with insurance companies with the aim of recovering payment of indemnity or other benefits before legal action, as well as recovers all the claims connected with accidents, including claims due to loss of health, claims from losing income, reimbursement of medical costs and travel expenses, among others. In addition, through Eucocar SA, the Company offers replacement car after collision.

name: MFO
businessSummary: MFO SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the steel profiles manufacturing segment of industry. It produces steel profiles, anchors and reinforcements for PVC window joinery, cutting and profiling sheet, as well as foiling and laminating PVC profiles. It operates in the European Union, Russia and Ukraine. The Company divides its activities into two segments: Cold-bent sections, and Special sections. In the Cold-bent sections segment it manufactures and distributes window reinforcements and in the Special sections segment it offers special profiles based on individual documentation of the ordering party. Apart from window reinforcements it manufactures special profiles which can be applied in: light steel constructions, fences, elevated floors, racks, automotive industry, among others.

name: MAGNA POLONIA
businessSummary: Magna Polonia SA, formerly Narodowy Fundusz Inwestycyjny Magna Polonia SA, is a Poland-based investment fund active in telecommunication sector. Its range of activities includes the purchase of valuable papers issued by Treasury, buying or taking over units or shares of the companies registered and performing in Poland, investing in other valuable papers and granting loans to other bodies registered and performing in Poland. As of December 31, 2011, it had three direct subsidiaries: INFO-TV-FM Sp. z o.o. engaged in mobile television, Zninska Kolej Powiatowa Sp. z o.o., Mediatel SA that manages a capital group consisted of Elterix SA, Telepin SA, Velvet Telecom LCC and Sieci Cyfrowe Sp. z o.o. As of March 20, 2012, Rasting Limited owned a 52.5% stake in the Company. As of January 30, 2012, it sold a 61.23% stake in INFO TV FM Sp. z o.o. to Cyfrowy Polsat SA.

name: GRUPA AZOTY ZAKLADY AZOTOWE PULAWY
businessSummary: Grupa Azoty Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy SA is a Poland-based company active in the chemical industry that manufactures fertilizers. The Company operates within three business segments. The Agro segment is engaged in the production of nitrogen fertilizers, such as ammonium nitrate, urea, ammonium sulfate, phosphorus fertilizers and fertilizer blends, such as superphosphate, amofoska, agrafoska. In addition, the Agro segment sells merchandises and materials (fertilizers, feed, grains and crop protection chemicals). The Chemical segment produces semi-finished and finished goods: urea, hydrogen peroxide, sulfuric acid, ammonium sulfate, cyclohexanone, cyclohexane and sodium bisulfite. The Energy Segment provides semi-finished and finished goods and supplies, including heat, electricity, low- and high-pressure natural gas, as well as various types of steam and water. It also sells property rights (certificates of origin for electricity from cogeneration).

name: BIOMAXIMA
businessSummary: BioMaxima SA is a Poland-based company active in the laboratory diagnostics sector. It manufactures and distributes reagents and equipment for the laboratory diagnosis. It produces reagents for the in vitro diagnosis. The main product groups offered by BioMaxima include: diagnostic reagents and analyzers for clinical biochemistry; rapid tests and readers for detecting infectious diseases, cancer markers, cardiac markers and drugs of abuse; urine analysis systems; hematology analyzers and reagents; ion-selective analyzers and reagents; reagents and immunological analyzers of cardiac markers; glucometers; analyzers for gasometric tests and critical blood parameters tests. The Company supplies hospitals and laboratories in Poland, as well as in Lithuania, Latvia, Romania and France. On March 20, 2014, the Company merged with its wholly owned subsidiary Cebo Sp z o o.

name: MAXCOM
businessSummary: MaxCom SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the manufacture of consumer electronics. The Company focuses on the design, production and sell of mobile phones and other handheld devices under the Maxcom and Motorola brand name. Its product range includes mobile and fixed phones, Global Positioning System (GPS) navigation, baby monitoring systems, as well as walkie-talkie type of private mobile radios (PMRs), among others. The Company's mobile telecommunication devices are distributed within a number of categories, such as Comfort, Classic, Rugged and Smart. The Company also offers waterproof devices and product line for seniors. It operates after-sales service points across Poland.

name: BOOMBIT
businessSummary: Boombit SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the software development. The Company focuses on the production and publishing of games and applications for mobile devices. It specializes in development of various game modes, including Driving Simulator, Arcade, Social Sports Betting, Casino, Puzzle, Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA), Card, Hidden Object, Match-3 and Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game (MMORPG), among others. The Company's games portfolio includes such titles as Idle Coffee Corp, Tiny Gladiators, Darts Club, Tanks A Lot, Build a Bridge, Driving School and Dancing Line. Its applications are designed for iOS and Android mobile operating systems, as well as Nintendo Switch platform.

name: DR MIELE COSMED GROUP
businessSummary: Dr Miele Cosmed Group SA, formerly Global Cosmed SA is a Poland-based company active in the cosmetic sector. The Company is engaged in production and distribution of cosmetics and detergents. The Company’s brand portfolio comprises such products as Apart Natural and Malwa, personal wash and care products, Bobini Baby and Bobini, personal wash and care products for kids, Sofin Global, fabric softeners and washing liquids, Kret, cleaning detergents, and Robots, products for dishwashers. The Company sells its products domestically as well as abroad, in such countries as Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Germany, the Russian Federation, Albania, Kosovo and the United States. The Company is a part of the Dr. Miele Cosmed Group.

name: PJP MAKRUM
businessSummary: PJP Makrum SA, formerly known asrProjprzem Makrum SA, is a Poland-based company active in the construction industry. Its business is divided into four segments: Docking Solutions, Steel Constructions, Industrial Construction, and Other, which includes real estate leasing and rental, among others. The Docking Solutions offering includes the production, sale and maintenance of dock levellers, loading ramps, dock shelters, sectional industrial doors and high-speed shutters, among others, under the PromStahl brand. The Steel Constructions comprises mainly industrial halls and warehouses for the power, chemical and environmental industries. The Company operates as a general contractor of construction projects, specializing in the construction of equipped production halls, and additionally delivering also office buildings, shopping centers, supermarkets and residential buildings.

name: ZAKLADY URZADZEN KOTLOWYCH STAPORKOW
businessSummary: Zaklady Urzadzen Kotlowych Staporkow SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacture of equipment for the power engineering industry. Its offer is divided into three segments: Energy Science, including automatic stokers, scraper conveyors for slag handling, worm conveyors, biomass and coal combustion; Environment protections, including pulsation filters and two cyclone separator filters, among others; Infrastructure, including steel constructions, as well as steel moulds for columns and special wall and ceiling formwork systems. Its products are used in heat power engineering, heat power industry, sugar factories, cement mills, steelworks and foundries, and construction companies. Additionally, the Company offers services in areas of designing, consulting, and servicing. As of December 31, 2011 the Company was 66%-owned by Stalmax S.J.

name: TOWER INVESTMENTS
businessSummary: Tower Investments SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and engineering sector. The Company focuses on the development of turnkey commercial and residential projects. Its project phases include land acquisition, obtaining administrative permissions, building design and construction, as well as sale to investor. The Company's projects portfolio comprises retail stores, shopping malls and residential buildings. In addition, the Company operates shopping centers under the SHOPIN brand name. It owns a number of subsidiaries, such as Tower Swiebodzice Sp z o o and Shopin Plock Sp z o o. The Company is controlled by Floryda 1 Sp z o o SKA.

name: INTER CARS
businessSummary: Inter Cars SA is a Poland-based car and truck parts importer and distributor. The Company’s offering includes spare parts for passenger and commercial cars and trucks, motorcycle parts, semitrailers, tuning products, car accessories, garage equipment, as well as gas installation services and production of semi-trailers. It operates through 149 branches in Poland, and 106 branches abroad, located in such countries as: the Czech Republic, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Ukraine, Lithuania, Hungary, Croatia, Latvia, Italy and Romania. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated 20 subsidiaries, including Inter Cars Ukraine LCC, Lauber Sp. z o.o., Q-Service Sp. z o.o., Inter Cars Ceska Republika, Feber Sp. z o.o. and Inter Cars Slovenska Republika, among others.

name: CZERWONA TOREBKA
businessSummary: Czerwona Torebka SA is a Poland-based company active in the real estate sector. The Company manages retail centers and offers premises for lease. The Company focuses on franchise systems in the areas of pharmaceuticals, gastronomy, clothing, footwear and jewelry, among others. It also has its own grocery retail chain Warzywniak. It operates through Syngrapha Sp z o o

name: MBANK
businessSummary: mBank SA, previously BRE Bank SA, is a Poland-based commercial bank. Its services are divided in four divisions: Corporate banking, including domestic and foreign transactions, payment cards, financial risk management, investment of excess cash and other services, financial management, trade finance, financial consulting and other services for small and medium enterprises as well as for corporate and institutional customers; Private banking, offering comprehensive management of assets, both financial and non-financial, loans, payment cards and concierge; Retail banking and Financial services, including offer for corporate clients and provision of such services as leasing, factoring, wealth management and insurance, among others.

name: YARRL
businessSummary: Yarrl SA, formerly Unima 2000 Systemy Teleinformatyczne SA is a Poland-based company, which operates in the industry of data communications technologies. It offers business solutions to companies mostly on the domestic market. The Company designs, implements and integrates business and IT systems, covering fields such as analytics and data processing, integration and automation of business processes ,Information and Communication Technology services and RPA solutions. The Company also offers Call Center systems and Contact Centers, as well as providing other solutions based on voice communication with the client such as IVR, PDS, speech analytics and voice biometrics. In addition, The Company provides consultancy and maintenance services.

name: ASM GROUP
businessSummary: ASM Group SA is a Poland-based holding company engaged in sales and outsourcing support. The Company is a parent of a group, which consists of several companies specializing in areas of sales promotion, consulting and outsourcing, merchandising, field marketing, products exhibition and marketing research, among others. The Company operates through the following business segments: Merchandising, Outsourcing of the Sales Forces, Field Marketing, Corporate and Other Services. The Company's service offerings include mobile, stationary, weekend and visual merchandising, event and exhibit organization, cross-selling, shelf monitoring, mystery shopping, customer satisfaction survey and point-of-sale (POS) design, among others. Outsourcing services include recruitment and training of professional sales teams, their supervision and reporting their results, as well as employee leasing and temporary engagement. The Company, through its subsidiaries, is active in Poland, Italy and Germany.

name: REMAK ENERGOMONTAZ
businessSummary: Remak Energomontaz SA, formerly know as Przedsiebiorstwo Modernizacji Urzadzen Energetycznych Remak SA (Remak) is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of engineering services. Its main services comprise the repairs and modernization of steam and water boilers, as well as the assembly of power engineering equipment, fumes desulphurization installations, electrofilters, industrial installations and pipelines. In addition, the Company provides services related to repairs, modernizations and assembly of power engineering facilities such as water and steam boilers, pressure and non-pressure vessels, steam pipelines and repairs of pressure vessels. Remak completed numerous projects on the domestic market and abroad. It operates through its offices in Germany and the Netherlands. As of December 31, 2011, the Company’s main shareholders were Mostostal Warszawa SA, Legg Mason Zarzadzanie Aktywami SA, and PZU SA. In July 2013, the Company sold its entire stake in Rozruch SA.

name: BORYSZEW
businessSummary: Boryszew SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the aluminum production. The Company's activities are divided into six business segments: Aluminum, which focuses on the manufacture of aluminum wires and wire rods, sheets and strips; Copper, which produces copper pipes, tubes, alloy rods, bars and castings; Zinc and Lead, which provides lead alloys and refined lead from recycled batteries; Automotive, which is responsible for the production of plastic and metal car components, as well as automotive hoses; Chemicals, which offers various chemicals and plastic materials, such as antifreezes for car coolers, lubricants, pyrotechnic products and polyethylene terephthalate (PET) flakes, and Trade, which includes distribution of metals and real estate activities, among others. The Company also separates a new business segment in the metals which focuses on circular economy and sustainability goals. The Company operates through numerous subsidiaries in Europe, Asia and the Americas.

name: BEST
businessSummary: BEST SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the debt recovery sector. The Company recovers debt portfolios and offers debt recovery services, especially for banks, financial institutions and telecommunication companies. It also offers advice on a range of the debt recovery services, including pre-litigation, High Court proceedings, as well as enforcement and insolvency actions. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated one subsidiary, BEST TFI SA, engaged in the collection of non-performing loans.

name: POLWAX
businessSummary: Polwax SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the oil and gas refining and marketing industry. The Company specializes in the production and distribution of refined and deodorized paraffin, waxes and specialty industrial paraffin compositions. Its product portfolio includes products designed for candle-making industry, specialized products used for the production of candles, anti-corrosion agents, products designed for the manufacture of grave-lights, for wood impregnation, special applications, as well as products designed for contact with foodstuffs, anti-caking agents for fertilizers, casting waxes, hot-melt adhesives, grave-lights and candles. The Company’s products are used in such industries as wood processing, production of varnishes and paints, manufacture of explosives, paper and packaging, as well as rubber and food industry, among others.

name: BANK POLSKA KASA OPIEKI
businessSummary: Bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA (Bank Pekao SA) is a Poland-based commercial bank. It offers services to both individual and corporate clients. The Bank’s business is divided into four segments: Retail banking, offering scope of banking activities to the individual customers, small and micro enterprises; Private banking, offering banking activities to wealthiest individual customers; Corporate and Investment banking, offering banking activities to medium and large enterprises, including activities on the inter-bank market, investments in debt securities and other instruments; and Assets and Liabilities Management and other, covering supervision and monitoring of fund transfers.

name: ERBUD
businessSummary: Erbud SA is a Poland-based company active in the construction and engineering sector. It operates in three segments: large-volume building, road engineering, and energy sector construction. It is engaged in the development of public utilities, such as hospitals, swimming pools and schools; commercial buildings, including shopping and services centers; residential buildings, encompassing housing estates, multifamily buildings; hotels and industrial constructions and halls, such as steel and reinforced concrete frames. It is also involved in the modernization and renovation of existing objects, construction of infrastructure and specialist building, such as railroads and road tunnels. The Company operates on the domestic market and in Germany and Ireland. It is a parent of a capital group and operates such subsidiaries as Erbud International Sp z oo, GWI GmbH and Przedsiebiorstwo Budownictwa Drogowo Inzynieryjnego SA, among others.

name: PMPG POLSKIE MEDIA
businessSummary: PMPG Polskie Media SA, formerly Platforma Mediowa Point Group SA, is a Poland-based company that is engaged in the media and marketing sector. The Company is a parent entity of a capital group and operates through a number of subsidiaries, including: Media Point Group Sp z o o, involved in press and Internet publications; Admobile Sp z o o, a mobile marketing agency; BTL Point Group Sp z o o, an advertising agency; Gemtext Sp z o o, a printing house; News PR Sp z o o, a public relations agency; Media Works SA, an advertising agency; Bluetooth and Marketing Services Sp z o o, broker in the field of Internet advertising; TV Point Group Sp z o o, active in broadcasting industry, and Sport24.pl Sp z o o, a company managing sport.24.pl websote, among others.

name: MOVIE GAMES
businessSummary: Movie Games SA is a Poland-based computer game developer. The Company produces a diversified portfolio of computer games aimed at the international market. The Company publishes approximately 10 new game titles a year. It covers the whole development process, from building the creative team, through development, production and testing, to publishing of the finished title, its marketing and distribution. The Company focuses on digital distribution through gaming platforms, such as Steam. In addition, the Company distributes select titles through traditional channels in cooperation with international publishers. The Company develops games in such genres as flight simulators, psychological horror, tower defense, first person shooter, survival horror and role-playing games, among others. Some of its titles include 303 Squadron: Battle of Britain, Lust for Darkness, Orbital Racer, Project Remedium, Soulblight and Treasure Hunter Simulator.

name: DIGITREE GROUP
businessSummary: Digitree Group SA, formerly Sare SA, is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the digital marketing industry. The Company provides software solutions, as well as e-marketing services and sales support in the domestic market and internationally. It organizes activities into six segments, based on the operations of the Group companies. SARE offers tools for implementing integrated and targeted communication via e-mail and mobile channels. INIS and JU specialize in e-mail marketing campaigns. Salelifter, Adepto and Cashback Services are engaged in database building, lead generation, financial intermediation and cashback services. VideoTarget provides solutions in the area of video advertising. Sales Intelligence provides marketing tools and software for the e-commerce market. Fast White Cat specializes in creating online shops.

name: TEN SQUARE GAMES
businessSummary: Ten Square Games SA is a Poland-based mobile games development company. The Company is focused on 3D simulation hobby games for people who seek outdoor experiences on their mobile devices, like fishing or hunting games. Its games are available on social platforms, a network of partner sites, as well as on Google Play, App Store and Microsoft Store.

name: NEW TECH CAPITAL
businessSummary: New Tech Capital SA, formerly Invista SA, is a Poland-based business consulting company. The Company’s services portfolio includes financial risk management, financial and strategic advisory, audit services, currency and commodity market analysis, private equity management, as well as mergers and takeovers. The offer is mainly addressed to the small and medium companies. In addition, Invista SA offers trainings in the field of investment risk management and currency market analyses. As of December 31, 2011, the Company wholly owned a brokerage house, Invista Dom Maklerski SA.

name: IZOLACJA JAROCIN
businessSummary: Izolacja Jarocin SA is a Poland-based producer and wholesaler of asphalt roofing materials. The Company’s range of products includes various types of asphalt roofing, including paper-based and thermally sealed; mastic asphalt; asphalt shingles with fiberglass filing; construction putty, including resin- and asphalt resin-based, as well as other adhesives and insulation mixtures. Additionally, it provides specialized equipment, tools and services for asphalt roofing installation. The Company operates a production facility in Jarocin, Poland. It offers thermally sealed tar papers under the Jarbit and Jarplast brands.

name: SCANWAY
businessSummary: Scanway SA, formerly Scanway Sp z o o, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in manufacturing of instruments and appliances for measuring, testing and navigation. The Company operates in the testing and measuring equipment business sector. The Company offers measurement systems, primarily vision systems, and laser processing systems. The Company offers completed laser processing stations, such as engraving and marking, as well as integration and technological consulting services. The Company consists of Industry operating in the industrial area team and Space designing and supplying commercial optical instruments for the space industry team. The Company is an experienced team of engineers and specialists in vision technology: opticians, programmers, FPGA specialists, mechatronics and automation engineers.

name: TRANS POLONIA
businessSummary: Trans Polonia SA is a Poland-based transportation company. It is engaged in the international road transportation of chemicals, bitumen food liquids, using auto trailers and tank containers. The Company operates throughout Europe, focuses on the operational management from its Polish office in Tczew and two foreign offices based in France and the Netherlands. The Company’s clients are petrochemical and trading companies located in Europe, which produce and trade bitumen, oils, glues, latex, resins, and paraffins. The main shareholder of the Company is Vataro Holdings Ltd. The Company operates through Euro Investor Sp z o o.

name: ERSTE BANK POLSKA
businessSummary: Erste Bank Polska SA, formerly Santander Bank Polska SA, is a Poland-based commercial bank. The Company offers a range of banking services for individual, small and medium-sized enterprise, and corporate clients. It operates through a nationwide network of retail branches in Poland, as well as automatic teller machines (ATM). The Company offers services including personal and business accounts, loans and mortgages, securities intermediation, leasing, factoring, asset and fund management, insurance, and shares trading. The Bank issues debit and credit cards and provides customers with access to their accounts through digital channels, including online banking, fixed-line telephony, and mobile banking platforms.

name: POZNANSKA KORPORACJA BUDOWLANA PEKABEX
businessSummary: Poznanska Korporacja Budowlana Pekabex SA is a Poland-based company operating in the construction and engineering industry. The company operates in the subsequent sectors: prefabrication, construction services, implementation of development projects on its own account, production services, rental services. Within the Prefabrication segment, The Company undertakes a range of activities related to the design, production, delivery, and assembly of prefabricated structures. This includes design work, followed by the manufacturing of components, as well as delivery and assembly of prefabricated structures both nationally and abroad. Within the Construction Services segment, The Company provides comprehensive contract execution services as a contractor with the participation of external subcontractors.

name: APS ENERGIA
businessSummary: APS Energia SA is a Poland-based designer and producer of uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems for industrial application. The Company has three operating segments: Power Supply Systems, which include manufacturing of emergency power systems, alternating and direct current (AC/DC) receivers, rectifiers, uninterruptible power sources, inverters, frequency converters, active filters, power system surveillance systems and fuel cells, among others; Industrial Power Engineering Services, which include design, assembly, installation, commissioning, warranty and post-warranty service of the power supply equipment, among others, and Other segments, which provide training and consultancy in the field of power systems for industry and research institutions. The Company's solutions are offered worldwide, with applications in industrial markets, such as oil and gas, power industry, nuclear and renewable energy, traction and transport, telecommunication and others.

name: GRUPA FORTE
businessSummary: Grupa Forte SA, formerly Fabryki Mebli Forte SA, is a Poland-based company, which is engaged in the production of furniture. It specializes in home, office and kitchen furniture. Its home furniture offerings include furniture systems for the lounge, dining room, bedroom, living room, sitting room, study and children's room, as well as wall units. The Company's office furniture offerings include a range of system furniture, which consists of number of cabinets in different designs and dimensions. The offer also includes complex computer stands. In the area of kitchen furniture, its product line consists of ready-made cabinets that can be put together in different arrangements, as well as customized kitchen projects. The Company operates through subsidiaries, including MV Forte GmbH, Forte Mobel AG, Forte Mobila Srl and TM Handel Sp z o o, among others.

name: FOODHUB
businessSummary: Foodhub SA, formerly known as Pamapol SA is a Poland-based company mainly engaged in the food processing industry. The Company's offer comprises meat and vegetable products, including ready to eat meals, canned food, tinned meat, pates, soups, poultry sausages and spices. The Company is also engaged in the wholesale trade of its product s, as well as glass and glass products production and wholesale. The Company is the dominant entity in the Pamapol Group, which consists of subsidiaries, including WZPOW Kwidzyn Sp z o o, Mitmar Sp z o o, among others. The main shareholder of the Company is Amerykanka Struktura Sp z o o SKA.

name: MEX POLSKA
businessSummary: Mex Polska SA is a Poland-based holding company engaged in gastronomy sector. As of January 9, 2012, the Company operated 10 restaurants under the brand name The Mexican, with Mexican national cuisine, located in Warsaw, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw, Cracow, Sopot and Zakopane; two restaurants under the brand name Browar De Brasil with Brazilian national cuisine and own breweries, located in Lodz an Warsaw; and four music clubs, Klub Desperados and Opera Club, both located in Warsaw, Klub Bedroom located in Lodz and Klub Bed, located in Wroclaw. The Company operated though subsidiaries and affiliates, such as Mex Master Sp z o o, Mag Sp z o o, Mex k Sp z o o, Ase Sp z o o, Villa Sp z o o, Aad Sp z o o, Mex P Sp z o o and Cafe II Sp z o o. The Company was 57.88%-owned by Milduks Limited.

name: OPONEO PL
businessSummary: Oponeo.pl SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the online distribution of tires and other automotive parts. The Company’s products portfolio includes approximately 100 brands of tires for cars, trucks and off-road vehicles, aluminum and steel wheel rims and other automotive parts, as well as car audio articles and cosmetics. Oponeo.pl SA provides its services in wholesale and retail trade using e-commerce tools. The Company’s products are sold through Polish Internet portals, such as opony.com, opony.pl, ogumienie.com, oponeo.pl, felgi.pl and motostrada.pl, as well as through foreign Internet portals. It operates throught Opony.pl Sp z o o, Oponeo Brandhouse Sp z o o, Oponeo.co.uk Ltd, Oponeo.com Inc and Autocentrum.pl SA, among others.

name: RELPOL
businessSummary: Relpol SA is a Polish company specializing in electromagnetic relays. The Company is a producer and wholesaler of relays, industrial automation equipment, control systems, and radiation portal monitors. The Company’s product line is divided into four basic lines, including plug-in power relay, used in industrial applications; printed circuit board (PCB) power relays used as power components in electronic devices; interface relays for automations systems; and relays sockets for connection of relays. Additionally, the Company’s product offering includes: contactors and thermal relays, time relays, monitoring relays, motor protection circuit breakers, lighting and overvoltage protection devices, push-buttons and switches. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated eight subsidiaries, based in Ukraine, Belarus, the Russian Federation, Lithuania, France, the United Kingdom and Poland.

name: CREEPY JAR
businessSummary: Creepy Jar SA is a Poland-based independent survival simulator games developer. The company is a creator of Dying Light; The Following; Dead Island; Dead Island: Riptide, Call of Juarez; The Cartel, Mad Riders, Nail’d, GTI Racing and Xpand Rally Xtreme. The Company is focused on development of its new project Green Hell. The Green Hell is a survival simulator set in a explorable open world of the Amazon Rainforest. The goal of the player is to survive in this harsh and uncharted environment.

name: ONDE
businessSummary: Onde SA, former Przedsiebiorstwo Budownictwa Drogowo Inzynieryjnego SA, is a Poland-based construction company. It operates in the construction, road, and electrical engineering sector nationwide also providse services related to the construction of photovoltaic.

name: POWSZECHNA KASA OSZCZEDNOSCI BANK POLSKI
businessSummary: Powszechna Kasa Oszczednosci Bank Polski SA is a Poland-based commercial bank. The Bank’s operations comprise cash deposits, maintenance of accounts, granting loans and cash advances, granting and confirming bank guarantees, clearing cash transactions, issuance of cards and conducting transactions with the use of cards, as well as conducting forward transactions. At the same time, the Bank conducts brokerage activities through its brokerage house. It also provides specialist financial services relating to leasing, factoring, investment funds, pension funds and Internet banking. It conducts investment and development operations in the real estate sector. It addresses its offer to both private and corporate clients. On April 4, 2014, the Company acquired Nordea Bank Polska SA.

name: PBS FINANSE
businessSummary: PBS Finanse SA is a Poland‑based company primarily engaged in the real estate development and investment industry. The Company focuses on development activities in the residential construction market, including investment in housing projects and real estate assets. Their key product is residential property development projects, which are real estate investment and construction development activities. It aims to generate revenue through development and sale or management of residential real estate assets while utilizing internally available financial resources for project financing.

name: LIBET
businessSummary: Libet SA is a Poland-based company engaged in construction materials industry. The Company manufactures and sells sett and other concrete surfacing materials, such as paving blocks, pavement blocks and sandstone. The Company has production facilities in 14 factories and has 24 production lines. Libet SA also has a distribution network of Authorized Retail Outlets and sells its products directly to road construction companies, warehouses and general construction concerns. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated two wholly owned subsidiaries, Libet 200 Sp. z o.o. and Libet Libiaz Sp. z o.o.

name: GOBARTO
businessSummary: Gobarto SA, formerly Polski Koncern Miesny Duda SA, is a Poland-based company active in the meat processing and distribution industry. The Company focuses on the red meat production. Its main line of business is purchasing and slaughtering of pigs and cattle, as well as butchery services. Apart from sides of pork and quarters of beef, the range of products includes cuts of pork and beef, culinary meat, pluck and fats. Moreover, the Company's offer includes game meat and grains and oilseeds production. As a complement to its production and trading activities, the Company offers services with regard to the freezing and storage of foodstuffs that require specialist refrigeration facilities. It operates within a group comprising approximately 30 companies based in Poland, Ukraine and Germany. The main shareholder of the Company is Cedrob SA. It operates through Meat Pack Sp z o o. The main shareholder of the Company is Cedrob SA.

name: BLOOBER TEAM
businessSummary: Bloober Team SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in video games development. The Company focuses on designing and publishing games for consoles and mobile devices. Its projects range includes multi- and single-player games, which stories are placed in imaginary world. The Company's portfolio comprises a number of game titles, such as Layers Of Fear, BRAWL, Medium and Scopophobia. The Company sells games online via digital distribution network. Its video games are created for PlayStation, Xbox, Android system and Steam platform. The Company operates through iFun4all Sp z oo, iPlacement Sp z oo and Neuro Code Sp z oo, Digital Games Services Sp z oo and WFH Games Sp z oo, among others.

name: SUNEX
businessSummary: Sunex SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the electrical components and equipment industry. The Company is the manufacturer of solutions in the branch of solar technique. Sunex SA offers various products, such as heat pumps, sun collectors, pump groups and fitting, mounting sets, connection sets, tanks, regulators, heat carriers, expansion vessels and filling stations. In addition, the Company organizes trainings to the installers on the field of building, operation mode and selection proper solar systems. It operates internationally.

name: STARHEDGE
businessSummary: Starhedge SA. is a Poland-based company specializing in investment and holding activities. The Company is engaged in investments across the financial, technology, and real estate sectors, including property development projects. Its activities include managing investment holdings, evaluating and pursuing business opportunities, and participating in residential real estate development initiatives. The Company operates through a diversified investment approach and is involved in the allocation and management of capital across selected industries. In addition, STARHEDGE S.A. focuses on activities related to corporate investments, asset management, and the development of projects within its investment portfolio, with operations spanning multiple areas of economic activity.

name: PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO HYDRAULIKI SILOWEJ HYDR
businessSummary: Przedsiebiorstwo Hydrauliki Silowej Hydrotor SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the industrial machinery sector. Its main product groups consist of the hydraulic elements, such as the gear pumps, combine harvesters, bucket loaders, forklift trucks and vans; the hydraulic selector valves with manual and electronic controls, bucket loaders and building machines; the engine oil pumps and the pressure relief and non-return valves, used in forklift trucks, building and road construction machines, combine harvesters and steering block units. In addition, the Company produces the hydraulic power source units, piston pins, toothed and piston flow meters and tool holders. It exports its products to Germany, France, Slovakia, Iraq, Egypt, the Russian Federation, Denmark, the United Kingdom and Hungary, among others. In September 2013, it sold 57.05% stake of Defka's share capital.

name: 11 BIT STUDIOS
businessSummary: 11 BIT STUDIOS SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the game development industry. Its product portfolio includes four games: Anomaly Korea, Sleepwalker’s Journey, Funky Smugglers and Anomaly Warzone Earth. The Company produces video games for different devices, such as video consoles, personal computers (PC), and Apple products (iPhone, iPad), among others.

name: AIRWAY MEDIX
businessSummary: Airway Medix SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the biotechnology and medical research industry. The Company focuses on the research, development and commercialization of devices for single use in mechanically ventilated patients in intensive care units (ICU), and patients with life-threatening and anesthesiology division. It offers closed suction system, a closed cleaning system for simple hygiene treatment, endotracheal intubation tubes and oral care solution for cleaning the mouth.

name: CLEAN&CARBON ENERGY
businessSummary: Clean&Carbon Energy SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the real estate operations. The Company’s main activities are buying and selling real property as well as renting and managing owned and leased properties. It rents properties in Szczecin, Gorzow Wielkopolski, Stargard Szczecinski and Cecenowo.

name: ING BANK SLASKI
businessSummary: ING Bank Slaski SA is a Poland-based commercial Bank. The Bank divides its business into two segments: Retail Banking segment and Corporate Banking segment. Its offer includes currents accounts, savings, credits and loans credit and paying cards, insurances, electronic banking, broker activities and fund management and other activities connected with finance, insurance and pension funds. As of December 31, 2012, the Bank’s subsidiaries and affiliated entities were ING Securities SA, Centrum Banku Slaskiego Sp. z o.o., ING ABL Polska SA, ING Uslugi dla Biznesu SA, Solver Sp. z o.o. and ING Powszechte Towarzystwo Emerytalne SA. The Bank’s major shareholder was ING Bank NV, with a 75% stake of its capital.

name: BUMECH
businessSummary: BUMECH SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the coal mining support and machinery industry. The Company provides its services in three segments: drilling of underground headings; servicing, operational maintenance and machine overhauls; and manufacturing of mining machines and equipment. It also makes industrial installations and devices for other sectors of the economy, such as power engineering, energy, ore and mineral mining. In addition, it is an authorized seller of Katowicki Holding Weglowy SA and offers coal from such mines as Myslowice-Wesola, Wujek, and Murcki - Staszic. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated one wholly owned subsidiary, Bumech - Technika Gornicza Sp. z o.o.

name: PRZEDSIEBIORSTWO PRZEMYSLU SPOZYWCZEGO P
businessSummary: Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslu Spozywczego PEPEES SA is a Poland-based potato processing plant. The Company is a manufacturer of natural starch products produced from genetically modified organism free (GMO-free) agricultural products. The Company is primarily focused on mannufacturing potato starch, which is used in food, pharmaceutical, paper, textile and chemical industries for giving a product proper texture, appearance, moistness, consistency and storage durability. The Company offers also maltodextrin, component of powdered products and used in food industry; crystalline glucose, used in pharmaceutical, foodstuff, and chemical industry, as well as a product for direct consumption and a sweetener; anhydrous glucose, mainly used in pharmaceutical industry for production of drugs and supplements; potato protein; glucose syrups widely used in confectionary industry and potato grits.

name: PZU
businessSummary: Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen SA (PZU SA) is a Poland-based joint stock company operating in the sectors of property and casualty insurance. PZU SA is the parent company for numerous entities comprising the PZU Group. The Company provides property and casualty insurance in terms of gross written premiums, with motor insurance for retail and corporate customers as its principal product. PZU Zycie provides life insurance in terms of gross written premiums with group and individual life insurance as its principal products. PTE PZU manages OFE PZU Zlota Jesien, an open pension fund. TFI PZU offers participation units in open investment funds, including specialized open funds; investment certificates in closed investment fund; investment plans; and pension schemes, including Employee Pension Schemes and Individual Pension Accounts. On September 15, 2014, the Company acquired 100% stake in Link4.

name: BANK MILLENNIUM
businessSummary: Bank Millennium SA is a Poland-based commercial bank. Its product and service offer includes personal accounts, debit and credit cards, overdraft limits, cash and mortgage loans, saving accounts, term deposits, investment funds, brokerage services, structured products and insurance products. Its business is divided into three segments, including Retail Banking, providing services for individual customers and small enterprises; Corporate Banking, providing services for corporate customers; and Treasury and investment operations, offering financial instruments for both individual and corporate customers. As of December 31, 2012, the Bank rendered its services through a network of 447 outlets located in Polish cities, Internet banking (Millenet), telephone banking and a network of automated teller machines (ATMs). It operated six subsidiaries, including Millennium Leasing Sp. z o.o. and Millennium Dom Maklerski SA, among others. Banco Comercial Portugues SA held a 65.51% stake in the Bank

name: BIOTON
businessSummary: Bioton SA is a Poland-based company active in the pharmaceutical sector. The Company is engaged in research, development and wholesale trade of pharmaceutical and biotechnological products. The Company's portfolio consists of oral hypoglycemic drugs (metformin and glimepride) as well as recombinant human insulin in pharmaceutical substance form and for injections. Additionally, the Company provides advertising services. As of December 31, 2011, the Company formed a capital group and operated through its subsidiaries, including BIOTON TRADE Sp. z o.o., Mindar Holdings Ltd, Germonta Holdings Ltd, Tricel SA, SciGen Ltd and BioPartners Holdings AG, among others. On June 12, 2014, it sold a 50% stake in Copernicus Sp. z o.o.

name: ENERGOINSTAL
businessSummary: Energoinstal SA is a Poland-based manufacturer of power boilers. Its offer includes power steam boilers, high-duty power water boilers, steam biofuel boilers, boilers and auxiliary devices for waste incinerating plants, boiler houses, supporting structures of boilers and industrial objects, oil and gas burners, gas and oil pressure reducing-metering stations, finned tubes, environmental protection installations and equipment, central heating systems, processing heat installation, water and sewage systems, ventilation and air-conditioning systems, thermal insulations, energetic pipelines and anticorrosion painting, as well as installations made of precious steels for the food industry. The Company also offers assembly and maintenance services. Energoinstal SA is a parent company of the Capital Group that comprises Energoinstal Sp z o o, Instal Bielsko Sp z o o, Instal Development Sp z o o, among others. On November 15, 2013, WAM Sp z o o acquired 61.80% stake in the Company.

name: CYFROWY POLSAT
businessSummary: Cyfrowy Polsat SA is a Poland-based pay digital television platform operator. It is composed of Cyfrowy Polsat, direct-to-home (DTH) platform, and Telewizja Polsat, commercial television (TV) broadcaster. It operates through one business segment: Retail business, comprising DTH, broadband Internet in High Speed Packet Access (HSPA) and Long Term Evolution (LTE) technologies, as well as mobile telephony services in a mobile virtual network operator (MVNO) model; and Broadcasting and television production, offering TV channels consisting of general entertainment, sports, news, business, lifestyle, movie and children’s channels. On May 7, 2014, the Company acquired 100% stake in Metelem Holding Company Ltd. It operates through Midas SA, through Polkomtel SA.

name: SKARBIEC HOLDING
businessSummary: Skarbiec Holding SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the field of investment management. The Company’s product portfolio comprises: open end funds, such as Skarbiec Akcja, Skarbiec Lokacyjny and Skarbiec Akcji Nowej Europy; closed end funds, including Skarbiec Rynku Nieruchomosci; fund of funds, offering investment in Skarbiec Top Funduszy Akcji, and Skarbiec Top Funduszy Stabilnych, among others; and a number of pension funds. Its products are primarily based on equities and bonds. Furthermore, It provides portfolio and asset management services that are aimed at high net worth individuals (HNWI), as well as corporate and institutional customers. The Company operates through a subsidiary, named Skarbiec TFI SA.

name: VARSAV GAME STUDIOS
businessSummary: Varsav Game Studios SA, formerly Varsav VR SA, is a Poland-based company that focuses its activities in the area of computer games and application production. The company also provides Internet Technology (IT)services to external entities and creates technological and business facilities for projects in the new technologies sector. In addition, as an additional activity complementing the basic business, the Company conducts activities consisting in providing substantive, technological or financial support for projects from entities in the computer games industry.

name: ANSWEAR COM
businessSummary: Answear.Com SA is a Poland-based company, engaged primarily in the Electronic Shopping and Mail-Order Houses industry. The Company is an owner and operator of the Internet multi-brand clothing shop - Answear.com. The Company offers a wide range of clothing products for men, women, and children. The products offered by the Company include women's dresses, women's sneakers, women's jackets, women's wallets, women's sports bras, women's sweatshirts, women's bags, women's sunglasses, men's jeans, men's jackets, men's shoes, men's T-shirts, men's shorts, men's shirts, and men's sweatshirts. The Company sells products of approximately 150 brands known worldwide and has 150 000 different kinds of products.

name: NOVAVIS GROUP
businessSummary: Novavis Group SA, formerly known as Rubicon Partners SA, is a Poland-based Company engaged in Renewable Energy industry. The Company offers comprehensive services related to the implementation of renewable energy projects at every stage: from design and obtaining all formal approvals (development), through the implementation of orders, material deliveries and physical construction, to effective investor supervision, audits and consulting in the field of energy management in intelligent buildings, as well as optimizing energy-intensive processes in industrial plants. The Company is also engaged in energy storage market, offering solutions related to design and investment preparation. The Company is also providing financing services in the green energy sector and comprehensive implementation of projects on the renewable energy market.

name: COGNOR HOLDING
businessSummary: Cognor Holding SA, formerly Cognor SA, is a Poland-based company that operates in the steel industry. The Company’s activities are divided into four business segments: Scrap, Production, Distribution and Other. The Scrap division focuses on buying, processing, refining and selling of scrap metal and nonferrous scrap. The Production division is responsible for processing scrap metal into steel billets, as well as converting steel billets and nonferrous scrap into finished products. The Distribution division sells various commodities, such as steel products, steel and nonferrous scrap and steel billets. The Other division includes materials recycling, among others. The Company's products range comprises metal bars, steel sheet, plates, pipes and rods, as well as sheet zinc and tin plates, among others. It operates through a number of subsidiaries, such as Cognor Blachy Dachowe SA, Zlomrex Metal Sp z o o and Huta Stali Jakosciowych SA. The Company is controlled by PS Holdco Sp z o o.

name: CELON PHARMA
businessSummary: Celon Pharma SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the pharmaceuticals manufacture. The Company focuses on research, development and production of generic drugs for cancer, neurological diseases, diabetes and other metabolic disorders treatment, among others. Its products portfolio comprises pills, such as Aromek, Bosentan Celon, Donepex, Ketrel, Lazivir and Valzek, as well as inhalation powder, such as Salmex. The Company's research center develops pharmaceuticals within a number of therapeutic areas, including oncology, neurology, as well as inflammatory and metabolic diseases. The Company is a subsidiary of Glatton sp z o o.

name: 3R GAMES
businessSummary: 3R Games SA, formerly known as HubStyle SA, is a Poland-based company. Main acitity of the Company is publishing of computer games for high-end virtual reality devices and platforms Facebook Oculus Quest 2 PlayStation VR, HTC Vive, Steam VR.

name: PLAYWAY
businessSummary: Playway SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the computer games development. The Company’s activities are divided into two business segments: Computer games and Mobile games. The Computer games division focuses on creating and distributing games for Windows and Mac operating systems. Its game titles include Hard West, Car Mechanic Simulator, Professional Farmer 2014 and Ancient Space, among others. The Mobile games division produces and publishes games, such as Car Mechanic Simulator 2014 Mobile, Cook It Up and Diner Mania, for mobile devices with Android and iOS operating systems. In addition, it develops games for consoles, including PlayStation (PS) and Xbox. The Company distributes its products mainly through online platforms, such as Steam, App Store and Google Play. The Company controls a number of subsidiaries, such as CreativeForge Games SA, Madmind Studio Sp z oo, Atomic Jelly Sp z oo and Fishing Games Sp z oo.

name: BRAS
businessSummary: Bras SA, formerly Inventi SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the provision of renewable energy services. The Company’s activities are divided into three business areas: Project development, which focuses on the creation and implementation of renewable energy projects, collection of construction permissions, provision of environmental studies, as well as coordination of design works before project sale, among others; Energy management, which includes consulting services for individual customers, energy audits and modernization of energy installations, and Consulting, which offers services to companies active in the electric utilities sector, including analysis of energy market, computer systems and corporate structure, as well as financial and legal advisory, among others.

name: KCI
businessSummary: KCI SA is a Poland-based company principally engaged in the real estate projects. The Company focuses its activities on the housing investment, mainly located in Krakow and Warsaw in Poland. The Company leads such investments as Kamienice Herbowe and projects in Zablocie, Poland. KCI SA is a parent entity of a capital group, holding such companies as: Ponar Holding Sp. z o.o., PONAR Real Estate sp. z o.o., active in the real estate sector; KCI Centrum Zablocie sp z o.o., a property owner in Zablocie engaged in the real estate management and Ponar Corporate Center Sp. z o.o. In addition it operates through Gremi Media SA z o o and operates Jupiter SA. The main shareholder of the Company is KCI Park Technologiczny Krowodrza SA, a unit of Gremi Sp z o o, and Gremi Sp z o o. It merged with Gremi Inwestycje SA.

name: TEXT
businessSummary: Text SA, formerly known as Livechat Software SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the software industry. The Company is a producer and global provider of software as a service (SaaS) LiveChat, communication software for business. It enables fast and intuitive communication between company's employees and customers visiting corporate Website. The application also tracks customers’ activity on a Website. The Company produces and distributes software for business-to-consumer (B2C) and business-to-business (B2B) communication. Its product portfolio includes three types of LiveChat plans: Solo, dedicated to single user and offering such features as unlimited chats, ticketing system, enhanced security and basic reporting; Team, for numerous teams that additionally includes chat routing and groups creation; and Enterprise, for companies that, additionally to previous ones, provides advanced reporting, work scheduler and unlimited visits on a Website.

name: MDI ENERGIA
businessSummary: MDI Energia SA, formally Skystone Capital SA, is a Poland-based company investing in enterprises operating in renewable energy sources sector. The Company is engaged in financing and co-financing investment projects in the renewable energy market by taking up shares and organizing financing by providing loans and subsidies. It evaluates, prepares and executes investment projects aimed at producing green electrical energy and heat. As of December 31, 2011, the Company was the major shareholder of such companies as Ozen Plus Sp z o o, Elektrownie Wodne Zeneris Sp z o o, Biogaz Zeneris Sp z o o and Energia Trojanowo Sp z o o. On June 11, 2014, the Company sold 54.85% stake in Viatron SA to Cresco Financial Advisors Sp z o o. The main shareholder of the Company is Ipopema 12 FIZAN.

name: ARCHICOM
businessSummary: Archicom SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in the homebuilding industry. The Company is active in the construction of multifamily homes and commercial spaces. The Firm's portfolio encompasses of several projects, such as Olimpia Port, Ogrody Hallera, Sloneczne Inwestycje, Spirala Czasu, Na Ustroniu, Na Krzyckiej, Cztery Pory Roku, Rozy Wiatrow, Siena and Ksiezno, as well as Liskego 7, West Forum and Renaissance BC. The Company operates multiple channels of sale, including the Internet. In Archicom Studio, a company operating within the Group Archicom, the Company develops the architectural concepts. Archicom SA concentrates its activities mainly in Wroclaw. The Firm operates through Altona Investments Sp z o o.

name: KRUK
businessSummary: Kruk SA is a Poland-based company, which is engaged in the business support industry. The Company is a multi-operator, which offers loss prevention and debt collection services. The Company divides its business into two main operating segments: Debt Purchase, including acquisition of non-performing debt portfolios, and Debt Collection Outsourcing, offering fee-based collection of debt on client’s behalf, focused on consumer and corporate loans. The Company provides services to financial institutions and large corporate customers. It manages receivables of banks, credit intermediaries, leasing companies and digital platform providers, among others. The Company’s operating activities concentrate in a number of countries, such as Poland, Romania, Czech Republic, Slovakia and Spain. The Company's subsidiaries include Kruk Deutschland GmbH, Presco Investments Sarl and Espand Soluciones de Gestion y Recuperacion de Deuda SL, among others.

name: JASTRZEBSKA SPOLKA WEGLOWA
businessSummary: Jastrzebska Spolka Weglowa SA is a Poland-based coking coal producer. The Company’s activities are divided into two sectors: Coal, including extraction and sales of black coal; and Coke, including production and sales of coke and coal derivatives. Additionally, the Company is engaged in natural gas mining and generation, transmission and distribution of electricity. The Company’s products are sold domestically as well as to Germany, Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Hungary, among others. The Company operates five mining plants: Borynia-Zofiowka, Budryk, Jas-Mos, Krupinski and Pniowek.

name: CENTRUM MEDYCZNE ENEL MED
businessSummary: Centrum Medyczne Enel Med SA is a Poland-based company that provides medical services. The Company is the parent company of the ENEL-MED Capital Group. It offers medical services on the Polish healthcare market for both private patients and those using services within the National Health Fund. The Company provides medical services including: basic and specialist outpatient care, including rehabilitation and outpatient procedures, dental care, including implantology, prosthetics and orthodontics, diagnostic imaging tests, hospitalization, including procedures and surgeries in selected specializations in the form of elective surgeries, out-of-home medicine and interventional home visits as well as aesthetic medicine.

name: LOKUM DEWELOPER
businessSummary: Lokum Deweloper SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the construction and engineering industry. The Company offers wide range of commercial and residential buildings, including selling of flats, apartments, houses and parking lots, as well as renting offices and commercial spaces. In addition, Lokum Deweloper SA provides partial finishing flats services, such as building renovation.
