The Company's products portfolio encompasses Lokum Vita, Lokum da Vinci and Lokum de Trevi, among others. It is active in the domestic market, exactly in Wroclaw.

name: GLOBE TRADE CENTRE
businessSummary: Globe Trade Centre SA (GTC) is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the real estate sector. The Company operates within two real estate market segments, including Office and Commercial Space Rental, and Residential Development for Sale. Through subsidiaries, joint ventures and associates, the Company operates commercial and residential real estate companies in Poland, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, the Russian Federation, Slovakia, Hungary and Ukraine. Its portfolio consists of commercial buildings, residential properties and undeveloped plots of land. The Company is engaged in real estate management, as well as real estate purchasing, sales and rental. Among the Company’s clients are such companies as Carrefour, Cora, Zara, Reserved, Peek & Cloopenburg, C&A, H&M, Cinema City and New Yorker, among others. The main shareholder of the Company is LSREF III GTC Investments BV (LSREF).

name: PROCHEM
businessSummary: Prochem SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the engineering and construction and environmental sectors. The Company provides such services as construction, including engineering and design, general contracting, project management, technical consulting, construction work, electrical installations and assembly services and rental of construction equipment; leas of office space; maintenance of installations and industrial plants, public buildings and facilities and housing estates; and technical consulting, development and implementation of new technology, integration of data processing systems. The Company operates several subsidiaries, including Elektromontaz Krakow SA, Teoma SA, Iryd Sp z oo, Prochem Inwestycje Sp z oo and Prochem-Zachod Sp z oo, among others.

name: ML SYSTEM
businessSummary: ML System SA is a Poland-based company active in photovoltaic industry. It focuses primarily on design, engineering and production of building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) cell systems, which generate electrical power from sunlight. The Company’s core business areas include: Research and Development, which includes Research and Development Centre for Photovoltaics, where research in the field of nanotechnology is carried out, including electrochemical properties of nanomaterials, electron structure of radiation converters and quantum dots efficiency, among others; Building Management System, which consist of Energy Management System, a software suite for energy gain visualisation, and Security Systems, including a number of low voltage and high power system installations, as well as Photovoltaic Insulating Glass Units (IGUs), which includes glass processing plant of flat glass and mirrors used in construction, interior furnishing and architecture.

name: COMPERIA PL
businessSummary: Comperia.pl SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the Internet services industry. The Company provides search engine comparison Website. Its product compares mainly financial products, such as loans for private and business clients, mortgages, remortgages, debt consolidations, creditworthiness, bank deposits, investments funds, personal accounts, leasing, factoring and insurance, such as life and non-life insurance, as well as global system for mobile (GMS) communications offers. Its clients are able to search through thematic sections and preferences. In addition, Comperia.pl SA provides reports ranking, analysis, trends in the market for financial products, guides and financial articles about comparable services.

name: ALTA
businessSummary: Alta SA is a Poland-based investment company. It holds a portfolio of companies operating in several market segments, mainly in the real estate sector: Chmielowskie Sp z o o, a special purpose vehicle that implements the Siewierz eco-friendly town project; TUP Property SA, which implements long-term property investments and manages a portfolio of real properties for letting; Port Jachtowy Nieporet Sp z o o, engaged in the management of an inland port and provision of leisure services; X-press Couriers Sp z o o, which provides local courier services; Kino-Centrum Fordon Sp z o o, which controls the construction of the culture and leisure centre in Bydgoszcz, and Centrum Handlowe Bazanty Sp z o o, engaged in the construction of shopping center in Katowice, among others. The Company is controlled by Hlamata Holdings Ltd.

name: GENOMTEC
businessSummary: Genomtec SA is a Poland-based company engaged in biotechnology and medical research business sector and it is operating in the field of clinical diagnostics. The Company is focused on development of of Genomtec ID, a mobile platform for genetic diagnosis in the point of patient care. Its creation and commercialization allows the diagnostic process to be executed in point of care setting, such as: primary care clinics, pharmacies, doctor’s offices, hospital emergency departments (ERs) without the need for complicated and time-consuming laboratory workflow conducted by qualified personnel.

name: CREOTECH QUANTUM
businessSummary: Creotech Quantum SA is a Poland-based company operating in the quantum technology sector, providing systems for quantum communication, time synchronization, and scientific research applications. The Company specializes in the design and manufacture of quantum key distribution systems for secure key exchange, White Rabbit time synchronization systems, Sinara ARTIQ control electronics, and advanced scientific cameras. Its activities are organized around quantum communication solutions, time and frequency distribution systems, and control and measurement electronics supporting research infrastructures. The primary focus of the Company is the application of quantum physics, photonics, and electronic systems to support secure communication, precise time transfer, and coordinated operation of distributed research systems.

name: MULTIQURE
businessSummary: Multiqure SA, formerly known as Pure Biologics SA is a Poland-based biotechnology company engaged in the discovery and development of biologic drug candidates. The Company focuses on research and development activities in oncology and other therapeutic areas. Its technology platforms include antibody- and aptamer-based solutions used in the identification and development of therapeutic candidates targeting specific biological pathways. The Company's pipeline comprises biologic drug candidates, including PB003G, PB004 and PBA-0405. The Company conducts research in immuno-oncology and develops therapeutic programs aimed at addressing unmet medical needs through innovative biologic approaches. In addition to drug discovery activities, it undertakes preclinical research and development work related to the advancement of its therapeutic candidates.

name: NOCTILUCA
businessSummary: Noctiluca SA is a Poland-based company, which is specializing in the synthesis of organic compounds used in optoelectronics (diodes, displays, lasers, photosensitive dyes, solar cells). The main goal of the entiy's project is to develop OLED emitters based on a new class of organic TADF semiconductors (electroluminescence due to thermally active delayed fluorescence) for use in products such as OLED displays and lighting. This technology allows the further development of displays used in smartphones or TVs and improvement of their various parameters as well as economic and performance indicators.

name: PGF POLSKA GRUPA FOTOWOLTAICZNA
businessSummary: PGF Polska Grupa Fotowoltaiczna SA, formerly known as Zastal SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in a real estate rental. The Company’s offer includes commercial and nonresidential property rental, such as offices, warehouses and industrial plants. Through its subsidiaries, it provides such services as international cargo transportation, automotive repair and maintenance, property protection, financial services, railroad cars manufacturing, production of industrial parts and components, as well as repair of engines. It operates the Zastal Industrial Zone, where it offers the rental of industrial space and machinery. The Company owns a number of subsidiaries, such as Zastal Transport Sp z o o, Sundragon SA, Oze Capital SA, Zastal Wagony Sp z o o and Landex Sp z o o.

name: SKYLINE INVESTMENT
businessSummary: Skyline Investment SA is a Poland-based consulting company. As an adviser, the Company gains financial funds for entities through public share offers, mergers, takeovers and debentures emissions. Skyline Investment SA focuses its advisory activities on investing in non-public entities, in which it acts as a financial consultant at the initial public offering. The Company’s subsidiaries include Sky Energy Sp z o o, Skyline Insolvency Solutions Sp z o o, SBS Sp z o o, Skyline Development Sp z o o, Skyline Venture Sp z o o, Skyline Interim Management Sp z o o, Skyline Bio Sp z o o, Polska Grupa Odziezowa SA.

name: LARQ
businessSummary: Larq SA, previously CAM Media SA, is a Poland-based advertising agency. It operates under six segments: Transit Advertising, which includes campaigns on external and internal surfaces of buses and streetcars; Ambient Solutions, which includes spatial installations inside retail outlets and urban display conditions; Mega Format, which includes surface displays on building facades and three dimensional (3D) structures; Event Unlimited, which includes occasional events, integration events and cultural events; Retail Ticket, which includes advertisements on the reserves of cash-register receipt invoices in hypermarket and supermarket chains; and Creative Works, which includes image, product and promotional campaigns, loyalty programs, visual identification design, packaging design and retail outlets interior design. As of December 31, 2011, the Company formed a capital group consisting of five subsidiaries. On December 12, 2012, the Company acquired a 50.49% stake in Brand 24 SA.

name: MANYDEV STUDIO
businessSummary: Manydev Studio SE, formerly Platynowe Inwestycje SE is a Poland-based company, which structure is made up of teams, mainly engages in creating and developing computer games. The Company is implementing various projects, which have playable demo versions and team can collect feedback from players, which is valuable clue in which direction project development should be aimed at. The Company's portfolio of games includes My Museum and Illusion Lands. Manydev Studio cooperates with studios from the Playway group and Playway SA (a company from the gamdev industry that brings capital, know-how, publishing support and also offers the possibility of cross-promotion and cross-selling).

name: CPD
businessSummary: CPD SA, formerly Celtic Property Developments SA, is a Poland-based company that is active in the real estate sector. The Company with its subsidiaries concentrates on on development projects in the market segment of offices and apartments. Its activities include the purchase of lands, on which It constructs apartments or offices, the purchase of existing real properties with a potential for creation of additional value by change of their intended usage, improving of their standard or optimization of their area. The Company has offices in Warsaw, London, Milan and Budapest. It also possesses commercial and residential properties in Montenegro and Hungary. It operates through a number of subsidiaries and sub-subsidiaries, which are based in Sweden, Cyprus, the United Kingdom, Hungary, Italy and Poland.

name: NEXITY GLOBAL
businessSummary: Nexity Global SA, formerly Everest Investments SA, is a Poland-based company, which is involved in the creation of IT solutions for electromobility and the entire modern energy sector, based on the new EU directive RED II. This is related to the dynamic development of infrastructure for electric vehicles in Poland and Europe and the implementation of a comprehensive system as a tool enabling the synergy of renewable energy sources, energy storage and prosumers with electromobility.

name: BIOCELTIX
businessSummary: Bioceltix SA is a Poland-based biopharmaceutical company, which operates in the field of veterinary medicine. The Company deal with the development of candidates for veterinary medicinal products based on the immunomodulatory properties of mesenchymal stem cells used as the active substance of the drug. Entity's products are intended for the treatment of companion animals. The Company carry out research and development works, which enable clinical trials and full registration of medicinal products in the European Medicines Agency, as is the case with medicines and drugs administered to humans.

name: POLTREG
businessSummary: Poltreg SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in biotechnology and medical research. The Company conducts research in the field of autoimmunological diseases. The Company works on a method of healing, that uses t-regulated cells (TREGs). The Firm possesses its own, patented technology to obtain T-regulated lymphocytes, that are used in the therapy. The Company works on therapy for diseases such as type one diabetes, type two diabetes, and multiple sclerosis. In its research, the Company cooperates with multiple specialists from various fields of science. The Company is developing its own research center, which is intended as a basic location for conducting future research activities.

name: CAPTOR THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Captor Therapeutics SA is a Poland-based biopharmaceutical company, which specializes in the development of drugs that cause the targeted degradation of pathogenic proteins. The Company works in the field of neoplastic and autoimmune diseases for which there is no treatment option, or the available methods show therapeutic limitations. The Company covers aspects of early-stage drug development to deliver therapeutics for life-threatening and life-impairing diseases. The broadly applicable Optigrade tm Targeted Protein Degradation (TPD) platform allows for the creation of new drugs.

name: BUMECH DEFENSE PARTNERS
businessSummary: Bumech Defense Partners SA, formerly Capital Partners SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the aerospace and defense business sector. The Company specializes in the manufacturing complete military armored vehicles, combat tanks, specialized components for combat tanks, and self-propelled weapons. The Company is also engaged in the repair and maintenance of military combat vehicles, ships, boats, aircraft as well as spacecraft. Additionally, The Company offers small arms ammunition as well as bombs, depth charges, rockets, grenades, mines, and torpedoes.

name: MEDCAMP
businessSummary: Medcamp SA, formerly T2 Investment SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the real estate operations. The Company is involved in the acquisition, management, redevelopment and upgrade, as well as rental and sale of commercial properties, including office areas and warehouses. In addition, the Company is involved in long-term investments in construction and real estate entities. It conducts rental and redevelopment projects, such as Poznan, Jasielska; Poznan, Komorniki; Poznan, Jasielska, Inkubator; Szamotuly, Dworcowa; among others. The Company aims to build a research and development center in Poznan, specializing in such areas as personalized medicine, genetics, genomics and bioinformatics, supported by artificial intelligence, The Company operates through subsidiaries, including T2 Inkubator Sp z o o, T2 Szamotuly Sp z o o, Polskie Centrum Badan i Rozwoju Sp z o o, among others. The majority shareholder of the Company is Moonrock Enterprise SA.

name: PBG SA W RESTRUKTURYZACJI W LIKWIDACJI
businessSummary: PBG SA w restrukturyzacji w likwidacji is Poland-based company primarily engaged in the construction industry. The Company provides services in the field of comprehensive execution of installations for natural gas, crude oil, as well as, fuels. The Company conduct business as a general contractor, consortium participant or subcontractor in the field of: design, execution, repairs, operation and service in the areas of: extraction and transmission of natural gas and crude oil and storage of natural gas and fuels Liquefied natural gas (LNG) Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) Pentane plus (C5+) and Compressed natural gas (CNG). The Company carries investments involving both the construction of new facilities and the modernization of existing storage facilities along with the accompanying infrastructure.

name: OCTAVA
businessSummary: Octava SA is a Polish-based Real Estate Investment Fund. Initially a restructuring fund with controlling interests in over 30 companies from various sectors, in 2004 the Company entered the real estate market as a financial investor. Octava SA's main investment target are medium term, medium size real estate projects both commercial and residential. The Company pursues a goal based on the investment portfolio of up to ten medium-sized real estate projects at a time. The Company's main shareholder is Elliott Management Corp, through its member company named Beresford Energy Corp, holding a 56.8% stake in Octava SA.

name: SOHO DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: Soho Development SA, previously Black Lion Fund SA, is a Poland-based investment company active in private equity and venture capital sector. The Company invests primarily in companies from real estate, medical, and publishing sectors. At the same time, together with the National Capital Fund, it set up a separate entity for investment in innovative companies that are in the early stages of development. The primary objective of the Company is capital investment and support for the period from three to five years, made in the projects of mid-size development, consolidation and restructuring range. The subject of Fund’s activity are also acquisition of the securities issued by the National Treasure, stocks or other securities issued by the registered entities and acting in Poland, as well as execution of the rights to shares, options of stocks and other securities. On November 20, 2012, the Company acquired a 100% stake in Recycling Park Sp. z o.o.

name: CREOTECH INSTRUMENTS
businessSummary: Creotech Instruments SA is a Poland-based company, that operates in the space sector. The Company is a provider of space technologies and specialises in the development and manufacture of electronic products and information technology (IT) systems, such as systems based on imaging of the Earth Observation systems and UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) technology for monitoring altitude obstacles for manned and unmanned aerial vehicles and development of specialized electronics and hardware applicable in such fields as quantum computers, quantum cryptography, quantum physics and high-energy physics laboratories and microsatellites.

name: NANOGROUP
businessSummary: Nanogroup SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the biotechnology sector. The Company focuses on the investment in, as well as development of advanced biotechnological projects in the areas of cancer prevention, early diagnosis, targeted cancer therapies and ontological rehabilitation. Its projects portfolio includes NanoVelos, which is responsible for the creation of drug delivery system for proven oncologic medicines to optimize their performance; NanoSanguis, which develops artificial blood to keep alive patients wounded in accidents, as well as a system, named Organ farm, to preserve human organs ex vivo, and NanoThea, which is dedicated to technology that detects cancer cells in early stage.

name: MEDINICE
businessSummary: Medinice SA is a Poland-based company engaged in medical diagnostic and testing equipment business sector. The Company specializes in creating, developing and commercializing safe and minimally invasive solutions in the field of medicine, in particular cardiology and cardio surgery. Its portfolio comprises of projects, such as CathAIO, Cryoapplicator, Med-IConsole, Minimax, Pacepress and others. All of the Company's projects have a global potential. The Company cooperates with research centers in Poland and Europe. It strives to commercialize inventions brought by both co-founders of the Company and acquired projects through the sale of licenses worldwide in the production of medical devices.

name: MOLECURE
businessSummary: Molecure SA, formerly known as Oncoarendi Therapeutics SA, is a Poland-based biopharmaceutical company. The Company is dedicated to discovering, developing and commercializing therapeutics for neoplastic and inflammatory diseases. The Company's business model is focused on drug discovery and development, with its core strength in medicinal chemistry and preclinical biology, enhanced by scientific collaborations in specific disease areas. The Company has a platform of 3 distinct small molecule programs targeting chitinases hydrolytic enzymes with potential utility in diverse inflammatory and fibrotic diseases of high unmet medical need. Additionally, it has initiated a program focused on development of small molecule immune modulators to stop the ability of tumors to escape immune surveillance.

name: SCOPE FLUIDICS
businessSummary: Scope Fluidics SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the biotechnology. The Company focuses on diagnostic and med-tech solutions. It develops disposable microfluidic systems for the collection of micro-samples of blood, as well as storage of reagents for diagnostic markers. Its projects include PCR ONE system that delivers the bacterial and viral pathogen detection, and BacterOMIC system that delivers information on bacterial susceptibility to antibiotics and on the resistance mechanisms. The Company provides access to laboratories and workshops for developed projects, as well as administrative facilities and services, including financing. In addition, it cooperates with doctors, medical personnel, project managers, engineers and academics.

name: DATAWALK
businessSummary: Datawalk SA, formerly known as Pilab SA, is a Poland-based a software publisher. The Company specializes in the area of data analysis, offering Business Intelligence solutions. It operates DataWalk, an agile analysis platform, which enables financial and insurance institutions to discover fraud attempts, combat money laundering, as well as analyze and monitor business processes, such as sales, claim adjustment and debt collection, among other applications. The Company operates through Datawalk Inc, its wholly-owned subsidiary based in the United States.

name: SATIS GROUP
businessSummary: Satis Group SA, formerly iAlbatros Group SA, is a Poland-based holding company engaged in the information technology (IT) sector. Through its subsidiaries, the Company provides IT services and software solutions to businesses. The Company's subsidiary, Satis GPS Sp z o o (Satis GPS), offers a vehicle positioning and fleet management system based on global positioning system (GPS) technology. The SATIS system supports cost and efficiency planning with its data analytics feature. Its additional functionalities include tracking field employees, monitoring fuel levels and automatic alerts about accidents on route. Other projects of Satis GPS include the Electronic Surveillance System, implemented for the Ministry of Justice and used for monitoring the whereabouts of a sentenced person with a special electronic bracelet, and CommandX, a crisis management platform enabling coordination of rescue and law enforcement services. It offers its products domestically and internationally.

name: ALL IN GAMES
businessSummary: All In! Games SA, formerly known as Setanta SA, is a Poland-based company operating in the game development industry. The Company operates in the publishing segment. Within this activity, It is engaged in publishing computer games produced by game development studios. The Company's publishing activities focus on publishing and creating games for the Personal Computer (PC) platform and PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch consoles, as well as Steam platform. The Company offers a variety of games including genres such as: Action, Adventure, Arcade, Family and kids, Indie, Multiplayer, Platformer, Racing, Simulation, Singleplayer or Strategy. The games offer includes titles such as: Chernobylite, Backfirewall, Exo One or Phantom Hellcat.

name: LUNA GLOBAL
businessSummary: Luna Global SA, formerly Less SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the tobacco products manufacturing industry. The Company is focused on manufacturing, distribution and sale of nicotine and energy pouches. The Company's product portfolio includes nicotine pouch products marketed under the 77, Bjorn and Maverick brands, as well as energy pouch products marketed under the X-Booster and Cafero brands. The Company also provides original equipment manufacturer (OEM) production services for third-party customers. Through its manufacturing and distribution operations, the Company supplies products to domestic and international markets and serves customers in the nicotine and consumer goods sectors.

name: XTPL
businessSummary: XTPL SA is Poland-based company, which develops a ground-breaking technology of printing of a wide spectrum of nonmaterial that is protected by a patent application. The Company's technology is used in the global industries of thin film solar cells and in the manufacturing of displays, touch screens and flexible electronics. It replaces the rare indium in the production process of transparent conductive films (TCF).The company is based at one of the cutting-edge laboratories in this part of Europe with access to devices and research infrastructure.

name: COLUMBUS ENERGY
businessSummary: Columbus Energy SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the renewable energy equipment and services industry. The Company focuses on the development, installation and maintenance of photovoltaic (PV) solar systems for single-family houses, as well as commercial properties. It provides PV solar panels and energy inverters, which enable the conversion of direct current (DC) into alternating current (AC). The users are able to connect its PV solar system with power grid and send additions of generated power directly to transmission lines. Furthermore, the Company offers advisory to business customers related to energy audits, energy efficiency and project financing, as well as provides installation services on commercial buildings.

name: WIRTUALNA POLSKA HOLDING
businessSummary: Wirtualna Polska Holding SA is a Poland-based holding company. The Company owns entities that are engaged in the Internet publishing and broadcasting content, including operating business, technology, sports and entertainment portals, as well as electronic mail (e-mail) and electronic commerce (e-commerce). It also offers a range of advertising products, including display ads. The Company operates through such Internet portals as Wirtualna Polska, o2.pl, Money.pl, WP SportoweFakty, Dobreprogramy.pl, WP Parenting, Domodi and Homebook, among others. The Company operates domestically.

name: POLENERGIA
businessSummary: Polenergia SA is a Poland-based company that specializes in the development, implementation and management of electricity and heat generation projects. The Company’s services are divided into three segments: Energy Outsourcing, including renders operator services as well as production and sales of electricity and heat generated in its plants; Biomass Fuels, including production of renewable energy made from agricultural biomass; and Wind Energy, including development and sales of wind farms as well as construction and operation of wind farms. The Company also offers services in the areas of development and set-up of new projects, including technical consultancy, project financing and operational services. Additionally, it sells solid, liquid and gas fuels.

name: NPL NOVA
businessSummary: Npl Nova SA, formerly known as Pragma Inkaso SA is a Poland-based company which specializes in servicing bank receivables secured by mortgages. The Company specializes in servicing and investing in mortgage-secured receivables. Its offer include advice, mediation, and comprehensive legal audits, guiding clients through every stage of the transaction process. The Company provides services that cater to banks, individual investors, real estate agents, property owners, entrepreneurs, as well as bailiffs and receivers seeking buyers for various types of real estate, including office buildings, warehouses, land, factories, and apartments. The Company cooperates with the restructuring and debt collection departments of banks and connects them with the world of financial investors. It also helps in the restructuring of bankrupt, unfinished, neglected and abandoned real estate investments into functioning businesses.

name: PHARMENA
businessSummary: Pharmena SA is a Poland-based pharmaceutical and life science company specializing in the research, development, and commercialization of products and technologies derived from scientific research, particularly in the areas of healthy aging, bioscience, and topical technologies. The Company is structured around research and development activities focused on the biological and therapeutic potential of 1-methylnicotinamide (1-MNA), a naturally occurring metabolite of niacin, and develops dietary supplements, health-related products, and drug candidates based on this technology. The Company's core activity centers on the application of 1-MNA technology, including products marketed under the Endotelio and Menavitin product lines. The Company conducts research in cooperation with academic institutions and research centers and supports its activities through patent protection and commercialization of developed technologies in domestic and international markets.

name: INTERBUD LUBLIN
businessSummary: INTERBUD LUBLIN SA is a Poland-based company active in construction and engineering. It is engaged in residential, industrial, commercial and environmental construction. It also offers modernization of public and commercial properties such as schools, hospital branches, sport halls and pitches, petrol stations, warehouses, office buildings, sewer systems, water treatment plants and others. Additionally, the Company provides preparation of land for construction, civil engineering, rental of construction equipment and real estate services. As of December 31, 2011, the Company held a 100% stake in Interbud-Willowa sp. z o.o. It started works on preparing bankruptcy with possibility of creditors' agreement motion.

name: SELVITA
businessSummary: Selvita SA, formerly Selvita Cro SA, is a Poland-based integrated service company active in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. The Company is engaged in providing multidisciplinary solutions supporting customers and projects within area of drug discovery, regulatory studies, as well as research and development. It offers its clients drug discovery support at every stage of the early discovery phase up to preclinical research, from target validation up to the selection of a clinical candidate. Also, it offers services at every stage of the drug discovery process in the field of drug testing and bioanalytical analyses, from development and validation of methods, stability studies, to routine quality control testing. The Company cooperates with numerous research institutes and universities from Europe and the United States.

name: POLSKI HOLDING NIERUCHOMOSCI
businessSummary: Polski Holding Nieruchomosci SA, formerly Grupa PHN SA, is a Poland-based holding company that is engaged in real estate development and operations. It operates a portfolio of approximately 180 properties, which are located across Poland in such cities and towns as, Warsaw, Wroclaw, Gdansk, Pruszkow, Parzniewo, Kolbaskowo, Lucmierz and Lewandow, among others. It possesses undeveloped land of a surface around 1,300 ha. The Group's principal activities include rental, sale and administration of retail, exhibition, office and advertising space, rental of warehouses, land investment, commercial real estate development, marketing and property management and others. It operates through subsidiaries, such as PHN 5 Sp z o o acquired another subsidiaries from the Company, such as Intraco SA, Dalmor SA, Budexpo Sp z o o,Andersia Business Centre Sp z o o and Wroclawskie Centrum Prasowe Sp z o o.

name: BBI DEVELOPMENT
businessSummary: BBI Development SA is a Poland-based development fund manager. The Fund was established as a part of the Program of National Privatization. BBI Development Narodowy Fundusz Inwestycyjny SA’s main activity is investing in the development projects, including the financing and managing real estate projects from the stage of acquiring land to the sale of premises, in certain cases preceded by a lease. Additionally, it invests in Polish and foreign currencies through the bank deposits. It operates on the basis of the Act of National Investment Funds. As of December 31, 2011, it formed a capital group with a number of subsidiaries, such as Realty 2 Management Sp. z o.o., Juvenes-Projekt Sp. z o.o. and Juvenes-Serwis Sp. z o.o.

name: SDS OPTIC
businessSummary: SDS Optic SA is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in medical research. The Company’s primary research activity relates to the oncology sector. The Firm wishes to develop a method for early breast cancer diagnosis. The current method of diagnosis relies on biopsy and histopathology. The purpose of the tests is to identify cancer markers. The Company tries to implement InProbe method, which is faster and more accurate- the method should be able to provide results within 20 minutes. The Company is also engaged in research regarding different kinds of diseases such as fungal diseases. The Company cooperates with specialists from different fields such as biology, medicine, technology, and sciences related to medicine.

name: EKO EXPORT
businessSummary: EKO EXPORT SA is a Poland-based company engaged in processing and distribution of microspheres. The microspheres provided by the Company can be used in various areas, including building sector (elevation panels, special cements, mortars, plasters), power engineering and technology (drilling mud, propeller arms, spaceship coating and composites) and automotive industry (composites, tires, moulds). Microspheres are also used in production of various sport equipment (boats, surfboards, canoes), ceramics (refractory materials, insulating materials) and plastics (nylon, polyethylene). EKO EXPORT SA imports grey and white raw microspheres as well as dried microspheres mainly from Russia, Kazakhstan and Ukraine. The Company's subsidiaries include EKO Sphere KZ, a Kazakhstan-based company.

name: MIRACULUM
businessSummary: Miraculum SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the manufacture, distribution, wholesale and retail trade of cosmetics and skin care products. The Company’s portfolio of brands includes Miraculum, Pani Walewska, Brutal, Gracja, Tanita, Paloma, Lider, Wars and Byc moze. The product range includes facial care cosmetics, featuring creams, toners, milks and masks; body care solutions, encompassing hand creams and body lotions; sun protection articles; perfumes; skin care solutions for teenagers; and supplementing products. It operates in the domestic and foreign markets, exporting its products to approximately 20 countries worldwide, including Russia, Ukraine, Azerbaijan, Lithuania, Belarus, the United States and Germany, among others.

name: COMP
businessSummary: Comp SA is a Poland-based company active in the information technology (IT) sector. The Company offers IT consulting, creating conceptual solutions, project advice, integration of different system platforms, training and service, and net infrastructure for local and wide area network systems. Comp SA owns data processing centers and back-up centers. Additionally, the Company produces computers, peripheral equipment and cash registers. Among the Company’s major partners are companies from the finance, public, transport, services, telecommunications and other sectors. As of December 31, 2011, the Company formed a capital group with its 15 subsidiaries, including Pacomp Sp. z o.o., Safe Computing Sp. z o.o., Enigma Systemy Ochrony Informacji Sp. z o.o., ZUK Elzab SA and Comp Centrum Innowacji Sp. z o.o., among others.

name: MOSTOSTAL WARSZAWA
businessSummary: Mostostal Warszawa SA is a Poland-based company active in the construction sector. It operates through six divisions: General Construction, which focuses on the construction of housing estates, offices and public utility buildings; Industrial Construction, specializing in petrochemical, chemical, power and cement industrial projects; Civil Engineering, active in the construction of roads, bridges, underground structures and other facilities for the municipal metro system; Road Construction, involved in rehabilitation, modernization and construction of roads, elements of municipal communication infrastructure and railway lines; Environmental Engineering, engaged in the construction of environment protection; Other Services, offering engineering services, design services, courses for welders, renting transport units and construction equipment and machines. The Company is a subsidiary of Acciona Infraestructuras SA.

name: NEUCA
businessSummary: Neuca SA is a Poland-based company, which operates in the healthcare market. The Company is mainly involved in the distribution of drugs to pharmacies. It also operates in other sectors of the health market, such as production of drugs, supplements and cosmetics under its own brand, clinical trials, telemedicine, Information Technology (IT) solutions and e-commerce in the health care industry.

name: WIELTON
businessSummary: Wielton SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the production of semi-trailers and trailers. The Company’s product portfolio includes almost 60 types of transportation vehicles grouped in nine categories, including universal, body box and refrigerator semi-trailers, tippers, semi-trailers for machinery transportation, center axle trailers, tipper bodies, trailers, and semi-trailers for containers. The Company’s customers are the companies from industrial segments, such as transportation, construction, agriculture and distribution. It sell its products both in the wholesale trade nad through the network of retail stores. The Company operates subsidiaries, such as Wielton GmbH, Wielton Logistic Sp z o o, Wielton Ukraina Sp z o o, Wielton By, Wielton Italia Sarl, among others.

name: ORANGE POLSKA
businessSummary: Orange Polska SA is a Poland-based company active in the telecommunication sector, formed as a result of a merger among Telekomunikacja Polska SA, Polska Telefonia Komorkowa-Centertel Sp z o o and Orange Polska Sp z o o. The Company is organized into two segments: Fixed line which includes entities offering telecom services based on fixed line technology and other companies offering services for those entities; and Mobile which includes entities offering telecom services based on mobile technology and other companies offering services for those entities. It offers such services as fixed-line telephony, Integrated Services Digital Network (ISDN), fixed access to the Internet, TV and Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP). It is a DCS 1800 and GSM 900 mobile telecommunications provider. It also provides leased lines, data transmission and sells telecommunications equipment. On February 13, 2014, the Company sold 100% stake in Wirtualna Polska SA to o2 Sp z o o.

name: INTERSPORT POLSKA
businessSummary: Intersport Polska SA is a Poland-based company, which is principally engaged in the trade of sports goods. Its offering includes a range of sports equipment and clothes under such brand names as Adidas, Nike, Reebok, Puma, Asics, Giant, Ecco, Rossignol, Salomon, The North Face and Jack Wolfskin, as well as products under its own-brand names: McKinley and Pro Touch, among others. The Company operates 30 outlets located in malls in Poland, in such cities as Cracow, Warsaw, Katowice, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw, Gdansk and others. In addition, the Company provides seasonal maintenance of sport equipment, rental of ski models and tennis rackets, operates ski club for kids and teenagers and others.

name: PROTEKTOR
businessSummary: Protektor SA, formerly Lubelskie Zaklady Przemyslu Skorzanego Protektor SA, is a Poland-based producer of leather military, professional, as well as working and protective footwear. Its products range includes military, firemen, as well as safety and work footwear. Additionally, the Company’s portfolio includes footwear for hunters and motorcyclists. The Company operate four footwear production plants, based in Poland, the Czech Republic and Moldova. The Company has a distribution network throughout Poland. The Company sells its products in Europe, Asia, Africa and South America. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated six subsidiaries, including Abeba Spezialschuh-Ausstatter GmbH, Inform Brill GmbH and Praos pluas as, among others. As of May 15, 2012, the Company sold its subsidiary Prabos plus as.

name: GIELDA PAPIEROW WARTOSCIOWYCH W WARSZAWI
businessSummary: Gielda Papierow Wartosciowych w Warszawie SA (Warsaw Stock Exchange, GPW) is a Poland-based stock exchange. It is a parent entity of WSE Group that offers products and services within its trading markets of equity, derivate, fixed income and structured products. It also distributes market data. The Company has two business lines: Financial market, which includes trading in equities, derivatives, fixed-income and other instruments, listing, and information services; and Commodity market, which includes trading in electricity and property rights in certificates of origin, operation of a register of certificates of origin, clearing, trade and technical trade operator services. As of December 31, 2011, it operates two wholly owned subsidiaries, WSEInfoEngine SA, providing data transmission and information services; and Instytut Rynku Kapitalowego WSE Research SA, engaged in publishing; as well as 92.47%-owned BondSpot SA.

name: T BULL
businessSummary: T-Bull SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the mobile games development. The Company focuses on designing, producing and distributing games for mobile devices with Android, iOS, Windows Mobile and Black Berry operating systems. The Company mainly creates first person shooter (FPS) and racing games. Its products portfolio includes Top Speed: Drag & Fast Racing, Zombie Call: Trigger Shooter, Traffic: Illegal Road Racing, as well as High Speed Race: Racing Need. The Company's games are published through various platforms, such as Google Play, AppStore, Windows Phone, Black-Berry World, Amazon and Opera Mobile Store, and are distributed worldwide.

name: GRUPA AZOTY ZAKLADY CHEMICZNE POLICE
businessSummary: Grupa Azoty Zaklady Chemiczne Police SA, formerly know as Zaklady Chemiczne Police SA is a Poland-based company that is engaged in the production of mineral fertilizers, titanium dioxide and chemicals. The Company specializes in the production of a wide range of chemical products, including: nitrogen, nitrogen-sulphur, two-component and compound fertilizers, various types of pigments (including Tytanpol R-001, R-002, R-003 and so on), organic and inorganic chemicals, such as liquid ammonia, fluorosilicic acid, defluorinated phosphoric acid or uncoated urea. In addition, The Company also offers laboratory services, supplying of drinking, process and cooling water, as well as wastewater treatment services, as well as thermal power generation, electrical energy and natural gas supply.

name: GRUPA AZOTY
businessSummary: Grupa Azoty SA is a Poland-based producer of chemical products. Its products portfolio is divided into five segments. Fertilizers segment includes manufacturing and sales of nitrogenous fertilizers (urea, nitrate, ammonium nitrates, ammonium sulphate nitrate, a mixture of ammonium sulphate and urea, ammonium sulphate), compound fertilizers, ammonia; Plastics segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of polyamide 6 (Tarnamid, Alphalon), polyacetal (Tarnoform), caprolactam; OXO segment includes manufacturing and sales of alcohols (2-ethylohexanol, n-butanol, isobutanol, octanol F) and plasticizers, such as bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate, diisobutyl phthalate, among others; Pigment segment is engaged in manufacturing and sales of titanium white, Tytanpol; Other Activities segment includes energy, laboratory services, catalysts, rental of properties. The Company operates through subsidiaries, including Grupa Azoty ZAK SA, ATT Polymers GmbH, Zaklady Chemiczne Police SA, among others.

name: CLOUD TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Cloud Technologies SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the Internet services and consulting industry. The Company is active in online advertising in the segment of Big Data Cloud Computing. Cloud Technologies SA optimizes advertising campaigns based on Programmatic Buying. The Company pursues strategy based on tools that make use of the potential of online media to carry out advertising campaigns. Cloud Technologies SA is diversifying its products and services portfolio with technologies that are designed for Mobile Devices and that use elements of the Internet of Things. It provides data management platform, real-time bidding in email marketing solutions, mobile games platforms and email marketing in the cloud solutions.

name: GRUPA KETY
businessSummary: Grupa Kety SA is a Poland-based company that is principally engaged in the aluminum industry. The Company’s activities are divided into following segments: Extruded Product, Aluminum Systems, Constructional Accessories, Constructional Service, Transport Systems and Flexible Packaging. The Company’s offer includes aluminum profiles, components, extrusions, multi-layer packaging made of aluminum foil and polypropylene, polyethylene and polyester films and paper, building fittings and system accessories, and car bodies for utility cars, among others. It also provides assembly of aluminum facades. On May 21, 2014, the Company established new wholly owned subsidiary, Grupa Kety Italia srl.

name: SYNTHAVERSE
businessSummary: Synthaverse SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the biopharmaceutical and pharmaceutical manufacturing industry. The Company focuses on the development, manufacture, and commercialization of biological medicinal products, vaccines, immunotherapies, probiotics, and laboratory reagents. It offers its services in the field such as: oncological immunotherapy, Immunotherapy in Serological Conflict, Passive immunotherapy in hepatitis B, Active anti-tuberculosis immunotherapy, Gynecology and Proctology, Probiotics, Laboratory reagents. Its activities also include biotechnology research and development, pharmaceutical substance manufacturing, packaging services, and selected healthcare-related services.

name: REINO CAPITAL
businessSummary: Reino Capital SA, formerly Graviton Capital SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in business advisory and management consulting activities.

name: GRUPA VIRTUS
businessSummary: Grupa Virtus SA, formerly known as Raen SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the investment management business sector. The Company is also engaged in providing capital as well as specialized financing services such as bonds, loans, bridge financing, leasing, or factoring for the defence sector and dual-use technologies. The Company acts as a financial operator that supports enterprises implementing key projects for state security – from production financing, through technological investments, to the implementation of contracts for public and private entities. The Company supports the development of production lines, plant modernization, and the implementation of new technologies in the defence sector. The Company enables businesses to participate in programs such as European Defence Fund (EDF), Act in Support of Ammunition Production (ASAP) and Security Action for Europe (SAFE).

name: CD PROJEKT RED
businessSummary: CD Projekt SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the leisure products industry. It is a player on the global digital entertainment market. The Company is active in four operating segments. The Distribution and Publishing in Poland segment is responsible for the production and marketing of computers game, movies on digital discs (DVD) and Blu-ray storage devices in the domestic market. The Production of Games segment, through CD Project Red, focuses on the production of video games, sale of licenses and products associated with the digital sector. The Global Digital Distribution of Games segment is engaged in the distribution of computer games through the Websites, and the Others segment focuses on the holding activities. The Company’s main products are The Witcher, The Witcher 2: Assasins of Kings and The Witcher 3: Wild HuntCyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk 2077. It operates through subsidiaries, such as GOG Poland Sp z o o, Brand Project Sp z o o and CD Project Brands SA, among others.

name: REDAN SA W LIKWIDACJI
businessSummary: Redan SA W Likwidacji, formerly Redan SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the distribution, wholesale and retail trade of textiles, casual clothes, shoes and accessories. The Company’s business is divided into two segments: Trade, conducting logistics operations such as purchasing goods from suppliers, storing in the warehouse, carrying out customs clearance, packaging before shipment to stores or customers and distributing apparel and clothing accessories Top Secret brand products to foreign customers, and Services segment, providing services in the field of financial management, human resources (HR) and Information Technology (IT), such as management of server infrastructure and computer networks, development of applications for internal needs and interfaces for data exchange.

name: GRUPA PRACUJ
businessSummary: Grupa Pracuj SA is a Poland-based company engaged in digital recruitment market. The Company provides support services to businesses in the recruitment, retention and development of employees and technological support for Human Resources (HR) processes in companies within the Software as a Service (SaaS) model. Grupa Pracuj's operations cover two main areas of activity: comprehensive online recruitment and modern technologies for Human Resources (HR). The Company owns the brands, such as Pracuj.pl, Robota.ua, Dryg.pl, Theprotocol.it and eRecruiter system. The Company has been present in Poland and Ukraine.

name: MCI CAPITAL ALTERNATYWNA SPOLKA INWESTYC
businessSummary: MCI Capital Alternatywna Spolka Inwestycyjna SA, formally MCI Capital SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the management of investment funds. The Company is active in two business segments, namely Investment and Asset management. The Company’s operations cover the investments and management of venture capital (VC) funds, as well as the investments and management of private equity (PE). The Company manages funds including MCI.PrivateVentures FIZ fund, Internet Ventures FIZ and MCI Digital and Climatech Fund V S.C.A. MCI Capital Alternatywna Spolka Inwestycyjna SA counts with subsidiaries including MCI Capital TFI SA, PEM Asset Management Sp z o o w likwidacji and MCI Digital and MCI Digital and Climatech GP S.a r.l.

name: BENEFIT SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Benefit Systems SA is a Poland-based company engaged in providing work benefits in the area of sport, recreations, culture and entertainment for employers. The Company is a provider of solutions in the area of non-wage employee benefits in the field of sports and recreation (including the MultiSport card, MultiActive, MultiSport Kids), and also operates in the area of managing fitness clubs belonging to Its own networks within the Fitness branch. The Company is also developing the MultiLife product, providing access to online services that support users in everyday care for their health, well-being and personal development (for example: a diet creator, language platform, mindfulness course, e-books, yoga course or consultations with experts). The Company also offers products in the form of Cafeteria, which allow the employee to choose a non-wage benefit from a list accepted by the employer

name: CI GAMES
businessSummary: CI Games SE, formerly CI Games SA, is a Poland-based company engaged in the computer games industry. The Company specializes in the production and distribution of various computer and console games. The Company is a publisher and representative of foreign producers as well. The Company’s product portfolio includes a range of games genres, such as shooters, simulators and Role Playing Games (RPG) with titles such as Sniper Ghost Warrior, Dogfight 1942 or The Lords of the Fallen among others. The Company operates a number of subsidiaries, including United Label SA, CI Games USA Inc, Business Area Sp z o o, Business Area Sp z o o Sp j, CI Games SA Sp j, CI Games UK Ltd, CI Games Mediterranean Projects SL, CI Games Bucharest Studio SRL.

name: WISE FINANCE
businessSummary: Wise Finance SA, formerly Noble Financials SA, is a Poland-based holding company active in the real estate sector. It is engaged in investment, sale, lease and intermediation in renting of properties, as well as in property management and interior design. It offers management of the cycle of creation of the real property value, organization of the projects and supervision of the investments being carried outs, management of customer relations, marketing and public relations. The Company operates through a number of subsidiaries, including Mysquare.pl Sp z o o.

name: OT LOGISTICS
businessSummary: OT Logistics SA is a Poland-based company active in the transportation sector. The Company is primarily engaged in transportation of goods by inland navigation. It also provides services of inshore waterway transport, service supporting waterway transport, excavation of gravel and sand, renting of the real estate, warehousing and storing of goods and transshipment. The Company operates a number of floating units. OT Logistics SA concentrates its activities on the Oder river, on the section Gliwice - Wroclaw as well as in the region of Szczecin, Poland. OT Logistics is a parent entity of OT Logistics Group, which consist of several companies active in Poland, Center and Western Europe. The Company’s major shareholder is I Fundusz Mistral SA.

name: RYVU THERAPEUTICS
businessSummary: Ryvu Therapeutics SA is a Poland-based company that operates in the biotechnology industry. The Company focuses on oncology drug discovery and research and development (R&D) activities. Its primary products are therapeutic drug candidates and related research programs for cancer treatment. These products are biotechnology based therapies and drug development assets that are evaluated and advanced through preclinical and clinical research. The primary goal of this technology is to identify therapeutic targets and support the development of medicines for patients with cancer. The Company also conducts contract research activities and enters licensing and research collaboration agreements related to biotechnology and drug development.

name: DINO POLSKA
businessSummary: Dino Polska SA is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the food retail. The Company focuses on operating a supermarkets chain under the Dino brand name. Its offer includes dairy and bakery products, chocolate and non-chocolate confectionary, fruits and vegetables, alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, as well as pet food, among others. In addition, the Company provides meat stalls under the Agro-Rydzyna brand name, as well as sells non-food goods, such as cosmetics, household products, kitchen appliances and toys. It also offers mobile phone recharge, cash back service and vouchers. The Company's supermarkets are located in a number of Polish voivodeships, including wielkopolskie, dolnoslaskie, lodzkie, mazowieckie and pomorskie, among others.

name: VIGO PHOTONICS
businessSummary: Vigo Photonics SA, formerly known as Vigo System SA, is a Poland-based company engaged primarily in the production of detectors. The Company is operating in two segments: Detection Modules Segment and Semiconductor Materials Segment. Detection Modules Segment is a branch of activities concentrated on the production of different kinds of detectors, especially based on infrared, and standard and customized High Operating Temperature cadmium mercury telluride (HgCdTe) detectors. Semiconductor Materials Segment is a branch of activities concentrated on the production of semiconductors. The Company's products are divided into three categories, including Infrared Detectors, Infrared Cameras and Measurement Equipment. The Company sells its products worldwide, including the United States, Canada, Finland and Australia, among others. The Firm also cooperates and sells the products to American National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA).

name: MODIVO
businessSummary: Modivo SA, formerly known as CCC SA, is a Poland-based company operating in the footwear, apparel, and accessories markets across 23 countries, offering an omnichannel model that combines approximately 1,200 physical stores with extensive e‑commerce operations under the CCC, HalfPrice, eobuwie.pl, Modivo, Worldbox, and Boardriders banners. The Company structures its activities around a “house of brands” concept, providing products from both strategic in‑house labels and global partner brands through online and offline channels. Its core business segments include multi‑brand fashion retail supported by logistics, digital infrastructure, and customer‑experience solutions, enabling integrated fashion commerce across European markets.

name: ONESANO
businessSummary: Onesano SA, formerly known as Skotan SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in special foods and wellbeing products business industry. The Company focuses on developing new solutions in the field of human supplementation. Its products contain ultra-pure, concentrated omega-3, 6, and 9 fatty acids in the form of ethyl esters, ensuring high bioavailability and bioretention in the human body. Its offer also includes products with a combination of ingredients, combining the postbiotic Yarrowia lipolytica, food enriched with selenium, and the postbiotic Yarrowia lipolytica food enriched with chromium, with the addition of other plant extracts.

name: DADELO
businessSummary: Dadelo SA is a Poland-based company, which operates primarily in the Electronic Shopping and Mail-Order Houses sector. The Company operates its own e-shopping platform Centrum.rowerowe.pl, which enables the customers to browse the offers of the Company digitally and purchase the assortment at home. The Company’s offered products are focused on sports and cycling. There is a wide variety of bicycles of a different kind to purchase, such as mountain bicycles, cross bicycles, city bicycles, electric bicycles, and BMXs. The bicycles are for both genders and for children. The Company also offers a wide range of products connected to cycling such as cycling accessories, shoes, parts, clothing, and casks.

name: DIAGNOSTYKA
businessSummary: Diagnostyka SA is a Poland-based company. It operates a network of medical labs. The Company specializes in providing laboratory services from collecting and transporting biological materials, through testing, to providing the results of medical analysis. It specializes in laboratory tests, specialized tests, Molecular biology tests, Autoimmune diagnostics, blood collection. The Company operates a network of 180 laboratories and 1,100 Sampling Labs throughout Poland. It offers a wide range of laboratory analyzes (over 3000 test types), both routine and specialist, available with and without a physician’s referral, such as hematology, diagnostics of infections, allergology, hormonal diagnostics and more.

name: FABRYKA OBRABIAREK RAFAMET SA W RESTRUKT
businessSummary: Fabryka Obrabiarek Rafamet SA w restrukturyzacji is a Poland-based company engaged in the industrial machinery production. The Company manufactures and sells machine tools for the railway, shipbuilding, steel, paper, aviation, as well as energy industries. The Company’s product range includes the special purpose machine tools, horizontal and wheel lathes, vertical turning and boring mills and milling machines, among others. The Company also runs its own iron foundry and sells its products mainly to the European countries, as well as domestically.

name: COMPREMUM
businessSummary: Compremum SA is a Poland-based company which is primarily engaged in construction and engineering sector. The Company's activities are divided into five business segments: Holding activities, which provides business support and advisory services in the field of, among others, accounting and finance, Human resources (HR) and payroll, Information Technology (IT), legal, security support, marketing and administrative services; Construction services, which provides construction services in the field of general, industrial and engineering construction for institutional clients and public entities; Railway division, which provides periodic repairs, maintenance, modernization and inspection of passenger railway wagons; Renewable Energy, which is engaged in construction work related to the photovoltaic farms and sale and servicing of energy storage facilities and Real estate development services, which carries out development projects and construction works as a general contractor.

name: MEDICALGORITHMICS
businessSummary: Medicalgorithmics SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the advanced medical equipment and technology industry. The Company develops and manufactures system for the diagnosis of heart arrhythmia. Its product, named PocketECG, is used for remote monitoring of cardiac disorders, arrhythmia diagnosis and monitoring of heart, as well as is used for clinical drugs trials for cardiac safety. In addition, Medicalgorithmics SA provides services in the field of information technology and biotechnology, scientific research and development of natural sciences. Moreover, the Company works on the several projects, such as a device for tele-rehabilitation cardiology, software for optimizing repetitive task in hospitals, as well as devices and systems for remote description of the electrocardiography (ECG). It operates through MEDICALGORITHMICS US HOLDING CORPORATION and Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring LLC and Medi-Lynx Cardiac Monitoring LLC.

name: VIVID GAMES
businessSummary: Vivid Games SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the software development. The Company focuses on designing mobile games for smartphones, tablets and consoles. Its products offer comprises car races, adventure and battle games, as well as boxing and ski jumping games, among others. The Company's game titles include Prime Time Rush, Real Boxing and Godfire: Rise of Prometheus, among others. In addition, the Company is involved in games publishing and promotion for third parties.

name: MABION
businessSummary: Mabion SA is a Poland-based biopharmaceutical company. The Company provides a broad spectrum of services in the segment of small and medium-sized projects at various stages of development (from early-stage discovery to commercial manufacturing). The Company's competencies include the selection of protein expression technologies, their purification, GMP-standard manufacturing activities (obtaining Active Substances - Drug Substance and Finished Products - Drug Product), development of analytical tools (for structural, functional, physicochemical characterization), clinical development, clinical analytics and a full range of regulatory activities in the development and operational areas. The Company's goal is to establish itself as a recognizable player in the global contract manufacturing and contract drug development market and to complete its full transformation into an integrated biologics CDMO company.

name: CYBER FOLKS
businessSummary: Cyber_Folks SA is a Poland-based technology company operating in the e-commerce industry. The Company focuses on providing an integrated e-commerce ecosystem that supports the operation and management of online stores and digital sales processes. Its offerings include e-commerce platforms, hosting and infrastructure services, backend systems, third party integrations, application marketplaces, storefront and checkout tools, and communication platforms based on Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS). The primary purpose of its technology ecosystem is to enable businesses to manage online commerce activities through connected software, infrastructure, communication, and transaction management tools within a unified environment.

name: DIGITAL NETWORK
businessSummary: Digital Network SA, is a Poland-based company primarily engaged in the media and advertising industry. The Company focuses on digital outdoor advertising, managing a nationwide network of over 20,000 LED advertising screens through its subsidiary, Screen Network Spolka Akcyjna. Their key product is the digital out-of-home (DOOH) advertising network, which is a system of interconnected digital screens used for displaying advertising content in public spaces. It aims to deliver targeted advertising messages to a broad audience, reaching approximately 6.5 million consumers daily across Poland. The Company also provides consulting services, digital content distribution (including content from the naEkranie.pl website), and supports the distribution and marketing of thematic television channels.

name: VERCOM
businessSummary: Vercom SA is a Poland-based technology Company that creates solutions in the Saas model. It supplies a technology enabling the integration and automation of various electronic communication channels.

name: MO BRUK
businessSummary: Mo-Bruk SA is a Poland-based company involved in the production of concrete. It is also active in the area of hazardous and other than hazardous industrial waste management. Additionally, the Company operates a waste recovery plant, waste recycling plant, alternative fuel production plant and an industrial waste landfill. The Company produces alternative fuels from municipal and industrial wastes. The Company is also the owner of two open non-stop petrol stations for liquefied fuel, as well as a technical inspection station. Mo-Bruk SA is also engaged in the construction of concrete surfaces. As of December 31, 2011, the Company operated one wholly owned subsidiary, Raf-Ekologia Sp. z o.o.

name: MEDAPP SA W RESTRUKTURYZACJI
businessSummary: Medapp SA is a Poland-based company engaged in the software development. The Company provides a software application, named Carna Life, which is used in telemedicine sector. Carna Life serves as communication channel between doctors and patient. Carna Life is a telemedicine system that enables patients to upload test results and receive doctor's interpretation. The application operates in online (upload and download of data) and offline (review of data) mode. Carna Life provides statistics, graphic visualizations and tables with interpreted data. The Company is controlled by Moonrock Enterprise SA.

name: ZAKLAD BUDOWY MASZYN ZREMB CHOJNICE
businessSummary: Zaklad Budowy Maszyn Zremb Chojnice SA is a Poland-based producer of steel constructions and containers. The Company’s offer contains offshore containers for shipping and drilling platforms; basket containers for transportation of equipment to drilling platforms; mini-mud freight containers for transportation of equipment and food for drilling platform personnel; containers for the transportation of waste; specialist containers for machine shops, compression shops and generators; reinforced ceiling military containers and platforms; containers for radioactive waste, steel roof constructions and frames for glazed facades and other individually designed buildings and plants, as well as various other steel constructions.

name: OFG BANCORP
businessSummary: OFG Bancorp is a financial holding company. The Company is engaged in providing banking and financial services through its subsidiaries. The Company operates through three segments: Banking, Wealth Management and Treasury. The Company provides banking and financial services to its clients through a range of banking and financial solutions, including commercial, consumer, auto, and mortgage lending; checking and savings accounts; financial planning, insurance, financial service, and investment brokerage, and corporate and individual trust and retirement services. The Company provides these services through various subsidiaries, including a commercial bank, Oriental Bank; a securities broker-dealer, Oriental Financial Services Corp. (Oriental Financial Services); an insurance agency, Oriental Insurance, LLC (Oriental Insurance), and a retirement plan administrator, Oriental Pension Consultants, Inc. (OPC).

name: POPULAR
businessSummary: Popular, Inc. (Popular) is a financial holding company. The Company operates in two segments: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico (BPPR), which includes its Puerto Rico business, and Banco Popular North America (BPNA), which includes its the United States mainland business. The Company has operations in Puerto Rico, the United States and the Caribbean. The Company's BPPR segment provides retail, mortgage and commercial banking services through its banking subsidiary, Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, as well as auto and equipment leasing and financing, investment banking, broker-dealer and insurance services through specialized subsidiaries. The Company's BPNA segment consists of Popular North America, Inc. (PNA) functioning as the holding company for its operations in the United States. It also operates PNA's subsidiary, E-LOAN, Inc. The banking operations of BPNA in the United States mainland are based in New York, Florida and New Jersey, conducted under the name of Popular Community Bank.

name: FIRST BANCORP
businessSummary: First BanCorp. is a financial holding company. As of December 31, 2016, the Company controlled two subsidiaries: FirstBank Puerto Rico (the Bank or FirstBank) and FirstBank Insurance Agency, Inc. (FirstBank Insurance Agency). It operates in six segments: Commercial and Corporate Banking, which consists of lending and other services; Consumer (Retail) Banking, which consists of consumer lending and deposit-taking activities; Mortgage Banking, which consists of the origination, sale, and servicing of a range of residential mortgage loan products and related hedging activities; Treasury and Investments, which consists of treasury and investment management functions; United States Operations, which consists of all banking activities conducted by FirstBank on the United States mainland, and Virgin Islands Operations, which consists of banking activities conducted by FirstBank in the United States Virgin Islands and British Virgin Islands, including retail and commercial banking services.

name: GLINTT GLOBAL
businessSummary: Glintt Global SA, formerly Glintt Global Intelligent Technologies SA is a Portugal-based computing services company. It operates through two sub-brands, Glintt Life and Glintt Next. Glintt Life operates in the global healthcare market and is dedicated to revolutionizing healthcare through digital innovation. It creates cutting-edge solutions that enhance patient care, ensure efficient interoperability, and empowers healthcare professionals. Glintt Next is a multi-sector technology consultancy. It specializes in custom application development. From creating interactive Web and mobile apps, Glintt Next's focus is on robust application management, ensuring businesses stay connected and competitive.

name: TEIXEIRA DUARTE
businessSummary: Teixeira Duarte SA is a Portugal-based company primarily engaged in the construction sector. The Company’s activities are divided into seven business segments: Construction, involved in the geotechnical and rehabilitation works, construction of buildings and infrastructure, as well as mechanical engineering, among others; Concessions and Services, which operates highways, waste collection and treatment plants, manages properties and cement production plants, among others; Real Estate, which offers residential, commercial, health, leisure, industrial and logistics real estate development and management; Hotel services, which is involved in the operation of hotels and health clubs; Distribution, consists of food products wholesale and retail, as well as operation of stores with household goods; Energy, active in the operation of petrol stations, natural gas distribution and sale of solar energy equipment, among others, and Automotive that comprises the sale of automobiles and trucks.

name: IBERSOL SGPS
businessSummary: Ibersol SGPS SA is a Portugal-based company primarily engaged in the operation of restaurants. It is active in Portugal and Spain. The Company divides its activities into six business areas: Restaurants and Delivery; Counters; Travel; Coffee Kiosks; Catering, and Concessions. In the Restaurants and Delivery area, it is involved in the operation of restaurant chains under brand names of Pizza Hut, Pasta Caffe and Pizza Movil. In the Counters area, it operates restaurant chains under banners KFC, O Kilo, Burger King and Pans, as well as The Eat-Out Group brand names. The Travel business sector includes the provision of foodservices on highways and airports. The Coffee Kiosks sector consists of coffee retailers under the brand name Delta. In the Catering sector, it is active in the preparation of meals. The Concessions sector includes the management of concessions for provision of foodservices in number of spots in Portugal, such as Serralves Museum and Casa da Musica, among others.

name: GALP ENERGIA SGPS
businessSummary: Galp Energia SGPS SA (Galp) is a Portugal-based holding company engaged in the oil and gas industry. Galp’s activities are divided into three business segments: Exploration and Production; Refining and Marketing, and Gas and Power. In the Exploration and Production segment, the Company explores, develops and produces oil and natural gas, operating in approximately 40 projects worldwide. In the Refining and Distribution area, Galp Energia SGPS SA is active in the operation of oil and gas refineries for the production of gasoline, as well as in the marketing of petroleum. The Company operates two refineries in Portugal. In the Gas and Power segment, Galp Energia SGPS SA is mainly engaged in the distribution and marketing of natural gas, as well as in the generation and sale of electricity.

name: NOS SGPS
businessSummary: NOS SGPS SA, known as Zon Optimus SGPS SA, is a Portugal-based company engaged in the broadcasting and telecommunication industry. It was created as a result of a merger between ZON Multimedia Servicos de Telecomunicacoes e Multimedia SGPS SA (ZON) and Optimus - SGPS SA (OPTIMUS). The Company is active in the distribution of cable and satellite television; the production of movies, series, sport and children’s channels, and management of the advertising space on pay television (TV) channels and in cinemas. It is also involved in the provision of a range of mobile and wired communications services to residential and corporate customers, including voice, data, television (TV) and roaming services. Additionally, it operates in the audiovisual sector, which includes video production and sale, cinema distribution and exhibition, and the acquisition and negotiation of pay TV and video-on-demand rights. The Company is a subsidiary of ZOPT SGPS SA.

name: SONAE SGPS
businessSummary: Sonae SGPS SA (Sonae) is a Portugal-based holding company primarily engaged in the retail trade of food. The Company divides its business into six segments: Sonae MC, which is active in the food retail mainly through hypermarkets, supermarkets and franchised local food stores; Sonae Sierra, which develops and manages shopping malls; Sonae SR, which includes specialized retail stores, such as electronics, sports goods and fashion shops; Sonae RP, which is involved in the real estate sector; Sonaecom, which provides integrated telecommunication services, and the Investment Management, which support the Company’s business through the assets portfolio management. The Company's portfolio includes Continente, Modalfa, Worten, Losan and Zippy brands, among others. The Company operates in approximately 66 countries, including Portugal, Spain, Greece, Germany, Italy, Turkey and Brazil, among others.

name: JERONIMO MARTINS SGPS
businessSummary: Jeronimo Martins SGPS SA is a Portugal-based company engaged in the food retail sector. The Company's activities are divided into three business segments: Portugal Retail, which comprises operation of Pingo Doce supermarkets; Portugal Cash & Carry, which includes the wholesale business unit Recheio, and Poland Retail, which operates a network of supermarkets under the Biedronka brand name. In addition, the Company is involved in the operation of drugstores under the Hebe banner and pharmacies under the Apteka Na Zdrowie brand name. The Company also manages a network of supermarkets under the Ara brand name in Colombia. The Company is a subsidiary of Sociedade Francisco Manuel Dos Santos BV.

name: IMPRESA
businessSummary: Impresa Sociedade Gestora de Participacoes Sociais SA (Impresa SGPS SA) is a Portugal-based holding company involved in the media industry, with interests covering television broadcasting and newspaper publishing, among others. The Company divides its business into three main segments: Television segment, which includes video production and operation of private television channels in Portugal, such as SIC, SIC Noticias, SIC Radical and SIC Internacional; Publishing segment, which is active in the publishing of newspapers, including Expresso, and segment Others, which comprises activities in the real estate sector, multimedia solutions and geo-location technological solutions. The Company operates an online platform, Impresa Media Criativa, that gathers all of its creative outlets. The Company’s subsidiaries include Impresa Publishing SA, SIC - Sociedade Independente de Comunicacao SA, Impresa Digital Producao Multimedia Lda and Impresa Servicos Sociedade Unipessoal Lda, among others.

name: SEMAPA SOCIEDADE DE INVESTIMENTO E GESTA
businessSummary: Semapa Sociedade de Investimento e Gestao SGPS SA is a Portugal-based holding company engaged in three business segments: Paper and Pulp; Cement and Derivatives, and Environment. The Paper and Pulp business segment, operated by the subsidiary Portucel SA, is engaged in the production and sale of cellulose pulp and paper, as well as in the forestry and agricultural production. The Cement and Derivatives business segment, operated by the subsidiary Secil - Companhia Geral de Cal e Cimento SA, is engaged in the manufacture and sale of cement, ready-mix concrete, dry pre-prepared mortars, precast concrete and hydraulic lime. The Environment business segment, operated by the subsidiary ETSA - Investimentos SGPS SA, is involved in the collection, transport, storage, processing and recovery of animal by-products, as well as in the collection and recycling of used cooking oil. The Company, through its subsidiaries, operates in Tunisia, Spain, Angola, Poland and France, among others.

name: SCLUBE BRAGA
