Elite Commercial REIT Management Pte. Ltd. operates as the manager of Elite UK REIT. Elite UK REIT was founded in 2018 and is based in Singapore.

name: BUKIT SEMBAWANG ESTATES
businessSummary: Bukit Sembawang Estates Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in property development and operating of serviced apartments. The Company's segments include Property Development, Hospitality and Investment Holding. The Property Development segment engages in the development of residential properties for sale. The Hospitality segment owns serviced apartment units. The Investment holding segment engages in holding and management of office building and investments. The subsidiaries of the Company include Bukit Sembawang View Pte. Ltd., Singapore United Estates (Private) Limited, Sembawang Estates (Private) Limited, Paterson Collection Pte. Ltd., Paterson One Pte. Ltd., BSEL Development Pte. Ltd., Bukit Sembawang Land Pte. Ltd., Bukit One Pte. Ltd., and Bukit Two Pte. Ltd. it holds landed homes in Seletar Hills, Sembawang Hills, Luxus Hills and in Singapore locations such as District 9 and 10.

name: FOOD EMPIRE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Food Empire Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company engaged in branding and manufacturing in the food and beverage industry. The Company’s primary business is instant coffee beverages, which are retailed under its flagship MacCoffee and CafePHO brands. The Company extends to more than 60 countries across North Asia, Eastern Europe, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East, and North America. Its branded consumer business is supported by a vertically integrated business model that comprises nine manufacturing facilities in six countries and 23 offices worldwide. It also offers a range of other beverages such as tea and hot chocolate under its family of proprietary brands including Petrovskaya Sloboda, Klassno and Hillway. It is also involved in the snack manufacturing and distribution business under its Kracks and Chizzpa brands. Its brands include FesAroma, Melosa, Assam, Nauryz, Simba, and Indira.

name: STAMFORD LAND
businessSummary: Stamford Land Corporation Ltd is a Singapore-based investment holding company. It is an independent owner and operator of luxury hotels in Australia, and an established real estate developer and investor. The Company has five reportable segments. The Hotel owning and management segment, which possesses the ownership and management of hotels. The Property development segment, which is engaged in the development, construction, and trading in properties. The Property investment segment is focused on holding properties for rental income and/or capital appreciation. The trading segment manages interior decoration companies and a travel agency. The Others segment manages corporate services for the Company, treasury functions and investments in securities. The Company owns and operates multiple portfolios of luxury, high-end Stamford Hotels in cities and prime locations throughout Australia, including Sydney, Adelaide, Melbourne, and Brisbane.

name: STRACO
businessSummary: Straco Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based company engaged in the development and management of aquatic-related facilities and tourism-related assets. The Company operates through two segments: Aquariums and Giant Observation Wheel (GOW). The Aquariums segment represents the operation of aquatic-related facilities and tourist attractions, including sea mammal performances, in the People’s Republic of China (PRC). Retail, food and beverage are auxiliary goods and services arising from the operation of aquatic-related facilities. Its GOW segment is in the operation of a circular giant observation structure and the provision of commercial space in Singapore. Its other operations include the operation of a cable-car facility. The Company's operating assets include Shanghai Ocean Aquarium, Singapore Flyer, Underwater World Xiamen, and Lixing Cable Car. Its subsidiaries include Infotainment Development & Management Pte Ltd, New Bay Holdings Pte Ltd, Straco Leisure Pte Ltd, and others.

isin: FHH|FOUNDATION HEALTHCARE HOLDIN|FHH.SI|Foundation Healthcare Holdings Limited
name: FOUNDATION HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Foundation Healthcare Holdings Limited designs and develops integrated private healthcare platform that connects medical specialists, healthcare providers, payors, patients, and facilities in Singapore. The company's platform offers three core verticals, including Specialists that provides specialist medical services  Medical Centres, comprising of surgery centres, radiology and imaging centre, and fertility centre  and Technology vertical offers AVA, a platform to connect various stakeholders within the healthcare ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Singapore.

name: HRNETGROUP
businessSummary: HRnetGroup Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. It is a recruitment and staffing company in Asia. The Company operates in three segments: Professional Recruitment, Flexible Staffing, and Others. It provides professional recruitment services primarily under its HRnetOne, PeopleSearch, PeopleFirst, and SearchAsia brands and staffing solutions under its RecruitExpress and RecruitFirst brands. The Company sources, recommends, and hires contractors on its payroll on a back-to-back basis. It provides recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) services, including workplace analysis and planning, contract negotiation, customized recruitment process and assessment, onboarding and offboarding, recruitment marketing programs, employee liaison and management, interviews, recommendations, and selection. It has approximately 18 brands, 40 business units across 17 Asian cities, and over 900 consultants. Its subsidiaries include HRnet One Pte Ltd and Recruit Express Pte Ltd.

isin: CRPU|SASSEUR REAL ESTATE INVESTME|CRPU.SI|Sasseur Real Estate Investment Trust
name: SASSEUR REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST
businessSummary: Sasseur Real Estate Investment Trust invests in a portfolio of real estate and related assets. The company operates through four segments: Sasseur (Chongqing Liangjiang) Outlet, Sasseur (Chongqing Bishan) Outlet, Sasseur (Hefei) Outlet, and (Sasseur (Kunming) Outlet. Its property portfolio comprises four retail outlet malls located in the People's Republic of China. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Singapore. Sasseur Real Estate Investment Trust operates as a subsidiary of Sasseur Cayman Holding II Ltd.

name: HC SURGICAL SPECIALISTS
businessSummary: HC Surgical Specialists Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company, together with its subsidiaries, are engaged in providing medical services. It is primarily involved in the provision of endoscopic procedures, including gastroscopies and colonoscopies, and general surgery services, with a focus on colorectal procedures across a network of clinics located throughout Singapore. Its businesses include facilities and clinics, and specialist surgeons and general practitioners. It operates a network of clinics located throughout Singapore, in both residential areas and central areas, which are accessible to the public for consultation. Its clinics have facilities needed to perform a range of procedures on-site, including endoscopic procedures and other minor surgical services. Its subsidiaries include Heah Sieu Min (Mt E) Pte. Ltd., Heah Sieu Min (Bukit Batok) Pte. Ltd., CKH (Farrer Park) Pte. Ltd., HC (Siglap) Pte. Ltd., HC (TPY) Pte. Ltd., Malcolm Lim Pte. Ltd.

name: SINGAPORE LAND GROUP
businessSummary: Singapore Land Group Limited is a Singapore-based real estate company. The principal activity of the Company is investment holding. Its diversified portfolio includes commercial offices, retail properties, residential developments, hotels, and information technology (IT) services. Its segments include Property investment, Property development, Hotel operations, Technology operations, and Others. The Property investment segment is engaged in the leasing of commercial office properties and retail space. The Property trading segment is engaged in the development of properties for sale. The Hotel operations segment is engaged in the operation of hotels. The Technology operations segment is engaged in the distribution of computers and related products, providing systems integration, and networking infrastructure services. Its Others segment includes investment in shares and provision of property management, project management, marketing management and related services.

name: DIGITAL CORE REIT
businessSummary: Digital Core REIT, a leading pure-play data centre REIT listed in Singapore and sponsored by Digital Realty, announced today it has reached an agreement to sell interests in three North American assets and redeploy the proceeds to acquire partial interests in one data centre in Singapore, one data centre in Osaka, pay down debt, and repurchase units on the open market. The transaction is expected to be approximately 4.1 percent accretive to Digital Core REIT's Distribution Per Unit, or DPU, and aggregate leverage is expected to improve by approximately 290 basis points, from 39.2 percent as at 30 June 2026 to 36.3 percent pro forma for the contemplated transaction. Digital Core REIT was established in 2021 and is based in Singapore.

name: BW LPG
businessSummary: BW LPG Limited is a Singapore-based owner and operator of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) vessels, owning and operating gas carriers (VLGCs) with a total carrying capacity of over four million CBM (Cubic Meter). The Company's business includes LPG shipping, product services and infrastructure. It owns and operates a fleet of LPG-powered VLGCs. Its VLGCs are retrofitted with LPG dual-fuel propulsion technology. It provides customers with integrated LPG delivery services. It is focused on its downstream terminal infrastructure and LPG distribution, as its core shipping business serves its customers with VLGCs, and its in-house product services team purchases LPG and delivers it directly to buyers and/or receivers. It owns and operates a total of over 54 VLGCs, of which 29 are LPG dual-fuel, solidifying the Company’s position as owner and operator of VLGCs, and that of the dual-fuel-powered VLGCs. Its owned VLGCs include BW Aries, BW Balder, BW Chinook and BW Gemini, among others.

name: APAC REALTY
businessSummary: APAC Realty Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is primarily engaged in owning and operating the master franchise rights relating to the ERA Real Estate brand for sale and licensing to sub-franchisees in the Asia Pacific region. The Company operates through three segments: Real estate brokerage income, Rental income, and Others. The Real estate brokerage income segment relates to commission and fee income from the brokerage of resale and rental of residential, commercial, and industrial properties, and new residential projects for sale by various developers. The Rental income segment includes rental income generated from properties, workstations, lockers, and furniture. Its Others segment includes incentives, referral, professional indemnity insurance, business conference income, and miscellaneous income. Its subsidiaries include Realty International Associates Pte Ltd and APAC Investment Pte Ltd.

name: PC PARTNER GROUP
businessSummary: PC Partner Group Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company principally engaged in the design, development and manufacturing of VGA Cards for desktop PCs, EMS, and the manufacturing and trading of other PC-related products and components. The Company also offers one-stop electronic manufacturing services to brands all over the world. Its key products are video graphics cards, motherboards and mini-PCs. Its primary brands include ZOTAC, Inno3D and Manli. For products under its own brands, the Company and its subsidiaries sell them to more than 70 countries across various regions, either directly from its headquarters or through its subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, the People’s Republic of China and the United States. It provides EMS to brands, including providers of ATM and POS systems, industrial devices such as accelerator cards and control cards, and various types of consumer electronic products, such as electronic clocks and wireless thermometers.

name: SATS
businessSummary: SATS Ltd. is a Singapore-based company primarily engaged in investment holding. Its other activities include renting premises and providing management services to related companies. The Company operates through three segments: Food Solutions, Gateway Services, and Others. The Food Solutions segment mainly provides inflight and institutional catering, food processing, distribution services, and airline laundry services in the Asia-Pacific region and the United Kingdom. The Gateway Services segment offers airport and cruise terminal services, as well as trucking services. Airport terminal services include airfreight handling, passenger services, aviation security, baggage handling, and apron services for airline customers. On the provision of cruise terminal services, the segment manages and operates Marina Bay Cruise Center in Singapore and Kai Tak Cruise Terminal in Hong Kong. Its subsidiaries are SATS Airport Services Pte Ltd, SATS Catering Pte Ltd, SATS Treasury Pte Ltd, and others.

isin: DHLU|DAIWA HOUSE LOGISTICS TRUST|DHLU.SI|Daiwa House Logistics Trust
name: DAIWA HOUSE LOGISTICS TRUST
businessSummary: Daiwa House Logistics Trust is a Singapore real estate investment trust (REIT) established with the investment strategy of principally investing in a portfolio of income-producing logistics and industrial real estate assets located across Asia. Its portfolio currently comprises 18 high-quality logistics properties across Japan and one property in Vietnam, with an aggregate net lettable area more than 499,000 sqm. DHLT is managed by Daiwa House Asset Management Asia Pte. Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of its Sponsor, Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. Daiwa House Logistics Trust was incorporated in Singapore.

name: OUE HEALTHCARE
businessSummary: OUE Healthcare Limited, an investment holding company, owns, operates, and invests in healthcare businesses in Singapore, China, Myanmar, Indonesia, and Japan. It operates through Healthcare Operations, Healthcare Assets, Properties Under Development, and Investments segments. The company is involved in the operation of hospitals and clinics  supply of medical equipment and pharmaceutical products  and rental of investment properties and owned assets. It also engages in the development of medical facilities, healthcare-related assets, and integrated mixed-used projects  and investment in real estate investment trusts and properties. The company was formerly known as OUE Lippo Healthcare Limited and changed its name to OUE Healthcare Limited in April 2023. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Singapore. OUE Healthcare Limited is a subsidiary of OUE Limited.

name: MOBVISTA
businessSummary: Mobvista Inc. is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in the provisions of advertising technology services and marketing technology services. The Company's products and services include Mintegral (User Acquisition & Monetization), GameAnalytics (Data Analytics), Nativex (Performance Marketing), Mindworks and Playturbo (Ad Creative), and XMP (Optimization). Mintegral, its AI-driven programmatic advertising platform, facilitates clients to connect to global users in an automated and scalable manner. Its GameAnalytics provides real-time player behavior data analysis across all mainstream game engines and operating systems. The Company's automated creative production platform, Playturbo, supports automated creative production features like AI voiceover, AI translation, AI object removal, and AI rapid image generation. Its SolarEngine provides advertisers with comprehensive user acquisition attribution and multi-dimensional marketing data analysis capabilities.

name: KAROOOOO
businessSummary: Karooooo Ltd. is a Singapore-based company. The principal activities include the provision of real-time mobility data analytics solutions for smart transportation through its software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform, physical and electronic commerce vehicle buying and selling, and providing a technology platform focused on last-mile delivery. The Company’s segments include Cartrack, Carzuka, and Karooooo Logistics. Cartrack offers an on-the-ground operational Internet of Things (IoT) SaaS cloud that optimizes transportation, operations, and workflow data. Carzuka is a physical and electronic commerce marketplace for vehicle buying and selling, allowing customers to source, buy, and sell vehicles. Karooooo Logistics provides a software application for managing last-mile delivery and general operational logistics. The Company’s subsidiaries include Cartrack Holdings Proprietary Limited, Carzuka.com Pte Ltd, Karooooo Management Company Pte. Ltd., Karooooo Cartrack Limited, and others.

name: PROPNEX
businessSummary: PropNex Limited is a Singapore-based real estate company. The Company operates through four segments: Agency services, Project marketing services, Administrative support services and Training services. Its Agency services segment provides real estate agency services relate to services rendered in the sale and lease of public and private residential and commercial/industrial properties, including housing and development board flats and executive condominium, private condominiums, landed properties, retail shops, offices, and factories. Its Project marketing services segment provides real estate project marketing services related to services rendered in the sale of new private residential development projects for third-party property developers in Singapore as well as overseas. Its Administrative support services segment relates to use of space and other ancillary services. Its Training services segment relates mainly to real estate-related courses and training programs.

name: CREDIT BUREAU ASIA
businessSummary: Credit Bureau Asia Limited is a Singapore-based company, together with its subsidiaries, is a providing credit and risk information solutions in Southeast Asia. The Company’s segments include Non-Financial Institution Data and Financial Institution Data. It provides access to credit information on consumers or business entities, generated from up-to-date credit information contributed by subscribing members. The Company’s products and services include credit and risk information reports, credit scores, monitoring services, data trends and analytics, and client-specific tailored solutions. It offers worldwide and cross-border credit reporting services. The Company has more than 255 financial institution members across Singapore, Cambodia, and Myanmar, including banks, microfinance institutions, leasing companies, and rural credit operators. Its subsidiaries include Infocredit Holdings Pte. Ltd., CBA Investment Holdings Pte. Ltd., CBA (Cambodia) Pte. Ltd., and CBA (China) Pte. Ltd.

name: KEPPEL DC REIT
businessSummary: Keppel DC REIT is a data center real estate investment trust listed in Asia that invests in a diversified portfolio of incoming-producing real estate assets used primarily for data center purposes, as well as real estate and assets that support the digital economy. Its investments comprise a mix of colocation, fully fitted and shell and core assets, and debt securities. Its portfolio comprises approximately 23 centers that are in Singapore, Australia, China, Germany, Republic of Ireland (Ireland), Italy, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. Its data centers include Keppel DC Singapore 1, Keppel DC Singapore 2, Keppel DC Singapore 3, Keppel DC Singapore 4, Keppel DC Singapore 5, Keppel DC Singapore 7, Keppel DC Singapore 8, DC1, Gore Hill Data Centre, Guangdong Data Centre 1, Guangdong Data Centre 2, Guangdong Data Centre 3, maincubes Data Centre, Keppel DC Dublin 1, Keppel DC Dublin 2, Amsterdam Data Centre, Eindhoven Campus, Cardiff Data Centre, London Data Centre and others.

name: CAPITALAND INDIA TRUST
businessSummary: CapitaLand India Trust (CLINT) was listed on the Singapore Exchange Securities Trading Limited (SGX-ST) in August 2007 as the first Indian property trust in Asia. Its principal objective is to own income-producing real estate used primarily as business space in India. CLINT may also develop and acquire land or uncompleted developments primarily to be used as business space, with the objective of holding the properties upon completion. As at 30 June 2026, CLINT's assets under management stood at S3.5 billion dollars. CLINT's portfolio includes eight world-class IT business parks, three industrial facilities, one logistics park and four data center developments in India, with total completed floor area of 22.0 million square feet spread across Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune and Mumbai. CLINT is focused on capitalizing on the fast-growing IT industry and logistics/industrial asset classes in India, as well as proactively diversifying into other asset classes such as data centres. CLINT is structured as a business trust, offering stable income distributions like a real estate investment trust. CLINT focuses on enhancing shareholder value by actively managing existing properties, developing vacant land in its portfolio, and acquiring new properties. CLINT is managed by CapitaLand India Trust Management Pte. Ltd. The Trustee Manager is a wholly owned subsidiary of Singapore-listed CapitaLand Investment Limited, a leading global real asset manager with a strong presence in Asia. CapitaLand India Trust was established on December 07, 2004 and incorporated in Singapore.

name: UOL GROUP
businessSummary: UOL Group Limited is a Singapore-based property and hospitality company. The principal activities of the Company are investments in properties, subsidiaries, associated companies and listed and unlisted securities. The Company's segments include Property development, Property investments, Hotel operations, Investments, Technology operations and Management services. Property development segment is engaged in the development of properties for sale. The Property investments segment is involved in the leasing of commercial properties and serviced suites. Hotel operations segment is engaged in the operation of owned hotels. Its Investments segment invests in quoted and unquoted financial assets. The Technology operations segment is engaged in the distribution of computers and related products, including the provision of systems integration and networking infrastructure services. Management services segment is engaged in hotel management services under the Pan Pacific and PARKROYAL brands.

name: JOYY
businessSummary: JOYY Inc. is a global technology company. The Company operates several social media platforms such as Bigo Live, Likee and Hago that enable users to interact with others in real time. It operates through two segments: BIGO and All other. The BIGO segment primarily consists of several social entertainment platforms, including Bigo Live, Likee, imo, and certain audio live streaming platform, as well as its advertising platform, Bigo Ads. The All other segment primarily consist of Hago, Shopline, certain audio live streaming platforms, and others. Bigo Live enables its users to share their life moments, showcase their talents, socialize, and connect with other users. Likee enables users to easily discover, create and share short-form videos, with all-in-one video creation tools, such as filters and special effects, and AI-backed personalized feed. Hago provides casual games, audio and video multiuser chatrooms and three-dimensional (3D) avatars and 3D interactive scenes.

name: OUE
businessSummary: OUE Limited is a Singapore-based real estate development, investment and management company. Its segments include Real Estate, Healthcare and Others. The Real Estate segment includes investment properties, hospitality and development properties. Investment properties and fund management includes renting of investment properties owned by it and management of real estate investment trusts and investment properties under development. Hospitality includes operation of hotels and hotel management. Development properties include the sale of residential properties and other properties under development. The Healthcare segment is engaged in the operation of investment holdings, development of medical real estate, healthcare-related assets and integrated mixed-use development and provision of healthcare services and management of healthcare investment trusts. OUE Restaurants’ portfolio includes VUE, HighHouse, NOVA, Osteria Mozza, Takayama, Hashida Singapore and others.

name: FIRST REAL ESTATE INVESTMENT TRUST
businessSummary: First Real Estate Investment Trust (the Trust) is a Singapore-based healthcare real estate investment trust (REIT). The principal activity of the Trust is to invest in a portfolio of income producing real estate properties, which are primarily used for healthcare and healthcare related purposes. The primary objective is to deliver regular and stable distributions to unitholders and to achieve long-term growth in the net asset value per unit. The Trust has an asset portfolio of over 32 properties across Asia. These include approximately 15 properties in Indonesia comprising over 11 hospitals, two integrated hospitals and malls, one integrated hospital & hotel, and one hotel and country club; three nursing homes in Singapore; and 14 nursing homes in Japan. Its properties include Siloam Hospitals Baubau & Lippo Plaza Baubau, Siloam Hospitals Yogyakarta, Siloam Sriwijaya, Siloam Hospitals Bali, Loyal Residence Ayase, and others. Its manager is First REIT Management Limited.

name: JUMBO GROUP
businessSummary: Jumbo Group Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a food and beverage company engaged in the operation and management of restaurants and manufacturing of food. The Company operates in Singapore, the People’s Republic of China, South Korea, and Taiwan. Its brands include JUMBO Seafood, JUMBO Signatures, JUMBO Catering, NG AH SIO Bak Kut Teh, Chui Huay Lim Teochew Cuisine, Zui Yu Xuan Teochew Cuisine, Chao Ting, Kok Kee Wonton Noodle, Lau Lim Mee Pok, Singapore Seafood Republic, XINYAO, and Mutiara Seafood. Mutiara Seafood is a halal Singapore-style seafood restaurant. The Company, through its lifestyle brand Love, Afare, offers a range of products comprising packaged sauces and spice mixes for its signature dishes, snacks, tea, and merchandise. Its JUMBO Catering brand provides catering services for events. Its flagship brand, JUMBO Signatures, offers multiple dining options.

name: MICRO MECHANICS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Micro-Mechanics (Holdings) Ltd. is a Singapore-based global integrated mechanics solution company. The Company designs, manufactures and markets high-precision parts and tools used in process-critical applications for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. The Company’s segments include Consumable Tools and Wafer Fabrication Equipment (WFE) parts. Its Consumable Tools segment focuses on the design and manufacturing of miniature consumable tools used in the assembly and testing of semiconductors. Its WFE parts segment focuses primarily on making parts for semiconductor wafer fabrication equipment. Its products and solutions include Semiconductor, which include Die Attach, Wire-bonding, and Encapsulation. The Company serves a worldwide base of customers from five manufacturing facilities located in Singapore, Malaysia, China, the Philippines and the United States, and a direct sales presence in Taiwan, Europe, Thailand and Japan.

name: SAMUDERA SHIPPING LINE
businessSummary: Samudera Shipping Line Ltd is a Singapore-based company, which is primarily engaged in the transportation of containerized and non-containerized cargo through its container shipping and bulk and tanker business segments. The principal activities of the Company are the ownership and operating of ocean-going ships and the provision of containerized feeder shipping services. It provides logistics and warehousing related services. The Company's segments include Container Shipping, Bulk and Tanker and Logistics. The Container Shipping segment provides feeder services for the transportation of containerized cargo between Singapore as a hub port and other outgoing spoke ports in Asia, as well as inter-region and intra-region container shipping services to end users. The Bulk and Tanker segment provides transportation of special dry bulk, liquid and gas cargo in the international, as well as Indonesian domestic market. The Logistics segment includes forwarding, warehousing and other services.

name: HOSEN GROUP
businessSummary: Hosen Group Ltd. is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in importing, exporting, and distributing fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), specializing in processed food. The Company operates through two segments: House brands and Non-house brands. The House brands segment is engaged in the development, trading and distribution of canned seafood, canned fruits and vegetables and canned meat products, and chocolate products. Its Non-house brands segment is engaged in the importation, distribution, wholesaling and retailing of canned food and household consumable goods. The Company’s brands include Hosen Quality, Highway, Fortune, LaDiva, Sincero, Calbuco, Cocoa Grande, Living Forest, Hosen Select, Royal Select, Hula, and Fortune Tuna. The Company’s subsidiaries are Hock Seng Food Pte Ltd, Hosen Chocolate Sdn Bhd, Fortune Melinka Pte. Ltd, and among others.

name: ZIXIN GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Zixin Group Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a sweet potato biotech-focused integrated industrial value chain operator in the People’s Republic of China. Its segments include Cultivation and Supply (C&S), Product Innovation and Food Production (PIFP), Recovery & Recycling (R&R) and Others. Its C&S segment includes sales of fresh sweet potatoes, sales of sweet potato seedlings, research and development of sweet potato varieties to cultivate sweet potato seedlings, sweet potato cultivation techniques and solutions to improve the quality and yield of farmlands. Its PIFP segment includes sale of sweet potato processed products, and brand building, marketing and distribution. Its R&R segment includes sales of probiotic-infused sweet potato feedstock. The Others segment includes investment holdings expenses, provision of management, treasury and administrative services.

name: JE CLEANTECH HOLDINGS
businessSummary: JE Cleantech Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based company, which is principally engaged in the sale of precision cleaning systems and other equipment. The Company, through its subsidiary, JCS-Echigo Pte Ltd, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells cleaning systems for various industrial end-use applications primarily to customers in Singapore and Malaysia. The cleaning systems and other equipment the Company manufactures and sells are categorized into four different categories: aqueous washing systems, plating and cleaning systems, train cleaning systems and other equipment, such as filtration units. Its cleaning systems are mainly designed for precision cleaning, with features such as particle filtration, ultrasonic or megasonic rinses with a range of frequencies, high pressure drying technology, high flow rate spray, and deionized water rinses. The Company intends to relocate its dishwashing operations to the JCS Facility, along with its manufacturing operations.

name: TREK 2000 INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Trek 2000 International Ltd is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the ownership of a portfolio of intellectual property. The Company operates through four segments: Customised solutions, offers design solutions that incorporate its software, hardware and firmware; Interactive consumer solutions segment, provides external storage solutions; Renewable energy solutions, offers artificial intelligence solutions to manage renewable energy activities; and Corporate, comprises the corporate office in Singapore. The Company, through its subsidiaries, is engaged in research, design, development and dealing in computer hardware, software, and electronic components; marketing and distribution of computer peripherals and electronic components, and development and marketing of Web portal services, including social networking sites. Trek, ThumbDrive, and FluCard are trademarks or registered trademarks of the Company in Singapore and/or other countries.

name: HOCK LIAN SENG HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Hock Lian Seng Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based civil engineering company. The Company, through its subsidiaries, is engaged in managing its core business activities, such as civil engineering and construction, building construction, property development and investment. The Company's segments include Civil Engineering, Properties Development and Properties Investment. The Civil engineering segment is engaged in infrastructure construction and civil engineering works for bridges, expressways, tunnels and other related infrastructure works. The Properties development segment is engaged in the development of properties in the residential and industrial sectors. The Properties investment segment is engaged in the investment properties held to earn rentals and/or for capital appreciation, and others.

name: POWERMATIC DATA SYSTEMS
businessSummary: Powermatic Data Systems Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in manufacturing and sale of owned-made wireless connectivity products and the provision of sales /products related services. The principal activities of the Company are manufacturing, marketing and trading wireless connectivity products, which include wireless modules, embedded board, antenna, and providing sale and products related services. Its segments include Wireless connectivity products, Property and Corporate holding and others. The Wireless connectivity products segment includes s manufacturing, sales, marketing and distribution of wireless connectivity products. The Property segment comprises managing the investment properties. Its product range includes wireless radio modules, embedded boards, indoor and outdoor access points and wireless antennas. The products are used in various industries such as factory automation, healthcare, hospitality, and security surveillance.

name: NATURAL COOL HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Natural Cool Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company operates through four segments: Aircon and Engineering, Paint and Coatings, Food and Beverages (F&B), and Technology. The Aircon and Engineering segment is engaged in trading air-conditioning units and spare parts, installation services for commercial air-conditioning systems and mechanical ventilation, plumbing and sanitary works and maintenance services. The Paint and Coatings segment is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of paint and basic chemicals. The F&B segment is engaged in the operation of restaurants and stalls, manufacturing and wholesale of F&B products. The Technology segment is involved in the installation of building automated systems for remote monitoring and maintenances services. Its subsidiaries include Natural Cool Airconditioning & Engineering Pte Ltd, Cougar Paint Pte. Ltd., Natural Cool Asia Pte. Ltd., Lifestyle Guru Pte. Ltd., SFB Holdings Pte. Ltd., and others.

name: KODA
businessSummary: Koda Ltd is a Singapore-based company. The Company is engaged in the manufacture and export of furniture and fixtures of wood (including upholstery), furniture design service and investment holding. Its segments include manufacturing; retail and distribution. It uses different metals such as fluted glass, tempered glass, or crystal-clear glass, brass, stainless steel, and aluminum in its furniture, combining with wood. It also uses eather, bycast leather, bonded leather, polyvinyl chloride (PVC), polyurethane (PU) leather and leather-likes in chairs, headboards, and sofas. The Company's subsidiaries include Jatat Furniture Industries Sdn Bhd, Koda Woodcraft Sdn Bhd, Koda Indochine Co., Ltd, Koda International Co., Ltd, Koda Saigon Co., Ltd, Commune Lifestyle Pte Ltd, Commune Lifestyle Sdn Bhd, Commune (Dongguan) Trading Co. Ltd, Commune (Chongqing) Trading Co. Ltd, Commune (Shanghai) Trading Co. Ltd.

name: RECTITUDE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Rectitude Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company. The Company is principally involved in the provision of safety equipment, encompassing essential items, such as personal protective clothing, hand gloves, safety footwear, and personal fall arrest systems, portable fire extinguishers, and traffic products, such as rubber speed humps, wheel stops and wheel chocks. It also offers auxiliary products, such as industrial hardware tools and electrical hardware required for construction sites. Its products and solutions are marketed to an array of distributor networks and end markets, both in Singapore and throughout the Southeast Asian region, including Brunei, Cambodia, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Vietnam. Its customers belong to the infrastructure development, building construction, marine, oil and gas industries, and general industrial markets. Its subsidiaries include Alturan Supplies Pte. Ltd, P.T.H Pte. Ltd., and Rectitude Pte Ltd.

name: BOUSTEAD SINGAPORE
businessSummary: Boustead Singapore Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company operates through five segments: Energy Engineering, Real Estate Solutions, Geospatial, Healthcare and HQ Activities. Energy Engineering segment is engaged in designing, engineering and supplying critical systems, including process heater systems, heat recovery systems and process control systems for the global oil and gas, and petrochemical sectors. Real Estate Solutions segment is engaged in the provision of eco-sustainable real estate solutions, including turnkey engineering and construction services, development management, asset and leasing management, and fund management services for diversified classes of real estate. Geospatial is engaged in distribution, professional services, and solutions related to Esri ArcGIS, the geographic information system, smart mapping, and location analytics platform. Healthcare is engaged in distribution, services, and solutions related to medical solutions.

name: TAKA JEWELLERY HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Taka Jewellery Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company’s subsidiaries are engaged in the business of wholesale and retail of jewelry, pawn broking, and secured moneylending. Its segments are wholesale and exhibitions, retail, and financial services. The wholesale and exhibitions segment is engaged in the sale of jewelry through participation in international jewelry exhibitions and trade fairs and to wholesale customers. The retail segment is engaged in the sale of jewelry to customers at retail outlets and promotional events. The financial services segment is engaged in the pawn-broking business and the secured lending business. It offers a range of jewelry items and designs consisting of classic solitaires for everyday wear and designer pieces. Its brands include Taka Jewellery, which sells jewelry; Top Cash, which is a pawnbroking business including the trading and retailing of used gold and pre-owned jewelry.

name: LINCOTRADE & ASSOCIATES HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Lincotrade & Associates Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company specializes in interior fitting-out services, additions and alterations (A&A) works, and other building construction services. The Company operates through three segments, namely Commercial, Residential, and Showflats. Its Commercial segment is engaged in the provision of construction services to commercial premises, such as offices, hotels, shopping malls, and food and beverage establishments. Its Residential segment is engaged in the provision of construction services to residential premises, such as condominium developments. Its Showflats segment is engaged in building showflats and sales galleries. The Company’s subsidiary is Lincotrade & Associates Pte Ltd, which engages in provision of interior design, renovation, carpentry and joinery services, carrying over interior fitting-out works and manufacturing of builders’ carpentry, and joinery.

name: AZTECH GLOBAL
businessSummary: Aztech Global Ltd. is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company and its subsidiaries design and manufacture Internet of things (IoT) devices and data-communication products across diverse industries including security, consumer, communications, health-tech, industrial and automotive. It operates through two segments: manufacturing and distribution and trading. The manufacturing segment manufactures electronic products for its customers, including related corporations. The distribution and trading segment sells electronic products to its customers including related corporations. It distributes a range of IoT devices and data-communication products sold under its Aztech and Kyla brands through channel partners and e-commerce platforms. It also provides one-stop design and manufacturing services for blue chip customers, technology start-ups and others.

name: TAT SENG PACKAGING GROUP
businessSummary: Tat Seng Packaging Group Ltd is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing and sales of corrugated paper products and other packaging products. The Company's geographical segments include Singapore and the People's Republic of China (PRC). The Company's products include corrugated paper boards, corrugated paper cartons, die-cut boxes, assembly cartons and heavy-duty corrugated packaging products. It also carries and sells a range of other packaging related products. Its customers include multi-national corporations and local manufacturers in the food and beverage industry, electronics and electrical industry, pharmaceutical and chemical industry, plastic and metal stamping industry as well as other exporting related industries. The Company's subsidiaries include United Packaging Industries Pte. Ltd., Tat Seng Packaging (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., Hefei Dansun Packaging Co., Ltd., and Tianjin Dansun Packaging Co., Ltd.

name: GOLDEN AGRI RESOURCES
businessSummary: Golden Agri-Resources Ltd is a fully integrated agribusiness company focused on the technology-driven production and distribution of palm-based products. Its segments include Plantations and palm oil mills; and Palm, laurics and others. The Plantations and palm oil mills segment comprises the products from the upstream business. The Palm, laurics and others segment includes processing and global merchandising of palm and oilseed-based products comprising bulk and branded products, oleochemicals, sugar and other vegetable oils. The Company's activities include cultivating and harvesting oil palm trees; extracting fresh fruit bunches into crude palm oil and palm kernels; processing them into value-added products, such as cooking oil, margarine, shortening, biodiesel and oleochemicals. It also has complementary businesses, such as soybean-based products in China, sunflower-based products in India, and sugar businesses.

name: UNION GAS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Union Gas Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company and its subsidiaries are engaged in providing fuel products. The Company’s three segments: Gas fuel, Liquid fuel and Others. Its gas fuel segment is engaged in bottling liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and the sale and distribution of bottled LPG and LPG-related accessories and services to dealers, domestic households, and industrial and commercial customers. Its liquid fuel segment is engaged in the sale and distribution of diesel and petrol to commercial customers and to vehicles through a refiling station and bulk sales of diesel. Its other operations include provision of corporate services, revenue from electric vehicle charging services and sale of industrial gases. Its services include residential LPG, commercial LPG, diesel, natural gas, compressed natural gas, piped natural gas and others. It offers stoves, hoods, rubber hoses, and regulators for LPG usage to primarily residential homes.

name: UP FINTECH HOLDING
businessSummary: UP Fintech Holding Ltd is mainly engaged in the operation of an integrated financial technology platform providing cross-market, multi-product investment experience for investors around the world. The Company offers comprehensive brokerage services through its integrated single-account structure, which empowers users in trade execution, margin financing and securities lending across different global markets. The Company also provides value-added services, such as investor education, community engagement and IR/PR platform, all within a few taps or clicks through application (APP) on smartphone, tablet and personal computer (PC) terminals. The Company also offers ESOP management services to soon-to-be listed and listed companies. The Company primarily operates its business in the New Zealand, Singapore and the United States.

isin: NS8U.SI|Hutchison Port Holdings Trust|NS8U.SI|Hutchison Port Holdings Trust
name: HUTCHISON PORT HOLDINGS TRUST
businessSummary: Hutchison Port Holdings Trust invests in, develops, operates, and manages deep-water container ports in Guangdong Province of the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and Macau. The company invests in other types of port assets, such as river ports  and undertakes various port ancillary services, including trucking, feedering, freight forwarding, supply chain management, warehousing, and distribution services. Hutchison Port Holdings Trust was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Singapore.

name: SINGAPORE POST
businessSummary: Singapore Post Limited is a Singapore-based postal and e-commerce logistics provider in Asia Pacific. The portfolio of businesses spans from national and international postal services to warehousing and fulfillment, and last-mile delivery. The Company’s segment includes International and Singapore. The international segment comprises international cross-border distribution of mail and parcels, and logistics solutions including warehousing services. The Singapore segment comprises domestic postal services, including mail distribution and products and services transacted at the post offices; parcel distribution; eCommerce logistics and other value-added solutions; and property leasing. The Company’s subsidiaries include Singapore Post Enterprise Private Limited, SingPost Logistics Holdings Pte. Ltd., SingPost Investments Pte. Ltd., SingPost Logistics Investments Pte. Ltd., SingPost Holdings Pte. Ltd., and others.

name: A SONIC AEROSPACE
businessSummary: A-Sonic Aerospace Limited is a Singapore-based company. The Company is engaged in investment holding and provision of management services. The Company operates through two business segments: Aviation and Logistics. The Company's Aviation segment is engaged in the purchase and sale of aircraft and aircraft engines. Its Logistics segment is engaged in providing supply chain management services. The Company specializes in various aspects of logistic solutions, including international and domestic multi-modal transportation, warehousing, distribution, customs clearance, and airport ground services. The Company operates in approximately 28 cities in 15 countries, spanning four continents in Asia, North America, Europe, and Sub-Continent India. The Company’s subsidiaries include A-Sonic Aviation Solutions Pte. Ltd. and A-Sonic Logistic Solutions Pte. Ltd.

name: SBS TRANSIT
businessSummary: SBS Transit Ltd is a Singapore-based company that is engaged in the provision of public transport services, such as bus and rail services. Its public transport services include Basic Bus Services, Express Bus Services, City Direct Bus Services, Shuttle Bus Services, North East Line, Downtown Line, Sengkang Light Rail Transit, and Punggol Light Rail Transit. Its bus fleet consists of approximately 3,329 buses, and its rail fleet includes 198 trains. It operates through two segments: Public Transport Services and Other Commercial Services. The Public Transport Services segment is engaged in the provision of bus and rail services to commuters traveling on public transport systems. The Other Commercial Services segment is engaged in advertisements on buses and trains and at bus interchanges and rail stations, and rental collections from commercial and shop space at bus interchanges and rail stations. Its subsidiaries include SBS Transit Rail Pte. Ltd. and SBS Transit Mobility Pte. Ltd.

name: VIBROPOWER
businessSummary: VibroPower Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the provision of management and administrative support to its subsidiaries. The Company operates through two segments: Projects (supplying power generators) and Others. Its others segment includes rental income from leasehold property. The Company has two principal activities, one is supplying, designing, manufacturing, installing, commissioning and servicing power generators used mainly in commercial and industrial projects and housing projects, the other is supplying electricity to power grids. Its geographical segments include Singapore, Asia, Hong Kong and China. Its subsidiaries include GMTM Holdings Pte. Ltd., Shanghai VibroPower Generators Equipment Co. Ltd., and VibroPower Pte. Ltd. The Shanghai VibroPower Generators Equipment Co. Ltd. is engaged in the import and sale of engines and spare parts.

name: LHT HOLDINGS
businessSummary: LHT Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in manufacturing and trading of wooden pallets and timber-related products. The Company manufactures wooden pallets, boxes and crates in Singapore. Its segments include pallet/packaging, timber related products, Technical Wood and related products, and pallet rental and others. The pallet/packaging segment is mainly engaged in the manufacture and supply of wooden pallets and cases for the packing of industrial products. The timber related products segment is mainly engaged in the trading of raw timber related products. The Technical Wood and related products segment is engaged in the manufacture of Technical Wood, Technical Wood flooring and wood waste collection. The pallet rental and others segment are mainly engaged in pallet-leasing business. Its products include Greenflo Door, Greenflo Flooring, Plastic Pallet, Pinewood/Solid Timber/Plywood, Wooden Pallet, and others.

name: SEATRIUM
businessSummary: Seatrium Limited is a Singapore-based company, which is engaged in the provision of management services and investment holding. The business activities of the Company and its subsidiaries include the provision of engineering solutions to the global offshore, marine, and energy industries. The Company has two reportable segments, namely Rigs & floaters, repairs & upgrades, offshore platforms and specialised shipbuilding segment and Ship chartering segment. Its key business sectors include Oil & Gas Newbuilds and Conversions, Offshore Renewables, Repairs & Upgrades, and New Energies. It operates shipyards, engineering & technology centers and facilities in various countries such as Singapore, Brazil, China, India, Indonesia, and other countries. Its subsidiaries include Gravifloat AS, Jurong Shipyard Pte Ltd, PPL Shipyard Pte Ltd, Jurong Shipbuilders Private Limited, Seatrium (SG) Pte. Ltd., Seatrium Financial Services Pte. Ltd., SML Shipyard Pte Ltd, among others.

name: BANYAN TREE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Banyan Tree Holdings Limited is an investment holding company. The Company is engaged in the provision of project design and management services. The Company manages a diversified portfolio of hotels, resorts, spas, galleries, golf courses, and residences. Its segments include Hotel Investments, Residences, and Fee-based. Its Hotel Investments segment includes hotel and restaurant operations. The Residences segment comprises hotel residences, Laguna property sales and development project/site sales. Hotel residence business relates to the sale of hotel villas or suites to investors. The Laguna property sales business relates to the development and sale of properties which are standalone vacation homes in Laguna Phuket. The Fee-based segment comprises the management of hotels and resorts, the management and operation of spas, the provision of project and design services, the management and ownership of golf courses, and rental of retail outlets and offices.

name: NIPPECRAFT
businessSummary: Nippecraft Limited is a Singapore-based lifestyle stationery solutions provider. The principal activities of the Company are those relating to the design, manufacture, distribution and trading of paper, personal and business organizing tools, as well as general trading of pulp, chemical, and recycled waste and other products. The Company has two business segments: Stationery business and Trading business. The main activities of the Stationery business segment are design, development, sales and marketing of planners/ diaries, business accessories and related stationery products. The main activities of the Trading business segment are trading and strategic sourcing of recycled waste, chemicals, papers, paper bags, pulp, and other related materials. Its core brands are Collins and Debden. Collins is a stationery brand in the UK and Australia.

name: GRAND BANKS YACHTS
businessSummary: Grand Banks Yachts Limited is a Singapore-based company. The Company operates as a renowned manufacturer of recreational motor yachts. It manufactures yachts under the Grand Banks, Eastbay, and Palm Beach brands out of its manufacturing yard at Pasir Gudang, Johor, Malaysia. It provides new boat sales, brokerages, and support services out of its waterfront facilities in the United States of America, Europe, and Australia. The yachts, which range between approximately 42 feet and 107 feet. It offers long-range cruiser series models such as Grand Banks 85, Grand Banks 73, Grand Banks 65, Grand Banks 62, Grand Banks 60, and Grand Banks 54. The Grand Banks 85 offers a spacious cockpit for entertaining around 10 and 20 guests. The extended length beam provides a range of customizable layout configurations, including three or four staterooms and separate crew or guest quarters. The Grand Banks 65 ranges over 19-foot, 2-inch beam and generous interior volume.

name: AERIES TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Aeries Technology, Inc. provides professional and technology consulting services in North America, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. It provides professional advisory services, such as the participation of senior leadership, recommending strategies and practices related to operating model design, consultation on various areas, market availability, regulatory compliance, and optimization of tax structure  and operations management services, including application engineering, information technology, data analytics and business intelligence, cybersecurity, finance and accounting, human resources, customer service, and operations. The company serves portfolio companies of private equity firms, middle-market companies, and technology-enabled enterprises. Aeries Technology, Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Singapore.

isin: 2342.HK|Comba Telecom Systems Holdings Limited|2342.HK|Comba Telecom Systems Holdings Limited
name: COMBA TELECOM SYSTEMS HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Comba Telecom Systems Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of wireless telecommunications network system equipment and related engineering services. It operates in two segments: Wireless Telecommunications Network System Equipment and Services, and Operator Telecommunication Services. The company provides base station antennas and subsystems  open radio  ScanViS  and network system products, as well as cell site and enterprise solutions  consultancy, DAS network design, maintenance, and network optimization services  and technical support, value-added, and repairing services. It also engages in assembling, trading, and marketing of wireless telecommunications network system equipment  manufacture and sale of intelligent machinery  research and development, and trading of digital microwave system equipment  and provision of hardware and software solutions and services. The company serves airport, education, government and public safety, healthcare, hospitality, retail, stadium, and transportation industries. It has operations in Mainland China, rest of Asia Pacific, the Americas, the European Union, the Middle East, and internationally. Comba Telecom Systems Holdings Limited was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Singapore.

name: HYPHENS PHARMA INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Hyphens Pharma International Limited is a Singapore-based specialty pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare company. The Company's principal activities are those of an investment holding company and provision of management services. The Company's segments include Specialty pharma principals, Proprietary brands, and Medical hypermart and digital. The Specialty pharma principals segment is engaged in the business of marketing and selling a range of specialty pharmaceutical products with exclusivity in the relevant ASEAN countries. The Proprietary brands segment is engaged in the business of developing, marketing and selling its own proprietary range of dermatological products and health supplement products. The Medical hypermart and digital segment is a wholesaler of pharmaceuticals and medical supplies in Singapore, which the Company and its subsidiaries position themselves as a medical hypermart for healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions and retail pharmacies.

name: QIAN HU
businessSummary: Qian Hu Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based integrated ornamental fish service provider. The principal activities of the Company are those relating to the import, export, farming, breeding and distribution of ornamental fishes and aquarium and pet accessories. Its segments include Fish, Accessories, Plastics and Others. The Fish segment includes fish farming, breeding, distribution, and trading of ornamental and edible fish/seafood. The Accessories segment includes manufacturing and distribution of aquarium and pet accessories. The Plastics segment includes the manufacturing and distribution of plastic bags. It has business activities ranging from the breeding of Dragon Fish to farming, importing, exporting, and distributing of over 1,000 species and varieties of ornamental fish. It farms fingerlings of Grouper variants, such as Humpback Groupers, Coral Trout and Hybrid Giant Groupers primarily for the China market. It exports ornamental fish to approximately 80 countries.

name: ES GROUP HOLDINGS
businessSummary: ES Group (Holdings) Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company and provider of management and technical services. The Company's core business activities include ship building, ship repair, rig building, ship conversion and offshore structures, blasting and painting, scaffolding, and pipe works business. Its segments include New building repair, and Shipping. The New building and repair segment is engaged in new building, conversion and repair of offshore and marine structures and vessels, and labor supply. The Shipping segment is engaged in ship chartering, marine supplies, and related activities. It also involves in the engineering, procurement, and construction of the 85 meters self-propel transporter. Its ship conversion and offshore structures include bow thruster, crane tub, forecastle block, poop block, flare tower, stern thruster, helideck, and others. It also owns an over 70,000-square meter shipyard with fabrication grounds through its subsidiary in Thailand.

isin: VZS.F|COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd.|VZS.F|COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd.
name: COSCO SHIPPING INTERNATIONAL SINGAPORE
businessSummary: COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, provides integrated logistics services in South and Southeast Asia. It operates through Shipping, Ship Repair and Marine Engineering Activities, Logistics, and Property Management segments. The company provides warehousing solutions, including crating and packing cross-docking emergency parts distribution knitting and co-packing services labeling and tagging light manufacturing pick and pack, labeling, fulfillment, delivery purchase order management re-work receiving and inventory replenishment sorting, and segregating stock transfer. It also offers dry bulk shipping services generally for grain, iron ore, coal, steel, cement, and fertilizer, as well as provides fabrication work services and production of marine outfitting components for all types of vessels, such as oil tankers, bulk carriers, and container liners. In addition, the company provides container depots for storing and servicing general purpose containers, reefer containers, and other special equipment  and automotive logistics, including warehouse and storage, repossessed vehicle assistance, storage of used/de-registered cars for export or scrap, transportation and documentation, and stuffing/un-stuffing of vehicles into containers services. Further, it offers trucking, police escort, port clearance, freight-coordination, and dry hubbing services  and property management services. The company was formerly known as COSCO Corporation (Singapore) Limited and changed its name to COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd. in April 2017. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Singapore. COSCO SHIPPING International (Singapore) Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Ocean Shipping Company Limited.

name: KOYO INTERNATIONAL
businessSummary: Koyo International Limited is a Singapore-based company. The principal activities of the Company are those of investment holding and business of providing integrated mechanical and electrical engineering (M&E) services. It has four operating segments, namely Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management, and Investment Holding Business. The Mechanical Engineering segment is engaged in designing and installing air-conditioning and mechanical ventilation, plumbing and sanitary installation, fire prevention and protection systems, as well as integrated systems. The Electrical Engineering segment is engaged in designing and installing high- and low-tension electrical distribution systems, as well as communications, audio-visual and security systems. The Facilities Management segment provides maintenance, repair and replacement services. The Investment Holding Business segment is engaged in measuring the quoted equity securities at a value through profit or loss.

name: FU YU
businessSummary: Fu Yu Corporation Limited is a Singapore-based company that provides vertically integrated services for the manufacture of precision plastic components and the fabrication of precision molds and dies. The Company operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Supply Chain Management Services. Its Manufacturing segment is engaged in the manufacturing and sub-assembly of precision plastic parts and components. The Manufacturing segment has three geographical markets that are based on the location of assets, which include Singapore, Malaysia, and China. Its comprehensive capabilities range from precision tool design and fabrication, precision injection molding to secondary processes, such as silk screen printing, ultrasonic welding, heat staking and spray painting, as well as sub-assembly. Its Supply Chain Management Services segment is engaged in selling crude and refined petroleum products, including gasoil and crude palm oil products such as acid oil.

name: OLAM GROUP
businessSummary: Olam Group Limited is engaged in the sourcing, processing, packaging, and merchandising of agricultural products. It is focused on food and agri-business, supplying food, ingredients, feed, and fiber to customers. Its segments include Olam Food Ingredients, Olam Global Agri, and Remaining Olam Group. The Olam Food Ingredients segment includes cocoa, coffee, edible nuts, spices, and dairy. The Olam Global Agri segment includes grains and oilseeds, freight, edible oils, feed and proteins, rice, wood products, and commodity Financial Services. The Remaining Olam Group segment includes de-prioritized businesses (rubber plantations, fertilizer, infrastructure and logistics, and other de-prioritized assets), continuing/gestating businesses (palm plantations, Russian dairy and packaged foods), and incubating businesses (engine 2 growth platforms). It works with food manufacturers and artisanal chefs, packaged food producers to retailers, and from feed producers to cotton spinners.

name: FRASER AND NEAVE
businessSummary: Fraser and Neave, Limited is a Singapore-based company that is engaged in the production and sale of beverages and dairy products, and printing and publishing. The Company’s geographical segments include Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam. Its Food and Beverage (F&B) division produces, markets and sells soft drinks, beer, dairies, juices and ice cream. Its F&B brands include 100PLUS, F&N and F&N NUTRISOY for Soft Drinks, CHANG for Beer, F&N MAGNOLIA for Dairies, and F&N MAGNOLIA and F&N KING'S for Ice Cream. Its printing and publishing brands include Marshall Cavendish, Times Printers, Print Lab, Office & Schools Solutions, Times Distribution, Pansing, Times bookstores, Kaboom and GoGuru. The Company’s subsidiaries include Emerald Brewery Myanmar Limited, F&N Foods Pte Ltd, F&N Creameries Group, Fraser & Neave Holdings Bhd Group, Warburg Group and Yoke Food Industries Group.

name: ELLIPSIZ
businessSummary: Ellipsiz Ltd is a Singapore-based engineering and service solution provider. The principal activities of the Company are investment holding and the provision of management services. Its segments include Distribution and Services Solutions (DSS), Automated Precision System Solutions (APSS), Property Investment and Development, and Egg Production and Distribution (EPD). DSS segment provides solutions for in-circuit and functional testing, distribution and trading of scientific instruments and electronic equipment, provision of related technical services and support. APSS provides customized systems and solutions for test automation, high precision automated assembly process for fiber and lens, and full automated wafer level testing. Property Investment and Development segment develops properties for investment purposes. EPD segment is engaged in the production and distribution of fresh eggs. It serves customers in the semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries.

name: BAKER TECHNOLOGY
businessSummary: Baker Technology Limited is an investment holding company, which offers the provision of specialized marine offshore equipment and services for the oil and gas and renewables sectors. The Company and its subsidiaries, engage in the design, construction, operation and chartering of mobile offshore units and offshore supply vessels, along with the design and construction of a range of critical equipment and components for the marine offshore industry. Its products and services include offshore pedestal cranes, anchor winches, skidding systems, jacking systems, raw water tower structures and wind turbine installation equipment, among others. It has three operating segments. The marine offshore segment comprises manufacturers and providers of specialized marine offshore equipment and services for the oil and gas industry. The investments segment relates to the investments in available-for-sale investments. The corporate segment is engaged in corporate services and treasury functions.

name: YANGZIJIANG FINANCIAL HOLDING
businessSummary: Yangzijiang Financial Holding Ltd. is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is engaged in investment-related activities and its investments include debt investments, venture capital investments, maritime fund investments, micro-financing, and fund management and investment advisory services. Its investment management business is focused on achieving capital appreciation and investment income from investments in both public and private companies, as well as deploying funds into various situations. Its fund and wealth management business generates recurring fee-based income from managing third-party investment funds and provision of wealth management services, via acquiring capital markets services-licensed fund management companies and/or setting up a fund management company in Singapore. It invests in debt investments comprising fixed interest debt instruments through intermediary financial institutions for specific borrowings arranged by such intermediaries.

name: LION ASIAPAC
businessSummary: Lion Asiapac Limited is a Singapore-based company engaged in lime sales, trading of steel consumables, and investment holdings. The Company's segments include Supply of roofing solutions, Lime sales, Trading, and Investment holding. Supply of roofing solutions segment provides solutions for metal roofing and wall cladding. Lime sales segment is engaged in the production and sales of quicklime, hydrated lime, and quicklime powder. Trading segment is engaged in the trading of consumables required for steel product manufacturing. Investment holding segment is engaged in managing investments. The Company’s subsidiaries include Compact Energy Sdn Bhd, LAP Exploration Pte. Ltd., LAP Investment Pte. Ltd., and LAP Trading & Marketing Pte. Ltd. The Compact Energy Sdn Bhd produces lime products and has approximately two quicklime plants with a total annual production capacity of 400,000 metric tons. The LAP Trading & Marketing Pte Ltd is engaged in the trading of steel consumables.

name: OM HOLDINGS
businessSummary: OM Holdings Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company supplies manganese ores and ferroalloys. Through its trading network, the Company distributes products from its Asia-Pacific base to customers across the world. The Company is engaged in the business of trading raw ores, smelting and marketing processed ferroalloys. Its businesses include Bootu Creek Mine, Samalaju Smelting Complex, Qinzhou Smelter, Marketing & Trading, and Tshipi Borwa. The Company operates through three segments: Mining, Smelting, and Marketing and trading. The Mining segment is engaged in the exploration and mining of manganese ore. The Smelting segment is engaged in the production of manganese ferroalloys, ferrosilicon, and manganese sinter ore. The Marketing and trading segment is engaged in the trading of manganese ore, manganese ferroalloys, ferrosilicon, sinter ore, chrome ore and iron ore.

name: INNOTEK
businessSummary: InnoTek Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. The Company is a precision metal components manufacturer, providing metal stamping, commercial tool and die fabrications, and precision machining works. The Company's segments include Precision Components and Tooling, and Precision Machining. The Precision Components and Tooling segment specializes in sales of stamping components, tooling design and fabrication to a range of industries such as automotive components, office automation and consumer electronics products. It also provides die making services to manufacturers of such products. The Precision Machining segment specializes in the machining of products mainly from the television (TV) and office automation industries. This segment also has a specialty in metal-related components for customers in the TV, tablets and mobile-phone industries through advanced technologies like cold-forging, computer numerical control machining and surface decoration.

name: STARHUB
businessSummary: StarHub Ltd is a Singapore-based company engaged in the operation and provision of telecommunications services and other businesses relating to the info-communications industry. The Company operates through two segments: Telecommunications and Cybersecurity. The Telecommunications segment comprises the Company’s mobile, entertainment, broadband, enterprise business, and equipment sales on a fully integrated network that has centralized customer service, sales, marketing, and administration support. This segment also includes regional information and communication technology (ICT), MyRepublic Broadband, and JOS entities. The Cybersecurity segment is engaged in the provision of systems integration activities and the supply of high-security assurance products and technology. The Company develops and offers corporate and government clients solutions incorporating artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data analytics, cloud computing, the Internet of Things (IoT), and robotics.

isin: G07|GREAT EASTERN HOLDINGS|G07.SI|Great Eastern Holdings Limited
name: GREAT EASTERN HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Great Eastern Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides insurance products in Singapore, Malaysia, and rest of Asia. It operates through Life Insurance, Non-Life Insurance, and Shareholders segments. The company offers life, health, and personal accident insurance  retirement income, wealth accumulation, and investment-linked funds  as well as travel, car, home, and maid insurance. It also provides National Schemes, such as Dependants' Protection Scheme, a term-life insurance scheme that covers death, terminal illness, and total permanent disability  Great Legacy Programme  MediSave-approved  and other property and casualty insurance for businesses. In addition, the company offers asset management services. It serves through distribution channels, such as tied agency force, bancassurance, brokers and financial advisory firm Great Eastern financial advisers. The company was formerly known as Pastiche Limited. Great Eastern Holdings Limited was founded in 1908 and is based in Singapore. Great Eastern Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited.

name: MONEYMAX FINANCIAL SERVICES
businessSummary: MoneyMax Financial Services Ltd. (MoneyMax) is a Singapore-based financial services provider, retailer, and trader of luxury products in Southeast Asia. The principal activity of the Company is that of investment holdings. It is also engaged, through its subsidiaries, pawnbroking, retail and trading of gold and luxury items, secured lending, auction and general insurance. The Company provides customers with short-term financing solutions, secured by pledged collateral articles such as gold, diamond and gem-set jewelry, and timepieces. It offers loans to individuals and businesses in the form of secured collateral, such as property. Its segments are Pawnbroking, Retail and trading of gold and luxury items, Secured lending, and Other operations including investment holding and provision of other support services. The Company offers motor, travel, home, and commercial insurance services. The Company, through its MoneyMax Online platform, offers to shop, sell and appraise their valuables.

name: GLOBAL INVACOM GROUP
businessSummary: Global Invacom Group Limited is a Singapore-based investment holding company. It is an independent, fully integrated, satellite ground network equipment provider. The Company together with its subsidiaries offers a portfolio of satellite ground network equipment products and solutions, including Satellite Communications (Satcom); Satellite Broadcast Television (SatTV); and Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), that cater to the needs the industry’s main market sectors. Its two business segments include Very Small Aperture Terminal (VSAT) and Non-VSAT. It has a portfolio of multiple patented technologies and manufacturing processes which are designed, developed and manufactured in-house, including Radio Frequency (RF) electronics, Metal and light-weight composite antennas, Antenna multi-axis steering and tracking systems, Radio Frequency over Fibre (RFoF) transport and distribution, and Waveguide transport and distribution.

name: SOUND GROUP
businessSummary: Sound Group Inc. is a global artificial intelligence (AI)-powered audio company. Leveraging its voice AI technologies and deep audio interaction and building a diverse ecosystem of intelligent audio products that cater to a global user base. The Company’s offerings include live audio streaming, multi-user voice interactions, and podcasts. Its SoundSphereAI, a voice AI technology showcase and experience platform. The platform presents selected voice AI technologies and research and development (R&D) achievements across automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech and real-time audio intelligence. SoundSphereAI provides an interactive experience module that allows users to intuitively explore voice AI technology use cases through introduction of the Company’s voice AI technology architecture, capability modules, and applied scenarios. The Company also offers developers, creators, and partners a window into voice technology capabilities and long-term technical roadmap.

name: MARCO POLO MARINE
businessSummary: Marco Polo Marine Ltd. is a Singapore-based investment holding company. It is a marine logistic company which principally engages in shipping and shipyard businesses. The shipping business of the Company relates to the chartering of Offshore Supply Vessels (OSVs), which comprise mainly Anchor Handling Tug Supply Vessels (AHTS). The shipyard business of the Company relates to ship building as well as the provision of ship maintenance, repair, outfitting and conversion services. The Company’s segments include Ship chartering services, which relate to charter hire activities; and Shipbuilding and repair services, which relate to sales of goods, shipbuilding, and ship repair activities. Its subsidiaries include Marco Polo Shipping Co Pte Ltd, Marco Polo Shipyard Pte Ltd, MP Marine Pte Ltd, and MP Ventures Pte Ltd.

name: GRP
businessSummary: GRP Limited is a Singapore-based company that is engaged in the investment holding and rental of properties. The Company's segments include Hose & Marine, Measuring Instruments / Metrology, and Property. The Hose & Marine segment is engaged in engineering works and hose management services, such as the design and manufacture of hose fittings and couplings, and provides services to the onshore, offshore, marine, pharmaceutical, and petrochemical markets. The Measuring Instruments / Metrology segment is engaged in the trading and distribution of precision measuring instruments and equipment. The Property segment is engaged in property development activities, such as acquiring and holding property-related assets and trading in properties. Its subsidiaries include GRP Land Pte Ltd, GRP Pte Ltd, Region Suppliers (Pte) Limited, GRP Suppliers Pte Ltd, and Region Suppliers Sdn Bhd. Region Suppliers Sdn Bhd is engaged in trading of measuring instruments and scientific apparatus.

name: ASPIAL LIFESTYLE
