businessSummary: Standard Bank Group Limited is a South Africa-based financial services provider company. It operates in four segments. Personal & Private Banking is offered to individual clients from personal to private clients that provides tailored and comprehensive financial services solutions. Business & Commercial Banking is offered to small and medium-sized businesses, as well as large commercial enterprises consisting of broad-based client solutions that delivers advisory, networking and sustainability support required by its clients. Corporate & Investment Banking is offered to large companies (multinational, regional and domestic), governments, parastatals and institutional clients providing in-depth sector and regional expertise, specialized capabilities and access to capital markets for advisory, transactional, risk management and funding support. Insurance & Asset Management providing solutions to fulfil clients' long and short-term insurance, health, investment and asset management needs.

name: ASPEN PHARMACARE HOLDINGS
businessSummary: Aspen Pharmacare Holdings Limited is a South Africa-based global specialty and branded multinational pharmaceutical company. The Company focuses on marketing and manufacturing a range of post-patent, branded medicines and domestic brands covering both hospital and consumer markets. Its segments include Prescription, Over the counter (OTC), Injectables, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), Finished Dose Form (FDF) and Heparin. It offers sterile products in injectable form primarily administered in hospitals and also those prescribed and administered by either physicians or in a retail pharmacy environment. Its key brands include Arixtra, Diprivan, Fraxiparine, Marcaine, Sustanon and Xylocaine (Injectables). Its OTC segment includes products that do not require prescriptions and are primarily sold in the retail pharmacy and fast-moving consumer goods sectors. Its Prescription segment includes products which generally require a prescription from a healthcare professional.

name: ANDRADA MINING
businessSummary: Andrada Mining Limited is a Guernsey-based critical raw materials producer with mining and exploration assets in Namibia. The Company’s assets include Uis Mine, Lithium Ridge, Brandberg West, and others. The flagship Uis tin mine is scalable, tin and tantalum off-take agreements to supply Thailand Smelting and Refining Co. Limited (Thaisarco) and AfriMet Resources AG (Afrimet), respectively. Its Lithium Ridge (Nai-Nais) mining asset is within about 133 mining area situated approximately 35 kilometers (km) southeast of the Uis Mine, along the D1903 road linking to the B2 highway. This license area is situated within the NaiNais-Kohero pegmatite belt. The Lithium Ridge is approximately 3300-hectare (ha) licensed area. Its Brandberg West mining asset is a largely under-explored licensed area of approximately 35 000 ha in Namibia's Erongo region. Brandberg West mine is a producer of tin and tungsten.

name: LESAKA TECHNOLOGIES
businessSummary: Lesaka Technologies, Inc. is a South African Fintech company, providing financial services and software to Southern Africa's underserviced consumers (business-to-consumer) and merchants (business-to-business). The Company offers a range of integrated payment solutions, including transactional accounts (banking), lending, insurance, payouts, cash management solutions, card acceptance, supplier payments, software services and bill payments. The Company's operating divisions include Consumer Division, Merchant Division and Enterprise Division. Consumer Division offers transactional accounts (banking), insurance, lending and payments solutions to help underserviced consumers. Merchant Division provides merchant acquiring, software, cash management services, lending and ADP, that help merchants and micro-merchants to transact efficiently. Enterprise Division delivers software and payment technology to enterprise clients, who are generally large-scale corporate and government organizations.

name: ZAMBEEF PRODUCTS
businessSummary: Zambeef Products PLC is a Zambia-based integrated cold chain food products and agribusiness company. The Company engages in the production, processing, distribution, and retailing of beef, chicken, pork, milk, dairy products, fish, flour, and stockfeed. Its segment includes Retailing and cold chain food products and Cropping and Milling. The Retailing and food production segment sells cold food chain products, which are mainly beef, chicken, pork, fish, milk, leather and dairy products, as well as the sale of day-old chicks and stockfeed. The Cropping and milling segment sells wheat, soya and maize grain as well as flour mill and bread. The Company has approximately 236 retail outlets. It has five beef abattoirs, and three feedlots are located throughout Zambia, with a capacity to slaughter approximately 230,000 cattle a year. It produces chicken in Zambia, with a capacity of approximately 10.6 million broilers and 31.8 million-day-old chicks a year.

name: MEIKLES
businessSummary: Meikles Limited is a Zimbabwe-based investments holding company. The Company is engaged in the business of supermarkets, hotels, property and security guard services. Its segments include Hotels, Properties, Security Services, and Corporate and other. Its two geographical segments include Zimbabwe and non-Zimbabwe. Retail segment includes TM Supermarkets trading as TM Pick n Pay. Hospitality segment includes The Victoria Falls Hotel (Operated in partnership with African Sun Limited). Real Estate and Property segment includes Thomas Meikle Properties. Security Services segment includes Meikles Guard Services. Thomas Meikle Properties owns 23 properties across Zimbabwe the majority of these being commercial properties. These properties are leased to third parties. Its subsidiaries include TM Supermarkets (Private) Limited, Meikles Hospitality (Private) Limited, Cape Grace Investments Limited, Greatermans Stores (1979) (Private) Limited, and Thomas Meikle Properties (Private) Limited.

name: HWANGE COLLIERY
businessSummary: Hwange Colliery Company Limited is a Zimbabwe-based company, which explores, mines, processes and markets coal, coke and associated by-products. The Company is engaged in extraction, processing and distribution of coal and coal products and provision of health services and various retail goods and services. The Company's segments include Mining, Medical Services, and Estates. The Mining segment is engaged in extracting, processing and distribution of coal and coal products. The Medical Services segment provides healthcare to staff members and the surrounding community. The Estates segment provides properties for rental and sells retail goods and services. The Company's coal products are marketed in various categories, including thermal coal (HPS), industrial coal (HIC) and coking coal (HCC). Its coke is marketed in various categories, including foundry coke, metallurgical coke, coke peas, and coke breeze. Its by-product of coke includes benzol, tar naphthalene, and coke oven gas.
